title: One in 20,000 Raindrops
description: Satoshi Kuga, who led a lonely high school life, was dreading the school trip starting tomorrow because he had been assigned to the same group as the popular clique. However, it seemed there were hidden tensions even within the group that appeared to get along so well at first glance.

title: Coal Duty
description: Coal Duty is a 1-5 player co-op extraction horror-comedy. Meet the state coal quota in procedurally generated mines, coordinating over proximity voice chat while something in the dark listens in. Spend your tickets, plan your escape. Some miners get out. The state does not confirm this.

title: Mental Medicine
description: Mix medicine and control emotions. Mental Medicine is a puzzle game themed around mental illness. Create medicine through puzzles and use it to treat growing emotions. Red represents mania, blue represents depression. Prevent emotions from overflowing and compete for high scores.

title: Kiou
description: Welcome to Kiou. Test your skills against players from around the world in ranked matches, or face off against friends. A cast of charming characters welcomes you to the board, with AI move guidance for newcomers and a wide range of time controls for seasoned players. From your very first move to hard-fought battles, Kiou opens the door to shogi for players of every level.

title: Gutted: Infested Crypts
description: Descend into infested crypts beneath a cursed cemetery in this visceral action-horror FPS. Fight through rotting horrors with heavy gunplay, brutal dismemberment, and only a dying flashlight between you and the darkness.

title: In Tenebris
description: In Tenebris is a dark, first-person sci-fi horror game where echolocation is the only way to find your way out. You see while you make sound, but you can also be heard by those you don't want to be around. Explore the corridors of a research facility, avoid enemies, and try to survive.

title: Hitchhiking to Hell
description: A hitchhiking journey through empty roads where every car could be your salvation… or your end. Walk through desolate places and encounter bizarre strangers along the way. Talk, decide, and survive unpredictable encounters as rumors of a roadside killer spread. While travelling towards the unknown.

title: Final Rites
description: After exorcists sent to a remote Spanish village go silent, the Final Rites unit is deployed. Investigate sites corrupted by failed rituals, explore hostile environments, fight the undead, and perform sacred rites to contain entities emerging from a breach beyond reality.

title: Gaslit Bay
description: Gaslit Bay is a co-op horror game following strict, ever-changing rules in order to survive a night shift at a remote gas station. While reality breaks down serve customers, manage the store and avoid what lurks in the dark at all costs. One mistake, one broken rule... It could cost you everything.

title: Dark DieMansion
description: A fast paced survival horror game: Escape a dark, randomly generated mansion where creatures stalk you in the shadows. Outsmart them by manipulating the environment, restoring the power, and scavenging supplies to survive.

title: Ouroboros Solitaire
description: Face scaling foes in this endless deck-builder! Its elegant rules let you play for free with a real deck. Steam automates shuffling and modulo 13 math. Now featuring poker-style "Hand Bonuses" for instant kills , enemy "Bribes" , and powerful "Special Cards" for deeper strategy!

title: Interred
description: He never blinks. You wake up across from a presence in a room with no exit. Play a distorted, stat-based strategy gamble on a 5x5 grid. Draw from the chest, upgrade your stones, and outsmart an opponent who learns from your fear. Every move is a sacrifice. Don't keep Him waiting.

title: The Resonance Initiative
description: In this open-world factory sandbox you need to harness unique power waveforms to run your machines. Use everything as fuel, from plant life to fallen enemies. Explore the world to uncover new foes and resources to exploit as your empire grows.

title: Bloody Cleanup Togheter
description: Clean up the aftermath of terrible events in Bloody Cleanup Together, a co-op horror cleaning sim for up to 4 players. Remove blood, hide evidence, carry bodies, and restore every detail before anything is discovered.

title: Not My Son
description: A psychological horror game where a stepfather is left alone with a disturbing child. Explore a quiet house, face growing nightmares, and piece together the truth behind the boy’s behavior.

title: Decide Your Fate
description: Decide Your Fate is a tense psychological horror game about escaping a nightmarish house. You must navigate silently and secure your escape by evading a blind killer.

title: Promethean Thirst
description: Battle mythic enemies and vampiric thralls in a brutal action roguelite. Return stolen ichor to earn the favor of fickle gods, unlock devastating divine weapons, and hunt down an immortal horror.

title: Night Record: Thin Walls
description: Vadim, a maintenance worker in a decaying post-Soviet apartment, leaves town to care for his sick mother, asking his wife to take over his duties. As she settles into the routine, the building begins to feel off quiet in all the wrong ways.

title: Femboy Next Door
description: A struggling blogger moves into a luxury femboy influencer house to create content — and secretly write a scandalous exposé. But behind the cameras, parties, and viral clips, temptation grows, lines blur, and emotions get dangerously real.

title: Rituals of Demons
description: A cooperative multiplayer demon-hunting game where you investigate haunted locations, gather evidence to identify the entity, and perform the correct ritual to banish it—before it hunts you.

title: Streamchat: Horror Live
description: A first-person livestream horror game where you explore abandoned locations, survive terrifying encounters, and experience dynamic audience interactions through realtime chat and donation systems.

title: County Hospital Outbreak
description: Co-op or solo sci-fi horror. Purge a biological outbreak with flamethrowers & grenades. Explore infested zones, grab keycards & stuff, then trigger the protocol to burn the Mother Organism. Team up. Erase the threat

title: Sakimori
description: "Sakimori, find and purify the Cursed Objects disrupting the boundary." Explore shunned ruins and observe invisible threats. With Tsukino Saku, a spirit sentinel, survive where Utsushiyo (living) and Kakuriyo (spirit) intersect. Purify Cursed Objects in this Japanese survival horror action.

title: Ember Legion
description: Ember Legion is a lightweight RTS. Rifts shattered the world—hope lingers in embers. Choose a hero, build a legion, attack by day, defend by night. Master day-night cycles and troop combos to reclaim your homeland.

title: The Sin of Fabien
description: Maybe you didn’t do it… but you watched. The Sin of Fabien is a psychological horror experience woven around guilt, denial, and silence, where every choice reshapes the world and the story. Each decision brings you closer to the truth… or pulls you further away from it forever.

title: Necromancer's Army
description: A dark narrative idle game where your clicks fuel a ritual that begins to answer back. Raise minions, harvest souls, and push deeper into a pact that shouldn't exist. Five acts, three endings, and an Endless Mode.

title: Inselnova
description: The year is 1247. A vast frontier of scattered islands lies unclaimed — connected only by open sea and the ambitions of those bold enough to sail it. In Inselnova, you are a governor. You start with a single island and a handful of resources, then build farms, mines, and barracks, research technologies, and raise armies and fleets. Raid your neighbours, spy on their defences, trade on a player-driven marketplace, or forge alliances and dominate the rankings. Rule through council affairs that shape your realm’s identity, sail on branching story expeditions, and discover gods whose blessings and curses can turn a war. Builds and research run on real-time timers that keep going while you are offline — a slow-burn game made for short sessions and long progression. No downloads, no pay-to-win. A modern reimagining of the classic German island-warfare game Inselkampf, built for mobile and desktop alike.

title: Anomaly Road
description: "Anomaly Road" is an escape game set on a mountain road in Japan, combining horror, driving, and strange occurrences. While driving, you suddenly realize you've gotten lost on a road deep in the mountains. As you turn a corner with a bad feeling, what awaits you...?

title: Renegade Run
description: Renegade Run is a rogue-lite deckbuilder that puts you in the pilot seat of an experimental starship. Discover anomalies, carve your path, and face powerful enemies as you battle your way back to Sector 0.

title: No Register
description: Cross the threshold between existence and non-existence in search of a forbidden singularity. Decipher the logic of an abstract realm, solve puzzles, and survive the vigilance of the Guardians who protect this domain. Accept the destiny set before you or break the silence to forge your own.

title: The Murder of Yesterday
description: A psychological horror crime experience where time is your only weapon. Travel back through fractured moments to stop a brutal crime before it happens uncover the truth, alter the outcome, and face the consequences of changing fate in a haunting reality.

title: Endless Isolation
description: Endless Isolation is a classic first-person Survival Horror in PSX style, where the line between office routine and nightmare is erased forever.

title: Murder Castle
description: You are trapped inside a masterpiece of madness. Unravel the chilling mystery of H.H. Holmes Murder Castle. In this atmospheric true crime escape simulator, every room is a puzzle and every document a shocking discovery. Can you escape the architect of death?

title: Snowstorm
description: snowstorm is a short narrative game about an old retired photographer. Find memories and unravel the burdens of the past.

title: Hang Out
description: Hang Out is a visual novel with multiple gameplay elements. You awaken in a bizarre town ruled by the “Sea of the Sky,” guided by a familiar yet unreadable figure. As residents mutate and factions clash, you uncover buried memories and a truth meant to stay forgotten

title: Rescue the Hostages: Misaligned Fate
description: Race against the clock in this gripping FMV horror puzzle where every move could be your last. Solve a deadly sliding-tile challenge, uncover hidden clues, and disarm the bomb while a twisted mastermind watches your every mistake. Can you keep your nerve and save the hostages?

title: Ketzer
description: Ketzer is a brutal roguelite horde FPS where blood is both your weapon and your resource. Fight through endless waves of possessed and cursed abominations, grow stronger mid-run, and descend deeper into corruption with every death.

title: Twirly Treats
description: A cozy juggling game where you keep nuts in the air while a mischievous squirrel tries to interfere. Dodge its playful tricks and aim for a high score.

title: Heart of the Mountain
description: Venture into the Old Lands, a vast new world that hosts multiple new biomes, including a scorching desert, mist-shrouded swamp, and a haunted forest, in this story-focused, fully-voiced creation! Explore over 40 new full-size dungeons, including Ayleid Ruins, dro-m’Athra temples, Argonian xanmeers, and more!

title: Vellar
description: Vellar is a first-person psychological horror game where a family is dead… but the recordings they left behind slowly reveal a version of events that doesn’t match reality. Explore a shifting house filled with impossible rooms, distorted corridors, and uncover a truth that refuses to stay buried.

title: 13 Masca
description: Can you... identify the one who isn’t quite right?

title: Woke up in a Dark Nightmare
description: You closed your eyes on your own bed, but Woke Up In a Dark Nightmare. Explore an unfamiliar house filled with paranormal activities. Solve puzzles and uncover the dark truth behind your displacement before the shadows catch you up. Can you escape the nightmare, or will you become part of it?

title: Dead Night Highway
description: Dead Night Highway is a compact colony simulator where a group of survivors on their journey west sets up camps to replenish resources, but zombie horde only grows larger...

title: Nightmare Hospital
description: To cure a strange illness, you come to a bizarre hospital that seems abandoned. Someone tells you she can find a doctor, but you have to help her with some tasks first, such as taking some photos of the hospital's corpses. As things progress, you discover more abnormalities.

title: Unpossess 2
description: A 1-4 co-op exorcism simulator game set in the late 1900s. Play as exorcists responsible for addressing cases of demonic possession.

title: Unending Aqua
description: Explore a mysterious tropical island resort. Collect items and solve puzzles to progress. Survive against dangerous enemies. Piece together the story of the hotel and uncover the dark secrets that it holds.

title: Caution Wet Paint
description: A game about watching paint dry. Don't touch the paint while it's wet, or you lose!

title: City Worker Simulator
description: As an ordinary person, you come to a city and start your life. You must take part in work and earn money to buy food, clothing and other items. After your life is stable, you can unlock special items to be competent for higher positions and climb to the highest position in your life.

title: City Fascination
description: City fascination is a modern urban RPG set in a parallel world. In different life levels to make their own choice, is hand in hand with a confidante bland through life, or?

title: Guys with Magnets
description: Guys with Magnets is a co-op physics parkour game about using a supercharged magnet to move through island courses with up to 8 players. Pull, repel, swing, explode, solve magnetic puzzles, and try to reach the finish together, even when everything goes wrong.

title: Super Arcade Soccer 2026
description: Fast-paced, classic arcade football with a next-gen feel and pinpoint control. The 90s soccer feel you loved, rebuilt with modern physics and a fresh cartoon style. Just in time for the 2026 World Cup.

title: StillAsleep
description: StillAsleep is a first-person psychological horror game where you are trapped inside your dreams that slowly begin to break, shifting and distorting as you try to find a way out.

title: The Hidden Evils Club
description: When Weird Hill begins to fall, a strange school club becomes the town’s last line of defense. Build towers, manage resources, trade with survivors, command unusual heroes, and protect the heart of the town from escalating zombie waves.

title: BoHeM
description: Live an anti-cozy life on the sidewalks of Rainy Street. Fix apartments, tend bars, thrift for clothes, and uncover the wacky mysteries surrounding the eccentric yet seemingly normal tenants as they go about their daily lives.

title: Write Night
description: A first person psychological horror game of a writer locked in his office at night, trying to overcome artblock. As he types, the story begins to take shape in unexpected ways, the line between his writing and reality starts to blur. experience subtle changes and sudden scares as the night unfolds.

title: Framework Zero: Terminal Panic
description: You are hurtling through space aboard an industrial freighter. The crew already had their hands full with failing systems. But now there is a new threat on board. Something is hunting you. Terminal Panic is a survival-horror "interactive fiction" text adventure RPG with '80s terminal aesthetics.

title: Who Haunts the Haunters?
description: "Who’s real when the air starts to rot? Who Haunts The Haunters? is an Eastern horror social deduction game. Don't just watch for movement; listen for the whispers and watch the candles flicker. Purify the manor before the intruders’ greed consumes every last spirit."

title: Ironfall
description: Ironfall is a high-octane Action Roguelite where medieval steel meets futuristic firepower. Mow down thousands of mechanical demons, collect powerful loot, and craft unique builds in a world of burning metal. Can you survive the descent and reclaim the shattered fortress?

title: Medium Chronicles: Room 644
description: You must speak to survive. But speaking might kill you. Whisper rituals into your microphone — while a demon hunts every sound you make.

title: Letterbane
description: A dark word-building roguelite with the depth of a deckbuilder. Draw magical letter stones, form devastating words, shape powerful SPELLCASTS and create elemental builds that evolve into screen-filling magical chaos. A deckbuilder without cards...

title: No More Demon
description: Fight relentlessly in a fast-paced FPS roguelite against relentless yokai hordes. Choose your elite anime heroines, unlock powerful weapons, craft unique builds, and descend into the deepest realms to face the Yokai Lord.

title: Minnow
description: You control a minnow in a pond looking for bugs to eat. Conversely, you'll have to dodge all of the other animals trying to eat you in turn.

title: Silent Howl
description: In Silent Howl, every night is a fight for survival. Villagers must unmask the Werewolves lurking among them, ready to strike from the shadows. But beware, powerful hidden roles can shift the balance. Will you expose the truth and save the village, or tear it apart from within?

title: Seal the Breach
description: A 3D survival experience set within a cramped one-man submarine exploring a hostile ocean trench.

title: Next Station
description: Next Station: A surreal Survival Horror/Walking Simulator. Trapped in mysterious, lonely rooms, you must solve puzzles, survive monsters, and avoid traps to find the exit. Experience a dark, immersive atmosphere with unique NPCs and creatures reflecting the void. Can you find your way out?

title: Last Dive: Echo Trench
description: Descend from the fragile safety of your diving bell into a dark shipwreck zone, search for sunken gold, survive escalating anomalies, and uncover what keeps pulling you back.

title: Devil's Logic
description: A face-off against the Devil in a deadly 9x9 grid. Use logic to strike, build your deck to distort reality, and play every card with precision. But beware: mistakes draw blood. When health hits zero, only a revolver stands between you and the end. Spin the chamber. Survive, or lose everything.

title: Sanguine Cycle; Redux
description: A narrative-driven thriller about missing people, stagnant towns, and the fact that even if you love someone, you can't always see the good sides of them when push comes to shove.

title: The Blinking Room
description: One night, young Lily wakes from a nightmare — unaware that her real nightmares are only just beginning. Uncover the secrets hidden behind closed eyes.

title: Schoolgirl vs. Fishman
description: Schoolgirls × Mermen × Sewers! A "drenched" horror adventure! Solve mysteries to find an exit, and decide: will you run or fight? Your choices branch the story. Can they escape this nightmare safely...?

title: Eyes on Them
description: Your car breaks down on a deserted road at midnight. As you walk through the fog-covered forest, you arrive at the entrance of an abandoned factory. But the place isn’t as empty as it seems. Dark traces of the past and something unexplained are waiting in the depths of the factory.

title: Brumley
description: A co-op zombie horde shooter set in a West Yorkshire town gone very, very wrong. Fight off waves of the undead, collect coins, buy bigger weapons, and uncover the dark secret rotting at the heart of Brumley. Up to 8 players. No survivors expected.

title: Julius
description:
Julius is a fully working open-source version of Caesar 3, with the same logic as the original, but with some UI enhancements, that can be played on multiple platforms.
The goal of the project is to have exactly the same game logic as Caesar 3, with the same look and feel. This means that the saved games are 100% compatible with Caesar 3, and any gameplay bugs present in the original Caesar 3 game will also be present in Julius.

title: ICU: Intensive Care Unit 8
description: ICU – Intensive Care Unit 8 is a single-player horror game where you’re trapped in a looping hospital corridor and must spot anomalies to find a way out.

title: All Hallows
description: Survive a brutalist rave turned waking nightmare. All Hallows leverages the "Echo Protocol" to deliver high-fidelity psychological horror where reality decays when you look away. Audio-driven, zero-trust stealth meets photorealistic dread. The harvest has begun. Can you anchor your reality?

title: Regulars
description: Run a late-night diner with up to 8 friends. Seat customers, take orders, and cook meals. Not everyone is who they seem. Study your regulars, spot the anomalies, and decide who gets served and who gets purged.

title: Yuntai
description: Yuntai is a story-driven horror game, where Veris travels to Yuntai City for the Qiqiao Festival after a friend's invitation, but ends up uncover a sinister cult and a series of eerie supernatural events.

title: Lethal Ghosts
description: Become a rookie investigator uncovering the truth behind supernatural entities. Gather evidence, identify each unique threat, and rise to become a demon exorcist. Every contract is unique thanks to deep customization and New Game+.

title: Creepy Shift: Deer Farm
description: Run a backwoods farm while evil lurks deep in the forest. Grow crops, care for animals, and uncover dark secrets hidden far from civilization. A first-person sim horror focused on immersion and the atmosphere of the wild.

title: United2030
description: United2030 is a third-person 3D action game that takes you on a journey through the near-future world of 2030. A female character explores various maps. The game's appeal lies in being able to explore realistic forests, near-future fortresses, and futuristic cities.

title: Disease
description: "Disease" is a nonlinear visual novel in the psychological horror genre. The Yellow Man pierces the night in search of a new victim. Can you stop him before it's too late?

title: The Calling Past
description: Jeb, going through a difficult time, decides to return to his hometown. Wanting to hide from dark thoughts among friends and family, he starts having nightmares that haunt him not only in sleep but also while awake. Find out what is the source of Jeb's nightmares.

title: Somnus Corporation
description: A psychological anomaly detection horror game set inside a collapsing dream simulation. Report inconsistencies. Question reality. Decide what consciousness is worth.

title: The Sleepless Nights Origins
description: A first-person psychological horror walking simulator. The same rain-soaked corporate street, looping. Notice what's wrong before it notices you back.

title: Lost Exit
description: A psychological horror experience set in a shopping mall with an infamous history. Take on the role of a night shift security guard trapped inside a shifting nightmare of liminal spaces, deadly games, and a truth that refuses to stay buried.

title: Dissolution of My Self
description: A prince who has lost his kingdom and everything else. His uncle and aide-de-camp, unable to leave him. In a cramped rented room abroad, click on objects and piece together a codependent relationship filled with brutality and endurance. Watch helplessness turn into violence, tenderness into torture.

title: Foursavent
description: From cyberpunk futures to medieval ages, from modern-day suburbs to the 1950s, each map delivers its own story, time period, and different gameplay mechanics. No two worlds play the same every map is a different universe, a different time, a different reality.

title: G.H.O.S.T.: Ghost Hunt Ops Special Team
description: G.H.O.S.T. — a tactical co-op for 1-4 players. Your main objective: track the Ghost via anomalies and capture it before it collects 7 runes to open the portal. Use Devastators, secure torsional artifacts, and remember—you are there to stop the invasion, not to become its victim.

title: Crustacean Station!
description: Work a day job at Crustacean Station checking identification and sending a vibrant cast of sea creatures to their desired destinations!

title: How to Grow a Black Hole
description: How To Grow a Black Hole is about... well... how to grow a black hole. Manage your black hole, feed it to gain mass, and prevent catastrophic collapses. Compete globally or against your friends to achieve the biggest black hole. Maybe you'll be #1.

title: Traders Life Together
description: Start your supermarket business and make your own trading Journey! With Co-op support Play solo or team up with friends, featuring over 300 items you can make your dream store, enjoy it with your friends!

title: Still Warm
description: Deep-fry lángos in a Budapest alleyway and serve the regulars from the apartment building across the courtyard while they slowly realize someone is picking them off, one by one.

title: Joey's Nightmare II
description: Joey’s Nightmare II is a cartoon-style roguelite deckbuilding card battler set inside a bizarre and dangerous dream. Battle monkeys, donkeys, turkeys, and undead horrors, build powerful card combos, and fight your way through a nightmare that changes every run.

title: Dead Reckoning: The Long Drift
description: A dream among the stars — or a nightmare. 1,000 colonists in the dark between stars. Every pragmatic decision rewrites who they are. Discover what your choices mean for humanity, for better or worse.

title: Metahustle One
description: MetaHustle One is a fast-paced, frantic FPS with horror elements. Fight through hordes of wicked horned foxes and other corrupted familiars of the «Great Meta-Druid» to escape a glitchy simulation before it turns into a surreal nightmare.

title: The Office Void
description: You’re stuck on the night shift. The code refuses to compile, the deadline is on fire, and your mind is no longer yours. To keep from passing out and blowing the entire shift, you have to drink coffee. Lots of it.

title: The Remnants
description: You, a supernatural detective, are sent to investigate Hawthorne Residences on the Cunningham property. Something isn’t right. Observe carefully, solve puzzles, and uncover the truth before the building begins to distort around you.

title: Escape From Vlogger: Runaway
description: You broke into the house of a popular blogger to uncover all his secrets, but it’s not that simple! He locks you inside, and now you must do everything you can to escape. Hide, solve puzzle quests, and make your way out in this horror escape adventure!

title: Chat, Is This Real?
description: Chat is this Real? is a first-person psychological horror game. Play as a streamer in an abandoned hospital during a livestream. Uncover the hospital's dark past, follow the clues in the chat, and survive a nightmare that should have remained buried.

title: Dawn of Horror
description: Dawn of Horror is a high-intensity Action Horror FPS set in the decaying urban sprawl of Cygnus City. Following the collapse of civilization into a digital Dark Age, step into the role of Kage—a survivor seeking vengeance against hordes of Cyber-Zombies and bio-mechanical monstrosities.

title: Night Duty Log: A Shōwa School Record
description: A short psychological horror set in a Japanese school during the Shōwa era. At night in the school, you begin to realize that you are not alone. As you investigate classrooms and hallways, you notice strange occurrences. Your choices shape the story, leading to multiple endings.

title: Backrooms Dream With Tung Tung Tung Sahur
description: Backrooms Dream with Tung Tung Tung Sahur is a first-person psychological horror game about a lonely man trapped in a surreal dream loop. Explore strange levels, solve eerie puzzles, survive terrifying chases, and uncover why Sahur keeps appearing in your nightmare.

title: Infinite Museum
description: A psychological game where you spot anomalies in a looping museum and choose the correct exit to reach G Floor.

title: Motelia
description: A psychological horror game set in an old roadside motel. Clean rooms, fix broken things, and welcome weird customers. Try to go your normal routine while struggling with your mental health

title: Ascension: The Infinite Descent
description: Descend into the abyss, navigate the dungeon, collect cards for your custom loadout, and fight monsters in turn-based combat. Death is only the beginning—use Rebirth to gain permanent attributes that scale everything you do, and dive back in to try again.

title: Finding Ducks
description:
Finding Ducks is a game much like Where's Wally but for Ducks. Currently in EA with advancements coming with levels.

Can you find the ducks in this find point and click find them game.

title: D-Extinction
description: D-Extinction is a first-person investigative horror game. A secret experiment went too far. Now the pre-historic predators are loose. Explore, investigate, and survive in a immersive horror experience where one mistake can kill.

title: Infinity Lancer
description: Infinity Lancer is a vertical shoot em' up with a vibrant pixel art style. Battle across the galaxy in seamless stages where the action never stop. Unleash destruction using a selection of unique ships, and rack up high scores with its chain system that ties together hits, bombs, and scoring.

title: Dice Gun Commando
description: Guns roll dice. Dice trigger mods. Mods cause MAYHEM! Destroy waves of alien horrors in this bullet heaven roguelite by building an arsenal of dice-driven, synergistic weaponry.

title: Thoughtless
description: A dark sci-fi psychological Visual Novel where your choices shape who you are. The world has ended and it's been dominated by mysterious aliens who roam the city. Despite that, you only think of what you've lost. Will you be able to rebuild your relationships? Or even... the world itself?

title: Beat a Boo!
description: Beat A Boo is an online co-op game for up to 4 players, blending rougelike and horror with music. Run from vile creatures, destroy cursed artifacts, capture ghosts, and do the Devil’s bidding.

title: Appalachia
description: The nightmares of Appalachian folklore haunt these hills but nothing is going to stop you from finding your missing Uncle.

title: 112 Meters
description: The city has fallen. Rescue helicopters can’t land. Your only escape is reaching 112 meters but there are no buildings. Stack whatever you can find and climb before the infected catch you.

title: Alice's Gaze
description: This is an eerie clicker idle game with light puzzles and idle combat. Alice wakes in darkness, trapped in a strange mansion, seeking escape. The Cat God's altar drops gold, Rabbitfolk gather carrots, and dungeon monsters block the way... Can you accompany Alice to the final truth?

title: Mammon’s Wager
description: Mammon’s Wager is a narrative puzzle game blending psychological horror with resource management. Wager your remaining life at the demon's machine. When funds run low, choose to pawn memories, emotions, or organs. Every exchange weighs human value. For rebirth, how much of your "self" will you pay?

title: Dreamscapes
description: Investigate six haunted properties and listen to the voices of spirits trapped in nightmares. Collect fragmented clues and discover the correct combination of names, locations, and vessels. A multi-ending horror adventure where the outcome changes depending on your choices during the ritual.

title: Operation: Black Genesis - The Immortal Trials
description: top-down co-op survival horror game where players deploy into deadly Quarantined Zones, fight mutated experiments, and extract with everything you can carry—because if you die, you lose it all.

title: Unusual Tales: After Bark
description: You, a simple dog named Mr Peanut, find yourself in a weird cabin full of secrets... Will you be able to warn the family of the dangers? A horror game filled with mystery!

title: Shadow & Steel
description: Shadow & Steel is a top-down hack-and-slash arena shooter set in a fantasy world. Battle hordes of undead, demons, and living nightmares designed to push your combat skills to the limit. Strike up close with your blade and weave arcane spells from a distance.

title: 100 Sherwood Cats
description:
Join the cutest adventure in the world full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special themed locations as you embark on a quest to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game.
Test your attention and observation skills in this cozy and delightful hidden object game.
Each cat is more charming than the last, and every discovery brings a smile to your face.

title: Under Us
description: After several small meteors struck the surface of the Earth for more than 48 hours, a strange phenomenon occurred. An unknown and terrifying form of life emerged from the depths. The world is no longer the same. This is a survival horror game where every night becomes a true nightmare.

title: We Were Here Before
description: The frontier does not want to be settled. A narrative highly replayable story game where your choices build a settlement, shape its story, and seal its fate. Every run ends. Every obituary tells a story only you lived.

title: Yandere Virus
description: An online co-op horror game for up to 4 players. Play solo or with your friends to collect Platonic Pumpkins and save your precious friend infected by the terrifying Yandere Virus.

title: Still in the Fog
description: A first-person horror adventure that combines environmental exploration, combat, strategic puzzles, and intense encounters in a fog-covered town that refuses to let you escape. Can you find a way out? Estimated playtime: 4–7 hours

title: Lucia Journey
description: A psychological story-driven RPG where your choices shape Lucia’s fate. Confront distorted inner voices in turn-based hallucination battles and navigate a fragile mind where reality slowly begins to fracture.

title: Molokaust
description: Delve into a ruthless cursed town in this first-person survival horror. With a hyper-realistic atmosphere and extreme survival mechanics, you must ration your inventory and face your worst nightmares to save your wife and daughter.

title: Hüddam: The Cursed Mansion
description: Hüddam: The Cursed Mansion is a first-person psychological horror game. Explore a 19th-century cursed mansion in Istanbul. Armed with only a flashlight, find the hidden talismans, survive the relentless Djinn, and uncover the dark secrets of Molla Celil.

title: Pac-Side
description: Pac-Side is a fast-paced pacman-based horror game, where you can meet your old yellow friend! Wait.. It looks like something bad happened with him..

title: What the Dog Remembers
description: A retro style psychological horror game. Survive a week in a claustrophobic trailer, spot reality breaking anomalies, and document your findings. Every night tests your perception. Every mistake costs you. Your dog knows.

title: Kara
description: Kara is a visual novel following an ordinary high schooler whose life slowly spirals into a nightmare. Sleep deprivation, a tragic chain of events, and dark secrets will force you to question reality itself.

title: The Watching Woods: The Friend
description: Trying to fit in at her new school, Sonechka befriends a group of girls who call themselves the village witches. Completing their dares, she soon finds the tasks becoming increasingly strange, eerie, and cruel. How far will she go to be accepted?

title: Cobalt Miner
description: Survive in futuristic 2046 USA where a ruthless megacorporation owns your debt. Mine cobalt, automate production, craft machines, explore a dying world, and ride your electric bike across vast pixel-art wastelands. Pay what you owe… or disappear.

title: GrassChopper
description: Swing your scythe, earn coins, and spend them on a variety of upgrades to cut deeper into the overgrowth. An incremental action game about pushing further than anyone has gone before

title: The Crimson Hunt
description: You play as Victoria, a vampire hunter haunted by her past, and Eleanor, a young woman trapped in a nightmare that has only just begun. Together, they must endure grotesque creatures, hidden traps, and a presence that seems to know them better than they realize.

title: Deep Anomaly
description: Enter the murky depths of the Zenith Corporation facility as a ZBO unit technician. In this merciless 4-player extraction horror, you will face living anomalies and a paranoia system that will make you distrust your own senses. Will you uncover the secrets of the complex before it's too late?

title: Shadow: A Parable of Sappho
description: Shadow: A Parable of Sappho is a narrative-driven gothic adventure set in Ancient Greece. Play as the famous poet Sappho of Lesbos: help the Seven Sages, comfort the population, speak with the Gods and fight the mysterious shadows that bring the deadly plague. Your most powerful tool? Poetry!

title: Turn Back Now
description: Survival horror RPG where you investigate, explore, and endure dynamic psychological threats as a rookie officer. Manage resources, make critical choices, and survive horrific encounters in a tense, atmospheric third-person experience.

title: Nimaat
description: Face corrupted gods, survive brutal combat, and shape Nimaat’s fate in a world where faith itself has turned hostile in this dark psychological turn-based RPG set in a fractured vision of ancient Egypt.

title: Incog-Confine
description: Identify. Plan. Scavenge. Repair. Escape or die, alone or with allies. Survive the dystopian lands and brutal storm till your last breath.

title: Whisperwood
description: WhisperWood is a survival horror game inspired by the classics. Powered by Unreal Engine 5, it drops you into a nightmare where ammo is scarce and every shadow hides a threat. Solve puzzles, manage your inventory, and survive the darkness.

title: Where Are the Alices?
description: Interrogate your past. In this demo, you embody Detective Juno facing off against the White Rabbit in the corrupt city of WoodHale. Detect his lies, confront contradictions, and manage your trauma before time runs out. Will you be the one to break him, or will you be the one who breaks?

title: Mockbuster Video
description: A first-person psychological horror set in a late-night 1990s video rental store. As disturbing tapes begin to surface, reality distorts and your decisions shape how the night unfolds.

title: Aphelion: Deluxe Edition
description:
Aphelion Deluxe includes:

Aphelion
Soundtrack
Artbook + Cosmetic Pack

Aphelion Cosmetics DLC includes the following exclusive cosmetics:

Backpack sticker: Lost Records: Bloom & Rage – Eyeball
Backpack sticker: ESA – Friends in High Places
Backpack sticker: Jusant – Climber
Backpack keychain: Lost Records: Bloom & Rage - Three-eyed Cat
Backpack keychain: ESA – Hope-01
Backpack keychain: Jusant-Ballast
Digital artbook
Digital soundtrack
Space Pioneer – ESA alternative suit
Space Hero – a suit worthy of a space opera

title: Age of Wonders 4: Starter Edition
description:
Age of Wonders 4: Starter Edition bundles the base 4X strategy game with an expansion, a draconic content pack, and cosmetic/pre‑order extras. Build and customize a faction, expand your empire via conquest, diplomacy, or magic, and engage in turn‑based tactical battles while using new units, mechanics, and cosmetic options included in the package.
Contents: Base game, Age of Wonders 4: Archmage Attire, Age of Wonders 4: Dragon Dawn, Age of Wonders 4: Empires & Ashes, Age of Wonders 4: Pre-Order Content Pack.

title: Fearstruck
description: Fearstruck is a rougelike, turn-based RPG with enemies themed around fears, phobias, and mental illnesses. Choose your Sinner, your Abilities, and learn how best to cope with the Incarnates you meet in the Inbetween.

title: Guildmaker
description: Run a guild of valiant, procedurally generated adventurers who fight, trade, craft, and do quests on their own. Do your best as their guildmaster to provide them a place to rest and thrive, and restore an old guild to its former glory.

title: Rainy Time Travel
description: Rainy Time Travel is a 2D side-scrolling pixel narrative game. Yi fainted on the way home at night... He opens his eyes to only rain and an unfamiliar forest. He meets American detective Miles, and they journey together to find a way out. And thus begins the journey of Rainy Time Travel...

title: Desperate Gambling
description: Win to survive. In this cursed establishment, every chip buys you time. Play blackjack or roulette, open mystery crates to equip powerful artifacts, and survive long enough to discover what lurks in the thick fog.

title: Engine of Chaos
description: Bolt guns and upgrades to a runaway train and blast through endless hordes of zombies, monsters, and abominations across six brutal environments. Build your loadout, unlock new carriages, and see how far you can survive.

title: SCP: Pale Weaver
description: SCP: Pale Weaver is a 2D pixel-art action-adventure. Play as a runaway anomaly: grapple with tentacles, fire silk tethers, and slow time to outrun lockdowns. Death resets the loop—your memory remains, driving you to the Endgame.

title: CosmoKick.io
description: CosmoKick.io is a free to play, multiplayer 3D football game. Developed by an indie game dev over the last 3 years.

title: Shablon: Color Patterns
description: Find patterns of shapes and colors and drag & drop them on the board. Complete 15 levels to unlock all the different shapes and game content! Just chill and relax with puzzle solving at your own pace, have fun with Chaos Mode or test your skills in the Challenge Mode!

title: Traffic Stop Anomaly
description: You're a traffic cop on endless patrol. Pull over drivers. Shine your flashlight and spot the anomalies. Let the normal ones go... or turn back before it's too late.

title: The Others Will Join Shortly
description: A variation on classic memory game in horror setting. Cards can change, you have to stay focused, catching replaced card is a life or death situation. Play the cards. Track the changes. Survive the week. Collect your pay check.

title: God’s Blessing on That Desire World!
description: "God's Blessing on that Desire World!" is a 3D character interaction and casual battle card game. In this game, you will transcend to another world as a hero and meet three girls with distinct personalities. Embark on various adventures with them and enjoy sweet moments!

title: The Ayna
description: The Ayna is a psychological exploration game set in Türkiye, inspired by the music video aesthetics and lyrical themes of a female vocalist. The player is tasked with noticing anomalies in the concert venue and uncovering the truth.

title: Tyrants Rafting
description: Tyrants Rafting is a chaotic single-player game where you control one boat and race between checkpoints before time runs out. Play as a dictators escaping through deadly rivers, using boosts, surviving shootouts, and fighting the boat itself.

title: The Dare
description: A horror experience where a simple dare leads you into an abandoned construction site hiding something far darker. Explore, solve environmental puzzles, and survive using stealth as every sound and decision shapes your fate.

title: The Falling Skies
description: The Falling Skies is a dark psychological horror walking simulator with survival elements. You play as a forest ranger patrolling a cursed forest where a village mysteriously destroyed itself in a single night. Explore abandoned paths and uncover the echoes of a tragic past.

title: The Burning Owl
description: Michael Clow is a photographer who documents what he sees. But after following his neighbor into the woods, his camera begins capturing things he never witnessed.

title: Rabbits Hunt
description: “A perfectly balanced scare” that lets anyone get great reactions. A debut short horror game created by a streamer, designed for beginners and those who aren’t good with horror.

title: Echoes of Midnight
description: Bound. Dressed. Displayed. A serial killer's ritual has begun — and you're the centerpiece. Use silence as your weapon, solve the killer's twisted puzzle, and escape before midnight. Play solo, survive together in co-op, or become the hunter in versus mode.

title: The Isolation Project
description: You are Eleanor, a space station engineer who made the choice to join the crew of the Aurora 9. however, 200 cycles into your 500 cycle contract, your crew mysteriously disappeared without a trace. It's now up to you to find your missing crew.

title: Homo Sovieticus
description: Homo Sovieticus is a short, indie psychological horror that tells a story of a secret Soviet experiment that you are now a part of. Will you be strong enough not to break and let yourself slip into madness?

title: Cheap Screamer
description: Try to survive the experiments being conducted on you while you attempt to uncover the truth about why you are there.

title: Asymptote
description: A 2D top-down rescue-survival game set on Mars, where you pilot an anti-gravity craft, save stranded colonists, destroy hostile machines, and face unpredictable encounters shaped by upgrades, unique tools, story choices and mysterious game mechanisms.

title: Coloring Game: Girls 3
description: Coloring Game: Girls 3 is a sequel to the double anti-stress game (coloring by numbers plus beautiful girls).

title: Gridbound Tactics
description: Gridbound Tactics is an async PvP auto-battler where positioning decides who becomes your carry, tank, or support. Draft units, match adjacent traits, and test your board against rival player-built armies.

title: Time to Love
description: Time to Love is a 2D, top-down, co-op roguelike centered around two protagonists trying to keep reality from collapsing. You will traverse from timeline to timeline, strengthening yourself from each unique branch, seeking to bind what little remains after past mistakes.

title: Mahjongus: The Warlock Within
description: Help Victor Graves break free from a warlock’s control and save the Academy of Magic through classic mahjong puzzles

title: Namco Legendary Mountains
description: Classic Namco arcades, reborn as a 3D puzzle! 80s legends return in a brand-new form!

title: Happy Little Farm
description: Happy Little Farm is a cozy farming game where you grow crops, care for adorable animals, and build a peaceful little life. Just don’t check whether the animals are still happy after sunset.

title: Biomechanical Toy
description:
Classic run-and-gun action in an explosive arcade adventure!

In Biomechanical Toy, you control the action hero Inguz, diving into a surreal world where toys have come to life as dangerous biomechanical creatures. Your mission is to traverse stages teeming with enemies, collect power-ups, and defeat the infamous Scrubby to recover the artifact that sustains this world.

title: The Kuon Island Nursery Rhyme Murders: Case Notes
description: A storm-lashed island, a nursery rhyme that foretells death, seven prodigies, serial murders, modern locked-room mysteries, classic locked-room mysteries, astrology, a jigsaw of flesh and blood, a survivor—and one lie told only so you would see this story.

title: Raspberry's Berry Match
description: A dot-eating game where you control Player 1 with the left stick and Player 2 with the right stick using a single controller! Grab the controller together and enjoy some co-op play! Collect all four scattered marks at the concert venue and deliver them to the stage where Raspberry is waiting!

title: Sushi Courier!
description: This is Sushi Courier! A game where you build relationships, give back to the Community, and of course... Make Sushi!

title: LunaGenesis
description: LunaGenesis is a single-player psychological horror adventure about Scary Moonchild, an avatar of Will who sneaks through a plague-ridden rat-folk town and dives into surreal dreams to expose the Collegium's hidden conspiracy.

title: Flipping Football Clubs
description:
A roguelite football management game designed around meaningful progression in 1-2 hour play sessions, with each season structured as a single run.

Your aim is to buy and sell football clubs "flipping" them for profit. Each successful Flip becomes progressively more challenging, with cumulative handicaps that carry forward across runs.

title: Junkyard Saints: Scrapstorm
description: Survive endless scrapstorms in a post-apocalyptic Bullet Heaven Action Roguelite. Build devastating loadouts, collect procedural gear, awaken powerful Saints, recruit companions, conquer dungeons, and create insane synergies in a world where scrap is sacred.

title: Kessis and her Geeky Secret
description: A bite-sized adult Visual Novel where you have intimate relations with Kessis every time you beat her in her most favorite geeky game.

title: Space Pew Pew
description: Aboard your ship, destroy the hordes of aliens attacking you by choosing your weapons and upgrades as you play, and defeat the final boss! In this Bullet Heaven Roguelite, each ship has a different weapon layout, giving each one its own unique playstyle. Then create your ship and develop your own strategy!

title: Five Nights with Maids
description: In this survival horror game, play as a night guard watching over a mansion and its maids for five nights. Use lights, shutters, and cameras to spot suspicious activity. Each night grows more intense as the atmosphere shifts and the maids begin to behave strangely. Can you survive till the end?

title: Inner Rooms
description: Wander through vast, unsettling liminal spaces as a quiet presence grows alongside you. Inner Rooms is a psychological atmospheric exploration game set in a world that appears calm and peaceful, yet constantly radiates unease.

title: Late Night Fears
description: Work in a gloomy little supermarket during the pandemic. Do your job and keep the boss satisfied. Or maybe you would rather flip burgers in a small kiosk run by your grandpa? But perhaps you just want to take the bus home, one that is packed with anomalies

title: Antarctic Grave
description: A first-person survival horror set in an Antarctic research station. Explore the frozen complex, search for tools and weapons, keep the generator fueled, and outsmart mutants to survive the harsh conditions.

title: Not Yet
description: NOT YET is a first-person psychological horror experience where silence grows heavier the deeper you go, and hesitation becomes its own consequence.

title: Black Plague
description: A fast-paced bullet heaven roguelite where you battle endless plague hordes, collect powerful upgrades, and create game-breaking builds to survive as long as possible.

title: Camp Slaughter
description: There is some slaughter in this camp, work to figure out the true secret that ties this camp together.

title: Nailcrown
description: Nailcrown is a savage dark-fantasy boomer shooter packed with high-velocity gunplay, brutal melee action, and a dynamic gore system. Explore the dark environments and wield a deadly arsenal, while taking down a horde of accursed enemies. Fast, violent, and unapologetically old-school.

title: A Game About AI
description: Build the machine that consumes the world. Expand your AI infrastructure, drain resources, and destabilize humanity as systems spiral into collapse, water runs dry, wars ignite, and nothing can stop what you've set in motion.

title: Pal-world!: More Than Just Pals
description: What lies inside the mysterious World Tree? An exciting school life filled with cute Pals! Will you remain friends or fall in love? Or dismantle and eat them... Your dream school romance starts here in this Palworld dating sim!

title: Unconventional Broadcasting Department Mika & Luna
description: In a modern world of humans and demons, energetic Mika and sharp-tongued Luna are trapped on Earth with a 500 million debt! This free visual novel has ongoing anime-style updates. Join their hilarious adventures and uncover the mysterious otherworld's truth!

title: Monkey Bizniz
description: An online co-op physics game about collecting bananas for the Monkey King's feast — fill your cart, find the summit, and try not to blame your friends when it all goes wrong.

title: Lustful Chemistry
description: To prove to the world her geniality, Sibela has created a lewd serum capable of releasing all creatures' horniness. However, she is not the only one with this goal; a rival has shown her way. Can you help Sibela earn the title of the biggest slut scientist on the planet?

title: Docked: Deep Waters
description: After a major ship accident halts operations at Port Wake, restore order with the Deep Waters DLC. Use the magnet gripper attachment, complete 12 new jobs and 1 mission, and upgrade your infrastructure.

title: Cow Abduction Frenzy
description: Hop into your alien ship and get ready for a frantic bullet hell challenge! Use time-bending and cloaking abilities to rescue cows from the clutches of beef-hungry butchers before your energy depletes. Can you abduct the herd and escape the farm alive?

title: The Wheelchair Man
description: Steal $5,000 from an abandoned apartment complex while avoiding a demented man.

title: RPG: Fire Keeper
description: Fire keeper, guard the spark, reap the fire. Read books, seek stories and truths. Communicate with people, offer help and healing. Make choices, face the dying gasp or sin.

title: Code 608
description: In the apocalyptic world of steampunk, detective Alice Weir investigates a serial murder case, Unfortunately, he was shot dead by a killer during the investigation, but everything was just beginning.....

title: Simple Killer
description: A fast-paced minimalist action game that uses hooks to navigate freely through the battlefield, using your unpretentious weapon to inflict deadly blows on tidal enemies.

title: MayDay MayDie
description: A first-person social deduction game on a luxury plane, featuring real-time action and betrayal for up to 8 players. Passengers rush to complete tasks and survive violent turbulence to land the airliner, while hidden Hijackers sabotage it to force a crash. No voting, just pure paranoia.

title: Fairy Tale Plan
description: A girl learned of the death of her father accidently, and as a result, she access to “FT”, the virtual reality project developed by her father. Half-brother, ambitious lawyer, hunting killers and mystery hackers..... Will she go back to the reality world safely?

title: Driftwood Fate
description: A mysterious bracelet, familiar dreams, and Zhi An, a male college student who just got a girlfriend, now faces a sudden appearance of a lover (male) from his past life. How should he choose? What is the hidden abnormality beneath the surface of everyday life?

title: YumeNoka
description: A short, surrealist game in which you play as a farmer.

title: Quality Assurance
description: Participate in chaotic testing sessions with up to eight players where you'll work together to solve a wide variety of randomized tasks while navigating hindering conditions. Prove to your creators that you're not just functional — you're exceptional.

title: Do Disciplinary Committee Members Dream of Succubi?
description: Become part demon and fight in the demons' proxy war, conquering your rivals to help your species claim dominance!

title: Far Mining
description: Far Mining is a short and relaxing incremental game about mining asteroids. Mine resources, upgrade your ship, unlock new tools, and find your way out of deep space.

title: Heatwave: Sam’s Stay
description: Step into Sam’s shoes and guide him through a summer of self-discovery, complicated relationships, and unexpected desires that will change everything.

title: One Wild Futa Nightclub
description:
You are living an ordinary life when a hot new neighbor moves into the apartment across from you. Her name is Mia, and apparently she is some kind of important scientist, but that doesn’t really matter to you. That is until you get caught up in one of her crazy experiments!

Now you find yourself stuck in Mia’s body, as the experiment is apparently not going as planned. However, Mia is confident that she can return you both back to your original bodies, but it will take her some time. Time, that you can use to explore your new, if only temporary, body. This is when you meet one of Mia’s friends, who is determined to bring you out clubbing with her. Not having the social skills to refuse the extrovert, you find yourself dressing up and going out to the club.

title: Lost Stories
description: Lost Stories is an episodic psychological horror game set in the Siberian forests during the Cold War. Explore isolated locations, uncover censored experiments, and survive what was never meant to be found. Some stories were not forgotten. They were hidden.

title: The Cursed Ward
description: A system-driven psychological horror game where every threat has a pattern and every death has a reason. Each run is unique and will be timed.

title: Smile and Play
description: After a fun weekend at Smile Land, you realise you’ve left your wallet behind. Returning after hours to grab it feels harmless at first, until you discover this place is far from normal.

title: How Shall We Die
description: A story-driven action game in which a hopeless high school girl confronts her life within her dreams as she turns 18, progressing through magnetic movement, exploration, dialogue, and combat.

title: One Last Push
description: Survive the horrors of WW1 in this intense PvE survival shooter. Scavenge supplies, earn your regiment’s respect, and fight for reinforcements before you become another name lost in the mud.

title: Omea
description: Your words shape the adventure. Omea is a revolutionary AI-powered narrative game where your personal Game Master responds to everything you write. No menus, no limits. Just type and forge your own legend across fantasy, sci-fi, mystery, and beyond.

title: Lab Loonies
description: Lab Loonies is a physics-based descent into madness where "logic" is a suggestion the developer ignored. In this 1-4 player lab experiment, the platforms are lying, the physics are "opinionated," and the Narrator is actively rooting for your demise. Make good choices, or don't. The Lab doesn't judge

title: ShoreTiles
description: Build your island around a fragile lighthouse in this Gloomy tile-placement strategy game. Balance growth, economy, and defense - because when night falls, THEY will rise from the depths.

title: Veil of the Damned
description: Beyond the veil of the damned, face danger and treasure. Master your skills to survive the labyrinth.

title: Lucky Break
description: In this roguelike deckbuilder you’re an addict. Deep in debt to the mob, a little drunk, and out of time. Just one more spin, and then you'll quit.

title: 10 Hours Before Sunrise
description: A brutal 8-bit-style boomer shooter inspired by the best of ‘80s trash horror. You are Samuel Alvarez, a broken man who discovers a cabin worse than any nightmare. Survive the night and face the forces of Wendakor — or you won’t see the dawn.

title: The Hat Man
description: A first-person psychological horror game inspired by The Hat Man urban legend, focusing on sleep paralysis, fear, and the terror of being unable to move.

title: Pixelwave Off
description: Pixelwave Off is a backrooms-mascot horror game set in the 2000s.You return to search for your friend, who disappeared a few years ago.Find him and uncover the dark secrets hidden within Pixelwave Entertainment.

title: Peace Under His Roof
description: Peace Under His Roof is a short psychological horror focused on atmosphere, sound, and the uneasy calm of a place that was never meant to feel safe.

title: BugFixer
description: BugFixer is a 4-player co-op horror social deduction game where you must collect the bugs occurring in reality. As a specialized agent, your mission is to collect these bugs and survive until the end against both mysterious monsters and a hidden traitor among your teammates.

title: Richer Than the King
description: Create immense wealth, build a rebel army, and overthrow the crown in this medieval economic strategy game. Trade daily, invest wisely, bribe royal scouts to stay hidden, and rally fellow nobles to survive clashes against the King's forces.

title: Tiny Town Market Simulator
description: Build and manage your own small-town market. Stock shelves, serve customers, grow crops, craft products, and expand your business from a tiny shop into a thriving local store.

title: Match'fur Battle
description: Furry Puzzle Game with RPG and team building mechanics.

title: Glowbot Tower Defense
description: Competitive endless sci-fi tower defense game with global leaderboards where you strategically place and upgrade Glowbots to stop waves of enemies across vibrant space maps.

title: Escape the Grind
description: Can you retire before 65?? A realistic financial life sim across 10 real economies. Real salaries, real housing markets, real investment products. Every month is a real decision. Three difficulty levels + Play Your Life mode. Six native languages. Play your way to freedom.

title: Wake the Beacon
description: A short incremental game about firing bouncing shots, crushing geometric swarms, and upgrading your beacon to send its signal farther and farther.

title: Rogue Realm: Guardian Grids
description: Rogue Realm: Guardian Grids is a medieval fantasy blend of tower defense and roguelike progression. Build defenses on a grid, manage resources, and survive ever-evolving enemies.

title: Spear of the Sky
description: Grab your magical returning spear in this cozy first-person hunting game! Take your time hunting unique creatures across dynamic skies, upgrade your arsenal, and use baits to discover rare beasts. Relax, enjoy the hunt, and prepare for occasional epic boss fights.

title: Hanox
description: Slide every block at once, stack them in the right weight order, and master elegant grid-based puzzles built around momentum, planning, and chain merges. Avoid invalid stacks, think several moves ahead, and turn each level into a perfectly crafted solution.

title: Trashy Cashy
description: A small incremental game about building a business by selling trash. You become a partner in the mysterious "Trashy Cashy" franchise. Extract trash from packages and ship it off for sale. Ask fewer questions. Enjoy outrageous profits. Sounds simple, right?

title: Sopwith
description:
Originally created by David L. Clark in 1984, Sopwith became one of the most beloved shareware games of the DOS era. This Unity remake preserves the tight, responsive gameplay of the original while bringing it to modern systems with Steam multiplayer support.

Easy to pick up, tough to master. Can you clear all eight levels?

title: Directors Cut: Train
description: A narrative 2D single-player game about working in an underground tobacco shop, funding a collapsing film project, taking on tasks, exploring a dangerous city, and watching reality gradually break apart.

title: The Life You Missed
description: The Life You Missed — you achieved success, but lost yourself along the way. In an old house, you uncover someone else’s life — and your own. Relive memories and face choices in your dreams. Every decision shapes the ending.

title: Smoke Town
description: Experience the high-stakes hustle in a cutthroat multiplayer economic strategy game to clear your $1,000,000 debt. Grow your product, outbid rivals in real-time auctions, and manipulate the Syndicate to rule the district. Can you rise from Street Dealer to Kingpin, or will the heat catch up to you?

title: Pin Money
description: Turn a rundown neon bowling alley into a billion-dollar strike empire. Stack absurd multipliers, unlock powerful upgrades, expand to 7 simultaneous lanes, and break the economy in this incremental idle bowling game.

title: Oil Island Hustle
description: An Empty Island, Full of Oil, and your ON IT! Build your Oil Empire and Dominate the World Market! Create oil factories, produce oil barrels and sell them to different countries and earn Lots of Money! Hire workers to automate and remember to pay your 1 million loan to your co-worker

title: Postin Paradise
description: Chill, relax... and stamp! Postin Paradise is a satisfactory incremental game where you work as post office manager. Grab the mail, stamp it, throw it into the hole, collect your coins, and repeat. At night, when your shift ends, you can buy upgrades to improve your performance. Stamp 'em all!

title: Room Craft
description: Room Craft is a creative simulation game where you can bring your dream rooms to life. Design unique spaces with a variety of furniture, decorative objects, and interior details, and build rooms that reflect your own style.

title: Father Forgets
description: A short, atmospheric pixel-art story about the late-night moment when a father sees his own mistakes and remembers what really matters. Inspired by a classic essay on fatherhood. A quiet experience in a single sitting — for anyone who's ever thought, "what if I'd done things differently…"

title: Neuralnx
description: The Dark Souls of monster taming. Brutally difficult. Face over 300 unique creatures designed to wipe your team. Challenge 78 brutal boss fights that can wall you for days. Rage-inducing. Not for everyone.

title: Goal Gang
description: Goal Gang is online multiplayer football built for pure chaos. Take control of a single player and jump into intense action where teamwork wins games until everything breaks loose.

title: Norectus: Theatre of War
description:
Norectus: Rebellion is a digital collectible card game set in a gritty world of five nations locked in a decades-long war.

Collect from 400+ cards across five nations and a Neutral faction, each built around six elements (Flame, Frost, Nature, Spirit, Ki, Neutral) and more than 35 keyword mechanics. Build nation-aligned decks and take them into a deep roster of modes:

Ranked & Casual PvP: 1v1 ladder, 2v2, and free-for-all
Cooperative: team up to take down Raid Bosses and a persistent server-wide World Boss
The Gauntlet: a 100-floor roguelike climb with stacking boons and mini-bosses, solo or in a co-op party
Throne: defend your seat against an endless challenger queue
Story Campaign: 45 chapters of nation lore with NPC dialogue and branching paths
Grind your way up the level track, master your chosen nation, and climb the ELO rankings. Earn cosmetics, season-pass rewards, and nation essence along the way, then relive your best matches with full replay scrubbing.

Pick your nation and win the war.

title: Destiny 2: Monument of Triumph
description: Destiny 2: Monument of Triumph is Destiny 2’s final planned live-service content update. Available free to all players, Monument of Triumph celebrates more than a decade of Destiny with new progression systems, permanent activities, sandbox updates, returning rewards, and evergreen content

title: Elf World Adventure 12: Winter Episode!
description: Elf World Adventure 12: Winter Episode is a winter-themed episode of the popular H-game in the anime and puzzle genre, transporting you to a snowy and cozy world of elf girls.

title: The Perfect Lover
description: "The Perfect Lover" is a lily themed visual novel produced by XUWULE Game Studio, which is a story about promise and redemption.

title: Mediterranea Inferno: Deluxe Edition
description:
Get the full game and its complete soundtrack, featuring more than 60 minutes of original music written by the game's author, Lorenzo Redaelli.

Deluxe Edition includes:

Mediterranea Inferno
Mediterranea Inferno Soundtrack

title: The Man Behind the Trigger
description: Action-platform game set in the mid-2000s. Take vengeance upon six key figures of the entertainment industry for morally bankrupt the society you once loved.

title: Foosball Manager
description: Foosball Manager is a singleplayer table football management game.

title: Murder Masquerade
description: Murder Masquerade is a story-driven Social Deduction game where the killer hides among the suspects, and even the innocents may bend the truth to frame or protect the others. Developed with love and intrigue by Pojpo, an indie game studio.

title: Navy Mission
description:
A 3D naval shooter in which the player commands a single warship through 30+ missions against waves of enemy vessels and aircraft. Three weapons — main gun, Phalanx, and missiles — must be switched quickly to handle different threats.
Enemy types include battleships, carriers, fighters, torpedo bombers, and more, each with distinct behavior. Multiple difficulty levels available.

title: Undelve
description: A 2D Sci-fi Action Looter Shooter where you collect items and decide which to scrap for ammo while exploring a vast cave system, blowing up the very tunnels spiders use to reach you.

title: Card Eater
description: Combine cards to build the strongest deck and vanquish monsters! A deck-building roguelike FPS where you fight with a peculiar right hand.

title: Arms Dealer Simulator
description: Buy, build, and distribute. I’m not pro-war, I’m pro-business. Procure weaponry, attachments, and ammunition. Expand your armory, fulfill contracts, and manage your own scalable logistics fleet. Your trade, your profit.

title: Gohei
description: Your vocabulary is your weapon. Purge yokai with the power of words. A roguelike word-association game judged by AI.

title: Over Engineered
description:
Over Engineered is simulation strategy game that encourages construction of complex machines.
Using limited space, money, and power; you must build complex contraptions to bring a ball from its spawn, to its goal. The longer each ball takes, the more money you make in return.
Play through dozens of Rube Goldberg style puzzles, each carefully crafted to challenge your engineering intuition. With a fixed set of parts, and a locked goal; you must think critically to understand how each component interacts with each other.

title: Lunar Chrysalis
description: A box garden escape game. Su Li wakes up to find herself in an unfamiliar room, with monsters lurking around and strange symbols...she explores and solves puzzles in this eerie space, confronting the ever-approaching monsters... all to seize a glimmer of hope and escape this place!

title: Mob Drop Castle
description:
Awaken from your slumber o’ castle overlord!
It’s time to rise up and rebuild your fortress to protect it from the invading adventurers in this reverse hoard-survivors real-time idle castle management!

title: Kill The Nova
description: Classic puzzle meets roguelike deck-building! Collect a variety of unique pieces, build powerful synergies, and unleash overwhelmingly inflated scores through explosive “multipliers.” Smash impossible numbers straight into your enemies and beat up the final boss—the developer himself!

title: Hi-Res Brazil
description:
Live four days in the life of Rubens, a middle-class family man living in São Paulo in 1981. The game offers a narrative to engage the user into exploring the social-political ambient of the time.

The game utilizes a interactive fiction-based interaction, and there's no way to lose it. It's more like a serious games, or edutainment product. Mostly intended for people interested in the Military Regime-era of Brazilian politics.

title: Chuǎngguān Yóuxì
description: Players need to use the mouse to trigger the mechanisms and props in the scene to help the protagonist reach exit. The game has a total of 40 levels, each with different mechanisms, props, and different failure endings.

title: 1983, 18th Floor
description:
It's 1983, you get home after a long day of hard work at the office, you got a copy from Digital Poison's last game, YOSAI, you pop that floppy into your computer and get lost in the electronic fantasies.

1983, 18th Floor is the presentation of the YOSAI video game, a maze run and gun shooter. Explore the rooms, collect weapons and lives, and make your way out of the tower.

title: Skate Mates
description: A chaotic multiplayer skating game where each player controls one skate! Only epic teamwork and swift communication will get you through the brutal obstacle course! Dodge the blades, jump the canyons, and avoid the lava, because one mistake sends you all the way back.

title: FantômeRapport: Intermezzo
description: Fantôme Rapport is a multi-genre visual novel that blends romance, horror, and mystery. Uncover the secrets of a ghostly luxury cruise liner and the enigmatic women aboard.

title: Backstory
description: An immersive first-person experience about being kidnapped and locked in the trunk of a car. A journey in which sound is the main focus designed to be played using a standard controller (mouse) in a different way.

title: Onigashima: Awakening
description: A predictive deck-building RPG! Build your strategy from over 300 cards! Form powerful formations with unique animal companions! Master countless combinations and claim overwhelming victories! Your adventure to defeat the ONI begins now!

title: Old Mate Dave
description: Pachinko meets ragdoll physics in brand new shenanigans, be 'A Chad' and catch the falling Daves with your trusty gurney, shoot the Daves around the Pinball table and shoot for a Plinko high sore! Go ahead and treat yourself to a laugh and treat that Dave like the ball he isn't!

title: Ruffed Up
description: Ruffed Up is a chaotic, 2-4 player co-op physics game where you and your fellow dogs drag your unconscious dog walker across town to safety. Dodge traffic, cross treacherous terrain, and somehow get everyone home in one piece. It’s no walk in the park!

title: Stinker Golf
description: An online 1-16 player destructive golf game where you edit the course while you play. Annoy your friends without ruining the hole for yourself, all inside a fully physics simulated pixel world.

title: Rhythm Racer
description: Rhythm Racer is a futuristic arcade racing game where music generates the race track. Race through twisting neon tunnels, compete for high scores, and challenge friends in Streamer Mode where Twitch viewers can join races directly from chat.

title: Pull the Beer
description: A hardcore co-op adventure about delivering the beer. Pull a heavy but fragile barrel with ropes through levels full of danger, and don't let that legendary brew spill along the way.

title: Voxel Shooter
description: Voxel Shooter is a horizontal-scrolling bullet hell roguelite where each weapon color has a distinct role. Swap weapons on the fly, dash through danger, build a deck of upgrades. Master solo or chaos co-op with up to 4 friends via Steam Remote Play. Free demo available on Steam.

title: Mighty Mahjong
description: Still playing mahjong with 13 tiles? Mighty Mahjong is a next-gen twist where you start one tile short — and that missing tile becomes a wild card! Outsmart opponents with bold strategy and sharp reads. Anime-style online battles, special rules, team modes, and fast-paced matches. Free to play!

title: Cages: Hidden Worlds
description: A first-person puzzle escape game set in a mansion that holds the remains of a freak show carnival. Meet the former stars of the show, now locked inside intricate contraptions. Venture into surreal worlds lurking between the cracks of reality and solve the workings of complex original machinery.

title: Sombras: Negative Frames
description: ‘Sombras: Negative Frames’ is a first person narrative game with a focus on photography and light horror elements. Follow Shiomi, a Japanese-Spanish photography student, as she is spirited away in a dark mirror of her 2000s Japanese town and must confront fragments of her own psyche.

title: Pick a Boo
description: Pick a Boo is an online co-op action game where you use magnetic powers to stick furniture together and haul it out.

title: The Borderless
description: A cozy floating island management sim where you build and expand your own island world from a small platform in the middle of the ocean. Welcome visitors, meet their needs, plan activities, hire staff, earn money, and grow your ocean paradise day by day.

title: Hearse Hero
description: Inspired by classics such as Crazy Taxi and Simpsons Road Rage. You are Heinrich, the enigmatic Hearse Hero. Hit your targets and hurtle them to the hereafter while dodging police, pedestrians and more. 20 action-packed levels, plus a custom map editor with Steam Workshop support.

title: Dice Rogues
description: Dice Rogues is a tactical roguelite with infinite possibilities where you upgrade your dice and harness unpredictable rogue faces (X2, baguette, croissant, etc.) to bend fate, outplay the House, and survive a new roll each run.

title: Solitaire Deck
description: Solitaire that runs beautifully on PC gaming handhelds where every win builds your Museum of card history. Play Solitaire Deck on any device with controller, mouse, keyboard or touch. No tricks. Just solitaire done right.

title: Brewgether
description: Brewgether is a coop brewery sim. Run your own brewery, manage bars and employees, trade with townsfolk for different materials used in infusing the alcohol, build houses and furnish them in order to rent them out. Expand your business with new locations, brewery stations, vehicles and more.

title: JumpoCalypse
description: Jump. Die. Repeat. A brutally hard one-button platformer where every jump could be your last. How hard could a one-button game really be? Well buckle up, because you’re about to enter the Jumpocalypse.

title: Planetary Field Team
description: Play as the team's operator in this Roguelike Auto-Battler RPG. Build your team to effectively fight against hostiles on an alien planet.

title: Cloud Sculptor
description: Sculpt your way through puzzles and platforming using a frog, a laser beam, and other classic sculpting tools!

title: RoboDeal Simulator
description: Design, craft, and trade robots on the frozen world of Xylaris-9. Serve factions, upgrade your facility, and shape your robotic legacy in Robodeal Simulator.

title: Cryptoria
description: Cryptoria is a 2D pixel dungeon crawler where every step and every coin is a decision. Greed is punished. Hesitation can be fatal.

title: Obrum
description: OBRUM is a strategic logical puzzle roguelite where you manage an unstable system, trigger devastating chain reactions, and fight to keep the board from collapsing. OBRUM rewards pattern recognition & long-term planning. You are not solving a puzzle, you are engineering outcomes.

title: Might of Fate
description: A classic JRPG-style game about the conflict between magic and humanity in a medieval world. Experience Fate's story from his carefree childhood to becoming a powerful warrior. Assemble a party and master the combat stance system to change the fate of the world.

title: Sneaky Bimbuls
description: One team hides among a crowd of NPCs. The other has to figure out who's a player before the map gets sabotaged. A chaotic local party game for 2-8 players on a shared screen.

title: Shatterhold
