description: Idle survivor meets shared world. Your Hold produces resources 24/7. Your expeditions push back a fracturing reality. 25 regions. 8,000 zones. One world. Every player matters. Success and failure is shared by your entire region.

title: Gene Crawl: Dungeon Descent
description: > Die. Inherit. Evolve. Fight through dungeons, craft gear, brew potions, and collect relics — then die, pass your DNA to the next generation, and push deeper. Something is watching. Every death makes your bloodline stronger — but who benefits? An idle incremental RPG with a dark secret.

title: Enter the Depths
description: Enter the Depths is a minimalistic dice-building roguelike. Customize your dice, collect powerful relics, and battle through an ever-shifting dungeon to confront the Void.

title: Zetrya: Dungeon Dive
description: A group of adventurers work their way through a dungeon with the goal of clearing it. Finding new threats along the way.

title: Choose Your Paul!
description: Build bizarre Pauls. Break the run. Choose Your Paul is a strategic roguelite auto battler where you choose a unique Trainer, capture strange creatures called Pauls, craft powerful synergies through positioning and upgrades, and push through branching routes filled with battles, elites, shops, events, and bosses.

title: Stamp Collector
description: Stamp Collector is a relaxing and satisfying collection simulation. Use stamp punchers to punch collection objects and add the resulting stamps to your collection. Discover new themes and gradually expand your collection step by step.

title: Shapemonger
description: Shapemonger is a colorful arcadey incremental game about destroying shapes - in outer space! - getting money and buying upgrades

title: Crazy Fruit Shooter
description: One day you wake up and find yourself turned into a Fruitman? Face the endless waves of vegetables chasing you, grab your gun, and blast them away!

title: IdleDiablo
description: IdleDiablo is a Diablo-inspired idle loot game. Earn resources while idle, build your equipment & skills, and conquer all foes!

title: Chthonian TD
description: Fast-paced co-op action roguelite × tower defense. Fight escalating waves, risk resources in a dangerous mine, defeat the boss - then see how long you survive in Endless.

title: Edifice
description: A sudden quarantine leaves you stranded within a forgotten sector of the Edifice, a decaying megastructure sheltering the last remnants of mankind. You'll need to scavenge whatever equipment you can get your hands on and venture deep into the sector's crumbling facilities to escape.

title: Keep Cutting
description: A short and satisfying incremental game about cutting endless grass and buying upgrades to clear more.

title: Eon Survivor
description: Harvest vital resources behind enemy lines and survive relentless waves! Deploy from a carrier forced to retreat, collect fast, and secure your cargo before time runs out. Push your luck in this fast-paced rogue-lite space shooter—or be left behind.

title: Survivor: Gunfire
description: Survivor: Gunfire​​ is a first-person roguelite shooter where players survive relentless monster hordes by continuously upgrading weapons and combining powerful buffs.

title: Zero Sum
description: A hand-drawn twin-stick roguelite where every bullet is an equation and every enemy is a number. Subtract, divide, root, modulo. 7 operators, 22 firing modes, 9 bosses, 80+ upgrades. Reduce them all to zero. No health bars, just raw arithmetic violence. You failed math class. Math didn't forget.

title: Beaming
description: Beaming is a minimalist logic-based puzzler that involves directing beams through a hexagonal grid.

title: Proto Zero
description: There is no point in looking back. The only way left is forward. - O. Escape the mega complex and find out what happened to the world our protagonist Yuuto once knew after his long slumber, in this new generation 3d action sci-fi brawler.

title: Tidy Up
description: Tidy Up is a cozy inventory-sorting game where you organize all those scattered items. Great for chill streams — relax, sort, and chat with your viewers!

title: Mini Pond Farm: Frogs & Lilypads
description: Collect all the cute frogs! Shape your pond paradise, fill it with colorful hoppers, make them happy with reeds and lilies, and enjoy pure cozy serenity.

title: Metapathic
description: Metapathic is a movement-based hack-and-slash set in the Abyssosphere, an unfathomable pit housing the remains of a sprawling research facility. Take control of an android girl in search of her memories, and brave the Abyssosphere with a suite of abilities that fluidly blend combat and traversal.

title: Cafe Haven
description: Welcome to Cafe Haven, a cozy cafe management game! Unlock new recipes, decorate your cafe, and grow your business into the most beloved spot in town. Can you create a cafe success story?

title: Believr Pro Wrestling
description: BPW gives you all the stress of running a wrestling promotion, without the money, the glory, or the safety net.

title: Assassin Of Dombardos
description: Third person Shooter game where cyborg warrior need find Dombardos names big Sci-fi turret with shield and destroy big enemy boss and find skull. Also player need avoid Dombardos army

title: Black Box: Hacker Day One
description: A hacking sim that runs inside a fake desktop OS, with no menus laid over the top. You get a terminal, 72 hours, and one job: get into North Korea's missile network and send its rockets to the Moon instead of Seoul. Do it quietly and nobody ever finds out you were there.

title: The Obsessive Shadow: Chapter 2
description: Something sinister stirs on Old Diamond Drive. 16 year old Justin, armed only with a flashlight and camcorder, takes a dare to spend the night. As shadows close in, he realizes escape isn't possible, and he's not alone. Witness the horrors of the past as you explore the ruins of what once thrived...

title: Nine Spaces
description:
Nine rooms filled with scattered thoughts, surreal visuals, hand drawn characters, and atmospheric audio.

This is a short "look around and walk" type of experience inspired by Don's Soup 0.9.

title: Interlocked: Puzzle Islands
description: Solve tactile three-dimensional burr puzzles on cozy Puzzle Islands. Twist, pull and dismantle handcrafted puzzles in immersive VR or with mouse & keyboard… alongside one curious little bird friend.

title: Idle Hacker
description: IdleHacker is an idler/incremental game where you hack the world.

title: Coloring Game 5.5
description:
An additional set of images for Coloring Game 5.

Size: 20 images / 550,000 px.

Duration: 15 hours (Pen Mode) / 8 hours (Fill Mode)

title: Coloring Game 5.6
description:
An additional set of images for Coloring Game 5.

Size: 30 images / 850,000 px.

Duration: 22 hours (Pen Mode) / 12 hours (Fill Mode)

title: Shed
description: Flush your friends. Burn the deck. SHED everything. SHED is a competitive card-shedding game where your goal is simple: get rid of everything before your opponents do.

title: Rally TS
description: Rally TS - The Ultimate Auto Simulator Experience Embark on an epic journey through the world of rally racing in TS Rally, where your dream of becoming the #1 racer in the Race of Champions begins with a single street car and rise to the global championship glory.

title: Beggar's Road
description: A darkly comic medieval roguelike where you travel between towns, recruit desperate companions, and survive strange encounters through difficult choices, scarce resources, and shifting alliances with bishops, merchants, and bandits.

title: Otherwar: Deluxe Edition
description: In Otherwar: Deluxe Edition, you are a defender angel tasked with pushing away the incoming attack from Hell. Plan your defense and use resources carefully in this bullet hell/tower defense mash up, now with all of the DLC included! With the Studio Secrets DLC, Chronicles of Creation DLC, and Crafting Compendium DLC, get a glimpse behind the gates of Otherwar with mini art books and unused art, as well as early demos and a look into the creation of the game!

title: Sludge Department
description: A murky point-and-click puzzle game where a straightforward repair job gets stranger the deeper you go. Solve 2D and 3D puzzles, meet weird characters, and figure out what is happening below the sludge.

title: Getting Home
description: A space landing adventure about love and perseverance. Master precision controls, conserve fuel, and navigate deadly cosmic hazards on a journey to find your way home.

title: Senpai ga Imouto no Saigo no Natsu
description: This is a relaxed yuri visual novel, celebrating the birthday of a senior in early summer.

title: Bulletreign: Survivors
description: Top-down military bullet hell survivor. Drive armored vehicles behind enemy lines, rescue prisoners, fuse devastating weapons, and push forward. 25 weapons, 9 fusions, 6 crew members. Every run is a new offensive.

title: Rogue Mate
description: A roguelite chess RPG where your pieces evolve beyond the board. Unlock branching skill trees, recruit and build your warband, then battle through ten handcrafted boss encounters, each with unique mechanics designed to dismantle your strategy.

title: Tickets, Please!
description: Become a train conductor and run your own train in a relaxing cozy simulation! Check tickets, keep everything clean, repair faults, and upgrade your train. Experience humorous chaos on the rails in a laid-back yet hectic single-player adventure.

title: Kouhai wo Iwau Saisho no Fuyu
description: A sequel to Senpai ga Imouto no Saigo no Natsu. This is a relaxed yuri visual novel, depicting the conclusion between these two.

title: Notebook Workshop
description: Manage your own cute notebook shop. Create unique designs in your workshop. Carefully package orders and make your customers happy with distinctive designs. Grow your small shop and become one of the most beloved notebook stores.

title: Election Train
description: A turn-based strategy card game where up to 4 players compete for votes across real-world maps. Play cards, control cities, dominate regions, and outsmart your rivals to win the election. 7 maps, 4 unique parties, and dynamic disaster events.

title: Lane of the Eternal Night
description: An exploratory, self-chosen experience type of light roguelike turn-based pixel indie game, currently without much storyline. Although the combat is turn-based, it's more like a rock-paper-scissors style game mode, and it also includes skills.

title: Pixelords
description: Pixelords is a 2D pixel art autobattler where victory is decided before battle begins. Build a squad from 10 elements and 35 units, place them freely on a gridless battlefield, and enjoy solo campaign, 4-player co-op Trials, and real-time PvP.

title: Cat Hits the Deck
description: Deckbuilder roguelike about a cat that fears being hurt but has only cards that hurt her before enemies! Min-max your resources, get OverPowered cards in your paw, and build an unlosable Deck that prolly gonna kill you 9 times^^

title: Cats' World
description: Inspired by PokeRouge, this game, Cats' World, adopts a retro visual effect similar to Snes Mode7, combines the framework of traditional turn-based games, and focuses on team development through automated battle and treasure grinding.

title: Symptoms of Infection
description: Examine and test patients for common and novel infections using sophisticated medical instrumentation and disinfection procedures. All infected patients must be sent to the isolation ward for further evaluation or treatment. Rumors of mysterious diseases and human experimentation are unconfirmed.

title: Deliverage
description: Deliverage is a hardcore open-world PvP delivery game where every shipment is a gamble. Fight other players for valuable cargo, repair and modify fragile vehicles, outplay rivals in a shifting economy, and climb from nothing to the top of a ruthless world.

title: Meshuda
description: Meshuda is the retro style 2D adventure game and it's adopted simple command battle. Choose from three command in the battle --ATTACK, EVADE, SPECIAL SKILL-- . You fight as Aziga village's warrior, Meshuda, to save your village.

title: Hardcore Soldier
description: Vengeance or Die in this no mercy, bullet hell, run and gun shooter that requires player skill, with only one life and one hit death, game over. You just can't get hit.

title: Tower.Defense(): Program the Fight
description: A tower defense game where you program your turrets instead of upgrading them. Drag and drop visual code blocks to define targeting, conditions, and firing logic. No coding experience needed. Your strategy is your code.

title: Snap Jaw
description: A thrilling rogue-lite horror fishing experience. Pillage the sea, upgrade your boat, and feed the increasingly hungry colossal-mechatronic creatures of the deep. All in an attempt to reverse the rapture of your adorable dog Jeremiah.

title: We Belong Dead
description: Toxic Yuri VN between a mad scientist, and her spectral lover who haunts the living. It has been far too long since you passed. You have been gone for so long. But no longer. I will bring you back my love. No matter the cost.

title: Sweetie Candy Maze: Violet Plum
description: Dive into a vibrant candy world! Collect delicious sweets and find your way through playful violet plum mazes in this sweet and colorful adventure.

title: Hook-Kick
description: She ate me! The indignity of this has seemingly left you immortal. Stored for safekeeping (head being so pretty and all) you team up with a couple of bones from a slain wizard and a stretchy pirate-snake named hook in this kicking platformer filled with circles all the way up and down.

title: Dead Reckoner
description: Navigate the darkness in Dead Reckoner, a stealth-action submarine game where survival depends on more than firepower alone. Slip through the shadows, elude your enemies, and exploit their weaknesses as a new recruit in a mysterious government initiative that will determine the future of humanity.

title: Stealth Operative Syn: Virtual Training
description: Synthia “Syn” is training to become a Stealth Operative. In order to do so, she trains in the Virtual Simulation Room. Use different tactics and techniques to sneak past the guards and obstacles. Finish every level to complete your virtual training!

title: Ancient Adventure
description: Evil has taken over the world. Equip your Weapon of Choice and venture forth. Journey out into the world to avenge your predecessors. Survive the hordes of monsters, seek out to extinguish the source of all Evil, so that one day, your people may finally live in peace.

title: Recess
description: A chaotic multiplayer party game where childhood playground games turn into all-out competition. Tag, hide, chase, and outplay your friends across imaginative maps all before the bell rings.

title: Beat & Beasties
description: Run and defeat countless enemies and obstacles! Beat & Beasties is an action game that harmoniously blends the thrill of running and roguelike.

title: Item Shop Simulator
description: Run an item shop in the Australian outback. Stock swords, potions, and emu eggs. Delve 15 dungeons for loot. Your customers work jobs and spend their wages on your wares... if you can keep them supplied.

title: Reflection Arena
description: A shooting action game set in a closed arena where reflecting projectiles fly. Test your limits in evasion and interception.

title: Elemental Magic Wars
description: A hero-based 3D tower defense game featuring 9 elements, elemental reactions, RPG growth, gear drops, and thrilling battles. Command your heroes, build your defense, and face endless waves of elemental enemies.

title: Soccerboy vs. Aliens
description: Play as Soccerboy, a plucky little soccer fanatic in this 2D action, puzzle platformer. Honing your ball skills, you must take on an alien invasion to save the galaxy and your soccer idol Bro-naldo, in this fun take on the platforming genre.

title: V-Dash Dungeon
description: A brand new, free, indie vtuber fangame inspired by games like Holocure and Vampire Survivors! Play as your favorite vtuber, summon their chatters to aid you, earn over 100 upgrades and unlockables to make your perfect build, and descend endless dungeon floors filled with familiar foes!

title: SubPrime Delivery
description: Drag & Drop Various Action Blocks to Guide The Robot to The End of The Level!

title: The Blue-G Interactive Vector Archive 77-97
description: Explore the rich vector arcade 'history' of Blue-G Interactive in this enhanced collection of 11 games. Made to run fast even on low spec hardware!

title: Jaywalk: An Endless Arcade Hopper Game
description: Hop, dodge, and race to the top in this endless runner inspired by Frogger! Collect coins, unlock new characters, and compete with friends in fast-paced multiplayer chaos.

title: Jolt: Neon Breaker
description: Take direct control of the ball in this high-speed neon brick breaker. Upgrade your capacities, unleash devastating abilities, and smash through waves of bricks in this hypnotic arcade experience.

title: The Bone Crypt
description: Steam’s first PvP Domino Deckbuilder! Connect pips on bone tiles to chain attacks and outsmart enemies in a tactical roguelike tomb. Master a deep solo campaign or crush rivals in online PvP. No cards, just pure bone-clinking strategy. Do you have the marrow to escape the crypt?

title: Corelith
description: Corelith is a wave-based roguelike top-down action game. Explore the Corelith Dungeon, craft Skill Cores, and create your own unique build.

title: Orbosis Gloriosis
description: A physics-based incremental game where you split and merge orbs

title: Third Walker
description: Third Walker is a raw, experimental sci-fi first-person shooter (FPS) set inside a dying space station at the edge of known systems. Developed solo by Abrham Tekuam under Apex Nova Games in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, this early playable prototype focuses strictly on tight gunplay mechanics, tense atmospheric exploration, and emergent combat encounters. Currently in an active technical demonstration phase, the project allows players to engage in the Station Alpha arena to test weapon recoil and combat pacing, with the development roadmap driven directly by community feedback.

title: Sesame Street: Friends & Fun
description: Welcome to Sesame Street! A place to play, laugh and grow. There’s so much to do with Elmo and your Sesame Steet friends. Enjoy exploring their world, growing beanstalks, cooking tasty food, and helping your new friends throw a big party for the neighborhood.

title: MarsCity3026
description: A game for kids and adults. Grapple, swing, move mechanical puzzle pieces. Play as a robot that solves mazes and mechanical puzzles. Each puzzle brings the terra-forming machines back online so that the humans can wake from cryo-sleep.

title: C.L.A.S.H: Colonial Life Advancing Self-sustained Hemisphere - Chapter 1
description: C.L.A.S.H: Colonial Life Advancing Self-sustained Hemisphere - Chapter 1 is an action/adventure title with platformer elements. Parkour your way through 25 unique buildings to collect hidden individual objectives/powerups. While you're at it, avoid toxic blobs that will radiate you into nothingness.

title: Project Chernaya
description: Project Chernaya is a FPS Puzzle Based game combined with horror on a post sovietic theme. Be careful, every step you take and the deeper you go, the more you will realize that you are not alone...

title: Baldi's Basics in 2D
description:
Baldi's Basics in 2D is a pixel-art fan recreation of the original survival-horror edutainment parody by Mystman12. Developed by ChimeLmaple5876, this project translates the infamous 3D schoolhouse environment into a flat, top-down 2D role-playing perspective. Players must navigate the pixelated corridors of the school, solve math problems on the "You Can Think Pad," and collect notebooks while avoiding the main antagonist, Baldi.

While faithfully retaining the core gameplay mechanics and tension of the original game, this 2D adaptation introduces a layer of unique original content, distinct sprite artwork, and updated mapping systems. Players must manage their stamina, utilize items strategically, and dodge familiar school characters in a retro, stylized format.

title: Pokémon Infinite Fusion 2: Hoenn
description: The sequel to Pokémon Infinite Fusion, taking place in the Hoenn region.

title: Class of '09: Puzzle Showdown
description: The Class of '09 cast is back to bring you the most out of pocket puzzle game ever made. Featuring a story rich campaign, an absurd multi-ending side quest, and online PvP... All requiring quick skills to outlast your opponent! Still wrapped in late 2000's nostalgia!

title: Bean Wizard Eviscerates the Gonklins
description: The world's first twin-stick anthill shooter! Reign terror down on the Gonklins using every bean in your arsenal. Be careful, warrior Gonklins will strike back with their blasters! Upgrade your legume weaponry and defeat King Donklin the Gonklin!

title: Saturday Night at Freddy's
description:
After what went down at Freddy’s in the 90s, you refuse to return, but bills are tight, so you reluctantly accept the gig. Once inside, you find out something’s seriously wrong, unable to leave, locked inside with the recycled remains of a once pristine gang of animatronics, now old and stained with time. Will you survive 'til the cleanup crew arrives at 6? Or will you find yourself another victim of a horror story old as time…
In this FNAF-inspired horror-game, you must protect yourself from the animatronics of Freddy Fazbar's.

title: Who Wants To Be King?!
description: The year is 865. Vikings are sailing to avenge Ragnar Lothbrok. Build your city and defend it—alone or with friends.

title: Backrooms Security Room
description: Watch the surroundings of the outpost through cameras, keep creatures away by using lights, and protect yourself by locking doors in case of danger. Welcome to the five nights at Backrooms.

title: MythicTale
description: Battle rivals, unleash energy attacks, explore dangerous zones, and take on platforming challenges as you fight to rise through the Super Fighter League in a 2.5D pixel-art action RPG.

title: Dice Carnival
description: Dice Carnival is a roguelike score-chaser where you roll, bank, and chain dice into explosive combos. Collect powerful Tokens, pick your Tour, crush chapter Bosses, and push your score beyond the limit.

title: The Ammonite’s Whisper
description: A 2D exploration-based horror adventure set in the “Deep Realm,” an otherworld connected to a natural history museum. Experience a unique atmosphere where quiet intellectual spaces intertwine with unsettling phenomena.

title: Little Lilicia
description: A full-fledged farm life sim where you live as a rancher, socialize, and find love with heroines in the town of Kokotan, home of the Forest Goddess. Step into the shoes of the protagonist, Philo, who becomes a rancher by chance, and revitalize the run-down farm.

title: Cloudsea Frontier
description: This is a classic long-form RPG inspired by the masterpieces of the 1990s JRPG era. It unfolds a story of adventure through the Cloud Sea world and saving the world.

title: Sign: Broken Kether
description: Sign is a visual novel series that blends fantasy, urban life, and adventure. The story follows Lyra, a high school girl who encounters Cygnus, a witch from another world. Together, they embark on a journey to reclaim the witch’s lost powers.

title: Wizard Magic
description: An autistic wizard and their ADHD familiar go on the adventure of a lifetime. Make strange friends, battle wizards and monsters, and explore the magical city of Bizzaire in this bite-sized pixel-art RPG!

title: Pizza House Simulator
description: Run your dream pizzeria solo or with up to 6 players in chaotic online co-op multiplayer. Cook authentic pizzas, automate your kitchen, customize your restaurant, survive disasters, invest in stocks, gamble and build the ultimate Italian restaurant empire.

title: Dying Light: The Beast - Hunter Essentials
description:
Stealth takedowns are front and centre with he Hush crossbow delivering silent death, while the Trapper outfit ensures you blend into the forests of Castor Wood. A single-use UV bar, Temporary XP Booster and military Medi kit will offer further advantages against the horde. The set is completed with a Villedor weapon charm to remind you why you fight.

Hunter Essentials contains:
- Hush Crossbow
- Trapper Gear Parts
- Villedor Weapon Charm
- 3x Military Medkit
- 5x UV Bar
- 3x Temporary XP Boost

title: Dying Light: The Beast - Action Hero Essentials
description: Supercharge your Dying Light: The Beast experience to those of a big-screen Action Hero, bringing the ultimate tools of survival right to your fingertips as you fight for the future. Boasting the precision-driven Predator Rifle and the iconic Afterkill 47 charm, your arsenal becomes a statement of power as the fight continues. And pull on an iconic and suitably rugged Hardboiled outfit, inspired by the big screen’s greatest heroes. Accompanied by crucial consumables, you'll look the part as you face every challenge head-on.

title: Fee Payment & Cigarettes
description: Fee Payment & Cigarettes is a first-person psychological horror anomaly-spotting game. Enter a hospital in first-person, finish all payment checklists. Spot anomalies, then head to the payment counter or retreat to the smoking area to calm down.

title: Hotdog Butcher
description: The colorful lights of the carnival, laughter, and the sound of music. Everything seems ordinary as you serve your customers from your hotdog truck. But as the night grows deeper the crowd fades, the lights go out and something starts watching you.

title: Pubes
description: A 3D action game where you control a strand of body hair and move around a 3D room! Use the unique fluffy floating and sticking abilities of body hair to safely reach your destination!

title: Football Rising: Zero to Hero
description: A lifestyle football RPG where you rise from the 4th division to world glory. Build a deck from over 100 skill cards, romance 22 unique characters, compete across 8 countries, and pass your legacy to the next generation. Your football life begins now.

title: Error: Girlfriend Not Found
description: One-room cyberpunk Visual Novel about doubt, guilt and memory. Talk to a girl who claims to be your girlfriend, question reality, and unlock multiple endings in a short, replayable psychological story.

title: Return Machine.Love()
description: 3 different Robot-romance stories. Written, drawn, and made by humans, for humans. Since the very moment the first mechanical mind became aware of itself, it craved love. No one truly understand why the heart made of copper and wires started beating, but it did. Even after we were gone.

title: Station Nexus
description: A survey vessel bound for a destination 96,000 km away. While investigating a destroyed spacecraft, you encounter an unexplained spatial anomaly. Manage power and resources to continue your journey, and uncover the truth behind a phenomenon that is slowly consuming reality itself.

title: Lusófona Games Collection 2025
description: Lusófona Games Collection 2025 brings you five unique, student and staff made games from Lusófona University. Dive into creative prototypes packed with passion, gameplay innovation, and behind-the-scenes commentary from the next generation of game developers!

title: KeyFortress
description: This is an innovative game blending typing, action roguelike, and tower defense. Fight by typing, improve posture and build muscle memory. Hate typing? Try card battles with keyboard keys! Enjoy typing+roguelike+slot machine card strategy mode too!

title: LetMeSee
description: A collection of fun and relaxing puzzle games.

title: Myriad Realms
description: Rare pure single-player retro 2D side-scroller on Steam. Recreates classic MMO golden-era vibe, no pay-to-win, no IAPs, no forced social. Enjoy pure, stress-relieving fun of slaying monsters, hunting loot, and free exploration.

title: EagleRoad: WorldRise
description: This is an open world 3D gunfight game based on the law of the jungle, which emphasizes the survival of the fittest. It is also a mission centered combat game based on experience leveling. It combines elements of role-playing, tactical strategy, and experience leveling.

title: Blood Welkin
description: Shoot, smash, and eviscerate abominations in BLOOD WELKIN - an FPS roguelite with dozens of unique kit-building items and a gripping story for you to discover. YOU. ARE. NOT. CRAZY.

title: Snap the Cat
description: An incremental game about taking photos of cats. Upgrade your account, unlock new cats, and take photos of them so everyone on the planet will follow you!

title: S.A.N.D.Y.: Beach Cleaner
description: This is a cozy, narrative and dark game in which you clean oil off the beach, sort out trash and rescue animals. Relaxing cleanup in a post-apocalyptic world.

title: Redline JDM Drift
description: Experience stylish JDM drifting with online multiplayer, smooth handling, and striking visuals. Drive legendary-inspired cars, score massive drift combos, explore the roads solo or with friends, and rise as the next Drift King.

title: The Dreaming City Chronicles: Quest for the Vanished World
description: Explore the mysteries of your soul to discover whether you're melancholic, choleric, sanguine, or phlegmatic. Each decision reflects your inner world, challenging your perception and revealing the hidden depths of your personality in this journey of self-discovery.

title: Storm Clan
description: Race across the alien ocean in a high-speed boat in this deck-building bullet hell. Weave through waves of bizarre enemies while dodging glowing projectiles and build your deck to overcharge weapons, add bounces and spreads, and survive escalating chaos.

title: Lizard Simulator
description: That's a simulator game 100%. Trust us.

title: Yousei Shou Meikyuu: Fairies Odyssey
description: Yousei Shou Meikyuu: Fairies Odyssey is a Touhou Project fangame with gameplay inspired by Etrian Odyssey.

title: Necromancer Delivery Service
description: A 3D physics-driven action racing game where players take on the role of a struggling necromancer forced into a delivery job in a chaotic city. Deliver packages, collect money and souls as tips, and use chaotic spells.

title: Defense of Kyrath
description: Tower defense meets roguelike in a fantasy kingdom. Position 9 wardens across enchanted forests, pastoral meadows, and volcanic badlands. 30+ enemies with resistances and weaknesses. A talent tree for meaningful progression. Climb the Folly - a 20-tier roguelike ascent. Kyrath will not fall.

title: Hosting Simulator: 2026
description: Manage your own hosting company! Set up your servers, upgrade your infrastructure, create hosting packages, and serve your customers. Play solo or with friends in co-op, and turn your company from a small business into a large data center.

title: Undying: Kowloon in Red
description: UNDYING: Kowloon in Red is a visual novel/RPG hybrid where you grow as a vampire, using skills and vampiric abilities to overcome challenges and survive.

title: The Profaned
description: The Profaned is an Anomaly-Hunt horror game about a person who's trying to cleanse his sins. The primary task is to investigate the endless forsaken church to find the anomalies and capture them with your camera to cleanse your sins. And if you fail to do so, start again from the beginning.

title: Lootborne
description: Lootborne is a dark fantasy desktop autobattler. Build your character, loot gear, push through PvE stages, and challenge other players in async PvP duels while battle rages at the edge of your screen.

title: Apology Video
description: An FMV Choose-Your-Own-Adventure that'll leave you wanting to like and subscribe!

title: Just a Little Longer
description: Just a Little Longer is a punishing top-down shooter with the staples of classic action horror games, with a brutal permadeath gambling twist: whenever you die in the recurring nightmare the game takes place in, your save file is instantly deleted

title: Verto
description: Drop blocks, match colors, rotate everything. This puzzle game adds mind-bending board rotation to classic gameplay. Choose from timed challenges or endless modes, and compete for high scores. Easy to learn, impossible to master.

title: Bit Maze
description: Guide Bitty through the mazes in this twisting plattformer.

title: Through the Manor
description: A cozy building sandbox where you craft painterly structures and step inside them in 3rd person. Build whimsical manors, explore every room you design, and reside within your creations in this atmospheric, stress-free experience.

title: A Game About Bouncing DVD
description: A minimalist incremental game where you watch DVD logos bounce endlessly, earn points, upgrade your screen, and unlock increasingly powerful upgrades.

title: The Minesweeper
description: The classic game of minesweeper from a fresh new perspective. Play alone or with a friend in this third person puzzle game, where you toss grenades, plant flags, and math a path to victory. Enjoy the calm of nature, chill tunes and chaotic reveals.

title: Rogue Kingdom
description: In Rogue Kingdom, Online Roguelike meets Settlement Building! Clear dungeons, claim them, fill them with NPCs, and defend them in an online world. Grow stronger through loot, mining, crafting, magic, and help from other players.

title: Deliver Together
description: In Deliver Together, You control either (or both) of the two trucks attached to the same loooong trailer. And who's driving? Oh, just you. Or you and a friend. Or maybe eight of you, all screaming different directions at once. Your goal is to reach the finish line in chaotic tracks.

title: Invisible Ascent
description: A rage-inducing memory platformer where the path disappears before you jump. Study the platforms, trust your memory, and climb upward one painful mistake at a time.

title: Blazeo
description: Hell's failed Eden must burn. As Lucifer's right hand, tear through endless hordes of grotesque mistakes. Grow stronger, spread fire, erase your master's shame.

title: Boby and the Witch
description: Boby’s girlfriend has been abducted by a witch—race through 3 worlds and 18 levels to save her. Can you beat it in under 5 minutes?

title: Agatha Christie: Death on the Nile - Deluxe Edition
description:
The Deluxe Edition of Agatha Christie - Death on the Nile includes:

- The Art of: Death on the Nile - HD Digital Artbook
- The Game Original Soundtrack

title: Cells of Division
description: Cells of Division is a top-down bullet hell roguelike. Fight with past-run clones (up to 6 allies), mix ~100 items, and defeat 50+ bosses. Destroy viruses and defend the immune system!

title: Sengoku Dynasty: Sakura Edition
description: Experience Sengoku Dynasty in legendary style. The Sakura Edition includes the main game and the Sakura DLC.

title: Vampire: The Masquerade - Bloodlines 2: Expansion Pass
description: Deepen your experience with a day-one Cosmetic Pack for your haven and two Story Packs delivering new narratives, combat mechanics, and outfits - inviting you to uncover the intertwined stories that shape Seattle’s fate.

title: Galador: The Prince and the Coward - Digital Deluxe Edition
Knights in Tight Spaces: Collector's Edition
description:
Knights in Tight Spaces - Collector's Edition includes:
Knights in Tight Spaces
Knights in Tight Spaces - Official Game Soundtrack
Knights in Tight Spaces - Artbook

title: Limited Space
description: Frantic 1–4 player co-op space survival. Build defenses, repair your ship, and hold out as endless asteroid waves tear everything apart.

title: The Message From Deep Space
description: Mission: Translate an interstellar message, using the universal languages of math & science.

title: Alyup
description: Alyup: An insane power fantasy. Unleash a cosmic barrage of hyperspheres with godlike powers, ascend the vast reaches of space like blazing rockets to razor-edged arena clashes, rescue fallen allies in tactical duels, grind stats to forge apocalyptic strikes, or perish in one devastating flash!

title: Increbouncer
description: Increbouncer is a short incremental ball game where you launch balls, earn two different currencies from wall bounces and ball collisions, unlock new balls, and level up a skill tree to maximize your income.

title: Bounce Forever
description: Bounce from the backyard to the clouds in this punishing vertical climber. The only thing faster than the climb is the fall. Bounce forever and you might just reach the top.

title: Curling
description: Whether you are a Curling fan or you want to discover a new sport game, you'll enjoy playing Curling in its one player game or local multiplayer game . Curling has beed designed to be as close as possible to reality while providing best gameplay.

title: Pro Soccer Manager 27
description: Become the manager of a football team and take full control of your club. Manage scouting, training, facilities, and squad development. Choose your philosophy: focus on coaching and tactics, or invest in developing the next generation of stars. Success depends on your decisions.

title: Bullet Spell
description: Dodge, weave, and coordinate your way through bullets and enemies in this magical spy-thriller! Stress-test your ability to multitask by controlling the twin sisters Aurora and Solana simultaneously, or share control with a second player to coordinate the twins' survival.

title: Balls & Gamble
description: Balls & Gamble is a casino-inspired incremental game where you shoot a LOT of balls, earn money, buy upgrades, gamble, unlock new balls, and eventually break reality itself.

title: Cute Country
description: You can build your own royal city. With over 100+buildings and massive home decorations, create an unparalleled kingdom. There are many mysterious races in the alternate world, and you can recruit humans, elves, beasts, or even rarer demons, dragons, etc. to build your kingdom together.

title: Neon Null
description:
Reality is collapsing into the Null, a digital void that consumes entire sectors of existence. As the last surviving pilot, you dive into corrupted space to fight through hostile anomalies, recover lost data, and uncover the force behind the collapse before everything is erased.

Every run presents a new challenge. Enemy formations, hazards, and upgrade opportunities shift from one attempt to the next, forcing you to adjust your strategy on the fly. Powerful builds can emerge quickly, but a single mistake can end a run just as fast.

Progress doesn't stop when you fail. Unlock new upgrades, expand your arsenal, and discover abilities that open new ways to approach future runs. Each attempt helps you push farther, survive longer, and tackle increasingly difficult encounters.

Built around responsive controls and rapid-fire action, Neon Null rewards skill, experimentation, and persistence. The farther you travel into the fractured cosmos, the more dangerous and unpredictable it becomes.

title: Plasma Dome
description: Plasma Dome is a tactical tower defense with roguelite progression and no predefined paths. Defend your city from an aerial assault of geometric entities from another dimension.

title: Cybersport Manager
description: Lead an esports team in a MOBA discipline, draft heroes, manage players, and guide your organization to championship glory in a strategic autobattler with deep management elements.

title: Of Bricks and Patterns
description: Bored with putting the same pieces in the same 10*20 grid ? Of Bricks and Patterns allows you to complete dozens of different patterns, with dozens of different pieces ! So, come fill patterns and reach sky-high scores in Of Bricks and Patterns !

title: Sakura Hime 6
description: Step into this world where charming girls of all kinds long for your touch. Win their hearts one by one and embark on a soul-stirring journey through another world!

title: Office Leveling
description: Office Leveling is a management game about secretly playing a minimalist clicker at work without getting caught. As you level up, you must complete office tasks, deal with coworkers dropping by with requests, and solve small puzzles to stay under the radar.

title: Fancy Farm Brawl
description: Closed Playtest Now Live! Mix relaxing farming & tower defense. Early testers average over 98 minutes per play session. Click Request Access on store page to apply for limited slots.

title: Wet Wealth
description: Casual casino slot + adult visual novel. Spin reels to collect items, finish quests, earn gold and crystals, and renovate a luxury penthouse. Upgrade girls to unlock new outfits, story chapters, and fully animated intimate scenes.

title: Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader - Processional of the Damned
description: Venture into the Processional — a massive, otherworldly graveyard of ships lost to the void. What begins as a search for riches turns into a descent into the unknown. Navigate shifting corridors, avoid ancient traps, and uncover strange truths that defy logic. A new companion joins your crew — someone shaped by this impossible place. This expansion introduces new story, a mysterious new region, unique enemies and some fresh gameplay mechanics.

title: Behind The Walls
description: A first-person puzzle adventure where you explore a secret place, solve mysteries, and uncover the dark truth hidden behind the walls.

title: Flocked and Loaded
description: Raise your herd. Arm them for war. Survive the wild! Guide your flock through dangerous environments, battling escalating waves of predators. Extract your surviving animals to your ranch to unlock powerful guardians, expand your roster, and prepare for even deadlier runs.

title: Dodecium
description: Solo Indie delivers a local 1-4 player split-screen physics-based create and combat sandbox with scientific tools for PvP or PvE. Replay many unique campaigns. Master your hex build strategy, microscopes, and chemistry skills. Be clever to achieve victory and learn as you go. June NEXT FEST.

title: Master Healer Kale With Useless Party
description: A short incremental game where you play as a Healer in a party. Your main job is to keep your party alive. Upgrade 200+ skills in a skill tree, from healing to party damage. Designed to be completed in around 4 hours.

title: The Last Tale Told: Spam
description: You live alone. Work from home. You haven't been out for days, trapped by endless rain. Every day your phone rings, it's an unknown number. “Suspected Scam” is what you read on the screen. You think it's just spam.

title: Make or Break!
description: Play matchmaker and bring couples together while a serial killer is lurking in your hometown.

title: Between the Shelves
description: A cozy bookshop management game where customers step out of classic literature. Curate your shelves, recommend the perfect book, and unlock new items and mechanics as your shop grows into a living collection of stories.

title: Deadhead Angel!
description: Wander through broken realities with an angel stuck in your eye.

title: Spirit Dungeon
description: Party building × deckbuilding × auto battle. As a summoner, collect spirits, choose your cards, and brave the depths of a dark forest dungeon in this roguelike RPG.

Trapped in a mysterious space shrouded in an unsettling atmosphere, a unknown presence creeps up from behind— "it" doesn't move while you're watching. But the moment you look away, it closes in without a sound. Can you escape "it" and find your way out of this enigmatic space?

title: Ultimate Blacksmith Tycoon
description: Run a blacksmith shop as a shopkeeper with a rare appraisal skill. Craft weapons and armor, sell to a shifting cast of customers, and dispatch adventurers into dungeons for loot. Manage a 28-day business loop with dynamic item rarity and a deep tech tree. A management sim blending crafting, shop-keeping, and a dispatch RPG layer. Now in Early Access.

title: MunchiesGretel
description: Deep in the dim forest, where the trees had stolen the light and the wind had vanished...the brother and sister walked along a path shrouded in purple mist.

title: Zero Clearance
description:
You’re isolated in a building swarmed with hostile AI drones. Fight through and escape.

Realistic firearm handling is simulated. Pay attention to your weapon condition and master handling it quickly and correctly.

title: Skill Eater
description: Skill Eater is a roguelite game where you've been turned into a slime with no choice but to steal opponents' skills to grow stronger. Eat your way through the humans and monsters that stand in your way, claim their powers, and aim to defeat the final boss that awaits you.

title: Hope of Elements
description: Harness elemental chains to defeat foes, collect treasures, and craft unique builds in high-risk, high-reward adventures. Hope of Elements is a roguelike with elemental gameplay, RPG mechanics, and turn-based tactics. Join Elise and dragon Pipi on their magical journey.

title: Cyberwars
description: Cyberwars is a turn-based tactics roguelike. You move infantry, vehicles, helicopters, naval units, and aircraft across hand-built maps, capture cities and factories for production, hold airports and ports to control the air and sea, and use terrain and fog of war to break the enemy line.

title: Killer Bees
description: The found footage from the "Killer Bees" case has been leaked online. You can witness what the officials hid for all these years.

title: Santa Slays Tonight
description:
A DEAD MALL. A LONG NIGHT.

You’re working the last overnight security shift at a shopping mall. Christmas decorations hang lifelessly overhead. The lights buzz. The music warps and skips. Somewhere down the concourse, a red shape stands perfectly still.

DON’T. LOOK. AWAY.

This isn’t a chase. If you’re looking at Santa, he’s frozen. Look away to reset a breaker, silence an alarm, or lock a gate and he moves. Every task forces you to turn your back. Every second your eyes aren’t on him is a risk.

Listen for bells.

Watch the lights.

And hope you don’t turn around too late.

Clock out… or disappear into the hallway.

Santa slays tonight.

title: Before Darkness Falls
description: A tactical survival strategy game where you manage a collapsing colony, make impossible decisions, and face the consequences as every choice shapes what survives the night.

title: Exit Only
description:
Exit Only is a psychological horror game about routine turning strange.
You play a new employee at a small software company. Life seems normal — quiet office, simple tasks. One evening you go to a nearby store and bump into a colleague. But something about them feels wrong.

title: The Uninvited
description:
After the events of Eternal Night... some man found this story online... and he decided to check out what was really going on in that house... it would be a huge mistake that would completely change his life...

Eternal Night is a game where a janitor comes to clean a house... but very strange things happen there.

title: Revive! Onsen Town!
description: Revive! Onsen Town! is a cozy life simulation set in the Japanese countryside. Play as a girl on summer vacation or the mayor revitalizing the village. Catch bugs, fish, work part-time, cook, and help locals. Shape the town with your choices and bring this quiet hot spring town back to life.

title: Red Margins
description:
Unseen is an episodic psychological horror game where each episode tells a story about something not everyone will ever see...

The player was an ordinary copy shop worker, everything was going as usual, client after client, photo after photo... over time, the clients became stranger and stranger... at some point, something went wrong.

title: Unseen: Someone
description: Michael, is a 14-year-old teenager living the ordinary life of a game developer. He usually preferred to work at night because he felt the calm and special atmosphere there. At one point, he needed to leave the room at night but it seems that was a mistake...

title: M.O.Q.R. Company
description: M.O.Q.R.Company is a sci-fi management simulation game that pays homage to the computer games of the 80s. Step into your role as president of a demolition company that handles ancient relics as you run your company in a dry, barren world!

title: AE: Archeological Expedition
description: Explore dig sites inspired by real locations, from Petra to Pompeii, and unearth artifacts spanning 10 historical eras. Brush away the centuries, discover the stories behind each find, and fill your journal one careful dig at a time

title: Bas de Beer naar Pirateneiland
description: "Bas the Bear to Pirate Island" was a Dutch educational computer adventure game for children aged 3 to 6.

title: Lost in Fuzz
description: Step back into the 90s with this thrilling modern-retro 2D platformer, bursting with a vibrant vintage aesthetic. Grab your rad snapback, crack open a Sunny D, and dive headfirst into the world of Fuzz!

title: Fallout: Nuclear Sunset
description: Nuclear Sunset (NS) is a complete overhaul of Fallout: New Vegas and Fallout 3, with over 1500 mods focused on modernizing, expanding, rebalancing, and enhancing all aspects of both Wastelands.

title: Runa in Nightmare House
description: One day, the unlucky girl "Runa Ichiya" wakes up in a haunted house.

title: Shatterfarms
description: Farm. Forage. Fight. Shatterfarms is a first-person farmcore roguelike where you'll scavenge and fight through the calamity, while cultivating a mysterious farm to survive and grow stronger. Creatures are untamed, magic unstable, and horrors unimaginable. Welcome to Shatterfarms.

title: My Ransomware Can’t Be This Cute?!
description: Your computer's been hijacked! And now she wants to play a little card-flipping game with you... Read the clues and narrow it down, or just trust your gut and go for broke. Collect cards, level up, and chain together some insane combos. One more flip for the big score? Or cash out while you're safe?

title: World Railway
description: In World Railway, a sim management game, you're a conductor reviving a rundown train. Produce and gather resources via loops, process and manage onboard. A new world unfolds with the wheel's rumble. On your journey, forge bonds and witness the seasons.

title: Hunter White
description: White Hunt is a 2.5D open sandbox co-op hunting game. Every weapon features unique branching attack chains. Mix and match countless talismans to forge your exclusive combat style!

title: Limbo Break
description: A general-audience infinite flow ADV. You will play as Jiang Yuejiao. After being framed and forced to flee to the neighboring country of Dipa, you are drawn into various terrifying worlds, Only by uncovering the hidden truths within these places might you find a way back to the real world.

title: Akizora ni Mau Confetti
description: One autumn day, Hayato met a young girl who was standing with an umbrella in the pouring rain. Picking up the notebook which he thought was hers, his normal life gradually changes. He visits the drama club to look for the owner of the notebook. There he meets various club members: Saya, the girl he met before, who is also a screenwriter; Yuki, his classmate who is an amazing actor; Nanami, his tennen dojikko apartment manager who is also the club leader; and Kanae, a mysterious girl with amnesia who he found collapsed on the roof. He joins the club to help revive it and becomes the lead in the upcoming original play about an urban legend. With each passing day of practice, his monochrome world gradually turns into color.

title: Cosette: The Untitled Game
description: An adventure game that combines escape room challenges, side-scrolling exploration, combat, and text-based gameplay. With nearly 30 different game endings and over 40 original CGs awaiting your discovery.

title: Feathers & All
description:
Miss Nevermore arrives at the country estate of a family friend. Summer has begun to bleed out at the hands of fall, and the city has been buzzing since the hottest of days, about the affairs of house Noblesse. Apparently one of their children has gone missing. They had run away to be with their darling, leaving the next eldest to carry on the burden of their family name. Miss Nevermore has heard the whispers from behind closed doors, however. And rumour has it… That the truth is far more malicious below the neatly smoothed out surface.

The doors creak open.

Time to see if the rumours are true.

title: Dinerz
description:
Dinerz is a diner simulation game, where you manage you own diner.
Cook meals, server customers, clean tables, wash dishes and hire staff, you can play alone or with your friends.

title: Hiveswap: Act 3
description: Joey has survived evil clowns and an explosive train crash, but the only refuge from Alternia's deadly sun is deep underground. Point-and-click your way through ancient ruins, confounding puzzles and the horrors of the dark to help our plucky teen adventurer make it home to Earth in one piece.

title: The Pawn Broker
description: The Pawn Broker is an atmospheric horror economic survival game. Run a cursed pawnshop, analyze every item that comes through for signs of theft or dark curses, and make high-stakes decisions to stay profitable before your five days are up.

title: Bloodwoven
description: From the creator of Blood West comes Bloodwoven - an immersive sim, survival FPS where you hunt, survive and thrive in a world built upon the frozen corpse of a forgotten god. Climb icy peaks, manage resources and temperature while fending off alien ice-age predators and other tribes.

title: GoldenEye 007: Recompiled
description: A native PC port of GoldenEye 007 (Xbox 360/XBLA).

title: Demersus
description: Demersus is a first-person atmospheric walking sim that explores the horrific reality of alcohol addiction through environmental storytelling and puzzles. Navigate the protagonist's fractured psyche, rendered as a beautifully haunting, hand-crafted clay mindscape and see what lies beneath.

title: Fuck's Quest II
description: in this game u play as Fuck and u get to use crappy weapons and talk to horrible NPCs and find the bible crystals and explore my game and find secrets and play further to see what the next part of the game is

title: Blood West: Dead Man's Edition
description: Blood West is a weird‑west stealth FPS that blends Western legends with eldritch horror. Play as the Undead Gunslinger or the Shaman across multiple scenarios, using stealth, perk‑based progression, and an array of weapons to confront supernatural foes in 20+ hours of story‑driven combat and exploration.

title: Trash Day
description: Team up with your raccoon squad in this physics-based co-op adventure. Scavenge trash, fill your stolen shopping cart, and work together to get back home. Live your best raccoon life.

title: Pixel Rain
description:
Pixel Rain is a relaxing falling-sand physics sandbox where every cell on a giant grid obeys its own rules. Pour water, drop sand, ignite lava, grow crystals — then sit back and watch it all interact.

There's no campaign, no fail state, no pressure. Just you, a canvas full of physics-driven pixels, and a lot of satisfying emergent behaviour.

title: Bering Tonnage
description: Build and automate a cargo fleet across over 250 real-world ports in this maritime tycoon. Route ships through strategic canals, navigate tropical cyclones and geopolitical sanctions, and grow a small shipping company into a global logistics empire.

title: Laptop Architect
description: Design laptops from the PCB up and build a global tech empire! Balance complex heat and power mechanics, manage your corporate budget, and conquer international markets. Do you have what it takes to become the ultimate Laptop Architect?

title: Road Defense Racing
description: High-speed vehicular combat racing set in the world of Road Defense: Outsiders. Drive, shoot, destroy, and upgrade your car across 30 challenging tracks. Battle armed rivals and survive attacks from a hostile crowd while earning cash to upgrade your vehicle.

title: GeoFlag
description: A geography game for the curious. Match flags. Place countries. Race the daily challenge. Four game modes covering 154 countries, with two visual themes — vintage parchment or modern aerial — to set the mood.

title: The Blood Mage II
description: The Blood Mage 2 is a turn-based Puzzle/Dungeon Crawler RPG hybrid. You play as a blood mage, so your health doubles as mana pool. Fight against different creatures and explore the environments to reach your goal!

title: Reversi2048
description: Reversi meets 2048. Every time a piece is flipped, its score doubles. Having more pieces isn't enough if your opponent's total score is higher, you lose. A fresh take on a classic strategy game.

title: Tactical Roulette
description: A turn-based roguelite of risk and strategy. Build your deck, survive deadly tournaments, and test your luck against friends or bots in local and online play.

title: Spud Keeper
description: Pick up and smash bugs, upgrade your tools to protect your potato patch from escalating waves of pests!

title: Idle_Directive
description: Idly gather and manage resources to repair what's left of a decaying world. Scavenge forgotten ruins, meet scattered survivors, and push back against the inevitable collapse. Idle_Directive is a grid-based inventory and resource management idle game.

title: Make My Sandwich
description: Make My Sandwich is a cute puzzle game about assembling sandwiches by hand. Read the order cards and drag ingredients onto the board, stacking them carefully layer by layer. Consider your guests' diets and tastes, pick the perfect drink, and follow all order requirements to clear the level!

title: Gray Trading
description: Gray Trading is an incremental game where you buy and sell stocks, trade forex, and dive into other unusual markets. Earn money, unlock upgrades, and conquer every type of trading.

title: TocoToco
description: TocoToco is an addictive platformer where every jump matters. Explore colorful levels, dodge challenging obstacles, and uncover hidden secrets while testing your reflexes. Easy to learn, hard to master.

title: Bravest!
description: The “Braveast” series—a retro RPG from the feature phone era—and its landmark first installment!

title: Double Knight
description: Fight through a dangerous dungeon with an ever-growing army of synchronized doubles in this chaotic roguelike.

title: Scrap Yard Idle
description: Build your own scrap empire in this incremental idle game. Collect, process, and automate your production chain while optimizing resources and scaling your industrial system.

title: Rising Moonshade
description: Rising Moonshade is a turn-based strategy game set in a medieval fantasy world. Lead your squad through ever-changing missions—gather resources, forge equipment, and build tactical playstyles. Under the dual pressure of survival and combat, you must ultimately withstand the Demon King's invasion.

title: The Last of RAM
description: A fast-paced parkour FPS where movement is survival. Break into secure facilities, fight through enemies, and keep moving or die trying.

title: Project Reprieve
description: A fast-paced FNaF-inspired roguelike first person sit 'n' survive, beat the demons and sins back and repent for you and your friends sins!

title: MoeArmy vs. SuArmy
description: MoeArmy vs SuArmy is a 2D auto-battle strategy game. Choose the Moe or Su faction, build structures to deploy formations, combine cards, gear, and commander skills to power up your troops, exploit armor counters in automatic combat, and destroy the enemy base to claim victory!

title: Monster Flipper
description: Monster Flipper is a short incremental game where you buy and level monsters, smash them with a giant hammer for gold, and unlock swords and artifacts to automate your progress.

title: Ibiza Madness: Zombie vs. Demons
description: Ibiza Madness: Zombie vs Demons is an action game where you survive waves of zombies and demons in explosive environments. Fight, collect weapons, and master each level.

title: Gold ’n Goal
description: Gold ’n Goal is an absurd soccer incremental game about scoring ridiculous amounts of goals, earning good € and training your team to be the champions of the universe!

title: Three Kingdoms: Alias
description: A world where officers hide their names and abilities. Can you spot Zhuge Liang? A hardcore turn-based strategy simulation for true Three Kingdoms devotees.

title: Stuck in the Sewers
description: Stuck in the Sewers is a chill puzzle game about finding your way out in a maze of pipes.

title: 25 Days in the Dark
description: The game puts you in the role of a lost child who must survive 25 days in a dangerous, pixelated world full of hostile creatures. Every day is a fight for survival—you must find food by hunting, fishing, or gathering berries. However, even the simplest tasks can be risky.

title: The Blackwood Project
description: You're an agent investigating a distress signal, armed with your trusted flashlight and revolver. Creep through the horror infested darkness of Blackwood Manor to uncover its secrets. A Short and sweet game made by students over a 9 week period

title: Link Lab
description: Connections are all you need to succeed. Link objects together to share and mix traits to create the tools you need to solve each level. Be careful which resource you spend where though, as each one is single use and you might need that piece later!

title: Lost in the Fogbound Deadwood
description: You are already lost. Most will never escape the Deadwood. Dense fog slowly destroys your sense of direction, your confidence, and eventually your mind as you search for keys, resources, and escape routes. Escape within 60 minutes… before the Deadwood consumes you completely.

title: Unlucky Day
description: A clicker game about surviving a day that hates you. Starting with terrible odds, can Mika make it through ten disasters in a row and meet her friend at the bar?

title: ZeroOut
description: Complete puzzles by zeroing out the board! This is achieved by placing the pieces onto the board. Once the piece is placed, the numbers of the affiliated squares on the board will decrease based on the number of the piece. Pieces may need to be rotated or flipped.

title: Florence Mirror
description: Florence Mirror is a dark fantasy Action RPG set in modern Florence, where a hidden mirror dimension unleashes monstrous reflections of human sins. As Leonardo Tornabuoni, fight through 30+ bosses, master arcane powers, and choose between a story-driven path or a brutal Souls-like challenge.

title: Nexus of the Dead God: The Microcosm
description: You will lead a squad—formed solely for the sake of survival—as you continuously push forward across a vast hexagonal map. Recruit companions, adjust your formation, devise tactics, and carve your way out of the Bone-strewn Continent through a series of automatically unfolding battles.

title: Talisman Codes
description: A cyberpunk × fantasy card battle RPG. Build your deck through diverse quests and grow an unstoppable party. Uncover the secrets of the Talisman Code — a mysterious device that summons spirits — in this deep deckbuilding experience.

title: Am I Still Me
description: Dark power makes you stronger — but each bargain erodes your mind. A dark fantasy deckbuilding roguelite where your choices shape both your power and your ending.

title: Railway Routes
description: Guide trains, build tracks, and solve relaxing grid-based railway puzzles. Plan the perfect route across 100+ handcrafted levels and watch your railway come to life.

title: Void Ignition
description: Void Ignition is an atmospheric incremental game tat combines satisfying "number-goes-up" progression with an unraveling sci-fi mystery.

title: Sol One
description: A grounded open-world survival crafting game where you're stranded alone on Mars. Explore the red planet, extract resources, build a pressurized base, manage oxygen, power, and food, and construct the rocket that's your only way home.

title: Chinese Newcomer
description: "Chinese Newcomer" blends deck-building with career simulation. Players choose one of three cards to collect, manage stamina. Use "Legacy Points" to grant Five-Elements talents to descendants, rectifying past regrets. Make choices along paths and embarking on a multi-generational journey.

title: Colorful Slots
description: Colorful Slots is a short incremental game where you play slot machines to achieve increasingly higher scores.

title: A Maze in Labyrinth
description: Get lost... in the labyrinth. Explore the interconnected maze to find the "exit." Race, climb, and slide through the multiple areas, and try solving the mystery of the “Amazing Labyrinth” in the process.

title: Tomb Raider: Agility Skill
description: The Agility skill lets Lara ascend mountain faces more quickly and ensures she lands safely from higher falls (single player upgrade).

title: Tomb Raider: Animal Instinct
description: The Animal instinct skill lights up XP-laden animals in Survival Instinct mode, to help Lara upgrade more quickly (single player upgrade).

title: Touhou Sousenkyou: Land of Oracular Zeitgeist
description:
An extraordinary new entry to the world of Touhou shmup fangames is arriving in 2026!

With the sudden announcement of a "popularity contest" occuring in the Human Village, a variety of maidens—from familiar faces like Reimu Hakurei and Marisa Kirisame to completely new and original characters never seen before—set off to win the contest by battling it out.

But lurking in the shadows behind the curtains of this "popularity royale" lies a mastermind attempting to fix the matches...

A Phantasmagoria-styled versus game, sure to draw in allies, spectators, and even fairies!

title: Mega Man: Revenge of the Fallen
Tomb Raider: Fisherman
description: The stalwart crew Fisherman (multiplayer playable character).

title: Tomb Raider: Headshot Reticule
description: The headshot reticule lets Lara utilize her weapons more accurately. When used with the pistol silencer, it makes for a deadly combination (single player upgrade).

title: CAPTCHA.Exe
description: You are locked inside a small testing room. Your only job is to solve standard CAPTCHA tests by speaking into your microphone. Tell the machine where the fire hydrants and crosswalks are to prove you are human.

title: Tomb Raider: Agency SPS 12
description: The shotgun that Agent 47 uses in Hitman: Absolution (multiplayer weapon).

title: Tomb Raider: HX AP-15
description: The SMG that Agent 47 uses in Hitman: Absolution (multiplayer weapon).

title: Tomb Raider: Silverballer
description: The signature Pistol that Agent 47 uses in Hitman: Absolution (multiplayer weapon).

title: Matilda
description:
You are 5 years old.
Your parents left.
And your sister made a terrible mistake.

title: Tomb Raider: Pistol Burst
description: The three-shot burst pistol upgrade lets Lara unleash a hail of firepower on her foes (single player upgrade).

title: Chronicle of Wuxia & Xianxia Survivors
description: Chronicle of Wuxia & Xianxia Survivors: A roguelite pixel survivors-like integrating card combos and explosive numbers. Choose from dozens of martial & mystical techniques, place and embed your Star Atlas. Grow stronger, face greater challenges. Grow stronger, rise in the Dharma-Ending Age.

title: Tomb Raider: Pistol Silencer
description: The pistol silencer lets Lara use stealthy tactics to overcome even the trickiest of situations (single player upgrade).

title: Tomb Raider: Scavenger Bandit
description: The crafty Scavenger Bandit (multiplayer playable character).

title: The Shackles Holder #735
description: The Shackles Holder #735 is a female-oriented text-based game set in a steampunk world. On November 30, 1875, Police Chief Temis, known for his 100% case clearance rate, was transferred to the crime-ridden city of Nineveh.

title: Tomb Raider: Scavenger Executioner
description: The deadly Scavenger Executioner (multiplayer playable character).

title: Periapsis: Gravity Slingshot
description: Lead humanitys final journey beyond Earth. Launch ships, harness gravity slingshots, and explore distant star systems to make humanity multi-planetary.

title: Chronicles Puzzle: History Path
description: Piece together the shards of time in this historical sliding puzzle game. Experience a journey from the Big Bang to the future through 80 unique levels and 320 challenges. Choose from four difficulties, collect trophies, and unlock the wonders of the world - available in 14 languages.

title: Tomb Raider: Scavenger Scout
description: The wily Scavenger Scout (multiplayer playable character).

title: EULA
description: An image created by AI is it yours? An AI art tool is placed before a nameless illustrator. To accept, or to refuse. A visual novel that tells the same story in different forms. Your choices shape the ending - there is no right answer.

title: Gun Monkey!
description: Help your fellow monkeys escape back to the jungle by gunning your way through obstacles and challenges. Test your skill in a open environment and find your way home! Choose how you want to play, save companions (or don't) and unlock guns that help you traverse the world!

title: Maybe It Meant Something
description: Platformer journeying a nightmare of meaning.

title: Raise: Embrace the Future
description: rAIse: Embrace the Future is a classic style first-person shooter inspired by cyberpunk and the golden age of 90s action games. Battle gangs and megacorporations in intense firefights driven by a brutal soundtrack.

title: Normal Dev Guy: Inside Kenney World
description: Norman is just a regular game dev who jumped inside his own game to test it — and now he must fix bugs in the most unexpected way possible: by playing crazy minigames from within the code!

title: Escape From Ground
description: Endless jumping adventure with procedural levels, power-ups, enemies, and unique biomes.

title: Mechanical Defense Line
description: This is a tower defense, card-based roguelike game. Build and modify your turrets, equip gear to challenge levels and experience the story. Strengthen yourself via various functions, choose talents in battles to win. Get no less than 10 pieces of equipment in every fight.More content awaits in-game

title: Grid Realm
description: A lightweight city-building game with LowPoly style. No complex management or resource systems here—just pure and simple building. Choose your favorite buildings and create your ideal city according to your preferences.

title: Spright
description: Spright is a 2D action-adventure about a lone warrior in a diving helm, drawn into the ruins of a fallen world. Craft weapons, bend spacetime, and fight through hostile environments, survive ambushes, and explore strange realms.

title: Giant Waifu Wash Simulator
description: Clean the city, serve a giant superstar, and shape your relationship in this relaxing power-washing simulator set in a vibrant resort town. No pressure, just satisfying gameplay and choices that matter.

title: Garisani Detective Agency
description: Garisani Detective Agency is a story-driven real-time co-op deduction game for two.In 1990s Korea, play as a brother and his ghost sister, taking cases from the living and the dead. Gather clues from two angles and solve puzzles together.An analog era of pagers and payphones.

title: Iron Wasteland
description: After the bombs fell, civilization collapsed into chaos. Scavenge the ruins of a shattered world, gather vital resources, and fight off hostile enemies determined to claim what little remains.

title: Celestial Reverie
description: Celestial Reverie is the world’s first 3D anime AI life companion. Meet Rei, your always-on desktop parnter powered by Artificial Super Personalization tech, feel her completely independent mind and authentic soul! Say No to insincere flattery, say Yes to true emotion!

title: Smash Dash: Demolition Run
description: Top-down PvE looter shooter. Fight, loot, and survive—extract to keep your items and clear the stage.

title: Eon Empires
description: Create and lead your civilization from the Stone Age to a futuristic era. Shape history on customizable maps through war, diplomacy, culture, trade, science, and religion.

title: Arc Salvo
description: Arc Salvo is a fast-paced online turn-based artillery game featuring explosive team battles, a growing arsenal, and deep character customization.

title: Fenrir
description: The Nine Worlds are crumbling. Fenrir is free. Build your warrior from hundreds of items, master a deep build system, and fight your way through Midgard to Asgard — before the beast devours everything.

title: The Adventures of Hooman
description: A sci-fi comedy graphic novel where you play Hooman, an android too conceded to be scared and too lucky to die. Your crew is going to die but they could have avoided an untimely death if they had only listened to you. You are not the problem.

title: Rocket Man X
description: In this third-person platformer shooter, fight your way through enemies and platform your way through levels. Unlock new armor by finding the hidden boxes, and earn new weapons by beating the bosses.

title: File Tower Defence
description: Defend your desktop from invading viruses! An OS-themed strategic tower defense game where you combine various file extensions to build powerful defense towers.

title: Planet Harvester: Incremental Odyssey
description: Planet Harvester is a relaxing low-poly incremental game. Pilot your crawler across beautiful worlds, chew through resources, unlock new tools, hire drones, and customize your machine for ever bigger hauls. Turn small numbers into massive ones!

title: Lux Anima
description: A relaxing incremental tower defense where your defenses are flowers. Defeat incoming spirits, grow your garden, collect essence, unlock upgrades, and protect the Sacred Core.

title: Dead Color
description: Dead Color is a fast-paced game of agility and reflexes where you control a dummy in freefall through space. Your goal is to survive as many rounds as possible, navigating obstacles and facing the game's central rule: the color of the edge dictates your next action.

title: Level Up, Tiny King!
description: Level Up, Tiny King! is a solo survivors-like auto-shooter platformer. After being kidnapped and thrown into the dungeons, you must fight your way upward. Survive relentless waves of cute enemies while climbing. Grow stronger, recruit magical buddies, and reclaim your throne.

title: Clash of Armadas: Koxinga
description: Tower Defense + Auto Chess + Naval Battle Choose from the legendary captains of the Age of Sail – Blackbeard, Francis Drake, Horatio Nelson, Zheng Chenggong… and more. Command 10+ ships. Position your fleet. Broadside fire. Enemies come in waves on fixed routes.

title: Retro Puzzles: Eviva L'arte
description: A museum inspired jigsaw journey: 225 masterpieces, 45 artists, 9 regions, and three difficulty tiers up to 4160 pieces, plus fact based artist bios and artwork notes.

title: Molluscarium
description: Relax and collect over 500 unique molluscs in this cozy idle game. Watch larvae grow into stunning adults in real-time, customize vibrant aquatic habitats across 9 themed packs, and discover rare species from garden snails to deep-sea cephalopods.

title: U Tsu Tsu Tsu
description: Roam a quiet late-night city in this chill point-and-click adventure. Click anything that catches your eye, check your phone, and reply to viewer comments only if you feel like it. Take your time and enjoy a slow, unhurried night—free from anyone's expectations.

title: Mosaic Garden: The Flower Game
description: A relaxing yet strategic puzzle game where flowers spread and mutate in real time. Shape their growth, clear space, and transform one pattern into the next on a colorful 10×9 grid.

title: Nuktedan: The Forgotten Emotions
description: Rediscover the 7 emotions lost by a bird with Alzheimer's. Every memory is a color, every color is a power.

title: Ember Express
description: Ember Express is a sci-fi light yuri narrative adventure. Step into the role of a junior researcher at megacorporation COSMIC, uncover the truth behind the "Ember" incident, and rekindle a buried memory with your mysterious superior.

title: Meow Box City
description: Meow Box City is a multiplayer, strategy-focused game where, ahead of the upcoming local elections, you build your own lobby against rival parties, thwart your opponents’ plans with devious schemes, and try to boost your popularity in the city by making the right moves at the right time. Collect cards, place your buildings, balance satisfaction–population–revenue… and secure the ballot boxes on election night. Let’s keep this between us: we’re winning...

title: The Legend of the 4 Elements
description: The Legend of the 4 Elements is a platformer with elemental combat. Control heroes of Fire, Water, Earth, and Air, use unique abilities, overcome challenges, battle dangerous enemies, and restore balance to the world of the elements.

title: Reptilarium
description: Relax and collect hundreds of unique reptiles in this cozy idle game. Watch eggs hatch and babies grow in real-time, customize stunning terrariums, and discover rare species from geckos to chameleons.

title: Harold Rabbit 3: The House of Mysteries
description: Harold Rabbit and Maud Bumblebee have been invited to the mansion of Archibald Squirrel, for a great game of wits. Can Harold and Maud solve the riddles and puzzles Archibald Squirrel has prepared for them?

title: GalactiWar: Empire Simulator
description: Watch empires rise and fall, or intervene with godly powers, in GalactiWar, a space empire simulation sandbox game.

title: Tyrania Enforcers
description: Faced with evil... would you pull the trigger? Tyrania Enforcers is a story-driven visual novel exploring morality, duty, and the cost of enforcing order in a world on the brink of conflict.

title: Carol and the Bells: A Cozy Strategy Game
description: Carol and the Bells is a cozy, turn-based strategy roguelike Minesweeper-style game played on a grid. Build a deck to shape what appears on the board, manage risk, and decide when to ring the bell and move on.

title: Storytime Cats: A Day at the Park
description: Storytime Cats – A Day At The Park is a hidden object game where you’ll search for hundreds of hidden cats scattered throughout a cozy park. The only thing they're missing is their favorite hooman. Can you find and pet them all?

title: Moon Garden
description: A cozy incremental game about growing your way home. Strategically plant flowers, optimize machinery, and grow your tree tall enough to escape!

title: Ponder Thy Realm
description: Observe magical environments, memorize your surroundings, detect magical aberrations, and report them before time runs out on the clock and reality unravels in this first-person observation game.

title: Legend of Idle
description: In this incremental game, you must rebuild your kingdom! Gather resources, construct numerous buildings, and set out to conquer everything with your army! A game in the style of the SNES!

title: Fascist
description: As National Guard, stand defiant against relentless hordes. Unleash righteous fury. Old Glory waves eternal and America endures because YOU fight!
