title: Phantacall Realm
description: A unique game that deeply fuses the “Phantacall Realm” card-matching mechanic with RPG. By flipping cards to looting treasures, and synthesizing cards. Your gift of memory may grant you fortune, but true progress comes from mastering skills, wielding relics, and relying on strategy.

title: Peter The Stash Hunter
description: A business sim + looting + strategy hybrid. Outbid rival hunters at storage auctions, ransack what you win, then run the shop that bankrolls Peter's search for his missing grandfather. Sabotage cards, Dutch vs English bidding, harpoon chases. Every box could hide a secret.

title: Kevin's In Trouble
description: Kevin’s In Trouble is a top-down roguelite deckbuilding bullet heaven where you'll battle through unrelenting waves of enemies while building a deck of powerful weapons and perks to survive the gauntlet, defeat the bosses, and escape!

title: J.League Pro Soccer Club wo Tsukurou!
Isekai Bistro
description: The lively Isekai Bistro is always filled with laughter and surprises. Here, every race and species gathers under one roof to share fine wine, delicious food, and unforgettable memories. Get ready to meet a colorful cast of monster babes and uncover the heartfelt stories behind each and every one!

title: Aromantic Confession
description:
Two friends reconnect after one spent a few months abroad. One is looking to hang out, but the other fell in love and is looking to confess...

Aromantic Confession is a dating sim that explores the aromantic experience during a love confession. Think about it: one person stammers out a few words while caught up in a swell of emotion, and the other doesn't understand that experience at any level.

title: Pro Soccer Club wo Tsukurou! Online
Pro Soccer Club wo Tsukurou! Online 2
J.League Pro Soccer Club wo Tsukurou! Online
Character Limit
description: A fast-paced word game where the more letters you have, the less time remains to make a word.

title: Stationbreak
description: A grounded sci-fi station builder where you hold failing systems together while pursued by a relentless, energy-hungry swarm. As a fleet on the run, drop into hostile systems, gather what you can, and jump away before you are overwhelmed. Try to survive long enough to secure a future for humanity.

title: Poumosa
description: POUMOSA is an indie Point And Click adventure game. Discover the people of an unknown island. Study their language, their history, their culture or make your trip profitable... It's up to you!

title: Poem of the Starherd
description: A relaxing farming simulation game where you take care of humanoid spirits in a mysterious world. Grow crops, raise spirits (animals), live together with someone you love, and enjoy fun-filled days with a variety of approaches!

title: Alice and the Devil's Prison
description: Escape adventure game. During a tea party, Alice and her friends become trapped in a world created by demons. Will they be able to escape this twisted realm safely?

title: Left Fore Dead: Zombie Battle Golf
description: A chaotic multiplayer golf game where zombies keep showing up and your friends make everything worse.

title: Next Reign: Kingdom
description: Medieval incremental kingdom builder combining city building, resource management, automation and auto-battler combat.

title: NowLoading Forever
description: Can you actually “play” this game!? Before you can play "FINAL TALES QUEST", you must first load the game data.

title: Industronaut
description:
Industronaut is a first-person survival engineering game set on a hostile, radiation-heavy planet.

You were left behind after a failed evacuation. Alone on the surface, you must build a sealed habitat, produce oxygen, water, and food, mine raw resources, and turn them into the systems that keep you alive.

Expand from a small survival shelter into an industrial base. Process resources through production chains, unlock new machines, manage power, storage, and logistics, and use drones to scan for ore deposits and move materials between machines and storage.

There is no combat and no rescue waiting for you. Survival depends on engineering, automation, and your ability to keep the base running.

title: Reactor Critical
description: High-stakes starship combat on a hex grid. Outmaneuver your enemies, unleash devastating firepower, or swarm their capital ships with fighter squadrons. Every decision counts.

title: Labyrinth of the Crystal Princess
description: A horror adventure that tasks you with detecting the Unseen to escape the facility's labyrinths alive.

title: Ah. Ah. Ah.
description: A wholesome voice-input action game that can be cleared in about 15 minutes.

title: False Alarm
description: False Alarm is a 2D stealth adventure where you enter each level with nothing, and use whatever you can find to complete your mission. Throw a crowbar, blow up a microwave, brew some coffee, drop a chandelier on someone's head. Stay out of the light and distract your enemies however you can.

title: Dig Raiders: Anomaly Extraction
description: DIG Raiders: Anomaly Extraction is a co-op digging sim where you and your crew burrow through 10+ layers of the unknown—team up to uncover the truth, battle rivals, and race to secure alien gems. Dig deep. Extract the anomaly. Get out alive!

title: Travelling Home: Ever After
description: Get your very own moving castle! Travelling Home: Ever After is a cozy background app combined with productivity tools. Journey through a charming world in a cozy house built on a train.Perfect for studying, working, creating, or simply drifting off to sleep.

title: At Night : Freakshow
description: You are not here to watch the Freakshow. You are one of its acts. A freak. Pretend to be mute, speak through your parrot, train with freaks, learn their ways, and participate in the Freakshow to deliver a spectacular performance they will never forget.

title: Quiet Bruise
description: Play as dumb plushies trying to keep a collapsing factory alive in this tower defence factory automation game. Build chaotic production lines, fight off hordes of cats and crocs, survive your own terrible decisions and keep the factory running.

title: Chesscent
description: Chesscent is a pixel art turn-based strategy roguelite that blends classic chess with rule-breaking cards. Face impossible rivals, embrace defeat, and unlock new permanent abilities to change the outcome of the match.

title: MLF: Pro Catch
description:
The official Major League Fishing game, a fishing sim you can play solo or online with friends. Cast, troll, and feel every fish fight back as you control the drag, manage line tension, and read each run and dive to land your catch. Reel in over 50 species, from Largemouth bass and Rainbow trout to Muskellunge, Alligator gar, and sharks, each with its own model, habitat, and behavior.

Explore six diverse waters, including Shadow Lake, the Everglades, the Florida Keys, and Lake Whitney, all with a full day-night cycle and shifting weather. Fish from shore, docks, or boat, and gear up with tackle from real brands like Mossy Oak, YETI, Abu Garcia, and Berkley. Compete in tournaments, climb the leaderboards, and chase your personal-best trophies.

title: Hamster, Eat, Run
description: This is a casual strategy game about being a hamster on your first escape. To survive out there, you must learn to efficiently gather energy from food and upgrade hoarding level to gain new survival tricks. Fail, you'll have no choice but to be a house pet again!

title: Mihashira
description: A 2D top-down arena shooter. A freely scrolling shooter. Pixel graphics reminiscent of the SNES. Easy to control with the directional pad, two shot buttons, and a bomb button. Make full use of your two shots to smash through enemies.

title: Bunderkin: The Ocular Eclipse
description: Trapped in a 3day time loop, you must master each moment and live the perfect day or watch the town that despises you fall into darkness.

title: Bojan
description: You think you have it bad? Try getting thrown into a quest with nothing to protect yourself, except your wits! In this trial and error adventure game, patience is key. Explore the castle including 6* bosses and 18 levels complete with their own layouts, enemy paths, buttons, doors and coins!

title: Block Sprawl
description: A spatial puzzle strategy game where cards create building shapes. Fit them into tight, constrained grids, expand your city, and use cards to bend rules and unlock actions. Min-max adjacency, terrain, and line bonuses to meet ever-increasing city council demands and engineer massive combo turns.

title: Money Trails
description: Become a billionaire as you venture out in your limousine. Decide what to buy and build to grow your endless procedurally generated island. Add up your money, incrementally increase your passive income and receive random alerts on your Personal Digital Assistant while you travel.

title: MeltyFlow: A Cozy Desktop Lava Lamp
description: A cozy desktop lava lamp you can shape, touch, and customize. Watch glowing liquid melt and flow, nudge it like a digital fidget, and use timers and a minimalistic to-do list to support focus while adding warm ambience to your workspace.

title: Golod
description: Golod is an atmospheric visual novel about survival in the pixel-art style, where you will have to fight not only with a lack of food, but also with panic, suffocating idleness, secrets of the past, betrayal and difficult moral choices in a confined space.

title: Koko's Cafe
description: Serve coffee and befriend customers as you learn their story in this coming-of-age visual novel.

title: Valehona Tap!
description: Tap your way through Valehona Tap! A 2D pixel tap and idle game, Impress your friends with high Prestige Levels and Goons Slain. Can you reach the boss?

title: Medic Mayhem
description: Toy soldiers fight on chaotic battlefields and you're the medic! Four player local coop with friends and bots. Win the war by saving lives!

title: Resurface
description: Escape the ocean depths in this casual incremental mining game. Mine, upgrade, and explore biomes as your strength grows to crazy proportions!

title: God, Save the Queens!
description: You are God. The king’s five daughters have been taken. Fight thousands of enemies, unlock powerful skills, and crush the evil wizard Zaharad in this brutal 2.5D roguelike!

title: Total Football Online
description: Build your All-Star lineup in Total Football Online! Easy to pick up, it lets you dive into pure football fun at your fingertips. With events and player updates syncing with real-world tournaments, get ready for a truly immersive football experience.

title: Galactic Bounty
description: Play as a droid bounty hunter for hire. Accept contracts, deploy into dangerous locations, eliminate targets, break into secure systems, and get paid. Spend your rewards on weapons, gear and software upgrades for your droid.

title: Pandora's Sack
description: Pandora's Sack is a deck builder roguelite auto battler where the players use a slot machine system to create a ridiculously silly army to fight Pandora's minions.

title: Mikane's Hand
description: A girl's card battle world — where you witness the turmoil of youth. What is this place?

title: Wanderers' Outpost
description: A Colony-Sim in a dungeonpunk-fantasy world where you build outpost near ancient ruins, support adventurers, and tax their loot. Expand your outpost, survive waves of dungeon-born monsters, and ultimately conquer the depths before they consume the outpost.

title: Castles & Castellans
description: Castles & Castellans is a hybrid of real-time strategy and third-person action. Rule from the castle-building RTS view - construct, manage, and fortify against looming threats. Then step into the castellan’s boots in TPP, fighting side by side with your soldiers atop the very walls you built.

title: Beneath their Names
description: You are a scholarship student at the secluded Veir Academy. Two heroines. Nora or Lika? Trust or distance? Submit to the system — or break it? An introspective visual novel about tension, closeness, and silent choices.

title: Walrus Fly
description: Walrus Fly is an endless on-rails flying game, where you fly through rings! Enjoy combat-free flying, and use resources carefully to hold onto your Ring Streak. Go for as long as you can, but lose your HP and it's game over!

title: Landscaper Simulator
description: Lawns are wild. Parks are buried in weeds. Streets are littered. The world needs a hero, and that’s where you come in. As the Landscaper, it’s your job to turn disorder into beauty. With your weed whacker, pressure washer, and trash vacuum, you’ll trim, wash, and restore every space to perfection.

title: Escape the Marine Lab
description: Your first day as a new hire at a marine laboratory begins on the boat that takes you to the lab

title: Magical Girl Yusya-chan and the Labyrinth of Lust
description: Everyone's favorite idol "Yusha-chan" stars in a new turn-based roguelike! Conquer deep dungeons, grow stronger, and seize victory, or taste a brutal defeat! Guide Yusha-chan, brought to life with fluid Live2D animations, to her destiny. Streamers welcome!

title: Robot Reckoning
description: This is a hardcore physics-action game that rewards skillful maneuvering and tactical thinking with satisfying, robot-smashing action! Survive long enough to learn about secret AI society, and discover the truth behind the Robot Reckoning.

title: Forgotten Trails
description:
Survive alone in a silent, abandoned world.

Humanity is gone. No cities, no voices — only endless forests, cold winds, and the distant howl of wolves.

How long can you last when the world no longer cares if you live or die?

Forgotten Trails is a hardcore survival experience focused on solitude, exploration, and true wilderness survival.

title: PawRebuild
description: Five animal friends turn messy ruins into a cozy haven by matching identical items. It features 10 scenes with 5 renovation stages for each, adopts a distinctive cardboard art style, has no time limits or penalty mechanics, and allows you to unlock all achievements effortlessly.

title: Stickman 3D Wingsuit: Deluxe
description: You are a stickman wingsuit pilot! Fly through beautiful 3D levels and avoid deadly lava, spikes and saw blades. Remember to open up your parachute! Skydiving as a stick man has never been so bloody and deadly! Gorgeous 3D levels! People will say this is the best wingsuit game with stickmen!

title: FZDDR
description: A silly side-scrolling arcade game where you play as a flying demonic zombie dinosaur with a chainsaw for a tail. Dodge obstacles, collect coins and cut demons in half. How long will you resist in this madness?

title: Hunt Asylum Together
description: Hunt Asylum Together is a 1-4 player co-op horror action game. Use your radar to find hidden cursed books inside an abandoned asylum, fight terrifying enemies with weapons and melee attacks, and work together to break the curse. But be careful — the past is still alive inside these walls.

title: Fragments of Fear
description: A VHS found-footage horror anthology where everyday chores become your worst nightmares. Experience a growing collection of bite-sized analog horror episodes, from a late-night trip to the laundromat to a terrifying walk home. Can you survive the mundane?

title: Jurassic World Evolution 3: Deluxe Edition
description: Build your own Jurassic World like never before. Nurture generations of awe-inspiring dinosaurs with the series debut of juveniles, create and manage sprawling prehistoric parks around the globe, and let your imagination roar with powerful new creative options.

title: Electric Sheep
description: Dredge the memories of an old Butler Robot to piece the past together and solve a Murder at a family home.

title: A.C.I.T. Soup
description: A small SOUP-like where you explore the subconscious of a girl name Ube.

title: Deep Soup
description:
Deep Soup is a surreal, soup-like exploration game.

Each room contains one unique object. When you get close to it, you can interact to move on to the next room.

A credits text file is included in the game folder.

title: Portrait Painter
description: Paint portraits to help a struggling art museum in this relaxing painting game.

title: Not a Customer
description: Good job! you just got hired at your local grocery store and have to serve customer, it's simple as it sounds but theres a twist, make sure you serve real humans and not dopplegangers or it might be your last shift...

title: Forensics: Crime Scene Detective
description: Become a forensic specialist in a realistic crime lab simulator. Investigate crime scenes, collect microscopic evidence, and identify perpetrators in the lab using DNA and digital analysis. Based on the experience and insights of experts from the State Criminal Police Office Rhineland-Palatinate.

title: Too Hot to Be True
description: “Finding a wife in a week? Are you for real?!" Your parents are visiting next week, and they expect you to show up with a bride. With only days left, your only hope may be the five gorgeous women staying at your seaside guesthouse. As feelings shift fast, who will you choose?

title: Power of Seasons
description: Power of Seasons is a single-player ARPG game with a fantasy theme developed by Shanghai Danju Game Studio. It is set in a fictional world based on the Spring and Autumn Period of China. It tells the story of the struggle between the Huai Kingdom and the Min Kingdom. After the defeat of the Min Kingdom, the general Ling Gufu and his entire family were slaughtered. His son, Ling Gucong, grows up and goes on adventures in the chaotic world to avenge his country and family.

title: Untold Stories 01: Goliath
description: Welcome to Untold Stories. This is where I post my CTM maps. (Complete The Monument) The objective is to finish the Monument by placing different colored wools and other material blocks on it. You find these wool blocks scattered around the map. The material blocks are iron, gold and diamond blocks. You may craft these blocks for the monument, But you are not allowed to craft the wool blocks.

title: Overwatch: Reign of Talon - Season 3: Into the Tigers Den
description:
Are you ready to step Into the Tiger’s Den?

A new chapter in the Reign of Talon starts here with the arrival of our newest Damage Hero, Shion. As the Hashimoto Clan’s most terrifying elder, Shion brings a dangerous new arsenal to the battlefield with her dual semi-auto pistols and a motorcycle she can crash into her enemies.

Battle through the streets of Tokyo in the all-new Hybrid Map, Neon Junction, filled with nods to Japanese culture and easter eggs around every corner. Tokyo also comes to life in our new Anima Strike Meta Event where you earn new rewards based on which path you choose to go down.

That’s not all though! Unlock brand new cosmetics through the Season 3 Battle Pass and in the Shop like Illari’s Ascendant Phoenix Mythic Hero Skin, Hanzo’s Tokyo Rebel Mythic Weapon Skin, new Ultra Skins with added VFX, new skins as part of our upcoming YOASOBI collaboration, and much more.

title: Cart by Cart
description: Run your own cozy supermarket. Buy shelves and products, stock your store, open for customers, and scan items at checkout. Handle cash or card payments, give correct change and grow your business day by day.

title: Cook with Card
description: Run your own cozy restaurant, prepare orders and create efficient kitchen workflows using your cards in this relaxing cooking management game.

title: Horse Magic
description: Horse Magic is a choice-driven visual novel about Kaiah and her roommate Iris, whose bond is tested by a surreal event. Navigate love, identity, and forbidden desire through branching choices, emotional drama, and futa-themed intimacy.

title: Four Lights
description: This story is of God and us and our grand revenge against Lucifer.

title: Rogue Company: Season 10 - Eternal Conflict
description: Season 10, based on the theme of Mysticism, was the tenth season of Rogue Company. It started on February 28, 2023 and ended on April 18, 2023, lasting for 50 days.

title: Ferrum
description:
FERRUM is a award winning, student developed, 10 week Souls-like Boss Fighting prototype made for a university course.

"Enter a world dominated by ruin and brutality, where humanity has achieved biological immortality, at the cost of their humanity. These creatures are fused together with iron components, trying to stop the stop the spread of rampant mutations. As societies fell and civilizations ceased, as people lost control, the only goal left was to get energy for another day, at any cost."

Play as an amalgamation trying to survive, and consume your way up a Sun cult mountain, and assimilate the leader.

title: Amen: The Quiet Exodus
description: Cursed the womb that bears emptiness beneath its heart. For the child enters the world with the veil upon its face, yet its soul wanders lone in the heavens where God is not. Why then does she not hasten to the place that was prepared for her? Seek the truth in our visual novel.

title: Boopie Island
description: Build a cozy colony for your Boopies! Keep them happy with swings, flowers, and plenty of cozy surprises — and watch your little village grow.

title: Seeding The Wasteland
description:
Feeling like doing some gardening? Head to the planet Tau to relax with this narrative-driven plant management game!

You'll play as a small robot named Orchid, tasked with cultivating various plants to bring the planet back to life!

You'll have your ship, charging stations, and your trusty tools at your disposal. Aboard the Internode, your shuttle, you'll navigate across a desolate land to reach Demeter, a mysterious robotic entity.

title: The Black Shift
description: In this AI-powered thriller, your phone is the gateway to a dark past. As a mine chief, you receive messages from a mysterious stranger demanding you put your workers in danger in exchange for uncovering forgotten historical secrets. Who will pay the price for the truth?

title: Shoot Together
description: Run non-stop and blast everything in your way! SINGLE-PLAYER: Level up, fight bosses, and unlock permanent upgrades. PVP MODE: Make split-second roguelike choices mid-run to leave your friend behind and claim the top spot on the leaderboards!

title: Wheelchair for Two
description: Start a chaotic co-op adventure in one wheelchair. Two players control different sides of the chair and must work together to survive brutal obstacles, dangerous jumps, and physics-based challenges. Play solo, local co-op, or online with a friend — one small mistake can send you both falling down.

title: Cat Mail Co.
description: Run a cozy cat post office. Sort and deliver parcels from the daily boat, organizing everything your way. At night, the moon reveals hidden truths about packages. Clear a strange backlog, help locals, and unlock new abilities and destinations.

title: Masuku
description: An abstract strategy game for 1–4 players. Place, rotate, and flip cards to reveal colours and symbols that match shifting scoring goals. Smart positioning and a bit of luck decide who reaches 50 points first

title: CyberDeck: The Cyberpunk Roguelike Deckbuilder
description:
A Fast Cyberpunk Deckbuilder Where Every Run Plays Differently
CyberDeck is a roguelike deckbuilder about making sharp decisions under pressure. Choose your route, draft new cards, install powerful chrome, adapt to random enemies, and build a deck that can survive the city.

Every run starts a new puzzle. The map, rewards, enemies, and upgrade paths change each time you play.

title: Paradise Sea
description: Where are we? But the destination is clear. In this sea of trees, my final home, there must be a paradise. Who am I? But my purpose is clear. The noise that wanders in the deep consciousness, seeking the peace that lies beyond.

title: The Planetary Archive
description: The Planetary Archive is a retro space survival game about grief. Explore the galaxy, maintain your space station, scavenge for replacement parts, and start to understand why you're out here.

title: Forgotten Fluff
description: Forgotten Fluff is a mysterious escape the room game set inside an abandoned circus. Solve puzzles, help trapped animals and slowly uncover the truth about the strange place you've awakened in. Can you escape?

title: Tyrants Must Fall
description: Build your rebel army and lead them to victory over the Tyrant King in this turn-based tactical roguelike. Improve your leader's skills, unlock new units, and hone your battlefield strategy as you march towards your fate as the Hero of Destiny.

title: JumpStart Adventures 4th Grade: Sapphire Falls
description: JumpStart Adventures 4th Grade: Sapphire Falls is a JumpStart game that was released by Knowledge Adventure in 1999, replacing JumpStart Adventures 4th Grade: Haunted Island. It is intended to teach a full fourth grade curriculum.

title: Red Flag
description:
You find yourself seated at a table with other survivors (from 6 to 12 players).

Each player has hidden information about themselves – their pre-catastrophe profession, skills, phobias, and more.

Over the course of several rounds, players take turns revealing information about themselves, discussing, arguing, and trying to convince the others that they are the ones who deserve to remain in the shelter.

title: Socialiskigrad
description: Welcome to the Republic of Socialiskigrad, a budding nation to shape with bags of cement! Build working-class districts, develop national industry, and govern the metropolises of each region. Only you can become the shining President the country deserves!

title: Flora Parasocial
description: Audiences connect to their favorite celebrities all the time. How does it affect these people when put into a game of life or death? Only time will tell.

title: The Social Grip: Llama Drama
description: The Social Grip: Llama Drama offers an immersive, second-person experience where strategy and quick-thinking are critical. Will you be able to guide Dan the Llama safely through Trig's offices?

title: Schedule Store Simulator
description: Rise from a small-time drug dealer to a feared kingpin as you manufacture and distribute narcotics across the gritty underbelly of Tokyo. Grow your empire by acquiring properties, running businesses, hiring employees, and dominating the streets.

title: Switch Shapes
description: A rhythm and reflex game where thinking means death. Switch shapes, dodge obstacles, and immerse yourself in a cyberpunk audiovisual experience powered by dynamic music that evolves with your performance.

title: Ghost of Tokyo
description: Ghost of Tokyo — a choice-driven visual novel about identity, temptation, and unseen power in the heart of the world’s most electrifying city.

title: The Lost Land of Bahía Blanca
description: In this visual novel with RPG elements, you leave your exile to venture directly into the jaws of a bloodthirsty vampiric regime in search of a past that won't stop calling out to you. A game inspired in the horrors of Argentina's last civil–military dictatorship.

title: Beneath Paris
description:
Beneath Paris is an atmospheric first person horror experience that takes players into the depths of the forbidden French Catacombs. What begins as a desperate search quickly turns into a descent into darkness, where the tunnels stretch further than they should and the silence never truly feels empty.

Descend into the forbidden French Catacombs in this atmospheric first person horror experience. Explore restricted tunnels, uncover hidden secrets, and venture deeper into forgotten passages where the further you go, the more it feels like something is down there with you.

title: Aghia
description: The Dark Voievode has unleashed his beasts to violate your homeland. Eradicate these creatures from the face of the Earth as you make your way across the country in this '90s-inspired FPS.

title: Cozy Twinkie
description: Help Twinkie maintain her proper orgasm rhythm in a series of naughty minigames.

title: Maze 95 Ultimate
description: The maze that hypnotized a generation is back. It was a screensaver. But now? You can finally walk those halls yourself. Or just relax and watch, like the old times.

title: Zenless Zone Zero: Update 3.0 - A Sleepwalker's Confession
description:
Marking the start of Zenless Zone Zero's Season 3, Version 3.0 includes:
• New Characters: Velina, Norma and Pyrois
• New Main Story Quest: A Sleepwalker's Confession
• New region: Roscaelifer
• New gameplay mechanics, events, and anniversary celebrations
• ...and more!

title: There Is No Fangame
description: "There Is No Fangame" is a fangame of the popular Point&Click comedy adventure game "There Is No Game: Wrong Dimension" made by Pascal Cammisotto and his fantastic team "Draw Me A Pixel".

title: Raiders 1941
description: Raiders 1941 is a fast-paced, vertical scrolling shoot ‘em up that blends exciting retro action of arcade classics, with modern gameplay up to 120hz refresh rate.

title: Moony Mayhem: Cheeks Unleashed
description: Moony Mayhem: Cheeks Unleashed is a goofy 3D puzzle-platformer where your greatest asset is your backside. Solve lateral thinking puzzles to complete your Civic Disturbance Duty.

title: Vape Store Miami
description: Run your own retro Miami vape shop in this 1–4 player co-op simulator. Stock shelves, serve customers, craft custom e-liquids, handle phone and online orders, grow your reputation, and expand the business.

title: Don't Get Fired!
description: The company is going under and corporate has made YOU the office manager. Turn things around quick or everyone's doomed. Run the office, keep employees productive, and avoid disasters. Muscle through the workday or automate the grind. Play solo or with friends — just Don't Get Fired!

title: Uncracked
description: Crack your enemies with an arsenal of weapons and various tactics in this 2D egg-splosive, gore-filled, yet kid-friendly action platformer, teeming with splattering yolk and shattering eggshels and survive the fierce cage wars.

title: Fairy Springs
description: You are a magical Fairy tasked with your first assignment: aid the critters of the glen through the seasons of a year. Take your time getting to know the valley's inhabitants in this cozy little adventure. Every day has a new task to complete with each animal neighbor having something fresh to say.

title: Tsubasa Heaven
description:
One night, high school teacher Kuzuki happens to meet his student, Haneishi, at a convenience store.
He goes to dinner with her and keeps it a secret from his pregnant wife and everyone at school... Will that act send him to heaven or hell?

title: Dirty Laundry
description: Unable to hold down a job, Emily tries her luck on the night shift at a local laundromat. However, what starts as an ordinary job quickly turns into a nightmare as bizarre customers arrive, and the dark secrets of one particularly suspicious nightly visitor change her life forever.

title: PawMart Tiny Market
description: Build and manage a cozy idle supermarket run by cute animals at the bottom of your screen. Produce goods, stock shelves, automate your store, hire employees and expand your tiny market.

title: Pixel Gun 2
description: Fast-paced multiplayer shooter with destructible arenas, wild builds, and matches that never play the same. Break the map, adapt on the fly, and outplay your opponents in short, chaotic PvP battles.

title: State Z
description: State Z is a post-apocalyptic open-world survival game where you'll have to survive threats from human NPCs, zombies, other players, and your own needs, all within a 64 km² map with 100% exploration. Build your own base, hunt, gather resources, cultivate a farm, maintain vehicles, and trade with communities for rewards. The choice is yours: join your friends, trust strangers, or be alone wolf. It's all in your hands.

title: Proxima
description: In the shadow of Europa, a top secret research station run by mega-corporation Artemis falls to alien chaos. Scavenge, explore, and interact with a fully reactive and physics-driven world as you meet other crew members, and fight, sneak, or puzzle-solve your way to survival – and uncover the truth.

title: Un Petit Noel
description: Help Nanna make the most of the first Christmas she's going to spend alone!

title: Ember Seeker
description: An atmospheric exploration game set in a Dark Fantasy world. Explore the ruins of an ancient civilisation and uncover it's forgotten past through a short nonlinear story with timeless retro graphics.

title: TankFall Arena
description: TankFall Arena is a fast-paced top-down tank combat game where precision, ricochets, and weapon mastery decide every battle. Fight solo or with a friend, adapt to changing arenas, and outmaneuver opponents using unique weapons and environmental strategy.

title: Kingdoms vs. Zombies
description: Kingdoms vs Zombies is a blend of strategy, tower defense, and roguelike gameplay, where you must defend your kingdom against endless hordes of the undead.

title: Kirilma: Helix Horizon
description: Explore a dystopian sci-fi world in KIRILMA: Helix Horizon, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover the truth behind a collapsed world.

title: Dark Stream
description:
A desperate livestream. A house that shouldn’t be entered. A Twitch chat that won’t stay quiet. Survive the subathon as a disgraced creator, as the haunting awakens and your audience decides your fate.

In Dark Stream, you play a fearless content creator chasing clout by livestreaming from a house rumored to be haunted for decades. But this isn’t just exploration, you’re stepping directly into active paranormal events. Armed with your laptop, a flickering flashlight, and a live chat feed, you’ll push deeper into the house, uncover its violent past, and survive the encounters that react to you.

title: VeilStalker
description: A solo and co-op fantasy survival game where you as modern hunter is trapped in a brutal magical realm. Build bases, scavenge scarce ammunition, hunt legendary creatures, and survive against giant monsters, haunting undead and unforgiving environments.

title: Cozy Tide
description: A cozy fishing and island-building game where you catch strange fish, expand your tiny island, decorate postcard islands, complete daily voyages, and collect your way through a cheerful ocean world.

title: Rampallians
description: In Rampallians you build a deck of 40 cards from the nearly 400 cards in the game. It is a PvP where you play gatherers to get the resources to play your other cards and build your settlement. The first decision you make each game is your faction.

title: Pogopa
description: In this funny & unconventional physics-based platformer, you help Grandpa conquer a treacherous mountain to rescue his granddaughter. Master the Pogo3000 and Grandma’s Balloon Helmet to reach the summit!

title: Aurule Dynasty
description: Discover hidden secrets. Delve into dungeons. Solve puzzles. Find ancient relics to vanquish bosses. Unravel the mysteries of the Kingdom of Aurule and its talkative denizens in this Zelda-like adventure.

title: Darkness Has Eyes
description: Survive the dark in this tense atmospheric horror game. Face your fears and explore abandoned floors while searching for key items to escape the dark.

title: Monster Shop Simulator
description: Build and manage your own monster shop. Stock magical eggs, hatch and collect monsters, set your prices, hire employees, host monster cage events, and grow your business.

title: The Disappearance of Emily Crowe
description: A first-person psychological horror game where you explore, hide, and evade entities with unique behaviors while using your real phone to detect and exorcise nearby threats, as you uncover what happened to your missing sister.

title: The Furry Protocol
description: Survive and escape from the scientific research complex in the Siberian forests and uncover the secrets of the corporation that built this complex.

title: Dream Riders
description: Dream Riders is a fast-paced 2.5D auto runner driving sim set in a hand-drawn dreampop pixel world.

title: Harlequinade
description: Harlequinade is a horror otome romance visual novel about a never-ending carnival and a very death-prone college student. With the aid of 2 clowns, can you escape this timeloop?

title: Salt & Soul: Pocket Chef's Adventure
description: Awaken as a fragile porcelain salt shaker in a colossal, shadowy kitchen. Guided by your grandmother’s spirit, retrieve the key ingredient and master manual cooking mechanics to revive lost recipes. In this atmospheric adventure, every jump is a risk, and every dish tells a story.

title: Love All My Girls
description: What would you do with infinite resurrection and time travel? Predict the future, save the world, get rich overnight… or date six girls at once? You’ve lived every man’s dream but stepped into a fatal trap. You’re just trying to make them all happy—what’s wrong with that?

title: Dumb Dunks
description: Dumb Dunks! is a wildly creative, satirical twist on basketball where every level throws a ridiculous new object and target at you. Master tricky physics, perfect your timing, and embrace the chaos in this humorous physics-based dunking frenzy.

title: Death's Life 2
description: A physics-based puzzle game where you play as Death, creating “accidental” deaths through chain reactions. Solve scenarios in multiple ways or survive and escape from deadly trap-filled environments.

title: Pokémon Nova
description: An open-world widescreen fangame set in the Ultra Megalopolis from Pokémon Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon! Explore the Ultra Space in an adventure focused on story, puzzles, and exploration! Become a member of the Ultra Recon Squad and help recover the stolen light from Necrozma!

title: It's Chopping Time!: Gold Edition
description: Supporter Pack, which lets you pimp in gold the appearance of the game! (This DLC is purely cosmetic)

title: Jolly and Whimsy
description: 'Jolly & Whimsy' is a short, experimental picture-book style visual novel. When her best friend, Whimsy the cat, suddenly returns to the Cat Planet, Jolly will try any spell to bring him back.

title: Fortifend
description: Fortifend is a fantasy city builder with a mix of resource management and strategic tower defense. As Lord Mayor, build your settlement into a fortified city capable of fending off waves of demonic invaders. Guard the gates!

title: Minecraft: Chaos Cubed
description: Chaos Cubed is Minecraft's secong game drop of 2026. It introduces the Sulfur Caves, a new underground biome featuring sulfur, cinnabar, and the Sulfur Cube, a new mob capable of absorbing nearby blocks and taking on their properties. This drop also adds geysers, sulfur and cinnabar block sets, and a friend list.

title: Mortal Kombat 11: Klassic Cassie
description: Play as Klassic Cassie, a playable Cassie Cage skin inspired by Klassic Mortal Kombat costumes.

title: Water You Doing?
description: Your ride is dead, and rough waters lie ahead! Survive aboard a musty boat in a totally chaotic co-op. Collect scrap, patch up leaks, swap your catch for cold brews, and use harpoons to break the laws of physics!

title: Mortal Kombat 11: Ninja Mime Johnny Cage
description: Players who purchase the Mortal Kombat 11 Kombat Pack receive this exclusive playable Johnny Cage Skin. Ninja Mime, one of actor Johnny Cage's most iconic roles, is legendary in the Mortal Kombat Universe. Ninja Mime Johnny Cage - Silent. But Deadly!

title: Salty's Garbage
description: A clown themed point and click game.

title: Hariti
description: "Hariti" is a first-person psychological horror game. You will play as a mother searching for her missing daughter in a crisis-ridden hospital. Experience an atmosphere of extreme dread within the halls of this abandoned Chinese-style medical facility.

title: Crococo
description: An urban legend says there are alligators living in the sewers of New York. Go down there and see for yourself. A 90s-style comedy horror game featuring classic single-voice VHS dubbing.

title: Peerless Beauty Detective: Alice
description: A murder occurred at the Ai Qing Apartment. The female owner of Apartment 1802 died strangely. There was no struggle, no signs of a fight. Why did she die at night? Why wasn't the male owner at home? All the mysteries await the detective: Alice to solve. There is only one truth, let's find it!

title: Tavern Timer
description: Welcome to your Tavern! A cozy focus tool where you pick a keeper to run the tavern while you work. Customize from floor to fireplace with 200+ items. Pomodoro, custom timers, and to-do list included. Productivity has never felt so magical!

title: Operation Stutter
description: In this psychological horror set deep within a top‑secret Cold War research bunker, fear takes form in shadows. Aim your film‑camera and watch reality shift. Solve mind‑bending puzzles, and confront both the specter of global conflict and the creatures lurking in your psyche.

title: Craft & Deliver
description: Run your own cozy garage workshop—craft handmade products, prepare customer orders, and deliver them to your neighbors while growing your small business.

title: Universal Harvest: Incremental
description: Universal Harvest: Incremental is a relaxing incremental game about interplanetary travel. Explore new planets, gather rare resources, develop technologies, and unlock more and more possibilities!

title: Majestria: Incremental Survival
description: A top-down roguelite auto-battler where every hero fights with a deadly magic circle. Build powers from seven god pantheons, unlock characters with rare abilities, and lead your champion through relentless waves of hundreds.

title: The Obedience Experiment
description: The Obedience Experiment is a first-person psychological horror game where you must make difficult decisions when lives are put into your hands. Explore 10 encounters with unique consequences by investigating evidence and deciding who to trust.

title: Rutrum
description: Rutrum is a physics roguelike about dropping gems, popping rocks, and unlocking chests. Build a deck of gems, inscribe them with runes, merge them together to cause damage, touch them to acquire loot from enemies. DROP, POP, UNLOCK!

title: The Last Login
description: The Last Login is a psychological hacker thriller where you use GHOST//OS to exploit websites, intercept data, control cameras, and make dangerous choices as the voice in your head pushes you deeper into crime.

title: Succubus Successor: Delilah's Juicy Journey
description: Succubus Successor is a seductive-themed Metroidvania. Play as a succubus on a mission to hunt down the demon lord. Use your powers of seduction to charm enemies and engage in intimate encounters. Explore a vast world and solve tricky puzzles to uncover dark secrets.

title: The Confined: Basement
description: Wake up in a dark basement as a victim with no memory of your past. Can you uncover your true identity and solve the mystery of your past by collecting the cryptic notes left by your captor? Face the brutal truths and find a way to escape this nightmare alive.

title: Crystalyn
description: Start with one bullet. End with hundreds. Crystalyn is a fast-paced top-down bullet-hell looter shooter about pushing your build to its absolute limits. Fight monsters, defeat bosses, and turn their loot into unstoppable firepower.

title: Neko Miko Kaibyo Shioki No Emaki
description: Neko Miko Kaibyo Shioki no Emaki is an arcade-style action game where both allies and enemies are cats. Control the cat shrine maiden and her cat companions with the joystick, and run through the stages while defending against the fierce attacks of the monstrous cats with your feline companions.

title: Garden Eternal
description: The cozy garden that keeps on growing. Garden Eternal is an idle clicker where you tap a glowing Heart, raise bees & buildings, and draft cards through every season. A calm place, mostly. But the garden keeps its own hours, and not everything that blooms after dark is a flower.

title: PNR: Point of No return
description: You don't dodge. You push through. PNR: Point of No Return is a space opera roguelite where you blast through enemy fleets head-on, forging a new loadout every sortie. Build your arsenal mid-battle, come back alive, hit the jackpot on the Slingshot, and do it all again.

title: Demon Siege
description: A retro-inspired boomer shooter where every powerup stacks infinitely. Become an unstoppable demon-slaying powerhouse with insane speed, massive jumps, multi-bullet weapons, and game-breaking builds.

title: Nightmist
description: Survive the fog in this intense body-cam horror thriller... Nightmist to be a tense, tactical horror game. You play as a soldier hunting terrorists in a dark forest where the fog is so thick you can barely see a few feet ahead. It’s about being quiet, staying sharp, and surviving the night.

title: The Punchbag Machine
description: A fast-paced pixel-neon rhythm roguelite where every missed punch can end your run. Hit falling notes, chain combos, upgrade your boxer, defeat 9 bosses, and climb the leaderboard.

title: Copa City: Elite Tifo Collection
description: Transform your stadium with elite tifos for Borussia Dortmund, Bayern Munich, Arsenal FC, Clube de Regatas do Flamengo, Beşiktaş JK, and Olympique Marseille. The ultimate visual upgrade for matchday!

title: Averi the Accursed
description: Shunned outsider Averi becomes her small planet's last hope against the tyrannical Lord Kroff and Lady Psonos in this action-packed 2D pixel art platformer.

title: Femme Fatality
description: You are a serial killer who exclusively targets men. For a fee. To afford nice things. It's legal and you're good at it.

title: Meowmories
description: Our memories will bring us back together. A bittersweet and heartwarming "Meowmare" adventure about a cat's journey to find its owner. This is your story, and the story of your beloved cat.

title: Monster Hatcher
description: An incremental monster-farming game where you catch and hatch unique creatures, unlock powerful upgrades, expand your skill tree, harvest resources, and battle in idle arenas to become the ultimate monster hatcher.

title: Booth Butcher
description: No weapons. No backup. Just you, a meat cleaver, and the closing shift from hell. Uncover the theater's dark secrets, and survive the night or become the BOOTH BUTCHER'S next attraction.

title: Reapers Reception
description: Manage a hotel for criminals, spot anomalies, and find out who killed your sister 15 years ago.

title: Underground Business
description: Underground Business is a horror cooking game where you prepare orders for a rural town at a pizzeria kiosk. Take orders, cook pizza, investigate the suspicious pizzeria underground and run for your life in high-intensity chases!

title: Late Order
description: Night shifts at a cursed 24/7 diner. Every night — new rules and unsettling events. Fulfill orders, don't annoy the bizarre monster in the mascot's body, and maybe you'll have a chance to survive until dawn.

title: Going My Way?
description: In a world consumed by an insomnia pandemic, where there are no laws and people are going crazy, you're a train conductor racing through an endless night blizzard. Study the strange passengers, solve mysteries, and survive the time loop before the snowy abyss swallows you up.

title: Graveyard Cabin
description: An FMV anomaly horror game. You are a night guard at a desolate graveyard. Monitor the cameras, spot the unnatural, and survive.

title: Keep Watering
description: Keep Watering is an incremental game with a cozy, hypnotic loop where every drop of water grows into something extraordinary.

title: Ninja Cat Remewstered
description:
You have nine lives. Make them count.

Ninja Cat Remewstered is a challenging fast-paced platformer where a lone cat seeks to prove himself to the big bosses of the world. Starting with only shuriken on hand, he will find tools throughout his journey, laying claim to gold while he's at it!

...But stay aware! There are a variety of relentless enemies and hazards that will stand between him and his goals.

title: School Owner Simulator
description: Build and run a secondary school from scratch. Plan classrooms and facilities, manage staff and daily schedules, support student development, and improve your school through stronger performance, better results, and growing reputation.

title: Farm Factory Simulator
description: Grow crops, automate production, and manage your own store. Turn fresh harvests into valuable products and create a wide range of goods. Optimize your workflow with efficient production chains and smart business decisions. Expand your facilities and build the fully automated farm-to-market business.

title: PinRogue
description: PinRogue is a pinball roguelike where physics, strategy, and chaos collide. Launch your ball, earn points and multiplier by hitting bumpers, score satisfying combos, purchase powerful upgrades in the shop, and create game-breaking builds!

title: Spy Carnival
description: Spy Carnival is a 2-10 player social deception game set in a vibrant, chaotic funfair. Spies hide among the crowd, sabotaging rides and eliminating visitors while blending in with NPCs. Officers must stay sharp, read the crowd and take down the spies before the carnival turns into complete chaos.

title: Cat a Photo
description: Cat a Photo is a lively, fast‑paced multiplayer game all about capturing the perfect cat photo.

title: Lunadra: Luna Awakens the Legendary Dragon
description: Lunadra: Luna Awakens the Legendary Dragon is a survivor-style roguelite action RPG for Nintendo Switch. Play as Luna, a curious black cat adventurer, and harness the power of the legendary dragon Selva. Use Scale Change magic to grow giant or shrink tiny while battling legendary monsters in fast-paced 10-minute adventures. Build powerful combinations using weapon, support, and beast cards, and team up with a friend in local 2-player co-op.

title: Queen's Blade Re:Build
description: A roguelite deckbuilder featuring strong, beautiful female warriors. We fused real time card games and roguelite together to make the exciting single player deckbuilder. Discover new cards and item, Craft a strong deck. Break your rival of all their armor and defeat them with a finishing move!

title: Echolink: Recursion
description: EchoLink: Recursion is an active incremental hacking simulation spanning 1990s dial-up to 2150s megacities. Hack through time by infiltrating networks, building proxy chains, and automating routines. Every reset reboots you with exponential upgrades. Grow a skill tree and rewrite history.

title: Endless Rails
description: Protect your train with your drones as it rolls through a monster-infested wasteland. Reach new stations to buy new weapons, wagons, and upgrades. Keep rolling until you or the game crashes. Isometric bullet heaven roguelite.

title: PulseWave
description: Every weapon fires to the beat you create. Mix guns, modifiers, and upgrades to build deadly combinations in this rhythm-shooter roguelike.

title: Turbo Loop
description:
Turbo Loop is a casual slot car racing game built around simple gameplay that is easy to pick up, yet challenging to master. Whether you're chasing perfect lap times or battling head-to-head, every race is about precision, timing, and control.

Take on AI opponents, challenge a friend in local multiplayer, and push your skills across a wide variety of tracks. Unlock new cars, fine-tune their look, and create your own racing circuits with a simple and easy-to-use track editor.

title: Hyousei Buyuuroku: Record of Ice Fairy War
description: Hyousei Buyuuroku: Record Of Ice Fairy War is a Touhou Project fangame by Team Socially Unfit. The gameplay is similar to Yousei Daisensou: Touhou Sangetsusei.

title: Voidrave
description: A neon bullet hell where the deeper you fly, the less space behaves. Blast through 100 waves and 20 hand-crafted pixel bosses, mutate your ship with roguelite powers, and uncover the truth: you are not crossing the void. You are inside it.

title: Saintless
description: Explore the halls of the underground cult of The Open Hand. Experience the test rooms setup for your initiation in this psychological horror exploration game. Never forget....they are always watching.

title: Human Resources
description: You work in Human Resources. In this dystopian document thriller, use your terminal to scrutinize records and expose human-like AI. Spot contradictions to detect the impostors. Efficiency is mandatory. Failure is unforgivable.

title: Ikapali
description: IKAPALI is a uber-short, linear point-and-click horror game about killing a paedophile to save women and children. Explore a house that's not yours and exact vigilante revenge against society's ill. But as his life unfolds in front of you, will you blindly follow your moral compass through death's door?

title: Glorpotron
description: A tower defense roguelike about robots and ooze. Play solo or local multiplayer, protect the Glorp, and defeat the creeps.

title: Oort Protocol: Perihelion
description: Command 4 operators in a hardcore tactical roguelike set in 2476. No tutorials. No hand-holding. Decipher a system-wide conspiracy through ASCII tactical combat and deep terminal interrogation. Every choice persists.

title: Trials of Mary
description: Survive 4 deadly trials inspired by classic horror. As Mary, solve environmental puzzles and outsmart hunters through strategic evasion and self-defense in this cinematic journey. A psychological horror experience where vulnerability and high tension reach their peak awaits you.

title: Red Spiral 1993
description:
A mysterious incident has caused the barrier between the spiritual and the physical to be shattered, letting evil of all shapes and sizes bleed into our dimension.

Somewhere in the streets of Japan, a student disappears, dragged into Hell's arterial system by one of these dimensional wounds.

She doesn't know what she did to deserve such punishment, but what she does know is that she must survive at all costs, and escape the Spiral once and for all.

title: Moon Fete
description: Moon Fete is a fantasy night-market sim where you lead a traveling merchant troupe, set up stalls under starlight, and serve skewers, fish, and drinks to travelers with stories. Unlock new races, towns, and legends while managing strategy, mini-games, and bonds in a magical, heartwarming journey.

title: OrbitFix
description: Inherit a derelict space station on the edge of the galaxy and breathe new life into it. As the ultimate space mechanic, you will repair diverse spaceships, trade with pilots, and expand your services. Start with a single rusty dock and build the most bustling service hub in the sector!

title: Alchemix
description: Run your own alchemy shop in this alchemist and mixologist simulator! Talk with customers to learn their needs and preferences. Gather rare, high-quality ingredients and craft magical recipes through minigames.

title: Patchkins Party
description: Patchkins is a multiplayer racing game for 2 to 6 players where you build the course as you play. Each round, players draw and place objects like Platforms, Obstacles, and Specials, then race to the finish without dying.

title: TwwwT: The Witches Who Weave Timelines
description: A 2D action-focused roguelite where you control “witches from history,” battling endless enemies and dense bullet-hell barrages to correct fractured timelines

title: Hey Tom!
description: Stranded on an abandoned island hunted by the terrifying creature Tom, you must fight, scavenge, and manipulate your environment to survive and uncover multiple endings.

title: The Undermind
description: An underground laboratory where every decision counts. Manage energy, listen to NPC screams, and keep the doors under control. One wrong move and the monsters will break through. Will you survive?

title: Nova Swarm
description: Pick a ship, dive into readable bullet chaos, take down huge angry bosses, grab the bonus core you probably should have left alone, and chase one cleaner run in Nova Swarm.

title: RoboCop: Prime Directives
description: 10 years after regaining his humanity, Alex Murphy–alias Robocop–finds himself being used as a pawn in an OCP power struggle, pitting him against the people who were most important to him in his previous life.

title: Frog It Up
description: Frog It Up is an incremental clicker game where you lure frogs to a pond and help them build their own cozy little city. As the pond grows, you’ll decide which upgrades to unlock, shaping how the city expands over time and steering progress in the direction you prefer.

title: A Matter of Pain
description: In A Matter of Pain, you oversee a vast institutional complex dedicated to the administration of the damned. Souls arrive bearing guilt. Damnation is an industry like any other. It requires middle management. Your duty is simple: process souls efficiently and keep the system running.

title: Shear Heaven
description: Shear fluffy sheep to build a rope back home. Explore floating sky islands, tropical beaches, and underwater worlds. A sky full of surprises and very dramatic sheep.

title: Stare into Death and Be Still
description: Stare into Death and Be Still is a 4 map MBF21 challenge WAD originally concepted for NaNoWADMo 2025, before obligations to other projects and the sheer scope of my plans caused it to be delayed significantly. The four maps rapidly ramp in difficulty (expect slaughter!), and start relatively modest in scale before exploding in size for the finale, all accompanied by a fully bespoke soundtrack by yours truly.

title: Herd
description:
Herd is a cute-but-competitive tactical card battler set in a magical musical world.
Build your deck, and face your rival in fast strategic duels where every card you play becomes part of a live musical performance.

But victory is not about reducing health points.

In Herd, you win by converting the Mélodus — adorable divine creatures who react to music, magic and momentum. Read your opponent, control the stage, trigger powerful synergies, and turn the crowd before your rival does.

title: Chop Sous-y-chef
description: No holds barred boomer shooter with beat 'em up + hack n' slash elements. They thought it was a quick in and out job. They thought they were gonna make Chop suey outta the Sous-chef. But they got it all wrong. Now he's preparing a very special three course meal for them that they'll never forget...

title: Darkphobia
description: Turn off the lights. Reach the bed. Stay alive. Play through three intertwining nightmares where light is your only lifeline. Don't stay in the dark too long, or "It" will find you.

title: Feed the Cat: Gravity Puzzle
description: Move platforms, manipulate gravity, and solve relaxing physics puzzles to guide the food safely into the hungry cat's bowl. A cute, logic-based casual game where your main goal is simple: make sure the feline gets its treat!

title: Rampage Kage
description: Rampage-Kage is a demanding 2D Metroidvania action-platformer set in a Tokyo underworld. As Kage, you must master punishing, precision combat to dismantle city gangs. Explore an interconnected urban labyrinth, collect powerful charms to customize your skills.

title: Hex Harmony
description: Restore the balance between Nature and Human using futuristic technologies. Each island is a true puzzle. Build thoughtfully, observe interactions, and shape a durable world in a calm and accessible experience.

title: Cemetery Simulator
description: Carry the coffin with your crew and build the best necropolis! Dig graves, lower coffins, and keep everything tidy. Decorate the area to earn the prestige needed to unlock new sectors. Play solo or in co-op mode for up to 4 players, facing vandals and ghosts!

title: Heroes World Online
description: Heroes World Online is a fan-made MMORPG with an isometric view, focused on exploration, character progression, and player interaction. Inspired by classic online RPGs, it offers a world full of monsters, treasures, quests, and challenges for those seeking a true adventure and progression experience.

title: Mechanical Granny
description: An atmospheric point & click quest where the player explores a mysterious house, solves puzzles, and uncovers the disturbing truth behind the grandmother's strange behavior.

title: Kingdom Craft
description: Kingdom Craft is a survival game in a world of floating islands with unique gravity. Craft items by combining different materials, explore, build, and progress to reach the ancient portal and return home.

title: Stream plays Gustav
description:
Chat controls the character.
The streamer tries to help.

It’s both teamwork and sabotage at the same time.

title: Lilies in the Graveyard
description:
You are tasked with finding and eliminating an anomaly.
This task leads you to a small, remote village.
Then, in the graveyard, you meet a strange girl scattering ashes who introduces herself as Lily.
You make a deal.

title: Purgatory X: Amalia
description: During the afternoon events of Purgatory 2, Amalia and an ANT unit are deployed to neutralize the demons escaping from the Lobelia facility, with orders to capture D-007.

title: Caged In Concrete
description: A student made platformer game about a lost individual looking for a better life. They must make their way through a brutal city while facing manifestations of their thoughts and feelings on their journey to escape the city. The game features a platforming and puzzle system that rewards the players death by giving them moveable box they can position or push enemies with.

title: The Unleaving
description: The Unleaving is a Chinese folk-horror Cthulhu RPG. As a member of a paranormal investigation group, venture into rural ghost stories and uncover the truth through dialogue, skill checks, and a little dice luck. Many stories, occupations, endingssome answers lie beyond knowing. They never left.

title: Break The Chain
description:
Break the Chain is a physics-based puzzle game where every step matters.
You are bound together — and your only goal is to escape.

title: Potluck
description:
One autumn day, Potluck the witch held a big veggie potluck with all her witch friends. They decided to go off and play volleyball before the meal. But as they were leaving, the Demon King came upon their feast... and stole it!

When the witches got back, they discovered that their food was gone. Potluck had to teach that Demon King a lesson!

title: Not Sleep Hero
description: "Not Sleep Hero" is a turn-based strategy game. Your goal is to make the best decisions each turn to overcome approaching threats and safely complete your expedition. Unlike the Hero's courageous actions, their companions are so sleepy that they might not be much help.

title: Unclean Water
description: Unclean Water is an FPS roguelike action game where you must escape the sewers of Marlene. Defeat Night Moss assassins using precise strikes, defense, smashes, and shield bashes to exploit enemy openings. Unlock a variety of furniture and items to turn your endless challenges into ultimate success.

title: Gamba God
description: Bet, raise, and gamble your life away as you try to beat the 7 Stages of Draw Poker to become the Gambling God in this Poker Roguelite game. Every hand matters, every risk holds weight, and every upgrade counts toward your goal.

title: Bouncy Ball
description: Your goal: hit the red button with the ball! Each click teleports the ball across the screen, jumping between all four corners. Time your clicks, control the movement, and land every shot.

title: Don't Knife Me!
description: Don't Knife Me! is a funny knife-throwing game. Throw knives at the target and hope that you hit it. You'll be laughing by the end of the game!

title: Tape Man
description: "Tape Man" is a puzzle platformer packed with hidden mechanics for you to discover. Throw your measuring tape to explore a vast maze of puzzles. Your measure tapes work as a platform, an obstacle, and many other things—it's for you to find out!

title: Mind Inc
description: Mind Inc is a puzzle adventure inside the labyrinth of the mind. Gather scattered pieces of thought and restore forgotten memories.

title: Flame Up
description: Flame Up is a simplistic fighting game with no jumping, no blocking, no health, and no fuss, only you and your neutral. Featuring easy to learn systems, intuitive controls, and ROLLBACK NETCODE.

title: Chessillo
description: A roguelike deck-building tactical game fused with chess. Choose a cursed Prince, collect pieces with magical abilities, and conquer three acts of boss encounters where the board itself fights against you.

title: Professional Cats
description: Professional Cats is a cozy collection of 4 mini-games where cats dressed in different professions challenge your observation and memory skills. Find, match, and organize them while competing on global leaderboards!

title: Neon Pulsefire
description: Create an endless variety of unique builds and decimate huge waves of enemies. Unlock unique classes, weapons, passives and stats to unlock even more overpowered builds as you weave your way through enemies, arena hazards and projectile assaults.

title: Regret to Inform
description: A game about finding reasons to say "no." Review resumes, detect inconsistencies, and deliver rejection letters.

title: Clank-Robotics
description: Build your own robot. Program your robots AI in the Visual Scripting logic editor. Compete against other people's robots in the ranked arena. Build the strongest and smartest robot and win.

title: BeaterCore
description: beaterCore is an arcade racing game for those who prefer cheap rusty beaters over specialized sports cars. Buy, repair, restore, and race your dream project car

title: Beeing Hive
description: Beeing Hive is a relaxed hive-building simulation with clicker elements. Design the inside of your beehive, click for resources, optimize comb layouts and bee roles, and protect your colony from wasps, moths, a woodpecker, and a hungry bear.

title: SherloCat Nonogram Bahia
description: Take on 120 nonograms and embark on Sherlock Holmes' adventures in Bahia. Choose between relaxing in Classic Mode or testing your limits in Challenge Mode. Guaranteed fun for everyone from beginner to puzzle master!

title: Aliens Took My Stuff
description: In this 1-4 player co-op simulator, you are aliens stealing people's personal belongings straight from their homes to study their DNA. Use telekinesis, turn invisible, and deploy advanced sci-fi gadgets to rob houses clean. Just avoid getting caught by angry Earthlings!

title: Tidy Tidy
description: A casual healing organizing game. No complex controls—just click and drag to logically sort and arrange items across scenes, turning clutter into order. With no time limits, savor the relaxation and healing of tidying up.

title: Sweet Dance
description: A next-gen 3D dress-up rhythm dance game. Mix and match a vast collection of fashionable outfits, master the hottest dance moves, and unlock trending TikTok hits. Meet new friends and embark on a sweet romantic journey!

title: Extreme Racing Line
description: A fast minimalist top-down racer where you push tight lines, skim the edge of the track, and chase faster lap times on fully visible single-screen circuits.

title: Bitvania
description: Bitvania is a chaotic action platformer where you start weaponless. Grab anything you find—from daggers to durians to slippers—manage stamina, and hope for a rare 1% critical hit that deals massive damage when it matters most.

title: Unsight
description: Boundaries breached. Diplomacy failed. As a covert agent, infiltrate enemy lines and uncover a lethal secret. Plan your move, strike from the shadows, and survive the heat of action. If you fail, the world falls. UNSIGHT: Espionage in its purest, deadliest form.

title: White Ward
description: You Are Trapped In A Endless White Hospital Ward. The Nurse Asks You To Wait Patiently, But Something Tells You That Is A Bad Idea. Examine Each Ward Carefully To Escape The White Ward.

title: Rockfall
description: Rockfall is a 2D mining adventure where you descend into dangerous depths to gather resources, upgrade your gear, and survive hidden dungeons filled with traps, treasure, and danger. Dig deep, explore wisely… and don’t stay underground too long.

title: Poolcore Reflection
description: Pool core games. Explore the open pool core, find all the ducks, and unlock new scenes. Relaxing sound effects, no ghost elements, short process, produced by a 15 year old junior high school student alone.

title: Digital Anima: Virtual Lifeform Care Kit
description: Digital Anima: Electronic Life Form Raising Kit is a psychological desktop invasion horror game where you raise a virtual pet on your own computer. Raise a Digima inside a tiny window on your desktop and watch the conspiracy behind its evolution and the truth about its developer slowly unravel.

title: Cozy Mining
description: A cozy idle mining game that lives on your desktop. Click to send your miner digging. They'll walk, dig, and collect automatically while you work or relax. Forge pickaxes, equip accessories, unlock adorable animal miners, and grow stronger with every run. Reach Floor 1000 — together.

title: Rift Rumble
description: Rift Rumble is a lightning fast, platform party fighter where fighters from across the universe have come to battle for control of The Rift. Play with unlimited players locally across numerous unique maps.

title: Split Circuit Arena
description: One robot. Two pilots. Absolute chaos. Split Circuit Arena is a physics-based co-op game where you control the left side of a combat bot and a friend controls the right. Scream, coordinate, and smash enemies in pure arcade mayhem.

title: Infinite Evo TD
description: A tower defense game where mechanics evolve through your choices. Strengthen classic tower defense, blend in other game genres, or abandon tower defense entirely. Each level unlocks a fresh ruleset, making one purchase feel like many games in one.

title: Bōnin
description: Battle your friends in this exciting PvP sudoku showdown! Run around nature-themed puzzle boards while avoiding dangerous pencil projectiles, making good use of power-ups, and, most importantly, fill in the missing numbers faster than your opponent.

title: Exploring the Endless Land: 60s
description: Disaster strikes, and you only have 60 seconds. Scavenge supplies with up to 3 teammates in a lab about to self-destruct, escape into an unknown forest, and use 500 types of random events to write your survival story—will you wait to be rescued alive, or uncover the truth the company is hiding?

title: 2Dom!
description: 2Dom! is a Chill 2D sidescroller physics-based chain reaction puzzle game featuring dominoes!

title: Neon Planet
description: Build a life on a neon-lit alien planet. Farm, fish, cook, craft, decorate your home. Mine 100 floors deep, climb a combat spire, win at the casino. Solo or with up to 24 friends in a player-driven economy.

title: Dwarf the Dungeonist
description: Turn-based dwarf puzzle crawler: Solve tricky mechanics, explore mysterious dungeons, and survive the depths.

title: Total Simp Death
description: You're a waifu just trying to get by, eating burgers to get thicker. The simps keep coming but you have your trusty rocket launcher.

title: Knee Slide
description: A short time attack game where you race across rainbow courses in outer space by knee sliding. Master drifting and turbo while avoiding falling off the course to achieve the fastest time possible. The game features 5 stages designed for quick play sessions and repeated attempts.

title: Liminal Escape
description: Liminal Escape is a Backrooms co-op survival horror game for up to 4 players, where you and your friends will fight to escape from the unsettling, endless depths of Liminal space.

title: Slime Soup
description: Run a grimy fantasy soup kitchen where you drop and link bouncing slimes to trigger messy chain reactions. Build wild combos with strange ingredients, serve bizarre customers, and turn your filthy cauldron into a chaotic score machine.

title: Vertigo Enigma
description: Congratulations! You have been chosen for Vertigo Enigma. A narrative puzzle experiment where your logic and observation are the test. Until it glitches. Until you understand what "chosen" means...

title: 67 Simulator
description: 67 Simulator is a chaotic handtracking party game. No controllers needed. Use your webcam to play, compete with friends and strangers, unlock cosmetics and survive ever changing modes.

title: Knock It Over, Again?
description: Master your skills as a cat to knock things over! Pushing things to fall off the edge is easy, but what if you have some targets that are harder to hit just right? Test your physics intuition and see how long your perseverance lasts before you rage-quit.

title: Happy's Humble Burger Cult
description: The original cooking horror returns in an unhinged co-op experience for 1-4 players. Grill burgers, serve customers, and hit your quota before the kitchen turns into a nightmare. When Asset Joy begins her hunt, try to escape alive and extract your hard-earned cash to survive another shift.

title: Vincit
description: Vincit is a blend of fast-paced shooter action and a spellcast system. Craft bullet combos, obliterate enemies as fast as you can, and have a blast.

title: Jurassic World Evolution 3: Rebirth Expansion
description:
A new era is born in the action-packed Jurassic World Evolution 3: Rebirth Expansion.

Delve into a game expanding narrative inspired by the dramatic events of Jurassic World Rebirth. Take control of three top-secret locations, and come face to face with four new dinosaurs, including the terrifying Distortus rex!

title: G-Mode Archives+: Pac-Man
description: The timeless masterpiece that has taken the world by storm is here! Eating all Pac-Dots while dodging the ghosts!

title: Dead or Alive 6: The King of Fighters XIV Mashup Content Set
description:
Content:
- Dead or Alive 6 Character: Mai Shiranui
- Dead or Alive 6 Character: Kula Diamond
- DOA6 Mai Shiranui Debut Costume Set
- DOA6 Kula Diamond Debut Costume Set

title: Thug Wars
description: An open world GTA style third person crime action game set in 3 cities, New York, London and Moscow. Contains 56 missions , humourous dialogue and a huge world. With retro ps2 style graphics and vehicles unique to each city. The story is centred around the main player doing jobs for the mob and different gangs to gain wealth and power and climb the power hierarchy.

title: Paragon Story
description: Now begins the tale of a brave old RPG. No blade forged by man can sever what binds thee to thy fate. Brave hero, seek what lies buried within and face what thou truly art! Go forth: gather humans, animals, and monsters alike to thy cause, bear the legendary relics, and strike down the Demon King!

title: Secret Squonker
description: Secret Squonker is an MBF21 compatible episode featuring 8 distinct maps styled after various Squonker Team members. Each mapper was assigned a random author which they were tasked with emulating to the best of their abilities using the recently released BTSX E1 and E2 Texture Resource.

title: Kyklos
description: In this turn based RPG You must seek out the first gate lost to time. While many myths relate to its existence, only yours will lead to eternal enlightenment. Go out and explore towns, cities, temples, and caves which depths seem to grow stranger the deeper you go.

title: Broken Cycle
description: Broken Cycle is a dark-fantasy auto-battler RPG that lets you build a team of up to 5 mercenaries and send them to clear dungeons automatically — while you engineer their battle tactics, loot, craft and enchant their gear.

title: The King of Fighters XV: DLC Team Pass "Team Pass 1"
description:
*Characters from "KOF XV DLC Characters 'Team GAROU'" and "KOF XV DLC Characters 'Team SOUTH TOWN'" are also available separately. Please be aware of this when making your purchase.

KOF XV DLC Characters "Team GAROU"

KOF XV DLC Characters "Team SOUTH TOWN" (Scheduled for May 2022)

title: Mortal Kombat 11: Thanks A Million Johnny Cage
description: Play as Thanks A Million Johnny Cage, a thank you from Johnny Cage to his millions of fans!

title: Polymorphite
description: Polymorphite is a rhythm-adventure hybrid game that fuses keyboard-and-mouse rhythm dodging gameplay with a deep narrative following three concurrent Tokyo residents as a bizarre serial murder case unravels the fabric of reality; and the question of what it means to be “human” becomes more important than ever before.

title: Big Adventure: Trip to Europe 11 - Collector's Edition
description: Pack your bags! Start your journey today, no luggage or visa required!

title: Until Then: Deluxe Edition
description:
The Deluxe Edition includes:

- Until Then
- Until Then Afterimages DLC

In a world still recovering from catastrophe, Mark Borja and his friends navigate the joys and woes of another year of high school. Wake up in a typical teenage bedroom, practice piano, race to meet homework deadlines, and build (and burn) relationships, as you reminisce about the daily insecurities of high school life.

That is, until a fateful meeting sets off a chain reaction, upending Mark's life. People disappear and memories prove unreliable. Uncover a hidden truth with Mark and his friends in this narrative adventure and race to unravel the mystery before it's too late.

Play Out Your Own Adventure
Meet a diverse and achingly familiar cast of characters to converse with in person, over text, and through email. Get to know them, build relationships, flunk group projects, and watch how their individual personal stories unfold alongside yours.

Investigate the Setting through Everyday Technology
Explore the depths of social media where your likes and comments may pose consequences. Scroll through social posts, emails, webpages, and more on your in-game smartphone, where you might discover hints and clues about the people and world around you. Chat with your friends, classmates, and even strangers.

Explore Themes of Love, Loss, and Friendship
Tackle philosophical issues as the main character. Make mistakes and difficult choices. Will Mark stand up for his friends and be there when they need him or will he let them down? Can he heal his wounds by letting go of the past? Decide for yourself how Mark grows and strives to do better throughout the story.

Play Addictively Mundane Minigames
Insert a flash drive—oh wait, wrong way—nope, it was right the first time. Fight your friend for more fishballs at the food stand outside. Get in the groove to pay for the jeepney. Lose yourself in little games you find yourself playing in everyday life.

Immerse Yourself in a Cinematic Visual Experience
Witness an intriguing narrative uniquely presented in eye-catching hand-drawn pixel art and immerse yourself in the warm colors and music of a world trying to move on from tragedy. Characters, landscapes, and props blend in 3D. Shadows, reflections, and lighting set the tone in a lovingly crafted experience.

Experience a World Inspired by Philippine Locations and Culture
Traverse Philippine-inspired landscapes in search for the truth.
