From the heart of the bustling capital to long bus rides past grass fields and coast towns, explore the world of Until Then set in a fictional version of the Philippines. Interior spaces are shaped by the mannerisms of the locals, setting the scene for a recent past.

title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword - Premium Deluxe Edition
description:
The Premium Deluxe Edition includes:
• Onimusha: Way of the Sword

• Premium Deluxe Kit - A set containing the contents of both the Deluxe Kit and Premium Kit:
• Charm: Oni Lady

title: Minecraft Dungeons II: Deluxe Edition
description: Drop the pickaxe, grab a sword, and charge into a thrilling new adventure in the Minecraft Dungeons II Deluxe Edition, featuring unique cosmetics, pre-order cosmetics, and DLC 1+2 (when released)!

title: EA Sports FC 26: The World's Game Edition
description:

description:

title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword - Charm: Little Dancer
Onimusha: Way of the Sword - Charm: Mentor
description: A charm modeled after a mighty swordsman who serves as a mentor to Miyamoto Musashi! It grants a special effect when equipped.

title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword - Charm: Oni Lady
description: A beautiful charm modeled after the Oni Lady! It grants a special effect when equipped.

title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword - Cloudbiter Haori
Onimusha: Way of the Sword - Hellfire Haori
Onimusha: Way of the Sword - Moonlight Haori
Onimusha: Way of the Sword - Oni Gauntlet: Crimson Lotus
Onimusha: Way of the Sword - Sword Appearance: Bamboo & Panda
Onimusha: Way of the Sword - Sword Appearance: Enryuu
description: An item that gives Miyamoto Musashi's swords an ornate appearance! Thought by some to be imbued with the power of fire, but besides their intimidating design they are ordinary blades.

title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword - Sword Appearance: Raizan
description: An item that gives Miyamoto Musashi's swords a striking appearance! Thought by some to be imbued with the power of lightning, but besides their shocking design they are ordinary blades.

title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword - Sword Appearance: Whittled Oar
description: An item that gives Miyamoto Musashi's swords an unrefined appearance! An oar whittled down into a wooden sword. A simple weapon, but in the hands of Musashi it could easily shatter someone's skull.

title: Fungidemi
description: Fungidemi is an incremental RPG game where you gather your party, sharpen your skills, find magical weapons and explore unique maps while fulfilling small quests in a heart-warming story.

title: MS_Dos
description: Imagine yourself trapped in a computer. Imagine if... maybe you are... Imagine yourself trapped in a weirdcore-inspired open-world metroidvania-style game. How would you feel? Can you feel at all? Perhaps try figuring out. In this game, you take a stroll across numerous strange worlds, listening to what people tell you, and doing as they say. Have you ever wanted to deliver milk? Have you ever wanted to serve the Milkman? Have you ever wanted to (not) kill an Angel?

title: Bubbly
description: Fast-paced roguelike extraction arcade game. Pop endless waves of bubbles, build devastating upgrade combinations, defeat powerful bosses, and decide when to extract before losing everything.

title: Jammed
description: Jammed is a casual traffic management game.

title: Koiiro Chu! Lips
description:
Haruka is just your average high school student idly coasting through his life. His mornings generally start with a delivery from his childhood friend and neighbor Mirai, who has an inexplicable hate for him. His daily commute is interrupted by the cheerful and forever-in-love Nagisa, who never misses an opportunity to profess her undying love for him. At school he spends time with his good friend Ikuya, a bit of a pervy moron, often finding himself in trouble with his mature yet cute teacher Shizuku.

His lazy days continue on and on, until a chance encounter with a mysterious pot changes his life forever... How will his life ever return to normal?!

title: 8 Hours Till Dawn
description:
Play 8 Hours Till Dawn solo, or with up to five other friends, a survival party game where you plan out your actions and movements ahead of time. Navigate your survivor to the center room to grab a weapon then make it to an outer room with a window and hopefully stop the infected. Can you last 8 hours till dawn?

During each in-game "hour" you will plan your actions using the 8 Action cards you draw under a timer. This timer gives you the same amount of time every round, but as the night goes on, the decisions stack up, the horde keeps growing, and the weight of every choice gets heavier. Harder difficulties give you even less time.

title: PlanetOrbit
description: Turn a bare rock into a neon-lit casino planet. Win chips at poker, baccarat, blackjack, chinchiro, roulette and slots, then spend them on buildings and watch the dry ground turn green. Drawn by the lights, NPCs begin to visit. Grow the liveliest planet in the galaxy, your way.

title: Don’t Return to Wonderland
description: A dark fairy-tale horror adventure inspired by Alice in Wonderland. Use mysterious powers to forge your path and confront the horrors lurking within a world that is both adorable and cruel.

title: Pop! Pachinko
description: Pop! Pachinko is a pachinko roguelite with city pop vibes. Build up your collection of enchanted balls to fire into the machine. Collect charms to build up powerful synergies between your balls. Listen to some pop music as you expand your Chibi Pop collection!

title: Copy Cats
description: Utilize the power of the mysterious cloning machine and use your handy copy cats to solve puzzles and help a little kitty escape from a strange virtual dimension!

title: Frog Telephone
description: Frog Telephone is a folklore mystery adventure game rooted in computer science concepts. You play as an amnesiac phone operator at a Tokyo travel agency, reconstructing shattered reality through the spin of a dial, exploring the terrifying truth hidden behind Gero City's mystery.

title: Wanderdawn
description: Explore various worlds in a hack-and-slash action game - In a world ravaged by an unknown disaster, face various monsters with the diverse weapons you find.

title: Click the Button
description: Click the Button is an incremental game about clicking a button to receive chests that deliver incredible rewards. Improve your skills to become the strongest.

title: Rust of New York
description: A post-apocalyptic ruin exploration RPG. A Fallout-style game. A highly flexible game design featuring a wealth of skills and equipment, a vast number of locations, and numerous skill checks. The sprawling ruins of a chaotic New York City stand before you!

title: Metroidvania Maker
description: Create, play, and share custom Metroidvania worlds with a built-in world editor, co-op play, and player-made adventures.

title: Totally Rigged
description: A Totally Rigged incremental game about mining to the center of the earth. Upgrade your drill, hire workers, and collect rare minerals until your fuel depletes.

title: Limitless Survivor
description: Incremental roguelite with infinite progression. Collect powerful artifacts, gather crystals, and scale your stats to absurd levels. Let auto-play handle the grind anytime—even while you're away.

title: Goldfish Simulator
description: Goldfish Simulator: “Endless Move” is a meditative idle goldfish simulation game. The goldfish react as if they were alive, and their movements are realistic and elegant.

title: Sigillum
description: The streets have fallen ill. You have been sent on a divine mission; you are the only hope to eradicate the evil that looms over the city and to uncover the secrets hidden in its depths.

title: Solomon's Boneyard: Hideous Retro Edition
description: Twenty-Three years before the horrifying events chronicled in "Solomon's Keep," the Wizard's college first suspected they might have a problem with one of their new graduates. A battle mage was dispatched to put an end to this young "Solomon Dark" before he could grow in power...

title: I Need to Fix My Dream Car (But I Work at a Junkyard)
description: Dig through junk, find rare parts and lost collectibles, rescue dogs, complete odd customer orders, hire helpers, and relax as you slowly rebuild your dad's dream car in this cozy junkyard simulator.

title: Loaded Dice
description: Wager. Survive. Profit. Throw your friends around and bet against them to show who's faster, better, and smarter in Loaded Dice, a fast action-strategy party game.

title: Jumpscare Scare Jump
description: This is a casual horror game similar to a haunted attraction, where you search for 50 jumpscares. Whether you like them or not, this game will help you build up your tolerance to them!!

title: 101 Dogs Hidden in Singapore
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 dogs in Singapore in the hand-crafted landscape. Earn tons of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

title: 101 Dogs Hidden in Milan
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 dogs in Milan in the hand-crafted landscape. Earn tons of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

title: Idle Knight
description: Idle Knight turns every click, keystroke, and controller input into XP. Level up your warrior, build your stats, fight in ranked duels, conquer dungeons, join guilds, and crush seasonal events all from your desktop.

title: Tiny Cats vs Toys
description: Timy Cats vs Toys is a hidden object game – the player's task is to find the kittens, free the trapped cats, and eliminate the warlike toys.

title: Genshin Impact: Sunny Summer Fontinalia
description:
Version "Luna VIII" of Genshin Impact, also known as "Song of the Welkin Moon: Scherzo". This update includes:
• New character: Sandrone
• New area: Frost Moon
• New main event: Sunny Summer Fontinalia
• New elemental reaction: Stellar-Conduct
• New updates for Miliastra Wonderland
• New QoL, and more!

title: Fang and Izzy Pinball Bash
description: A Pinball arcade based game focused on speed and strategy as you venture down into the land of ‘Spinneburrow’ with a touch of OSC styled humor.

title: Cython Cat
description: Cython Cat is a openworld speed platformer, play as Miru and explore the lands of the Cython Ruins. Find shards, keys and furballs, scattered around to unlock different areas. Enjoy running around the world, at high speeds. Challenge your speedrunning skills in the Jungle Temple to get the highest rank! Fight Terru, the final boss who remains at rest in his secret cage.

title: RPG2
description:
In RPG², the world of Rpangaea is under siege by a wicked creature operating from somewhere within the shadows of the sinister swamplands. Only an RPG, an ancient automaton built for war, is capable of stopping it, but be careful: wicked monsters have long roamed Rpangaea, causing destruction and bloodshed in their wake.

Three audit stones are strewn across the land, and can be collected to increase your power, though it is optional to do so. In fact, barring the tutorial dungeon, you can pretty much bypass the entire game and face the final boss if you know what you're doing.

title: BunnyFly: Season of Summer
description:
On a little mysterious island in the middle of an isolated unknown lake, strange creatures exist. Bunnyflies! Little bunny-like creatures with wings like a butterfly.
They fly and collect pollen to chew and bring back to their different hives as honey or wax, where one queen exists to help them all.

Explore this island as Princess Honeybun, the queen's daughter who's now old enough to make her own hive and start her own colony! Help the residents, collect Royal Jelly, and become the next bunny matriarch!

This game was originally created for the GMTK 2025 Game Jam, and has been expanded to have better visuals, performance, more mechanics, a much larger and complex world, higher variety of flowers, characters, a few mini-biomes, and a lot more lore to try and find.

title: Birthday Visit
description: What do you do when your child is visiting on their birthday that you totally forgot?! Microwave your child's birthday meal to perfection, navigate through tense conversations, and pay close attention to select a gift they'll love! Can you restore your relationship with your child? Or will you destroy what's left?

title: Lonely Silver Rose
description:
After a traumatic childhood event, Alyss Rosewood became distant, the opposite of who she used to be. Feeling guilty and afraid of putting her family in danger again, she isolated herself just to keep anyone suspicious away. But, when she thought she could finally have peace, everything she had been trying to avoid had just begun.

The person who caused all her worries is back, and he will do whatever it takes to ruin her completely, just as he promised a long time ago.

title: Romance of the Three Kingdoms XIV Complete Edition
description: Romance of the Three Kingdoms XIV Complete Edition includes the Romance of the Three Kingdoms XIV base game, the downloadable content “Diplomacy and Strategy Expansion Pack Bundle,” Season Pass, Season Pass 2, and new content added in the Complete Edition.

title: Cozy Cleanup
description: Clean up after a big party, collect trash, and earn money for better tools and new areas. Play at your own pace, customize your equipment, and find hidden rubber ducks. No violence, no stress, just relaxing cleanup.

title: Cozy Interiors
description: Ever dreamed of becoming an interior designer? Design cozy homes and get paid for it. Build and decorate charming interiors, unlock a wide variety of furniture, and create wholesome spaces filled with personality, furry friends, and perfect little details.

title: Stall Tycoon
description: Stock & organize - Buy fruits, stationery, tools. Arrange for quick access. Listen/read English - Customer says/show item name. Click/drag the correct item in time. Natural repetition - Same words reappear. Running your stall becomes the best review.

title: Night Rolls Cozy Store
description: Run a cozy late-night store. Prep fresh sushi and rolls, stock the shelves, and serve customers until dawn. A chill store management game where every night shift is yours to own.

title: Cozy Radiation Cleaner
description: Cozy Radiation Cleaner is a dark post-apocalyptic exploration and cleanup game where you scan dangerous zones, locate radioactive objects, and restore contaminated environments using specialized equipment and radiation detection tools.

title: An Arcade Full of Cats: Complete Edition
description:
An Arcade Full of Cats: Complete Edition includes:

An Arcade Full of Cats
TimeWarp Trouble DLC

title: A Park Full of Cats: Complete Edition
description:
A Park Full of Cats - Complete Edition includes:

A Park Full of Cats
Haunted Ride DLC

title: Crown Control
description: Tactical roguelike deckbuilder: play solo or in online co-op with up to 4 players. Choose your character, level up your class, collect and play cards to attack, defend, heal, summon allies, place traps, and alter the terrain in turn-based isometric battles to overthrow a tyrant king.

title: Without a Hitch: Steam Exclusive - Valve Hat
description: This Unlock includes the Steam Exclusive 'Valve Hat' Cosmetic Item.

title: Mak Survival
description:
Mak Survival is an open-world survival game where you play as a lone human survivor with a single mission:
Stay alive — and help evolve the world of Oratius, a land threatened by wild creatures and terrifying monsters.

title: Cascader
description: A Portal-esque puzzler set in a supernatural forest that shifts and changes around you.

title: Fortune Pact
description: A cursed arcade machine. A demon's pact. A hidden exorcism buried in the code. Find the encrypted phrases. Speak them aloud. Save the souls — or be claimed by the darkness.

title: Dave's Wrecking Yard 3D
description: It's the late 1990s all over again and you find yourself as the owner of Dave's Wrecking Yard. Earn cash by filling various parts orders by phone, internet, & walk-in customers. New engine rebuilding shop will keep you busy, but enjoy working at your own pace while ordering pizzas and chugging sodas.

title: Shadows of Eldemir
description: Shadows of Eldemir is a retro-inspired, Victorian cosmic-horror, point-and-click adventure RPG, where a London schoolmaster travels to a remote Eastern European village searching for his missing fiancée, only to discover the archaeological expedition she joined may have disturbed something ancient.

title: Backfools
description: One ordinary moment, you suddenly find yourself lost in a strange and unfamiliar place. There, you encounter the beings who inhabit it. Backfools is a first-person adventure game.

title: Dead by Daylight: Jason
description: Dead by Daylight’s Jason includes a new Killer, The Slasher. Purchasing this add-on unlocks the Hockey Mask badge and the Misty Cabin banner.

title: Give Us a Sign
description: Give Us A Sign is a 1-4 player co-op psychological horror simulation. As an investigator, use specialized equipment to detect entities and gather evidence in haunted locations. Every word you speak shapes the haunting around you. Once you ask for a sign, there is no turning back.

title: B.O.B.Y's Journey
description: Follow a robot’s journey to find the Spiritual Island, seeking the key to offering genuine emotional support while healing and transforming within, a story of resilience, self-discovery, and inner growth.

title: The 4 Masked
description: A 4-player co-op FPS adventure where you swing through trees using vines, escape wild animals, and survive dangerous biomes. Each player has a unique role, and teamwork is the key to survival.

title: Disney Dreamlight Valley: Honeyglow Woods
description: Cross through a magical new gateway into the titular Honeyglow Woods, a land inspired by Winnie the Pooh, filled with puzzles, lost secrets, and a fair share of honey. Soon you'll reunite with Winnie the Pooh, Piglet, and Eeyore to return to the fun, carefree days of childhood!

title: Whistling at Night
description: A short horror experience inspired by Indigenous Folklore

title: The King of Fighters XV: Team Pass 2
description:
*In order to use this content, the Base Game (sold separately) is required. You may need to apply the latest patch before using this product.
*Characters from "Team AWAKENED OROCHI" and "Team SAMURAI" are also available separately. Please be aware of this when making your purchase.

[Product Contents]
- KOF XV DLC Characters "Team AWAKENED OROCHI"
- KOF XV DLC Characters "Team SAMURAI" (3 DLC characters to be released in 2022)

title: Do You Really Know About Soccer?
description: Climb the Tower and Prove You Know Soccer

title: Motorhome: Traveling North America 4 - Collector's Edition
description: Remember that feeling of wind in your hair and the endless road?

title: Let's Aim! Crane Game
description: The hugely popular crane game series is back and better than ever! Aim, grab, and hook your prizes! Master a variety of crane arms and win tons of prizes!

title: Virtual Aquarium
description: A relaxing game displayed as an overlay above system windows.

title: Acorn Avengers
description: When the forest ranger is abducted, it's the Acorn Avengers to the rescue! Classic 16-bit platforming mayhem for up to 2 players co-op!

title: Venus: The Last Ascent
description: A science fiction survival game about an astronaut stranded on the surface of Venus, who has to survive against the planet's hostile environment by making use of a customizable mobile base.

title: BonkCity
description: BonkCity is a 90s hip-hop horde survivor roguelike. Playing as an MC defending your block, you survive waves of posers, record label security, and label muscle across a procedurally chaotic back-alley night. Move and auto-attack while drafting weapons and perks from level-up cards, evolve maxed weapons into powerful combos, and earn "drip" — cosmetic gear that stacks into real stats. Each run climbs toward a three-phase showdown with the Industry Plant, a manufactured fake MC built to replace the cypher. Features a shared Daily Block seed with leaderboards, four playable characters (more to come), and challenge modifiers called Beefs. Built solo in Godot, drawing DNA from Vampire Survivors and Brotato with the color and soul of Jet Set Radio and Streets of Rage.

title: Future Sauce Dispenser
description: The year is 2145. Humanity has forgotten how to eat without Sauce. You serve the Sauce for everything: phones, bricks, and occasionally food. Pick the right blend, keep the flow, and survive the absurdity. A dystopian satire that feels ridiculous… until it doesn't.

title: Blob Factory
description: A hard 2D platformer with a slight puzzle solving element and a simple goal, escape the lab. The main gameplay has to do with the ability to stick to surfaces and jump off them, allowing you to make jumps you otherwise couldn't. Use this to dodge lasers, lava, electricity, and the scientists that made you on your eventual escape from antarctica.

title: Fatum
description:
"May the Miracle always hallow thy name."

FATUM is a turn based RPG about a young noble trying to find an exit from the castle where he lives after it being mysteriously accursed.

You must find the answers for your troubled mind and soul as you try to save friends made along this mysterious dimension.

Will this young man be able to exceed the expectations of the world and decide his own fate?

title: Rogue Run
description: Rogue Run is a frantic action roguelite and arcade. Escape space cops while delivering valuable cargo across dangerous planetary systems. Pick your pilot, combine countless items your way, and don’t die. Will you smuggle with the rebels or join the space junkyard?

title: Jump Duck
description: Jump and duck the shots to survive. Don't blink! Test and train your reflexes and timing. A modern remake of the Xbox 360 Indy game Jump Duck. Inspired by Twisted System from Fuzion Frenzy.

title: Anjail!
description: This is the interactive continuation of the Indie pilot ANJAIL CHAPTER 1!

title: Star Cosmic
description: Star Cosmic is a minimalist 2D HTML5 arcade game where players control a spaceship navigating through a dense asteroid field. The objective is to survive as long as possible by dodging oncoming meteors using the keyboard arrow keys, with the game's speed increasing as the score rises.

title: First Class Rescue
description: Climb the mountain by building your path in this cute & cosy roguelite puzzle platformer. Make your way to the top of the mountain to rescue the residents of Pine Peaks!

title: Space Gnomes
description:
Space Gnomes is a wacky multiplayer co-op game where a team of space gnomes is trying to escape an invading empire of space-faring garden moles focused on enslaving the known universe.

Each day, you land on a procedurally generated planet where you scavenge resources, fight enemies, and try to survive long enough to craft upgrades, build weapons, and push further into space.

title: Nǚwáng
description: Find the woman you like, make her your queen, and protect her well.

title: Anomalous Veil
description: Anomalous Veil is a psychological horror experience that can be completed in 30–90 minutes and features branching endings.

title: Dual Protocol: The Case of Eva & Miles
description: Play as Agent Eva to follow the trail, or as Analyst Miles to manage the operation. Dual Protocol is an asymmetric noir puzzle game where two players progress only through conversation. Without seeing each other’s screens, combine the data you have and uncover the truth behind the Castellari murder.

title: Flecto
description: Flecto is a puzzle game where you place blocks in order to deflect bullets and shatter targets. Strategically use your tiles to split bullets, bounce them around each level, and destroy every target.

title: Lost in Art
description: Explore a surreal, twisted version of real-world art gallery in this atmospheric puzzle adventure inspired by classic survival horror. Use creative thinking and a mysterious power to solve puzzles, evade a sinister threat, and uncover the secret of a cursed artwork; before it traps you for good.

title: Graveyard Orbit
description: A satisfying incremental where you build the ultimate mining ship, loot every piece of an alien megastructure, and upgrade your abilities with an array of unlockable parts and skill trees. MINE. BUILD. UPGRADE. REPEAT.

title: Unhold
description: Unhold is a rock climbing simulator on Unreal Engine 5. Alone or with friends, conquer sheer cliffs, enjoy the views, and choose the mode that suits your taste from checkpoints to hardcore ascents with no room for error.

title: Tales Beyond the Tomb: No Witnesses
description: A psychological horror anthology inspired by disturbing real-life cases. In No Witnesses, a simple road trip turns into a brutal fight for survival when two sisters cross paths with a ruthless serial killer stalking the highways at night.

title: FishOmatic
description: Build your dream ocean island fish factory! This is an automation game for beginners or experts that would like to chill while automating their fish factory. Scout ocean for new fishing locations, send your robots to get a haul of fish, then automate the processing of them into a cozy empire.

title: The Last Good Boy
description: A Cozy idle RPG inspired by my real-life dog called Ramon, the goodest boy in the world. Gather, craft, unlock new lands, enchant your gear, and battle monsters on a quest to find out where all the other good boys have gone.

title: Greebly Gambit
description: Greebly Gambit is a chaotic fantasy smash-and-grab-style game where you play as a goblin trying to steal everything not nailed down in order to help revive the god of hope.

title: Bone Stuff
description: You wake up in hell. You are incomplete, confused, and your friends might be your greatest chance — or your biggest problem. In this dark comedy co-op adventure for 2–6 players, use your limbs, solve puzzles, and find out who reaches the exit.

title: Gunshot Arcade
description: Gunshot Arcade combines the action of a classic arcade shoot 'em up with the meta-progression of a roguelike. Buy some weapons, upgrade your gear and survive as long as you can. Unlock much stronger guns from wave to wave and reach a new record, good luck.

title: Phantasma Hotel
description: A cursed hotel that kills you, revives you in the bathroom, and rolls the dice on your fate with every step, every fight, and every terrible choice you make.

title: Rune Tavern
description: This is an asynchronous PVP auto chess game. Arrange your runes and components, use energy transfer to activate as many rune skills as possible, and build a powerful lineup! In the face of randomly matched opponents, be the first to smash the enemy's elemental blocks and win more!

title: Idle Aqua Driller
description: Dive into the depths of the ocean in this incremental game about underwater mining! Control drilling rigs, hire divers and submarines, and unlock new layers and resources. Upgrade your decks, speed up mining, and develop your skill tree to turn your station into a powerful underwater complex.

title: 100 for Justice
description: 100 lives, one justice. Manage 100 citizens in a country falling to shadow forces. Your choices shape a collective timeline across decades. Lead unions, survive assassinations, and leave a legacy of resistance in this text-based political strategy sim. Words are your greatest weapon.

title: Indian Street Food Simulator
description: Run your own simple and friendly Indian street food stall. Serve customers from your roadside stand, cook authentic dishes and absurd food combos, manage limited ingredients, and keep up with orders. A chaotic yet warm single-player experience focused on your stall.

title: Art Studio Simulator
description: Bring your wildest imagination to life in your art studio. Paint, sell, build your own gallery, and invite friends to admire your art.

title: Rescue Guys: Firefighters Simulator
description: A chaotic open-city rescue sim where you improvise your way through fires, disasters, and absurd emergencies. No training, no rules - just fast decisions, creative problem-solving, and a city that keeps getting worse.

title: Real Car Market Simulator Together
description: Start from nothing and build your own car trading empire in Real Car Market Simulator Together. Buy, inspect, negotiate, repair, and sell vehicles solo or with up to 4 players. Every deal is a risk, and only smart teamwork leads to profit.

title: Diadem of Manstraut
description: The first complete Sword of Moonlight game produced with the English translation. A complete, original soundtrack accompanies classic King’s Field style gameplay. A crown cracks. Evil is abound. Zeir Grimholdt sets out to banish the encroaching evil and repair the diadem.

title: Mori Adventures
description:
Mori Adventures is a 3D puzzle platformer. The main goals is to find all ingredients needed for a curing potion for their mother.

The player progresses by solving puzzles, which are based on interactions with objects around the island or paths hidden within the environment. The game involves the exploration of an open world made of multiple islands.

title: Gumball Hero
description: A fast-paced 3D action roguelike where you play as a gumball machine, shooting bouncing candy to survive waves of enemies. Build your loadout, combine powerful gumballs, and reclaim your mall before its too late.

title: You Are the Loading Screen
description: The loading screen never ends. Solve bizarre challenges, survive fake system failures, defeat corrupted software, and uncover the truth behind a self-aware progress bar in this meta-comedy puzzle adventure.

title: Juno and Hope Destroy Capitalism
description: A quick visual novel about hungry lesbians who destroy the American economic system after going to a burger joint.

title: Imouto Paradise! 2
description: An all-ages version of Imouto Paradise! 2

title: Cleaning Simulator: Ultimate Mess
description: Clean, organize, and restore different environments in this level-based cleaning simulator. Every level introduces new mechanics, tools, and satisfying ways to turn mess into perfection.

title: Doctor Pigeon Simulator
description: This isn't a normal ER. What's going on here, why are you pooping in the hallway?! I'll attend to the patient having a heart attack. Oh no, the exploding uncle! Stay away from my bed. I don't think I can manage this ER...

title: Total Survival Simulator
description: Tell your own stories in Total Survival Simulator and watch the simulation play out in real time. Create characters, set relationships, traits and make them survive in a fight to the death with up to 16 other contestants.

title: Drump Simulator
description: A satirical game where you make choices as the American President Tonald Drump.

title: Physician Simulator
description: A district physician simulator. See patients, review lab results, make diagnoses and write prescriptions. Real doctors say they recognize themselves. Every decision has consequences.

title: Real Life Simulator
description: Rise to the top of trade with your friends! Buy and sell second-hand goods, establish a car dealership, manage the real estate market, and own the biggest businesses in the city. Real Life Simulator combines all trading simulations in a 2D Co-op world.

title: Garden Cleanup Simulator
description: Turn overgrown, messy gardens into clean and beautiful spaces. There is no rush. No stress. Just you, your tools, and the simple pleasure of turning chaos into order.

title: Container Hunter Simulator
description: Salvage lost containers from the depths, uncover their hidden value, and sell them at auction to build your maritime empire.

title: Car Sales Simulator
description: Grow from a small dealer into a successful automotive tycoon.

title: Medieval Tavern Simulator
description: Rebuild your medieval tavern from the ground up. Serve food and ale, manage staff, entertain guests, and shape the atmosphere with music and decor. Balance profit, reputation, and chaos as every night brings new stories and unexpected events.

title: Haggle Simulator
description: A Monopoly-style board game focused on negotiation, trading, and bidding between players. Can take out loans from the bank. be careful—late payments may result in asset repossession! Trade via group chat or private messages. Cross-play with mobile players. Come and sharpen your haggling skills!

title: Basement Server Simulator
description: Build a basement hosting empire solo or in co-op. Buy and place servers, install server apps, set your prices, accept time-limited customer contracts, and balance power, internet, heat, and hardware failures as you expand your operation.

title: Minibus Simulator
description: Build your own minibus business and transport passengers across the city. Load luggage, maintain and wash your vehicle, unlock new routes and grow your transport career in a living city.

title: Resort Simulator
description: Run and manage a seaside resort! Take care of guests and handle daily operations. Grow your resort step by step, create the perfect vacation atmosphere, and enjoy a calming simulation experience.

title: Crypto Trading Simulator
description: Trade volatile crypto markets in real time, build automation bots, and upgrade your home-office into a capable trading setup. With bills rising and pressure mounting, every decision can push you toward profit or wipe you out.

title: Pizza Man Simulator
description: Burned the pizza? Just drown it in ketchup! In your restaurant, microwaving a frozen Hawaiian is literally an everyday thing. Serve picky customers, upgrade your pizzeria and improvise in the kitchen. The most important rules? Nobody gets food poisoning… and the cash actually adds up.

title: Nowhere to Run
description: Nowhere to Run is an interactive film with over 120 choices and 18 different endings! Embark on a journey with Lucy and help her escape the desert before her abductor finds her. But he's not the only one she needs to worry about...

title: Covert Koalas: Phasco
description: A comfy hidden-koala game with unique hand-drawn visuals and adjustable difficulty. The story follows a group of koalas escaping their captivity and searching for a new home. Has hints, over 10 levels and original soundtrack.

title: Sandwich Shop Simulator
description: Run your own sandwich shop! Stock your ingredients, prepare delicious sandwiches, take payments, customize and expand your store, and become the best sandwich shop in town!

title: HeartCore Descent
description:
Fly to the center of the planet to destroy its core!

HeartCore Descent is a simple yet challenging 2D Precision Platformer Indie game, where you control a rocketship through various terrains. The goal is to fly through all levels, and reach the heart core at the center of the planet.

There are 5 Chapters, each with a different theme. Each chapter has 5 levels, so 25 levels total, each level progressively getting harder. When you crash, you restart at the beginning of the level. If you close the game mid-chapter, you need to play the chapter over again.

This game is incredibly hardcore (heartcore), so good luck! (You'll need it.)

title: Mostly Delivered
description: They hired you to deliver. They didn't say how. Arcade motorcycle courier game where cargo doesn't stay strapped and neither do passengers. Dispatch hasn't called since.

title: Do You Like Italian Food?
description:
Do You Like Italian Food? is a short, slice-of-life, romantic visual novel about a shy college student, a coffee shop crush, and finding the nerve to ask for a date.

Jared is only supposed to be stopping by for caffeine. Instead, he keeps finding himself drawn back by a smile, a little conversation, and the hope that maybe this could become more than part of his routine.

title: Archipeo
description: Build an island empire, automate sprawling production chains, and compete with up to 16 players across a procedurally generated ocean.

title: Capy Farm
description: A short incremental game where you build a farm run entirely by capybaras. Expand your fields, automate production, earn massive profits, and outperform rival farms to win the Grand Harvest Competition.

title: What They Gave Us
description: You wake up in the cold of the science facility.

title: Quantum Era
description: Explore, Fight, Upgrade. Join the roguelite action in third-person, every fight raises alert levels! Conquer outposts, unlock weapons and powerups in an unpredictable procedural environment, get out before the island turns against you!

title: Blackwater Exchange
description: Run a basement black market pawn shop in a gritty 1990s city. Inspect questionable goods, negotiate with desperate sellers, resell through shady contacts, manage heat, survive raids, and decide whether each item is a payday, a fake, a trap, or a liability.

title: Have You Seen the Moon?
description: Solve puzzles to escape Nature Park.

title: TooneQuest
description:
A 3rd person Adventure in full 3d featuring Day and Night and expansive vistas.
TooneQuest is a casual game where the player explores and captures creatures as they are discovered. Use the TooneDex to help find some of the trickier to find Toones.
Find and capture all the 50 of the unique creatures hiding on the 5 islands.
Discover Abilities such as Jump, Crawl, Glide and Double-jump to help you navigate and explore the Islands.

title: Garfield: Escape from Monday
description: Wake up Garfield from this nightmarish veggie filled 3D Platformer! The laziest cat is about to work hard in Garfield - Escape from Monday!

title: Backrooms Protocol
description: Backrooms Protocol is a 1–4 player co-op horror game focused on exploration, research, and survival across the levels of the Backrooms.

title: Back to 21
description: A narrative RPG life-sim about the dreams you talked yourself out of. You’ve been given a chance to go back to 21. Build relationships, explore new paths, and pursue the passion you once buried. Beneath it all lies a deeper truth about the world that contains you. Or perhaps… that you contain.

title: Playback '94: Episode 1 - Post Office
description: Alex Reed, a private detective, traveled to Willow Creek Valley to investigate the disappearance of journalist James Carter. As he stepped into the abandoned post office, he couldn't shake the feeling that someone else was already there.

title: Ghostly Simulator: Your Neighboring Ghost Story Collection
description: Welcome to an immersive horror fiction reading simulator. Every tale within is rooted in the chinese mundane, familiar moments we all live through —like the annual Spring Festival Gala You can shut down the simulator at any time. But remember: reality is always far more horrifying than any story.

title: Backrooms: The Old Watcher
description: This work is inspired by Exit 8, Backrooms, and liminal spaces - environments that evoke an unsettling sense of the familiar yet strange. However, is there any way out for the old man? No, there isn't.

title: Escape Simulator 2: Apocalypse DLC
description: The Apocalypse DLC adds 4 new escape rooms set in a near-future world devastated by an unknown catastrophe. Civilization has gone quiet. Cities are overgrown, systems are failing, and the only way forward is through the clues left by those who came before you.

title: Oblivion Maiden
description: An exploration adventure set in St. Dorothia Academy, a magical educational institution hidden deep within a forest. A story that begins with an encounter with a girl named Lulunya, and unfolds through mysterious phenomena and dream worlds.

title: Mk50TWL Vehicle Battler Custom Slider
description:
Real time tactical battles in (rough) terrain, space, sea. Vehicle designer with custom weapons and custom chassis sizes. Some realism-inspired mechanics and complex rules including vision, sensors, destroyable components. Campaign about battles, survival, lite 4x and resource management.
Sci-fi / modern, strategy, indie, single-player.

title: Lab47
description: Enter mysterious worlds through a laboratory portal and explore the unknown with friends. Discover eerie, magical, and fantastical dimensions, collect items, and trade equipment in Lab47.

title: Terror on Tromos 5
description: "The Final Frontier" has gone silent. Uncover the truth and escape with your life.

title: Rocket League: Season 23
description:
Season 23 is the thirty-seventh competitive season in Rocket League and the twenty-third competitive season after the free to play update. It is themed around the 2026 FIFA World Cup and features the Ryza Trophy and Ryza T60 Bodies in the Rocket Pass.

This season introduces the Night variant of the Futura Garden arena to the game as well as the ability to pick which side of the goal post you can respawn from.

title: JumpStart Pre-K
description: In JumpStart Pre-K, the player goes to various locations in a town, including a bakery, a firehouse, and a construction site. Each place has an educational minigame hosted by one of four characters: Eleanor the elephant, Casey the cat, Kisha the koala, and Pierre the polar bear. Upon completing minigames, the player earns objects to put in the park.

title: O2
description: A short deep-sea horror game where you explore a dark and mysterious ocean, photograph strange discoveries, and uncover what lurks beneath the depths.

title: Ignitement
description: As a fire shaman, descend into a meditative battle against your inner demons. Wield explosive fire magic in a rogue-lite inferno. Burn through hordes, gather coins, unlock upgrades, and master the flame.

title: Chu!! Karate Uranai Voxel
description: Karate and fortune-telling become one――KARATE URANAI. When two warriors meet, fate is placed beneath the fist. Face a charging tiger, birds in flight, a floating sage master, and the phantom dragon. Throw an avocado, offer a bow, or perhaps――

title: Pig King
description: The battle for the pig throne has begun! Fight your way to the top in this arena party brawler for up to 4 players.

title: SWAT God
description:
SWAT God is the world's fastest shooter. Unique mouse control gives you limitless speed and precision. Merciless enemies that only get harder. Are you fast enough?

SWAT God can do things that most do not understand and many refuse to believe. Move like lightning. Dispatch whole squads with one burst and vanish before the sound hits their friends. Bolt to the hostage and rush them to safety in a blur. Shoot one enemy and before his friends can turn to look, flank around the entire building in an instant to finish off the rest.

This is a hyper speed top down shooter that aims to remove all speed limits. Mouse control gives you as much speed and precision as you're capable of. Enemies with faster-than-human reactions will hunt you down, surround you, bombard you with grenades and rockets.

title: Billion Egg Farm
description: Billion Egg Farm is a first-person automation game where you put chickens to work laying eggs and build production lines for eggs, meat, and processed goods.

title: Special Agent: Aigis Pink
description: Aigis Pink and Blue work together under Tritonis to combat the evil organization known as Joker. A month after Aigis Blue infiltrates Joker's hideout alone and goes missing, Aigis Pink begins searching for her missing partner...

title: Monji
description: A virtual companion that lives on your desktop and shares your clock. Monjis grow in real time, from an egg to a grown-up adult shaped by time-based events and small choices. Explore new places, loot parts and craft unique visual mods for your device to show your personality. MONji grows on you !

title: Text Dungeon: The Ring of Life
description: No graphics, No tiles. Just text-RPG adventure! Explore a shifting labyrinth, regain the Ring of Life from the wizard Shingor. Classic roguelike-style messages guide your journey, with narrative scenes evoking the spirit of MUDs and gamebooks. Death is permanent. Every run brings new discoveries.

title: Sewer Call
description: Sewer Call is an atmospheric indie horror game that plunges players into the dark, claustrophobic depths of an underground sewer system. Tasked with answering a mysterious call or investigating a sudden anomaly beneath the city, you must navigate a maze of damp tunnels. As you manage your limited resources and solve environmental puzzles to find a way out, you quickly realize you are not alone. Something dangerous lurks in the shadows, and every step could be your last.

title: The Sphere
description: A grieving mechanic. A sphere that fell from the sky. A mystery that was never meant to be found. The Sphere is a short, atmospheric point & click adventure about loss, wonder, and the unknown.

title: Metro Architect
description: In Metro Architect, you will design, expand, and optimize realistic metro and subway networks inspired by real-world transit systems. Build stations, manage trains, reduce congestion, and keep your city moving.

title: Mackle Story
description: Mackle Story is an RPG by Yamu Soft Laboratory.

title: Shy Dogs: Hidden Orchestra 2
description: Shy Dogs Hidden Orchestra 2 is the sequel to the cozy hidden object game Shy Dogs Hidden Orchestra. This time, you must find not only the dogs, but also their instruments.

title: Mackle Story Remake
description: Mackle Story Remake is a fantasy RPG for Windows by Yamu Soft Laboratory.

title: Locked in Love: The Office
description: An interactive escape room game where your choices determine your fate. Right before a "long holiday," you find yourself trapped in the office with beautiful women for unknown reasons. Collect clues, cooperate with them, and escape this place!

title: Battlemage Ascension
description: Dark Messiah-inspired first-person melee slasher where you play as a battle mage. Combine brutal, physics-driven melee combat with devastating elemental spells and highly interactive environments, kick enemies into traps and throw objects with telekinesis.

title: The Silent Expedition Echo Protocol
description: Co-op first-person horror for 14 players. You and your friends are trapped in endless liminal backrooms where nothing makes sense. Explore, find keys and almond water, and work together to evade unstoppable monsters and escape.

title: Backrooms: The Void
description: Backrooms: The Void is a cooperative psychological horror game for 14 players. Trapped in an endless emptiness where space feels alive and reality constantly distorts, you must navigate decaying corridors, forgotten places, and impossible structures while something unseen follows your every move.

title: Persona 4 Revival: Digital Premium Edition
description:
Persona 4 Revival: P3R & P5R Extra BGM Set

Persona 3 Reload BGMs include:
1. Dungeon BGM: Basement (P3R ver.)
2. Boss Battle BGM: Heartful Cry
3. Result BGM: After the Battle (P3R ver.)

Persona 5 Royal BGMs include:
1. Dungeon BGM: The Whims of Fate
2. Normal Battle BGM: Will Power
3. Result BGM: Triumph

title: My Tsundere Sister
description: The sequel to "My Cold Girlfriend" is here! Live under the same roof with your tsundere cousin sister sporting red twin tails, experience her daily quiet care beneath her sharp tongue, and unlock exclusive sweet and heartwarming summer moments.

title: Carpet Cleaning Simulator
description: Clean carpets, earn money, and grow stronger in this incremental cleaning game. Scrub, rinse, and squeegee your way to profit—before time resets and you start again.

title: DVD Dealer Simulator
description: Build and manage your own DVD game store in DVD Dealer Simulator. Buy, sell, and trade game discs, expand your inventory, upgrade your shop, and move to bigger locations as your business grows. Turn a small store into a thriving gaming retail empire.

title: Epic Card Battle Simulator
description: a PvP card auto-battler simulator, play solo or with up-to 6 Friends! Play cards to summon little dudes who auto-battle each other to the death!

title: Pocket Kitten
description: Pocket Kitten is a cozy virtual pet sim sandbox game where you play with kittens and decorate the space.

title: Neo Capitalist: Stock Market Survival Simulator
description: Trade by day. Eat, sleep, and survive by night. Lose everything with a single bad decision. Neo Capitalist is a financial survival roguelite where the richer you get, the harder the system fights back. Play in a realistic stock market simulation or in a dystopian cyber-punk world.

title: Mackle Story 2
description: The sequel to Mackle Story, an RPG for Windows PCs.

title: Devices Disruptive Offense Simulator
description: Devices Disruptive Offense Simulator (D.D.O.S.) is a physics-based 1v1 combat game where you setup and distribute malicious devices to smash, shoot, blast and electrocute the hostile servers till they get denial-of-service.

title: Crow's Curated Closet: Shop Simulator
description: Step into the role of a boutique owner with a flair for the unusual. Decorate your shop, unlock new collections, and create a space your customers won’t want to leave. Grow your business, optimise your layout, and watch the numbers climb. Turn your tiny shop into a thriving gothic fashion powerhouse

title: Budget Renovation Simulator
description: Turn "Trash" into "Cash"! Buy wrecked houses, hunt for the cheapest materials, and fix them up for a massive profit. Spend the least to make the most in this renovation challenge! Can you finish the job without going broke?

title: Boxing Life Simulator
description: Boxing Life Simulator is a simulator game which combined with boxing mechanics. You can fight with your opponents on tournaments, you can have a social life, you can make money and spend it to improve your power and your social life statues.

title: Gatekeeper Simulator: Inner Circle
description: You guard the gate of a secret society. Every visitor lies, some better than others. Inspect, decide, and live with the consequences of who you let inside.

title: Fit Happens
description: Run a clothing shop in a small town, stock outfits and accessories, set prices, decorate your space, participate in fashion shows, and grow your reputation as you turn an empty storefront into a thriving boutique.

title: Home Store Simulator
description: Run your own home goods store! Sell sofas, refrigerators, TVs and more. Purchase products, set your prices, take payments, design your layout, handle shoplifters, and expand your store to build a successful retail business.

title: Supermarket Life Simulator
description: Run your own supermarket! Buy, stock, and sell items, expand your store, and manage customers. Customize your layout, explore new locations, and hire staff. Keep things fresh with variety and new challenges as you grow your business.

title: Haunted Bar Simulator
description: Run a cozy bar with friends by day. Serve strange customers and survive the horror by night.

title: Supermarket Simulator: Idle Tycoon Clicker
description: Start with a small market and build a huge supermarket empire! In Supermarket Simulator: Idle Tycoon Clicker, fill your shelves, satisfy your customers, make upgrades, increase your income, and grow your store. Click, manage, earn, and reach the top!

title: Dreams of a Visionary
description: Dreams Of A Visionary is a first-person exploration adventure set in a mysterious Victorian mansion. Explore richly detailed rooms, solve challenging puzzles, and gradually uncover the hidden secrets of this surreal dream.

title: Eskinita
description: Eskinita is a short atmospheric Filipino-inspired suspense horror game about working late nights in a small neighborhood lugawan and surviving the walk home through dark alleyways.

title: Supermarket Chaos
description: Supermarket Chaos is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort 4,668 products in a messy supermarket. Enjoy the satisfaction of stocking shelves in a calm, relaxing atmosphere.

title: Froggle
description:
Froggle is a weirdly empowering, delightfully breakable (F)roguelite dungeon crawler!

Live. Die. Ribbit. Inspired by Slay the Spire, Balatro, and Inscryption - if you like any of these, you'll probably like Froggle

Rich, unique, tactical turn-based combat. Basic initially; progressively awesomer.

title: Grapixo Arte em Guerra
description: Scratch in a 2.5D world that blends hip hop aesthetics with action/platforming, where urban art has come to life. Explore dynamic environments, face cleaning robots, and uncover secrets of this vibrant world as you reclaim your identity in this intense and colorful adventure.

title: Dawn in Bloody Darkness
description:
The main character comes true long-awaited dream and he buys a private house. All goes well until terrible things start happening at night. You realize you're not alone here, and you can only wait for dawn.

-Stealth gameplay (you can hide in the game).

-The monsters will be looking for you.

-Several opportunities to get into another world.

-Multiple endings. What you get-depends on you!

-Grim soundtrack.

title: Project Red Sun
description:
Project Red Sun is a flightcade game that takes place in a once-broken world, with challenging gameplay inspired by classic flight shooters and sci-fi titles of yesteryear.

Worked on by people who have done it before, Project Red Sun is at heart an exploration into the power of an ace, the voracity of the enemy, and what it means to be a hero.

title: 101 Dogs Hidden in Miami
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 dogs in Miami in the hand-crafted landscape. Earn tons of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick! ️

title: 101 Dogs Hidden in Bangkok
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 dogs in Bangkok in the hand-crafted landscape. Earn tons of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick! ️

title: 101 Dogs Hidden in New Delhi
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 dogs in New Delhi in the hand-crafted landscape. Earn tons of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick! ️

title: 101 Dogs Hidden in London
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 dogs in London in the hand-crafted landscape. Earn tons of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick! ️

title: 101 Cats in Sydney
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens in the hand-crafted Sydney landscape. Earn lots of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick! ️

title: 101 Cats in Munich
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens in the hand-crafted Munich landscape. Earn lots of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick! ️

title: 101 Dogs Hidden in Vienna
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 dogs in Vienna in the hand-crafted landscape. Earn tons of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick! ️

title: 101 Dogs Hidden in New York
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 dogs in New York in the hand-crafted landscape. Earn tons of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick! ️

title: Blooming Ashes
description:
This game is a course project that we're excited to launch and experiment with in the Steam world. We're telling a story with great enthusiasm and hope that it reaches many people who can appreciate the world in which it unfolds. The game is based in a post-apocalyptic world ravaged by a pandemic called Lavender, which infects simply by breathing it. The story takes place two years after the pandemic's outbreak. It's a graphic novel with decision-making, in which you'll play as Char, one of the main characters. It's a relatively short experience that introduces the entire world of Lavender.

In short, the game is a graphic novel with constant decision-making. Depending on the choices you make, the course of the story can change, leading to several endings in this first chapter.

title: Flavors of Spain
description: Embark on a fast-paced arcade culinary journey! Master the brave bull to shoot iconic dishes to the 52 provinces of Spain. Test your aim and discover the rich gastronomy of Spain in this indie blend of geography, gastronomy, and strategy.

title: Pixel Texas Hold'em
description: Online Texas Hold'em with publicly verifiable fair dealing. We never manipulate outcomes to drive spending. Every hand is decided by player judgment, strategy, nerve, and timing. Play with friends, read opponents, manage your chips, and personalize your table with themes and card backs.

title: Endless Invader
description: Defend the planet to the end by taking down waves of enemies! Orbit Assault Action Defense game "Endless Invader" Don't you want to get completely immersed in the play with various combat styles? Play now!

title: Project: Firmament
description: Project: Firmament is a top-down horde shooter where you blast through missions using a unique aiming system that puts quick-minded positioning, map knowledge, and loadout planning as the main contributors to your success.

title: Project Corner
description: Project Corner is a fast-paced, tactical multiplayer Prop Hunt game where the classic childhood hide-and-seek hits a whole new level of tension and comedy.

title: Mini Golf Simulator
description: A new style of mini golf game where you swing with the Joy-Con hanging down!

title: Hunting Pro Simulator
description: In Hunting Pro Simulator, your hearts racing, hands shaking BAM! Take the perfect headshot! Feel the thrill, aim the target, and celebrate as the beast hits the ground. Hunting has never felt this easy!

title: Galactic Pit Stop Simulator
description: Run the busiest fuel station on the edge of known space. Refuel incoming ships, trade goods in your market and hangar, upgrade your station, and keep travelers happy solo or with up to 3 friends in online co-op. Build the ultimate galactic pit stop.

title: F1 Simulator
description: F1 Simulator puts you in the cockpit, where every turn, every boost, and every second counts. Feel the adrenaline, chase insane speeds, and carve your name into the record books as the ultimate racing legend!

title: Bar Darts Simulator
description: In Bar Darts Simulator, grab a few beers with friends, crack a few jokes, and challenge each other across 10 fun dart games. Aim, throw, and take a sip of your drink while you listen to the lively bar atmosphere.

title: Battleships Simulator
description: Battleships Simulator puts you in command of mighty shipsstrike, sink your opponent, and claim victory! Feel the thrill of naval battles and outsmart your foe in intense, turn-based war action!

title: Lazy Kickers
description: Lazy kickers is a tiny soccer incremental where you grow balls from plants and shoot goals for coins. Start small and climb the leaderboards, unlocking more upgrades to score millions and plunge the playing field into total chaos.

title: The Luffman Experiment
description: An experimental adult visual novel set entirely inside a computer operational system. You interact with different characters, the main one being a man with self-destructive fetishes who gives you the power to decide his own fate. Your choices can lead you and him to thirteen different endings. (contains sexual topics, mature themes and nudity).

title: Mayu no Ori kara Mieru Sora
description:
A mystery adventure game set in a near-future school.
It features over 50 CGs, 3 routes, 21 endings, and over 10 hours of gameplay.

title: Ichiya Kitan
description:
There was a humble novelist. The novelist stayed at an inn, harboring a certain wish in his heart.
The novelist wanted his wish granted.
— I wanted the zashiki-warashi, a house spirit said to appear at that inn, to grant my wish.

title: The Last Flight
description: Rebuild a forgotten airplane, manage your survival, and soar across a hauntingly beautiful world. Balance your stats, scavenge for parts, and chart your course through a post-apocalyptic sky. Every flight is a step closer to freedom... If your past doesn’t catch up first. Prepare for takeoff!

title: Adabana no Yakata
description: Six men and women have been gathered at a mysterious mansion. The one who brought them together is a girl who calls herself Kurenai Otogiri. She claims to be a psychopathic serial killer and demands that the six men and women participate in a life-or-death game.

title: Cardinal Fall
description: Cardinal Fall is a nonprofit, community-developed, story-driven, 3d side-view, survival-horror, single or co-op game set within an original far-future dystopian sci-fi universe where you play as a clone—known as an Echo, located in a research facility where catastrophic events are unfolding.

title: Dungeons & Dragons Online: Terror of Demogorgon
Blade of Mercy: Bloody Countess
description: Blade of Mercy: Bloody Countess is a 2D action with metroidvania elements set in a 16th-century fantasy world, drawn with cozy pixels. Explore a mysterious realm, battle ruthless enemies, and uncover powerful weapons and abilities. And remember: beer is the best medicine in these grim times!

title: Austerity X
description: It's election season in the UK. Justine visits Barmford to ask the cross-obsessed locals who they're voting for in this classic survival horror. Find rabbit holes and uncover scandals as you unveil the gruesome reality behind Michael Hallow's 30 year reign as mayor, before the calendar runs out.

title: Ibuki Suika Game
description: A Touhou themed Suika game clone.

title: Galaksia Online
description: Galaksia Online is an action-packed, 2D multiplayer space MMORPG blending retro pixel art aesthetics with mechanics. Forge alliances, custom-build your starships block by block, and engage in massive faction-based PvP wars or challenging PvE raid battles across dangerous stellar sectors.

title: Empire Water Works
description: Empire Water Works is a steam engine simulator based in a water pumping station. Operate and maintain your pumping station day and night, maintain city water pressure and fulfill contracts. Interact with realistic steam, coal-firing, and audio simulation in a vintage setting.

title: Megako Punch!
description: “Megako Punch!” is a fast-paced deck-building roguelike!Jump into a world teeming with monsters and beat them to a pulp with your special moves!

title: Tileburg
description: Tileburg is a game where each tile played has direct effects as well as powerful combos that trigger as soon as the conditions are met. Transform the landscape and develop your city while scoring points. Each turn, the city expands on a random tile!

title: Hack 42: Typing Incremental
description: Hack 42 is a short typing incremental game about crafting powerful hacks and smashing computers for fun and profit.

title: Void Fragment
description: The Void needs to grow. An idle incremental game where you feed a Void with Mana and Essences. Collect Void Fragments to upgrade the spirits, so they can continue feeding the Void even more.

title: Land of Disorder
description: Land of Disorder is a vertical ecology open-world sandbox MMO. You will come to the world of "The Aten Continent" as an adventurer where magic and creation are interwoven to write your own legend.

title: TFC2: The Fertile Crescent 2 - Collapse of The Bronze Age
description: Lead your small caravan on a great journey across the ancient world, in a story-driven RTS where protecting your family and friends matters more than conquest.

title: Her Red Cosmos
description: A burnt out singer seeks solitude in her deceased grandmother's old home. Then something starts leaving her flowers.

title: Wish Creatures
description: Turn your monsters into stars and wish on them in turn-based battle!

title: Grimdelve
description: Grimdelve is a role playing game where the last of humanity dwells underground. Guide two souls through a dying world and decide who they become. Sneak past strangers, try to understand them, or tear them apart. Become charming manipulators or complete disasters.

title: Boli
description: Boli is a retro-style JRPG with hand-drawn ASCII art. Venture forth into the wilderness to find a cure for a rare disease that is decimating your village.

title: SimCity Societies Deluxe Edition
description: This compilation includes SimCity Societies and its add-on SimCity Societies: Destinations.

title: Ten Years of Rain
description: Ten Years of Rain is a fantasy adventure Zelda-like with a unique Central Asian inspired setting. Pick up your blade, call your hawk, and prepare to travel the cursed lands. Battle the forces of the Great Khan, explore the secret places of the world, and discover the cause of the long rain...

title: Some Type of Trip
description: A simple typing narrative game exploring the depths of the mind. Sometimes cozy and warm, sometimes intense and challenging, always interesting.

title: PoPiRoRai
description: POPIRORAI is a bizarre puzzle adventure in which you must decipher texts written in a mysterious language and overcome obstacles as you set out to discover what has happened in this minimalist 1-bit world. Find the light, Roppi...

title: Harvest Hollow
description: You’ve just inherited a house on a small farming island. Grow crops, gather resources, and get to know the locals... But what was supposed to be a peaceful new life will quickly turn into an investigation.

title: Bloodstate
description:
Bloodstate is a first-person zombie survival horror game developed by KAIGEN. Players take on the role of the sole survivor of a failed military operation and must fight their way through infected territory while restoring power, scavenging resources, and uncovering the truth behind a catastrophic outbreak.

The game features mission-based progression, large-scale horde encounters, dynamic zombie dismemberment, infection management, and a variety of special infected with unique behaviors. Players must search for weapons, ammunition, medical supplies, batteries, and infection cures while navigating dangerous environments filled with hostile infected.

Special infected include ELENA, a highly infectious female infected; STALKER packs, crawler-type predators that hunt and drag victims to feeding locations; MAUL, a massive infected capable of devastating area attacks; Zombie Dogs; and Dark Infected that avoid sunlight and lurk within buildings and shadowed areas.

Additional gameplay features include enterable buildings, destructible routes, environmental interactions, night vision gameplay, military support events, helicopter flyovers, weapon scavenging, and progression through interconnected missions and Advance Points.

Built in Unity 6 HDRP, BLOODSTATE combines atmospheric exploration, survival mechanics, and large-scale infected encounters into a single-player zombie survival horror experience.

title: S.L.O.P
description: SLOP is an online co-op Horror cooking game where you and Up to 3 other friends scavenge abandoned storage rooms, gather questionable ingredients, and cook the biggest meal possible to satisfy your corporate overlord monsters.

title: Oops Unit
description: Oops Unit is an online co-op game where up to 6 players team up as a bomb squad. Solve puzzles, gather resources, and push through deadly traps and enemies to reach and defuse every bomb. Extract, buy new gear, and repeat—or die trying, because anything, even your friends, can sabotage the mission.

title: Sunrose
description: Type in any seven letter phrase, and play with the corresponding SUNROSE.

title: Beyond R'proach
description: Beyond R'proach is a short five minute long game where you can push plants out of your way.

title: I
description: There is a button for jumping, and a button for dashing. You can do a jump and a dash in the air once for every spirit you clear.

title: Dinosaur Hunting Simulator
description: Go back in time in Dinosaur Hunting Simulator, grip your rifle tight, and feel the thrill as you track massive tyrannosaurus, triceratops, and more across wild, untamed landscapes. Every hunt is a heart-pounding adventure.

title: Truck Simulator 2026: USA
description: Step into the driver’s seat in Truck Simulator 2026: USA! Haul cargo across iconic American highways, drive trucks, customize your rig, and build your own transport empire from coast to coast!

title: Boxing Pro Simulator
description: Boxing Pro Simulator throws you into the ring with the roar of the crowd in your ears! Unleash unstoppable punches, lightning jabs, and crushing hooks in adrenaline-fueled bouts where every hit could be the knockout blow!

title: Spaceship Pro Simulator
description: Spaceship Pro Simulator. Strapped in and ready. One ship, one missionsurvive the unknown. Enemies ahead, systems online. This is my journey through deep space, and I'm not going down easy.

title: Pilot Force Simulator
description: Pilot Force Simulator throws you into the heart of a chaotic space battle. Dodge waves of bullets, feel the thrill of near-misses, and unleash powerful attacks in an intense, fast-paced fight through the stars!

title: Squirrel University Simulator
description: You are a squirrel, the goal is to get a diploma on campus. You can follow the to-do list to play, or find secrets in every corner of the campus.

title: My Favorite Store Simulator
description: Start with a small shop and work your way up to a huge supermarket! Manage prices, serve customers, catch thieves, hire staff, and much more. Play solo or in co-op with up to 4 players.

title: Flyra: FPV Drone Simulator
description: Flyra is a high-speed FPV drone simulator with Racing, Freestyle, and Survival challenges. Test your reflexes, explore unique environments, and fly a range of drones with realistic physics. Discover the thrill of flying free.

title: Ding! Pocket It!: Rogue Simulator
description: A Roguelite deck-builder with pool-style controls. Refine your cap combos, hone your shot skills, and use Base × Multiplier to rack up a high score!

title: Lost Soul Aside: Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
Embark on an epic odyssey to save your sister and the whole of humankind from dimensional invaders in a stylish single player action-adventure RPG.

The Digital Deluxe Edition includes:
• Lost Soul Aside
• Three weapon fragment cosmetics: Genesis Thunder, Everlasting Ember, and Crystal of Abyss
• Arena skin: Golden Blaze
• Ruby Necklace health booster
• Gemstone Badge XP booster
• Digital soundtrack
• Digital art book

title: Almost Out
description: Almost Out is a horror escape room simulator where you must escape a psycho while leaving no traces of your escape attempt.

title: Crow's Foot
description: A turn-based hex strategy you can finish over lunch. Outsmart AI rivals, each with their own grudges, ambitions, and breaking points. Conquer provinces, command knights, scouts, assassins, and more. Unlock rule-bending scrolls. Go bankrupt and your own army defects.

title: NoodlePunk
description: Forced into a corporate-mandated work program, you must run a noodle shop in a dying cyberpunk city to pay off your crushing debt. Prepare orders fast, manage your ingredients, and upgrade your operation while keeping up with relentless customer drones.

title: FleetLord
description: A space RTS about decisions, not menus. Conquer planets, link them to fuel your war machine, and level up your empire with randomized perk cards. Crush all opposition.

title: Don't Lose Face!
description: Don't Lose Face! is an abstract simulation game that makes you flustered and laugh until you're exhausted. What you're about to face: multi-tasking torture, facial features that slide down like cream, hilarious physics feedback, abstract random events…

title: Circuit Keep
description: Circuit Keep is a grid‑based tower defense game where players build and upgrade circuit‑themed defenses to repel escalating waves of intrusions. The game features a campaign of handcrafted lattices, a research system, and multiple enemy types with unique behaviors. Players manage resources, optimize layouts, and adapt to changing threats across increasingly complex maps.

title: Fable: Premium Edition
description: Fable Premium Edition includes the full game with Early Access, letting you play up to 5 days before launch, and Premium Edition Content Pack (featuring Splendid Armour, Bastard Armour, and in-game gifts), Fable Digital Artbook & Soundtrack, and the Fable: Order of the Hero expansion coming post-launch.

title: Soul Food
description: A survival RPG with Slow-burn weight-gain aspect! Lost on a pilgrimage, you end up in the ruins of a fallen kingdom. Feed on the animated guardians of this lost place to cultivate your various stats and abilities. Maybe even recruit other adventurers and guardians to your cause!

title: Furry Aim Trainer 2: Multiplayer Gooning
description: Furry Aim Trainer 2 arrives with more advanced training and multiplayer support! With a massive selection of furry targets and so many weapons to train on, you can enhance your skills and your pleasure at the same time!

title: Corrupted Archives
description: A Boom compatible 6 maps journey through a corrupted WAD. Each map can be completed in ﻿10-15 minutes.

title: Never Look Back
description: A psychological, rule-based horror game set on an infinite liminal staircase. Players have to descend the staircase, squeeze a cute rubber duck, and never look back as the Darkness follows behind.

title: The Velvet Green Witch: A Quiet Life
description: A survival RPG centered on gathering herbs, hunting, and harvesting to stay alive. Explore the forest to secure food and resources, maintain your life at a small base, and build a quiet connection with a witch. The potions she brews expand your options in both exploration and daily living.

title: Gears of War: E-Day Premium Edition
description:
The Gears of War: E-Day Premium Edition Includes:
- Base Game
- Up to 5-Days Early Access
- Bravo Squad Signature Weapon Pack
- Five Seasonal Customization Packs, starting with the Emergence Pack at launch (the remaining packs will be available as released)
- 1,000 Iron (premium in-game currency)

title: Chonky Cat
description: Become the fluffiest menace in Chonky Cat, play as a massively overfed cat on a never ending snack binge. Chase, crush, and devour waves of creatures to grow even fatter and more unstoppable. Eat everything, unlock upgrades, multipliers and customizations and see just how chonky you can get!

title: Hill-Z
description: Zombie wave survival meets King of the hill. Survive, Upgrade, and Protect your flag. Face the unexpected through special rounds, endure the constantly growing horde, and customize your loadout. How many rounds will you survive?

title: Hecate's Grove
description:
Once thought to be lost to the satanic panic of the late 80s, Hecate's Grove has found its way into your hands. Made by Animism, a one-person dev team from the pacific northwest, known for absorbing tongue-in-cheek computer games. Hecate's Grove is a piece of interactive fiction that only asks one thing of its player: their time.

This game was made for the O2A2 VN Jam 2023, a micro Visual Novel jam with strict asset limitations and a 1000-word limit.

title: Congratulations On Your Purchase
description: The most expensive game on Steam. A palace, a red carpet, paparazzi, and a wall where you leave your name — visible to every owner who comes after you. Ten minutes. The price is not a mistake. It is the point.

title: Teardown: Quilez R0113R Robot
description:
The Quilez R0113R is the latest addition to the autonomous robot security system.
R0113R can patrol the most remote locations and traverse the toughest terrain given its two form formula paired with its powerful grappling winch.

title: Teardown: Relics of Barkuna
description:
You play as James Thorvaldsson, a seasoned solo explorer. Commissioned by the Relic Hunters Group, he sets off on a mission to retrieve the Great Gem of Barkuna.

Explore the jungle-enveloped Jaguar’s Haven, traverse the cliffs high in the mountain of Eagle’s Perch, and unravel the secrets hidden within the lava-filled Serpent’s Hollow.

title: Forged from Monsters
description: Not every sword begins as steel. Forge weapons from monster parts with hands-on control over every step of the process. Discover surprising effective combinations of creature parts heroes bring to your smithy.

title: MonCraft 199X
description: Explore a retro-inspired open-world sandbox adventure set in a post-Y2K alternate reality. As an aspiring Mon trainer you'll battle opponents, rescue lost souls, rebuild towns, and research mysterious monsters across a wild world. Can you conquer the chaos and restore a thriving community?

title: Shout-Ai
description: This game contains psychological horror, unsettling dialogue, screen noise, blackouts, glitches, fake code logs, and effects that may appear as if something is happening on the player's PC. It does not contain gore, explicit sexual content, drug use, or realistic violence against real people.

title: Slot Grind
description: Slot Grind is an incremental slot machine game where you spin, earn money, and put it back into upgrades. Unlock new machines with better payouts, improve them, and automate your slots as your profits grow, until you finally pay off your debts.

title: Typegrinder
description: A keyboard-first typing game built around discovery. Hunt new words across 3-to-12 letter brackets, forge speed-runs from your personal decks, and battle the world on daily online leaderboards. Pure typing, no fluff.

title: Decktoon
description: Decktoon is a strategic card game inspired by Brazilian comics, where you build decks with characters, scenes, and twists to battle in dynamic matches full of combos, tactics, and emotion.

title: Marie Android
description: Do you like Marie‑chan? You play as Marie Android, a small girl‑like robot who meets many friends. Using mysterious powers, she can become muscular, flatten into a paper‑thin form, or transform into a giant tank to fight enemies. Borrow your friends’ abilities and save Akacha Town.

title: Kaiju Princess: Super Survivor Showdown
description: Explore a phantasmic realm! Pulverize your enemies! Don't die! Ah... But don't forget to find a way out! Choose from a variety of weapons, skills, and items to complement your character's traits and customize the optimal combat style for survival. Get ready for a fast-paced roguelike survival game!

title: Sender Unknown
description: Work the night shift in an underground sorting facility. Weigh packages, compare their contents, and meet your quota by 6 AM. But beware, some packages hide dark secrets. Identify bad batches, earn cash, and survive the night in this tense PSX-style horror job simulator.

title: SCP: Antimemetics Division
description: No, it's not your first day. The Amnestics have kicked in, and Site-48 has locked down. Scavenge restricted gear, gain clearance to forgotten levels, and bend reality to escape lethal SCP anomalies. Tactile survival horror where remembering too much will get you annihilated.

title: Micro RPG
description: Monsters have invaded the kingdom, taking advantage of the knights' annual holiday! You are the last hope! Equip yourself with weapons and fight the monsters surrounding you in this turn-based game with your spinning attacks across a dozen fantasy worlds!

title: LarsGadiel
description: LarsGadiel is a classic NES-style Metroidvania and the prequel to Xenon Valkyrie.

title: Fell & Sell
