description: Slay. Loot. Sell. Survive! Dive into a first-person blend of hack'n'slash roguelike and shop management. Plunder deadly dungeons for loot, escape with your life, craft, and stock your shelves. Then risk it all once more for profit!

title: Fjellward
description: Fjellward is a pixelart 2D sandbox game set in a procedurally generated world. The game is centered around exploration and mining.

title: Going Once!
description: Going Once! is a cozy art gallery / auction house management game. Appraise and buy art, display it in your gallery and auction it off to the highest bidder!

title: Kill the Super Duper Big Monster
description: Kill the Super Duper Big Monster is an idle/incremental game where you face different monsters while the game is running. Defeat various monsters to improve your skills, unlock cosmetics, and customize your island.

title: The Final Week
description: Take command of the final place on earth that hasn't been complete destroyed. Gather survivors and save as many of them as you can by sending them into space to the base there. Remember you have 7 days

title: DAL'T-4
description: Whatever you do — don't press ALT and F4. No body. No memory. Just two keys: ALT and F4. You are a virus — and this PC is your hunting ground. Burrow into the system, devour programs, and corrupt everything in your path. Rule this digital world. Or be deleted trying.

title: Caca Clicker
description: The most absurd clicker on Steam! Click, produce, prestige, and dive into Corrupted Mode. Face bosses, challenge the casino, unlock 25 skins, 33 wallpapers, and dozens of achievements. A wacky universe for hundreds of hours of gameplay.

title: Atelier's Key
description: Atelier's Key is a dark-fantasy FPS set in a root-bound Victorian world inhabited by puppets. Severed from a hivemind and armed with a mysterious weapon; shoot, grapple, and unlock your way through this world to save a Father from his own damned creation.

title: Mò Bǐ Wū Sī De Fēngyìn
Shēngsǐ Jūjī: Zhànhuǒ Chóng Rán - Guójì Bǎn
description: The Steam version of Global Strike has expanded modes and weapons compared to the original browser version

title: Brix
description: Think it, build it, and watch it break. Brix is a physics-based engineering sandbox where you tackle impossible challenges with your own custom creations. From battlebots to earthquake-proof towers..

title: A Mountain Called Hope
description: Explore a hauntingly abandoned late 1800s mountain coal mining town afflicted by a violent winter storm.

title: Qiāng Shén Chūjī
description: Hurry to encircle the growing monsters in the nest! Upgrade weapons, choose your exclusive occupation, strategy combination, a 15 minute meat pigeon experience, and directly shoot, explode, brush, explode!! You can also select the 20 minute mode!

title: Zuòwéi Yóuxì Hè Shīgē De Shìjiè
description: One day, Yule unexpectedly encounters the mysterious girl from his dreams, Elwin. Yul embarks on a journey with her to collect manuscripts and uncover the truth of the past.

title: Hotel Manager: Together
description: Build your own hotel empire from scratch! Welcome guests, prepare rooms, hire staff, and transform a small motel into a five-star luxury resort. Can you keep your guests happy and reach the top in this fast-paced time management game ?

title: Jiàn Wǔ Xuánhuàn Zhī Lǚ
description: 一款玄幻类的文字挂机冒险游戏，可放置可探索剧情，即刻进入一个系统丰富且娱乐快捷的挂机世界吧！

title: Grandpa Needs Fish
description: Grandpa Needs Fish is a cozy idle clicker game where fortune rides the waves. You are Abraham and you have one mission: catch as many fish as possible. Every cast brings new rewards and every upgrade makes you stronger. Hover, catch, upgrade, and repeat in this satisfying idle incremental adventure.

title: Chicken Escape
description: Chaotic co-op fun! Play as clumsy chickens, escape the farm, and survive physics-based madness with your friends.

title: Train Set Code
description: Build a train set layout where everything runs on its own. Automate points and signals to direct the trains and keep them moving. Get creative and design a huge network that carries a fleet of trains.

title: Ghostpunk
description: Investigate paranormal cases using a 1990s CRT terminal. Analyze photos. Decode audio. Interrogate suspects and decide what’s real, what’s fake and who’s lying. But the deeper you go, the more the system starts watching you back.

title: A Simpler World
description: A small, cozy building game. Tidy up and decorate a pixel-art world. No goals, just vibes.

title: When the Stars Threw Down Their Spears
description: When the Stars Threw Down Their Spears is a story-rich, retro space shooter inspired by DOS-era space games like Star Control, Solar Winds, and Lightspeed. Blast your way through fast-paced arcade combat; build out modular, upgradable ships; and explore a galaxy torn by war.

title: Good Hands
description: In Good Hands, join Nia as she helps her neighbor Aunty Zubeida tidy up a tangled garden. Tend, sort, and restore calm in this cozy puzzle about care and connection. Unwind with over 100 uniquely crafted puzzles, made for anyone who finds joy in gardens.

title: Into the Deep
description:
This game was made by 6 students as a group project assignment for their third year in the bachelor Digital Arts & Entertainment at Hogeschool West-Vlaanderen in Belgium.

The music was composed by Behnaz Tohidi, student at the Royal Conservatoire of Ghent.

Into The Deep - a rhythm roguelike game where you must dive into the ocean and clear it from corruption caused by a meteor.

Dash and fight your way through the rooms full of corrupted creatures and find your way to the Final Boss. On your playthrough you might find various abilities that you can equipt to completely change your playstyle for the run.

title: Salvation: Echoes of War
description: Explore a haunting purgatory in this third-person stealth adventure. Injured and trapped in a nightmare after war, solve puzzles, outsmart enemies, and rely on your loyal companion to find a way back to life. Can you escape your past and survive the echoes of war?

title: The Bed Above My Head
description: Youre playing a game in the dark. Something in your room is not. In this Sit & Survive type psychological horror game, you're a child playing on your console, while something roams your room. Observe your surroundings, listen carefully and manage your stress to survive this nightmarish night.

title: Sourcevoid Online
description:
Heavily inspired by Anomidae's INTERLOPER webseries, Sourcevoid Online is a massively online multiplayer fan game where you literally fall onto contemporary and forgotten community maps created for Valve’s original line-up of Source Engine titles.

Powered by a custom, remarkably accurate Source Engine asset importer developed for Godot Engine; the game allows you to explore countless maps from Half-Life 2, Counter-Strike: Source, Team Fortress 2, Garry's Mod and other games.

You can play alone or gather with your friends by inputting the same spawn seed on the main menu. Featuring proximity text and voice chats, if lucky enough you might randomly come across and interact with other players exploring the vast void... but be wary: the entities native to this environment do not want you to be here. Can you make it to the door?

title: Hell Cleaners
description: A first-person automation game set in hell. Suck up demon bodies, feed them into the Grinder, fuel your Purifier, and deploy a swarm of Doombas to build a cleaning operation that runs itself and takes the rot back one zone at a time.

title: Quickscope King
description: A fast arcade sniper challenge where every shot counts.

title: Forgive Me My Love
description: A first-person psychological horror game about the crushing weight of guilt. Live through the aftermath of a devastating tragedy: your wife is dead, and its your fault. But when her casket is brought home, something inexplicable and terrifying begins to warp your reality...

title: TerraFirmaGreg
description:
The TerraFirmaGreg group of modpacks are a special hybrid of two titans of modding: TerraFirmaCraft (a deep, realistic survival overhaul) and GregTech (an expansive tech mod famous for its realistic chemistry and complex progression). Both have been seamlessly blended together for a stone-age-to-space-age experience.

Are you looking for a longer modpack where every step feels rewarding, and you're constantly building upon previous technologies in a way that feels seamless and natural?
Do you want a modpack where every mod is carefully integrated instead of just thrown in?
Do you dislike magic mods, or want to try a tech modpack that feels less "minecrafty" with its automation?
Or do you just want to try out GregTech without losing years of your life? Then TerraFirmaGreg may be the modpack for you!

TerraFirmaGreg-Modern (for 1.20.1) is a modern iteration built on GregTech Modern. It emphasizes seamless integration of all mods (Create, Ad Astra, AE2) along with a ton of custom content for a seamless and unique experience. This is a more "polished" experience with modern mechanics.

TerraFirmaGreg-Vintage (for 1.12.2) is the classic version based on GregTech CEu. It offers "survival as it should be" - harsh, realistic, and full of challenges, with classic tech mods like Galacticraft and OpenComputers.

Both packs feature natural progression, deep integration, both survival and automation, a non-magic focus, and tons of in-game help in the form of quests and guides so you can easily navigate your way.

title: By My Side
description: Survive the wild with a loyal dog at your side. Wash up with nothing, tame a stray and raise it as your companion — build and power a home, outlast brutal winters, and face a world that fights back.

title: Northeast Past
description: Immersed in the turbulent "Tohoku" underworld epic of the 1980s, "Northeast Past" is a real-life interactive video game that combines hardcore underworld survival rules with multi-branching narratives, taking you to experience the underworld and get involved in the bloody fate of gang disputes.

title: Tisis
description: Tisis is a first-person psychological horror game focused on exploration, environmental storytelling, and sanity management as you navigate the thin boundary between light, darkness, and madness.

title: Liminal 98
description: Navigate four procedurally generated liminal spaces. Reach the exit. Beat your time. Something may be watching.

title: Backrooms: Exit 8
description: SCP-6876 has escaped. Your mission: retrieve 10 vials of Toilet water for DARPA to synthesize into a poison against it. Carefully observe each stall to escape the Endless Bathrooms, avoid SCP-6876, and reach 'Room 10'

title: Ghosts Keep Out
description: Defend your base in this Roguelite survival shooter TD! Mix random skills + evolve gems to craft your Build. 5-min fast rounds, intense zombie & ghost hordes. Triple progression: Spirits, guns, heroes. Easy to learn, hard to put down. Low barrier, high ceiling. Every run is fresh!

title: Beach Defense: Zombie Invasion
description: Command soldiers, survive zombie waves! A light strategy game mixing turn-based & real-time strategy, bullet hell, and backpack-like mechanics. Fit troops into limited backpack slots, build max firepower, challenge difficulty levels, and defend the last beach. Perfect for tower defense & fans.

title: Orbit's Grocery
description: Manage the galaxys quirkiest store in Orbits Grocery! Balance retail tasks like window wiping and shelf stocking with chaotic mini-games. Encounter eccentric aliens that trigger FPS, racing, and horror events. Survive cosmic phenomena in this genre-bending workplace adventure.

title: Backrooms Game Creator
description: Backrooms Game Creator lets you build and explore your own liminal horror worlds. Design levels, customize enemies, lighting, and items, and create unique experiencesfrom quiet, eerie spaces to intense survival scenarios.

title: Ikun vs. Xhz
description: Play as an Aikun, armed with basketballs and chicken claws, reclaim the stolen eggs, and stand against endless waves of Black Fans across 250 levels. The unique death penalty and True Love Ranking system make every battle full of challenge and fun.

title: Liminal: Escape Route
description: Your only goal is to find a door and advance to the next level. Sounds simple enough, right? But in these endless, unsettling liminal spaces, nothing is as it seems. What could possibly go wrong?

title: Backrooms: Lost Signal
description: A terrifying 1-4 player co-op horror game. Explore 10+ handcrafted Backrooms maps, survive against 8+ unique entities, and use proximity voice chat to coordinate or panic. Your decisions shape the story with multiple endings. Discover optional lore that reveals the truth behind these Backrooms.

title: Backrooms: Last Chance
description: Backrooms: Last Chance is a first-person horror and puzzle game. Collect 25 keys and 5 keycards across three levels to escape the maze and the dark hotel. A tense atmosphere and sudden jumpscares keep you on edge. Average playtime: 12 hours.

title: Backrooms: Labyrinth Glitch
description: Backrooms: Labyrinth Glitch is a cooperative horror experience for 14 players.Silence has a sound and its not what it should be.Every step feels wrong, every shadow seems to move when youre not looking.The only question is: how long can you keep going?

title: Backrooms: Realism
description: Youve slipped into the Backrooms an endless maze that watches your back. Keep your sanity, hunger, and thirst in check as horrific entities stalk you throughout the halls.

title: Liminal Explorer
description: Wander through a variety of eerie liminal spaces whilst completing puzzles and discovering secrets. Each level is designed to be explored to its fullest, packed with hidden details and objectives for true Liminal Explorers.

title: Backrooms Union
description: A co-op or solo survival-horror scavenger game where you explore labyrinthine Backrooms levels, dodge stalking entities, haul scrap to hit corporate quotas, and invest your pay in upgrades to dive even deeper

title: Backrooms: Glitchfield
description: Backrooms: Glitchfield is a cooperative horror game for 14 players. You have to explore this level by yourself or with the help of your friends and complete it, have you ever encountered crashes? and if they have flooded the whole world will you be able to complete the game?

title: Backrooms: The Wrong Level
description: Backrooms: The Wrong Level is a cooperative horror game for 14 players. Alone or with friends, you will explore the game, trying to understand where you are, what is happening and how to survive on this hellish level.

title: Backrooms: The True Level
description: Backrooms: The True Level is a cooperative horror game for 14 players. Together or alone, you will explore this level trying to understand whether it is real, but can the darkness in this world be peaceful?

title: Walking In
description: This is a walking type game developed and produced by a single player, which only requires walking and appreciation, with slight decryption. But please rest assured that there are no monsters or protruding face elements in the game, so feel free to play.

title: Isekai Guild Simulation
description: Isekai Guild Simulation is a guild management game where you run an adventurers' guild: recruit adventurers, send them on quests, trade items, and grow your guild's rank and reputation. Manage your party, complete kingdom decrees, upgrade your hall, and balance your gold and fame as your guild rises from humble beginnings to legendary status.

title: Kitty Found a Camera
description: A First-and-Third-Person Photo Shooter (FATPPS) where you take photos to solve problems and get into mischief.

title: Exo Digger
description: Exo Digger is a relaxing mining simulator set on a distant planet. Dig deep, extract rare minerals, upgrade your equipment, and expand your inventory. Explore the depths, but beware some areas of the mines may be dangerous. Who knows what secrets this planet holds beneath its surface?

title: Backrooms: The Deep Dark
description: Backrooms: The Deep Dark is a 4-player cooperative horror game where you will survive in a mysterious scary atmospheric world, wander through unknown dark corners and get scared of every nook and cranny!

title: Level 13
description: Escape your apartment corridor starting on Level 13. Look closely for anomalies to find the way out and avoid any unpleasant neighbors you find along the way.

title: Backrooms: The Yellow Dream
description: A wanderer who will survive face to face with unknown creatures of the Backrooms. Build your base, craft your very own weapons and keep yourself alive! Search for an exit while you feel the fear to the core! Are you ready? Because Backrooms: The Yellow Dream is going to push your limits!

title: Deadpact
description: Sentenced to death, you're sent into the dark for one last chance at freedom. The things hunting you are not mindless monsters. Each one hunts you, learns your every move, and never forgets. Outsmart them, or die. Every choice you make changes how your story ends.

title: Run the Backrooms
description: Run the Backrooms is a cooperative horror game that supports up to 6 players. The game has several levels and entities that will certainly make your gameplay very exciting. The game has free updates, always bringing new game levels and bug fixes.

title: Backrooms: 5 Missing Wanderers
description: Backrooms: 5 Missing Wanderers is a liminal-spaced horror game which is inspired by the backrooms. The player has to solve puzzles and find the exit.

title: Backrooms Levels
description: Experience liminal spaces like never before. A psychological exploration where intuition replaces guidance, environments feel alive, and the fear comes not from monsters, but from being lost, observed, and slowly overwhelmed by the space itself.

title: Cold Contours: Intake
description: Cold Contours: Intake is an atmospheric first-person 3D puzzle game set inside a frozen industrial megastructure. Use magnets to explore its halls and machinery: throw them, attach them to metal, change their polarity, and activate old mechanisms.

title: Backrooms: 2005
description: Backrooms - 2005 is a chapter-based Backrooms exploration game.

title: Stone Age Assassin
description: A first-person horror game set in the Stone Age, where the story explores fear through situations completely different from the conventional. Gather fruits, craft recipes, and venture into unknown places.

title: Life in the Crater Lake
description: Explore a hidden underwater ecosystem beneath the surface of a remote crater lake. Become familiar with the diverse local wildlife, investigate submerged ruins and wrecks, and recover lost equipment to slowly uncover the lake's mysteries.

title: Hex Tower Boogie
description: Hex Tower Boogie is a tower defense game combined with factory-style automation, played on a hexagonal grid. Players build conveyor belts, splitters and mergers to route ammunition to their towers; towers only fire when supplied by the production line. It mixes logistics and supply-chain management with wave-based defense. Developed with the Godot engine.

title: Infinity Nikki: Where Stars Yearn
description:
A message from the summer night arrives, and every note begins to resonate with joy.

Bubbles and fireworks drift together into this dazzling encounter, while melodies ripple through the air and flowing light traces every joyful silhouette.

Between every heartbeat and every step, a spark of starlight lingers, turning a fleeting moment along the journey into eternity.

title: Virus X
description: Virus X is a first-person horror game where you must stop a virus from spreading any further. You’ll have someone on comms guiding you through everything, and you must survive while stopping the outbreak. Bloodthirsty creatures will try to stop you, but you must keep going—you must keep fighting. The human race depends on it.

title: Invisible Opus
description: A game for SOUPJAM2026 created by Caim Luna in RPGmaker VX Ace.

title: Greed and Greed
description: Greed and Greed is the sequel for Greed and Grind. It's a game where your main goal is to become strongeeeer!! You can grind as much as you want!

title: Chronime Puzzle: Girls
description: Chronime Puzzle: Girls is a relaxing puzzle game featuring beautiful steampunk anime-inspired artwork.

title: Cursed House 16
description: The Cursed House series returns with new gameplay mechanics and a rewarding bonus system. Explore a shadowy manor as you solve engaging Match-3 puzzles and unlock exciting bonuses. Uncover hidden secrets and banish evil spirits in this strategic puzzle adventure.

title: Subself: Lies Deep
description:
In a dystopian future overseen by a corporate dictatorship, prisoners are arbitrarily subjected to brutal conditions for crimes they may or may not have committed. The only hope of freedom is a deal - one simple favor in exchange for a reduced sentence. Seems like a good deal, right?

Well, except that favor is a solo expedition into the depths of an alien ocean full of deadly metal-consuming algae and terrifying sea creatures. With only a suit between you and certain death. And you're probably not the first, nor the last prisoner to be roped into this deal. Good luck staying alive long enough to complete the mission.

title: Dune: Imperium - Immortality
description:
As the Great Houses wage war, the Bene Tleilax advance their own agenda by trading in genetic innovations. Will you hire Face Dancer spies of unmatched skill? Regrow damaged tissue and organs? Or dare to employ people restored to life as gholas.

Immortality expands Dune: Imperium in new directions. Make shadowy deals with the Tleilaxu to harvest genetic specimens. Unlock the potential of scientific research. Graft cards together to empower your Agents.

Explore a universe of possibilities with Dune: Imperium Immortality.

title: Eggconsole Relics MSX2
description: Seize enemy bodies to brave the mysteries of the deep! Featuring the unique "Spirit Ride" system and a cinematic sci-fi atmosphere, Bothtec’s legendary 1986 masterpiece remains a timeless action-adventure.

title: Dreaming Blue
description: Dreaming Blue is a romance visual novel set in a world of shrine gods and spirits. The protagonist is a woman in her mid-to-late twenties meeting different supernatural beings while on a mission to break her curse.

title: Card Night at Gigi's
description: Pull up a chair at Gigi's table. Six classic card games — Setback, Hearts, Cribbage, No-Limit Hold'em, Spades, Euchre — wrapped in a cozy cocktail-lounge hub.

title: Flippant
description: An abstract incremental game about flipping a coin and maybe some other things too

title: Dune: Imperium - Uprising
description:
After betraying and destroying House Atreides, the Emperor Shaddam Corrino IV has given House Harkonnen control over the planet Arrakis once more. But a mysterious warrior named Muad’Dib has risen to power among the Fremen, threatening the schemes of the Emperor and his allies.

This major expansion for Dune: Imperium Digital transforms the core experience with a new Imperium deck, reimagined conflicts, fresh leaders, and updated spaces to send your agents.

In Uprising, you want to continue to balance military might with political intrigue, wielding new tools in pursuit of victory. Spies will shore up your plans. Vital contracts will expand your resources. Or learn the ways of the Fremen and ride mighty sandworms into battle!

title: Incrempire
description: Defend. Upgrade. Dominate. A relaxing incremental base-defense game, packed with powerful skills and a deep skill tree.

title: A Game About Flipping Cards
description: Did you read the title? That's the game, I promise. Flip cards to make money to buy upgrades to make more money to buy more upgrades to make more money. There is an arbitrary goal that has been set by the developer, but you can actually play indefinitely.

title: Worn by the Forgotten
description: A forgotten god, worshipped in countless forms, was vanquished by the evil deity Yanutan—but left behind a mask holding four beliefs and the divine beasts that embody them. As Worn, the girl who finds it, wield the beasts, uncover the world's lost secrets, and overcome every trial.

title: Insomnia Club
description: Insomnia Club is a dark, grounded emotional visual novel about early-adult confusion, social issues, intimacy, and self-identity. You play as a long-term insomniac employee whose life gradually slips out of control as reality tightens around you.

title: Charge 'N Zap!
description: Navigate electrifying puzzles in Charge 'N Zap!, a 2D isometric game where you control Bit, a charged hero saving the Zapverse. Use strategic polarization to overcome traps, neutralize enemies, and race against time in a world of dynamic challenges and vibrant energy.

title: Shoo, Naughty Little Monsters!
description: Shoo, Naughty Little Monsters! is a 3D isometric tower defense and resource management game where you play as a young farmer who must tend to their crops, serve customers, and defend against cute but mischievous little monsters. Use available resources to keep them off your property and secure your profits.

title: Echoes of Above
description: Echoes of Above is an action game where you strike back — literally. Hit enemy projectiles mid-air, deflect their force and use the environment to survive. Master precision combat across two difficulty modes in a mythical world abandoned by the gods. Every shot fired at you is a weapon waiting to be reclaimed.

title: Jack Pottwin: House of Odds
description: Fight your way up a 10-story casino tower to wake from a fever dream in this Roguelike Deckbuilder. Craft your deck, modify runs with lucky coins, and control the Odds. Fuse cards to build high value attacks, trigger poker combos to add powerful combat traits to your cards.

title: Another Night at the Archive
description: Search through an old archive for clues to bizarre and strange events.

title: Astaryn: RPG Idler
description: A World of Warcraft inspired game, with RPG features and an offline progression. Choose a hero and start farming, fight monsters, level up your skills, complete all the quests, run dungeons and get the best gear while joining player Clans and fighting in the PvP Arena!

title: Card City Nights Forever
description: It's cards! It's a city! It's night! And this time it's forever! Card City Nights Forever is the third and final installment of the series, with the best core TCG gameplay yet, a whole new huge 3D adventure, and an online mode that will last forever!

title: Kenpin Sagyou
description: You have a reason for needing a lump sum of money. You applied for a job through a mysterious job site recommended by a friend and started a part-time job inspecting products. The job is simple: pack normal products in paper bags and dispose of defective products by attaching a shipping label. If you overlook a defect or dispose of a normal product, bad things will happen. To avoid such problems, be sure to do your job carefully and accurately.

title: Squishy League
description: Squishy League is a fast paced versus sport game where you control a squishy character that can only move by dashing. Smash the Ball into your opponent’s goal to score points ! Master charged shoots, spins, and wall bounces to outsmart your opponent. Play locally or online in crazy 1v1 matches.

title: Orders, Captain!
description: Use your voice to command your pirate crew before enemy ships sink you!

title: Oil.exe
description: Drill the wells. Run the refinery. Read the market. OIL is a free text-based simulation of running a petroleum operation, played at a 1980s green-phosphor terminal. End each year richer or bankrupt. Mind the bear market. Climb the leaderboard.

title: Lich Lords
description: Lich Lords is a Soulslike dungeon crawler where the undead are cursed to fight eternally. Descend into eldritch dungeons, defeat rival Liches, uncover the truth behind the cycle, and claim the crown.

title: Help! I'm Turning Into a Mermaid!
description: After surviving a near death encounter on their first day of work, Hunter has noticed something shocking. They're slowly turning into a mermaid! The latest adventure game/life simulation hybrid from the creators of the Max's Big Bust series.

title: Bad Football
description: The arcade football game built to ruin friendships. Fast, brutal, lawless. Pick from 48 national teams and lift the Worst Cup, or wreck a friend in local 1v1.

title: Planet Love Story
description:
Planet Love Story is a melancholic adventure about love, memory and the boundary between life and death. An amnesiac woman awakens alone in a desert on the moon, a place believed to receive the souls of the dead. Meanwhile, a man on Earth attempts to build a rocket capable of reaching her and bringing her back.

Presented in a picture-book-like visual style, the game follows two people separated by an impossible distance as their stories gradually converge.

title: Carist
description: Carist is a dark modern-day side-scrolling RPG by LuciferBrand (later ImCyan). The player follows Carist, a deeply disturbed man possessed by a warped sense of justice. He wields a sacred firearm left by a wartime hero and embarks on a violent crusade against perceived evildoers. The game features 2D side-view exploration and combat, and its narrative explores themes of fanaticism and the consequences of violence.

title: Unbound Drift
description: A momentum based precision physics game about swinging around and chasing the high of perfect flow

title: Illegal Alien Tower Defense
description:
Shapeshifting Alien Trespassers have invaded Earth!

Their vile species, known as "Third-Worlders", hails from the third planet of a nearby star system, and have now unleashed their rampaging hordes, consuming everything in their path, seeking to turn all of Earth into a dumpy Third-World Hellscape!

You play as Johnny Righteous, a mild-mannered computer programmer working at the Department of Defense on a top-secret Defensive AI, known as Sentinel, before it was mysteriously cancelled. Now, using the last copy of Sentinel's code, it is up to you to turn back the tides of the invasion.

Can you save civilization from the brink of collapse, and restore our High-Trust society?

Or will evil Alien Shapeshifters win World War 3 by waging a Third-World War?

title: Principia
description: Physics-based sandbox game with electronic circuitry, mechanics, robots, puzzles Lua scripting and more.

title: Layer2
description: Walk into walls, descend into spaces. A SOUP fan game made for SOUPJAM2026.

title: Low Poly Truck Simulator
description: Explore Greece by delivering packages in a realistic environment. Whether you deliver, or explore, you will still experience how it feels to be in Greece.

title: RMN Soup
description:
A Soup-like is a game inspired by the Japanese art game SOUP.

RMN Soup is a collaborative soup-like created using the Bapalon engine by users of rpgmaker.net. It is a pure exploration simulator where you go through a series of rooms and enjoy the scenery. Some are funny, some are unnerving, and some are cozy. You never know what you're going to get next!

RMN Soup currently contains 28 rooms by a total of 9 contributors.

title: Astro Yoinkers
description: Team up with your fellow Astro Yoinkers in this fast-paced multiplayer CTF. Physics-based grappling across moving asteroids, yoink enemy crystals, and vaporize lobbies with orbital strike satellites.

title: SCP: Mr. Jupiter
description: A first-person SCP horror adventure where you survive a catastrophic containment breach, explore a collapsing facility, and evade the mysterious Mr. Jupiter.

title: Jeffrey Eggstein
description: Big Es back in action! Working the farm over Summer is never easy - but everyone knows youre the best. Do your utmost to keep the product moving, the customers happy and the law at bay, and everythingll turn out great!

title: Maple Ridge
description: After losing his wife in an accident, Alex is left alone in a suburban house where every little detail reminds him of the past. An ordinary evening quickly turns into a series of strange and unsettling events.

title: Gone Me
description: You happened to meet a college student girl who studies witchcraft, and together you entered the mysterious illusions at 30 degrees north latitude, starting a romantic and fantastical adventure. But you know, this is just the beginning...

title: 2026 Soup Jam
description: Soup Jam is broken into two chapters Night 1 and Night 2. Explore the world, seek lore, collect the Gold Chalice and return it to the Temple.

title: My Hero Academia: All's Justice - Deluxe Edition
description:
The Deluxe Edition includes:
• MY HERO ACADEMIA: All's Justice
• Season Pass
- Season Pass Bonus - The Worldwide Star Card

title: Vapor Soup
description: Vapor Soup is a SOUP-like game. The concept is simple, spawn into a room and walk into a creature which takes you to another room on a new night. As the nights progress, the more procedurally generated elements are added to the room. You might also encounter modifier cubes that will alter the music, textures, or add something new to the rooms.

title: Bugs in the Brain
description: Bugs in the Brain is a Soup-like project crafted in the Bapalon engine. There are 18 rooms separated by 3 nights, or "swarms", in this case. 3 swarms, 6 rooms each.

title: BunnyBakery
description: Play as a little bunny running a cute bakery — bake and sell all kinds of sweets like cupcakes, donuts, pancakes, banana splits, and more!

title: Sindikat
description: SINDIKAT is an online board game about business and money: buy companies, upgrade assets, collect rent, and outplay your friends in the fight for full control of the city.

title: Assassin of Aliens
description: Play as space warrior in this 2d person sci-fi shooter game. Mission is to kill different enemies like spiders and troopers and end of level destroy big ufo ship and collect skulls
0.5% is a hand-drawn black and white visual novel. It features two college students June and Tai. June's choices and discovery will uncover Tai's secrets.

title: Mesozoic Dawn
description: Mesozoic Dawn is a multiplayer online dinosaur survival game. Starting as a vulnerable juvenile dinosaur, you must navigate the perils of the prehistoric wilderness, utilizing the core "Growth + Nesting = Evolution" system to achieve leapfrog species iteration and evolution.

title: Wyldernook
description: Choose your champion. Predict, then outwit. Every move resolves simultaneously in a charming storybook universe. Wyldernook is a free-to-play trading card game with roguelike campaign, 1v1 and multiplayer PvP, and a custom card creator.

title: With Your Coworker
description: Meet Yumi, your adorable catgirl coworker. Whether you're working, gaming, or just spending time at your PC, she'll stay by your side throughout the day!

title: Free Puzzle
description: A jigsaw puzzle game in which you can work on multiple double-sided puzzles at once, import your own images or use one of the many illustrations by The Hound, eXaHeVa, Mortis Ghost and Alias Conrad Coldwood.

title: Kon: Tale of the Darkness
description: A dark-fantasy interdimensional adventure. Snap your fingers to explore overlapping realities, face high-intensity platforming sections, solve environmental puzzles, and escape a deadly force threatening to consume everything.

title: CTR Native
description: A native PC port of Crash Team Racing (PS1).

title: Blast Vein
description: A brutal retro FPS roguelike set inside a collapsing mind filled with biomechanical horrors. Die. Adapt. Descend further.

title: Heavenly Island
description: Welcome to the once-every-few-centuries “Seeder Festival,” held on a secluded island shrouded in mystery! You’ve been chosen to become the “Great Seeder,” the fertility god of a mysterious, remote island. Gather the 17 “Golden Balls” and gain the favor of the island’s God!

title: Forsaken Rules
description: A challenging action roguelike with PS1 retro aesthetics where you use a shield as a weapon. Master the combat, make high-risk decisions, and go through three surreal hells in a pact with the Devil that will decide your survival.

title: Adhain
description: Become a god and expand your influence through kindness or fear. Grow your settlements, make villages believe in you, and teach your creature how to follow your example. Play alone or join other gods, as allies or rivals.

title: The Inverted Tower
description: A dark fantasy CRPG with multiple routes and endings, all surrounding the hunt for a wish-granting chalice guarded beneath a dungeon known as the Inverted Tower.

title: Hand Eternal
description: With mythic powers, hunt down the demon lords of the Godplant's Realm on your mission to purge the world of solar delirium. Slay any who stand in the way in this bizarre fast-paced 3D action-adventure game.

title: The Registry
description: People hand you documents. You check for inconsistencies. Then approve or deny using your stamp.

title: Cresata
description: Betrayed. Imprisoned. Left to die. Following a treacherous rebellion, Phaedon of Arsica is imprisoned and left for dead. Freed by a twist of fate, he now hunts down those who betrayed him and his homeland.

title: Snowbound With Irene
description: A surreal action-adventure RPG set in a strange world consumed by 'Snowbound.' Play as an armless girl named Irene and explore the land of 'Majoolah'. Battle strange creatures up north or explore the beautiful small town of 'Miren' in the east. Make choices that can impact your story.

title: Playback
description:
PLAYBACK is a first-person psychological horror game set in the abandoned Ravenwood Street. Explore dark buildings, collect mysterious VHS tapes, and uncover hidden documents that reveal the disturbing history of the street and the people who once lived there.
A dangerous entity roams the area, forcing you to stay alert as you investigate locations including Panda’s Bamboo Bar, Wilted Rose, and other forgotten businesses. Every discovery brings you closer to the truth behind missing children, secret experiments, and the mysterious Dr. Zeno.
Search Ravenwood Street, survive the entity, and uncover what was never meant to be found.

title: Desktop Destroyer
description: Fan remake.

title: Tuìhūn Hòu, Zōngzhǔ Mǎjiǎ Cáng Bùzhù
Lóng Yuè Jiǔtiān: Qíng Xì Jiānghú
Hydro Chicks
description: A difficult parkour game about riding a sea scooter upstream to reach the top of the Hydro Mountain.

title: Muv-Luv: Tactics Kalidasa at Nightmare
description: The heir to the legendary "Muv-Luv Alternative" series, "Muv-Luv: Tactics Kalidasa at Nightmare" is a tactical simulation RPG devoted to pure gameplay excellence.

title: Wasabi
description: Every day, a new corpse turns up in this quiet town. Every day, a new suspect emerges. And every day, that cave looms larger, more ominously. Amidst gory crime scenes and suffocating interrogations, only one thing will lead you to the truth: wasabi.

title: Monster Fantasy
description: Hunt giant monsters and build a beautiful home! Monster Fantasy is an action RPG with cozy life-sim elements. As an amnesiac hero, explore Eldoras, battle monsters with companions, befriend villagers, and enjoy fishing, cooking, gathering, and crafting.

title: Aoi Umi no Tristia: Hatsumei Koubou Funtou ki
Morvus
description: Your monastery is the last hope for those with nowhere else to go. Supplies are running out. You cannot save everyone. Every day, you decide who to help — and try to save not only their lives, but your own soul.

title: Brayz
description: Top speed: 8,000 km/h. A hyper-velocity, 64-racer high-speed racing game set in a futuristic solar system! Deep strategic options with Arts and Gear, combined with an unparalleled high-speed experience, await you. Aim for the top in the fastest race in human history!

title: Debrisverse
description: The debt is a trap. DEBRISVERSE is a sci-fi incremental sim where you crush space debris for profit. Use roguelite upgrades to accelerate destruction and pay off your $100M debt. But this perfect workplace has a dark secret. Uncover the system's conspiracy across 7 unique endings.

title: Steel Maiden
description: Two buttons. Pure, explosive speed. A lightning-fast action roguelite you play with just two buttons. Forge your own combat style with builds that shift every run, and chase that rush of pure dopamine through gorgeous visuals.

title: Dhalman
description: Dhalman is a single-player action adventure featuring Metroidvania exploration and fighting gameplay across countries, with curry restaurant management between battles. Join DHALMAN on a flavorful journey to face evolving bosses, discover new worlds, and build the world’s greatest curry restaurant.

title: Paranormal Meatball Simulator
description: An unhinged paranormal simulation of a spicy Turkish meatball stuck on a ceiling! Survive a 16-day cryptic loop filled with ghosts, reality-bending physics, and a cosmic UFO escape plan. After this, you will never throw food at your ceiling again!

title: Dino Dearest
description: Dino Dearest is a game about winning the hearts of a variety of dinosaurs and prehistoric dinosaur-like animals. If you like wildly branching storylines, cool music, parallax, or being consumed by spaghetti, this game might be for you.

title: Public Fears: George's Farm
description: Felix Turner is forced out of the police force by mysterious forces. His friend George urges him to seek refuge at his remote farmhouse. In search of peace, Felix has no idea what awaits him…

title: Nights of the Sleeping God
description: Highly moddable classical roguelike with persistence dungeons and fully simulated physics and chemistry.

title: Nights at the Convenience Store
description: Nights at the Convenience Store is a first-person horror simulation game where you work the night shift at a 24/7 store. Scan groceries, restock shelves, take out the trash — and try not to think too hard about what's lurking in the back.

title: One Last Box
description: One Last Box is a short indie first-person horror game. You have just been hired as a package sorter for a mysterious company. Examine boxes based on clues, decide whether to accept or return them, but be aware... you are not completely alone here.

title: Pantomime Horse Obstacle Course
description: Pantomime Horse Obstacle Course is a wacky, slapstick, co-op platformer. Grab a friend and two gamepads, and show off your teamwork - or drag your partner to the finish line (sometimes literally). Filled with chaotic levels and tough challenges for you to complete, get out there and break a leg!

title: Idle Startup
description: Build a tech company from a one-person garage into a global empire. Train six skills, complete their upgrade trees, chase milestone bonuses, and unlock new departments in this clean, addictive incremental idle game — progress keeps rolling even while you're away.

title: Emi's Solo Ghost Hunting 2
description: Emi's Solo Ghost Hunting 2 is a 2D survival horror game based on the story of a solo paranormal investigator called Emi, who got a call from a client in order to investigate a haunted property called The Cold House, located just beside a cemetery in California, for proof of the paranormal.

title: Sad Virus Waterland
description: Sad Virus mission to collect beer bottles in this 3rd person adventure game in waterland map and avoid traps

title: The Name I Wear
description: Play as a spy in a first-person narrative puzzle game. Writing a name allows you to take on that identity. Explore a riad, gather clues, and uncover the truth. With no pen at your disposal, creatively and unexpectedly use the environment to form names and change identities.

title: Tomomon Little
description: A chill idle-monster capturing desktop toy in the corner of your screen. Buy upgrades, catch rare Tomomon, and customize your character at your own pace!

title: Catapulture
description: Build your island base, gather resources, hire workers, and launch ridiculous catapult attacks at your rival. Catapulture is a fun multiplayer base-building battle where every match turns into a chaotic construction and shooting race.

title: Game Design at WVU Arcade
description: A 3d arcade game in which you play the machines in your store to upgrade them and get ready for opening day. All games are created by students and alumni from Game Design and Interactive Media at West Virginia University.

title: Northward
description: Northward is an open-world co-op adventure about sailing a scrappy ship through a northern archipelago, exploring the uncharted, finding lost treasure, and uncovering the mystery of a fallen star.

title: Distantia
description: A dark 2D action platformer where exploration is key. Every discovery becomes a tool. Every mistake, a lesson. Learn the hidden rules of this place where you are trapped. Adapt to deadly encounters and master fast-paced combat to uncover what lies beneath the surface.

title: Blood of Rations
description: Blood of Rations is a WW2 extraction shooter set in 1944 occupied Europe. Deploy alone into solo PvPvE raids, scavenge what the dead left behind, and extract alive — or lose everything you carried in. No minimap, all-diegetic audio, a grid inventory where every slot is a decision, and an 8-second extraction window. Between raids you rebuild the underground bunker you call home.

title: Gnomageddon: Forge of Infinity
description: Gnomageddon is a physics-based action RPG where you command a team of gnomes and dig deep in search of the Forge of Infinity. Explore a procedurally generated world and collect hundreds of modifiable items alone or with up to five friends.

title: Kami: The Great Guardian
description: In this short, compact 2D Metroidvania, join Kami on their quest to save their homeland from a calamity wrought from the stars. Use the abilities you discover to explore deeper into the source of this corruption and restore nature.

title: Usurper of Fire
description: Usurp the Fire of angels and demons, and reclaim mankinds fate! Delve into randomized dungeons, loot legendary items, and forge your ultimate build. Loot, rise, and fight again. Every drop could reshape the way you play.

title: The Acorn Protocol
description: An immersive sim looter-shooter where interdimensional squirrels confiscate your gear when you die. Infiltrate parody worlds, negotiate with bureaucratic rodents, and raid The Vault. Some things are worth dying for. Repeatedly.

title: Voidline
description: Survive relentless machine swarms in the collapsing Voidline. Loot upgrades, evolve your ship, and stack game-breaking builds as each run grows faster, harder, and more chaotic. Unlock new ships and become unstoppable.

title: Nexus Legacy
description: Rebuild civilization from a single planet in Nexus Legacy, a persistent sci-fi 4X MMO. Colonize worlds, manage resources, research technologies, command fleets, forge alliances, and fight for control of a living galaxy.

title: Trainz Simulator World Tour
description: In Trainz Simulator World Tour you drive powerful trains across the USA, UK, and Australia with 4 detailed routes, 16 gameplay sessions, and iconic locos from steam to diesel. Your adventure starts now!

title: Idle Regenerator
description: Idle RPG with 99+ powers, deep equipment forging, sidekick roster, dungeons, constellations, prestige resets, and offline progress. No energy timers. No pay-to-win. Just depth.

title: MoonHack
description: MoonHack is an emotional cyber-noir adventure game where songs rewrite the rules of the world. The story segments are closely integrated with 3D rhythm-action gameplay synchronized with vocal performances, and through songs, the rules behind a system that controls happiness will be rewritten.

title: Edu Simulator
description: EDU SIMULATOR is a satirical horror roguelite with a distinct retro aesthetic inspired by the PSX era and Windows 98 interfaces. Players must survive unforgiving labyrinth chase mechanics while advancing through a perk-based progression system, navigating an atmosphere that blends survival horror tension with the absurd humor behind being chased by a flat sliding picture.

title: Marshals of War: Orcblood
description: Command powerful heroes and epic armies in Marshals of War: Orcblood, a stylized fantasy action Real Time Strategy game. Cast spells, defeat bosses, loot treasure, build defenses, and lead men, dwarves and elves to victory, in solo, or co-op against the orcs and their masters.

title: Anchor-13
description: Anchor-13 is a cyberpunk roguelike deckbuilder. Wield a unique dual-weapon system and combine cyberware, daemons, and gear to forge powerful decks. Across endless time loops, save your lover, uncover the truth, and bring down the corporation that rules the city.

title: MNOZ: My Nuclear Octopus 2
description: Everyone's favourite nuclear octopus is back to save the world once again, in MNOZ, the explosive sequel to the hit game My Nuclear Octopus. MNOZ is a psychedelic retro arcade game for fans of pure out-and-out arcade blasters - an overload of sight and sound. Chase those high scores!

title: Bulwark: Falconeer Chronicles - Medieval Houses
description: Medieval style timberframe houses for that high fantasy or Laketown style Bulwark settlement.

title: World of Claudecraft
description: A classic-style micro-MMO: nine vanilla-flavored classes, real classic-era combat formulas, a hand-built quest world across three zones, 5-player elite dungeons, a ranked 1v1 arena, parties, trading and duels — on an authoritative server with persistent characters.

title: Dog's Walts
description:
This is a pop and lighthearted 3D action game starring a slightly clumsy but lovable dog.
Use your hammer to smash enemies and obstacles and send them flying off the stage.
The more things you knock away, the higher your score climbs.
With simple controls and playful physics-based action,
this game is all about fun, chaos, and satisfying hits.

title: Yots
description: Cooperative survival horror for up to 4 players. Complete the Quota, fight the creatures birthed by City of Mist, and build your own powerful loadout using unique artifacts.

title: Gaming Burnout Treatment Center
description: Digital ED Treatment Center is a random launcher for players in a gaming slump. We help you rediscover the joy of play and unearth hidden gems buried in your library. Click to start your treatment and reignite your gaming vigor!

title: Lost In The Store
description:
A Short Horror Game where your mom left you alone at the register, what will you do?
Try to survive and find a way back to go to the real world.

title: Battlespace Command
description: Take command of modern warfare across land, air, and sea in a real-time strategy sandbox. Direct every unit, from infantry to aircraft carriers, across vast, real-world scale battlefields where sensors, strategy, and coordination decide the outcome.

title: Qliphah in Providence's Shadow
description: Set against the backdrop of a distorted Shibuya—where supernatural anomalies have begun bleeding into reality—the story follows two dual protagonists. Both harbor these very anomalies within themselves as they embark on a dark quest to uncover the truth behind the city's eerie phenomena.

title: MixCD
description: MixCD - This Games Industry Darling of an A.I. Powered Driving SIM is Sooooo Amazing, it plays itself!

title: Elderfeast
description: Hunt. Carve. Cook. Elderfeast is a co-op action game where the monsters are the menu. Hunt Lovecraftian horrors across the galaxy and slice them apart for ingredients to make your next meal. The better you cook, the stronger you become, but there's always something more terrifying to hunt next.

title: Shadow Saw Us
description: After their grandfather’s passing, Bell and Mark inherit the burden he left behind as the spirits he once sealed begin to break free. With the help of Banana, a Tani spirit and his old friend, they must help people, search for enchanted blades, and face dangerous spirits like Isacus.

title: The UNDA Legacy
description: An atmospheric 3D puzzle game based on the principles of wave physics. Explore the mysterious Roursus island and solve over 25 puzzles using reflection, interference, and resonance. Uncover the fate of a vanished research team in a peaceful world where science meets philosophy.

title: Floor 12
description: A horror-infused walking simulator inspired by the classics of anomaly hunting. Watch the lights closely, listen to the sounds, and trust your intuition. One wrong step and the journey begins anew. How many floors separate you from freedom?

title: How to Destroy a City
description: How to Destroy a City is a casual incremental game where you pilot a giant robot to destroy the city. Upgrade your robot, fight the army, and unlock special abilities and new robots. It's time to turn the city to ashes!

title: Nitro Thrash
description: Become a master of physics by launching your car into the air, performing kickflips, and grinding rails. Complete missions to unlock levels and cosmetics, practice tricks until perfection, or just goof around with friends.

title: Black Lily Inmortal
description: Experience this 2D Top-Down combat game featuring tragic yuri and dark fantasy. Step into the rusty armor of Marliese Haugen as she traverses a bleak, desolate world to reach the one she loves.

title: Crone
description: Fetch the eyes of the crone as you delve into her lair in this roguelike dungeon crawling adventure.

title: Cytokine Storm
description: Cytokine Storm is a retro survival horror set inside a coma patient's body. Battle parasites, viruses, and a defective immune system to wake yourself up. Explore a surreal biological world where you must use your wits, weapons, and unique costumes to survive grotesque locations and puzzles.

title: Coin$ Pusher Ltd
description: Push money into a hole, and do it quickly. If you are squeamish about using your left mouse button, beware! This is a tactile, satisfying, short 20-40 minute experience.

title: Argosy
description: Begin with a single ship and a handful of coin. Buy low, sail far, sell high — then turn profit into power. Build trade routes, factories, and fleets across a living economy, outwit rival merchants, and rise from humble trader to master of the seas.

title: Werewolf: The Gloaming Malice
description: Trapped in the Shadow Fortress, you play as a Hunter. Scour for gears and link the clues to unmask the lies. Execute the hidden werewolves before you become the next nightly sacrifice.

title: Dungeon Armory
description: Craft your own weapons, explore dungeons, and progress. Prove your skills in the capital's competitions and defeat the monsters of the prophecy. A medieval fantasy RPG with crafting elements that combines blacksmith simulation with action-packed dungeon crawling.

title: Bumper Bout
description: A PvP pinball hero fighter! Battle friends or the CPU, local or online across a mix of quirky and colorful arenas each bursting with hazards and surprises. Master every character’s unique ultimate move to turn the tides at the last moment!

title: Mangrove Express
description: Pilot a delivery boat through the lively waterways of a tropical cyber world. Master momentum, discover villages, and chart your own routes in a speedboat delivery adventure. It’s a simple job—until it isn’t :)

title: DCS World: C-130J
description: Get ready to step into the cockpit of the DCS: C-130J, the latest model of the most versatile military transport aircraft ever built. The C-130J puts you in command of the world’s celebrated tactical transporter, renowned for delivering troops, tanks, supplies, and lifesaving relief to hostile and war torn places. From engine start to wheels-up, every switch and system has been painstakingly recreated to let you haul and airdrop exactly as real C-130J crews do.

title: DCS World: NS 430 Navigation System for MiG-29A Cockpit
description: The NS 430 for the MiG-29A module integrates the NS 430 panel directly into the MiG-29A cockpit (not as a pop-up display). The NS 430 is fully wired into the electrical and radio systems of the MiG-29A.

title: DCS World: La-7 by OctopusG
description: The La-7 is a World War II, Soviet, single-engine piston fighter that was developed by the Semyon Lavochkin design bureau. It was an evolution of the La-5 series of Soviet fighters that improved the design in significant ways. Entering service in 1944, the La-7 became one of the most effective and refined Soviet fighters of Eastern Front.

title: DCS World: F-100D Super Sabre by Grinnelli Designs
description: The F-100D Super Sabre entered service in 1956 as the U.S. Air Force's definitive fighter-bomber. Succeeding the legendary F-86, it was the first fighter aircraft capable of supersonic speed in level flight. Although developed as a day air-superiority fighter, the Super Sabre family eventually saw the F-100D repurposed as a ground-attack platform.

title: DCS World: Cold War Germany by Ugra Media
description: DCS: Cold War Germany, developed by Ugra-Media, recreates central Europe at the height of the Cold War in the 1980s. Created by the developers of the acclaimed DCS: Syria and Normandy, this map of West Germany, East Germany, Poland, Czechoslovakia, and the Low Countries centers on the strategically important Fulda Gap, and it also includes part of the Baltic Sea. The area measures 980x800 km and accurately reproduces the cities of Berlin, Frankfurt, Hamburg, Magdeburg, Leipzig, Hannover, Lübeck and others.

title: Whispers of the Requiem
description: Step into the mind of a disgraced ex-cop, once a servant of a powerful cult that controls society from the shadows. Now hunted, betrayed, and haunted by sins too dark to name, you must hide the truth before it devours you.

title: Silent Dread: Last Order
description: A first-person psychological horror game about a late-night delivery and the disturbing events that follow.

title: The Sinkhole
description: Experience claustrophobic cave horror powered by your webcam. In this psychological nightmare, a massive underground sinkhole hides a sinister entity. Ditch the mouseyour real head movements control your view, and your actual hands are used to climb, grab, and scramble through the dark.

title: Craft Drill
description: Craft Drill - this mining simulator puts you in control of powerful drilling equipment, letting you explore mysterious mines and uncover hidden treasures.

title: Festive Themed Santa Killer Simulator
description:
This is a brief first-person shooter game that offers minimal replicability.

You take control of a nameless character on a mission to eliminate Santa and anyone accompanying him. Use guns from the Marksman to shoot your way through each mission.

title: Fast Food Funkin'
description: Have some beats with yo' mickey dee double-cheese. A high-caloric Friday Night Funkin' parody game made for the annual Flash Forward Jam on Newgrounds

title: Jenny Love You
description: Jenny Love You is a first-person horror puzzle game where players take on the role of a thief. While breaking into a mansion to steal, they discover an eerie doll and encounter various terrifying events...

title: For The Fatherland
description: 6 June 1944, the greatest military invasion in human history begins with Allied soldiers landing in Normandy trying to bring an end to the war. You have been given the task of stopping the Allied invasion and defending the German territories in France. Will you be worthy and defend the Fatherland?

title: Wave 43
description: Capture fish. Grow stronger. Break the ocean. Build insane combos and climb the leaderboard.

title: Ashes Nomad
description: Ashes Nomad is a single map add-on for Ashes 2063 Afterglow. Step into the shoes of the Nomad as he finds himself coerced into helping a local settlement clear out some run of the mill gang goons.

title: DCS World: Marianas WWII Map
description: DCS: Marianas 1944 Terrain freezes the archipelago at a knife-edge moment days before the first U.S. Marine amphibious waves slam ashore in Operation Forager. Every reef, ridge and runway has been rebuilt from wartime reconnaissance mosaics and engineering plans so you can script bombardments, beach-landings and carrier strikes exactly where they happened between 15 June and 10 August 1944.

title: Rampancy
description:
Rampancy is a retro-inspired sci-fi boomer shooter and a love letter to the classics that defined the genre.

Inspired by Marathon, Wolfenstein 3D, DOOM, & System Shock, it blends fast-paced shooting, eerie sci-fi atmosphere, and a twisting narrative.

You awaken as a cybernetic soldier from the Phoenix Program, tasked with stopping a rogue AI—but nothing is as it seems.
Blast through aliens, rampaging machines, and corrupted experiments with an arsenal of retro handcrafted rotoscoped weapons.

Classic FPS action meets a chilling mystery—can you stop the rampancy, or are you just another pawn in a bigger plan?

title: Aoi Sora no Neosphere Doki-doki Adventure Effective E
description: A sidestory of Aoi Sora no Neosphere, with purely visual novel gameplay and no simulation elements.

title: D.C.5 to 4: Luminous Memories
description: A fandisk for Da Capo 4 and Da Capo 5.

title: D.C.5 to 4: Luminous Memories - First Press Edition
description: Includes 2 drama CDs.

title: D.C.5 to 4: Luminous Memories - Deluxe Limited Edition
description: Includes 2 drama CDs, a vocal + arranged OST CD, and a B2 tapestry.

title: Fellas
description: A 2.5D city life sim where you can help out friends, decorate your apartment, and explore the history of Campna.

title: YKnytt
description:
A remake of the atmospheric platformer Knytt Stories, originally developed by Nifflas. With over 1200 community levels!

It features many quality-of-life improvements over the original including dynamic screen resizing, keybinding, user-settings, built-in level downloader, controller support, touchscreen support, detailed map system with markers, and more.

title: Hoshi Ori Yume Mirai: Rikka to Anata no 1-Shuunen Kinen, Icha Love Birthday
description: A short fandisc made to mark Narusawa Rikka's birthday.

title: Scarecrow: Heart of Straw
description: "Scarecrow: Heart of Straw" is fast-paced arcade game. Protect the corn from evil crows, pelicans, and cows.

title: Yandere Otoko no Ko no Toriatsukaikata
Europa Universalis V: Fate of the Phoenix
Mythic Manager
description:
Mythic Manager is a fantasy guild management simulator where players recruit, train, and develop a roster of heroes across long-term seasons. Players make decisions around party composition, progression, resources, and strategy as their guild takes on dungeons, raids, and arena tournaments.

Built around roster building and management rather than direct combat control, the game focuses on planning, specialization, and adapting to the strengths and weaknesses of each guild member. Success comes from developing the right team, making difficult cuts, and preparing the guild for increasingly demanding challenges.

title: Stock Car USA
description: Ladies and gentlemen, start your engines! The ultimate homage to Arcade Racing is here! Stock Car USA hits Steam!

title: Motorsport Manager 2
description: The world of motorsport returns in the next evolution of the ultimate motorsport management sim. Compete in multiple series, master deeper strategy than ever before, and lead your team to victory on and off the track. Build your racing legacy.

title: Hello Duck
description: A cozy idle desktop game where a little duck eats grass, lays eggs, earns coins, and lives a lazy life on a tiny floating island.

title: Sparrow Country
description: Embark on a mystical journey as a Sparrow, exploring enchanted worlds and meeting new characters. Complete challenges to enhance your skills and progress through the game. Level up your character to increase size and capability. Earn XP by collecting stars, completing races and challenges.

title: Arcade Archives 2: Moon Shuttle
description:
Moon Shuttle is a shooter released by Nichibutsu in 1981.

Players can enjoy alternating stages in which they destroy or dodge through groups of meteors to reach the goal, and stages in which they defeat enemies with wave motion cannons.

title: Decompose With Me
description: You wake up to find yourself in the woods with no memory of how you got there. A cute girl stands above you. Is she there to help, or does she want something else...?

title: Twilight Infiniforest
description:
You can only be hit once!
Can you fend off the Blue Proboscoids until twilight ends?! (Wave 100)
Use explosive, ice and ricochet bolts to fend them off!

title: Daescent
description: Made in 7 days for EyeJam, for the theme 'Descent'.

title: DaeusProfundis
description: Made in 7 days for EyeJam, for the theme 'Decay'.

title: Dragon's Dogma II: Dark Arisen
description: This is a bundle containing both Dragon's Dogma II and the Dragon's Dogma II: Dark Arisen Expansion.

title: Frag-A-Friend
description: Frag-A-Friend is a multiplayer first-person shooter inspired by Quake, STRAFTAT, and the stupid shit that can happen in online games. Partake in the intimate violence 1v1ing your bestie. Establish everlasting friendships with your loved ones. Kill and be killed, all in the name of camaraderie

title: Hyakkano: 100 Girlfriends
description: Right now this is just a glorified Card Collector with the added bonus of some easy Mini-Games to spend those 3 minutes away while your main game load or your coffe cools a little more.

title: Lucy Half Lucid
description:
A fragment of an immigrant gets lost inside "her own" life

what happens "next"

title: Deltarune: Chapter 6
description: An upcoming chapter for Deltarune.

title: Reel Talk: A Thoughtful Fishcussion
description: You feel lost, and a friend suggests to come fishing in the French River. He told you to not pay any attention to the fish, as they only want you to leave, but it's hard when their blabbering is so interesting...

title: Unbeatable: The Jamie Paige Content Companion
description:
Introducing The Jamie Paige Content Companion DLC - a full on collaborative project with hit vocal synth producer Jamie Paige! Upgrade Arcade Mode with a dose of new originals, fan-favorite tracks, playable characters, and all new challenges.

Unbeatable - The Jamie Paige Content Companion DLC includes:
Four brand new originals exclusive to Unbeatable, made in collaboration between the D-Cell Sound Team and Jamie P.

Two additional remixes with Jamie-P's "I Wish That I Could Fall" and Unbeatable's "Sleeping In", plus an exclusive cover of エビチャーハン! sung by Quaver (Holly Earl).

Plus a multitude of additional tracks, leading to a total of 12(?) songs.

Two Playable New Characters: Jamie Paige (she's real!), and Chef Quaver (she's frying some rice)

Two New Stages: The Apple Orchard (based on Birdbrain), and Wrestling Arena (based on :women_wrestling:). Plus, enjoy music video backgrounds for Birdbrain, Rot for Clout, and Machine Love!

New DLC-Exclusive Challenge Folio included with the DLC, featuring unlocks for additional Arcade Mode titles, menu palettes, end game Star charts, and...

No secrets.

title: Laira Cut Me Open
description: Laira Cut Me Open is a 2D interactive story about a woman's fear and hatred. Find the perpetrator who cut you open, stole part of your body, locked you up in a psych ward, and snatched your husband, money and job. When she shows her face, you're gonna return the favor.

title: Overworked
description: Overworked is a furry, adult, visual novel-style point-and-click mystery where time is of the essence. Will you spend time with the locals? Or work towards the main story's goal?

title: Holey
description: Holey is a co-op horror game where you are part of a crew sheltering in a collapsed tunnel, scavenging loot across maps filled with deadly creatures born from a biological war. Feed the creature, convert its waste into fuel, and reach the radio tower

title: Blue Dynasty
description: Blue Dynasty is a Medieval ARPG/Strategy game that blends TD and Hack and Slash genres with Rogue Lite mechanics. Dominate the map by strengthening your equipment, but remember there is no shield stronger than the city walls. If you are looking for challenging discoveries, the dungeons await you.

title: Eyes of the Factory
description: Explore the abandoned Blackforge Industries factory and uncover the dark secrets hidden within its walls. Solve puzzles, survive terrifying encounters, and discover why the factory never forgot you in this atmospheric first-person horror experience. Now are you ready for join Black Forge Industries?

title: Holey Ship
description: Holey Ship is a chaotic co-op game for up to four players. Where you and your crew fix boats under pressure. Repair damage, solve fast tasks, and keep customers happy in a fun and chaotic world. Work together or mess with your friends but can your crew stop everything from sinking!

title: Dungeons & Dummies
description: Descend alone or drag up to 7 friends into a deep, ever-changing dungeon that does not care about your feelings. Chase loot, quests, and power while insisting “one more floor” is a great idea. Greed is encouraged. Survival is optional.

title: MFTK: Survivors
description: Conquer and pillage planets as a one-man army in this brutal action roguelite set in a bizarre and dark technofantasy universe. Battle hordes, plunder your enemies, forge devastating arsenals, and carve your path through endless intergalactic god-wars under the watchful eye of a mysterious goddess.

title: Echoed Nights
description:
Explore a fragmented, surreal facility, evade twisted memory-born monsters, and collect scattered objects to piece together your forgotten past as an unknown voice guides you, whispering cryptic hints and haunting warnings. Its words draw you deeper into the twisted halls, where every step could reveal a truth—or awaken a nightmare.

Collect stuffed animals, the last remnants of memories scattered across the disjointed, surreal environment. Each one holds a fragment of your forgotten past, slowly revealing the story behind the horrors that haunt you. The world itself is a puzzle of scattered memories, stitched together yet never whole.

Will you be able to remember the ONE from your scattered memories, or will you be consumed by the echoes lurking in the dark?

title: Exoria
description: An action-adventure game where a grappling hook lets you explore, solve puzzles, and fight fluidly on your quest for the mythical sword Exoria.

title: Sveta Sky AI
description: A short story in the form of a correspondence with the assistant Sveta Sky AI. Can your AI companion become more than just text and sounds? That's what we're about to find out.

title: Gemcraft: Legacy Collection
description: Experience the original three GemCraft games in one collection. GemCraft 1, GemCraft 0, and GemCraft Labyrinth! Forge and combine magical gems, build deadly defenses, and survive relentless waves in one of the most beloved Flash-era tower defense series!

title: Cradle of the Dark Brood
description:
Cradle of the Dark Brood is a dark fantasy incremental breeding game about building power through inheritance, mutation, automation, and conquest.

You begin as something trapped outside the rules of the world, able to act only through the creatures you create. Breed new offspring, preserve stronger bloodlines, cull weaker results, and shape your brood into a force capable of surviving beyond the cradle.

Every generation can push your numbers higher. Improve core traits such as Lethality, Vitality, Durability, Motility, and Synapticity, then use those gains to unlock new systems, stronger roles, and more dangerous forms of progression.

title: Apothecary of Ashes
description:
Apothecary of Ashes is a choice driven narrative visual novel that takes place over a seven day period. Players navigate a dark setting centered around a spreading plague and the psychological impact of survival, making daily decisions that directly affect the story's progression.
Gameplay consists of reading text, managing narrative progression, and selecting one of three choices each day. These decisions track player choices across multiple moral axes, specifically balancing compassion versus pragmatism, truth versus deception, and mercy versus control. The game features branching paths and a total of four distinct endings based on the moral choices accumulated throughout the week.

title: DCS World: Mosquito FB VI Freeman's Folly Campaign by SUNTS Simulations
description: A story based campaign with two fictitious protagonists F/Lt Dougie Maxwell (RAAF), a former Blemhiem Mk.1 (F) pilot and F/Sgt Ginger Fenwick is your Geordie navigator from Cramlington in the North East of England. It can be flown as a novice or veteran DCS Mosquito pilot alike and the WWII Asset Pack is not required. Mission types are based upon actual historical records and Mosquito Squadron ORBS (Operations Record Books), as are the weather conditions for the dates your sorties are flown.

title: DCS World: F/A-18C: The Rampagers Campaign by Baltic Dragon
description: The Rampagers campaign was developed by Baltic Dragon and Whipbird Production. Follow the F/A-18C squadron - VFA-83 The Rampagers - aboard the USS Harry S Truman as their tour is extended by a month to reinforce Operation Inherent Resolve in Syria from the Eastern Mediterranean Sea.

title: Sky 2120
description: In 2120 robots ruled the world. As a pilot, your mission is to shoot down flying machines and fight bosses to regain the sky for humans.

title: Kanji de Go Go!
description: A kanji quiz game where you write kanji and compound words by hand. Test your kanji skills across multiple modes, from the accessible Entertainment Mode, to the challenging Serious Mode, the same-level Rush Mode, and the bonus score attack mode KAKITORI ISSEN.

title: Barbecue
description: Barbecue is a co-op party game where 1 to 4 players manage a backyard BBQ that spirals into total chaos. Light the fire, grill the meat, serve the guests, and try not to burn everything down.

title: Steel Seraphim: Proving Grounds
description: STEEL SERAPHIM: PROVING GROUNDS: Play as Aster, a lonely young pilot as he controls a colossal mech to fight off volcanic monsters. In between missions, romance your fellow pilots aboard the massive Faraday Station. Find love, survive in this hybrid third-person shooter/visual novel.

title: Bureaucromancer
description: Bureaucromancer is a turn-based tactical shooter set in a floating records office in the sky. A medieval fantasy where rather than magic, they discovered the awesome power of bureaucracy.

title: Doomsday Draft
description: Doomsday Draft is a multiplayer social deduction game for 4–8 players. Receive a random character with unique traits, reveal your cards, convince others of your value, and vote on who gets to stay in the bunker after the apocalypse.

title: The Finest Spark
description: /You are the captain! Pull yourself together and get us out of here... sir!/ — gather EXPARTS, advance weapons, master space flight, and rain metal onto your enemies in this physics-driven space sim roguelike where playing chicken with asteroids is just as dangerous as enemy fire.

title: Quixotic
description: This is a fun casual running game where you control a golden capsule rolling forward on a cobblestone track.

title: Scarlet Idol
description: Scarlet Idol is a 3D Chinese folk horror puzzle game featuring a co-op two-player mode. The game integrates various folk cultural elements, including the funeral rituals of the Wu-Yue region, Ghost operas, Mulian operas, the duomin (outcast communities)

title: Impact to the Head
description: Story-driven, first-person melee combat game. After being discharged from the military, a man turns to the occupation of a hired killer.

title: Retro Golf Mania
description: Retro Golf Mania is a relaxing golf experience wrapped in vibrant pixel art. Challenge your friends on handcrafted courses, or build your own with the full-featured in-game editor and share them instantly through Steam Workshop.

title: Miruri: Mahou Fuku Bouken
description:
Miu, a girl with a passion for fashion, heads to the mall to buy a new dress, only to discover she doesn’t have enough money. Disappointed, she returns home, where she finds the magical rabbit named Ruki waiting for her. Ruki tells Miu that he can help her obtain new outfits and later joined by Rina the fairy, the three of them embark on an outfit collecting adventure together!

Join Miu, Ruki and Rina on their adventures in this adventure comedy game with a bit(?) of perverted humour!

title: Dungeons of Freeport
description: A Daily Extraction Roguelike Dungeon-Crawler. Play the same dungeons as everyone else, once a day. Select your gear and delve into dungeons, attempting to escape with the loot you obtain. Inspired by classical roguelikes of decades past, but with a modern interface and metagame.

title: ASDVD: Umareta Bakari no Love Song
description: ASDVD: Umareta Bakari no Love Song is a re-release of AS: Angelic Serenade on DVD. This version of the game has an expanded soundtrack, as well as additional endings and story events.

title: Earth New Fall
description: Earth New Fall is a post-nuclear apocalypse suspenseful horror game developed by ThundyVT.

title: Fablery
description: Take control of legendary Heroes from myths, tales, and legends of every culture. Each Hero has a unique deck reflecting their personality and powers. Enter a tactical card game where strategy and foresight turn every battle into an unforgettable story.

title: The People's Sky
description: The fourth iteration of the People's Tree series, The People's Sky is an experimental game where players design items, append messages, and place them in a shared digital sky.

title: Wet Candy
description: There's candy underwater, in the pool. Not so sweet... and definitely not for everyone.

title: AS Rabbie Aizouban
description: A bundle containing ASDVD: Umareta Bakari no Love Song and Magical Twirler Angel Rabbie, as well as AS~Angelic Serenade Prelude and the Tenbatsu Angel Rabbie OVA.

title: Shirogane no Cal to Soukuu no Joou
description: Shirogane no Cal to Soukuu no Joou is a science fiction/fantasy visual novel by Kuma-san Team and Kogado Studio.

title: Anchored Alone
description: A noise wakes you up late at night, no one else to be found. Explore the fishing boat while you try to figure out what happened.

title: Organize My Drawer
description: A cozy relaxing organizing game where you solve levels, customize your items, follow the story and unlock more mysteries. Includes daily challenges and relaxing music.

title: All 9 Lives
description:
Trade your lives for POWER. Fight against your friends with endless character customization possibilities and rollback netcode.

All 9 Lives is a small indie fighting game, playable on web browsers for free. The Steam version has a few exclusive benefits:
- Faster load times
- Playable without an internet connection
- Bonus stages
- Arcade mode with unique character endings
- Practice mode with advanced features
- Exclusive "Steam Supporter" tag for to use online
- Development support for additional features and content.

title: Tenebrarium
description: An idle-like alien colony simulator.

title: Ardent: Rise
description: Ardent: Rise is a fantasy real-time action RPG with strong tank / damage / healing roles, and multiplayer CO-OP PVE focus.
