title: Beyonders
description: Beyonders follows a 5-person co-op elite space crew (including one dog!) sent across the solar system to investigate anomalies, recover lost assets, and survive extreme environments. Using the scientific method and cooperative engineering, players complete missions. "Could it be aliens? Never!"

title: Pintando com Senninha
description: Educational interactive CD-ROM game released in 1996 by MPO Vídeo. Based on the famous comic character created by Formula 1 champion Ayrton Senna, the game features a collection of classic activities for children, including a digital painting studio, a memory match game, and drag-and-drop sliding puzzles.

title: Ways Unknown
description: Piece together ancient secrets hidden in plain sight in this surreal open-world mystery set in a strange desert.

title: Zornhau
description: Medieval combat sandbox, hack-and-slash game

title: The One Behind You
description: A short psychological horror experience about a day in the life of a psychopath

title: Country of Snow
description:
The Ageless Winter. A curse that was cast upon Canada. A never-ending winter that withers the land. The only way to stop the curse to cut out the root of the curse, an agent of the Calamity, the sinister Ice Witch herself!

Join Cedrick, a Knight of Narvikk, whose sworn duty is to preserve the land. Thus, he must vanquish the Ice Witch! In his efforts to put an end to the Ageless Winter, he gathers allies and a share of adversaries as well.

Here is hoping that he can put an end to the curse by the end of his journey.

title: Prison Fighters
description: Help a bunch of inmates trying to escape prison. Engage in turn based combat against the guards and prison cultists to make your way through the facility, and collect items to power your prison fighters up.

title: Psycho Casket
description: Psycho Casket is an interactive RPG about a vampire and her impossible decision. It's been waiting for you. Yes, you.

title: Scourge
description: Carve through an ever shifting cyberknight dungeon using alien powers and haunted firearms.

title: Floworks
description: A node-graph automation × idle factory builder. Materials flow along the wires you draw and transform at each machine — wire Mine → Smelt → Build → Ship. Spot glowing bottlenecks, balance power against wire distance, supply growing towns, and climb a deep production tree from steel to robots and drones. It keeps running even while idle and offline, with zero image or audio assets — every visual and sound is generated in code.

title: Outworks
description: Build a towering 3D fortress and hold the line. Stack floors, raise walls, and place turrets by altitude to survive escalating swarms of ground and flying machines closing on your core — then watch one collapsing tower take everything with it. A lean, neon, code-built base-defense roguelite.

title: Sticks and Stones
description: Post-apocalyptic survival simulator set after an asteroid (or asteroids) impact.

title: Front Line
description: A side-scrolling action shooter where you push through enemy lines, switching between handgun, machine gun, shotgun, and sniper rifle. Weapon choice and reload timing can mean the difference between life and death. No extra lives. No continues. One life to conquer the battlefield.

title: Balance It!
description: Balance It is a difficult game about transporting physics objects without dropping them while also avoiding obstacles.

title: Magika Bounce
description:
Magika Bounce is a single-player, top-down action brick-breaker combat game.
Play as a high school girl empowered by the North Star, controlling a ricocheting comet to shatter enemies.
Face constellation-powered foes and uncover a hidden conspiracy.

title: Pupillary
description:
Pupillary is a short surveillance horror game where your job is to monitor live camera feeds, identify anomalies and report them before the situation gets out of control.

Anomalies can be subtle or aggressive, ranging from moved objects and missing items to camera distortions, disturbing images, and hostile intruders. Across 2 levels, you will encounter 10 anomaly types and over 100 different anomalies designed to test your memory, attention and nerves.

To help you keep track of suspicious changes, Pupillary also lets you draw directly on the camera feed. Mark objects, circle details, or leave notes to yourself.

Report every anomaly you can find, survive until 6 AM and do not trust everything you see on the cameras.

title: Ms. Spinderella
description: Ms. Spinderella is an arcade-style score attack game where players weave intricate spider webs to capture wandering insects and earn the highest score possible. By drawing complete web outlines, players can trap multiple bugs at once, wrap them into spinning silk cocoons, and cash in increasingly rewarding captures before sunrise. Combining strategic territory control with fast-paced arcade gameplay, Ms. Spinderella challenges players to balance risk and efficiency while mastering the art of the perfect web.

title: My New Tenant
description:
When Jay hears a noise at night, the one thing they didn't expect was to find not a raccoon but a monster in their barn!

Luckily, the monster turns out to be quite the attractive gentleman.

Even more luckily, he's very much Jay's type.

title: Backrooms: Eternals
description: Backrooms: Eternals is not a game. It's a relentless, ever-expanding simulation of the ultimate horror: an infinite reality, stripped of all meaning. There are no goals, only survival. No hope, only the decaying echo of what was once reality. Welcome to your forever home.

title: Hitsuji no Hakobune
description: In 2104 a huge meteorite approaches the Earth in 7 days. The USA and their allies are unable to provide solution for this problem. At such time unrecognized genius gathers three talented people at an underground cellar. They need to decide which one of them sits in the shuttle and flies to the death trip to the meteorite.

title: Blue Flow Fandisc
description: Blue Flow Fandisc is a contains 3 standalone missions that can be played without the original game. In addition, it includes an artwork collection, a walkthrough for Blue Flow, desktop accessories, RASETSU, RASETSU 2 & Blue Flow game demos and a 3-episode audio drama CD.

title: Fox Two Protocol
description: Fox Two Protocol is intense modern jet combat. A perfect balance between arcade fun and realistic simulation, pilot progression, deep customization, and spectacular air-to-air & air-to-ground battles. Feel like a real fighter pilot, even with just keyboard and mouse.

title: Blue Blaster Fandisc: Claudia Dakkan Sakusen
description: Blue Blaster Fandisc: Claudia Dakkan Sakusen is a fandisc of Blue Blaster featuring 3 new playable chapters along with other digital extras.

title: Puzzles: Space Cats
description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

title: I Shall Name the Dead
description: The Nameless Dead cannot be buried, their remains pile up in a mass of indignity. You have crawled from the gutter to name them. Explore the cemetery and uncover their names before the Worm eats your insides.

title: Scream Note
description: Jumpscare your friends. If you write your friend's name on a page, the monster jumpscares them and they scream. Co-op comedy horror where you and your friends are trapped in a haunted neighborhood house. Can you reach the exit together, or will you scare each other out? 222 unique, crazy jumpscares!

title: Flesh Fossil
description: Stranded on a mysterious island overrun by dinosaurs, you must find a way to escape. Uncover the island's past, manage your resources and evade those pursuing you.

title: Swaddle
description: You are a young intern in the maternity ward, and your job is to watch over the newborns on the second floor every night. But something very hungry wants to reach these children and devour them. Stop it immediately. Save the babies.

title: Inside the Shadows
description: Inside The Shadows is a first-person psychological horror game with a heavy, realistic atmosphere. Embark on an intimate and unsettling journey as you explore every room of the house, uncovering secrets that shaped your life before you were born and reveal your familys dark past.

title: Rose:Ruin
description: Drawn into a spectral library within the Spirit World, the protagonist seeks a way to escape with guidance from Lisa, a woman trapped within. A horror adventure that uncovers the lingering emotions and hidden truths left behind in the Spirit World

title: Elemental Run
description: Elemental Run is a first-person 3D endless runner. Navigate through increasingly dense traffic and survive as long as possible. By jumping, sliding, and using skills at the right moments, you clear obstacles and spend collected coins on upgrades to push further each run.

title: Geareo
description: Real gears that don't slip in a mechanical invention sandbox. Build freely with resizable parts and shapes, overcome physics challenges, and follow kit instructions. Unleash your engineering creativity with intricate clockwork contraptions, steam-powered systems, and fully functional circuits.

title: Wetline: Fire Break
description: Fire spreads through everything it touches. Pilot your water bomber low to refill, and lay wetlines that cut the blaze off before it reaches town. Ignite controlled fires when water isn't enough. A fast, tense firefighting puzzle where every second feeds the fire. What will you save?

title: Decked Out
description: Decked Out is a card-slinging deck-building roguelike. Use cards in real time to wipe out waves of enemies in order to defend and upgrade your town.

title: HAFO: Horse Around, Find Out
description: Take control of an elite, equine warrior, defeating jobber jockeys who stand in your way as you race to the finish line, using fierce foreleg punches, hind leg kicks. HAFO isn't your grandsire's horse racing game. Wanna know how? Well Horse Around, and Find Out!

title: Mermaid Garden
description:
A cute, atmospheric and relaxing game about mermaid gardening... 

Star flowers , sea weed , sea blaze!

What will your garden look like?

title: Hauntmates
description: Co-op horror investigation game across multiple maps. Enter procedurally generated environments, use your equipment to gather clues, and identify the entity. Watch your back, because monsters are hunting you down.

title: Reefsong
description: Reefsong is a Top-Down 2.5D Action game where the player character controls a mermaid with a magic staff she must activate by singing. With her magic voice, she activates magical abilities to defend her ecosystem from an alien Mothership that drops polluting ships!

title: Elden Ring Demake
description:
Experience a PS1-inspired reimagining of Elden Ring in this fan-made demake. Battle the fearsome Omenkiller in a fast-paced Souls-like encounter, complete with retro visuals, nostalgic low-poly graphics, and classic PlayStation-era aesthetics.

Dodge, strike, and survive in this faithful recreation that captures the spirit of Elden Ring through the lens of a late '90s action game.

title: Arma: Cold War Assault Remastered
description: The genre-defining military sim that began as Operation Flashpoint (2001), now a modernized, 64-bit, cross-platform build for Windows and Linux, with its engine released as open source. Over 2 million copies sold. The Cold War battlefield of Everon and Nogova, remastered for today's hardware.

title: Dawson Oaks Trailer Park
description: A proximity voice chat social deduction game where criminals must commit secret crimes while a Supervisor hunts them, and a hidden Snitch betrays them from within.

title: SpringTale
description: Explore, fight and play together in a roguelike platformer MMO. Adventure through changing worlds, meet other players along the way and team up to take on challenging bosses. Collect powerful gear that shapes how you play.

title: The House They Left Behind
description: A first-person horror game about returning to a familiar place that no longer feels safe. Explore a remote house, search for your missing grandparents, and uncover what was happening right in front of you all along.

title: Pathfinder: The Dragon's Demand
description: Pathfinder: The Dragon’s Demand is a single-player, turn-based CRPG that takes role-playing back to its roots with miniature-based characters and digital dice to recreate the look and feel of a tabletop RPG. Based on the Pathfinder module The Dragon’s Demand by fan-favorite adventure designer Mike Shel.

title: Battle Live! The Idol School Collection
description: Battle Live! The Idol School Collection is a compilation of episodic, short stories that take place in the idol school of Pride Park.

title: Dragon Kisser
description: Left alone as your little villages last hope, you: Domingo, know what you must do to save your people and also pull a hot date, and that is to do what you know best: Romance the dragon attacking your home! Put your charisma to the test in this cheeky third-person soulslike boss battle!

title: The Untold Tales of the Vocaloids
description: Iroha City is a known, but peaceful city that some may even consider too peaceful and thus boring. However, Kagamine Rin doesn't think so and she always finds a way to make her everyday life exciting, while also spending time with her friends, the other Vocaloids. But one day, a strange phenomenon occurs which marks the end of their peaceful daily life, demanding a lot of personal growth and overcoming their fears as they embark in a quest to save the world.

title: Vessels: Noiret Mansion
description: A retro-inspired PSX survival horror game set in the mysterious Noiret Mansion. Explore a cursed estate, solve puzzles, uncover the fate of the Noiret family, and survive the horrors lurking within its walls.

title: Stigmata
description: Stigmata is a classic survival horror experience where you must fight, explore, and manage your resources to survive. A man finds himself alone in a city where reality is beginning to unfold. Does judgement await you or something else? Your decisions directly affect the world and your experience.

title: ZeroEco
description: A psychological horror narrative game in pixel art about routine, memory, and the fear of change. Explore, interpret, and uncover what lies hidden within yourself.

title: Enarian Online
description:
An online, single & multiplayer, text-based action role-playing game.

Dive into a fast-paced, loot-driven adventure, across the shattered fragments of reality. Equip powerful items, gather powerful abilities, and conquer bosses, all through beautifully formatted text.

title: Railroad Rummy
description: A classic multiplayer rummy card game where you draw, discard, build winning hands, and outplay friends and family in tense, easy-to-learn matches inspired by real camping table traditions.

title: Kaitou Tenshi Twin Angel: Maboroshi no Shoujo
description: A freeware visual novel spin-off belonging to the Twin Angel franchise. The story follows life-long friends and classmates Haruka Minazuki and Aoi Kannazuki at St. Cherine Academy. While they appear to be ordinary students by day, they secretly transform at night into the heroic, magical "Phantom Thief Angels" to fight evil and thwart major conspiracies.

title: Something Beautiful
description: Something Beautiful is an immersive, music-driven point-and-click adventure game. Explore detailed, atmospheric environments, solve intricate puzzles, and experience a compelling story from musician and visual artist Murlo.

title: Gunjutsu
description: GUNJUTSU combines the score-chasing creativity of Skate 3 with Call of Duty Trickshotting. Learn the basics, master the 'Trickshot Iceberg' and compete on the global leaderboard. If you’ve ever hit a 360, this game was made for you.

title: DoomMapGuessr
description:
DoomMapGuessr is a geo-guessing game where, instead of guessing in which part of the world you are, you try to guess where the screenshot being shown to you was taken, in the Classic DOOM franchise and some extra WADs.

DoomMapGuessr allows for fun gameplay with customization settings available, such as being able to pick your own screenshots and WADs!

title: Hell Above
description: Team up to hack, slash, fight, and die (... a lot). A merciless soulslike boss-rush trapped in a low-poly, PS1-era Dante poem... except this time you're venturing up the inferno...

title: Commie Bobrs
description: Commie Bobrs is a chaotic co-op physics-based building simulator. Assemble iconic Eastern Europe buildings block by block using cranes, forklifts, pure muscle power and your friend's questionable guidance. Just try not to die while doing it...

title: Spirimonz
description: Spirimonz is a game in which you hunt down evil spirits and capture various ghostly companions who will help you and follow you on every new mission.

title: Beghost
description: BEGHOST is a narrative-heavy 2D action-adventure game set in the bowels of a haunted dungeon. Uncover the dungeon's darkest secrets with your ghost girl companion Bee, as you navigate your way through enemies, traps, and more, in a desperate attempt to escape!

title: Dear Pianissimo Refrain
description: An expanded re-release of Dear Pianissimo with new characters, new scenarios and three new vocal songs.

title: Heartbeat Under One Roof
description: Sakura, the protagonist’s childhood friend, gets scouted by a talent agency and begins her journey as an idol. She moves in with the protagonist, who works in Tokyo. With his support, can Sakura rise to become a top idol with one million fans?

title: HouseWarming
description: Brian Lewis buys an old house, hoping for a quiet and orderly life. But on the very first night, the house begins to behave strangely... What starts as a harmless incident slowly turns into something far more terrifying... What if someone else is inside?

title: Heroes of Retribution
description: A rogue-like RPG set in a ruined world. Take on the role of a tank commander. Discover other heroes and factions. Upgrade your tank, acquire new skills, and find forgotten relics in this devastated world. Choose your side, get stronger and become humanity's savior.

title: Plinko Dungeon
description: Drop orbs, cast spells, survive the dungeon. Plinko Dungeon blends plinko physics with roguelite action combat. Build your spells and items around each run's machine, then fight your way deeper into the dungeon.

title: The Joust
description: The Joust delivers laughably fun physics, HD cartoony graphics, and endless ways to brawl! Battle as a medieval knight, a futuristic space warrior, or even an elephant... with over 80 classes to choose from, the choice is yours! Multiplayer and Singleplayer are supported in a first-class fashion!

title: Trash: Tale of Wastetown
description: Explore Wastetown, a metropolis populated by trashes. Play as Slim, a cardboard box, in an action-stealth adventure among dangers and secrets. Will you be able to face deadly enemies and defeat a great enemy that has now taken control of the city?

title: Reverse Survivors
description: A reversed survivors-like where you are sending waves of monster to stop the survivors.

title: Chicken Blaster
description: Chicken Blaster is a casual arcade shooter where quick reflexes are the key to victory. Shoot coins, avoid hazards, and see how long you can survive as the chaos ramps up.

title: Beso's Shawarma
description: Beso's Shawarma is a short, narrative-driven horror game. A late-night call lures you on a surreal journey through empty streets to a sketchy shawarma shop. Talk to a cast of strange characters, make a terrifying choice, and try to escape a disjointed, looping nightmare.

title: Turscar Isle
description: Infiltrate the base of a cult of spammers in this Thief-style stealth extraction game! Exact poetic justice on them by stealing everything they haven't nailed down, then go back and steal the nails.

title: Lord of the Trough
description: Lord of the Trough is about getting to the desired girth and claiming the superior oats. Enjoy the pastures of Svinwald with up to 5 other players. Live to impress the tall skinny ones. Compete in a range of mini-games to determine the superior pig. Serve up a range of undesirable slop to your ungirthed brothers.

title: Runeboard
description: RuneBoard is a browser-based adventure inspired by the exploration, progression, skills, combat, and community spirit of classic MMORPGs.

title: TetraPlinko
description: Tetra-Plinko is a high-energy physics puzzler that collides two classic arcade games! Drop blocks strategically to navigate a peg-filled board, unleash massive multiplier combos, and watch the chaos unfold. Rack up points in this addictive, fast-paced mashup of strategy and gravity!

title: Paper Paws
description: Paper Paws a cozy card collecting game about kittens! Scratch, clean, laminate and collect all the cats in your album. Can you collect them all?

title: Botmare
description: BOTMARE is a hardcore Lovecraftian FPS. Survive timed challenges alone or with friends via split-screen & Steam Remote Play. Collect tokens, activate relics, escort allies and battle vicious monsters and bosses. Master diverse weapons and realistic ballistics in this ever-dangerous nightmare realm.

title: Endless Defense
description: Endless Defense is a roguelite sci-fi tower defense game where every run becomes a new build. Place turrets, choose traits, draw upgrade cards, use special tiles, and evolve your defense to survive endless waves of enemies, elites, and bosses.

title: Mendel Simulator
description: Welcome to Mendel Simulator: Flower crossbreeding, a game that blends relaxing simulation with the authentic science of plant genetics. Become a master breeder in your own private greenhouse, where every bloom tells a story of inheritance.

title: Quadrix
description: Rule the board with chaotic card synergies in a high-tempo block-placement roguelite. Bend physics, reverse board collapses, and chain game-breaking combos. Dominate online PvP, Co-op, and a 100-level Campaign. Draw your cards. Break the game.

title: Amitabha Buddha
description: Amitabha Buddha is an action role-playing game set against the backdrop of Buddhist teachings. Players embody a Bodhisattva on a journey to redeem the fierce souls trapped in the borderlands, embarking on a path through the joys and sorrows of the Saha world.

title: Vampy's Big Day
description: Sneak through the shadows as a clumsy vampire learning to avoid deadly sunlight… with a little help from a sun fairy. Will you find redemption, or embrace the darkness?

title: Beatrix
description: Beatrix is a dark roguelike board-builder. Shape the battlefield: deploy Canones ("Canons") to orchestrate your strategy and use tactical positioning to surround and flip your enemies. Judge the damned and restore order to Hell.

title: QuizMasters
description: QuizMasters is much more than a trivia game. Play alone or with friends in a thrilling mix of three round types — no purchase needed for your friends to join! Features multiple choice trivia (powered by Open Trivia DB), 8 puzzle games including maze and minesweeper, and creative rounds where players invent subtitles for funny videos and get voted on. Friends join FREE via browser on any device (PC, Mac, Android, iOS). One person buys it on Steam, everyone else can play. Build your own custom quiz with 11 mini-games across 3 round types.

title: Farewells Clicker
description: Farewells Clicker is an addictive blend of clicker and city builder! Expand your island, develop your city, and produce resources endlessly. Upgrade your buildings and skills through a vast skill tree to progress further and further!

title: Lost In Dimensions
description: This is a survival game where you must unveil the story and find your truth. Decide your fate and avoid trouble in the form of military bandits and keep an eye out for those pesky sharks! Explore dimensions, islands and discover civilisations. Good luck!

title: Bee Space
description: Plant flowers and deploy tech from orbit in this roguelike deckbuilder! Terraform tiny hex grid islands as advanced space Bees. Contend with fickle weather, strange creatures, mysterious artifacts and meddling bosses as you reclaim Earth for all Bee-Kind!

title: Beetle Sumo
description: Beetle Sumo turns Japanese rhinoceros beetle wrestling into a fast couch-party battle. Charge, shove, scramble, and survive as up to 8 beetles fight to be the last one on the table.

title: Crown of the Nile: Cleopatra's Choice
description: Become Cleopatra VII in a historical romance visual novel of power, betrayal, and forbidden desire. Reclaim your throne, navigate Rome’s ambitions, and rewrite the fate of Ancient Egypt through your choices

title: Karting Core
description: A single-player kart racing game focused on skill-based driving. Race across 10+ tracks, unlock 3 kart tiers, compete in 5 tournaments, customize your garage and camera, and master races, time trials, and drift challenges.

title: Jerico Proxyma: Zsiványűr
description: At the end of human civilization, the world's most unfortunate mercenary squad accidentally sets off a chain reaction that completely transforms Jerico Proxyma's solar system and sheds light on the history of dark creation in this corner of the galaxy. Outlawman!

title: Durt: Motocross Championship
description: Arcade motocross with a late-'90s PSX soul: throttle-controlled drifts, back-it-in braking, real air with tricks, and a screaming two-stroke. A full championship across motocross and supercross tracks, built hand-in-hand with its players.

title: MITH: Make It To Heaven
description: MITH: Make It To Heaven is an NSFW visual novel set in an fantasy university. You are the first human to be accepted in the prestigious Arcane Academy university a long time, this will bring you a lot of attention from your peers, who you can date in MITH!

title: Around The Core
description: A space-themed incremental shooter where destruction fuels growth. Annihilate asteroids, harvest wealth, and climb a massive upgrade tree.

title: Dodgecore
description: Dodge. Survive. Improve. Face escalating projectile chaos, powerful boss attacks and fast arcade gameplay. Unlock skins, use unique abilities and push your high score further with every run.

title: Ghost Exorcist
description: Purify ghosts and collect their souls. Grow stronger with every soul you gather, unlock powerful upgrades through the skill tree, and guide restless spirits to their final rest in this progression-driven action game.

title: Scorched Dominion
description: A dark fantasy turn-based strategy game about competing for territory and assets. Command unique units, disrupt enemy advances, and expand your power. Features five factions, five AI difficulty levels, and local two-player battles.

title: Doorcrash!
description: Deliver food fast while causing as much destruction as possible. Laws be dammed!

title: Trees Inc
description: Build a self-sustaining forest in this incremental idle game where you chop trees, automate production with workers, stack upgrades for exponential growth, and use prestige and XP-based perks to push your output further every run.

title: EXO-Roid
description: A space rangers journey to escape planets. Build your own in the map designer or play the pre made map. Save your progress by making a 'Testament' (Notepad and pen required). The choice is yours. God speed, Ranger!

title: Swordsmith of Greyhaven
description: Run a weaponsmith shop in dark medieval city of Greyhaven. Sell weapons, manage gold, debt, materials, and fame, while customers, beggars, bandits, and rumors reveal the consequences of every choice.

title: Bladeforged: The Seventh Sword
description: Bladeforged: The Seventh Sword is a fast-paced 2D pixel art Metroidvania. Wield a versatile guardian blade and a high-tech bracelet to execute fluid combo cancels, parry ruthless abstract enemies, and explore the interconnected world of Regis to stop a cosmic multiversal invasion.

title: Misdamnation
description: In this poignant story influenced by RPG Maker classics and psychological horror, you’re Div, an ill-fated soldier robbed of his memories and identity. Navigate the surreal dystopia poised for revolt, ponder moral dilemmas, and discover who you used to be, before they’ve branded you as a monster.

title: Hostile Entity
description: A reality breach has unleashed something terrible. Fight through 30+ levels, deadly enemies, and brutal boss fights in this 2D top-down horror action game to stop the entity behind the anomaly.

title: The Missing Rune
description: A psychological horror sim where you play a low-level researcher, who has to banish demonic entities back to where they came from. While having to keep the entitles in your peripheral vision, you must use the Rune Operation Manual to input the right runes, and send them back.

title: Nymble 2
description: Jack returns in Nymble 2, a turn-based puzzle-platformer where every step and jump matters. Solve 100+ handcrafted levels filled with new enemies, traps, and hazards that react when you move. Find the seedling, plant it, and climb the beanstalk to reach the next level above.

title: My Life as a Vampire's Maid
description: In this suspenseful fantasy visual novel, play as a young man stranded in snowy mountains. Guided by unseen forces, you enter an isolated mansion. As a peculiar daily life unfolds, you live alongside two vampire girls. Immerse yourself in this profound, dreamlike dark fairy tale.

title: Nyonin-jima 2: Shima Hitotsu Marugoto Hame Pako Haramase Seikatsu
description: The sequel to "Nyo-Nin-Jima: My New Life in Charge of a Tropical Island"

title: Monke Survivor
description: You are a Monke beating up endless waves of office workers with brutal melee combat and ragdoll physics. Smash props for rare buffs, stack game-breaking items and compete on the Global Leaderboards in this aggressive action-roguelite.

title: Gyaru to Papakatsu: Yarichin Chuunen Oji no Enjoy PacoPaco Life
description:
Middle-aged, still single, no lover, no hobbies, only dull, unsatisfying and repeating work-filled days.
One day, you meet a group of unique gals through a certain matching app, and you end up forming secret relationships with them.

title: Thanks for the Soup
description: The job's simple: Go around town and satisfy your customers with some nice and hot soup. Hop on your bicycle and go around town, make some money, buy items, take care of your cat, and much more in this immersive horror simulator.

title: Come In
description: After months of chatting online, she invites you over. A quiet house in the middle of the woods seems like the perfect place for a romantic encounter. But the longer you stay inside, the more you realize something is wrong with this place.

title: All But Weak
description: All But Weak is a Couch Coop Roguelite for 1 to 4 players. Mix elements, stack crazy weapon modifiers, and try to survive the madness with your friends.

title: Corrupted Worlds
description: A 2D platformer about breaking videogames and using glitches.

title: The Totemist
description: Run an occult shop in a quietly strange town, crafting totems and talismans inspired by real witchcraft. Help townspeople with their burdens at your own pace while uncovering an ancient darkness beneath the town, one only you can stop.

title: Jade Shadows: Constellations
description:
A new and terrible education awaits on Venus…

The Jade Shadows: Constellations Quest continues Stalker’s story with an unlikely reality where both outcomes of a past decision are in an endless battle to prevail over the other. Step into this new cinematic Quest as the shadow and put a stop to this eternal conflict.

Come face to face with Sirius & Orion and their mentors. Orion is guided by Vena, Garuda’s Protoframe, the blood-drenched Wytch. Sirius is mentored by Ryoku, Ash’s Protoframe, the blade swarm assassin. Both sides vying to erase the other in order to secure their future.

Completing the Quest will unlock access to the Uranus Proxima, where you can play two new Railjack missions: Scoria’s Angel and The Kuva Wytch. Join either Vena or Ryoku with their own Railjack and crew in an epic hunt to take the other down. Completing these missions will reward you with new resources used to trade at a secret vendor in Pontis Tower, a new hub located in Uranus.

Wield the power of the stars with Sirius & Orion, our 65th Warframe. Two Warframes in one, in a constant duel for supremacy. They bring with them their signature Heavy Scythes, Pride and Wrath, each granting their own Melee buffs for Slam Attacks.

Embrace bloodlust with Vena’s Gemini Skin for Garuda or become a calculated killer with Ryoku’s Gemini Skin for Ash. Each comes with their own Gemini Emote showcasing these rivals' disposition and lethality.

Vena and Ryoku aren’t the only blade-proficient warriors in this update… Spears are also flying from Styanax Prime! Become the ultimate golden hoplite with Styanax Prime, Afentis Prime, Athodai Prime and his Prime Accessories with Styanax Prime Access.

The stars aligned and brought you even more to gaze upon in this update, Tenno! Knowledge glides on dark wings with the Dante Tytonis Collection. Railjack missions can now be played on The Steel Path difficulty. The Obex, Destreza, Stug, Ballistica, and Vectis Incarnons are also here. New Warframe Augment Mods for Dante, Nokko, Koumei and Temple have been added to Faction Syndicates. Nidus’ abilities have received a touch up and we’ve packed this update with loads of Quality of Life changes. And so much more to discover!

Thank you to Sumo Digital for co-developing the Railjack content, as well as the Vena & Ryoku cosmetic items in this update!

title: Apex Legends Overclocked
description:
NEW LEGEND: AXLE
Move fast and hit hard with new Legend Axle, the combat racer pushing the Apex Games to its limits. Chain slides, launch into high-speed rotations, and dominate with hypermobile gameplay.

DEATHBOX RESPAWNS
Getting downed is temporary, but revenge is forever. Pull off bigger, better comebacks with Deathbox respawns. Revive squadmates directly at their Deathbox, no beacon hunting required.

PUSH LEGENDS TO THEIR LIMITS
Keep pushing and stay in the fight! Conduit gains an extra Tactical charge and greater mobility, Vantage gets improved optics, a 2x canted sight, faster repositioning, and more.

OVERCLOCKED BATTLE PASS SPLIT 1
Power through with the Overclocked Battle Pass Split 1..

Earn new prototype Legendary Skins for Conduit and Crypto, a Reactive RE-45 Skin, and more.

title: 101 Cats in Brussels
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens in the hand-crafted Brussels landscape. Earn lots of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick! ️

title: 101 Cats in Budapest
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens in the hand-crafted Budapest landscape. Earn lots of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

title: Summer Seaside Search
description: Summer Seaside Search is a relaxing spot the difference game that transforms sunny beach days into a fun test of observation. At first glance, each seaside scene looks picture perfect, with golden sands, rolling waves, and colorful umbrellas, but subtle differences are hidden throughout, waiting to be discovered.

title: Mittelland AD: Origins
description: Attain fame and fortune in late medieval Europe! Prove your economic prowess, outmaneuver your rivals, and immortalize yourself in the history books! The classic economic simulation set from 1500 onwards.

title: Marble Mirage
description: A homoerotic thriller visual novel set in a luxurious men’s spa. Investigate a murder, pursue romance, solve puzzles, and uncover dangerous secrets.

title: Age of Empires Mobile: PC Edition
description: Build empires, forge alliances and conquer hundreds of players in real time.

title: MalOvent
description: MalOvent is an adult horror visual novel centered around SCP-1471. Over the course of play you'll be presented with choices that matter not only for you as the main character, but for the greater world around you. Will you be able to unearth the truth before the walls come crashing down?

title: Our Light Affliction: Spider's Covenant
description: A dark fantasy/yandere otome game about a girl who can see spirits, the spider apparition who tricks her into a contract, and the exorcist who is after them. Decide who to trust, and whether you'll fix them, or make them worse...

title: Heroines Paradox
description: “Heroines Paradox” is a hybrid Dungeon Crawler and Visual Novel, told through an urban horror narrative reminiscent of Junji Ito’s storytelling style.

title: City Cleaning
description: City Cleaning is a meditative and calming adventure that will allow you to escape the hustle and bustle of everyday life and immerse yourself in a tranquil atmosphere. In this game, your task is to transform the city streets, clearing them of dirt and debris and restoring their former beauty.

title: Color Splash: Reptiles
description: Color Splash: Reptiles is a charming and relaxing puzzle game that will lift your spirits and take You into the world of adorable reptiles and art. Venture into the gallery, where you will find many extraordinary and colorful birds paintings.

title: One Billion Ducks
description: An incremental journey about duck hunting with your canine companions. Shoot rare ducks, sell them, upgrade your abilities, and collect one billion ducks to combat world hunger!

title: Knuckle Creek
description:
Knuckle Creek is a slapstick comedy brawler designed for friends, fun and light-hearted play sessions. Smash your way through chaotic matches with up to eight players in Battle mode (offline/online) or jump into the Single Player campaign to unlock various dress-up items for your characters, bombs, and flags.

The stage is set, the chickens are clucking, LET’S GO!

title: Jigsaw Savant
description: Jigsaw Savant is a unique game combining gorgeous puzzles with an engaging and fun story about saving Christmas. You'll complete over 100 puzzles (with 4 difficulty levels to choose from and up to 615 pieces) as the story slowly unravels and you can save Christmas.

title: A Ridiculous Waste of Time
description: A Ridiculous Waste of Time is a collection of casual mini-games designed to test your mind and your reflexes. There's something for everyone in this Ridiculous library of fun!

title: DK64: Rekongpiled
description: DK64: Rekongpiled is a native PC port of the classic N64 title, built from the same developers behind the popular Donkey Kong 64 Randomizer.

title: Stackpot!
description: In this tiny trivia game each question you answer will either reward you with a new expensive item or punish you with a worthless piece of junk. Stack these rewards, or punishments, as high as you can without your pile falling over and make lots of money.

title: FearPark Chapter 1
description: FearPark is a horror experience set in an abandoned amusement park. The current version represents the full core experience, with potential improvements and updates planned after release. FearPark is currently in active development. Some features and content may change before the final release.

title: Bird-Shot
description: Bird-shot is a wild west themed 1-bit light gun game where the player plays as an retired outlaw hunting down ducks.

title: Doppler
description: Die fast. Restart faster. Scream a little. Meet Doppler: a tiny blue ball of blue nerves with a red bandana snapping in the wind.

title: Toy Keeper
description: Sort up to 27,564 toys across massive multi-floor toy stores, solo or with up to ∞ players, unlock powerful upgrades, and turn complete chaos into perfect organization in this cozy 3D cleanup game.

title: Jay Jay the Jet Plane: Sky Heroes to the Rescue
Alcurio
description: Alcurio is a chaotic co-op fantasy adventure where you and your friends explore enchanted wilds, collect strange items, and feed them into the Arcwell to fill your Arcana quota. Cast spells, complete odd quests, and escape into the portal before time runs out!

title: OneShot: Solstice
description: The Solstice chapter and ending conclude the story of OneShot and put and end to New Game Plus. You also get to explore new areas, solve new puzzles, meet new characters and to see old characters in a new light.

title: G Squad
description: Run the gauntlet with G Squad in this hand-crafted autobattler with roguelite and RPG elements, designed to scratch the strategy itch without the spreadsheets. 9 unique heroes, in-run rewards, permanent progression, and boss challenge modifiers to test yourself against.

title: IDLE: Intergalactic Defense League Exterminators
description: An incremental game about blasting bugs, collecting guts, upgrading a base, and blasting more bugs!

title: Hantu and Hunted
description: Morph into props to survive as a human or hunt as the legendary ghosts of Southeast Asian folklore. Asymmetric horror prop hunt with proximity voice chat. Hide, hunt and escape.

title: Pest Protocol
description: The swarm is infinite—your hands aren't. Pest Protocol is a short, satisfying incremental game. Start by clicking to eradicate pests, then rapidly deploy autonomous systems to clear the screen for you. Build, upgrade, and scale your extermination empire. Automate the eradication.

title: Hex Judge
description: Hex Judge is a medieval narrative investigation game where players take on the role of an inquisitor questioning villagers accused of witchcraft. Gather testimonies, uncover contradictions, and decide who will be judged. Every choice leads to one of multiple endings.

title: Late Night Manifest
description:
Late Night Manifest is a PSX-style post-apocalyptic survival horror game with fixed third-person camera, focused on exploration, environmental storytelling, and puzzle-solving.

You begin alone in your own home, with no clear answers. From there, you must explore the region by visiting key locations by car, unlocking doors, and navigating interconnected paths to reach critical destinations. Progress is driven by observation: examining environments, solving riddles, and overcoming obstacles that block your way forward.

title: Watashi ga Sekai wo Sukutta Hi
description:
To us, who are breathing our last every moment we are alive, you are beyond a shadow of a doubt a hero.

This is a story of the female protagonist being summoned to another world, becoming a hero and saving the world.

title: Very Safe Dino Park
description: Very Safe Dino Park is a cooperative simulation game for 1–4 players where you build, manage, and maintain a prehistoric theme park. Feed dinosaurs, clean enclosures, keep guests safe, repair failing systems, and expand your park while dealing with unpredictable disasters. Work together to keep everything under control, or watch the park descend into chaotic, dinosaur-filled mayhem.

title: Deep Sea Fish: Hidden World
description: A short incremental fishing game where you catch fish, earn gold, and unlock powerful upgrades to explore the deep sea.

title: JPEG
description: A short psychological walk sim from a first-person perspective. Day after day, you perform routine tasks in the same apartment, following on-screen prompts. But the familiar walls begin to change — the protagonist is going mad, and so are you. Will you make it to the day the screen fades to black?

title: InfinityMine
description: No enemies—debt and a volatile ore market are your true foes. Mine a dungeon that changes every day. Drop to 0 HP and you lose the day’s mined ore. Upgrade tools, manage carry limits, time sales, and descend to the deepest layer.

title: Manala: Equinox War
description: The swords are fake, the hits don't count and the monster is just a guy in a costume. Manala is a videogame about live-action roleplay (LARP): build a combat deck, fight other players and argue over armor points.

title: Cut to Pieces
description:
Butler works for his master, Sr. Cole Hector, who asks him to visit an auction where they will sell the most prestigious paintings. But when Butler misses the auction, he has to come up with a creative solution to prevent getting fired.

Use an old newspaper to mimic the real paintings. Search for similar objects or shapes, cut them out, and place them correctly on the canvas. Will your master, with his terrible eye-sight, be fooled by your creation, or will you have to find a new job?

title: An Angler's Light
description: It's dark at the bottom of the sea. As an anglerfish, you are the only source of light down there. But your preys can see you coming, to catch them you will have to turn off your precious light for a moment.

title: My Keyboard is Full of Ants!
Hope Falters
description: Slide letters to get Hope to the exit. Break words apart and mix them together, lose hope, and find it again.

title: Organic Evolution
description: Organic Evolution is a neon platformer set in a microcosm. Jump across organic structures, break blocks, avoid hostile creatures, and find keys to navigate through 8 biological environments.

title: Desktop Snail Assassin
description: A idle desktop snails-like. Every now and then the murderous snail assassin is hunting your mouse cursor, turning your desktop into a chaotic bullet hell. How long can you survive?!

title: Lisia
description: Drive your truck on deadly roads. Use the winch, build bridges, and spray-paint the body. Reach the summit alone or in co-op with friends. And remember the main rule: don't look down!

title: Guns of Eschaton
description: The worlds first soulslike FPS pulls you into an apocalyptic Western by the legendary Viktor Antonov: a land of dust, blood, and horror. Study your enemies, count your bullets, forge your own style with gunpowder and prayers. Solo or in co-opgo West, gunslinger, go West and die with the country!

title: Terra Invicta: Dark Skies
description: Face the alien invasion in two new scenarios for Terra Invicta. Drop into a world shattered by nuclear fire a century ago, or rewind to 2003 and trade the rush to the stars for a slower fight on Earth.

title: Dark Points
description: Scan the environment every 10 seconds.

title: Cultivation: Mystic Realm of Spirit Mountain
description: You'll explore uncharted spirit mountains teeming with spirit plants, stones, treasures, and beasts. Gather resources, grow plants, refine pills to advance, with spirit roots, skills, and pets aiding your relaxed cultivation. Begin your journey!

title: Sheep It
description: Sheep It is a relaxing game about using sheep lives as currency for tools.

title: Avion
description: Avion is a chilled flight physics simulator.

title: Limby
description: LIMBY is a twisted puzzle platformer. Play as Limby, a frat bro turned zombie. Traverse through 30 absurd and brain scrambling levels. Use your severed limbs to reach new heights and unlock new pathways to achieve your ultimate goal: Devour. The. Nerd.

title: Sponge Break
description: Sponge Break is a physics-based co-op survival game in which one to four players control sponges attempting to escape down a treacherous river aboard a fragile raft, steering through rapids, environmental hazards, and hostile wildlife. It supports drop-in co-op and solo play, and features proximity voice chat with sponges that lip-sync to player speech. Players use a plunger that doubles as a grappling hook, throw loose objects, and store loot in a shared raft stash, while a physics system governs raft handling and damage. Progression is level-based across multiple biomes such as sewers, rivers, and abandoned facilities, with safehouses between levels for repairing, reviving, and restocking, alongside over 100 unlockable cosmetic options, emotes, controller support, and a range of side activities.

title: Arthur's 2nd Grade
description: Arthur's 2nd Grade is the perfect combination of learning, fun, and helpful features. With 15 different educational activities and 20 creative activities, Arthur's 2nd Grade teaches a full year's worth of second grade skills and entertains your child with limitless fun and learning!

title: Arthur's Preschool
description: Arthur's Preschool is the perfect combination of learning, fun, and helpful features. With 9 exciting learning activities and over 20 creative activities, Arthur's Preschool teaches a full year's worth of preschool skills and entertains your child with limitless fun and learning!

title: Arthur's Math Games
description: Arthur's Math Games is the perfect combination of learning, fun, and helpful features. With 6 different fun-filled activities and 5 levels of difficulty, Arthur's Math Games will entertain your child with hours of learning and fun!

title: WinMind
description:
WinMind is a single player, freeware version of the classic, code breaking game Mastermind.

Game-play is virtually identical to all other Mastermind clones, the player has to deduce the correct five colour code and has twelve attempts to accomplish this. In response to each guess the player is told how many colours in the right position and how many colours in the wrong position were present in the attempt.

The game has three difficulty levels and can be played by the keyboard or the mouse.

title: Aura Farming
description: Aura Farming is an incremental tower-climbing game where you play as an immortal warrior, rescue allies, and grow your Aura to reach the top and save the princess.

title: Darkman: Bounty Hunter
description: You are a bounty hunter living in an alternate parallel universe in a timeline close to the present day. Your mission is to kill the demons that plague the townspeople and make the area more livable.

title: Herb's Homegrown Havoc
description: Herb's Homegrown Havoc is a simple but chaotic arcade roguelike. Pluck plants out of the ground before they rot and summon hostile creatures! Upgrade after each round to increase Herb's strength and skills in various ways.

title: A Storm of Snails
description: Shape a rich environment of shifting sands, wild swamps, and ancient ruins. Each biome you create unlocks new materials, developments, and regional wonders. Build rivers, paths, and connect your settlements across the wilderness. Forge a living world where nature and civilization rise together.

title: Bolariki
description: The match-3 roguelike. Stack relics, shatter rules, and pull off outrageous combos, all inside a puzzle game that boots like a fever dream from 1995. Crunchy, retro, and dangerously easy to start. Impossible to stop.

title: Filthy Kitchen
description: Filthy Kitchen is an 8-bit homebrew action-platformer originally developed for the 2016 Nesdev competition. The game is themed around the chore of cleaning a disastrously messy kitchen, with the primary objective being to navigate the environment to locate a missing broom. As players move through the game, they utilize a swatter to crush flies, featuring a combo system that awards massive score multipliers for taking out multiple flies in a single swing. The gameplay also requires players to dodge thematic environmental hazards, such as dirty dishes and out-of-control appliances, while collecting fresh food to restore health and increase their score. The game is available to play directly in a web browser or as a downloadable ROM for NES emulators.

title: Goo Deer
description: Goo Deer is a dark, first-person gas station management game set in a foggy world addicted to the strange drink Goo Deer. Players craft and sell a variety of Goo Deer flavors, manage inventory, and hire employees to help run the store. To keep up with demand, players venture into the misty forest to hunt deer for ingredients while avoiding a dangerous creature lurking in the fog. Balancing resources, staff, and production, and failing to meet the cravings of a desperate public can have deadly consequences. Survive and expand in a strange, eerie world.

title: Infinite Empire
description: Infinite Empire is a strategy and simulation game that blends 4X and LitRPG mechanics within a sci-fi and fantasy universe featuring steampunk, bio-organic, and necromantic aesthetics. A core feature is modular ship building, where players physically draw their hulls and place components that directly impact their tactical vulnerabilities. These massive vessels engage in slow, deliberate "Age of Sail" style combat focused on positioning and broadside attacks. Between battles, players expand their territory in a dynamic galaxy, managing an escalating notoriety system against autonomous AI factions while looting and crafting hybrid technologies.

title: Horn of Africa
description: Horn of Africa is an open-world survival and piracy game set on the coast of East Africa. Start with a small fishing boat, collect containers at sea, raid ships, trade contraband, and build your own pirate operation.

title: Unholy Employer Simulator
description: A roguelike, incremental business-sim where you cultivate a family environment, make BIG profit and sacrifice the lives of your employees to the devil. Welcome to the world of business.

title: Tung Tung Tung Survival
description: Tung Tung Tung Survival is a first-person single-player survival horror experience set across a dense, isolated 1km × 1km island. Search every corner for the scattered parts you need to repair your boat and escape. But you are not alone. You were never alone.

title: Perpetual Fear
description: Embark on a mind-bending journey in a 3D first-person horror game that plunges you into the disorienting depths of an ever-shifting house. Trapped in an endless loop, you must navigate through bizarre rooms and find the anomalies. Can you spot the difference?

title: Backrooms: Research
description: A multiplayer backrooms extraction game up to 4 players where you manage your own base and enter open, non-linear levels to complete objectives, explore unknown environments, and gather resources and items needed to survive.

title: Love You
description: A traditional Yume Nikki fangame about Aitsuki, young and heartbroken girl who explores various locations in her dreams

title: Code Vein II: Mask of Idris
description:
Beyond time and space...another story of history alteration.

Several worlds that had vanished due to historical changes.
Now, on the stage of the "Discard World," where the passions of those who lived there gather, a new exploration with fresh characters and another battle to save the world unfold.

title: Megabait
description: A brutal top-down obstacle course where every second counts. Master precise movement to survive deadly hazard rooms, leave a bloody trail of your past mistakes, and uncover every secret on your path to 100% completion.

title: The Mutiny
description: A third-person zombie survival RPG built by one solo developer. Scavenge a post-apocalyptic town, manage gear that breaks, hunger that bites, and a world that gets darker the longer you stay alive.

title: House of Tides
description: Descend into a shifting labyrinth of memories, imagined lives, and fractured identities in this first-person psychological sci-fi horror game about grief, guilt, and obsession, set inside a forgotten theatre beneath a drowned world.

title: Keykruncher
description: KEYKRUNCHER is the fun and effective treatment for all your keyboard-eating needs! Look down, follow the monitor, press the correct KEY, and KRUNCH. EAT the whole keyboard before IT eats you.

title: Night Shift Hospital
description: A chaotic co-op job simulation where up to four players take on the role of night-shift doctors in a bizarre hospital. Diagnose unusual patients, assign them to the correct treatment areas, survive increasingly unpredictable night shifts, and avoid making too many mistakes before your entire team gets fired

title: Yuki no Imouto
description: Short horror story made for Vjutsu contest.

title: Fête De La Soupe
description: A soup-like made with BAPALON for the SOUPJAM 2026.

title: Soup4U
description: An exploration game made in Bapalon for SOUPJAM2026.

title: REM Hemispheres
description: A short exploration game made for SOUPJAM2026.

title: Sepapu
description: Playing with a field of bits on the magical sandlight. A puzzle, it solved neatly.

title: Room.txt
description: You find yourself in a room with no doors. This is an unconventional soup-like made for SOUPJAMP2026.

title: Su8way
description: You are Henry, a man who only wanted to take Train 8 to work. But you quickly realize that something is wrong. Everything seems to repeat itself like a loop. Objects and people begin to change, and nothing is quite the way it should be.

title: Alternate Tales of Ryukyu: Bonds of the Red Sakura Trees
description: A Heartfelt Romance Set Amid the Skies and Seas of Ryukyu. Witness the stories of bittersweet love and men defying fate, set in Okinawa.

title: Precinct IX
description: Precinct IX is a cyberpunk police management and turn-based combat game. Receive visitors, manage cases and resources, dispatch unique officers to unstable scenes, and change case outcomes—and your relationships—through dialogue, command, and battle.

title: Incandescent X
description: Protect your ship against wave after wave of brightly coloured enemies in this fast paced arcade inspired shooter. Use your abilities to survive as long as you can!

title: The Three Cardinals
description: Fly freely across small open-worlds, sing to the the music, and meet the locals as you search for your chicks: The Three Cardinals.

title: Melancholy Lake: Camocipher12 Shorts
description: A surreal, abstract kinetic visual novel in which two girls go on a date in the middle of a broken world, using down-to-earth intimacy to survive the deteriorating nature and reality surrounding them.

title: ComboChain Pulse
description: ComboChain Pulse is a fast-paced top-down survival shooter where every second matters. Build devastating combos, unlock powerful upgrades, and survive relentless waves of enemies across unique biomes.

title: Big Golden Rock
description: Big Golden Rock is a pixel incremental clicker about a huge golden rock. Gather resources, hire shooters and archers, build towers, launch rockets, summon UFOs, and unlock increasingly powerful upgrades.

title: Skroll
description: Wake up, junkie. Your brain is hungry and only infinite scrolling can satisfy it. Manage dopamine, battery, and sanity in this survival roguelike about digital slavery.

title: Evons
description:
Evons is a strategic collectible card game where two players clash on a 7x7 grid to seize control of the battlefield. Build your 60 card deck, summon monsters forged from six elements of fire, nature, earth, water, electric, and dark, and aim your arrows to flip your rivals to your side.

Spend your credits wisely. Unleash devastating abilities like Firestorm, Resurrection, and Shockwave, then chain reaction after reaction into game breaking combos. Every arrow is a threat, every cell a battleground, every turn a gamble.

Fill the board. Break your enemy. Rule the grid. Easy to learn, hard to master, impossible to put down.

title: Hemlon the Grey
description: Hemlon the Grey is a deflection-based 2D Souls-like where life and death are decided by a blade. Follow the story of Hemlon, a half-demon warrior, as she uncovers the dark secrets of the Reinz Republic and the Broken Wings.

title: Ghostflippers
description: Flip haunted houses with your friends… before the ghost flips you. Reach your quota, grow your business, and survive the night.

title: Sudoku Haven
description: Daily brain & logic puzzles. Find your calm in 450,000+ Sudoku puzzles — free and offline. A fresh daily challenge, real solving trainers, and 20 quiet themes. Unwind and start solving.

title: Sharehouse
description: An otome horror visual novel set in a mysterious sharehouse filled with strange rules. Forge bonds with your fellow housemates as you unravel the secrets hidden within the house, where breaking the rules may mean losing more than your life.

title: 100 Yen Exorcist
description: Welcome to your part-time job cleaning up evil spirits! We picked up everything you’ll need from a 100-yen shop—more or less. Use your supplies properly, or just chuck them at the ghosts. Your call.

title: Bear Horror
description: Real-time strategy meets dark SCP survival. Play as the self-replicating SCP-1048, also known as the Builder Bear, gather grotesque resources, mass-produce a horrifying army of teddy clones and survive against Foundation personnel.

title: The Drawn Hour
description: The Drawn Hour is a haunted-terminal card roguelike. Dial into a cursed dial-up BBS as one of three operators, build a deck, and claw through three corrupted sectors. Manage your rising Corruption, hunt relics, and face what waits at the drawn hour — alone, or in 2–4 player online co-op.

title: Rouge's Flush
description: Rogue's Flush is a single-player poker roguelike deckbuilder where every hand is a heist. Recruit 70 Crew, cheat with 30 Tricks, buy Rackets, beat escalating Marks, and carry risky Long Con cases past the Pit Boss.

title: Kwad
description: Kwad is a snappy, grid-based puzzle game where you play as a square. Jump, snap, and merge with other Kwads to morph your way through clever spatial challenges.

title: Perfect Thog
description:
Perfect THoG is a game about placing gems unto a grid. When the arrange phase completes, THoGs are scored, and a round-winner declared.

Place in the arrange phase...

Score in the THoG phase...

Compete for perfection in Versus puzzle action, or in Perfect single player modes (such as Forever).

Become perfect.

6 THoGs: Frog Water, Fire, Cardinal Earth, Jordo the Last, Inscrutable Wizard Glibbyr, and Roadside Duality.

Unto this perfect grid, the 6 by 6 by 6 space will be filled by alternating gems!

New interpolation of perfect-imperfection; a big-bang but tiny and not-real!

The fifth game by Sam Atlas, music by DL Salo

title: Simulation 9
description:
Simulation 9 is a psychological anomaly game with unexpected twists.
The rules are simple: if you find an anomaly, turn back. If you don't, keep moving forward.
Or is it?
Uncover the truth behind the simulation, descend into its depths, find a way out, and survive.

title: The Red One: Occultation
description: A thrilling team-based third-person shooter where cooperation is key. Work together to complete challenging missions, face powerful enemies, and uncover hidden secrets in a dynamic battlefield.

title: Green Suits
description: Lead a squad of agents and psychics in a drama-based JRPG against an extra-dimensional cult as you explore surreal architecture and investigate paranormal crimes. Master turn-based combat where emotional states and hidden enemy intentions demand constant adaptation.

title: Rebel Roar
description: Rebel Roar is a tactical roguelike deckbuilder set in an animal cyberpunk universe. Lead a group of rebel animals, in a revolution against an evil Sapien Corporation. Combine decks to create your perfect warrior: from ninja cat to hacker possum.

title: Working Days
description: Main character discovers that his body is transparent one day. In order to return his normal body he consults different offices and takes various bodyguard, spy and security jobs.

title: Kaze no Keishousha
description: Main character has an ability to see things not noticed by anyone like ghosts and monsters. Eventually he starts to work as a detective to be able to use his abilities for the benefit of other people. One day he meets a girl-like spirit who has no memory of her past. He can't send her to police since she's not a human. The two start to live together. At the same time, more and more spirits start to appear and trigger various incidents. What's the purpose of it all?

title: Labyrinthos: The Depths Want You
description: Ascend the sunken labyrinth called the Tower and choose your path to escape to the surface. Battle foes, forge relationships, and find power in this roguelite dark fantasy RPG.

title: Once Upon A Card
description: Help a royal child find their way through their dreams! Use cards to build paths, create combos, and adapt your strategy as each run brings new challenges and bosses. Will you let the nightmares take over?

title: Toki no Ihoujin
description: An all ages version of Pythian, with additional characters and endings.

title: F1 25: 2026 Season Edition
description: Rewrite The Grid with the ultimate evolution in racing: EA Sports F1 25: 2026 Season Edition. Get F1 25 and the 2026 Season Pack in one bundle for the most complete Formula 1 experience. Race through the action-packed 2025 season, then step into a new era with the ground breaking 2026 cars, the next generation of Grand Prix racing.

title: Dungeon Dominator
description: Build and expand your own warm, cozy dungeon where your minions live miserable lives and do their evil things. Take part in thrilling battles against humans, angels, and powerful bosses, defending your domain. Conquer the world by commanding an army with a wave of your hand!

title: Spider Matrix
description: You are an error. A glitch in the Collective Mind program. A human trapped in a metal body on an asteroid swarming with alien machines that see you as a threat to be eliminated immediately. Why are there two minds in one body? Who are you — still human, or a soulless machine?

title: Considerable Grandfather: It Followed Me Home
description: Extract the Boggies from 18+ new levels set in the Fall world. Trap new enemies, grab new tools, and push the cretins out of your neighborhood!

title: DVD Screensaver Simulator Rebirth Reimagined Definitive Reloaded Special Intergrade Ultimate HD Legacy Collection Remastered (2027 Edition)
description: Experience the ultimate re-imagining of the classic DVD screensaver game. With updated next gen visuals, modernized gameplay, and a reimagined storyline. The wait is finally over. For a new generation.

title: Skullchef
description: Skullchef: The Wooden Soup — a cozy idle clicker. Stir the magical cauldron, summon quirky helpers, collect hundreds of charm skins, and ascend through prestige. Relaxing ASMR vibes, daily missions, achievements and global leaderboards. English & Spanish. By SmallCreek.

title: The Stone Ship
description: In The Stone Ship, paintings, maps, and photographs expand into living scenes, revealing hidden paths that lead back in time to the origins of an ancient megalithic monument. It is a single‑player, first‑person mystery‑exploration game featuring puzzle elements and navigation challenges.

title: Sea of Pirates
description:
Sea of Pirates is a top-down, open-sea pirate MMO — one living ocean, shared by captains from every corner of the world.

It offers the oldest fantasy on the water: a flag of your own, a crew at your back, and a horizon with no fixed edge. You begin as a nobody on a single-mast sloop and sail into a persistent world that remembers every cannon you fire and every rival you send to the deep. Rise far enough, and the seas learn your name.

This is a world built for the long voyage — seasonal, competitive, and shaped by the players who live in it. No two legends are written the same way. The tide is open; the rest is up to you.

title: Wind Fantasy Double Cross
description:
Wind Fantasy is a tactical role-playing game series developed by Hongyu Technology Business Co., Ltd. from Taiwan. The first installment, Wind Fantasy: Magic War, was released in 1999. The series comprises three main story arcs: the Philisdo Chapter, the Red and Blue Chapter, and the standalone chapter Wind Fantasy Special Purpose. The Philisdo Chapter spans the first four main games, narrating the entanglement between the Goddess of Order, Raksis, and the Underworld King. The Red and Blue Chapter, presented through the fifth and sixth main games as well as Wind Fantasy XX, depicts the conflict between humans and natural forces within the Green Star Civilization. The entire series was launched on the Steam Platform in August 2022.

The games utilize the RAP Combat System and a chapter-based narrative structure, featuring the Badge Class Change System, the Monster Raising and Synthesis System, and the Bond Dialogue System. The Philisdo Chapter concluded with Wind Fantasy IV: The End of the Holy War. Spin-off works of the series include the online game Adventure Generation Online. As of 2009, the main series and side stories have produced a total of eight main titles and two side stories.

title: Lost Deltarune
description: Lost Deltarune is a fan-made RPG based on the world of DELTARUNE. Set in an alternate Dark World, the game features turn-based bullet-hell combat, puzzle-solving, custom chiptune soundtracks, and an original narrative centered on player choice and control.

title: Ultimate Guess Game
description: Ultimate Guess Game is a thrilling digital social game. Challenge a friend and race to identify the mystery image you are holding using strategic "Yes/No" questions. With diverse categories to choose from, use your deduction skills to win! Can you solve the puzzle before your opponent does?

title: 101 Dogs Hidden in Rome
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 dogs in Rome in the hand-crafted landscape. Earn tons of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

title: Cave of Treats
description: Live a spooky Halloween night as a skeleton dressed up as a mummy! Play a haunted old arcade game that, on Halloween night, can bring monsters out of the TV. Fight off waves of monsters trying to escape the game to steal all your candy!

title: Rock, Paper, Scissors, Shoot!
description: A hand-drawn roguelite duel where rock-paper-scissors becomes a streak-based gamble. Win money, buy upgrades, face bizarre opponents, and unlock SHOOT when luck turns ugly.

title: Cult of the Lamb: The One Who Waits
description:
The Cult of the Lamb: The One Who Waits bundle brings together the base game and multiple packs that expand your cult-building adventure. As a possessed lamb, you gather resources, build your flock’s home, hold dark rituals, and spread sermons while exploring a sprawling, procedurally generated world.
Includes the base game, Cultist Pack, Heretic Pack, Sinful Pack, Pilgrim Pack, and Woolhaven DLC.

title: Definitely Not a Cult
description: Build your “totally normal” community, upgrade your base, gather weird resources, recruit suspiciously calm members, and pretend the red flags are just decorative. Manage the chaos, unlock content, earn achievements, and do not ask why everyone keeps talking about pyramids.

title: Wizard Soup
description: The first collaborative project from Machine Wizards Interactive, explore our soup, explore your feelings, and vibe to your hearts content.

title: Crop and Claw 2
description: Crop and Claw 2 is an adventure-JRPG in a world of dragons featuring turn-based combat, story and optional custom party members.

title: Super Smash Bros. Crusade Remix
description: Super Smash Bros. Crusade Remix is the strange child of Crusade and CMC+ put into one package - retaining the fundamentals, fun and style of Crusade (Albiet, with their old-school philosophies), and the content and customisability of CMC+. The intent was to sort of run with an old-school vison of what the game would look like with lessened pressure, and a stronger focus on shaking things up rather than replicating Ultimate and seeing what sticks.

title: The Game That Takes Place on a Cruise Ship
description:
The Game That Takes Place on a Cruise Ship is a 2D point-and-click cartoon adventure game. The player controls Gertrude Zzyrgenhymer, a young, unemployed, blue-haired woman. The game starts when she wins a trip aboard the S.S. Asylum, a modern cruise ship.

During the game, the player explores the ship, meets all kinds of different characters and gets into various situations, depending on his previous choices. The game contains 4 branching story paths, leading to 4 different endings.

title: EA Sports FC 27
description: Welcome to The World’s Game in EA Sports FC 27. Step into The Grounds to experience a football playground where the streets meet the stadium, and feel greater control in every mode as community-driven innovations deliver more true-to-football gameplay.

title: NBA 2K27
description: The hustle doesn’t stop and the run never ends in NBA 2K27. Chase greatness around the clock in MyCAREER, MyTEAM, and MyNBA, and make your hoop dreams a reality.

title: The Final Ascent
description: Build your deck, equip your gear, and begin your climb. The Final Ascent is a build-first roguelike deckbuilder where every run expands your collection, sharpens your strategy, and pushes you higher on the global leaderboards.

title: Āsh
description: A short virtual museum exhibit. Explore the environments for as long as you'd like. When you are ready to move on, find and interact with the object of interest located somewhere in the room.

title: The First Descendant: Season 4
description:
A hundred years of waiting comes to an end.

In the name of Qliphoth, Karel declares war upon the Descendants.
Prepare yourselves for the ultimate battle.

title: Piggy Only Up
description: Support up to 8 pigs online with fun adventures. Climb the peak together, defy setbacks, showing your skills and perseverance. Cooperation or competition is up to you. "Piggy Only Up" is full of challenges and joys, waiting for you to join.

title: The Internship
description: Welcome to CorpCorp Incorporated. Complete your work, monitor your coworkers, and survive your internship in a surreal office horror game where something is deeply wrong beneath the surface.

title: K-Pop Rising: Dream to Shine
description: Make your dream come true and become a K-Pop Star in this exciting life sim and rhythm game! Dance and sing your way through the competition and rise to glory. Customise your character to your image, it is your time to shine!

title: Aster League: 2179
description: Aster League: 2179 is a kart racing spinoff to the small vehicles content of BallisticNG. Boost is king, and piloting in a straight line is a sure-fire way to lose the race.

title: SpaceCiv
description:
SpaceCiv is a persistent, browser-based multiplayer 4X strategy game about colonizing space — one that you can play at your own pace, even while you're away. You start small: a lone colony on a single world, an economy to balance, a first ship to build. From there you explore your home system, reach for other stars, and grow an empire that expands until it collides with the domains of real players around you.
Six playable races each bring a distinct identity — from the balanced, diplomatic Terrans to the swift raiding Felari, the hive-like Brood, and the exotic Voidborn — with fleets you design and fit to your strategy. The galaxy itself is shared and ever-growing, expanding as new players arrive, with an endless frontier to explore and a contested heartland worth holding.
Play it calm or play it cutthroat. Build a beautiful, humming empire, cooperate in alliances, or fight for dominance across seasonal ages that each end in a galaxy-shaping reckoning — and whose greatest deeds are recorded in a chronicle that outlasts them. However you play, your empire keeps living while you're offline, and the story you leave behind endures.

title: NocturneRecomp
description: Static recompilation of Castlevania: Symphony of the Night (Xbox Live Arcade) for Windows and Linux.

title: The Crew: Motorfest - Season 8
description: Season 8 of The Crew Motorfest brings two new Playlists, a lineup of 21 new vehicles, Ranked Grand Races, new partnerships, and much, much more

title: My Merry May with be
description: A sci-fi romance visual novel collection containing the complete My Merry May series in Full HD. Includes My Merry May, My Merry Maybe, and the additional scenarios Beginning, Metempsychosis, and Epilogue.

title: Elderborn: Vengeance
description:
ELDERBORN: VENGEANCE brings brutal first-person melee combat into the age of blood, iron, and ancient gods - heavier in impact, faster in motion, and more responsive than before. Unleash the new hook to close the distance, lure them to the edge, and kick their pathetic forms into the pit. Dodge incoming blows and answer with powerful counters, break their guard with heavy slashes, or outflank enemies, climb above them, and come down with a crushing aerial assault.

Every fight is a trial of timing, force, and position - close the distance, change the angle, exploit the opening, and turn the battlefield into a slaughter pit of your own making.

title: Corrupt.exe
description: Corrupt.exe is a neon roguelite where you play the malware. Swarm-survival action with evolving weapons, a 225-combo fusion system, and an adaptive antivirus that profiles your movement, learns your habits, and hunts you smarter every run. Infect. Evolve. Extract — or go endless.

title: Company of Heroes 3: Final Stand
description: Company of Heroes 3: Final Stand delivers a standalone roguelite wave-defense experience for solo and cooperative play. Command and survive against fast-paced escalating enemy waves, intimidating bosses, and dynamic battlefield events. Are you ready to make your final stand?

title: Unknown Horizon
description: Retro styled, top-down, space exploration adventure where you will meet new alien races, learn their secrets and build their trust to get their help to find a way home.

title: Mischief House
description:
One housemate is playing both sides. The Menace gets chores too, but only as cover. Their real job is wrecking yours: snatching items out of your hands, jamming doors shut, cutting the lights, then drifting back to the dishes like nothing happened. After each round the whole house votes in secret on who they think it is, and nobody sees the results until the match is over.

The twist is that sabotage covers the Menace's tracks. Every job they pull off quietly wipes suspicion off their name, so a sloppy Menace gets caught while a careful one walks free. If the votes still stick, the hardest-working housemate wins. If they don't, you all just lost to someone who spent three rounds doing the washing up.

title: Desktop Pinforge
description: A cyberpunk idle pinball game that lives on your desktop. Smash blocks, automate your build, upgrade your Reactor and Launcher, and let your neon machine print profit while you work or play.

title: Goblin Attack
description: Shoot goblins, grow your army, and maintain your speed with every tap. Play in full screen or let the game run silently at the bottom of the screen while you do other things.

title: Mad Merchant
description: Build, arm, and command a merchant train across a hostile wasteland. Choose your routes, trade for profit, upgrade your wagons, and survive deadly ambushes on the rails.

title: Honkai: Star Rail - In Ravages Does the Whistle Sound
description:
Version 4.4 of Honkai: Star Rail, which includes:
• New characters: Himeko • Nova, Rin Tohsaka, and Gilgamesh
• New Trailblaze Mission: "In Ravages Does the Whistle Sound"
• Updated collaboration with Fate/stay night
• New events
• ...and more!

title: Vespera
description: Vespera is a dark fantasy idle RPG. Fight hundreds of enemies, craft gear, build your character with talents, gems and elements, recruit mercenaries that fight with you, and take on world bosses with other players! Full offline progression. No microtransactions, you buy the game, you own the game.

title: Rise of the Nindroids
description:
Rise of the Nindroids is an online game on the Cartoon Network website.
