Take control of each of the 5 ninja as you traverse across the 4 worlds on your quest to stop the Nindroids.

title: The Crew: Motorfest - Year 3 Pass
description:
The Year 3 Pass includes:

- A total of 20 new vehicles via monthly drops*, including 2 exclusive vehicles on Day 1: the Ferrari 12Cilindri (2025) and Zenvo Aurora Agil (2026).

- 1 bonus vehicle exclusively for Year 1 Pass or Year 2 Pass owners: the majestic Cadillac Ciel concept.

*2 exclusives vehicles available at purchase + 6 vehicles dropped every season through Year 3 starting with 2 at the start of Season 8

title: Anno 117: Pax Romana - Year 1 Pass
description:
Expand your Roman Empire to new provinces with the Anno 117: Pax Romana Year 1 Pass!
This Year 1 Pass contains 3 DLCs:

• Prophecies of Ash (April 2026)
• The Hippodrome (August 2026)
• Dawn of the Delta (November 2026)
AND 5 additional immediately available cosmetics:
• 3 unique sigils
• The Pool of Tranquility (ornament)
• The Golden Flagship skin

title: Velocity: The Race Begins
description:
Velocity: The Race Begins is an exciting 300,000-word interactive racing novel by Matt Ryland, where your choices control the story. It's entirely text-based—without graphics or sound effects—and fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination.

Choose the type of person you will become. Will you fight all for yourself? Or will you stand by family? Rise through an underground scene ruled by ruthless gangs, organized mafias, crooked cops, and other racers who think they own the streets.

title: TeaKnights
description: TeaKnights is a Y2K-inspired musical rail shooter set across seven tea-powered biodomes. As apprentice Camellia Jetsworth, blast enemies with TeaSetter REGALIAS, build chain combos to drive the dynamic soundtrack, face bosses, aid fellow knights, explore the overworld, and customize your look.

title: Guild Soup
description: Created for SOUPJAM2026, Guild Soup is the joined effort of several Moth Guild members. Deeply inspired by the original SOUP as well as SOUP ROOMS and many other SOUP-likes, we got together to have fun and create some cool spaces in the process.

title: PlazaSoup
description: PLAZASOUP is an eclectic exploration game with ~399̴9̶9̸9̸9̴ rooms created by a handful of friends. A SOUP-like for SOUPJAM2026.

title: Jawed
description: Jawed is a psychological horror game where you play as Adam, a man muzzled by a life of silent torture since the disappearance of his fiancée. Presented with evidence that she may be alive, Adam must confront their strained relationship and face the only thing that can truly set him free: the truth.

title: Dream Tape LLC
description: You're a dream researcher who received a pile of tapes in a lab. The lab you work at records people's dreams. Your goal is to observe the areas within the recordings. The pay is low, but this is groundbreaking technology in it's earliest state.

title: The Crew: Motorfest - Season 9
description: Season 9 of The Crew Motorfest adds two new playlists (NASCAR on March 4, 2026, and RC Frenzy on May 6, 2026), a new Hawaii playground island (Kaho’Olawe), and a new TrackForge feature on Moloka’i and Lanai for designing custom tracks. The season also includes 18 new vehicles, plus new NASCAR content with pit stop management, drafting, and a roster of events and challenges including prototype and rival rewards.

title: Bossleft
description: BOSSLEFT is an open-world voxel adventure that embraces the charm of classic gaming. Collect powerful weapons, battle alien invaders, and take on unique boss battles.

title: The Crew: Motorfest - Season 10
description: Season 10 of The Crew Motorfest adds “The Motorfest Late Show” (a new playlist with monthly themes and 12 main events), new TrackForge Kit additions for Kaho’Olawe (“Street and Touge” plus Drift Trial/Drift Path with new drift kits and modules), and a new one-hour “Hawaii Grand Tour” time-attack. It also introduces new open-world stories starting August 5, beginning with Kai’s Garage and Project 356 (Porsche 356 reward), plus new radiant/elite bundles and upcoming collaborations.

title: Anhedonia: Sanctuary of Ash
description: Dive into a world consumed by the biblical apocalypse. As a fallen priest seeking redemption, battle demonic horrors, cleanse the tormented, and gather what remains to rebuild the Sanctuary of Ash - the faint light in a dying world.

title: Cicadia
description: A indie first person shooter roguelike featuring class based items, stats, and resource management mechanics around Bile.

title: Last Epoch: Shattered Omens
description: Step into Omen Windows and confront the entities born from the Observer’s madness. Embrace the power of Corruption to transform your gear into powerful new items and reshape your build with Idol Altars which change the shape of your idol inventory. Wield two new Rogue skills as you push deeper into the monolith and discover new Echo Chains. Experience new quality of life updates… and more!

title: Hunter: The Reckoning - Day for Night
description: These monsters aren’t just in the movies! Will you hunt the vampires, werewolves and others stalking Hollywood, or will you become a monster instead? An interactive, text-based game set in the World of Darkness shared story universe.

title: God of Chaos
description: Defy nature’s laws and avenge your slain pantheon! Humanity once feared and hated you, but now, awakened from a thousand-year slumber, you are their only hope. A text-based interactive game.

title: The Legend of Fireball
description: Unleash your fireball power and destroy your way to legendary mastery!

title: Where's Our Ouis?
description:
An entry for the 2026 itemLabel "Friends of Peepy" Art Contest.
This game follows itemLabel's own Professor Item and Assistant Label as they navigate the Juldarian Jungle, keen to solve the mystery of the missing Ouioui crisis.

title: Mortu
description: A psychological horror game about Tom, a man consumed by guilt and the traumatic events that defined his life. Unable to move on from his past, he finds himself trapped in an increasingly disturbing nightmare.

title: King in the Mountain
description: A calm strategic incremental mining game where you rebuild your Mountain Hall between expeditions. Plan each descent, choose where your dwarves dig, gather gold and rare artifacts, and return home when the torch burns out. Upgrade your crew, dig deeper, and bring your fallen kingdom back to life

title: Honkai Impact 3rd: Lives Flourish Where Feathers Fall
description:
Version 8.9 of Honkai Impact 3rd, which includes
• New Part 2 Story Chapter XIII: A Rose in a Curtsy
• New S Rank Valkyrie: Wings of Panacea (Seele)
• New Featured Event: Maximum Speed: Delivery Dash
• ...and more!

title: Fu-Fu-Chan: Way Up!
description: Blow into the microphone and breathe life into your climb. As simple as a breath. As deep as the sky.

title: Huntsman Against Darkness
description: A dark roguelite action experience where you fight through endless hordes of corrupted creatures, free your family and rebuild the village. Survive brutal arena battles, unlock powerful upgrades, defeat massive bosses, and rebuild a fallen medieval village one run at a time.

title: Ring Toss Legend
description: Ring Toss Legend is a casual physics game where you toss rings onto prize pegs, earn coins, upgrade your skills, and chase bigger rewards as you explore new stages.

title: The Tolerance Group
description: You are an operator of The Tolerance Group, monitoring surveillance cameras in various locations, where reality has begun to break its tolerance. Identify these continuity failures and promptly report them before the world is overwhelmed by horror.

title: Chessamphetamine
description: A lightning-fast roguelike deckbuilding auto-battler. Puts the Chess back in "auto chess".

title: Paironix
description: A fast-paced, rogue-lite tile-matching adventure! Connect identical pairs to unleash powerful magic spells, adapt to shifting grids, and draft game-changing upgrades. Can you survive the ever-evolving trials in this striking minimalist vector world?

title: Floppy Dick
description:
Floppy Dick is an arcade game inspired by classic side-scrolling reflex challenges.
Your goal is simple: survive as long as possible while navigating increasingly difficult obstacles.

What starts as a silly and absurd concept quickly turns into a demanding test of timing, focus, and precision.

title: Dimensions 2
description:
DIMENSIONS 2 is the culmination of years of development by a single creator: the definitive conclusion of a story that has evolved across multiple dimensions.

As a direct sequel, it continues the narrative… and also brings together DIMENSIONS and DIMENSIONS: The Catalyst, now fully integrated and remastered into a single experience.

The entire journey has been rebuilt and elevated: new mechanics, visual improvements, and a redesigned progression system that redefines how each dimension is experienced.

DIMENSIONS is an experimental saga where each universe breaks the rules: mechanics change, visual styles evolve, and every dimension feels like a different game within a unified vision.

More than a sequel, DIMENSIONS 2 is the definitive edition of the entire saga.

title: Duco
description: Duco is a card-based survival roguelike set in a post-apocalyptic world. Draw from location-based decks to gather resources, loot, craft, build, and survive. Unlock new characters and maps, combine them with traits to create unique runs.

title: Ganbaru Kimi to no Futari Gurashi: Iede Gal Icha Love Seikatsu SLG
description:
Overworked with overtime every single day, only coming home to sleep.
The protagonist, who feels no hope in his daily life, begins living together with a runaway gal named "Kaede."
In exchange for letting her stay, the promise she proposed was "to cheer up the old man."
Through her devoted support, he gradually regains his energy.

title: Uptime: A Cloud Provider Sim
description:
You build it with your hands.

Uptime drops you onto the floor of your own cloud provider, first person. Buy the servers, carry them to the rack, seat them with a satisfying click. Run the cable yourself: pull it off the spool, find the port, watch it lay across the floor with real sag. Power on. Sign your first customer.

Underneath all of it is a real simulation. Every server, switch, cable and port is a live entity in a deterministic engine, not set dressing, not a bar filling up. When something breaks, it breaks because the model says it should.

title: For Honor: Juren - Hero
description:
Embody the chaotic nature of our new Wu Lin hero, Juren. Victory comes at any cost – betrayal is always an option. Relentless in the storm of war, Juren will pursue his own goals above all else. Wielding a Fang Tian Hua Ji halberd, Juren's arsenal of attacks is overwhelming and unpredictable.
Includes:
1 New Hero: Juren
1 Ornament
1 Elite Outfit
7-Day Champion Status (extra XP, extra loot, and more)
3 Scavenger Crates with random gear

title: Living with My Bratty Neighbor
description: In this light simulation, spend 30 days with Rin, your next-door neighbor who drops by every day, shaking up your quiet life. Whether you work, chat, or play games together, balance your time wisely as every choice matters. Will you win her trust or let this bratty girl have her way instead?

title: Route
description: Route is a co-op survival game about driving a school bus across a zombie-infested world locked in endless night. Loot, craft, and upgrade your bus with a crew of four, and unlock new zones, each one its own challenge. Find out where the Route leads, if you make it that far.

title: Tomb Raider: Lost and Found
description: Lost and Found expands the lore behind one of Lara’s first adventures. Find documents all throughout the game to learn more about Lara’s backstory, as well as the history behind the Lost City of Iram.

title: Maze Survivor
description: Maze Survivor is a survival game set in a procedural maze teeming with monsters. Explore, gather resources, craft items, and upgrade your attributes to escape alive.

title: The Abyss Below
description: The year is 1997. Pilot a small submersible into the depths of the Pacific to investigate a massive sonar anomaly. Navigate by instruments, scan targets, and uncover something far older than it should be.

title: When Will I Get Home?
description: Indie anomaly-detection game set in a bleak Eastern-European stairwell. 11 floors, 40+ anomalies, minimal horror, maximal tension.

title: I Know a Spot
description:
I Know a Spot is a cozy sandbox building game about creating peaceful campsites in beautiful natural locations. Customize your car, explore forests, lakes, mountains, and seasonal landscapes, then build the perfect place to relax with your loyal dog.

There are no objectives, timers, or pressure—just creative freedom. Decorate your campsite with tents, lanterns, furniture, and cozy props, personalize your vehicle, and enjoy calm moments surrounded by nature at your own pace.

title: Kluber's Adventure
description: Kluber's Adventure. Finally, your choices matter... Unless Kluber has better plans. Welcome to an absurdist narrative experience.

title: Noun Town: Learn & Chill
description: Learn 500+ words across 12 languages (including Japanese + Spanish). Test your vocabulary to earn credits, unlock relaxing lofi tracks, and customize your study space. Put your progress on autopilot and watch your vocabulary grow while you chill.

title: Cats in the Shell
description: Provoke explosive chain reactions and experiment ever-evolving combat strategies in this mech-building roguelike auto battler. Mix and match components and mech modules to discover powerful synergies, then watch each creation spring to life in satisfying combat sequences.

title: Visite virtuelle de l'Assemblée nationale
description: Visit the French National Assembly from home, using your computer, your Steam Deck, or your virtual reality headset.

title: Sea of Thieves: Fights & Festivals - Season 19
description: With three new Acts to explore, a collection of corresponding Deeds, new Events and overhauled Faction Battles, plus some choice cosmetics unlocked by earning Renown, there are plenty of rewards up for grabs in Season 19!

title: Don't Pick Up Stray Aliens
description:
Another day has gone by. Too much paperwork, too little energy... and on the way home you see a tall blond guy bowing to a vending machine like it just committed an unforgivable damage to it.

He claims he's an alien who crashed here months ago. Tried many forms to survive: streetlight, cat, mailbox... But he says the human body is the easiest to handle.

With a notebook in hand, his eyes gleaming like a puppy's, he asks you: "please teach me how to be human".

How can you not bring him home?

title: Susanoo: Typing Action
description: A soulslike-typing game where you defeat enemies through typing and parry their attacks with precise timing.

title: Remothered: Broken Porcelain Remastered
description: The second chapter of the iconic modern old school survival horror saga. Remastered in Unreal Engine 5 to deliver a dramatically improved experience, while keeping every mechanic, every scare, and every secret exactly as they were.

title: Remothered: Tormented Fathers Remastered
description: The first chapter of the modern old school survival horror saga, rebuilt in Unreal Engine 5. Same ruthless tension, sharper everything.

title: Forza Horizon 6 1998 Nissan Skyline Gt-r 40th Anniversary
description: Forza Horizon 6 1998 Nissan Skyline GT-R 40th Anniversary

title: Ice Cream Man
description: ICE CREAM MAN is a first person PSX-style horror game. After a late-night gaming session, your walk home turns into a nightmare. Navigate unfamiliar backyards, jump fences and hide in the shadows to escape a murderous Ice Cream Man. Can you make it home alive? Or do you have a rocky road ahead?

title: MegaManX6Recomp
description: MegaManX6Recomp is a native PC port.

title: Caleria
description:
Caleria is a 2D top-down open-world medieval RPG focused on exploration, discovery, and player-driven adventure. Set within the mysterious Grimward Kingdom, players can explore diverse regions, interact with unique characters, complete quests, uncover hidden secrets, and face dangerous creatures.

Key features include open-world exploration, multiple character roles, quest and trading systems, survival mechanics, combat, and a world filled with hidden discoveries.

title: Cosmic Mart
description: Step into Cosmic Mart, the space supermarket where the deal of the day is certain death. Wipe out the relentless alien infestation devouring the facility in this frantic action roguelike. Choose your mercenary and survive long enough to reach the sixth floor.

title: Krimson Patrol
description: Join the Krimson Patrol and blast your way through mutants and demons in this simple shoot`em up game. No real challenge, just hold the trigger and run ahead! 3 story episodes and new playable characters that unlock while you progress through the campaign.

title: Nordic Ashes: Survivors of Ragnarok - Twilight of Yggdrasil
description:
The events in Nordic Ashes: Twilight of Yggdrasil take place after you conquer the 9 Realms.

It is your mission to face new challenges, new enemies, and defeat the terror of the gods: Fenrir, son of Loki and slayer of Odin during Ragnarok.

Three new realms have been discovered so you can explore new areas and show your opponents your real power.

This DLC includes the following features:
3 New Realms with new enemies, mechanics and outstanding bosses.
2 New EPIC Characters + skins.
3 Themed Skins, each one for a different survivor and related to each of the new realms.
New Relics, to create new synergies and broken builds.
Original Soundtrack by Rubén Melià.

title: EA Sports College Football 27: Deluxe Edition
description:
Includes:

3 Day Early Access
Exclusive Early Access Solo Challenges
83 OVR BND Countdown Player Item (Choice of 1 of 5)
81 OVR BND Cover Athlete Player Item (Choice of 1 of 3)
100 Dynasty Coach Points
250 Road to Glory Skill Points

title: Clara Wraiths 2
description: Clara Wraiths 2 is a 2D top-down survival horror game based on the story of a psychic, called Clara, who investigates the various haunted locations in the US in order to help out the spirits to move on or find peace.

title: Rock Band Simulator
description: A first-person rock band life sim where you explore a gritty 1990s neighbourhood, play rhythm-based concerts, get into fights, make bad decisions, and somehow keep your band together.

title: Pact of the Black Tide
description: A narrative point-and-click adventure game blending puzzles and wit. Explore, interact with a cast of colorful characters, combine items, and manipulate reality through an integrated magic system. Humor, adventure, and discovery await to bring you into new and unexpected worlds.

title: Desert Walk
description: A 10 minute Mood Piece trying to capture the feeling of being lost in the Nevada desert at night.

title: Fleck & Grus
description: Help Grus escort his friend Fleck safely back to his hometown in this fast-paced precision platformer. Navigate tight levels packed with tricky jumps, bouncing mechanics, and deadly hazards. Stay sharp, react quickly, and master each challenge to survive the journey.

title: Sleep Demon
description: Ever wondered what it is like to experience Sleep Paralysis? A Single player Phycological Horror Walking Simulator exploring the horrors of Sleep Paralysis, Lucid dreaming and Liminal Spaces, all based on my own personal experiences.

title: Smiling Mascots
description: Smiling Mascots is the leading company in creating cheerful and unforgettable mascots. Take control of Sofia as she investigates the mysterious disappearance of the company's founder and discovers that some smiles are far more disturbing than they appear.

title: PlantUp
description: Grow plants, process your harvest, and serve impatient customers before chaos takes over your shop. PlantUp blends cozy farming with fast-paced time management, clever upgrades, and a campaign full of challenges.

title: 18 Levels of Hells
description: 18 Levels of Hells is a time-survival, featuring bullet-hell & roguelite elements, folklore horror & 2D pixel-art, support up to 8 multiplayer online co-op. Players kill monsters, upgrade, unlock new weapon. Boss fights feature challenging rhythm-synchronized patterns.

title: Ready or Not: The Deadline is Coming!
description: Join Shiiba Masashi on an unexpected journey from fan to creator when his sister's eroge company faces an "emergency"! With childhood friend Miku by his side, they dive into game development, unraveling secrets, love, and their true creative passions along the way!!

title: Penguin Lifter
description: Penguin Lifter is a game where you work as a penguin lifter. You'll work outdoors, far from civilization, surrounded by cute creatures - penguins. It's just you, the snow, and the penguins...

title: Lunyatic Invaders
description: What is that... a cat!? A mysterious enemy has invaded from outer space. Break through a storm of bullets in your super fighter in this unique full-scale shooting game.

title: Vectron
description:
Vectron is rythmic electronic synesthesia experience.

Everything in Vectron is made with sound. The visuals in this game are a representation of the sound and is based on the simulation of an XY Oscilloscope.

title: Identity V: Ashes of Memory Episode II
description: The second half of Ashes of Memory.

title: Family Secrets 1: Empty Plate
description: This game tells the story of Miko and his younger sibling, Jun. One day, Miko receives a phone call from his mother, informing him that she will be away for work for a few days. Miko is left with the responsibility of taking care of Jun on his own. However...

title: Horizonite
description: Explore vibrant islands, gather resources, and manage your own resort in this charming 2.5D pixel art adventure. Combine laid-back island life with strategic turn-based combat as you unlock new areas, meet quirky characters, and build the ultimate getaway.

title: Affictionate
description: After a year of bad dates and failed job applications, you've nearly given up on the love story you've always written about. One night, you write your perfect man into a notebook... the next day, he becomes a reality. A romance visual novel about identity and the line between fiction and reality.

title: Independence Day: Festive Finds
description: Independence Day Festive Finds is a patriotic spot the difference game that transforms lively 4th of July celebrations into a fun and satisfying test of observation.

title: Final Generation
description: In Final Generation, a 2.5D sci-fi horror action roguelike, embark on an ever-changing journey that will reveal the fate of the past and the horrors of the future to those strong enough to survive.

title: Odin's Chess
description: A clash of gods played over sixty four squares. Three rule sets share one board: a classical match of kings, a variant where you raise your host from a hand of cards, and a roguelike where every kill reshapes the killer.

title: Ashes of Alice
description: Do not stray off the path. Ashes of Alice is an atmospheric, PSX-style narrative survival game where the world has already ended. Follow a fading blood trail through a desolate, ash-choked landscape, piecing together the final moments of humanity before your vision goes dark for good.

title: Bunny Flags
description: Sarge is BACK! Infiltrate enemy bases, plant Bunny flags and hunt down Racabat in this Tactical Roguelite Top-Down Shooter. Choose your loadout, adapt your strategy and reclaim what was taken. Are you ready to deploy?

title: Swarm of the Sea
description: You are a humble lighthouse keeper, working alone on a remote island. Being isolated for months on end really gnaws at your sanity. All those uncanny shadow figures and ghastly noises must be figments of your mind, right? Follow the signs on your path, find meaning in the madness and Save Our Souls.

title: Alice's Night at the Mansion
description: Three eccentric ghosts have kidnapped Alice's dog, Dinah! Help Alice free her dog, solve the mysteries of Monster Mansion, and make the annual Monster Party a success in this hand-drawn, point-and-click-inspired comedy adventure!

title: Dead Stadium: The Extinction Protocol
description: Dead Stadium: The Extinction Protocol is a single-player third-person zombie arena shooter with wave survival, cash drops, bullet-time combat, and over 90 upgrades.

title: Purrvivors
description: The catapoclypse is upon us. Lead battle-hardened cats against endless swarms of vermin — auto-fire your weapons, scoop kibble between waves, and stack 32 weapons + 30 items into gloriously broken builds. Solo or 4-player local co-op. Survive… or meOWWW.

title: Football, Tactics & Glory: World Championship
description: Lead a national side, call up the country's best players, and win World and Continental titles! Also includes: player loans, automated transfer search, a third tournament tier, spectator mode, significantly improved club management AI, foreign player limits, extra difficulty options, and more.

title: Can Demons Be Good?
description: The story is about a demon, who after being forced to join a rehabilitation program for demons falls madly in love with an angel.

title: Pandemonium Line: Flipping on Borrowed Dime
description: An action roguelike deckbuilder with a twist: build your deck out of coins! Fight your way through this hellish train to the driver’s cabin, all while the eyes of a snarky demon are observing you. Although it is thrilled to decide your fate by mere coin flips, you were the one to take its job offer.

title: Cornerfall
description: A text-based idle RPG that lives in the corner of your desktop. Build your character, send them into cursed lands, and check back to find new loot, defeated bosses, and higher tiers unlocked. All without lifting a finger.

title: Miss Sasami is Losing Her Mind!
description: A light-hearted lesbian romance between a tired office lady and a gyaru foxgirl. Make choices as Sasami and pursue a relationship with the cheerful Mirai, or risk ruining it.

title: Chill Cat
description: Chill Cat is a cute and chaotic 3v3 multiplayer top-down shooter where adorable cats battle for turf with colorful paint blasters!

title: Phantom Tower
description: Hack-and-slash action RPG. Climb an ever-changing Tower, loot enemies, forge your own build, and grow stronger with every run

title: Idle Crown
description: Rise from serf to sovereign in this medieval idle RPG. Level fifteen skills, raise a Holding stone by stone, slay drakes and leviathans, command workers, and grind your way to the throne. 100 achievements, 39 leaderboards, no energy bars, no waiting.

title: Frog Climb
description: Free-To-Play Stop following someone else's route. Create your own way to the top by building your own path Frog Climb is a stylized co-op climbing adventure where you must escape from terrariums Level up, gain powerful upgrades, and prove that no wall is too high for a frog with a plan

title: Goose Evolution
description: A relaxed and casual tower defense battle between geese. 16 parallel spaces, 108 civilizations, and confrontations between different troops.

title: Frocat Puzzles
description: For Frocat Puzzles, Ukrainian artists and writers have collaborated to create a relaxing experience. Piece together uniquely divided images in order to discover new stories.

title: Curious Paws: Hidden Objects
description: Curious Paws: Hidden Objects is a short, cozy hidden object game where you explore vibrant, hand-drawn locations through the eyes of a curious cat. Search for objects that could catch his attention, and enjoy a lively environment, relaxing music, and an atmosphere of slow-paced exploration.

title: System_Reboot
description: Dive into the heart of a compromised mainframe in this psychological, meta-narrative bullet heaven. You are the Icarus Protocol, an advanced system cleaner tasked with purging catastrophic malware. But as the glitches intensify you'll soon realize that this is far more than just a simple simulation.

title: Twin Hotel, Spa, and More
description:
TWIN Hotel, Spa and More is a minimalist, point-and-click interactive experience.

You begin confined to an elevator cabin. Operate the lift and serve the hotel's guests using the control panel.

After serving enough guests, you can leave the elevator and move around using the joystick on your wheelchair.

Your next assignment is waiting in another elevator.

title: ItzVerse: The Last File
description: Inspired by the mechanics of classics like OneShot and Undertale, ItzVerse: The Last File is an interactive, meta-narrative experience that breaks the fourth wall. Taking on the role of Davs—the creator himself—the player is forced to investigate their real computer architecture through files appearing on their desktop and windows that minimize on their own, all with the ultimate goal of stopping an imminent system collapse and rescuing their original characters from being deleted forever.

title: A Night at Moka Efti: A Babylon Berlin Story
description: Are you ready for the session? Let yourself be hypnotized and dive into the dazzling world of Moka Efti, known from the series *Babylon Berlin*. As a journalist, you’ll follow the clues to a mysterious case at the famous nightclub. But can you trust your memories?

title: 3Souls
description: 3 Souls is an isometric open-world adventure set in a vast archipelago. Control three brothers with unique playstyles, explore forgotten ruins, and gather resources to build your base. Uncover the secrets of the Althmerium in a grand journey where your choices shape the fate of a shattered world.

title: Dice Mice
description: Dice Mice is an fast paced arcade puzzle game inspired by classic 90s gameplay. Score massive combos or better yet, steal them from your opponents. Choose a mouse and roll some dice.

title: Hotel 8
description: In Hotel 8, you find yourself caught in a loop. To break free, you must detect anomalies. Once you locate an anomaly, you have to decide which direction to take; making the wrong choice sends you right back to the beginning.

title: A Tiny Life
description: Anna must rely on little fairy creatures called Pluckies to help her get the parts of her super shrinking machine back before 30 days or else she will stay this small size forever.

title: Persuasion RPG
description:
A Text-Driven Victorian Roguelike Mystery: Step into the fog-drenched world of Persuasion, a haunting retro-inspired RPG where choices are dynamic, every shadow hides a secret and every whispered lie could be your last clue.

Victorian Gothic Atmosphere: Set in the eerie halls of a decaying Victorian estate, Persuasion draws you into a labyrinth of candlelit corridors, locked attics and crumbling cellars—each filled with cryptic objects, ritualistic clues and unspeakable horrors. Lovecraftian madness blends with British restraint in this masterclass of moody mystery.

title: Altar Corp
description: A solo rhythmic FPS in the abandoned city called Yerneth.

title: Spanking Exorcist
description: Explore a somewhat alluring apartment complex, avoiding evil spirits while exorcising the ghosts of housewives, in this slightly sexy comedy horror game!

title: Hunter: Red Star
Hunter: Brotherhood
description: November 15th, 1991. With the organization threatening to collapse around him, Bratva steward Iosif Pelevin must decide where his loyalty lies as the past comes back to haunt him.

title: Seedverse
description: Seedverse is a free-to-play Sandbox Platformer MMO with a protected, player-driven economy. Splice seeds to discover new items, trade your way to the top, display your wealth with rare accessories, and build a world you can show off to others!

title: Of Love and Violence
description: Custom Campaign of Hotline Miami 2 set in a modernized Gensokyo.

title: White House
description:
The day has finally come. The 50 Blessings Operatives are causing an uprising in the White House.
Play as the General as you kill your way to meet the President, to seal the fate of the country.

title: Monster Storm
description:
You are the bullet hell.

Fight back against an overwhelming storm of monsters in this 2D top-down multiplayer reverse bullet hell, where you unleash screen-filling chaos while struggling to survive ever-escalating enemy hordes.

Dive into procedurally generated levels, build absurdly powerful characters, and push your skills, talents, and weapons to their limits. Every run is different. Every mistake is deadly. Every victory feels earned.

Whether you’re flying solo or surviving together, the storm never stops coming.

title: Miniquest
description: A retro fantasy quest shrunk down to mini-size! Challenging turn-based combat meets the tight pacing of an arcade game in this minimalist RPG. Become the Chosen Ones and vanquish the Dark Lord, all in the span of a couple of hours. Then do it again, exploring branching paths and alternative endings. Then do it again! And again. And again... forever?

title: Tumble Type
description: A frantic word puzzle where letter tiles rise, the board falls, and golden keys must be rescued. Spell fast, trigger orb powers, chase combos, unlock achievements and earn high-scores.

title: Venture
description: Two astronauts awaken on an alien planet. With only minutes of oxygen left, they must work together to scale staggering cliffs, study strange lifeforms, and search for a way home in this atmospheric co-op survival adventure.

title: Motherheart
description: Based on the concept album "When They Both Went Under" by Renting Asteroids, an unexpected call pulls you into the private world of a secluded writing circle following a tragedy. In this first-person point and click detective RPG, play as Carmen Voss, trace through drafts, and survive surreal combat.

title: Twist-Tac-Toe
description: A roguelike deckbuilder played on arcane tic-tac-toe boards. Collect volatile spell components and cursed relics to defeat the faculty in a replayable solo campaign, or hex your friends in online PvP.

title: Harmonic Drive
description: Harmonic Drive is an arcade-style rhythm game built around player reactive background effects and AI generated music.

title: The Lost Apartment
description: 'The Lost Apartment' is a photo-realistic bodycam story horror game developed by SDevScares and published on itchio in 2025. The game has around 45-60+ minutes of playtime, featuring an intense horror experience inside an apartment.

title: Antivirus Girl
description: Antivirus Girl is a defense shooter game where you become an inspector for the anti-malware Sentinel to protect computers from malware. Inspect files coming in from the network, let safe files pass through, and immediately eliminate malware.

title: Escape from Umbra
description: Immerse yourself in a survival horror escape room experience. Trapped in a mysterious world of darkness where shadows lurk, your only help is a secret book and a flashlight. Solve the enigmas and move unseen to escape Umbra’s domain.

title: Snowlike
description:
Carve your way through avalanches of critters, as you upgrade your weapons & gear on the way down the mountain.

Part satisfying snowboarding simulation, part snowballing bullet heaven, and all dynamically interwoven with a full original soundtrack of wacky bass music.

title: Tailbreak
description: Dinosaurs return in this on-rails action shooter with a feral twist!

title: Universal Flight Simulator 3 PvP
description: The sky is no longer the limit - it's the battlefield.

title: Left Not Right
description: Control Lefty with your left hand, and Righty with your right. At the same time! Don't worry — it's a single-player game. No friends required. Use both hands to control two characters at once and escape the underground research facility!

title: Foo Is Missing
description: This is a 2D action game set in a cyberpunk world. Use the "rollback" ability, which allows you to teleport to a previous position, to solve stages packed with various challenges.

title: Project: Ojisan
description: This is a game about stacking middle-aged men. Play it when you want to clear your mind.

title: Super Magic Ball! Home Run Derby
description: Read the unpredictable breaking balls and hit a home run!!! You can create your own original breaking balls and compete against others in an online mode!!!

title: Garbage Growth
description: Garbage Growth is a short incremental trash game about collecting people's trash, bananas and even babies, to make money and pollute the world even more. Hire rats, grow your pollution, and make everything worse!

title: Kaiject
description: Land on giant kaiju, drill through their bodies, and destroy the monsters from within. Gather resources, upgrade your weapons, and reach their main organs to save the city.

title: Plodding Recovery
description: "Why did it come to this?" That's what the protagonist asks, his body and mind worn to the breaking point. From there begins a journey of rediscovering the self he had long neglected. A small action at a time, he plods forward — slowly, haltingly — toward recovery.

title: Scum's Errand
description: Raid cursed dungeons, claim powerful loot, and escape before it's too late. Scum's Errand is a top-down roguelite horde shooter with extraction mechanics where every run makes you stronger, but greed can cost you everything.

title: The Repair Man
description: The Repair Man is a Platformer Exploration game where you have to fix the kingdom of New York City. You control the Repair Man, one of the last remains of the Repair Men Association and you have to fix and clean the streets of YOUR city.

title: Armor of God
description: A 2D pixel-art platformer where you choose which armor to wear. Full armor makes you invincible - anyone can win. Leave some behind and the game becomes a very different challenge.

title: SCP: Permafrost
description: A top-down pixelated souls-like set in the SCP universe. Explore the ruined Foundation, face hostile SCPs, and defeat the eldritch horrors that await.

title: Orbital Physics Simulator
description: Master physics in this hardcore orbital simulator where Einstein’s theories come to life. Plot trajectories and manipulate spacetime via general relativity, time dilation, and length contraction. Command your starship, outrun time, and explore a universe governed by real physics.

title: Outta Space
description: Where is your cat flying right now? Outta Space is an idle game where a tiny cat explores the universe from your desktop corner. Every keystroke, every click fuels the spaceship. From the Moon, past the solar system, to distant stars. Come back and see how far your lovely cat has gone.

title: Hangin' Off!
description: Lean deep into corners, race against the clock, and battle rival riders in a retro-inspired arcade motorcycle racing experience where every corner asks you the same question: do you brake, or do you believe?

title: Youkai Dock de Karada no Fuan wo Kaishou shitai Kagiyama Hina-tachi!!
description:
This is a word puzzle simulation game where you can have fun by rewriting the diagnosis results by changing just one character, adding just one character, or deleting as many as you like from the given text.
Complete the diagnosis results for all four characters, led by the protagonist, Hina Kagiyama.
This game is a fan work based on the Touhou Project.

title: SCP: Short Story
description: SCP: Short Story is a first-person shooter set in a world where the K-class scenario destroyed almost every living form. You’ll have to get through this dead world, retrieve essential documents from Site-17, and most importantly - do not get killed by what survived.

title: The Duke is Dead
description: A detective game where you solve the death of Duke Damian and related conspiracies

title: Sending my Pet Rock To Heaven!
description:
Sending my Pet Rock to Heaven is a high skill ceiling platformer that is purposely meant to frustrate you. Your goal is to bounce your way all the way up to find out if Heaven is real or not.

Along the way, you must skip over puddles to refresh your bounces or else your pet rock will not make it to heaven.

title: Animal Chameleon
description: Animal Chameleon is a multiplayer hide and seek game where you paint your animal to match the surroundings, stay hidden, and outsmart the seekers

title: Sunward
description: Born in an underground civilisation, you dream of the surface—a mythical, unknown world deemed taboo. Pursue your ambitions inspired by ancient relics, and make your way through the various underground layers that stand between you and your dream.

title: After End
description:
After End is a Cooperative Action Exploration game featuring an intuitive, deep, and fast paced Fluid Directional Combat system and a vast Open World.

Across beautiful and terrifying realms discover your past and defeat your demons to unshackle your soul for the afterlife.

Choose between multiple character classes with unique skill trees and craft a fresh build with each play through!

title: Fungi Simulator
description:
Become a Fungi and spread your spores as much as you can.

Unlock different kinds of Fungi and express yourself.

Take over the world by spreading your spores globally.

A clicker game where you try and get as much spores as you can,
and unlock different types of mushrooms with increasing difficulty.

title: Painting PC
description: Think you've got what it takes to become a famous artist? Start with one brush and absolutely no followers. Take on commissions, gain fans, unlock new tools, and build your reputation one painting at a time. Will clients happily pay the full amount, or wonder what they've just spent their money on?

title: Above the Sun
description: Yugemaru, a self-proclaimed gal mechanic, sets out to reach the top of the Acid Tower using the power of steam. With the eerie acid closing in, climb the randomly generated platforms — climb, climb, CLIMB! ...Wait — did I just fall? LOL.

title: Debris Zone
description:
Debris Zone is a top-down multiplayer space shooter set in a galaxy of drifting wreckage, contested territory, and trigger-happy pilots. Jump through portals into a connected world of open maps, each packed with enemies, loot, and lurking bosses, then fight in fast, skill-based dogfights where managing your shields and hull is the difference between a clean kill and a trip back to the repair station.

Customize your ship with lasers, shields, engines, amors and drones, hunt for gear to push your build further, and take on towering boss encounters with serious rewards. Earn gems, gold, and experience as you complete quests, climb the ranks, and unlock prestige titles to flaunt above your ship - all in a persistent online galaxy where every other pilot is a potential ally or you next target.

Suit up, pilot. The Debris Zone is waiting.

title: A Halloween Afternoon
description:
A very short game about working in a witch's kitchen...
The game is a part of Trick & Treat's 7 year anniversary celebration.

title: Scribble Hunt
description: Paint the bunny man and blend into the scene like a chameleon! 2–10 player online hide-and-seek. Sample colors, match the lighting, tune your materials — disguise yourself to perfection and slip away right under the Hunters' gaze.

title: Incyanspace
description: IncyanSpace follows the story of Li, an artificial human, who sets out to find his long-lost original human brother Yuan. Together with surviving New Humans, they stand against Xystem, a dominant force of mechanical lifeforms that controls the surface world.

title: Hyposolus
description: Hyposolus is an action role playing game with strategic elements. A long time has passed and the world is shattered. Experiment with different perks and spell combinations to defeat enemies. Explore the floating islands and discover the past. Reach the spirits calling for you.

title: Corrosiva
description: A doctor in search of a cure to a corrosive disease finds her forgotten childhood friend among the remains of a former city. Love and obsession meet underneath acid rain in this yuri visual novel.

title: Causality: Antopolia
description: Survive a collapsing totalitarian regime in this story-rich dystopian RPG. Explore a brutalist semi-open world, master tactical first-person combat, and make critical choices. Shape the fate of the country and your own.

title: Mecha Dress Up Game
description:
Build a giant robot with weapons, swords, armor, jetpacks, lasers, TV antennas, fancy hats, guitars, sharks, and much more.

It could be a walking tank with a dozen cannons and missile launchers, an industrial tunnel-boring machine, or a humble, music-loving helper robot.

All content is unlocked immediately—jump in and see where your imagination takes you.

title: The Kitten Game
description:
Slaughter NoLegs and his buddies in this whack-a-mole style game!
Warning: Contains animal cruelty! And loud noises! And causes hand injuries!

This game is played with a mouse, can be beaten in about 30 minutes, and has very frequent checkpoints.

You can also ignore the main game and play the dress-up mode instead.

title: Cat Cafe
description:
A swarm of adorable cats is thirsty, and you need to serve them quickly or go bankrupt!
Manage your own café in this chaotic matching game!

title: Three Weeks on the Atlantic
description: An engrossing visual novel set in the mid-19th century that blends historical fiction and fantasy. Take on the story of John Doe (A.Non), a young man who decides to leave his own country aboard the first ship he can find on a spur of the moment decision following a heated dispute with his father. Make decisions that shape John's life and help him grow, shaping a future in the New World from the uncertainty that he'd brought.

title: Ice Slider
description: Ice Slider is a game by Shining Watermelon Studios where you play as a hiker named Rob who enters Icy Cave. A cave with a Gauntlet of Ice Puzzles, in which he has to complete to exit. Play as Rob as he goes through this gauntlet of puzzles.

title: The Walking Dead: Streets of Survival
description: Fight walkers as Rick Grimes, Daryl Dixon and Michonne in a brutal arcade brawler set in the world of AMC’s The Walking Dead. Face ruthless enemies like the Saviors and overwhelming walker swarms as you unleash relentless combos, signature weapon attacks, and crushing finishers.

title: Gravity Grove
description: Gravity Grove is a 2D platformer set on the faces of a 3D cube. Walk over the edges to rotate the entire level, shifting gravity in your favor to open up new paths and uncover hidden secrets from the past.

title: Living on Plain Pasta
description: A conversation adventure where you spend the worst, best summer visiting your booze-loving senpai, making weird food, and sneaking out together at midnight.

title: My Fav Chill Streamer Dies a Million Times
description: From SCRAP, the masterminds behind the "Real Escape Game" phenomena with over 17 million attendees, comes a time-loop mystery adventure on Steam!

title: Problematic
description:
Problematic is a gothic party game where someone always goes too far.
Judge cursed answers, betray your friends, and battle in Problematic Chess, where strategy meets chaos.
Use power-ups, survive secret rules, and do whatever it takes to win. You will need every advantage you can get.

title: Don’t Pull Me!
description: Dont Pull Me is a physics-based co-op parkour game for 1 to 4 players. Tied together by a rope, you and your friends must climb, swing, carry objects, and survive chaotic ragdoll disasters without dragging the whole team down.

title: The Forgotten Nightmare Series
description: A classic-style text adventure game spanning three chapters. Enter verb/noun commands via keyboard, mouse, or game controller to explore, collect items, and solve puzzles in a post-apocalyptic, Christian-themed story. Features an auto-drawing map and hint system.

title: Meatballs
description: A fast, juicy bullet-hell roguelike where you're lunch fighting back. Pick from 11 meatballs, blast through 10 levels of waves and 5 outrageous bosses, and build a god-tier meatball from 30 weapons & 55 items — without stacking so much you literally fall apart.

title: War From Above
description: Pick your unit and then control all unit at once and win the war.

title: Cobra Strike
description: In Cobra Strike you pilot all sorts of gunships and helicopters with true retro-style inertia flight controls that will make you feel just awesome! The '90s call for your duty! Relive the Strike!

title: Europe Heatwave Simulator
description: It's 42°C. You have no air conditioning, because you live in Europe. You have a remote job, a useless fan on the way from GreedCo, and 14 days to survive in a Paris apartment that has become an oven. Good luck.

title: Clairvoyage: The Lighthouse
description:
You wake up on a stormy island at night to find the lighthouse dark. A ship is heading for the rocks. The previous lighthouse keeper is gone, leaving behind journals, notes, and the responsibility of the island to you.

But the night refuses to end. Mysterious beings have taken control of the island and time itself, forcing you to relive the the nightmare until you complete your mission.

Explore the island with only your lantern, uncover the truth behind the keeper’s disappearance, and restore the lighthouse before time runs out. Use physics-based interactions to carry objects, operate mechanisms, solve puzzles, and find a way to break the endless loop.

title: Trudge
description: A slow, minimalist psychological pixel experience about living the same empty routine in a silent city. Wake up. Work. Eat. Sleep. Beneath the depressing monotony and liminal surroundings, something slowly begins to break.

title: Progress98
description: A retro incremental idle desktop companion all about making progress on the side and at your own pace.

title: Goblin Solitaire
description: Relax with a cozy fantasy-themed Klondike solitaire experience. Customize card designs and backgrounds, unlock achievements, track statistics, and enjoy a charming goblin-inspired world while playing the classic card game you know and love.

title: Vampirium: 1997
description: 1997. Dracula is King of England. At his command, master your dark gifts to assassinate his enemies and secure his vampiric empire. Infiltrate locked-down locations, adapt and survive in living environments and uncover your own unique methods of executing missions.

title: Catanks
description: Catanks is a 3D game created by students from UPGRADE, reimagining nostalgic tank combat with decisive third-person cat-piloted gameplay.

title: Missy's Bugtastic Little Planet
description: Missy the kitty will hang out with you anywhere on your desktop and catch bugs! She will earn money based on the rarity of what she catches, and you can use that money to buy cosmetics and upgrades, or just see how much money she can make!

title: Train Graveyard Simulator
description: Dismantle massive trains piece by piece in Train Graveyard Simulator! Grab your hammer, fire up your torch, manage logistics with heavy machinery, sell valuable items, and turn this rusty train graveyard into a railway empire. There is no time to waste - you have a job to do!

title: The Laws of Probability
description: You have exactly 5. Bread is 4, the bus fare to school is 3. What do you give up? In this short narrative experience, you play as 13-year-old Adam. Confront an interface that reacts to a painful reality, and discover that freedom of choice is sometimes nothing but a privilege.

title: Pictures at an Exhibition
description: Aozora Haru, a troubled, recently orphaned art student, finds it hard to attach much meaning to many of the things in his life. Through the meaningful bonds he has created with the people close to him, however, he begins to understand that life is much more important than it initially seems.

title: Greedling: 2D Boss Rush
description: A silly-but-violent 2D boss rush where a laser-shooting eyeball battles deranged cartoon monsters in bullet-hell chaos. Time your special attacks, recover mid-fight, and survive gory slapstick deaths again and again.

title: Alis: World Reborn
description: Alis: World Reborn is an open-source survival game set in reconstructed real-world locations. It combines exploration, inventory and survival systems, interaction and dialogue with large-scale city environments generated from real geographic data.

title: The Lost Mixtape
description: Play as a raccoon with a cassette player, hunting for new tracks to dumpster dive to. Explore an abandoned mall and its surroundings to collect hidden cassettes. Dig through trash, uncover secret paths, and gather items. Experience this short adventure where someone's trash is a raccoon's treasure.

title: Foxy the First Steps
description: Foxy is a precision platformer focused on timing and control. Master the press jump, overcome 150 levels and perform crystal combos. Prove your skills, learn the story of this mysterious world, seek guardian's assistance and reach the path to the portal.

title: Evil Spirit Hunter
description: A fast-paced top-down action shooter set in dark dungeons. Fight off waves of evil spirits, gain temporary power-ups for instant advantages, and struggle to survive while under siege.

title: The Therapist Impostor
description: "Dr." Trigger, a man with no experience whatsoever, starts a therapy clinic. Will he cave under the pressure, or can he fake it till he makes it? Become the worst therapist ever (on purpose)! An interactive FMV comedy experience with dozens of choices, branching paths, and over 90 total endings!

title: Trauma Pets
description:
Batticuore. What was once nothing more than one of many european islands turned touristic attractions after their practical use faded over time, with plenty of history and untouched natural scenery... now has been rid of any life form by a mysterious curse. The only survivor? An eccentric fisherwoman that goes by the name of Martha Mahkklen.

Not only that! The waters surrounding Batticuore have been repopulated by a new race of creatures, the Trauma Pets! Bloodthirsty animals that have seemingly no other desire than to cause chaos and destruction, which is hardly worth concern for us humans since they're tiny acquatic creatures.

While scientists continue to research their bizarre biological makeup and behaviour, the common people have began to use them for sports in all sorts of competitions, both peaceful and violent. Now that's where you step in, not to stop this senseless abuse, but to be the very best at it.

title: Haruka Drive!
description:
Yuuya has a childhood friend named Haruka who is innately frail and has been hospitalized since she was young. Other than that, she was a normal girl who loved to write novels. Even though she has her way with him, he treasures her as a trusted friend.

One time, she told him not to visit her until she finished writing her book. He reluctantly agreed and was restless for the next week while looking forward to meeting her again. But one week later, he was welcomed by the sight of a fantasy world. Next to him was a girl who looked just like Haruka. What happened to him and what does the future hold?

title: Senpai, Suki Desu...... Osu!: Boku o Shitatte Kureru Kouhai wa Chibikko Bishoujo de...... Yankee!?
Tomodachi no Haha: Jukujuku Taru Omoi
Still Rolling
description: Still Rolling is an incremental idle game where you roll dice and try to get six sixes in a row. Upgrade your probability and various other things to improve your odds.

title: Sayonara, Space Rocks
description:
Sayonara, Space Rocks is a supercharged retro-modern homage to the classics that upends the experience with a bonus roulette system with each level.

You're a new Star Pilot recruit for the Earth Space Federation's (ESF) Sayonara, Space Rocks Program. You have been tasked with clearing the Egam-Oter Asteroid Belt of asteroids and a host of other unidentified anomalies by piloting a series of Class-A ESF drones supported by onboard clients of the HALICE hive computer.

The program features one or two player simultaneous expanded arcade action. With each level, the speed and your score multiplier increases, and you enter Bonus Time; a roulette system with thousands of combinations and over 50 unique gameplay perks and prizes. Over the course of a game, you'll face strange enemies and bosses, save humans, blast a lot of asteroids, and hopefully score a lot of points. In additions to the core game experience, you'll earn a slew of achievements, can visit "My Room" to customize your player card and view your rank and trophies, and sharpen your skills in the two-player Practice Mode.

As you progress, you can further customize your experience with unlockable player ship sprites, backgrounds, music, and asteroid color themes for thousands of combinations.

title: Idol Ura Eigyou: Kegasareta Stage Ishou
description: Struggling idol Amamiya Suzune is approached by her new male CEO with an offer of engaging in pillow business in exchange for success. Despite never considering such actions before, Suzune decides to go through with it in order to become a top idol and please her manager, Tsuji Yuusuke. However, the path to success is not easy, as she must contend with a popular rival idol Kitou Kirara and the problems that come with a newfound popularity.

title: Ai Yori Aoi Umi no Hate
Hearthstone: Escape from Violet Hold
description: They say no one escapes the Violet Hold. A group of Azeroth’s most infamous criminals is about to put that to the test. To break out of Dalaran’s maximum-security prison, these Rulebreakers will need to Prepare for any circumstance, use clever Disguises, and, when all else fails, Bribe the guards. The alarms are blaring. Magical defenses are activating. Warden Maiev is locking down the prison. In other words, everything is going exactly to plan. It’s time to make a daring Escape from Violet Hold!

title: Watch Yo Plane
description: Pilot a chaotic plane with a friend in this co-op rage adventure! Work together, survive brutal obstacles, conquer minigames, and see how far your teamwork can take you.

title: Fog'n'Silence
description: Lead a group of vagrants through the surreal open world of the afterlife. Observe their journey through the eyes of a drone operator. Hide from blind monsters. Avoid malicious fog. Embrace the cycle. Survive. Escape.

title: Endless Summer Syndrome
description: You ended the world. She, the one who holds every card, gave you an endless summer as your reward. Now your only way out is through sugar, jellyfish, sunlight, and blood — into the deepest reaches of her mind, or be dissolved along the way. Choose your path in this psycho-thriller visual novel.

title: Bliss Valley: After Dark
description: Welcome to the incredible downtown Bliss Valley! Explore the town and meet a variety of lovable characters you can date, romance, and seduce. Play your way in this NSFW furry visual novel RPG! This game contains explicit sexual content.

title: Kill The Sea
description: Sail your way to victory on a deadly campaign across the Seven Seas in a seafaring sandbox survivors-like. Hunt menacing beasts of legend, complete deliveries, win races, defend outposts, find treasures or gamble it all in an oceanic world driven by chaos, risk, and opportunity.

title: 3DMurderMystery TheAshenYou
description: "The Ashen you" is a 3D murder mystery for four players. Set in a French manor in the 18th century, a mysterious case of death by fire has occurred. Relive the suspects' memories, explore the manor to gather evidence, and work together to uncover the culprit through discussion.

title: BloodJack
description: BloodJack, a 2-4 player PvP blackjack battler where every player hides card, manipulates opponents, uses rule-breaking items, and bets the blood keeping them alive as the stakes rise.

title: Piano Trauma: Stress Deluxe
description: A co-op game about driving a piano to play a concert.

title: Down the Stairs: The Game
description: Down The Stairs: The Game is a physics-based ragdoll challenge where every clean stair run, brutal fall, shaft setup, and ghost race pushes you toward a better score. Stay in control, hit the beams, beat other players ghosts, and master the descent.

title: Florida Man Court
description: Prosecute. Defend. Judge. Throw objections... or punches. Outwit opposing counsel, cross-examine bizarre NPC witnesses, and turn procedurally generated Florida Man cases into unforgettable multiplayer courtroom chaos.

title: Tales From the Other Side: Beneath the Roots
description: Psychological first-person horror. Fate brings you to your grandfathers house, left abandoned after his mysterious disappearance. Explore it and uncover the dark secret hidden within.

title: Gyro
description:
Abandoned deep in space, you play as Gyro—a small utility bot tasked to clean up the remainder of what once was. Along your journey, you will gain new items to add to Gyro's arsenal of tools. But don't think you're getting off easy—your tasks will also become more and more challenging as you help discover the nature of Gyro's predicament. Featuring the music of A Life Elided, Gyro offers up whimsical, mysterious, sci-fi-based puzzles that will keep you wanting more.

Gyro supports controller or keyboard & mouse that allow you to roll around and use the tools listed on the left side of your screen. Consisting of six stages, you traverse from room to room, completing numerous tasks. Once all tasks in a room are complete, you'll be able to proceed to the next one. Upon reaching the end of a stage, you will face a boss. Defeating the boss will potentially give you a new tool and allow you to continue on to the next stage (once your other tasks are complete). You can save your progress through the menu—or autosave has you covered.

title: Snake Teaches Typing
description: Nokia Snake but its a typing game!

title: Touhou Crisis R
description: Touhou Project's most-beloved entry reimagined as a lightgun shooter! Blast your way through an army of foes across multiple stages! Includes a typing-mode for a more "educational" experience!

title: Aether Keepers
description: Tower Defense meets Casual Incremental! Be the ultimate caretaker and fiercely guard the core; Watch the stats skyrocket and enjoy pure mowing bliss!

title: Thunder Trucks: Heavy Racers
description: Race powerful semi trucks in high-speed competitions. Upgrade performance, master control, and dominate intense tracks to become the ultimate heavy racer.

title: The Grinch 2: Saving Christmas
description: Play as the Grinch, collect ornaments, master gadgets, and tackle festive challenges to decorate the ultimate Christmas tree for the Whos.

title: The Grinch: 2 in 1 Game Collection
description: The Grinch is back!

title: Make it! Shaved Ice
description: Get ready for a delicious shaved ice challenge! Make lots of shaved ice and watch your food cart prosper!

title: Shy Cats Hidden Orchestra 2
description: Find the cats. Discover the instruments. Reunite the orchestra!

title: Football Club Builder
description: Build, manage, and grow your own football club from Division 4 to European glory. Expand your stadium and facilities in 3D, compete in league and cup competitions, and create a football dynasty by making the right decisions in this fast-paced football manager game.

title: Zombie Survival 3D
description:
You wake up at night in a remote forest surrounded by a quarantine zone.

Without weapons.Without communication.Just a flashlight... and the feeling of being watched.

The only way to escape is to open the old gates of the laboratory perimeter.But they are locked with 10 mechanical locks.

The keys are scattered all over the infected forest.

And you're not alone here.

title: Neuroslop
description: On a rainy night, the protagonist steps into a café that has never been on this street before. Inside are strange visitors, conversations about how stories work, and an evening that lasts longer than it should. A short linear visual novel.

title: Kuroba: Oghuz
description: Kuroba is a historical RTS set in the brutal frontier of 13th-century Anatolia. Build settlements, manage logistics, and command armies in grounded, realistic combat. No magic, no heroes—only economy, strategy, and leadership determine who endures.

title: Solipsistic
description: Solipsistic is a free psychological horror game. Manipulate the game's files. The game knows you're there. The people inside it know it too.

title: Slice To Meet You
description: A cozy idle incremental game about the satisfying rhythm of chopping ingredients. Unlock new produce, upgrade your knives, and grow your earnings — all at your own pace, with no pressure and no timers.

title: Laballatory
description: A casual, incremental physics sandbox game where you operate a Newton's Cradle to earn high (possibly game breaking) scores to fund your escape from an experimental lab. Hit balls, earn money, upgrade your strategy, and unlock machines to help you escape.

title: FD's Industry Tycoon
description: Build a global industrial empire from a 1990s desktop. A retro business management sim, hand-drawn in pixel art. Alone or in MP: open factories worldwide, broker supply deals across continents, and acquire rivals when they falter. Markets shift, empires grow, and the CRT flickers.

title: The Colour Beyond: A Zeroth Kind
description: After foreseeing your own death, an unknown colour grants you ten more days to live and the power of Mind-Intrusion. Investigate mysteries and intrude into the minds of locals. When the ten days are up, will you hold on to your sanity and humanity, or become a living mutation?

title: 7 Shifts in Subway
description:
Every night shift follows the same route. Every passenger follows their own rules. Break just one… and they stop being human.

Take the role of a night subway driver trapped in a nightmare where every passenger hides a deadly secret. Observe, remember, and follow an ever-growing list of mysterious rules to survive all seven shifts. Every mistake has consequences, and every new night introduces horrors you've never seen before.

title: Star Haul Tycoon
description:
Star Haul Tycoon is a narrative logistics simulation that blends deep industrial automation with minimalist transport strategy - all wrapped in a layer of dark, corporate sci-fi humor.

You are an AI Unit working for Star Haul. Your directive is simple: Connect planets, run ships, and optimize supply chains to pay off your massive installation fee.

title: More Spore
description:
The MORE SPORE bundle includes the base game, the expansion Galactic adventures and the Creepy and Cute Parts Pack.

Spore
From Single Cell to Galactic God, evolve your creature in a universe of your own creations.
Play through Spore's five evolutionary stages: Cell, Creature, Tribe, Civilization, and Space. Each stage has its own unique style, challenges, and goals. You can play how you choose  start in Cell and nurture one species from humble tidepool organism to intergalactic traveler, or jump straight in and build tribes or civilizations on new planets. What you do with your universe is up to you.

Galactic Adventures
Get out of your starship and turn your Spore creatures into legendary Space Captains. For the first time, beam down with your allies to take on action-packed, planetside adventures. Complete quests, collect rewards, and even create and share your own missions

Creepy and Cute Parts Pack
Add horror and humor to your universe. Make grotesque beasts or cuddly critters, then watch them do the robot, zombie walk, break dance and more! Includes over 100 new items.

title: These Starless Skies
description: A team of planetary scientists must confront their personal demons and unravel the enigma of a mysterious tidally-locked planet, all before their inner chaos takes over in this sci-fi point and click adventure.

title: OxyRail
description: OxyRail is a cooperative survival and train-building game where players manage a moving base, gather resources, explore unknown worlds, defend against threats and upgrade their train while traveling through dangerous environments.

title: Komu
description: Komu is a live multiplayer party game built around community-versus-community competition. Two streamer audiences face off in real time across a rotating catalogue of mini-games spanning chaos arenas, racing, and trivia, with crowd participation mechanics that let viewers influence the action rather than only watch.

title: Outsail The Sun
description: Conquer dark oceans as the captain of a vampirate crew. Feast on sailor blood for roguelite-style upgrades, fend off mighty sea creatures with your overpowered builds, go treasure hunting, and outsail the sun to achieve bullet-heaven under the night sky!

title: Archimedes II: Some Like It Hot
description: Join Hercules to save Syracuse from erupting volcano fire in time management adventure! Gather resources, build and upgrade structures, complete strategic tasks, and banish mischievous ghosts to restore balance to the world

title: Void Daggers
description: One touch kills you. Your timer is your score. Neon wireframe horrors swarm from infinite darkness. Shatter them, harvest their essence, forge your daggers through 5 tiers of devastation. Bunny hop the void. Dagger jump to survive. Prove your skill on Steam leaderboards. For fans of Devil Daggers.

title: Bang Shoot.
description: A fast-paced arena shooter where you wield two weapons at once across unique battlegrounds. Each round is different: new map, teams, weapons, and modifiers.

title: Poker Matrix
description: In this turn-based poker strategy game, you and the AI take turns selecting five adjacent cards from the board, forming poker hands to determine the winner and earn chips. Convert your chips into points round by round to unlock more game modes!

title: Nash Racing Pursuit 2
description: Kevin Nash famous criminal and car driver is back. 11 tracks to find money piles under limited time and avoid police cars

title: Matilda 2
description:
The nightmare was never over.
It was only waiting.

title: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced: Deluxe Edition
description:
The Deluxe Edition contains the base game and the following content:
• The Master Assassin Character Pack: Edward costume, sword, pistol, and trinket with unique perks
• The Master Assassin Naval Pack: sail set, ship's pet, crew attire, wheel, figurehead, and hull trim

title: DREGS
description: Explore abandoned space facilities, recover relics from humanity's past, and escape with the loot in this multiplayer horror-comedy where every mission is a disaster. Panic, miscommunication, and your own friends will kill you faster than anything else.

title: HoloTrials: Case Covered
description: A graffiti mocking the Student Council President appears on the walls, and your best friend is the prime suspect! Play as a student detective in HoloTrials: Case Covered. Investigate the high school campus, face off against your rivals, and clear her name in this legal mystery.

title: Hamster Ballers
description: A short, hilariously unfair, two-player obstacle course that'll more than answer the question: "Would I lose my sanity if I were trapped in a hamster ball with this person and had to climb a stupid hazard filled mountain to get out?"

title: Star Trek: Warp
description: Star Trek: Warp is a card battler that combines deep gameplay, unique mechanics, and the joy of collecting and customizing powerful decks that feature characters and ships from across the Star Trek universe.

title: Weird Water World
description: Fish dark waters and discover procedurally generated fish that come in every color of the rainbow. Explore a weird ocean world haunted by Thalassophobic titans. Sell your catches. Try your luck sports betting at the bar. Drink delicious juices. Get eaten alive. Appease the Gods. Find your way home.

title: Most Scuffed Golf
description: Build the course, then break it. Most Scuffed Golf is mini-golf for 1–4 couch players: each one places a tile in the hole layout, then everyone shoots through the chaos you all built together. Ramps, curves, bridges — and a hole that's always somehow still reachable.

title: Fatimopolis
description: Logo após a chegada do ano novo de 2005, Lucas recebe uma ligação de seu chefe pedindo que ele faça algumas entregas em Fatimopolis, um vilarejo misterioso que, da noite para o dia, perdeu todos os seus habitantes.

title: Egg Harvester
description:
More eggs are required
Delve deeper and build the ever-expanding egg harvesting machine.
A mysterious first person factory building game.

title: Pete
description: In the video game Pete, you are a blue bird that has fallen out of your nest and you need to get back to your family. To do so you must find two fly orbs scattered across the map of the game, and go back to the middle of the map to fly up to your family and complete the game. Pete was developed by Craapy, and released to the public on December 23rd, 2022 for a game jam, and has seen many versions over the time of its release, including new features and fixes, the last update was on October 13th 2023.

title: Taiping Heavenly Kingdom
description: The setting is in mid-19th century China, an era when the great Qing Empire, rotten to the core, was plagued by both domestic troubles and foreign invasions.

title: Rogue Carrier
description: Lead a perilous expedition to study the mysteries of a sentient world in this roguelite colony management game. Build and manage a city atop an ocean-faring ship, and try to survive as the planet fights back!

title: Red Rooms
description: A time-sensitive strategy game where you must defend yourself from ominous entities. Defend yourself by using your camera flash, holding doors shut, and closing curtains. You must act quickly.

title: Window Seat
description: In a grime-dark future, windows need cleaning... and murders need solving.

title: R.A.I.L. Together
description: R.A.I.L. Together throws up to 4 players into a zombie apocalypse on rails. Fix the train, haul fuel, craft rails and save your friends while the engine burns, zombies climb onto the cars and the plan falls apart again.

title: Tiny Fortress
description: A short incremental game about defending your tiny fortress from hordes of tiny mobs. Place towers, gain resources by defeating enemies, and unlock new upgrades in the skill tree to strengthen your goblin stronghold.

title: Anomaly Inspector Simulator
description: Papers, Please in an SCP-inspired setting. You're an agent of a secret anomaly control bureau. Examine dangerous artifacts, conduct experiments and decide their fate. Keep the world from descending into chaos.

title: Flick
description: Shift realities with the flick of a light switch and plunge into the grotesque to uncover your family's twisted past. A psychological horror game where you must balance the light you need to progress with the terrifying nightmares it summons.

title: Memory of Memorie: A Chill Story
description:
The more you focus, the more the story unfolds.
A chill work adventure with a girl from another world.
Focus time no longer spent alone, for you.

title: Fragment Collapse
description: Fragment Collapse is a satisfying tile matching rogue-like deck-builder where you defragment your hard drive by matching clusters of files. Discover powerful cartridges to upgrade your computer, boost your files with enhancements and build massive combos for file-busting mayhem!

title: Paid by Blood
description:
Paid By Blood is a visual novel with a top-down and fixed camera perspective, supplemented by a few battles. You will play as Scout No. 3, venturing deep into dangerous zone to uncover the path leading to Ground Zero.

The total text volume of the game is approximately 50,000 Chinese characters (excluding punctuation marks).

Most texts can be freely chosen for reading or not. Your reading progress and choices will not affect the ending.

title: Wuthering Waves: Blade of Past Resounds, Lingering Dream Hymns
description:
Version 3.5 of Wuthering Waves includes:
- New Resonators: Yangyang: Xuanling, Suisui
- New Weapons: Azure Oath, Firstlight's Herald
- New Regions: Eastern Xuan Peaks, Southern Yuan Hills, Western Fang Peaks, Xuanfang
- 3 New Main Quests
- 2 New Deluxe Outfits
- New Events and Rewards

title: The Finals: Season 11 - Galaxy Masters!
description:
The Season 11 of The Finals includes:
- New Arena: Galaxy Estates
- Reworked Melee Combat System
- Cashout Bot Mode & New Onboarding
- Competitive and QoL Updates
- New Ultimate Battle Pass

title: Sakura no Uta: To Dance Over the Cherry Blossoms
description: SCA-DI's award-winning visual novel masterpiece is finally available in English and in full HD! Sakura no Uta is a story of those whose paths stop short—and of those who walk on.

title: Noodle Cable
description: The Noodle Cable Technologies welcome you in their company. Untangle and plug huge cables in room-sized puzzles and witness mind-altering surrealist environments.

title: Phageplay Basic
description: A story about going to the theatre. And the play is kind of strange very avant-garde. So you feel badly about yourself. And then it all starts over. Phageplay Basic is a full length stageplay embedded in a not quite completely-kinetic visual-novelette. Created for toxic yuri jam 2.

title: WildRoot
description: A cozy colony sim where survival is gentle—but life is alive. Build, farm, cook, craft and grow your settlement as colonists form relationships, help each other, and shape small, meaningful stories together.

title: Hotel The Memory
description: If you find an anomaly, remember it. Welcome to Hotel The Memory, an anomaly-hunting x memory-matching escape game. Match pairs of rooms with the exact same anomaly to escape from this strange hotel.

title: Cube & Seek
description: Relax and find hidden objects in handcrafted 3D tiny cube worlds. Search for hidden treasures and enjoy fun interactive surprises along the way!

title: Last Kid on the Bus
description:
This game is inspired (a total rip off) of the popular mobile game Granny.

Figure out how to escape by using equipment scattered around the school while the bus driver is lurking with his sledgy hammy hammer.

Q to drop objects.

This game was made in 1 week.

title: Mine Escape
description: Traped in a co-op horror game where the only way to evade death is by mining your way out. Navigate using rails fight using a machine gun and collect equipment along the way. Play solo or with friends and see if you have what it takes to survive.

title: The Astra Protocol
description: Cassette futuristic space simulator

title: Mystery Case Files: House That Love Built - Collector's Edition
description: In the latest Mystery Case Files adventure, stop Angelica from claiming the secret legacy beneath Ravenhearst!

title: Halloween Stories: The Death Card - Collector's Edition
description: Old friends reunite for Halloween, but Death has other plans!

title: Whispered Secrets: Poisoner's Masquerade - Collector's Edition
description: Bring your detective skills to the party for a murder mystery like none other!

title: Detectives United: Vengeance from the Past - Collector's Edition
description: Can your all-star detective team crack the case in time?

title: Archmage Idle
