description: An idle/incremental RPG where you're an Archmage of a wizard guild. Your skills bolster the frontlines and the supply lines. Every skill multiplies the others, and it all keeps running while you're away.

title: Merge Hidden
description: An innovative hidden-object game where every treasure is split in two! Find both halves in beautifully crafted scenes, then merge them to solve the puzzle. Five unique themed scenes with brain-opening combinations like straw hat + snowman, shield + sword. Simple to learn, endless challenges await!

title: ToSaVa
description: Master color theory without the textbooks. In ToSaVa, survival depends on your artistic eye. Play as a chameleon and use industry-standard sliders (HSV, RGB, Lab) to match the environment's color. The ultimate arcade challenge for designers, students, and color enthusiasts.

title: Arcanion: The Mekanos Invasion
description: The sequel to Arcanion: Tale of Magi, and Magi Side Story, where the Warriors of Arcanion face their greatest foe yet, the Mekanos Army. And it'll be a fight for their lives as they defend their home against these new invaders. Play as Magi and take part in missions to defend your home!

title: Your Own Cozy Motel
description: Build and run your own roadside motel in a hands-on simulator. Check in guests, clean and repair rooms, manage payments, upgrade facilities, and grow from a small stopover into a thriving, high-reputation business.

title: Alien Maker
description: A browser-based dress-up game where players customize spooky-cute aliens using drag-and-drop parts across multiple categories. Features a built-in prompt generator to inspire alien designs.

title: Luneia the Soothsayer
description: Play as Luneia the Soothsayer as you attempt to solve the mystery of the foggy Town of Salem. Interact with people and wield your ability to See into the past, present or future of their lives as a wandering fortune teller. Made for the (You) RPGmaker Jam #3. Game length is around 1-2 hours.

title: Fortnite OG: Chapter 1 Season 9
description:
Rediscover neon-lit Neo Tilted, futuristic Mega Mall and secluded Pressure Plant - locations that emerged after the Volcano’s destruction.

Ride Slipstream wind tunnels to get around the OG Island more quickly, find gold-lettered Hot Spots on the map and destroy Loot Carriers to grab higher-quality loot. Use Air Vents to launch into the air at high speed - you can move, shoot and build after takeoff without fall damage.

title: That’s Not My Mom
description: This is an anomaly-finding horror game where you search for unusual occurrences around the house. You play as a young elementary school boy who encounters anomalies every time he returns home from school. His mother behaves suspiciously, and strange events seem to be spreading throughout the city. Your goal is to uncover the truth behind this anomaly outbreak.

title: Floor404
description: There is something wrong with this hospital. Find every anomaly and escape alive.

title: Backrooms: Fade
description: Backrooms: Fade is a cooperative horror game for 1–4 players. Alone or with friends, you will explore a nightmarish level, trying to understand where you are, what is happening, and how to survive.

title: Cowboy Busy: Mowdown
description: Saddle up, partner. Dodge hordes, level up active/passive skills, fuse them into devastating Super Skills. Wield knives, turrets, or railguns. Every run (10 min) is a new roguelite build. Die? Respawn. Evolve. Survive the zombie apocalypse.

title: Backrooms: Multiverse
description: Backrooms Multiverse is a cooperative survival horror exploration game where you play as a team of researchers venturing deep into the endless Backrooms multiverse. Explore rare and mysterious environments, and encounter unique entities that few explorers have ever lived to see.

title: Arsonist '24 Director's Cut
description: Based on the recent Backrooms movie! Between the yellowed letters and bloody mysteries of the past, something horrible is wandering around. It's not happy to see any guests. It's hungry. And it KNOWS, that you're already here.

title: Backrooms Untold
description: Backrooms Untold is an atmospheric horror experience where you’re lost in an endless, infinite maze of fluorescent lit corridors, stained carpet, and humming lights. The deeper you go, the more it feels wrong—familiar spaces twisting into something hostile and unknowable. 8 total levels on launch.

title: Backrooms [Redacted]: Chapter 1
description: Backrooms [REDACTED] is a short action-adventure game that plunges you into the infinite cosmic horror inspired by the Backrooms concept.Navigate through the procedurally generated liminal spaces, uncover hidden secrets, while avoiding different entities.

title: Garden Souls
description: Garden Souls is a 2D action roguelite focused on fast combat, stylish combos and build crafting. Choose one of the four Garden Princesses, unlock new strikes, combine elements and adapt your combat style each run to face corrupted floral biomes and stop the Mandragora.

title: Harvester vs. Zombies
description: Mill hordes of zombies on the roads of villages, towns, and cities, avoid obstacles, buy upgrades, unlock increasingly powerful vehicles, complete missions, collect cards, earn achievements, break records, and compete with players from around the world in leaderboards and statistics.

title: Midnight Scour
description: Escape a rural nightmare in this atmospheric first-person horror game. You are hunted by a cunning killer. He lives, sleeps, and actively hunts based on your actions . Use stealth to navigate the house, solve puzzles, and complete one of the exits.

title: Vigil in the Mist
description: This is an atmospheric survival horror game, where you are stranded on a watchtower. Something knows you're there... and alone. Contact help, and use what you have to survive.

title: Noctiria
description: Noctiria is a horror roguelite deckbuilder set in a decaying 1990s city. Choose one of six heroes, combine brutal status effects, manage your Sanity and consumable relics, and permanently upgrade your arsenal between descents.

title: Mr Chin
description:
Mr chin remake of the msx game 'Mr Ching' from 1984
Collect Plates from the side of the screen https://. plates wobble after a while and evetualy fall, climb the pole again to to keep those plates spinning.

title: Frog vs Mural Girl 2: The Back Layer
description: Control a small frog and defeat the giant "Mural Girl". It is a 3D platform action game that focuses on "undressing" situations.

title: Dig for TCG Cards With Your Friends
description: A cozy junkyard card-collecting sim - now with online co-op. Dig through mountains of trash with friends, hunt rare collectible cards, sell your junk for profit, and upgrade your gear.

title: Gods Play Dice
description: A dice themed roguelike where every roll matters, and your journey will be lead by faith.. Luck isn't on your side, it is the game. Throw dice. Adapt. Survive, and most importantly believe in your dices.

title: Re:Metamorphosis Candina
description: All girls can transform with candy. A short branching visual novel about a mysterious candy shop and the girls who go there. What candy will you choose?

title: The Scarlet Lion
description: Play as an Urban Explorer and discover the dark secrets of a recently abandoned English pub.

title: Sushi Loop
description: Sushi Loop is a fast-paced cooking game where keeping order over your restaurant's conveyor belt is essential. Plan your Route, direct dishes along the belt, complete orders, and think quick to stay ahead of the clock. Every second matters. One mistake can break the loop.

title: Glimmers of the Past
description:
Greetings. Welcome to Glimmers of the Past - an interactive exhibition of the most recent electro-archeological discoveries from our home planet: Earth.

Broadcast live to you from the archives on Proxima Centauri b.

title: Franklin's Activity Center
description:
Franklin’s Activity Center is a computer game that includes eleven different mini-games featuring Franklin the Turtle, based on the books from Kids Can Press by Paulette Bourgeois and Brenda Clark.

The player first starts in Franklin’s Room, where he or she can select a game to play with. The games range from jigsaw puzzles to matching games, and colouring pages to making greeting cards, as well as from dinosaur bone hunting to dressing up.

The level of difficulty can be changed to suit children ages four to nine.

title: Irondrive
description: Irondrive is a top-down vehicular roguelike with real-time crew management. Players command a massive moving fortress crossing a hostile wasteland, managing a crew that fights fires, repairs critical systems, and mans weapons while the vehicle takes damage from combat and environmental hazards. Inspired by the crew survival mechanics of RimWorld and the tense, chaotic decision-making of FTL: Faster Than Light.

title: Unwoven
description: Face off against cursed creatures and protect Laima’s legacy in Unwoven, a fast-paced twin-stick shooter. Explore a gothic mansion and vanquish the spawn of a family curse. But beware: fate will test your skills and make every path more challenging.

title: Dereology Chime
description: Explore the school map freely and build relationships with the heroines in this exploration-based romance sim. Improve your stats by interacting with students, then win their hearts through actions like “Talk,” “Gift,” and “Charm” as you uncover the legend of the “Lovers’ Bell.”

title: Stream Bakery
description: A cozy multiplayer game built for Twitch streamers and their communities. Complete orders, earn rewards, and work together to run a bustling bakery!

title: Apidya' Special
description: Apidya is making a comeback in this authentic 24-bit pixel remake, built from the ground up, but utterly faithful to the original.

title: Magic Cards Duel
description: A fast-paced magic card game for 2 to 4 players. Use unique abilities to outplay opponents, make tactical choices, and control the match through skillful play.

title: The Full Ann Petting Experience
description: Give her a headpat!

title: Gear Notes: Ogre Slayer
description: Japanese dark fantasy action RPG inspired by Momotaro. Experience fast-paced combat with combos, parries, and real-time character switching.

title: Shoujo Minority: Nagisa Another Day
description: Mini scenario for Katakura Nagisa that includes new CG and one H scene.

title: Tete
description: A wobbly climbing adventure featuring a clumsy little golem. Can you conquer the hardcore controls and jiggling physics?

title: Keiyaku Kanojo: Shinmai Kanojo to Hajimeru, Tottemo H de Pure na Renai Lesson
One Button Games 5-in-1 Vol. 7
description:
Up Shot

You constantly run to the right, and your goal is to avoid squares falling on you from above. Hold the button to shoot upward and destroy the squares, but you'll remain stationary while shooting. Large squares require multiple shots.
The game ends when a square hits you.

Smily Angry

You're constantly running and can turn with the press of a button. Two faces shoot at you above you. They can be happy or angry. Your goal is to collect shots from the happy face to score points and avoid shots from the angry face. The faces randomly change their emotions.
The game ends when you're shot by the angry face.

V Bomb

You control a plane that constantly flies from side to side. Press the button to turn. Enemies fly beneath you and slowly approach your position. Enemies drop time bombs that explode upward. Your goal is to avoid the explosions and try to lure enemies into the blast. When the bombs are very close to each other, they explode in a chain reaction.
The game ends when you are caught in the blast or an enemy touches you.

Pin Climb

You score points by climbing pins. Hold the button to increase your reach. Try to avoid the pins that are below you.
The game ends when you reach the bottom of the screen.

Number Line

There are two lines of moving numbers on the screen. Press the button to sum the numbers in both lines. You score points when the sum in the top line is greater than the sum in the bottom line. When the top sum is less than the bottom sum, your score decreases and the lines become closer together.
The game ends when the lines intersect.

title: Journey of Johann: Castle Crusade
description:
Journey of Johann is an action adventure platformer with puzzle elements.
Make your way through levels and a boss with different challenges and obstacles.

title: Metal Detector Island
description: A cozy first-person metal-detecting adventure where you explore an island, follow signals, dig up buried chests, sell or collect your finds, upgrade your gear and unlock new areas in search of rarer treasures.

title: Idle Tides
description: Idle Tides is an idle incremental where the goal is to catch as many fish as you can. Unlock new upgrades to automate fishing and increase its speed.

title: Shower Game
description: Take a shower.

title: The Death and the Vampire
description: The death and the vampire is a 2d adventure game, full of mystery, comedy and drama.

title: Jigokuraku: Paradise Battle
description: The first game adaptation of the TV anime Hell's Paradise, now streaming with Season 2. "Jigokuraku: BATTLE IN HELL'S PARADISE" is now available.

title: Bitvoxel
description: BitVoxel is a 3D voxel sandbox and logic simulation game focused on building digital circuits. Players can create systems using switches, wires, logic gates, LEDs, memory blocks, and programmable components. Construction tools such as copy, paste, rotate, move, and reusable saved components supports large projects, ranging from simple circuits to custom processors.

title: Kill Loop
description: Ricochet! Destroy! Accelerate! This is a minimalist, high-speed action game. Dive into an endless loop of ricochets and destruction, and experience the pure thrill of the kill in a minimalist world!

title: Tsumi no Hikari Rendezvous: Mikan Blossom
description: A fandisc focusing on Mikan, the arts club's president, which didn't have a route in the original game.

title: Moto Shachiku no Ore ga Bishoujo JK ni Hirowarete Amaama Iyasare Ero Dousei Seikatsu
TurboJoy
description: TurboJoy is an arcade racing game with 20 city tracks, Nitro boosts, stunts, shortcuts, and vehicle upgrades — all driven by a big-eared bunny on a mission to win.

title: Krendel
description: Krendel is a strange point-and-click adventure without words or dialogue, where curiosity often leads to trouble. Explore, experiment, solve quirky puzzles, and tumble into absurd situations with a dose of dry humor. There’s definitely a story here. Probably.

title: Ski Yeet
description: Bomb down an endless, wraparound mountain in this arcade ski roguelike. Chain tricks into huge combos, stack 60+ power-ups across six rarity tiers, and outski a pack of hungry cryptids!

title: SpaceRiddle
description: What does this white object represent? A brief journey of 3D riddles.

title: The Lawnmover Massacre
description: A top-down arcade style game focused on the massacre of Earthling civilians courtesy of a "lawnmover".

title: Jinglebug Journey
description: Jinglebug Journey is a Visual Novel about a cursed video game, haunting a college student, "Max", who is in search for answers about his identity and happiness.

title: Suds and Buds
description: Suds and Buds is a short visual novel in which you play as the lovely Protagonist, who makes a late-night trip to the laundromat after finding their washing machine broken. However, in a world where vampires roam free, crazy scientists experiment on the undead, and other creatures wander with pride. . . our Protagonist is nothing but a fast-food employee. Isn't that embarrassing?!?!? Choose a peculiar stranger to talk to and mix your laundry loads with, spin the conversation in your favor, and get that washing machine spinning to win a lifetime friend!

title: Sukebe Orb
description: A fast-paced, casual, strip shooter that can be played with just the mouse. Destroy the clothes of anime-inspired SUKEBE girls to find the hidden SUKEBE Orbs!

title: I Became an Evil Witch that Cursed the Male Lead
description: I fell asleep playing a game where you romance a cute grim reaper and then... I woke up as the wicked witch in a dark fairy tale?!

title: The Wolf Wears Red
description: A serial killer, nicknamed "The Wolf" by townsfolk, has been ravaging the woods, claiming multiple young male victims over the past few months. The killer now sets out for their next victim. However, your latest targets aren't so easily devoured.

title: Perihelion: Rogue Orbit
description: Fit a ship, read the angle, and null your transversal for the high-alpha hit. Perihelion: Rogue Orbit is a 2D space combat roguelite about range control, tracking, and making your build work under pressure.

title: Spooky Tales: Nini's Teddy
description: Uncover the terrifying truth behind a cursed teddy bear in this first-person psychological horror adventure. Explore a haunted mansion, solve puzzles, survive supernatural encounters, and uncover Nini's tragic story in Chapter One of the Spooky Tales series.

title: Ice Cream Express
description: Drive your ice cream express through the neighborhood, craft delicious frozen treats, and serve fresh handmade ice creams to customers.

title: Casino of Time
description: Casino of Time is a roguelike game where you gamble with your time. Your time ticks down and you must try to earn enough time to survive as long as possible in the casino. A variety of permanent upgrades is provided every 2 minutes to tilt the odds in your favour!

title: Oath Eternal
description: A dark fantasy RPG inspired by the Metroidvania and Extraction genres.

title: The Angel Factory
description: A yuri visual novel produced by Gravity House for the second Toxic Yuri VN Jam.

title: Tear Them All
description: Tear through waves of doodle enemies with your pencil. Sharpen your weapon, balance melee and ranged combat, and survive the chaos in this fast-paced arena shooter.

title: BreakEven: Idle
description:
BreakEven is an idle action RPG for those players who enjoy the cycle - kill, loot, power-up, and destroy even harder.

The battle is automatically happening while you are making all the right decisions regarding the equipment selection, skill building, and overall strategy.

The game plays like an action RPG but values your time just like an idle game does.

The complexity is always ready when you need it but never interferes with you otherwise.

title: LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight - The Dark Knight Returns Suit
description: Pre-order bonus cosmetic for the game and its Deluxe Edition, inspired by the legendary comic series.

title: Lost Ages Hunting
description: Hunt across time itself. Track dinosaurs, Ice Age beasts, modern wildlife, and creatures from future eras in a unique hunting simulation spanning multiple worlds.

title: Deltarune: Chapter 7
description: The seventh and final chapter of Deltarune.

title: Pidgeon Pocket
description: Pidgeon Pocket is a chill incremental game about a rooftop pigeon-keeper who sends a flock of trained pigeons into a living city park to pickpocket small valuables from park-goers and bring the loot home. Each round the park transforms into a different live event, from a marathon or a street parade to a market, a concert or a dog show, while an intelligent police force reacts to every theft. Progression runs through a skill tree of abilities and rotating talents, growing the flock from a single pigeon into a full squad where every pigeon has its own superpower. Localized into 31 languages, fully playable with mouse, keyboard or controller, and built to run on Steam Deck.

title: Claw and Conjure
description: Claw and Conjure is an async PvP auto-battler with a fantasy RPG soul. Upgrade your town to alter your shop each round, then battle other players on a 3D map. Hire assassins, deploy traps, and resurrect exploding minions as you climb the global leaderboards.

title: Waifu Discovered 3: Cyberpunk Fantasy
description: An arcade anime shoot’em up with a unique strip’em up twist where the better you play, the more you reveal. Battle enemies, defeat absurd bosses, and unlock stunning waifus piece by piece.

title: Cotton Rock with You: Oriental Night Dreams
description: Cotton, the magical girl shoot-'em-up heroine, is back once again! This time, the adventure leaves the Magical Kingdom behind and heads to Japan.

title: Limekaruza STG
description: Slack artstyle indie Bullet Hell Shooter

title: Alchegator
description: Craft, destroy, and solve puzzles as an alligator in a strange room.

title: Brightest Bulb in the Darkest Room
description:
A short and surreal horror game made in RPG Maker 2003 for the 2026 SCREAMOLOGY game jam. The gameplay takes some inspiration from Yume Nikki, GOHOME, and the original Slender.

Follow Conny as they attempt to escape their new surreal surroundings. Conduct rituals at bookcases with scrapped notes to try and find a way out. Try to outrun the horrors in the dark as you navigate the strange landscape.

title: Ebb
description: ebb is a Yume Nikki fangame created in RPG Maker 2003. You play as Saikuru, a girl who isolates herself in her apartment and spends most of her days dreaming.

title: Neverness to Everness: 999 Nights
description:
Version 1.2 of Neverness to Everness, which includes:
• New Characters: Shinku and Iroi
• New Main Story Chapter
• New area: Warren Continent
• New events and game modes
• ...and more!

title: Demon's Soulbound
description: Demon's Soulbound is a gay bara adult 3rd person point'n click adventure about domination, bdsm, sex between men and monsters, and serving a demon master.

title: Sudden Strike 5: France - Road to Liberation
description:
Under the cover of darkness, they came – silently across the waves… In Sudden Strike 5 – France: Road to Liberation, deploy to one of the most decisive chapters in the liberation of France! Following D-Day, you’ll be joining the fight in a new Allied landing operation in August 1944.

Storm the shores of Camel Beach alongside Allied forces, fight together with the French Resistance, and command operations across six new missions set in Southern France. From the chaos of the Allied beach landings to the Axis retreat through the Rhône Valley, every battlefield presents a new tactical challenge that will test your strategic skill!

title: Jinn Hunter
description: In Jinn Hunter, you play a pair of superhuman hunters on a journey to unravel the secrets of the mysterious City of Brass. Seamlessly switch between characters and master their movesets in pulse-pounding battles to cut your way through enemies both human and monstrous.

title: Nasubi
description:
YOU TOOK PART IN A CONTROVERSIAL TV SHOW.

Experience an intense simulation of psychological endurance, inspired by the legendary late-90s Japanese reality experiment Susunu! Denpa Shõnen.

You are trapped in an empty room with no personal belongings, no provisions, and no human contact. Your sole connection to the outside world is an analog rotary phone...

title: Cross Strike
description: In the year of SC5910, the Sky Fortress was taken over by unknown enemies. Play as Cross, on a mission to resolve the crisis.

title: Phosphor
description:
Phosphor is a fast-paced sci-fi platformer roguelike where you descend into procedurally generated cyberpunk biomes, battling waves of drones, mechs, and biotech horrors.
Master dynamic combat blending gunfire, melee, dashes, and cyber spells. Stack elemental effects like Burn, Freeze, Shock, and Poison to unleash powerful reactions, then take on massive, pattern-heavy bosses.
Forge devastating builds from hundreds of weapons, passives, and abilities that synergize across runs. Unlock upgrades with persistence cores, tackle daily/weekly challenges, and push deeper with every attempt.
A high-mobility, challenging 2D action game inspired by the intensity of Dead Cells and the emergent chaos of Noita. Currently in active development and beta testing ahead of Steam launch.
Get to the core. The Phosphor still lives.

title: Nightmare Loop
description: Traverse the unsettling Gdańsk of the early digital era. Immerse yourself in a dark vision of a real city. Explore the Falowiec and other real-world locations as you search for answers to the mysteries. Try to stop the approaching nightmare in this unique horror game.

title: Pokémon Nightmare
description: Welcome to the Pacatus region, a small island known for its diverse environments, cosy towns and friendly citizens. You and your childhood friends, twins Xavier and Vivian, just accepted Professor Selina Parsley’s invitation to help her as field research assistants. Thanks to this, you will get your first Pokémon and have the opportunity to explore the wonders of Pacatus. Along the way, you'll meet numerous people, capture many Pokémon, challenge skilled Gym Leaders, and continually evolve as a trainer. Pacatus was a peaceful region for centuries, but recently dark clouds started to loom over it. Will you rise to the challenge, and put an end to the evil Team Epialtes’ (Eh-Pee-Ahl-Tees) schemes?

title: Grand Theft Auto Online: The Kortz Center Heist
description:
Scope out Los Santos’ premier cultural space and pocket prized artworks in The Kortz Center Heist, coming to GTA Online on July 14.

Link up with the mysterious Mr. Faber and his chief fixer Raf De Angelis to take on a blockbuster new Heist — where you'll meticulously stake out the museum and carefully plot your approach, then snatch the Kortz Center’s most valuable exhibits.

title: The Legend of Fireball: Rath DLC
description: Unleash Dark Family power with Rath!

title: Deer & Boy: Deluxe Edition
description: The Deluxe Edition includes Deer & Boy, its Artbook and its OST.

title: Seasonal Lockdown
description: An anxiety inducing survival game where you must balance removing anomalies while keeping unstable robotics under control. You are an undercover agent discovering the dark secrets an establishment owner is hiding from the government.

title: Carpet Cleaning Master
description: Clean filthy carpets until they look new again. Mind each one's rules, watch your water and power bills, and try not to think too hard about the company you work for. A cozy cleaning sim with something underneath.

title: Pointo's Big Adventure
description: Pointo's Big Adventure is a hand drawn, single-screen platformer about spinning and climbing. Play as Pointo the gray star in his grand journey to find and collect the Shiny Things! Why? Because shiny things are awesome!

title: Turbo Turkey
description: Thanksgiving is coming and you're on the menu. Run, jump, and shoot your way through 16 levels of Turkeyland in this collectathon platformer inspired by Banjo Kazooie, Donkey Kong Country and Crash Bandicoot. Collect pumpkins, race time trials, and prove you're no one's dinner.

title: Save the President: Trust Issues
description: A fast-paced social deduction party game for 4–10 players, grab your friends and play online together. One player is the President, but no one knows who. Protect them, complete tasks, and unmask the Killer hiding in plain sight. Accuse carefully: one wrong guess ends the game.

title: The Finals: Funkomatic 2000 Set
description: The FUNKOMATIC 2000 Set includes: 1 Legendary Outfit, 1 Legendary Weapon Skin, 1 Epic Emote, 1 Rare Charm, 2 400 Multibucks.

title: Fart Fighter
description: Fart Fighter is a 2D, top-down, pixel-art action game, where players travel across a world map, progressing through levels while collecting equipment, powerups and combining food to craft different farts and eliminate enemies.

title: Newbie: Become a Skateboarder
description: The interactive skate video! Free roam, pick a spot, set up your camera and try to ollie that stairset with the fully physics-driven board. Always-active ragdoll reacts to everything organically—no animations—making every moment unique! All you, realism first, and absolutely no hand-holding.

title: Plucked
description: Up to 12 players, one pond. A top-down bullet-heaven roguelite where you merge your guns into increasingly stupid firepower, then find out how much of it one duck can hold. Survive the waves, outlive the swarm, quack responsibly.

title: Lil' Quests
description: Where every Quest ends in Laughs and Chaos. Lil' Quests is a sandbox, adventure, co-op game with wacky physics, funny moments, and horses!

title: Orebital Dynamics
description: A tactile space‑mining incremental where you command snake-like drills through grids of space rock. At Orebital Dynamics, your job is to mine rare resources and bring every drill home safely.

title: SusDoku
description: A murder mystery blended with sudoku-style logic. Explore suspicious rooms, examine weapon evidence, and piece together clues through sharp deduction to reveal the killer. Play alone or work online with up to 4 detectives to solve the case together.

title: Radioactive Inc.
description: RADIOACTIVE, INC. invites you to the decaying, dangerous halls of a deserted nuclear research complex. Face your fears across 20 unique levels, each filled with new horrors, secrets, and challenges. 1- 4 player

title: Pppoker
description: PPPoker-Hold'em,Omaha Poker App,Global Battle,Home Games,Play Poker With Friends

title: Lawnmower Game Beer
description: Lawnmower simulation game where mission is to collect and find 10 beer bottles under limited time to finish game. Need also avoid bombs and zombies

title: Intelroach
description: A spy mission awaits you with an unusual agent-a cockroach! You’ll have to infiltrate a scientist’s house,solve puzzles,search for codes,and see the world from a completely new perspective. The puzzles will be challenging,and you’ll always have your helpful(or not-so-helpful) assistant by your side.

title: Legacy of the Ark: The Long Awakening
description: Legacy of the Ark: The Long Awakening is a sci-fi idle progression game where you rebuild a shattered colony ship, restore lost systems, automate production, and uncover the mystery hidden within the Ark’s damaged memory.

title: Aquabike Rush
description:
Dive into Aquabike Rush, an exhilarating underwater racing adventure that takes you beyond the surface and into the heart of the ocean’s mysteries. Take control of your high-tech aquatic bike and glide through breathtaking seascapes — from glowing coral reefs and forgotten shipwrecks to the dark, silent depths of the abyss.

Each race challenges you to master the underwater elements — fight against powerful currents, dodge treacherous traps, and adapt to the behavior of marine creatures that might help or hinder your progress. Speed and precision are key as every track is alive, unpredictable, and full of surprises.

Your mission is to prove yourself as the fastest and most skillful rider in the ocean.
Collect power-ups to boost your velocity, upgrade your gear, and unlock new, customizable aquabikes. Compete in thrilling multiplayer races, beat time trial records, and explore hidden routes packed with treasures and secrets. Every race is a battle for dominance — between man, machine, and the forces of the deep.

title: Kassei: Road Cycling - Next Season
description: Kassei: Road Cycling - Next Season is a summer sports simulation game. Become one of more than 80 male and female road cycling managers at more than 10 tours and classics - and decide on training plans as well as race tactics! The next season starts here ...

title: Marvel Rivals: Season 9 – The Mystery of Thebes
description: Season 9 of Marvel Rivals introduces brand new characters Jubilee and The Hood. It also includes a reworked Team Up system.

title: GreasyMac: Void Wilds
description:
This game is a collaborative effort from the GreasyMac community to celebrate Mac's birthday.

A short point and click adventure intended for GreasyMac fans, packed with in jokes and references to his streams.

title: Is it Normal to be Down Bad For My Friend?
description:
Hana has a crush on her beautiful friend. When they decide to live together, Hana wonders if she'd be able to survive.

A simple GL about a girl who's whipped for her best friend.

title: Wriggle Apple
description: Help the worm reach the apple! Navigate through tricky paths, avoid spikes, and use stones to climb higher. Each apple makes the worm bigger, but it may cause challenges. Can you help him?

title: Wriggle Apple 2
description: A winter puzzle adventure where a hungry worm collects apples. Plan your path carefully as it grows longer and fragile icy blocks break beneath it.

title: Wriggle Apple 3
description: Help the worm navigate the scorching desert, avoid traps, and grow longer with each apple. Solve puzzles, climb obstacles, and overcome new dangers in this thrilling desert adventure!

title: Jamhouse
description: Jamhouse is a fast paced falling block/platformer hybrid. Run, jump, and haul tasty tiles to clear waves of jams falling all around you!

title: Forever RPG
description: Embark on a new adventure on every playthrough. Find equipment, meet all sorts of NPCs and battle your way through a short 10 chapter randomised story. A casual retro roguelite RPG you can play forever!

title: Arkansas 2125
description: Arkansas 2125 is a turn-based post-apocalyptic game. Explore the wastelands of Arkansas, survive dangerous encounters, meet unique characters, and shape your own story through meaningful choices.

title: Collect Objects
description: Collect objects, how more you can? You need to solve puzzles to collect objects.

title: HoloDungeon: Koyori vs HollowLive in Honsha Tower
description: Wonderful maze “HoloDungeon” changes form with each challenge—within it lurks Hollow, beings not unlike Holomen. To rescue her snatched friends and make special Live a success, Hakui Koyori tries an unknown adventure! Roguelike RPG where you play using wisdom and brains remain even after down.

title: The Wackytown Game
description: Survive 14 waves of escalating absurdity. Defend the base, bank the cash, buy stupid upgrades. Bring a friend if you're brave.

title: The Light That Binds Us
description: Dive into The Light That Binds Us, a puzzle-adventure game where light shapes reality. Play as Yuè, a tormented soul, accompanied by her faithful protector, Yún. Cast shadows into paths, reshape the world to solve puzzles, explore breathtaking environments, and uncover the past that binds you!

title: Little Incrementisle
description: Little Incrementisle is an incremental colony-building game where you land on one wild island after another. On each island, you gather resources, construct buildings, recruit villagers, and develop your colony, until you’re ready to set sail for the next one.

title: The World Below: A Call Within
description: Achi ran away from the orphanage and he found himself surrounded by concrete, indifference, and violence. He was saved by a mysterious creature that came from within, and by a peculiar detective. He had no way of knowing that darker, more disturbing voices were about to reach him.

title: Magical Girl ER
description: A medical simulation where you examine and treat magical girls injured in kaiju disasters. With limited hospital beds and stamina, decide who to accept, who to refuse, and which treatment to choose.

title: Hearts Gone Black
description: Hearts Gone Black is a top-down survival horror game where you scavenge abandoned homes and gather or mine resources in open world, fight infected, manage survivors, build a base, and endure a broken world where weather, hunger, sanity, and moral choices slowly wear you down.

title: Palette: Glass Shard Mosaic
description: A fan remake in RPGMaker MV of Yoshitaka Nishida's Palette (2000), which also has elements from the 2001 Japan-exclusive Playstation remake Forget me not -Palette- that have been newly translated into English.

title: Iron Fuse
description: Weld weapons to your vehicle in the machine apocalypse of 3003. Survive against awful machines and operate in and our of your vehicle in this electrifying physics-based vehicular combat movement shooter.

title: Lust Doll Plus
description: Start naked, alone and confused in a dangerous place, and go on to carve out a piece of the world for yourself! A fully customizable, kinky erotica game!

title: Evil School
description: This game is an FMV about anti-bullying. A teenage girl mysteriously disappeared, and the truth was buried by power for eight years. Now, you return to this place of evil with a bloodstained list. The moment of slay & judgment has arrived...

title: They Came for Blood
description:
They Came for Blood is a desk simulation game. Your goal is to make it through the month and make enough income to afford rent in your apartment. Greet donors at the blood bank, look at their ID to determine if they're good to donate blood, and either let them inside, or reject them for not meeting the requirements. Sometimes vampires try to slip in, which can spell disaster for the hospital staff. Let in too many vampires, and the staff will be picked off one by one until you're the only one left to suck dry.

There are multiple endings, and several decisions to make while sorting donors as quickly as possible. They Came for Blood has a branching save file system, in case you've realized you've made a horrible mistake and need to turn back the clock.

title: Reciprocity: The Liminal Void
description: RECIPROCITY is a first-person horror game set in a Backrooms-inspired liminal world. Evade a relentless, unscripted entity, discover gadgets, sell items, upgrade your gear and escape. Your camera can reveal hidden paths and secrets, but each use empowers the very thing hunting you.

title: Forest Lookout
description: Forest Lookout is a first-person horror game where you navigate a lost person in a forest to safety. You can choose beetween options in dialogs to them. Listen to them, keep track of them, use your map and lead them out of the woods.

title: Rahasya
description: Enter a cursed ancestral haveli and uncover the truth behind a forgotten bloodline while surviving a reactive entity that watches, listens, learns your habits, and adapts to how you survive. Explore hidden rooms, solve ritual-based puzzles, and survive

title: Arkney: The Bone Road
description: Arkney: The Bone Road, a dark fantasy pixel RPG with real-time combat, boss fights, crafting and open-world exploration.

title: No Flowers in Arizona: Rust Red Vivarium
description:
Mirasol has been living with Dolores for as long as she remembers. Dolores has cared for Mirasol ever since a tragic accident impeded Mirasol's ability to live on her own.
Dolores is all Mirasol knows, and Mirasol is a weight that Dolores cannot shed.

title: Dungeon Repeater
description: Vera is a lone adventurer on an endless pilgrimage. Her journey leads her to the enigmatic Grange Island, home to a sprawling underground labyrinth. As she battles through waves of monsters and heads deeper and deeper into the depths, one question remains: what awaits her within the deepest layers?

title: Iron Carrot
description: Iron Carrot is a fast-paced third-person shooter with cute and gory visuals. The wolves took your country. Take it back.

title: The Death of Harsh Noise
description:
As the world is falling into ruin, Harsh Noise's body is following suit. Worn out by gender dysmorphia, drug addiction, and terminal illness, it can only see one fate on the horizon: Absolute Death.

Is there any salvation possible for a dwindling pack of it/its girls as they each contend with their own kind of existential decay? And just when everything is already at rock bottom, Harsh Noise's distant past goes after a certain trailer park...

title: Duel: The Game Show
description: Duel: The Game Show is a 2-player party game show with 30+ mini-games spanning trivia, memory, reflexes, and guessing challenges. Matches use a scoring pyramid across several rounds, with online multiplayer via Steam. Match length is adjustable, from quick 6-round duels to full 15-round marathons.

title: Torizon Telecom
description: Torizon Telecom is a text-based FPS game set in a vast world composed entirely of text. “Telecom”—a world where everything is text. “Telecom”... But does any other world exist beyond “Telecom”...? Or is “Telecom” the only one that exists...?

title: Aerial_Knight's MrFreezy
description: Play as a woman who's an axe-wielding serial killer in this light-hearted puzzle game about decapitating men, uncover the disturbing story behind New Detroit’s infamous serial killer, Mr. Freezy.

title: Kinetiks
description:
Kinetiks is a futuristic competitive arena sport game combining fast-paced action, tactical teamwork and physics-based gameplay.
Players compete in intense matches where movement, precision and strategy are essential. Control the energy disc, outmaneuver opponents and use teamwork to dominate the arena.
Designed as an esports-oriented experience, Kinetiks focuses on skill-based competition, dynamic gameplay and memorable team battles.

title: Shroom Soup
description:
You play as Arnika, a gloomy teenage girl.
Perpetually tired, you live off excessive sleep, lime juice, and instant soup.

You look into the vortex forming in your cup of said soup, this time mushroom flavour. Next thing you know, you are in an entirely different world where everything, from buildings to people, is being devoured by fungi.
It seems like you have no choice but to walk on... and face whatever lies ahead.

A retro-style RPG Maker psychological horror adventure featuring exploration, visual novel-like story, puzzles and turn-based battles.

title: Dravo's Twisted Show
description: You and up to 4 players are victims of a horror show, having to collaborate to solve multiple puzzles and use cooperative dynamics to find your way out, while surviving the creatures lurking around, hunting you, watching out for haunted events that can be a blessing or a bane for your survival.

title: Wyvern Warriors
description: Wyvern Warriors is an action game where players ride dragons and engage in dogfights with them.

title: Roads & Riches
description: Hit the road with your merchant caravan! Travel across faraway lands, sell wonderful wares, and find magical treasures - all to win over the world's hearts, minds... and wallets!

In 1994, a bitter labor dispute between Major League Baseball and the Players Association destroys a season and plunges the future of the sport into uncertainty.

For two amateur scorekeepers, the end of baseball is the end of an escape. They can no longer hide their faces behind their scorecards and the troubles of their time haunt their fragile relationship. Amidst it all is a growing realization that baseball itself is subject to the same forces that cast shadows over their lives.

What are scorecards good for? Every one is a mirror of its creator. Deep inside those cryptic grids of figures and diagrams are the thoughts scorekeepers can't put into words: the desire to be made new, an opaque sense of justice. Greed, hate, retribution, death.

title: Hell Deck
description: Collect units and build powerful synergies on a restricted grid in Hell Deck, a dark roguelike deckbuilder defense game. Construct your own bizarre, twisted ecosystem through a brutal cycle of predation and sacrifice, and survive the endless horrors that crawl from the abyss.

title: Urmels großer Flug
description:
"Urmel's Great Flight" (or Urmels großer Flug) is a platformer video game developed by the German studio Sunflowers Interactive Entertainment Software and released for Windows in 1996.

The player controls Urmel sitting in the helicopter. The goal in the various levels is to transport Urmel's friends—Wawa the monitor lizard, Ping the penguin, Wutz the pig, and Ophelia Tintenklecks—one by one from one platform to another.
The physics here are reminiscent of the 1982 arcade game Joust: gravity constantly pulls Urmel toward the ground, which the player must counter by pressing keys. In later levels, the flying mechanics change temporarily due to wind, whirlpools, or gas clouds, and permanently through magnets or underwater. Additionally, later levels can only be completed by precisely using gliding flight.
The total of 100 levels lead through many scenarios known from the stage plays "Urmel from the Ice Age" (1969) and "Urmel Plays in the Castle" (1974): the island of Titiwu, its jungle, the town of Winkelberg, its zoo, and its museum (dinosaur, knight, and Egypt sections), above the clouds, underwater, a swamp, the cave, and the volcano. The game can only be saved after completing a scenario (every 7 to 8 levels). A perfect walkthrough takes about three hours.

title: Dealer's Dice
description: Dealer's Dice is a high-stakes dice defense game engineered for true gamblers. Collect powerful dice, manage your betting table, and test your luck against an endless onslaught. Will you play it safe, or push your luck for the ultimate jackpot? Remember, you only have one life.

title: Color Attack!
description: Rotate and React

title: Who Am I Next?: Animals
description: Who Am I Next? : Animals is a fast-paced, 7-player brawler where you must survive ever-changing chaos. Clear your animal's missions and claim the #1 spot!

title: Icarus: Dangerous Horizons
description: This DLC significantly extends game content rising close to what we would do with a sequel. It includes a whole new map, mission campaign, and an array of new animals and bosses. Consider purchasing this if you have enjoyed the base game, and would like a substantial amount of extra content.

title: Ghost Justice
description: Lead elite operatives against ruthless cartels in a brutal narco conflict. Coordinate multiple tactical teams, plan ambushes, gather intelligence, and eliminate high-value targets through stealth-driven turn-based combat.

title: Postal Expedition
description: Postal Expedition is an exciting 3D game where you get behind the wheel of your van and collect all the letters as quickly as possible.

title: Flappy Dragoon
description: A 2D side scrolling shoot game , you can control a Asian girl who ride a white dragon and fight with monster.

title: Monkey Business
description: Monkey business is a fun and exciting platform game that will keep you at the edge of your seat for days to come, with 4 Worlds, 36 levels to complete winning won't come easy. Jump, climb and fight with strange creatures, complete levels and open up new levels and World's. Travel through this adventure and reach the final level to fight against the Big Boss, we dare you!

title: Everybody's Happy Place
description: EHP is a single player money game where you have just got kicked out of the house and now you have to get yourself back on your feet with a starting £2000 and a new job opportunity. Explore the world with vehicles and admire the colourful atmosphere. Grind up as much money as possible.

title: Roll 'em Out
description: Roll 'em Out is an indie adventure game best experienced when played with friends. You set out on an expedition to an ancient, unexplored cave. Suddenly one of your mates was cursed when he accidentally activated an ancient relic. He did not die but was transformed into a bouncy ball. You must Roll 'em Out of the cave to break the curse. Otherwise, the very cave will collapse, hiding its secrets from the world.
The gameplay is presented as a short interactive experience, serving primarily as an experiment in combining different art styles within a single project.

title: Brainrot Autobattler
description: Brainrot Autobattler is a chaotic roguelite auto-battler/autochess where you buy brainrot units, evolve them into stronger forms, trigger trait synergies, and survive a run full of shops, bosses, boons, and bad decisions.

title: Dating Killmulator 2
description:
Dating Killmulator 2 is the sequel to Dating Killmulator 1.
Step into the shoes of a female protagonist in an even crazier sequel that starts right where the last one ended: in the middle of chaos. Enjoy the new plot twists, romance scenes, and already outdated memes we’ve prepared just for you. We’re so happy to see you again!

title: Ken to Mahou no Relic Saga
The Colors of Love
description: The Colors of Love narrates the story of a teenager that is unmotivated in life. He's healthy, has two good friends, both of his loving parents and does well at school.

title: Dear Passengers
description: Play in co-op as the crew of the worlds worst airline. Your plane is falling apart, your cargo is illegal, and passenger safety barely makes the list.

title: Achivement Maze 1
description: Navigate through 33 increasingly complex mazes in this pure test of skill and patience. Move your ball from start to the checkered finish, unlock 100 achievements and prove you can beat them all. Simple, addictive and beautifully crafted.

title: Paper Shredder
description: Paper Shredder is an incremental game where a sheet-after-sheet grind scales into mass document destruction. Shred, sweep, upgrade, and cut down tower-high piles of confidential records to uncover what’s buried beneath.

title: Farming Simulator 25: Beans & Alpacas Expansion
description: Build your coffee estate and grow a warmer kind of farm life in Catuaí, a South America-inspired region shaped by coffee terraces, red soil and lush hills. Grow coffee beans, raise alpacas and Brahman cows, start new production chains and operate 25+ new machines!

title: Love, Startup & Co-founder
description: Love, Startup & Co-founder is a realistic visual novel with company management simulation. Build an AI startup from scratch and balance money, love, career under outside pressure. Navigate your relationships between five heroines with distinct personalities, and make choices that shape your journey.

title: Oblivion 2666
description: A slipstream magical realist visual novella about an outsider, a borrowed camera, and a city that no longer matches its own photographs—told through literary prose and ever-shifting, textured cinematic presentation.

title: Ghost Village Girl: The Village in a Cage
description: Lost in a forgotten mountain village, Itsuki and his companions must uncover the truth behind an ancient legend before the village’s mysterious influence consumes them. A psychological horror steeped in prewar Japanese folklore.

title: Whiskers In The Sand
description: Whiskers In The Sand is a fast-paced survivors-like arena roguelite where battle-ready cats shred through hordes of undead desert monsters. Unlock new cats, collect relics, stack upgrades, and forge ridiculous builds to survive the pharaoh's second reign.

title: Sakura no Toki: Sakura no Mori no Shita wo Ayumu - First Press Limited Edition
description: Contains a monochrome booklet, character mini shikishi, full-color special booklet, newly written novel booklet, OP full-arrangement CD and drama CD.

title: Unemployed Nightmare Together
description: Punch out or get punched! Unemployed Nightmare Together is a 1–4 player co-op horror where you're trapped inside a nightmare office by a relentless job application. Restore power, complete your paperwork, and reach the elevator before you're drained. Quitting is not an option.

title: App Developer Tycoon
description: Quit your job. Build apps from your bedroom. Beat your rivals, survive the rent, and claw your way from a spare room to a Silicon Valley HQ. A turn-based narrative tycoon about the indie developer grind.

title: The Political Simulator
description: Create a candidate and run a Presidential campaign across the United States. Improve your approval rating with battleground voters and try to earn enough support to win on election night. The campaign mode allows you to take part in a turn-based strategic campaign where every decision matters.

title: Mine the Deep
description: Battle relentless drone swarms, mine valuable resources, and upgrade your ship into a devastating weapon platform.

title: Touhou Defense Tale: AI Test in Touhou
description: A 2D Touhou fan game combining tower defense, tower merging, RTS-style control, and chaotic bullet-filled battles. Merge Touhou characters, build your defense, and compete for the fastest clear time on the leaderboard.

title: Stack Mates
description: Stack Mates is a co-op puzzle-platformer for 2-8 players built on teamwork and pure chaos. Shift your form between horizontal and vertical, climb on your friends, and reach the portal together. Remember, if even one person fails, everyone starts over!

title: Hunt Skeletons Together
description: Take on a cursed church in Hell with 1 to 4 players online — co-op or PvP! Hold the line against running, leaping, bone-throwing hordes. Swing above the dead with your grappling hook. Blast off limbs and unlock cosmetics with every kill. Stand together... or hunt each other down.

title: Even or Odd 1
description: "Even? Odd? Forget the math!" Enter the Collatz Conjecture—mathematics' greatest unsolved mystery—reimagined as a high-speed roguelike action game. Play as "Ichi," the muscle-brained magical girl, teleporting between lanes to smash back incoming numbers with charge shots!

title: Mega Man X Regenesis
description: Mega Man X fan-game, featuring an original story set in an alternate Mega Man X timeline.

title: WinBolo
description: A multiplayer top-down tank game for up to 16 players. Capture bases and pillboxes, harvest trees, build roads and walls, lay mines, and battle for control of the island. The Macintosh classic, rebuilt for modern platforms — free, open source, and cross-platform across desktop, mobile, and web.

title: Protect Your Humans
description: Rebuild a kingdom, raise an army and defeat the Demon King and his servants in this 4 player Couch co-op action shoot-em-up adventure. Protect Your Humans, or there will be no humans left to fight with.

title: Touhou: Records of Wealth-Seeking
description: Touhou: Records of Wealth-Seeking is a funny, chaotic visual novel and perfect for Touhou newcomers. No prior knowledge needed to enjoy it. Play as Keine, buy up Gensokyo’s assets, and face the invasion from the Outside World. You’ll meet all kinds of weirdos—and you’re one of them too.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Total Conversion
description: A total conversion mod for the original Doom. The aim for the mod is to recreate the first Legend of Zelda game released for the NES back in 87 in the old Doom engine.

title: The Bicycle Couriers
description: Learn the traffic rules in a playful way! In this game you are a bicycle courier who delivers parcels. If you deliver a package you receive money, but that doesn't get you there yet. You have to know the traffic rules and stick to them, otherwise you will end up in the hospital.

title: Sheep Move Together
description: Craft equipment from collected resources, and face the strange creatures lurking beyond the fog together in this 1-4 player co-op exploration and adventure game.

title: Valor 1944
description: Turn the tides of World War II across Europe and the Pacific in this action packed third person shooter.

title: Bowling Alley Simulator
description: Bowling Alley Simulator lets you build, manage, and grow your own bowling alley. Run the lanes, cook classic food, hire staff, and expand your business into a thriving entertainment destination.

title: Ys I Chronicals
description: This is the first game present in Ys I & II Chronicles compilation for the PlayStation Portable. This version is based off the 2001 PC remake of the games, containing new sounds and graphics.

title: Ys II Chronicals
description: This is the second game present in Ys I & II Chronicles compilation for the PlayStation Portable and a direct sequel of Ys I. This version is based off the 2001 PC remake of the games, containing new sounds and graphics

title: Pedals in Panic
description: Pedals in Panic is a small physics-based bike game where you control each pedal separately, steer with the mouse, jump over obstacles, and survive chaotic procedurally generated platforms.

title: Ruler of the Roost
description: Fight to become the Ruler of the Roost in this chaotic chicken battle royale shooter where heavily armed hens, explosive eggs, cursed power-ups, and unearthly poultry horrors turn the barnyard into an all-out feathered warzone.

title: Unnamed Pogo Game
description: Trapped in a surreal world, your only way out is to bounce your way to the top. Master brutal physics, survive impossible obstacles, and face the climb alone or with friends in this unforgiving pogo-stick challenge. One bad landing is all it takes to lose it all. Can you reach the peak?

title: Penumbra: Overture VR
description: This is a virtual reality mod of the horror game by Frictional Games, including head and hand tracking.

title: Half Step Princess
description: Tenth grader Gwendolyn Baker joins her schools fencing club and becomes entangled in rivalries and romance with her competitors.

title: Duskdog
description: A dark atmospheric survival exploration game. Humanity lives underground; you volunteered to walk the frozen surface alone. Explore and survive the cold and dark forgotten lands, and learn what the artificial sun is doing to this world and to you.

title: The Sound of Piano
description: A keyboard rhythm game featuring pure piano tracks, where every note hit generates a real key sound for an authentic piano response. Designed for intermediate to advanced players, the game includes a unique skill test algorithm to determine player ratings. All tracks are human-crafted without the use of AI-generated music. The game also features an automatic MIDI converter, allowing players to import and play their own MIDI files.

title: Heroes Saga
description: You've lost everything and found yourself in a world where a smile can become a deadly trap. "Heroes Saga" is a fantasy visual novel about choice, power, and temptation. Are you the hunter or the prey?

title: Aiocá
description: In vast open seas and aboard a vessel equiped to withstand the depths of the ocean, a lone fisherman fights day after day to survive the challanges brought by the endless blue. As he tries to reach an important place from his past, our protagonist, Omari, is being haunted by sins of the past during his trip. Before he loses his sanity, Omari must face countless dangers that threaten his life, while supernatural forces seek to pull him to the abyss. Hold on to your faith and survive in this cruel ocean to unravel Omari's past in Aiocá.

title: Bullet Box
description:
With the power of Sanko's Drawing and Animating, and the skill of Psychic's Coding, we present to you... BULLET BOX.

Bullet Box is a bite sized video game where you blow the brains of out various enemies to survive the PURGE. Collect blood clots to purchase items in the shop, slurp up heals to feel better than before, and take your little buddy on a hectic adventure through landmasses covered in the undead!

title: Silency: Cube 666
description: Find the exit inside a giant mechanical cube of 216 rooms that rotates and rebuilds itself. Every door may lead toward survival, or send you straight into death. Read counters, deduce the rules, and decide whether the next door can still let you leave alive.

title: Disjoined
description: Disjoined is an indie RPG that takes place after every other adventure has been completed, in the Infinite Mall at the End of Time. Explore, battle, and join the hilarious cast of misfits trying to restore temporal balance to the universe.

title: ColdSide: Retro Edition
description: ColdSide: Retro Edition is a reimagined version of the 2020 indie horror game, recreated in the style of classic retro titles. You once again find yourself in an abandoned bunker where research on anomalous phenomena is underway

title: Rock Paper Scissors: The Roguelike Puzzle Game
description: The Roguelike Puzzle game where you play Rock Paper Scissors and smash high scores with a variety of flavored blocks. Buy and equip power blocks to help you increase your score and get to the next round. Watch out for hazard blocks that may deter your progress and end your run.

title: Portal Together
description: A co-op platformer experience you can play with a friend! In a vertical world full of obstacles, create creative solutions and escape using portals, either with your friend or solo.

title: The Inseparables
description: The Inseparables is a hardcore 2D platformer with local co-op for two players.

title: Phy Lab
description: Phy Lab: immerse in stunning visuals, test your wits with realistic physics puzzles, and enjoy engaging gameplay. Challenge yourself now!

title: Sociopath
description: You and seven strangers are trapped in a countryside mansion, forced to play a killing game. For everyone else, the only way to survive is to find the killer. But for you, my dear killer, the only path forward is to slaughter them all.

title: Infinity Nikki: Golden Dust
description:
The age of Titans was forged in gold.
Happiness and glory lingered like the afterglow of sunset.
A thousand years of old wounds swirl within the cup.
Judgment looms on high, yet the final ruling has yet to fall.
With soul as bow and conviction as arrow, darkness shall be pierced—

title: Swordless
description: A broken sword... The left hand controls the hilt, the right hand guides the blade. They work together to reach the end, and unite as one!

title: Joint Venture
description: Run the prison commissary from behind the window: match IDs to prisoner numbers, obey the guards' daily rules, and fill orders for profit. Then build a contraband empire in drugs, shivs, and smuggled goods, dodging patrols, cameras, and pat-downs. Serve your time, or smuggle your way out.

title: Booox
description: "Booox" is a platform puzzle game where players control multiple characters simultaneously, coordinating their actions to solve challenges.

title: Attack Only
description: Experience a retro RPG as a princess who can only attack. Defeat enemies by targeting the game window and console itself! Before long, you’ll awaken to face a monster in the real world. Enjoy a multi-layered metafiction experience built on a classic RPG foundation.

title: Radiation Caterpillar
description: Are you willing to take risks to grow? Can you collect all the radiation without getting trapped in your own body? Test your skills in this unique space puzzle!

title: Catch the Turtle
description: A clicker game. The player must sit and watch the screen attentively, waiting for a chicken to run past, and then click on it with the mouse to catch it.

title: Cake Shop 3
description: Develop your Cake Shop business and promote it all around the world. Start playing Cake Shop 3 immediately, if you want to train your managing skills. Cake Shop is a Time Management game, where you have to prepare various sweetmeats to please your clients' tastes and even discover ever new recipes in the cuisines of the world. You can download Cake Shop 3 game absolutely for free to test your ability to run the business successfully and to set up your own shopping empire prevailing over your competitors' ones!

title: Kibble Cats
description: Kibble Cats is a cozy, short incremental game with a definite ending. Rebuild an ancient cat village around a buried Pawbelisk. Hire cats, unlock buildings and reach milestones as a thread emerges connecting it all to something greater. A force stirs within this village, and it dreams a Great Dream.

title: Cat Screen
description: Bring your desktop to life with 3D cats! Feed, pet, name your cats and earn points. Minimal menus, mouse-only controls, system-friendly design and weekly online rankings make you the best cat owner!

title: Nibble Quest
description: A collectathon 3D platformer featuring a hungry capybara in search of legendary snacks.

title: Mei Paranormies 2
description: Mei Paranormies 2 is a 2D top-down survival horror game where you play as Mei, the paranormal investigator, who got a call from the owner of a haunted guesthouse to investigate it for proof of the paranormal.

title: Seal of Shadows
description: Shatter the darkness in this 3-player co-op ARPG. Master 3 unique classes, loot epic gear, and battle through a 20+ hour hand-crafted campaign. Inspired by classics like Shadows of Mystara—grab a controller and forge your legend in Banesmeire today!

title: Danju
description: Danju is a pachinko game with unique ticket upgrades and quirky levels. Bet coins to collect trophies with increasing stakes and earn enough trophies to complete more and more challenging levels! Try out an endless run in Arcade mode to see how far you can get on the leaderboard!

title: Car Challenge
description: Car Сhallenge is a dynamic arcade game about speed, destruction and spectacular crashes. There are no rules here — just tracks, jumps, traps and maximum damage.

title: Girl Terminal
description: "Girl Terminal" is a desktop pet game where you earn reputation through mouse and keyboard actions, unlock outfits, and weapon mods. Spend your day with this apocalypse girl! Team up with friends and form your own squad!

title: Crownrats
description: Crownrats is a co-op colony RPG where mouse heroes explore locations, capture rooms, mine resources, build a home colony and resist rival warrens. Play solo with bots or together in quick tactical runs.

title: Once Upon A Katamari: Rolling Live Highlights
description: This paid DLC features ten stages originally featured in "Katamari Damacy Rolling Live", twelve new songs, six new cousins, and 18 new accessories.

title: The One Who Runs Away Is Chased
description:
The One Who Runs Away Is Chased

Simple. Cute. Addictively fun!

Take control of your adorable little yellow hero as you run and jump through endless procedurally generated levels. Time your jumps perfectly, avoid falling, and aim for the highest score possible!

Easy to learn but challenging to master, Kaçan Kovalanır is a fast-paced 2D platformer that's perfect for quick play sessions or chasing your personal best.

title: Memento*Fragment
description:
Memento*Fragment is a visual novel in which [You], the protagonist, recover your memories by viewing memory fragments.
The first contains the past of a girl, traveling alone through a world on the brink of destruction.
Continue watching to learn about her past, your relationship with her, and rediscover your identity.
Don't look away, no matter how tragic the answer may be.

title: Tidy Up: Spaceship
description: A cozy sci-fi tidy-up game. Gather the books scattered across your ship and sort each one into its rightful place. Play in calm normal gravity or start on Zero-G mode, where the books float in mid-air. No timers, no pressure.

title: Plausible Deniability: Cover Your Tracks
description: A satisfying incremental game about breaking boxes, shredding paperwork, and upgrading your operation to keep up with an endless flood of documents.

title: [Stories to Tell]: The Stoneville Incident
description: "Stories to Tell" Is a psychological horror game series developed by a 16 year old were each installment is based on a dream/nightmare that I, the developer, have experienced. This is a game you wouldn't want to miss...

title: S.T.A.R.V.E.
description:
S.T.A.R.V.E. is a farming roguelike deckbuilder set in space. The corporation drops you on an alien planet with a quota to fill. Deliver the harvest or lose the job.

Your farm is a grid and your deck at the same time. Cards plant crops and trigger harvests, and the payoff comes from how the tiles react to each other. Selling produce earns C.R.A.P., the company currency, which pays for booster packs and card mutations in the S.T.A.R.V.E. Lab.

Every quota you hit raises the next one. Each run starts on a new planet with its own hazards, so the money-printing combo that carried you last time has to be built again from scratch.

title: Hauntworks
description: Hauntworks is a dark comedy haunted house management sim where you build an automated scare factory. Your undertakers harvest human reactions like screams, vomit, and laughter as physical resources, which you pipe through production chains to appease otherworldly patrons and escape limbo. Releasing in Early Access Halloween 2026.

title: Full Metal Coffin
description: A 4 person multiplayer game that has you and your friends man a submarine through treacherous waters. navigate your way though underwater trenches and try to survive the onslaught of dangerous as you scout and plan your way ahead repairing your vessel and using sonar to help guide you.

title: Human's Red Destiny
description: This game tells the story of Mikari, a normal student who recently had to change schools because of murders in her town. At her new school, she meets and makes new friends, something she has never done before in her life. But someone is still following her...

title: Bound to Defend
description:
Bound to Defend is an endless wave defense game that combines roguelite progression with persistent loot. Level up, draft new skills each run, and experiment with different builds while surviving increasingly difficult waves. Earn gear that permanently carry across runs, allowing you to upgrade, merge, and strengthen your character over time.

Combat blends automatic attacks with manually activated abilities, runs can be saved and resumed at any time, and a live cross-platform monthly Top 100 leaderboard lets players compete for the highest score.

title: Dropoff
description: Work as a postman for a company, then build an empire ran by you, cause that is cool.

title: Famine in Wonderland
description: Step into a twisted parody of "Alice in Wonderland," where the bizarre meets the brutal. In "Famine in Wonderland," you’ll guide and protect Alice as she navigates in a world filled with strange characters.

title: Beat Slicer
description: Slice through the rhythm in Beat//Slicer, a hyper-reactive synthwave rhythm game where your music controls the action. Load any track, customize your grid, and choose from three distinct game modes. Slice with precision, build your multiplier, and master the neon horizon.

title: Arknights: Endfield - Update 1.4: Homecoming
description:
Version 1.4 of Arknights: Endfield includes:
• New Operators: Arcane, Liino
• New Weapons: New signature 6 weapons for Arcane and Liino
• New Areas: Yinglung Pass, and North Wuling Exclusion Zone
• New Main Story Chapter: Homecoming
• Expanded AIC Factory System
• New Events and Rewards

title: The Final Shuffle
description: Unjustly imprisoned and your wife kidnapped by a shadowy gang, you must escape captivity to hunt for the truth. In The Final Shuffle, navigate a dangerous conspiracy, solve lethal puzzles, and outrun your enemies. Can you save her and uncover the dark secret before it's too late?

title: Swim4Swim
description: a visual novel about swimming

title: Dead Turn
description: A psychological survival horror experience where reality unravels as you confront an unknown nightmare.

title: Betrayal Banquet
description:
Betrayal Banquet is an indie medieval multiplayer party game that combines cooking simulation with social deduction. Players take on the role of royal servants, preparing and serving meals for the kings while racing to complete orders before time runs out. At the same time, hidden Betrayers secretly work to poison the feast without revealing their identity. Every player must decide who to trust, watch for suspicious behavior, and work together to protect the banquet before it's too late.

Genres: Social Deduction, Party, Cooking Simulation, Multiplayer, Co-op.

title: Guildrun
description: Turn a simple team into an unstoppable force and crush waves of monsters in this PvE autobattler roguelike. No two runs feel the same as you bend heroes beyond their class roles and discover countless combinations and synergies. Seal the rifts at your own pace and uncover what tore them open.

title: People are Tools
description: Your friends are your only gear! In this chaotic co-op adventure, use your teammates as pickaxes, grapples, and tools to navigate procedurally generated caves and find fuel for your ship. Just remember: you’re not alone down here…

title: Dead End: Escape Your Fears
description:
Everyone thinks they can make it out... but they've never met the Millers.

Missing college students plague the small town of Roberta, but you never thought you’d be one of them. When you’re kidnapped in this puzzle horror game, there’s no one to rely on but yourself. Do you watch horror movies and believe you’d be smart enough to make it out? It’s time to prove it. Can you escape before you become just another local tragedy?

title: GoGeez
description: GoGeez is a psychological idle horror game about rotting alone in your room, getting addicted to cute little chibi creatures, and ignoring the increasingly horrifying world outside your screen

title: Super Real Mahjong Venus Returns
description: The legendary strip mahjong game is back with the latest VR technology! Play two-player mahjong against Shoko, Mizuki, Aya, and Akira, and each time you win, they'll take off a piece of clothing. Experience zero-distance stripping!

title: Beneath The Hill
description: Beneath The Hill is a first-person survival horror game about entering a cave beneath a village to investigate a strange beating heard below. The game focuses on lantern-based exploration, sound-sensitive goblin encounters, simple melee combat, and multiple endings.

title: Backrooms: Splatter
description: The Backrooms got colorful. Suit up, grab your paint, and splatter your way out of the liminal void with up to 4 friends.

title: Scary Cave Diving
description: A claustrophobic first-person underwater survival horror game where you must navigate procedurally generated cave systems on a draining oxygen tank while being hunted by a massive apex predator. Test your nerves in the main exploration mode, or fight back with a harpoon gun in the action-focused Shark Cage mode.

title: Pest Control in the Crypt
description: Pest Control in the Crypt is a strategic rogue-like wave-battler. Enhance your elemental potions with unique items and a branching skill tree to slay Pests. Delve into the Abyss and conquer the Crypt.

title: Eggs Never Hurt
description: "EggsNeverHurt" is a light rogue survival game that features single-player control with dual joysticks operating two characters simultaneously. Your primary focus is to ensure that the non-attacking character does not die and obtain monster rewards while the attacking character kill enemies.

title: Sweet Tea Tycoon
description: Run a sweet tea stand in this 2D pixel-art business simulator inspired by tycoon classics. Manage inventory, adjust your recipe, hire staff, invest in upgrades, and pick locations to maximize profits. Build a lasting business in endless Career mode, or chase high scores in a 30-day Challenge mode.

title: Fall Cat
description: Welcome to Fall Cat: a game where you play as a cat, who is immortal...

title: Nock Nock Loose
description: A short incremental tower defense game where you defend your city from enemy armies. Sharpen your archers' aim, unlock powerful abilities in a massive skill tree, and crush every warlord who dares besiege your walls.

title: Cut Cats' Balls
description: Cut Cats' Balls is a 2D management game with a simple art style. In this game, you will become a bully working in a pet hospital, sterilizing cats, bullying colleagues, trying to avoid mistakes, and striving to become the unique employee in the hospital.

title: SurgePoint
description: Craft weapons mid-run, strafe through chaos, chain recoil jumps, spawn platforms out of thin air. Pick cards. Break runs. Repeat.

title: Truco Argentino
description: The Truco you played in school or at a friend’s house — now with bots that trash talk you. You shout “I’m in,” lose with the four of cups, and hit rematch anyway. Because if it doesn’t hurt a little, it’s not Truco.

title: Tail and Сhaos
description:
Tail and Chaos is a colorful top-down action roguelite about a caravan of meerkats crossing a dangerous world. Choose one of three heroes, combine weapons and upgrades across eight shared slots, unlock synergies and evolutions, and survive 30-minute acts filled with branching routes, events, elite enemies, and bosses.

Journey through scorching dunes, a moonlit riverbed, and the Plateau of Dawn in three standalone acts or connect them in an Expedition. Choose a Caravan Law and a rescued specialist, carry one non-starter item between fresh builds, and continue later from a saved camp. Earn coins for permanent upgrades, complete achievements, and fill an encyclopedia as the caravan grows.

title: Flux Heroes
description: Flux Heroes is a side-scrolling beat ’em up focused on high-freedom combo combat. Fight through horizontal stages and boss battles with no fixed strings—launch, juggle, knock back, interrupt, and wall-bounce enemies to create your own skill-driven flow.

title: HoloBase
description: Enjoy real baseball action with hololive talents!! Create your own team with talents, fans, and mascots, and dive into intense, exciting games!

title: Gun Restoration Shop Simulator
description: Run a gun restoration workshop. Take in damaged firearms, dismantle them, and craft missing parts using various tools. Unlock advanced machinery, restore each weapon to its former glory. Track demand, negotiate prices, and run a successful restoration business.

title: Monochrome Echoes: Black
description: Monochrome Echoes White Edition has been boldly reworked into Black Edition, featuring randomized dungeons for endless replayability and Character Creation that lets you use your own favorite images.

title: S.O.N.A.R.: Submarine Operators Not Actually Ready
description: S.O.N.A.R. (Submarine Operators Not Actually Ready) is a 1–4 player online co-op submarine sim where teamwork is essential, panic is inevitable, and sinking is always just one wrong button away. Pilot, fight, repair, and pray your friends know what to do.

title: Overhatched
description: A chaotic 1–4 player couch co-op dinosaur management game where you hatch, raise, and ship dinosaurs through increasingly hectic facilities. Order supplies, manage physical inventory, grow food, and try not to run over your friends with the forklift.

title: Klorbiest Catch
description: Captain a klorb fishing boat on the Klorbing Sea, a modern-day gold rush over the world's most unpredictable waters. Bait & drop catch pots, manage a crew with minds of their own, and out-klorb your rival captains before the quota runs out.

title: Grommet Chod
description: Grommet Chod is a turn-based creature battler in which you assemble a team, strategize powerful synergies, and restore mankind’s lost data. Combat the corruption of cyberspace in a single-player roguelike, or battle rivals online in multiplayer!

title: Drawchemy
description: Your drawings come alive! Draw, build, and improvise your way home in this physics-based roguelike platformer. Escape a shifting realm of magic and alchemy, where creativity is your greatest tool.

title: 27 Survivors
description: Over a century ago, you and 99 other passengers left Earth aboard a colony ship in stasis. Now, the ship has awakened you early and you find only you and 26 other passengers remain. Make repairs and keep yourself alive while you investigate what happened to the rest of the passengers.

title: Black Well Devil
description: Ascend from the depths of hell in Black Well Devil, the stylish high-stakes platformer. Flick yourself into the air to reach higher heights, fall again and again, fight challenging bosses, and mayhaps fall in love.

title: Palettopia
