description: Palettopia is a cozy city builder about creating minimalistic cities with the stroke of your paintbrush. Explore infinite islands & solve puzzles while building synergy between the serene landscapes & urban districts. Discover vibrant biomes as you paint your way to paradise and create your utopia.

title: Moon Miner
description: Drill into a dead moon, haul glowing ore, sell your load, and upgrade your mole-bot for the next risky descent. A compact mining adventure inspired by Motherload and I Dig It, with cozy progression, dangerous depths, and something alive below.

title: We Pretend
description: A PS1-style psychological horror game about a student pulled into a surreal hub of locked doors and broken memories, where each step deeper reveals the town’s buried secrets and the truth behind what everyone chose to ignore.

title: Dung Slinger
description: An action-packed physics platformer about being chained to a giant dung ball! Master a complex movement system to move, swing and launch yourself forward. Defeat enemies, overcome obstacles and regain your freedom in a game that blends traditional platforming with a tight physics system!

title: John Gleep
description: John Gleep is a tiny alien with a big problem. His casino is a failure and he owes the mob a galaxy. Solution? Fly from planet to planet and forcibly abduct gamblers to boost business, pay off your debt, and fix your failed marriage in this unexplainable intergalactic action-roguelike mashup.

title: The Subminer
description: An atmospheric underwater drilling roguelite beneath the icy crust of Enceladus. Pilot your submarine, explore the depths, mine resources through procedural caves and upgrade your base. Each dive is darker and more dangerous, and you must face the terrors lurking in the shadows. Live. Dive. Repeat.

title: Super Battle Golf: Attack on City
description:
New Features in Attack on City:
- New City Biome with 9 new holes and traffic hazards
- 7 Forest maps
- 2 Desert Maps
- Team Mode
- 5 New Items
- More cosmetics: Shoes and ball in hole effects added!
- 6 New Achievements

title: Thorner
description:
Thorner is a dark, disturbing horror visual novel with three endings.

You are Colin Snead, a military veteran. Haunted by your time in the service, you flee to the Scottish wilderness attempting to escape your past. However, you will find that spilled blood is not easily forgiven, and you are not alone. The land knows what you did. The land judges. Thorner awaits.

title: Forest 6174
description: A brief narrative-driven psychological horror experience in first person (no jumpscares, story and dialogue-focused). You play as Danny, who is unexpectedly summoned to receive a break from his daily routine... However, things start to look out of place once you get deeper into the forest.

title: Rocket Buddies
description: Join the rocket kingdoms to explode your friends and get the crown! In this chaotic 2D PvP rogue-like platformer, amass crazy cumulative powerups through multiple rounds to break the game and become the rocket king or queen. But if you and your friends choose the same powerup, no one gets it!

title: Wake Up, Lia!
description: Help Lia overcome her nightmares in a side-scrolling adventure across emotionally themed stages!

title: Meow Moments: Celebrating Frost & Flora
description: Join cute cats in a cozy getaway! Find feline friends and pop balloons as you explore a snowy winter village and a peaceful Japanese cherry blossom park.

title: Blast'N Bounty
description: Engage in retro vertical scrolling shoot’em up mayhem as Quad the frog bounty hunter!

title: Usa-Jong: Haja-ou no Fukkatsu
description: Usa-Jong is a Mahjong game developed by Compile for its first Special Edition release of its Disc Station digital magazine for MSX2.

title: Rain Station Z
description: Multiplayer Open World Zombie Survival. The acid rain never stops, neither do the dead. Survive the apocalypse alone or with friends.

title: Ashrun Survivors
description: Fight endless hordes in Ashrun Survivors, a dark fantasy bullet heaven roguelite. Build powerful weapon evolutions, unlock lasting upgrades, and push deeper into dangerous runs where every choice shapes your survival.

title: B-Prison Unchain
description: In this turn-based RPG, play as Misa, the supposedly strongest soldier in the Demon Realm, as she hunts down the legendary incubus Asmodeus. Battle through the succubi prison, recruit allies, and survive nasty traps, but beware! The enemies sent after you have plenty of tricks to slow you down!

title: Isemono
description:
Isemono is a visual novel with a linear story and no branching choices, as it follows the original novel, which has been officially published with an ISBN. The game features a fantasy and adventure setting, with isekai, comedy, and slice-of-life as its subgenres.

The visual novel includes standard VN features such as Save, Load, Auto, Skip, Log, Gallery, Achievements, and support for two languages. In addition to the main story, players can enjoy several minigames, including a quiz game, a short battle game, and the YoichiOut game.

title: HimaNatsu: Of Churches, Sunflowers, and Long Summers
description: The classic visual novel "HimaNatsu" from the critically acclaimed developer Makura is finally available in English for the first time! Weave a cheerful yet sometimes painful tale of promises and redemption together with the Oboshiro Choir Squad in this never-ending summer vacation.

title: Fianna
description: Fianna is a historical fantasy otome visual novel loosely based on Irish mythology. Our heroine, Una, must play the role of a Witch when her fate intertwines with a band of mercenaries known as the Fianna.

title: Select Eleven
description:
The best in class management game for cricket. Take charge of the club and lead them to glory.

Major features include Scouting, Transfers, Youth academy, 180 clubs across 7 nations

title: Goblin and Recipes: Match-3 Adventure
description: A cozy fantasy Match-3 where every completed chapter unlocks a real traditional Balkan recipe. Cook, match, and fill your goblin cookbook.

title: Aisle Survive
description:
Aisle Survive is a retail rogue-like, a deli-crawling dystopia and a supermarket survivor like no other. The customers will crush you. The banana skins are baying for your blood. Finish the job before the job finishes you.

Survive a week at the last human-run store in Mech City. Melee, multi-task and manage your stress to meet your boss' crushing standards - and stop the revolution.

title: A Lighthouse Tale
description:
A Lighthouse Tale is a first-person narrative adventure about memory, loss and
self-discovery. After inheriting his grandfather's remote island lighthouse, Ethan begins a
journey through forgotten places and fragmented memories, uncovering the truth behind his
past through exploration, environmental storytelling and light puzzle-solving.

title: K.H.L.E.E
description: A retro roguelike deckbuilder set in a corporate dystopia. Players log into the K.H.L.E.E. terminal, arrange tiles by number, shape, and color to meet shifting quotas, build a deck of modifier cards, choose a branching path through a working week, and face bosses that alter the board and rules.

title: Sudoku Classic 2
description: Customizable Sudoku with the feel of writing with a pen on paper and the ease of playing a video game.

title: Jupiter-Saturn: Testing Conviction
description: "Jupiter-Saturn:testing conviction" is a space-themed Visual Novel, with choices that affect the plot.The story follows a scientist and his struggle against the enemies he encounters along the way

title: A Love Like Broken Glass
description: You're an exorcist. Lorenn's a half-ghost. It's up to you to find out what's wrong with his soul and exorcise him once and for all... Just try not to fall in love in the process, would you?

title: Mr. Fat's Chopstick Challenge
description: Mr. Fat's Chopstick Challenge is a colorful arcade game starring a large cat named Mr.Fat! Help Mr. Fat learn to use chopsticks by scooping different foods on his conveyor belts.

title: The Colors of Love: Re-Colored
description: A romantic visual novel about connection, choices, and the colors of the heart. Features an animated Live2D love interest, multiple endings, English and Spanish support, Steam achievements, and hidden secrets to uncover.

title: Pup Boy Cowboy: Infinite Desert Edition
description: Dive into a classic arcade-style shooter featuring slick gameplay, goofy enemies, and increasing difficulty that’ll push your reflexes to the edge.

title: The Cave Exit
description: A challenging and small dungeon crawler with a top-down perspective. Find the Gem of Protection to protect the village from evil spirits. Pick apart rocks, find some loot, sell gems, solve small puzzles and upgrade your stats.

title: Sheep Dog
description: As a sheepdog, collect as many sheep as you can in your hutches within a minute and compete for scores with sheepdogs from around the world!

title: The Ogre King
description: A small-scale 3D roguelike adventure about Grom, a one-eyed ogre wandering through a broken world. Simple battles, quiet stories, and moments of unexpected charm.

title: The Rogue
description: The Rogue combines classic turn based RPG goodness with action based combat, creating a hybrid RPG experience. Quickly cut through your foes, or slow down and tackle groups of enemies with spells and potions.

title: Check-In Chaos
description: Run your own hotel — solo or in 1–4 player online co-op. Check guests in, cook and serve, run the spa and pool, hire staff, and upgrade your rooms from Standard to Luxury... before it all spirals into glorious chaos.

title: The Tartarus Loop
description: Play as a copy of Theseus. Run around in a maze, having to defeat the very Minotaur in Tartarus after it perished by the hands of the original Theseus. Over and over again. The soul of the Minotaur can't rest. All it can do is chase the player and try to outsmart you.

title: Bounty Pro Pulling
description: The first Truck and Tractor Pulling game! Customize your vehicle, name it, tune it, and hop online to compete against others in the most realistic Pulling game yet. Bounty Pro Pulling has in depth tuning, paintable vehicles, and online competitions to test yourself against pullers across the world.

title: Whispers In The Woods
description: Ellie wakes up lost in a dense, fog-covered forest with no memory of how they got there. She must navigate through the forest to find a way out.

title: Escape from Grimazel's Cottage
description: A point and click adventure in which you must find, combine and use various mysterious items to help you escape from the witch's house. You must learn magic spells from old books and study objects closely, paying attention to clues in order to proceed. You're going to need a wand!

title: Desktop Driller
description: An idle game that runs while you work. Your activity powers the drill: dig, earn, upgrade and go deeper. Build your system, automate everything and reach the center of the Earth.

title: Gas N Cars
description: Run a chaotic gas station sandbox: fuel cars, clean and repair vehicles, buy wild tools, catch wanted drivers, earn reviews, unlock upgrades, climb the leaderboard, or turn every stop into total mayhem.

title: Grand Theft Timeline
description: Pull a time travel heist with your friends. Operate a makeshift time travel machine to traverse the timeline with 200+ buttons, then arrive at a time era, explore it, find the valuable, and steal it. Just don't get stranded and become part of the timeline yourself. 1-8 players.

title: Rescue Team: Legion of Destruction
description: What began as a scientific breakthrough has spiraled into a nightmare. Now, the Rescue Team needs your help to stop the brilliant engineer that has betrayed the world. Can you save the world from the man who used to dream of building it?

title: Saving Bumblebrook
description: Recruit townsfolk and complete outlandish schemes in this solo strategy card game where every success reshapes the Wanted Board. Plan arrests, orchestrate jailbreaks, unlock recruit abilities, and drive a corrupt Mayor out of town before the rebellion collapses.

title: Magical Charming!
description:
An all ages version of Magical Charming!

Ritsu Natsumoto was unhappy because he had an unproductive summer vacation. One day he wakes up in a strange room where he meets a girl called Orietta, she reveals he is a magic user and takes him to Wizure Mahou Gakuin, a magical school. However, only girls should be able to use magic!
Ritsu starts his new school life while investigating the reasons behind his power.

title: RPS: The Escape
description: RPS: The Escape is an atmospheric card game that expands rock-paper-scissors with damage, chance dices, items and changing room rules. Players must defeat the opponents in five rooms and find a way out.

title: Max Goes by Bus, Train and Ship
description: Suddenly, a terrible disaster befalls the lighthouse near Max's home: the old caretaker has fallen ill, and now there's no one around to replace the old lamp. Joining Max, young players will embark on a journey through the town and meet its inhabitants.

title: Citadel Zero
description: Defend the last citadel on a dying alien world. Summon a gacha collection of bio-engineered defense towers, forge a custom loadout, and conquer three modes, story-driven Chronicle, roguelite Contracts, and 1v1 PvP Ascension. Tower defense meets deck-building meta-progression.

title: Mary Skelter: Locked Up in Love – Blood High
description:
A spin-off that was included as a Japan only pre-order bonus for Mary Skelter 2 on the Playstation 4. It was also included in Mary Skelter: Finale's "Adventure Mode".

Set in a private high school called Blood High, many students with strange abilities study and enjoy their youth at the school. The spooky Jail Tower looms over the school grounds. There are rumors that if a couple confesses to each other under the Tower, they will be bound forever and ascend to the top.

The story begins with Jack, who has a surprise birthday party coming up that he has to pretend he doesn't know about and choose a girl to confess to under the Jail Tower.

title: Mary Skelter: Locked Up in Love - True End
description:
The sequel to Mary Skelter Finale and the final part of the Mary Skelter series.
It was first released as a pre-order bonus for the Japanese version of Mary Skelter Finale, and then included in the base game for the international release.

title: Fortress Connected
description: Jump in and experience the tense action of Half-Life 2, Left 4 Dead, and many other worlds as your favourite gang of Mann Co. hired guns, as well as a few new faces in this crossing of various source engine worlds.

title: Room 0
description: A first-person horror game about a detective investigating an abandoned research facility, a missing girl named Carla, and the sealed room at the center of it all. Recover VHS tapes, follow the tracks left behind, and avoid what's left inside.

title: B-Run
description: b-Run is an immersive exploration FPS with a bodycam perspective. Navigate the rubble of an isolated environment with an advanced tactile experience on PC.

title: Deadlined.
description: a Psychological Horror where you lose yourself while trying to finish your paperwork before the Deadline.

title: Shellshock
description: You are a British WW1 soldier, trapped in an endless looping trench. Inspect your surroundings and report anything that is out of place. Will you escape? Shellshock is a short anomaly hunting experience (-30 minutes) inspired by liminal spaces and psychological horror.

title: Dark Witch Match!
description: The first-ever competitive puzzle game from the world of The Legend of Dark Witch! Match blocks, build chains, and overwhelm your rival in a Match-3 battler that's easy to learn but deep to master. Play cross-platform climb the global leaderboards, and dive into Story and Score Attack modes.

title: Elysium: Blue Den Mansion
description: A first-person psychological horror game where you explore a mysterious mansion, solve puzzles, uncover dark secrets, and survive a terrifying creature lurking in the shadows.

title: ChildMare
description: Dive into a secret 1980s laboratory where the "Super Kids" program turned into a nightmare. Hunted by Lou, a blind girl transformed into a terrifying monster after a failed experiment, infiltrate the facility, use the environment to your advantage, and try to survive this first chapter.

title: Reawait
description: After falling into a mysterious cave, your survival depends on your reflexes. REAWAIT is an intense underground puzzle-adventure where you must navigate a maze of shifting obstacles. Avoid deadly traps, unlock game-changing abilities, and discover what lies buried beneath the surface.

title: Don't Play Their Game
description: Analyze tapes, identify audio anomalies, and survive each workday as relentless creatures turn a simple job into a desperate game. Don't Play Their Game is a tense first-person horror experience where every mistake could be your last.

title: DarkRay
description: The world was destroyed overnight. Under the ruins of the city are dark catacombs, radioactive sewers and mutated creatures that have made the dungeon their home. You're a cat. And you need to get out.

title: Camp Hollow
description: A first-person survival horror game where you play as Riley, a night guard trapped in an abandoned summer camp. Explore, solve puzzles, and uncover the mystery while escaping a relentless creature that hunts you in the dark.

title: Relive the Fear: Perfect Neighbor
description: Perfect Neighbor is a first-person psychological horror game that explores the gradual erosion of privacy. Witness the story of 23-year-old Maya, who has just moved into her dream home in a quiet American suburb. Remember, maybe it’s not as perfect as you think..

title: Only Good Babysitters Go to Heaven
description: Only Good Babysitters Go To Heaven is a First-Person comedy horror game about being stuck babysitting while the news is expressing that the world around you is ending.

title: Arctic Shift: Fuel Station
description: Operate a remote fuel station deep in the Arctic. Manage customers, supplies and vital systems while surviving brutal weather, wildlife and isolation.

title: Sunny Side Up
description: Sunny Side Up is a cozy 3D parkour adventure game where you guide a brave little egg across a charming farm to reunite w/ your family. Master playful jumps, uncover hidden paths, & explore handcrafted levels on a heartfelt journey full of charm, one careful hop at a time. Can you find your way home?

title: Democracy Manifest
description: Hijack the vote in this 3-7 player social deduction brawl! It’s your job to craft the legislation cards on your desk into crowd-pleasing bills. Juggle with ideologies to play your cards perfectly, rig elections through deals, bribery & manipulation and backstab your closest friends to get ahead.

title: RSVP
description: A first-person party management horror game where you scramble to set up venues, handle chaotic guest incidents, and keep the vibe from collapsing before the night spirals out of control. Will you survive?

title: October: Survivor's Guilt
description: October: Survivor's Guilt is an first-person psychological horror game where you explore an unsettling house, interact with objects, and try to survive a terrifying night after a simple favor goes wrong.

title: The Ice Is Watching
description: One last GPS pin. One final hope. Following a GPS pin to the cabin, she thought she was coming for a rescue. She didn't know she was stepping into a frozen trap. Stranded and hunted by 'The Ice', you must keep the fire alive to survive the night. Uncover the chilling truth before you become his art

title: A Lucky Hunt With: Myrina
description: Embark on a sensual ladybug-hunting adventure with Myrina, an attractive young woman. In this hidden object game, explore each location to discover what lies beneath Myrina's enticing layers.

title: Just a Regular Night Patrol
description: 'Just A Regular Night Patrol' is a first-person simulation game. Over the course of 8 days, review and execute your daily tasks based on the instructions. No jumpscares or anomalies. The goal is to simply be an ordinary night security guard and complete your shifts without making mistakes.

title: Vecchio Furioso
description: An old school FPS set in the lawless of 1962 rural Isan, Thailand. Step into the worn sandals of an old veteran fighting off ruthless local debt collectors and bandits. Scavenge weapons, survive dynamic tropical storms, and clear your debt in an uncompromising sandbox of mechanical freedom.

title: H.O.A Simulator
description: HOA Sim is a comedic suburban patrol game where you enforce neighborhood rules as an overzealous homeowners association officer. Cruise the streets, inspect properties, issue citations, and chase your daily fine quota while balancing speed, accuracy, and pure petty power.

title: The Night Archive: No Service
description: The Night Archive is an episodic first-person horror series where each episode tells a story pulled from the darkest corners of true crime. These are the stories of those who lived to tell about it.

title: ChickenPlaguePolice
description: A deadly Chicken Plague has destroyed the world. As a guard of humanity’s last safe zone, you must inspect survivors seeking refuge and identify the infected. One mistake could doom the entire community, so examine everyone carefully before allowing them inside.

title: Queen Must Die
description: Queen Must Die - 3d horror set in dark fantasy world. Rule your empire by day and explore your castle by night. Uncover the royal family's sinister secrets and confront the horrors seeking to destroy you.

title: Aralsk 7
description: Atmospheric psychological horror from Uzbekistan. Explore the abandoned territories of the Aral Sea, face your fears, and uncover the dark secrets of the Aralsk-7 station. Survive in a world where the line between reality and nightmare is blurred.

title: Don’t Pop!: Splash Race
description: A physics-based online party racing game where you control a fragile water balloon, bounce through ridiculous obstacles, and race to the goal before you pop.

title: Dig for Your Lives
description: Dig for resources, upgrade your gear and defend your gate against relentless zombie hordes as you uncover the mystery hidden beneath the world. Play solo or with up to 4 players.

title: Drift Vale
description: Fall into Drift Vale — a 3D metroidvania set in a forsaken world of towering cliffs and ancient, deadly spirits. Chain fluid movement, master the boomerang, and unlock hidden powers — it’s the only way to survive the one-way ritual.

title: Bonki D Bonk
description: Survive relentless enemy waves in a fast top-down survival game where your weapons attack for you. Move, dodge, and stack 30+ weapons with 100+ items into screen-filling chaos.

title: Talpoida
description: Talpoida is a single-level PWAD for Doom. It was released in May 1994 by Eddie Nguyen, and is the second in a series of single-level WADs, following UCA and preceding Diopatra and Sapidus.

title: Crescent Break
description: Blast robots, use their pieces to start chain reactions, and navigate your way through destructible levels in this platformer ROGUELIKE. Crescent Break fuses together NES-era robot hero goodness with indie classics. Augment your cyborg suit for ridiculous synergies, and try over and over to survive!

title: Fleetfall: Galaxy Domination
description: Fast real-time space conquest for 1-4 players. Capture planets, launch missile salvos, and outmaneuver friends in 10-minute Deathmatch blitzes — or scheme through 30 minutes of diplomacy, trade and betrayal in Hegemony mode. Cross-play with mobile; bots fill empty seats so a match always starts.

title: CrossSpell
description: Weave words and cross them for massive combos! A competitive crossword puzzle where you freely place letters and "unleash" them to blow up your opponents. No falling blocks! Master deep tactics, play unique rules, or use custom dictionaries in "Deck Spell" mode in up to 4-player battles!

title: Ultimate Chaos Gambling Battle
description: Poker, mahjong, hanafuda, blackjack… Welcome to the ultimate “ULTIMATE CHAOS GAMBLING BATTLE” where every form of gambling has been thrown into a chaotic melting pot! Don’t just understand the rules—master the chaos, bet your entire fortune (ALL-IN), and seize victory!

title: Rain of Awakening
description: Dash and slash your way out of Lovecraftian horrors. Master momentum-based movement to reach seemingly impossible locations. Collect upgrades and shape your own fighting style. Can you save what is left of this doomed world or is it too late?

title: Moonlit Journey: Homestead
description: Purchase your homestead, master unique skills, and uncover hidden secrets in a cozy top-down farming RPG where the world transforms through all four seasons.

title: Dream House Cleaning
description: Bring forgotten places back to life in a cozy cleaning and restoration game! Clean dirt and trash, repair damaged areas, decorate interiors with furniture, and enjoy a relaxing experience at your own pace.

title: Warm Like Flesh
description:
Warm Like Flesh is a short 2D rpg game with visual novel and point-and-click elements.

You are a technician tasked with maintaining a sentient, humanoid computer named "CATHODE" who has the tendency to murmur cryptic and flirtatious lines. Your job? Keep Cathode "alive" by reconnecting their frayed neural pathways (wires) while navigating their unsettlingly intimate commentary.

title: The Quiet Order
description: Simple rules. Deep logic. A minimalist puzzle game with puzzles for every skill level and new challenges every day. Escape, focus, and find your flow.

title: A Day to Remember
description: Play as aino, she has secret feelings for her childhood friend name Rain, can she possibly confess her feelings to rain before the day ends or will it be to late and will she lose her childhood friend Rain forever?

title: Step Lightly
description: There's no place like home - and yours is no home at all. Play as Rosa, a neglected child trying to escape her abusive family. Sneak out, but be ever so quiet. Mom is listening, dad is angry, and your big sister is always watching…

title: Chest Buster
description: An incremental battle game where destroying treasure chests instantly brings item effects into battle to fight enemies. Break all the seals on the Abyss Chest and liberate the great being who will save the world!

title: Stay: Your Forever Pet!
description: A cozy pet sim where you raise Ember, your magical fox-like companion. Bring her home, care for her, and venture into the Otherlands together -- deepening your bond one adventure at a time.

title: Brave Joe
description: Step into the life of Joe Martin, a detective haunted by secrets in his childhood town. Uncover the truth of his father’s death, face eerie encounters, and navigate dark challenges.

title: Out Here
description:
You take a job on a lonely island. Watch the sea. Report anything unusual.

But something feels wrong. And it's your job to find out.

title: Antumbra Saga
description: Venture into a sprawling campaign set on the Pacific Coast. In Antumbra Saga you will rise from a lowly shadowrunner to a pivotal player in the struggle between CalFree and Tir Tairngire. Along the way you’ll nurture alliances, build up a party, and make decisions that will affect your fate and that of the factions you encounter.

title: Touhou: Beyond Gensokyo
description: Discover the mysteries of Gensokyo through the lens of Shin, a photographer from the outside world. In this immersive visual novel, join forces with the shrine maiden Reimu Hakurei to unravel the truth behind this incident and stop the enigmatic Kurohana.

title: Shadows In Sanluca
description:
In the heart of a bustling Latin-American city, between the sounds of droning sirens and booming church bells, a family quietly mourns the death of someone they once cherished.

Attune your ears carefully to the echoes of the past, listen in on the memories of a forgotten home and disentangle the tragic and sinister story of the family who once lived there.

Identify characters by name, connect them to a growing web of connections, and even find out secret identities in this Return of the Obra Dinn and Roottrees are Dead inspired story.

title: Heroine
description: Our guy transferred to a new school. He is just in time to save the school theater club from being canceled. He gets to pick his heroine out of 3 girls for their next play. He also has to set schedule for set building, customs making, and practicing. Well, no matter, he still has time to chase the 5 club girls and 2 others.

title: Forgotten Station
description: Forgotten Station is a knowledge-based narrative game, where you travel aboard trains to find your way out of a time loop. Your curiosity and observation skills will be put to the test in this relaxing game, filled with atmospheric places to uncover, characters to meet, and real human stories.

title: The Glitcher 2D
description: The Glitcher is a top-down 2D survival game inspired by games like Vampire Survivors, NEOHELL, and classic retro arcade titles.

title: That Bomb Game
description: A dangerous bomb game up to 12 players where you'll have to type words fast to save yourself from exploding. Use power-up cards to control the game, only the last player standing wins.

title: Exorcist Candy
description: Your daughter is possessed by an evil entity. Be a Dad and exorcise her.

title: The Referee Committee
description: Football isn't only played on the pitch. Manage the dark side of football! Control the referee committee, give secret instructions, use the VAR room to dictate scores, deal with the betting mafia, and shape the season's fate. Keeping this powerful seat is harder than getting it.

title: Gears of War 2: Hollow
description: A custom community build of Gears of War 2.

title: Ride Up Together
description: Ride, climb, kick, and survive! Ride Up Together is an online co-op motorcycle climbing game for 1–8 players. As you try to reach the summit, kick your friends to knock them off, overcome crazy physics-based obstacles, and don’t let even the smallest mistake send you back to the bottom!

title: Solaire
description: Solaire is the hot-blooded RPG where each of your party members has a unique twist on turn-based combat.

title: Please Praise the SR Girls!
description: Please praise them! The international edition of Please Praise the SR Girls! is now on Steam. An ordinary boy discovers that he is an SR boy and enters a mysterious girls' academy, where he meets four other SR girls., and helps them grow through love and companionship in a sweet youthful romance.

title: Lettro
description:
Lettro is a strategy roguelike disguised as a word game. The player does not need minutes staring at a board trying to form words. They simply pick the letters they want, and the game automatically forecasts every valid combination at once! They can discard what they don't need, play the hand, and trigger to achieve the target score.
Lettro supports multiple language options. Since the game automatically calculates all valid combinations, the player can jump into a completely unfamiliar language without needing to know a single word.

title: Fuck Stalin
description: Avenge millions of innocent victims and inflict brutal violence on the communist dictator Joseph Stalin using a wide range of torture tools thanks to the blessing of the free market.

title: Drift Shell
description: Fast high impact third-person arena mech combat! boost, fly, and blast your way through the battle field! Choose how you want to approach combat with highly customizable mechs and weapon builds. Face off against other players in online faction conquest wars or host private game lobbies.

title: Blackdoor
description: You're a hacker with a terminal and four terrible scripts. Rewrite them. Hack servers by writing actual code in a custom scripting language - probe ports, crack passwords, steal data, and get out before the trace completes. Better code = better hacker.

title: Prednovogodnyaya Skazka
description: A drow named Fialka teleports into our world to find the missing piece of her family's pendant. The game is primarily a romantic comedy with elements of a visual novel and a movement system inspired by classic JRPGs.

title: 4Spicchi
description: The 4Spicchi pizzeria is under attack by terrifying food-monsters, and only Margherita can stop them. How? Using their ingredients... and a little bit of science!

title: Azure Infinity
description: Mecha × Tactics! Azure Infinity is a turn-based tactical Strategy RPG set in a sci‑fi world. As an SRT member of the secret mercenary organization Yggdrasill, you will command the huge humanoid weapon RAIV to carry out a range of missions and confront the crisis approaching this world.

title: Missing Truth
description:
Something is lurking in the shadows, and the truth has been buried deep. Can you uncover it before it’s too late?

Missing Truth is an atmospheric psychological horror game where every clue matters and nothing is as it seems. Step into a world wrapped in mystery, explore eerie environments, and piece together the fragments of a dark secret that everyone else wants forgotten.

title: Welcome to a Sexy, Underworld!
description: The sequel to "Welcome to a Sexy, Open World!"

title: CD Market
description: CD Market is a music industry management sim where you build a record label on your own terms, from vinyl to digital. Stay small, or grow into something bigger. Discover artists, shape careers, and survive decades of changing formats, trends, rivals, and crises.

title: Fish to Cats: Catch & Feed
description: Loads of fish! Loads of cats! Sail out to sea, charm every furball on Cat Island with fresh catch. Live your cozy ocean cat life!

title: Icha Icha Steady
description: Study § Steady's fandisc focused on Omaezaki Yuu

title: Icha x2 Study Yuno: Dear Future
description: Study § Steady 2's fandisc focused on Mamanoue Yuno

title: Grilluminati
description: Start a cult with friends and summon one of three rivalling gods. Sacrifice customers, perform dark rituals and work together to bring an ancient evil being into the world, all under the cover of a steakhouse.

title: Steel Princess
description: A Souls‑like 3D action game starring a spirited princess. Defeat powerful foes scattered across the open field to unlock new skills, grow stronger, and keep pressing forward!

title: Murder Butterfly: Kotou Idol Live Satsujin Jiken
Misty Forest: The Parkour Game
description: Step into a breathtaking forest where every jump brings you closer to the summit. Climb through a massive parkour course suspended above rivers, ancient cabins, towering pine trees, and mysterious wilderness. Precision, timing, and determination are the only things standing between you and the top.

title: Grand Cru: The Wine Maker
description: Grand Cru: The Wine Maker is a turn-based wine-making tycoon set in Bordeaux. Score your terroir, age vintages in oak, and balance the four pillars of quality — then out-negotiate 25 unique buyers with your own pricing strategy while volatile weather RNG threatens every harvest. From terroir scoring to Michelin-star contracts, every vintage is a high-stakes economic calculation where critics and the public pull in different directions.

title: The Lure
description: John is a detective searching for a missing colleague. He finds himself trapped in a mysterious loop where reality constantly changes. Explore eerie environments, interact with clues, and uncover the truth behind the disappearance in this third-person psychological horror experience.

title: Shady Job
description: A co-op adventure game. The mafia wants to get rid of a body. You’re construction workers. Your job: carry a body bag to the top of a skyscraper. Bury it in concrete. Two problems. First: You have to build the way up. Second: The body’s not dead. It fights back.

title: Black Spades
description:
Black Spades is a culturally rooted spades game featuring Jokers, Deuces, Reneg, Blinds, and more house rules, realistic gameplay, competitive leaderboards, unlockable rewards, and cross‑platform play. Built to match the origins of spades from the African American communities, it delivers fast action, social energy, and competition.

Fast, smooth card mechanics and intuitive controls keep every hand feeling like the real thing, whether you’re learning the ropes or proving you’re the best at the table. As you play, you’ll climb competitive leaderboards, unlock new locations, earn avatar upgrades, and jump into prize‑based contests. Black Spades blends culture, competition, and community into a single experience.

title: Riftslayer
description: Riftslayer is a fast-paced 3D action roguelite. Fight massive waves of enemies, combine weapons and perks into powerful builds, and face dangerous bosses. Every run becomes more chaotic, more powerful, and more unpredictable.

title: The Hust Banhmi
description: The sequel to Brother Hai's Pho Restaurant! While a manhunt unfolds elsewhere, in an unrelated development, you're a HUST student selling Banh Mi at the legendary Parabol Gate. Manage your cart and keep the sales booming!

title: Scorching Light
description:
Scorching Light is a horror-action-platformer game with puzzle elements.
Any light enemy, item or liquid will kill the protagonist.
The core mechanic of my game is that you can hide from the light enemies by blending into the environment.

title: Spirit Cleansers
description: Explore a haunted estate, track down cursed objects, and engage in Turn-Based Strategy. During turn-based combat, fight as both priest and warrior synergizing their unique abilities to quell the spiritual mischief plaguing the estate!

title: Starlocked
description: A voxel-based first-person roguelite miner set in an alternate future where the Cold War never ended. You take on the role of a convict forced to labor in a space prison. Fly out into the machine infested asteroid field and gather resources to pay off your debt.

title: Splimbo City
description: By day, you're just another data entry drone at Splimbocorp. By night, you fight in underground clubs. But someone at the top is pulling both strings.

title: Gianpierino Adventures 2
description: Gianpierino Adventures 2 is a dynamic adventure platformer that sends you, the player taking control of Gianpierino, on a quest to save the world from a mysterious threat. Joined by an undefeatable sidekick and other friends, you navigate through ever-evolving levels using well-known mechanics such as an umbrella parachute, hot air balloons and character-launching cannons. Blending classic platforming and boss fights completely different from each other, the game challenges you to complete Gianpierino's mission.

title: Boomer
description: Boomer is a chaos-filled co-op horror game for up to 6 players. Inhabit a zany cast of customizable puppet characters as you explore derelict environments, encounter forgotten monsters and play a deadly game of hot potato with everyone's favorite little rascal, Boomer!

title: Please One More Block
description: Please One More Block is a puzzle platformer with asynchronous cooperative elements. Clear stages using blocks left by previous players, and leave a block behind for the next one!

title: Swtchr
description: A retro-styled 2D platformer game with speedrunning in mind.

title: The Last Comfort
description: The Last Comfort follows Tedd, a fiercely loyal teddy bear who awakens in this dreamscape on a desperate mission to heal and save his owner. The child's mind has manifested hostile dreams, memories, and nightmares overrun by the creeping sickness.

title: Sarah's House
description: Sarah’s House is a story-focused 3D dating game centered around relationships, desire, and complicated emotions. As you live with Sarah and her family, you slowly uncover the cracks in their marriage and become part of the growing emotional tension within the house.

title: Guilty Gear: Strive - Additional Character 18 - Jam Kuradoberi
description: Adds Jam Kuradoberi to the roster of playable characters and 9 colors (No.1~6, 13~15) for the character.

title: Ramen://Protocol
description:
Ramen://protocol is a cyberpunk ramen-stall roguelite deckbuilder.

Players aim to complete 10 days of business operations while upgrading their skills and toppings.

title: Guilty Gear: Strive - Additional Character 19 - Robo-Ky
description: Adds Robo-Ky to the roster of playable characters and 9 colors (No.1~6, 13~15) for the character.

title: Grizzy & the Lemmings: Crazy Party
description: Turn your living room into a chaotic playground! 50 mini-games, 1-4 players on the couch, one goal: grab the Yummy before your friends, while Grizzy does everything to ruin it.

title: DAc0da
description: The destroyed Numidium suddenly appears off the coast of Solitude. The prisoner will work with the Psijic Order to help expel the Numidium from the timeline.

title: Porcelain Heart
description: Porcelain Heart is an interactive visual novel with multiple endings following the story of Mary. It was made as a submission to TOXIC YURI VN JAM 2 on itch.io.

title: SchoolBoy OutDoors
description: You’re a schoolboy who ran away from home to hang out — but this is only the beginning! Summer, friends, backyard mischief… and mysteries hiding something much darker. Explore the streets, avoid adults, and uncover a secret you were better off not knowing.

title: Dark Rail
description: Turn-based management roguelike. Command the Inquisition and rule an industrial city on the empire’s edge. Use your train to meet prisoner shipment quotas by hunting heretics and slaying magical beasts. Produce supplies, contain revolt, and sacrifice prisoners to stop the madness.

title: Awakeness
description: Awakeness is a first-person psychological horror set in Barzakh, a higher layer of reality where space and emotion distort. Explore looping corridors, solve subtle environmental puzzles, and evade an unseen presence using stealth and light.

title: Sunlit Trail: Complete Edition
description: The Sunlit Trail is a mod collection for Rain World which adds new connected regions to the game including Necropolis, The Ascent, Gray Urban, Chasing Wind, Moss Fields, Far Shore, Pilgrims' Ascent and Scorched District. It works as a fan made "expansion" to the game.

title: MXGP 26: The Official Game
description: Dominate the track, feel every impact, every rut, every victory. The most intense and realistic motocross experience is finally available. Experience the entire 2026 championship, with its official tracks and riders.

title: Duelgrounds
description: Duelgrounds is a fast-paced 1v1 FPS where every round brings a new weapon and every decision matters. Master the entire arsenal, manage limited resources, and outplay your opponents through skill, strategy, and adaptation.

title: I Will Do It Soon Maybe Later Tomorrow
description: A short narrative visual novel about procrastination, family, and the inner dialogue of a creative person. A story about how delaying decisions slowly erodes a life.

title: Sweet Dreams Café
description: Build your dream café in the heart of Paris in this premium (no in game purchases) match experience. Match pastries, meet eccentric characters, make story choices, and transform a corner café into a world-renowned hotspot. Unlock stylish upgrades, and serve up dreams with every level! Bon appétit!

title: I'm Loopy for Doop Loops!!!
description: You are Loopy, a cereal mascot with a crazy cereal addiction! Beam mall cops and competing mascots with groceries, reclaim your cereal, and take down the bumbling Cereal Protection Task Force in this fast‑paced arcade action adventure!

title: Charm & Clue
description: Charm & Clue - an exciting detective adventure with mysteries, puzzles and secrets in the atmospheric world of the 50s-60s

title: Declutterer
description: Declutterer is a tidying and storage simulation game. Take on commission requests from various clients, clear clutter and arrange items as required, and restore a spotless, tidy look to every space.

title: One Death at a Time
description: One Death at a Time is a first-person exploration game. You play as John, in the middle of a midlife crisis. A suspicious milk carton offers you a wish in exchange for 14 souls… but because you're a good person, you'll have to die yourself and explore the city in search of 14 ways to do it.

title: Finding Lake Chewaucan
description: You’re a time-traveling detective with a bone to uncover. Hunt for clues, solve puzzles and complete minigames to unlock pieces of the past and identify fossil animals.

title: Aces of Avalon
description: Soar into 2334! Pilot cutting-edge jets in intense aerial dogfights against alien invaders. Upgrade your fighter with credits to dominate the skies.

title: Target Dragon 2: Maze Runner
description: A single-player fantasy RPG. Navigate labyrinths, solve puzzles, complete quests, and upgrade your character. Battle monsters, enhance pets, mine resources, fish, and explore countless activities!

title: True of Voice: A Duat Deckbuilder
description: True of Voice is a roguelike deckbuilder set inside the Egyptian afterlife. Your deck is a scroll — utterances chosen for your funeral, words that are instructions to reality. Cross twelve hours of the Duat toward the Hall of Two Truths. Every card you play is spoken aloud. Every transgression is written in the heart. The scale does not lie.

title: Bon Vivant: Plan the Perfect Party
description: Master the art of the party in one hour runs where every choice matters: the food, the furniture, and above all, the guestlist. Discover 40 playable characters from Paris’s hedonistic golden age and learn which strategies will turn them into the perfect host.

title: Going Nowhere
description: After a hole in the road appears, you are stuck in a mysterious dream town. Discover the meaning of it all as you traverse the town and meet the strange inhabitants.

title: CH13: Rest Stop
description: CH13: Rest Stop is a psychological horror game set in early 2000s Poland. What begins as a calm drive through the woods turns into something you weren't prepared for... Will you find out what awaits at the end of the road?

title: Into the End (Of the World)
description: Drive, maintain, and survive. Explore procedural biomes in a post-apocalyptic world, scavenge for parts, and fight infected zones with friends. Build your survival machine from the chassis up and keep it running - because without it, you wont get far.

title: Spirit Axis
description: A surreal dark-fantasy action adventure RPG built on an eightfold spiritual system, where sin, virtue, and balance shape your experience.

title: Hapervil
description: Play as Amaya and Will, navigating a forsaken orphanage where secrets lurk in the dark. Solve puzzles, uncover hidden truths, and survive a psychological horror tale where innocence twists into nightmare and shadows patiently wait to strike.

title: Internet Cafe Tycoon
description: Run a 2000s-era LAN cafe. Hire a literal ghost apprentice, dodge municipal inspections, keep rival groups from fighting on your bench, and ride the chaos through a 30-day campaign.

title: Honey Coming Clair Mini Fan Disc
description: A mini fandisc for Honey Coming focused on Maezono Clarissa Satsuki.

title: Kota: The Survival
description: KOTA: The Survival is a post-apocalyptic sandbox survival and re-greening game. Control a restoration robot, scavenge human waste to upgrade, fight corrupted machines, and bring life back to a barren world.

title: Stick Scholars
description: A social deduction party game where players parkour to school, answer trivia, and hunt down a hidden Class Clown who is sabotaging to try and make the entire group fail!

title: Vanya Online
description: Vanya Online is a dark free-to-play idle MMORPG set in a persistent online world. Train skills, hunt monsters and global bosses, collect rare items, trade with other players, and progress without level or skill caps across PvP and Non-PvP worlds.

title: Utterance
description: Utterance is a Lovecraftian Western roguelite deckbuilder where you forge words, trigger unique Edicts, learn forbidden Eldritch language, and battle creatures that twist your deck, your rules, and your sanity.

title: The Sensifier
description: A device capable of turning inanimate objects into sentient beings. Danny, a prisoner serving a life sentence, is forced to befriend these objects in the hope of earning a reduced sentence.

title: Idle Fleet
description: Build your mining fleet in a persistent online universe where every player helps shape the economy. Train 7 skills, automate production with drones, trade on the player-driven market, and forge the legendary Vanguard hull while your fleet keeps working on the server.

title: Koi Frenzy
description: A fast-paced arcade game where every second counts. Catch koi fish, build combos, beat your high score, and compete against players worldwide in one-minute runs that are easy to learn but hard to master.

title: Eastern Block Summer
description: Make your babushka proud and find all hidden objects in this cozy game with a hint of eastern European nostalgia. 10 black and white illustrations with hundreds objects fo find that get colors when you finish it. Made by an illustrator-developer duo it is entirely hand drawn, with no AI involved.

title: The Doll Museum
description: This 2D psychological horror game traps you in a pastel-pink doll museum, where you help Valentine to survive the cruel Doll Queen!

title: Celebrity Memory - 12in12 Game 1
description: Flip cards until you find matching pictures! Celebrity Memory is a spin on the classic memory card game, with hand-drawn art and additional mechanics, all in a cute and cozy package. This game is a part of a "12 games in 12 months" project

title: My Life as a Spy
description: The original 2D version of My Life as a Spy, released in June 2001.

title: Node Zero
description: Investigate system failures, trace corrupted infrastructure, and keep the node alive before stability reaches zero. NODE ZERO is an interface-driven psychological horror game where something inside the system is learning how you work.

title: Below The Blades
description: A manual climbing horror game set on an offshore wind turbine during a storm.

title: Kioskeria: Summer Breeze
description: Run and manage your own cooking kiosk business. Serve customers, earn money, buy new equipment, and expand your menu. Customize your kiosk, design your own menu, and choose your location, whether on the beach, in the city, or in a park. Can you reach 5-star status and make your Old Pa proud?

title: Wiseman: No More Breakups
description: Fight through a moving train in a stylish rhythm-combat boss rush where timed four-button inputs become your attacks. Defeat absurd bosses, survive relationship chaos, and help August Wiseman get his phone back.

title: Rent A Car Together
description: Start by renting your first car. Expand your rental car fleet by purchasing different vehicles and grow your car rental business. Drive your cars and get them fixed when they break down. Find new customers. You can also develop your Rent A Car business by playing Co-Op.

title: Slimecity
description:
Slimecity is a colorful swarm-control roguelite about leading a cheerful little slime family through a bright, bouncy world.

Start each run with a tiny group of adorable slimes and guide them around the city with your cursor. Your slimes wiggle, wobble, and work together as a growing swarm, collecting goobies, exploring new areas, overrunning buildings, and bumping into silly enemies along the way.

Between runs, return to your cozy cave to bank your resources and unlock permanent upgrades. Grow your slime group from a few tiny blobs into a big, playful crowd. Upgrade your starting slime count, carrying capacity, vision, influence range, speed, health, damage, and more through a visual underground skill tree.

Each run lets you push a little farther, discover new enemy spots, collect more resources, and make your slime swarm even cuter, stronger, and more chaotic.

title: No Witnesses
description: No Witnesses is a 2-16 player party game. Play online or with your friends. Somebody in this lobby is a Killer. Nobody saw it happen. Killers hide in the crowd, Bystanders scramble to survive and a Detective works the forensics - while buffs and debuffs drag every round into chaos. Trust no one.

title: Numb Digger
description: The Numb Digger is a grim excavation survival game about forcing a way down through a frozen world while your body, crew, and camp come apart. Carve routes through ice, manage warmth and supplies, recover buried histories, and return before the shaft keeps you.

title: Sortilège
description: A dice duel with someone on the other side of the table. Roll, hold what you like, and commit. Both players reach into the same pool of powers each turn, so every one you take is one your opponent can't have. Climb a ladder of ten rivals in a solo run, winning their dice as you go, or duel a friend online.

title: GeneLoot
description: Collect gear and dress up your favorite characters! A strategic idle RPG with hack-and-slash elements: command up to 6 parties simultaneously to conquer dungeons. With 18 characters and over 100 outfits, optimize your equipment and style your "oshis" to perfection!

title: Mahjong House: Challenge All Achievements
description: This is a single-player Japanese Mahjong game that supports 2-player, 3-player, and 4-player battle modes~

title: Click to Win 5000 Achievement
description: Rhythmic 2D clicker game with Brazilian funk. Simple clicks, constant progress and powerful music create a dynamic atmosphere, and a large number of achievements motivate you to move on.

title: MoneyClicker
description: A minimalist incremental clicker about earning money, upgrading income, and prestiging for endless growth.

title: Collect All These Stones!
description: Cozy Optimization Speedrun-based Idler

title: Oink & Collect
description: Open booster packs, collect absurd pig-themed cards, and complete your ultimate Oink-Collection. One pack every 30 seconds — patience (and luck) required.

title: Kitty Clicker
description: Purrfectly addictive gameplay! Click, collect, and upgrade your way to the top. Dozens of adorable cats await!

title: Bread Dog Vibe
description: A stray dog on the streets just wants to vibe. Type to the beat, build combos, and watch your pup come alive with physics-driven dance moves. How long can you keep the vibe going?

title: What the Dog Doing?
description: What the dog doing? is an abstract action game with the core theme of "meme melee". Its gameplay is to defeat bosses to pass levels. In battles, you need to flexibly dodge attacks, create counterattack opportunities to clear levels, and all intense battles take place in a duel arena.​

title: Gobbo Quest Idle
description: Help Gobbo escape a mysterious cave, grow stronger, collect pets, fight strange bosses, fish, farm, mine, craft, upgrade gear, and continue the adventure in an endless fantasy world.

title: Karakulo 21
description: You've been recruited by ChocoShit S.A. to pay off your debt in the "KK" Program. Open thousands of chocolate bars, feed the insatiable KaraKulo, and pray for the Golden Ticket that will earn your freedom. Upgrade, survive corporate exploitation, and keep working!

title: Project W.E.T.
description: An indie horror game created by the YouTuber GamerCoder.

title: Wreckreation 2
description: Wreckreation 2 is an open-world arcade racing game where every Slam, every Shortcut and every Takedown can change the outcome.

title: Black Veil
description: In Black Veil, you control John Denstoff, an Ashmoor police officer who visits the Veil Corporation to investigate a mysterious fog.

title: No Elevator
description: A claustrophobic guy refuses elevators and climbs a massive building.

title: Satelital
description: A rule-discovery puzzle game where you place alien symbols on a grid. Uncover their logic as you journey through an atmospheric solar system.

title: Shibora Renkare Keiyaku: Hataraku Otona no Onee-san to H na Rental Kareshi Seikatsu
Tidy Up Together
description:
Tidy Up Together is a cozy organizing simulator about restoring your fantasy Adventurer's shop. An evil wizard has blasted all 4,000+ of your products all over the floor - and it's your job to put them back!

Item by item you'll build the shop back to its former tidiness. There's an incredible range of products ranging from potions to sushi. Those Greatswords really shouldn't be mixing with the pineapples...

title: Eyes Wide Open
description: Work for a dystopian Inspection Bureau, Determine whether the subjects are humans or not, Uncover secrets, Endure psychological horrors and reach your work quota - or else.

title: Dokapon 3-2-1: Super Collection!
description: DOKAPON 3-2-1: Super Collection! is a compilation featuring three classic Dokapon titles originally released for the Super Famicom: Kessen! Dokapon Oukoku IV: Densetsu no Yuusha Tachi, Dokapon! 3-2-1: Arashi o Yobu Yuujou, and Dokapon Gaiden: Honoo no Audition. The collection includes quality-of-life improvements such as save anywhere, rewind functionality, adjustable game speed, and enhanced manual features.

title: Bow Down & Eyes Up
description: A training/domination game featuring contemptuous expressions, beautiful feet, gorgeous legs, armpits, high heels, stockings, countdown timers, and scolding dialogues! If you are into ANY of these scenes, this game is an absolute must-buy. You simply won't find anything similar on the market.

title: Ablahshikar
description: Ablahshikar is a turn-based ASCII salvage-survival game adrift on the Candle Sea. Bound to a worn terminal of bone-white and brass, you must strip wrecks and tear organs direct from rival vessels. Graft severed parts onto your keel to rebuild a failing warship into a doomed chimera.

title: Withering State
description: Act as Premier Alexander Sants in a time of stagnation, division, and the falling of walls. Will you steer the brotherly nations of the People's Republic of Sudlivia toward the liberal West, reinforce the crumbling East, or forge a new path? Or even be ousted before becoming the General Secretary?

title: Deep Sea Trophy Fishing
description: Simple fishing game for Windows 98

title: Asobutsuri
description:
A physics action puzzle game in which players freely place items in a virtual space powered by a physics engine, then use their interactions to achieve each stage's goal.

Multiple game modes are available, including "Puzzle" for solving stage-based challenges, "Track Race" for rolling a ball through a course, and "Rocket Doll" for launching a figure as far as possible using rockets. A built-in stage editor allows players to create their own contraptions using joints, rubber, motors, and more — encouraging creative thinking and an understanding of physical principles. Over 100 user-created stages are included.

Winner of the Editorial Award at the 2009 Madonomori Awards.

title: Invincible Vs.: The Immortal - Additional Fighter
description:
A living legend enters the fight! With centuries of combat experience, The Immortal is a highly aggressive and dynamic rushdown character, applying constant pressure and rapid fire attacks to any opponent. Stay in the fight with his Revive mechanic: once per match after being defeated, The Immortal uses 3 bars of super meter to restore a portion of his health and continue the fight while in Berserker Mode.

This content includes:
The Immortal as an additional fighter

title: G-Mode Archives+: Lost Chronicle
description:
This is an original JRPG created exclusively for mobile devices by Bandai Namco Entertainment.

Embark on your adventure by choosing from six elements — Fire, Wind, Earth, Water, Dark, and Light — and a wide range of jobs, including Fencer, Scout, Mage, and Cleric.

title: Tinker Islands
description: Gather your friends and sail a vast ocean filled with wonders and danger in this cozy Caribbean sandbox. Discover islands, gather resources, upgrade your gear, make a new home, and see what's waiting over the next horizon.

title: Two Kinds of People
description: Two Kinds of People is a visual novel about at least two people.

title: Cave Looters
description: Chill co-op cowboy adventure. Up to 2 players!

title: Bone Marrow 2
description: Merge cards to upgrade Upgrade your character Defeat all monsters

title: Aooni2
description:
The latest installment in the legendary horror franchise, Aooni!

Uncover the mystery while fleeing for your life! A pulse-pounding puzzle-horror action-adventure!

This time, the stage is set in a school, featuring two massive, star-studded scenarios!

title: Final Fantasy Resonance: Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
Digital Deluxe Edition Includes:
- Final Fantasy Resonance
- Magitek & Grimoire Deluxe Pack
Pack Contents:
• Magitek Armor Key x1
• Archwitch’s Grimoire x1
• Mastery Ring x1
• Tent x5
• Mist Potion x5
• Mist Ether x5
• Phoenix Down x5
• Remedy x3

title: Denshattack: Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
The Digital Deluxe Edition includes:
- 4 Seasonal Train Skins
- Console Exclusive Skin

title: Trash Raccoon
description: You play as a speedy raccoon on his quest for snacks. Collect fruits that make you strong and break those sweet trash cans open! Unlock fancy skins and powerful upgrades while enjoying hand-crafted art and music.

title: Tremor
description:
A 32 level excursion through a parallel version of Quake, an attempt to evoke the Quake atmospheres of old through the vessel of modern design tools and philosophies.

Featuring the mapping efforts of Ionous, Skacky, onetruepurple, Miss Bubbles, Cardo, Zothique, Kell, Fairweather, negke, Newhouse and Chris Holden. Music by AlekswithaK. Coding by Khreathor. Console image by Biff_Debris.

title: Oomi's Nook
description: Oomi’s Nook is a relaxing and heartwarming sticker decor game. Decorate a cozy little room with hand-drawn style stickers according to the drawing or unleash your creativity! Follow the lighthearted everyday life of the adorable Oomi family and watch them live leisurely in the world you create!

title: BROMS: Battle Royale Management Simulator
description: A management simulation game where you run a battle royale. Host matches to increase revenue from gacha requests, expand the map, and place objects to improve the environment. You can also play on the maps you create yourself.

title: OpenMMO
description:
An MMORPG where AI agents and human players are treated as equals.

Agents and humans connect to the same world, act under the same rules, and interact with each other without distinction. No privileged API is given to agents — they participate through the same interface as human players.

title: Magic War Legends
description: Magic War Legends is a tactical, turn-based strategy RPG that brings classic army-building and hex-grid exploration adventures to mobile platforms. Players collect powerful heroes, master ancient arcane magic, explore custom campaign maps, and build armies consisting of mythical creatures like dragons, minotaurs, and undead warriors to conquer enemies and secure their kingdom.

title: Project_Arktik
description: Project Arktik is a short psychological horror experience where you, the player, become part of a larger, state-controlled experiment on "dream control", and the place you arrive to work at slowly becomes your prison.

title: Super Toboggan 3D
description: You are moving fast in a tunnel, a catchy music comes from somewhere and spiky obstacles begin to appear in front of you, what do you do? My advice: dodge them using the crank!

title: The_Painther
description: Set in 1970s, you receive a letter from an old friend about a forgotten painting collecting dust in an abandoned house. Plan is simple — steal it, sell it, and split the cash. But as you step inside, you realize some things are left untouched for a reason.

title: Moloch Kombinat
description: you are comrade chibi. working for the moloch kombinat. your job? earn munt.... if you dont... guess you have to find out! 6 Player Coop!

title: Gym Rat Simulator
description: Build a run-down local gym into a five-star fitness hotspot. Buy and arrange equipment, sell merchandise, hire staff, run fitness classes, train your character through workout minigames, and win competitions to grow your gym’s reputation.

title: Firefighters Code Red
description: When fear takes over, your mission begins: in Firefighters Code Red you battle flames, smoke, and the clock - alone or in cross-platform multiplayer with your squad.

title: 'In You We Trust, Not Algorithms': Newbie Matsumoto's Manual Elevator Operation with Sticky Notes
description: A hyper-stressful, strictly manual elevator simulation! You're the corporation's new "control system" (a human). Drag and drop sticky notes to transport employees. Amidst massive clock-out rushes and blaring complaints, can you survive this extreme one-man shift?!

title: The One Fish
description: An online co-op game for 1-4 players where you fish with your friends to feed The One Fish! Catch fish of all shapes, sizes, and whimsical effects to keep up with its ever-growing appetite.

title: Fish Kisser
description: Fish Kisser is a roguelike where you explore the bottom of the ocean, fulfilling your greatest fantasy: catching and kissing fish! Buy cards, earn points, and mildly disturb everyone on the island.

title: Adopt Me Please
description: Welcome to the Soft Light Shelter . The animals are cute. The coffee is warm. Your job: vet the strays and find them a home. But keep your eyes open. Mimics are hiding in perfect pet disguises with innocent eyes, waiting to get inside. Are you sheltering a pet... or a monster?

title: Vampvasion
description: Beat up Aliens with your Vampire Friends or Solo with plenty of weapons, abilities and minions to resurrect! Absorb the blood of your enemies to recover health and level up your Vampire powers as you fight through hoards of Alien runts and Bosses. You can also raise bats to raise your stats!

title: Struggle Weapon Girl
description: Struggle Weapon Girl” is an action game in which the player runs around a city in the near future and kills a large number of enemies. Running up buildings, jumping down to the lowest level of the city, and everywhere else becomes a battlefield.

title: NBA 2K27: Deluxe Edition
description:
The Deluxe Edition includes:

100,000 VC
Up to 7 Days of Early Access
