title: EA Sports FC 27: Ultimate Edition
description:
Ultimate Edition includes:
- 6,000 FC Points over 3 months
- FUT Player Evo slot
- 5 Manager Live Challenge Creation Slots
- 5-Star Senior Scout in Manager Career

Ultimate Edition pre-orders includes:
- Up to 7 days Early Access
- Season 1 Premium Pass
- FUT Player Dribbling Evo for FC 26
- Career Dynamic OVR Pre-season Boost

Ultimate Edition pre-orders by August 31st includes:
- FUT 85+ OVR International ICON Player Item (untradeable)
- FUT 93+ OVR ICON Player Pick (untradeable) for FC 26

Plus all Standard Edition, The Grounds and Career content.

title: I Fell in Love with the Mentally Unstable Depressed Goth on Campus
description: I Fell in Love with the Mentally Unstable Depressed Goth on Campus is an adult kinetic visual novel set at a university. After intervening when a towering goth student is confronted by two thugs, the protagonist becomes involved in an increasingly unusual relationship that uncovers her hidden nature. The game features a linear story, anime-style artwork, character CGs, and mature themes.

title: Feed Me More Brains
description: A silly first-person incremental game about feeding an ancient god with brains. Grab, throw and automate their delivery as you unlock mutations, summon loyal cultists, and transform your temple into the ultimate brain-feeding machine.

title: Nano Code:X
description: A small 2D game where you sneak through a lab simulation, collect parts, and rebuild your drone companion with multiple possible looks.

title: Hexpand
description: Real-time multiplayer strategy on the actual map of Earth. Spread hex territory across continents, capture cities for income, launch planes around the globe, and broker alliances you'll probably betray. 5–20 minute matches. The world is on the table.

title: Bio Fail
description: Bio Fail is a dark 2D platformer where you play as a biological anomaly—a monster that possesses humans. Control their bodies, fight your way through levels, solve puzzles, and destroy everything in your path. One body—one chance

title: Swimcraft
description: Turn your own photos into living fishing venues in a cozy angling sim grounded in real watercraft. Snap any water, stock it with fish, tie authentic rigs, read the swim, and land the specimen of a lifetime. Your swim, crafted.

title: VHS World '89
description: A cozy first-person sorting sim set in a 1989 video rental store. All 3,360 VHS tapes have spilled across the floor — pick them up, read the covers, and shelve them by genre. No timers, no pressure: just the quiet satisfaction of putting every last cassette back in its place.

title: 6600: The Park
description: You are an investigator sent to an isolated prehistoric park sealed after a "containment breach." Facilities have collapsed. The former tourist zones are now hunting grounds. Your mission: uncover the truth behind the disaster, gather evidence, and reach the evacuation point before it's too late.

title: Loopquarium
description: Loopquarium is an aquarium roguelike where you assemble a school of fish with unique abilities to repel invading apex predators. Start with a group of guppies, grow your population, and balance predator and prey to discover insane combos every run.

title: Tachyon Fire
description: Tachyon Fire is a hectic movement-focused arena shooter that pits you against an army of surreal mechanical creatures in a nightmarish dreamscape. Ski, slide, and launch yourself through the air while tearing apart the horde with unlimited firepower and a magic hammer.

title: Minimate
description: Solve puzzles with a chess board that sits in the corner of your screen. Challenge yourself to difficult puzzles, unlock streaks, and customize your board. Idle away and your chess buddy will always be there to help you practice.

title: No Final Night: Protect the Sponk Can
description: You are the night guard protecting the last Sponk Energy can in the world, and three energy drink junkies will break into your office to steal it. Watch the cameras, slam the doors and burn your power wisely to survive from 12 AM to 6 AM. Every night is harder than the last. There is no final night.

title: Whack-A-Monster
description: Whack-A-Monster. An incremental game about Whacking, Smashing, Splashing & BONKING monsters. Upgrade through the skill tree and unlock new weapons to vanquish all evil from this world.

title: Love Hotel Simulator
description: Love Hotel Simulator is a fun resource management game where you build your LOVE Hotel from the ground up! Hire staff, satisfy clients, customize rooms, expand your business, and level up your managerial skills. Immerse yourself with first-person gameplay!

title: Someone's Here
description: Just another night in your apartment soon transforms into a tense game of choices. Answer the door, trust no one, and survive the night. Every choice changes the outcome.

title: Here Again
description: You wake up in a silent underground facility with one simple instruction: REMEMBER THE BUTTON. Weird dreams and changing surroundings haunt this place. Explore, observe, and unveil the mystery that envelopes this place in this Retro Psychological Horror Game.

title: Rehaunted
description: Enter a house where every clue feels wrong. Investigate a brutal crime scene, uncover hidden evidence, and use your detective tools to piece together a disturbing truth buried beneath the silence.

title: Domefender
description: RTS city builder, where you can build and customize your battle mech to fight waves of enemies side by side with your troops.

title: Hide and Sink
description: Hide and Sink series is a retro horror anthology chronicling short stories of uncanny childhood events. Part 2: Hide and Sink is a first-person psychological horror game. What starts as an innocent game of after-school hide-and-seek quickly unravels into an uncanny terror.

title: Green Inferno
description: A new kind of horror deduction game that allows you to investigate freely. Examine detailed scenes, collect evidence in the form of clips, and use them to reconstruct events. Connect the clues, build your own theory, and unmask the macabre truth behind a doomed expedition.

title: Backrooms (2026)
description: An ultra-realistic co-op Backrooms experience for 1–6 players. Backrooms (2026) offers a mix of “classic” and brand-new, all original levels. Explore the levels, discover hidden routes, and cooperate with your team to escape.

title: Knowledge
description: Embark on a 3D general knowledge trivia adventure and test yourself! Memorize the correct path, gather letters, and answer 400 questions. Climb the global leaderboard — or play at your own pace.

title: Room by Room
description: A mystery-filled 3D Escape Room adventure. Explore immersive environments, carefully observe every detail, and solve intricate visual puzzles to advance. Test your logic, decipher secret codes, and find your way out through a series of increasingly complex rooms.

title: Dungeon Betwixt
description: Dungeon Betwixt is a fantasy extraction looter RPG built around risk, skill, and unforgettable dungeon stories. Stake your gear, descend into dangerous depths, and fight through fluid melee combat. Every strike can be countered. Every mistake can cost everything. Every escape can become a legend.

title: Detective Boto: Belle Memoir
description: A narrative game set in 1943 Belém, legends are vanishing, and the river’s secrets need a detective. Pink, if you will. As a shapeshifting river dolphin detective that turns into human (almost), uncover a noir mystery where folklore, memory, and conspiracy flow beneath the city.

title: Echo 9
description: Echo 9 is a tense first-person horror. You are Yon, a maintenance android. Navigate a failing shuttle through deep space, stabilize the dying reactor, and bring Eva to the evacuation point. Radiation is rising, the evacuation point far. Eva is in stasis. You are all she has.

title: Breath of the Waters: The Angler
description: A realistic fishing simulation with RPG elements, built in Unreal Engine 5. Authentic physics-based feel × open-water exploration — from float to lure and bottom fishing. Read the water, hone your skills, rise from novice to master angler. Fish solo, or team up with friends.

title: Cosmic Crowbar
description: Cosmic Crowbar is a story-driven action adventure beat-em-up. A mysterious metallic alien crash lands in a scrapyard and merges with a crowbar to survive. Alone and far from home, our mighty metallic hero explores the perplexing planet Earth, assembling ardent allies and facing fiendish foes!

title: Risk of Rain 2: Stagnant Pipeworks
description: Adds the Stagnant Pipeworks. Scavenge through the decrepit ancient pipes and drains on your expedition through Petrichor V.

title: Remote Union
description: Welcome to Kutarsk! Investigate the incident and dive deep into the story of the city and its inhabitants. Remote Union is a first-person adventure game set in a dark and gritty dystopian future.

title: Studio Sim: The Painting Game
description: A game about making abstract paintings in the studio.

title: Southern Lights: Broken Frequency
description: Lead a stranded Antarctic research station where every decision matters. Manage your crew and its scarce resources while an unseen cosmic threat slowly tightens its grip.

title: Hop-Co-Op
description: Master the Hop, then wreck your friends' runs in Co-Op. Hop-Co-Op is a first-person movement parkour game — race online, sabotage rivals with wild powerups, build your own maps, and deck out your character. Pure speed, pure chaos, better together.

title: Rooster Booster 3D
description: Rooster Booster 3D is a speedy retro platformer! Play through three unique, vaporwave-inspired zones as you optimize your completion time to unlock new characters and earn the Golden Torus!

title: The Epic and Amazing Adventure of GleepglorrpgilliandoohiggintilliousMMDCCXXXIX the Adventure Where GleepglorrpgilliandoohiggintilliousMMDCCXXXIX Lives and Becomes King GleepglorrpgilliandoohiggintilliousMMDCCXXXIX
description: Play as gleepglorrpgilliandoohiggintilliousMMDCCXXXIX and decide the best life for him to live.

title: The Dungeon of Lulu Farea: Rebirth
description: The Dungeon of Lulu Farea: Rebirth is an engaging blend of traditional turn-based RPG and puzzle game elements, boasting a complex world in which nothing is left to chance and every encounter matters. Genre classics such as fishing and side quests abound, and the game encourages thinking ahead to find the best way to obstacles in order to successfully clear the dungeon.

title: Password Not Valid
description: Password Not Valid is a party game for up to 6 players. You start with a normal password and end up with twelve vowels, text in quotes and even another player's name, because your friends are the ones picking the rules. Can you outlast them?

title: Zutto Tsukushite Ageru no!
description: Kentarou planned to leave his hometown after graduation to pursue his dream. Upon telling his childhood friends this, they demanded that he choose who will marry him before that happens! They started competing amongst themselves as to who would serve him the best. He told them that he will give them an answer by the end of the summer, which they thought to mean that this summer would be the last chance to appeal to him, adding more fuel to their battle for his heart. Who will he end up choosing… or rather, who will seize the spot by his side?

title: Keyboard Smash
description:
Keyboard Smash is a fully voice acted story driven comedy game about running a small store while the characters around you are too stupid for their own good.
Help strange and random customers, travel to many bizarre locations, and make choices that turn the story upside down.

title: Super Blood Hockey: Rogue Manager
description: A sports game where you don't control the players, instead play as a shady coach and use your deck of dirty tricks to become season champion. A unique hybrid of roguelike deckbuilder, auto-battler, and high action arcade hockey.

title: People's Press Kiosk
description: Run a kiosk in 1980s communist Poland. Check ration cards, distribute rationed goods, and dabble in illegal trade to support your family. Every decision can bring profit or trouble.

title: Deepward
description: Choose 3 heroes from a roster of six, each with distinct weapons, abilities, and playstyles. Build the right squad, switch between heroes on the fly, and fight relentless horrors in this fast-paced horror FPS roguelite set in the 1920s. Descend beneath a god-forsaken place where death is permanent.

title: Mimi Wuhui
description:
Xicheng is a snow queen who doesn't know what happiness or joy is, and Lingxing is a sunshine who happened to come into her life. "Secret Dance" is the story of two high school classmates, with a sweet and warm romance and detailed emotional descriptions.

This is a short bonus story about a sidecouple from Unwavering Love, and the events that take place one year before Symbiotic Love. However, the story can be read on its own.

title: Monarch: The Tainted Kingdom
description: Monarch: TTK is an Action Monster Taming RPG where strategy dictates the flow of combat. Capture monsters, gather their loot to build custom skillsets, and master an engaging Timeline-based combat system. Uncover the secrets of the Archs and break through the corruption plaguing the Continent!

title: Tamas: Shadowveil
description: Greed or Dread: Which will claim you first?​ Tamas: Shadowveil is a first-person PvPvE extraction game set in a dark world inspired by Chinese folklore.Enter haunted ruins, battle creatures and rival players with cold steel, claim rare relics, and escape alive.

title: Protocol Bound
description: Bound is a psychological thriller where you search through private conversations, hidden files, and recordings on devices that aren't your own. Manipulate others, uncover dark secrets, and shape the outcome through the choices you make.

title: Hellsplit: Labyrinth
description: A rogue-like VR action RPG with brutal, physics-driven medieval combat. Collect seven crystal shards across procedural dungeons. You get one life. No second chances.

title: Unicorn Academy: Island of Magic
description: You are invited to join Unicorn Academy! Create a magical connection with your own unicorn and forge friendship bonds with Sophia, Ava, Layla and the other heroes from the series. Wield unicorn magic and discover every corner of Unicorn Island.

title: American Navy Seals
description: Lead an elite Navy SEAL fireteam into a cinematic next-gen tactical shooter powered by Unreal Engine 5. Command your squad, master authentic weapons, and fight through deadly global missions where every order, every shot, and every life matters.

title: Tempest Rising: The Vetis Wrath
description: Take command of the fractured Veti to reclaim what is rightfully yours. Subjugate your foes and use them as tools to sacrifice for your goals in the conquest for vengeance against enemies both new and older than humanity itself.

title: Save the Ninja!
description: Co-op ninja for up to 6 players. Track wounded allies, use voice-activated ninjutsu, move through trees, and extract from dangerous zones.

title: Fat Hobo: Hobocop Saves Christmas
description: Fat Hobo is a first-person RPG adventure game about an ex-cop, turned vagrant hunting a killer. Convince, steal and piss your way to the bottom of an unbelievable mystery.

title: Net Worthless
description: A satirical life-and-money sim. One turn is one month: budget your hours, work the job, ride the market, outlive inflation and your own decisions. Pick a character and make their dream come true. Or at least don't die trying.

title: Unfated
description: Unfated is a single-player 3D papercraft Strategy RPG where you play as Jo, a peasant turned revolutionary as she leads a scrappy group of rebels to fight the forces of fate and oppression in a turn-based journey across the land of Antedeluvia, seeking to end a century long conflict.

title: Sānguózhì Qúnyīng Zhuàn
description:
In the final years of the Eastern Han dynasty, the realm is thrown into chaos. Warlords rise across the land, each vying for power in an age of constant conflict. Amid this ever-changing era, you will become a lord in your own right, beginning from a lone city on the frontier.

Recruit legendary heroes, develop your city, govern your people, build and train your armies, and conquer enemy territories. Will you restore the Han dynasty and bring about its revival? Will you carve out your own domain and proclaim yourself king? Or will you march into the Central Plains, claim the Mandate of Heaven, and rule over all under heaven?

Every decision you make has the power to rewrite this sweeping epic of a turbulent age.

title: Balance: Umbilical Wake
description: Step into a fishermans recurring nightmare of living on a levitating platform that tilts with every move. Learn the worlds rules, solve its puzzles, catch fish, and inject them into your navel to wake up. But the nightmare keeps returning until your childs birth begins to reshape it.

title: Puroma
description: You are a prisoner of your own bedroom. Unable to leave. Their eyes are everywhere. Somewhere below the layers of filth lies the true heart of reality. You must dig.

title: Dieathlon
description: Chart a course down dangerous mountain slopes with only your shotgun and your reflexes to keep you alive. Blast through obstacles, fend off deadly monsters, and make split-second decisions. Explore multiple routes, each filled with unique hazards and challenges.

title: Backrooms Manager: Together
description: A 6-player co-op scavenging and logistics game. Search dangerous sectors for items, break down junk into scrap to sell, deliver shipments on time, and manage your team budget. Use your earnings to upgrade abilities and equipment, meet each quota, and keep your balance positive.

title: Tribulum
description: Fight and survive during a great supernatural tribulation. Explore abandoned locations, confront people possessed by a demonic plague that destroys moral conscience, and uncover a story where faith, fear, and humanity collide.

title: Ringwyrm
description: Ringwyrm is an immersive action horror game with survival elements. Explore a nonlinear interconnected world, meet a large cast of memorable characters, slay a huge cast of sickly monstrosities and avoid myriad diseases and ailments.

title: Silverpine
description: Silverpine is an experimental fantasy lifesim with NPCs powered by a local AI model.

title: Bubba in the Turd Dimension
description: Bubba in the Turd dimension is a top-down shooter, where the player character Bubba uses his feces to attack enemies. His health is represented by his colon, and if he takes enough damage he will release his magic dump, causing a game over.

title: Black Hollow
description: Black Hollow is a dark fantasy roguelite FPS where you play as a lone plague doctor defending a remote farmstead from waves of plague-stricken villagers. Fight through the night with your staff, lantern, and unstable plague mixtures, then use the remains of the infected to unlock new attacks, potions, and upgrades at an ancient runestone.

title: Battlefield 6 Season 4
description: Battlefield 6 Season 4 expands the game's combined-arms multiplayer across land, air, and sea. It introduces naval warfare on Tsuru Reef, dynamic ocean systems, marine vehicles, new weapons and modes, and additional seasonal content for Battlefield 6 and REDSEC, including the return of Wake Island, custom lobbies, and spectator tools.

title: Smarty Labs
description: An indie first person puzzle platformer rage bait game that involves navigating a lab by solcing physics based puzzles. The game revolves around a boy who is out on a walk until he falls through a hole into an abandoned lab where he meets a robot that tasks him with undergoing experiments in the lab using a physics manipulation gun that creates physics anomalies that give the player different abilities. The game has 4 stages each with 10 rooms, therefore 40 levels.

title: Beaconfall
description: A fast-paced tower defense strategy with settlement management. Build, assign villagers, empower the lighthouse, and keep the light alive until the final wave.

title: Sticky Business: Seaside Tales
description:
Dive into a relaxing seaside getaway with Sticky Business: Seaside Tales!

Bring the ocean breeze to your cozy sticker shop with over 113 new stickers and colorful variants inspired by sunny beaches, salty waves, sea creatures, pirate treasures, tropical vacations, and peaceful moments by the shore.

Pack heartfelt orders for brand-new customers and discover 10 charming new stories full of surf contests, beach adventures, drifting romances, pirate conventions, summer vacations, and quiet coastal towns.
This DLC includes:

113 new stickers with additional color variants

10 new customer stories about surfing, pirates, summer vacations, and more!

8 new goodies

6 glitter papers

Whether you love turtles, whales, seashells, surfboards, palm trees, or treasure chests, Seaside Tales brings a splash of ocean magic to your sticker business.

title: BloodSpire
description: You are a cat surrounded by monsters inside a castle tower. A fast-paced action Cat-Roguelike with card upgrades and unique abilities.

title: Drop Loot
description: Drop Loot is a loot-matching, synergy-chaining, monster-exploding… roguelite dungeon crawler. Match tiles to deal damage and heal, stack powers to create chain reactions, descend to the heart of the well and paint it all red.

title: Roswyn
description: A story-rich indie bullet hell with pixel art visuals and intense action. Follow Leere through a mysterious world, face escalating dangers, meet memorable characters, and uncover the secrets hidden within its depths.

title: Prison Gambit
description: A 4-12 player online social party game about betrayal, cooperation and trust. No teams, only alliances. No traitors, only betrayals. Only one walks free.

title: Fighty Driver
description: Fighty Driver is a high-octane, single-player arcade combat racer. Trapped in a wasteland ruled by rival racing teams, your mission is to tear through the environment, collect power cores, and reach the extraction zone before your fuel hits zero. It's a fight for survival where you must scavenge coins while managing limited resources. Expect relentless AI pursuit and high-speed tactical racing. Tight controls and explosive combat are built on the Godot engine, offering pure arcade action that's easy to play but hard to master.

title: Haze Together
description: HAZE TOGETHER is a 1-4 player psychological survival horror game set in claustrophobic mines. Team up with friends, explore dangerous industrial facilities, and escape the darkness trying to consume you. Remember: the haze thickens every second, and you are not alone.

title: Lablue Horror
description: LaBlue Horror is a first-person psychological horror game set in a dark Backrooms-inspired maze. Explore, hide, survive and find the exit before the creature finds you.

title: A Love Letter in Snowfall
description: A Love Letter in Snowfall is a live-action, multi-ending interactive romance movie game. As a young B&B keeper in a small southern town, you meet, and fall for a visiting actress every choice rewrites your love story. Meet someone, and fall in love that trembles in bones.

title: Pornographer
description: Pornographer is, first and foremost, an interactive FILM. A film where you can influence what happens on screen. The dark and absurd humor will definitely leave no one indifferent.

title: The Minesweeper's Tale
description: From the clues, reveal an imaginary map zone by zone in this minesweeper-variant logic game, where each solved region transforms a grid into a work of cartographic art.

title: Intergalactic Ecstasy
description: In this Epic Sexual Adventure , Penny Patty Piper travels the universe fighting monsters and completing Heroic Sexual Challenges to earn the fabled Erotesian Stones, the keys to unlocking the path to a Planet where Sexual Pleasure is the purpose of life.

title: U.F.F.C: Ultra Fuckin' Fuckable Championship
description: Thrust and pump your way through the “U.F.F.C, the Ultra Fuckin’ Fuckable Championship” as President Trumy, the unrivaled master of the Art of the Erotic. Aid her in her quest to make the "Great Nation" Great Again by milking oils and tariffs dry from your neighbor to the world's most powerful leaders, using your awe-inspiring...

title: NTR & Zombies
description: NTR & Zombies! Survive, go out, find secrets and... well, maybe be cheated and cheat? It's up to you!

title: Ana's Auto Fellatio
description: Ana’s Auto Fellatio is a hand-drawn 2D adult mechanic simulator and visual novel starring the futanari protagonist Ana. Manage a car repair shop, take on repair jobs, level up with perks, unlock random benefits, enjoy erotic CGs, and balance business, time, and self-pleasure in a sandbox experience.

title: North Pole Workshop
description: Play as one of Santa’s elves to create, gift-wrap, and deliver toys. This 1-4 cooperative toy-making game can be completed at your own pace in easy difficulty(1 star). For more challenge and to test your team's coordination, you can attempt the harder timed difficulties (2-3 stars).

title: Horny Massage Clinic
description: The hard life of a worker changes when he decides to do something as trivial as going to a massage clinic. There he discovers that he can do more than just relieve his back pain. Thanks to his four hot masseuses, he will rise from the ashes.

title: Hentai Age Airport
description: Enjoy a tranquil puzzle adventure where every completed challenge reveals another stunning portrait. Free from stress and designed for pure relaxation, it offers a calming escape filled with gentle gameplay and beautiful imagery.

title: Langrisser: Sea of Sword
description: The latest evolution of the Langrisser series and a next-generation fantasy tactical RPG. Developed by Black Jack Studio, the original team behind Langrisser, the game also features an all-new score by welcome internationally acclaimed game composer Yasunori Nishiki.

title: Hentai Shion
description: Hentai Shion is an adult game in a mafia style, where the strict and sexy Shion leads you through a world of luxury, power, and temptation. Complete mini-games, unlock explicit illustrations, and dive into an atmosphere of danger and passion.

title: Hentai Roxy
description: Hentai Roxy is an adult game about a mysterious instructor, where temptation and control intertwine. Complete mini-games, unlock new looks for Roxy, and explore her hidden sides in a tense atmosphere of flirtation and edge-of-the-line play.

title: Hentai Police Girl
description: Hentai Police Girl is a seductive puzzle game where you complete levels to unlock revealing illustrations of a confident police officer.

title: Hentai Akira
description: Hentai Akira is a fast-paced puzzle game where you follow a determined sprinter on her road to victory. Complete memory and puzzle challenges to unlock new illustrations, as the intensity and rewards grow with each level.

title: Hentai Sake
description: Relaxing 18+ puzzle game with a bar vibe: complete mini-games, unlock seductive illustrations, and enjoy the smooth atmosphere of sake and nightlife.

title: Hentai Morgana
description: Hentai Morgana is a puzzle game filled with dark magic, midnight temptation, and gothic charm. Meet Morgana — a seductive vampire who hunts not only in the darkness, but for your attention as well. Complete levels and unlock new revealing illustrations.

title: Hentai Nefiris
description: Enter the world of ancient Egypt with the mysterious goddess Nefiris. Complete mini-games, unlock seductive anime illustrations, and reveal increasingly daring looks of the desert queen.

title: Hentai Sexy Nurse
description: an erotic anime game about a mysterious nurse. Solve puzzles, unlock hot scenes, earn achievements, and dive into a world of temptation and fantasy.

title: Alien Archeologist
description: Alien Archeologist is a chill incremental digging game. Use a variety of upgradeable tools to mine ore, blast through earth, and clean strange artifacts as you journey yet deeper toward the mystery hiding at the planet's core.

title: Null Horizon
description: Survive the void in Null Hørizøn. Trade, fight, and explore a retro-futuristic 3D galaxy with 2D sprites. Upgrade your ship, smuggle goods, and travel across the universe. Tactical Real-Time combat meets Grid-based exploration in this atmospheric space sim. The Null Hørizøn calls, Captain.

title: Stay: Ember's Desktop Adventures
description: Ember is a virtual pet who feels alive - and living on your desktop. Play with her, feed her - make her feel loved. She’ll be curious and attentive, mischievous when you need a distraction, quiet when you need a little focus time. Fully 3D and animated - with a little sass.

title: Place: Weapon Workshop
description: Place: Weapon Workshop is a casual 2D idle roguelite raising game. Unlock blueprints, forge weapons, gather resources, upgrade buildings, optimize stats and grow stronger to dominate the arena.

title: The Haunted Spot 2
description: The Haunted Spot is a 2D top-down survival horror game based on the story of a paranormal enthusiast called Jack who arrived at a century-old abandoned haunted house to experience the paranormal.

title: Sammy The Sharky
description: Dodge, dive, and survive as you move fish to escape the hungry shark and compete for the highest score on the global leaderboard.

title: Tomb of the Golden Relic
description: The game set in an ancient labyrinth with a mummy. Players take on the role of an adventurer searching for a lost golden artifact, but uncovering it triggers the mummy’s pursuit. Along the way, they must decide whether to escape with the real artifact, a fake, or leave empty-handed.

title: Random Coin
description: Buy, sell, and grow your capital in this simple, fast, and addictive trading simulation. Earn Prestige Coins and climb the Steam leaderboard.

title: GameDev Clicker: Tap & Build
description: Build your own game studio from scratch! Hire developers, click to code, release projects, and grow into a legendary game empire. Tap. Build. Profit!

title: Chrono Clues
description: A suspenseful detective puzzle game where players investigate cases woven between dreams and reality. Collect clues, examine evidence, and explore scenes to unravel the truth. Each case is interconnected, suspects are complex, and every deduction may reshape your understanding of the mystery.

title: Potion Dealer
description:
Iva, found as an infant in a river and adopted by a court noblewoman, spent her youth within the royal castle. At sixteen, she learns she is the daughter of a witch. Believing her future is limitless, she slips a love potion to the royal heir.

Two years later, the wedding ritual unravels—and her deception is exposed.

She barely escapes. Now hunted, Iva hides in a remote mountain hut, gathering herbs and brewing forbidden potions to sell—just to survive and pay for her safety.

But survival is not enough.

To break free from this trap, she must uncover the truth and take revenge on those who exploited her inexperience and set her up. It won’t be easy: her downfall is only a small piece of a much larger conspiracy.

title: Maneki Mania
description: Pet the lucky cat, spin the charm slots and chase the golden koban jackpot. Maneki Mania is a kawaii fortune shrine where you unlock lucky charms, grow your luck and watch the gold pile up. Cute on the outside, casino on the inside.

title: Eslabong
description: Arena combat meets mercenary club management. Recruit from a dynamic market, build your squad, and compete season after season in leagues and cups.

title: Reader Rabbit's Interactive Reading Journey 2
description: Reader Rabbit and Mat the Mouse help Sam the Lion find his imagination. Each screen contains a minigame that tests phonics skills and a storybook with language that helps reinforce those skills.

title: Chipper and Sons Lumber Co. Deluxe
description: It's that one game with the beavers in the forest that was deemed to be scary by many, but now it's back in this brand new DELUXE edition!

title: Math Heads
description: "Math Heads" is styled as a TV with its own channels. In each channel, there is either a game, an activity, or a parody program relating to math. The defining feature is the characters who have giant human heads animated like cutouts.

title: Cataclismo: The Old Kingdom
description: Reclaim a lost realm in a new strategic mode – conquer and defend multiple citadels, marshal supply lines to fuel your advance, and hold back escalating waves of horrors as the final reckoning stirs. Rebuild the Old Kingdom, turn by turn.

title: Kalpa: Cosmic Symphony - Cosmic Edition
description: A package containing the base game and popular DLCs — the best choice for those starting KALPA for the first time.

title: Potential Man
description: Potential Man is a role-playing experience where you must navigate the whims and woes of a humble seed. This wacky story features fully hand-drawn visuals, zany characters, and a classic JRPG-styled soundtrack to boot. Are you ready to achieve your true potential?

title: ChatGladiators
description: ChatGladiators is an interactive Twitch battle game for streamers where viewers become fighters. Streamers connect their Twitch account, start a battle, and let their community compete for victory in an arena.

title: EA Sports FC 27: Ultimate Plus Edition
description:
Exclusive Pre-order Edition available only until August 31st 2026.

Ultimate Plus Edition includes:
- Up to 7 days Early Access
- Seasons 1 to 5 Premium Passes
- 10,000 FC Points over 5 months
- FUT 85+ OVR International ICON Player Item (untradeable)
- Hall of FUT Player Pick (untradeable)
- Additional FUT Player Evo slot

Also includes the following FC 26 content:
- FUT 93+ OVR ICON Player Pick (untradeable)
- FUT Player Dribbling stats Evo
- FUT Player Physical stats Evo

Plus all Ultimate Edition, The Grounds and Career content.

title: Hubert Catching
description: Hubert Catching is a fun and simple game where you desperately scramble to throw small living stone pingies (penguins) into a hole, in an attempt to appease the beings that sent you into this realm so they may eventually set you free. Little do you know, your purpose is greater than a simple game.

title: Peg Champ
description: Take your best shot in this Pachinko puzzle game! Break pegs, earn money, and unlock a huge upgrade tree in this satisfying physics puzzler.

title: Project Bad Apple's AP400
description: "Project Bad Apple's AP400" is a fast-paced FPS that takes inspiration from numerous games that had made an impact, such as Half-Life 2 (2004), and DOOM (2016). It is, in its core, a single-player experience.

title: Souq Boss Simulator
description: Every Sheikh-sized fortune has to start somewhere. Yours starts with a tiny baqala. Manage your shop, meet the locals, build your fortune, and invest across a 2002 Gulf city inspired by Old Dubai & Riyadh. Solo or with friends in online co-op. Become the Souq Boss.

title: The Lonely Miner
description: A 2d pixel art incremental clicker/idle Mining game. You are dropped onto an Island, with a pickaxe and a dream. Collect rocks, sell rocks, hire workers and get rich!

title: Crooked
description: Crooked is a noir roguelite strategy game where rock-paper-scissors becomes a tense underground contest of bluffing, reading opponents and taking risks. Study your rivals, bend the rules when the moment is right, manage suspicion and climb through shady venues where every decision can turn the room against you.

title: Corporate 0
description: You're trapped in your office after a typical working day. Carefully explore every corner to reach freedom and break the loop.

title: Liminal Underground: Creatures Beyond
description: Overview: Make way through levels full of danger. Creatures lurk and hunt you down throughout the levels. Design: A horror, adventure with Objectives, creatures chasing you, and secret exits to find. Finding each exit, gets you closer to escaping. Localization: Recommended language: English

title: Hentai Furry Goat
description: Hentai Furry Goat is a relaxing anime puzzle game where you solve memory and logic challenges to unlock charming illustrations of a playful mountain goat girl. Enjoy a cozy atmosphere, progression rewards, and a gallery of collectible art.

title: Fluendora: The Realm of Scribes
description: Fluendora is a multiplayer and single-player word-puzzle. Prove to your friends you know some words (or learn some if you don't). Players can either compete for the highest score (up to 6 players) or enjoying a peaceful solo session. New: Twitch and Kick integration.

title: Olympians: Darius
description:

Uncover the truth behind the “Blue Tragedy” that unfolded at the abandoned hot springs!

What were Ai and the Mysterious Man really doing in the deserted hotel?

How did Ai end up there—and what became of the Mysterious Man?

Don't miss the hidden story behind the incident and the appearance of a new Blue Oni lurking within the ruins...

title: Desert Picaroon
description: Your goal is to descend into an endless, procedurally generated tomb, killing monsters and collecting their treasures. But be warned: the tomb is cursed, and every time you descend to a new floor, it will begin to crumble! Hurry to find the artifact and escape before it’s too late! Buy upgrades and make your way through the increasingly difficult levels!

title: DeepCroak
description:
DeepCroak is a puzzle game in which a very hungry little frog discovers a cave full of flies, and its goal is to eat them all!
On DeepCroak, you move across a grid filled with obstacles; the number of moves allowed is extremely limited, so be careful how you navigate.

title: Tower of Insolence
description: Grab your smithing hammer, pack your gear, and get ready to conquer the ominous Tower of Insolence in this cozy little puzzle game.

title: Wraith of the Cards
description:
Wraith of the Cards is a turn-based deckbuilding RPG with platforming exploration! Explore the vast halls of a mysterious mansion that has called you forth, and attack your way through enemies using special card magic!

Explore the halls of the mansion in EXPLORE MODE, solving puzzles and clearing obstacles in your way. Search furnature to find Gears and other machanical tools to assist on your journey, but they aren't the only things hiding in the mansion...

Fight your way forward in BATTLE MODE, using a card-based battle system where magical cards are collected and harnessed for combat! Total higher numbers together to pack higher punches, and level up to unlock over 20 unique Special Cards!

title: Redline: Strings of Fate
description: Redline is a sci-fi romance visual novel set in a near-future coastal city in southern Japan where gifted individuals can perceive, interpret, and influence human emotions — abilities now at the center of scientific research and corporate ambition.

title: Cigkofte Empire
description: A chaotic 1-4 player tycoon centered on Turkey's iconic Çiğ Köfte! Step behind the counter, serve hungry customers, and upgrade your equipment. Diversify your menu to build the neighborhood's most prestigious restaurant. Be fast, stay organized, and don't let anyone leave hungry!

title: Agro Tycoon
description: Grow a farming empire from a single plot of land. Agro Tycoon is an isometric pixel art management simulator where you're not just a farmer - you're the CEO of your own agricultural operation.

title: So Perfect I Could Eat You Up
description:
A mini restaurant simulator where envy eats you alive...

Enchanting Elixirs has been in Marion's family for years now, and it's up to her to make this cafe the best it can be!!! At all costs. Help Marion manage Enchanting Elixirs and make it great again!!! Or don't.

title: Mai: Child of Ages - Storms of Time
description: A mysterious floating factory has appeared in the skies!

title: Aetheris Core
description: A fast-paced sci-fi action roguelite where you battle escalating enemy waves, combine powerful abilities, and take on challenging boss encounters.

title: Torovo
description: Investigate the remnants of a forgotten industrial town in this handcrafted open world detective game. Take pictures and use them as evidence against the town’s residents. Track routines, plan your days ahead... and don't inhale the fumes.

title: CosmoFab
description: CosmoFab is a factory-building game focused on mining, production, and automation. Mine resources and build production lines to create a fully automated industrial system. Defend your base against relentless hostile creatures, explore the planet, and complete your mission.

title: Snowed Under
description: Snowed Under is a first-person game about shoveling snow in the mountains.

title: Pocket Dinos
description: An incremental dino collection game where prehistoric stickers come to life. Hatch eggs, discover unique variants, build thriving habitats, and uncover powerful combinations to grow your fortune.

title: Dirtnap
description: Dig, fly and fight through fully destructible maps in multiple game modes. Every character has its own unique ability, every biome its own hazards, and the weapon arsenal runs from machine guns to banana bombs to airstrikes. Play with friends, strangers, bots, or all of them.

title: Devil Typocrypha: Alt-Eschatopia
description: A Typing Card Battle D-RPG with ‹NO ALTERNATIVE›. Collect Cards. Command Demons. Control Keys. Chronicle the City’s Curse as a Devil Archivist. Raise and customize parties in your own strategy to expel evils in hybrid turn-based typing action. ‹Dispel› the ‹Distortions› of ‹Desire› and ‹Decay›.

title: Mom, I'll Be Home Late
description: A PvE-Cozy-Extraction-Roguelite about the moment when you should really be heading home. Gather loot, grow stronger, survive a world that keeps getting more dangerous — and bring your backpack home.

title: Shelve the Potions!
description: Shelve the Potions! Organize 2000+ potions on shelves after the witch's cats have knocked them over, using clues around an enchanted cellar. Learn strange symbols, decipher cryptic notes, and uncover the correct shelf orders in a cozy organizational simple puzzle game.

title: Seleka-san Who Exposes Unnoticed With Naked Coat
description: You wanna go nude in public, but you don't wanna get caught -- a true gentleperson's dilemma. Help Sereka indulge her dirtiest fantasies without anyone knowing!

title: Legend of Bakehime
description: A thrilling Japanese-style action game featuring Saya, a half-yokai princess who fires spiritual arrows from her bow, and Jubei, her kind-hearted retainer who wields a spear with mastery. Together, they stand against waves of terrifying yokai through the power of their bond!

title: Secret Flasher Manaka
description:
Freely enjoy flashing in public? Totally OK!
Prefer clearing missions one after another? That’s OK too!

As you sneak through each flashing challenge, Manaka evolves into a true flasher...
And as you progress, the missions become even more extreme

title: Poolrooms Museum
description: Explore surreal poolrooms, museums, and endless liminal spaces.

title: Disney Dreamlight Valley: Pixel Perfect
description: The 24th free update for Disney Dreamlight Valley brings new content inspired by Disney's Wreck-It Ralph - including the titular character as a Villager. It also included new features to Villagers Friendship levels, Floating Islands inspired by the Storybook Vale, new rooms for Olaf's Grand Exhibition and started the Pop City Star Path.

title: CarveOut 2160
description: Carveout 2160 is a snowboarding game centered around the most dangerous competition in the universe! Because this tournament is not on Earth! Land risky stunts to earn boost, use it to burst into shortcuts or wipeout the competition and rocket yourself around the planets and onto the podium!

title: T7's Basics in Educational
description: Just don't make anything wrong with this game, because T7 will get angry and try to catch you if you make wrong answers with the ThinkPad...

title: No Socks RPG
description: Fight groovy enemies, and recruit a team of sexy, cute and quirky Monster Girls to get your fits back!

title: Total RepeAt
description: Your ship is down. You're alone. 340,000 colonists vanished without a trace, and the VOID fleet is closing in. Escape Sector Omega-7 — and uncover the truth the UEF will kill to keep buried.

title: Boffins History Quiz Reel
description: History quiz game trivia, a comfortable indi challenge, learn as you go common building knowledge and difficult. Built relentless trial by trivia, 15 achievements available – That are reachable with practice. How much of history do you remember?

title: Campfire Stories: The Giant of Green Peaks
description: Ever wondered what you would do as the main character in those eerie campfire stories that kept you awake? Become hunted by an infamous cryptid deep in the ancient woods where you must outsmart what can't be fought — and find out! Can you survive in the terrifying Pacific Northwest wilderness?

title: Sparkfront: Online
description: A fast-paced PvP strategy game where armies evolve through three chaotic ages. Defend your tower, destroy your enemy’s, and outplay your rival with timing, items, and stat upgrades.

title: Alarm112: Fire Unit
description: Command fire rescue operations under pressure. Receive emergency calls, dispatch units and make critical decisions in a realistic emergency response strategy simulation.

title: Rollin' Garry
description: A surprisingly difficult challenge platformer. Roll your way to the top in this easy to play, tough to master physics-based platformer. One mistake and Garry could be toast!

title: Once Upon a Throne of Thorns
description: A dark fantasy boys' love / yaoi visual novel about an assassin who falls for the runaway prince he has been entasked with killing.

title: Am I OK?
description: A horror game inspired by Exit 8

title: Press: Authorized Disposal
description: Manage a trash disposal factory. Press, Burn, and Sort each load. Complete your contracts. Upgrade your operation. Keep the pit empty. Don't ask about the content!

title: Catjong 6: Pawztec Temple
description: A cozy mahjong-3 adventure awaits! Solve 200 fun levels with your playful cat and restore a tranquil outdoor world shaped by soft greenery and ancient stones.

title: Dino Jump Deluxe
description: Race against time in this frantic, side-scrolling endless runner. Master simple, high-speed controls to unlock a roster of mechanically distinct dinosaurs and a variety of biome colors. In Dino Jump, every collectable counts toward your ultimate prehistoric evolution.

title: Professional Chef
description: Transform simple ingredients into delicious dishes in Professional Chef. Buy, cook, sell, upgrade, and unlock new recipes. Optimize your processes, master every detail, and rise to culinary excellence in this engaging idle cooking experience!

title: Mini Soccer Manager
description: A compact 2D soccer management game that combines squad development, tactical decisions, club progression, and fast live match simulations.

title: Good Night, Mare
description: A bite-sized casual runner-action game. Become Mo, a fantasy creature. Dodge sweet dreams and munch only on nightmares as you run.

title: Blind Rage
description: The voices command you to commit a burglary! Unfortunately for them, you are blind and finding what they seek is a challenge! Chased after you try your best to not get caught and end up in the asylum.

title: Salt and Spice
description: From Mogadishu to Calcutta, master the bustling trade networks of the Indian Ocean during the golden age of maritime commerce.

title: Hextreaming: Deep
description: Hextreaming:Deep is a horror adventure game where you explore an abandoned water park alongside Suzy. Setting foot inside one of South Korea's top 5 most haunted locations. what on earth will she encounter this time? But hey, as long as she's with her viewers, at least she won't be lonely, right?

title: Cosdarica's Journey at the End of the World
description: Human civilization had finally burned out its last spark. The survivors chose to gather together, shutting themselves within safe zones to await death. But Cosdarica did not. Neither did I.

title: Heavy Cargo - The Truck Simulator: Heavy South
description:
New challenges for the south - hauling heavy cargo through the mountains!

The “Heavy South” DLC offers you a particularly extensive expansion of the map into the southern part of the game world, effectively doubling the overall size of the map. It also introduces a wide range of challenging new handcrafted missions, exciting new cargo types, new delivery locations, and matching brand-new trailers. Towing vehicles that block your route is a new route mission added to the game. Master the many new missions, enjoy the breathtaking mountain atmosphere, and take on new challenges in heavy and super-heavy haulage.

title: Alien Bloom
description: Alien Bloom is a three-player turn-based strategy card game in which rival factions compete for control of Earth. Players expand across a world map, attack territories, resolve battles using card-game mechanics, deploy spaceships, and pursue multiple victory conditions.

title: PolterDates
description: It's a short narrative game where you play as Dolores Delalma, a medium and matchmaker who has to pair souls.

title: Dongri Shuxia de Huiyi
description: My dream was to be a teacher or doctor. After finishing my studies, I received my first job internship email from the hospital. I worked as an intern therapist in this hospital, And I was responsible for a girl named "Yan Ye". After taking care of Yan Ye for a year, I finally arrived at the day of discharge, but one night I heard a strange conversation about "angels". In order to help "Yan Ye", I began to search for the truth behind the matter...

title: Wordventures: The Vampire Pirate
description: On the night of the full moon, a handful of children have seemingly disappeared in the sleepy seaside town of Mistyvale Oaks. Solve word search puzzles to track down leads, uncover clues, and solve the mystery of the ghost ship in this narrative puzzle adventure game.

title: KimiKiss: Chotto Matome Gekijou
description: A collection of nine scenarios with main heroines of KimiKiss and also additional heroines never appearing in KimiKiss. There is also an anniversary parody story and a drama CD.

title: Ultimate Lemon Basket
description: Ultimate lemon basket is a platformer where you lose if you drop a lemon on the ground. Between you and the goal are ghosts, cows, snipers, acid rain, hopes, dreams and other things AS WELL!!

title: Ian's Rocket
description: A history-based, strategy, open-world game in which a nation's economy is built from scratch by utilizing all available resources. Create cities and wonders, hire labor, sell crafted products, and build armies. Meet historical figures who will either fight to stop your efforts or trade with you.

title: Borbs
description: Reunite chonky borbs with their flock in this relaxing puzzle game, brought to life by hand-drawn artwork from a longtime bird keeper.

title: Asteria: Fate of the Fallen
description: Asteria: Fate of the Fallen is an anime style, virtual reality MMORPG where players can get lost in a completely new world. Fight, cook, craft, smith, or do it all as you make connections and explore the vast and immersive world of Asteria.

title: Xenomire
description: Xenomire is a 2D sci-fi horror extraction shooter. Descend to a contaminated alien planet, complete contracts, gather loot, and extract before the horrors lurking there tear you apart. Upgrade your gear and create unique builds for each high-risk expedition.

title: The Count is Down for Blood
description: A puzzle game where you control a vampire trying to get to its crypt by dawn, but on the way through he will need to suck up enough blood from the townsfolk.

title: Glade and Ritual
description: Glade and Ritual is a cute and short story game with some Breakout-meets-Peggle style minigames. You play as a gnome who is in charge of a small village with various bug inhabitants. In the centre of the village a magic flower grows. Every night the villagers come together to perform a ritual and in return the magic flower protects the village. However the flower starts loosing it's petals once a day, leading to chaos and tension between the villagers.

title: Slotbound
description: A roguelike auto-battler defense where luck meets strategy. Spin a 3x3 slot machine to summon units and grow your army by absorbing others. Use Items and Cores to manipulate the odds and survive challenging judgement waves and boss waves. Every spin and every choice counts.

title: Dreamsend: Wintersong
description: Experience a new approach to turn-based tactical combat in this 2.5D cyberpunk fantasy Strategy RPG. Empower your roster with abilities and items inspired by genre classics and MOBAs. Face unforgiving battles and grand multiphase bossfights to shape the fate of Veichne, the land of eternal winters.

title: Mythterra
description: The goblin tribes have descended from the wastelands, and only you can stop them. In this high-fantasy pixel art RTS, you must unite the fractured realms of humans, elves, and dwarves. Build your base, manage resources, and unleash powerful magic to defend your kingdom from the goblin horde.

title: Häxeri
description: Häxeri is a grid-based first-person dungeon crawler DRPG with turn-based combat. Form your own party, explore and map the sprawling corridors of the dungeon, and battle the monsters therein. Gain extra turns by exploiting their weaknesses, but be careful or they will exploit yours!

title: Before the Fall
description: 1990s, Hong Kong. Rookie playwright Keung Siu-ping finally stages her debut, but this windfall has a price: an estranged friend, a childhood idol, an enigmatic musician, and a broken family. Who is your muse? Who is your ruin? When the curtain falls, will you be the only one left on stage?

title: Jay and Silent Bob's: Joint Venture
description: After Jay and Silent Bob sell you a bad dimebag, you help New Jersey’s legendary slackers take their operation from a rundown backyard to the best operation in the tri-state area in this gleefully obscene cozy farming adventure.

title: Sanctum Wars: Ex Infernis
description: A dark medieval action RPG where faith is fading and demons walk among men. Uncover the truth behind God's silence, master brutal tactical melee combat, and fight your way through the cursed city of Valensbrück.

title: Conqueror's Blade: Three Kingdoms
description: Conqueror's Blade: Three Kingdoms is an open-world action war game blending hero combat and troop command. Lead legendary armies alongside allies to siege cities and claim vital resources. Forge alliances, crush rival factions, and seize the realm with steel and strategy!

title: The Money Man
description: A century ago, the wealthy fled to Mars. Earth is rotting, and the underworld owns New York. In a speakeasy backroom, you verify cash paid to a crime family, using tools and guides to spot counterfeits and expose liars. With someone you love on the line, there's no room for mistakes

title: Encrafted
description: Collect, refine, and craft with a vast array of materials, cashing out your most valuable creations to pass ever-rising profit goals! Leverage and synergise countless Artefacts, upgrades, and spells to become increasingly powerful in the addictive roguelike deckbuilding game Encrafted!

title: Capybara Pizza Cafe
description: Manage a cozy cafe run by Capybaras, for Capybaras. Bake pizzas, serve pizzas, clean tables and ring that cash register!

title: Void Noir
description:
The internet never sleeps. Neither do its mysteries.

Welcome to Void Noir, a cozy detective investigation game where every case is generated from real live Twitch stream metadata.

You are not browsing Twitch.

You are not watching streams.

You are a detective.

Each investigation begins at your desk as rain falls outside your office window. A fresh case file slides onto your monitor containing only a handful of clues.

A category.

A language.

Maybe a viewer count.

Maybe part of a title.

Maybe how long they've been live.

Using those clues, you'll investigate the live internet to identify the correct broadcaster before closing another case.

Every investigation is different because every investigation comes from actual live Twitch streams happening right now.

No handcrafted mysteries.

No scripted solutions.

The internet creates the cases.

You solve them.

title: Abu Batata
description: Abu Batata is a first-person street vendor simulator set in the lively streets of Egypt. Cook and sell sweet potatoes, upgrade your cart, attract different types of customers, negotiate prices, customize your equipment, and experience a story inspired by everyday Egyptian life. Expand your business while balancing customer satisfaction, upgrades, and the challenges of surviving as a small street vendor.

title: Rubber Duck Survival
description: Rubber Duck Survival is a 2D survival game where you control a rubber duck and face over 30 bosses plus 1 secret boss. Unlock skins, defeat challenging bosses, and face waves of enemies. Can you overcome the challenge?

title: Bar Keeper
description: A cozy first-person organizing simulator where you sort 3,235 scattered bottles, glasses, casks and more throughout a three-storey bar. Match every item to its proper place, combine half bottles, unlock helpful skills, and restore perfect order at your own pace—or race the clock.

title: Nioh 3: Hell Rising
description: Our protagonist and appointed shogun, Takechiyo, journeys through time and is led to Edo in the future by an unknown yokai he met in his dreams. There, following the death of the future Takechiyo, the era of peace has ended, and Edo has been retaken by the Crucible. With the cooperation of a one-eyed swordsman, Yagyu Jubei, and a Spanish envoy, Rodrigo, Takechiyo faces yet another plot revolving around Spirit Stones and an enemy with a strong resentment towards the shogunate.

title: Nioh 3: Bloody Insurrection
description: The second Nioh 3 DLC

title: Kuizu! Batounea!
description: This is a visual novel game in which players answer quizzes to progress through the story. One of the game's key features is the unique commentary provided by the characters for most of the quiz questions.

title: Shelves and Sorcery: Tidy Up the Enchanted Shop
description:
Shelves And Sorcery is a cozy fantasy organization simulator where every shelf, crate, and display is yours to perfect. Restore order to a magical shop overflowing with hundreds of unique items, from enchanted weapons and glowing potions to spellbooks, fresh produce, and curious trinkets.

Whether you enjoy tidying a small corner or spending hours perfecting every display, Shelves And Sorcery offers a relaxing experience built around the simple joy of bringing order to chaos.

title: Low Poly Flight Simulator
description: Explore a low poly world in a flight simulator game.

title: Paddle Cats
description: Paddle Cats is a cozy two-player couch co-op fishing adventure where two cats share one boat. Paddle together, explore the waters, catch fish and bring your haul back to camp.

title: Dot Clicker
description: An immersive aim training game set in a Neo-Japanese landscape. It focused on season-based addictive precision challenges with rewards but also features a narrative alongside with a leaderboard for the top aimers and aiming communities.

title: Bckspce
description: BCKSPCE, FOR A MESSAGE UNSENT as you spend the week with Stella, a close friend of yours, uncovering the mysteries of the long since abandoned SPECTRE OS. Despite her enthusiasm, something seems off with her... just don't let it bother you.

title: Guinea Pig Gunner
description: Guinea Pig Gunner is a run-and-gun platformer with boomer shooter DNA. It fuses skill-based action platforming with a massive arsenal of weapons.

title: Billionaire Life Simulator
description: Wake up in a penthouse. Sleep on a yacht. The alarm clock is a helicopter. BILLIONAIRE LIFE SIMULATOR is the ultimate "what if I had everything" sandbox — pilot private jets, host yacht parties, customize mansions, and live the Instagram fantasy in cinematic Unreal Engine detail.

title: Titanic Escape Simulator
description: Investigate a dark mystery aboard the RMS Titanic before the final night becomes a fight for survival. Explore, solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and make impossible choices as history’s most famous ship sinks beneath the Atlantic.

title: Jurassic Genesis: We Are Aliens
description: Your planet exploded. Your escape pod crash-landed 65 million years ago. You — and one other survivor — are the first humans on Earth. JURASSIC GENESIS is co-op prehistoric survival where dinosaurs hunt by day, the night is colder than space, and every footprint you leave becomes history.

title: Auto Tuktuk Mafia
description: Tired of waiting for high-budget crime games? Play as Raju, a rickshaw driver with a dream. Drift TukTuks, fight dancing cops, and deliver 'Spicy Flour' in an open-world chaos simulator where physics is optional. Warning: Contains glitches, flying cows, and 100% pure Emotional Damage

title: Reels of the Damned
description: A slot machine deckbuilding roguelike dungeon crawl. Choose a class, grow your symbol deck, unlock spells and relics, and fight your way to the bottom of the Dungeon!

title: Gyaku Katei Kyoushi: Kanojo wa Boku no Sensei ni Shite Dorei
Hell Of War: Combined Arms
description:
Hell Of War: Combined Arms is a tactical FPS/RTS hybrid set in modern combined-arms combat. Players observe the battlefield through a command drone, locate enemy forces, issue orders to infantry and armored vehicles, and call artillery and rocket support.

During battle, players can take direct control of an infantry commander, an armored vehicle, an FPV drone, or a drop drone. Missions focus on coordinating units, capturing control points, managing support resources, and using destructible buildings and vegetation to change the battlefield.

title: Pastor
description:
Pastor is a short atmospheric horror experience combining elements of a walking simulator, psychological thriller, and visual demo.

Originally created for a game jam that never took place, the project was later completed and released as an ultra-indie title. It was developed almost entirely by one person, with additional voice acting and several 3D models contributed by members of the developer’s community, all credited in the game.

Expect a small, experimental experience focused on atmosphere, exploration, and unsettling events rather than complex gameplay.

title: Whiplash
description: WHIPLASH is a speedrunning FPS where game-changing weapon mods turn ordinary guns into overpowered builds. Craft the perfect loadout, master each course, and chase the perfect run.

title: Descent Down Infinity
description:
Descent Down Infinity is a psychological horror game inspired by classics such as Silent Hill 2 and Dead Space

Descend down into the abandoned underground megastructure of Helix-8 and uncover what's happened to the people there.
As the newest member of the Infinity Inc. family, your goal is to retrieve important data from the very heart of the city, The Core.

title: Velocity Uncapped
description: Velocity Uncapped is an open-world 3D platformer with the gimmick of the player's velocity being uncapped. As Velocity the Tortoise, who is search for its missing cap, players can infinitely build up velocity as long as they don't collide with any obstacles. Velocity being uncapped is necessary for traversing through ordinarily-insurmountable obstacles.

title: RedMoonWorld
description: In a world built on sports and peace, three athletes are chosen by destiny to face the forgotten darkness. Their strength, born from passion and belief, will decide the world’s future.

title: Dependium
description: A fast-paced 4-player cooperative puzzle game where your success helps your teammate, not yourself. Solve memory challenges, pattern recognition tasks, and coordination puzzles under time pressure—but the points you earn go to the player next to you. Trust your team or watch everyone fail.

title: Mea’s Saifu Collection Party
description: A fan-made game for Vtuber Kagura Mea. Protect yourself and Halloween gifts amidst a storm of fierce attacks! Face off against 40 waves of enemies and a variety of bosses.

title: Punk Racer
description: Boost, drift, and slipstream through six neon-soaked tracks in this free low-poly anti-grav pod racer. Race a full pack of 8 — solo against AI drones, or online with cross-platform multiplayer between Steam, web, and iOS. Kit out your pod, chase fastest laps, earn GCRED.

title: Emissary One
description: Co-op horror (1—4+ players). You’re being sent to another site to assist a squad. But it seems something is going to go wrong. Will you be able to make it back alive this time?

title: Ducks in Disguise
description: Ducks in Disguise is a cozy hand-drawn hidden object game where you find hundreds of hidden rubber ducks in intricate 2D illustrations and collect them in your personal scrapbook.

title: Alphabetto's
description: Roguelite letter-deckbuilder. The characters of the great classics sit at your table. Chain, sign and mutate letters from a deck shared by every player — every card you add arms your rival as much as you. Unlock the works line by line.

title: Wobbly Heist
description: Take control of three capybaras infiltrating a fashion event in this stealth puzzle game. Stack under a disguise to blend in among humans, split up to solve puzzles, avoid suspicion, and steal a legendary jewel. But be careful: one wrong move could reveal what’s really under the coat!

title: Hacker’s Journey
description: Hacker’s Journey is a realistic hacking simulation game built around scenarios written by cybersecurity experts. No Hollywood hacking. Learn the tools, techniques, and tradecraft used in the wild.

title: The Fourteen Day Letters
description: "The Fourteen Day Letters" is a ADV game centered around “chatting.” In a world that has already gone mad, you and “Yuna” hold onto the last fragments of sanity through a chatroom, spending fourteen days as everything slowly falls apart. And in the end, the outcome will change based on your choices.

title: Condom Commander
description: Condom Commander is a fast-paced arcade shooter where you battle waves of viruses, bacteria, and mutated infections inside the human body. Collect coins, unlock upgrades, use powerful special weapons, and defeat dangerous bosses to stop the ultimate outbreak.

title: Madjack vs Magic
description: A bullet hell roguelike deck builder set in the 1920s following the mysterious death of a world renown talent. Madjack, a middle-aged rabbit magician, finds himself cursed as a permanent resident of an old manor. Now, he must put on his best performance yet to break the curse of the Swan Song.

title: At Run Time
description: At Run Time is a first-person parkour game focused on speed, precision, and risk-taking. After stealing an energy source from a smuggler’s hideout, escape through deadly traps using advanced movement skills before time runs out.

title: Wild Gunman Remake
description: Fan remake of the NES game Wild Gunman for PlayStation Vita, PlayStation 4, and Windows.

title: Snayk 3+
description: Higher dimensional snake with gradients and many options, who can beat a megadimension?

title: The Forbidden Tomes of Olipos
description: What started as an out-of-town gig quickly turns into the journey of a lifetime for Romina! The young librarian will hunt forbidden tomes, fight powerful foes, and discover ancient mysteries in this classic JRPG adventure. What truth awaits at the end of it all?

title: Nozomu School Daze
description: Your choices matter in Nozomu School Daze, a 90s shonen anime-meets-rom-com visual novel! As a college girl, Sari wants to attend school in peace. Too bad the martial artists in her life have other ideas! These 3 idiots get into a knock-down brawl, which YOU control! New genre: BATTLE ROMANCE

title: Kamikaze Empire
description: Carve the path to victory with kamikaze attacks! Blow away enemies with outlandish weapons, then become your own projectile and take the rest out in a blaze of explosive glory! A self destructive shmup where you devastate everything in your wake. "Squadron, charge~!"

title: 1 Thousand Deaths
description: Explore handcrafted worlds. Props are traps. Enemies hide as furniture. Glitches warp gravity. Die. Respawn. Try again.

title: Souten Koihime: Dawn of Sovereignty
description: A visual novel Inspired by ancient Chinese history. Sima Qian is an apprentice Keeper of Alternate Histories. Seeing a vision of the world in turmoil, he breaks the law of the celestial realm to go there. In that world, the age of the Red Dragon Maiden and the Vicious King is about to begin.

title: Puppy Truck
description: Puppy Truck is a puzzle-packed 3D platforming adventure about a tiny truck with the heart of a puppy! Explore Grandma’s eclectic house, filled with contraptions, challenges, and surprises as you race to make it to the birthday party on time.

title: Minecraft Matcha Flavoured
description: Matcha Flavoured is a datapack designed to reward casual players who don't enjoy making mob farms, or engaging in the technical aspects of minecraft. The goal being for casual players, who like to play slowly, to be able to gather the same amount of resources technical players do in the same amount of time.

title: Off Road Together
description: Off Road Together: An adventurous off-road experience in single or co-op mode for up to 4 people! Drive 4x4 vehicles through challenging terrain, overcome obstacles and camp and rest. Upgrade your equipment, strategize with your team and reach the top!

title: TV Archive: Tidy Up Together
description: Shelve the videotapes, unlock new skills, and use your unique methods to tidy up the TV archive. Enjoy the online co-op and online PvP with your friends, or go solo! Fill up the shelves and experience a sense of relief and satisfaction.

title: SnowJob
description: SnowJob is a 4-player co-op horror about hunting artifacts in a frozen anomalous zone full of hidden dangers. Dig through fully physical snow, explore the wasteland, and scan what you find before something underground finds you.

title: Nightmare Delivery
description:
Nightmare Delivery is a cooperative psychological horror game where players take the role of couriers sent into places no delivery should ever reach.

You do not deliver to houses, streets, or real locations.
You enter the distorted consciousness of different people and carry a package meant for the darkness hidden inside them. Each mission takes place inside a strange mental space shaped by fear, memory, guilt, obsession, or trauma. These places may look familiar at first, but their logic is broken. Corridors lead where they should not, rooms repeat without reason, and ordinary objects can become part of the puzzle.

title: Heroes of Hammerwatch II: Celestial Ruins
description: Take up the holy duties of the new Priest class and brave a fallen sanctum in the Celestial Ruins Expansion for Heroes of Hammerwatch II.

title: FreshWomen: Season 3
description: FreshWomen is a choice-driven adult Visual Novel focusing on the best parts of life. You're a college freshman who just earned a mansion. Bring girls to your home to romance, date, or fuck them. Your journey will be filled with comedy, love, and lots of sex.

title: Yashi - Sand Driver
description: In an endless desert, you are Yashi, a lone survivor... until this radio signal changes everything. Jump in your van with your faithful coyote, drive across the wastelands, survive the heat, scavenge resources, craft tools, fight the elements & find your way to New Eden in this feel-good road trip.

title: LumaWorlds
description: LumaWorlds is a 2D multiplayer sandbox game centered on its deep item crafting system, player-driven economy, and persistent, community-built worlds. LumaWorlds blends creative freedom, social trading, and collaborative world-building.

title: Smelly Bubbles
description:
You are in a pool with friends or random players.
One player can fart and others vote who farted, player who got most votes will be thrown out from the pool. Talk to others with voice chat and solve who really farted.

title: Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend
description: Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend is a single-player basketball career simulator set in an original fictional universe. Create a prospect, choose a College, International, or Pro path, shape skills and mentality through RPG decisions, and earn a role through performance, form, and consistency. Play or simulate games in the Live 2D Match Center while teams, rosters, markets, standings, playoffs, records, contracts, coaches, agents, sponsors, injuries, media pressure, and national-team selections evolve across multiple seasons.

title: A Brief Tale
description: A Brief Tale is a short RPG made with RPG Maker MV. The game is inspired by the never-ending story. It was created as part of the Jim Jam 2018 in a timespan of 48 hours.

title: Dead Man's Day
description:
In an old SALOON in the WILD WEST, a gunfight breaks out when a gambler is shot by a long-time debtor. The saloon-owner finds himself SHOT and bleeding on the ground.

At the moment of his death, he gets caught in a TIME LOOP and is forced to relive the day he died over and over again. Slip into the role of the almost dead bartender in this 3D FIRST PERSON ADVENTURE and manipulate the events of the day, so the fight never happens and you SURVIVE!

title: The Eventide
description: A supernatural mystery where perspective informs reality. Guide agents from the Eventide Agency through paranormal investigations across a neon-soaked cityscape. Explore, collect clues, and interpret the evidence to uncover the facts of each case and expose a deeper truth.

title: Drive to The Top
description: Jump, Swing and Boost your way to get to the finish as fast as you can! Try beating the level in both single player and 2-player co-op. How fast can you beat the game?

title: Voleur!
description: With a minute left in the Volouvre, Rion must dash around the museum to steal the remaining treasures before they get him... A Voleur in the Volouvre!!

title: About Frontlines
description: A turn-based strategy game built on total freedom. Design your own maps, forge your own units, and set your own rules of war. Build and play every era you can imagine. Quick, tense, tactical battles against AI, friends, or players worldwide.

title: Package chaos
description: Package Chaos is a cozy package sorting game where you turn a messy warehouse into a perfectly organized delivery center.Pick up, inspect, sort thousands of unique packages and enjoy the satisfying feeling of a perfectly organized warehouse.

title: Crownbane
description: Crownbane is a free-to-play asynchronous MMO strategy game set in an ongoing war between four nations. Each player rules a single city, developing four- and five-tier production chains into realm-wide masteries and managing an economy that includes a market, bank, tavern and inn. Armies are built from eighteen unit types across five battle roles, and surviving troops keep their veterancy between battles. Players pledge troops and supplies to scheduled fronts before war-day, after which the server resolves each battle turn by turn on a persistent shared front and returns a detailed battle log. It can be played in a web browser or on desktop.

title: World of Warcraft: Midnight - Curse of Ula'tek
description: A new threat coils in the shadows as the Curse of Ula’tek content update draws champions to the Coiled Isle. Uncover the secrets buried within its cursed depths, face venomous new dangers, and prepare for fresh challenges.

title: Croc 2: Kingdom of the Gobbos
description: Croc's back, and this time he's searching for his long-lost parents. Revived by the Dantinis, arch enemy Baron Dante vows revenge. Explore four mainland villages, rescue Gobbos, and battle new Guardians. Race cars and speedboats, ride minecarts, and take to the skies in the remastered 1999 classic.

title: Pitfalls 64
description: Take on a brutal, platforming gauntlet in Pitfalls 64! Clamber upwardly as a homesick gnome in search of his way back home, butt proceed with caution; one careless slip could spell a hard bonk back to the bottom...

title: Blockfeet
description: Welcome to the world of blocks! You are a "Blocksmith," a rare individual with the power to build and shape the world around you. Start with a blank slate and transform it into a thriving, customized town filled with unique villagers, cozy homes, and plenty of heartwarming activities.

title: Never Sort By Color
description:
Never Sort By Color is a first-person zen organization game where you use magnet gloves, part detection, sieves, and quick hotkey tossing to sort an enormous pile of plastic bricks into a labeled workshop. Instead of sorting by color, you sort by part type, rebuilding drawers and organizing bays as the floor area opens up.
As you complete categories, instruction books guide you to pull exact parts from the right drawers to assemble MOCs that snap together brick by brick, turning the quiet sorting loop into satisfying, functional model building.

title: Just Pool
description: Just Pool is a minimalist 8-ball pool game. Score all your balls to win the match, play with friends or solo.

title: Ludus: A Gladiator Story
description: A fully voiced branching narrative RPG of the Roman arena with a unique engraving and VO for every choice and outcome. Four origins, over 1,800 choices, and 19 endings. You will bleed on the sand. The only question is whether you bleed for them, or for yourself. Every choice leaves a scar.

title: Orun
description: Follow Orun through his journey to restore the guardian flame that once defended the city from creatures that now have devastated the land.

title: Rusty Vein
description: Rusty Vein is a 2.5D action-adventure game. Wearing a metal gauntlet, Rain sets out on a journey to defeat the mysterious doll legion that has occupied the town’s castle.

title: My Lovey-Dovey Angel Is a Total Deadbeat: Seriously Scary!
description: Hulotte’s classic visual novel is now on Steam! After an injury ends his track dream, Sakuma Tsumugi meets a clumsy Love Angel and begins a sweet search for his destined special someone.

title: Separator
description: Separator is a short nonlinear visual novel in the psychological horror genre, inspired by modern occultism and beliefs surrounding mysticism.

title: Doom 3: 2553
description: Doom 3: 2553 is a simple mod with the goal of putting the events of DOOM 3 in the Halo Universe. This means Halo weapons, character models, and lore. Weapons have been completely updated with new stats and models.

title: Elementis TD
description: Elementis TD is an elemental tower defense game. Basic towers are intentionally weak, and the core mechanic consists of combining them into 21 discoverable fusions. A Corruption system can affect the player's own towers during a wave. The game features a 7-chapter campaign, an endless mode with progressive scaling, and 90 achievements.
