title: Immortal Coil
description: Build powerful decks to confront the Gods in this lane-based, strategy card game. Play the Roguelike Adventure Mode or ascend the Tower of Battle in Gauntlet Mode. Discover wild deckbuilding synergies to unleash spectacular combos against formidable foes.

title: Call of Cutie
description: CALL OF CUTIE is a single-player horror adventure set inside a vast, terrifying laboratory. Explore dark corridors, solve puzzles, fight frightening enemies, and rescue the victims trapped inside. Choose your own path with Bubbles and find a way to escape.

title: The Two Body Problem
description: The Two Body Problem is a physics-driven puzzle game where two robots must literally carry, throw, and reposition each other to survive. The catch: you, alone, control both robots. The world demands cooperation, but there's no one to cooperate with except yourself.

title: Office Ladies
description: Get Safe for Work with six inspirational HR managers in this interactive Human Resources Training Program

title: Digital Survivor
description: A neon bullet-heaven survivors roguelite. Outrun the swarm as 4 hunted programs, forge 20 weapons into ultimate forms, master build-defining synergies, raid extraction vaults, climb leaderboard seasons — and face ROOT, the administrator that wants you deleted.

title: Slots & Slaughter
description: Spin slots, win gold, buy and upgrade items, then battle bizarre enemies as you build an overpowered item deck in this casual yet tactical roguelike deck-builder.

title: Rover’s Radventure: The New Millennium
description: After a regular day at work transforms into a bizarre trip that turns his life upside down, a washed-up park ranger named Rover needs to step up and go on a journey that will take him far beyond his wildest fantasies and lead him to confronting uncomfortable truths about himself and his past.

title: Cristal Absoluto
description: A F2P Indie Roleplaying Game, Discover its story about crystals and old universal beings.

title: Zenless Zone Zero: Update 3.1 - The Long Goodbye
description:
Marking the continuation of Zenless Zone Zero's Season 3, Version 3.1 includes:
• New Characters: Remielle and Sigrid
• New Main Story Quest: Season 3 Chapter 2: The Long Goodbye
• 2nd Anniversary Celebrations
• New gameplay mechanics, system updates, and events

title: Conquest: Global Domination
description:
Conquer the world through strategy, diplomacy, and military power.
Build your nation. Expand your empire. Dominate the globe.

title: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls - Year 1 Character and Stage Pass
description:
Expand your roster of fighting heroes and villains with the Year 1 Character and Stage Pass.

Includes four more iconic Marvel characters, an additional stage, and a set of result screen character poses.

title: Texturetown
description: TEXTURETOWN is an algorithmically remixed MMO created from assets of now-defunct mid-2000's children's MMOs. It uses the fabric of games themselves as media to collage.

title: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls - Year 1 DLC Character: Phoenix Cyclops
description:
Phoenix Cyclops, the first DLC character included in the Year 1 Character & Stage Pass, is coming to MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls!

Inspired by his Phoenix Five incarnation from Avengers vs. X-Men, this iconic X-Men leader harnesses the overwhelming power of the Phoenix Force, bringing a fiery new look and devastating abilities to the battlefield.

title: Desktop Detective
description:
Search for clues in this idle detective RPG that lives quietly in the corner of your screen.

Investigate crime scenes, gain clues, upgrade your stats, and grow stronger across ascensions while you go about your day.

title: Pheonix II
description: A fast-paced shoot 'em up where skill matters. Master over 100 ships, unleash powerful special abilities, and blast through waves of Invaders. Play a new mission every day and climb the world-wide leaderboards.

title: Fantasy Miner: Idle Depths
description: Dig for ore, discover new resources, smelt ingots, and unlock hundreds of upgrades in this fantasy mining idle game. Mine faster, dig deeper, and watch your progress grow.

title: The Regular: Same Dog Every Time
description: Run a cozy hot dog cart, serve charming customers, restock your stand, and end each shift a little better than the last in a relaxing food-making game with a strange little secret simmering under the surface.

title: Can You Cook My Last Meal?
description: A game where you become a prison chef and cook the final meals of death row inmates. Read each prisoner’s profile, choose ingredients, prepare the meal, and talk with them.

title: Sanasana
description: To bring her deceased sister back to life, a young girl sets out to steal the Golden Apples from three witches. Dodge beautiful yet merciless bullet patterns in this dark fantasy bullet hell shooter filled with madness.

title: Beyond The Frame
description: Beyond The Frame is an immersive horror game set in the liminal dreamscapes of an 11-year-old child. The deeper you explore, the more the anxieties of your subconscious mind creep into the dream. Will you be brave enough to face them?

title: Petty Ungodliness
description: The gods lost their power and took retail jobs. A single-player roguelite deckbuilder where relationships shape your deck and every battle plays out across three tactical lanes. Rebuild your bond with them to reclaim their power.

title: Slime Jump
description: Master precise jumps, climb ever higher, and race against the clock in this challenging precision platformer. Every jump matters, can you reach the top and earn every speed achievement?

title: Thimbleweed Park 2
description: Agents Ray and Reyes are investigating a murder at the Mansion. In a spoof of a classic whodunit, everyone is a suspect and the murderer will be confronted…... If you can find them. Not really a sequel. Not really a prequel. It’s more Thimbleweed Park and just as weird.

title: Riftfall
description: HELL DIDN'T CLOSE. IT EVOLVED. A fast, brutal retro indie FPS raised on the 90s classics: a 20-level campaign, 5 heavy weapons with alt-fires, 60+ enemy types, unique boss arenas, AI squadmates, permanent upgrades, skull keys, secrets and an epic soundtrack.
Pull the lever, stop the reels, and chase the 1 / 16384 triple 7.

title: Fading Light and Summer's Shadow
description: Uncover the hidden truth behind a summer festival in this Japanese-style story adventure.

title: Gift From God
description: Gift From God is a visual novel told through the eyes of Ryosuke Nikaido and Akane Yamamoto. As they face three missions from God, their hearts, pasts, and choices begin to intertwine, leading them toward the true meaning of God’s “gift.”

title: Nandao Ni Shi Gal Gaoshou
description: An introverted girl who is bad at games, an artist who struggles with drawing human anatomy, a wealthy young lady who wants to play visual novels for the rest of her life, and a younger sister trying her best to understand what anime is—you will play their protagonist and start a romantic comedy!

title: Chiaroscuro Lovers
description: A domineering CEO-like older sister who’s gentle only to her sister, a childhood friend who became her doctor, and a cheerful girl only she can see… Who was Chu Hebai before losing her memories, and how did she become entangled with them? A melancholic yuri AVG about regret and unspoken love.

title: Four Lights: The 3rd World - Hari Route
Four Lights: The 4th World - Märchen Route
description: This story is of God and us and our grand revenge against Lucifer.

title: Chiqing Meimei Shaxue de Xiongkong Riji
The Magical Girl Childhood Friend Lives Next Door
description: A story-driven romance visual novel where your choices shape relationships, uncover secrets, and lead to multiple endings with your childhood friend.

title: Drown in Yesterday's Sea
description: Xiamen,Fujian Province,2024. Gu Mengzhi, a 19-year-old student at Xiamen University, encounters a "sea spirit" named Coral—who hails from the ocean—and the two quickly become close.However, just as their bond deepens, an uninvited guest known as "The Stranger" arrives and disrupts everything.

title: Aerovice Frutiger World
description: A relaxing exploration adventure inspired by Frutiger Aero. Wander through dreamcore worlds, backrooms, poolrooms, and liminal spaces, uncover secrets, collect treasures, and experience a nostalgic journey in vibrant 3D.

title: Yggdrasil
description:
9 worlds, 9 colors, 9 puzzles to solve.

YGGDRASIL is a small 2D puzzle game about walking, exploring and finding your ways.

You wake up in a place you do not recognise, with buttons you do not know what they are for (yet), and not even recalling exactally what you are.

Every piece of information matters. There are no "quests" and no direct leads. You are on your own in YGGDRASIL.

title: Cosplaying in Costalia: The Tororo Sisters!
description: When Souta’s cosplay-filled camera gets broken, the Yamakake sisters volunteer to be cosplay models for him. After gratefully accepting and whipping up a flurry of cosplay outfits for the girls, they head to Costalia, a cosplayer’s paradise. But will their photo shoots go off without a hitch?

title: MinerMancers
description: MinerMancers is a co-op action game about under-appreciated wizards going mining together. You and up to 3 friends will cast spells, mine resources, fight monsters, and above all get back alive so you can spend your earnings on new hats, robes and beards.

title: CryptoGrid
description: CryptoGrid is an addictive clicker simulator where you build your digital empire from scratch. Click to earn coins, upgrade your performance, unlock unique music tracks, and collect rare items. Start your journey, manage your resources, and reach the top in this relaxing and engaging experience!

title: Touhou: Kira's Fangame Collection
description: A collection of 6 in 1 free to play fangames based on the Touhou Project! Play as Reimu and other iconic characters in these couch co-op adventures that include genres such as platforming, metroidvania, tower defense and 3D stealth!

title: Blue Oath
description: Blue Oath is a solo combat action-adventure game in which you play as a warrior swordfish who sets out on a journey to free a giant, cursed moray eel. Using powerful dash attacks, you can impale enemies and objects onto your beak, stack them, and throw them back as weapons or tools.

title: Condominium: No Exit
description: As always, another ordinary day riding the train home. Yet what awaits beyond the door is a world of chaos, far removed from common sense. Your phone suddenly begins ringing like mad...

title: Hell Forest
description: Hell Forest is a digital board game. In Hellwood, you take on the role of a strategic commander, leading a magnificent, non-violent war. With limited resources, you will use your wisdom to claim victory in one region after another.

title: Goodnight, B
description: Goodnight, B is a single-player 2D puzzle-platformer about a hungry little girl struggling with nightmares. Rotate and place sections of each level to complete them. Explore various environments, meet wacky characters, find secrets, and wall-jump your way towards that coveted midnight snack.

title: Bonely Hearts Club
description: A UTMV dating sim based on the UT, UF, US, HT & SF boys. A volunteer project filled with love.

title: 5D Chess With Multiverse Time Travel Chatting
description: Just chatting, but with the 5D Chess With Multiverse Time Travel starting screen in the background.

title: Oar'some Adventures
description: Paddles up, Hosers! OAR'SOME Adventures is a cozy/chaotic rafting and nature adventure for 1-8 players. Casually paddle your way down the river alone, or gather your friends for whitewater mischief and exploration in beautiful, yet dangerous, surroundings.

title: Rideshare "Stimulator"
description: Build your rideshare business while navigating real-world traffic, managing your vehicle, and transporting a wide range of unique passengers. Master the streets, keep your car in shape, and deliver every ride, no matter how strange it gets.

title: Monster Nursery
description: A relaxing idle monster collection game (with offline progress). Features 200 monster entries and 10 Lo-fi tracks.

title: Ravenshade Asylum
description:
Ravenshade Asylum is a psychological horror experience inspired by classic Silent Hill atmosphere and analog horror storytelling. Explore the abandoned halls of Ravenshade Asylum, uncover hidden records, disturbing experiments, and the truth behind a secret cult that turned treatment into something far more terrifying.

As you descend deeper into the asylum, reality begins to distort. Strange whispers echo through empty corridors, shadows linger in forgotten rooms, and the line between hallucination and reality slowly disappears. The patients were never meant to be cured. They were part of something far darker.

title: Hot Wheels Infinite Rush: Bone Shaker Skeletor Edition
Castlevania: Belmont's Curse - Midnight Edition
description:
This product contains the full game, Digital Sound & Art Gallery, as well as 3 bonus in-game items.
・Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse
・Digital Sound & Art Gallery
・Bonuses (In-game items) x3
- Trevor Style Costume
- Sypha Style Costume
- Family's Grace（Relic）

title: Silly Sausage Buffet
description: Silly Sausage, the worlds most stretchy dog! Navigate this surreal platformer using unique elastic controls. Stretch and weave your way through this doggy dream trilogy of edible delights. With challenges only made possible through elasticated gameplay. A full three course gaming meal awaits!

title: Tiny Ramen Shop
description: Run your own Tiny Ramen Shop! It's tiny, yes, but customers are already lining up to try your delicious ramen. Prepare food, stock your warehouse with fresh ingredients, upgrade and decorate your establishment. Hungry customers are waiting for their favorite ramen chef!

title: Fortnite Festival: Season 15
description:
He got his start rapping with friends while playing Fortnite, and now you and your friends can band up or go solo with his 4 new Jam Tracks "Ransom," "Dark Thoughts," “Love Me” and "500lbs".

The Neon Dreams Music Pass unlocks new Festival gear, like the music-reactive Tour Ready Lil Tecca Outfit, the Mic Mace Pickaxe, Tecca’s World Back Bling, and the Dopamine Tour-inspired Guitar.

title: Long Shadow
description: Guide one family across centuries of collapse, evacuation, settlement and interstellar expansion. Preserve memories, establish laws, command crews, inherit ships and face the Afterless as every choice becomes part of history.

title: World Climate Lab
description: World Climate Lab is a real-time planetary climate simulator. Import your own terrain or sculpt a world in the topography editor, then watch a living climate emerge from physics: winds, oceans, cloud bands and ice. Every climate is calculated, not painted.

title: Osta
description: A militaria collecting simulator where you hunt for items through metal detecting, auctions, and markets to build your collection and customize your home. Travel to various locations to uncover the relics of different conflicts throughout history.

title: Bomberful!
description: Welcome, interns, to the Bomberful company! In this game, assemble bomb parts on a grid, manage space to increase your score, and calibrate your unstable product by mixing chemicals and connecting wires.

title: Seasons of Books and Keys
description: After class, small problems drift into the library—harmless at first glance, yet hiding secrets and lies. You see the clues, hear every voice, and turn the page yourself as each case unravels. A bittersweet mystery adventure that blends the experience of reading with the feeling of watching a drama.

title: Bringers of Darkness
description: Fight for the forces of darkness in a fast-paced bullet heaven survivors-like. Become a champion of darkness, master unique abilities, and bring ruin to the kingdoms of light that created their own nightmares.

title: Mall: Tidy Up Together
description: Shelve the products, unlock new skills, and use your unique methods to tidy up the mall. Enjoy the online co-op and online PvP with your friends, or go solo! Fill up the shelves and experience a sense of relief and satisfaction.

title: Blackwood Lodge: The Siblings
description: Uncover the dark secrets of Blackwood Lodge in this atmospheric psychological horror game. As John Wilson, use your lighter to brave the dark, explore fractured spirit memories, and solve puzzles to piece together a tragic crime, all while evading a terrifying supernatural stalker.

title: Duellum
description: A chaotic roguelike of medieval jousts, broken builds and spectacular defeats. Buy wacky weapons, strap on eccentric armor and discover combos so overpowered they'd make the gods of jousting weep. Only the most wondrous fools shall rise to legend.

title: Revolution: Young Mao
description: Set around 1929, this interactive visual novel lets you relive the early Red Army's epic journey from a first-person perspective. Experience immersive historical narratives and make pivotal branching choices. Beware: wrong decisions will end your game!

title: Deep Drift Signal Below
description: Dive into a beautiful yet deadly pixel deep sea and track unknown signals from the abyss. Manage oxygen, pressure, currents, and creatures while exploring. Capture life with a harpoon, find relics and chests, upgrade gear, and face hidden giants. The deeper you go, the greater the risk.

title: Mask da Fart
description: Beat the Stinky Allegations by Masking your Farts as an Intern at your first day on the job

title: Sisyphus's Worst Day (Again)
description: Build traps, manipulate the environment, and engineer the perfect loop to keep Sisyphus from ever reaching the summit in this comedic isometric 3D puzzle game.

title: Twisted Party
description: Survive. Sabotage. Style on your friends. Twisted Party is a retro horror party game stuffed with deadly mini-games and buckets of blood. Betray your way to victory and unlock crazy skins by conquering brutal challenges. Last one standing wins

title: Rushfall
description: You are the king defending your kingdom from waves of slugs! Use swords, knives, and magical powers like lightning and a magic staff to protect your land. Upgrade wisely to survive!

title: Grim Hammer
description: Stop the stone golem and his army using powerful upgrades. Crush enemies with your hammer, earn gold, and unlock new abilities to defeat waves of monsters.

title: Dog of Wisdom
description: Dog of Wisdom is a 2D action platformer where you play as Pepper the dachshund. Fly around barking at nothing and sample the galaxy's best foods, all while attaining the knowledge to be good. Get the foods and the wisdom and the hat and the galaxy.

title: Nacho Chihuahua: The Movie - The Game
description: Join Nacho as he pursues his true destiny: to return to his homeland, South of the Border!

title: I Got the Zoomies!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
description: Claim your legit phone!!!!! I got the Zoomies is a visually chaotic incremental game where your only goal is to zoom in... indefinitely!

title: A Tangle of Snakes
description: Untangle the snakes! Help them escape without causing harm. Scare them in the right way, avoid obstacles, and prevent collisions in this fun and challenging puzzle game.

title: Winter Resort RPG
description: Visit the world famous Winter Resort, known for Snowbrawl - A competition where participants attempt to knock each other off balance with snowballs in a duel!

title: Bad Granny Little Thief
description: Bad Granny: Little Thief, a 3D horror survival adventure, you play as Bob, a kid uncovering the dark secrets of his suspicious neighbors. Navigate their eerie homes, solve puzzles, and survive tense FPS encounters. Your choices shape the story, leading to multiple thrilling endings.

title: God Is Not Here
description:
God Is Not Here is a first-person psychological horror game. The player explores an isolated house, investigates paranormal phenomena, solves environmental puzzles, and follows clues through recordings, surveillance cameras, and the surrounding environment.

The game focuses on atmosphere, narrative exploration, environmental storytelling, and encounters with hostile supernatural entities.

title: Time to Crate
description: "Time to Crate" is an incremental platformer/survivors-like/arcade/dating sim/jrpg love story. You're a circular saw. There are crates. Destroy them. Jump. Bump. Ground pound. Get the money. Buy upgrades. Become stronger. Ridiculously stronger. Do it again. And again. And again. Time. To. Crate.

title: Genshin Impact: Everwinter Without Mercy
description:
The sixth major update of Genshin Impact, also known as Version 7.0. This update includes:
• New characters: Odette, Alyosha and Cryo Traveler
• New region, Snezhnaya
• New main story quests: "Everwinter Without Mercy" and "Wraith's Nocturne"
• New elemental reaction: Stellar Swirl
• New main event: Great Expeditionist Challenge
• New third-person shooter elements

title: Oshikake Oku-sama to, Kimi no Uso
VSky-X MMORPG
description: Vortex Sky MMORPG is an old school wuxia game that mixes Twelve Sky 1 and Twelve Sky 2 in the same client and the same server for players to enjoy a totally renovated version of the game.

title: Catterplosion
description: Help Wiggle The Galaxy Swallower of Eternal Despair make his childrens become butterflys ! Place bombs and set their countdowns to explode Wiggle's childs into the magic ring of butterfly transformation.

title: Kiana & Biscuit: Pirates on a Visit!
description: A retro platforming game where two ladies, Kiana and Biscuit go on a vacation to a private island to spend time with their partners, only to be interrupted by dastardly pirates! Jump, collect coconuts and tokens, beat the par times, and aim for high ranks to unlock images in the gallery!

title: The Additional Dimension
description: A game set in 70s Soviet Union, you need to escape an unknown liminal dimension.

title: SelkoMadd
description:
A puzzle game with contemplation in colorful world. You must find the prince to save the kingdom.
Use antigravity, levers, teleportation and many features to solve the puzzles !

title: Arc-en-ciel no Majuu
description:
This is a world of beasts and magic.
Once a vibrant land, it was slowly coming to an end, ravaged by monsters and miasma.
While everyone was resigned to their fate, one day a lion boy encounters a canine boy with amnesia.
The boy possesses one of the seven colored keys said to grant the wishes of those who collect it.
Thus begins the boys' adventure to save the world.

title: Lemure Lemure
description:
A string of serial murders sends the Whitechapel district of Londinium into a fearful frenzy. Amidst those blood colored whispers, a white cat continues her daily life in the slums doing odd jobs and nothing of note.

Then, one day—as if ordained by God— she meets her fated lover: a dirty, dirty liar.

title: Mike the Hooper
description: Mike the Hooper is a 2D basketball puzzle platformer where you shoot hoops, open doors, and help Mike get home. Find your way through each level, make tricky shots, and overcome platforming challenges along the way.

title: Elevator: Avici
description: "Elevator: Avici" is a 1st-person psychological horror with a retro, HK lo-fi aesthetic. Trapped in a decaying apartment elevator, your only link to the outside is a strange voice on the intercom claiming to be a repairman. Will you follow his commands, or find your own escape from the darkness?

title: Last Known Vector
description: A short first-person sci-fi game focused on repairing a failing ship. Restore critical systems while avoiding a strange entity that has boarded your vessel.

title: Run from the Cops!
description: Run from the Cops! puts you behind the wheel in a high-speed chase for freedom and fortune. Take control of a clever troublemaker determined to score quick money and make a clean getaway through chaotic city streets.

title: Saga Onirica: Angelic Engine
description: Saga Onirica: Angelic Engine is a top-down shooter featuring experimental control schemes and mechanics, where you fight endless waves of demons by crafting the ultimate loadout from firearms, magic spells, and advanced technology.

title: FPV PVP
description: A competitive FPV drone shooter. Pilot an agile quadcopter with an RC transmitter, gamepad, or mouse and keyboard, and fight other players across 5v5 Bomb Defusal, Team Deathmatch, and 1v1 Ranked Duels. Two flight models, ranked ladders with global leaderboards, and a buy-menu economy.

title: Nate Hand Gesture
description: An entity traps you in a room in an endless loop; you must play a hand-gesture game just for a chance to survive or escape—and whatever you do, don't make her angry.

title: Kinetic TwinZ
description: In this Motion Control party game, turn volleyball into an act of defiance! Seize your Joy-Cons, dodge powerful attacks, and coordinate with your duo to defeat the "Anti-Fun" police. This game was created by students from the video game school ISART Digital as part of their final-year project.

title: R.E.G.O
description: R.E.G.O is a first-person psychological horror and narrative investigation game. On an isolated farm, the nights reveal clues tied to disappearances and an ongoing police investigation. The deeper you investigate, the further you are drawn into a mystery that was never meant to be uncovered.

title: Prison Legacy
description: What are you in for? Prison Legacy is a social MMORPG set inside a mixed-gender maximum-security prison. Choose one of 12 criminal classes, then fight turn-based battles, craft contraband, trade, steal, chat, and build a clan strong enough to outlast the hilarious darkness rising behind bars.

title: Plant Anywhere
description: Plan your real garden, then grow a virtual one. A spatial garden planner fused with a pixel-art farming simulator — companion planting, succession scheduling, seed-starting, 120+ crops, and local frost-date data. Design beds, track harvests, run the sim, and earn 20 achievements.

title: Monolilith
description: Follow the journey of the witch Muirguenet and celebrate evil оrgіеѕ to invoke evil creatures. You will welcome cultists, turn them into horny and powerful monsters, and spawn ominous monoliths from hell to fight back the inquisition in this real-time strategy game.

title: The Unfamiliars
description: The Unfamiliars is a first person atmospheric horror experience presented through a VHS camcorder perspective. Players explore a small isolated mobile home while documenting strange and unsettling events unfolding outside during a rainy night.

title: Echoes of the End: Enhanced Edition
description: Echoes of the End: Enhanced Edition is a free update to the 2025 fantasy action-adventure game.

title: Anti-Anti
description: A choice-driven psychological mystery visual novel, Anti-Anti. In a world once devastated by slime monsters, you are forced into a suspicious audition. A locked-room mystery, ensemble drama, adventure, thriller, and romance!

title: CypherWars
description: CypherWars is a cyberpunk-themed, Drug Wars-inspired, buy-low, sell-high arbitrage simulator roguelite set in the Maxx Cypher universe. Travel from node to node, buying and selling digital contraband for maximum profit, pay off your debt to the Syndicate, and try to maintain the highest net worth possible before your runner session runs out of cycles. But, watch out! Warden Stryker is always on the hunt for runners who strike it big in the grid and is ruthless when he catches you!

title: Hyper Trigger
description: Build nonstop momentum in this stylish fast-paced rocket-jumping platformer.

title: Fortune Summoners Special Edition
description: A 2D side-scrolling pixel art action RPG featuring advanced AI companions that fight and move on their own. A heartfelt story about children’s daily lives and small adventures in a world of swords and magic. The Special Edition update adds a Arche's Mystery Dungeon, a full-fledged roguelike RPG featuring randomly generated dungeons, rare treasures, and powerful mutant monsters. In addition the update adds additional items, artwork and a bonus mode: Arche's Arena.

title: The Aquarium Does Not Dance: The Idol Who Wants to Die
description: The prequel to The Aquarium does not dance, created by the horror-hating creator daidai, is now under development! Keep an eye out for more news about the new game, "The Aquarium does not dance: The Idol Who Wants to Die."

title: Two Point Museum: Update 5.0
description:
A new Digiverse expedition map is available to explore once players reach the start of Memento Mile’s second star

This new map gives Digiverse experts the ability to transcend their normal digital confines and explore the universes of other games

The Digiverse map will grow over time as new rifts are discovered, providing new exhibits, decoration and gameplay

title: C-ko-fn-ta-C
description:
A troubled illustrator runs away from home.

A lonely fan takes her under her wing.

From there, it’s all downhill.

A visual novel about responsibility, arrested adolescence, and the mortifying ordeal of being (un)known.

title: Nursery Rhyme: Full HD Remaster
description: An all ages remaster of Nursery Rhyme with a new Kururu route, re-recorded and re-arranged OP/ED songs and movies.

title: Der Böse Mann
description:
An action packtion thriller with horror elements. Its a jump and run because you jump and run. You need to survive until your deadly laser is charged and then kill the evil man. But don't get hit by the hands or his little minios.

This game was made for the GMTK GameJam 2026

title: Esurient
description: Upon the bones of a world long reclaimed by nature, embark on a journey wrought with danger and discovery. Leverage advanced mobility to navigate unforgiving terrain and dispatch fearsome foes. Bloom in veiled ruins haunted by beast and machine.

title: Glyphs of the East
description: Explore the dark, mystical land of Runetide in Glyphs of the East, a single-player real-time strategy game. Unravel ancient glyphs, harness their power, and command forces in a battle against the shadows. Master strategy and magic, as every move shapes your civilization's destiny.

title: Project Sentinel: Zero Tolerance
description: Project Sentinel is a 16-bit inspired run-and-gun platformer that blends arcade action with dystopian law enforcement. Intimidate suspects into compliance with a cybernetic roar, make arrests, rescue civilians, or enforce order through overwhelming firepower.

title: Hiderman
description: Hiderman is a first--person psychological horror game about collecting mushrooms in a dark, ever-changing forest while a mysterious creature watches from the trees. Use your flashlight to expose the creature, follow the signs, and survive through multiple escalating horror phases. Features randomized vegetation and mushroom placement, two endings, and an average playtime of 25-45 minutes.

title: Lootdeck
description: Lootdeck is a tactical roguelite deckbuilder deeply integrated with tabletop combat mechanics. Every item you equip adds new action cards to your deck. Craft your own unique playstyle through the loot you find, outsmart enemies on a tactical grid, and delve deeper into an ever-changing dungeon.

title: Annalog
description: Annalog is a "Zachtroidvania" homebrew NES game, combining Zach-like programming puzzles with Metroidvania-style platforming, exploration, upgrades, and bosses.

title: Sneaky Clean
description:
Sneaky Clean is a social deduction cleaning game where not everyone is squeaky clean.
Scrub down a luxury resort and clean up after the ones playing dirty. Play solo or in co-op, with or without troublemakers and prove you're not all washed up !

title: SuperPacker
description: An idle game about packing boxes!

title: Wand & Order: Tidy Up the Magic Shop!
description: Cozy first person co-op organizing and cleaning simulator! Sort wands, tarot decks and potions. Tidy up the shop to earn points and unlock powerful spells that help you restore order before the Alchemist returns!

title: Tidy Wizard: A Place For Every Plate
description: Clean up wizard dining halls with magic! A satisfying organizing simulator where you levitate scattered dishes, wash tableware in enchanted basins, and return each piece to its proper cabinet. Unlock new spells to help transmute bigger & bigger messes into shiny, neat spaces!

title: Tidy Mart
description: Tidy Mart is a cozy organizing game where you arrange hundreds of products across different stores, from a small corner shop to a sprawling supermarket. No time limits. No rushing customers. Sit back, relax, and enjoy.

title: Tidy Up History
description: Tidy Up History is a cozy cleaning sim where you inherit a chaotic museum. Tidy messy rooms, unlock new abilities, and find hidden keys to open new wings. Uncover historical knowledge to properly identify and showcase artifacts, returning the museum to its former glory.

title: Toy Shop: Tidy Up
description: A cozy organizing simulator where you sort over 1,274 toys in a messy toy shop. Every toy has a category. Every display is yours to design. Arrange the toys freely—no timers, no rules, no constraints. Just enjoy the satisfaction of tidy up the messy toys in your own creative way.

title: Let's Tidy Up!: Konbini
description: Let's Tidy Up! Konbini is a cozy organizing simulator where you need to return scattered products their proper place in a Japanese convenience store. Completing shelves unlocks new skills and abilities that you can use to help you stack over 5000 unique items as quickly as possible!

title: Tidy Shadows
description: A half hidden object, half decorating game where you navigate rooms to find and clean messes while racing against the clock. Prefer to relax and rearrange your home instead? No problem! Simply, shut off the time limit, flip on the lights, and decorate your home without time constraints.

title: Trance World
description: Trance World is a high-speed action platformer set in a world deep in the universe that is under attack by power-hungry, manipulative warlords. You play as Rem T. Saikle, a struggling individual facing classism with his older sister, Piper. However, when the planet-turned-mothership, Trauvia, invades Rem's home and kidnaps his sister, Rem is forced to defend himself and his people...using weapons he stole, and save his planet.

title: Dark Petition
description: Explore a vast cursed castle in a dark fantasy Reactive turn-based RPG. Uncover forgotten memories, battle ancient horrors, and descend into a dying kingdom trapped between life and death.

title: Horse Spirit Valley
description: Ride peaceful 3D valleys on your horse, collect every diamond on the map, and spend your sparkle on new pastures plus deep unicorn-style looks—coats, manes, saddles, armor, and horns—with Steam achievements to chase along the way.

title: Dungeon of Calibris: Demon Orb
description: Descend into a sprawling, perilous dungeon in this old‑school first‑person RPG. Build your party, uncover hidden rooms, battle deadly creatures, and meet a large cast of adventurers trying to survive the depths. Designed with the spirit of classic “dad‑era” dungeon crawlers.

title: Zack in Fight
description: 2D Traditionally Hand Animated Fighting Game based on the Animated Adventures of Zack in Time project

title: Purrrfect Spa
description: Welcome to Purrrfect Spa — a cozy ASMR game designed for relaxation and healing. Here, you’ll care for adorable feline clients, enjoy soothing soundscapes, and experience the gentle companionship and peaceful moments of a furry world.

title: Night Shift: Warehouse
description: Enter a dark warehouse where you must monitor cameras and search for anomalies in a realistic environment. Can you spot the unusual events before there are too many? A suspenseful atmosphere and fear at every turn will pull you into this chilling horror experience.

title: Mootation
description: Mootation blends minigames, humor, and incremental systems where you need to optimize production to become the best Space Farmer in the galaxy!

title: Kaschei
description: An experimental visual novel made for the Toxic Yuri VN Jam of 2026.

title: Nightmere
description: Nightmere is a detective-mystery game with psychological horror elements fused into it. Set in 1991, you play as Amelia, a young private investigator who reluctantly takes on a missing persons case in the small, quiet town of Nightmere - and finds something much darker.

title: Dear Magical Girls
description: Dear Magical Girls is a story-driven defense game about an overworked magical girl protecting the Mana Stone that keeps the city running. Move the vertices to reshape your magical field. Unlock modules and enchants, and build your own strategy to survive against waves of monsters.

title: Unchest
description: A mouse-only management game with a bit of tower defense. Restock goods, trade with customers and craft gear for the nighttime—if the monsters reach your shop, they’ll plunder your hard-earned gold.

title: Very Realistic Game Dev Simulator
description: A Short Simulation Game

title: Victor Space Program
description: A first-person voxel survival crafting game. Land on a strange new planet, dig up what you need, build better tools, watch out for the wildlife, and put together the rocket that takes you home.

title: Eldread: Horrors of a Dark Moon
description: Manage your oxygen levels and navigate a cosmic horror roguelite in a lunar colony. Confront nightmarish body-horror anomalies, survive unpredictable text-driven events, and endure the madness waiting beneath the dark moon.

title: Aethercore
description: Aethercore is a third-person Action RPG set in a cyberpunk-dystopian world where immortality is for sale. Slash, dodge, parry, and use spells as you fight robotic enemies, mercenary ninjas, and undead creatures. Explore a sprawling city, take down an evil corporation, and retrieve your stolen soul.

title: The Hell Bread
description: The Hell Bread is a 2D pixel platformer where you made a deal with the devil to earn a loaf of bread. The game is currently in beta.

title: Persona 5 Royal: Rose & Violet
description: A story mod for Persona 5 meant to act as an extension of the 'Kasumi as Protagonist' mod: editing confidants, story events, and various dialogues to suit Kasumi while maintaining the original story overall.

title: Feathered Fortune
description: A cozy simulation game where you run a post office in Melthoria, a kingdom weakened by war and plague. Send pigeons on city-to-city deliveries, build a farm, grow useful goods, trade what you produce, and help the kingdom recover.

title: Outlaw Standoff
description: Outlaw Standoff is a fast-paced Western reflex shooter. Face off against Outlaws, but don't hit sweet Miss Abigail, or it's Game Over! How many Outlaws can you take down before they outgun you?

title: We Are So Dead
description: A co-op seance horror game where one of you died first, and only you can see what's killing the others. Your only voice is a Ouija board your friends keep misreading. Guide them through a haunted house and banish the demon before sunrise. 2-8 players.

title: Spirefall
description: The wars are fake. The grudges are real. A roguelite deckbuilder set in the taverns of Spirefall — win the Gauntlet, build your caravan, and conquer the greatest tables in the realm. One card at a time. Probably after questioning the stew.

title: Baff B
description: Minimalist, hardcore and challenging game in the genre of avoid-em up that will test your reflexes, timing and planning! This game is hard as hell!

title: Money for Girls: Amortized
description: Fashion. Corruption. Malice. A girl detective faces her darkest mystery yet, in this horror-romance visual novel with stickers, outfits, and bad ends.

title: TaCam
description: TaCam is a tactical multiplayer FPS with a realistic bodycam perspective, fluid gunplay, and extensive weapon customization. Engage in intense combat across modes like Team Deathmatch and Skirmish, using teamwork and strategy to dominate the battlefield.

title: Evo Born
description: Survive the day/night cycles, gain XP in battles with other creatures using your cards and tech tree abilities. Win the game by defeating the day 20 boss.

title: DreamRace
description: DreamRace is a high-speed arcade racing runner where you blast through 30 levels across six unique worlds.

title: Man Game: Reflex Testing
description: Man Game is a 2D fast-paced roguelike platformer with a uniquely goofy 3-color artstyle where you must control a Man and escape his evil clones copying his every move.

title: Neon Sunset
description: A brave little sun has found himself in endless neon dungeons! Help him jump across platforms, collect coins, dodge devious enemies, and destroy blocks in search of hidden treasures.

title: NieR Gestalt ver.1.22474487139...
description: NieR Gestalt ver.1.22474487139... is a fan-made overhaul for NieR Replicant ver.1.22474487139... that recreates the experience of the original Western release, NieR Gestalt. It replaces Brother Nier with the older Father Nier throughout the prologue and both parts of the story, including gameplay models, cutscenes, Dark Phantasm forms, the Shadowlord, and several alternate outfits. The mod also restores and adapts dialogue text, voice audio, music, pre-rendered movies, menus, and other presentation elements from the 2010 release, alongside various model improvements and optional add-ons designed to provide a more complete Gestalt-style playthrough.

title: Market Simulator: Miami Beach
description: Build your supermarket empire in Miami Beach! Start in a tent, drive to pick up wholesale cargo, and physically stock shelves. Survive the street economy, use your family to gather extra cash, and expand to two stores in this realistic business management and life sim.

title: Take Your Throne
description: A Tower Defense-style game. Take a strong stance and defend your throne against the brazen and utterly shameless claims of your enemies. With each level, your opponents will become increasingly resourceful... be prepared for anything... from formal charges to an angry mob!

title: Pixel Traveler
description: Pixel Traveler is a rogue lite action game where players can freely edit skills and trigger chains. Design your own skill set; Utilize limited resources, transform and synthesize each other to obtain the ideal skill combination, and debug to maximize the effect.

title: Camping Keeper
description: Build your campground from the ground up: tent sites, cabins, showers, pools, and the pipes and power lines behind them. Watch autonomous campers live, complain... and review you. Set prices, hire staff, and climb from a muddy one-star field to a five-star resort.

title: Golden Balloon
description: A native and browser source port of the Diddy Kong Racing.

title: Wizalign
description: A match-3 adventure RPG where every action happens on the puzzle board. Battle monsters, collect keys, discover powerful dungeon items, manage health and shields, and defeat bosses as you explore overworlds and dungeons inspired by classic adventure games.

title: Dash n Cry: Bursting
description: Help Lala Sparks reignite her passion by bursting through hundreds of hand-crafted challenges! DASH n CRY: Bursting is a fast-paced 2D precision platformer. Every DASH matters, every CRY will make you stronger!

title: American Truck Simulator: North Dakota
description: From the colourful Badlands of the west to the fertile plains of the east, this northern Great Plains state is filled with scenic drives, hardworking industries, and unique landmarks waiting to be discovered behind the wheel.

title: Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown - Delta Chronicles
description:
Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown - Delta Chronicles adds new missions, recruitable heroes, six technologies, and four NPC ships to your Delta Quadrant journey. It includes storylines such as a Talaxian colony under threat, a debate over Dr. Gegen’s “Distant Origin Theory,” and choices that affect Voyager’s ability to return home.

New playable/available characters include Reginald Barclay and Dr. Forra Gegen, alongside allied options like the Ferengi Marauder and additional ships such as the Voth City Ship, Allos’ Ship, and Nocona’s Ship.

title: Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown - Expansion Pass
description: The Delta Quadrant is vast and full of stories to tell. The Expansion Pass adds popular, fan favorite scenarios to your journey in Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown

title: Project: Melee Only
description: Play as an android and fight your way to the highest stage possible. Keep your level and your EXP and start again stronger. Reveal the secret of your purpose and the memories of your past life.

title: Deathmate
description: DEATHMATE is a chess-themed roguelike deckbuilder. Build an army of pieces, stack a deck full of moves, and battle your way across the map towards the Grim Reaper.

title: Law of Demons
description: Law of Demons is a dark medieval action-adventure, brought to life with the twisted art and uncanny vision of Sierra Tunis. Traverse the surreal and violent world of Spire and face off against the diabolical foes which stand in your way. Do you have what it takes to fight the law?

title: Thveit
description: Thveit is a cozy Norse settlement builder where changing seasons, ancient beliefs, and folklore creatures shape the fate of your settlements. Guide your settlers, manage resources, and grow a thriving community as humans and mythical beings learn to live side by side.

title: Space Savory
description: Not that far away, in a galaxy… A diner with questionable hygiene, bubbling with dark secrets and darker humor, in the middle of cosmic nothingness. Welcome to Space Savory. Don’t be fooled by appearances, the best flavor in the universe is cooked right here. (Only within the observable part.)

title: Factory Default: Build, Trade, Repeat
description: Build a global industrial empire on a 3D planet earth. Mine resources, manufacture complex goods, trade across continents, and shape your companys reputation through powerful policies. Control every step of the supply chain and turn industry into influence.

title: Foragarden
description: Forager blends RPG, open-world exploration, and life-sim gameplay. Light, seasons, weather, and anomalies constantly reshape a continent shaped by sixteen mutating attributes. Meet allies and foes hiding their own transformations, and choose one of two protagonists across branching storylines.

title: Steps To The Stars
description: A single player puzzle game following the journey of two stars as they climb to return to the constellation from which they have fallen.

title: Vice Signalling
description: Vice Signalling is a short narrative game where you infiltrate a secret society of the rich and powerful. Decipher secret signals and use them to uncover a conspiracy against the Emperor.

title: GOT3D
description: A faithful 3D action-adventure remake of the classic 1994 DOS shareware title 'God of Thunder' built in the Godot engine. Players traverse the land of Midgard as Thor, solving puzzles, talking to wacky townspeople, and using the mythical hammer Mjolnir to defeat the evil serpent Jormangund.

title: Profaned
description: Profaned is an Egyptian-themed old-school FPS in the vein of PowerSlave and Quake, built on the DarkPlaces engine.

title: Primal Axis
description: Codex-driven creature collector in Aethel-Hearth — explore, fight, gather, craft, breed, and fill the ledger.

title: A Casa Maluca
description: A Casa Maluca is an educational game featuring audio and text in Portuguese, developed and distributed by Positivo Informática and released in 1996 for Windows 95.

title: Wizard Dungeon
description: Wizard Dungeon is an old school action rpg inspired by Diablo 1 and 2, with a unique pixel art style inspired by NES and Gameboy aesthetics. Grind through dungeon floors full of monsters, level up, spend skill points, equip items, and try to find a way out. Play the early access demo on itch for free! https://tonyhork.itch.io/wizard-dungeon

title: Hasbro Games Junior Collection
description: Get ready for a big, colorful game night full of laughs, surprises, and “just one more turn!” moments! This collection brings 3 classic junior board games; Monopoly, The Game of Life, and Clue to life in one exciting video game made for kids and families.

title: Bomb's Lair
description: Throw angry bombs and solve puzzles in this 2D puzzle game. Discover four worlds with 48 handcrafted levels. Will you succeed and claim the treasure at the bottom of The Bomb's Lair? (Description from Steam Store Page)

title: The Immortal John Triptych
description:
he Immortal John Triptych is the ULTIMATE anthology of the Joe Richardson games. Four Last Things, The Procession to Calvary, and Death of the Reprobate are brought together under one glorious sun with never-before-seen deleted scenes, updated language parity across all three titles, an expanded soundtrack by Eduardo Antonello with new original recordings, manual saves for Four Last Things, backflips in The Procession to Calvary, and a button to trigger a superfluous trumpeted fanfare whenever you need to celebrate. Embrace the absurd, the profound, and the sweet soothing aesthetic of the Renaissance in The Immortal John Triptych.

Immortal John is dying. A holy war has ended in chaos. Sin itself demands reckoning. Three interconnected tales unfold across a world built from Renaissance paintings and Classical music, where the ridiculous and the profound collide.

Help locals with their daily tasks, only to find the Devil lurking in the shadows. Chase a tyrant across kingdoms while assisting inept magicians and negotiating with God Almighty. Navigate sin, death, judgement, heaven and hell, all topped with a cherry of gleeful flippancy.

From quiet countryside kindness spiraling into madness, to holy vengeance wrapped in absurdity, to cosmic philosophy delivered with a wink and a nudge, The Immortal John Triptych proves that the most intelligent thing you can do is embrace the utterly ridiculous.

title: Marupoyo: The Round Chick's Adventure
description: A tilt-based platformer game for everyone. Players control Marupoyo’s momentum as he rolls through 120 vibrant levels, avoiding obstacles, exploring, and rescuing his lost siblings.

title: Blast Off! Summer Showdown
description: Blast off and let the chaos begin! A party game for up to 4 players featuring 10 summer-themed minigames, including rocket fireworks, flowing somen races, and BBQ battles!

title: Bubsy 4D + Bubsy in: The Purrfect Collection
description: Bubsy 4D The infamous, wise-cracking bobcat has returned to 3D in a new platforming adventure. Bubsy is back with new challenges, new moves, and even more purrsonality.

title: Marque & Reprisal
description: Explore. Trade. Fish. Whale. Colonize. Fight. Pillage. Survive. You are a sea captain in the year 1522, and the whole world is yours to discover in this roguelike sandbox historical sailing simulator.

title: Dino Runner: Chronicles
description: Dino Runner: Chronicles is a fast-paced, procedurally generated 2D platform runner. Test your reflexes as you jump, dodge, and slide through 8 increasingly difficult dimensions. Reach the portal, unlock new skins, and survive the ever-accelerating dash!

title: Asteranova
description: Fast-paced vertical scrolling space shooter featuring intense boss battles, challenging enemy waves, and score-driven arcade gameplay.

title: Sunfall '80
description: Pilot a lone ship across a stark, vector-style battlefield as the world steadily collapses into the sun. Combat focuses on precision: aim carefully, fire deliberately, and dodge incoming shots from autonomous enemy constructs that track and engage on sight.

title: ShipShaper
description: ShipShaper is a creative game about the simple joy of designing ships. Nothing more. Nothing less. Export to Bulwark, 3D print, or use in your own games with a free commercial license.

title: Banana Airways
description: Chaotic online co-op for up to 6 players with proximity voice chat. You're the crew of the worst low-cost airline in the sky: one flies the plane, another fixes the engine out on the wing, another serves coffee while the cockpit is on fire. The passengers are cannibal chickens, some turn radioactive, and a baby might end up flying the plane.

title: Glass Zero
description: This game is a prequel to "Glass," exploring the past and the formation of its universe.

title: Defiance Survivors
description: Defiance Survivors is a fantasy style casual Roguelike game. There are two modes in the game. To become a hero and survive among monsters, Or to become a summoner summoning monsters and hunting heroes. Both modes exist independently and can be freely chosen.

title: Dead Dawg Delivery Co.
description: Deliver the package, sabotage your friends, and avoid the horrors lurking in procedurally generated maps. Only one of you can claim the reward—everyone else is just in the way.

title: Oh No, Not Another L
description: A classic puzzle game in a recognizable genre. No skills, progression, or plot. Just you, falling pieces, and the desire to beat your own high score.

title: Baff A
description: Minimalist, hardcore and challenging game in the genre of avoid-em up that will test your reflexes, timing and planning! This game is hard as hell!

title: Shiba Knight
description: Jump Up!!!!!!! Save your Princess!!! Countless obstacles are waiting for you! Show your jumping and control skills!The princess is waiting for you!!! It's an action game that emphasizes jumping. Do jump action and save the princess in the last place to avoid various obstacles!!

title: Nova Fighter
description: Are you ready to face a brutal, fast-paced pixel-art 2D action platformer where every level is a test of skill? Slash through ruined lands, master high-speed combat, overcome precision platforming, and fight ruthless boss battles in a journey built for players who love a real challenge.

title: When She's Gone
description: Point and click adventure of a man left alone during Battle of Britain. When the Manchester Blitz starts over Stockport, he decides to look for his wife and adventure starts.

title: Sweetie Candy Maze: Coral Peach
description: Dive into a vibrant candy world! Collect delicious sweets and find your way through playful coral peach mazes in this sweet and colorful adventure.

title: Wealdfall Squirrel
description: Wealdfall Squirrel is a 2D platformer game that let's you take control of a squirrel on a quest to gather hazelnuts in the Wealdfall Forest and surrounding areas. Run, jump, avoid creatures of the wild and survive the Wealdfall.

title: Ladder Lad
description: In a world that has forgotten how to jump, one Lad must rise. Climb, wobble, and bounce your way to new heights in this challenging, 100% ladder-themed precision platformer.

title: Hell Roulette
description: Congratulations, you're dead again! Bet years of your sentence in Hell and earn your way back to life by reducing your debt to zero. Bid for the revolver like you're playing poker, take risks like you're playing Russian roulette, and claim the pot while everyone at the table tries to stop you.

title: Buloki: Escape from the Alien Ship
description:
Are you ready to die and retry?

Buloki has been abducted by aliens! Master grid-based movement, don't fall, avoid traps and patrolling aliens, and find your way out of the ship.

Every mistake is your own. No luck, only skill.

Think you're good at video games?

Prove it.

title: Godreaper
description: Godreaper is a dark third-person action-adventure where the fate of your homeland hangs in the balance. As the bogatyr Zaremire, explore every corner of a world inspired by East Slavic mythology. Defeat the creatures of Navi, battle almighty gods and save your homeland from inevitable destruction.

title: Dungeons & Donuts
description: Dungeons & Donuts is a co-op action RPG that combines bullet hell dodging with roguelite dungeon runs for up to four players online, and is also playable solo. Between runs, players sell loot in a village, tend a farm, develop the settlement for materials, and craft donuts that act as consumable power-ups shaping the next run. Dungeon runs feature randomized power-up drops and last roughly 10 to 18 minutes, with Delves providing special ores for gear enhancement. Developed by the two-person team at Sas & Sons Game Studio, the game launched in Steam Early Access in August 2026.

title: Tumble in the Deep Noon
description: Play as a tumbleweed in the final 8 seconds of a western film. Satisfy the order (critics) and chaos (audience). A short game about charisma.

title: Layang Atma
description: An isometric psychological survival horror where memories become reality. Fight terrifying manifestations, solve symbolic puzzles, and uncover the truth hidden within a fractured mind.

title: Draft Day Sports: College Football 27
description:
Build the college football program you've always envisioned. Draft Day Sports: College Football puts you in complete control of every aspect of running a successful program—from assembling your coaching staff and recruiting future stars to managing the transfer portal, developing players, creating game plans, and competing for conference championships and the national title.

Every decision shapes the future of your program. Scout prospects across the country, build relationships with recruits, evaluate talent that fits your system, and construct recruiting classes capable of competing with the nation's elite. Develop your roster over multiple seasons, adapt to injuries and changing personnel, and watch your players grow into All-Americans and draft prospects.

Game day is only the beginning. Manage your depth chart, install offensive and defensive philosophies, make critical coaching decisions, and adjust your strategy as opponents evolve throughout the season. Whether you're taking over a perennial powerhouse or rebuilding a struggling program from the ground up, every season presents new challenges and new opportunities.

Featuring one of the deepest franchise experiences available in sports gaming, Draft Day Sports: College Football is built for players who love long-term team building, realistic management, and the satisfaction of creating a dynasty that can dominate for decades.

title: Dice Crawler
description: At the bottom of the dungeon lies the rotting corpse of a dead god, festering and devouring the land above. Descend into the depths. Slay the monsters. Resurrect the god. Dice Crawler is a dice-based roguelite game.

title: Chronicles Of Lumethis
description: Chronicles of Lumethis is a single-player idle/AFK RPG where every system feeds another: gather, craft, fight, collect — and keep progressing while the game is closed. There is no prestige, no rebirth, no reset. All progression is forward, forever.

title: Pith
description: Traverse a wonderful and strange world, find playful tools, and uncover secrets in PITH, a metroidbrainia/puzzle-platforming adventure full of twists and surprises.

title: Probably Stolen
description: Probably Stolen is a cyberpunk shopkeeping simulator set in a dystopian space station. Craft, trade, and smuggle goods of questionable origin, navigate faction loyalties, and stop rampant AI by killing those it controls. Earn enough to buy out your shop before rising rent forces your hand.

title: A Hummingbird Amongst the Odd Star
description: A truly analogue twin-stick shooter.

title: Oryo
description: A comprehensive online roleplaying sandbox game that focuses on player-driven story telling and spontaneous roleplaying experiences.

title: PDF File Slayer
description: Are you tired of society's scum and would love to shoot them dead? Then you're in the right place. This retro FPS is made by people fed up with those who prey on the most defenseless.

title: Your Happy Place
description: You found My Happy Place. Did I find Your Happy Place?

title: Bogatyr: Survival of the Worlds
description: Bogatyr: Survival of the Worlds is a 2D action roguelite inspired by Slavic folklore. Fight endless hordes of enemies in zero gravity, develop unique heroes, collect equipment and artifacts, explore new worlds, and defeat powerful bosses. Each hero has their own abilities, playstyle, and permanent Path Tree progression.

title: Dante's Rumba
description: A route-planning puzzle game set in an oddly cozy version of Dantes Inferno. Clean up Hell, one circle at a time, discover various traps, and help Faust deal with a malfunctioning Rumba, an overly dramatic dead poet, and a personal mission he wont quite talk about.

title: It Comes at Night
description: You play as David Carter, an independent explorer drawn to an old mansion, what begins as a simple investigation turns into something far more sinister. the house is not empty.. and whatever lives in it does not stay behind.

title: Disturbing Fears: Workplace
description: Disturbing Fears s an episodic psychological horror game based on true events that immerses players in haunting narratives.

title: SurviRail: Deep Space
description: SurviRail is a game about exploration and managing your own space train. Expand your train cars, upgrade your engines, collect resources, and discover new locations in the unknown space.

title: The Expansion
description: A psychological first-person horror experience set in endless Backrooms. Explore abandoned corridors, uncover hidden secrets, evade mysterious entities, and survive a world where every turn leads deeper into the unknown.

title: OBITT: Escape From the Room
description: You stray from a shrine into a room and become a palm-sized person. This is an escape action game to find your way out through trial and error from a miniature perspective. Manage your HP to survive and break free from this giant room! A time attack mode is included for an extra challenge.

title: Curse of the Abandoned Floor
description: Curse Of The Abandoned Floor is a first-person Chinese horror game. It starts with a paranormal video about an urban legend: "Beware the non-existent elevator mezzanine. If you enter it, you will be trapped forever."

title: Office Keeper
description: 5-to-10-minute score-attack cleaning with a spooky twist. Clean an abandoned office while evading a creepy "Entity." Vacuum and wipe away randomized dust, watching filth vanish right where it's traced. Secure the target score and report back to finish the shift!

title: ChronoQuest VR
description: Narrative VR adventure inspired by classic graphic adventures. Explore historical eras, interact with characters, and solve story-driven puzzles through dialogue and immersive environments. Designed for experienced players who enjoy story-driven challenges.

title: Pooliminal
description: Pooliminal is an atmospheric liminal space horror game set in endless, procedurally generated poolrooms. A Backrooms-inspired descent into thalassophobia, where the real terror lies in the dark water below.

title: Night Train Simulator: Blackout
description: A slow-burn psychological horror train simulator. Drive the train. Follow the schedule. Ignore what's outside.

title: Helen Keller Simulator
description: Explore a world without your eyes and ears to guide you. Uncover the secrets this world has to offer, hoard all the items you can find or get lost trying.

title: No Return Address
description: Night shift at a distribution center. Ordinary packages go forward, strange ones go to reject. Just dont make a mistake when the boxes start containing things that should never be there.

title: Cosmic Shenanigans
description: Cosmic Shenanigans is an episodic, story-driven, fast-paced platformer starring the duo of Hickory and Chocoa. As they speed through action-packed cosmic levels, the two characters embark on a journey of personal growth, learning more about themselves and their world with every step.

title: Crabs & Cocktails
description:
Makai and Rhett have two things in common, they both work at Cloudville beach, Makai as a lifeguard and Rhett as a bartender.

They also slept together.

Makai and Rhett both want to see each other again, and as luck would have it they are able to.

As they both have to work together to plan Cloudville Beach’s annual Luau, with the help of their two best friends: Lola and Sunny.

Will this be the hottest summer yet? Or will it go down in flames?

title: War of the Austrian Succession
description:
Fight across the battlefields of eighteenth-century Europe in War of the Austrian Succession, a detailed tactical wargame covering the major campaigns, battles, and theaters of the vast dynastic conflict that reshaped the balance of power in Europe.

From Mollwitz and Chotusitz to Dettingen, Fontenoy, Rocoux, Lauffeld, and Culloden, War of the Austrian Succession places you in command of the armies that fought for crowns, territory, dynastic survival, and continental dominance. What began as a succession crisis following the death of Holy Roman Emperor Karl VI quickly expanded into a sprawling European war involving Austria, Prussia, France, Britain, Bavaria, Spain, Sardinia, the Dutch Republic, Jacobite rebels, and countless allied states and auxiliary formations.

Take command in War of the Austrian Succession, where detailed tactical maps and historically grounded orders of battle place you in control of armies fighting across snow-covered plains, fortified cities, mountain passes, rivers, villages, and sprawling continental battlefields. Every battle is shaped by the realities of eighteenth-century warfare: rigid linear tactics, cavalry shock action, artillery deployment, militia reliability, command limitations, fatigue, terrain, morale, and the growing importance of light troops and maneuver warfare.

title: Conatus: Forgotten Depths
description: A dark fantasy dungeon crawler where every weapon defines a unique playstyle. Explore interconnected regions, uncover hidden secrets, craft powerful potions and unravel the mysteries of a world built from everything humanity chose to forget.

title: Index 1391
description: In this techno-gothic roguelike deckbuilder, journey to the heart of a twisted sanctum to destroy the virus infecting your faith. Wield sacred cards to defeat corrupted foes, build a powerful deck, and equip rule-altering doctrines that reshape the rules of combat.

title: Quiet
description:
Your ship crashed, your crew is stranded, and this house is somehow your best chance of survival. Search for ship parts while every movement and real-world sound risks alerting the homeowner.

Stay QUIET, keep your flock together, and try not to quack under pressure.

title: Feeding Yuyuko
description: As the gardener and head chef of the White Jade Tower, Konpaku Youmu, please try making something delicious for Lady Yuyuko.

title: Seaworks: Trap Season
description: Seaworks: Trap Season is a hands-on crab fishing life sim set in the remote pacific northwest in the 1990s. Take fishing bounties by fax, maintain and customize your boat, brave changing weather, sort your catch and build a small life on the edge of the sea.

title: Bergwerk: A Mining Sim
description: Build your own mining company in the coal region of Grubental! Construct your colliery above ground, descend into procedurally generated depths, and operate over 15 heavy machines. Master mine statics, infrastructure, complex transport networks, and sell your coal on dynamic markets.

title: Might & Mushroom
description: Draft your own shop in this deckbuilding roguelike auto-battler! Summon fungal versions of legendary heroes, and take control of your fate with a unique shop-building system and innovative synergy mechanics! Revolution is brewing—let's turn that evil dragon into mushroom soup!

title: My Perfect Nails
description: My Perfect Nails is a retro simulation game inspired by the 2000's web games, where you create the perfect set of nails for your customers! Choose between many options and accessories to create the nails of their dreams! ✨

title: Marshland Hollow
description: A spooky yet cozy horror adventure... Who is this Wolfram, arriving to unravel the strange change on the Island? Who can be trusted, what lurks in the attic, and what really happened that night? Step into the shoes of several characters in this short atmospheric tale of gentle gothic spookiness...

title: I Unplugged the Kids
description: Manage a chaotic kindergarten of baby bots in this first-person simulator. Care for their needs, run activities, upgrade stations or throw and tase them. Be a gentle caregiver or embrace chaos as the evil teacher, the choice is yours.

title: WEGO World War II: Overlord
description: WEGO World War II: Overlord is an operational-level, ground-centric WEGOWW2 game system. This hex-based wargame recreates the Allied invasion of Western Europe. Includes 14 historical scenarios, from the landing at Omaha beach to a huge 135-turn campaign that covers the entire Normandy campaign.

title: Deadhead: Autorail
description: Learn what a hostile workplace truly feels like on this ever-changing haunted train. Can you trust yourself to make the right decisions? Will you figure out the train's dark secrets on this journey or the next?

title: A Courting of Curses
description: Play as your own villainess in this 3D romance RPG! Romance four mysterious suitors that bring survival or destruction. Live your life in a Magical Academy, trapped in a day/night cycle: study, socialise, and fight for your life—then do it all over again.

title: Sunset Artisan Chocolate
description: Run a cozy seaside chocolate boutique! Weigh, melt, and craft handmade treats for your colorful customers, experiment with new recipes, meet locals, grow your chocolate brand, and settle into life in Sunset Town.

title: Snap & Print
description: Run the cutest little photo & print shop in town! Snap & Print is a cozy job simulator, where you take portraits, edit and restore pictures, and decorate shots with hats, flowers, stickers, and more. Upgrade your studio, unlock new props, and make every customer smile.

title: Graphic Design Is My Passion
description: Graphic Design is my passion is a cooperative game, where one player tries to describe a specific painting order, that the other has to build from pieces of different artworks. But be careful: everything must be ready before the timer stops!

title: Just Madness: Earth Apocalypse 1979
description: The world ended. The madness began. As Max, survive a brutal, radioactive wasteland to save your kidnapped daughter from a ruthless gang. Fight radiation, explore a dangerous open world in 1st/3rd person, and make choices that shape your destiny in this dark RPG survival.

title: Trans': Boku to Atashi no Kyoukaisen
description: On Christmas Eve, the protagonist is suddenly dumped by his girlfriend. She leaves her clothes in his room. At that moment, an urge to wear them arises within him. This leads to an escalating desire to crossdress. What path will he take?

title: Federal Cadet
description: Federal Cadet is a single-player police simulation and investigation game. Start as a cadet in Pinewood, patrol the town, question witnesses and suspects, analyze evidence, and rise through the department ranks.

title: Hidden Cats: Castle
description: Go on a short but sweet adventure into the black and white world of castle! Enjoy the search for cats and recreate a colorful picture. 150 cute cats are waiting for you! Play and relax!

title: Origins TCG
description: Origins is the first free-to-compete TCG. Compete on skill alone (zero pay-to-win) for limited digitally graded cards you can buy, sell, and trade!

title: Typical NPC
description: Run a grimy fantasy weapon shop while heroes save the world somewhere else. Sell rusty swords, survive arrogant customers, repair the damage, and fight for your retirement before the final battle arrives.

title: Lumiric Stage
description: Create musical content with real-time MIDI visualization, Magic Piano, real-time sheet music, built-in camera tools, and cinematic Stages. Design and share custom particle effects as portable .mvfx files. Built for creators, pianists, educators, performers, and streamers.

title: Harpy
description: Harpy is a "Foddian" game, a difficult platformer with a simple and unique movement system. Climb a spire of floating islands, trek four different levels with fresh challenges and hazards, and try not to fall all the way down.

title: Delta Directive
description: Fast-paced online PvP where skill and strategy decide the victor.

title: Crown Chase
description: Crown Chase is a fast-paced multiplayer party game where you compete against friends to grab and hold the magical crown. Run, dash, and use unique abilities in stylized 3D arenas to outsmart your opponents and claim the ultimate victory.

title: Ultimate Snake
description: Snake game is a simple and addictive puzzle game where players control a continuously growing snake, eating food to increase its length while avoiding collisions with itself or the walls.

title: Ratcore
description: You don't know where you are or what your purpose is, but all you know is you want to escape. In this linear, puzzle-filled precision platformer, you must dive whiskers first into many unknown territories. There are many strange yet satisfying mechanics to keep the gameplay unique and fun.

title: Path of Survival
description: In "Path of Survival" you'll take control of a powerful car and embark on a thrilling journey through a zombie-infested world. Your goal is to reach the finish line while shooting down the walking dead that have invaded everything and are everywhere.

title: Oasis of Lilies
description: Julie's Oasis is a haven for gentlewomen looking for relaxation and discreet pleasures. Ayame enters the club, unsure what to expect, only to meet strangely familiar women one after another. Oasis of Lilies is a light-hearted visual novel about a girl who dreams of having a harem of her own.

title: Please Ignore The Anomalies
description: A first-person psychological horror game about observing strange anomalies, surviving disturbing entities, and trying to make it to work on time. Sometimes the house is completely normal... sometimes it is not.

title: Dance of the Butterflies
description: Your twin sister is missing. Under her name, you uncover a deadly system where 50 people compete for a Wish powerful enough to change anything. The price of entry is a piece of yourself, signed away in a contract. Survive. Find her. And try not to lose yourself to the people you meet along the way.

title: Infected World
description: Embark on a thrilling adventure amidst a zombie outbreak! Your task is to use powerful weapons to battle hordes of the undead and defend your lands.

title: Flies.
description: A house infested with rot. The smell of mold in the air. Why are you here? Who are you doing this for? Maybe with enough attempts you'll find the real answer. You just have to remember it. After all, you don't want to get swarmed by flies... Right?

title: Cosmic Distortion
description: Cosmic Distortion is a thrilling, high-speed game where you take control of a spaceship and race through an endless cosmic tunnel! Your goal is to deftly dodge all sorts of obstacles, collect points, and try to beat your own high score.

title: Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection - Accessory: Ornament of Bonds
description: Contains the following: Accessory: Ornament of Bonds A special accessory for the protagonist to wear!

title: Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection - Accessory: Royal Monocle
description: Contains the following: Accessory: Royal Monocle A special accessory for the protagonist to wear!

title: Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection - Accessory: Fang Talisman
description: Contains the following: Accessory: Fang Talisman A special accessory for the protagonist to wear!

title: Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection - Accessory: Protective Band
description: Contains the following: Accessory: Protective Band A special accessory for the protagonist to wear!

title: Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection - Accessory: Crystalline Ornament
description: Contains the following: Accessory: Crystalline Ornament A special accessory for the protagonist to wear!

title: Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection - Accessory: Pearl Earrings
description: Contains the following: Accessory: Pearl Earrings A special accessory for the protagonist to wear!

title: Super Serpent Snake 3D
description: Take control of a sleek snake, slither through diverse obstacle and see how long you can grow. Eat the glowing cube to grow longer and score points.

title: Dark Wonderland
description: Alice finds herself lost in a whimsical but dangerous Wonderland. In this dark fantasy action-adventure you will meet the twisted creeps and critters that inhabit it, feel free to kill them, they're mad like you.

title: Soulgrave
description: SOULGRAVE is a character-driven action roguelike where you create wild builds, explore ever-changing dungeons, and battle brutal bosses with puzzle-like, telegraphed mechanics. Restore a shattered world... or doom it forever.

title: Love D3ath Love
description: In 2222, your AI secretly sends over 3,000 job applications worldwide without you knowing. Soon after, three powerful women appear, each insisting you belong with her. You’re thrown into a growing crisis, their ambitions colliding endlessly. What do they actually want from you?

title: Luduvo
description: Luduvo is a user-generated content (UGC) sandbox gaming platform built on a proprietary engine. The platform allows players to create, share, and play community-designed games using a suite of built-in development tools and custom avatar configurations. Emphasizing digital safety and moderation, Luduvo features an in-game economy driven by virtual currency (Lunes).

title: Monster Girl Clinic
description: Welcome to Monster Girl Clinic. You arrive as a patient — but something here isn't adding up. Get to know the clinic's unusual staff, follow the clues, and uncover what's really going on, in a story-driven visual novel of mystery, romance, and monster girls.

title: My Singing Monsters Karaoke
description: Choose your favorite Monster and hop on the karaoke stage for the performance of a lifetime! Hit the notes, conduct the chaos, and watch your favorite Monster performers squish, stretch, and contort through every song. Whether you’re pitch-perfect or off key, every karaoke concert will be memorable!

title: Monster Smoosh
description: Drop monsters into a jar and smoosh the matching ones together to climb an 11-creature ladder — from humble fuzzball to derpy elder god. A physics-chaos merge game where combos run big, cows are currency, and death is a feature, not a fail-state. Easy to start. Gloriously hard to put down.

title: Château Pluie: The New Cellar Keeper
description: A cozy single-player simulation game. You've inherited an old vineyard, and a cellar of 1,600 wine bottles, each waiting for its place. Sort, organize, and shelve them all as the new cellar keeper. Relax into the rain and music. Unlock new skills, trust your instincts, and bring the cellar to life.

title: The Prince's Keeper
description: Play as the newest servant to Prince Railan, who's had all of his previous servants fired.
