While navigating your position, you'll try to pry down his carefully guarded walls as you challenge him on everything he believes about himself and the world. Just try not to get fired in the process.

title: Mine Defense
description: Mine Defense is a 2D action-adventure game inspired by sandbox survival games. Explore a dangerous world, gather resources, craft weapons and equipment, fight hostile creatures, and build your own base. Progress through the game by discovering new materials, improving your gear, and facing increasingly powerful enemies and bosses.

title: Apex Legends: Marked
description:
Marked is the latest season of Apex Legends, bringing a significant rework for Bloodhound alongside buffs for Loba and Rampart. It also introduces an energy weapon systems overhaul and brand-new Corrupted Attachments that change how you approach loadouts and fights.

Set on a refreshed World’s Edge, Marked adds quality-of-life improvements and a wide range of balancing updates aimed at sharpening competitive play.

title: Sono Kaori de Mitasaretai: #7b5544 no Koi wo Shita Watashi no Hajimete wo Master ni Agetai
Counterweight
description: A social deduction tower-builder for 4–8 players. Stack blocks, raise the tower, and figure out which of your friends is placing them badly on purpose. Grab chaotic items, vote people out, and forge the Impostor Detector before every block hits the ground.

title: 3Dash Ultra
description: 3Dash Ultra, the new and improved three-dimensional autoscrolling platformer. Jump and fly your way through danger in this 3D rhythm-based action platformer!

title: Hook Party Arena
description: Hook, ricochet, rescue, and outplay your rivals in a fast top-down multiplayer arena. Pull enemies into hazards, save teammates, trigger two-hook Headshots, and shape each short match with upgrades and tactical items in customizable Steam lobbies.

title: Toaru Majutsu no Index
description: A massively multiplayer online, action roleplaying games based on the Toaru Majutsu No Index franchise.

title: Eternal Blade
description: An open-world action RPG set in the Baransu Realm. Play as Emerald, the last of the Murakai Bloodline and daughter of Sensei Lux, fighting to gather the Almighty Gemstones, wield the Eternal Blade, and free her father from an eternal curse before chaos and darkness are unleashed on the realm.

title: Catalyst Core
description: A grid-based roguelike deckbuilder where every move sets up your next reaction. Build your deck, collect Elemental Cores and chain powerful elemental combos to defeat your enemies.

title: Kago
description:
"In a victorian-esque era, Rudolf is the lady's maid of a bride-to-be Sirius..."
A Rudosiri themed visual novel.

title: SymphonyRecomp
description: A native static recompilation of Castlevania: Symphony of the Night (PS1) to PC.

title: Man I Just Wanna Live
description: Mia wakes up with a hangover and a dead body in her apartment. Unfortunately, the body has friends who are about to break in through the front door. From there, things only get worse. This "MSPaint-noir" VN with 16 endings is as stylish as it is relentless. Mia just wants to live! Well, who doesn’t?

title: Doamari
description: Doamari is a RPG game about strange places and strange things. Meet people, fight enemies, uncover secrets, and more. This is my diorama... I made it for you.

title: Horse Club Ride West
description: The Horse Club is visiting the Wild River Ranch! Travel with your friends Hannah, Sofia, Sarah, and Lisa to the Wild West. Explore the vast landscape, help old and new friends, experience exciting adventures on horseback, and win the crown at the Western riding tournament!

title: Watch The Edge Honey
description: Watch The Edge, Honey! is a psychological thriller wrapped in a vertical climbing adventure, built to test your nerves as much as your reflexes. As you climb under Eva's guidance, you'll fight gravity, your fear of heights, and — most of all — the quiet, manipulative pressure she plants in your mind.

title: S.K.R.U.B. Squad
description: S.K.R.U.B. Squad is a chill, cozy cleaning game playable with up to four players online or single player. Play as an alien slime on a team of aliens who travel the galaxy cleaning environments across various times and dimensions..

title: Arcostate
description: Arcostate is a turn-based sci-fi roguelike set on a post-post-cataclysmic Earth. Explore ruins, hostile wilderness, and the lands surrounding Aathman, the planet’s last surviving arcology, while uncovering the events that brought civilization to ruin. Create a character through attributes, skills, equipment, cybernetics, and psychic powers, then survive a persistent simulated world shaped by factions, scheduled NPCs, weather, aging, and emergent encounters. Fight, sneak, scavenge, craft, build a home, recruit companions, and travel through hand-authored and procedurally generated locations, including endless caves and a derelict monorail network. Choose between classic roguelike and roleplaying modes.

title: Sort Them Ducks
description: Sort Them Ducks is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort over 4,000 unique rubber ducks onto the correct shelves. Enjoy the satisfying process of turning a messy duck store into a perfectly organized collection at your own pace.

title: Cleaning up the Puzzle Gallery
description: Cleaning Up The Puzzle Gallery is a cozy first-person organization simulator about cleaning up 2071 puzzle pieces scattered across a gallery of 87 famous paintings. Whether you want to relax and solve jigsaw puzzles to classical music, or min-max to get the fastest times, the gallery needs cleaning.

title: Dirty
description: The Dirty game will have an interesting exciting plot, many interesting styles and mechanics for a full-fledged comfortable game.There are memorable characters in the game, as well as epidemic monsters.You will have to solve puzzles to get to the next location, or break through to the breach, as well as the game contains a system for changing the plot of your choice, depending on how the dialogue with one or another character enters.This game also contains 2D and 3D graphics.The game features crafting items.:first aid kit, weapons, repairs, upgrades.

title: The Attic: A Mystery Puzzle Game
description:
The Attic is an adventure in which you'll have to solve riddles, puzzles, and repair objects from the ‘80s and ‘90s to unveil the secret your brother and his mysterious friend, Destiny, were hiding.

Hideouts, secret spots, locked chests, mysterious videogame cartridges… A cozy adventure with hints of mystery inspired by escape rooms and the classic point-and-click adventure games.

title: Gin and Wall
description: Gin and Wall is game about dodging many walls. Cotrols are jump and move. You can play basic mode and coin mode.

title: Hellcrown
description: You are dead. But your ghostly hand still commands. Hellcrown is a roguelite strategy game where every run unfolds into a chain of random stories, sieges, and consequences.

title: Knell
description: You are the last bellkeeper of a plague-dead parish. Each night you climb the tower and ring the passing bell for the dead, as the office demands. But the bell has begun calling something back. Now every night is a vigil: survive from the first toll until the matins bell at dawn — twenty minutes of dark, and everything in it wants your candle out.

title: Girlfailure Art Club
description: Fall in love again with the cringey otaku girls who spent their school days drawing in the corner. Packed with 2010s otaku culture, memes, and second-hand embarrassment, this visual novel lets you relive a painfully cute youth with the oddballs of a Japanese art club!

title: Ouju: Isle of the Accursed
description: In the Seto Inland Sea lies Sarubotoke, a cursed remote island. Each after their own goals, a mismatched group of four men and women make their way to this strange isle as the curtain rises on a tale of crime, murder, and curses.

title: Warrior Quest
description: Warrior Quest is a single-player, text-driven dark-fantasy RPG where old-school dungeon crawling meets next-gen, free-form, offline AI diplomacy. Fight, sneak, negotiate in your own words, recruit unlikely companions... and whatever you do, roll well.

title: Naron
description:
Naron is a co-op mining roguelite for 1-4 players. You take a drillship twenty depths down into a dying moon. Every depth has an objective waiting, and the drill won't move until it's done.

Between depths the crew decides the route together at the map table. Two depths ahead are visible: the biome, the task and the hazards waiting there. The safe route pays less, the hard one pays more, and there is no going back.

The rock is fully deformable - no fixed mining nodes anywhere. And every bit of progress on the main objective wakes the moon: pressure fronts tear open, broods swarm out, the way back gets more expensive. If the crew falls, the run is over - what you learned and permanently unlocked comes with you into the next one.

title: A Game About Fishing
description: Cast your line and unwind in a cozy, stylized fishing game. Explore calm waters, catch charming low-poly fish, and enjoy satisfying, relaxing gameplay at your own pace. A peaceful solo experience focused on comfort, atmosphere, and the simple joy of fishing.

title: Sweetie Candy Maze: Blackberry
description: Dive into a vibrant candy world! Collect delicious sweets and find your way through playful blackberry mazes in this sweet and colorful adventure.

title: Baff C
description: Minimalist, hardcore and challenging game in the genre of avoid-em up that will test your reflexes, timing and planning! This game is hard as hell!

title: Hidden Rabbit 2
description: Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of a special location, and in a theme-filled place teeming with bunnies, try to find 100 cute little rabbits and 30 carrots hidden throughout the game. Can you find them all?

title: Space Memory: Fairies
description: Cute, relaxing memory game where you match pairs of adorable fairies in space

title: Tiny Wizard Tavern
description: Run a cozy magical tavern on a moonlit road. Serve travelers, manage supplies, survive strange events, and grow your reputation in a charming fantasy world.

title: Kingdom Rules
description: Restore a struggling kingdom in a cozy medieval strategy game: build farms, houses, and barracks, balance taxes, grow your population, and repel raids.

title: Mad Yu: Rural Idle
description: Experience the ultimate rural rampage! Help Yu, the maddest woman in the village, automate her farm in this frantic idle clicker.

title: Five Nights At PT's II
description: A horror survival game set in your bedroom as you try and fend off 5 different and unique enemies using only a flashlight, doors, and a generator. Dive deep into the story with fully playable pixelated cutscenes and smooth animation.

title: The Outskirts
description: You wake up in a dense fog, standing in the middle of a desolate four-way intersection at the edge of town. Trapped in an endlessly repeating neighborhood, you must carefully determine which of the four roads is the safe route.

title: Confettied
description: You're tasked with cleaning up every last piece of confetti after an office party gone too far. Collect confetti, cash-in, and upgrade your line-up of unconventional tools to collect even more!

title: Tabletop Baseball
description: A physics-powered arcade baseball blast! Time your swing, rack up runs, and climb classic high score tables. Play solo or versus a friend with one controller or two.

title: Age of Clicks
description: Age of Clicks - A unique blend of global strategy and clicker gameplay. Manage your country with clicks: build factories, mine resources, and lead armies into battle. Click your enemies into surrender and reshape the political map of the world!

title: Infinity Bounce
description: Turn the galaxy into a chaotic pinball machine to feed a voracious space cat in this physics-based incremental game. Expand and upgrade your arsenal of various celestial bodies and stuff the cat to the brink of a big bang.

title: Tally Man
description: You find yourself in an infinitely looping dungeon tasked with verifying the ledger. Count the skulls, ensure the count, and increase the tally to escape.

title: Portentum
description: The cryptid deck-building auto battler. Hunt for broken combos using cryptids from around the world like Bigfoot, Jimothy, Nessie, and the Chupacabra. If somebody's uncle saw it in the woods in 1973, there's a good chance it's a card in Portentum.

title: G-Mode Archives+: Kishinden Strike-G-
description: This title is a simulation RPG, originally released for Japanese flip phone application, in which players control robots. The story unfolds through lively exchanges between a colorful cast of characters, with a scenario by Hachirō Izumi.

title: Other Tower
description:
Next to the legendary Pizza Tower stands another tower, an "Other" tower of sorts. Full of strange places unfamiliar to pizza-kind and uncomfortable familiar faces, are you ready to get funky again in the name of Peppino's Pizza?

Featuring 4 Levels, Idaho Volcano, Golf 2, Po-Boy Bayou and Carl Palace, now moving to gamemaker!

title: Pippa of Caerbannog
description: An infuriating platformer themed around Monty Python and the Holy Grail starring Pipkin Pippa in her search for the holy grail. Climb through 5 levels to reach the end, be careful not to fall and lose all your progress!

title: Gone Exploring
description: One curious octopus. One underwater research centre. The long way home. A short 3D point-and-click adventure about a small escape - played with all eight hands.

title: Dionysus
description: Dionysus is a revolutionary mix between Pong and Cards

title: Hacking Into Erebus
description:
Hacking Into Erebus is a hacking game centered on taking control of a spacecraft named USS Erebus.

The ship is stranded on a remote alien planet. The crew is in cryogenic sleep. The player physically navigates inside the ship using robots while simultaneously gaining access to its network systems. The ship's central operating system, ARIA, protects the system but operates aggressively against the player.

The player must manage robots and interact with panels and terminals to successfully take control of the ship's systems.

title: Train Sim World 6: Schnellfahrstrecke Nürnberg - Ingolstadt Route Add-On
description: Accelerate to thrill-seeking speeds with TSG’s Schnellfahrstrecke Nürnberg - Ingolstadt! Experience German 300 km/h operations in Train Sim World; take the ICE 3 faster than you ever have before, and shuttle between stops with the classic DB BR 101.

title: Train Sim World 6: Tadami Line: Aizu-Wakamatsu - Tadami Route Add-On
description: With Union Workshop’s Tadami Line, the dense valleys and quaint, trundling rails of rural Japan make their debut in Train Sim World! Explore the stunning Fukushima Prefecture and take on local passenger duties among the mountains.

title: Train Sim World 6: Thames Valley - Windsor, Henley & Marlow Branch Lines Add-On
description: Token-up and tackle a trifecta of Thames Valley duties as no less than 3 routes - the Windsor, Marlow and Henley branch lines – arrive in Train Sim World courtesy of Incredible Trains! Expand your Great Western experience and hop across an iconic trio of tracks aboard Networker Turbo traction.

title: Train Sim World 6: Cargo Line Vol. 6 - Gas
description: Discover different freight traffic with Skyhook Games' Cargo Line for Train Sim World. In Vol. 6, hop to Mannheim - Kaiserslautern for the first German pack! Don't let the pressure get to you as you turn up the heat with Zags Gas Tankers in-tow.

title: Chigusa's Diary
description: Chigusa was just an everyday schoolgirl, but once she began to notice the boys, her life gradually started to change in unexpected ways...

title: Warpfire.io
description: Warpfire - Conquer space with your allies in a rich and varied gameplay. A recreation of a legendary space MMO, 100% JavaScript, directly in your browser! No installation required!

title: El Restaurante de Sam
description: You're a former employee of El Restaurante de Sam, you've returned to find out what happened to your colleagues, your goal is to find them...

title: Oops! You're the Hero!
description: Oops! You’re the Hero! is a fantasy adventure about a Thief who has stolen an artifact that deems him the ‘Hero’. Choose to fight or avoid the bosses who have sworn to defeat you, explore the world of Othaya, and return the artifact before more shenanigans befell you because…Oops! You’re the Hero!

title: Irreverence
description: Irreverence is a fast paced top down shooter. Run, shoot, and dive into intense combat with a variety of strange foes in this quirky hotline miami like.

title: Helldivers 2: Devoid of Liberty
description:
We have watched the Void stretch across the galaxy for too long. The threat posed to our Liberty is too great and we can no longer stand by as the Illuminate gain ground.

Helldivers, you are needed on the battlefield of a new frontier–one more wild and uncertain than any we have faced prior. We must venture into their haunted abyss, the Void, and liberate it back into Super Earth’s control.

title: Medieval Lands
description: Medieval Lands is an old-school fantasy MMORPG brimming with mysterious lore and exciting adventures. Forge your own path in a classless gaming experience with a variety of skills, races, and playstyles. Explore the open world, slay mystical monsters, battle other players, amass riches, and more!

title: Orange Man Smash!
description: Take on the deep state swamp, coastal elites, big tech and more, in this wacky whack-a-mole adventure, Orange Man Smash!

title: Will O Wing
description: Explore, harness magic, and guide the wayward through harsh and unchecked lands. Atmospheric locations full of unique puzzles that you can challenge in any order you choose. Piece together the truth of a long-forgotten civilization in this stunning puzzle platformer.

title: Cata-Bomb
description: Pinball game by where you use cat bombs to defeat bosses but the bombs explode in 30 seconds if they don't hit anything.

title: Cat Crisis
description: Cat Crisis is an online co-op game about being cute little cats rescuing even cuter kittens. Hide from terrifying dogs, pet frightened kittens, and rescue them to save all catkind! Play Cat Crisis with up to 4 players!

title: Dengeki Nurse
description: Dengeki Nurse is a time capsule of early-1990s Japanese computer gaming. Mixing point and click adventure scenes, vivid pixel-art characters, FM-synth sound, and bizarre turn-based “Dengeki Combat” encounters into something loud, scrappy, and unmistakably of its era.

title: Internet Cafe 98
description: Grow a small 1998 internet cafe from a single outdated PC into a packed business. Serve customers, upgrade your computers and network, and research new technology in this retro incremental tycoon game.

title: Shalter 03
description: Shalter 03 is an asymmetric first-person co-op puzzle-adventure game where three players take control of characters deprived of sight, hearing, and speech. Stranded in a hazardous facility, players must collaborate tightly to overcome their unique physical limitations, communicate through environmental cues, and balance real-time buffs and debuffs to solve complex puzzles before the clock runs out.

title: Trap Yuri Tempest
description: A romantic storm is brewing at Ayanohara Academy! A princely trap and a delinquent one... two unlikely he-iresses are destined to become lovers. Who will sweep the other into the tempest of love first? A cross-dressing yuri VN packed with humor, heart, and outrageous twists!

title: Alibito
description:
Alibito is a multiplayer party game of deception, creativity, and deduction. In each round, every player must invent a completely false but believable story about themselves. The goal is simple: make your lie convincing enough to fool the other players.

Once everyone has written their alibi, all the stories are shuffled and displayed anonymously. Players must carefully read each alibi, look for clues, and decide who they think wrote it. Some stories may sound ridiculous, while others could be so realistic that they seem true.

Points are awarded to players who correctly identify the authors of the alibis. At the same time, players earn points when their own alibi successfully misleads others. The most skilled liars can even earn bonus points if nobody manages to uncover their identity.

Every round creates new opportunities for bluffing, surprising revelations, and hilarious discussions. Whether you're playing with friends, family, classmates, or coworkers, Alibito turns simple storytelling into a battle of wit and deception.

Can you create the perfect lie and convince everyone that it could be true? Or will your friends expose you before the round is over? In Alibito, every story is a mystery waiting to be solved.

title: She Sings, but She’s Not a Skylark, Not Even a Nightingale.
description: A cutting-edge visual novel that incorporates many modern expressions for an immersive experience.

title: S.O.L School Of Labyrinth
description: A dungeon crawl RPG set in an otherworldly realm beneath an old school building. Explore again and again, restore your base, and find your way back to everyday life.

title: The Castle of Dr. Hoot
description: Welcome to the mysterious castle of spelling extraordinaire, Dr. Hoot! Explore the classroom, the lab, the library and the...detention dungeon? Put your mind to the test with spelling challenges and logic riddles as you avoid the wrath of the strict, cranky spelling teacher, Dr. Hoot.

title: Date Senbei
description: this is a dark comedy full of terrible people. the content is meant for mature audiences, viewer discretion is advised.

title: Adachi Ballin'
description: This game is a 3D basketball action game. The player plays against AI controlled players to score points, and the first to score seven baskets wins. Players can move around the court, dribble and steal the ball, aim and adjust the power of their shots, and switch between different camera views. The game features an SP system, as well as standard basketball mechanics where players can call upon Persona attacks that can knock opponents into a ragdoll state and cause them to lose possession of the ball. AI opponents are able to chase down loose balls, steal possession, shoot the ball at the basket, and use their own Persona attacks during matches.

title: Desktop Island: Idle Together!
description: Desktop Island is a co-op life sim to be enjoyed through both an active or idle playstyle. Play solo, or with up to 5 friends to restore your island and create a communal hub. Meet the inhabitants, choose your profession, master deep progression, and gather resources to build your dream island.

title: Cozy Farm Life Simulator
description:
Turn a quiet patch of land into your own little farm, complete with crops, animals and pets, and watch it flourish.

Start with just a few planting beds and some basic tools. Buy seeds, plant each crop by hand, care for them, wait for the right moment and then sell the harvest for a profit. As your farm grows, you can unlock more space, upgrade your equipment, increase production and become more efficient every day.

title: Tale of Specters: Joseon 1592
description:
Tale of Specters: Joseon 1592 takes the 1592 war and bends it into alternate-history fantasy. You lead a ragtag company of exiles, defectors, and outlaws across battlefields where magic and steel share the same grid.

Terrain wins fights — along with skills, not just stat sheets
Every map is built on height. Take the high ground, force enemies onto bad footing, and play the four elements — earth, water, fire, wind — off each other. Read the turn order, land the right status effects, and you'll take fights you had no business winning.

title: Cards On The Table
description: A roguelike deckbuilder that combines poker with card vs card combat. Set in the seedy Fortune city, players climb the ranks of the wizard poker tournament, building their stack of chips and filling their deck with magical playing cards, where each suit has a unique ability.

title: A.S.S. (Amazing Slot Survivor)
description: Spin the slot machine. If luck is on your side, your power explodes. Level up fast, collect items, and build your loadout. Hunt down “Spawners” that endlessly create monsters, survive the bullet hell, and clear stages. Overwhelm enemies with insane growth driven by luck and choice.

title: Jaderaze Inferno
description: Jaderaze Inferno - is an action-adventure platformer. The action takes place on the island, when damage penetrates into the jade dream of the guardian spirit, the warrior awakens and sees that his homeland has been destroyed. Set out on a journey to defeat the filth.

title: Boss Slayers
description: No game to play with a friend? Now you're a team of boss hunters. Challenge the most dangerous monsters! Dodge rains of projectiles, seize the right moment to attack and discover the weaknesses of cunning bosses.

title: On & Off
description: On & Off is a turn-based strategy game where you manipulate pieces on a grid to trigger explosive chain reactions. Toggle pieces ON to attack, defend, and heal. Read the enemy's telegraphed intents, unleash powerful skills, and master the board to survive!

title: A.D.D. (Anomaly Detection Department)
description: A.D.D is a management simulation game where you run operations for a company investigating the Backrooms. Connect nodes, build workflows, dispatch employees, and deliver the results the company demands.

title: Lockey
description: Seal your enemies with the power of a mystical key. Wield your key as a weapon to build Seal Power. Seal enemies, absorb their power, and unleash devastating Engraving abilities. Fight through the Lock Kingdom, defeat the mighty Lock King.

title: Unload
description: UNLOAD is an interception-focused top-down shooter where ammo is life. Intercept lethal projectiles to reload and survive by a thread. As a Visitor who lost everything in an explosion, hunt down those tied to the incident and uncover the truth behind that day.

title: Hell O’ Halo
description: "Lost your halo? Report to Hell!" Demoted from a cushy Heaven desk job to field duty in Hell, your fight for clock-out times and benefits begins! Build custom decks with opinionated office supplies, smash demon skulls, and loot your halo back. Welcome to Hell—no mercy, no overtime pay!

title: Sura: Shattered Star
description: Sure: Shattered Star is a sword-fighting action platformer set in space. Play as Sura, a mercenary grieving the loss of her comrades, and cut down everything that stands in your way.

title: Task Bar of Ragnalis
description: Your taskbar turns into a battlefield! *Task Bar of Ragnalis* is an idle auto-RPG for PC. Heroes fight, collect treasure, and level up on their own. Combine equipment, form a trio, and find weapons with random abilities. Just let it run and get hooked!

title: Blue Sign
description: In the fictional port city of Rissebra, you work as a marine insurance underwriter. Review the documents brought to your desk by shipowners, and uncover the risks hidden in their vessels, routes, and cargo. The decision to approve or reject each insurance contract rests entirely on your judgment.

title: No Results Found
description: One computer. One room. And records that were never erased. Search. Can you uncover the whole truth?

title: Bolsheviktion 2: Yurovsky's Revenge
description: Whites in chaos. A kidnapped royal son. One man to save the Empire. In this explosive standalone sequel to Bolsheviktion 3D, pursue your son’s kidnappers across war-torn Russia through four action-packed acts, blasting Bolsheviks to an original MIDI soundtrack with chunky pixel graphics!

title: AfterMove
description: Move one piece. Everything else moves with you. AfterMove is a minimalist puzzle game where every piece on the board follows its own rule — find the sequence that wins. 180+ hand-crafted levels. Quietly merciless, deeply satisfying.

title: Keypad Simulator
description: Try to guess a randomly generated 4-digit code on a keypad. It resets each day or when someone guesses it correctly. You only have one try each day. If you guess right, you earn a point.

title: Dust Bunny Simulator
description: You are a dust bunny under the couch. You don't move — the world moves you. Grow from a speck into a Dust Monster while dodging the one true predator: the Roomba. A cozy, gloriously helpless idle sim.

title: Launch Window
description: Launch Window is a single player physics-based automation game where you establish supply chains across an entire solar system using orbital mechanics.

title: The Tower Must Fall
description: Build an impossible tower. Defend it against endless sieges. Watch it crumble, then rebuild stronger.

title: Solider AutoChess
description: You will own all the kungfu in the world. "Solider AutoChess" is a cricket-fighting auto-chess game. Every battle is 1V1. You need to constantly upgrade and skillfully combine kungfus to reach the top.

title: Red Protocol
description: A psychological sci-fi thriller aboard an orbital quarantine station. Interrogate 10 astronauts, identify 4 infected crew members, and prevent a mutiny before Earth reentry.

title: Salus Per Aquam
description: Salus per aquam is a climbing game set in a dreamlike world where the goal is to reach the highest point of the protagonist's existence by climbing surreal objects and navigating metaphysical landscapes.

title: The Magic Master
description: A soulslike inspired game with a magic-only, long-range combat system. Defeat unique bosses along a linear path and unlock new spells.

title: Brew & Defend
description: Brew & Defend is a medieval tavern management game with tower defense mechanics. Build your supply chain, grow crops, brew beverages, and place taverns along the road to satisfy a parade of thirsty customers before they ruin your reputation!

title: Mamma Mu och Kråkan: Vinterlek
description: 8 winter mini-games with the children book characters Mama Moo and The Crow.

title: Crazy Farm: Roguelike Idle Building Game
description: This is the most chaotic farm in the universe. Combine 150+ crazy items to theorycraft game-breaking builds. Trigger massive, automated chain reactions to skyrocket your yields, poop to win!

title: Luke Jump
description: Luke Jump is a 2D horizontal platform action game. You'll have to fight your way through levels and challenge the ultimate enemy. Twenty hand-crafted locations await you, filled with monsters and giant bosses waiting to challenge you and cut you down.

title: Snot Pop!
description: Trap, pop, and splat your way through slime-choked sewers in this '90s-style vertical pixel platformer! Armed only with snot bubbles, outmanoeuvre vile Mouldlings, Mushrooms, Bog Belchers, Glumbats, and Brutes across fifty+ levels. Chain clears, beat the clock, and rescue the Goblin Princess!

title: Derby Heroines: Run, Bet, Win!
description: Horse-racing rules, track-girl speed. Buy Win, Exacta or Trifecta tickets against realistic odds — then hit the track and win the race yourself with dash, skills and specials. Collect 100+ runners, train them, chase the Pinzudo 5 jackpot. In-game currency only. Streaming welcome!

title: Stick Mountain
description: In Stick Mountain, become an elite S-Co agent tasked with eliminating deadly threats across different worlds. Master elemental powers, craft powerful gear, and forge your own path to shape the fate of entire civilizations.

title: Marble Souls
description: Prepare to roll through the dense, interconnected world of MARBLE SOULS. Collect lost souls and level up your marble in the new genre-defying game from the creators of Mosa Lina & FALLSTRUKTUR.

title: Yappy Bird
description: Yappy Bird is a voice-controlled descent into chaos. Your mic is your controller—your dignity is optional. Yell to flap, whisper to glide, fail in silence. Test your lungs, your neighbours’ patience, and your questionable life choices.

title: The World's Hardest Game 3D Nostalgia
description: Easy to play, hard to finish. The World's Hardest Game, which you used to play on flash game sites, is now with you in 3D. The same 30 levels as in the original game are now here! Dodge enemies and reach to the end in this 3D Hard Platformer!

title: Sad Virus Darkland
description: Sad Virus is back now in dark themed land called darkland. Mission again collect beer bottles in this third person adventure walking game

title: Ball Boy Simulator
description: A first-person lost-item exploration simulator set in a Japanese high school baseball club. Search for missing baseballs while enduring the strict hierarchy and unreasonable treatment from coaches and upperclassmen.

title: MapGod
description: MapGod is a fast-paced online party platformer for 3–16 players. The winner of each round becomes the MapGod, controls the next arena and uses traps and powers against the other players.

title: Alfons Åberg ”Bara överallt!”
description: 17 different mini games with the Gunilla Bergström character Alfons Åberg.

title: Medieval Invasion
description: Build towers, defend your main structure from waves of enemies in an intense strategy game. Prove your skills, join the legends!

title: Blue Man Adventure
description: short game time, no story、no dialogue. The core of the game is battle-oriented, The ultimate goal of the game is to kill the biggest monster.

title: Osu!Lazer
description:
osu!lazer is the open-source, next-generation client overhaul of the free-to-play rhythm game osu!, rewritten from scratch by Dean Herbert (ppy) and community contributors using the custom osu-framework. While retaining the core circle-clicking, taiko, catch, and mania gameplay rulesets of the 2007 original, osu!lazer introduces updated game mechanics, including slider end accuracy scoring, real-time score processing, cross-platform mobile parity, and a highly customizable user interface and HUD layout.

Built to eventually replace the legacy stable client, osu!lazer features a built-in skin editor, an overhauled multiplayer architecture with custom room settings, extensive gameplay modifier customization, and native support across Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS. Player progression, beatmap downloads, and global leaderboards are integrated directly with the main osu! infrastructure.

title: Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest
description: Create your own Warrior Cat and journey through the Lake Territories in an immersive action-adventure inspired by the beloved Warrior Cats book series. Hunt, explore, battle rival Clans, uncover prophecies, and shape your legacy with every choice you make.

title: Peak: The Final Ascent
description: Peak: The Final Ascent pushes the co-op mountain-climbing formula into even more hostile territory. This final major update adds two new late-game variant biomes—the ghostly Gloom and trap-filled The Citadel—replacing the Caldera and The Kiln areas as you climb. Along the way, a danger-filled dungeon awaits, and a teased monster may hunt you during your ascent.

title: Quake: Dawn of the Machine
description: To celebrate Quake’s 30th anniversary, the award-winning team at MachineGames—in collaboration with id Software—returns with Dawn of the Machine, a brutal new episode building on their critically acclaimed work on Dimension of the Machine and Dimension of the Past. Delivering ferocious combat, labyrinthine level design, and nightmarish realms that twist reality beyond recognition, it pushes the legacy of the genre-defining first-person shooter even further, honoring one of gaming’s most enduring icons.

title: The Arab League of Misfits
description: The Arab League of Misfits is a 1v1 deckbuilder fueled by Arab pop culture and historical satire. Crush opponents in the Arab Tour roguelite campaign or in brutal PvP matches. Command 140 distinct cards and master seven playstyles from day one, so you can focus purely on throwing digital slippers.

title: In the Van
description: A cozy post-apocalyptic survival game where your van is your home, your shelter, and your key to survival. Scavenge, craft, and uncover the stories the dead left behind.

title: The Castle of the West
description: A Fast-Paced, Fantasy-Themed, First-Person-Shooter in which you get a rapid-fire crossbow and take down hordes of classic fantasy monsters

title: Caterva: Outsider Dreams
description: Everyone in the village has had the same dream... the same nightmare. Everyone except you. Caterva: Outsider Dreams is an exploration and puzzle adventure set aboard an abandoned space station, where players uncover a cosmic mystery through strange characters and interconnected secrets.

title: Hold My Hand (Or Let Go)
description: A free Visual Novel about unrequited love, envy, friendship and forgiveness. Experience the story of Charlie, a completely normal Swedish college student that’s graduating next week. But before he does that, he has to say goodbye to all the friends that he made during his three years in town.

title: FR34KS
description:
Welcome to Freaville Summer Camp, where young adults from nearby universities come together to spend the summer.

You play as a 21-year-old student who soon realizes it's no coincidence that the members of this camp are nicknamed the Freaks.

Everyone has secrets, some dark and some heartwarming, and it's up to you to decide which side you'll uncover through your choices.

title: Rudolf's Very Good, No Bad Day-o
description:
A Rudosiri themed visual novel.

Two years after their last encounter, Symboli Rudolf and Sirius Symboli meet again in a restaurant.

title: Ichikoi
description:
"Destined love begins in an instant―"

A short otome game with 4 suitors.

title: Rock Paper Kill
description: Rock Paper Kill is the sequel to Purple Maniac, a psychological horror point-and-click game about Rock Paper Scissors. You wake up in a cellar and are forced to play Rock Paper Scissors against the man trapped with you.

title: The Choices Of Priori
description: You wake in an empty room, condemned to endless work—until uncovering a mysterious black cloth, you find a vast underground lab, a group of strange creatures called KB-Cats are plotting a revolution there. Join their uprising, survive in this money-ruled world until you touch the truth and miracle.

title: Vitriol & Valor
description: Wield gesture-based magic to navigate a gothic nightmare that rearranges itself, survive the depths, and destroy the evil that has taken root in your reality.

title: Craig's Cave
description: Ha! You're no better than the last one. The same fate awaits you... Сome to Craig's Cave!

title: Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon: Wildlands - Definitive Edition
description:
The Definitive Edition includes:
- Tom Clancy’s Ghost Recon Wildlands
- Season Pass
- Year 2 Pass
- Quick Start Pack
- Deluxe Pack
- Nightfall Protocol Pack
- Cold Eye Pack

title: Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon: Wildlands - Last Rites
description:
Last Rites is a free update for Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon Wildlands, celebrating the franchise's 25th anniversary, featuring 4K and 60 FPS upgrades, expanded customization options, and more!

Return to a darker, more hostile Bolivia to hunt down a sinister new threat, La Llorona--a cult leader, in a tense and unsettling new linear mission.

title: Kindawn: The Parish Remembers
description: A first-person atmospheric horror exploration game. You play as an adult returning to the Siberian town where you grew up as an orphan. As you piece together fractured memories and uncover what happened in your absence, the line between folklore and nightmare begins to dissolve. The game is designed for a single playthrough of approximately 3-5 hours.

title: Depths of Providence
description: Depths of Providence is a turn-based roguelike JRPG through 100 procedurally generated floors. Your party enters at level 1 with empty pockets. Fight down through instant-death depths and escape with rare loot before you lose it all. Bank blue-chest relics forever and climb the daily leaderboard.

title: Working95
description: Point and click work simulator where you do office jobs, like spreadsheets, sorting files, making a ledger, and more!

title: Snapshot Adventures: Secret of Bird Island
description: Collect cool items to help you achieve that perfect shot, create fantastic birds using the included Bird Creator, then release them into the wilds of the internet for other Snapshot players to find and photograph.

title: PowBall Deluxe
description: First released for DOS in 1996, now rebuilt to work on modern computers. Remake of the classic Breakout / Arkanoid genre with resources, a shop, weapons and more.

title: The Walking Dead: Streets of Survival - Deluxe Edition
description:
The Deluxe Edition includes The Arcade Apocalypse Pack:
• 2 Weapon Skins - Tactical Magnum and Unlockable Mystery Weapon Skin
• 1 Character Skin - Civic Republic Military Rick
• The Walker Pit - Endless Survival Combat Mode
• HELL ON EARTH Difficulty mode - Hardcore Mode without Checkpoints
• Digital Soundtrack

title: Deep Sea Delivery & Co.
description: Explore a procedurally generated world and fulfill time-sensitive quests in this frantic underwater adventure!

title: Ball Picker: Clean Up the Golf Yard
description: Collect +1,000,000 golf balls, earn money, buy new vehicles, and clean up the golf yard. Ball Picker - Clean up the Golf Yard is an active incremental game centered on an organizing and relaxing experience.

title: Ashes of Vaelmoor
description: A small Indie game made by me and my friends, designed for speedrunning.

title: Baron Misanthrope
description: A short 1-2 hour denpa visual novel about a man of dubious sanity and his mysterious top hat-wearing companion.

title: Market Manager Simulator
description: Build and manage your own market. Fill the shelves, set prices, serve customers, manage online orders and grow your business. Hire employees, check stocks and turn your market into a large business.

title: Mega Snake: 16-Bit Edition
description:
Relive the golden age of arcade gaming with Mega Snake: 16-Bit Edition, a retro-inspired arcade snake game featuring vibrant 16-bit visuals, responsive controls, and classic high-score gameplay.

Guide your snake through an endless grid, collect pellets to grow longer, avoid walls, obstacles, and your own tail, and survive as the speed steadily increases. Whether playing with a keyboard, gamepad, or touch controls, every run is a new challenge to beat your best score.

Designed for modern PCs and Xbox, the game supports offline play and delivers a pure arcade experience with no ads or microtransactions.

title: Focus Froggy
description: Focus Froggy is a bug-catching, platformer adventure. Experience the calm life of a frog in the swamp. Jump and explore, catch evasive bugs, customize your appearance, complete quests, upgrade abilities, and most importantly: Focus!

title: Nothing Goes Right: Bad Business
description: A co-op restaurant management game where every successful day creates bigger problems. Cook, serve, survive chaos, pay the bills, and see how long your business can stay alive.

title: Cosmic Crumbs: Bakery Simulator
description: Build and run your own bakery in space as orders start stacking up. Keep the machines moving, prepare sweet treats, manage your robot helpers, and turn your little shop into the galaxy’s busiest bakery — solo or with friends.

title: Red Echoes: Berlin
description: Berlin 1918. Amidst the turmoil of the Great War, the fires of revolution burn. With the German Kaiser's reign rapidly coming to an end, lead a group of socialist revolutionaries and attempt to change the course of history. Will you succeed and bring about a better tomorrow?

title: Ace & Aro: Heart-to-Heart
description: Welcome to the Ace & Aro Meetup! Whether you’re a-spec yourself or just curious to learn more, we hope you feel welcome here. Meet the members, try a cocktail (or two) and unwind with some arcade games. Let’s have a heart-to-heart!

title: Tide of Tactics
description: Tide of Tactics is a medieval turn-based tactics game. Choose a commander to play, each with their own unique unit and abilities, then go to battle on a grid-based battlefield. Use the terrain to your advantage, place traps on the ground, and build the right units to counter your enemy.

title: Red Capture
description: Red Capture is a side-scrolling game where the player controls a red square, dodging dangerous figures and jumping on constantly shifting and randomly changing platforms. The game also features a competitive two-player mode where you can see who can last the longest.

title: Cyber Miner
description: An endless roguelite with flappy controls and randomised power-up mechanics.

title: RobBred: Funny Chat
description: Bored? Lonely? Want to meet new people? Here you'll meet random players and have crazy, funny, and interesting conversations. One of the craziest indie games of the year is here.

title: Night Creed
description: In the ruined lands of an ancient kingdom, evil, hidden for centuries in the ruins of old castles, awakens. Monsters begin to emerge from dark rifts, filling the deserted fortresses and forgotten roads.

title: Immortal Faces
description: Challenge your memory, test your nerves, and immerse yourself in a world where to forget is to die. Are you ready to look into the faces of the immortals and remember them forever?

title: Tanxl
description: The peaceful daily routine was shattered, and the secret hidden deep within the forest is leading her to the door of fate.

title: Arcadox
description: Welcome to Arcadox, a game where classic Arkanoid nostalgia meets the aesthetics of the early internet and 80s dreams.

Your family is murdered before your own eyes leaving you in a mentally debilitated state. You must now open your mind and accept the truth of what has happened to free yourself from a spiral of emotional degradation.

title: Balloon Ride
description: Balloon Ride is a game where you control the balloon and fly through avoiding all the obstacles Every distance you cover will give you score Challenge yourself in getting more score

title: Saylor Assassin Puzzle
description: Puzzle game which contains 6 images to solve from different themes

title: Shape Boxed
description: A minimalistic arcade reaction speed puzzle game. There are three boxes at the bottom of the screen and various figures fall on top of them.

title: Company Tycoon
description: A cyberpunk-styled business simulation and tycoon game where players build, scale, and manage their own tech empire.

title: Dark of the Depths
description: A first-person deep sea exploration game. Use only a torch to navigate through rusted structures, encountering both dangerous and harmless sea creatures. Uncover the mysteries of the trench, and experience the phobia-inducing atmosphere of the ocean floor.

title: PatriotMemoirs
description: Shangchuan, 1939, Japanese-occupied. By day a bowing traitor, by night a ghost, in Demon's Lair, No. 86. All wear masks: pretend, kill, survive. When sacrificing a friend is the only way, when betrayed, when only isolated cities remain - fight to the end, live a coward, or take an unimagined path?

title: Having fun, Mochi?
description:
Having fun, Mochi? is a cozy narrative hidden object game set in a hand-drawn watercolor world. Play as the mischievous Shiba Inu pup Mochi, who wanders from a ceramics shop into an unfamiliar forest, where you search for playful surprises by looking, zooming, and interacting with what’s around you.
The gameplay focuses on discovering small objects in richly layered scenes, using smooth mouse controls and a relaxing, story-led experience with no graphics or sound in the browser version.

title: Sails
description: Plunder, craft and live the pirate’s life. This is a multiplayer pirate survival game where you mine, craft, trade and plunder to survive. Form alliances with other players to strengthen your crew and wage war on your enemies. Fight to keep what’s yours before others take it.

title: Reanimal: The Prisoner
description: Join The Soldier and The Prisoner on a journey through the war-ravaged streets of this once-familiar place, as they stumble blindly down a rabbit hole that will change their lives forever.

title: Lowmoor Idle RPG: An Adventurer's Chronicle
description: A zero-player idle RPG in the spirit of Progress Quest, told in a Win9x chronicle. Shape a 2,108-skill tree, face 179 illustrated monsters, earn 100 achievements and find tens of thousands of equipment combinations in two adventures. Watch it run or close the window.

title: Misdealt
description: Win your crown back! Build a strong deck, explore a mystical world and expand your abilities in this medieval fantasy adventure where everything comes down to the cards. And if luck isn't on your side, bend the rules to ensure your ultimate victory!

title: Papa
description: Years after escaping your childhood home, you return to visit your dying father one last time. As strange events unfold, memories of the past begin to blur with reality.

title: Megastore: Tidy Up Together
description: Megastore: Tidy Up Together is a cozy sorting game for solo or co-op play. Take on 5 stores at any difficulty, from a Toy Store with 3,555 items to a massive Megastore with 13,357 items. Pick up, sort, shelve, and get ready to open!

title: Big Bad Pharma
description: A cosy pharmacy-stocking sim with a wicked streak. Clock in, sort the shelves, chase satisfying upgrades, and slowly climb the corporate ladder of a pharmacy that maybe shouldn't exist. Tidy. Satisfying. A little bit evil.

title: Hunter x Hunter: Nen x Impact - Additional Character 1 Neferpitou
description: This add-on unlocks the playable character "Neferpitou."

title: You Must Remember
description: A dark past stops Patient 11 from retaining memories, leaving him hostile and lost in time. Dive deep into his mind through hypnosis to help him recover the truth. Every attempt is completely different. Are you up for the challenge?

title: Ultima V: Lazarus
description: Remake of Ultima V: Warriors of Destiny in Dungeon Siege.

title: Five Nights In The Backrooms
description:
After 12-Link Labs discovers 'The Backrooms', they also find a terrifying creature. This creature is very hostile, and no matter how hard they try... They can't contain it.

So they’ve sent you, a very dangerous convict to watch over it and analyse its behaviour. Will you survive five nights in the backrooms?

title: Japan Stigmatized Property 3
description: Can you survive until dawn? Monitor real Japanese properties and report every anomaly. Miss too many… and you will fail.

title: Metroid Prime Origins
description:
A fully complete adaptation of Metroid Prime for the Game Cube in 2D, complimented by a fake-bit aesthetic. This has been lovely to work on, and I had a lovely team of fellow fans by my side this entire time.

This game was made with no generative AI. All sprites and music were created by fans, and all of the in-game lore has been re-written; based on the original NTSC lore.

title: Deflect
description: A bullet hell parry roguelite where your shield is the only weapon. Catch enemy fire and send it screaming back through 100 waves, endless hybrid-boss gauntlets, and a mountain of loot. Seven Reapers, one rule: Don't Shoot, Send it back!

title: Zingeldinger in "The Cowboy Who Couldn't Shoot"
description: "Zingeldinger in "The Cowboy Who Couldn't Shoot"" is sokoban videogame in which you must solve a series of puzzles using your cowboy abilities in order to recieve encouragement from The Warriors of Encouragevar. Gain enough encouragement to steady your aim and slay the vile beast that has followed them from their realm into The Wild West!

title: Harvesters
description: A short incremental game about gathering resources in different planets. Upgrade the harvesters, unlock new buildings, and unlock new ways to gather resources! It's all about watching lil people do their thing.

title: Mokis
description: June, 1999. In a Tokyo suburb overshadowed by Nostradamus' prophecy, grow closer to six girls as the end of the world approaches. An emotional romance visual novel where your choices shape each heroine's fate and reveal what people truly seek at the end of an era.

title: Caladrius 2: Dark Element
description: A dark gothic world ruled by beauty and darkness... Over a decade after its debut, the infamous Shame Break system returns. Discover striking characters brought to life by acclaimed illustrators, and master enhanced Element Shot and Shame Break systems in this exhilarating 2D bullet-hell shooter.

title: Mighty Moth and the Horrible, Terrible, Awful, No-Good Day!
description:
Save the day and save your date, one punch at a time!

You’re Mighty Moth, hero of the universe, defender of Cecropolis and helpless romantic! After saving your crush for the millionth time, you finally score a dinner date for 8:00PM. But your excitement is cut short, as the nefarious Shocked Cult has broken into your base and stolen all the galactic gifts you gathered for your date!

Help Mighty Moth beat up cultists, recover her gifts and get to her date before the risotto gets cold!

title: Verum Titan
description: A first-person narrative driven action game. You wake up as Carla, no memories, lost in a futuristic world. On your journey you must blast through an army of enemies. Accompanied by Romer, your Vacuum cleaner sidekick you will travel to unlock the mysteries of what happened.

title: Emergency Buddies
description: Emergency Buddies is a co-op ambulance sim for up to 4 players about the world's least qualified paramedic crew. Grab a call, floor it across town, and haul your patient to the hospital alive, ideally! Drive fast and careful, trying to keep patients breathing.

title: Harbourlight
description: Warm light, late nights, one guest at a time. Grow, raise and catch your ingredients, then build each dish by hand across eight flavours, tailored to whoever's at the counter. Listen as your regulars open up, and watch a sleepy harbour town wake up as new faces arrive with new tastes to learn.

title: DreamPost
description: Review files, assemble dreams, and fulfill daily orders using a retro employee terminal. Build friendships with coworkers from different eras, investigate deleted files, and await a letter addressed both to and from yourselfbut before any of that, make sure you meet this weeks performance quota.

title: Catherine?
description: When an experiment goes wrong...

title: Neverness to Everness: Rising from the Moonlit Fog
description: Version 1.3 of Neverness to Everness, which includes: • New Characters: Zankou and Linko • New Main Story Chapter • New area: Duskmoor • New events and game modes • ...and more!

title: Ultraprocessor Ribbon
description: Follow the story of Stella and her computer-turned-android Ribbon as they fight to make old computers legal again.

title: Dawn Sanatorium
description: A childhood you don't remember arrives on an old film reel. Step into the Dawn Sanatorium — a first-person psychological horror where a projector rewrites reality, a horned figure watches from the dark, and the truth about who you are waits at the very bottom.

title: Wuthering Waves: Lamplight in Mirage, Sword’s Resolve in Heart
description: Continuing the journey across Solaris-3, Version 3.6 advances the game’s main story while introducing two new Resonators, powerful new weapons, challenging combat encounters, limited-time events, and extensive gameplay improvements across every platform.

title: Among Demons
description: Build a team of demons, survive endless dungeon runs, and explore a shared online world. Recruit defeated enemies, create powerful builds, extract before losing everything, and defeat challenging world bosses to earn lasting buffs.

title: Columbus
description: Columbus》 is a dark fantasy visual novel with dual male leads. Play as Weaponzzie, a nameless weapon trapped in a wealthy estate. Dialogue choices drive a branching story to 10 endings—tenderness, ruin, freedom, or downfall. Your bond with the young master is defined by you.

title: Rosebound
description: There's love in deathーdeath in eternity. Rosebound is a fully voiced visual novel set in a world of vampires, high-tech mercenaries, magical priests, and man-made horrors.

title: Soul Siblings
description: A nearly 15-year-old student falls asleep during a lesson, but nobody wakes her up. She awakens after a terrifying dreams and realizes it's already nighttime. While looking for a route to get out from the school building, she learns unusual things about paranormal activity and her family's tragedy.

title: Scavenge Protocol
description: Land on strange planets, loot valuable junk, dodge deadly creatures, convert scrap into energy, and desperately attempt to survive with your friends in this co-op horror adventure.

title: Ocean Diver
description: An arcade high-score based game where you shoot enemies from a submarine. Score more points with the missile by shooting enemies far away and pierce multiple enemies with one harpoon shot to score more points.

title: DigitDash3
description: DigitDash3 is a live interactive party game for Twitch and Kick. Up to seven viewers compete on a shared 13×13 numbered grid by typing chat commands to move a single game piece and score the most points.

title: Saimin Gakuen: Intrusion Edition
description: A classic title from Japan’s renowned visual novel developer, Fudegaki Soft! What kind of unexpected encounters await the seemingly ordinary protagonist in his professional journey...?

title: PinScape
description:
PinScape is a Roguelite where you play Pinball on a board you've built yourself: place down the bumpers, the flippers, and any kind of item wherever you want.
Uncover wild interactions and powerful synergies, to chase ever-breaking scores!

title: Marvel Rivals: Season 9.5 – The Hood
description: Season 9.5 of Marvel Rivals introduces The Hood, a new Vanguard who combines dual pistols with dark magic. After stealing an enchanted cloak from the Vault, Parker Robbins rises from New York’s criminal underground in pursuit of greater power, channeling demonic forces as his path leads him into the conflict unfolding in Thebes.

title: Modified Girl Eurie!
description: Modified Girl Eurie is dispatched to Tengetsu Town. Her mission is to rescue those who are powerless to fight and wipe out the monsters near the town.

title: Polyzonia
description: An ecosystem sim set in the Amazon rainforest. Grow plants, create habitats for animals, and click to hunt prey, pollinate flowers, eat fruit, and poop to spread seeds. Unlock automation and make the rainforest grow and thrive on its own.

title: How to Train Your Bro's Girlfriend
description: Don’t call it an inferiority complex but it’s such a pain always trailing one step behind your buddy in life, in work, and in relationships. Well, sorry bro, but this time we’ll be one step ahead by fucking your girlfriend first!

title: Eye of the Incubus
description: Shiro, an unassuming castle servant, one day comes into contact with a mysterious demon and is transformed into a half-demon. Though baffled at first, now half-man and half-demon, Shiro begins to accept his newfound life. Free at long last, however, Shiro finds himself in the center of chaos and trouble…

title: Donkey Kong Land Remake
description:
Donkey Kong Land Remake is a fanmade recreation for PC of the original Donkey Kong Land, but with looks, sound and controls in the style of DKC!
Featuring 30+ full sized levels, tight controls and a lot of secrets to uncover, so Donkey and Diddy can get all their bananas back, again!

title: The Escape From Dungeon Keep
description: A classic text RPG: type commands to explore, fight turn-based battles, manage inventory, upgrade gear, and finish side quests. Chase multiple endings, New Game+ content, achievements, and moddable Workshop maps.

title: Monolith: Dark Matter
description: A round-based FPS for 1–4 players set inside the Monolith — a brutalist complex shaped by living black matter. Fight escalating waves of its marionettes, earn points to unlock new sectors and build your arsenal, and uncover the route to a final encounter.

title: Radiorizon
description: Dash into this challenging 2D platformer where you visit the remains of an old star system. You cannot fight the hostile creatures, only the god-like entities that sense danger in your presence. Explore the dangerous environment, talk to the inhabitants and destroy all 3 planets to save humanity.

title: Brave Billiards
description: 《Brave Billiards》is a strategy action game that combines billiards physics, roguelike building, and fantasy monster battles. Aim, charge, and strike to launch the cue ball across the table in combos, defeat monster balls, collect relics and skills, and create your own adventure style.

title: [Hell is Empty]
description: Dreadnaught has been granted the holiest of tasks: destroy everything in his path until all he sees is in ruins. But when he finds a damaged robot named Miss Sunshine...something within Dreadnaught snaps. And now the only person who may be safe is Miss Sunshine.[A story-driven first-person brawler]

title: The Last Portal
description: Build and upgrade a fantasy army to defend the last surviving portal across 150 increasingly dangerous waves, expanding zones, and powerful boss battles.

title: BeBalance
description: Balance brooms, reeds, feather dusters, and one deeply uncooperative crowbar on a single fingertip. Chase the center of mass, survive crosswinds and parrots, earn coins, unlock skills, and consider an important question: is staying upright really more impressive than being caught?

title: Hauntasy
description: Do you believe in ghosts? A wealthy baron offers you $1,000,000 to take part in the Hauntasy, a seven-night challenge inside his family's supposedly haunted estate. Keep watch, manage your limited resources, and survive until dawn to claim the reward.

title: Desk Top Racer
description: Turn your desktop into a living racetrack with this idle racing management game. Acquire cars, equip parts, and compete online against other players. Win championships and expand your garage through Mastery, Collections, and new rewards.

title: Skies of Valoria
description: "Skies of Valoria" is a fantasy action Roguelite with dynamic builds and fast combat. Soar the clouds on "Aethelwhale", team up with 4 Valkyries across Valoria, and strike the Demon King's Castle! Harness War Souls for endless combos and summon monsters to sweep away all foes.

title: 1 Bit Chaos
description: Trapped inside an old CRT TV, hundreds of ruthless creatures are rushing at you! Start praying to level up, power up with random cards, and die a lot. Spend your gold on new weapons and tiny companions, then try again. Death has never been this profitable!

title: Esc Trip
description: Esc Trip is a non-linear oddball vacation sim with a cute sticker scrapbook aesthetic.

title: Survive the Shift
description: workplace survival card decision game. Starting as an intern, you must balance boss trust, team popularity, business output, and personal savings. Slacking rules, dinner culture, and bizarre blame-shifting communications turn into choice cards. Swipe once a day to see how many days you can survive.

title: Insurance Fraud
description: A blackjack roguelike where hands pay for their shape, not just their total. Build absurd combos from upgrades and cards that have no business in a deck, then take five dealers for everything they’ve got. The insurance is not entirely legal.

title: Harvest Deadline
description: Plant crops, earn money, and reach the daily goal in this pixel-art farming roguelite. Buy upgrades, discover artifacts, and create powerful synergies in short, strategic runs where every decision can grow your farm—or end it.

title: Tinted Sands: Welcome to Swirling Paw Point
description: Tinted Sands: Welcome to Swirling Paw Point is a NSFW Visual Novel Dating Sim full of a variety of kink and fetish. You are spirited away from your dismal life onto a new island where your kinks and fetish come to life with the anthropomorphic residents of this paradise! Live out your new life getting to know the hunks who live on the island while discovering hidden fetishes and kinks that lead you on a transformative journey of self-acceptance and empowerment.

title: Persona5: The Phantom X - Virtual Sweetheart
description: Version 1.1 of Persona5: The Phantom X, which includes: The finale to Mission 2's story, the debut of Yui (Codename: Bui), a new Phantom Idol, new events, synergies, and side missions, quality of life updates... and more!

title: Hide and Fuse
description: Turn into a lamp. Freeze. Pray. One player carries a live bomb and hunts the room — everyone else is furniture. Blend in, hold your nerve, and pass the bomb before it blows. A party game of disguise, panic, and betrayal for 2–10 players (or grab a few and let the chaos fill the rest)

title: Capy of Gods
description: A vertical-climbing action roguelike: scale a massive tower as a capybara while your weapons fire on their own, bullet-heaven style. Level up, shape your build, take on quests, and unlock weapons and characters. Every run generates a brand-new tower.

title: Hacker vs It
description: DOS old school game showing how a hacker and an IT workers do their jobs. The idea of this game is show the hacking and the IT process with less fantasy elements. Shows a WAY closer perspective the actual hacking strategies.

title: Horse Magnifier: The Full Horse
description: Horse Magnifier: The Full Horse is the full and expanded version of the viral puzzle game

title: Mad Ever After
description: Happily ever after? Team up in this chaotic 1-4 player co-op roguelike FPS. Journey through twisted fairytale realms, wield shapeshifting magical staffs, combine powerful spells and upgrades, and battle bizarre enemies and corrupted fairytale bosses. Rewrite the story, one chaotic run at a time.

title: Poko Poko Field
description: 'Poko Poko Field' is a roguelite action game where the fluffy Pomeranian "Watapoko" conquers islands scattered across the world through knockback battles. Combine skills, build your strategy, and set out on an adventure to become the strongest across the islands.

title: Blue Flag Down, Guard Up
description: A fast-paced Blue Flag, White Flag arcade game where a split-second choice determines your score. Follow changing commands to test your reflexes and focus. Enjoy classic rules with fresh features, perfect for casual family fun.

title: Voracity
description: Voracity is a relaxing industrial game. Your objective is simple: crank the generator, produce meat cubes and feed it to the monster to meet your quota. Watch your step!

title: One Stroke Hunter
description: A brainy roguelite monster-hunting game fought with a single continuous stroke. Connect grid squares in one unbroken line to build attacks, defenses, and spells, then slay your enemies. Deeper levels bring more complex fields and a new map every run. Draw the perfect path.

title: Re:Dream
description: Re:Dream is a walking simulator in which the player discovers photographs. A copy of our world, or a world inside a copy. 3 real life characters, who discover their self of our reality.

title: FrogStray
description: A tough, precise platformer. Guide a lost frog home using charged jumps and wall-kicks through hand-crafted, obstacle-filled levels. A pure challenge of skill.

title: Roubaga
description:
Roubaga is a fast-paced online multiplayer social deduction game inspired by Werewolf and Gartic Phone. No downloads, no accounts, and no setup required — simply choose a nickname, pick an avatar, create a room, share a 4-character code, and start playing with friends.

During each game, players are secretly assigned unique roles and divided into different factions. The villagers must uncover the hidden werewolves before it's too late, while the werewolves work together to eliminate everyone else. Special roles such as the Seer, Witch, Hunter, Cupid, Mentor, YooGos, Zenix, F1 Driver, Tung Tung Tung Sahur, Algator37, and many others add strategy, mystery, and unexpected twists to every match.

Roubaga features real-time gameplay, customizable rules, private chat channels, room presets, role selection, voting systems, captain elections, and unique original roles created exclusively for the game. Every match is different, whether you prefer classic Werewolf gameplay, investigation-focused rounds, creator-themed modes, or complete chaos.

With 42 unique avatars, quick room creation, and browser-based access, Roubaga is designed for friends who want exciting social deduction games without complicated installations or registrations.

title: Babu Me Baby!
description: Haruki Osanai is just trying to get by in life, but too much stress from work has taken a toll on him. His physician resorts to an unusual method to help him relieve stress... Hypnosis! However, things take an unexpected turn...

title: Summer Dash: Our Track Team's Summer Training Trip
description: As coach of the girls' track team, go on an exciting retreat in the countryside with the three best girls of your team, where you'll help them overcome their struggles and unlock their full potential!

title: Lambda Neros R
description: Finding a mystical sword in a cave turned out more than this adventurer ever bargained for! Now saddled with the crassest of partners, Rimua embarks on an epic quest which will decide the fate of not just the continent, but the very world...

title: Syphon Filter 2: Recompiled
description: An experimental Windows static recompilation of Syphon Filter 2.

title: Imperial Knights
description: Become an imperial knight to reclaim your family's honor and discover what drove your sister to abandon her country!

title: Eternal Sonata: Reprise
description: A static recompilation of Eternal Sonata (Xbox 360) for Windows and Linux.

title: Devil Drive Polaris
description: Devil Drive Polaris is a single-stage vertical shoot 'em up featuring a player-controlled dynamic difficulty (rank) system that encourages ratcheting up the difficulty to chase higher scores. This game was developed in about a week for the fifth TWG game jam.

title: Clickbait Tycoon
description:
Clickbait Tycoon is an idle/incremental simulation game in which the player builds a clickbait media company in a pixel-art depiction of 1980s New York. Beginning with a single website and desk, the player publishes articles to generate views and ad revenue, then reinvests earnings into staff, upgrades, and new mechanics unlocked through a Research Lab system.

The core loop combines active clicking with automation: players staff a newsroom across twelve hire tiers, catch trending topics, fix typos for combo streaks, publish golden articles, and respond to breaking news events by choosing to verify stories, publish immediately, or sell tips. A separate RPG layer follows a field writer through 40 quests featuring boss encounters against editors-turned-monsters, lootable gear, and click-based combat.

Additional systems include an office tower with a 10x10 grid of rooms that grant permanent bonuses across resets, collectible creatures called Pocket Pals that hatch from boss-dropped eggs and can be merged and evolved, staff policies, payroll, scandals, and daily, weekly, and seasonal events. The game features two layers of prestige: selling out resets a run in exchange for permanent website bonuses, while a later buyout trades the entire empire for Legacy Shares. It includes offline progression, over 270 achievements, and cloud saves.

title: Not Monsters
description: A medieval themed party game for 4-15 players where social deduction becomes ragdoll combat and monsters hide in plain sight.

title: Pinched
description: Multiplayer horror game about being lost in pitch-black tunnels with nothing but a flashlight and your voice. Four players spawn in a procedural generated maze in total darkness, where proximity voice chat echoes and bounces down the halls, so you hear each other long before you find each other. Race for the exit, climb ahead of rising floodwater, or survive the thing that hunts you by sound. Every map is generated fresh each round, and nobody has the layout memorized, including the developer.

title: Accident Investigator Simulator: Black Box
description: Step into the role of a federal investigator and uncover the truth behind every disaster. Recover black boxes, cross-reference evidence, expose contradictions, and name the real cause before an innocent takes the fall. Every conclusion matters in this tense investigation sim full of twists.

title: Syncline
description: Syncline is a grid-based puzzle game in which the player rolls a straight line of cubes across a board and lines it up with goal blocks. The line tumbles as a rigid body: it can lie flat or stand on end, climb terrain, and split apart when driven into obstacles — cubes that cannot pass break off and remain on the grid, where a later move can reconnect them. Rotating the camera in 90-degree steps changes the movement directions and decides which cubes are kept when the line splits. Hazard blocks destroy or transform cubes that land on them; nothing is randomized, and every level is verified solvable by the game's own solver and stamped with a par move count. The game features a campaign of themed level packs, a built-in level editor backed by the same solver, and community level sharing through mod.io. Inspired by Bloxorz and Cuboid.

title: Satsuki-iro no Sora ni
description:
It's been a month since Shuuya and others moved into this city.
Shuuya and Asami started living together. His daily life was monotone but peaceful until he met Kikyou and Anon.

A little bittersweet story of love and change.

title: Devil's Dice
description:
Devil's Dice is a game about rolling the dice to pay off your debt. Fail, and you'll have to pay the consequences.

Buy trinkets to tilt the odds in your favour and try not to fall behind on your payments.

The game is currently in Early Access and is playable from start to finish, including an endless mode and over 50 in-game trinkets.

title: Persona5: The Phantom X - The Revenge Fox
PentaPip
description:
Roll. Hold. Break the rules.
Roll five dice. Keep what you need. Score one category. Then turn those familiar choices into a roguelite build powerful enough to outscore five rule-changing bosses.

PentaPip starts with classic roll–hold–score strategy and builds from there. Between scorecards, spend your cash on Tricks, Runes, and Sigils. Combine their effects with bonuses and multipliers until an ordinary scorecard becomes a finely tuned scoring machine.

title: Little Picnic
description: Little Picnic is a relaxing open-world adventure set on a peaceful rural island in South Korea’s southern sea. Spend your summer vacation at your grandmother’s home, explore the island freely, meet its residents, and relive the quiet magic of childhood summers.

title: Ticket to Nowhere
description:
Enjoy your movie... if you can ever reach the theater.

You just wanted to catch a late-night screening, but you find yourself trapped in a strangely empty cinema corridor. The lights hum, the posters stare back at you, and the only way out is the elevator at the end of the hall. But memory is a fragile thing, and this place loves to play tricks on your mind.

Ticket to Nowhere is a psychological anomaly observation game where your eyes—and your ears—are your only lifeline.

title: Stalingrad 1942
description: Stalingrad 1942 is a retro-inspired 16-bit arcade tank shooter from InfinitByte Studios. Take command of a defensive tank and battle through endless sectors filled with enemy tanks, anti-tank guns, aircraft, and powerful bosses. Collect power-ups, build massive combo chains, and survive as long as possible while chasing the highest score.

title: Nitro Horizon
description: Nitro Horizon is a neon-inspired top-down arcade racing game from InfinitByte Studios. Race against AI rivals across six unique circuits, master high-speed drifting and nitro boosts, unlock seven distinct vehicles, and compete across Arcade Race, Time Attack, and Championship modes. Earn credits, improve your garage, and climb the leaderboard in a fast-paced single-player racing experience.

title: Assassin’s Creed Black Flag Resynced: Collector’s Edition
description:
Assassin’s Creed Black Flag Resynced puts you in the role of Edward Kenway, sailing the Caribbean and battling enemies with boarding attacks, stealth takedowns, and close-quarters combat using sword, pistol, and the Hidden Blade. A rebuilt experience expands naval encounters and open-world exploration across seas and islands.
This Collector’s Edition includes a deluxe copy of the game, the Blackbeard’s Crimson Pack (Edward costume, sword, and pistol), and Deluxe Content with the Master Assassin Character Pack and Master Assassin Naval Pack. It also comes with premium physical keepsakes: an Edward Kenway figurine, Edward’s leather logbook, a wearable metal Assassin brooch, an exclusive Steelbook, a cloth world map, and a sea shanty music sheet.

title: Reverse 1999: Last and First Principles
description:
Version 3.6 of Reverse: 1999, which includes:
• New character: Enigma
• New Garments for Recoleta, Marsha and White Rum
• New main event: Last and First Principles
• …and more!

title: Lady Pearl
description: A standard travel-themed RPG known for its well-developed characters and careful craftsmanship as well as a large cast of party members. It’s a somewhat meandering travel story about the protagonists wandering around in search of a legendary jewel, Lady Pearl, gem said to possess immense power and supreme beauty, have remained undiscovered for ages.

title: Ace Combat 6: Recompiled
description: A native PC port of Ace Combat 6: Fires of Liberation (Xbox 360).

title: 8bit Salvage
description: An incremental cleaning game about a tiny salvage shop that takes retired game sprites and scrubs them for the pixels they're made of. Scrub the art, reclaim the pixels, sell the salvage, and upgrade your equipment - while goo, roller brushes, and mutation waves turn a calm cleanup into chaos. Scrub old game art. Save the pixels. Clean through chaos.

title: Ikarus
description: IKARUS blends the bullet-hell chaos of arcade shmups with the strategic edge of a roguelike deck-builder. Dodge, parry, and shoot through waves of hostile machines while crafting game-breaking card synergies. How close to the sun will you fly?

title: Condemned 2: Recompiled
description: A static recompilation of Condemned 2: Bloodshot (Xbox 360).

title: Breached: Follow Me
description:
Breached: Follow Me is a first-person psychological horror game that takes you into the dark atmosphere of Eastern Europe, where ordinary places hide terrifying stories.

After meeting an online friend, you set out toward events that slowly spiral out of control. What began as a simple adventure turns into a dangerous investigation, where every discovery brings you closer to the truth.

title: Redtail Relic Rush
description:
Adventure never slows down in Redtail Relic Rush! Join Redtail, a fearless red panda explorer armed with a grappling hook, on an action-packed journey through ancient ruins filled with danger, mystery, and legendary treasures.
