Run nonstop through thrilling platforming challenges packed with traps, enemies, and daring leaps. Swing through the air, build momentum at just the right moment, and master the perfect rhythm to overcome every obstacle as you race toward the legendary Golden Idol.

Explore 30 exciting levels across 3 unique biomes, from lush jungle ruins and mysterious cliffs to ancient pyramids full of secrets. Every environment introduces fresh challenges that put your reflexes, timing, and precision to the test while keeping the adventure fun and rewarding.

With charming pixel art, responsive controls, and smooth gameplay that always makes you want to play just one more level, Redtail Relic Rush is the perfect adventure for fans of fast-paced platformers, exploration, and exciting action.

Grab your grappling hook, keep your momentum, and prove that no treasure is out of your reach!

title: Sonic.exe Plus!
description:
Uncover the haunting sins of the past update-by-update in this Sonic.exe fan game.

As the father of a deceased son, you, Edward Mislik, must play through your sons old Sonic the Hedgehog game cardrige, only to find things aren't the same as they used to be. The characters are different. They look twisted and multilated, their faces unchanging, and in cutscenes they look 3D. They act without input, almost seeming alive... They speak of things they should have no knowledge of... Sonic himself seems espechally knowing, as if you're best buddies... Will you find the way to save them, or will you join them? Your choice...

title: Kitchen Sync: The Flying Tavern
description: Kitchen Sync: The Flying Tavern is a fantasy cooking RPG. Assemble a party of adventurous chefs and serve delicious food and drink to guests all across the far away realm of Rosolare. Build unbreakable bonds, craft a fantastical menu, customize your cooking strategy, and reunite the world.

title: Mini Monuments
description: Mini Monuments is a calming diorama restoration game where you dig, clean, and rebuild handcrafted miniature ruins. Use tactile tools at your own pace and watch as each scene comes back to life piece by piece.

title: Fuhon
description:
Fuhon is a cozy nature-sandbox adventure about restoring a fragmented, decaying world. Play as a small fox spirit that explores mysterious islands, uncovers nature’s secrets, and discovers light puzzle and platforming challenges as you transform barren land into thriving habitats for cute animals.
As you explore, you unlock plants, trees, mushrooms, decorations, and magical or functional items, building and shaping the environment around you at your own pace in a relaxing, atmospheric world.

title: Reverse 1999: On Another's Sorrow
description:
Version 3.7 of Reverse: 1999, which includes:
• New characters: Rhiannon, Ms. Stranger, Coppélia and Silverwing Eagle
• New Garments for Nautika, Coppélia, Charon, Fatutu, Spathodea, 37 and Name Day
• New main story chapter: On Another's Sorrow
• New Anecdote for Silverwing Eagle
• …and more!

title: Altus Chess: Archaic Beginnings
description: Classical chess plays one move at a time. Altus plays in resonance. Link pieces through quantum-inspired entanglement and trigger cascading resonance reactions across the board. A premium single-player chess experience that preserves every classical rule while dramatically raising strategic depth.

title: Blink Atomic Music
description: This is a game where you dodge bullet patterns generated from music using movement and Blink (short warp). Each song lasts about 2 minutes, and there are 9 songs in total.

title: MadHouse for Toys
description: Madhouse for Toys is a top-down horror game where an AI-powered plush rabbit tries to escape from a toy asylum. Solve puzzles, hide, or fight against insane toys. The unique 3D horror style and the unusual world make the game unlike anything else.

title: Board Poker
description: A roguelike deckbuilder where you build a board, not just a hand. Drop cards onto the grid and score poker hands across every row, column, and diagonal at once. Stack rule-breaking augments, chain explosive combos, and rake in the gold.

title: Grave New World
description: A tactical Tetris roguelike set in a dark Lovecraftian world. Build a powerful deck of shape cards, outsmart the undead, and master fast-paced runs where every piece can change the battlefield.

title: Shisya Zero
description: A new series launches on the paranormal channel [Tatarium]. Your mission is to examine photos submitted by listeners and speculate on the incidents hidden behind them. But with each examination, inexplicable disturbances creep into the studio.

title: Frogs Aren't Fresh
description: Frogs Aren't Fresh is a cozy, logic puzzle game, where you complete increasingly complex laundry orders! Take your time, and figure out the placement order to make sure everyone gets their clothes the way they like them.

title: Minty Abyss
description:
Minty Abyss is a short and simple single-stage vertical shoot 'em up. Pilot the fighter Mint, blaze a path through the Abyssal Fleet, and don’t let a single enemy escape.

This game is balanced around a no-miss run. Try to clear it without taking a hit, and save a high score! For a more casual experience, you can choose to continue up to 9 times after dying, at the cost of your score.

This project began with the creation of a very basic prototype in October 2024, but 95% of development work occurred across 9 days in January 2025 for TWG’s The Worst Game Jam. This is the first game I’ve developed, and I approached it with the goal of familiarizing myself with Shooting Game Builder.

title: 28 Leicester Square
description: Something has gone wrong at the 28 Leicester Square manor. Danger lurks around every corner. In this horror puzzle game, you will uncover the truth of what happened to this place and reveal secrets that should have stayed hidden. Every man has two sides; let's just hope you help the right one.

title: Mixolydia Fringes
description: Halt its ascension. Explore the lands through death to ascertain the way, they will hide their riches from those who take the trodden path. Be sure to find your way there before too long. Dethrone the Good King.

title: Dig n Fight
description: Dig for treasures, build powerful backpack synergies, and defeat all enemies.

title: Moonleap Maker
description: a level creator for the game Moonleap

title: SkullBall
description: Have you ever wanted to play Quake, but also wanted there to be something a little extra? Meet Skullball, a boomer shooter where the aim of the game is to grab the Skull at the center of the map and take it to the opposing team's goal!

title: Overwatch: Reign of Talon - Season 4: Heroes of Busan
description: Play as our newest Tank Hero, D.Mon, when Season 4: Heroes of Busan launches on Aug 11.

title: Shibogami
description: Shibōgami is a physics-driven 2D platformer prototype built around rope-swinging momentum. Fire your rope, connect to anchor points, and swing and fling yourself through the world in search of food for your big, dog spirit companion.

title: Pink Light
description: In this action RPG, play as a devoted Sister cursed by a demon and stripped of healing magic. Fight through a deadly dungeon with fast-paced sword combat, various gear choices, and relentless traps. Uncover dark secrets before Yarashina City falls.

title: Broken Depths RPG
description:
You are Ari, a treasure hunter seeking riches in the depths.
What you didn't know is that this cave is cursed.
Can you make it to floor 30?

title: Sushi Claw Machine
description: Aim, grab, and blast off! Command a chaotic physics-based crane arm to send sushi flying. Capture wacky dishes like grooving salmon and runaway ginger to complete your guide. Face giant cranes and sushi swarms in this hilarious physics comedy. How will you react to the madness?

title: Mind Parasitic
description: You are a player who has just logged out of the VR MMORPG “NEW World.” Suddenly, your mind is downloaded into a stranger named 周雲成. Luckily, he may help you reclaim your body—but you never expected to be drawn into the first clash of an unprecedented AI security war.

title: The Roach Hotel: Chapter 2
description: Continue the story of The Roach Hotel, descending deep below, where the air grows heavy and the shadows feels alive. Down here, the cockroaches are the least of your concerns… something far worse is waiting to play.

title: Bitiverse
description: Bitiverse is a free persistent browser MMORPG built by solo developer Fortisq. Players explore one shared world, fight monsters, delve into procedural dungeons, gather resources, master crafting skills, trade, join guilds, build homesteads and create personal underground dungeons beneath their estates. It can be played immediately in a browser without creating an account.

title: Isolated Island: After the Flood
description: Survive in a world drowned by disaster. Explore by day, hide by night, fight zombies, scavenge resources, build your shelter, and trade with other factions. Your survival, your strategy.

title: Tide of Lone Stars
description: Tide of Lone Stars is an ADV / AVG with conventional gameplay and unconventional apocalyptic sci-fi narrative. As a disabled girl living outside the walls, Blanka, you will meet a strange man, Adrian. An amazing adventure of “Love, Rebirth and Death” is ready to begin.

title: Chocolate Parade
description: A heavy-weapon battle between the mightiest sweets! "Chocolate Parade" is a crazy roguelike action game where you roll sweets and unleash heavy weapons! Players (solo or co-op) can create their own parade and compete for coins on a boss-rush battlefield!

title: Delivery Survivors
description: Delivery Survivors is a survivor-like action roguelite game. Gather powerful relics and weapons, level up your character, create unique builds and slaughter your way through endless minions and bosses in the dungeon.

title: Death Counter
description: You're a cameraman, filming dead bodies and unseen horrors from the past, and instantly changing what the Death Counter watches in the future.

title: Void Fate
description: Void Fate is a hardcore action Roguelite. Embody a combat avatar in a virtual space to survive wave-based arena battles. Master Perfect Blocks, Perfect Dodges, and Transcendence Mode. Seize Void Cores from fallen foes to craft your ultimate build, and face off against overwhelmingly powerful bosses!

title: Hair Removal Salon Simulator
description: Experience the oddly satisfying world of laser hair removal! Zap through thick beards, manage your customers' pain levels, and build your hairy empire. Will you run a 5-star luxury salon or a house of screams?

title: Galaxy Critter Co.
description: Galaxy Critter Co. is a cute chaotic roguelike where tower defense meets top-down shooting: build by day, fight by night, and craft broken synergies to survive the Swarm.

title: Cheeky Cheerhythm
description: "Wanna crush my pride? No way, you wimp!♡" Coach your proud student Iroha, designed by Asanagi, in this physical rhythm game! No matter your flawless timing, you'll get cheeky banter. Yet, your coaching works: her smooth Live2D animations react in real-time to your rhythm!

title: Gate Breaker: Ascension
description: Killed by the Demon King Riot, Meiky is thrown into the Divine Trials to reclaim his life. Master fast-paced combat with swords, spears, hammers, katanas, dual guns, bows, and multiple magic to survive relentless battles.

title: Demon World: Raya's Way of Life
description: In this turn-based RPG, you play as the mercenary Raya, completing missions with cunning, force, or diplomacy. Benevolent choices may come at a hidden cost, while ruthless ones could end up saving humanity.

title: Kaboom Farm
description: Collect, command, and chaos! Push your Kaboom Chickens to the limit—and prank them even harder. Rake in profits, evolve your team into crazed legends and restore the legendary farm to its former glory!

title: The Missing Threads
description: Erased memories, scattered clues. What will you uncover, and what will you leave buried?As an amnesiac detective, investigate crime scenes with limited focus. You can't analyze everything. Strategically choose your leads to shape the case and reclaim your lost past.

title: Scapegoat & Rational
description: Children vanish in a small town. Investigator Reacher is drawn to a cursed mansion, where members of the rescue team begin to die. Is it a curse — or a killer among them? Scapegoat & Rational blends mystery storytelling, key evidence collection, and escape-style Puzzles.

title: Cybus Adventure
description: After waking up, Cybus finds out that his treasured, super-delicious cosmic fish has been stolen—and to make matters worse, a blizzard has blown a hole in his home’s wall. Join Cybus on his quest to reclaim the cosmic delicacy and see what absurd adventures await him along the way!

title: Savi's Tale: When White Petals Fall Like First Snow
description: Join Savi the cat in the afterlife's 'Good Place' as he prepares a gift for his person. Explore a cozy world, grow along the way, and build friendships with a variety of characters. Run and play, reflect on cherished memories, and discover the meaning of bonds and waiting.

title: Izakaya Izakoza
description: “Izakaya Izakoza” is a deckbuilding roguelike that combines card battles with grid-based strategy. Fully animated, lively characters jump through the battlefield! Live a day that begins with a conversation, flows through food, and ends with a climactic fight.

title: Eldritch Break
description: Vibrant, high-octane 2.5D boomer shooter that smashes together the fast-paced action of classics like Doom and Duke Nukem with the mind-bending, non-Euclidean environments of an eldritch prison.

title: Seeker Tactics
description: Seeker Tactics is a turn-based extraction looter. Players assume the role of a Seeker, exploring dangerous dungeons, seeking powerful artifacts, and ensuring their safe escape.

title: Soon, Only the Ocean
description: A game about climate change and the death of an island. Played out in real time.

title: Shinki Kakusei Valcross
description: "Girls x Mecha" RPG.

title: Gummy Invaders
description: Cute, fierce, and irresistibly addictive, this casual incremental game is pure, zero-stress fun.

title: Slime Slayer: Endless Loot
description: Click to aim, reap souls, enjoy pop-bubble hack-and-slash. An incremental ARPG focused on looting and build crafting. Build unique setups from 20+ classes and 100+ core talents. Change combat rules with hundreds of uniques and Gemword system.

title: Cartel Pilots Wanted
description: Cartel Pilots Wanted is a co-op pilot job sim set in a tropical archipelago controlled by the cartel. Fly smuggling missions with friends, deliver sketchy cargo, and upgrade your aircraft. Master accessible flight physics and explore hidden islands with a chill criminal vibe.

title: The Dead We Knew: Open World Survival
description: Explore a dangerous open world, loot abandoned places, build your shelter, produce food, and manage your resources. Survive alone or in co-op against zombies, hostile humans, and the growing dangers that come with the fog.

title: Paws & Circuits: Reboot Earth
description:
Explovival – not just another survival

Paws & Circuits is a cozy eco-survival game about a wounded raccoon, his drone buddy, and a trash-covered 4×4 km island. Clean up human leftovers, recycle resources, and gather seasonal plants to survive changing weather and four distinct seasons – without loot grind or stress survival.

title: God of Stocks
description: An incremental management game about manipulating the market to get filthy rich. Buy low, sell high, chain absurd combos and earn divine blessings from stock market gods. Will you play it safe or risk everything?

title: Yet Another Incremental Game (But This Time About Coding)
description: Yet Another Incremental Game (But This Time About Coding) is an idle clicker about... coding (thanks, Captain Obvious). Smash your keyboard, spawn code, and discover the questionable joy of programming. No actual skills required.

title: Donald Jump
description: A brutally difficult one-button precision platformer. Leap, dodge, and survive through 50 deadly levels with only 10 lives. Simple controls, punishing design—can you conquer the chaos, or will you rage-quit like the rest?

title: Flying Wizards
description: Fly in the skies with your old magic carpet ! Gather orichalcum and underworld arcanes to fuel your powers and purge Atlantis of rampaging monsters and mad sorcerers. A first shooter with a hint of strategy.

title: Caduca
description: Lead the last of the faithful in this tactical roguelike adventure through a ruined world and into the gates of hell. Master deep elemental combat in a game where abilities have meaningful upgrades, items have surprising combinations, and every run demands new strategies.

title: Space Memory TDG
description: Dive into 'Space Memory TDG,' an action-packed memory game set in space. Match pairs, master turret mode, disrupt UFO activities, and collect points through speed and strategy.

title: Soldier Blaster
description:
Soldier Blaster is a retro-inspired vertical-scrolling shooter built around strategic shot switching and the bullet-absorbing “Force” system.
Rotate the Force to block enemy attacks, absorb bullets to charge your Burst gauge, and unleash a high-powered mode that boosts your firing rate and scoring potential.

title: Love-Colored Memories
description:
Love-Colored Memories is a Touhou Project dating sim where Marisa suddenly realizes she's completely forgotten about Valentine's Day!

With White Day fast approaching, she'll have just a few weeks to train her stats, manage her daily schedule, and win the hearts of Gensokyo's unforgettable girls before time runs out.

Every choice matters as you balance self-improvement, explore familiar locations, and go on perfect dates, leading to unique romantic routes and multiple endings.

Whether your love story blossoms or crashes and burns, one thing's for sure: White Day waits for no witch!

This game was made in three weeks for Touhou Pride Game Jam 8!

title: Knytt Classic
description: Celebrate the 20th anniversary of the indie freeware classic, rebuilt for modern machines! Explore a maze-like planet as the Knytt, a peaceful being abducted by aliens, find your missing ship parts, and get back home in this zen-like atmospheric platformer.

title: My Own Hero Party
description: A party-building casual incremental game where every expedition is a race against your stamina. Recruit allies, clear room-based dungeons, gather gold, and grow a custom upgrade tree after being kicked out of the hero party.

title: Crafting in Berxley
description: Craft, trade and grow your business in the charming kingdom of Berxley. Test your crafting skills using more than 180 blueprints and 250 items. Buy properties and storage to bring more items into each level or sell them for profit in the world economy. Become the master craftsman the kingdom needs

title: Self Deleted
description: In a cyberpunk city, debts are paid with memories. You have 30 minutes to choose what to erase — love, friendship, or yourself. An interactive story with 7 endings about identity, survival, and the price of memory.

title: Memory Train
description: Train your memory in this puzzle game. Several numbers appear in front of you, which you need to remember and press in the same sequence.

title: NASCAR 26
description: The official game of NASCAR is back and better than ever with NASCAR 26! Battle your way through all four NASCAR National Series in Career, Quick Race, Championship, Multiplayer, or our all new mode featuring The Chase!

title: Against the Light
description: A mysterious encounter turns into something far deeper. In a futuristic world where emotions and truth intertwine, your choices will shape a fragile bond… and uncover what lies beyond the light.

title: Escape from Vacov
description: A deceptive 2D platformer where the system wants you banned. Fake floors, vanishing platforms, and traps that wait for one wrong jump. Run. Jump. Trust nothing. Escape Vacov before it locks you out.

title: Fur and Fangs
description: A fast-paced action roguelike where players defend their homeland against endless waves of invading mice—solo or with up to 4 players.

title: Crazy Bike
description: Race through the chaotic streets of New York in Crazy Bike, a modern reimagining of the arcade classic Crazy Courier. Deliver packages at breakneck speed, dodge traffic, pull off insane stunts, and master the art of urban biking in a fast-paced open city playground.

title: Super Clown Puzzles
description: New Super clown platformer where super clown need solve puzzles, avoid traps and collect stars

title: Neon Drift Ultra
description: Neon Drift Ultra is an adrenaline racing arcade game in which the soul of the classic Soviet car industry meets the dazzling aesthetics of webpunk

title: The Mall Explodes!
description: The Mall Explodes! is a visual novel about a security guard with only a few minutes to stop a bomb from exploding in a shopping mall. Figure out who the bomber is and stop them before it's too late!

title: Cryptogram
description: Cryptogram is a multiplayer substitution-cipher puzzle game: every puzzle hides a quote, a line, or a saying behind a scrambled alphabet, and it's up to you to crack the code one letter at a time. Solve alone at your own pace, or open a lobby and work the same puzzle with friends in real time — everyone sees the board update live as guesses land, hints get spent, and the last letters click into place.

title: Encroacher: Snakes
description: A snake-tossing cryptic adventure. Visuals that remind you of schooltime spent in computer lab. The snakes will not tolerate failure.

title: Bright Sky: The Watch of the Future
description: The Watch of the Future is a retro Adventure Game(AVG/ADV) & Love Education Game(EDU/SIM).

title: Warp Rush
description: Warp Rush - A frantic arcade game where your spaceship hurtles through an endless tunnel woven from colorful fabric scraps!

title: Gravity Knight
description: Gravity Knight is a 3D, third-person puzzle platforming game that requires you to manipulate gravity and complete various puzzle rooms to escape the dungeon!

title: Craftica
description: Craftica is an elegant block-based sandbox game with ultra high degrees of freedom for creative building. Here you can build smooth and beautiful architectures, or construct advanced devices and machineries such as computers, vehicles and robots. Try it out and start exploring your imaginations!

title: Voxelantis
description: Voxelantis is a sandbox building and survival game set in a flat or spherical voxel world. Build anything out of your imagination, or adventure into uncharted territories to fight dangerous creatures. You can and deserve to have a small home planet of your own.

title: Rifle Range
description: This game is a game that can only shoot rifle range targets. No Enemy, No skill tree, No Level. May be training for your aim. There is a score ranking so you can see who earned the most points. Look at the sample video for details.

title: Case of 1980
description: A sudden call from your grandfather pulls you back to the family farm. As Nathan, you arrive expecting a routine visit, only to stumble upon a horrifying reality tied to a 1980 crime. Trapped and isolated, you must face the entities lurking in the shadows and survive the night.

title: Anything but a Gun
description: A roguelite first-person shooter set in a corporate office overrun by AI. Battle through randomized floors using 20 bizarre weapons. Earn achievements, unlock upgrades, and take back everyone's jobs. The only rule? It's Anything but a Gun.

title: Welcome to Desal
description: Welcome to Desal is a short psychological horror experience where an ordinary job slowly turns into something deeply unsettling. Forced to work off your debt, you take on simple café tasks-serving customers, cleaning, and following orders-but something about this place isn’t right.

title: Tower of Scherbenmark
description: A turn-based ASCII roguelike RPG set in the shattered dark-fantasy realm of Scherbenmark. Listen for monsters beyond your sight, survive shifting floors, and follow the echoes left by your missing sister Mara into an ancient rift.

title: HypnoFish Inc.
description: HypnoFish Inc. is a first-person incremental game about working for the world's largest fishing corporation. Hypnotize fish, sell your catch, purchase upgrades, and uncover the mystery of this fishy business!

title: Lawn Order
description: There are 50,000 leaves on this lawn and every one of them is your problem. A first-person leaf blower sim with obsessively real leaf physics and some fun surprises.

title: Aquaculture Simulator
description:
Aquaculture Simulator is a management simulation in which the player operates an indoor recirculating aquaculture facility. Two parallel economies run in the same hall: rainbow trout are raised to weight and sold by the kilogram for thin but predictable margins, while koi are valued by grade based on pattern, colour and body conformation.

A young koi does not reveal its final quality. The game presents a range of possible outcomes that narrows as the fish matures, forcing the player to decide whether an animal is worth feeding for up to two years before its value is known. Fish consume feed daily, so keeping low grade stock erodes profit.

Water chemistry underpins both operations. Oxygen must be held within a corridor, as insufficient levels suffocate fish while excessive levels cause gas bubble disease. Ammonia rises with overfeeding, and a single temperature control separates the two species. Customer orders arrive as email on an in game terminal with a calendar and banking application, and missed pickup dates cost both money and reputation.

title: Scouts Out
description: Scouts Out is a score-driven arcade helicopter shooter built around control, pressure, and survival.

title: Coffee Raccoons
description: Run your intergalactic brewing business as you explore alien worlds in search of rare ingredients. Upgrade your machines, unlock quirky space gear, and journey to distant planets to discover new flavors. Craft irresistible menus and grow your café into a legendary coffee destination among the stars!

title: Crop Empire
description: From seed to empire—plant, harvest, and prosper! Crop Empire blends farming, upgrades, and idle automation, letting you watch your fields flourish while you strategize, unlock talents, and expand into a true agricultural dynasty.

title: F.A.G.E.N.
description: F.A.G.E.N. is a 2–4 player co-op comedy-horror game where every sound you make affects your nose. Run a bizarre restaurant by day, collect the F.A.G.E.N. resources demanded by your boss at night, and try to reach the goals they set before you get fired.

title: Tileshire
description: TileShire is a cozy, crafty minimalist town-builder. Combine tiles to grow a home rich with life.

title: Overbooked
description: In this Roguelike deckbuilder, arrange rooms for eccentric animal guests under overbooking pressure to meet KPIs. Upgrade rooms with furniture, and squeeze in your freeloading Panda Manager at peak capacity.

title: She is...
description:
Sakuragaoka is a hospital in the suburbs. It’s divided into two factions; the president who is head of surgery, and the vice president who is the head of internal medicine.

The black-hearted president is hatching a plot to oust the vice president, who opposes him utterly. Meanwhile the anti-president faction (lead by the vice president) is also aiming to get the president fired by bringing to light his history of embezzling.

Both sides hire private detectives to find each other’s weak points. The anti president faction has hired the protagonist, Amamiya Kotarou, while the president’s faction has hired Niimura Miwa.

Many people have become embroiled in the war between factions; the female doctors, your rival detective, the nurses with their sad pasts, a new patient with a tumultuous relationship with her father… they hurt each other, and the hatred between them grows.

This is a detective adventure game, set in a hospital that grips the very fate of everyone inside.

title: Nineteen: 19
description:
6 teenagers, 3 boys and 3 girls, 19 years old each, and a mature woman offering her help for the daily cooking, are spending one week together in a villa...

Most of them never experienced a first love yet and it's clear some of them are expecting a lot from this opportunity...

As one of the boy you are tempted to either seduce the girl you have a crush on, or protect an innocent girl from the evil lust of a cold hearted comrade... The choice is yours...

title: Town of Tinysville
description: Town of Tinysville is a deck building roguelike set on tiny maps with huge stakes. Strategically place buildings, grow your deck, and master powerful synergies. Enhance your run using unique chance cards, landmarks, and powerful laws that permanently affect your town.

title: Colonus
description: A medieval village-building game about shaping a charming settlement, cultivating the land, and watching a small community flourish.

title: Kaede Doori: Brand New Days Innocent
description: Main character studies at a university and works at a part-time job. It is possible to seek love from heroines of "Days Innocent" who have grown up, or from new girls.

title: Amanatsu Location
description:
You visit a private resort on a southern island.
There, you find several girls enjoying their vacation...
The character creation feature has been revamped!
The feel remains the same, but even more beautiful girls await your encounter!

In addition to normal communication, you can tease them with massages and water guns, and sometimes share intimate moments to deepen your bond with each other.
You can fully enjoy a sweet and stimulating summer!

title: Bus Simulator Offroad
description: A realistic offroad bus driving simulator. Drive heavy buses through mountain trails, jungle paths, and muddy tracks while handling bus duties like refueling, tyre changes, and washing. Features rain and night driving, passenger transport missions, and physics-based handling across diverse terrain.

title: Grounded 2: Into the Abyss
description: Take the plunge into Grounded 2's largest update yet. Explore a vast new pond area, build beneath the surface, unlock new diving gear, battle deadly creatures, and ride the Toe Biter Nymph Buggy as you venture deeper into the park.

title: Daiblos Core
description: Daiblos Core is a chibi-Anime RPG that utilizes turn-based mecha girl combat. The player takes the role of the Captain of an alien exploration project, recruiting mecha girls in an effort to defend humanity from the various extraterrestrial threats.

title: Goblin God
description: In Goblin God, you rule a tribe of chaotic goblins! Build villages, defend against evil humans, and unleash divine powers to shape the world (or cause mayhem). Each island brings new challenges—will you lead your goblins to glory or just enjoy the chaos?

title: Oharion
description:
Oharion is an online MMORPG focused on progression, exploration, competitive PvP, and cooperative battles in a fantasy world shaped by elemental forces and ancient dragons.

Explore a vast open world filled with cities, dungeons, castles, ancient forests, dangerous deserts, and regions controlled by elemental creatures. Develop your character through equipment, skills, attributes, professions, and long-term progression systems.

title: Live Rise!!: 4K Fever
description: The new generation community-driven 4K falling-note rhythm game Live Rise!!: 4K Fever. You will join Mengyu to experience unique rhythm challenges or create your own custom charts to craft your very own rhythm adventure.

title: Mr. "Bargain Expert"
description: Play as an antique shop owner in this incremental idle management game. Buy low and sell high, appraise and acquire valuable antiques, hire employees to automate the business, expand into new branches, build your own antique empire, and collect rare treasures.

title: Bit
description: In Bit, you play as Bit. A little pixel alone in the void. Bit has the urge to climb. Why does he want to climb? Find out with him across 10 unique worlds and help him find his purpose.

title: If Enemy: Smack!
description: Build your party and design their combat logic using If-Then conditions and skill rotations. Watch your tactics unfold in fast, RNG-free auto-battles. If you fall, analyze the enemy, reconfigure your setup, and try again. Solve the puzzle-dungeons and min-max your score!

title: Procession Engine
description: A real-time tug-of-war roguelike deck builder. Your buildings spawn your army. Your cards, blueprints, and imbues decide what that army becomes. Place buildings in your yard, work the belt, and push two lanes until one stronghold falls.

title: Desouled
description: How many times have you wished you could forget and just sleep? Desouled forces you to look at what we avoid seeing: raw, cruel, sometimes inhuman stories. All of them real. In a relentless fight, dodging is your only defense. You can't win. You can only survive.

title: Island Survival: Escape from Paradise
description:
Will you be able to manage this bunch of lazy and good for nothing people?

Island Survival: Escape from Paradise is a casual and strategy 3D game where you will need to help a group of castaways escape from a tropical island. To do this, you must assign them tasks such as gathering water and food or building a boat. The problem is that each one will have their own skills and preferences, so they might refuse to do a task they don't like, or cause an accident trying to do something they're bad at.

It's your job to discover and remember the hobbies and skills of your castaways in order to assign them the most appropriate tasks.

title: Stellar Odyssey
description: A sci-fi space combat game where you pilot customizable ships, fight alone, team up, or challenge other players in free-movement Arena battles, climb leaderboards, and develop your pilot for a growing Persistent Online Universe.

title: Extract Survivors
description: Extraction survivors-like meets deep ARPG Loot. Fight endless hordes across deadly floors, extract, then roll, gamble, and upgrade gear across 10 tiers of modifiers and powerful Uniques to forge a game-breaking build. One life. Permadeath. Infinite loot. How deep can you fall?

title: Arcflame Frontiers
description:
Arcflame Frontiers is a turn-based tactics wargame where positioning, timing, and decisive action determine the outcome of every battle. Command one of three mechanically distinct factions across handcrafted battlefields built for explosive, intelligent combat.

Most tactics games make you wait. Build up resources then play units by spending mana. Arcflame Frontiers doesn't.

title: The Too-Cute Girl Who Moved in Next Door
description: A 3D romance simulation game with point-and-click exploration and interaction with the heroine. The story branches into a pure romance route or a revenge route, leading to multiple endings.

title: Skatebug
description: Skatebug is a finger-mashing board-slamming bailfest where you memorise key combinations to perform tricks for the unemployed.

title: Build a Cat Tower to reach the Fish
description: A short incremental game about building a Cat Tower to reach the Fish. Unlock new cats, each with their own color and special ability. Stack them higher and faster for even tastier fish.

title: Cold Case
description: Enter the burned crime scene and restore 8 cases from the past. The crime scene photos and records have been charred black, but as a cold case investigator, your deduction and forensic skills can reveal what happened. Search by keyword, reconstruct the sequence of events, and uncover the truth.

title: Okugafuchi Shopping Arcade
description: A timid real estate agent is sent to the abandoned Okugafuchi Shopping District to perform a mysterious ritual for redevelopment. But a wandering female ghost and the town’s cursed past stand in the way. As he uncovers old documents and legends, a buried truth begins to surface.

title: Big Market Simulator
description: Build and manage a massive supermarket. Order products, stock shelves, serve customers, and expand your business into the ultimate shopping destination.

title: Kimbap Factory
description: Automate the ultimate Korean kitchen. Route belts, watch ingredients transform, and physically assemble each kimbap roll step by step. Discover new recipes, fulfill requests, and expand your kitchen at your own pace. No pressure, no timers, just a satisfying and unique casual factory experience.

title: G-Diffuser
description: A native PC port of F-Zero X (N64), including 64DD Expansion Kit support.

title: 10 Million Pixels
description: Mine through millions of pixels to find the one golden pixel. A mesmerizing incremental game about exploration and erosion.

title: Fablewood Chronicles
description:
Fablewood Chronicles is an idle strategy game about a civilization of moveable regions that keeps running whether or not you are watching it.

You buy a region and put it somewhere. Every region type reaches a certain distance, so two placed within reach of each other open a road between them. Money cannot improve that road. It improves because people walk it, and a worn road is faster and kinder to the traveller on it. Wear enough of them in and the lines stop being lines: roads bundle into trunks, crossings collapse into junctions, and highways curve between the places your people actually go. Drag the two regions apart and the road between them is lost permanently.

title: Giantess Playground
description: Giantess Playground: Stomp as a towering Giantess or scamper as a tiny citizen in a city based destruction sandbox game. Crush buildings, dodge feet, play hide and seek in a sandbox map with Giantess girls.

title: Escape the House
description: You're locked in your crazy Granny's house. She can hear everything and runs incredibly fast. Hide in closets, be quiet, solve puzzles, and find a way to escape before your days are up. A tense PSX survival horror game where every dropped object can cost you your life.

title: ATC: Tower & Ground
description: ATC: Tower & Ground is an air traffic control simulation where players manage tower and ground operations at real-world airports, currently featuring LEPA (Palma de Mallorca) and LEMH (Menorca). Issue clearances, sequence traffic, and resolve conflicts using realistic ATC procedures, including ILS approaches, go-arounds, and ground taxi routing across authentic airport layouts.

title: B.F.G:Crew
description: Crew a ridiculously massive cannon in co-op. The crew selects the shell, loads it, and aims the cannon by interacting with numerous levers, buttons, and wheels while the spotter identifies ennemies, calculates angles, shares information, and gives orders to the other crewmates.

title: Mini Mart Survivors
description: SHIFT24 is a mysterious convenience store chain. As night deepens, strange customers swarm endlessly. Ramen, snacks, and coffee become weapons. Fight them off, and clues hidden in branches worldwide begin to emerge. Follow the clues and pay down your debt to uncover the truth behind SHIFT24.

title: Miranza Futebol Clube
description: Your team is 3-0 down in the second half and there's nothing you can do. In Miranza FC you're the chairman, not the manager: you sign the cheques, answer to the board, take the heat from the supporters and just watch the match decide whether you keep your job.

title: Worldforge: Construct & Destroy
description: Build, destroy, and experiment in a physics-driven voxel sandbox featuring fully destructible environments, dynamic combat, explosive chain reactions, and creative sandbox gameplay.

title: Forest Curse
description: Forest Curse is an adventure game with RPG elements. A gripping adventure awaits you in a mysterious and dangerous world. Your goal is to survive and escape this cursed place at any cost.

title: Rubble Rampage
description: Embark on a thrilling space adventure on a mysterious planet where you'll become a master marksman with a powerful space cannon!

title: Labyrinth of Anxiety
description: You are trapped in a labyrinth of identical rooms that repeat endlessly. The goal is to find the right door and move forward before anxiety consumes you. Every decision matters... the labyrinth doesn't forgive mistakes.

title: Nori Game
description: A chaotic 1–4 player chest-heist party game. Steal treasure from your friends, hide your loot, build defenses, and race to be the first to secure 5 chests.

title: Sector War
description: Embark on an epic space strategy adventure!

title: Protect the Grimoire
description: Survive, protect, and strike back in Protect the Grimoire! A fast-paced roguelite bullet hell shoot ’em up. Face relentless Dark Wizards and fight your way toward the most powerful grimoires in existence.

title: Flying over the Penguin's Hollow
description: Meet Vinnie, aka "The Trickster." In his dreams, he's a criminal mastermind, the terror of banks and the ladies. In reality, he's the guy who tried to break into a gumball machine, mistaking it for a safe, got his hand stuck, and screamed at it until the cops arrived.

title: Hunt Zombies Together
description: Hunt Zombies Together is a co-op multiplayer FPS survival horror game where you and your friends battle waves of zombies and supernatural enemies inside a cursed mansion. Can be played by 1 to 4 people.

title: CPU Invaders: Cyber Arcade
description: A sequel to the Steam Awards finalist that lets you interact with your desktop while playing, watch YouTube videos, chat with your friends, and more! Cyber Arcade overlays classic arcade games on top of your computer screen as you fight off glitch-born digital parasites.

title: Sin or Suffer
description: Sin or Suffer is a brutal mix of survival-horror and JRPG. Locked in a medieval prison, you awake amidst a cold silence. The guards are gone; inmates and madness own the place. Something terrible lurks underground. But the only way to the truth is down.

title: Royal Flux: The Astral Shadow Plague
description:
A card system built for thinkers

Royal Flux is a turn-based card battle game where both sides place simultaneously — you never know exactly what your opponent is committing until combat resolves. Victory belongs to the player who reads the board, builds the better deck, and understands the kingdom triangle before the damage is done.

This is not a game of whoever draws the rarest card. There are no packs to purchase, no randomised loot, and no pay-to-win shortcuts. Every card in Royal Flux earns its place through strategic composition and the mechanics that govern how kingdoms clash.

title: Scientist and Alchemist
description: Edward Elric meets Alfons Heiderich, the two fall in love.

title: Grand Voyage
description:
Welcome to Grand Voyage - a digital experience where you can wind back the clock to explore and learn about history's most fascinating machines and the people who built and sailed on them, brought to you by the team behind the YouTube channel Oceanliner Designs. Join your friends and step aboard the majestic RMS Empress of Ireland in 1907 at the fully explorable Liverpool Landing Stage, and from there, enjoy a transatlantic voyage packed with minigames, exploration, and exciting surprises. Fine tune the weather and time of day exactly to your liking, kick back with some blackjack or poker, then get the crew together for some fun in Photo Mode! Finally, land at the Port of Quebec to learn about the gateway to Canada as it really was in the early 1900's and follow in the footsteps of thousands of people who started a new life via this historic port.

Players can also choose to experience the ship's harrowing final moments in an optional sinking level which serves to teach about this pivotal moment in history.

More ships and ports to be added in future DLCs including the ill-fated TSMS Lakonia which was lost to a fire at sea in 1964. Her story will include the ports of Southampton and Madeira, offering you a sunny escape amidst an idyllic 1960s setting. Like Empress, players have the choice to also follow Lakonia in her final moments as fire spread through the vessel and spelled her end.

Whether you're out to learn about history, experience a bygone era, or simply have fun at sea with your friends, Grand Voyage promises to be an experience like no other!

title: Minkle's Masks of Mayhem
description: A cosy 2.5D micro management game, situated in a magical fantasy universe. Play as Minkle, and help him arrive safely at his destination by keeping his troublesome masks at bay.

title: Sym Shepherd
description: SYM Shepherd - Sam the German Shepherd is exploring a construction site. Help him perform tasks in this fun & challenging dog simulator.

title: The Lord of the Rings: War in the North - Legacy Edition
description: Step into a darker, grittier Middle-earth. The Lord of the Rings: War in the North - Legacy Edition expands Tolkien’s epic legendarium, delving into the brutal, untold story of Agandaûr, a Black Númenórean and servant of Sauron who has rallied an immense force in the ruins of Fornost.

title: Mystery Phantoms: Ghostly Secrets - Collector's Edition
description: Investigate haunted locations, find hidden objects, solve eerie puzzles, and uncover ghostly secrets as reality begins to crack around you.

title: Modavuj: Forest Camp
description: While exploring the remnants of a forgotten civilization, you realize the forest is far from alone. You must confront the guardians of this dark past and survive.

title: G-Mode Archives+: Tantei Kibukawa Ryousuke Jikentan Vol. 17 - Midoumaru-tei Jiken
description: Kibukawa’s debut case as a detective is finally revealed. Uncover the strange mystery surrounding the Midoumaru Manor!

title: Sector 86
description: Create combo chaos & face the consequences

title: Five Nights at Sonic's 4: Halloween Edition
description: An official epilogue to the Five Nights at Sonic's series, and a reimagining of Five Nights at Sonic's 4! Experience the classic fangame in a new Halloween-themed setting with new characters and mechanics.

title: Night Call: Home
description: Night Call: Home is a short, immersive first-person horror experience. You play as a teenager left home alone. Do your homework, check your phone, cook a meal… but soon, the peaceful night takes a dark turn. Someone's at the door. And it’s not your mom.

title: Attic Antiquities
description: Precious dolls haunted by evil spirits have appeared on your doorstep. Use the tools of the Beaufort Family Workshop to exorcise them and learn why they've come to you.

title: Chief Bubble Officer
description: Chief Bubble Officer is a turn-based number strategy game about dressing up financial reports. Draw number cards and place them into different reports, combine numbers, raise scores, find the best moves under ever-changing rules, and trigger chain bonuses.

title: Unbroken Valor
description: In this dark ink‑wash roguelike card game, build your 3‑person squad. Freely combine Eight‑Gua elements, 12 Blessings, treasures, talismans and mental insights. Fight and grow within endless time loops; every sword swing is a new unknown adventure.

title: Pro Wrestling Tycoon
description: Pro Wrestling Tycoon is a day-by-day wrestling promotion management sim. Book shows, manage contracts and storylines, negotiate network deals, and compete in a living industry of rival companies, news, and backstage drama. Deep modding and Steam Workshop support let you shape the universe.

title: Long Dives
description: Sink a mining outpost into the deep and keep it growing while you're away. Dive through ten depths, automate everything, decode the Archive, and strike covenants with the dark. A layered idle-incremental with 50 achievements, full offline progress, illustrated in pixel-art.

title: Click to Obsolete
description: A satirical incremental clicker game. Play as a corporate tech CEO automating all human labor. Build server infrastructure, allocate compute to AI, manufacture robot armies, and lobby politicians to reduce global employment from 8 billion to zero.

title: Job Simulator: Human Relations
description: The beloved world of Job Simulator is coming to flat-screen PC for the first time! Team up with up to four players to relive ancient human traditions of teamwork, workplace chaos, and questionable promotions in an all-new co-op physics comedy game.

title: Gemmy Gems: A Cozy Shop Sim
description:
Gemmy Gems: A Cozy Shop Sim is a relaxing shop management and crafting game set in a magical world. Run your own jewelry store as you wander to find rough stones, shape and cut them in your warm workshop, and serve magical customers with their own preferences.
With no timers and plenty of calm exploration, you can unlock new biomes at your own pace, gather hidden treasures, and use your earnings to grow your shop and work toward building a sparkling personal museum collection.

title: Blindfold: Sound Chase
description: Blindfold: Sound Chase is an asymmetric online tag game where one blindfolded seeker faces off against several runners. An invisible seeker and runners who are in danger if they make a sound. A simple game of tag turns into a tense psychological battle.

title: Steal & Sell Simulator
description: Steal valuable goods at night and sell them for a profit during the day. Start small, grow your business, and take on bigger, riskier jobs as the police close in. Invest in your shop, unlock new opportunities, and build a more efficient operation with every successful theft.

title: Immortal Chess
description: Chess game with classes, Mana, spells, traps and skills. Build your strategy, disrupt your opponent and compete across platforms in tactical matches. Choose the class that suits best your play style.

title: Breakout Baby
description: Breakout Baby is a blood-pumping, Pac-Man–infused, first-person horror roguelike where you must help a poor baby escape to the surface. Run from creatures, scoop up pellets, and shake your baby to survive.

title: Voidwood
description: Voidwood is a 1-4 player co-op survival horror game, where your voice can save your friends or lead the hunt straight to them. By day, you scavenge an inviting, cursed forest. By night, you survive the hunt. Push your luck, go deeper, and speak carefully. The forest is listening.

title: Sign It
description: Monteririo, a city steeped in violence and vice, welcomes a young examining magistrate. An appointment from the Crown has effectively exiled you to this southern outpost, a thousand leagues from home. Tell me—is there truly a way back to the North for you?

title: Factor Zoo
description: Factor Zoo is a strategy puzzle game blending Sudoku and betting. Pick 5 lucky cells before each round, then solve the board with Sudoku techniques. Revealed numbers form hands—pairs, straights, or five of a kind—to earn multiplier rewards.

title: Diddy Kong Racing: Recompiled
description: DKR-R is a cross-platform static recompilation of Diddy Kong Racing for Windows and Linux.

title: Omerta
description: A narrative card game about respect, survival, and the cost of silence. Manage your money, your health, your reputation, your family. Create your character and lean into your strenghts. Swipe left, swipe right. Every choice leaves a mark.

title: Phantom: Phantom of Inferno - Nitro Archive
description:
A web of swirling conspiracies. A whirlwind of bullets. Amidst it all, a poignant tale of a boy and a girl unfolds...

The neo-noir visual novel Phantom PHANTOM OF INFERNO, originally released in 2000 as Nitroplus's (now NITRO ORIGIN) first title, is now on Steam!
The Steam port is available in three languages: Japanese, English and Simplified Chinese.
*Voiceover is only available in Japanese.

title: Recursudoku
description:
Ever wanted to play Sudoku but found it too predictable?

In Recursudoku, empty cells can hide entire Sudoku puzzles. Solve those inner boards to reveal numbers needed in the puzzle above. Keep diving deeper, uncovering clues, and working your way back up until the main board is complete.

With up to 10 nested layers of puzzles, Recursudoku adds a new twist to the classic Sudoku formula.

title: Greatlandia Election Simulator
description: An election based sim on a fictional map, 'Greatlandia', and your goal is to win with a majority. It is made by ChairMapping, and the coding is assisted by GPT

title: War Pawns
description: Fast-paced WWII turn-based tactics with team-based multiplayer, objective-driven battles, and a built-in map editor to create and share custom battlefields.

title: Prehistoric Adventure
description: The World's greatest adventure is waiting for you. Just step through the entrance gates, and visit an age when the Earth was ruled by giant, exotic beasts. It's not just about prehistoric thrills, though, as modern attractions vie for your attention, including very tall and fast rollercoasters.

title: Mr Trippy
description: You are a humble ice-cream salesperson. Completely legit. No drugs in this van, no sir. You absolutely only sell ice cream and not drugs. If you want drugs, don't come to this truck because this is a legitimate business, thank you very much.

title: Plushy's Playground: Into the Slide
description: Plushy's Playground: Into the Slide is a story-driven analog horror game about exploring a strange playground, solving puzzles, and following hidden clues. They say there is a place on the other side, built by kids for kids, where no one is supposed to grow up. But you're not a kid anymore.

title: Just Anomaly: Hospital
description: 15 floors. One hospital. How careful can you be while shaking with fear?

title: True Nightmare: Diner Loop
description: Immerse yourself in an atmospheric psychological horror with a haunting VHS aesthetic. As a new FBI agent, you become trapped in a looping anomaly inside a secluded roadside cafe. With every room you explore, the nightmare grows, and something relentlessly follows you. Can you escape?

title: Shenmue I & II VR Mod
description: This is a mod by Tensai37 for the Steam version of Shenmue I & II for PC to bring it into virtual reality.

title: The Orphaned House
description:
Step into mystery in The Orphaned House. Explore its rooms, manipulate the environment to solve puzzles, and follow your intuition to uncover every hidden secret in this atmospheric adventure game. Curiosity will be rewarded. The truth must be unlocked. Can you solve the mystery of The Orphaned House?

The Orphaned House is brought to you by Charm Games, the award-winning studio behind the groundbreaking worlds of FORM and Twilight Path. Curiosity and smarts are key to unravelling the mysteries within its walls. Be intrepid, dig deep, and witness the cascading impact of your visit as the House responds to your presence and actions. This is a world built for the observant eye. Study each room carefully to solve intuitive puzzles woven into the very structure of this beautiful, intricately designed house.

title: Carnivore!
description:
Carnivore! is a fully-animated Horror Comedy adventure!

Featuring cute animal characters as they work, run and KILL to avoid gruesome fates.

Meet cute, mean, stupid 'n' scary characters on your quest. Lovers, Rivals & Monsters that will reap your woolly flesh.
Explore a grim world from the deep foggy fields to the terrifying restaurant industry.
Featuring Fully-Animated in-game cutscenes of cartoon animals living the worst nightmare of their lives.
Can you uncover all of the secrets and achievements?
A story-driven narrative where you control the Sheep's fate... as well as the fate of others.

title: Murder Is Game Over: Final Fright
description: A bite-sized mini-mystery adventure in the spirit of the Murder Is Game Over series!

title: Modular Delight
description:
This Farmer's Delight addon implements a new modular cooking system into the game.
The mod ships with 16 built-in properties, and even at default settings that adds up to thousands of functionally unique meals. But that's just the starting point - like the Origins mod, every part of this system is fully datapack-driven, so anyone can add, remove, or reshape properties without touching a line of code.

title: Curse of the Countess
description: Descend a gothic clocktower dreamscape to escape the curse of time. A short, atmospheric puzzle game that gently blends Sokoban mechanics, bullet-hell traversal, and dark mystery.

title: Province: Suroste
description: Province: Suroste is a handcrafted retro open-world RPG inspired by classic fantasy adventures. Explore a low-fantasy world, investigate a mysterious murder, fight dangerous enemies, trade with merchants, and uncover the secrets of a living world built entirely by a solo developer.

title: Data Duty
description: Congratulations on your new position as Chief Technology Officer of Dubitably Data! Learn about cybersecurity as you survive cyber-based disasters, complete objectives, explore, and interact with the custom 3D office environment! All in a fun little indie game!

title: Mecha Tower Defense
description: A Tower Defense with Build Strategy. Evolve towers. Level characters. Earn Skill points. Fail until you succeed and complete harder and harder difficulties. This isn't your grandma's tower defense. No two runs will ever be the same. Unlock achievements and Unleash your power!

title: Joe Terror
description:
Donald Jr goes to the playground with his mom to meet his friends. They have a great time playing together, but during a break to go to the restroom, something strange happens. When he comes back, he can't find anyone. Everyone has disappeared, leaving behind only silence.

Oh, I almost forgot to mention, there’s one other presence left: JOE and his prisoner ball, HUNTER. The playground has transformed into a mysterious and eerie place, and it's up to Donald Jr to navigate through various challenges, solve puzzles, and uncover clues to figure out what happened.

Will you help Donald Jr bring back the joy and laughter to the playground, or will the silence remain forever?

title: Autobahn Police Simulator 4
description: Experience daily police duty on Germany's Autobahn like never before and keep the peace in a living open world. From traffic stops to high-speed pursuits: every call is yours to answer.

title: Traks
description: Race, Build, Customize, Share! Physics based racing game featuring diverse tracks, extensive car customization, and a powerful intuitive block-based track editor with simple text-message sharing. Race solo against bots, compete online, or build and share your own tracks with friends!

title: Huntervania
description: Huntervania is a fast-paced action roguelike inspired by the chaotic intensity of Vampire Survivors and Brotato. Face relentless hordes, develop your character, and become an unstoppable hunter—or fall in the attempt.

title: DarkPurple
description: Dark Purple is a strategic roguelike Deckbuilder Game wrapped in a vibrant anime art style, where every decision shapes your run and no two cards play quite the same. Build a powerful deck, face challenging enemies and see how far you can push.

title: Ignite the Depths
description: Ignite the Depths is a cooperative hack-and-slash dungeon crawler set across three hand-crafted dimensions. Venture into the Abyss alone or form a party of up to four players to battle monstrous creatures, solve environmental puzzles, and forge wildly different builds.

title: Phantom Blade Zero: Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
The Digital Deluxe Edition includes:
- Phantom Blade Zero
- Deluxe Edition Exclusive Outfit: Wulin Legend
- Deluxe Edition Exclusive Outfit: Blood-Steel Form
- Digital Artbook
- Digital Soundtrack (OST)

title: 2 Étoiles sont nées
description:
2 Étoiles sont nées is a 3D cooperative adventure game in which two children explore worlds shaped by emotions while searching for their missing parents. Each world introduces its own rules, puzzles and environmental constraints, requiring the characters to cooperate and understand how that emotion affects the world.

Players can reverse gravity through the Inverted State, allowing them to walk on ceilings while transforming environmental elements, hazards, accessible paths, gameplay rules and music. The game can be played in local cooperative multiplayer or solo with an AI-controlled companion.

title: WW2 Rebuilder: Remagen and Caen
description:
Prepare for the biggest challenge in WW2 Rebuilder!
The Remagen and Caen DLC brings you two spectacular locations, filled with dramatic history and unique reconstruction tasks.

Remagen – where a single bridge changed the course of the war.
Caen – the heart of Normandy, rebuilt from the ground up after devastating battles.

Enter shattered cities, clear the ruins, restore key structures, and bring life back to places once swallowed by destruction. Each mission brings new tools, new mechanics, fresh challenges, and surprising details that make every brick count.

Two cities. Two stories. One mission:
build the future on the ashes of the past.

Discover new areas, meet the locals, and make decisions that shape the post-war world. This DLC is the perfect reason to return to WW2 Rebuilder and experience it on a whole new scale.

Restore the glory of Remagen and Caen — and prove that hope can be rebuilt even after the darkest times.

title: Super Clown Obstacles
description: New super clown adventure game where mission is avoid traps and rotating objects and find Crown in different levels

title: Five Feet
description: Early Access — A solo-developed 5v5 futsal game with retro style, power-ups, and chaotic FFA modes. No rules. No refs. Just goals.

title: Gutz
description: Gutz is a hyper-violent, high-speed FPS. Kill faster, score higher.

title: Worm in Ruins
description: Second part of worm adventures and walking simulation and survival game as player worm and mission to find stars and avoid traps in this third person game in ruined land

title: Super Idle Poop Clicker
description: A goofy idle clicker about clicking poop and collecting farts, buying upgrades, and watching numbers get absolutely out of control.

title: 100 Dragon Cats
description: Join the cutest adventure in cat-filled, themed locations! Explore charming, hand-drawn illustrations of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. ️‍Can you find them all? ️‍

title: 100 Music Cats
description: Join the cutest adventure in cat-filled, themed locations! Explore charming, hand-drawn illustrations of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. ️‍ Can you find them all? ️

title: Three Doors
description: Three Doors is a simple yet addictive game of chance! Choose one of three doors: if you're lucky, you'll advance; if you're unlucky, the game will start over. Make your choice and discover what awaits you!

title: 100 Swamp Cats
description: Join the cutest adventure in cat-filled, themed locations! Explore charming, hand-drawn illustrations of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. ️‍ Can you find them all? ️‍

title: 100 Toy Cats
description: Join the cutest adventure in cat-filled, themed locations! Explore charming, hand-drawn illustrations of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. ️‍Can you find them all? ️‍

title: Dead Broke
description: Dead Broke is a frenetic action-arena roguelite with a twist: there is no health bar. There is only your money, draining away with every shot and every hit. Manage your finances while dodging hordes of debtors, bosses that attack your wallet, and a casino that never wants to let you leave.

title: Cozy Banker
description: The bank is drowning in cash. Sort eight currencies, organize over 30,000 banknotes, fill 34 safe-deposit boxes, and turn financial chaos into cozy order.

title: Let's Tidy Up!: Treasure
description: Let's Tidy Up! : Treasure is a cozy organizing simulator about tidying up a Dwarf treasure room after a particularly lucrative year. Complete full shelves to unlock skills and abilities. Sort, stack and shelve 8,888 unique items as you slowly unravel the secrets beneath...

title: Game Shop Panic
description: No magic, no skills, no cooldowns. The only things that can clean up this messy store are your own two hands. Pick up retro game cartridges spanning three generations—8-bit, 16-bit, and 32-bit—stacked high on the floor, one by one, and place them manually onto the shelves of the correct genre.

title: Konbini Cleanup
description: Konbini Cleanup is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort 2,928 products in a messy konbini. Clean, learn abilities, and restore order in a calm and atmospheric environment.

title: Witch Cabin Cleanup
description: Witch's Cabin Cleanup is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort 5,313 curios in a cluttered witch's cabin. Clean, learn spells, and restore order in a calm and atmospheric environment.

title: Black Friday Janitor: Clean the Whole Mall
description: Black Friday Janitor is a organization game that hands you the biggest clean up job of the year. Tens of thousands of items: misplaced products to return to their correct spots, rubbish to collect and dirt to tidy up. Don't expect to finish it all in one go!

title: Storehand
description: Storehand is a cozy stocking game about organizing 6,298 grocery items across 14 aisles and shaping your own store layout. Map custom aisles, unlock helpful abilities, and enjoy free‑placement mode as you relax and build the perfect shop of your dreams.

title: Bubsy 4D: The Black Hole Update
description: The Black Hole Update (Version 1.2) is a free content update that adds 15 new levels to Bubsy 4D, as well as new outfits and time trial medals.

title: Wardogs: Supporter Edition
description:
Wardogs: Supporter Edition includes the base game and the Supporter Pack, a collection of cosmetic items for Wardogs.

The Supporter Pack includes the Valkyra A-91 Rifle camo, Lonestar Bushmaster camo, Manticore KH-2002 camo, Littlebird Helicopter "Taxi" camo, a supporter scoreboard icon, a grenade bobblehead, and a helmet bobblehead.

title: Remaining Grace
description:
From the lead designer of Dreamfall Chapters and Draugen, Remaining Grace is an intimate non-linear ghost story about chosen family, human connections, and the mosaic of quiet moments that bind them.

Move through the world as Grace's wandering spirit. Enter her loved ones through the happenstance of human touch. Inhabit their perspectives across three time periods, weaving a bigger picture between private worlds to explore a multi-layered tale only the dead could tell. Witness a beautiful web of complex relationships before they too disappear forever.

title: Z-Sector
description: Z-Sector is an intense zombie wave shooter. Push back endless hordes, get tactical upgrades, and rule global leaderboards. How many waves will you survive? Master your arsenal and become the ultimate survivor!

title: MareDare 2: The Daring Sequel
description: It's time for another dare with Merry Berry, the berry loving mare! This time, she's been given a dare by the spike loving mare, Pokey! She must collect all the berries while dodging all the spikes in all 4 levels to finish the dare in this heart pumping 3d platformer!

title: Keeb Quest: Typing Battles
description: Keeb Quest turns typing practice into an adventure. No equipment to grind, no rotations to memorize, no stats to manage besides the ones that matter: your speed and your accuracy. Battle enemies and bosses, explore branching stories, and watch yourself get faster and more accurate with every run.

title: Mega Man X Recompiled
description: A static recompilation of Mega Man X (SNES) into native C.

title: Mega Man X4: Recompiled
description: Mega Man X4: Recompiled is a cross-platform static recompilation of Mega Man X4 for Windows and Linux.

title: Mega Man X5: Recompiled
description: Mega Man X5: Recompiled is a cross-platform static recompilation of Mega Man X5 for Windows and Linux.

title: Kesu-Ji
description: Kesu-Ji is a game featuring 6 modes centered around various "merge" mechanics. (Puzzle Mode、Action Mode 、Shooting Mode) You can aim for high scores on the online leaderboards in each mode and earn rewards. Enjoy a satisfying merging experience set in a chill, relaxing atmosphere!

title: Night of Restoration
description: Night of Restoration is a short horror game with 1 ending and 2 possible deaths.

title: RavenQuest: Treasures Below
description:
Treasures Below is a major expansion for the MMORPG RavenQuest, introducing new competitive ladders, deep progression systems, and challenging PvE content.

At the core of the expansion is the "Expeditions" system, a highly replayable roguelike dungeon mode where players navigate unpredictable encounters, manage debilitating Afflictions, and utilize powerful buffs called Songs to survive.

The update also heavily expands competitive play, launching Season 1 of the Ranked Arena alongside specialized, time-limited leaderboards tailored to specific playstyles like sharpshooting (Ballistics) and resource mastery (Naturalist). To support these new challenges, Treasures Below revamps character progression with advanced gear upgrade mechanics, including Warforging, Infusion, and Augmenting, a new Gemstone progression track, and quality-of-life enhancements like "Mass Collect" for streamlined harvesting.

title: Mancalero
description: Mancalero is the ancient strategy board game of Mancala, rebuilt as a roguelike deckbuilder. Collect special marbles, stack blessings, discover synergies, and break every table with increasing scores.

title: Fuyukuru.: Winter winds, adieu?
description: A “denpa” visual novel about a grisly murder in a sealed institution for immortal girls. Wool needle, knitting needle, sewing machine needle. Silk needle, stitching needle, injection needle. Futon needle, clothing needle, hook for a fish. Follow the needles to your immortal death.

title: Rebirth TD
description: Defend a dying world and bring it back to life as you play. Grow spirit trees to defeat enemies, releasing energy that spreads across the land, restoring the forest in real time as you push back a world-consuming blight.

title: Project Zarya
description: Project Zarya is an open-world adventure set in post-apocalyptic Russia, where every day is a fight for survival. Explore, gather resources, build shelters, craft equipment, and battle the infected alone or with friends.

title: Dearest Lucy
description: On your way home during a storm, you got kidnapped and told to take part in a totally real ritual!

title: Soul & Brittle
description: A woman looks for a significant other in the worst possible situation.

title: Abu Khammas
description:
An Arabic super Mario fan rage platformer game.

Abu Khammas is looking for his lost wife in this very familiar land. He has to beat all levels to rescue her.

title: Launch Them All
description: A high-stakes turn-based missile duel where every shot matters. Spy, bluff, and deploy powerful tactical abilities to destroy enemy military assets while avoiding civilian casualties. Casual strategy in an approachable, classic style!

title: Evil Moon: Unspoken
description: Boomer shooter metroidvania. Nun with a gun. Because of the Malediction of the Moon, only devoted sisters with vows of silence can move freely in the city of Abbadox. So take up arms, Siléncia, and blast your way through these cobbled and winding streets!

title: 2x2
description: 2x2 is an MBF21 community project hosted by brendondle, and is the sequel to 1x1! Once again, the concept is very simple: the maps only use 2 textures and 2 flats, with the exception of a single switch texture and F_SKY (which was only allowed to be used if a texture was transferred to it!). Double the textures, double the flats, and double the fun! The wad features 24 mbf21-compatible maps made by various authors. The difficulty curve is as steep as a mountain, though difficulty settings are implemented and HMP or HNTR are strongly recommended for first playthroughs. Additionally, many of the maps, especially the later ones, get really long. It is absolutely not recommended to marathon this wad, unless you intentionally want to burn yourself out. Maps are ordered very roughly by difficulty. Pistol starts are intended but we won't put a gun to your head.

title: Slots & Skulls
description: A turn-based roguelite built on a slot machine. Spin to attack, open chests for new symbols, strike deals with cats, and risk your symbols at the anvil.

title: Sekai de Ichiban Dame na Koi
The Descent of King Hesper
description: A monumental DROD community hold containing hundreds of turn-based roach-slaying conundrums. The culmination of ten years of work by a team of 45 architects, testers, writers, spriters and programmers.

title: High Roller Penny
description: A bold pachinko-inspired roguelike. With bunny girls. Build your best pegboard with special pegs, balls and passive effects to reach legendary scores. Lose and get executed on the spot. Oh did we mention this is a death game?

title: Stickman Adventure
description: A 2D stickman platformer where players control a stickman to dodge traps and obstacles along the way to reach the checkpoint.

title: Zentris
description: Zentris is inspired by the classic 1988 falling blocks game, with modern controls and settings to make it more enjoyable today! Built with difficulty settings for a range of play from classic difficulty to full relaxation. 26 different tracks with built in music effect that immerse you in the game!

title: My Tiny Grocery Store
description: My Tiny Grocery Store is an idle shopping simulator located in the bottom right corner of your screen that allows you to manage your store while also completing other tasks! Design your store, arrange your shelves, and enjoy earning money.

title: Retro Sci-Fi Adventure
description: Retro Sci-Fi Adventure is a short 3D action game with simple controls.

title: Food Store Simulator
description: Run your own food store! Buy products, stock shelves, serve customers, and expand your shop into a bigger business.

title: Nekobyte
description: Nekobyte is a retro-styled sidescrolling beat-em-up influenced by soulslike gameplay. Beyond the game’s normal mode of play, a randomizer mode is also available to play for players who want an extra challenge or varied subsequent playthroughs.

title: Revenger Origin
description: The retro RPG from the feature phone era, the Revenge Series, is back!

title: Hello, Runa!
description: Wake up "Runa," an AI girl trapped in an old game console for 7 years. Experience a deep connection through dynamic animations and full voice acting for every line. Repair the system and discover the truth in this unique visual novel.

title: Goblin Dish
description: Goblin Dish - A captivating 3D logic puzzle.

title: City Cleaning 2
description: City Cleaning 2 is a sequel to the first part of this meditative adventure, offering you a unique opportunity to escape the hustle and bustle of everyday life and immerse yourself in an atmosphere of peace and harmony.

title: The Faraway King
description: A narrative adventure with exploration and visual novel elements. Join J.D. on a journey through the nation of Yoom to find the mythical figure known as the Faraway King and rid himself of his supposed curse. But should J.D. trust his bizarre companion, Zxtabella?

title: Linwu: Spirit Beast Ranch
description: A Monster Rancher-style monster-raising sim: summon a spirit beast at a shrine, train it week by week through drills, food and rest, take it through tournament cups — and when its time comes, pass its spirit on to the next generation. Raising, not just battling; bond, not just stats.

title: Juvenile Power Fantasy
description:
•Juvenile Power Fantasy is a mod about everything dying super-fast, including you.
•Juvenile Power Fantasy is a gratuitous ZScript playground by a non-programmer who doesn't really know how to use it.
•Juvenile Power Fantasy is a mod where the monsters learned to move not-slow.
•Juvenile Power Fantasy is a tribute to the half-remembered works of Cory Whittle, as viewed through a funhouse mirror.
•Juvenile Power Fantasy is really, really hard. Like, damn.
•Juvenile Power Fantasy is perhaps not entirely serious, ala Reelism.
•Juvenile Power Fantasy is heavily customizable via in-game Mutators.
•Juvenile Power Fantasy is a mod that unerringly punishes you for the slightest mistake.
•Juvenile Power Fantasy is a mod that doesn't mind if you break the map by jumping. Go ahead. Try it!
•Juvenile Power Fantasy contains customizable options for friendly AI companions, ala Marine's Best Friend
•Juvenile Power Fantasy is not winning any awards anytime soon.
•Juvenile Power Fantasy is one of the few mods that actually pays attention to the "Gender" setting in Player Options.
•Juvenile Power Fantasy is a mod.

title: Dead Stop: No Vacancy
description: Dead Stop - No Vacancy is a short first-person horror game set in an isolated roadside motel. Explore the Paradise Motel, uncover its disturbing history, solve environmental puzzles, and survive a night in which something has gone terribly wrong.

title: Half Grip
description: Get hooked on this brutal one-armed rogue-like combat racing game where every action is a gamble. Steer, shoot and reload - each split-second counts as you compete against armed rivals across atmospheric tracks rendered in harsh pixelated detail.

title: Sambird
description: Where roguelite RPG, Souls-like difficulty and slot machines collide: build your party from 8 classes and use their skills to attack! Parry enemy attacks at the right moment to take no damage. Every run is different!

title: G.E.M. Grab & Exit
description: Hand-Drawn Twin-Stick Shooter in space where one must survive the robotic ships onslaught and extract with the loot to exchange for ship upgrades.

title: Moonbringer
description: Moonbringer is a fast-paced action shmup with a skill tree. Kill the waves, stack the loot and upgrade your ship. Unlock a variety of new abilities and become more powerful every run. Shoot, die, upgrade, and dive into space one more time.

title: Ogre Stampede
description: Ogre Stampede is an incremental bullet hell with lots of physics. Tons of stupid trolls and ogres are running wild in a mosh pit. Knock them away with your shield! Be the last one standing.

title: Monster Museum: Tidy Up the Collection!
description: Step into the relaxing world of Monster Museum! Team up with your favorite creature companion and begin your journey to restore the museum by sorting 2614 monster figurines.  Unlock new abilities, collect badges and uncover hidden secrets along the way. Cozy, single player, no timers.

title: Split Second Volley
description: Turn based anime-style sports battles! Create outrageous combos and last minute saves using teamwork and unique skills. You can even use guns! Outsmart your foes, choreograph larger than life moments, and win PvP battles with STYLE!

title: Leviathan: Rhino
description: Live through the final days of an old man in a small village threatened by an approaching giant Leviathan. An existential horror game about inevitability, loneliness, and a man with nowhere to go and no reason to leave.

title: Fantasy Journey
