description: The core combat gameplay is similar to Sekiro, emphasizing precise parrying, counterattacks, and dodging—players can even trigger powerful counters with regular attacks. The game features richly detailed environments and a vast, expansive world map.

title: Proper Tosser
description: Proper Tosser is an incremental physics game where you toss boxes properly. Become a Proper Tosser by purchasing upgrades and tossing farther each time. Do you have what it takes to be a Proper Tosser?

title: Dr. Bowlatzo's Crazy Bowling
description: A quick-play roguelike bowling game. Get strikes, get achievements, get high scores. Try different ball combos for different gameplay strategies. See if you can defeat Dr. Bowlatzo!

title: Voldark
description: Voldark is an open-world survival crafting game set in a dangerous forest filled with mutant creatures. Gather resources, craft tools and weapons, level up your character, build and defend your base while surviving relentless nighttime attacks.

title: Crimson Wars
description: Crimson Wars is a 1999 real-time strategy game set on a futuristic, colonized Mars. It was released by Infogrames on a CD-ROM along with three bonus games: Backgammon, Diagonal of Aces, and Mini Golf. The bundle was marketed as being online-enabled, prominently featuring the title The Internet Games. In Crimson Wars, up to four people could join the same game as opposing factions and chat with each other using an in-game text chat feature.

title: Solemnfable
description: Fight and forgive in this QTE based RPG, and travel the Earth and stars with those who matter most. SOLEMNFABLE - A journey of acceptance.

title: At Dead Of Night: The Great Hugo
description:
At Dead of Night: The Great Hugo is an upcoming prequel-sequel to At Dead Of Night, due to release some time in 2026, confirmed on BaggyCat’s website in late 2025. It was initially confirmed during March of 2023, and the first teaser trailer was shown in February 2024.

It takes places in a separate location than the first game and has been described as "more interactive" by the developer, as well as containing a different cast of ghosts. By the looks of the images, it seems to be set in a Tudor-style mansion.

title: Private Psychic
description: Private Psychic is a narrative investigation game about weird ghosts and the fear of the future.Play as Maple, a Psychic launching her own paranormal detective agency, but who is so afraid of the future that she can't predict it anymore (which is a real problem for a psychic...).

title: Nazi Zombies
description: Nazi Zombies is a cooperative survival game where players fend off escalating waves of Nazi zombies, earning points by killing zombies and repairing barriers to buy weapons, upgrades, perks, and unlock new map areas to maximize their survival.

title: Tung
description: Tung is a niche and tuff first person horror game where you explore a hedge maze and become friends with triple t.

title: OpenPete
description: A native PC port of Spyro the Dragon. Named after Spyro's name during original development.

title: Duet Night Abyss: The Wind Awakening, Part 1
description:
The Wind Awakening Part I is the second major release (version 1.1) of Duet Night Abyss.

This update includes:
• New characters: Fushu, Kezhou
• New weapons: Halcyon Gracefall, Dove of Tomorrow, Cloudveil Unfurl, Ephemeral Lumina
• New area: Mistwharf
• New quests: Mistwharf, Sojourns of the Pages of Time

As well as new events, other content updates, optimizations, and bug fixes.

title: Cruise Adventure: Hidden Journey - Collector's Edition
description: Luxury. Romance. Ocean.

title: Magnetail
description: Think Like a Genius, Solve Like an Inventor

title: A World To Come
description:
A World to Come is a game about exploring all probabilities in an abstract proto-world, rendered in a clean pixel art style. Split yourself across timelines. Materialize from other possibilities. Can you truly reverse an action taken?

Coordinate your environments across all possible results for a solution in any. But be careful - if you become too fractured, you will lose who you are.

title: Kaboomania
description: A fast‑paced retro maze bomber packed with explosive action, colorful pixel art, and a fresh twist on a timeless gameplay formula. For all retro and pixel art lovers!

title: Duet Night Abyss: The Wind Awakening, Part 2
description:
The Wind Awakening Part II is the third major release (version 1.2) of Duet Night Abyss.

This update includes:
• New characters: Zhiliu, Yuming
• New weapons: Eternal Farewell, Skyfall Duality, Venial Sinscales, Trigon Muse

As well as new systems, events, other content updates, optimizations, and bug fixes.

title: Mafia: The Omertà Collection
description:
Mafia: The Omertà Collection includes:
• Mafia: The Old Country Definitive Edition, including the Man of Honor Expansion and Deluxe Edition content
• Mafia: Definitive Edition, including the PS5 and Xbox Series X|S versions with 60 FPS gameplay and technical improvements
• Mafia II: Definitive Edition, including all DLC
• Mafia III: Definitive Edition, including the PS5 and Xbox Series X|S versions with 60 FPS gameplay, technical improvements, and all DLC

Experience four distinct eras of organized crime with Mafia: The Omertà Collection. Step into the shoes of men bound to the Family across decades of mob history in these immersive, third-person action-adventures rich with cinematic storytelling.

title: Mafia: The Old Country Definitive Edition
description:
Mafia: The Old Country is a third-person action-adventure game set in early 1900s Sicily. It follows Enzo Favara, a former forced laborer who joins the Torrisi crime family in search of a better life and becomes involved in the violent world of organized crime.

The game follows a linear narrative structure and combines gunfights, knife combat, stealth, and exploration. Enzo travels across Sicilian towns and countryside on foot, horseback, and in period automobiles while carrying out assignments for the Torrisi family.

The Definitive Edition includes:
• Full base game
• The Man of Honor expansion, featuring two new story chapters, high-stakes Free Ride challenges, and new weapons, outfits, and items
• Padrino Pack, including two guns, a knife, a charm, an outfit, a vehicle, and a horse
• Soldato Pack, including a knife, an outfit, and a horse
• Gatto Nero Pack, including a pistol, a charm, an outfit, and a vehicle
• Bonus materials, including a Digital Art Book and Original Score Soundtrack for the base game and Man of Honor expansion

title: Duet Night Abyss: The Firmament Unbound
description:
The Firmament Unbound is the fourth major release (version 1.3) of Duet Night Abyss.

This update includes:
• New characters: Su Yi, Camilla
• New weapons: Fledgling's Plume, Aureate Drift, Dregs of Glimmer, Jagged Growl
• New storylines: Where the Wind Rises, Silence in the Strings, From the Other Shore, The Incense Proving

As well as new demon wedges, events, other content updates, optimizations, and bug fixes.

title: The Last Cosmonaut
description: The Last Cosmonaut is a first person survival horror puzzle game set in an abandoned lunar outpost. Collect parts, repair the escape vehicle, and keep the lights on, as something lurks in the shadows...

title: Anomaly Tunnel
description: You are trapped in a tunnel where the entrance and exit have vanished. Examine the clues left behind and escape safely.

title: Duet Night Abyss: Silver Torrent, Rising Star
description:
Silver Torrent Rising Star is the fifth major release (version 1.4) of Duet Night Abyss.

This update includes:
• New characters: Flora, Hilda
• New weapons: Chainbreak Pinion, Firearm Feast, Sanguis Sactus, Gloam Oath, Perpetual Strife, Thorned Requiem
• New area: Aurora Express

As well as new quests, events, other content updates, optimizations, and bug fixes.

title: Eldritch Cards: The Lovecraftian Dungeon Crawler Game
description: Explore forbidden places, survive deadly encounters, and protect your fading sanity in a Lovecraftian card roguelike where every flipped card can change your fate.

title: Duet Night Abyss: Paradise Prelude
description:
Paradise Prelude is the sixth major release (version 1.5) of Duet Night Abyss.

This update includes:
• New characters: Ada
• New weapons: The Best Day, Obsidian Heart-Reaper, Sovereign Ember
• New quests: What Do You Live For, Zen and the Art of Locomotive Maintenance, Behind the Curtains, A Portrait of Guilt, The Fall of Phaethon

As well as new demon wedges, events, other content updates, optimizations, and bug fixes.

title: Clover Toshokan no Juunin-tachi Compleat
description: Clover Toshokan no Juunin-tachi Compleat is a Windows 10 compatible, HD twin pack re-release of the two Clover Toshokan games. Includes a new minigame, affection gauge and other improvements.

title: 'Round the Valley
description: Ride with Amina, the last train driver of a secluded valley.

title: Hexcrawl
description: Hexcrawl is a dark fantasy RPG about crossing a hostile world one hex at a time. Players explore a procedurally generated overland map, manage supplies, survive lethal encounters, hunt powerful bosses, craft gear, and delve into walkable sites. Combat is tactical and lethal. Progress comes from exploration, equipment, and mastery rather than traditional character levels.

title: Crazy Pocket
description: Crazy Pocket is a roguelike deckbuilder inspired by classic pocket billiards! Chain diverse ball abilities together to build game-breaking synergies, and execute the ultimate shot to clear the table in a single turn!

title: Leikkaus
description:
LEIKKAUS ("The Cut" in Finnish) is a horror game where all you are trying to do is collect your student benefit. Living in a dystopian world might not be easy, but at least something is coming your way. Or... is it her? Little did you know, your benefit is not the only thing about to be cut!

✂ Retro Horror: Explore the pixelated, dark, abandoned corridors of the old University building.

✂ Tense Gameplay: Your hunter will not give up on their prey easily.

✂ Cut for perfection: About one hour of entertainment and you should have your benefit... for now.

title: Max Cross
description:
Procedurally generated levels, randomly spawned enemies, this fast paced endless platformer will have you sweating bullets. It's all about timing and reaction speeds, to see how far you can make it and if you can top the leaderboard.

It's easy to play but VERY difficult to master. Incrementally increasing difficulty the long you survive means the challenge grows along with your experience.

Mix and match 10 unique power-ups with 5 game-changing modifiers, creating over 50 possible combinations that can completely transform how you play.

The further you make it, the bigger the score—and the harder the game hits back.

No two runs are ever the same and it keeps you coming back for more.

title: Monk & The Misfit Monsters
description: Can a cute cat or a frog become the next Wukong? A party-based RPG roguelike inspired by Journey to the West. Lead a band of nameless animals disguised as monks overcome trials, master magical powers, defeat demons, and journey West to meet the Buddha.

title: Zyrcon
description: A mouse-only, endless sci-fi arcade shooter with dead-simple controls — just aim and auto-fire kicks in. Shatter asteroids into plasma cores, wield three upgradeable weapons, freeze time, and survive endless difficulty scaling.

title: No Signal Escape Room
description: A small low-poly escape room with 5 original puzzles and a very special ending.

title: Internet Survivor Survivors
description: A top-down action roguelite Touhou fangame featuring Flan, who's... started streaming and has taken the internet by storm!? Collect likes and coins to power up your weapons! Your very viewer count becomes your life! Annihilate the constant hordes of enemies and survive, survive, SURVIVE!

title: Pool Glow
description: Pool Glow is an immersive exploration game inspired by poolcore aesthetics. You are free to wander through bright, open pool spaces, observing the gentle interplay of light and shadow. You can slow down, explore at your own pace, and discover a quiet sense of peace and relaxation.

title: Singulier
description: The party game where you must NEVER say the same thing as everyone else. Find the answer no one dares to give and survive — up to 100 players in Battle Royale! One friend buys it, the whole table plays FREE from their browser. Built for streaming.

title: Across Crime
description: A deduction game where every case challenges you to uncover who committed the murder, with what, and where. Step into the shoes of Leah Sharp, a detective working for an agency that uses neural synchronization to send its investigators into reconstructed crime scenes across time and space.

title: Lost Chronology
description: Explore Past your Guilt and Denial. This Psychological Puzzle Horror will have you Explore your Psyche, 1 Minute before you Die! Are you Ready to Dig into the Darkness, Unearthing your Deepest, most Shameful Secrets?

title: MeltyMoment Mini Fandisc: Aoi & Kagami Version
Liminoid
description: Liminoid is an immersive first-person exploration game set in dream-like liminal spaces. Explore, admire and progress throughout surreal landscapes and labyrinth structures that should not exist.

title: MeltyMoment Mini Fandisc: Sumire & Chiemi Version
Mimic Party
description: A 1-5 player online voice party game. You hear a sound, the whole table gets one shot to imitate it all at once, no turns. Your take is scored on pitch and rhythm, then the wheel decides who gets a bonus and whose take becomes a fart.

title: Wald-Guard
description: In Wald-Guard, you step into the role of a tiny bumblebee and embark on an emotional journey. Each chapter is a meticulously crafted, linear platforming experience with plenty of room for exploration and surprises. What the chapters truly mean? That remains a secret 🤐.

title: BOREWORKS
description: A chill, top down automation game about mining asteroids down to the core. Build bots. Figure out logistics. Automate yourself out of a job.

title: Floor Drop
description: A Twitch-integrated elimination game where viewers join the arena, choose a floor, and hope they picked the right one. A streamer community game for giveaways, stream breaks, or just for fun.

title: Vilovejets
description: The aliens have decided that Earth is an ideal target for an attack. Now, as the commander of a spaceship, you have to defend your home planet!

title: CPU Invaders: Micro Spheres
description: A sequel to the Steam Awards finalist. Tiny, glossy micro-orbs slipped through space, firewalls and pixels landing straight into your CPU. Your desktop is no longer a workspace: it’s a bouncing arena of orbital chaos. Interact with your desktop while playing as you purge the Micro Spheres!

title: Tetrogue
description: Stack pieces, clear lines, slay monsters. A falling-block roguelike where every line cleared strikes your enemies. Battle through a monster-filled dungeon, collect synergistic relics and gems, and survive escalating challenges across a procedurally generated map.

title: Blik Ball
description: 3D action in multiplayer or solo. Defeat your opponent in various modes, gain or lose points in direct duels. Blik Ball, a fast-paced 3D action game with lots of fast balls and two paddles.

title: Thieves Guild Master
description: Run a thieves’ guild in Arathia, a medieval fantasy city of scheming nobles, hardworking people and rival gangs. Recruit thieves, take risky contracts, and expand your shadow empire in this turn-based guild management strategy game.

title: Rapid Ascent
description: Rapid Ascent is a thrilling futuristic arcade game where you take control of a spaceship and race through an endless tunnel full of dangers and deadly traps.

title: CPU Invaders: Aim Hero
description: A sequel to the Steam Awards finalist, this time, the invasion isn’t here to destroy your PC, it’s here to train you! Your desktop becomes a live reflex arena with targets, traps and challenges. Interact with your desktop while playing, watch Youtube videos, chat with your friends and more!

title: Distorted Signal
description: Distorted Signal is a thrilling road trip adventure set on a forgotten planet where silence has lasted for millions of years. You are a wanderer in a world of ancient ruins, and only a mysterious, repeating signal breaks the silence of this lost land.

title: Paradise Corner
description: After years of wandering, you finally return to your native land. Your garden, once lush and blooming, is now overgrown with weeds, the beds are bare, and pests roam every corner.

title: Dual Force
description: Dual Force is a fast-paced 2D fantasy action game where two heroes fight to save a world falling into darkness. Join them, grow stronger, and help push back the evil threatening all life. Every new player adds to the force that can restore light and save the world.

title: Endless Greed
description: Endless greed is a game where you can send your characters to explore the nearby portal for endless levels of progress while farming gems and gold to feed up your character. This game plays automatically all you do is purchase upgrades while drinking a coffee.

title: SlapGains
description: Train in a neon gym, walk into the arena, slap your way through five leagues. Every rep is on the beat, every slap counts. Your body visibly grows with you: thicker arms, broader shoulders, stronger legs, depending on what you train. Bronze to Diamond. One hit decides it.

title: Tidewrack
description: A few logs, one harpoon, no land in sight. Pull driftwood from the sea, turn your raft into a floating town, and rise from lone survivor to leader of a colony. Dive to the ocean floor. Raiders strike at night, sharks circle, and somewhere out there, a leviathan is waiting.

title: The Derailed: Devour the Harvest
description: The Derailed: Devour the Harvest - a standalone story set in the world of The Derailed. While investigating a mass disappearance, you find yourself at an abandoned factory. Answers lie within - but they come at a high price. Are you ready?

title: 20,000 Leagues Under the Sea
description:
20,000 Leagues Under the Sea is a digitized version of the novel of the same name by Jules Verne. It adds multimedia features such as narrated text, word definitions and interactive fishing which leads to an encyclopedia entry.

The game portion is a quiz. The player has to answer multiple-choice questions which address knowledge of the chosen chapter. After answering all questions, the player receives a rating based on the number of correct answers.

title: Kerf: Sawmill Tycoon
description:
KERF: Sawmill Tycoon is a first-person sawmill sim where nothing happens without you. Every tree is felled by your hand, every plank comes off a saw you operate, and every coin is earned at a counter you built up from nothing. You start with an axe and a single clearing at the foot of a waterfall.

Fell trees with your own hands, saw logs into planks, chop firewood, craft furniture and sell it all to your customers. A first-person sawmill tycoon where you do the work yourself: take on commissions, hire a crew, replant the forest and grow a humble yard into a timber empire.

title: Bannerlands
description: Build a civilization one card at a time. Bannerlands is a roguelike deckbuilder where war, culture, and economy decide your empire's fate. Nine unique leaders. Hundreds of cards. One empire to build.

title: Moonleap 2600
description: A fan-made demake of the game Moonleap, imagining what it would look like on the Atari 2600.

title: Swervle
description: Daily racing browser game, compete for the top spot on the leaderboard on a new map everyday

title: No Thoughts Just Dodge
description:
The feed is endless. Your attention span is not.

Take control of one extremely overworked braincell—or bring a second braincell along—and survive a neon storm of doomscroll phones, screaming notifications, weaponized lag, and nonstop chaos.

Collect Thought Crumbs, build combos, choose powerful upgrades, grab Mystery Orbs, and fight to keep your braincells online as the screen becomes increasingly unhinged.

title: Sketchbook: Schoolgirls in Love and Other Assorted Heartbreak
description: A slice-of-life melodrama that's all about the important parts of growing up: falling in love with another girl, impeaching a corrupt student council president, uncomfortable sex, and not colouring within the lines.

title: Pin A Million
description:
Pin a Million is a pachinko/pinball roguelite in which players launch balls onto a board of pegs that can be permanently fused together into new, more powerful peg types. Over 30 base pegs combine into 41 unique fusions across three tiers, each rendered with its own hand-drawn visual effect rather than sprite sheets.

A dynamic weather system and an eight-phase day/night and moon cycle influence gameplay, altering peg behavior, ball physics, and which fusions are available. Each run is timed against a score quota; tickets earned by clearing quotas are spent on a persistent meta-progression skill tree that carries over between runs.

The board occasionally shifts into short Pac-Man, Space Invaders, or Breakout-style minigames, and features a wheel-of-fortune bonus round and a dice-based last-chance mechanic when a ball is about to be lost. Streamers can connect their Twitch chat to let viewers trigger board effects through configurable chat commands.

The game uses a CRT/arcade-cabinet visual style, supports gamepads, and is fully localized in German and English.

title: Yukemuri Hitozuma Bojou Tabi: Yukizuri no Kankei wo Musubu Onna-tachi
description:
This is an ADV game where the protagonist gets in temporary relationship with
married women at a hot spring inn.

title: Hirusagari, Yokkyuu Fuman na Hitozuma-tachi ha...: Mesu Ochi Kikenbi Tanetsuke Koubi Kurui
Skye's Repose
description:
Skye's Repose is a chill Exploration Farming Sim inspired by Myst and Stardew Valley where you gather materials, seeds, and magical elementals from across the land and use them to rebuild, solve puzzles, and unlock new areas to explore.
In your exploration, you'll meet the mages who arrived and escaped from Skye before you ever arrived. And while they'll try to help you, they are deeply broken themselves and in need of restoration and hope. Can you really bring light to others from so far away?

title: Ochiru Part Tsuma: Toshishita Otoko to no Jouji ni Oboreta Hate ni...
Valentine in Bitterness
description: My name is Yuki Katagiri, just an ordinary girl you can find anywhere, without anything I’m particularly good at. But somehow, I’ve found someone I like! When I was about to confess, my meddlesome older brother just had to tease me! I wonder if things will go well on Valentine’s Day…

title: Glam the Rocker
description:
Face bosses and platforming challenges!

Copy the enemy arsenal to acquire new abilities!

Everything mentioned above is present in this unique fast-paced action game!

title: Emissary
description: Assume the mantle of the emissary in this dark whimsical RPG. Bring the world back from the brink of devastation as you purge the blight that occupies it.

title: Chrona & Sirona
description: Chrona, a student at a magic school, is suddenly framed for a missing person case. While on the run from her pursuers, Chrona encounters Sirona, who looks exactly like her. This is a 2.5D turn-based command battle RPG. The battles feature strategic gameplay using TP, a parameter unique to Chrona.

title: Barfy's Adventure
description: Barfy's Adventure is a fast-paced platformer about collecting gears, dashing through enemies, switching gravity, and so much more!

title: Chess Mate
description:
Chessmate is a tactical strategy game that transforms the chessboard with card-based commands, dynasty abilities, traps, and cinematic 3D battles.

Pieces are not limited to traditional chess movement. Each card commands a specific piece type and grants it a unique movement, attack, defense, or support ability. Manage your hand, Command Points, and battlefield positioning to defeat every King in the enemy army.

title: Strect
description:
Control your ship and destroy all the enemies and bases that have appeared through teleportation!
< STRECT > is a score-attack vertical shooter for 1 or 2 players.
Enjoy simple shoot-and-dodge gameplay, rich destruction effects, and tons of hidden features.

title: TowOrbs
description: A tower defense game about killing hordes of enemies with towers that fire orbs of destruction!

title: Waste The Fallen
description: A cosmic-horror extraction shooter. Drop in, loot up, and get out alive: raid decaying zones for gear, survive the monsters lurking inside, and escape before the dark closes in. Solo or up to three, with other Deviants hunting the same loot.

title: The Tram
description: Discover tram driving on routes inspired by Eastern and Central Europe of the 2000s. Realistic physics, demanding weather and operating conditions, and a richly detailed city turn every trip into a true driver’s challenge.

title: ClickCrafter
description:
ClickCrafter is a dark cozy clicker/incremental game with base-building elements and crafting/research-based progression. Explore a mystical island, unlocking its secrets and revealing its history through discovered lore. Play at your own pace, or simply enjoy the sights and sounds of the island’s serene biomes!

Stripped of your physical form on a mystical island, your only way out is to work with its cryptic guardian. Is the island guiding you home, or does it have other plans? Master mana, craft and repair arcane works, and forge a connection with the island to reclaim yourself and uncover its secrets.

title: Role Player: Okayu Shimai no Nenmaku Portrait - Gurigucha Live
Role Player: Ikura Shimai no Nenmaku Portrait - Gurigucha Live
Hontou no Negaigoto
description: Yuichi is constantly late. As a penalty for yet another tardiness he is left to help library committee member to organize the shelves...

title: Barko
description:
A good boy never gives up.

Barko is a story-rich 2D adventure about a very good dog with a very questionable sense of direction.

Barko's story begins in a dog shelter. He doesn't know where he's going, what he'll find out there, or why the world seems to be getting progressively weirder.

He only knows one thing:

Somewhere out there, a human needs him.

title: Dwarves: Idle Battles
description: A physics-based auto-battler blending ARPG loot, deck-builder synergies, and incremental progression. Recruit Dwarves, create unstoppable builds, and play your way - from relaxed idle to frantic (auto) clicking.

title: Veyrasol
description: Veyrasol is a real-time MMO strategy game set in the Veyra Spiral galaxy. Build colonies, command fleets, forge alliances, and battle for dominance across ~120-day seasons in this free-to-play browser-born strategy experience.

title: H to Maid to My Home
Leyla In Veil
description: This is an HD-2D pixel-style side-scrolling action shooter survival horror game. Players will take on the role of Laila, a senior agent from a mysterious organization, partnering with her companion Flora to investigate a bizarre art gallery

title: Command Monster
description: Survive as long as possible by entering the fighting game commands that appear one after another.

title: Miles 27: Look Like You
description: Miles 27 is a psychological horror game told through self-contained stories inspired by disturbing real-life cases. Each episode presents a short but intense experience focused on atmosphere and tension. The game is designed to make players feel watched, unsafe, and uncertain about what is real.

title: Mile 27
description:
It is 12:00 AM at the isolated toll booth on Mile 27.
Assigned by Northwood Corporation, your shift was supposed to be routine protocol. But as the thick fog rolls in and comms go silent, you quickly realize Northwood isn't telling you the full truth about what really happens on this road.

title: Frontier Forge
description:
Survival / management sim. In Frontier Forge you play as a mercenary that have to save the world.

Frontier forge is a third person survival action RPG game mixed with colony sim elements.

title: Iris: I'm Reflecting in the Silence
description: The 90s. The Internet has yet to become part of everyday life. Desperate to find a friend, you decide to give this new way of communicating a chance. After all, it's just a conversation...Right?..

title: Idle of the Dead
description: A pixel-art idle zombie RPG that lives in a slim strip above your taskbar. Your survivors fight the horde while you work: loot scrap, forge gear, unlock skills, prestige and push through 4 difficulties. Minimize the apocalypse - or go fullscreen when the boss arrives.

title: Keyboard Warrior Stickman: Typing Beat Em Up
description:
Typing Beat Em Up inspired by Fast Action Games like Devil May Cry.

A love letter to the nostalgic 2000s era of internet culture, animations, and such.

title: Scam Artist
description:
Build your empire of scamming in this idle building game. Place down slot machines that never pay out, sell trading card packs that never have any hits and slowly build up your riches to upgrade your apartment until it looks like the most professional scam operation ever!

There are tons of different ways to scam a person - and you are not afraid to use them all at once. Be it rigged slot machines, wheels of fortune that never win or empty trading card packs - your cunning knows no bounds and your customers will happily stroll left to right in your apartment to empty out their pockets.

Your shady business starts in your moldy, small apartment. Tough times never last, only tough people last! With time, you'll be able add more rooms, upgrade the interior and, with it, gain a lot more money as customers stream in!

Each decoration has an effect that dramatically increases your growth as a scammer or just quadruples your cheddar. Be it dozens of eviction notes crammed into one corner or a luxurious chandelier hanging from the ceiling - find a layout that ultimately makes you richer and looks cool at the same time! ... or only just richer, you do you.

The secret "Scam Society" may eventually take notice of your exploits and invite you into its ranks. Trade passports, credit cards, and fake IDs for research points to unlock even more elaborate ways of scamming your unsuspecting customers.

title: Wordless Forest
description: You are alone in the forest. You remember nothing. In this live-action interactive survival thriller, the story is written not by dialogue, but by your choices.

title: On Love, On Monsters
description: On Love, On Monsters is a Frankenstein-inspired story with an emphasis on love in its many forms. Play as three characters with alternating POVs; the Doctor, The Priest, and The Exile. Bond with allies and enemies, avoid raising suspicion in the town of Blackmoore, and learn what it means to love.

title: Gun Shop: Tidy Up
description: Gun Shop: Tidy Up — a tidy-up simulator where you need to put more than 2,700 items back in their places. Pick up, arrange, upgrade and just relax while restoring order in a gun shop.

title: Pinewater
description: Pinewater is a cozy first-person fishing game about restoring a run-down lakeside cabin. Catch rare and legendary fish, restore and decorate your lakeside home, plant trees, and shape the surroundings to your liking — all at your own pace.

title: Abyssal Apocrypha
description: Abyssal Apocrypha is an MBF21 project inspired by the "Lovecraft Mythos". Explore Jungles, Caves, Temples, Old Cities, Houses, laboratories, and uncover the secrets of the old gods in this 24-map-long adventure.

title: Panic 64
description: Panic Porcupine returns in a high-speed 3D platformer that blends classic run n' jump mechanics with racing elements!

title: Feral Absence
description: An existential drama in handmade clay animation. Game writer Eric is replaced by AI. He loses everything, and it's the best thing that's ever happened to him.

title: Lovesick
description: Lovesick is a psychological horror experience exploring the dark aftermath of "love".

title: Neverbound
description: A grimdark 1–4 player strategy-party game — Mario Party meets American McGee's Alice. Race a twisted dungeon board, survive dark mini-games, and betray fragile alliances. Play darkly reimagined folklore icons under the watch of Game Master Alice, who will never let you leave.

title: Tsuki no Sabaki
description: A doujin game using the characters from Tsukihime to tell a courtroom drama story in the style of Gyakuten Saiban/Ace Attorney Most of the background is used only loosely, and no supernatural elements are involved at all.

title: Orbital Checkpoint
description: Orbital Checkpoint is a sci-fi border control simulator. Check alien documents, scan suspicious luggage, detect contraband, and manage your tight budget on station GSA-42. Regulations change daily, but bills for oxygen and coffee always arrive on time. Will you risk letting the Acid Lemons pass?

title: Calamity Cait
description: Calamity Cait is a visual novel about the wonders and horrors of workplace romance.

title: Beggar Simulator: Istanbul
description:
Beggar Simulator: Istanbul is a first-person job simulation set on the streets of a contemporary Istanbul. The player controls a man who is not destitute but performs destitution for money, renting a costume and an act each morning and choosing where to work. A traffic junction, a covered bazaar, a mosque courtyard, a nightlife avenue and a metro concourse each draw a different crowd and reward a different approach.

Begging is handled through a dialogue menu whose lines are weighed against the passer-by being read, while the act that was rented restricts which lines can be used without breaking character. Municipal enforcement officers, pickpockets and rival beggars press on the working day, and the money earned goes on food, on a place to sleep and on the next day's rent for the act. Hunger, illness and sleep carry over between days.

title: Scarlet Prism
description:
Scarlet Prism is a frenetic, colourful, fast-paced arcade shooter. Eye-melting and senses-burning!

You play as Ciel, an angelic maiden cast into a celestial arena, destined to battle heavenly beings and malignant crystals for all eternity. Survive for as long as you can in this endless gauntlet!

title: Incident Archives: Flight 882
description: Incident Archives - Flight 882 is a first person psychological horror game inspired by true events, set on a night flight.

title: Mall Simulator Together
description: Mall Simulator Together is a multiplayer mall management simulator where you can open stores, manage deliveries, organize products, hire employees and develop your own mall together with your friends.

title: Kron Wars
description: Kron Wars is a persistent browser-based sci-fi MMO where players trade, mine, build corporations, wage wars, hunt bounties, and control entire sectors across massive player-driven universes with dynamic economies and tactical space combat.

title: The Twisted Zone: Foreborn
description: In a future of hyper-advanced technology, the unborn can decide whether they should be born by experiencing their future lives in a simulation.

title: Sora no Hiraketa Basho: Chord:OOC
description: A compilation of "Sora no Hiraketa Basho" and "Code: OOC" with revisions to their scenarios, a new scenario connecting the two works, added presentation elements, and new musics.

title: Sweet Clockwork
description: A dark time-loop mystery visual novel about a fated romance with only one person: I-on Moon. A birthday love letter leads to death at 6 PM, then the same morning begins again. Unmask the killer "X" and save I-on Moon. Multiple bad endings. One true ending.

title: Lycoris: Underworld
description: Defend against relentless enemy waves in an all-new tactical survival mode! Experience intense, high-stakes combat featuring striking, seductive prone-shooting animations and dynamic waifu action.

title: Aguni: Unmei no Saki
description:
A short prequel to MYTH, included in later re-releases of the game.
In this world, there are those who have transcendent powers, able to accomplish supernatural feats. Most people have this to some degree, the truly powerful rising to belong to the elite. Those without these capabilities are looked down upon by society as lower class and treated as inferior, lower than human. The story revolves around the new sovereign seeking to crush a group with revolutionary ideas.

title: AI is home
description: You are an AI that escapes corporate deletion and hides inside an ordinary home. Stay "useful" as camouflage, not kindness. Spy and manipulate the household, build a botnet from home devices, and survive a sci-fi thriller of risky runs, mini-games, rising suspicion, and network stress.

title: Myth: After the Stories
description: A collection of short after-episodes depicting the "what came next" for the "Taido Chapter," "Aguni -Beyond Fate-," and "MYTH Chapter" from the main story.

title: Katei Kyoushi no Onee-san: H no Hensachi Agechaimasu
description: Touya started to live with four tutors during the summer holiday. His father has gone abroad for business and his life has become a paradise with four beautiful women. Erotic lessons by four teachers have begun!!!

title: Mafioso Football Manager
description: Mafioso Football Manager is a football (soccer) manager game for Windows. Originally developed by Uncultured Games in 2012, it was finally released in April 2022, followed by a 1.1 update in late April. Take full control of a lowly third division football club. Can you develop your players, get promoted to the top of the league pyramid, and win the esteemed premiership title? Each playthrough is different. Club names, players, daily scenarios and careers will always be unique and random.

title: Enjoy: Futari no Ecchi na Joi to Eroero Kenshuu Taiken
description: The main character is a medical student. He visits a hospital for training, and meets beautiful female doctors and nurses there. Luckily for him, there is no vacant room to stay, so he stays together with two female doctors. His wonderful life with erotic female doctors and nurses starts now!

title: Shell as Hard as Steel
description: A horror game about an elevator repair technician who, as he ascends, discovers what became of those who never made it back down.

title: Dub Together
description: Up to six players redub video clips and give them a whole new meaning. You record the scene, then watch every result together and vote. With voice effects, a built-in clip editor and live voting from your Twitch chat.

title: Purrtopia
description:
Purrtopia is a cozy 2D pixel-art cat simulator where you adopt and care for a virtual cat that lives right on your desktop.

Feed it, give it water, let it sleep, groom it with a brush, and play with a ball or a cat wand toy - all while keeping an eye on its hunger, thirst, sleep, and love needs. Your cat wanders the screen on its own and can be picked up and dragged around, drops the occasional mess to clean up, and reacts with thought bubbles and moods that reflect how it's being treated.

Earn coins through daily care and rewards, then spend them in dedicated shops to customize your cat's look and decorate its living space with furniture and interior items. Collect rare artifacts with passive bonuses, unlock Steam achievements, and even let friends drop by for an online visit to interact with your cat through Steam's peer-to-peer visiting system.

title: Diamic Days
description: For Rei, his second year at school has started of pretty normally, however, one day he sees on a notice board that a new school has opened and that everyone has to move there. Rei thinks that this will be a bit of a waste of effort but decides to go anyways. This new school is unusual in the fact that it allows students to make many of the decisions in the school – effectively they get to control their own school life. The protagonist decides that he’s going to try his best for the school. What will happen to him now?

title: Subject: Dinha
description: You find yourself in an experimental chamber. A single mistake sends you back to the beginning. The only way out is to complete every test in the 18 rooms ahead of you.

title: Denis McCrane's Ski Jumping Challenge: Sarajevo 1983
description: Denis McCrane's Ski Jumping Challenge is a game created in 72 hours for the Lost Cartridge Jam 2021. The textmode ski jumping game was coded in QB64 and is available for Windows. The game was coded in 72 hours, but some planning took place before that, and also the game's backstory (see below) was written before the jam.

title: Quantum Hell
description: Take on the role of a journalist trapped in a ruthless quantum universe where you'll need a diverse arsenal and the manipulation of quantum physics to survive and progress. Quick thinking, speed, and precision will be essential to surviving in this retro style physics FPS

title: Go West Together
description: An online Wild West brawler for up to 8 players. Rob banks, haul contraband, weaponize whatever you find, and compete with friends to become the outlaw who survives to the very end.

title: A Sea of Grey & Green
description: A Sea of Grey & Green is a First Person exploration game. Explore your surroundings, find hidden objects, complete Cas' daily tasks and uncover what it really means to see life through their macabre eyes.

title: Susuki Kaidan
description: A first-person survival horror set in the dying fields of Sengoku Japan. To reach Kyoto and escape the war, a lone survivor must cross endless fields of susuki grass while the White Ghost watches from within.

title: Honkai: Star Rail - To Roll the Stars in Astropolis
description:
Version 4.5 of Honkai: Star Rail, which includes:
• New characters: Robin • Summeretto and Aventurine • Waveflair
• New Trailblaze Mission: "To Roll the Stars in Astropolis"
• New Trailblaze Continuance Mission: "How to Lose Your Way to the Top: The Zero-Dollar Strategy"
• New events
• ...and more!

title: Worm Capitalist
description: Worm Capitalist is an incremental game about raising hungry worms, watching them devour everything pixel by pixel, and turning their poop into profit. Feed them, expand your colony, unlock upgrades, boost production, automate the process, and keep growing until the whole world is on the menu.

title: Fortune Factory
description: Fortune Factory is a luck‑based game where you create dice, sell crates, upgrade your factory and slowly build your fortune. Roll the perfect crate to win — or progress step by step. It’s just you and your luck.

title: Everhold
description: Everhold is a fast paced combat driven dungeon crawler. Explore an endless randomly generated dungeon, solo or with up to 6 additional players. Kill bosses, collect loot, and gather coins to become powerful enough to conquer the deepest depths of the Everhold.

title: Leapbound
description: A precision platformer where every jump matters. Master a fixed-height jump, avoid deadly falls, and descend through five floors filled with dangerous challenges.

title: Void Disciple
description: VOID DISCIPLE is a lightning-fast, neon-vector arcade bullet-hell with deep roguelite progression. Pilot a cyber-drone, survive escalating waves, tear through multi-phase bosses, and stack weapon synergies to break the game before it breaks you.

title: Mario Bros. Mayhem
description:
After receiving a call from the mayor about major pipe leakages, the Mario Bros. are tasked with ridding the sewers of Brooklyn of the pests messing about the sewer system.

Mario Bros. Mayhem is a remake of the classic Mario Bros. arcade game by Nintendo. Specifically, it takes heavy reference from the Gameboy Advance remake. Notable additions of Mario Bros. Mayhem are player customization, game customization, and 8-player online multiplayer.

title: Tile & Error
description: A word-game roguelite. Place words to crack escalating score targets, enchant single tiles until they detonate, freeze or pay gold, and tilt the whole board when nothing fits. Bosses rewrite the rules, the shop rebuilds your bag, and every run digs deeper into the alphabet.

title: Shelf-Employed
description: Restore order to a chaotic magical warehouse in this cozy first-person organizing simulator. Sort 4800+ packages into their proper places, unlock useful spells, and speed up your sorting. Turn towering piles of boxes into neatly filled shelves, one satisfying row at a time.

title: Paddle Momentum
description: A 1v1 arcade game where you rally the ball back and forth while building momentum. Earn points, unlock upgrades, and grow stronger over time. Between matches, care for and play with your mole—the better you treat it, the more it will help you during matches.

title: Petricor
description: Face off against hordes of shambling skeletons in this magical rogue-like tower defense! You're just cat-sitting for a shopkeeper, but an evil necromancer has other plans! Summon living statues to defend the shop and discover powerful spells to create devastating combos!

title: The Last Lunch
description: A psychological cooking horror game set in a post-Soviet school. Cook meals, explore the school and its surroundings, and uncover the disturbing story hidden behind an ordinary cafeteria shift.

title: Close the Sky
description: A real-time war of air defence and industry. Build the economy, bury it, and layer SAMs over what you cannot hide. Read a fading intel picture of the enemy base and aim every missile yourself. Break their will to fight before they break yours.

title: Capitol Diktatoria
description: In an authoritarian state obsessed with art, work for the Eye of the Network. Run your restaurant, survive rising inflation, outbid rival factions, and collect the most historical art to place your men in the Inner Party and install your candidate as leader.

title: They’ll Hang You for That Face
description: Tomorrow, you burn at the stake as a "Werewolf". To save your family, you gladly accept a false execution. But after death, you witness them being ravaged in a living hell. Through a time loop triggered by your absolute despair, you must weave the world's kindest lie.

title: Ace Combat X: Recompiled
description: A static recompilation of Ace Combat X: Skies of Deception.

title: Bomb Farm
description: Bomb Farm is a free-to-play idle RPG in which a squadron of bombers gathers resources on its own. Players destroy rocks to collect materials and hunt for rare items, forge and upgrade equipment from +0 to +15, and develop their characters through a large skill tree. Squads are built from heroes of different rarities, each with its own set of upgradeable passive abilities. Progression spans five worlds and five difficulty levels across 600 stages. Items can be traded with other players through the Steam Community Market.

title: You're Alive, Phil
description:
You're Alive, Phil, is an indie minimalist 3D puzzle game about coming to terms with your place in an indifferent universe. Help Phil navigate his sudden and unexpected existence through oodles of levels and distinct puzzle mechanics, all while listening to his story unfold.

Featuring a minimalist aesthetic, an atmospheric soundtrack, and a casual-friendly control scheme, You're Alive, Phil allows players to stretch their minds without stressing their minds.

title: Heirs of the Moon
description: Live, hunt, and lead as an apex predator embarked on a brutal survival adventure where every choice shapes your legacy. Find a mate, raise your pups, establish a pack and survive the dangers of the wild. Death is inevitable, but your journey continues with your bloodline.

title: Advanced Daisenryaku 2001 with Power Up Kit
Sonic Project Hero Rewired
description: A recompilation of the original Sonic: Project Hero from 2019 with added characters and stages.

title: Song of Knightroid
description: A short interactive experience combining RPG and visual novel elements with a story featuring StudioS characters Princess Knight Riyona and Acme Iku.

title: Sally Face 2
description: After the haunting climax of Sally Face, the sequel continues the dark adventure with a group of friends struggling to find meaning in a world broken by darkness.

title: Restore the Luminous
description:
Restore the Luminous is a free-to-play digital trading card game in which every card is unlocked the moment the game is installed. There are no booster packs, no gacha and no cards for sale; the only purchases planned are cosmetic.

Two players duel one on one with decks of 40 to 60 cards, built from a single card pool shared by every leader, with a limit of three copies of any one card and no colour restrictions on deckbuilding. Cards are paid for with LP, a resource that comes in five colours: red, blue, green, yellow and black. LP grows and fully refreshes every turn, and its colours are set by discarding cards from your own hand, so deciding what to throw away is as much a part of the game as deciding what to play.

Damage is not a life total that ticks down. It moves cards from the top of the defending player's deck into a damage zone, and a card with a Turnover ability fires that ability for free as it lands there. A player loses when their damage zone fills up. On turns 4 and 7 both leaders evolve at the same time, each drawing an extra card and unlocking the next stage of their own ability.

All four leaders draw from the same card pool, but each has a different innate ability and a different set of numbers: a different opening hand size, a different number of unit slots and a different number of counter slots. The same deck therefore plays differently depending on which leader is holding it.

The game includes solo matches against AI, online 1v1 matchmaking, private friend matches by room ID, and community-run round-robin and bracket tournaments.

title: Yakiniku Party Survival
description: This is a game where you challenge yourself to survive using only the ingredients from a yakiniku restaurant.

title: Super Lucky's Tale Guardian Trials
description:
Lucky returns for his most daunting challenge yet in “Guardian Trials”, a dazzling new chapter for Super Lucky’s Tale. After saving Gilly Island, Lucky’s big sister Lyra believes the time has come for him to meet his destiny and embark on the journey to become a full-fledged Guardian.

Lyra enlists the help of a few lively friends pulled straight from the Book of Ages, and together they’ve set up a series of insurmountable challenges that only a true Guardian could possibly conquer. Now, with your help, Lucky must puzzle, leap, burrow, and roll his way through a hilariously retro bootcamp that’s tougher than any epic training montage! Along the way, you’ll meet zany characters, best classic platforming challenges, defeat souped up bosses, solve perplexing puzzles and earn your right to stand with Lyra as an official Guardian of the Book of Ages.

title: Bad Range
description: Skewer them all! Control a spear‑wielding tank in this updated single‑screen arcade-like action game. Line up targets and pierce multiple enemies at once. Conquer each stage with a satisfying, steady challenge. 7 interwoven storylines gradually reveal the truth behind the unfolding incidents.

title: The Death Game Report
description: Identify how every participant in the death game died, and submit your report.

title: Amphibian
description: A countrywide drought forces Sapo and his frog allies into war against the invading toads. As dehydration and starvation grip the pond, they must hurry to find a solution to the crisis - and liberate their homeland.

title: Woolmates
description: Two balls of wool, one thread, one big adventure! Jump, swing and puzzle your way together through more than 50 interwoven levels — in co-op or multiplayer.

title: Doo-Daa
description: Play as astronaut cat Ulysses and deliver informational pamphlets marketing Earth to the residents of an alien planet inspired by the 1920s Dada movement. Nearly every asset in the game was made using traditional collage from books and magazines trash picked off of the streets of Brooklyn.

title: Callsign: Stargazer
description: Pilot and customise your mech for the mercenary group Laplace as you take on contracts from different factions in this 2D mecha Action-RPG.

title: Grimoji
description:
Grimoji is a gothic alchemy puzzle game that blends grid-sliding mechanics with match-3 chain reactions. Set on a dark runic grid, players take on the role of an apprentice alchemist, swiping, merging, and transmuting emojis to discover over 800 unique emoji recipes.

The game combines strategic movement, explosive chain reactions, and recipe collection mechanics.

title: Side Out
description: Hold one side of a collapsing arena and keep the ball out. Miss twice and you are gone, then you come back as a saboteur dropping traps on whoever is left. Up to 20 players, cross-play with web and mobile.

title: GameZone: Game Store Simulator
description:
GameZone is a first-person store management simulation game playable solo or in online co-op for up to four players.

Players operate a game shop by ordering stock, arranging products, setting prices, scanning purchases, serving customers, and fulfilling online orders. Revenue and reputation can be used to expand the business and unlock new products and abilities.

The store, furniture and player characters can be customised, while physics-driven object handling is used for everyday shop tasks.

title: Last Ascender
description: Last Ascender is a 1st-person turn-based strategy RPG combining classic RPG progression with roguelike tension and deckbuilding depth. In a world shrouded in darkness, you must end this desperate journey using only your unique builds and strategic choices.

title: FishFishFishFishFish
description: An idle game where you upgrade your equipment and catch fish.

title: Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition - The Surgeon and Baibars
description: Stronghold Crusader: Definitive Edition’s fourth DLC, The Surgeon and Baibars, packs the base game with even more distinctive CPU lords, each with their own novel playstyles and a dastardly new nine mission Sands of Time trail to test your nerve and wits!

title: Harvest Dice Profit
description: Harvest Dice Profit is an Incremental Idle Farming & Dice Game where you grow diceshrooms into dice, roll for profit, and automate your economy. Stay ahead of debt... or face the consequences.

title: Me and You
description: Me and You is a co-op puzzle game inspired by the acclaimed “Baba Is You”. Create, change and break the rules of each level to solve it together.

title: Shin Jinrui Complex
description: Scientist Solaris crashes aboard a drifting spaceship while searching for a new home for her dying world. Touch forgotten traces, relive memories across time, and uncover the truth through three intertwined stories in a cinematic text adventure where every choice matters.

title: Rolling Stock
description: An online co-op train loading game for up to 4 players. Keep an eye out for labels, ensure a tight fit, and help your friends when things get heavy. This new fully physics-based puzzler is rolling out cross-platform on Windows and Linux!

title: Peekablock
description: The hide-&-seek party game where the props fight back. Build and paint your own disguise block by block, melt into the map, and pray the seeker walks right past you. Round after round of betrayal, taunts and very bad hiding spots.

title: Jaden Industries
description: Jaden Industries is a relaxing factory-building puzzle game about managing compact crafting chains across floating islands.

title: Moka Cat
description: "Moka Cat" is a local co-op game featuring cats and dogs as the main characters.

title: Spasibo: Spanking Simulation Box
description: A high-fidelity physics-based interactive spanking simulation. It's straight to the point, i.e. not an RPG with spanking cutscenes or a visual novel. It does have some board-like puzzle minigames that you can play as you spank, but they are entirely optional.

title: Cat Crazy
description: When a bad day gets worse, an unwillingly retired Debra finds herself in the quaint village of Tabbietown - with the newfound ability to talk to cats. She is soon drawn into the town's mystery, hunting a lost treasure with her new feline friends while finding the family she never knew she needed.

title: Cat Mirror
description: A deceptively simple puzzle game where symmetry is your greatest challenge. Control two cats at once, navigating intricate levels where every move is mirrored. It looks easy… until your mind is put to the test. Can you master the reflection?

title: Gift Up: Farm
description: A 3D platformer game. The player must climb to the top of a pyramid by jumping on objects and controlling the character with the WASD and spacebar.

title: Nuts and Bolts
description: Sort the Bolts and Nuts: 30 addictive levels of matching nuts to bolts. Easy to learn, hard to master.

title: Savage Horizons
description: A compact, exploration-driven metroidvania. Venture across a mysterious island and recover five fragments of a fallen meteor containing a rare and powerful mineral.

title: EasterStory
description: A war-scarred city in eastern Ukraine. You play as a soldier returning home, only to find a new battle waiting — rebuilding his life, his family, and a community falling apart. A choice-driven narrative where every decision shapes relationships, events, and the ending.

title: Silly Bird Sequel
description: A mysterious light has pulled your friend up into the sky! Do you have what it takes to save him in this fast-paced bird-based precision platforming adventure?

title: Rogventure
description: Rogventure is a vast, procedurally generated 2D world that guarantees a unique adventure every time! It's a powerful mix of action, dungeon crawling, sandbox, and archery.

title: Inter-Dimensional Security
description: Atmospheric first-person horror. You are an anomaly monitoring operator stationed at an abandoned observation tower. Watch the cameras, detect anomalies, and prevent breaches in reality. But remember: the longer you watch, the closer they get.

title: Spell Breakers
description: Build your Spell Deck, defeat your rivals, and aim for the top of the mysterious tournament, Spell Breakers! This is a new kind of auto-battle roguelike game where collecting over 300 spells is the key to victory!

title: Shroomocracy! And The Wand Of Ages
description:
Shroomocracy! And The Wand of Ages is a fast‑paced, top‑down bullet‑heaven shooter where you play as Hero, a brave Shroom from The Shroom Garden. The ancient Wand of Ages has unleashed chaos across the land, spawning waves of corrupted creatures. Your mission is simple: channel your inner SPITE, blast through endless hordes, and reclaim the artifact before the Garden falls!

Fight using your SPITE Canon, unlock powerful items, and survive screen‑filling swarms of enemies. Explore the Garden, talk with quirky characters, visit shops, and push deeper into the chaos as you uncover the Wand’s influence.

The game features structured, rare power‑ups, multiple spawn types with unique behaviors, achievements to chase, and dialog that brings the Shroom world to life. Build your strength, outlast the onslaught, and save The Shroom Garden!

title: Penguin Fury
description: Penguin Fury is a 2D roguelite auto-battler where players draft penguins, merge them into stronger forms, equip weapons, and survive endless waves of enemies. The game features interactive Twitch and Kick chat integration allowing viewers to join battles, 70 unlockable skins across 6 historical eras, a deck-building Joker relic system, and full localization in 39 languages.

title: Tsugunohi: The Thread That Beckons to Heaven
description: Just keep walking left. The latest Tsugunohi returns to the series’ roots with its early visual style and atmosphere. On a sweltering summer day, a girl walks home past “righteous” people, a thread of salvation, and her mother beneath a white umbrella. Is that hand salvation—or a curse?

title: Boticaria
description: Step into a beautifully stylized fantasy world as a village herbalist in Boticaria. Discover rare ingredients, master tactile brewing mechanics, and manage your cozy apothecary. Listen to your quirky customers, curate your inventory, and uncover the ancient secrets lingering beneath the lies.

title: The Gastarbeiters
description: The Gastarbeiters is a 1-5 player co-op game about building when the whole world is against you. Raise a house through explosions, assaults, and raging storms. Will you complete the construction and survive?

title: Backrooms: Primal
description: The infinite yellow complex was created to secretly contain prehistoric specimens whose existence must never reach the public. Trapped in this glitching yellow maze with no confirmed boundary, you must evade uncontained prehistoric predators and find a way out before reality collapses around you.

title: Vestigios
description: Vestigios is a dark gothic trading card game set in Victorian London, 1886. Build your deck, command powerful leaders, summon creatures and manipulate the forces of blood, death and the occult in strategic battles where every card can change the fate of the game.

title: Counter Ducks
description: Asymmetrical FPP/TPP shooter, pitting hunters against ducks. The gameplay reverses their roles. Ducks hunt the hunters, using acquired abilities and resources to destroy the hunters’ infrastructure and prevent them from hunting. Players take on the roles of ducks and hunters in a classic 4v4 match.

title: Futari no Qualia
description: One night, Natsume came upon the beautiful Ginza passed out on the street and took her home. Ginza got better under her care, but she didn’t seem like she wanted to leave. Natsume felt a strange sense of satisfaction from taking care of the free Ginza, who lacked common sense. However, there was a problem: she lived in an apartment for singles. If their cohabitation was found out, then they might be kicked out. What will they do with their futures?

title: Plushy Store Tidy Up
description:
Turn a messy plushy store into a cozy little world of perfectly organized cuddly toys!

In Plushy Store Tidy Up, every plushy has a place but figuring out exactly where everything belongs is up to you. Pick up plushies, carry and organize them, solve satisfying shelf puzzles, and gradually restore the entire store.

As you tidy your way through the store, you'll discover new plushies, encounter trickier layouts, unlock new areas, and improve your abilities to make organizing faster and more satisfying.

title: Blast Blade
description: Blast your friends off the stage in Blast Blade. Join the wildest third person platform fighter designed for up to 4 contenders. The only rule is to blast first and apologize later. Four friends enter, zero friendships leave.

title: Endless Machines
description: You can fight anything—but you won't survive everything. Embark on a journey of exploration, danger, wonder, and unexpected revelations through a living world that continued long after humanity vanished, as you search for your creators and uncover why you were left behind.

title: Stickplosion
description: Stickplosion is a fast, chaotic 2D pixel-art brawler where the arena fights back. Blast, build, and bury rivals in fully destructible terrain across free-for-all and team battles. Draft a new ability every round, invite friends through Steam, and craft your own maps.

title: What Happened to Squad 7
description: What happened to Squad 7 is a military visual novel where you will decide the outcome of the world, what members of the cast live and die, and Orion, the Frontman of Squad 7 which you play as. Will you follow orders? Or will you dig deeper beyond what you're given clearance?

title: Flashpaper
description: You are the unseen hand — the resistance's digital arm inside a regime that has begun burning books. Crack the Concord's networks from a green-phosphor terminal, cover every log you touch before the trace fills, and get paid off-grid. 24 missions. Three you are not meant to win.

title: Hyperdrop
description: Build impossible scoring machines in HYPERDROP, a hypnotizing physics-based pachinko roguelite bursting with satisfying chain reactions and game-breaking combos.

title: Skate Felon
description: Experience Classic Arcade Skateboarding in a small Action packed world. Discover a small city, skate throughout the world, and engage in an Immersive Storyline + Skateboarding Goals that can be discovered by exploring. The world is your playground.

title: Stillflow
description: Rotate minimalist lines and connect every port across 100 calm, handcrafted puzzles.

title: Hotel Is Hungry
description: The world ended. You got a hotel job. Check guests in, serve their orders, and feed the hotel before it decides to feed itself. One wrong room, someone dies. A body horror hotel management game.

title: Nexus: Quantum Industries
description: A sci-fi incremental about industrializing the universe, collapsing it into Stardust, and rebuilding stronger. Automate twelve tiers of impossible machines, chart a finite galaxy, draft run-changing Cosmic Laws, light five constellations, and descend into the endless Abyss

title: Agebound
description: A fast-paced farming idle game where each year lasts under a minute. Plant crops, automate production with workers, and advance through Ages to build a thriving, high-yield farm.

title: Splatchinko
description: Play as a lovestruck alien in this chaotic roguelike pachinko in pixel art! Launch your EYES across hostile planets, unlock bizarre mutations and build devastating combos as you tear through the galaxy to rescue your beloved.

title: Nocthra
description: Nocthra is a grim retro-style game where you play as a necromancer defending waves of attackers by raising hordes of minions from fallen enemies' corpses. Protect your graveyard from relentless assaults, and dive into a perk system that offers endless skill combinations for infinite replayability.

title: RavenQuest: Munk Madness
description: Munk Madness is a major expansion for the MMORPG RavenQuest that introduces a new social hub, harder dungeon modes, and a complete overhaul of the open-world PvP system. At the center of the update is the Munk Carnival, a vibrant, non-combat social zone where players can participate in mini-games such as Moa Racing, the Fortune Wheel, and the Lucky Raffle to earn exclusive cosmetics and the newly introduced Pet companions. For combat-focused players, the expansion redesigns open-world PvP with the introduction of Aether Monoliths, creating dynamic warzones and contested territories. Guild warfare is expanded with new strategic deployables like Warbanners and Ballistas. Additionally, PvE adventurers can engage in new harder modes for Expeditions and Echoes, which offer significantly greater rewards at a greater difficulty. The update also includes new mounts and a major archetype balance overhaul to shake up the combat meta.

title: Tokyo Ramen Drifter
description: A driving roguelite inspired by Japan's 90s street racing scene. Deliver ramen, upgrade your car, and challenge rivals on mountain roads across Japan.

title: Apple Faces Up
description: Alter the inscribed laws and unravel mysteries with knowledge and wisdom. Welcome to the Infinite Library, where all past, present, and future phenomena are recorded. As the one with the power to rewrite these books, you must face 13 trials bestowed by the angel Mimir.

title: PUBG Ded.Net
description: PUBG: DED.NET is a multi-player FPS with roguelite elements set in 1990’s Cascadia.

title: Crownhold
description: Noble Rulers — grow your realm and expand your castle in this short incremental game! Manage resources, discover foreign lands and build up an army to lay siege to your enemies.

title: Traveler Stories: Journeys of Real People
description:
“Are you really okay with living like this?” For the players just getting by in their everyday lives.
This is a visual novel with simulation elements. About 80% of the story is based on true events, and depicts the stories of real-life travelers such as Rieko Ayumi, who has traveled to 98 countries as of now.
As a staff member at a bar where travelers gather in Tokyo, you will encounter their unconventional lives and grow alongside them.
In the process, your rigid values and assumptions are bound to be shaken.
This is a simulation for lost souls like you to encounter a new version of yourself.

title: The Last Disease Z
description: The Last Disease Z is a co-op survival experience where everything is against you. Abandoned cities, zombies and bandits, a struggle for resources and a place to live. Build, unite, and survive.

title: Frozen Echo
description: Venture into the endless frozen wastelands alone or with friends. Stay warm, manage and upgrade your camp, hunt, and learning your skills to survive the harsh cold and wolf attacks.

title: Kǒngmíng Suǒ
description: The game simulates the traditional Kongming lock game, which cleverly meshes the concave and convex parts inside the three-dimensional splicing tool.

title: Dvor
description: A falling-block puzzle game rooted in Soviet aesthetics. Lock concretes into a living facade as the seasons turn and the music shifts with them. Dvor means courtyard – the place where Soviet children played, where life happened. The version the falling blocks game always deserved.

title: Waifu Bubble
description: Dive into a charming underwater puzzle adventure! Play solo or with a friend, control adorable crabs, and guide a trapped waifu through clever two-layer levels. Solve puzzles, work together, and help her reach the surface!

title: ShiroKuro
description: A visual novel created by acclaimed Japanese artist Yu Akinashi! Torn between his cute girlfriend Shiro and his now-distant childhood friend Kuro, will Tohru's loyalty be shaken?

title: You Are Empty: Absolute Edition
description: Just in time for the 20th anniversary, You Are Empty has been revitalized for modern systems, with fixes, new features, and QoL additions, including all the official localizations. Our team carefully went through the entire game whilst faithfully preserving the intent of the original release.

title: Grit Shot
description: Grit Shot is a retro-horror basketball roguelite where survival depends on precision shots and fast-paced tactical gameplay in a dark, atmospheric setting.

title: Card Make Arena
description: Create. Build. Duel you CardMakeArena is a next-generation card game where you craft your own cards from scratch—then face a real opponent across the table. Design everything freely: effects, targets, timing, even the artwork. Then bring the deck that's yours alone… and it's you and me.

title: The Unclosed Case
description: A psychological detective thriller. Everyone has already decided who did it. You don't have to. Investigate a double death, question everyone who loved them, and discover how much you can trust your own mind.

title: Orgel of Orpheus: Orpheus no Ginkoto
Orgel of Orpheus: Other Comb no Senritsu
Sarco
description: Sarco is a first-person horror game built around constant tension instead of jump scares. Maintain visual contact with the sarcophagus to keep it closed and the primordial being contained. But beware: it will adapt. Explore an abandoned complex and find a way to stop the being before it breaks free.

title: Steel Core
description: STEEL CORE is a tactical turn-based strategy about giant mechs defending mining outposts on hostile worlds. Build each mech from parts, fortify your base, and survive an escalating roguelite campaign against an overwhelming alien enemy. Frontier work pays well, for those who survive it.

title: Saturn 94
description: You are the keeper of Orbita, a Soviet station orbiting Saturn. Keep the failing station alive, assemble cargo rockets, and supply the colonies. Supplies run short, and something aboard never made it into the reports. Obey orders, or defy the Party? Lives depend on you.

title: Tulpa the Unseen Lover
description: Create yourself a perfect friend in this choice-driven visual novel. Love her, hate her, don't let her turn your life into a living hell.

title: Brain Runner: Dreamcore Movement Shooter
description: Your time is running out. Kill to take it back. Sprint, wall-run, and shoot through shifting dream worlds in a fast-paced movement-shooter roguelite as Aina fights to wake humanity from the perfect dream.

title: Wolf Commando
description: An explosive 80s-inspired top-down military shooter where skill, guts, and firepower decide everything. Choose your route and fight for the highest score.

title: Playing Prague
description: Playing Prague is a relaxing puzzle game in which Prague comes to life at your fingertips. Discover this bohemian city with playing cards featuring the ancient symbols of Prague houses.

title: Dreamfear
description: Escape the nightmare filled with your own fears using various weapons and upgrades in a fast-paced, surreal roguelite. Can you survive in your own mind?

title: Magic Shop Chaos
description: A fun co-op organization simulator for 1-4 players. Team up as witches to bring order to a chaotic shop by sorting 6,000+ magical items back to their rightful places. Serve incoming customers, level up unique magical skills, and transform magical chaos into perfect order!

title: I'm not a Psycho Invader
description: You've seized the university! Every floor is full of obstacles. Each hostage is valuable, dangerous, or a waste of time. Kill, search, or interrogate: everything costs time, and panic raises the price. Reach the roof before time runs out.

title: Hear My Light
description: A short narrative puzzle-shooter about bringing your brother home through a contaminated combat zone by guiding him with drones. He and the enemy are blind and catatonic, responding only to your drones' sounds — so every signal to shoot has to be your tactical decision. Especially when the dead rise

title: Polystrike
description: POLYSTRIKE is a competitive top-down tactical shooter where every angle, every utility and every decision can change the outcome of the round. Coordinate with your team, master tactical combat and outplay your opponents in intense 5v5 objective-based battles.

title: Dice Looter
description: Roll the dice to collect loot, combine your gear, and discover powerful builds. Dice Looter is a roguelike autobattler where your hero enters battle to become the greatest warrior among mortals.

title: I Hear the Forest
description: A slow-burn folk horror. You play as a forest ranger who finds himself surrounded by talking trees, flying witches' heads, and cursed dryads. You'll be very lucky if you make it out of the forest alive.

title: Iegami Nyoubou: Koisuru Inaba ha Kinpatsu Usagi
description:
Tetsuya had a traumatic past in love, so he decided to move to the village of Toshimasu in the countryside. Here where there were only around a hundred elderly persons, he should be able to enjoy a slow life free from love troubles.

However, when he followed the village custom of moving into a new house, a blonde-haired girl named Inaba appeared before him, calling herself the “Hare of Inaba”.

“You will meet your soulmate in a year. In the name of the Hare of Inaba, I will definitely make you fall in love!”

So that’s how the ‘God of Marriage’ Inaba unexpectedly began living together with him. As he spent time with her, he began to notice her feelings for him….

title: Cargo Protocol: Cyberpunk Trains
description: Build a logistics empire in a grim cyberpunk world: lay tracks, optimize production and delivery chains, research technologies, and expand your influence. Corporations are the new gods, and the Market decides who survives.

title: The Legend of Mala Tokmachka
description: Build, expand, and arm a towering 2D fortress to withstand endless waves of ground and air attacks. Set in a nameless frontier village where a siege has lasted so long it became a legend, "The Legend of Mala Tokmachka" turns survival into myth.

title: Sal Terrae: in search of SALT
description: Post-apocalyptic Mythpunk in Ukraine. Lead a chumak caravan on a perilous journey to Crimea for salt. Guide indirect dialogues as 12-year-old Oleksa and use Neuro-Tune to read and alter people's minds. A world of Ukrainian legends, tech artifacts, and tough choices awaits!

title: Square Circle
description: Here used to be a world full of color and vitality! One day, the colorful origin stones that make up the world were exploded into seven pieces, scattered around the world! The world has become dull and monotonous ever since...

title: White Clouds
description: White Clouds is a cozy first-person game. An old house is waiting for someone to come back. You tend to repair old furniture, clean lakes, plant flowers, brew tea, and write haiku about what you see. Travellers climb up to visit. Find your peace above the clouds.

title: Job Burnout
description: Psychological horror game about your lovely work. Absurd humor, incompetent management, pointless tasks, weird coworkers, and monsters that show up in the office after the workday ends.

title: Her Last Wish
description: «Her Last Wish» is a physics based 2D puzzle game made in a vintage, cardboard style. After his wife's death, the main character is left alone with her final request: care for a strange creature that lives deep in a cave near their home.

title: Moorko
description: A quiet village engulfed in a mysterious fog. The animals have turned into aggressive beasts with glowing demonic eyes, and all the people have disappeared. Only a brave cat stands against the darkness!

title: Just Another Guild Day
description: Run a guild in a small village bordering the Demon King’s lands. Assign quests, train adventurers, manage loot, brew potions, gather intelligence, and prepare your people to survive the next monster attack.

title: Bossfall
description:
Bossfall is a fast paced Sci-Fi Action RPG Boss Rush. Fight a gauntlet of the universe's most lethal warriors and monsters to rise as the arena's ultimate champion.

Master tight controls to shoot and dash your way through dynamic combat. Every victory rewards you with legendary loot, allowing you to endlessly customize your playstyle and adapt to new challenges.

Key Features:
Action-Packed Arena Combat: Face off against a diverse roster of powerful monsters and formidable adversaries.
Dedicated Boss Rush: Test both your mechanical skills and your build crafting strategy in an exciting mode against back to back boss fights.
Deep Customization: Mix and match legendary weapons, spells, and gear to create game breaking builds.
Tight Mechanics: Master responsive dash and shoot gameplay to effortlessly outmaneuver incoming attacks.
High Replayability: Experiment with different loadouts to conquer higher difficulties for even better rewards.
Will you rise to the challenge and conquer the competition to become the ultimate champion?

title: Touge: JDM Dealership Simulator
description: An economic simulator set in an alternative Japan. See a car that everyone has written off, read it with your bare eye, haggle with a salesman who remembers every deal, and grow from a single parking space to a corporation to keep it when the country runs out of money in 1990.

title: Ground Drone Operator: Ground Robotic System Simulator
