description: Co-op combat UGV simulator. One drone - several operators. Configure your ground drone for the mission and split roles between platform, weapon station, and equipment. Run robotic assaults, escorts, supply runs, evacuations and raids behind enemy lines.

title: Radar Line
description: Command a radar-guided air-defense network against drones, cruise missiles, and ballistic threats. Buy intelligence, deploy radars and launchers, manage a limited stock of interceptors, then investigate every breach before the next attack begins.

title: Invasia
description: Invasia is a project for those who miss Sci-Fi horror games, but featuring cutting-edge visuals. You wake up alone to the distant wail of sirens. The bright corridors of the space station are gone, replaced by claustrophobic darkness. Something has gone dreadfully wrong.

title: Party's Over: Backyard Cleanup Simulator
description: A satisfying first-person cleanup sim. Collect trash, cash it in, unlock upgrades and new areas, and piece together what really happened last night.

title: VOID PRIEST
description: You are the Void Priest, bound to an Elder God against your will. Guided only by relics, symbols, and light, solve eldritch mysteries and perform forbidden rituals. Survive long enough to choose whether you stay faithful or betray.

title: Zaibaly
description: Horror-comedy boomer shooter, fantastic reimagining of a real-life experience of living under the constant threat of aerial assault

title: No Signal: Chornobyl
description: No Signal is a strictly online co-op psychological horror game set in the abandoned Chornobyl Exclusion Zone. Explore decaying towns, solve tasks together, and question everything—because you and your partner may not be seeing the same reality.

title: Mischief Moves In
description: Welcome to the laid-back nighttime world of Mischief Moves In. You’re Mischief, a raccoon who has just moved into the neighborhood. Find furniture to decorate your new home. Lend a paw to other animals during your adventure, and don’t worry about causing a little mischief along the way!

title: Hamster and the Village of Sun
description: A relaxing “hamster × sandbox” building game where you restore a quiet mountain peak and build a cozy, sunflower-filled hamster village.

title: My Clinical Death
description:
A novella based on the story of a girl who experienced clinical death.

An experience turned into a fairy tale.

A tragedy that, thank God, has ended well so far.

title: Milo's Tiny Fish Pond
description: Create a vibrant, personal fish pond right on your desktop! Easily raise idle fish, collect cute species, and customize your digital space. Earn continuous rewards even while offline, decorate freely with simple taps and soothing sounds, build your serene desktop oasis effortlessly.

title: Reefling
description: Reefling is a calm desktop aquarium that sits in the corner of your screen. Feed your fish with a click, earn shells over time, and collect over 150 pixel-art species. Decorate the tank and watch day turn to night. Your fish never starve and you can't lose, so just relax while you work.

title: Sucronomicon
description: Sucronomicon is a co-op cooking game where baking meets magic and chaos! Set in a dark fairy tale world, up to four players work together in kitchen-based arenas to craft enchanted confections using physics-driven tools while fighting back hordes of baked monstrosities. With voice chat, cursed legendary weapons, and kitchen puzzles, every session is a deliciously unpredictable showdown.

title: GodWright
description: Sculpt a tiny pixel world, seed it with life, and watch civilizations rise on their own. Kingdoms war, trade, and crown kings; dynasties fall to rebellion; whole ages turn. A cozy god-game sandbox where the story isn't scripted — it's discovered. No goals, no clock. Just a tiny world that lives.

title: Adventure Springs Bakery
description: Bake 35 recipes, set prices, serve quirky customers, decorate your shop, dress up in wizard robes, and learn real economics. 36 curriculum-aligned learning scenarios teach kids about profit, budgets, supply & demand through play. A cozy educational management sim for kids and families.

title: Pixel Chess Idle RPG
description: Chess meets Idle RPG! Forget checkmate—pieces have HP, stats, and loot. Earn gold for every move, upgrade your army, and unlock skills like Splash Damage. Automate your board to grind endlessly, then Rebirth for massive multipliers. A strategic loop of infinite scaling and pixel-art destruction.

title: Bratki
description: They rule the city, master the art of protection rackets, and carve up territories. They are the scourge of street kiosks, cooperatives, and black market dealers.

title: Absolute Signalling
description: Absolute Signalling is an early prototype of a mechanical signalling simulator. You play as a signaller actually pulling the levers, and ringing the bell codes to get the trains down the lines...the right lines!

title: No. 10: Full Confidence
description: No. 10: Full Confidence is a political satire survival game, with you as British PM. Open your red ministerial box, decide which ridiculous crisis to fix, and keep Cabinet, Backbenchers, the Media, and the Public just barely on side.

title: Fortnite: Chapter 7 - Season 4: Override
description: Your mission is simple - override the system, take back the Island, and stop Geno before it’s GAME OVER.

title: Vector Surge
description:
Vector Surge is a fast, uncompromising twin-stick arena shooter set inside a reactive signal field. Move, aim, dash and detonate your way through geometric swarms while the grid bends, pulses and fractures around every collision.

Almost everything you see is constructed live. Ships, enemies, projectiles, formations, effects, grid reactions and combat patterns are drawn from procedural vector geometry rather than conventional sprite sheets. Encounters remix enemy families, elites, hazards and formations on the fly. In Universe mode, procedural objectives, loot, mutations, routes and escalating sector conditions turn that same arena into a long-form expedition that is different every time you enter it.

There are no safe corners. Your multiplier is always fading. The best score is always one riskier kill away.

title: Shadow Bridge
description: A trading game about arming a war. Five kingdoms, one neutral village, one shop — yours. Sell good steel to a friend, cursed steel to an enemy, and let thirty years of war end the way you decide. You never draw a sword.

title: Midwest Goodbye
description: A narrative deck builder that mixes 2D and 3D art and makes you want to say goodbye just a little longer.

title: SCP: Darkwater
description: A psychological horror game inspired by SCP-1128. As a young woman trapped in a surreal loop, explore your bathroom and submerge yourself in the bathtub to enter a terrifying ocean dimension inhabited by a colossal entity lurking in the depths.

title: Samba del Tuerto
description: "Samba del Tuerto" is a short narrative video game with voice and text only in Spanish, about the people living in a village haunted by the crows that flock above their heads.

title: Aswang Hunter
description: Real-time horror battler meets tense house defense. As a rogue hunter, explore vulnerable homes, watch window silhouettes, and protect families from an Aswang outbreak. Scavenge bolos and spears, manage controls for each arm, and stop folklore monsters from escaping. Will they survive until dawn?

title: Jeep Horror
description: Drive a traditional jeepney through the dark Philippine streets, picking up commuters under the cover of night. But some passengers aren't human. Watch for doppelgangers, serial killers, and mythological monsters. Collect weird fares, manage your cabin, and try to survive the night shift.

title: RavenQuest: Rise of Tyrants
description:
Rise of Tyrants is a major endgame PvE expansion for the MMORPG RavenQuest, introducing complex group-based content, expanding the pet system, and overhauling core progression mechanics. At the heart of the update is the new "Tyrant System," which features five uniquely choreographed boss encounters (such as Sol Xoloth, the Sun King, and Sultan Zaraketh, the Elemental Storm) that rotate weekly. Designed specifically for coordinated five-player parties, these battles move beyond simple stat checks, requiring players to react to phase shifts, environmental hazards, and complex mechanics.

The system introduces "Sigils," an escalating difficulty modifier that allows groups to push for higher tiers of rewards and competitive leaderboard placement. Tied to these bosses is a new permanent progression layer called Relics.

The expansion also introduces Pet Awakening, granting new utility and resources through the game's transmutation loops, alongside a major rework of the Rangers Company hunting tasks featuring a global auto-balancing kill-count system. Additionally, the Munk Carnival social hub expands with new mini-games.

title: ReChan
description: ReChan is a reverse engineering project focused on reimplementing the game Jackie Chan: Stuntmaster.

title: Metroid Prime Hunters: Recompiled
description: Metroid Prime Hunters: Recompiled is a native recompilation of Metroid Prime Hunters.

title: Beat Breaker
description: Yet another brick breaker game... but with a rhythm twist!

title: Lupicraft
description:
Lupicraft is a Minecraft SMP project by Twitch Creator Lupisora, bringing players and creators from different communities together in a shared world.

A light roleplay server focused on player-driven stories, exploration, quests, events, and building your own place in the world. Follow story-driven quests, form alliances, start rivalries, meet new people, and create your own adventures.

title: March of the Red Queen
description: March on a rival Queen. Choose who eats and who doesn’t, who sleeps and who burns the midnight oil, who keeps walking by your side and who is left behind. Then pay the consequences.

title: Tuned In
description: A cursed TV holds you captive. To break free, survive the dark entity's programs of mind-bending puzzles, terror, and impossible choices, as reality and the broadcast slowly bleed into one another.

title: Mizuki: Demon-Slaying Housewife
description: In a world where demons and humans are in conflict, brave Demon-Slaying Warriors fight to protect family bonds in this emotional RPG! S-rank Demon-Slaying Warriors Mizuki, Cecilia, and Rekka learn that Mizuki's daughter Akari has failed her infiltration mission and been captured. To rescue Akari, the three infiltrate the demons' lair, but they are discovered by the enemy. Will Mizuki and the others successfully rescue Akari?

title: Wildlife Ballistics
description: Wildlife Ballistics is a fast-paced, tactical top-down shooter where you command a team of unique animal operatives, kick down doors, clear rooms and neutralize threats.

title: Kilnborn
description: Test your platform fighting-game fundamentals in Kilnborn, a fast-paced platform fighting game where you die in one hit. Kilnborn's pottery protagonists may be fragile, but all play differently with depth to discover in every match.

title: Project Tomorrow
description: A base-building survival game with terraforming and crafting. Earth lies poisoned and abandoned ten thousand years after invasion. Awaken from stasis, defend your fragile foothold, and restore a dead world so humanity can live here again.

title: Grimveil
description: A classic-style MMORPG built solo from scratch. Pick from 6 classes, grind real progression, loot your gear, and team up with a party or guild in an actively developed world made by someone who loves the genre.

title: Woahblade
description: Be the last uncontrollably-spinning bandicoot standing, in this unofficial chaotic multiplayer spin-off fan game that blends Crash Bandicoot with Beyblade. Build up outrageous RPMs and Dash, Bash, n Crash your opponents off the stage!

title: Terranigma
description: Thematic boldness. Stunning character design. Excellent music. Smooth gameplay. Terranigma had it all... except a modern re-release. Now, the beloved action JRPG classic is back for the first time since 1995!

title: The Somnolent Prince
description:
Goro Akechi's days have all become the same: He wakes up. He watches TV shows, or he reads a book. He leaves his house. He grabs something to eat. He takes the subway. He visits a sleeping Ren Amamiya. He talks to him. He leaves again. He takes the subway again. He… doesn't go home. He goes to Odaiba. He fights. He dies.

…And then he wakes up back home. Again and again.

Every day he hopes the cycle will break, that he will finally be free… and every day he is wrong.

But You can change this. All you have to do is 'Wish' for it. So, press start, and free him from this Fate.

title: Pierline
description: Pierline is a short first-person psychological horror game about an ordinary night that takes an unexpected turn. You play as Daniel Hayes, a Florida traffic officer who decides to spend the night fishing at an old pier along the coast, after a friend recommends the place.

title: Ninja Baseball League-Man: Bases Loaded
description:
Ninja Baseball League-Man: Bases Loaded is an arcade-style beat ’em up that combines baseball and martial arts, this action game has players battling through side-scrolling stages with pitches, swings, grabs, throws, combos, and special attacks. Up to four players can team up in shared-screen co-op to reclaim a stolen trophy.

Expanding on the original arcade release, the game adds a playable character, new stages, an arranged mode with revised enemy layouts, minigames, and newly arranged music alongside the original soundtrack.

title: Kokoro Space Opera
description: In Kokoro Space Opera join an all-girl squad of galactic fighter pilots as they try to save the Earth from assured destruction. Will this wacky space adventure get a happy ending? Or is this sci-fi story secretly a tragedy? Your choices decide their fate!

title: Laura Bailey Mysteries
description: Join mystery writer Laura Bailey as she investigates two gripping murder mysteries. Search crime scenes for clues, interrogate suspects, solve puzzles, reconstruct torn notes, and make your final accusation. Includes a murder mystery-themed card game.

title: Assault Wing 3
description: Top-down arcade skillbased multiplayer PvP space-shooter game. Setup your loadout (Ship, Two weapons, Utility and Passive mods) and blast out other players in different game modes.

title: Horton Genetics: Breach
description: First-person survival horror. You are a technician at Horton Genetics' Facility 79 when a sector goes dark and something gets out. No weapon, no backup, no way out. You hide, you run, and you work the facility to stay one step ahead of it.

title: Vice Vision Runner
description: Prepare, Vice! Prove you are able - to navigate terrain, in pitch-black shadow beneath the canopy. Discover routes, and estimate time to complete. Immersive walking sim about Hellgate peninsula exploration. Ambient slow-paced runner

title: Okaa-san
description: This is a Japanese horror, puzzle-solving, walking simulator.Your mother suddenly collapses right in front of you. Save her.You only have two actions to change her fate. Search for clues hidden throughout the house, piece together the truth, and try again and again to reach the happy ending.

title: Gods of the Grid
description: Fight your way up Olympus in a match-3 roguelike. Match runes to strike and heal, cast spells and claim relics, and find the weakness every foe is hiding. Nine realms, seven demigods, one life per run.

title: Goi Coins
description: Roll coins engraved with Japanese kana and build words from what lands face-up — a calm tabletop word game set in a quiet Japanese room. A play of luck, vocabulary, and knowing when to stop. Solo high-score, local 2-player, and online versus.

title: Super Dev Quest
description: When a young game developer is unexpectedly pulled into one of his own creations, he must survive in a dangerous game-inspired world filled with traps and deadly enemies.

title: Handlebar
description: Attach strange devices to your handlebar. Descend randomly generated downhill realms. A world-hopping bike roguelike.

title: Disaster Crew
description: Disaster Crew is a co-op game about friends taking strange jobs in dangerous places. Explore unpredictable worksites, build what the client asked for, and face weird hazards together.

title: A Dark Cave
description: A Dark Cave is a story-driven survival, settlement-building, and incremental adventure where every decision matters. Inspired by the minimalist incremental classics, A Dark Cave trades flashy graphics for intense atmosphere, discovery, and meaningful choices. Build a thriving village, uncover ancient secrets, and descend ever deeper into a world that becomes more dangerous the stronger you grow.

title: Ringwold: The Last Collector
description: Ringwold, the last of his kind, is trapped aboard a strange collector ship. Explore the ship, earn credits, use specialized machines, unlock upgrades, and collect creature cards reconstructed from corrupted Earth biology.

title: Shinkuu, Shoujo Namida wo Koboseru ka
description:
In June, a girl throws herself from her school rooftop. As class president, Shimabara witnessed her death and becomes determined to uncover the truth behind it. Her investigation leads her to Kusamizu Yuusui, a mysterious girl hiding a dark and troubled past.

But through another perspective, we discover Yuusui’s connection to the girl who died: a fragile bond shaped by loneliness, bullying, and fleeting moments of warmth. As past and present slowly collide, the truth behind the tragedy begins to emerge.

title: Floors of Fate
description: Challenge your skills in Floors of Fate, a single-player Action RPG. Battle through 50 handcrafted floors, customize your character, and piece together the lore of a ruined world. Every floor brings new enemies and tougher trials.

title: Solipcyst
description: SOLIPCYST is a puzzle visual novel: one patient, eight weeks, one hour at a time. Peel apart everything she tells you in good confidence to dig for clues. Pack her mind like a suitcase. Medicate, manipulate, stabilize, groom - anything necessary to heal the patient. Among other things.

title: Shotrun
description: One shot. One kill. Shotrun throws you into a brutal office nightmare where only the fastest survive. Blast your way through and reach The Manager at any cost.

title: Claims & Caverns
description: A 4-player co-op fantasy horror game. Descend deep into the mines, gather evidence, and avoid the horrors that lurk in the depths.

title: Hide and Moo!
description: Somewhere in this field, someone is doing their best animal impression. It’s you. Record your own animal sound, then try to match it under pressure while hunters close in. A chaotic voice-mimicry hide-and-seek party game with proximity chat.

title: Sands of Fate
description: Sands of Fate is a grimdark survival sandbox MMORPG built for roleplayers, by roleplayers. In the scarred world of Elarin, there are no chosen heroes and no prophecies, only your fight to survive as the Strand, a corrupted manifestation of the Weave of Creation, spreads unchecked and swallows everything in its path. Rebuild, or be consumed.

title: Through Space
description: In this fast-paced arcade game, you take control of a powerful spacecraft, flying through an endless tunnel and avoiding various obstacles. Score as many points as possible and set your own incredible high score!

title: Getaway Golf
description: At Golf Corp. Security guards patrol the lab. Lasers protect it. Armored doors seal it. Hidden in the back is an AI-powered golf ball. Built to cheat. Birdie every time. No suspicion. It looks like a regular golf ball. But it has a secret. It has a mind of its own. And it wants freedom.

title: Ultimate Super Bean
description: Ultimate Super Bean is a multiplayer, fast paced, parkour shooter. You can fight with friends or bots in different game modes. Collect skins, explore the maps, and master the guns. Have fun in this world of beans!

title: Keep Her Safe
description: Keep Her Safe is a survival shooting game. Gather resources, fortify your base, and withstand zombie hordes to keep the rocket project alive and bring an end to the acid rain apocalypse. Besides the hard life in wasteland, you can also chill up with friends in different multiplayer gameplays.

title: Egg Drop Soup
description: Drop Eggs on passing cars to cause as much public damage as you can. Use Banana Peels and Doughnuts to slip away from the pursuing police force. Complete your Missions before getting caught to make your getaway!

title: Don't Mess With Your Ex
description: Don’t Mess With Your Ex is a horror escape game where you wake up trapped in a house orchestrated by your vengeful ex. Solve puzzles, evade unseen threats, and search for clues in a dark, unsettling environment. With jump scares, psychological tension, and stealth mechanics, the game blends escape-room challenges with emotional horror.

title: Model Sisters
description: This is a game in which the photographer helps the model sisters pose correctly.

title: Gaslift: A Chair Horror
description: You are a prisoner, kidnapped by a psycho along with five other factory workers. Forced into a deadly tournament based on the rules of the prisoner's dilemma, you must make difficult choices: cooperate with others to escape or betray them to save yourself. Choose wisely, or face death by a chair.

title: Indulge
description: This game is a vibrant take on the classic fruit-slicing genre, blending it with a unique twist.

title: Eat It
description: Eat it is a crazy arcade game where you have to eat as much food as possible while facing the different threats that appear throughout your challenge.

title: With Eyes Closed: Season 2
description: With Eyes Closed - Season 2 is a Visual Novel style game that emphasizes storytelling, realistic characters, a branching narrative with numerous choices, and, of course, exceptional visual quality.

title: Afternoon Frontline
description: Afternoon Frontline is a free tower defense game with light roguelite elements. Make random choices, strengthen your characters, refine your team, and put together builds suited to each situation as you hold the line against incoming waves.

title: Sorry About The Mess
description:
You went to your favorite bakery every day for years, made friends with the owners, Mara and Colin, and even got yourself a nickname, Crumb. (Seriously though, those crumble cookies are the best!)

But Colin has disappeared, leaving Mara all alone, stress-baking in a hot mess of a kitchen. You’re a good friend, so you make a house visit. Will you investigate Colin, comfort your friend, or something more?

title: Pocket Furies
description: A deck‑building card battler where players take turns collecting treats to tame new Furies, expanding their arsenal and ramping up their power until they finally overwhelm the opposition.

title: Tales From the Dark Manor
description: Tales From the Dark Manor is a narrative visual novel where you play as a struggling journalist given a limited time to interview supernatural beings inside a mysterious manor where the laws of logic no longer apply. Every choice uncovers a new secret.

title: Ridge Hold
description: Build a cozy fantasy village, train warriors and archers, and hold the high ground. Gather wood and gold between waves, fortify the stairs, and protect your castle in this cute 2D tower defense strategy game.

title: Sudoku Mansion
description: A story-driven Sudoku adventure by puzzle setter Nurator, featured on Cracking the Cryptic. Explore a mysterious mansion of handcrafted Sudoku variants, master increasingly intricate puzzles, and uncover the secret hidden beyond the grid.

title: Go! Super Awesome Monkey!
description: Play as SAM in Go! Super Awesome Monkey and save the world from AI Tech Overlords in this cute 3D Platformer! Collect pizza slices, coins, & floppy discs by spinning, dashing, and slamming (and more!) in 100+ levels. Play at your own pace: casually explore or speedrun to rise up the leaderboards!

title: Nuclear Engineer Tycoon
description: Build a nuclear power plant and manage reactors, generators, and turbines, producing energy to keep the city lit and prevent reactor explosions. Earn resources, research nuclear technologies, build larger and more modern reactors, refine uranium, and create a nuclear energy empire.

title: Trial by Chat
description:
Trial by Chat is a crowd-judged party game built for Twitch streamers. Players answer a prompt with the funniest card in their hand, but instead of players judging each other, live chat decides the winner. Every viewer, across every connected streamer's channel, votes in real time using simple chat commands.

Play solo with your own community, or team up with other streamers for a true crossover session where every connected chat votes together. An OBS-ready overlay displays the game live on stream, and hosts get full control over game settings, pacing, and content.

Trial by Chat is designed specifically to boost chat engagement and interaction, turning passive viewers into active participants in every round.

title: Not Quite Dead
description: Open world zombie survival Coop game with base building, looting, crafting, vehicles, and exploration

title: Astral Sever
description: Astral Sever is a 4-player co-op extraction game. You are not a hero, you are a Pilot: a disposable mercenary sent into the Data Rifts to do the SDF's dirty work. Match your Resonance to the Rift's Magnitude, hunt colossal Titans, carve off their parts, and smuggle the loot back past the scanners. Every piece torn off enrages the Titan, and the deadlier the prey, the bigger the payout. Developed and published by Everreach Labs, Inc. Coming to PC.

title: PokeFields
description:
PokeFields is a brand new Pokemon MMORPG designed around both new and old fans of the Pokemon franchise. Starting in the Iconic Kanto region packed with new areas and a custom storyline, this gives a fresh perspective to give players a new experience.
Here, players have access to an influx of Pokemon not normally found in Kanto, as well as Mining, Foraging and Tree Cutting. These resources can be used to aid in your quest to conquer the Kanto region 12 years after Red.

title: Chaotic World
description: Chaotic World is a top-down PvE arena shooter where your objective is to clear waves of different and unique enemies until you destroy them all. Set across colorful maps, you will have the opportunity to make yourself stronger by leveling up and finding loot on your way to the last wave!

title: Kaperfahrt
description:
Kaperfahrt is an open world pirate sandbox set in a simulated Caribbean during the age of sail. Around 200 AI captains sail, trade and wage their own wars independently of the player, so conflicts and trade routes exist whether the player takes part in them or not.

Players engage in naval combat, board and capture enemy vessels, and command a fleet of up to four ships that fight in formation. Trade runs between five rival houses whose economy reacts to player actions, so blockading a harbour shifts prices across the map. A bounty list of 23 named pirates, each with their own crew and fighting style, forms the long term goal.

Kaperfahrt is developed by Kleinod Games, a one person studio from Germany, and is built in Godot.

title: Automobili Lamborghini: Recompiled
description: A native PC port of the Nintendo 64 game Automobili Lamborghini, produced by static recompilation of the original game code.

title: Rage Racer PC
description: A native Windows, Linux and macOS port of Rage Racer.

title: Gold Coast Gambits: Boca Raton & Palm Beach
description: A turn-based digital board game set in Boca Raton and Palm Beach, Florida. Compete for Prestige through property, Luxury Cards, and strategic map play. Tackle 50 Solo Gambits with increasingly challenging bots and varied objectives, or play the full board game solo against bots or with friends.

title: Nautus
description:
From the indie studio behind Have a Nice Death and Unruly Heroes comes NAUTUS, a quirky underwater adventure where the surface is your cozy sanctuary, but the ocean floor is a whole different beast.

Explore the abyss in your upgradable submarine, face strange creatures, gather resources, and recover mysterious artifacts to uncover what happened to the N.A.U.T.U.S. research team.

Return to the surface to craft, build, and befriend its eccentric inhabitants before diving even deeper—solo or with up to three friends in online co-op.

title: Pictorbit
description: Pictorbit is an open-world pixel art platformer social game. Players can draw, code, chat, play board games and make music. Pictorbit is an independent successor to Manyland, which was made by Philipp Lenssen and Scott Lowe.

title: ReDraft: The Fantasy Football Simulator
description: A Fantasy Football simulator for PC: make your draft, create your team and win your fantasy league.

title: Deep Blue Sushi
description: Deep Blue Sushi is a casual 1–5 player co-op adventure where you explore the ocean, catch fresh fish, prepare sushi, serve customers, and grow your restaurant while uncovering the secrets of the mysterious Deep Blue.

title: Glimpo
description: Fight endless waves of enemies in this arcade roguelite shooter. Build and level up your skillset, unlock synergies and become ridiculously overpowered!

title: El Notas
description: Explore, Discover and Play your instrument in order to revive an ancient music-powered island and its missing civilization.

title: Rain's Golf
description: A multiplayer golf game with a chaotic twist! Each round, opponents draw random cards to sabotage the current player’s shot - from explosive traps to wild obstacles. With a constantly expanding deck of cards, no two matches are ever the same. Outsmart, obstruct, and outplay your friends to win!

title: Brawl Arena Shooter
description: A fast-paced top-down arena shooter where cute animal heroes clash in chaotic online battles. Dash through bushes, grab power-ups, outplay rivals, and climb the global leaderboard in nonstop action.

title: Bendy and the Brine Barrel
description: Bendy and the Brine Barrel, also known by it's filename "Pickle", is a joke survival horror game almost entirely paralleling Bendy and the Ink Machine's demo. It was released by "Joey Drew Pickle Inc" through Bendy: Secrets of the Machine via a QR code inside of the main room, leading to a subpage on the Bendy website that had the file for the game.

title: Extreme Hill Driver
description: Master brutal hill climbs with realistic physics, upgrade your car, unlock tougher maps, and race to the finish before gravity or fuel takes you down.

title: Nova Jumper
description: Jump through different worlds to find your lost sheep.

title: Yn Moddey Dhoo
description: The first narrative Manx Gaelic language game. A 1-bit dithered first-person horror game based on Manx folklore. The Moddey Dhoo, a massive black dog, stalks the corridors of Peel Castle. Run. Hide. Escape. Don't look into its eyes; they might be the last thing you see.

title: Dash Duels
description: Dash To Kill. A chaotic neon combat arena for 1-4 local players. No health bars: one hit is fatal. Use ricochet physics, broken power-ups, and pure trolling to humiliate your friends. Are you a true Sigma or just another NPC?

title: Slime in the Ice Machine
description:
Slime in the Ice Machine is a hand-drawn narrative game that is launching in 2027.

In your dying dad's strip-mall cantina, you find a psychotropic slime tunnel to the world's greatest dives. Each new bar has a surreal crisis to solve: kick open doors to places you don't belong, entangle yourself with strangers, and master practical vices such as vandalism, seduction, & journalism.

title: ChromaFlow
description: Build a color-powered factory. Extract red, green, and blue, transport them across networks of conveyor belts, and blend them to create an expanding spectrum. Fulfill the demands of the Chroma Core, unlock technology, and optimize every production line.

title: A Couple Nights at the Chud House
description: You fell asleep first at the sleepover, and now your friends aren't acting quite the same. Defend yourself from the Chuds in this point-and-click style horror game, uncover forgotten memories, and discover what's really happening.

title: Open Up, Michael!
description: Balance strange offerings on a door handle, remember its unsettling note sequences, and find out who Michael really is. A short first-person comedy-horror game about five rituals, readable puzzles, two endings, and one suspiciously well-balanced cheese wedge.

title: The Memory Library
description: Found the card you need? Then combine it. Even a card that looks completely useless might become surprisingly useful once you combine it. Probably. Collect and synthesize cards, create unexpected synergies, and take on 10 story chapters and an endless dungeon.

title: Labhorror
description: A first-person horror set in a locked mansion the size of a city block. Carry three scrolls out of a 200-metre labyrinth while a man with an axe walks its corridors. Your flashlight is the only thing he will not walk into.

title: Grow & Go: Cozy Deliveries
description: Grow & Go: Cozy Deliveries is a cozy delivery and farming game where you harvest fruits, gather resources, and complete deliveries in a relaxing countryside world. Explore, collect, and grow your small business while enjoying a peaceful and charming atmosphere.

title: Make Her Real
description: A young inmate is given a faded body pillow of a girl from an old romance VN. Then she starts speaking... and becomes the only person who still sees him as human. A short psychological horror VN about isolation, guilt, parasocial comfort, and the terror of choosing freedom.

title: Distorted Minds
description: Distorted Minds is a chilling anthology of SGG’s original psychological horror stories. Seemingly harmless tales twist into something far darker, each branching into multiple endings and hiding secrets that were never meant to be uncovered.

title: Aquarium Anomaly
description: Aquarium Anomaly is a short first-person observational game inspired by Exit 8 and Platform 8, set in an endless aquarium shark tunnel. Watch for anomalies, and trust what you think is normal.

title: Nightlatch: Haunted House
description: A low-to-mid poly horror escape game across 3 different houses. Find the keys you need room by room, hide from a stalking presence, and uncover the story through scattered notes - each house with 4 difficulty tiers of 10 levels.

title: Light & Glory
description: Light & Glory is a short indie horror game where the main gimmick is you can only move when you are completely blind. There is a significant amount of lore and story. "What would you do to become Jacob the second"

title: Sleep Aid
description: Not every game is meant to be fair. Not every player is meant to survive. Bluff, adapt, and outsmart your opponent in tense poker matches where the cards don't always play by the rules.

title: Is That a Human Organ?
description: This is a horror-themed anomaly-hunting game. As a black market cargo inspector, you must carefully check each item to ensure its normal. Please note that when I say cargo, Im referring to organs.

title: Blightfall
description: Blightfall is a fast-paced first-person horde shooter for 1–4 players. Fight through escalating stages on a neon-lit alien world, stack powerful loot, charge shrines under pressure, defeat massive bosses, and loop back with rising difficulty. Solo or online co-op.

title: A Border With No End
description: A Border with No End is a horrorpunk adventure RPG set right in the middle of your normal everyday insanity, psychotic depression and a surreal nightmare, that is both meaningless and interpretive. Fight for nothing and loose it all.

title: Maze of Doors
description: Maze of Doors is a psychological horror puzzle game where every door leads to a new impossible room. Explore a shifting maze, solve puzzles, survive terrifying encounters, and uncover the secrets hidden beyond each door.

title: Rat Farm
description: Propagate, mutate, and sell vermin progeny from your rat farm, where every rat is unique. Farm cheese, protect your land, and appease the Rat King with rodent eugenics in this surreal farming simulator.

title: Nocturnal Echoes
description: Nocturnal Echoes is a dark fantasy 2D action RPG set in the haunted world of Elaris. Explore cursed villages, forgotten towers, flooded barrows, and corrupted sanctuaries as a mysterious book pulls you into a story of memory, sacrifice, and ancient Wards beginning to fail.

title: Absolutely Nothing Good
description: Do you believe that on Halloween night, the line between the world of the living and the dead becomes thinner? If not, then youre probably used to simply buying children off with candy. But imagine being stuck on a night shift in an ordinary roadside minimarket...

title: Take Care of My Heifer
description: "Take Care of My Heifer," reads the job listing. Sounds simple... until you step inside the house.

title: Hollow Hide
description: Hollow Hide asymmetric hide-and-seek with new mechanics. Gather resources for disguise, signal your friends, run from the hunter. Or play as the hunter track down escaped test subjects and shoot them with your rifle

title: Ling House: Echoes Within
description: Ling House: Echoes Within is a first-person psychological horror experience. Uncover the hidden tragedy beneath the surface of a haunted house. As reality breaks down, your video camera reveals images of an alternate space. You must see through the connection between both worlds to escape.

title: Hell Hospital
description: Survive the night in an insane asylum where the patients have taken over. Kill, hide, sneak, think, inject, blast, and whack your way through this survival horror action adventure immersive sim inspired by System Shock and classic survival horror games.

title: Deeds Were Done 2: Project Ascend
description: A PS2-style indie game about government studies on humans. they were subjects of experimentation to gather "crucial" data for military and medical purposes. you got assigned to work with the other scientists.

title: The Eternal Woods
description: The Eternal Woods is a short, fast paced incremental about an adventurer trapped in a never ending Woods. Sharpen your axe, upgrade your skills and conquer the different Forests to escape the Woods!

title: Cleanup On Aisle 3
description:
Cleanup on Aisle 3 is an arcade management game about running failing grocery stores. Each day, the player stocks shelves from incoming pallets, rings up customers before their patience runs out, wrangles shopping carts back from the parking lot, and mops up whatever got spilled along the way. Between days, the player drafts upgrade cards to expand the store, hire staff, and automate the chores that are getting out of hand.

The campaign spans seven stores, each with its own layout and its own set of problems. Corporate sends the player from store to store with a memo and a promise that this one will be different. Miss the daily sales target too often and the run ends in a firing. Play solo, or bring a second player in local co-op or Steam Remote Play Together.

title: One Day, the World
description: "One Day, the World" is a minimalistic platformer created with Game Maker 8. It has simple graphics, eerie music and much effort behind it.

title: Obby Revival Project
description: Taking roblox obbying outside of roblox, for everyone to enjoy with no baszucki's trying to threaten your hobby!

title: Look to the Birds
description: A cozy first-person birdwatching game about slowing down, noticing nature, and finding peace in small moments. Photograph 30+ bird species across five hand-crafted dioramas and fill your journal as you travel through the Canadian Maritimes.

title: Tales of Formentera
description: Tales of Formentera is an adventure game set on a small island inspired by real Formentera landscapes, where you explore freely to uncover a local mystery. Talk to islanders about their stories and legends, solve environmental puzzles, collect hidden items, and complete optional side quests as you piece together clues about what's happening on the island.

title: My Hero Academia: All's Justice - Playable Character Izuku Midoriya Overlay Full Style
My Hero Academia: All's Justice - Playable Character Nana Shimura
My Hero Academia: All's Justice - The Worldwide Star Card
description: Obtain The Worldwide Star Card, a collectible item in My Hero Academia: All's Justice

title: My Hero Academia: All's Justice - Ultimate Edition
Ever After Again: A Stories Adventure
description: Return to the world of Stories, or enter it for the first time, in an action RPG where your choices shape the adventure, a sarcastic narrator follows your every triumph and disaster, and you'll combine swords, sorcery, and flexible card-based powers to find the hero's path that will save the world!

title: Between Gods
description: Between Gods is a punishing action roguelite where your crusade is to slay every god. Master precise parries, battle relentless foes, discover powerful gear from shops and enemy drops, and grow stronger by spending skill points after each death.

title: Aipom's Great Pirate Adventure
description: Aipom's Great Pirate Adventure is a roguelite-ish, pirate-themed, grid-less, grid-full, treasure-filled, light-hearted, auto-chess fan-game made for the Eevee Expo Game Jam 2026.

title: ReTrime
description: You have 24 hours to explore this land and prepare for its inevitable end. Fight a variety of enemies and bosses; discover a huge arsenal with near-endless potential for player expression and, through each attempt, learn to do it as efficiently as possible.

title: Death By Taxes
description: A satirical incremental clicker about a billionaire facing the one thing money can’t fix: taxes. Spend every last dollar on increasingly stupid purchases before the bill kills you.

title: UnderForged
description: UnderForged is a chaotic co-op crafting game where you play as a team of dwarven blacksmiths. Mine, smelt, and forge raw iron into legendary equipment. Expand your workshop, upgrade your tools, and most importantly fulfil your contracts.

title: Stray Dog: Nobody Cares
description: A stray dog saved by a disgraced knight marches to rescue its captured master. Scorned by all as useless roadside trash, it grips his frayed sword in its jaws and ventures forth. Features: Stealth kills, custom levels, precise parries, brutal boss fights.

title: Parry Counter
description: PARRY COUNTER is a 2D side-scrolling Soulslike action game that puts your timing to the ultimate test. Master perfect parries to deflect enemy strikes and challenge a relentless boss rush. Every battle tests your skill, precision, and courage. Will you rise to counter every attack?

title: Carry the Count
description: Carry the Count is a co-op adventure game for 1 to 4 freaky little freaks. Carry your vampire master across a medieval fantasy world to his bloodthirsty lover Romilda. Fight barbarians, solve puzzles, outsmart evil fish guys, and don't let the masters coffin break. Maybe one day, Igors will be free?

title: My Brother Hacker
description: My Brother Hacker is a single-player hacking game set in 2036. Your brother has been missing for two weeks. He left a USB stick behind: an unfamiliar operating system, and an AI that starts teaching you how to break into networks.

title: Japanese Ramen Simulator
description: Japanese Ramen Simulator is a ramen shop management sim for up to six players. Prepare ingredients, cook noodles, and arrange toppings to craft the perfect bowl. Create original dishes, design your kitchen and dining area, and build your ramen restaurant with friends or on your own!

title: Storage 8
description: Storage8 is a short atmospheric observation walking simulator set in a quiet self-storage facility. Carefully examine four open storage units, a mannequin, and stacks of boxes. If the space feels unfamiliar, turn back. If it feels unchanged, move forward and find your way out.

title: Suba Pogo
description: An emergency call echoed through the peaceful Hololive!! Subaru from the Oozora Police Department picks up the phone and rushes out on an urgent dispatch...!!!

title: Sift Heads: Cartels 4
description: Join Vinnie in a battle against powerful criminal organizations in Chicago. With his sidekicks Shorty and Kiro, navigate a dangerous world of violence and greed. Use special tactics, powerful weapons, and specialized skills to survive. Uncover secrets and be merciless.

title: Legion Hunters
description: Command your squad in a strategy-MMORPG. Unlock over 200 champions and 10 races, upgrade your castle, and gear up to dominate global rankings. Prepare for the war to come!

title: Within The Experiments
description: A system-driven turn-based RPG bringing new strategy to the classic Wizardry-style formula. Cut in on enemy actions with the "Interrupt Timeline Battle" system. Lead a five-member party, strengthen your team through combat and item discovery, and explore the dungeon's depths.

title: Folder Folder Folder
description: A relaxing incremental game about cleaning up your desktop. Sort files into folders, meet the locals, upgrade your tools, and go from manually sorting files one by one to cleaning up hundreds at a time. Immerse yourself in an atmosphere of tranquility where no one will hurt you. No one.

title: Puzzles Forest
description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

title: Ambience
description: Ambience is a first-person spatial puzzle, where you combine lights and colors to access new dimensions and shape the minimalistic world around you.

title: Puzzles: Fish
description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

title: Puzzles: Dog
description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

title: Octbuster: Video Rental Store Cleanup
description: Octbuster is a cozy organization game about closing up an 80s video rental store after hours as an octopus. With the help of your kitten pals, scoop up piles of procedurally placed VHS tapes with real tentacle arms and sort over 10,000 of them however you want. No timer, no score, no way to lose.

title: Puzzles Dino
description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

title: Imperfections
description: Imperfections is a 2D space shooter, where you build your own battleship, manage energy and heat to fight off enemies and bosses.

title: Hardcore and Death
description: Run through huge multi-level locations, avoiding spikes, falling platforms, and flying blades, use double jumps, and choose your route to reach the Heart before the lights go out.

title: Khalco Farm
description: Top down RTS style single unit HERO control. Escape a dangerous forest, find your way back to town.

title: Mega Mash Mons
description: Giant monstrosities fly swim climb and battle on enormous fields to level up to being the strongest creature alive. Master multiple game modes in early access and more to come to level up and customize your Mons!

title: Sala de Juegos 3D
description: 3D Game Room is the perfect space to enjoy classic board games with family or friends

title: War Land TD
description: War Land TD is a strategic tower-defense card battler where you defend a single vulnerable tower by summoning heroes and bosses with cards. Build your deck, manage gold tokens, and fight challenging enemies across 12 levels in 4 unique locations.

title: TShip Online
description:
TShip Online is a cooperative online naval role-playing game in which each player commands a ship and joins other players in PvE battles against computer-controlled enemies. Players develop their vessels through levels, equipment, active and passive skills, and combat class specializations, with different roles contributing to the fleet during battle.

The game features Twitch integration that allows viewers to join battles from a stream and participate in shared encounters. Ships can also be customized with cosmetic skins, while progression and combat are centered around cooperative fleet-based gameplay.

title: Ski-E-O! Ski Resort Tycoon
description: Build the cozy ski resort of your dreams in this management game where no two winters are the same. Paint trails onto real mountains, connect lifts, and place the lodges and après bars that keep thousands of skiers warm, fed, and happy.

title: Minds Define Us
description: Fire up your camper van and hit the road! Minds Define Us is a story-driven, top-down extraction action-adventure. Scavenge supplies in robot-infested zones, safely extract, meet companions, share home-cooked campfire meals, and upgrade your gear as you uncover the truth behind the distant rumble.

title: Fear of Faith
description: FEAR OF FAITH is a 1-4 player co-op survival horror game where cloned soldiers raid cursed WWII bunkers. Choose your class, combine spells and drink BEER to keep your FEAR away, or face a fate worse than DEATH

title: Boil Cabbage Make Soup
description: A cosy idler starring an Onion who makes soup anywhere on your desktop! Watch him grow and harvest cabbages to make delicious soup for a cast of colourful customers. Decorate your island and customise your Onion with your hard-earned gold to level him up, and build your very own soup making empire!

title: Heatwarped
description: Ratfield sits atop an underground racing scene. Conquer the streets by warping the odds in your favor. Customize your ride to the max, meet up with other racers from your pda's racing forum to compete, and build respect.

title: 99 Nights In The Apocalypse
description: Survive 99 nights in the world’s worst apocalypse. Scavenge by day, build a questionable camp, and try to survive the night as escaped asylum patients, deranged staff, and things much worse come looking for you.

title: Top Steed
description: Enter the world of high-speed horse racing! Saddle up and drift across over-the-top tracks in this multiplayer racing game with realistic riding controls. Claim victory with your TOP STEED!

title: Dumb Ways to Build
description: Dumb Ways to Build is a chaotic, physics-based co-op game. Team up with friends to assemble your crew and take-on dangerous construction jobs. With all the gear and no idea, work together to build your path forward, or die trying!

title: Japanese Swordsmith
description: From tamahagane to a finished katana. Become a swordsmith in Bakumatsu Kyoto—sumikiri, mizuheshi, folding forge, the quench, polishing—finish a Japanese sword with your own hands. A hardcore swordsmith simulator. It will not be easy.

title: Walk Around the World
description: A cozy desktop companion where BilBil explores the world while you work or stream. Talk, click, and help your tiny traveler visit real countries, unlock charming outfits, and take every step of the journey.

title: Mr.Mag: The Dark Side Within
description: A hero, but alone, A magnet doll finds himself drawn into THE DARK SIDE WITHIN. Mr. Mag is a puzzle-adventure. Use magnetic power not to conquer, but to survive. To search. To remember what it means to be pulled—by something more than instinct.

title: Wobble Bros
description: Carry a ragdoll patient through chaotic physics rescue courses as wobbly doctors in 2–4 player co-op. Control your floppy bodies, coordinate with your team, and reach the evac point without dropping the patient.

title: Eddie’s Last Shift
description: Run a late-night burger shop during a deadly outbreak. Cook orders, identify infected customers, and stop the Silent Plague before your town is lost.

title: Your Cozy Unboxing
description: A cozy unboxing simulator where you peel tape, slice cardboard, unscrew, clean and break seals on mystery boxes as a rising content creator, turning every item into both décor for your room and content for your social feeds.

title: Crewmate Rush Space Escape Runner
description:
Crewmate Rush Space Escape Runner is a feature-rich, high-octane 3D sci-fi runner where players sprint through high-tech spaceship corridors, dodge lethal hazards, and escape the pursuing Void Hunter.

Designed with deep gameplay mechanics and robust social integration, the game offers a complete multi-platform arcade experience across web and mobile platforms.

title: Silent Wounds: The Doll
description: Silent Wounds is an episodic psychological horror anthology. Each episode offers a compact and intense narrative experience. In this first episode, a man returns home and trades reality for the dangerous, silent obsession with a perfect doll.

title: Moo Who?
description: Can you make animal sounds well enough to survive? Moo Who is a multiplayer party game based on sound imitation, where animal players hide among the NPCs and make animal sounds into their microphones before the hunters figure out who’s faking it.

title: The Deep Waits
description: You have one minute to live. Eat, explore, fight, and craft your way off a cursed island before the deep takes you.

title: Eastern Dream
description: Build the city, then step inside your own story. Solve handcrafted building puzzles, meet unforgettable characters, and uncover the forgotten tale hidden within your city.

title: Subverse - Celestina Unbound
description:
Experience the next chapter of galactic fuckery with Subverse's newest DLC!

Empress Celestina sends a distress call to the Mary Celeste, and it's up to you to help her out of a rather sticky situation!

title: Riot Riders
description: Swing from a chopper while your bro pilots in a co-op physics-driven aerial bullet hell, using a wild “Swing-to-Aim” system to unleash BIG guns, pull off absurd stunts, chase high scores, and prevent another WORLD WAR.

title: Throne & Conquest: King Arthur
description: Rule as King Arthur and unite a fractured kingdom. Make difficult decisions, conquer rival lands, and balance your kingdom in this strategy adventure.

title: Concrete Burial
description: Equipped only with a weapon that consumes your own blood, explore an ancient brutalist catacomb. Beware the Eyes of The Whispering Crypt. Find the 4 artifacts of desire. Confront God.

title: Carnosis
description: Carnosis is a horror dungeon crawler set in a grimdark empire filled with mutated monstrosities and war machines. Sever enemy limbs, steal the flesh of defeated foes, and chain devastating status combos to butcher your way to the emperor.

title: Die First
description: Die First is a casual, physics-based party game where the first player dead wins! Run, jump, dash, and use items or map hazards to destroy yourself while saving your opponents.

title: Space Snatcher
description: 6-player co-op horror chaos where you're trapped aboard increasingly dangerous space stations. Scan every monster the Company demands, scavenge for powerful items to help you survive, and keep the ship's systems repaired. But the biggest threat might just be your friends.

title: Echoes of Kyria
description: Fight solo or with up to 4 players co-op to take on massive bosses in this stylized 3D action rogue-like bullet heaven. Step into Kyria, battle against relentless hordes, and master the dynamic, fast-paced combat.

title: Endless Bounce
description:
Endless Bounce is a roguelite pinball game where you build the table yourself.

Between stages you buy bumpers and marks in the shop and place them on the playfield by hand. Drag two bumpers together to combine them into something stronger, find the synergies, and reach the score target before the clock runs out. There are 50 stages across 5 worlds, with a boss every ten that steals your bumpers, and an endless mode once you clear stage 50.

Every run is different: randomized shop offers, over 40 items with as many combinations, and 6 unlockable balls that each change the rules. Between runs, 40 talents in 10 branches make the next attempt stronger.

title: Mr. Swop
description: Help Mr. Swop find stars by swapping tiles around.

title: Galumb
description: Galumb is a chaotic and fun party game where you can compete fiercely against your friends or rivals—or team up to overcome challenges together. Your goal is simple: navigate obstacle-filled courses and be the first to reach the finish line. But remember, you’re not the only one fighting for the same goal.

title: Seven Nights With Hanako
description: Ancient Leylines, a once in a 10 millennia blood moon, and one seriously bratty ghost! Seven Nights, Seven Challenges, Seven Hearts; Survive a week in Hanako's Hell realm or become her eternal play-thing!

title: Limp Mode
description:
Limp Mode is a driving survival game with simulation-leaning handling, deep tuning and an OBD diagnostic scanner as its central tool. Cars wear out, leak and fail in ways that can be diagnosed and repaired: when a warning light comes on, the player reads the fault codes to find the failing part, clears them to limp on a little further, or disables systems outright to trade reliability for power. Handling is built on slip-based tire physics, weight transfer and drift behaviour, and the workshop that serves as the player's base includes a proving ground with a track editor for shaking down a build before taking it out.

Beyond the solo campaign - a thousand-kilometre drive down the highway to reach the player's grandfather - the game offers drift servers for up to twenty players, with a public server browser and a festival pit lane where players build and decorate their own pit box. Cars are persistent across every mode and keep their condition, damage and odometer reading, with a service history recording every repair. Parts can be stripped from wrecks, and the world persists after a death, so abandoned wrecks and emptied containers stay where they were left. The dead still hold the cities and are dangerous to meet on foot, but they are weather rather than the subject. It can be played solo or in co-op for up to four players.

title: It Was Not A Suicide
description: A psychological horror detective simulation set in Rainier Falls in 2005. Uncover the truth behind Adele's death by finding contradictions in the case files. Are you brilliant enough to expose the suspects' lies in a single attempt? Because you only get one chance to make an arrest.

title: Pop Float a-way
description: POP Float a-way is a multiplayer party platformer for up to 8 players where you dash through obstacle-packed tracks by yelling into your mic, knock rivals off course, and try not to pop before you cross the finish line.

title: Clock Mayhem
description:
Clock Mayhem is a fast-paced platformer built around urgency, where players must run quickly and overcome obstacles and challenges to reach the end of each level before it is too late.

What makes the game unique is that each level is designed with its own twists and challenges. Every stage has its own time limit and collectibles, providing a dynamic experience.

You will start with Luni, but other characters can be unlocked after completing all cycles. Each character has their own abilities and their own set of completely different levels, providing a unique gameplay experience. To master the entire game and set new records, players must complete every cycle with every character.

Each level you reach will automatically become available in Practice Mode, where you can select and replay it, learn its patterns, and improve without penalty. This helps you prepare for each cycle, since every cycle must be completed in one go to master it.

title: Bullet Vendetta
description:
Bullet Vendetta is a fast-paced action shooter packed with intense and thrilling shootouts.

Betrayed by the mafia and having served time in prison, the protagonist finally gets his chance for revenge after years behind bars.

The mafia controls various districts of the city, and it’s up to you to clear them of criminals. Use a variety of firearms to fight your way through crowds of enemies and survive in unequal battles.

Make quick decisions, adapt to dangerous situations, and fight your way through a hail of bullets. Free the city from mafia control and carry out the revenge that has been burning inside the main character for many years.

title: Eggs Must Flow
description: Eggs Must Flow is an adorable chicken clicker game where you click, hatch, and automate your way to egg supremacy. Unlock chickens with unique passive powers, boost your production, and keep your coop clean... or things could get very messy.

title: Halo: Project Chozo
description:
A crossover mod for Halo Combat Evolved on MCC with Metroid Prime elements!

Relive the Campaign of Halo as the infamous bounty hunter Samus Aran! With a small but powerful array of weaponry like the Power Beam, Super Missile and Plasma Beam, fight the Covenant Armada and waves of Flood Metroid Prime style!

All enemies and vehicles have weaknesses and resistances to certain weapons, plus rebalanced difficulty, a new health system, improved UNSC AI, and more!

As well as a secret on the final level...

Will Samus Aran be able to claim her most ambitious bounty yet?

title: Climb, Cube, Climb!
description: Climb, Cube, Climb! is a rage-game inspired platformer where the primary obstacle standing in your way is gravity. Employ a diverse set of movement skills to ascend to the top, but be wary: falling is guaranteed.

title: Claustrum
description: Claustrum is an atmospheric first-person exploration game set within an endless brutalist megastructure. Navigate dark industrial corridors, interact with forgotten machinery, and uncover the mystery of a dormant complex that was never meant to wake up.

title: No More Slimes!!
description: Face the mysterious slime army in the peaceful canyon! As the lone fixer, hunt endless swarms with unique interdimensional mercenaries. Build your own style through a vast skill tree and rare relics. Upgrade weapons for massive firepower. Can you find the mastermind and save the canyon?

title: Carve The Cave Together
description: Dig a cave with a friend, one cell at a time. Throw balls into solid rock in zero gravity and they never stop, so the more cave you open the further everything flies. Mine ore, feed the machine, unlock a roster of balls that each dig differently.

title: Marble Mill
description: An idle game where every coin is a real collision. Build a marble mill, watch it grow into a roaring machine — and finish it in one satisfying evening. 100% achievements in ~3 hours, endless sandbox after. An idle game that ends.

title: Boneyard Bounce!
description: All four edges of the board are your paddle — a block breaker unfolded in four directions. Fire a spell-ball into a monster-packed graveyard maze and watch it carom through the horde. Elemental kills chain-detonate straight through walls. Smash the headstones too; the landlord pays for wreckage.

title: Streamer vs. Chat
description: Streamer vs. Chat is a next-level interactive game where a Twitch streamer competes directly against their viewers. By typing chat commands, viewers influence matches in real time, triggering combat actions, mini-games (like Marbles and Quiz), and effects like flashbangs or screen changes. Featuring leaderboards with a points system, it transforms traditional livestreams into an unpredictable, competitive, and chaotic experience.

title: The Yard: Escape from Prison
description: The Yard : Escape From Prison is an online co-op prison escape for up to 6 players. Follow the daily routine to avoid suspicion while crafting tools and planning your breakout under the guards' noses. Upgrade your stats and experience a tense atmosphere where you can cooperate to escape or compete to see who leaves first.

title: Pitchside Empire
description: Pitchside Empire is a business management simulation in which the player runs a five-a-side football pitch rental facility. Customers phone in to book slots and the player quotes a price for each call, negotiating against a hidden customer budget, with regular clients and facility reputation affecting how much teams are willing to pay. Profits are reinvested into changing rooms, showers, a canteen, seating, floodlights that make evening slots sellable, and pitch surface upgrades, while additional plots such as an industrial yard, harbour district, lakeside complex, downtown arena and hilltop campus each hold four pitches and attract a different clientele. Staff including managers, cleaners, cooks, attendants and security can be hired and promoted to run the business automatically. From level 10 the local clubs hold a neighbourhood league season on the player's pitches in exchange for a hosting fee and ticket revenue. The game also features customer reviews, on-pitch fights that damage reputation, and thirty-day history charts for cash, occupancy and level.

title: Laundromat 8
description: Spot the anomaly. Choose STOP or RESUME. You are trapped in an endlessly repeating laundromat where even the smallest change matters. Study the room, make the right calls, finish your laundry, and find your way home.

title: Hadalyth Zero
description: Hadalyth Zero is a penguin-based multiplayer fishing chatroom game with fleshed out life-sim mechanics. Catch hundreds of unique fish, customize your penguin, complete objectives, and hangout with people.

title: Mado Marks
description: Three students record themselves in a classroom room that shouldn’t exist... The next morning, one of them is gone forever... A short psychological horror VN about memory, proof, and erasure.

title: Velocrash
description: Velocrash is a party racing game in which players take turns building the track before racing on it together. Each round, every player draws a random hand of cards and places one track piece or trap - such as saw blades, oil slicks, boost pads, or launch ramps - so the track grows longer and more chaotic every round. Finishing a race scores points, but sabotaging opponents is often more rewarding. The game features 3D arcade driving physics, online multiplayer for 2 to 8 players via Steam invite, two game modes (points race and time trial), two worlds, multiple cars and colors, and gamepad support. It is localized in five languages. VELOCRASH was created by a single developer and released into Steam Early Access on August 8, 2026, developed and published by Apolloxian Games.

title: Moon and Away
description: A short, atmospheric, story-driven experience about a young woman searching for meaning in a world that no longer feels familiar.

title: Cursed Ciddy
description: Follow Betty as she explores the abandoned ruins of Comical Entertainment in search of answers. Solve puzzles, uncover forgotten secrets, and survive the dangers hidden within a once-beloved entertainment center concealing a dark mystery below. Nothing is as it seems.

title: Solomon no Kagi: Another Ver
description: Fan remake of the Tecmo's arcade game Solomon's Key.

title: Real Backrooms
description: Explore the deepest parts of the Backrooms in an attempt to escape alive, alone or with your friends! Are you ready to face this dangerous world? Or will you accept your fate and die? Choose, or the Backrooms will choose for you!

title: Manorism
description: Solve its secrets or become one in this third-person cozy-horror puzzle adventure about home and belonging. Explore quirky rooms, test unspoken rules, and use magic to solve playful puzzles as strange secrets unfold within a mysterious manor. Refuge is only the beginning.

title: Still Rain: The Arrival
description: Ethan returns to his cousin's old family house, deep in the forest, a place he hasn't set foot in for five years, ever since the family who lived there vanished without a trace.

title: Inner Demons
description: Inner Demons is a first-person psychological horror game where the line between madness and reality dissolves. Explore, fight, and evade disturbing manifestations of your own mind as they invade the world around you - if you can tell them apart from what is real.

title: Mother;Above
description: Matoki is about to flood to protect the inhabitants of the city above... Vik and his companions head for the flood controls, but his search for his missing mother threatens to consume him. A psychological horror VN about sacrifice, and what desperation makes people willing to do.

title: Sunlust: The Way We Remember It
description: Sunlust: The Way We Remember It is a 32-map [CITATION NEEDED] megawad where we at Broken Lamp Records made tribute to our favourite iwad, I mean megawad, Sunlust by Ribbiks and... and... fuck, who was the other guy? fuuuuck. I'm so sorry. I don't remember. fuckkk I'm so sorry. Anyway, these maps are all faithful recreations of each Sunder map purely from memory, with absolutely no creative liberties taken! However, our memories are not that great. For instance, we didn't remember what complevel Scythe 2 was, so we just went with the funniest number we could think of (21). Turns out this number is only 10 off from the actual complevel so we didn't do that bad! These maps are extremely similar in gameplay and quality [CITATION NEEDED] to the original Speed of Doom, so you know what to expect. We hope you will enjoy Sunlust: The Way Id Did, I mean Sunlust In Name Only, I mean, shit, I mean Sunlust: The Way We Remember It, based on Sunlust by Ribbiks and Et Al. Yeah, that was the other guy! Have funlust!

title: War Forge
description:
War Forge is a 2D lane brawler where two teams of champions battle across three lanes to destroy the enemy base. Players fight enemy champions, push lanes, destroy towers, and work together to gain an advantage.

What makes War Forge different is its unique second layer of the map, where teams can leave the lanes to fight over powerful objectives and team-wide buffs. This creates another layer of strategy beyond simply pushing lanes.

Fight. Push. Capture objectives. Destroy the enemy.

title: DinoBones: Tidy Up the Museum
description: Dino Bones: Tidy Up the Museum! is a cozy skeleton restoration sim. Identify, collect, and piece together around 2,000 scattered dinosaur bones. Feel chaos turn into order, and with every skeleton you rebuild, the museum reveals another secret.

title: Lin Ling
description:
Lin Ling is a choice‑driven indie visual‑novel game on PC. Step into a realistic‑style story filled with complicated relationships, tough decisions and hidden secrets.

Players will make critical choices that shape the plot and lead you toward multiple different endings. Every decision carries real‑world consequences, and there is no perfectly safe option.

Featuring original hand‑drawn artwork, atmospheric background music and well‑written character dialogues, this narrative experience is great for streaming. Viewers can watch and discuss your in‑game choices, making each playthrough unique and fun for audiences.

Play through different branches, unlock character stories and discover all possible endings. If you enjoy story‑rich games with meaningful player choices, Lin Ling offers you a memorable experience.

title: Alpine Faction VR
description: Alpine Faction VR is a virtual-reality implementation for the 2001 FPS Red Faction, built on top of the Alpine Faction community patch.

title: Ball Scratch Simulator
description: Your balls itch. You are in public. This is now everybody’s problem. Covertly scratch your balls through multiple public incidents, battle your useless hand, and stop before everyone finds out what kind of person you are.

title: The Ignition Protocol
description: The Ignition Protocol is an incremental, top-down mining game set in space. Mine and haul asteroids in zero-g, build and automate your base, and ignite a new star - the last light in a fading universe.

title: Endless Coven
description: Endless Coven – Desktop Editor is a tool for tabletop role-playing games designed specifically for the Endless Coven universe. However, the universe's creator, 53R070N1N, also allows for the editor to be used for role-playing games set outside the Endless Coven universe.

title: Discharge Pending
description:
Discharge Pending is a psychological anomaly horror game set inside an abandoned hospital. Trapped on the upper floors, the player must descend one level at a time while carefully observing the environment for anything that has changed. At the end of each floor, they must decide whether an anomaly is present. A wrong decision sends them back to the top.

Each run features randomized anomalies, locations, variants and audiovisual events, ranging from subtle environmental changes to surreal encounters and active threats. As the descent continues, the hospital becomes increasingly unreliable, forcing the player to question what is real and what should not be there.

title: Dice Hoarder
description: Dice Hoarder is a cozy organizing game where you restock a mysterious dice shop. Sort every die in the shop, match them into complete seven-piece sets, and uncover what is hidden behind your new job.

title: Alfred's Alien Abduction Adventure
description: Join Alfred in this 3D adventure game set onboard a scary alien mothership. In space no one can hear you s#!t yourself, thankfully.

title: Little Horrors: The Mortuary
description: A midnight call wakes you up. Your employee at the mortuary is trapped in the storeroom and you have to go help him.

title: It's About Pirates
description: Command your ship in an action-packed pirate roguelike. Combine deadly weapons, powerful items, and a fearless captain to create unique builds and survive the dangers of the high seas!

title: Clinical Memory
description: This is not just a walking simulator. This is a new genre: a memory simulator. Explore Ward 7B, survive distorted cycles, collect fragments of memory, and face a truth that changes everything at the end.

title: Abort Sequence
description: Scour your desk, find the right pages and decipher their content to find the defusal codes in this fast-paced puzzle experience! Beat multiple difficulties, optimize your solving strategies and find the right codes among thousands of possible combinations!

title: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls - Animated Chromatic Color Unlock
description: - Animated Chromatic Color Unlock for all 20 launch characters

title: Remnant Humanity
description:
Remnant Humanity is a real-time (with pause) salvage game where you type commands to guide your crew through procedurally generated derelict wrecks while trying to help remnant colonies survive.

Fly around in your rust bucket, siphon fuel from derelict ships, manage oxygen, dodge radiation, outrun enemies, heal your crew, ... Crew members can die permanently, so know when the risk is about to become too high and you need to abandon the mission. Missions help you and other colonies survive. Can you spare some of the highly requested resources to unlock new ship systems?

title: Dog of Dracula: Barbecue Densetsu
description: An otaku noir nakige about a groomer stuck in a sauceless city. Developed by major depressive auteurs Team Batsu as part of their class project on Marxist theory.

title: White Dwarf
description: White Dwarf is a top-down survival shooter about holding onto a piece of empty space for as long as you can. Your weapon fires automatically at the nearest target, so the only things you control are where you stand and when you spend your cooldowns. Everything else comes down to the choices you make along the way.

title: Roads of Da Vinci: In Search of Origins
description: Travel across Italy, collect artifacts, and uncover the truth about the origins of Roman mythology through ancient temples and ruins.

title: Flood With Friends
description: Nail a raft (or a plane) out of junk, load it with everything valuable or ridiculous and sail for the next island before the water swallows you up. Co-op physics chaos for 1-8 friends.

title: Carcelera
description: Carcelera is an exploration and light puzzle game. You are in prison, and so is the Moon. Forge your own destiny, you can repent later.

title: Old Man's Sushi
description: No free handouts, earn your legacy! Grandpa wants to leave his sushi shop to you, but he doubts you're ready. Catch fresh fish, roll delicious sushi, collect antiques, and clear Grandpa's To-Do List to prove your worth!

title: Armory Keeper
description: Restore order to a massive armory. Find and sort over 1,500 weapons, ammunition, grenades, and military equipment scattered throughout the facility, placing every item on its correct rack. As you organize the armory, unlock abilities that help you sort faster and more efficiently.

title: Monochrome Angel
description: Explore the derelict ruins of abandoned megastructures in this slow-paced first-person platformer. Discover movement upgrades to facilitate platforming and exploration. Find data logs of those who have gone before to uncover the lore of this dark world. //Return to Hemron, o Fallen//

title: Exspelled
description: Exspelled is a cozy fantasy life sim mixed with tower defense. Build and customize your village, gather resources, welcome outcast creatures, and prepare your defenses. Expand your settlement, strengthen your community, and protect your new home against increasingly dangerous waves of enemies.

title: The Night Route
description: A night shift in a quiet suburb seemed like an easy way to earn some extra cash. You're a regular courier on foot. Deliver the orders and head home. But remember: the darkness hides those who stay awake at night, and someone is watching your route very closely.

title: Disaster Response Force
description: Disaster Response Force is a twin-stick 2D top-down hack-and-slash arcade game. Choose one of three characters and gain upgrades to survive longer and get your score as high as possible before you inevitably succumb to the horde. Every moment you stall the onslaught is one more civilian saved.

title: Pray Your God!
description:
Pray Your God! is a retro-styled comedy game about founding a cult and guessing numbers.

The player names a cult, recruits a flock and then prays: they pick a number from one to a hundred, and an Inquisitor picks one after them, with a die that does not cheat.
A wrong guess costs a follower and earns a fresh piece of paperwork; a correct one triggers one of 16 endings, each with its own animation, its own obituary and its own achievement, assigned at random. Runs last two to four minutes.

The whole game is played through a text interface drawn in a Commodore-era palette.

title: Reality Breach
description: Reality Breach is a first-person psychological horror game where your own creation turns against you. Step into the shoes of an exhausted indie developer trapped in a shifting home studio, evading a relentless entity born from your own corrupted code

title: Selkie's Salvage&Co.
description: Selkie’s Salvage&Co. is a first-person physics based incremental fishing game. Your task is to clean up the flooded planet! Fish up scrap, grind all of it down and collect trinkets of the past. Expand your salvaging operation and go beyond!

title: Storage 8 VR
description: This game is a VR port of an existing game. A quiet self-storage facility. Four open storage units. A single mannequin. Stacks of boxes.

title: Rootknot
