description: Defeat demons not with swords, but with juggling skills, in a combat mechanic never seen before! Challenge your reaction time in a deckbuilding roguelite, fighting mysterious creatures. Rescue your performance troupe and perform at the long-awaited king's wedding with the help of the Wak Wak tree.

title: Mica King
description: Mica King is an original top down action adventure game. Travel as an adventurer of variety skills to the once great and magical kingdom of Virrdale. Uncover the power of Mica and face the dark forces behind the bitter downfall of the king.

title: Burning Bridges
description: You discover a suspicious box on your parents attic. Uncover a long hidden family secret by rummaging through old homevideo and letters.

title: Everguest: The Veiled Inn
description: Everguest: The Veiled Inn is a dark fantasy roguelite strategy RPG with turn-based tactical combat, active dodge timing, and powerful relic and mod builds. Choose your path, manage Mana and Overflow, and survive the cursed inn’s deadly loop.

title: Forefeathers
description: Forefeathers is an atmospheric story-adventure with puzzle elements! Experience a heartfelt story as the little penguin Bokki and his ghostly Grandma work together to solve light puzzles and rekindle the memories of her past.

title: Triple Realms
description: A small relaxing roguelike puzzle city builder where you place tiles to grow small towns, gather resources, and expand your capital. Discover new buildings, unlock powerful upgrades, and shape your own evolving landscape.

title: Babushka
description: A Cozy Roguelite set in a mystical Slavic forest starring Vesna, a quest-completing babushka that thrashes mutated creatures and malicious forest spirits in Turn-Based Combat. An exciting genre mix of Farming simulation, Roguelite, and Narrative.

title: The Medieval Journey
description: The Medieval Journey is a living medieval MMORPG where generations shape the world. Build relationships, marry, raise children and continue your family's legacy through the ages. Master professions, create thriving businesses, trade across authentic historical cities and forge a dynasty.

title: Tetword
description: Tetword is a word-puzzle falling-block game across seven ancient civilizations. Rotate the whole arena, stack glyph cubes, and spell the target words to clear the board. Master real writing systems from Greek to hieroglyphs — solo or in local 2-player duels.

title: Hitherto: School of Swordcery and Shieldjuration
description: Welcome to Hitherto High, his Majesty's Magic School of Swordcery and Shieldjuration! Train your students in the ways of magic to ready them for their final exams!!

title: Museologist: Tidy Up the Museum!
description: Museologist: Tidy Up the Museum! A single-player simulation. The whole collection has fallen apart. Find where each fragment belongs, piece it back together like a puzzle, and restore 428 objects from 3,105 scattered pieces.

title: Quackyard
description: A cozy incremental farming sim about helping your duck friend clean out their backyard. Dig, mine and farm your way to clearing up the space so that a tea party with friends can be hosted.

title: Anno 117: Pax Romana – The Hippodrome
description:
Construct the Hippodrome, a monumental five-stage project that challenges your city planning and resource management skills. Once unlocked with the Patricians, it introduces chariot races as a new city event, allowing you to entertain citizens, increase your city’s splendor, and unlock more prestigious competitions.

Assign specialists to train as chariot drivers, turning anyone from a seasoned veteran to a humble baker into a potential racing champion.

title: How to Ride Elevators Like a Human
description: A chill puzzle game about an alien trying to understand one of humanity’s strangest social rules: why does everyone avoid eye contact in elevators?

title: Garage: Tidy Up!
description: Garage: Tidy Up! is a cozy first-person organizing simulator where you restore order in a messy auto workshop. Sort tools, parts, tires, paints, wires, and garage equipment into their proper zones, upgrade your skills, and turn chaos into the perfect dream garage.

title: Grass Cutter 9000: Director's Cut
description: Grass to cut, guys to meet and things to eat. Get upgrades, increase your currency and explore different locations in this short incremental Video Game.

title: Cheap Tattoo
description: Run your own tattoo shop and actually do the tattooing. Dial in voltage and needle depth, line it, shade it, wipe the blood — and keep the customer from walking out. Too shallow and the ink won't hold. Too deep and you'll hear about it.

title: Smoke Keeper
description: A cozy first-person organizing simulator where you sort 4,316 scattered items throughout a two-storey Victorian tobacconist. Put every item on its proper shelf, unlock helpful skills, and restore perfect order at your own pace—or race the clock.

title: The World's Shortest Horror Game
description: Press one button. Regret it immediately. A bite-sized analog horror comedy made to be finished in minutes, streamed for reactions, or gifted to a friend as a tiny act of betrayal. Headphones strongly recommended. Friendship not guaranteed.

title: Crafty Survivors: Wicked Winter
description: Two new characters added to the roster of the game with their unique skills and mechanics. A whole new region with its own perils to conquer and a brand new type of stage.

title: Nostalgia Game Shop: Tidy Up
description: In Nostalgia Game Shop: Tidy up you will have to organize more than 4000 copies of games from your childhood and put them in the right shelves. Relax with the nostalgic atmosphere and check out what games you can recognize. Pick up, sort, organize. Repeat!

title: No Clean, No Exit
description: A 1-6 player co-op horror comedy about cleaning. Mop the filth out of a procedurally generated house while roaches, bedbugs, and ceiling-crawling spiders try to drag you off. The truck doesn't leave until the place is spotless.

title: Surviving Mars: Relaunched - Feeding the Future
description: Follow the dreams of humanity's boldest pioneers in Surviving Mars: Relaunched "Feeding the Future". Master the art of feeding a colony and face the challenges of life on Mars. Contains new buildings, food resources, colonist traits, technologies, and laws.

title: Tails of Iron II: Blood and Brine
description: Blood and Brine, the free expansion for Tails of Iron 2: Whiskers of Winter. Leave the frozen wastes of the North behind and travel to Hardshell Brook, a coastal settlement where new characters, dangerous creatures and something altogether more sinister are waiting beneath the waves.

title: The Last Elf
description:
A dark-fantasy action RPG where the Elves fall first — and the last Elven blade must ride to protect the Kingdom of Men.

Fight through a collapsing world in stamina-driven real-time combat, level up by hunting monsters, and push through four story chapters toward a final breach into the Demon Lord’s realm.

title: Mantis Clicker
description: Mantis Clicker is a pixel-art incremental idle game about raising a magical mantis colony, battling strange creatures, and expanding a colony of your own. It combines clicking, automation, evolution, combat, crafting, farming, fishing, building, and prestige progression across a colorful world filled with quests, loot, abilities, and secrets.

title: Asdivine Knot
description: Tie the knot of fate in a skybound fantasy RPG!

title: 4096 Space Traders Era
description: Trade the galaxy. Fight for it. Rule it.

title: Y2kill
description: A top-down arcade zombie roguelite set in 99's New York City. Build broken combos, unlock a million-dollar arsenal, slay four monster bosses, and survive the party at the end of the world.

title: Water's Bounty
description: Set across a vast global map, Water's Bounty thrusts you into a sea full of nonstop dangers. You'll navigate a world dominated by the ruthless Ronek Trading Company; a commercial empire branding all independent merchants as pirates to protect their monopoly.

title: Afterlight: The Apartment
description: Explore an mid-2000s Korean apartment complex in this short first-person psychological horror experience.

title: T7's Basics in Birthday
description: Celebrate the original game but collect 7 cakes and get out to win!

title: Lovers Die
description:
Beat the Devil at his own dice game. Get out of Hell with Romeo.

Upgrade your dice, hit target scores, unlock new story branches and see where your choices take you. Inspired by Shakespeare, Dante and Baz Lurhman, alongside games like Yahtzee, Lovers Die starts with Juliet waking up in purgatory with no way out, a handful of dice, and one thing she knows for sure: Romeo got there first.

To find him, she has to play her way through Hell, making deals, taking risks and figuring out what she's willing to sacrifice for redemption. Wagers, conversations and questions all give you choices. Some open new paths. Some close them. Some have consequences you won't see coming.

title: The Last Road
description: In this narrative-driven casual strategy RPG, you take on the role of The Driver, sworn to deliver goods along The Last Road. With each journey bringing different semi randomized events to challenge the player, you will need to manage your resources carefully in order to survive.

title: Portal 2: Project 2009
description: Experience an accuracy focused nearly 1:1 recreation of Portal 2's early 2009 story. Made over the last 4 years by a team of Portal enthusiasts and beta researchers, this 2 hour long digital experience features Mel, the cut GLaDOS hub, new personality spheres and dozens of previously unseen areas.

title: Paver: Tidy Up Together
description: Transform a chaotic area into a satisfying work of art. Follow the paver layout plan and place 4,064 pavers in their correct locations. Work alone or together with friends, develop useful skills, and restore the plaza piece by piece.

title: Drive in the Rain
description: Drive in the is a horror-tinged, experiential road-movie adventure in which the story unfolds through your passengers' conversations as you drive a rain-lashed highway to your destination. Players simply keep driving down a rainy highway at night, straight toward their destination.

title: Leadville
description: Leadville is a grid-based hidden movement strategy game. Each turn, players secretly plan the movement and shot direction of their crew, trying to outmaneuver their rivals.

title: Skygate Zero
description: Explore the flooded future on your customisable Glideboard. Ride, trick, wallride and grind the wasteland, smash enemies, grab Shards, and tune your setup as you reconnect the Skyways and find your line to the impossible.

title: Ghost in the SQL Data
description: Somebody reported the fire fourteen minutes before it started. Prove it in real SQL. Learn the language from your first line, question a live evidence database, and let the records name the culprit for you.

title: Burst Noir: Fireworks Simulator
description: Burst Noir is a fireworks show design simulation where the night sky becomes your canvas. Choose fireworks with different colors and shapes, arrange them on a timeline, complete missions to unlock more, and watch your finished show unfold over mountains and water.

title: Mask It
description: Mask It is a black-comedy adventure about manufacturing outrage by "editing" the news. As a fresh news editor, your job is to give dull everyday news a little "touch-up" and turn it into a viral sensation no one can look away from!

title: Sword of Mine
description: Sword of Mine is a skill-based platformer where you play as a sword, and you have to climb your way up into the sky by balancing, jumping and swinging yourself from platform to platform until you reach your goal! Time your jumps, manage your strength, grab onto ledges, and use the platforms' unique mechanics to reach the top.

title: Pravda: Concept25
description: Pravda is a narrative stealth-puzzle about journalism under a totalitarian regime. You play Saga, a state-branded “Liar” working for the Resistance to bring down the Party. Your task is clear: Collect information. Craft the truth. Change the world. But in Abil-Gudit, every truth has a cost.

title: No Cook Today
description: A classic 2D platformer action jumping, shooter PVP game. Player 1 and 2 play as two little chefs who use various foods to battle. On this food continent, the goal is to shoot down the other party and keep staying on platformer. Many food-related weapons and props are for you to explore!

title: Shopping Cart Pusher
description: Experience the supermarket version of Grand Theft "Shopping Cart"! This is no easy job. You'll need plenty of patience, a sharp mind, and nimble hands to become a qualified shopping cart pusher, otherwise, I guarantee you'll never find all the carts!

title: She Doesn't Know
description: A visual novel set in Japan in 1999. You relive a single day in the lives of Haruka and Shiho, two high school sophomores.

title: I Thought I Knew You
description: A coming-of-age yuri visual novel set in a university. Players take on the role of a female protagonist and deepen their relationships with three girls. The game features a multi-ending format where the story branches based on the player's choices.

title: T-Shirt Kingdom
description: Driven by boundless creativity, this is an idle game where every visual element—from the storefront to the battlefield—is yours to design. Paired with a deep strategic core that spawns endless idle and combat builds, T-Shirt Kingdom places the art of creation and warfare entirely in your hands.

title: Idle Squares
description: Claim tiles one by one in this cozy idle fantasy strategy game. Harvest resources, unlock upgrades, and prestige to grow stronger, then automate it all. No single path to victory. Click your way across each map or play hands-free. Clear every tile, complete every map, and conquer the whole Atlas.

title: Little Doll Village
description: A Wretch travels to the Holy Land in search of a good time.

title: Blasterbug: Last Bug Standing
description: Bzz bzz! Hop in chaotic bomb-fueled battles inspired by arcade action classics we all love! Blaster up to 8 players locally with ant-astics Pome-grenades in this bomb-em-up party game and bee the last bug standing!

title: Union of Rivals
description: A deep colony sim and city builder. Manage resources and production chains to build the railroad from East to West. Found towns, harvest and refine the goods that fuel the line, then persuade or outlast the settlements in your path. Every citizen has a name, a trait, and a breaking point.

title: Ninja JajaMaru Yokai Night Parade
description: Ninja JaJaMaru-kun returns in a yokai-filled hack-and-slash action game! Stray into a dungeon party, defeat dancing yokai, master flashy Ninpo, and amass an arsenal of ninja gear! Clear special "Yokai Night Parade" rules for loot, decorate your base for stat boosts and save Princess Sakura!

title: Sanitarium Enhanced
description: The timeless psychological horror point-and-click adventure Sanitarium returns with new enhancements. Originally released in 1998 and named Adventure Game of the Year, Sanitarium Enhanced adds full controller support, quality of life improvements, and never-before-seen bonus materials.

title: Infested DX
description: Escape a space nightmare as the sole survivor of an alien infestation. Search for clues and solve puzzles as you avoid deadly encounters with zombies, mutants, robots and unseen alien pathogens. Find a cure and a way home in this retro point and click adventure!

title: Dokimon Quest: II
description: "Maiko, we're coming for you!" ー Dive into the past in a direct sequel to Dokimon Quest. Travel between the modern world and Edo period Japan to save your friend in this GBC-era Monster Tamer JRPG!

title: Alien Breed 35th Anniversary
description: The breed is back! Celebrate 35 years of Alien Breed with the definitive collection. Featuring 6 classic games, interactive archives, modern controls, visual enhancements, co-op multiplayer, Online Rush Mode and Horde Mode, bringing the complete sci-fi horror legacy back to your screens.

title: Drive of the Dead
description: An online co-op auto-shooter roguelite: drive a gun-covered car through endless zombie hordes with up to 3 friends. Auto-firing weapons, run-shaping upgrade cards, and a swarm that never stops. Crush thousands. Survive the road. Save the worst B-movie ever made.

title: Ecstatica
description: Ecstatica is a pioneering survival-horror adventure set in the demon-cursed medieval village of Tirich. Explore a world rendered entirely from ellipsoids, sneak past or fight off nightmarish creatures, solve puzzles, and lift the curse.

title: The Unworthy
description: What if Hell made a mistake? Based on the testimony of a man who survived clinical death, this cinematic psychological horror challenges you to confront your fears and fight your way back to life, while something lurking in the darkness does everything it can to keep you among the damned forever.

title: Pokémon Survivor Burst
description:
Pokémon Survivors Burst is a free, unofficial Pokémon fan game focused on survival-action gameplay. Players control a Pokémon directly while facing increasingly dangerous enemy waves, gaining experience and choosing upgrades and abilities throughout each run. The game features multiple playable characters, progression challenges, boss encounters, Classic and Rush game modes, and online leaderboards.
Pokémon Survivors Burst is a non-commercial fan project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Nintendo, Game Freak, Creatures Inc. or The Pokémon Company.

title: Moon Shop Simulator
description:
Moon Shop Simulator is a first-person management game where you run a small shop beneath the lunar surface.

From your terminal, order goods from Earth, manage cargo taxes, receive deliveries, organize your stock in numbered racks, and prepare customer orders.

Each product has its own weight, volume, and size. Your purchasing, storage, and shipping decisions directly affect your shop’s profitability.

title: Borrowed Sight
description: A mysterious epidemic violently killed millions in hours. Sealed inside a darkened van, your only connection to the silent, altered city is a damaged remote-controlled car. Navigate using coordinates, angles, and camera feeds to uncover the truthwithout drawing the attention of what remains.

title: Scawy Game
description: Kenguin Sting, a failed horror writer, buys a cheap asset-store house to write his masterpiece. His only job: feed the cats. And keep Grandma on her pills. And survive 4 days and 4 nights. An absurd parody horror game.

title: The Forge: Steel Frontier
description: The Forge is a mech-combat sci-fi action game. Step into the cockpit as mercenary pilot Ivan and fight alongside a mech with a soul—Machine Spirit. Dormant Dragon holds a strange and rare mineral. When wolves come for the ore, you and your mech must choose, and planet's fate hangs in the balance.

title: Take Me to Your Leader
description:
Deploy Brain Slugs around the Globe to Save the World from itself.

A Survivors-like on planet Earth, where you Capture Locations designated by Name, Flag, Stats, and More. Fend off Earth's meager resistance by upgrading your ship's weapons systems. Unlock new characters, each with different missions, abilities, and priorities!

title: Smashing Bottles
description: Smashing Bottles is a short and satisfying incremental game where you break bottles to earn money, upgrade your bat, discover new bottles, and cause chaos! Will you smash enough bottles to buy the universe?

title: Kritzel Krieg
description: Kritzelkrieg is Age of War on squared notebook paper – except you draw your whole army yourself.

title: Mega Merge
description: Mega Merge is a cosy fruit-merging roguelite. Drop, combine and grow fruit while drafting from 400+ modifiers to create wild builds, exploit powerful synergies, manage curses and chase ever-higher scores.

title: Night Society
description: Night Society is a card-based dungeon crawler where reckless teenagers with supernatural powers fight against paranormal creatures as they search for the hidden source of evil and attempt to eradicate it before it destroys their hometown.

title: Infinite Hole Sim Remix
description:
Infinite Hole Sim Remix has been remixed to offer a better experience over the original.

Infinite Hole Sim Remix is a ONCE IN A LIFETIME experience, fall down a hole, and keep falling FOREVER!

title: OverInfected
description: OverInfected is a tactical roguelike auto battler featuring parasite management mechanics, where your life is on a timer. The stronger you are, the faster your ‘weapon’ kills you. Death isn’t an option – it’s a core gameplay element. During a run, you’ll need to find hosts to transfer into, freeing yourself from your problems. Sooner or later, your life will start all over again.

title: Echoes From Below
description: Lead a guild of hunters in this tactical dungeon-crawler RPG where personal bonds of love, rivalry and grief shape your tactics, and permadeath makes every loss matter. How many will you bring home?

title: Ylem's Cat
description: Ylem’s Cat is an action-adventure game driven by the bond between a girl and her cat. Led by curiosity and knowledge, Molly sets out on a journey to find her missing mother across a dying planet, exploring ruins and uncovering the truth buried within the giants.

title: Meowdventure
description: Meowdventure - is an Adventure RPG Game where, as Phil, you must overcome all the obstacles, puzzles, enemies, in your path to return from a lucid dream back to reality!

title: Stay in Your Lane
description: Stay in Your Lane is a side-scrolling real-time strategy game inspired by Age of War and Swords & Soldiers. Mine gold, research your tech tree, summon idiom-powered units that march and fight on their own, and cast spells to turn the tide. Story campaign, puzzle challenges, and online 1v1 and 2v2.

title: Artificial Bloodline
description: Artificial Bloodline is a single-player horror escape game. Explore an abandoned hospital, scavenge for resources, and use your environment to evade terrifying monsters as you search for an escape route and uncover the secrets hidden within. Escape before it's too late!

title: Cauldron Chaos: Brew Potions & Tidy Up
description: Cauldron Chaos: Brew Potions & Tidy Up is an alchemy organization game enjoyable solo or co-op. Clean up 1000+ ingredients, refine them in multiple ways and brew almost 200 unique recipes to place them into correct shelves to transform the laboratory into a place filled with harmony & peace.

title: Cycle01
description: A minimalist game about washing contaminated laundry. Wash, sell, upgrade, and buy new equipment. Keep the contamination in check. A small mystery is waiting for you at the end.

title: Dub Night Live
description: Grab a mic and redub the internet. Dub Night Live mutes the cast of a short clip and hands the roles to you and up to 8 friends. Everyone records at once, nobody hears anyone, then the whole party watches the finished cut together. Build your own clips with the in-app editor.

title: Wolcen II
description: Many years after Wolcen: Lords of Mayhem, return to a world on the brink of collapse. Master brutal combat, build your character without fixed classes, combine skills and gear, and unleash your Shadow Form in this dark fantasy Action RPG. Play alone or in co-op.

title: Muumit ja näkymätön lapsi
description: A game based on the short story "The Invisible Child" by Tove Jansson. You play as the invisible child, Ninny, and with the help from Moominmamma, you try to become visible again.

title: Stories Once Told: Echoes of Valor
description: Cut your way through dark dungeons and solve riddles and puzzles, all from a first-person perspective. Choose your hero, master the tactical combat system, and face merciless bosses in solo mode or co-op.

title: Hunter's Journey: Nightmare Hunting - Collector's Edition
Quinn
description: Quinn is a chaotic 1–4 player co-op & solo game set in a high-tech AI research facility. Monitor the lab through your tablet, operate physical control panels, work together, and deal with whatever goes wrong. Quinn is always watching.

title: Elta: Defy All Gods
description: Brawl your way out of corrupted worlds alongside your dragon-god companion in an adrenaline-fueled action-platformer blending free-form melee combat, fluid platforming and sci-fi exploration. Become the champion of your fallen god, Elta.

title: Dynasty Basketball Manager
description: A basketball manager game without the fuss. Your players are your deck. A unique blend of sports management, roguelikes, and deckbuilders: draft, trade, and upgrade cards, choose perks, and play thrilling card battles instead of watching simulations. Create a dynasty from any team!

title: Snatcher: Peculiar Deliveries
description: You are tasked with fighting your way to snatch and deliver anything your mysterious patron demands. Use your surroundings to gain the edge over your enemies, as you never know what might come in handy in this hand-drawn, fantasy FPS boomer shooter.

title: Train Sim World 7
description: Live life on the tracks and discover the joy of train simulation. Whether looking for a relaxing run on the rails or seeking the thrill of mastering your virtual train driver career, find your way in Train Sim World 7.

title: Final Footage
description: Find what doesn't belong. Capture the evidence. Survive what finds you. Final Footage is a psychological horror game where you investigate anomalies, hide from the Knocker, upgrade your equipment, and unlock increasingly dangerous locations.

title: Junkpot
description: A roguelike about bidding blind on sealed storage crates. Read the odds, buy the crate, then stack charms that multiply what falls out. Type combos, rarity bonuses and odds boosts compound into one engine. Build it fast — the quota doubles every round.

title: Unsealed: Vigil
description: Stuck in a wheelchair. A bell in your hand. Horrors in the darkness. Find them. Ring the bell. Don’t let them reach you. Escape the nightmare. Wake up.

title: Worms Galactic Tactics
description: Worms makes an explosive leap into tactical roguelike combat! Battle across destructible arenas, mod classic weapons and unleash devastating strategic combos as you fight for survival, riches and glory!

title: Overthinking
description: The world seems to collapse and Black chooses confinement. Holding onto a last hope, he seeks to prevent suffering before everything dies. But the refuge crumbles and his own mind gives way. A claustrophobic experience where the greatest threat lives with you.

title: RollerCoaster Tycoon Wonderworks
description: It’s the grand opening of a new RollerCoaster Tycoon, featuring new levels of chaos and wonder as you do whatever it takes to keep guests happy (and injury-free). Customize rides, manage guests, and build wild roller coasters in your theme parks as you boost profits and expand your empire.

title: Village Incremental
description: Village Incremental is an incremental game where you harvest resources and grow your village and research tools.

title: CQ: Calling Any Station
description: An idle/incremental game about a lone radio operator keying into a silent universe. Click or walk away, both work just as well. Build your station, log distant contacts, retune to grow stronger, and slowly decode what answers back.

title: Battle Meating
description: Survive without getting burned! BATTLE MEATING is a local multiplayer party game for 1–4 players. Become a Meat and fight to be the last one standing. Bring your controllers and battle with up to 4 players locally. Enjoy a wacky, chaotic meat party!

title: Acornia: Mirror Worlds
description: Acornia: Mirror Worlds is a bake-and-brawl management adventure game! Run your shop in one dimension, fight angry spirits in the other. Your special skill? Stuffing your bottomless cheek pouches with treats - to plate up or shoot up enemies!

title: Gravhounds
description: Gravhounds is a 1–4 player co-op action builder. Drop into hostile planets as a pack, build and defend your base in physics-driven mayhem, and extract with everything you can carry before you become alien chow. The longer you stay, the greater the danger... and the rewards.

title: Murals
description: These are not the tales you were told. Express yourself through stylized combat in the hand-painted worlds of Murals, a twisted isometric action-adventure where fairytales have gone spectacularly wrong.

title: Creator Shelter
description: Build an underground shelter for content creators. Recruit new talent, construct specialized rooms, manage your resources and grow your operation into a thriving creator empire.

title: Humankind II
description: Build a civilization that spans the ages in this historical turn-based strategy game. Combine evolving cultures, raise cities, command armies and expand your empire as a changing climate reshapes the world and your path through history.

title: Pops
description: Pops is a physics-based puzzle roguelike about managing limited moves and building broken synergies. Pop potions, hit massive score quotas, and draft passive skills to create game-breaking chain reactions.

title: Age Twisters
description: Age Twisters is a 2-player co-op narrative adventure game that allows you to send a free invite to friends via the Friend’s Pass. Play as a grandfather and granddaughter to solve puzzles by freely changing your age and reveal the dark secrets hidden beneath a facade of lies.

title: Deadline: Afterlife Processing
description: The dead wait in line. You run the press. Read each soul, judge it, seal it and get paid for it. Tired of doing it yourself? The catalog has machines that'll do the work for you. Management recommends it. Management appreciates your cooperation.

title: Guardians of Dreamstate
description: Guardians of Dreamstate TCG is a fantasy trading card game where both players share every turn. Draw, Set, LVL UP and battle across five lanes every turn. Your goal of the game is simple, damage your opponents 7 card life deck while they have none remaining and you win the game!

title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow 6 Tactics
description: Tom Clancy’s Rainbow Six Tactics is a turn-based tactical game set in the R6 universe. Command operator squads in tense battles, execute synchronized breaches, exploit destruction, and unravel a conspiracy.

title: Memeology Club
description: For 3-6 players! Play from anywhere in the world. Get together online, talk with built-in voice chat, and laugh like you're all sitting at the same table.

title: Smile Your Day
description: Two Players, Two Perspectives, One Cult. You and a friend explore the opulent cult known as Lifted Spirits in Boston, 2014. One player is the Hacker, controlling the cult's cameras and communications. With their aid, the other player stealths around the office hoping to discover the cult's secrets.

title: Groundwork
description: The humans are coming. Someone has to get the place ready. Scan what grows here, gather and mine. Repair the robots from crashed ships, and they'll teach you new recipes and take over jobs. Build a new home for the humans, and a home for the robots you found. No combat, no timer, no fail screen.

title: Graventh
description: Descend into dangerous caves, mine valuable resources, fight deadly creatures and escape with your loot. Upgrade your gear, expand your underground safe zone and push deeper each run. The greater the risk, the greater the reward.

title: See the Sky
description: Sometimes the only way to rewrite the past is to relive it. A visual novel in the genre of detective and psychological thriller, where you do not investigate crimes but the psyche and memories of the main characters.

title: Armed-Mageddon
description: Grab some guns, mow down endless enemies and grow insanely powerful! Equip outrageous weapons, level up with game-changing upgrades, and create devastating synergies as you blast your way through the end of the world!

title: Exterminauts
description: Exterminauts is a co-op third-person PvE shooter using weaponized power tools and mad-science gadgets to exterminate alien pests. Take on MegaCorp contracts amid energy supremacy clashes, while aliens' thirst for Polymorphic Plasma disrupts plans. Punch In. Clean Up. Get Paid.

title: Shuriken Maestro
description: An incremental game where you're a novice with the sword. Lucky for you, shurikens are more your specialty. Defeat enemies using your shurikens, hone your skills, upgrade your arsenal, and progress through increasingly challenging zones.

title: Card Revolution Soccer
description: Card Revolution Soccer is a football card game that simulates on-field action through simple card reveals via clicking on them. Level up entire nations or yourself as a Head-coach and play World Tour- or Cup-Modes. Fine-tune the gameplay to your liking with customizable sliders.

title: Schedule: Rehab Business
description: Play in co-op at the worst rehab center in town. Manage patients, deal with disasters, and try to help everyone recover without losing control.

title: Dust Origins
description: DUST: Origins is an isometric horror shooter set aboard a doomed orbital prison platform, imagined by the creators of Darksiders. Abruptly freed from cryo-prison, you fight to escape a murderer’s row of violent criminals and horrifying monsters before the station tears itself apart.

title: Cable Arrange
description: Every room has one outlet on the wall, two to eight appliances, and cables that do not reach. Plug power strips into power strips, run extension cords across the floor, and turn on everything in the room. An isometric puzzle game with no timer, no score, and no way to fail.

title: Extravalence
description: Lead a party of living chemical elements through a fractured world where every bond changes the battle. Switch between unique heroes, combine their abilities, manage volatile reactions and restore the stability.

title: Voidhold
description: A sci-fi horde-survival roguelite. Lead a four-soldier fireteam, a combat dog and an eagle-drone against endless escalating waves. Chain run-altering synergies, push through 10 biomes, and hold the line at the edge of the void.

title: KnitBone
description: KnitBone is a story-driven psychological horror visual novel, where the therapist is more traumatized than the patient.

title: 1001 Threads of Mizan
description:
A 1-3 person cooperative action‑adventure set in a sprawling Arabian fantasy world.
Soar across mythic landscapes on nimble flying carpets, battle colossal jinn that tower above the world, and unravel a tale of betrayal that threatens to tear the world apart. Inspired by One Thousand and One Nights, this is a shared journey where exploration, combat, and storytelling are woven into a single, unforgettable experience.

title: Mistport
description: Mistport sets you as a booth inspector, in a gloomy Victorian city. Inspect documents for ships that pull into the misty harbor, identify suspicious individuals, and uncover mysteries that will shape the city’s fate. Stay loyal to your post or venture into the mists of insanity. The choice is yours.

title: Ghost Express
description: "Ghost Express" is a 2D storage-organizing puzzle game about Spooky, a ghost who's too cute to scare anyone. Pack each shop's goods one by one into the box grid, then deliver them to the apartment nearby. As goods pile up and boxes fill, can Spooky complete the challenge?

title: First Draft
description: First Draft is an arcade flight shooter where you enter intense aerial battles with enemy paper airplanes, survive challenging encounters, and take on powerful bosses as you push your piloting skills to the limit.

title: Little Bettas
description: Little Bettas is a cozy pixel-art simulation game focused on breeding, genetics, collecting, and caring for betta fish. Players can create genetic lines, discover new colors, patterns and mutations, decorate aquariums, care for their fish, expand their collection, and learn real facts about bettas along the way.

title: Stack Together: To the Moon
description: Work together to build towering structures and reach the Moon! Build massive towers, launch rockets, slow down the incoming meteor, and discover anomaly boxes to keep your structure balanced. A chaotic physics-based co-op adventure for up to 4 players!

title: LEGO Skylines
description: Build what only you can in LEGO Skylines. In this cozy, customizable city-builder, your choices bring a living, breathing metropolis to life. Go big or obsess over the details. No instructions. Unlimited space. And there’s just one rule. Make it yours.

title: Cat a Loop
description: Lead a cat in a tactical roguelike auto-battler! Fight your way through 4 dangerous biomes, combine 200+ items to create powerful synergies, and unlock passive abilities. Unravel the mystery of the portal, defeat unique bosses, and save the feline world from the encroaching evil!

title: Heroes of Might and Magic III Remake
description: Rediscover the critically acclaimed turn-based strategy classic and its two expansions, faithfully rebuilt in full 3D and 4K. Explore a vibrant fantasy world and lead mighty heroes in epic battles.

title: Fall of the Void
description: Fall of the Void is a dark fantasy isometric ARPG merging high-octane hack-and-slash combat with deep build crafting. Descend into perilous dungeons across fractured realms, master evolving abilities, and forge devastating power synergies to shape your destiny.

title: Provinces
description: Provinces is a compact turn-based strategy game about leading your one and only army across a medievalish war board. Roll for Action Points, cut enemy supply lines, storm rival capitals and watch your tiny soldiers deal with the consequences in fast, automatic battles.

title: Notary Block
description: Notary Block is a 48 player party game in a Hong Kong twin-tower estate rebuilt from a real block. Physics grab and throw; hide bodies in a blackout. Keys or a true vote open the ground gatenot a team win. Your night report: left, died, or failed to leave?

title: Chill Drive Together
description: An endless road that builds itself as you drive, and no reason to hurry down it. Playable with 1 or 2 players. Press B and the world around you changes on the spot, with no loading. Rain, snow, night skies, real traffic, photo mode.

title: Farmbound
description: An addictive idle farming simulation where you build a massive agricultural empire from a single wheat plot. Harvest crops, adopt cute animals, automate production, unlock powerful skills, and prestige to multiply your yields into astronomical profits.

title: Tarae: The Unbound
description: TARAE: The Unbound is an action RPG set in an Eastern dark fantasy world. Explore Taegwido, an island born upon the shattered boundaries of the Six Realms, and master the distinct combat styles and builds of six unique classes.

title: Like or Die
description: A team-based survival FPS where streamers clash in a fierce battle for survival. Cosmic platform "Quaya Stream" broadcasts your every moment live. Reshape the battlefield with blocks and create new twists. In a world where wins and deaths become content, the survival stream is about to begin.

title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered
description:
The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered modernizes the acclaimed role-playing game with a range of upgrades and enhancements. Become monster slayer for hire Geralt of Rivia and journey across a dark fantasy open world in an epic quest to find your adopted daughter Ciri.

The Remastered update is free for players who own The Witcher 3 and includes both Hearts of Stone and Blood and Wine expansions.

title: Capital City
description: Capital City combines city, resource, and transport management within an infinite steampunk fantasy world. Mine resources, build factories and logistics networks. Transport raw and processed materials and goods to your city to ensure it keeps growing and expanding.

title: Production City
description: Production City is a city builder focused on manufacturing, logistics, and politics. Build efficient production chains, make impactful (or questionable) decisions, and grow your city into an industrial empire!

title: Bam Ball
description: Aim, shoot, and dominate: In this pinball-inspired roguelike, you defeat enemies through precise ricochets and combine abilities into explosive synergies. Every shot can trigger a chain reaction that determines victory or defeat.

title: Flying Pigs
description: Become part of the Flying Pigs and free the world from tyranny. Face the enemy of freedom in this unique shoot 'em up set in the skies of World War II. Eyes up, rookie! It's time for pigs to take flight!

title: My Fairy Princess
description: My Fairy Princess is a life sim set in an Eastern fantasy world, featuring multiple endings. You take on the role of a parent, raising your daughter in a fabled realm of spiritual beauty and tranquility. How will you guide your daughter into an uncertain future?

title: Olimpia OT
description: Olimpia OT is a Greek mythology-inspired MMORPG that combines classic Tibia-style gameplay with modern RPG systems and original content. Players explore a dangerous world inspired by the myths of Olympus, choose their vocation and divine allegiance, fight monsters and powerful bosses, discover dungeons, craft and upgrade equipment, and develop their characters through unique progression systems. Olimpia OT features eight distinct vocations, Divine Paths, a Devotion system, custom combat mechanics, ranked monsters, crafting, item upgrades, arenas, PvE and PvP content, and a persistent online world.

title: For Honor: Arakure - Hero
description:
The Arakure Hero offer includes:

- 1 New Hero: Arakure
- 1 Ornament
- 1 Elite Outfit
- 7-Day Champion Status (extra XP, extra loot, and more)
- 3 Scavenger Crates with random gear

Live by your own rules and rely on your instincts. Take on multiple opponents and fight dirty to steal another victory. Wielding tonfas, Arakure packs a punch. Her brazen personality brings a unique perspective to the Samurai faction and with weapons never seen before, she is not afraid to do what it takes to win a fight. Explosive, scrappy, Arakure will hit you where it hurts.

title: Unclaimed: Loot or Junk
description: Unbox. Sort. Collect. Become a master of discovery by exploring unclaimed packages. Complete every set, from vintage gadgets to "Golden Junk". Sell piles of everyday items to buy new shipments and hunt for truly rare treasures. What will you find in the next box?

title: Pierce Through Heavens
description: Pierce Through Heavens is an open-world multiplayer RPG inspired by Chinese mythology and xianxia literature. Gather rare resources, craft potent elixirs, and cultivate ancient martial arts to survive the continent’s many dangers and rise as an immortal.

title: Hector Dinger
description: Press space to hit the bell to time the letters of the word! Letters scroll left when the right letter is under the pointer!

title: Fusty Dungeon
description: Travel the land and explore a dungeon with two beautiful ladies to find the cure to your childhood friend’s curse.

title: Breakout Garage
description: Breakout Garage is an open-world driving and racing simulator built around old-school American muscle, deep tuning, drag racing, and the garage life.

title: HopScout
description: HopScout is a cozy logic puzzle game about arranging cute, picky rabbits to keep everyone happy. Take your time solving puzzles, help the rabbit burrow overcome a looming crisis, and discover the heartwarming stories of its adorable residents.

title: Moo-A-Doodle-Doo
description: Transform into anything. Sound like anything. Fool your friends in this chaotic multiplayer party game.

title: From Below
description: A first-person mystery horror game where you explore a mysterious mansion, interact with objects, collect evidence and records, and uncover the truth behind a past incident.

title: Tatlone
description: Our protagonist lives an ordinary life, yet something continues to spark their curiosity. One day, a close friend calls and invites them to visit a place where their grandmother also lives. Before long, they begin working on a shared project together.

title: Rotting Grief
description: A short psychological-horror narrative in which your choices matter. Journey through the give stages of grief as Liam, a man who just recently lost his wife due to... unknown... circumstances.

title: Poncik's Little Tragedy
description: Explore an abandoned theater consumed by a mysterious fungal infestation. Use Poncik Bot to solve puzzles, restore power, and uncover the secrets hidden within. Something terrible happened here, and the truth is still waiting to be found.

title: Doors Closed
description: To save your sick son, you take a job as a security inspector at a secretive lab, the very place rumored to be causing his illness. Inspect IDs, scan for contraband, and weed out impostors. Do your job, earn your paycheck, and save your family. Just don't let the wrong people in.

title: My Friend, the Wickhorn
description: A first-person psychological horror where you care for your cat, maintain an isolated mountain cabin, and uncover the link between your father’s secret past and the ancient curse that has taken hold of your friend.

title: Pokémon Plasma
description:
Welcome to Luminaria, a radiant island where the laws of nature are enforced by the powerful Plasma Police. As a newly graduated Pokémon Trainer, you set out to challenge the region's Gyms while meeting allies, rivals and many other characters along the way.
Pokémon Plasma expands on the classic Pokémon formula with criminal captures, raids, crafting, side quests, mini-games, an enhanced Shiny system and a more developed Trainer career path. Players can explore the region, train Pokémon from multiple generations and continue into a challenging post-game.
Pokémon Plasma is a free, unofficial and non-commercial Pokémon fan game.

title: Crime Simulator: Playgrounds
description: Crime Simulator: Playgrounds is a short, chaotic, and hilarious entry in the Crime Simulator franchise. Throw hammers, spray pepper gas, and cause mayhem solo or with up to 4 players. Take over hideouts, complete absurd missions, and unleash destruction with the wildest weapons. No rules—just fun!

title: Crossed Parallel Lines Murder Case
description: Do you believe that parallel worlds really exist? An ordinary college student, Chen Chou, wakes up one day to find himself transported aboard a space research vessel. The strangers on the ship all claim to know him. Could it be that he has crossed over into a parallel world...

title: Message From Aliens
description: In year 2057, Earth received a large number of mysterious symbols from space. Who are they? Where are they from? And more importantly, what are they talking about?

title: Relicfall
description: Forge your own class in this Bullet Heaven Action Roguelite. Combine 3 professions to shape a unique skill tree, hunt for powerful loot, and socket relics to create game-breaking synergies. Slay endless hordes and push your build to its limits.

title: Queen Of The Sands
description: Set in a fantasy world, “The Sand Queen” is a challenging, traditional turn-based roguelike. The man-eating wolf sets out on a journey to protect Little Red Riding Hood.

title: Minato
description: Minato combines classic minesweeper with roguelike elements. Progress through increasingly challenging stages, discover unique items, and face guardians that add unexpected twists before proceeding to the next floor.

title: Unicycle Journey
description: One wheel. Many challenges. Grab your unicycle, overcome tough obstacles, and make it to the end — alone or with friends.

title: Fuwa! Fuwa! Omurice Simulator Roguelite
description: Run a tiny omurice diner in a business-sim roguelite. By day, serve orders in a rhythm game (auto-play available). By night: loans, investments, hiring. Global crises hit hard; shelves and share prices ride on the seed. Profit, bankruptcy, or another kind of happiness? Survive raging capitalism.

title: Inseco
description: Para sobrevivir a un mundo agonizante, debes presenciar el fin de la humanidad. Vive un tenso horror point-and-click donde cada decisión brutal sella tu destino. Mientras el mundo muta en un monstruo, ¿cuánta de tu humanidad sacrificarás para sobrevivir al enjambre?

title: Dorc
description: In a world ruled by »them«, Dorc's grandpa has a plan: a time machine. But when a jump goes wrong, Dorc is stranded across time. Change the past to shape the future in this story-driven adventure platformer with cute characters and clever time mechanics.

title: Hijinks High
description: Hijinks High turns an average school day into a disaster with up to five friends. Pull off ridiculous classroom objectives, hold off the faculty with your own bodily fluids, and make the bus before the janitor drags you to detention. Then go home to the Cul-De-Sack and do it again tomorrow.

title: Wishseeker
description: Wishseeker is a turn-based tactical roguelite where you lead a party of four Wishseekers into the ever-changing Hollow Vault. Master fast-paced grid-based combat, craft unique builds with skills and artifacts, and uncover the truth behind the corruption lurking beneath every expedition.

title: Diplomacy is Not an Option: Fog of War
description: Fog of War is a DLC for the Diplomacy is Not an Option. In the new story campaign, you’ll build cities, conquer strongholds, and defend against waves of enemy hordes in epic battles. Continue the story of the Ironbrow dynasty and help the young Prince save the long-suffering Samreignia.

title: BlazePunk
description: In BlazePunk, you have to fight a conformist corpo-cult that keeps your city under its authoritarian grip. Skate through the city, disrupt cult gatherings by hijacking brainwashing speakers and fight their enforcers to liberate the people and ignite resistance.

title: G-Hell
description: G-Hell is a fast-paced sci-fi action roguelike that blends massive survivors-style horde battles with strategic inventory management. Every run sends you into a different world devoured by a cosmic entity. Create powerful strategies through item combinations and embrace a mission with no return!

title: Taro Is Back
description: A video you must never play. What happened to the influencer who vanished?

title: Fathomless
description: Survive the deep. Build and manage a nomadic underwater colony in a retro-futuristic ocean world. Resources are finite, forcing your colony ever deeper into the deadly abyss.

title: Ripgraze
description: A few-minute deep-sea score attack. Flip gravity to rise or dive, graze reefs and jellyfish to charge OVERDRIVE, then spend it for a burst of slow-motion scoring. Playing it safe is the losing move. The deeper you go, the more the ocean changes.

title: OmOchim
description: Build machines, contraptions and playgrounds out of everyday objects in a physics sandbox driven by visual programming. Overcome obstacles, save the city, create worlds. Every goal has a dozen answers. Every crash, collapse and explosion is just the next idea.

title: Hush Darling
description: Hush Darling is a psychological point-and-click narrative game inspired by classic makeup and dress-up games. Follow a young woman as she uses makeup to hide the visible signs of an abusive relationship, while the cute facade gradually gives way to a much darker reality.

title: Lumiere
description: At the core of everything in Lumiere is Light and Shadow. Journey as Soleil and Umbra as they embark on a mission to unite a beautiful world lost to darkness. With drop-in co-op play, a second player can join the adventure and uncover the mysteries of the land together.

title: Confined Space
description: Pilot a customizable spaceship, battle through procedurally generated arenas, and adapt your build with modular abilities to survive escalating enemy waves in this fast-paced 2D top-down roguelike shoot em up

title: The Necessary Evil
description: The Necessary Evil is a tactical RPG about making difficult decisions and preparing for the unpredictable. Lead "volunteers" into the dark and rotting recesses of the collective unconscious, colonized and industrialized and plundered for profit. Every decision matters, and every choice has a cost.

title: Limes 235
description: A historically grounded single-player point-and-click adventure that blends narrative-driven exploration, role-based perspective shifts, and puzzle solving into an emotional rollercoaster of contrasting storylines and moral choice.

title: Derby Life: Ranch & Race
description: Derby Life: Ranch & Race is where great racehorses are made, not born. Breed, raise, and train your own on a living open-world ranch, then saddle up and race the World Tour. Roam, fish, explore, compete. Your ranch, your horse, your glory.

title: Rat King Adventure
description: Rat King Adventure, or RKA is a multiplatform roguelike game and an exciting reimagining of Rat King PD 2, where every run is different, but still blessed by the glorious Rat King! Enter the dangerous dungeons as one of 7 playable characters, interact with their inhabitants, defeat powerful rat-like creatures, and try not to die (the hardest task (maybe not))!

title: Infernal West
description: Infernal West is a first-person psychological horror puzzle game set in a Wild West saloon. Observe every detail, identify the anomalies warping reality, and unravel the mysteries hidden within an endless loop. Every decision may bring you closer to the exit... or trap you in the loop forever.

title: Girl!Panic!!!
description: A cozy narrative game about going on an online date with your crush as a massive nerd~

title: Kayak Photography Sim
description: A meditative kayaking and photography sim. Open water, a slow boat, and nowhere you have to be. Paddle until you feel like stopping, photograph whatever catches your eye, dive underwater to explore what's down there. Nothing chases you. Nothing is timed. You're just chilling and exploring.

title: Grandma's Guide to the Grand Outside
description: Grandma calls for aid! Well she wants a visit, but she lives in the middle of nowhere. Pack wisely, step into the wilderness, and see if you can reach her!

title: Drone Tanks
description: Battle through high-energy 3D arenas, forge powerful upgrade synergies, and master fast-paced combat in a roguelite built for endless replayability. Pilot a flying tank, bonk enemies with a massive hammer, and take on bosses whose attacks are orchestrated by the soundtrack itself.

title: Bonk Voyage
description: You and your friends are fearless space couriers delivering cargo to bizarre and exotic planets. Pilot the trusty old Croakpit, parkour across asteroids in zero gravity, and avoid getting bonked into the cold, dark void of space. Ready to tackle the universe's most dangerous delivery job?

title: Abraca Drunk
description: A gaggle of (mana-)drunk wizards try to get home after a long night out. In their inebriated state, they accidentally bring random objects around them to life - oh no! Play with your friends in this 4-Person Co-Op Roguelite, and defeat the creatures to help everyone get back home!

title: World of Slime
description: World of Slime is a casual MMORPG where you capture, collect, and grow with all kinds of slimes. Find new slimes through field capture, synthesis, and fishing, then take them with you into battles, exploration, and puzzles.

title: Conquista: Tide of Wills
description: Conquista a strategy game that blends colony sim w/ 4X gameplay. Build thriving cities and lead your nation to dominance. With living units who work, build relationships, and pursue ambitions of their own, you must respond to their desires. The seeds of history may be sown through one's dreams.

title: Koinori
description: koᴉnori - an ambient and cozy cooperative summer adventure for two, - solve puzzles shaped by light and shadows together, in a world inspired by Japanese aesthetics and cooled with watercolor touches.

title: Hexgarden
description: Hexgarden is a peaceful base-building game where you place plants from your deck next to one another to increase your magical power and withstand the ever returning frost. Explore the mist surrounding your garden, unlock magical relics, and improve your plants.

title: Bet on Beta
description: A roguelike deckbuilder where your team is so chaotic that every sprint is like playing on a slot machine. Hire coworker cards for your deck, staff them on the machine, and spin for tickets, epics, and OKRs. From garage startup to IPO.

title: Dumpster Gang
description: Play as a gang of mischievous raccoons in this chaotic co-op sandbox for 1-4 players. Complete ridiculous missions, steal everything you can carry, and outsmart a relentless Exterminator determined to throw your gang behind bars.

title: Nostra
description: A story-driven dark fantasy JRPG with tactical party-based combat, built by a solo developer with external artists and musicians. Three kingdoms hold an uneasy peace while something older stirs beneath it. Leave your village and lead a party into a world of fragile beauty and gathering shadow.

title: Luck of the Draw
description: A wild west themed Roguelike Deck-builder where you claim bounties by getting into western standoffs and growing your arsenal. Order your bullets and buffs into the cylinder to create devastating combos and deal massive damage!

title: Chosen By Odin
description: Hunt the cults of Ragnarök across epic Norse realms in this 1-3 player co-op action game. Wield Godly powers, roll dice to shape mighty builds with your friends, and escape as overwhelming hordes close in. Return to Valhalla, grow stronger, and rewrite the saga.

title: Almos a Dream Painter's Tale
description: Explore a hand-crafted Metroidvania where dreams and nightmares collide. Master fast-paced combat, craft powerful spells, and harness Color to restore a dying world while uncovering the truth behind the Dream Painters.

title: WizBall
description: Wizball is a 2D pinball-inspired roguelike game where you play as a regular child attempting to beat the Powerscale Tournament. Your only weapons are powerful balls used to steal the enemy's mana and attack them. Climb up the Tournament's ranking to unlock powerful balls!

title: Magic Market World
description: "Magic Market World" is a PvP rhythm game with strategic elements. Place your advertisement spells, sell your products and make sure to stay ahead of the competition!

title: Elsewar
description: Master the unpredictable forces of Elsewar, a roguelike deck-builder where tactical synergy meets high-stakes fantasy combat. Draft powerful cards, uncover game-changing relics, and adapt your strategy on the fly as you battle through an ever-shifting, perilous world. Can you build the ultimate deck and survive the onslaught?

title: FPS Chess: Ignition
description: FPS Chess: Ignition features the all new "wood" set of pieces with new unique weapons and abilities, plus a new map that reimagines the original FPS Chess map!

title: Kakeochi
description: Mitsumi received a short message from his childhood friend Kaguya, who was a year younger than him. When she revealed that she had been set up for an arranged marriage, he regretted not taking action in advancing their relationship. He believes that they share the same feelings and had been satisfied the way things were, but now with the girl who he loves crying before him, he had to immediately make a decision…

title: Little Sick Girls: Osananajimi no Koibito
description:
The second-year student Akito is a late-blooming yet stereotypical chuunibyou: engrossed in anime, manga and games, and able to recite lines from memory. Because of this, despite his good looks and attractive voice, he was viewed as a disappointing ikemen. However, he paid no heed to what he believed was mindless drivel and enjoyed his hobbies every day at the school’s anime and game club with his close friend Shunta.

Then due to a certain incident, his childhood friend and class rep Eri began to stay by his side at all times, devoting herself to him. He thought that it was strange and after seeing a specialist, she was diagnosed with the ‘dependence type’ of ‘Aphrodite Syndrome’ and labelled as a ‘Little Sick Girl’.

title: Little Sick Girls: Kagami no Naka no Idol
Strange Zoo
description: Pomerania Games is an independent game development studio based in Gdańsk, Poland. The studio focuses on creating simulation and management games and is the developer of Strange Zoo, a zoo management game featuring animal care, expansion, resource management, and dynamic events.

title: Seven Blasphemies
description: Seven Blasphemies is a traditional turn-based roguelike where every dawn may curse your run forever. Explore a dying world, choose from doomed classes, survive lethal OSR-inspired encounters, and race against extinction before the seventh blasphemy ends all.

title: Bandocracy
description: Welcome to the Bandocracy! Manage a rock band's journey from writing songs to breaking hearts to saving the world in this banger of a narrative game.

title: Bathysphere
description: The year is 1940—you wake up in a bathysphere, stuck in an endlessly repeating battle against enemies unknown. Investigate your surroundings and uncover the truth behind the time loop.

title: TapRacer
description: Two keys, strictly alternating, as fast as you can. TapRacer is a drag racer with real vehicle physics: torque curves, clutch slip, tire temperature, weight transfer. Burnout, launch, four shifts — and the quarter mile is over.

title: DNA Nemesis
description: Survive in the wildest Battle Royale! Choose from 10 animal species, each with its own unique ability based on its natural attack and defence mechanisms. Master an extreme experience and become the ultimate species. In DNA NEMESIS there are no heroes; only predators and prey.

title: Squish Them All
description: Squish Them All is a top-down arcade shooter where your weapon has hidden abilities you have to figure out how to use. Face swarms of human sized insects and conquer the leaderboards. The bugs die in one shot but make one mistake and you will die.

title: Greak 2: Alliance of the Storms
description: Greak 2 is a hand-drawn co-op metroidvania adventure. After fleeing their invaded world, siblings Greak and Adara find themselves in the hostile lands of Synoraz. Split in parallel dimensions, they must work together to save the last Storm egg before the ancient species is lost forever

title: Protocol: Chapter 1 - Limbo
description: Return to an abandoned hospital you have no memory of. You don't know who you are, but this place remembers you.

title: PixelJunk Monsters 3
description: Celebrating the 20th anniversary of the PixelJunk Monsters series, the legendary series returns to its hand-drawn roots in glorious 4K! Run, dance, and build towers to defend against Monsters, with new roguelike elements adding strategic depth. Play solo or with up to two players online or locally.

title: Mokomon: Five Elements
description: A Roguelike Auto Battler focused on creature taming and evolution. Choose your Tamer, master the Five Elements system, and break the game by discovering new evolutions and insane synergies to annihilate hordes, defeat bosses, and outmatch other players' builds.

title: Bye Bye Bonnie
description: Bye Bye Bonnie is a co-op journey for up to 4 players set in a dystopian wasteland. Tee-up a giant talking skull to defy physics, conquer dungeons, help strange NPCs, and find lost siblings. Upgrade your skull to ascend The Tower. Mother is waiting...

title: Piggy Monte
description: Three little banks, one golden coin, and a heavy steel hammer. Track the coin through the shuffle, pick right, and crack the bank open. Climb fourteen rooms from a kitchen table to the last table, where nine banks move at once. Play money only.

title: Alkimya: House of Wisdom
description: A first-person survival horror game set in the House of Wisdom during the 1258 siege of Baghdad. Scavenge for resources, craft alchemical flasks, unlock an interconnected sanctum of Golden Age puzzles, and survive the Mongol invaders — and the cosmic horror waiting beneath them.

title: Craggfall
description: You are a rock. Craggfall is a physics-driven momentum game where you roll, leap, and crash a living rock through dynamic terrain. Shatter what stands in your way as you explore mysterious worlds. Build up speed into huge air, and relive every glorious wipeout in instant replay.

title: Enarian: Orbital Command
description: A spaceship based RTS/RPG Hybrid, take command from your own outpost and lead wings of fighters, bombers, frigates and more, against powerful enemy fleets. Defend, Assault, Hack, Repair and Recover cargo for corporations and pirate factions building the strength of your ship and notoriety.

title: Gambit Gardens
description: Become the ruler of the garden in this cute multiplayer strategy game! Win blind auctions and grow powerful plants before your opponents grab the best turf.

title: Echo Harvest
description: Build settlements, command the Echoes of former lives, and race against a corruption consuming the world. Echo Harvest is a colony roguelite where every failed timeline becomes part of the history that shapes the next.

title: My Sexy Fairies
description: Step into the enchanting world of My Sexy Fairies, where you become the trusted assistant of four charming fairy girls. My Sexy Fairies - is a meditative, relaxing game that takes 30 minutes to complete.

title: The Creature Mafia
description: Battle creatures, survive the mob, and explore the city prohibition forgot! An action RPG + creature collector set in 1926 Kansas City, The Creature Mafia mixes a realistic world with cartoonish creature combat. Your creatures’ lives are in your hands - can you prevail against the mob?

title: The Forlorn
description: Fight for your life through five nights (technically six) in this hand-drawn 2D game of resource-management and survival. Keep the fire lit, sharpen your sword, and fend off progressively angrier creatures in the Cursed Forest. Comes with a 4/20 mode, cryptic lore, how to draw, and many secrets!

title: Monster Girls: You Can't Say No
description: Adult adventure set in a monster college where desire is survival. Host an incubus, manage rising “heat,” flirt, and build relationships to stay alive. Explore, upgrade abilities, and unlock scenes in a mix of dating sim and resource management.

title: Groovekeeper: Sort the Record Shop
description: A first-person record-sorting game: no customers, no economy, no time pressure. Shelve records by genre, spin the rare ones, relax.

title: Sweetheart
description: Survive the breakup with your high school sweetheart of 15 years. Escape her Hollywood mansion where fame, dysfunction, and the fantasy of everlasting love has mutated your lifelong partner into a monster.

title: Breakaway Hockey League
description: Fast, team-based competitive hockey. Lace up and take control of one skater in third-person. Dominate the ice with dynamic movement, precision shooting, skillful passing, and massive hits. Build chemistry with your squad and climb the ranks in nonstop hockey action.

title: Hippo Hop
description: Hippo Hop is a relaxed 2D flyer where you guide a dapper, winged hippo through fever-dream-50s-jazz-bar-themed handcrafted levels. Flap and glide through the spaces between screen-printing-style instruments, and scoop up glowing drink-themed pickups to the beat of mid-century jazz tracks.

title: Ocean Cargo Manager
description: A classic maritime business simulation about cargo ships, ports, commodity trading, and route planning. Build your shipping company, navigate markets inspired by real-world trade structures, and make long-term management decisions.

title: Police Simulator
description: The latest entry in the Police Simulator franchise lets you build your career in Faremont City. Take on over 50 missions and callouts, patrol with a K9 partner, drive specialized police vehicles, and play solo or with a friend.

title: Creatures Like Us
description: Creatures Like Us is a queer narrative sim about squatting, solidarity & community. Follow a group of friends as they make homes in abandoned buildings, forage, fix stuff, hold meetings and figure out how to live alongside each other.

title: Kingdom III: Rising Realms
description: Protect your crown! Kingdom returns in an all-new micro-strategy and tower defense game set in a shattered realm. Embark on an atmospheric adventure across lands of legend to build a lasting legacy and challenge the empowered Greed threat.

title: Machina Blue
description: Become a mech pilot in Machina Blue, where RPG and shooter elements blend together to deliver the soul of retro anime in a unique way.

title: Last Ditch Effort
description: Enter a grimdark world consumed by endless war and join Igor on a desperate mission in Last-Ditch Effort, a pixel-art character-action game featuring fast-paced combat, handcrafted animation and stylized comic-book storytelling.

title: Warchaic
description: Command your army, build your economy, and advance through the ages in Warchaic, a fast-paced online 1v1 strategy game. Deploy units, construct buildings and defenses, choose powerful cards, and outsmart your opponent to destroy their base.

title: Dungeons & Dragons: Long Rest Tavern
description: Tired of going on adventures? Build and run the finest tavern in the coziest corner of the Dungeons & Dragons universe. Let heroes face danger, while you turn their tales into your fortune. Every legend needs a long rest.

title: Manga Club Advisor wants to support Saeki Sasara
description: One day, a student in your class blurts out, "I want to make manga!" As her homeroom teacher, you decide to create a club with her and carefully guide Saeki-san in achieving her dream.

title: Cutout
description: Dismember your enemies and steal their limbs to gain new powers in this side-scrolling action horror game set in a grim, handcrafted fairy tale world made of paper. Rebuild Lena, child of the forest, and shape who she becomes through the choices you make.

title: Boitatá: Wilderness Reborn
description: A 2D Tower Defense Survival game inspired by Brazilian folklore. Expand your territory, rescue animals to build your defenses, and use Boitatá's abilities to fight waves of invaders in battles that combine strategy, action, and territory management.

title: Escape from Playtime
description: An online 1-4 player co-op horror experience where you and your friends are trapped in an abandoned toy factory. A mysterious voice commands you for an unknown purpose as you explore shifting halls, scavenge for tools, and fight for survival against creatures that lurk in the dark.

title: Matelotes
description: The Royal Hen has disappeared! Lead a group of enthusiastic (though unqualified) sailors on a quest for glory, riches, and, as fate would have it, poultry. Visit a variety of islands, resolve political conflicts, and upgrade your boat in this narrative adventure game inspired by RPGs.

title: Spiritbound: The Goddess's Quest
description: At a haunted house... This place is the lair of evil spirits with dark desires. An exorcist suggested, "Let's summon the legendary God!" That's right...this is a exorcism story brought to you by the God.

title: Prospera
description: Prospera is a first- & third person citybuilder set in the Victorian era, blending survival, crafting, strategy, management. Rise to an industrial tycoon as you build, manage, and explore your city. Plan production chains, optimize logistics, and ensure prosperity.

title: Half Hour RPG
description: Up to 30 minutes of epic adventure. Half Hour RPG is a hand-asset-flipped RPG designed with uncompromising respect for your time. Every unnecessary system was deliberately left unimplemented.

title: Medieval Dynasty: The Backwood
description: Unleash your imagination with our new free DLC introducing The Backwood! This whole new map will be available in Creative Mode, giving you complete freedom to build, design, and misbehave. Immerse yourself in peaceful serenity or let loose and cause

title: Baitcore
description: Waking up from a shipwreck, you find yourself trapped inside a drifting container, lost somewhere in the open ocean. By day, scavenge for supplies among the wreckage and fish to survive. When night falls, stay hidden—because something is lurking beneath the waves.

title: Black Walls
description: Explore a silent, impossible world of puzzles and obstacles. Make symbolic choices whose consequences may not be clear, your decisions shape your ending. Choose Chill Mode for a calm, mysterious journey with nothing hunting you, or Horror Mode for fear, danger, and something that wants you dead.

title: Mercyrail: Havenbound
description: Command one of Britain's last working trains. Build an evacuation route from London to Glasgow across the real UK rail network, manage a community under pressure, and decide who gets passage as infection and collapse transform every journey.

title: The Things We Don't See: 10 Interactive Stories of Horror, Mystery, and the Unknown
description: Ten Storiees. Dozens of impossible choices. Every choice decides who survives, what they become, or what they never should have seen. A branching visual novel anthology of horror, conspiracy, and quiet dread — with dozens of endings.

title: Nicotine Merchant Simulator
description: You're a Nicotine Merchant. Start your production using improvised materials and grow it into a large enterprise. But be careful, just a few wrong moves and everything could fall apart!

title: Derby Dynasty: Horse Racing RPG
description: Horse stable management and realistic race simulation in one. Draft, lane position and energy management run on real physics — and you ride the race yourself. Buy, train and breed horses to build a bloodline that lasts for generations.

title: Sven Rescues a Princess
description: Sven Rescues a Princess is a 3D horde brawler for 1-10 players. Hack and slash through 30-45 minute runs to save six princesses, then live with whatever you brought home. Hordes keep time with the music. Unlock everything by playing. No microtransactions or loot boxes.

title: International Obsession
description:
It's signing season for the Provisional Government, and Kissy and Torture Ball have their sights on the most valuable free agent of all. But who else is staking out a claim to the transfigured earth? What is "the millennium", and is it over yet or not?

Part 1 in the Future Jumpers series of pulse-pounding action storygames.

title: Pastimes
description: Pastimes is a calm 2D logic puzzle based on Pieter Bruegel the Elder's painting Children's Games (1560). Players fill a large numbered grid where each clue indicates how many cells must be filled in the surrounding 3×3 area. Solving the puzzle gradually reveals the full painting, divided into scenes that unlock short notes about the historical games depicted. The game can be played solo or in local split-screen co-op on the same shared puzzle, with support for Steam Remote Play Together.

title: Bobrix
description: Explore, play, and create on Bobrix. You can create your own games, make friends, and customize your avatar on Bobrix! Every game is multiplayer so invite your friends to join a new small community!

title: Watch My Step!
description:
Watch My Step! is an asymmetric co-op game where players must communicate and cooperate to survive dangerous traps and navigate challenging courses together.

Invisible traps, different perspectives, and only one way out! In this 2–4 player online co-op platformer, every player sees different traps. Warn each other, overcome the course together, and climb to the top of the leaderboards with your best time!

title: The History of Everything
description: A historical TCG in the tradition of Hearthstone and Magic: The Gathering. Craft a deck from unlikely combinations of your favourite figures from across history. No grind, no microtransactions; everyone has all the cards. Play with friends: chat freely, share your decks, and compete to be the best!

title: Blargle and the Quest for the Nothing Burger
description: Join Blargle on his quest in this arcade-inspired runner and retrieve his stolen Nothing Burger. Avoid obstacles, collect quotes, and destroy anything in your path to the notorious pirate Captain Raqet!

title: Echoland
description: Echoland is an idle mining game that quietly continues digging away in the corner of your desktop. Unearth the traces of humanity on an Earth where no one remains. The past cannot be changed. — But its memories can still be uncovered.

title: Exogear
description: Exogear is a high-speed 3D action-platformer inspired by classic games and animes.

title: Eldritch Wildlife Tours
description: Eldritch Wildlife Tours is a cozy, Lovecraftian 2-player co-op / solo exploration and adventure game where one role charts a course to cosmic sea creatures based on collective sightings and takes promotional photos while the other safely steers a tour boat full of paying passengers.

title: Police Officer
description: Police Officer is a first-person police station simulator where you manage a police station: process suspects, hear citizens' pleas, and manage the daily chaos of law enforcement—one decision at a time.

title: Meow Star Archives
description: In this 2D puzzle game, you need to restore the cats' severely damaged memory archives to stop their souls from fading away. No timers, no pressure. Just enjoy the satisfaction of each piece falling into place, and the cozy moments spent with adorable cats.

title: Callout
description: Callout is a short found-footage style, atmospheric horror game where your first day on the job maintaining the sewage system turns into a nightmare!

title: Media Basket Manager
description: Media Basket Manager is a single-player basketball management simulation game where you take full control of a basketball club. Manage transfers, develop young prospects, create tactics, and make key decisions to build a championship-winning team.

title: Alexus 2040
description: Relive that pure arcade thrill that you haven't experienced... in a long time! Load up on unique power-ups to create deadly combinations, unlock new ships with unique abilities, and defeat numerous bosses along the way.

title: The Grand Book Archive: Tidy Up
description: Restore the Grand Book Archive by sorting 2,990 archaic books onto their rightful shelves. Use your observation and magical spells to organize the collection as quickly as possible. Completing each run will unlock more powerful upgrades that will help you become the ultimate archivist.

title: Night of the X-mas Trees
description:
Night of the X-mas Trees is a Christmas-Themed Survival-Horror game where a lone officer receives a call to investigate a Christmas Tree Lot during a very cold winter night. The power is on, but it looks like no one is around. While you may think that the frigid cold is the only thing to worry about, the truth is that the Christmas Tree lot appears to be overrun by demonic X-mas tree demons.
