Will you be able to survive the night to see Christmas, will you freeze to death from the dreaded cold, or will you get chopped down by the Christmas Trees?

Of course, you could just leave whenever.

title: Home Watcher
description:
In this unsettling first-person horror game, you play as a young man spending the night alone—until a neighbor suddenly asks you to watch his house across the street.
What starts as a simple favor quickly spirals into a disturbing, sleepless night.

The longer you watch, the more things feel... off.
The question is: are you really alone?

title: Camp Glaspond
description:
Camp Glaspond, the site of a brutal massacre of which you are the only survivor.

It's been twenty years, and now you're taking your daughter Madison to nursing school.

Haunted by the events of the past, you find yourself stumbling to consciousness, your wrecked car several feet away. Madison is nowhere to be found.

In the distance lurks a familiar place, one you thought you had left behind.

Camp Glaspond.

title: Sugar Lies
description: That love tastes like a sweet lie. A young man who hates lies. A girl who lives by them. A short visual novel about a classic summer boy-meets-girl romance.

title: Space Industry
description:
Manage your own modular space fleet by gathering resources, processing them, and expanding your fully automated drones.
Space Industry is a 2D space automation sandbox game in which players build and expand a modular spaceship, mine asteroids, automate production with drones, research new technologies and explore a galaxy filled with hostile fleets. The objective is to prepare the ship for humanity's most dangerous expedition: a journey to the black hole.

title: The Ash Remembers
description:
The Ash Remembers is a dark fantasy idle RPG set in Veyr, a world where ash has been falling for as long as the chronicles reach — and where the ash does not forget. The player arrives at the city of Emberwake as a nameless wanderer and builds a life there: fighting, gathering, cooking and forging.

Progress continues while the game is closed. Combat, gathering and crafting run offline, so a returning player finds work already done instead of a backlog to catch up on.

Sixteen professions feed into one another. Mining and smelting supply the forge, farming and fishing supply the kitchen, and cooked food is what keeps a character standing in long fights — there is no pure-combat path through the game.

More than 120 enemies, eight weekly titans and a line of world bosses make up the endgame. Each carries its own damage weakness, loot table and piece of story, and matching a weapon to that weakness matters more than raw numbers. The Ashfall lets a character let go of everything and begin again stronger: the world's own form of prestige, and never a resurrection.

The game is menu- and text-driven rather than action-driven, runs in the browser and as a desktop build, and is fully playable in German and English. It tells no chosen-one story — nobody here is saving the world, and the chronicle never claims otherwise.

title: Tiny industry
description: A relaxing automation game where building a factory stays simple. Create production lines, connect your buildings, and unlock new technologies without worrying about ratios. Just ask yourself one question: What does this item need?

title: Sisterly Bliss: Don't Let Mom Find Out
description: A light admonishment from Mom sparks the realization that these twin sisters care for each other in more than a familial sense. In this dramatic & romantic yuri Visual Novel, it's up to you to navigate the forbidden tension between the sisters so their love can flourish without growing one-sided.

title: Rip N Ship Simulator
description: Build your own card-breaking empire in Rip N Ship Simulator. Open packs for viewers, manage live orders, grow your simulated stream, collect and grade cards, run giveaways and auctions, upgrade your setup, and create custom cards, packs, and complete sets.

title: Neural Maze
description: 2 neurons. 2 joysticks. One brain must control both at the same time: yours. Guide your lost neurons through increasingly convoluted mazes – reversed controls, power cuts, memory mode – under the watchful eye of an overwhelmed doctor. Is your brain ready?

title: Armada Fighters
description: Armada Fighter is a fast-paced arcade shoot ’em up focused on reflexes, movement, and intense action.

title: Rogue Fortune
description: Fast-paced action roguelite where greed meets relentless combat, demanding ever stronger builds and sacrifices. Cut through hordes of monsters, arrange Relics into devastating arcane synergies, and gamble your newfound fortune for the strength to escape a temple determined to take it all back.

title: Quadrillion Carrots
description: Harvest an absurd number of carrots! Start with your bare hands, unlock powerful tools and helper robots, explore six farming zones, catch living carrots, survive explosive ones, and turn manual labor into harvesting chaos.

title: Rise of the Merchants
description: Rise of the Merchants is a medieval city-building, economic, political, and trade simulation set in a persistent online world. Start with a small settlement in your county, develop it into an influential city, and establish a trade network that extends far beyond its borders.

title: Skapheim
description: A roguelike city-builder where clever synergies decide whether your realm survives. Each season, draft new pieces, place them on your hex board, and push your realm toward Odin’s next demand. Stack scoring bonuses with contracts and obelisks to turn careful planning into explosive scores.

title: Dune: Awakening - Filmic Archive
description: Bring the Imperium to Dune: Awakening with gear inspired by Dune: Part One and Part Two. Wear iconic armor and stillsuits, build a Sardaukar base with 73 construction pieces, and finish it with exclusive décor, weapons, and emotes.

title: Rise of the Spellbaker
description: In Rise of the Spellbaker, a charming hand-crafted, fairy-tale inspired Action-Adventure, one Witch finds herself to be the sole survivor of an unknown plague. With no-one but your loyal Cat Familiar by your side, set forth into the corrupted land.

title: Vaewolf
description: Half-werewolf, half-vampire… all vengeance. Unleash your relentless wrath in a brutal, ceaseless quest for revenge in a bold Hack and Slash power fantasy set in the untamed English North.

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024: City Update 16 - Italy
Rustbuckets
description: Rustbuckets is a twin-stick action-adventure where you control a throwable shield like a second character, exploring a desolate world of forgotten machines.

title: Cursed Clouds 64
description: Cursed Clouds 64 is a 90’s inspired 3D-Collectathon featuring a cute little cat-magician accompanied by a grumpy book. Jump and run through a variety of worlds to free the world from an evil fog. Unlock new worlds and learn magic spells from lost bookpages to reach hidden places.

title: Flekkia
description: A Roguelite board game where every tile counts. Play as an Archer torn between the purity of the Angel and the rage of the Demon. Build your equipment, manipulate the terrain, and turn your movement into a devastating attack. Dying is only the beginning to rewrite your destiny.

title: BLOK 200: Prologue
description: A visual novel in the Samosbor setting. You are a student of the technical college who wakes up in a stranger's hab-cell after your own death. You must come to terms with your new grim nature and face the cruel world far from the walls of your native incubator block.

title: What Goes Up
description: A chaotic co-op physics-building game where you stack, balance and jury rig gigantic junk towers to ridiculous heights for collection using the power of grav guns and friendship before the clock runs out

title: Shared RC
description: Two players. One RC car. One controls the left wheels, the other the right. Try to reach the top together.

title: Locomochi
description: Locomochi is a cozy and relaxing puzzle game where you control your favorite toy train. Deliver the right wagons, solve handcrafted railway puzzles, and explore a charming world full of adorable characters and wholesome adventures!

title: Kholin Echo
description: Kholin Echo is an space action rogue like. Find a way to stop the Oblivion wave, liftoff with your ship, explore procedurally generated planets, fight enemies and collect energy to improve your abilities and weapons, while discovering the secrets of an ancient civilization

title: Dark Island: Faded Memories
description: Ride dragons across forgotten islands. Explore the ruins of a world that fell long ago. Battle monsters and fallen soldiers lurking in the dark. Play solo, or team up with friends in co-op. Nostalgic graphics and style that bring back the magic of childhood.

title: Taflheim
description: Taflheim is a roguelike boardgame inspired by the historical Viking-Age game Tafl. It augments the deep strategic gameplay of Tafl with longship-loads of new content, charming pixel graphics, an original soundtrack, and a healthy serving of humour.

title: Odonata Augmenta: Rogue Dragonfly
description: A 3D Bullet Heaven with low-poly pixel graphics where you take control of a dragonfly and turn your agile moveset, the environment, and your enemies' own weapons against them. Upgrade your arsenal and become the ultimate apex predator!

title: Grampage: Life at 67
description: Your retirement isn't going to fund itself! Pension not cutting it? No problem. Grab up to three fellow retirees, break into houses, and steal your way to the retirement you deserve. Work together when you have to - but remember: only one of you gets to retire!

title: Girl Design
description: Girl Design is a girlypop narrative game about freelance life and a love letter to creative burnout. Play as Jada, a graphic designer, answering unhinged client emails and fixing your work “just a bit” using stickers, doodles and vibes.

title: Super Beat 'em up World
description: Embark on an action-packed co-op adventure through spectacular theme parks, master unique heroes and outrageous power-ups, battle unforgettable bosses, and uncover the sinister conspiracy behind the DUX Corporation while searching for your missing friend, TUU.

title: The Humanity Check
description: The Humanity Check is a psychological horror narrative game. Awaken in the Rebirth Project, explore an eerie interface built by your subconscious, and piece together shattered memories. But are they really yoursand do YOU even exist?

title: Poled Apart
description: Poled Apart is a short 3D cooperative platformer for two players. Combine your magnetic powers of attraction and repulsion to explore a mysterious world full of dangerous antimatter.

title: Astrojunk
description: Play in co-op as a crew of aliens racing to escape an impending meteor strike. Gather resources, fabricate scrap metal, survive brutal fabrication stations and assemble your spaceship to survive the chaos. Work together to build and launch before time runs out!

title: Otome Kishi: Ima Sugu Watashi wo Dakishimete
Pulse Drive
description: Tap to the beat to build speed! Pulse Drive is an arcade racer with rhythm.Casually enjoy a ride through original dreamlike environments, challenge yourself to complete all the tracks, or challenge your friends on the leaderboards!

title: Mave's Castle
description: Mave the Dragon needs help moving out! Organize her hoard of treasures and curiosities while drinking potions, tasting shrooms, and reading tomes to progress through the castle's various rooms.

title: Soft Ruin
description: Soft Ruin is an Open Dungeon Exploration Game.

title: Outblight
description: "Nothing down there is what the stories say." A turn-based clash roguelite where you pit your moves against the enemy's, slot against slot and the stronger strike breaks through. Kirs takes the contracts nobody else will. The legends are silent about the abyss, so Kirs goes down to ask in person.

title: Express 404
description: Drive a storm-ridden night train, manage your speed and your passengers — one of them is a mimic. Build powerful upgrades between stations, reach dangerous quotas, expose the monster, or profit from chaos in this roguelite paranoia simulator.

title: Merge Day: Office Girls
description: Merge Day: Office Girls is a casual merge puzzle and dating sim game set in a bustling office! Combine various items, complete daily quests, and unlock romantic visual novel stories with charming female colleagues. Build relationships, discover their secrets, and enjoy the daily grind!

title: Argot's Laboratory
description: Argot's Laboratory is a 1-bit science simulator that puts you in control of a high tech lab. Modify, inspect, and evolve strange creatures, all while trying to not to lose your job! Can you complete the genetic tree before time runs out or will your boss finally snap?

title: Paragon's Hand
description: Collect cards, duel rivals, forge new bonds and seek your own way forward! Explore a story of friendship and competition that revolves around the TCG Paragon’s Hand. Do you believe in the Power of Friendship?

title: Re:Red
description: Stay on the path, Little Red. Spot anomalies in an uncanny, looping forest to reach Grandma’s house with your basket of goodies intact. If safe, press forward. If not, turn back immediately. Trust your paper map, explore strange new areas, and most of all, watch out for the Big Bad Wolf.

title: Kick the Piñata!
description: Grab your trusty bat and smash piñatas in this colorful incremental game. Buy weapons, unlock upgrades, rebirth, and build your strangely arranged home. Everything is cute, everything is fine, and the piñatas are definitely not alive.

title: Hordia
description: Cut down endless hordes of monsters and become absurdly powerful! Loot, upgrade, and stack augments into wild builds. Hold the island with cannons and traps, hunt down the bosses waiting out on the map, and survive as long as you can. Solo or online co-op!

title: Build the Hole
description: Build the course, sabotage your friends and be the first to putt the ball! Go fast to be first, or play it smart and rack up points by taking fewer shots. Place obstacles, traps and use powerups to sabotage them. But remember, they might also be plotting to sabotage you.

title: Fall off Reach
description: Fall Off Reach is a first-person narrative survival game and the sequel to Drift Into Eternity. Alone in the wreck of the WANDERER IV, explore, repair failing systems, and delay the inevitable as everything keeping you alive collapses.

title: 300 Miles to Her: Every Hitcher Lies
description: The 3 AM call changes everything. The world is ending and your wife is 300 miles away. Grab what you can from the house and hit the gas. The apocalypse is full of hitchhikers but trust no one. Every passenger lies. The random junk you packed decides who you meet and how you die.

title: Yeommae
description: Yeommae is a point-and-click game about traditional Korean shamanism. Investigate objects, witness past memories, and solve puzzles. Uncover the truth through the four senses and untangle the twins' twisted fate at the hands of the Mudang.

title: Little Jimmy´s Nightmare
description: Little Jimmy's Nightmare is an action roguelite where cute hand-drawn 16-bit charm meets brutal combat, flying guts and powerful item synergies. Explore handcrafted worlds, build outrageous combinations and carve your way through cultists, monsters and bizarre bosses.

title: Cook to Zero
description: Cook meals to deploy mercenaries and hold back waves of monsters! Manage the kitchen and battlefield at the same time in this pixel-art real-time strategy defense game.

title: Flippy the Spider
description: Jump, glide, and swing your way through increasingly challenging levels, eating flies and searching for your way home. Master tight, physics-based controls, explore 5 distinct worlds, and collect trophies along the way!

title: Technically Heroes
description: A light-hearted four-player 2D adventure. Pick a class, gather your party, and hold the shore as the rift gets deeper.

title: Card Slay
description: The poker roguelike where the House fights back. Chase the flush, sweat the last discard, then slam it down and watch the damage hit: red suits strike, black suits shield. The monsters read your hand, call your ranks and cheat, so stack your ritual deck, out-cheat them, and slay your fate.

title: IllumaNet
description: Build a living network across the dark. In this strategic incremental game, connect distant stations with pulse bridges, turn every cycle into Data, and manage limited Grid Power as you scan the unknown and expand into strange new biomes.

title: Pillagers: The Poisoned Throne
description: Lead a band of goblin rebels through a brutal turn-based tactics campaign. Train your roster, rebuild your fortress, manage scarce resources, and survive a war where every mistake can leave your army weaker than before.

title: Grape by Grape
description: A cozy vineyard idler with no clicking and no game-over. Hover to water your vines, then turn grapes into wine, raisins, vinegar and pekmez across your own little estate and sell them at your shop. 14 grapes, gentle automation, and a vineyard that works while you're away.

title: Vespillo
description: A multiplayer extraction platformer. Grapple down into the dark and haul out what you can carry. Light your candle and death becomes real: no respawn, no second chance. You lie where you fell until another player carries your skull home

title: The Price of Tomorrow
description: The Price of Tomorrow is a story-driven sci-fi drama about the choice between a corporation and the people of planet Chenora. As Jack Butler, you negotiate, break taboos, and decide the planet’s fate. Yield to the temptations of Omnilat — and choose wisely.

title: Hyperflora
description: Hack, slash, and harvest across uncharted alien worlds. Collect rare cosmic plants brimming with unnatural power to cultivate in your orbital greenhouse. Refine their essence, craft otherworldly weapons and armor, and venture beyond.

title: Our Blood Ties
description: Our Blood Ties is a psychological horror game where you take on the role of a policer officer investigating an abandoned house. Inside, you will encounter ghosts of the family that used to live there and communicate with them. Each ghost has their own story, all shaped by one defining event.

title: First-Person Jigsaw
description: Play jigsaw puzzles from a first-person perspective! Sort, organize, and assemble huge piles of pieces at your own pace. Chill out solo or play online with up to 16 players. Import your own images to create custom puzzles, then play them yourself or share them online.

title: Dustbloom
description: Team up with friends in this 1-4 player co-op survival game. Build a massive mobile base, automate your production, and terraform a dead red desert into a lush green world. Craft weapons to survive nightly skeleton attacks and uncover the dark mystery of the lost 14th team.

title: PC Fish: Taskbar Aquarium
description: Raise, Collect, Trade! Discover rare fish, grow your collection, and build a living aquarium right on your desktop.

title: Scott Pilgrim EX: Back in the Band
description: Stephen Stills, Kim Pine, and Knives Chau warp into the fight, completing the full band lineup in Scott Pilgrim EX. It's time for a reunion... and a few more greatest hits.

title: Vital Decisions
description: Take charge of a chaotic emergency room up to 8 players. Examine patients’ vitals, diagnose their conditions, and choose the right treatment. Prioritize emergencies and keep the shift under control as your patients’ conditions worsen around you.

title: Skulls Skulls Skulls
description: Skulls Skulls Skulls is a short active Incremental game. Fire spells at the cave, get skulls, spend skulls on yourself and get more and more powerful!

title: Can I Come In?
description: Your parents have left, and you're home alone. What begins as an ordinary evening after school slowly turns into a living nightmare, where every little sound makes your heart race. Remember the most important rule: don't open the door for anyone.

title: Like a dog
description: Inside an infinite laboratory where inhumane experiments were conducted on dogs, a concise story about loneliness, perseverance, and madness is told...

title: Simulador StreamHub
description: Simulador StreamHUB is a browser-based career simulation game about building and managing a streaming career. Players make quarterly decisions while managing audience growth, money, energy, community, equipment, staff, employment and streaming platforms. Random events, quick-time events, crises and different career outcomes make each playthrough unfold differently.

title: Too Many Toys!
description: Too Many Toys! is a cozy organizing simulator where you'll sort 5,517 toys in a messy toy shop. Put every toy back in its correct place, complete rows to gain points, and spend them on upgrades that make organizing faster and more satisfying!

title: Black Hole Grow Forever
description: Shatter drifting matter, feed a growing black hole, and build a sprawling web of permanent upgrades. Every short run unlocks wilder skills, from screen-wide lasers to chain lightning, bombs, and gravity.

title: Rescue the Hostages: Twenty Deadly Questions
description: Rescue the Hostages: Twenty Deadly Questions is a horror FMV game centered on a hostage crisis involving a mad bomber. The player must participate in a deadly variation of the classic Twenty Questions game in order to disarm a bomb and rescue the hostages. Gameplay focuses on deduction and decision-making under pressure as players narrow down the correct answers before time runs out.

title: Manic Miner
description:
The legendary platforming classic is back!
Jump, collect, survive - Rediscover one of the greatest and most challenging video game classics of all time!

title: Honkai Impact 3rd: The Light at Dream's End
description:
Version 9.0 of Honkai Impact 3rd, marking the end of Part 2 of the main story, which includes:
• New Part 2 Story Finale: The Future We Embrace
• New AstralOp: Senadina
• New Featured Event: Captain's Wishing Tree Secrets
• ...and more!

title: The Canon Keeper
description:
The Canon Keeper is a narrative-driven document inspection game set in a dystopian future where the government has destroyed existing Bibles and begun distributing rewritten versions of Scripture. The player works in an underground resistance facility, examining recovered passages and determining whether each document contains authentic Scripture or altered material.

Gameplay centers on reviewing documents, comparing passages, using reference tools, and making decisions under time pressure. Players can use mechanics such as prayer, cross-referencing, and document inspection to help determine whether material should be preserved in the Bible or destroyed. Decisions made throughout the game can influence the resistance, underground churches, and the events that unfold outside the player’s workspace.

title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 - Vault Edition
description:
The Vault Edition includes:
• Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4
• Hostile Alliance Operator Pack
- 4 Operator Skins: Price, Valeria, Ghost, Blix
• Special Forces Operator Pack
- 4 Operator Skins representing the United Kingdom, Germany, France, and South Korea, each with voice packs in their local languages
• Signature Weapon Collection
- 5 Signature Weapons
• BlackCell (1 Season)
- Includes: Battle Pass, 20 Tier Skips, 1,100 CP and more
• DMZ Deployment Bonus
- Additional bonus content in DMZ

title: Garaji
description: Dungeon crawler about hooligans and bandits set in post-Soviet outskirts. Classic grid-based movement and turn-based combat. An ocean of blood and violence.

title: Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising - Legendary Edition
description:
The definitive fighting game experience for beginners and veterans alike—now available in a complete Legendary Edition!

Set Contents:
• Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising base game
• Deluxe Character Pass 1
• Deluxe Character Pass 2
• Additional Character Set (Id)

title: Escape the Exomoon
description: Escape the Exomoon is a narrative driven cyberpunk sci-fi horror game. Hack, hide, and fight your way across an abandoned space colony and learn the terrifying secrets within. Will you sacrifice your sanity for survival?

title: Revertices
description: Directed by one of Cuphead's developers, Revertices is an action combat sidescroller where you will be forced to fight the corrupted remains of your friends: your duty is to reset the cycle at all costs, but in doing so you doom yourself and your companions to repeat the same horrors.

title: The Last Ores
description:
The Last Ore — A first-person incremental game where you dig, sell, and realize grandpa might have been right all along.

Dig the earth, collect ores and sell them to upgrade your equipment. Explore a mysterious depths. And the deeper you go… the more you realize something ancient has been waiting for you down there, in the dark, for a very long time.

title: Cartoon Crime
description: Cartoon Crime is an open-world action crime game with third-person and top-down gameplay, story missions, police chases, recruitable bodyguards, enterable shops, and bowling, billiards, and arcade mini-games.

title: Where To?
description: Drive a late-night taxi through a city where no one can be trusted. Pick up suspicious passengers, follow unsettling routes, and face strange conversations and irreversible choices. Tonight, who you take, where you drop them off, and where you go next are all up to you. A retro horror taxi game.

title: Destined Notes: The Written Fate
description: A massacre. A past that won’t stay buried. As Daniel, dive into a chilling investigation that spirals into pure horror. Explore, solve, survive—but something is watching. The deeper you go, the lesser you escape.

title: Olympic Snow Girl
description: “Winter Olympic Girl’s Dream” is an inspirational interactive story game about the growth of a young female skier. Players experience the development of the story through interactive choices, collect character-exclusive CGs, and follow each character’s journey of growth.

title: Void Cargo: Equilibrium
description: A first-person sci-fi cargo flight sim. Pilot a physics-driven lander, plan risky routes, manage fuel and heavy cargo, and save deliveries by repairing system failures mid-flight. Earn credits and upgrade your ship.

title: Galactum Meridian
description:
Galactum Meridian is a research-first space strategy game about leading humanity’s first deep survey beyond Sol.

Command the ISA Far Horizon, a deep-survey cruiser sent into nearby star systems where the map is incomplete, the data is uncertain, and every discovery changes what comes next. You are not here to paint borders across space with fleets. You are building the first working picture of humanity’s interstellar future.

Galactum Meridian begins with real astronomical structure: nearby stars, confirmed exoplanet data where available, and catalog-backed system information drawn from sources such as the NASA Exoplanet Archive and other astronomy datasets.

But this is not a dry simulator. Known science gives the galaxy its backbone. From there, the game layers survey results, modeled possibilities, strange worlds, and speculative discoveries into systems you can investigate. Galactum Meridian brings in more than 10,000 actual stars from current star catalogs for you to travel to and investigate, updated frequently as new data becomes available.

Some things are observed. Some are inferred from what we know. Some are fictional, mysterious, and waiting for your expedition to discover them.

title: Diss Diss Discussion
description: When student council president Sakurai fights to make uniforms optional, Hiyama pushes back against her (because Sakurai-senpai looks too good in them!) with nonsensical wit. Hasumi can barely look at what her crush gets himself into... A visual novel about the dumb things we say to get things done.

title: I Buried Steve
description: I Buried Steve is a multiplayer party platformer set on a beach, in which players build the racecourse while they compete on it. Each round begins at a tiki bar, where players privately draft build pieces and hazards, then fly over the level and place them in secret. Nobody sees the additions until the countdown ends, at which point up to eight players race the altered course at once while rising flood water closes in behind them. Points are scored for reaching the finish and for eliminating rivals with traps, including the traps a player laid themselves. The game includes 40 build pieces and 14 hazards such as spinning blades, swinging axes and punch blocks, transit pieces such as pipes, bounce pads and portals, and power ups including a grappling hook, a boomerang and a spade for burying opponents in the sand. It supports online and local split screen play for up to eight players, round modifiers, solo time trials and unlockable cosmetics.

title: Hell Apartment
description: Paranormal streamer Shunya Takahashi sneaks into a cursed apartment where a family vanished. When the door of Room 101 shuts, escape becomes impossible without solving its riddles. Clear the rooms one by one and face the truth of "that day" beyond Room 203.

title: Rockets.com
description:
Welcome to ROCKets.com, where we dream big and ROCK hard!

...that's what the ROCKets.com website used to say before their space rocket Flying V crashed onto the company headquarters, killing everyone inside.

You're the inspector tasked with investigating what chain of events led to that terrible tragedy. Dig through the emails, put names to the faces, and find out exactly what went wrong.

The report is due on Friday. Good luck!

title: Backyard Paintball
description: Multiplayer FPS game with cross-play to mobile players.

title: Biletide
description: An atmospheric tower-defence strategy game about holding back an oozing toxic Tide. A distant mining colony has awakened a living flood that seeps from breaches in the ground. Dig for resources, raise the land for defence, and burn your way to seal the breaches.

title: Overstimulacrum
description: You are overstimulated. Explore the annals of Your mind through the lens of an FMV point and click museum experience. Watch sensory memories, find what's real. Receive Your gift.

title: 911 Dispatcher: Unknown Caller
description: 911 Dispatcher: Unknown Caller — a first-person psychological horror game in which you work as a night-shift emergency dispatcher. Take calls, decide when to send a police unit, and get to the bottom of a mysterious call connected to an old closed case.

title: Weekend Renters
description:
Preparing a cabin for guests... what could go wrong?
"Weekend Renters" is a short retro-style indie horror game.

title: Lost Hopes: Day of Betrayal
description: 19 year old Chloe was left at her grandparents George and Helen's country house for a few days due to her parents' trip abroad. Little did she know that this short vacation would turn into a nightmare where she must pay the price of an old betrayal.

title: T7's Basics Plus
description: This is a game of the T7's Basics, but includes cool stuffs like flooding event and more. Players collect 7 laptops and esacpe the schoolhouse to win.

title: The Snare Below
description: Explore an old subway that was never opened to the public. Walk deep into the underground where the plans of man kept failing. Leave the safe glow of normalcy behind and travel the dark. But beware, for inside that place there is something that can turn your fears into reality.

title: Romut
description:
Romut is an indie first-person psychological horror game that relies on oppressive atmosphere.

Sometimes you have to plunge into the terrifying darkness in order to change something.

title: Humani Project
description: In Humani Project, you explore a beautiful yet dangerous post-apocalyptic world. Traverse a lush underground forest, blistering volcano, or even the choking depths of the ocean. Every power-up you discover feels deeply tied to the world around you — ancient relics that unlock new abilities, hidden paths, and deeper secrets.

title: Apartment 12
description:
Noah's parents are out of town. They left him with his aunt, Lizzie. She is taking care of him and trying her best to make him feel safe and happy.

Noah, like many other kids, loves to draw. He asks Lizzie to bring him paper and crayons.

title: White Coat, Red Hands
description:
You are a renowned surgeon in the 90s, driving home after a long day of work.

Lost in the radio, your mind drifts, until the sudden impact.
You’ve hit someone.

Now you must decide: help them, or leave them to die.

title: The Brave Hearts II: False Skies
description: The Brave Hearts II: False Skies is a fully voice-acted, story-driven arcade shoot 'em up. Four years after the Cruabar War, advanced autonomous drones begin appearing across former war zones and civilian airspace. As a newly assigned Brave Heart pilot, players defend Uflein's skies, uncover the origin of the drone threat, and fight through campaign missions featuring aerial combat, boss encounters, QTE moments, and visual-novel-style cutscenes.

title: Komparet
description: Komparet is a short first-person horror adventure set in the Northern Italian countryside. The story draws from a lesser known folktale from the Veneto region. It was made for the Italocurso 2025 Horror Jam.

title: Re:Blue
description: A native PC port of Blue Dragon (2006).

title: Besöket
description:
Help your friend who’s trapped in a strange Swedish cottage, while trying to survive the unknown horrors in the cabin.

Besöket is a first-person horror game inspired by SOMA. You respond to a cry of help from your friend, locked in a strange Swedish cottage. Find a way to free your friend, solve the puzzles all while evading the unknown horrors of the house. You better be careful, or this act of kindness might be your last.

title: Can I Have a Glass of Water?
description: You wake up in the middle of the night to your daughter asking you for a glass of water. How could you say no to that? Just get her the water, and ignore anything unusual around the house. Everything is fine.

title: SCP-847
description: SCP-847 is a human female mannequin, 156 cm tall and 27 kg in mass, constructed of human hair and an unknown composite fibrous polymer that abrades and shatters similarly to porcelain. Exploratory laparoscopy of SCP-847 shows the presence of internal structures resembling an incomplete set of bones, organs, and major blood vessels, composed of the same polymer. Small amounts of a black, volatile resin similar to plastination compounds leak from the eyes and damage regions of the mannequin.

title: ViewerFrenzy
description: ViewerFrenzy is a stream-enabled racing and competition game built for livestream communities. Viewers join competitions through Twitch chat and race across custom-built ground and space courses. During a competition, viewers can influence the action with nitro boosts, asteroids, tornadoes, and nukes. Streamers can build their own tracks, configure competitions, manage viewer roles and vehicles, and connect game events to streamer.bot. ViewerFrenzy also includes vehicle customization, statistics, leaderboards, and community management tools.

title: Skinned Alive
description: A serial killer who works with the devil manages to kidnap you, he left you in a cell while he is busy with his other victims. Can you manage to escape?

title: Enclosure
description:
Are you sure who you really are?

The game is inspired by P.T. - a well known horror teaser, which has the "looping" method of telling a story or/and progressing the game. This project was done under 1 week. It does not include any complex mechanics or groundbreaking visuals - simply short, atmospheric and story driven.

title: Trust the Watchers
description:
"On a small clearing in the woods, we find three souls around a small fire, struggling to stay warm."

That's it. The rest is up to you.

title: The Touch
description:
Are you prepared to face the unknown lurking in the shadows? The Touch is an immersive short horror experience set in an ordinary suburban American home. This spine-chilling game, inspired by classic PS1-style graphics, is designed to keep you on the edge of your seat as you unravel the mysterious events unfolding before your eyes.

As a young woman living with your baby, your unsettling journey begins one fateful night when a strange noise in the living room awakens you. Step by step, the eerie atmosphere grows thicker, and you'll soon find yourself haunted by an unseen presence. But beware... not everything is as it seems.

title: The Apartment Next Door
description:
After receiving a 911 call from a woman claiming she can hear strange noises coming from the apartment next to her, a lone police officer is sent to check the place out armed with nothing but a VHS camera.

What secrets will he discover in The Apartment Next Door.

title: Gimmick
description:
Gimmick is a short, spooky data transfer simulator. You play as David, who
receives an offer for a job. Simple-transfer data on floppy disks. Are you up to the task? What secrets does this place hide? Play to find out.

title: Dark Doll
description: Dark Doll is a short horror game with a VHS style , where the player finds themselves in an abandoned house shrouded in mystery. What starts as a simple exploration quickly turns into a terrifying experience, as the player discovers that malevolent forces await in the darkness, with no way to predict what they will face.

title: Dispatched
description: You are Officer Reed. Dispatched to a quiet suburban home for a late-night welfare check. No backup. No response from the occupants. No idea what you're walking into. As you step inside, the silence is overwhelming. The house feels off — too still, too quiet. You're here to do your job… but something inside wants you to remember.

title: Just Forgot to Eat
description: In this game you are someone who has just moved house for your job, but because at home you are a very spoiled and forgetful person, so you always forget to eat, one day you wake up from your sleep because you are hungry, the clock shows 01:00 AM, you haven't eaten since yesterday morning, so now you have to go out and look for a food stall that is still open, but in the middle of the road you find a woman, she is crying in fear...

title: Dark Hotel
description:
Dark hotel is a first-person short horror game created by a solo developer. The game takes place in a hotel that is dark enough and creepy. You are completely alone in this hotel but there is something sinister that haunts you. Can you get out of this terrible place before you lose sanity?

The game is inspired by P.T but takes place in a hotel

title: Huíwén Zhànqí
description: There are 11 classes in the war board game. Each class has 4 skills, one passive, and 24 equipment (8 equipment have active skills). You can switch to the third-person perspective when fighting.

title: Magic Tower: Cao Cao
description: Magic Tower: Cao Cao - Prequel to Jiang Wei's saga. Play as Jiang's father in an alternate Three Kingdoms. Recruit generals with tokens, face Cao Cao in a fateful duel. Pixel-art RPG with multi-endings. Relaunched with enhancements.

title: Xiàozhǎng Mónǐqì
description: 校长模拟器是一款开罗式玩法的休闲类模拟经营游戏。在游戏中玩家将以高中校长的身份管理整个学校，充分调动学校的资源，完成上级布置的任务。将学校建立成为全国一流的高中。

title: Radio Disturbance
description:
You are a scout, patrolling an unknown "government" test facility. While on duty an incident occurs, a dead body is found, and you get wrapped up in far more than just a day job.

Survive a truly shapeless space of pure discovery and full of threats, guided only by the pulse of your radio's tracker. Find things not meant for your eyes, discover new ground, and truly [REDACTED], all whilst being completely and utterly alone... or are you?

title: Paul's Lost Remains
description: You are a camper who wakes up in the middle of the night to a horrifying scream. You rush out of your tent and find that your friend Paul is missing, and there is blood on the ground. You decide to search for him in the dark and creepy forest, hoping that he is still alive. But as you explore the forest, you find his severed body parts scattered around, and you have to collect them and put them on a cross in the center of the forest. What will happen when you complete the cross? Find out in this short horror game that will test your nerves and challenge your sanity.

title: Motel
description: Seek help at a remote motel. Uncover the horrors that await.

title: Yttrium X
description: Zellia Mots goes awol and steals yttrium X the Plutocracy of Yeoman's secret Mech in this PvE mech brawler!

title: Three Headed Santa: The Awakening
description:
A tribute to Bad indie horror games.

Gregory has made a fatal error when decorating his Christmas tree and accidentally summons Three-headed Santa! How will he escape the nightmare?

title: Just Want to Eat
description:
You as someone who is watching his favorite movie...

Then while watching, you feel hungry, and want to eat something...

But in the kitchen there is no food and you go out to buy food...

But suddenly something is chasing you...

title: Captain Warrington's Play Maze
description:
Warrington Burger has recently become one of the most well-known and successful burger chains in the business.

Our story begins just as Albert and his mother have finished their meals, wholly satisfied with the quality of the food.

In preparation to resume their evening activities, Betty Anne excuses herself for the briefest of moments...

And that's exactly when Albert starts to hear his voice.

title: Shelfwatcher
description: It's almost Christmas and your personal Elf on the Shelf is making sure you stay on the nice list! Enjoy the festive fun as it adds magic to your holiday. He's watching.

title: Nightmare Conquest
description: Nightmare Conquest is a game focused on strategy, planning, and build creation. Assemble your team of monsters, position them intelligently, and evolve their abilities to face increasingly difficult challenges. Every decision matters — from the upgrades you choose to how you combine your monsters on the battlefield.

title: Terminal Terror
description:
In Terminal Terror, you find yourself alone at a desolate bus stop in the dead of night, waiting for your bus.

As the minutes tick by, an eerie silence envelops the scene, broken only by distant, unidentifiable sounds.

Suddenly, strange and unexpected occurrences begin to unfold, and your sense of reality starts to warp.

Will you catch your bus — or will you become another lost soul in the night?

title: The Pit Stop
description:
A short horror story created by Luke from White Patch Games

It’s just another night shift at the gas station… but some people aren’t really who they seem.

You're the gas station attendant, activate the pump and fill up each customer's tank.

title: Tame Me Hard!
description: Take on the role of a female adventurer with debts to pay in this side-scrolling dungeon crawler. Head into different types of dungeons to encounter various creatures. Fight them, capture and train them, then sell them for profit. Pay off your debt before time runs out!

title: Warscape Alpha
description: Pilot your Hovertank through 60 levels of old school arcade style action in both single and multiplayer modes. Collect new weapons and bonuses during battle to defeat, outrun and confuse your enemy.

title: Cold Aisle: Data Center Tycoon
description: Build your own data center business from an empty industrial hall. Order hardware, install servers and GPUs, connect power and networking, manage cooling and capacity, and grow from your first rack into a market-leading company.

title: Puzzles Snow
description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

title: Puzzles Magic
description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

title: Puzzles Fruit
description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

title: Slick As The Devil
description: An experimental psychological-horror tabletop game based on 3-Cup Shuffle. Keep your eye on the ball, buy special items between rounds, and see if you can beat the devil himself at the ultimate conman game.

title: Escape Hatch
description: Build and operate your own escape room. Seal your friends inside, guide them, give them hints, or leave them in the dark.

title: Daily War Online
description: Daily War — Build an island fortress tile by tile, design its defenses, and declare war on ELO-matched rivals. Drop a battle card to bend the rules, then watch the clash unfold. No twitch reflexes — just sharp building and smart timing. One war a day. Make it count.

title: Life on Neptune
description: Build a new life and a new home on a distant planet. Explore islands to find furniture for your house. Meet aliens and make the best of a strange situation. A Life on NEPTUNE awaits.

title: Jitsuni Hana Nari Sousabuyo -Brother In Arms-
Harvest Exit Plan
description:
Harvest Exit Plan is a first-person collect-a-thon set in an orchard the player has inherited from their grandparents. Fruit is picked up by hand at first, later with a grabber and a fruit vacuum; each tool can be upgraded for reach, speed, yield per grab and basket capacity, paid for from the proceeds of what was sold before.

Six gardens open one after another, each with its own fruit type and an automated harvester that keeps collecting while the player is elsewhere. Collecting without pause builds a streak that raises the pace in stages and culminates in a Frenzy state. Clearing a quarter of a garden keeps it clear and pays a bonus for the rest of the run. Rare fruit variants, per-garden mastery goals and a records screen track how thoroughly a run was played. Emptying the orchard ends the first season rather than the game. Each following season runs faster than the last and opens card slots; cards dealt between seasons modify the next run, for example larger baskets, longer reach, more productive harvesters or cheaper upgrades.

title: Toll: The Ferryman's Ledger
description: You are Charon. You take the coins from the eyes of the dead — and one of them, someday, must be your own. A short incremental with a real ending: five rivers, a tribute owed to Hades, and a price on your own freedom. It ends. That is the whole point.

title: The Hidden Camp
description: The Hidden Camp is a multiplayer social deduction survival game for 9 players. Work together, complete tasks, identify the hidden traitors, and survive tense rounds filled with suspicion, strategy, and betrayal.

title: LeManager
description: LeManager is a fast football management simulation where you build squads, scout and negotiate transfers, train players, set tactics, handle player egos and incidents, and play endless seasons without losing the speed of classic management games.

title: Halftime Manager
description: A classic football manager in a modern guise: take charge of a club, fine-tune your tactics and experience every matchday as a compact TV broadcast with a 2D pitch, live ticker and half-time dressing room. Six nations, three leagues per country, one shared European cup.

title: Beefy Boi
description: A job simulator horror. Gather ingredients, assemble orders, and hand them to customers. Your boss is a massive meat monster and we intentionally broke him. Pay your bills when you get back to your room.

title: Don't Stop Mike
description: Fight through 34 deadly rooms, each guarded by four enemies. Defeat them all to break through the barriers and advance. Dodge deadly spike traps, survive the intense combat, and clear all 34 rooms to conquer the ultimate challenge.

title: Arkan Solas 2: The Silence of Valemora
Big Adventure: Trip to Europe 13 - Collector's Edition
description: Pack your bags, it's time to travel!

title: Argonauts Agency: The World on His Shoulders
One in the Well
description:
You have fallen down a deep, deep well.

Ascend to the top with nothing but your two bare hands using a White Knuckle inspired control scheme, and most importantly of all:

don't
stop
climbing

title: Scribble Grounds
description: A small game where you can draw on anything, in a 3D space that you share with your friends

title: Catnip Wars
description: Catnip Wars is a 1-4 player co-op tower defense game in which players control Catbots defending a catnip farm from waves of monsters. Turrets, walls, farms, windmills and repair stations are placed freely on a hex grid, and the farm doubles as the economy: catnip fields fund weapons and windmills power turrets. Fourteen monster types attack the farm, ranging from swarming chompers to armored giants and boss Necros. Players can man a heavy BFG turret, revive downed teammates, and progress through a 43-node tech tree across matches. The game includes eleven playable Catbots, 100 achievements and global leaderboards, and can be played solo or online with up to four players.

title: Misfortuna
description: Incremental Spinning game. Spin a roulette wheel, stack absurd upgrades, multiply your balls, and watch payouts spiral from pocket change to numbers that barely fit on the screen! In Misfortuna every spin is a chance to break the game even further in your favor!

title: Pay your Deeds
description:
Pay Your Deeds is a roguelike deck-builder played on a 5×4 slot reel.

You are in debt, and every few days the Sector expects another payment.

Spin the reel, collect Scrap Credits and add new Symbols to your build. Find combinations that work together, remove the ones that don't, and try to make enough money before your next Deed is due.

title: Grilled Poppycock
description:
Grilled Poppycock is a surreal adventure game with elements of platformer and puzzle.

Isu was heading home to enjoy a bbq evening. However, their plans were disrupted by something unexpected. Isu ended up locked inside the Wonderful Wonderland of Wonderworks and Wonderers. To return home, they need to lock parts of this world. Will Isu manage to get to their long-awaited bbq dinner?

title: Current Draw
description: Build an electrical deck, balance loads across three phases, and push your breakers to their limits. Create powerful card and tool synergies, beat escalating score targets, and decide how much risk your panel can handle in this electrical roguelike deckbuilder.

title: Bloom Busters
description: Bash & blast mutated creatures, restore infested gardens and defend the once-peaceful Bloomland in this frantic solo or local co-op action arcade game. Gather resources, grow flowers, feed animals, complete garden chores, and master handcrafted levels with adaptive difficulty.

title: Salvare
description: Every soul seeks absolution, yet not each deserves it. Salvare is a psychological horror game where you step into the worn cassock of a young Catholic priest, burdened with hearing the confessions of those who come seeking God's mercy.

title: The Birdwatcher's Journal
description: Photograph and identify birds on a mysterious island. Each bird you discover brings you one step closer to uncovering what happened to the researcher before you, and the secrets of the island

title: Knightbane
description: Survive 12 minutes. Then the final boss arrives. Shatter the terrain to escape, loot its contents, or funnel the horde into a killing trap. Cleanse the lands for boons and ASCEND your abilities: not merely empowered, but altered. An action survivor-like.

title: Natsu ni Kanaderu Bokura no Uta
description: When Haruka was small, he was friends with many girls. One day, those girls played a secret game amongst themselves and one of them never appeared after that game. Many years later, while enjoying the sea, he meets a girl who he thought was a mermaid. She was Kanon, the girl who had left them back then. He calls out to her, but she doesn’t acknowledge knowing him.

title: Bomber Angel Bombriel: Forever the Kings
description: Bomber Angel Bombriel: Forever the Kings is a top-down free-scrolling bomb-placement action/shooter that shares the same lineage as classic masterpieces like RoboWarrior (NES). It’s a fresh new game dressed in pastel, cute visuals—nostalgic in spirit, yet with noticeably improved controls.

title: Last Wail of the Sea King
description: Explore the body of a dying sea beast in this first-person RPG with JRPG-inspired turn-based combat. Recruit bizarre companions, battle mutated creatures and uncover the secrets of the Sea King.

title: Dawnhold
description: Top-down action base-defense game where you gather resources, build up your defenses, and survive relentless enemy waves. Strike back by assaulting enemy strongholds and defeating powerful bosses in a fight to protect the Sunstone.

title: Pencils Down
description: Pencils Down is an analog horror roguelike where you take a 44-question exam under the watch of an unseen proctor. Wager confidence chips on answers, risk erasers on red-ink questions, and face questions generated from your real-time mistakes. Three exam forms offer escalating dread, while a meta-progression system lets you buy study aids that may help or doom you. Five endings, 400+ period-authentic questions, and a creeping sense of being watched make this a uniquely personal nightmare. Played entirely offline with mouse and keyboard.

title: So Close
description:
So Close is a cooperative platformer for one to four players in which a team escapes a linear level filled with unpredictable traps. The players wear explosive collars that detonate if they move too far apart, and the death of a single player restarts the run for the entire team. Two modes are available: Realism, which restarts the full level after each death, and Easy,
which resumes from the last checkpoint. The game is hosted by an in-game gamemaster named Proxxy.

title: Put Back Stuff
description: Put Back Stuff is a cozy organisation simulator where you put items back where they belong. Enjoy peaceful, play at your pace organisation.

title: Crazy Life
description: A life simulation game for up to 6 online players.Become a resident of Shishizaka City and aim to become the richest by getting jobs, changing careers, buying properties, getting married, raising children, and using cards.Experience a turbulent life in a vast city!

title: Wispip's Siege
description: Wispip's Siege is a 2D action-adventure siege sandbox set in a dark, procedurally generated world. Descend from the perilous surface through underground caverns, deep ruins, and the deadly Abyss — each layer more dangerous and rewarding than the last.

title: Plum
description: Plum is a short (about 1h) contemplative 3D collectathon, where you play as a plum, rolling and bouncing your way through a colorful world, searching for your way home. Your journey will take you through lands, caves, snowy mountains and more. Each area with ghost plums to meet, each with a story to tell.

title: 1930: Ink & Bullets
description: A turn-based tactical strategy game featuring a 1930s cartoon art style. Face your opponent in a tense tabletop duel, use your perks wisely, manage your resources, and try to survive each round in this suspenseful noir universe.

title: False Oath
description: False Oath is a retro-style survival horror game set in a medieval era. A deadly plague spreads across the kingdom. Search for a cure before it’s too late.

title: Loop Apartment: Visitor
description: You come to see a friend you haven't seen in years. Unit 305 is unlocked, and empty. Open the door to leave and the hallway outside isn't the one you came up. Psychological horror investigation in a retro interface: the building reassembles itself every time you lose consciousness.

title: Fevercide
description: Fevercide is a metroidvania with elements of horror and adventure games. Join Sandra as she explores the stately cities of a Russian Empire that never fell. Solve puzzles, fight with monsters, and face the demons from her past.

title: Retrobot
description: The year is 2109, and Retrobots is the world's most chaotic sport. Select your Retrobot, customize and tune it to perfection, and enter the battle. Smash, slam, launch, and destroy your opponents in arenas across the world. Are you ready to kick some bot?

title: TCG Card Chaos
description: TCG Card Chaos is a first-person casual simulation game in which players explore a chaotic card shop and sort more than 5,000 collectible cards. Players inspect card types, rarities, numbers and symbols, open card packs, discover graded cards, and return every card to its correct place.

title: Regolith
description: Regolith is a base building space RPG where you explore vibrant worlds while collecting materials. Use what you gather to build elaborate supply chains and scale up production to fully automate your factories and make powerful items. You will need them to challenge the enemies you encounter...

title: Momentigrade
description: A fast-paced 3D metroidvania with a focus on stylish, momentum driven movement. Chain together jumps, dashes, wall kicks, and pole swings as you explore a colorful interconnected city and climb into the clouds. Fight creatures, discover secrets, and see how long you can keep the flow going.

title: Replik
description: Replik is a solo extraction-soulslike where your mistakes come back to haunt you! Scavenge for resources between warring factions and empower your Replikas to rise from hunted to hunter. In a world where life is fabricated, death still comes at a price.

title: SinEater
description: Climb and parkour through procedurally generated towers of memories in search of your own sins in this third-person exploration platformer. Survive in the world after the second great flood. Manage resources and needs, scavenge and trade with fellow sin-eaters.

title: Baerim
description: Baerim is an online fantasy MMORPG focused on character progression, cooperative dungeons, guild gameplay and competitive PvP events. It combines a classic progression system with modern quality-of-life features, seasonal content, challenging bosses and a player-driven economy. Players can develop their characters, collect equipment, join guilds and participate in regular PvE and PvP activities.

title: Lonely Highway
description: Survival Horror inspired by Resident Evil, Silent Hill.

title: Osananajimi to Amaaku Ecchi ni Sugosu Houhou
description: Sousuke has a childhood friend, Asuka. His family often moves due to his father's business. One day, Emily and Kotone, his other two childhood friends, start to live with his family. Emily finds a diary, which Sousuke used to keep when he was a child, and some erotic games they played are written in it. Inspired by it, Asuka, Emily and Kotone start to fight to decide who is the real Sousuke's childhood friend by playing the erotic games they used to play...

title: Bloody Duke
description: Bloody Duke is a 2.5D dark-fantasy action-adventure game with souls-like combat, set in a world inspired by Transylvanian, Slavic, Latin and Celtic Mythology. Play as the cursed Duke Blaise Vaelthorne fighting his way back to the Phoenix Throne, wielding the sentient blade Erinyes and making risky pacts with the Devil along the way!

title: Love Buster!!
description:
There's been a mix-up in Castle Town!? On the morning of the Hometown festival, suddenly it's SUSIE'S turn to be the main character!
Guide her choices! Grow her bonds with her friends, or burn them down in a series of disasters! Lay low and avoid suspicion, or raise a scene and let everyone know about you!

title: Another Black Hole Incremental
description: Another Black Hole Incremental is an incremental roguelike in which the player controls a black hole. Each run is limited by a constantly draining stability timer; feeding on dust, asteroids, moons, planets, and stars slows the drain. When the timer expires, the run's progress converts into Hawking Radiation, a permanent currency spent on an upgrade constellation that persists across runs. Play progresses through four scale tiers — asteroid, lunar, stellar, and galactic — ending in the consumption of a galactic core, followed by an endless mode with escalating depth. Systems offer seeded route choices, optional side missions, and a date-seeded daily challenge in which all players receive the same field and modifier. A free demo is available.

title: Cloud Runner
description: Cloud Runner is a casual First Person 3D platformer that tests your skills with relaxing fun levels and arenas. Collect coins to boost your speed and multiply your combo.

title: Bombs vs Bots
description: Bombs vs Bots is a chaotic action game featuring physics-based destruction and light environmental puzzles. As a support engineer for Cola Corp, you are tasked with defeating an army of AI-powered bots that have taken over the company's new headquarters.

title: Pawned Souls
description: Pawned Souls is a 3D soulslike action game mixed with chess, where players control a pawn fighting hostile pieces bound by strict chess movement through real-time sword combat, precision parries, and spatial positioning.

title: Likvar: Zoya
description: You are assigned to Zoya, a candidate with 30 days to become a Likvar—a superpowered field operative. Manage her condition, send her on dangerous missions, and report or alter the results. Your choices shape her performance, trust, and future.

title: Immerguest: The Veiled Inn
description: Immerguest: The Veiled Inn is a dark fantasy turn-based party RPG with a roguelite structure. Lead three distinct heroes through branching runs, combine their abilities and modify individual skills with upgrades discovered along the way. Enemy turns remain interactive through precisely timed real-time dodges, including challenging multi-hit attacks. Each journey begins at the Veiled Inn and leads through battles, events, elite encounters and powerful bosses hidden within the mist.

title: College Architect
description: Design, build, and manage a college campus. Become an architect of a prestigious university that only accepts the most elite students, or a community college that allows for normal everyday folks to pursue an education regardless of their academic background. What will you build, Architect?

title: Tranniversary Death Drive
description: Tranniversary Death Drive is an experimental kinetic novel which explores the links between transgender identity, poverty, and insanity. It is inspired by surrealist poets and 'pataphysics. The game is presented as "an account of the last chapters of the Holy War".

title: Banana Kingdom
description: An addictive retro strategy simulation! Simple rules with deep strategy. A powerful, highly flexible map editor. Built by a developer who has sunk countless hours into strategy games, with one concept in mind: the perfect companion for an immortal life.

title: Bound by Destiny
description: Control a dark dungeon as the Viber Lord, in an attempt to trap Princess Mistynail. Place and trigger traps, unleash creatures, and strike at key moments to block her path as she tries to find the exit. Prevent her escape and pave the way for your rebirth and revenge on her bloodline!

title: Dreadlines
description: Live two of your wildest fantasies: Being employed AND talking to women! Date your undead coworkers, survive corporate deadlines and try not to lose your soul in this satirical monster office dating sim.

title: Neon Howl
description: Neon Howl is a fast-paced neon arcade shooter featuring a campaign, bosses, Boss Rush and Anomalies.

title: Morpho Reverie
description: Welcome to the world of the artcore narrative rhythm game Morpho Reverie. You are my kindred soul. No matter what, you never miss my performance. This time, play music with me. And when we do—we will surely be reunited.

title: The Wickers House
description: An atmospheric first-person horror game. You wake up after a road accident. Before you stands a house where you thought you could find help. But this house is a trap for those who dare enter...

title: Fading Reality
description: Tormented by the disappearance of his wife Emily, Thomas returns to an abandoned place where reality and nightmares begin to blur.

title: Skyscraper Security: Zombie Rain
description: Defend a neon megacity from zombies raining from the sky in a fast first-person action roguelike. Choose a doctrine, bend time, build devastating upgrades, survive 15 escalating waves, and chase a place on the global leaderboard.

title: 9 Yin Sutra: Immortal
description: An open-world cultivation sandbox built with Unreal Engine 5. Survive, build, and explore a vast realm; master mystical runes, forge powerful artifacts, and carve your own path to immortality alongside cultivators from around the world.

title: The Black Lily Blooms in Her Eyes
description: This adventure game follows the mystery of a bell said to have the power to grant wishes, as you build your deck and challenge six magicians. A roguelike mode with changing routes and item choices also offers strategic battles separate from the story.

title: Crescent Tower: Rising
description: Crescent Tower: Rising is an 8-bit-style RPG where players explore a tower that appears once every 50 years, aiming to reach its summit with a party of customizable heroes. The game features a five-chapter interwoven story, classic turn-based combat, and deep character customization, including 14 classes and a skill-block system. With a mapping system to uncover secrets and a playtime of 15-25 hours, it blends retro aesthetics with modern RPG mechanics.

title: Elegorithm
description: Hack and optimize inefficient elevators in Elegorithm, a Sci-Fi simulation. Connect nodes to build custom algorithms and route endless passenger waves. Clear strict wait time and power targets to upgrade your system. If floors overflow, your hack is detected—game over!

title: Super Bloom
description: Grab your watering can, find some seeds and make the desert around you bloom. - No combat, no death, no timer. Just you and your garden.

title: Proyecto Huemul
description: First-person survival horror inspired by a real Argentine conspiracy. Explore abandoned underground facilities, manage scarce resources, and stay out of its sight. Survive whatever lurks beneath the surface.

title: Geopogo Cities: Windsor–Detroit
description: A real-world city-building simulation where you shape the future of downtown Windsor–Detroit. Zone, redevelop, and experiment with growth using real map data in a living urban sandbox.

title: Tale of Dark Light
description: This is a cute fantasy-themed ARPG looter game. You will control the main character, deftly dodging enemy attacks, consuming food to recover health or enhance your abilities, and using normal attacks and charged attacks to defeat enemies.

title: Treasurer
description: You are the Treasurer. Balance between 4 factions, responding to their demands. Earn gold, send it on tasks with risks and rewards, invest in passive income, and account for value growth. Exchange gold for gems and develop meta-progression: strengthen starting resources and improve future sessions.

title: ElDorado
description: Explore the forests and temples of a remote island in search of the fabled city of gold - "ElDorado". Solve a series of puzzles to unlock the doorway to endless riches.

title: Mission Whilkas
description: Jump, run, laugh, and rage! In Mission Whilkas, test your skills, overcome tricky platforming challenges, and try to complete the game in under two hours while securing the legendary Whilkas cat food recipe.

title: Final Battle in Zhifudao
description: "Final battle in zhifudao" is a first-person shooter game with teamwork as the core, and its game mechanics mainly include the following aspects: • Faction Mechanics • Competitive Mode Mechanics: Typically used in multiplayer Ranked matches, each faction can have up to 16 players.

title: Gamble Your Breath
description: A claustrophobic click-based survival game where every spin, card, and choice could be your last. Earn oxygen by gambling your fate through charms, curses, and rising debt before the air runs out.

title: Not a Safe Place
description: Trapped in an endless cave without light. Only the dripping of water, your footsteps – and Zac's yellowed notes. Solve puzzles, find secret paths, and survive as reality and madness dangerously draw near.

title: Cold Trigger
description: Dive into Cold Trigger, a thrilling third-person shooter (TPS) that puts you in the center of fast-paced, action-packed battles.

title: Mini Heroes: Squad Online
description: Fast-paced 2D online arena shooter for up to four players. Choose from over 20 weapons, customize your heroes, and dominate intense PvP battles.

title: Goblins and Gunslingers
description: Deal spells and six-shooters across a seven-lane frontier. Goblins & Gunslingers is a western-fantasy card duel where gunpowder meets magic — draft 8 outlaw factions, hire deputies, flip Gnomes into Golems, and outdraw rivals in ranked play or a roguelike Frontier Run.

title: Shift Chess
description: This is a chess variant in which players can “control the board” as a move action. The game supports online play, matches against AI, and local analysis. It also features a usable notation system and several customizable board rules.

title: Velocity: Midnight Run
description:
Velocity - Midnight Run is an arcade survival racer where every run is a high-speed pressure test through endless midnight traffic. Highways open up. Streets squeeze tighter. Alleys punish hesitation. Cops close in if you slow down. Rival racers pull alongside and dare you to hold the line.

Your goal is not to finish first. Your goal is to keep going.

Scrape through gaps. Thread near misses. Switch cameras. Burn out at the line. Blow the engine if you abuse the redline. Push acceleration, grip, or top speed when the run demands it, then live with what you drained to get there.

title: A Girl A Rain
description: After pushing open the door, or perhaps before, the world has transformed. Will you be able to escape this rainstorm? Or will you stay...?

title: Dao Zhi Hua Yin
description: Don't fear to speak elusive words. The only certainty is that all things present shall fade away in time.

title: A Wind-Shaped Love
description: In a world ravaged by disasters, a young rescuer meets an android girl who feels too deeply—and falls in love. When fate tears them apart, he spends ten years chasing a ghost in white. Can love outlast even death?

title: The Big Suck
description: An incremental game where you ARE the tornado. Destroy fields, cars and buildings, gather wreck to grow, and spend the payday on upgrades in a huge skill tree. Past a certain size the storm stops being weather and picks its catastrophe — fire, flood, winter, or the void — while the county answers with fire crews, bomb squads, tanks and jets.

title: Isle of Flesh
description: Short retro horror game inspired by H. P. Lovecraft’s “Dagon.” Focused on atmosphere and story.

title: Chernobyl: Simulator
description: Chernobyl Simulator puts you in the control room of the most infamous nuclear power plant in history. Step into the shoes of a reactor operator, where every switch, gauge, and decision matters. Experience the pressure, responsibility, and unforgiving complexity of Soviet-era nuclear operations.

title: Tails & Trails
description: Explore cozy 3D worlds, follow the trails, solve playful puzzles, and photograph every hidden cat you can find.

title: Quiet Hour
description: The prohibition is back! Build, decorate and manage your very own underground speakeasy. Just make sure to keep it down, or you will spend the night in handcuffs!

title: Hound Riders
description: A western post-apocalyptic roguelike deckbuilder where cards are bullets. Build your ammo, chain blood-magic combos, and target enemy aim spots in tactical turn-based duels. Explore a cursed wasteland in a nonlinear map where every route, shot, and choice matters.

title: Stranded Deep 2
description: Stranded Deep 2 is the next installment in the series, plunging you into a beautiful but dangerous desert wilderness. Stranded. Alone. No rescue is coming. An endless river carves through a world bursting with life, danger, and discovery. The desert doesn’t care if you survive. You must earn the right to be here. And you will. Every tool, every discovery, every step further into the frontier is the result of surviving long enough and venturing far enough to reach it. As you explore deeper you realize there’s more to the desert than simply surviving.

title: Slaymeji: Roguelite Desktop Survivor
description: Build a ring of weapons and fight through 25 waves in a 2D fantasy bullet heaven. Prefer to watch? Let Auto Mode take over. Outside the arena, your hunter lives on your desktop and turns completed to-dos into permanent game progress.

title: Dragonlance: Veil of the Last Sanctum
description: Survive the collapse of reality in a dark fantasy turn-based RPG where worlds collide and planar rifts unleash ancient horrors. Explore frozen seas, ruined kingdoms, and blighted realms as you gather powerful souls to restore or destroy the Veil between worlds.

title: Race! Then Retry...
description: A fast paced, challenging, puzzle based, arcade racing experience. Race on 35 unique tracks as you try to survive, beat the clock and top the leaderboards.

title: Soon We'll Be No One
description: Soon We'll Be No One is a very short visual novel written for O2A2 2026, a game jam with a strict limit on words and assets.

title: Just A Dice Game
description: A relaxing dice rolling roguelike about chasing score targets and trying to break the game. Build up your collection of dice while buying upgrades, relics and other powerups to build wild synergies and laugh in the face of RNG.

title: Soulstonia
description:
Welcome to Soulstonia, a cozy fantasy RPG where your adventurers don't stand around waiting for you.

Recruit Summoners with their own skills, equipment, traits, dreams, and ambitions. Send them gathering, crafting, fighting, or exploring, or leave them to decide what to work on themselves.

See something interesting? Take direct control at any time.

title: My Fire Is Bigger Than Yours
description: Grow a tiny fire until it's bigger than the Sun! A short incremental game about throwing things into a fire, starting a cult, experimenting with builds, and creating chaotic chain reactions.

title: Desiderium
description: A brief essay on desires and the consequences of having them. Feed an insaciable sovereign, explore surreal environments, and seek the hiddens ambitions within those who surround you.

title: ArMystic
description: ArMystic is a non-linear exploration RPG centered around an aimless formation drowned in illusion. Follow an unknown path, conceived from unseen torment.

title: Ann's Parlor
description: Awakened from years of slumber, the witch Ann returns to her old cabin, where visitors arrive seeking love, truth, or glimpses of fate. Through crystal-ball readings, you interpret their stories and guide their paths—every choice reshaping their destinies and the secrets that await within.

title: Unit-5000
description: UNIT-5000 is a top-down extraction roguelite bullet hell where you build a combat mech and fight alien invaders. Experiment with weapons and modules, face hordes and multi-phase bosses, extract resources before a run goes wrong, and use them to unlock deadlier builds for the next fight.

title: My Friend, Dysentery
description: A darkly comedic "horribly realistic fantasy travel simulator" survival adventure roguelike inspired by Oregon Trail. Journey to the Promised Land to kill a dragon! Fight monsters, manage supplies & disasters, and learn that fantasy journeys are nothing heroic like the films, but cripplingly brutal.

title: Silent Mainland
description: Silent Mainland is a roguelike deckbuilder based on movement and grid mechanics. Players engage in tactical battles on a vast 5x12 battlefield. Facing waves of oncoming monsters, use card-driven movement and positional control to defeat foes in dynamic formations.

title: After Eternity
description: Awaken as the Inquisitor, prepare your soul, and dive into an epic sci-fi survival horror adventure. Fight ceaseless horrors, challenge abhorrent scientists, and protect the universe in its final moments. Will you ease humanity into a peaceful slumber or succumb to the dream of a new world?

title: Wishing Well Simulator
description: You are a wishing well in a small seaside town. Eight people return for eight days, tossing coins and whispering what they want most. Your power is limited: every wish you grant makes another impossible. The town remembers everything.

title: Shrine Labyrinth
description: A 1–4 player co-op Japanese horror game. Beyond the torii gate lies an otherworldly labyrinth whose layout changes randomly. Work together to escape as you run from, hide from, and sometimes confront terrifying supernatural entities!

title: Just a Stupid Room
description: Explore 30 rooms filled with original puzzles in this first-person puzzle game. Observe, experiment, and doubt the obvious. The door won't open itself.

title: Feastfall
description: Feastfall is a cooking roguelike deckbuilder. Plate ingredient cards into recipes, stack game-breaking charm synergies, and feed ravenous monsters. This is not a kitchen sim. It's a life-or-death gamble at the dinner table — and the house is starving.

title: I was rebuilt
description:
I was rebuilt is a challenging precision platformer rage game where frustration and glory are measured in milliseconds. Thought you were a platforming god just because you beat Super Meat Boy or Celeste? How cute.

Here, you take control of R3B, an agile robot created by Dr. Zhang, who has jumped straight into the most sadistic and lethal TV show on the planet: “Robot Annihilation Madness”.

title: The Dream Of Winning The Lottery
description: Find clues to lucky numbers through prophetic dreams and various events, then buy lottery tickets each week. Keep chasing the jackpot and fulfill your dream in this simple 2D point-and-click lottery simulation game.

title: That Cloud Looks Like
description: Huh? This cloud looks like... something! What do you see in a randomly generated cloud? The drawer adds clues inside the cloud, while the other players try to guess the answer from as few clues as possible. Compete using your imagination and intuition in this online drawing quiz game.

title: Tidying Simulator
description: Find scattered objects and return them to their proper places in this first-person tidying simulator. Follow silhouettes and a compass, unlock new abilities as you progress, and restore the entire house to perfection!

title: Astral Bounty
description: Astral Bounty is a science-fiction 2D arcade shoot ’em up inspired by Blood Money. Players destroy hand-built enemy formations and collect credits during each stage. Credits can be spent at in-level shops on weapons and upgrades. The game has a single, demanding difficulty setting. Optional checkpoint insurance allows a run to continue after death, but doing so invalidates the one-credit clear.

title: The Third Surveillance Bureau
