description: Watch the monitors, spot anomalies, and protect citizens in the dead of night. The Third Surveillance Bureau is a 2D horror game centered on surveillance. Cycle through camera feeds, report irregularities in time, and uncover a reality far more terrifying than monsters.

title: Bad Slime
description: Bad SLIME is a fast-paced action roguelite built on controls that forces you to either move or attack. Explore a fallen megacity and fight monsters, gather treasure and reveal secrets. Collect items that not only make you stronger - it changes what you are.

title: Cortesia Rising
description: Cortesia Rising is a space captain simulator that combines tactical ground combat, crew & ship management, and broadside naval combat in a hand-crafted Sci-Fi universe, developed and self-published by an experienced team of industry veterans and artists.

title: Words Of Power
description:
Words Of Power is a fill-in-the-blank roguelike deckbuilder. Travel deep into the dungeon and fight using the power of words. Construct sentences of devastating power and rewrite your foes.

Rewrite reality one sentence at a time!

title: Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United
description: Experience a full remake of Romancing SaGa 3, featuring fully realized 3D graphics, refined gameplay systems, new musical arrangements, voice acting, and more. Choose from eight different protagonists and embark on a turn-based RPG adventure as you uncover the fate of the Child of Destiny.

title: Print I Love U
description:
"A few weeks ago I came across a second hand laptop. The previous owner had disappeared.

On it, I found this game: Print I Love U. It's a short visual novel with three simple mini-games. Reaching the end takes about 15 minutes. It’s got hand-drawn characters and an original soundtrack that’s been living in my head rent-free since the first time I played it.

At the beginning, there's a note. It says the game was made for someone called Alice. It says: I hope you find this.

I've been trying to find her too.

I don't know who made this game. I don't know who Alice is. What I do know is that something about it stays with you, whether you want it to or not.

There's more than one ending. Not all of them feel like endings.

If you're Alice (or if you think you might know her) please tell me. Maybe you can solve this mystery."

This game may include content that is not suitable for all ages.

title: Made Up Chart
description: Surreal quick reactions virtual trading game where you buy and sell made up stocks by shooting it’s buy and sell buttons. Different made up stocks are more volatile, sell at the right time to maximise your gains/minimise losses. Sell before the made up stock goes off the screen, crashes or gameover.

title: Puzzle to the End
description: It's a puzzle game where you can piece together images using specially shaped pieces. Featuring an 8x8 standard grid, magnetic grids, flipable grids, and shape-shifting blocks, it offers over 30 levels of escalating challenges—each piece holds the key to victory.

title: Gem Tales 2: Crystal Dragon
description: Gem Tales 2: Crystal Dragon is a story-rich match-3 adventure with 100 handcrafted levels. Match crystals, solve clever puzzles, and help Luna guide a lonely crystal dragon through a changing world filled with charm and magic.

title: Chomp Chomp Carnage
description: Eat everything. Grow big. The ocean's never looked this cozy and deadly at the same time. A fish-eat-fish arcade chomper where every creature is crafted from wool. Devour your way up the food chain in Chomp Chomp Carnage.

title: Sandbox Survivors
description: A 2D survival RPG set in a post-apocalyptic landscape. Players must gather resources, construct a safe haven, and fend off the monstrous threats that roam the earth.

title: Capitaland
description: Start by selling lemonade and rise to become the king of the town. Build businesses, earn reputation, play minigames, buy luxury items, and gain boosts by collecting mushrooms.

title: Undead World Order
description: Undead World Order is a 2D zombie horde shoot-'em-up where you take command of heavily armed tanks to obliterate the flesh-hungry zombie hordes and everything else standing between you and survival.

title: Arachnaut
description: A 2D side scrolling offline platformer with style and music at its core. Avoid hazards, collect power-ups, unlock game modes, upgrade your abilities, and complete achievements. Oh... and get some hats while you're at it!

title: The Legend of Fatinha
description: The Legend of Fatinha is a third-person fantasy action RPG set in a medieval world threatened by a growing darkness. Explore, aid kingdom soldiers, and develop your character through equipment, skills, and combat tactics. With flexible build choices, a gradual progression system, five main chapters, and a hidden ending, the game emphasizes exploration and experimentation over cinematic storytelling.

title: Rule: After Waking Up, Please Don't Call Me
description: "Rule: After Waking Up, Please Don't Call Me" is an independent game created by a single person. In the game, players take on the role of an amnesiac girl, who needs to retrieve her memories and explore the tragic murders that once happened here in a dungeon full of death and rules.

title: Zenonia
description: Remember the RPG that defined a generation? ZENONIA is back—faithfully restored and now on Steam. Relive the adventure that kept you playing for hours, or experience it for the first time.

title: The Cat in Yellow
description: An adorable cat turns creepy. Take care of it, explore the house, and survive the night.

title: Doko no Donata no Kanjou Root
description: Shouta’s mother is the Kaguya-hime from fairy tales. This spring, a new transfer student Tsubasa appeared in his class. In her previous life, she was a prince who was rejected by Kaguya-hime. She recognized features of Kaguya-hime in him and fell in love with him at first sight. However, her confession was stopped by other girls who used to be Kaguya-hime’s suitors and who held feelings for him.

title: Cube on a Leash
description: Cube on a Leash is a dungeon crawler roguelike about commanding your very volatile pet cube. Use your leash to avoid collateral damage as the cube carries out your sequences of attacks -- both manually and automatically -- and becomes your customizable agent of mass destruction.

title: Funorbit
description: Funorbit is a physics-based pixel art space survival simulation where you navigate a vast, procedurally generated universe using realistic orbital mechanics. Master acceleration, deceleration, and gravitational forces to explore planets, moons, and drifting meteoroids, each with unique motion and spin. Collide with meteoroids to break them into pieces, evade cosmic dangers, and use your HUD to track real-time speed, distances, and directions as you travel through deep space.

title: CyberKitty: Neon Merge
description: Suika games have evolved! CyberKitty: Neon Merge is a cozy, yet action-driven, dynamic 2D physics puzzle game for 90s retro, pixel art, and match-3 fans! Instead of watermelons, merge a cast of colourful cats. With the CatCade system, swiftly match kitties to boost your multiplier for mega scores!

title: Find The Needle
description: Your a pleasant farmer that dropped a bag of needles into a haystack, now your goal is to find the needle. Incremental game where you build multiple Satisfactory style structures and create real production lines to construct the biggest hay processing and needle finding factory possible.

title: Ballistic Brews
description: Drive tanks and robots in an immersive roguelike bullet heaven. Drift, shoot, and smash through 15 waves while brewing the ultimate build to defeat brutal bosses and elite enemies.

title: Blight Doctors
description: Discover, diagnose, exorcise. You are a plague doctor paranormal investigator living in a rotten, gothic city at the end of an apocalypse. Banish ghosts, cure plagues, treat with monsters... all in co-op and proximity chat!

title: Sfsim
description: sfsim is a realistic 3D space flight simulator under development. You can already download the sfsim playtest build on Steam and try it out. sfsim uses true celestial positions of Earth and Sun from NASA. Use an advanced single-stage-to-orbit space craft to take off, orbit the planet, perform reentry, and land back on Earth. sfsim features a true to scale Earth planet using NOAA elevation data and procedurally generated volumetric clouds.

title: Floraison
description: Floraison is a cozy narrative game based on the language of flowers. Explore Heimat, meet its curious inhabitants, gather rare plants, and craft emotionally powerful bouquets to help them, shape the story, and convey the message of your choice.

title: Silk & Sorrow
description: Two children stumble into a hidden world where all the unwanted from humanity ends up to find new purpose. Together, they must explore a haunting, hand-drawn landscape, survive its twisted horrors, and uncover the origins of the Chrysalis

title: I Woke up in an RPG
description: After dying, you awaken inside a fantasy game world. Battle through a 3D action-RPG with soulslike-inspired combat. Slash, shoot, and cast spells to conquer powerful enemies before youre lost in the game for good.

title: Seaforge: Shores of Atlantis
description: Beneath the waves, the world of Atlantis awaits. Build your home base on sunlit Mediterranean shores, then dive into sunken ruins to uncover secrets of the deep. Get stronger, dive deeper, and battle dark forces with up to 3 friends in this underwater survival crafting odyssey!

title: The 7th Shift
description: A psychological horror game about working overnight shifts alone in a grocery store. Stock shelves. Clean. Do your job. But you soon realize something sinister is watching. Survive seven shifts to discover why you were really hired and face a choice that will seal your fate.

title: Nightwatch at the Museum
description: A routine night shift at an old Javanese museum. A fire from 1990 that nobody talks about. And something, or someone that refuses to let the truth stay buried.

title: 5-Star Taxi
description: A fast-paced arcade taxi game where time is your greatest enemy - find shortcuts, deliver passengers, tear through a destructible city, escape the police, and earn a perfect 5-star rating before your shift ends.

title: Silent Authority: Blood & Bourbon
description: Strategy meets action RPG in the 1920s New York underworld of crime. Collect protection money, trade, and expand your criminal empire while leading your crew in brutal tactical combat. Rule the city with cunning diplomacy or pure bloodshed.

title: SE3 Protocol: Last Drop
description: CE-III Protocol is a horror puzzle RPG set in an SCP-inspired world. An amnesiac girl wakes in the darknessfrail, timid but not alone nor defenseless. Face deadly entities: observe, evade, exploit or simply eliminate them. Lead her through this surreal nightmare, and uncover the secret behind it.

title: Last Pill Bar
description: A virus is spreading. You can't afford to pickle everyone. Keep the bar open and decide who gets pickled before the outbreak decides who dies.

title: Medieval Squad Tactics
description: This game is focused on turn based tactical combats. The complexity of the game comes from having to carefully manage your various formations in order to defeat your enemies. Carefully plan your actions to win the battle.

title: Velvet Shedding
description: Bring back Llum from the infected comfort of his memories. Find his most precious moments and shatter them all in this open exploration game.

title: Emberglade
description: A roguelike slot machine you actually play. Spin to survive, loot relics that rewrite the reels, and bet your gold against a rising toll — or die broke on the road to Shadowkeep.

title: Demon Crisis
description: A classic On-Rails Shooter, compatible with every modern USB lightgun with live recoil. Hide in cover to avoid hits and reload, then emerge to shoot your way through a horde of bloodthirsty demons.

title: Fleshgrinder
description:
Fleshgrinder is an isometric post-apocalyptic action-rpg where every decision has weight.
Set in 2053, six months after the Fleshgrinder virus outbreak transformed 70% of augmented humanity into a hive-minded techno-organic collective.

Features three distinct characters with their own skill trees, optional friendly fire, hardcore permadeath mode, dismemberment physics, randomized mission areas, 30+ unique weapons, 100+armors, augmentations, consumables, ammo types with deep penetration mechanics and tons of loot with highly randomized attributes. NPCs with lots of side-quests and a faction reputation system which determines trade prices, dialogue choices and overall behaviour. Battle 11 unique enemy types through seamless mission areas in a huge persistent world where everything stays as you left it - all to stop the evolution of the Fleshgrinder and save humanity from extinction.

title: The Monkey's Paw
description: Hold the monkey's paw and make a wish, but remember: everything comes at a price. A short horror visual novel where choices matter...painfully.

title: Aeonfall
description: Command the Unwoven—heroes erased from history—in a tactical 2D Roguelite where every turn shifts the battlefield. Lead your squad through a fractured Greek timeline to dismantle the Loom of Fate and dethrone a paranoid King of the Gods.

title: Woke Quest
description: Woke Quest is a satirical turn-based RPG that humorously critiques real-life events, people, and gaming clichés. Four unsuspecting individuals are suddenly pulled from their reality into a vibrant realm of magic and mythical creatures. Solve the mystery of a deep conspiracy.

title: Dynamite Day
description: Sirens blare, the instruments lie. Dynamite Day is a co-op thriller inside a missile-defense bunker: in minutes, tell a real attack from the spies' lies and decide whether to launch the counterstrike. Co-op for up to 6 players. One mistake - and humanity is dust.

title: Static Hour
description: Static Hour is a 1980s newsroom thriller where you decide what goes on air during a mysterious lockdown. Uncover a story you cant see but only hear, and choose which voices make it to air. Every broadcast pushes the town closer to the truth or deeper into panic.

title: Duat: Beyond Light & Shadow
description: The mystical Egyptian underworld beckons you in Duat: Beyond Light & Shadow! Foil the plans of Set and Apep using your powers of light. Explore the varied environments of the underworld and battle your way through in this epic pixel art style Metroidvania.

title: Sole Salvation
description: Sole Salvation is an action roguelite hack and slash where you can wield a ranged weapon and a melee weapon simultaneously. Recover your thoughts to combine your abilities, defeat the creatures that hunt you, and advance through the corrupted lands of your memories in search of redemption.

title: Fedanheim
description: A first-person psychological horror set in a plant that runs on human flesh. Lose limbs, scavenge scrap, and craft prostheses at the workbench to open the way forward. Every replacement makes your steps louder, and something in the corridors hears everything. You cannot fight it. Run and hide.

title: Unknown at This Address
description: Unknown at This Address is a horror game set in a small 1970s Normandy village. You play as a local kid delivering the morning mail by bike after all communications went dark.

title: Ichorian Tales
description: Inspired by the traditional Zelda formula, Ichorian Tales is focused on that old-school dungeon crawling experience! Explore, fight enemies, solve puzzles and obtain new abilities to crack open the dungeon and fight massive bosses!

title: Still Rooms
description: A cozy, pixel-art decorating game where you design and furnish unique homes across 7 themed locations — from modern apartments and rustic houses to retro 80’s interiors, student rooms, rooftops, and even a spaceship.

title: Finite Jest
description: A first-person office horror-comedy where you survive corporate shifts, complete bizarre jobs, sabotage the workplace to finish faster, and avoid getting caught by Clanker, the AI watching over the company.

title: Aertan
description:
Aertan is a cooperative online RPG set on a tropical island and the seas around it. Players share one persistent server world: a fishing village with inhabitants who follow their own daily routines, a safe harbor, wild shores, and open water with several sea zones to sail through.

The core loop revolves around the sea. Players fish with rods and bait, row and sail small boats, and hunt large sea creatures with a harpoon and line, where tension, stamina and the boat itself are part of the fight. Catches and carcasses are butchered, cooked or crafted into tools, gear and bait. Gathering and crafting feed a skill system inspired by EVE Online: skills train over time through a queue, while combat and gathering only accelerate it.

Progression is horizontal rather than level-based. Characters are built from modular parts with a choice of species, face and body, and are meant to be equipped through crafting and trade. The design draws on Albion Online, EVE Online, ArcheAge and Dredge. The game is in early alpha and is available for Windows through its own launcher.

title: Chaos Warrior
description: Chaos Warrior is a retro JRPG inspired by the NES era. Fight deadly monsters, explore dangerous locations, and gain the strength to become the hero that saves the world!

title: Arknights: Endfield - Update 1.5: Dreamscape of Wind and Snow
description:
Version 1.5 of Arknights: Endfield includes:
• New Operators: Typhoeus
• New Free Operator Event: Purrchena
• New Weapons: New signature 6★ weapon for Typhoeus
• New Areas: Snowy Forest, Suiming
• New Story Content: New story chapters and missions
• New Systems: RE-Factor Headhunting
• New Events and Rewards

title: Olinda Fighters
description: Olinda Fighters is a brawl style fight game inspired by Brazil's northeastern carnival characters. Featuring two different play modes: rounds or last man standing, for 1 up to 4 players. Use power-ups and energy drinks to move faster and hit harder your opponents. Remote Play multiplayer compatible!

title: Spooky Land Defenders
description: A spooktacular strategic monster defense roguelite. Protect your haunted house from interdimensional corporate real estate investors by collecting horrific monsters, dreadful decor, terrible traps, and bizarre curios. Easy to sink your fangs into, but also a FRIGHTENINGLY deep strategy game!

title: On The Hook
description: You owe the casino boss a debt you can never repay—one that snowballs with compounding interest, growing heavier by the night. Several young female agents, themselves ensnared in the trap, are ready to take your orders. Make it out of the casino before the debt buries you alive.

title: Taboo Village: Tokimeki Card Game
description: Play a deadly roguelite card game with a mysterious animal-eared girl in your dreams. Build melds, upgrade your cards, gain powerful abilities, and defeat bosses. Lose, and you'll never wake up—but as long as she's there, maybe staying in the dream isn't so bad.

title: Fenestra: My Focus, Her Future
description: Fenestra awakens inside your PC knowing only her name. Work, study, and create with her in this Princess Maker-inspired raising-sim adventure with focus tools. Your focus time fuels her growth; the stats you raise and words you choose shape her personality, appearance, your bond, and her future.

title: Zelene Lux: Spirit Notes - Collector's Edition
Pirate Twist
description:
Pirate Twist is a top-down 2D naval roguelite where your ship is a mobile base. Outfit it from 17 modules across a 5×8 grid: cannons, mortars, hull plates, storage holds, and repair stations. Every loadout creates a different playstyle.

Sail a branching three-sea campaign where you pick your path through every expedition. Fight pirate fleets, brave storms and mystery waters, hold a besieged port through five waves, and duel a named boss captain at each sea's finale.

Combat is pure positioning, with no cursor and no twitch-aim. Pick your live broadside, swing it onto the enemy, and time the volley. Directional component damage (hull, sails, crew, fire), four ammo types, and stern-rake bonuses reward reading the fight.

Defeat costs resources, not the run. You rebuild at Port and sail back out. Captain XP and skills persist across runs, five captain archetypes wait to be unlocked, and a per-captain New Game+ ladder ramps the threat after every win.

title: Incredeck
description: Incredeck is a small incremental game where you collect cards, earn money, buy upgrades, and unlock new stages of the game.

title: Witches' Legacy: Dark Days to Come - Collector's Edition
Witches' Legacy: Dark Days to Come
Witches' Legacy: The City That Isn't There
Critical Failure: No Man's Land
description:
A live action series controlled by a video game, the story goes from the game to the show Critical Failure like both worlds are one, allowing the viewers of the show at home to experience more through the game of the current timeline and story of Critical Failure. This is a game that evolves and changes as the story Critical Failure does. Each of the Critical Failure series of games will change as time does with each new release of an episode. Each time an episode changes, so will the games.

This game will remain a zombie survival game with constant improvements and new levels as the story evolves. 4-player multiplayer wave-based zombie survival game that you can always play solo.

With the added touch of the Drive-In Theatre, you will be given access to the content we release as it changes the game around you.

From the mind of Sinyster Soulutions Studios comes a brutal, wave-based zombie survival experience that bleeds directly into the universe of their hit show, CRITICAL FAILURE.

You aren't just playing a game; you are surviving the aftermath. As the show's narrative twists, mutates, and fractures, the game evolves in real time. Every lore drop, every catastrophic broadcast event, and every "critical failure" on screen rewrites the rules of your survival.

4-PLAYER wave based zombie survival that evolves with the shows episodic content release.

title: Wilderness Mosaic: Where the Road Takes Me
Shoku Pain
description: Run a night-shift bakery inside a quarantine zone. Every customer looks human at first. Check their symptoms, fill the report, and make the call bread, medicine, or the knife. Keep your supplies stocked and beware what waits outside the glass.

title: Fish Them All!
description: Move your boat, drop the hook, and reel in whole schools of fish. Expand your skill tree with new Steam-edition upgrades, recruit divers, drones, and a UFO, and watch each 30–60 second run explode. A complete 4–5 hour pixel-art incremental fishing adventure.

title: Martha's Dolls 2
description: Return to the decaying halls of the Martha Estate in this bone chilling sequel to the viral horror hit. As an urban explorer obsessed with the "Disappeared," you step into a nightmare where the porcelain faces aren't just decorations they are silent hunters.

title: Leg Day: Four Steps Through Hell
description:
Leg Day: Four Steps Through Hell is a physics-based precision platformer where you control a single leg trying to escape an increasingly absurd and hostile world.

Control a single leg in a brutal physics-based precision platformer. Balance, jump and master momentum through four increasingly absurd stages. One bad move can send you falling.

title: Recycle Shop Eco
description: 3-Match Puzzle × Human Observation × Horror Novel Recycle Shop ECO is a binary art style 3-match puzzle and horror novel game. Fulfill customers' requests, gather information about them, and explore a hidden world of horror.

title: The Sea Is Our Stage
description: A fantasy yuri visual novel in which a noblewoman uncovers her father's evil plot and, along with her lowborn friends, takes to the seas to flee from high society. Her plan to right her family's wrongs and return home are disrupted by the untimely arrival of an enigmatic and flirtatious pirate.

title: Go Next!
description: Grow exponentially stronger as you survive hordes of monsters across 9 different worlds. Gather resources, level up, build your skill tree, and parkour your way out of chaos!

title: The Last Curse
description: The Last Curse is a first-person psychological horror game. Uncover terrifying secrets, solve intricate puzzles, and navigate dark, atmospheric environments where fear lurks around every corner. Trust your instincts to survive the night.

title: The Gutter
description: Descend into 1801 China as an opium-addicted father who sold his daughter, now prowling a burned-out floating brothel for treasures. As you touch relics of the dead, violent memories reveal a sickening truth: the greatest monster in this tale has always been you.

title: Exam Simulator 2024
description: Inspired by online typeracing games like typeracer, this unique and difficult horror survival game is sure to be something you haven't seen before. With 4 unlockable difficulties that get gradually harder and harder, nearing impossibility, there is surely something for everyone.

title: Kill Me Yesterday
description: A rainy night in 2040. Tyren is shot dead by his wife of seven years, Samantha—only to wake up ten years in the past. In this cyberpunk mystery RPG, enter others' minds, uncover hidden memories, and chase the truth through choices and restarts to find her again.

title: Mycelium Protocol
description: A nonlinear thriller where cyberpunk meets biopunk. A rebellion is brewing in the “perfect” city of Kudesh. Choose your side and decide who you are willing to trust with your life.

title: Terminal Reign
description:
Terminal Reign is a game about remotely controlling an armoured vehicle with a clunky diegetic interface.

Operate a remote armoured vehicle for the glory and whims of a dying empire. Undertake tactical missions, configure your command desk with an array of devices, and remain in favour to survive.

"A vast empire struggles to maintain its millennia old grip on the stars. Headed by an emperor half-deranged by centuries of rule, its power is challenged by the organising kingdoms that border its domain. To manage these threats, the empire presses anyone it can into servitude to operate its decaying military of remote weapons."

title: Cloudgazer: A Game About Watching Clouds
description: A game about watching clouds. Discover hundreds of hidden shapes, train your pareidolia, and let your imagination do the rest.

title: Mafia Hotel
description: Mafia Hotel is a multiplayer social deduction game for up to 16 players. Talk, lie, accuse, and vote by day, then return to your hotel room at night—where the Mafia may come knocking. Survive the night and uncover who you can trust.

title: Pegs of Hell
description: A physics roguelike where you build the pachinko board yourself. Place and upgrade pegs, arrange powerful Arcana, split balls, trigger elemental chains and create absurd scoring machines before Hell's rent catches up with you.

title: Squarelings
description: A chaotic co-op puzzle platformer for 4–12 players, where every level is a new test of communication, teamwork and friendship.

title: The Grey Wolves - Knight's Cross Edition
description: GWX - Knight's Cross Edition is the official successor to the Grey Wolves eXpansion - commonly known as "GWX" - the most popular supermod for the classic 2005 U-boat simulation game Silent Hunter III.

title: Rob Run
description: Rob Run is a brutal crime sandbox featuring thousands of players. Rise above everyone through the grit, the grime, and the struggle. Break free and take yourself from squalor by any means.

title: Elf no Oyome-san: Harem Kon Suishou
Lord Liberty Quest II: Pure White
description: Someone is secretly hastening the revival of the "Black Devil" that assaults the Disodart Continent every few decades. Taking the situation gravely, the royal capital entrusts the tower's investigation to a church priestess. But that priestess is a young, innocent maiden…

title: Momoiro Okami no Honoka-san: Ikenai, O-mo-te-na-shi
Gem Party
description: Match 3 or more gems to channel their power into your cute animal party. Defeat the endless bosses charging toward you.

title: Trade the Crash
description: A no-rewind trading survival sim set during the dot-com crash. Manage $50,000, pay living expenses, and trade 63 fictionalized instruments across 818 market days. Choose a career path, manage risk, and learn from 86 built-in lessons while every decision carries forward.

title: The Library on the Lake
description: Library on the Lake is a narrative multiverse where players take on the mantle of the Archivist. Undo a magical curse by traveling into different books to repair corrupted stories. Explore other worlds, meet a unique cast of characters, and play engaging mini games.

title: Desktop Bouncer
description: Desktop Bouncer is a cozy desktop companion physics game where a lively cartoon ball bounces across your screen, colliding with icons, chasing high scores, and turning your desktop into a playful arcade playground while you work, browse, or relax.

title: The Sovereign's Board
description: The Sovereign's Board is an online 1v1, 3D, turn-based strategy game. Battle against your rival by utilizing a team of 3 unique characters all with their own strengths and weaknesses.

title: Observation Protocol
description: Observation Protocol is a first-person psychological horror game set in a liminal office space that exists outside normal space. From an external observation post, you must monitor camera feeds and identify discrepancies within the facility. When the power cuts, protocol requires you to enter the facility yourself, photograph every discrepancy, and return before the passage closes at 6 AM.

title: Books for Bad Neighbors
description: Run a 199X bookshop by mail. Every order tells you what someone plans to do. Decide what to sell, and to whom.

title: Pocket Adventurer
description: Your desktop's tiniest hero. A cozy idle RPG that lives above your taskbar: heroes delve dungeons and haul loot home while you work, companions fill your camp, and every retired legend makes the next hero stronger.

title: RippleLoop
description: Chain together stone skips in this relaxing incremental game. Launch, bounce across the water, upgrade, and go further with every throw. Buy new upgrades and powers to become the best stone skipper.

title: G-Mode Archives+: Ridge Racer
description: A legendary 3D car racing masterpiece that earned its place in gaming history. Blast through corners with spectacular drifting!

title: Banana Republic
description: In Banana Republic, guerrilla fighters seize the supreme court. Neutralize terrorists, rescue hostages, choose to serve your country. Uncover a history of corruption and violence.

title: Lost Museum: Echoes of the Chromageists
description: Forgotten masterpieces with stories still left to be told... Lost Museum -Echoes of the Chromageists- is an adventure game that tells the story of Chromageists, beings with strange faces born of paintings. Through their memories, unravel the meaning each piece of art holds.

title: Kokoro Clover Infinite Phantasm
description: The latest installment in the Kokoro Clover series, which crosses visual novel style stories with boss battling action, all in the style of a Saturday-morning cartoon! Featuring new locations, new characters, and new transformations! Join our heroes as they work together to face the forces of evil!

title: Stonefall
description: You are a stone, fallen from the cosmic abyss into an unforgiving dark fantasy world. Unleash abilities as you jump, roll, slam and air-cannon your way through deadly obstacles, topple four colossal bosses in souls-like combat, and return to the cold void of space where you belong.

title: Super Takoyaki Battle
description:
Experience takoyaki-making like never before!
Make as many as you can in an all-out battle!

title: Melon on a Mission
description: Being a watermelon has never been this dangerous. Climb your way to the top by jumping across everyday objects, balancing on tricky platforms, and avoiding a juicy disaster. Every fall could mean a long trip back down — or a smashed watermelon. Stay calm, keep climbing, and complete your mission.

title: Frontier Tale
description: Frontier Tale is a cozy adventure farming game that blends extraction-style gameplay with town building. Forge weapons, explore a charming cel-shaded fantasy world, gather rare resources, recruit unique companions, and build your dream frontier from the ground up.

title: Captive Love Melty Holic
description: Ruito, a popular underground idol, is suddenly kidnapped and confined in an unfamiliar abandoned building. Blocked by tricky traps and relentlessly pursued by obsessive stans—can Ruito safely escape this building of madness...?

title: Weekend Solitaire: Grace in Motion
description: Over 200 exciting levels, three game modes, beautiful natural environments, a variety of bonuses, and unique obstacles. A relaxing solitaire adventure that both newcomers and seasoned card puzzle fans will enjoy.

title: Panchito Delivery: Project Elevator
description: You're a delivery guy whose routine drop-off turned into a nightmare. Survive the terror of this first-person roguelite, manage your elevator, and reach the Top Floor.

title: The Missing Tail
description: The Missing Tail is a cozy co-op adventure where you play as two cats exploring a lively medieval courtyard and castle.

title: Cubic Color Confusion
description: A puzzle game where a unique color-cycle mechanic requires you to think ahead. Every move affects the state of the puzzle, opening new paths while closing others. Conquer increasingly mind-bending levels as you find order in apparent chaos. Can you sort out the confusion?

title: The Blood of Dawnwalker: Day 1 Edition
description:
The Day 1 Edition comes as a Steelbook with a slipcover.

14th-century Europe.
Bloody conflicts sweep the lands, and the Black Death comes for the survivors. It's a moment of weakness - and that's all they needed.
Vampires seize their opportunity. They walk out of the shadows and claim what they've been denied for centuries: freedom, and power that comes with it. Other creatures of the night follow their lead. Legends turn into reality, and history as we know it will never be the same.
A young man turned into a Dawnwalker, forever treading the line between the world of day and the realm of night. Fight for your humanity or embrace the cursed powers to save your family. Whatever your choice, the question stands: is your soul worth the lives of those you love?

title: Submind
description: Dive into broken minds, with up to 3 friends, in order to stabilize them. Pick the correct path, solve puzzles, pay attention to your surroundings, all while making sure the patient's mind doesn't go to the point of no return, because if does, you'll be facing their worse traumas and nightmares.

title: Liminal Sorting
description: Liminal Sorting is a relaxing organizing simulator set in a mysterious liminal space. Sort more than 6,000 objects, discover strange rooms, unlock abilities, and enjoy a peaceful experience with moments of suspense and timed challenges. Who knows what secrets that mysterious cat is hiding...

title: 404: The Absent God
description: 404: The Absent God is a 2D metroidvania blending exploration, combat, and mystery in a techno-fantasy setting. Players explore the mysterious planet 404 in search of forgotten artifacts, competing against the robotic Zorg race to find the Eye of Vyr'Nox, the fabled Relic of the Absent God.Platform

title: Snooze Control
description: An arcade driving game about mastering the art of the nap - while driving! Steer a brakeless truck through traffic on never-ending roads while skillfuly managing your Snooze-O-Meter - read the road, pick your moment, and keep the truck in control.

title: The Shadows Of Eldergroove
description:
20 years have passed since Agent Rebecca went missing.

The Fresterous Police Department gave up and the world moved on. But Sarah, the daughter of the lead investigator, Agent Rebecca, refuses to let the mystery rest. Firing up her car, she arrives in Eldergroove, a forsaken place where an entire town vanished without a trace.

Is she alone?

title: Lofelia's Cozy Corner
description: Meet Lofelia, your dreamy desktop companion who writes books as you work, study or game. In this cozy clicker game, every time you press a key Lofelia continues to write her stories.

title: Churrasco
description: Be the family BBQ master and try to grill in peace while your chaotic relatives turn everything upside down. Manage the grill, handle food orders, complete quests, and capture memories.

title: Maneater 2
description: The splash-hit ShaRkPG returns in Maneater 2! Eat, explore, and evolve as you try to escape an invite-only preview event for Neptune’s Kingdom — an ultra-luxury seaside theme park destined for disaster, where YOU are that disaster.

title: Crimson Desert: Charting the Unknown
description: Reclaim power and reach beyond-into the unknown.The story of Pywel continues in Crimson Desert: Charting the Unknown as Kliff, Oongka, and Damiane set out to discover their purpose and shape their futures. However, as turmoil unfolds around them, each must fight to forge a path through the trials ahead. Join them on a new adventure and discover what new possibilities await across Pywel.

title: Fire Up Together
description: Fire Up Together is a physics-based co-op platforming adventure for up to four players. Use pressurized water to launch yourself into the air, extinguish fires, overcome chaotic obstacles, and climb as high as possible with your friends.

title: 20 Trials to Heaven
description: In Purgatory, death is not defeat, but surrender is final. A lost soul must face twenty trials with one life and no checkpoints. Will your soul endure the journey, or fade into darkness?

title: Uncanyon
description: Uncanyon is a puzzle-first adventure that drops you into a forgotten world, tucked into the seam between unparallel realities.

title: Beast Market
description: The hunt is automatic. The reading is yours. Build a stockpile while away, compare values, holdings, and sources in the Market Terminal, then choose the next beast to hunt in this free-to-play idle hunting RPG.

title: Light Source
description: Follow Bulb and bring back the light to the dim kingdom of Lumeria, in this dark 2D turn-based RPG. Help the locals and battle your way through increasingly harder odds while uncovering the secrets hidden within the decaying kingdom.

title: Command Doctrine
description: Describe a battle and AI builds it. Describe a war and get a whole campaign. Command Doctrine is a turn-based wargame with endless generated scenarios. Command armies across seven eras and outthink your enemy with supply, morale and terrain. Will your doctrine hold?

title: Rhapsody in Scarlet
description: Set in the jazz-filled streets of 1920s New York, magus Ellie Myers embarks on a journey to confront a threat that could shake the world. Experience exhilarating combat and stack up combos with beasts and magick in this all-new action-adventure game!

title: Arena Blues: Requiem for 35
description: Set in a medieval Roman arena, this is a simultaneous turn-based psychological strategy game. Experience intricate and intense combat based on weapon physics and realistic collision detection. Choose 3 out of 15 slave gladiators, each with their own unique backstory, to form your team.

title: Polluted Flesh
description: Very short on-rails collector game where you're stuck in the guts of a cosmic sea creature, polluted by waste.

title: Gridiron Football League
description: Call plays and take control on the field in a retro American football game backed by a deep franchise simulation. Draft, trade, and develop players, build custom teams and rosters, and chase championships across multiple seasons.

title: Axis Football 2027
description: Axis Football 2027 is a complete American Football Simulation featuring fluid gameplay, endless customization, and the industry's best franchise mode.

title: Brick: One Block at a Time
description: Start with a brick and build a life in a Newark-inspired urban survival sandbox. Scavenge the city and forest, unlock blueprints, build and raid bases, drive stolen cars, command recruits, outsmart rival clans and police, or survive with friends in co-op.

title: This Game is Simple
description: Wander through an ever-changing level in This Game is Simple- a quiet, meditative story about a game developer losing passion towards their work.

title: The Eminence in Shadow: Phantom Echoes
description:
Lurk in the shadows and hunt the shadows.
The Eminence in Shadow comes to home consoles for the first time!
Challenge the powerful opponents that stand in your way in this roguelite action game.

title: Where the Seeds Fall
description: Blight has infected the land, forcing humanity to live upon the branches of the World Tree. After a chance encounter with a strange child, your world begins to fall apart. Navigate ruins, read the wind, and take a leap of faith into this thrilling action-adventure game.

title: CONQ: Crown of No Quarter
description: You were promised the heavens, but found only eternal purgatory -- unable to escape, unable to truly die. Gather your forces across sea and land, show no mercy, and give your enemies no quarter. It's time to bleed again.

title: Rematch: Season 5 - Blue Lock
description:
Rematch × Blue Lock is out now!

New Limited-Time Mode
Jump into Aura Striker, our new limited-time 3V3 game mode. Activate your Aura to temporarily boost your movement speed and shot power. Adapt, seize the momentum, and make every opportunity count!

Free Rewards for Every Player
Head to the store and claim your free Blue Lock Welcome Bundle. You can also progress through the free Event Pass by completing challenges across Aura Striker, Casual, and Ranked, and unlock Blue Lock-inspired cosmetics along the way.

Step into the World of Blue Lock
Take to the pitch with cosmetic bundles inspired by four iconic Blue Lock characters:
Yoichi Isagi
Meguru Bachira
Seishiro Nagi
Rin Itoshi
Each bundle includes a character-inspired skin, a unique goal celebration, and profile cosmetics.

Let's go, diamonds in the rough. Time for aura farming.

title: Final Fantasy VII Revelation: Story DLC 1 - Sephiroth
Final Fantasy VII Revelation: Story DLC 2 - Vincent & the Turks
Secret Cats: Independence Day
description: Dive into the enchanting world of "Secret Cats - Independence Day" a hidden object game where your mission is to uncover every cat hidden within stunning hand-painted artwork. Let your keen eye and curiosity guide you through this captivating journey.

title: Hollywood Hustle: A Prop Collector Simulator
description: A physics-driven cleanup simulator on an abandoned Hollywood studio. Fantasy epics, sitcoms, sci-fi blockbusters: their props ended up here. Sort it all, ship boxed orders to film sets and beyond, sell the rest, and resurrect the old animatronics to help.

title: Project Zircon
description: PROJECT ZIRCON is a deckbuilding roguelike card game. As the ruler of a nation, recruit powerful Character Cards and construct Facilities to expand and strengthen your nation. Build a new strategy every run to save the world from the resurrected Calamity Dragon of the Abyss.

title: Wanderlust: The City of Mists - Collector's Edition
Final Fantasy VII Revelation: Story Expansion Pass
description: Final Fantasy VII Revelation's Story Expansion Pass. This product includes Accessory: Reclaimant Choker & Survival Set, Story DLC 1: Sephiroth, and Story DLC 2: Vincent & the Turks.

title: Final Fantasy VII Revelation: Premium Edition
description: This product includes the main game, the Story Expansion Pass, and Early Access, which allows you to play the game 24 hours before its release.

title: Veronica Rivers: The Order of Conspiracy
Final Fantasy VII Revelation: Accessory - Reclaimant Choker & Survival Set
description: An item set for Final Fantasy VII Revelation.

title: Final Fantasy VII Remake Series Trilogy Edition
description: The Trilogy Edition of the Final Fantasy VII Remake Series.

title: Final Fantasy VII Revelation: Summoning Materia - Polydroid Alexander
description: A summoning materia that summons Polydroid Alexander in the game.

title: Final Fantasy VII Revelation: Armor - Nymphwing Bracelet
description: A bracelet that slightly restores MP after battle.

title: Final Fantasy VII Revelation: Accessory - Risk Taker's Choker
description: A choker that restores HP when using a limit break attack.

title: Final Fantasy VII Revelation: Premium Plus Edition
description: The Premium Plus Edition of Final Fantasy VII Revelation. This product includes the main game, the Story Expansion Pass, and Early Access, which allows you to play the game 24 hours before its release.

title: Vacation Adventures: Cruise Director 6 - Collector's Edition
description: Family friendly Hidden Object Game set onboard a luxury cruise lines

title: Untold History: Descendant of the Sun - Collector's Edition
Aubac
description: Aubac is a video game that turns the player’s operating system into part of the gameplay. It interacts with real files on your computer to help you solve a mystery connected to the game’s executable. Explore, manipulate, and connect clues beyond the traditional game window. An immersive experience that breaks the fourth wall and redefines the digital puzzle genre.

title: Twistingo: Tree of Life - Collector's Edition
description: Embark on an enhanced HOPA adventure! Help Raya search intricate hidden object scenes, solve engaging puzzles, and restore balance to Lumira!

title: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege: Operation Splitfire
description: New dangers emerge and Rainbow Six Siege launches Operation Split Fire to identify these threats. Flying back to his Egyptian homeland to assist, Operator Noor brings his worldly knowledge, tactical acumen, and his Horus Lance gadget, a projectile that can attach on ballistic shields or surfaces and then emit flames!

title: Travel Cuisine 3: The Sea of Flavours
Agile Cube
description: In Agile Cube, you control a cube. You jump across platforms. You reach the portal. That's it, but the challenge is in the timing, the spacing, and getting better each time.

title: Trial of the Gods: Ariadne's Journey
Tower of Wishes 5: Indonesia
description: Tower of Wishes 5: Indonesia is an enchanting match-3 puzzle set in mystical Indonesia, blending rich storytelling with challenging puzzle gameplay. Besieged by a devouring shadow, your people's memories are fading. Can you climb the tower, solve the puzzles, and restore the First Song of creation?

title: Hitobashira
description: A PSX-style horror game set in a Japanese high school in the 90s. You play as a lone schoolgirl trying to piece together how she ended up there. Explore the empty halls, uncover what happened, and find a way out before you get found.

title: Starbase Tactics
description: Starbase Tactics is a fast 1v1 rts autobattler about planning, scouting, timing, and tactical choices. Play compact, competitive matches designed around clear decision-making.

title: Rakhem
description: Rakhem is an action platformer roguelite where you decide the enemies you have to face! Collect treasure to progress throughout each of the game's varied areas, choosing between the many different upgrades and foes available at your disposal, as well as spending cash on useful permanent upgrades!

title: The Listener
description: "The Listener is a first-person investigation game. Play as a Yugoslav radio amateur at the height of the Cold War. Use your equipment to pick up mysterious transmissions, analyze cryptic messages, and gather hidden clues to uncover a sinister conspiracy"

title: Platform Chess
description: Platform Chess combines classic board strategy with platform-fighting combat. Plan your moves, battle for captures, and master the unique abilities of every chess piece in local matches or against the computer.

title: Clobbo
description: A gore comedy roguelite about hitting a whole crowd at once. Everything comes apart in pieces and nothing gets cleaned up: blood pools, bodies pile, the map remembers every swing. Die, spend the loot, send in the next robot.

title: Ashen Legacy
description: Ashen Legacy is a fast-paced 2D Action RPG set in a dark fantasy world. Master intense combat, unleash powerful skills, defeat deadly monsters, and uncover the legacy buried within the ashes.

title: Lucent
description: Lucent is a logic-based puzzle game, where you aim to hit the target within the provided moves.

title: Time Mysteries 3: The Final Enigma - Collector's Edition
Slum Z
description: Slum Z is a horror incremental roguelike featuring tower defense elements. Fight through relentless zombie hordes, a single-player in a dark survival shooter where every bullet counts. hunt for rare cursed blood, and upgrade your arsenal and prepare yourself.

title: PeeVPee
description: A chaotic multiplayer party game where you drink, fill your bladder, and compete with your friends to pee on as much as possible. Drink up, aim well, and claim the most territory to win!

title: Tornado: The Secret of the Magic Cave
Fjordal
description: A Viking colony sim with production chains and resource management. Establish a Norse village and refine the land's resources. Pay tribute to the King, or grow strong enough to fight back.

title: Fibbtry
description: A Poolcore atmospheric exploration game. Wander freely, drift in thought, until you're ready to wake and carry this rain back into the real world.

title: Maskborne
description: A dark, hand-drawn Metroidvania set in a world where death has disappeared. Fight twisted creatures, uncover forgotten secrets, and discover powerful Boundlings as you journey to restore death to a world that has forgotten how to die.

title: Level P
description: You are trapped underground with one way out. Find your car, follow the sound, and dont let the car park fool you.

title: Corposlop
description: Corposlop is an automation game that lives on your desktop. Harvesting resources using bureaucracy, and refine it into components to feed the corporate machine. Make advanced factories and efficient pipelines to make the most out the limited land you have.

title: Theatre of Shadows: As You Wish
Sleep Outbreak
description: An online co-op horror game for 1-2 players. The Sleep has fallen upon the region. Every one has fallen asleep while dangerous Moribo and Day-Night Terrors roam. Extract materials and save Moribos before the environment turns hostile at night. Fail to extract and your gear are lost to the dark.

title: Final Fist
description: Step into the shoes of a survivor in a dying, alien-occupied earth. Fight through the zombified horde of infected humans with your extensive knowledge of martial arts and evade capture by your alien overlords while on a mission to avenge your planet.

title: Kayf-Life: Complete Edition
description: A modification for Half-Life 2, which is a parody with an alternative look at the story and different voice acting, made in the manner of amateur Russian film dubbing that was popular in late 90's and early 2000s. It also brings visual overhaul, reworked gameplay, new mechanics and more!

title: The Snow Fable: Mystery of the Flame - Collector's Edition
The Secret of Margrave Manor: Remastered
The Secret Order 4: Beyond Time - Collector's Edition
The Secret Order 5: The Buried Kingdom - Collector's Edition
The Other Side: Tower of Souls Remaster - Collector's Edition
Pact or Peril: World Domination
description:
Pact or Peril is a free-to-play strategy game for 1–8 players. Deploy armies, capture territories, control regions, collect cards, and form pacts with other players.

Form pacts, conquer maps, analyze battles, create custom maps, and compete across three win conditions in single-player or online multiplayer.

title: Bajillionaire
description: Purchase and customize ridiculously large slot machines in a quest for inner healing & finding out who did it. BAJILLIONAIRE is a not only a state of the art money-making experience but indeed a chance at spiritual awakening and a welcome distraction from job hunting.

title: The Pirate's Treasure: An Oliver Hook Mystery
The No Jumpscare Show
description:
Welcome to The No Jumpscare Show!
Brought to you by Polypaw, this is a narrative comedy short horror game that promises a 100% jumpscare-free experience! ...Hopefully.

This release is the first part of the story, offering a playtime of around 30 minutes.

In a world where the paranormal is normal, the horror industry has gotten incredibly lazy.

Jumpscares have become the most boring cliché on earth, and Illy is completely unimpressed. She signs up for a shady haunted house promising true psychological horror... without jumpscares? At least, that's what the waiver says.

Run by yours truly, "Thingy the Thing," the kicker is this: if you don't get scared, you'll win $10,000!!

With Illy's constant pushing... things will not end well. And the show will h̷a̷v̷e̷ NOT HAVE ANY JUMPSCARES = )

title: Homicide Desk
description: Read the evidence. Run the forensics. Question suspects in your own words, they lie, crack, or lawyer up. Accuse the wrong person, and Internal Affairs comes after you.

title: Momotaro and the Oni Island
description: The Japanese tale in a Match-3 RPG format! Link elemental orbs to unleash powerful attacks, summon loyal allies, and navigate strategic routes through Onigashima to face the Oni King!

title: Battle of the Kyoshin
description: A miko gal and a Kyoshin go head-to-head with an enemy Kyoshin! Power up your Kyoshin as you fight, and take them down! Finish them with a trump-card Kamiwaza!

title: Nudge
description: nudge is a cozy organization-sim about finding space for your work, mom, and huge assortment of gacha toys. Unbox over 50 collectibles from 8 unique sets, decorate your first apartment, and try to find room for everything in your life, including mom.

title: The Dying Mind
description: The Dying Mind is a story-driven 2D metroidvania where you explore the fractured mind of a young writer, battle symbolic enemies, and uncover lost memories in a race between life and death.

title: It Girl
description: It Girl is a dramatic adventure defined by tense exploration and puzzle-solving mechanics. Play as Nina Tate, a socialite abandoned by her family and standing at a crossroads, as she carries out a series of acts of sabotage to keep her lifestyle afloat. Crafted in the style of a classic horror game, It Girl features a story-driven mode that immerses you in an ironic, satirical narrative.

title: Drawmi: Card Shop
description: Drawmi: Card Shop is an immersive simulator where you and your friends can draw all the cards you sell and run a thriving card shop together.

title: The Keeper of Antiques: The Revived Book
The Keeper of Antiques: The Imaginary World - Collector's Edition
The Battle of Olympus
description: The 1988 classic action-RPG returns! The original creators are rebuilding the code and redrawing the pixel art for a handcrafted Steam remake of a mythic journey across ancient Greece.

title: The Dandelion Endures.
description: This is a dandelion life simulation adventure.

title: Hamayumishi: The Night Parade of a Hundred Yokai
description: The Hamayumishi uses their intense powers of concentration and skills with the bow to protect the villages from the gamboling yokai! This is a side-scrolling twin-stick shooting game. While aiming, the game will slow down to allow you to line up your shot before letting it fly.

title: The Enthralling Realms: The Witch and the Elven Princess
The Enthralling Realms: The Fairy's Quest
The Curio Society: The Thief of Life - Collector's Edition
DIY Dadish
description: Create your own adventure and share it with the world! Everyone's favorite radish dad is back, but this time the story is up to you! in DIY Dadish gives players the ability to design any Dadish level they can imagine.

title: The Great Unknown: Houdini's Castle - Collector's Edition
The Clock the Queen and the Door on the Beach
description: This is a first person adventure about helping an inventor start a very unusual and untested reactor, to save a distant civilization. You explore the island, find clues in the environment, and make progress by solving simple, but interconnected and layered puzzles.

title: Rainbow Tower Defense
description:
Rainbow Tower Defense flips traditional tower defense mechanics on their head by removing direct tower attacks entirely. Instead, the connecting lines drawn between towers act as the primary weapon and line of defense.

Both towers and monsters possess three primary colors, and linking towers inherits or blends these colors into new hues along the connecting line.
To defeat incoming waves, players must strategically match and combine line colors based on elemental and color affinities.

title: Fame & Fear: Dungeon Architect
description: Fame & Fear: Dungeon Architect is a dungeon management and building game where players design, expand and manage a dungeon like a deadly theme park. Build rooms, place traps, monsters, treasures and decorations, attract adventurers, and balance Fear, Prestige, Comfort, Wealth and Reputation without becoming dangerous enough to provoke the Kingdom.

title: Blast Horizon
description: A single-player arcade-style shoot 'em up focused on precise positioning and dodging. Players face waves of enemies approaching from multiple directions, collect energy dropped by foes to temporarily slow time, and use bombs to clear the screen when overwhelmed. Includes a practice mode and emphasizes score-based replayability.

title: Put Your Toys Away Together!
description: A cozy co-op game about turning the toy store of your dreams into a perfectly organized world. Sort all 20,000 toys, find the right home for every doll, dinosaur and train, and watch the shelves spring back to life – on your own or with up to 4 friends.

title: Circulo
description: Circulo is a fast-paced 2D arena survival game centered around geometric chaos. Players control a small circle while facing waves of hostile shapes in an increasingly dangerous battlefield. Defeated enemies provide resources used to improve stats, unlock combat options and acquire upgrades. Runs feature different projectile types, passive upgrades, specialized abilities, enemy variants, bosses, checkpoints and random events.

title: Palm City
description: A first-person co-op action game set in a sunny open city. Play solo or with friends, explore the streets, plan heists, and escape with the loot. Use vehicles, the environment, and physics to your advantage when even the best-laid plan descends into chaos.

title: Face the Puzzle: Masked Journey
description: A difficult and cozy sokoban-like puzzle game. Pick up and drop different masks to change the way you interact with the world. Push objects, move machinery as one, reveal hidden paths, uncover secrets, and activate switches. Press every button, solve every puzzle, and light the candle.

title: Spaces of Mine
description:
An explorable introspection on the meaning of spaces/images through a coming-of-age lens.
Navigate a maze of empty landscapes and bittersweet memories about growing up online.

title: Bellfrost
description: A roguelike city builder where you lead an expedition to build settlements against the ice. Survive harsh winters, fulfill the needs of your villagers, and explore mystical locations with your heroes. Reclaim the realm one island at a time.

title: Pang in Time
description: Blast bubbles through time! Pang In Time is a hilarious arcade adventure. Pop bubbles in wacky worlds with dinosaurs, spaceships & more!

title: Depths' Tale
description: Depths’ Tale is a short first-person cosmic horror experience about a lone fisherman working the night shift. Far from shore, only the waves keep you company... for now.

title: Jinmu: Kamunagara
description: The main character dreams of meeting his missing sister again. One day he meets a girl who looks exactly like her. The next day he returns to that place only to find her fighting another girl with swords...

title: Astonishia Story
description:
Follow Lloyd von Reuental on his quest to recover a stolen relic and regain his honor in this tale of prejudice, manipulation, and duty. The Elven Queen is set on claiming the powers of an ancient god, and it'll be up to you to stop her!

Astonishia Story is an updated version of the classic Korean RPG, featuring enhanced visuals and refined mechanics. Master grid-based battles, recruit mercenaries, and do whatever it takes to see your duty through, even if that means saving the world in the process.

title: PopyAlive
description: The game has a high level of strategy and skill, and players need to move flexibly and use various weapons and tactics to deal with different levels and enemies.

title: Cat or Potat
description: Okay, big guy. So you saw a cat and thought you are a cat-pro? Let's see how you address a simple question - what is it that you see? Is it a cat, or is it a potato?

title: Syobon Action: All-Stars
description: This mod expands Syobon Action (Cat Mario) with levels inspired by several entries in the series, including Syobon 2, 3, 4, 5, Jin, and Takumi. Built around the original game’s source code and physics, it adds new blocks, enemies, skins, achievements, extras, and a level editor. Expect the series’ signature tricky platforming and plenty of frustration.

title: Ninon the Upside-Down Mermaid
description:
In the underwater kingdom of Cerebrite, there live several mermaid princesses. One of them is Ninon, who was born in a peculiar manner unlike the other merfolk: she had the head of a fish, and the legs of a human. As such, the other merfolk shun her, and she feels out of place amongst even her own family.

Meanwhile, Ninon herself carries a desire to see the world beyond her home of the White Sea, a desire that is granted in a most unorthodox fashion on the night of her 21st birthday, in the form of a chance encounter with a nobleman named Vivien Bellerose.

title: Praxion-7
description: A drowned world you can never leave. Crash on it, jack into alien tech, and make your living cutting open salvage, fitting ships and undercutting rivals on a market players run. 390 islands are still unclaimed. Take one.

title: Grimoire Limbo
description:
Trapped in a Necromancer's Grimoire, can you find your memories and escape before losing your mind?

Grimoire Limbo is a turn-based horror adventure set in beautifully crafted, etched-ink environments. 2D sprites interact with the 3D-world like drawings in a book. Every encounter wears on your sanity. Recover a lost memory, and you pull back from the edge. Die, and you slide closer to it.

You can only keep what you can carry - two weapons and two utility items. Every use damages the item a little more until it breaks. Keep the trusted weapon that's almost spent and risk it failing mid-fight, or replace it with one that might not be as powerful but will last a little longer.

title: Gradanix
description: Gradanix is a permadeath co-op action RPG roguelike. Players pick one of seven classes - warrior, paladin, rogue, hunter, mage, priest or warlock - and descend through an endless, procedurally generated dungeon that grows harder with every level, with a boss encounter every seventh floor. Death ends a run permanently, and the depth reached is the score, recorded on global leaderboards that run in three-month seasons. Runs can be played solo, in online co-op or over LAN, with experience shared evenly between party members. An optional Corruption dial increases enemy difficulty and rewards, the first player to find each legendary item is recorded permanently as a world first, and characters keep their level, talents, bank and personal house between seasons.

title: Corid
description: CORID is a first-person hardcore psychological horror game that draws you into a dark, ever-changing world. Explore your surroundings, solve puzzles, and question your own perception—because even when nothing happens, it does not mean you are alone.

title: Puzzling Places: The King's Port
description: Piece together a towering coastal kingdom where ancient castles cling to jagged cliffs and ships drift through the bustling harbor below. Explore a world of legend, courage, and quiet grandeur — a place where myth and mastery meet stone and sea.

title: Star Space
description: A starship shooter — Play Online/LAN Team Deathmatch, or Deathmatch on 3 levels. Or practice by breaking the targets.

title: Surface: The Noise She Couldn't Make - Collector's Edition
The Andersen Accounts: A Voice of Reason - Collector's Edition
Sea of Lies: Leviathan Reef - Collector's Edition
Enigma Protocol
description: Set shortly after the events of the Cooperative Testing Initiative, a test subject wakes to GLaDOS' newest testing track. Make your way through 22 brand new test chambers in this map pack.

title: The Quiet Flat
description: The Quiet Flat is a first-person psychological horror game set in an atmospheric Soviet apartment. Uncover the mystery of your father’s death as your familiar home slowly transforms into a nightmare.

title: Mythmon: Mythic Monsters
description:
Mythmon is a hack-and-slash strategy game where you build the ultimate monster party to take down the Demon King's army.

As the commander, you'll combine Mythmon, equipment, and formations before heading into battle. Combat unfolds automatically, so careful preparation is the key to victory.

Recruit from a roster of 30 unique Mythmon, equip them with over 140 pieces of gear, and experiment with countless team combinations to forge the ultimate party and save the world from the Demon King's invasion!

title: Raven Tower
description:
Krucza Wieża is a free dark fantasy browser RPG set in the Polish city of Val'Gard at the foot of the Black Spire. Players build a character, spend the day on expeditions and training, craft gear, trade with others, join a brotherhood, and climb a 150-floor tower while competing in Arena PvP duels.

The game runs entirely in the browser with progress saved on the server. Combat is stance-based and resolved in round-by-round playback, with class styles and companions shaping each fight. Daily events, a season book, and a player market sit around the long climb of the Spire.

title: Drawmi: Creature Collector
description: A creature collector auto-battler where you can draw all the creatures you collect while battling your way to a Scribble Fighting art degree.

title: Dungeon Bucko
description: Dungeon Bucko is a retro styled dungeon crawler an homage to games like Dungeon Master. Based on Amiya Aranha's community. It was created for the 2026 Buckojam and turned into a full release.

title: Succubus Temptation
description: Succubus Temptation is a classic action game for masochistic audiences. Utilize basic controls such as attack, guard, and dodge to face off against succubi. Guard at the perfect timing to stagger enemies with a "just guard." Perfecting this move will be the key to conquering foes.

title: Aeterna: Shattered Legacy
description: A retro-style fantasy RPG where you explore towns and wilderness, complete quests, uncover secrets, and battle dangerous creatures while discovering the story of Aeterna.

title: Roads of Middle Ages 2: Collector's Edition
Elven Legend 3: The New Menace - Collector's Edition
Despair Beneath the Sunless Sky
description: A psychological horror RPG blending dark fantasy and mystery. Explore a relentless open world, alone or with companions, confront grotesque horrors in turn-based combat, and make irreversible choices. Uncover deep lore and mysteries visible only to those with discerning eyes.

title: UPG: Underground
description: A first person fighting game where your mouse controls your fists and everyone's a bean. Try Multiplayer to punch zombies with your friends, or just punch your friends instead!

title: Techno Chopper
description: Enter the Techno Chopper. Fly through a techno themed environment with rhythm effects, 3 unique music tracks, visualizer mode, 2 player mode, and more.

title: False Myth 2
description: The true sequel to False Myth— a true classic JRPG × beautiful-heroine adventure! Rouge, the agile assassin, sets off with his companions to uncover the truth behind the mysterious girl Sylphina, weaving the most heartrending and fiery “Tale of Hearts.”

title: Cats Around Us: Yarn Ball
description: We've hidden 200 cats inside a silent comic about a calico cat chasing a yarn ball all around the house. Can you find them all?

title: Christmas Luge: The Journey
description: Slide through the dangerous mountain passes to spread Christmas cheer to your fellow penguins — and solve a mystery along the way. Lighthearted with ambient winter environments, this is a game for all ages to enjoy during the Christmas season.

title: Dino Cleanup
description:
Dino Cleanup is a wholesome cleaning 3D platformer where you play as a cute dinosaur with a vacuum cleaner saving a world that has been covered in toxic goop.

So many dinosaur friends are waiting for you to save them from a world covered in icky goop! Scale giant dinosaurs, discover ancient mysteries, and stop the corruption at its source. Suck up the goop and unlock unique vacuum abilities!

title: Find Kittens 12: Pirates
description: Yo-ho-ho and a bottle of rum! Are you ready to travel on an exciting journey with pirates? What are you waiting for? Explore and find cute cats to fill the black-and-white world with bright colors.

title: Find Kittens 13: Cave Town
description: Light your lantern, traveler, for a journey into the depths of the earth awaits you! What are you waiting for?! Explore and find cute cats to fill this black-and-white world with different colors.

title: Sponge Hospital. Five Nights at Bob-Verse
description: A Game Of Neighbor Escape

title: Runner Gunner
description: Race through the streets in this third-person action runner, dodging obstacles or shooting them out of the way. Collect points, buy powerful upgrades, and optimize your run to beat your high score.

title: Dark Realm: Lord of the Winds - Collector's Edition
Vacation Wonders: Hidden Quest - Collector's Edition
Ominous Objects: Lumina Camera - Collector's Edition
Redemption Cemetery: At Death's Door - Collector's Edition
Enchanted Kingdom: Arcadian Backwoods - Collector's Edition
Space Battle Cats
description: SpaceBattleCats is a frantic space shooter where you fight off alien hordes by matching your weapon colors to your enemies. Pilot the CATNIC solo or in local co-op, manage real-time repairs, tackle wild minigames, and protect the feline mothership through the cosmos!

title: Catskill Mine: 10,000ft Below
description: A single-player horror game set in a decrepit roadside mine attraction. Descend to uncover the mine's dark history, and find a way to escape from the lurking horrors within.

title: Heartreasure: Recolor the World
description: “This world was never meant to be so blank!” Help Mary, a fairy Mendako who can’t remember her precious friend, as you find hidden hearts to bring color back to the world! A point-and-click hidden object adventure…Wait, why did the world disappear in the first place?

title: Pawn Shop
description: You were hired to work the night shift at a small pawn shop on the edge of town.

title: ValkyrieRecomp
description: A native PC recompilation project for Valkyrie Profile.

title: D.C.: Da Capo - Onsen-hen
description: A fan disc hot-springs sidestory of D.C. ~Da Capo~.

title: Puckoff: Reloaded
description: Puckoff: Reloaded is the latest, and greatest, version of the (in)famous game, Puckoff, previously available only for personal computers. Enter the world of no-rules hockey as a total newbie and work on your skills and attitude to meet with the mythical terrorizer, Dominator. Build your team of has-beens and legends while learning different playstyles to defeat a plethora of colorful characters around the globe. Team up with the ever cheerful Sarah, the best beer-league goalie Eddie, and the ever grumpy seen-it-all Coach. So grab your skates and Puck off!

title: Natsumegu
description: Atsushi is in his second year of high school. His school is going to get merged with another school after the end of the first period, so this is his "last" summer holiday. He enjoys it spending with his friends. One day, the news comes out that Yukako is going to transfer to another school. He decides to gather his friends, and set up a club to make memories for Yukako...

title: Katakoi no Tsuki Extra
description: One day, some gears of "time" are found. They don't have any power now, but they might be dangerous. Members of a folklore research club start collecting the gears, but Yone accidentally gets hold of one of them.... Love romance, school exam, and club activity. Their story still goes on...

title: Nami no Mani Mani Gaiden: Yumiko-san no Shinkon Nikki
description:
After a few years, Shintaro Shinohara - the protagonist of the first game - now the doctor of the island, marries the beautiful widow Yumiko.

This is their newly-married happy love-love life.

title: Dub Rumble
description: Dub Rumble is a voice-dubbing party game where you and your friends are the voice actors. Pick a scene, listen to each line once, then record your own performance over the backing track. Solo Booth lets one player dub every character; Couch Party passes the mic around a single PC; Online Party uses room codes, Steam invites and built-in voice chat, ending with a shared screening of the finished dub, "voiced by" credits and automatic performance scoring. Scenes come from community-made dub packs shared through the Steam Workshop, and the game is compatible with existing Choicer Voicer packs. Finished dubs can be exported as video clips to share.

title: SinsKiller
description:
SinsKiller is an action arcade shooter where you play as a fallen mage in a Dante's inspired Hell. You get to use your magic powers to obliterate hordes of enemies and bullet-hell bosses.

In SinsKiller you get a mix of bullet-hell and survivors like gameplay with no RNG, where movement, aim and timing matter most. You can choose from different magic elements to fit your playstyle then equip other items to create a build that feels truly yours. Each circle is inspired by the literary classis Divine Comedy while story itself draws inspiration from another Italian classic Jerusalem Delivered.

title: Hagitore! Datsui Chouhan Bakuchi
description: A strip dice gambling game.

title: Snap64 Recomp
description: A native Windows port of the Nintendo 64 game Pokémon Snap, made by static recompilation.

title: Hachiban Kareshi
description:
Point out the changes in your boyfriend Yahata-kun!
If you fail, you get reset back to August 1st and Yahata-kun's pattern changes.

title: White Rabbit's Wonderland 2: Twisted Worlds - Collector's Edition
Legends of China: Chang'e Flies to the Moon - Collector's Edition
Hidden Legacy: Whispering Walls - Collector's Edition
description: Investigate a cursed mansion and a city built on lies. Solve hidden-object puzzles and uncover the truth behind a vanished architect.

title: Crimson
description:
Crimson is a violent, gothic, roguelike, action-horror game all about a church arising out of Hell, and a heartbroken woman named Evelyn Chandler venturing inside to kill Count Dracula and his family. This is a blood-filled war out of love, revenge, and hunger.

Evelyn Chandler, recently heart-broken woman, has to explore and fight her way though "The Church of The Bloodthirsty" alongside her sturdy chainsaw-pistol known as "The Bloody Mary" (put together by her friend Babe Manners). Before the sun rises again, she must make her way to the top to face off against Dracula himself and discovers why everyone has been disappearing.

Try not to drown in the blood of the innocent as Evelyn and The Impaler go toe-to-toe in CRIMSON: THE GAME OF BLOOD

title: Wild Story: Primal Secrets - Collector's Edition
description: A wildfire scarred the reserve — now poachers and buried secrets threaten what remains. Explore the wilderness, rescue wildlife, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover the truth hidden deep within the forest.

title: Amazing Trip to Europe 4: Search for Cats
Amazing Trip to Europe 4: Search for Cats - Collector's Edition
12 Labours of Hercules XX: Hold My Gold - Collector's Edition
Coral Chronicles: Bookworms and Barnacles - Collector's Edition
Jewel Match Solitaire: Cats and Cards - Collector's Edition
Incredible Dracula: Bloodwood Secrets - Collector's Edition
Horta Maluca
description: Defend a mad garden in this top-down action roguelite. Face waves of mutant pests, collect seeds, fuse weapons, choose powerful upgrades and grow each vegetable hero through permanent progression. Build your arsenal and survive the final wave.

title: Hidden Portals: Chronicles of the Sunbound
Mystery of Myths: Whisper of Depth
Eightfold
description:
Eightfold is a poker-based deckbuilding roguelike. Players build hands from a deck of playing cards, with hands scored to defeat Bosses using standard poker rankings (pairs, straights, flushes, and so on). Runs are structured around selectable decks, each of which modifies core rules — altering hand size, discard counts, scoring conditions, or deck composition. The game features 22 decks, drawing on a circus and stage-performer theme (including Juggler, Sword Swallower, Tumbler, Contortionist, and Mime decks) alongside decks based on illusion and misdirection (Magician, Mentalist, Escape Artist, Cardist).

Additional systems include card enhancements, which apply permanent modifiers to individual cards, and curses, which introduce a drawback in exchange for a offsetting benefit. Progression is run-based, with players building a strategy across a sequence of acts using the cards, enhancements, and curses acquired along the way.

title: Tower's Gate
description:
A third-person aether-punk open world RPG for PC

You wake on a foreign world with a character you built — not a hero on rails. The world has dozens of creatures and thousands of dungeons to discover and conquer.

Character Leveling, Skills-based, Large Open World (107,000+ Square Kilometers), and over 13,000 Weekly Rotating Dungeons. Multiplayer capable for up to 8 players on a private server.

title: Gerphyon: The Ender Mansion
description: Will you survive 1000 rooms of pure arcade/horror pressure? Or will you crumble as soon as the lights begin to flicker and find yourself desperately running for your life from the indescribable, aberrant 'Friends' crawling through the bowels of this complex?

title: Helga the Viking Warrior 9: The Last Journey
Sea of Lies: Beneath the Surface - Collector's Edition
Secrets of Great Queens: Old Tower - Collector's Edition
Crowd Favorites
description: Step into the arena for fame and glory in Crowd Favorites, a 1v1 PvP rogue-lite fighter. Lost a round? You get to draft crazy upgrades and stack them for chaotic synergies to outsmart your opponent in fast-paced, unpredictable duels!

title: Spirit of Revenge: Gem Fury - Collector's Edition
Void Swarm
