description: Fight through endless enemy swarms in this fast-paced arcade space shooter with survivor-style progression. Upgrade your ship, unlock powerful fighters, and grow stronger with every run.

title: Lancelot: The Silver Knight
description: Experience the legends of Lancelot: The Silver Knight, as he sets out on a quest to reclaim his title as a knight. A quirky top-down action-adventure game set in an mystical Brittany filled with enigmatic dungeons, legendary monsters and chickens?

title: Covenant of Gears: The 3 Musketeers
description: Lead the Musketeers in this steampunk tactical CRPG! Tactical pause combat against the English invasion. Use the powerful Campaign Editor to create and share your own adventures. And play the official campaign and those from the community.

title: Flavour Fare
description: Discover Islands and different Cultures, learn how to cook and satisfy the villagers. Collect Ingredients find a kitchen to create your signature dishes. Build your own restaurant and hire chefs to satisfy your Customers. Collect different Recipes to get your own recipe book to cook IRL!

title: Chompy Party
description:
Hungry? Your friends and enemies are on the menu!
Welcome to Chompy Party! A free online multiplayer fan game set in the world of Skylanders, where you can play as the beloved (or feared) Skylanders Chompy.

title: Spirit City: Lofi Sessions - Magical Library
description:
Dust off your wizard hat and robes. The library is open!

The Magical Library expansion invites you into an arcane sanctuary overflowing with magical books, enchanted artifacts, and new Spirits to discover.

Master the basics of magic by studying dusty grimoires in the grand archives, or spend quiet moments bonding with your Spirit companion, curled up among piles of books.

title: TruWorlds
description: TruWorlds is an interactive platform that let’s users sign up, and create their own worlds to share with other players. We have our own custom scripting language, our own custom game engine, and a full custom creator that lets you create your game.

title: Hallowed Legends: Ship of Bones - Collector's Edition
Mystery Case Files: House That Love Built
Reflections of Life: A Shattered Heart
Secrets of Salem: The Phantom Cab
Lady Mabel Mysteries: Death on Board
Passage Zero
description: Passage Zero is a short psychological horror game about observation, limited controls, and paying attention.

title: Booked
description: BOOKED is a cozy first-person library game about finding misplaced books and returning them to the right shelves. Explore a charming library, discover 100+ colorful books and series, and enjoy a relaxed, pressure-free sorting experience.

title: Seven Minutes in the Closet
description:
You're pushed into playing 7 minutes in heaven at a party with a stranger. Everything goes wrong and you are stuck in there with him.

Warnings: Depictions of murder and violence, screen shaking.

title: Cards Everywhere!
description: Cards Everywhere! is a cozy organizing game where you sort through 2,000 scattered cards, collect over 1,500 unique ones, and place them in your collection album. Discover dozens of unique sets and unlock helpful abilities as your collection grows.

title: RavenVeil
description: Explore abandoned homes, forgotten paths, and hidden places in RavenVeil. Find clues, solve puzzles, unlock sealed areas, and uncover the Bride's mystery. Every discovery reveals darker secrets. Will you escape with the truth, or become part of RavenVeil forgotten history?

title: The Pogo Witch
description: A challenging hand-drawn 2D platform game. Master the pogo technique and climb to the top of the tower, where its creator awaits.

title: Calico Wilder and the Crystal Blade
description: Calico Wilder and the Crystal Blade is a 3D platformer inspired by classics of the early 2000's. Join Relic Hunters Calico and Lilly as they traverse an ancient temple in search of a strange and powerful artifact: the Crystal Blade!

title: My Fair Link: Yousei Byakuya Monogatari
description: One day the protagonist finds a fairy falling unconscious in the forest. He takes her home. The fairy tells her story: she fell in love with a human and now wishes to gain a human form with magic. The protagonist wishes to help and supply magical powers by providing sexual magic. This way their unusual cohabitation begins.

title: Verse of Birth
description: Your words rise as allies in this roguelike tactical battler. Collect "Logos" whose form and abilities are shaped by the words you type, craft a build that's yours alone, and fight your way through the dungeon in turn-based auto battles!

title: New Dawn Protocol
description:
New Dawn Protocol is a globe-scale civilization sandbox about rebuilding shared systems and living with what they make possible. Restore damaged corridors. Expand settlements across distinct biomes. Build power, water, food, care, industry, research, and transport networks that must function as connected parts of a real world.

Then let time move.

Workers commute. Freight follows the routes you built. Households migrate toward opportunity. Infrastructure ages. Storms expose fragile dependencies. Shortages travel across borders. Settlements specialize, relationships deepen, and successful arrangements become institutions with members, rules, leaders, and histories of their own.

title: Alma's Search
description: "Almas Search" is a cozy adventure puzzle game. Help Alma step out of her comfort zone and find her best friend, the lost bird Bert. Interact with residents, assemble objects in mini-games, and collect clues to keep the search on the right path. Will Alma be able to find Bert?

title: The End of Allegoria
description: A turn-based tactical RPG where your choices determine the fate of the world. Traverse a world that changes as you explore it, find new companions, and combine different class skills by mastering a multitude of equipment.

title: Numerical Alchemist
description: A 9x9 Sudoku-based logic puzzle with eight original constraints. Every stage is solved through pure logic alone, with no assumptions or brute force. The thrill comes when one breakthrough makes the board suddenly unravel. Even seasoned Sudoku players will find fresh discoveries and real challenge.

title: Kora: Neural Gridlock
description: Kora: Neural Gridlock is a psychological horror game set in a bleak brutalist cyberpunk research facility. A threatening presence moves through the structure and leaves disturbing signs of its passage.

title: Meowpire
description: Watch over a world where cat clans battle for territory from the perspective of a god. Pray with clicks, unleash divine powers, and guide your favorite clan to unification in this laid-back god game × clicker!

title: Minecraft: Wilderness Bound
description: Wilderness Bound is the third Minecraft game drop of 2026, focused on exploration and camping. It introduces the Dappled Forest biome, featuring poplar trees with red, orange, and yellow leaves, shelf mushrooms, and red shrubs. The drop also adds abandoned campsites, straw beds, cushions, and new decorative blocks made from poplar, wool, and concrete.

title: Road to Glory
description: Take the reins of a Football club and step into the role of a respected (or controversial) General Manager as you swipe left or right to make the decisions that will shape your team's fate.

title: Alien Express
description: Alien Express is a 2d, top-down gathering game. Absorb as many crops, plants, objects, Cows?, and other things before the time runs out.

title: Rummy Attack
description: "Rummy Attack" is a unique Roguelite Card Battler based on Rummy rules! Place cards on the field to create "Melds" (Sets or Runs) to unleash skills. Build your deck and overcome physical gimmicks like ground fissures to defeat the final boss. Choose between Tactical Move or High-Speed Time Mode!

title: Somnius
description: Somnius is a chaotic co-op extraction game for up to 6 players. Dive into collapsing dreams, turn anything into ammo, feed the portal to buy more time, and save the Dreamer before the dream burns away.

title: Triple Track
description: You need to free the cute animals captured in cages by hunters. To do this, you need to find three identical animal pictures at the same time. THE GAME TRAINS VISUAL MEMORY.

title: Pixel Chess
description: A classic game of chess reimagined with isometric pixel art and animated fantasy armies. Play solo against the AI or challenge your friends in local multiplayer.

title: Mini Airways: Map - Busy Skies
description: In the upcoming DLC for Mini Airways, we will take you to major aviation hubs around the world, bringing busier skies, more dynamic airspaces, and brand-new air traffic challenges.

title: Backrooms: Code Yellow
description: An online 1-6 player co-op game about investigating and collecting data in the infinitely massive Backrooms with your fellow employees. Explore. Do your job. Return alive.

title: In Memory of Mrs Frog
description: A narrative 2d pixelart plattformer, where you charge up the jump instead of just pressing it.

title: Youkashi no Haitokuai: Junshin Tenshi ha Dakarete Iromeku
Megasuki: Love Through Lenses with Yuuki Hoshino
description:
Yuuki Hoshino is a famous model and the most popular girl in school. Yuuma Hirose, on the other hand, is a boy who doesn't stand out at all. Although he has something of an interest in Yuuki, he feels that they live in completely different worlds.

One fateful lunchtime, Yuuma ends up lending this school celebrity his glasses. And over the course of several interactions, Yuuma finds himself falling for the flirtatious Yuuki's ditzy charms. Yuuki shows no hesitation in getting intimate with Yuuma, either. But although Yuuma is happier than ever, his consciousness of the gap between their social statuses makes him afraid to fall for her.

Is she teasing him? Is this an elaborate prank? How does Yuuki truly feel? And what's the true nature of their relationship?

title: Megasuki: Love Through Lenses with Ayumu Sakura
Megasuki: Love Through Lenses with Otoha Inami
Megasuki!: Kanojo to Boku no Megane Jijou - Amou Haruka-hen
Puzigo
description:
A relaxing jigsaw puzzle for people who want to slow down. Choose your preferred difficulty and enjoy the game at your own pace, from a casual 100-piece puzzle to a long-term challenge of up to 2,000,000 pieces.

Without being rushed by time limits or score ratings, immerse yourself in the small satisfaction of each piece clicking into place and enjoy a calm puzzle experience.

title: Megasuki!: Kanojo to Boku no Megane Jijou - Azumino G Sakurako-hen
Megasuki!: Kanojo to Boku no Megane Jijou - Toono Shiori-hen
Thank You Bus Driver
description: Thank You Bus Driver is a chaotic bus driving game where you take on the role of a town’s bus driver just trying to get through the day with minimal rulebreaking and maximum gratitude… in the form of Thank Yous!

title: The Miracle Of San Martin
description:
A survival horror experience that mixes classic and modern elements, a story where faith meets fear.

Explore San Martín, a remote hispanic town where a missing girl, a pit in the outskirts, whispered miracles, unspeakable sins, and buried horrors, challenge everything a Priest believes.

title: Omega Vanitas
description:
Omega Vanitas is a free-to-play post-apocalyptic open-world MMORPG featuring a retro 2D isometric presentation inspired by classic top-down role-playing games. Players explore a dangerous wasteland, scavenge for resources and equipment, complete quests, fight enemy gangs and mutated creatures, and develop their characters through experience, levels, skills, and attributes.

The game combines exploration and character progression with player interaction, item crafting and trading, pets and companions, real-time PvP combat, and faction-based gameplay. Players can join or create factions, construct faction structures, and work with other survivors while searching the wasteland for equipment and attempting to uncover what caused humanity's downfall.

title: Succupie: An Erotic Short Story
description: Succupie: An Erotic Short Story is a short, first-person slice-of-life tale about depression, demon girls and pizza! Step into the shoes of a dejected, reclusive 20-something year old in the mid 90s, who strikes up an unlikely 'situationship' with Marcine, a demonic pizza delivery girl.

title: Crime Shadows: Stolen Spotlight - Collector's Edition
description: Uncover a chilling mystery in this Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure. Search eerie scenes, solve puzzles, and survive a deadly movie come to life.

title: Lost Lands: Stories About the Sorceress, the Prince and the Minotaur - Collector's Edition
description: “Lost Lands: Stories about the Sorceress, the Prince and the Minotaur” is an adventure game in the Hidden Objects genre, with plenty of mini-games and puzzles, unforgettable characters, and complicated quests.

title: Dadi Kingdom
description:
You wear the crown, and that's where the trouble starts. Your court lies to you, your mages are useless, your priests are worse, and the clock is against you. Every morning you judge your people: release, gold fine or dungeon? Then you walk out the gate yourself and fight bandits, skeletons and worse: in a misty forest full of ruins, a bandit camp, a pirate ship in the middle of the desert and a smoking volcano.

Choose the Church or the mages: one teaches you the bow, the other fire. Pay for soldiers, walls and dragons, survive night attacks, and father an heir before your time runs out. Voiced in German, English and Spanish, with text in 13 languages.

title: Aerolicious
description: Aerolicious is a short and relaxing brick-breaking game about clearing a big chunk of 3,757 blocks.

title: Dragon Ball Z: Recompiled
description: A native PC port of Dragon Ball Z: Budokai 3 HD Collection (Xbox 360).

title: Open Nectar
description: A native, experimental, and open-source port of Pikmin (GameCube, 2001) for PC and Android.

title: Phantom 9
description: Phantom 9 is a fast-paced, free-to-play multiplayer arena shooter powered by Unreal Engine 5. Players engage in Tactical, lightning-fast combat across diverse, dynamic maps featuring destructible environments and strategic chokepoints. Featuring zero-lag responsiveness and tick-perfect hit registration, the game offers extensive tactical loadout customization with dozens of weapons and attachments. Players can compete across 7 distinct game modes and 12 unique maps, climbing the global leaderboards through skill-based ranked matchmaking.

title: Gamble Life
description:
Gamble Life is a four-player Five-Card Draw poker game that combines poker with special abilities and roguelike elements. Use powerful abilities to manipulate the rules of poker, build unique combinations, and win money from your opponents.

Play through a limited number of days, manage your funds, and fight to repay your debt before the deadline.

title: Ruptured Floor
description: Ruptured Floor is a puzzle horror game set in surreal office spaces. It tells a story about depression and work. The protagonist needs to find a way to escape, and uncover dark secrets in the process.

title: Helena: Cloud District
description: Helena: Cloud District is an atmospheric first-person exploration game where you explore a decaying mega-structure to photograph strange plants and uncover fragments of melancholic memories.

title: Catal Carta
description: A mystery visual novel set in a fading secondhand bookshop. Five childhood friends confront small-town scandals armed only with what they've read — drawing on the themes of unrelated books to unsettle the things people won't admit. 15 cases, 5–10 minutes each.

title: Fallout 2 Restoration Project Updated
description: Restoration Project, updated gathers and reintroduces unfinished or cut Fallout 2 content. It is based on killap’s Restoration Project.

title: Feline Fever Dream
description: Feline Fever Dream is a cat-themed RPG. On a sweltering island night, you awaken beside an incinerator to find… you're a cat?! Step out on unfamiliar paws, journey across Rosadol, unravel the mysteries of this bizarre summer, and uncover the fate that binds you to this island.

title: Gem Quest: Rush
description: A short and replayable time attack game. Enter the dungeon and collect all of the gems as quickly as possible.

title: Hey, Don't Look at Me
description: Hey, Don't Look at Me is a psychological first-person horror game where you'll observe ghosts through binoculars, investigate the circumstances of their deaths, and try to survive inside your own apartment. Just don't forget: sometimes, they're watching you too.

title: Maegami ga Nagakute Seikaku ga Kurai Kakuu no Otoko
description:
A short game about gloomy characters who cut their long bangs and become happier, losing their appeal in the process.

Made for a 24-hour game development challenge.

title: Did You See That?
description: A 2 player psychological horror game where not every player sees the same reality. Explore a carnival trapped in an endless transformation, detect anomalies, verify with your friend if they see the same thing and make the right decisions before the clown Bobby loses his temper...

title: UtuRoom
description:
"UtuRoom" is a puzzle game that uses a "copy area" and a "paste area" to reach the goal.
The two areas are used to change the terrain and create a path to the goal using gimmicks.

title: Backlot: Hollywood Studio Tycoon
description: A deep Hollywood studio simulation, 1930 to the streaming age. A back lot, a million dollars and no pictures. Commission scripts, sign stars to seven-year contracts, book dates against rival studios, and survive television, home video and everything else that came for the movies.

title: Roguestorm Beats
description: A bullet hell where the enemy is silence and your weapon is the jam you write. The music rests muted the music and left the notes to turn wild; capture their energy and apply it to your beat. Then use it to attack the silence and bring back the beat.

title: Pull My Finger
description: Face against up to 4 different players, your friends or bots. Take turns deciding which finger you are willing to pull, and see the outcome of your choices. Use the different items to get an advantage on your opponents. The best strategy comes out on top. 3 lives. 10 Choices. Your Move...

title: Allegro Molto ga Ikinokoru Game
description: A 2-player co-op survival action game. Automatically attack waves of enemies, collect EXP to level up, and survive for 3 minutes to face the final boss. Revive your fallen ally by staying close!

title: Ghosts of the Tozai Line
description: Explore a train stalled after an accident in this side-scrolling mystery adventure. Talk with the spirits of passengers, gather clues, and unravel the mysteries left aboard. Deliver lost feelings and belongings, and see the spirits off on their final journey.

title: Bebe Miner
description: Bebe Miner is a fast-paced arcade mining game where every level brings new surprises. Swing your hook, collect valuable treasures, avoid hazards, defeat bosses, unlock characters and climb the online leaderboard.

title: GridEnergy
description: Become the ultimate energy tycoon in this strategic incremental game. Start with humble coal mines, build complex supply chains, manipulate the stock market, and fund cutting-edge research to build the ultimate power source: a Dyson Sphere.

title: Mepekyon Racing
description: "Mepekyon Racing" is a casual racing game where you can freely drive around an open world. Explore the vast map to discover race courses and aim to place in the races. Enjoy customizing your car and its parts as you strive for the overall Grand Prix championship!

title: Veridus: The Walking Nightmare
description: Battle through fifteen escalating waves in a dark-fantasy action roguelite. Wield seven distinct weapons, combine abilities and imbuements, collect powerful equipment, rescue Abigail, and confront Lord Veydris before entering Nightmare Mode.

title: Cozy Fishing Life
description: A cozy little fishing game that lives on your desktop. Adorable animals fish on your wallpaper while you work — collect 300+ fish, grow an aquarium, build your boat fleet, and relax. Idle-friendly, wholesome, always cozy

title: The Inkspire
description: The Inkspire is a hand-drawn deck-building roguelike. Choose from five unique characters, build powerful card synergies, collect relics, and climb an ever-changing tower filled with battles, shops, and mysterious events.

title: Darrell 3D
description: Darrell 3D is an autonomous first-person dungeon crawler where you play as the spectator: gear Darrell up, choose his patches and loadout, send him back down, rescue dogs, witness bizarre FMVs, DMs, and events, and watch him fight his way through the dungeon to break free from his prison.

title: Tidy Up: Electronic Store Simulator
description: Bring order to a chaotic electronics store! Pick up misplaced gadgets, find where every item belongs, organize shelves and displays, earn rewards, upgrade your abilities, and transform a messy store into a perfectly organized space.

title: Pigkour
description: Pigkour is a third-person parkour game where you play as a pig escaping the Bacon House. Leap across flying food, kitchen equipment, and chaotic obstacles as you climb through the nightmare restaurant. Find your way to freedom and chase your dream of becoming a Wizard Pig.

title: Calpria
description: Calpria is a 3D arcade space shooter . The game combines fast-paced bullet hell combat with deep progression, wingman system and strategic partner customization. Developed by Lunakardo Games and released exclusively for Google Play Games for both PC & Android Devices

title: Dubbed
description: Pick a scene. Hand out the parts. Perform it together over your own microphones and get the clip back with your voices on it. Every line records separately, so you can retake the one that didn't land — then watch the finished dub with the whole room.

title: Lost in Paradise
description: Lost in Paradise is a third person point and click adventure reminiscent of the classics from 90s (similar to modern escape games or hidden object games, but deeper) with spellbinding ambient nature graphics and an art style all it's own.

title: Arui ha Koi to Iu Na no Mahou
Hime to Otome no Yakimochi Love
Detectives United: Vengeance from the Past
Fragments of Truth: An MCF Story
Mind Echoes: Remnants of the Past
Hunter's Journey: Tears of the Lake
The Harmony Chronicles: Cat Out of the Bag
Prisoners Chess
description: You know how the pieces move. You don't know how they die. A chess roguelike where every piece bleeds. Level them, perk them or lose them forever. Take the enemy King's head, or bleed their army dry. One path saves you. One damns you. Hell keeps score.

title: Eclesiar
description: Eclesiar is a free online multiplayer strategy game. Build nations, run economies and wage war with thousands of real players, right in your browser.

title: She Never Left
description: Return to an abandoned family home where old memories refuse to stay buried. Explore its dark rooms, uncover a forgotten tragedy, solve environmental puzzles, and survive the presence that has been waiting for you in this short first-person psychological horror.

title: Limbus Company: Season 8 - Punctum
description: It consists of the game's tenth Story Chapter (Canto X: The Gaze Bearing) , the eigth Mirror Dungeon and Line 7 of Refraction Railway, as well as the release of Identities based on story content and E.G.O exclusive to the Season's Pass

title: Delta 4: Terminal Protocol
description: Wake up to silence. One terminal, one survivor, one dying ship. Can you bring the Delta-4 back online? Delta 4 is a sci-fi survival terminal simtype commands, decode logs, and fight to keep a dying ship alive.

title: ChinanaGo!
description: "Chinana Go!" is a 2D action roguelike game where you control a sea cucumber, aiming to create the ultimate sea cucumber. By eating marine creatures, you become stronger and acquire special bodies that grant various abilities. Strive to become powerful with special bodies and eventually aim to devour a whale as the ultimate sea cucumber.

title: Bonespire
description: Ascend to your very own magical tower, high above a world of adventure and mystery. Forge artifacts, brew potions, decipher ancient scrolls, and summon uncanny guests, then watch the world below change with your choices. A dark, whimsical, combat-free crafting sim. Imp roommate included.

title: Raise, Rise & Die
description:
Raise, Rise & Die is a dark fantasy deckbuilder adapted from a physical card game. In solo Arena runs, players face automated enemy decks, collect new cards, and build synergies to climb the leaderboard.
Every card has a Soul Value that determines its cost to play, the Reserve it generates when sacrificed, and the health lost when it falls as the face-up Top Soul. Between battles, sacrificing cards from the deck restores health, creating a choice between preserving a powerful build and surviving the next encounter.
The game also features online one-on-one duels and Ancients’ Path, an editor for creating and sharing custom runs.

title: Too Hot to Hold
description: Grab the Ember and RUN! Too Hot to Hold is an up-to-10-player asymmetric party game of hot potato. Tiny Tricksters must pass the burning Ember every 10 seconds, while armed Wardens hunt them down and destroy it. Use abilities, set traps, and scream at your friends in chaotic proximity chat.

title: Community Arena
description: Community Arena is an interactive 2D community game designed for livestreams. Viewers can join the game through Twitch chat, choose a class, and fight together against waves of enemies and bosses. Using chat commands, players can upgrade their characters, use abilities and items, and directly influence the gameplay. The game combines cooperative arena gameplay with persistent character progression and various community-driven systems.

title: Ex Nihilo
description: Ex Nihilo is a non-linear, narrative driven adventure where time is of the essence. Squint your eyes to squeeze past your captors to safety. When you are caught by your pursuers, you will be pruned without mercy, only to reawaken in your pod further from home and with less time to escape.

title: Nyancrement
description: Nyancrement is an incremental game about a cat that has wandered into a mysterious world. Collect coins with cat punches, strengthen relics, and steadily increase the value of each punch while working toward the 10 billion coins needed to return home.

title: One Week at Flumpty's Fan-Made
description: One Week at Flumpty's Fan-Made is a remake of Jonochrome's original idea for the game that adds many new mechanics, redone artwork for basically everything, and both minor and major design changes for the characters.

title: Gay It Loud
description: Dating in the dreamy shopping mall of 1995! Hang out at the food court, have sloppy makeouts in the dressing room, loiter in the arcade, and collect nostalgic toys.

title: Puzzlez: A Shapez Game
description: A puzzle game set in the shapez universe, in which players construct compact production lines inside small 3D environments. It contains over 75 handcrafted puzzles that scale from simple shape production chains to multi-layer logistics problems, each solvable in several ways, with statistics for comparing solutions against other players. A built-in editor allows players to design and share their own puzzles and play community-made ones.

title: To Be Besieged
description: Defend the war torn civilians with allies against the 1 hour siege until rescue helicopter arrives

title: Night Maniac: The Origin Of Steven
description: A narrative horror set in Red Valley, 1948. Amidst the slaughterhouse, the rain, and the silence of a rotting town, follow Steven Watson in a dark story about isolation, control, and the origin of a legend.

title: Alter A.I.L.A.
description: An original RPG Maker game with multiple routes through the story, including a secret path tying together the other three options. Notably, Alter A.I.L.A. became popular enough for the author to return to the project with a full remake some years later.

title: Eternity Lost: Mystery of Aurum - Collector's Edition
description: Follow a mysterious girl into a hidden underground city built centuries ago by a secret order of Alchemists. Reveal a dangerous conspiracy, search for clues and items, solve puzzles and mini-games, and uncover the secrets of a forgotten world. Will you bring truth to the light?

title: Spellarium 14: Collector's Edition
description: A new Match3 Puzzle game with a city to build and tons of extras (hidden object, spot the difference,mahjong,jigsaw)

title: Spooky Dwellers 5: Collector's Edition
description: Dive into this spooky Match 3 puzzle adventure by conquering eerie levels, exploring hidden object scenes, and solving minigames to decorate your ultimate party parlor and banish the ancient shadows! Destroy the evil of Kthal-zghor!

title: Die Meeple
description: Die Meeple is a roguelite dice deckbuilder where classic board games have risen in revolt. Reclaim forgotten boards, battle their rebellious pieces, and unlock new dice, upgrades, and artifacts.

title: Clutter 19: Survey Says What? - Collector's Edition
description: Clutter 19: Survey Says What? - Collector's Edition delivers the most entertaining and challenging Clutter yet, featuring over 1,800 puzzles! Tackle new Clutter Gaps Diamond Style, Rotation Matters, Pop-Ups and Clutter Pics (Pic Jong) Variations, and more in this endlessly replayable challenge.

title: Charm & Clue 2: Collector's Edition
description: Charm & Clue 2 - detective puzzles, hidden clues, and secrets everywhere

title: Legendary Tales V: Price of Power - Collector's Edition
description: Forgotten lands and ancient magic give rise to a dangerous journey against the oppressive rule of witches. “Legendary Tales V. Price of Power” is an adventure game in the Hidden Objects genre, with plenty of mini-games and puzzles, unforgettable characters, and complicated quests.

title: Jixo 4: Magical Nights - Collector’s Edition
description: A cosy, glowing celebration of festive nights filled with colourful picture puzzles, gentle logic challenges, hidden-object fun, and delightful bonus surprises.

title: Christmas Wonderland 16: Collector's Edition
description: A family friendly festive hidden object game

title: Festival Journey: Secrets of Rio - Collector's Edition
description: Explore Rio in a vibrant puzzle adventure! Find hidden objects, solve mini-games, and uncover the secrets of Carnival!

title: Resident Evil Gaiden: Recompiled
description: A native static recompilation of Resident Evil Gaiden (Game Boy Color, 2001) for modern PC and Android platforms.

title: X-Men Destiny: Recompiled
description: A static recompilation port of X-Men Destiny (Xbox 360) to native PC.

title: Prop Revolt
description: A prop hunt where being seen is a resource. Hide as an everyday object and survive - or let the hunter stare, charge the Revolt, and fight back as a team. There's often a fine line between hiding and attacking. Will you defeat the Hunters, or will you hide until the end? You decide!

title: Tilting
description: Tilting - A Noir Poker Career is a single-player Texas Hold'em roguelite set in a noir world of dive bars, riverboats and private clubs. The player builds a poker career across eight venues in different cities, starting at small-stakes tables and progressing toward high-stakes championship tournaments. A bankroll is carried between games and a run ends when it is depleted. The game uses pixel art visuals and AI opponents, and contains no real-money gambling and no microtransactions.

title: Until Death Do We Part
description: Wake up, ruin your anniversary, kill your husband. Lather, rinse, repeat.

title: Ballzy: PvP Block Puzzle
description: Build the longest route, solve handcrafted and community puzzles, then outthink rivals in hidden-block PvP. Ballzy is a premium pixel-art strategy puzzler with Classic, Story, Puzzle, and asynchronous Battle modes.

title: The Stalked 4
description: Desperate for work, 27-year-old George signs up for the remote lighthouse job. What starts as beautiful and peaceful scenery slowly turns unsettling day by day. Is it just your mind playing tricks on you? Or is someone else here...?

title: Lurking Within
description: You wake up in an unfamiliar bathroom, with no memory of how you got there - but you know this won't end well.

title: Marbled Memories
description: Marbled Memories is a psychological horror game based on true events. Play as Derek, a young man severely mistreated and neglected by his mother. This game contains a story, puzzles, dark humor, many objects to interact with, collectibles, along with a few startling moments.

title: Hollow Crew
description: Hollow Crew is a survival horror set in the confines of an isolated space station. Its loyal androids have suddenly been turned against you - survive their relentless hunt and contain the emergency, or die trying.

title: Where the Redwood Ends
description: A group of friends looking for a weekend getaway are met with terror as one of them is mysteriously murdered. Trapped in an abandoned mansion deep in the Redwood Forest, they have no one to suspect but each other.
"771" is a first-person psychological horror game consisting of 7 unique gameplay segments, each created by a different developer.

title: Cursebreakers
description: Cursebreakers is an exclusively co-op first-person dungeon crawler. Invite a friend to join for free with Friend's Pass and master sword & sorcery together. Explore a lost castle and delve into a rich dark fantasy world full of monsters, traps and magic. Defeat the fallen queen and break the curse!

title: Restcue
description: You wake up in your familiar home, only to find yourself completely locked inside. Search for clues, evade an unknown presence, and piece together forgotten memories... In this confined space, the real terror is only just beginning. A intense 30-minute psychological horror experience.

title: Crescent Creek: Survival Horror
description: Crescent Creek: Survival Horror plunges you into a desolate farm, cut off from civilization and steeped in mystery. As you explore its winding corridors and ominous rooms, youll need to make critical choices, as each path could lead to salvation or peril.

title: Lumisar
description:
Lumisar is a PvP-focused fantasy MMORPG set in a persistent, seamless world without loading screens. Players choose from six races — Arin, Lumir, Shadir, Gorgar, Krahtar and Lumisari — each tied to its own kingdom, culture and class paths.

The core loop is built around kingdom building, territory control and warfare. Players form clans and alliances, contest castles and regions, and defend them through sieges. Combat is target-based and party-oriented, with dedicated support, buff and crowd-control roles rather than solo-focused action.

The game is built in Unreal Engine 5.8 on a custom authoritative server architecture, designed for large-scale battles within a single contiguous world.

title: The Final Witness
description: The Final Witness is a first-person psychological horror detective game where every case tells a different story. Explore a haunted family mansion, uncover hidden truths, analyze conflicting evidence, and identify the true killer before the darkness consumes your sanity.

title: RoboSquare: Recharged
description: A 16-player online party game where hovering robots dash, jump and slam each other off the map across five chaotic minigames. Your friends are worse than you remember, and the platform is smaller than you think.

title: Ultra Realistic Mine
description: Minecraft texture pack that transforms blocks and items into realistic real-life photos.

title: In Our Parlor
description: In Our Parlor is a short, horror walking simulator. The player must make their way through a mysterious manor to unfold the story, find the parlor, and escape this nightmare. Navigate a series of dark set pieces and follow the music to discover the path forward.

title: Team Hero Coder
description: Assemble your team of heroes. Program their strategy with PseudoC or C#. Watch them battle, learn from what happens, and improve your code. Are you game to code?

title: Greenhouse: Tidy Up!
description: Greenhouse: Tidy Up! is a cozy single-player simulation where you bring order to a messy greenhouse. Sort and place hundreds of flowers and plants, find the best way to organize everything, and compete with other players for the fastest time.

title: Green vs Tan
description: You are Green. They are Tan. Tower defense with plastic army men from your toy box. Defend your toy box with bazookas that blow up everything (including yourself), flamethrowers & more. 100+ levels of toy army men fun & many secrets to discover! Solo, co-op, or 1v1 up to 10v10.

title: The Collective
description: The Collective is a horror comedy RPG set in an strange world. You are alone, confused, imprisoned, and your choices matter more than you think. This game fuses elements of Fear & Hunger, Resident Evil, and Disco Elysium together in a fascinating concoction of a J-RPG.

title: PBA Pro Bowling 2027
description: Dominate the lanes in PBA Pro Bowling 2027! Customize your bowler’s unique style and arsenal with in-depth ball mechanics and Perks. Forge your legacy in PBA Tour Mode and Online Leagues, and defend your title in Online Tournaments and Ranked Play. This is where champions are made.

title: Explorers of Palan
description: Battle in turns: Gain EXP to become stronger with each victory as you calm agitated creatures. Defeated in battle? Don’t worry — besides recovery skills and items, your companion Feyrie can restore you.

title: Naughty Nurse
description: Naughty Nurse is a survival horror game. Medical bills are coming due, and the cost of healthcare has risen. Run through several haunted locations to collect the bills, but be careful. A murderous nurse will try to stop you from escaping, giving you a wide variety of effects.

title: Big Breakfast 2
description: In a world without Breakfast, one man decides to challenge fate! The debut RPG from Stahmpin' Grounds Studios, Big Breakfast 2, is an old-school turn-based RPG in the style of classic fantasy RPGs from the 8 bit era.

title: Bounty Trail
description: It is the fall of 1881 and your bounty hunting agency is in dire straits. Your no-good partner, Edward Thorne, took out a $10 000 loan and then took off. The debt must be paid by the end of the year so you’ve got no time to waste. Pick a target from the board, mount up, and set out on the Bounty Trail!

title: Hug & Betray
description: Hug, or betray. A psychological party game where everyone picks HUG, Sword, or Gun as the host calls each round. Taunt, bluff, and rack up points! A new kind of viewer-participation game — watch the stream, play from your phone! Who'll be the sore loser howling at the moon?

title: 9: The Dark Side of Notre Dame - Collector's Edition
Toy Chute: A Sorting Game
description: Float through zero gravity, grab thousands of adorable toys, and launch them into the right chutes to get everything organized. Hit Combo Rings along the way to play musical notes, chain your shots together, and create your own zero-G melody. Wigi Wigi...

title: Aladin & the Enchanted Lamp: Extended Edition
Blue Sun Saga
description: Go on a quest to restore life to the world in this retro inspired shooter! You must be skillful and tactical as many will try to stop you! You are an exile after all which is a death sentence. But things may be as they seem on this journey.

title: Alice's Wonderland 5: A Ray of Hope
All I want for Christmas are Subgames: Collector's Edition
Amaranthine Voyage: Legacy of the Guardians - Collector's Edition
Amaranthine Voyage: Winter Neverending - Collector's Edition
Tengoku no Vinea: Saiyaku no Majo to Nanatsu no Tsumi
Tianji: Shadow of the Ancients
description: Tianji: Shadow of the Ancients is a turn-based RPG set in the Tang Dynasty. As amnesiac Tianji Guard Shangguan Shuo, investigate the mysterious Xuanxin Order and uncover the truth of your past—only to discover your fate may be deeply tied to the Order.

title: Highways & Co.
description: Do you hate building cities but love managing traffic? Design the perfect road network in this traffic simulator. Build interchanges, roundabouts, bridges, and tunnels with powerful road-building tools. Keep traffic flowing, solve congestion, and avoid a pile-up!

title: Antique Shop: Journey of the Lost Souls
Screen Stocks
description: Screen Stocks is an online multiplayer trading game featuring a real-time simulated market. Buy, short, and sell stocks to gain unprecedented levels of wealth. Team up with other traders or outsmart them all. It's time to make some money!

title: Atelier Karia: The Night Kingdom & the Guide of Memories - Premium Box
description:
Includes an artbook, an extra music tracks CD, a set of nine A4-size water-repellent posters
and code for "Pioneering Team's Head Chef" costume for Karia

title: Clogwork
description: CLOGWORK is a factory-automation game where you turn random pieces into final shapes. Build conveyor belts, glue, cut and rotate parts, wire logic signals, and send the finished shape to the hub to fulfil ever-changing orders.

title: Atelier Karia: The Night Kingdom & the Guide of Memories - Special Premium Box
description: Contains an art book, extra tracks, a water-repellent A4 poster 9-type set, a Karia-exclusive early distribution costume "Head Chef of the Pioneer Corps" download serial, a newly drawn illustration A1 tapestry, a special cutlery set, and a sea urchin mascot keyholder.

title: Atelier Karia: The Night Kingdom & the Guide of Memories - GS Saikyou Galaxy Combo Set
description: Contains everything on the Special Premium edition + a framed artwork, an acrylic stand, a cauldron mug, more OST CD and a mini-novel.

title: Atelier Karia: The Night Kingdom & the Guide of Memories - Animate Limited Set
description: Contains an original illustration microfiber bath towel, original A4 acrylic panel and original illustration large acrylic stand.

title: Eggstreme Farming
description: Build and manage your own farm! Take care of chickens, ducks, geese, and turkeys, collect and sell eggs, buy new animals, expand your pens, and turn your farm into a thriving egg-production empire.

title: Atelier Karia: The Night Kingdom & the Guide of Memories - Gamers Super Limited Edition
description: Contains an original A4 character fine art print, placemat, plate, acrylic figure and B2 Tapestry

title: Atelier Karia: The Night Kingdom & the Guide of Memories - Rakuten Books Exclusive Set
description: Contains an original illustration smartphone stand, release commemorative character folio, original B2 tapestry, original mug with newly drawn illustration and an acrylic diorama with Karia & Yumia

title: Atelier Karia: The Night Kingdom & the Guide of Memories - WonderGOO Original Limited Set
description: Contains an original B2 Tapestry, original illustration acrylic figure and an acrylic figure of Yumia, and a mug

title: Broken Drive
description: Step into the mind of a grieving father who lost his daughter in a tragic car crash. Trapped in a terrifying loop within an abandoned hospital created by his own dementia-riddled subconscious, you must face your deepest fears. Broken Drive is a first-person psychological horror game.

title: Popgoes: Lost Love
description: Have you ever wanted to kiss an animatronic? I really don't know why anyone would want that, but in this game you can! Explore the Popgoes Pizzeria and seduce the cute mascot characters from POPGOES!

title: Tough Cat
description: This is a horde shooter. Earn coins by surviving as long as possible. Spend coins in the shop to unlock permanent upgrades outside runs, which is one of the core gameplay loops.

title: Cat Watch
description: A 2D arcade shooter minigame with roguelike progression where you control a cat defending an apartment against enemies that seek cover and strike at the right moment. Jump, attack, and eliminate waves of mosquitoes, rats, and bats as you advance toward the source of the infestation.

title: Cats and Tails
description: Cats & Tails is a luck-driven coin game where you chase a streak of 10 Cats, face unpredictable outcomes, and unlock multiple endings over repeated playthroughs.

title: Chronime Puzzle: Cats
description: Chronime Puzzle: Cats is a relaxing puzzle game featuring beautiful steampunk anime-inspired artwork.

title: Bang Bang Streaming
description:
Slam your fist on the table and blow away your haters and enemies to liven up your stream!

A 2D tower defense game where you aim to become a legendary streamer through your own gameplay and table-slamming!

title: The Celebrated Race
description: Tom Sawyer, the protagonist who wakes up from a deep sleep, doesn't know where he is. He gradually adapts to the strange village and fights against tyranny with his new partners in the new world. Game has 9 levels.With the progress of the game story, the character level will be higher and higher.

title: Spellarium 13
description: Use your Match 3 and Puzzle skills to Build the Star Service station in the new Spellarium episode!

title: Bakusei
description:
A 3D puzzle game in which a powerful god causes the solar system to explode.
In a universe of unique planets, God's goal is to destroy the sun.
God moves the planets by decoupling them, connecting them to the sun and causing a chain explosion from the outside to destroy the solar system!

title: Falling Star Town: The Ghost from Past
description: "On the last night of the year, the dead will turn into transparent ghosts,reunite with loved ones." Lost memories, an odd festival, and the night of the meteor shower... All these elements are intricately connected. But what truth awaits Tianhai?

title: Find All 10: Greece
description: Immerse yourself in an exciting adventure in Find All 10: Greece. You will explore an ancient Greek city, the colorful streets of a historic town and the unique scenery of a modern Greek city. Look for hidden objects and color this mysterious painted world.

title: Pet the Cat
description: Pet the Cat is a bullet-hell shooter where you unleash powerful attacks by petting an adorable cat! Fight through endless waves of enemies and upgrade your kitty into a formidable force with food, items, and weapons.

title: Serious Bigness
description: You’re a tiny kaiju dreaming of becoming a titan! Topple everything from dominoes to skyscrapers in a fully physics-driven world to grow big, seriously big! But move fast: kaiju are sleepy creatures and can't stay awake forever. How big can you get before time runs out?

title: Tsuki Journey
description: A relaxing slice of life adventure game where Tsuki travels between beautiful cities, meets new friends, uncovers stories, and fills out collection logs at his own pace, combining cozy idle activities with short, meaningful bursts of progression.

title: Node Crown
description: Node Crown is a roguelite focused on building a node-based kingdom. Quick runs designed for replayability, deep synergies, hundreds of nodes, and builds that make every run unique - you will find it here!

title: Annie's Dineinn
description:
DineInn is a cooking game where you manage a kitchen and motel while maintaining a relationship with your daughter and the local communities.
Your choices and decisions show impact in the real world. Work hard through the tough times and restore the building for a grand opening.

The gameplay can be described as a combination of elements from farming, poultry, cooking, cleaning, inventory management, restoration,etc together to make a fun gameplay.

title: Unexpected Tasks
description: Relax with a cozy Time Management adventure. Clear obstacles, gather resources, rebuild the kingdom, and enjoy satisfying progress at your own pace - with or without a timer.

title: Candy's Adventure: Speedrunners Copy
description: An update to "Candy's Adventure" from FNaC 3 that adds speedrunner tools and more!

title: The Rhapsody of Zephyr Remastered
description: 28 years later, Cyrano’s tragic journey of revenge begins anew. The War of Genesis: The Rhapsody of Zephyr returns in a remastered edition with HD 16:9 widescreen, full voice acting, and quality-of-life improvements. Rediscover an epic tale of tragedy and destiny.

title: Caustic Murmurs
description: Caustic Murmurs is a Yuri Visual Novel featuring themes of loss, loneliness, and deep love. Witness a growing bond an uncover unexpected secrets

title: Deep Nightmare: Phobias
description: Travel between the real world and your dreams, dive into your subconscious, and survive your own fears. In this mix of Survival Horror and Psychological Horror, you'll play through a collection of the scariest phobias out there while being constantly hunted by fear itself.

title: Chicken Miner
description:
Chicken Miner is an incremental game where you can gather massive amounts of resources with the help of chickens. Capture chickens in the hunting grounds, bring them back to your mine, and put them to work mining!
The chickens do the work for you!

title: Night Shift: Something Is Wrong
description: Your night shift was supposed to be simple. Watch the cameras, patrol the building, and report anything that changes. But the longer you stay, the less certain you become of what is real. Follow procedure. Pay attention. Something is wrong. Endless Mode and Speed Run Mode included.

title: Bust 'Em Up: Online FFA
description: Bust 'Em Up is an action-multiplayer free-for-all game where you fight against Busters! Use small blasts or big stars to wreck your opponents or hit 'em with a dangerous spin! Use emotes to express your victories across the vast arena! Whether you're in the grassy plains, the snow valley or the caves, you will always find a way to bust 'em up!

title: Words of Power: Logos
description: A galaxy enslaved by ancient words. Type fast, spell true, and fight back — every word is a weapon. Duel bosses, battle across a neon-vector galaxy, and prove you're eloquent enough to save the universe. Multiplayer coming soon!

title: Around the World with the Johnson Family
Salt of the Earth
description: An isometric medieval city builder. You hold one manor by charter: lay the roads, work the fields, and raise hovels into town houses by meeting what each household needs. Winters take stores, the Crown takes dues, and raiders take whatever will burn.

title: Sculpturillo
description: You get a secret word and you have to sculpt it in 3D clay while your friends spam the chat guessing absolute nonsense. Are you an artist or a disaster with hands? An online party game for 2 to 10 players, with characters you create yourself and matches in 6 languages.

title: Megastore Chaos
description: Turn massive messes into perfect order. Sort 30,281 items across 6 unique stores — from supermarkets and bookstores to electronics, games, wine and shoes — while unlocking skills that make organizing faster and more satisfying.

title: Salvage of the Demetria
description: A thousand-year-old library is coming out of the desert one find at a time. How you pull a piece free decides how much survives—tear a corner off and the writing on it is gone for good. Dig by hand, forge your own tools, and decide what to sell, preserve, or conceal.

title: Late Checkout
description: A short atmospheric horror about a night shift at a snowed-in motel. Winter 1999: a highway cut off from the world and a list of chores. Clean the rooms, drink your coffee, cross off line after line. But when the lights go out, ordinary work becomes survival. Just a flashlight, a cat and 3 endings.

title: Brixonia
description: A cozy multiplayer building sandbox where every world is shared and persistent. Place and break blocks, farm crops, fish, craft gear, and decorate your space alongside other players. No combat, no death penalty, just building at your own pace.

title: Island Raiders
description: Raid islands for resources, then head home to grow a Viking settlement that makes every future raid stronger. Island Raiders is an incremental base-builder where going out to explore and staying home both matter. Go raid. Come home. Build. Go raid again.

title: Last Solace
description: Last Solace is a turn-based CRPG set in a low-fantasy world. The empire weakens, and war has come to its heartland. Here, you embark on a journey to fulfill your last contract.

title: Welcome to Sunnybrook
description: Welcome to Sunnybrook, an idyllic community where residents come to escape. Play as a burglar breaking into affluent homes when something prehistoric descends on the unalert residents. Sneak, steal, and survive as you escape a community turned hunting ground that gives new meaning to "eat the rich"

title: Mana Alchemy
description: An open-world bullet heaven RPG. Explore a cursed island, forge spells via alchemy, and arrange them in your grimoire like a puzzle. Mow down monster hordes and hunt your 7 ruling sisters. Your final choice—execute or forgive them—determines the ending of this dark fantasy.

title: Crash Bandicoot 2: Recompiled
description: A static recompilation of Crash Bandicoot 2: Cortex Strikes Back.

title: Oath of Stigmata
description: In a world shattered by the Starfall Calamity, sanctuaries, city-states, and surviving factions fight for their last hope. Lead characters with unique beliefs and abilities on a perilous journey. Build your deck, deploy your units, and make tactical decisions that can turn the tide of battle.

title: Subgloom
description: A 2D metroidvania where you explore an underground world and the terrain is destructible. Use your laser gun to kill enemies, drones to fly around, bombs to destroy terrain, and explore hidden rooms to discover items.

title: Blade Dodger
description: A 2D arcade style arena survival game. As Spiff, you will sprint, dodge, and use your special abilities to stay alive long enough to make it through different levels and challenges. Features single player, 2-4 player local co-op, and 2-4 player online multiplayer.

title: Ludus Deceptor
description: Ludus Deceptor is a dark roguelike card game about risk, deception, and cursed bets. Battle at the card table, build powerful combinations, use bonuses, curses, interactive cards, and various items to escape prison, survive the royal court, and claim the throne.

title: Trucazo!
description: Trucazo is a fast-paced card game about bluffing, reading your opponent, and pushing your luck. Play elemental cards, build Synergy, raise the stakes with Dares, and turn even a terrible hand into a win if you can convince the R.I.N.G.M.A.S.T.E.R. you know exactly what you're doing.

title: Cthulhu's Eldritch Kitchen
description: Cthulhu's Eldritch Kitchen is a short incremental game about running your own kitchen to become the most powerful being on the planet.

title: Endless Mall
description: Endless Mall is a roguelike city-builder card game. Carefully select your shops, mind your layout, build a powerful economic engine, and rake in profits beyond your wildest imagination!

title: Sushi Gacha: Auto Battler
description: Gacha-powered auto battler, ten minutes a run. Spin for sushi figures, line up four on the counter, and watch them fight lineups other players left behind. Stack copies for stars, blend two into a new kind, beat a chef boss every fourth round. No paid gacha, no timers.

title: Ronan Rage: The Rugged Space Chase
description: You are Ronan, an ex-gang boss. When your old crew pulls a hilarious heist and steals your precious Turkish rug, it's all-out war! Jump in for a 3D roguelite rail-shooter: dodge space rocks, survive laser gauntlets, upgrade your ship and unleash hell. Fly fast. Shoot straight. Get that rug back!

title: Toilet 101
description: A liminal space anomaly detection simulator.

title: Escape From Argos 7
description: A retro computer incremental game about escaping a hostile alien planet. Explore an old desktop, gather resources, install programs, unlock upgrades, automate your progress, and find a way off Argos 7.

title: A Trans-Siberian Tea
description: A journey through the carriages of a Trans-Siberian train buried in the snow to reveal the identity of a legendary gentlewoman-thief as you speak with the frozen corpses of the passengers.

title: Five Nights in Minecraft: The Classic Collection
description: A collection of the classic Five Nights in Minecraft games by IvanG.

title: Biodome Bastion
description: Crash-land on a hostile alien world in this classic tower defense game and defend your outpost against relentless waves of evolving insectoid creatures. Build powerful defenses, unlock new technologies, and uncover the mystery behind a species capable of adapting to any environment.

title: Anispo
description: Anispo is a fast paced 2D real time strategy game set inside a digital warzone. Command streams of bytes of data, capture network nodes, reinforce your defenses, and outmaneuver computer controlled or online rivals across customizable cyber battlefields.

title: Byte Bistro
description: Program a little robot crew and bring a neighborhood café to life. Cook, serve, restock, and refine your routines across 24 services. Mix visual programming with hands-on minigames, then keep your kitchen humming in Desktop Companion mode.

title: Telly No Vision
description: Telly No Vision is a hybrid first & third person puzzle shooter where YOU can't see. Push back a hacker attack in a virtual world where giant floating TVs are your eyes!

title: Kebab Dynasty
description: Build and run your own kebab restaurant in a single-player management simulation. Set prices, hire staff, serve customers, keep the shop clean, upgrade the interior, and turn a small counter into a thriving food business.

title: The Cursed Armor
description: An action-platformer 2D adventure game with hack-and-slash combat. Explore places, find treasures, weapons, accessories, and more to grow stronger and defeat evil. Break the armor's curse and bring peace to the Kingdom of Caladrius; the world's destiny and yours depend on you.

title: Abductables
description: An arcade game about abducting humans, turning them into alien human hybrids to make money and get the highest score possible.

title: Spirit of Diwata
description: Heal instead of fight. A cozy co-op JRPG for up to three, on one screen or online, set in an Asian fantasy world where you play elemental spirit instruments to calm the creatures you meet. Every creature is someone to bond with, and each friendship brings a little more hope to the world.

title: Lunar Crypt
description: Journey through the spirit world to exorcise the twelve zodiac animals and save Chinese New Year in this zero-gravity precision platformer inspired by Chinese mythology and folklore.

title: Roast and Toast
description: Grow your garden, gather ingredients, and get cozy before opening the doors to hungry, demanding guests. Run the tavern, a warm haven from a harsh world. A wild, yet cozy, medieval tavern co-op sim for up to 4 players (solo too!), where careful prep meets total havoc once they walk in.

title: Iron Fury: Robot Boxing
description: A boxing game where your robots punch each other until only one is left standing. Win fights to earn cash in an incremental rewards system. Use cash to upgrade your robot and secure better opponents and bigger stages. Bigger stages and larger crowds equals more cash. Fight your way to the top!

title: Karakam: Call of the Dark Manor
description: Karakam: Call of the Dark Manor is a first person psychological horror game where you explore a cursed manor of a long forgotten bloodline. Solve riddles, explore the grounds and discover the horror stories hidden within the horror story. Dark Manor summons you, how will you answer it?

title: Tinker's Nook
description: Own and run a workshop in a steampunk fantasy world! Craft, fix and sell items to make a living while meeting countless townsfolk and listen to their stories.

title: Hollow Parish: Dead Frequency
description: Supernatural investigation and management, played from one desk. Read the evidence, identify what is out there, choose who to send, then guide them by radio while the timer runs. A wrong theory kills the people who trusted you. You hear the horror; you never see it.

title: Last Train to Yotsuya
description: Last Train to Yotsuya is a short first-person narrative experience. Explore different locations, observe your surroundings, and interact with the objects around you to gradually uncover a personal story through the details and events of the journey.

title: Witchwedge
description: A first-person horror adventure set in a remote Finnish cabin. Work at a quiet village shop, explore the wilderness, and uncover ancient forces drawn from Finnish mythology.

title: Blobby and the Milkshake
description: An octopus stole your milkshake. Why? Who knows! Ride robot crabs, fly fire hydrants, sled in bathtubs, and fight power-hungry pirate clams in this goofy, open-ended 2D platformer. Explore dozens of levels, branch your path, and do whatever it takes to get your drink back.

title: Inventorism
description: Inventorism is a real-time action roguelike where your build lives in your inventory: items take up grid space, link up with their neighbors, and merge into stronger versions. Get the layout right, then take it into the horde, reading the fight and picking targets as you carve a way through.

title: Hold the Dawn
description: Build by day. Survive the horde by night. Hold the Dawn is a 3D wasteland tower defense with unique auto-fighting heroes, tactical towers, zombie waves, and co-op over Steam, LAN, or local play.

title: Hardcore Cyborg
description: Take on the roll of a cybernetic soldier on a mission to destroy the enemy force before your world is consumed by an all encompassing corruption.

title: Alumbra
description: Alumbra is a suspenseful and surreal Metroidvania. Play as Vince, a frightened child trapped in a nightmare shaped by his fears and imagination. Armed with a lantern, master the light, explore haunting dreamscapes, overcome terrifying creatures, and face your fears to wake up.

title: Eternal Levels
description: Explore and survive in this 2D game set in the urban legend of the backrooms, with a wealth of objects, entities, levels, and sublevels at your disposal. Will you be able to survive and escape, or will you be trapped forever in this new reality?

title: Liminal Space Holiday
description: Take a break from life and enjoy a Liminal Space Holiday. A Relaxing Liminal Space Adventure full of Beautiful Atmospheric Nostalgic Locations and Artwork.

title: Ultradimensional
description: Explore over 40 interconnected levels, evade over 20 unique entities, solve puzzles, manage scarce resources, and survive a nonlinear backrooms horror experience with multiple routes, and extreme replayability.

title: Sepulvia
description: Sepulvia is a dungeon crawler RPG set in a psychedelic underworld. Fight ethereal tug-of-war battles and navigate supernatural metro lines to reclaim your best friend's soul from the realm's enigmatic ruler. No matter what happens, bring. Her. Home.

title: Backrooms: The Incident
description: Backrooms: The Incident is a cooperative horror game for 14 players. On your own or with friends, you'll explore the game world, trying to figure out what's going on, where you are, how to get out of there, and whether it's even possible.

title: Blue Sun
description: After years of oppression, the time has come to rise up. In this action-adventure boss-rush game, uncover a devastating conflict's history and take down FOFEC, an experimental enemy unit stripped of its humanity and modified to become the perfect super soldiers.

title: Camp Manager Simulator
description: The charm of nature and the difficulty of management games combine in this game. Manage, rent, and expand! Start with a simple campsite and grow it into a full outdoor resort with cabins, tents, events, and happy campers. Balance your finances, rental rates, and upkeep costs.

title: SCP: Containment Breach Revival
description: SCP - Containment Breach Revival is an In-Development remake of SCP - Containment Breach, aiming to be a mostly faithful recreation with additional creative liberties taken. Step into the shoes of D-9341 once again and see what's new, what's changed, and what's to come.

title: Zero Players Online
description:
Zero Players Online is an interpretation of RuneScape (and Old School RuneScape) as a sort of fancy text-adventure, framed as a long abandoned MUD that nobody has played in a long time.

In the decades since any players joined things have started getting a little strange around Gielinor. NPCs aren't quite acting they way they should, and some areas have changed or become unkempt due to a lack of maintenance.

title: Zenless Zone Zero: Update 3.2 - Their Secret Histories
description:
Version 3.2 of Zenless Zone Zero includes:
• New Characters: Claret and Roxy
• New Main Story: Their Secret Histories
• New Agent Specialty: Armorer
• New Gameplay Mechanics, System Updates, and Events
• Adds new achievements

title: Kagura Survivors x Summer Memories
description:
In a quiet, familiar ocean town, rifts between worlds begin to open. Three unlikely heroines find themselves facing a horde of monsters. But along with the monsters come new powers. Can they survive the coming Endless Night?

In collaboration with the developer Dojin Otome, we’re excited to bring you the first DLC to Kagura Survivors: Endless Night! Featuring Miyuki, Rio, and Yui from the hit game Summer Memories!

title: Game Store Cleanup
description: A cozy-chaotic first-person sim about restocking a wrecked game store. Sort every scattered item back onto its correct shelf and watch a total mess become a tidy, ready-to-open shop again.

title: Wolf of The Desert
description: Infiltrate Qamaria tower. Sneak through shadows, observe your surroundings. Gather ability chips to destroy and hack security devices, vanish, teleport past enemies, outsmart them using clones. Combine and upgrade ability chips for the ultimate loadout and bring down a corporate empire

title: Folk-Tography
description: Folk-Tography is a 4-player co-op cryptid photography extraction game. Photograph legendary creatures, investigate paranormal anomalies, manage scarce resources, and survive various dangers to escape with the evidence before the valley consumes you.

title: My Party Is Grinding
description: A desktop idle RPG where your party of five heroes fights, loots, and grows in a small window while you work.

title: Museum 8
description:
A museum after closing. You only ever walk forward — and the same hall keeps arriving. Look through your camera, read the hall, and open the right door.

Observe the museum. Spot what changed. Choose the right door.

Watch the official gameplay trailer for MUSEUM8 and get a closer look at its core anomaly-hunting gameplay—from subtle changes in the exhibits to encounters that become increasingly difficult to ignore.

Use your camcorder to reveal additional details and unsettling changes within certain anomalies.

title: Needle in a Haystack
description: Search for a needle hidden among 5,000,000 pieces of hay, alone or with up to 4 friends. Clear the hay piece by piece, enjoy the peaceful farm atmosphere, and hope luck is on your side.

title: Coin maker simulator
description:
Coin Maker Simulator is a cozy first-person crafting and management game set in a colorful medieval world.

Coin Maker Simulator combines crafting, management, resource progression, physics-based interactions, and workshop customization into a relaxing sandbox experience.

title: Hemlotrion: Broken Mirror
description: Hemlotrion - a magic school full of secrets and mysteries. Immerse yourself in a world of magic, friendship, and rivalry, learn new spells, battle magical creatures, explore hidden corners of the school, and uncover the dark secret hidden within its walls.

title: Haywired Prototype
description: Fast paced FPS mech action game.

title: Blight
description: Explore discover and gather samples of robot controlling fungus

title: AJ's Anomaly
description: First-person anomaly horror. Play as Amelia Jalisco, a fashion designer investigating her gallery the night before a big exhibition. After months of exhausting work and a series of troubled business relationships, she may be starting to lose her mind.

title: Respect The Horde
description: You're outnumbered. Outsmart them. Lure hordes of zombies into deadly traps, shape their path with obstacles, and grow stronger with every kill. But know when to walk away before overconfidence and greed turn your strategy into uncontrollable chaos.

title: Vice Club Simulator
description: Run your own strip club in a first-person nightclub management sim. Build your line-up, manage your dancers, stock the bar, keep VIPs happy, and control the chaos of the night. Spend your earnings on new dancers, drinks, and club upgrades.

title: ChipWits Worlds
description: A colony sim engineering sandbox where every robot is driven by a simulated 6502 CPU. Write and debug real assembly code to automate mining, power grids, logistics, and defense against alien swarms. Master systems programming to conquer lethal alien worlds.

title: Cook Heat!
description: In this cooperative cooking simulation game for up to 4 players, you take on the role of a team of chefs working in a variety of unique and slightly chaotic restaurants around the world.

title: Void Keeper
description: A scientist locked a dangerous discovery inside her own mind. Dive in, break through her defenses and recover the memory.

title: Story of the Needle in a Haystack
description: They say finding a needle in a haystack is impossible. Time to prove them wrong. Clear millions of pieces of hay from an old barn, upgrade your tools, sell what you collect, and search every last pile until that tiny needle finally shows itself.

title: Needle in a Haystack: A Time for Goats
description: Find the needle in a haystack! Use your bare hands and upgrade a variety of tools to search through a giant pile of hay and win the local competition!

title: Astario
description: Astario is a universe in which you can build functional ships and orbital stations with automated factories. Collect materials, craft new blocks, and expand into the universe. Nothing is ever truly static, ships, stations, asteroids, planets, everything follows the laws of orbital motion.

title: Check Please
description: Run chaotic restaurants in this fantasy medieval realm! Seat demanding magical creatures with your Demon Chef and serve over 100 unique dishes as you upgrade your taverns all across the kingdom! As the only human trapped in this fantasy medieval realm, your only way back to Earth is to wait tables.

title: Game Market Mayhem
description: Game Market Mayhem is a cozy organization simulator where you sort 5,120 scattered game boxes according to their genres and platforms. Transform a massive pile of boxes into the perfect game store. Fill the shelves, unwind, and enjoy the satisfaction of everything being in order!

title: No Man's Sky: Cosmos
description: Become director of a space station, join a galactic alliance, construct a space base and discover deep-space marvels in No Man's Sky Cosmos. Navigate space with a new star system map, strip colossal hulks for parts before hull integrity fails, recover and haul physical salvage to remote space outposts, celebrate 10 years of No Man’s Sky in the Our Journey Continues expedition, and much, much more.

title: Maria no Jisatsu
description:
Inspired by "The Virgin Suicides."

Two sisters commit suicide, a month apart, and no one can understand why. Why would they kill themselves? And what is the meaning of the red ribbons they left tied around the statue of the Virgin Mary?

title: Valheim: 1.0
description: The time has come to finally venture into the Deep North and Valheim 1.0.

title: Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Keepsake Sea
description: Become a magical mermaid and plunge into the waters of the Keepsake Sea! Uncover what secrets lie beneath the waves and embark on a thrilling new ocean adventure.

title: Ondeh Ondeh Kaya's Tasty Tale
description: Join Kaya on her quest to become a Worldbuilder in this heartwarming puzzle action-adventure. Explore the whimsical world of Selera, inspired by the rich cultures of Southeast Asia, where rhythm powers exploration, puzzles, and combat in a heartfelt tale of family, courage, and self-discovery.

title: Eternal Anima
description: Yearning for a better future is considered a capital offense in the kingdom of Urvis Ael. After Wade questions this key tenet of his society, he finds himself on the run in an era-spanning adventure that challenges his core beliefs and reveals an unknown world filled with hidden truths. Alongside an eclectic group of new allies trying to survive a dangerous journey, Wade must travel through time to save civilizations of the past from catastrophes and unravel the secrets of a lost history.

title: The Room Where You Can't Leave Without Drinking Water
description: This is a level-based first-person shooter. Players must complete objectives within a separate map in each level to advance to the next. This is a technology test game for the Primordial Universe, featuring a backpack, storage boxes, and shooting mechanics.

title: Metal Slug Ultimate Collection
description:
Metal Slug Ultimate Collection is a compilation of the entire Metal Slug series, including mainline entries, handheld titles, and the rare Location Test Version. It features quality-of-life improvements like Quick Save and Rewind, plus new modes such as Combat School and online leaderboards for added replayability.

Included Titles:

Metal Slug 1996)
Metal Slug 2 (1998)
Metal Slug X (1999)
Metal Slug 3 (2000)
Metal Slug 4 (2002)
Metal Slug 5 (2003)
Metal Slug Advance (2004)
Metal Slug 6 (2006)
Metal Slug 7 (2008)
The legendary Metal Slug Location Test Version (Never officially released)

title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Tag Force GX
description: Duel Alongside Your Partner and Forge Your Own Future!

title: Zero Gravity Heroes
description: Land. Jetpack. Shoot. Three arcade games in one — blast through 90 bite-sized stages across 30 missions to rebuild a shattered galactic map. Fast, precise, pick-up-and-play action with classic arcade DNA.

title: The Apothecary Diaries: The False Imperial Brother
description: Investigate mysteries, craft medicine, and uncover the truth in this brand-new story from The Apothecary Diaries. Explore the rear palace and capital to gather evidence and question witnesses, then assemble what you've learned into theories and deductions to solve thrilling mysteries in this sprawling adventure game.

title: Dragon Quest Heroes: Torneko's Mystery Dungeon Classic HD
description:
A thousand adventures in one! — Discover the roots of the Mystery Dungeon series. Originally released only in Japan, the first entry in the Mystery Dungeon series and prequel to Torneko: The Last Hope is finally making its international debut!

Set after the events of DRAGON QUEST IV, this is the story of Torneko, a man who dreams of becoming the world's greatest weapons merchant. One day, he hears rumors of a mysterious dungeon said to contain incredible treasures. In search of a legendary treasure that no one has ever managed to bring back, Torneko sets out for the Mystery Dungeon.

title: Spell Unbound
description: One spell. It is a circle. Spell Unbound is a pixel-art roguelite where you bind beasts by looping them with the mouse - no sword, no staff, nothing else in your hand. Draw tight. Something is always crossing your line.

title: Fuel Sort
description: Sort fuel cells into matching canisters in this sci-fi puzzle game. Pick up cells from the top of a canister and drop them onto matching colors or empty spaces. Solve 1000 levels with as few moves as possible, climb the global leaderboards and unlock achievements.

title: Next: The Portopia Serial Murder Case
description: The legendary "The Portopia Serial Murder Case" is reborn! Under the executive direction of Yuji Horii comes an all-new entry featuring five brand-new investigation files. Set in 1980s Kobe, conduct your investigation alongside a new cast of characters and uncover the secrets hidden behind the case.

title: Hoshin Engi Re:surrection
description: Wield mythic treasures, ride spirit beasts, and hack and slash through ever-shifting dungeons in an all-new roguelite steeped in Chinese myth, based on Ryu Fujisaki's Weekly Shonen Jump manga. A new hero, a new story, thirty years on.

title: Claim Denied
description: Co-op comedy horror, where you are a special department of Quark.Inc corporation investigating a series of mysterious incidents on a spaceship.

title: Monsters in Moonlight: Block Braw
description: An auto chess game using Tetris! Choose a hero and buy Tetris blocks to create a powerful battle force, then bravely enter Dracula's castle!

title: Ghostbreaker Corps
description: Engage in real-time battles, freely combine elements, and venture into roguelike challenges. Forge a one-of-a-kind legion and uncover the beauty of elemental synergy!

title: Rocket Adventures
description: Easy to lift off, hard to land. Test your piloting skills in a physics-based 3D platformer where gravity is your worst enemy. Thrust through stylized worlds, conserve fuel, and avoid explosive impacts. Only for true rocket scientists.

title: Meltdown Crew
description: Run a barely-stable nuclear reactor with your friends in this online co-op physics chaos game. Fix broken systems, manage radiation, survive power outages, and prevent a total meltdown before everything goes horribly wrong.

title: Dank Armada
description: A retro vector space shooter with classic arcade combat, seamless 2D and 3D perspective shifts, evolving enemy formations, and a haunting cosmic narrative.

title: Artifact: 3D Puzzle
description: Restore shattered masterpieces in this meditative 3D puzzle. From Greek amphorae to Egyptian statues, assemble 64 ancient artifacts piece by piece. Inspired by Kintsugi — the Japanese art of repairing broken pottery — Artifact offers a relaxing assembly experience with simple, intuitive controls.

title: Boom Buddies
description: Boom Buddies is a fixed-position bullet hell survival game where animal heroes face endless enemy waves, upgrade weapons through card choices, unlock new characters, and compete on global leaderboards.

title: Pixel Orbit
description: Incremental game about defending Earth from impending danger. Develop your Skill Tree to setup automatic turrets and various other defensive mechanisms.

title: Wild Justice
description: Wild Justice is a 3D first-person Western action-adventure game inspired by the 1985 ZX Spectrum classic The Wild Bunch. Set in the Wild West, players navigate the frontier while managing survival mechanics, tracking down outlaws, earning gold, and clear their name in a modern reimagining of classic retro gameplay.

title: Dodo Zombies
description: The world is in danger! Zombie dodos have escaped from an egg-shaped meteor and are devouring anything made of flesh. Your goal: survive—and have fun doing it.

title: Cam Master: Private Desires
