description: Get ready for epic live streams! Collect everything you need to make them truly unforgettable. From a variety of sex toys to challenging puzzle levels, earn stars and unlock exciting rewards that will take your streams to the next level! Over 20+ webcam girls! Over 100+ sex scenes!

title: Lust Solitaire: Horny Cards
description: Play the world's favorite card game and unlock stunning 18+ content. Complete levels, collect gorgeous girl cards, reveal intimate photo sets, and enjoy steamy animated scenes. It's the perfect mix of strategy and pleasure. Train your brain and indulge your desires !

title: Desire Empire
description: Desire Empire is an adult business management simulator where you build your own content empire. Hire models, upgrade studios, promote shows, and rake in millions from steamy performances. Do you have what it takes to dominate the industry and win over audiences worldwide?

title: Underfoot
description: A foot fetish NTR (netorase) visual novel with elements of moral degeneration.

title: An Ecospace of Epochs
description: You're a paleontologist in a far future from a different planet in an interconnected universe, you've got a new home that's yours in the sparsely populated part of the planet and you help with studying the past life and world spanning nearly a billion years ago

title: Sudokiller
description: Sudokiller is a cozy mystery puzzle game inspired by sudoku-style logic. Players use clues to place suspects on a grid, reconstruct the crime scene, and deduce who the killer is.

title: Dominó Gótico
description: A dark 2D domino game with strip mechanics. Defeat your opponent, remove their clothing, and break the cycle of death and resurrection.

title: A Studied Seduction
description:
Arthur Ruthven's thirty-fifth birthday is fast approaching, but he's worried that his life has started to stagnate.

Arthur was once a history teacher in Edinburgh, but an incident with a former pupil causes Arthur to retire early. Newly uneasy about teaching, and unsure if he can pursue the career he once loved, Arthur returns to live with his mother in their old family bookshop. He would prefer to forget his days as a teacher, and the anxieties that came with them...

But Arthur can only keep his past at bay for so long, and his life takes an unexpected turn when his mother hires a new helper at the bookshop over the summer holidays: one Mason Tierney, one of Arthur's former students.

Mason has done some growing up in the five years since Arthur last saw him, and now, he's twenty-one. Mason tries to be friendly with Arthur, but Arthur wonders. Is Mason being too friendly - and will Mason's interest in Arthur stir up uncomfortable memories Arthur would far rather see buried for good?

title: Pro Basketball Manager 2027
description: Take charge of a basketball club and oversee every aspect of its development. Build your roster, discover emerging talent, develop future stars, and implement the tactical vision that will define your team's identity.

title: Don't Knock Again, Sabrina!
description: Don't Knock Again, Sabrina! — a comedic visual novel about a pushy and horny neighbor who's always finding new reasons to knock on your door.

title: Trick or Freak
description:
You spend the night of Halloween at a monster party and are involved in a game of truth or dare with four handsome monsters ! With your actions and answers, you can earn their favors and by the end of the game, conquer their hearts.

However, be careful... Who knows what monsters might do to some reckless human...

title: Red Masked Ronin: Desires and Shadows
description: "Red Masked Ronin" is an open-world adult game where you play the lustful life of a Ronin in feudal Japan’s Middle Ages. The journey, beginning as a wandering Ronin, is shaped by seductive encounters and unexpectedly deepening passions.

title: Ubai Ending
description: Ryousuke is suddenly confronted with a difficult decision regarding the future of Ubai.

title: Horny Waifu: Kaiju Strike
description: Protect the world from giant monsters in Horny Waifu: Kaiju Strike! Pick from a variety of hot and, yes, HORNY waifus and battle kaiju in this epic fantasy adventure story! That story is about to keep you hooked with its twists and STEAMY FUN!

title: Mafia Queens
description: You’re the new boss in this family, and the queens aren’t hiding their desires. With every meeting there’s less and less clothing, fewer rules and more of what stays only between you behind closed doors. Start relationships and prove you’re worthy of their loyalty.

title: Maggot House: Song of the Hanging Mirror
description: Aliens turned humans into "maggots" – toiling underground, eating rotten flesh. Xingzhi has a house. Her and her tenants' fates are in your hands. Save Ku Yi? Follow Qi Qian? Each choice leads somewhere else. The road up is stained with blood. The answer is yours.

title: Stardom: Riichi Mahjong
description: An unexpected twist at a TV audition thrusts the hero into showbiz as an “actress,” starting a life like no other. Face dazzling rivals across the mahjong table, and in the vibrant Urban Mainstray, where conflicts are settled by mahjong, rise as the Stardom of Mahjong!

title: Heima
description: Dive into an immersive spatial puzzle adventure. After your brother disappears into a world that should not exist, follow his trail across four parallel worlds. Master the powers of SHIFT and HOLD, solve spatial puzzles, and uncover the truth behind his disappearance.

title: Desecrator
description: Loosely based on Dante Alighieri's "Divine Comedy", namely Inferno.

title: Quake 30th Anniversary 1024 Jam
description: This map jam was held from June 2-17, 2026. The rules were to build a map with a "play area" within 1024x1024x1024 units. The maps are built on the Arcane Dimensions mod.

title: It Thinks!
description: Design the chip that powers AI. Start with a single logic gate and build a computer: wire circuits, cast designs into reusable chips, program tiny kernels, and scale your architecture into a working GPU.

title: Tales of Ember
description: Tales of Ember is a free-to-play digital collectible card game. Decks are thirty cards and singleton, so no card appears twice. Fifteen heroes are spread across five prisms, ten of them combining two prisms, which determines what a player can build before the first card is played. Modes include a weekly ranked ladder that resets on Sunday, a curated draft format, campaign puzzles and community tournaments. The game runs on Windows, macOS, Linux, Android and iOS with cross-play on a single account. Its rules engine and card statistics derive from OpenSky, the open-source release of the code behind the discontinued game Skyweaver, re-implemented on a different engine.

title: Heavy Wake
description: Heavy Wake is a short dark-fantasy deckbuilding RPG where Fyodor ventures onto a cursed island in search of a cure for his dying people. Explore eerie locations, recruit strange companions, and build a party-driven deck as you face monsters and other dangers in tactical, turn-based card battles.

title: Waifus Achievement Clicker
description: Earn 100 easy, time-based steam achievements while clicking to love cute waifus across 24 levels! All for less than the cost of a can of coffee!

title: Battle Gang
description: Battle Gang is a chaotic and fun multiplayer brawler and party game developed by Kimura Games. Players control jelly-like, physics-based characters in hilarious battles across various arena modes, using interactive elements and fighting mechanics to defeat their opponents.

title: Age of the Fallen
description: A fast-paced dark-fantasy bullet-heaven roguelite where you battle endless hordes of demons across a medieval world. Choose from 10 unique heroes, collect and combine hundreds of cards, evolve powerful attacks, and create massive character builds as you fight through challenging scenarios, bosses, and story missions. The game also features two-player local co-op, letting you team up with a friend to take on Hell together.

title: Grey Cloaks of Aron: The Sleeping Village
description: A story-driven 2D detective adventure set in a mysterious medieval village, where two royal investigators are sent to solve a seemingly ordinary missing-person case that quickly takes a stranger turn. Explore the village, question its inhabitants, investigate crime scenes, and piece together clues to uncover the secrets behind the mysterious events, either alone or in local co-op.

title: Manorbound
description: Explore a manor trapped in a time loop and solve puzzles to uncover the manor's deepest secrets and break the cycle.

title: Tremble of Towers
description: Tremble of Towers is a CO-OP tower defense game where you can build any structure with any resource. Countless of combinations are waiting for you and your friends to be discovered in order to protect your beloved Goal Stone from all kinds of enemies in various maps!

title: The Glorious Colony
description: An ant colony automation game. You need to develop your colony, cultivate different sorts of plants and reactivate old machinery.

title: Headspace Reverie
description:
Explore the end of the World through a decaying virtual space.

Do you feel like something isn't quite right with the World? Do you feel a crippling sense of unease weighting you down a little bit more every day? Do you wanna scream for no particular reason? Do you look around and feel like everyone is doing okay except you? Are you a prisoner in your own head, with everything piling up with no way to prevent this?

This is the future, and it is terrifying.

title: Basic Parade or: "you should be depressed."
description: Socially underdeveloped Lisa found solace in books... Until her eyes fell out. You take the role of Henry, the therapist assigned to guide Lisa through her depression. There's just one problem: she isn't depressed.

title: Escape Path
description: Navigate complex mazes using your logic and avoiding enemies to rebuild the protective crystal. A hand-drawn puzzle-game combining action and problem-solving, where every mistake can be fatal! Ready to take on the challenge and find the pieces before it's too late?

title: Zedfall: Outbreak
description: ZedFall: Outbreak is a fast‑paced co‑op wave survival shooter with twin‑stick controls, evolving upgrade cards, and roguelite progression. Fight through numerous undead swarms, build powerful class combinations, and hold out long enough for extraction. There are 3 main game modes to play; Wave Survival, Tower Defence, Scavenge. Each game mode offers a different objective and gameplay experience.

title: Nexus Storm
description: Nexus Storm is a frenetic arcade shoot 'em up built for high scores. Blast through high-octane levels at breakneck speed, obliterate waves of enemies, and dominate the leaderboard—in the true spirit of 90s classics like Battle Squadron and R-Type.

title: Punching a Dirty Wizard
description: The Dirty Wizard wants you to punch him, he wants you to kill him. One strike at a time.

title: Warlord: Awaji
description: An army management simulator taking place in feudal japan made by Darkmatter games

title: Aretias: Cursed Island
description: Travel to an isolated island, use your camera to reveal what the naked eye cannot see, and uncover the truth behind a forgotten curse. Aretias: Cursed Island is a story-driven first-person horror game focused on exploration, environmental puzzles, and atmospheric tension.

title: CarX Rally
description: A realistic rally simulator powered by its own physics engine. Adapt your driving style to different cars, surfaces, and weather conditions, tackle hundreds of special stages created by the community in the in-game level editor, and compete against drivers from around the world.

title: FFFF: Fatal Five Finger Fillet
description:
Bet your fingers. A physically immersive horror roguelite.
Place your real fingers on the keyboard. Stab the knife between them.
Use rings and stab items to rack up a high score.
Can you keep your cool as the spinning blade closes in?

title: StateOS: The Political Sandbox
description: The political sandbox game where you build a career from state rep to the presidency. Authentic electoral systems, government departments, pass legislation, and a unique news landscape. Create custom scenarios, parties, and politicians in this data-driven democracy simulator.

title: Lost Odyssey: Recompiled
description: An experimental native PC port of Lost Odyssey for Xbox 360.

title: Jester Under Pressure
description: Diskarte is a Filipino-inspired visual novel where you play as a nonbinary jester trying to entertain a queen who explodes heads. With 33,000+ words, 60+ Filipino terms, and four branching routes (including romance), it blends humor, danger, and vibrant storytelling. Can you survive her wrath?

title: Terminus: Zombie Survivors 2
description: The dead won. Terminus: Zombie Survivors 2 is an open-world survival game: your past life shapes your second one – a nurse survives one way, a cop another. Scavenge, craft, build, farm, alone or with friends. The dead don't starve, don't tire, don't freeze. You do. Reach the Terminus, or die trying.

title: Fortress Merge
description: Merge buildings, upgrade your defenses, and protect your fortress from endless waves of zombies. Plan each move carefully, adapt your strategy, and survive as long as you can.

title: Hockey Beasts
description: Choose your team, step onto the ice, and see what kind of beast you are when the puck starts moving.

title: Random Mix
description:
The rhythm game that writes a brand-new song every time you press play. 50+ genres synthesized live. Tap it, remix it, or build your own: you are the DJ and the producer, no music knowledge needed. Fully offline.

A song that has never existed before builds itself around you: drums, bass, melody, all synthesized live on your machine. No downloads or song packs.

Random Mix is a rhythm game with a composer inside.

title: Kid Kirby Recreated
description: A recreation of a cancelled Kirby game that Nintendo contracted DMA design to make in the mid-90's, using information and assets shared publically by some of the old developers.

title: Artifacts of the Past: Ancient Mysteries
Emberwall
description: Emberwall is a roguelite tower defense game where you reshape enemy paths with tetromino walls, harvest resources, reveal a fog-covered wilderness, and combine powerful towers and elemental upgrades to defend your castle.

title: Beyond the Kingdom 3: Secrets of the Ancient
Beyond the Unknown: A Matter of Time - Collector's Edition
Blue Bite
description: Your "fingertips" will save the world! "BLUE BITE" is a fully voiced 3D romance action adventure set in a world inhabited only by women. Six heroines are threatened by the mysterious disease "bluebite", and the only cure is... your "massage"! Explore the 3D world and save the girls!

title: Aria Blue I: Natsuoto
description: Aria Blue I: Natsuoto is a coming-of-age fantasy visual novel that depicts the summer of nine boys and girls. The game will be released in multiple installments, with each installment focusing on one protagonist and two heroines, together weaving a single story that unfolds over the same period of time.

title: Dead or Alive 6: Last Round - Minato
War of Genesis: Idle Loot
description: Just leave it running. The rest takes care of itself. In a small corner of your desktop, a 3D character fights and loots all on its own. Snag good gear and trade it on the Steam Community Market. It's idle, yet you can't stop watching. Addictive looting at its finest.

title: Ultimate Pet Shop Simulator
description: Build and manage your own pet shop in a first-person simulation experience. Sell pets, place stands, decorate your store, satisfy customers, grow your business, and create the ultimate pet shop.

title: Monsters Are Coming!: Madness Builds
description: Madness Builds introduces a new biome, 3 townhalls, a new hero, weapon, buildings, challenges and more themed around laboratories, dangerous experiments and brilliant insanity.

title: Bunker Tidy Up
description: Bunker Tidy Up is a relaxing game about organizing a bunker. Arrange 17,276 supplies on shelves, categorize resources, and relax!

title: The Decree
description:
The Decree is a 1–3 player cooperative horror game about hunting souls, surviving a relentless 90-second clock, and making impossible choices when The Button appears.

Track wandering souls, capture them under pressure, fight Soul Drainers, and fulfill each Order before time runs out.

When The Button appears, choose PROCEED or STAY without knowing what either choice will cause.

Push your run further, survive the Orders, and decide when to extract—or keep going until the Decree breaks you.

title: Mega Man Battle Network Mashup
description: A sandbox style Mega Man Battle Network Fangame where after the events Battle Network 6, Lans Dad is gonna host a large tournament during the summer holiday so Lan and Megaman decide to prepare themselves for it. Gather chips, battle navis and explore the net and overworld once more where areas are familiar but different at same time.

title: Crowns and Pawns: Amber Road
description: Embark on a thrilling point-and-click road adventure across Europe. Travel through mesmerizing locations, solve puzzles and survive chilling threats while following the legendary Amber Road. Will you have the wits to uncover the mystery behind the enigmatic artifact - the Sun stone?

title: Chill with You: SHIOI's Sparkling Scenes
description: This is a Lo-Fi Productivity Visual Novel Game where you work alongside the expressive girl Shioi to stay focused. Use productivity tools and mix Lo-Fi music with ambient sounds to create your ideal workspace. Keep working together, and perhaps one day you and Shioi will grow closer…?

title: CarCrash.Tube: Car Crash Simulator
description: Create crazy crash scenarios, wreck cars, and capture the chaos! Share your best videos on your channel, gain new followers, and increase your earnings. Buy new vehicles and equipment, create bigger crashes, and take your CarCrash.Tube channel to the top!

title: Bloodbrand
description: Bloodbrand is a story-rich adventure game where every decision carries a weight. Navigate yourself through perilous situations with persuasion, deception, seduction. Explore the cold winter nights of the medieval realm of Norn and sate your vampiric hunger for murder, or resist it at a great cost.

title: Glazed Mirror: Myriad Cards
description: Randomly deal the cards, with the Role cards determining the card pool. Based on the technique cards in hand, play them in sequence to trigger their effects. Alter cards alter the initial deal, and the Phantasm challenge the depth limit.

title: Professor Layton and the Curious Village Remake
Arrow: Button Heart
description: "Arrow-ButtonHeart" is a 2D pixel-style game combining platform puzzles and action adventure. Players control an archer who uses archery skills and wit to solve mechanism-filled dungeon puzzles, face time limits and guarding monsters, experiencing an intense mix of puzzles and action.

title: SmashCore
description: SmashCore is a short, physics based incremental game about smashing asteroids into dust with your gravity cursor and feeding it to the Core. Discover ancient technology and new ores in deep space and use your cash to buy upgrades in the huge skill tree.

title: Witches of the Fourth
description: Witches of the Fourth 2.0 Is An Online Multiplayer Spell Casting TeamBase FPS Witch Hunt Where You Duel Against Your Friends Using Powerful Spells and Magical Abilities to Collect There Souls The Player With the Most Souls Win Witches of the Fourth is the Battle Between Black Magic and Core Magic

title: I Have an Adventure House
description: The boss couple of house of terror of amusement park of jiujiang city of new century is suddenly in some abandoned hospital is missing mysteriously, the relic that police can find has an old Rag Doll and a mysterious black mobile phone only

title: Cozy Farm: Tidy Up!
description: A cozy organizing simulator about sorting 2500+ adorable fruits, vegetables and other crops into greenhouses. Perform satisfying sorting combos, earn money for helpful upgrades and explore the farm at dawn or night. Take your time and tidy the farm, one shelf at a time!

title: Paradise Corner 2
description: Paradise Corner 2 is a cozy and relaxing casual clicker game.

title: The King of Go
description: Deploy! Assemble! Battle! In this innovative Go game, you can strategically deploy your pieces, combining them into a powerful army to defeat your enemies.

title: The Lost Identity
description: The Lost Identity is a 2D psychological adventure platformer where you wake up at the gates of purgatory after a tragic car accident. With no memory of who you are, you must navigate deadly traps, solve simple tasks for strange Soul's, and uncover the disturbing truth about your past — and your fate

title: Finding Ruby
description: A cozy hidden object adventure inspired by classic puzzle books. Join Ruby and her loyal friends on a journey across the world to uncover the mystery of her missing archaeologist parents through beautifully hand-crafted and highly detailed scenes.

title: Haunted Attractions
description: Build haunted theme parks and supervise ghosts in this cozy afterlife sim. Construct fun attractions, manage resources, recruit cute ghosts and haunt the park in order to spook and delight the guests!

title: One in a Thousand: Clover Book
description: A minimalist and relaxing hidden-object game about searching for the four-leaf clover in a clover patch. Go back to your youth and collect all variants in your collection book.

title: Where Is My Pet?
description: Where Is My Pet? is a hidden object, sorting, and animal game! Run your cozy shelter: place animals, sell them to loving homes, upgrade your shelter, build your dream house, and search the city for pets. Can you turn a shabby shelter into a profitable business?

title: Destabilized
description: A 4-player online co-op sci-fi game. Join the GeoDesX Discovery Team, work together to re-stabilize alternate dimensions, and jostle for corporate recognition (backstabbing is authorized). Convert items into energy, avoid anomalies, and get back to your home dimension... for science!

title: Fluxgates
description: A roguelike where every run is a factory you wire together on a canvas. Draft nodes, connect them into a production line, then press Run and find out. Each room demands more than the last - build the combo engine that keeps up, or stall three ticks from the target.

title: All In One Sports: KungFu DLC
description: Enjoy sparring by blocking or deflecting attacks with Kung Fu movements.

title: Bullet Barrage Basketball
description: A fast-paced arena brawler where basketball collides with bullet hell. Dodge bullets, shove rivals, and score through explosive mayhem in a fight where survival matters as much as the win.

title: All In One Sports: Hockey
description: Use controllers or trackers to block or strike pucks in intense air hockey duels.

title: All In One Sports: Soccer
description: Feel the thrill of realistic soccer actions in a fully immersive VR environment!

title: All In One Sports: Four Ball Billiards
description: Master 4-Ball billiards with strategic shot control in immersive VR!

title: All In One Sports: Three Cushion Billiards
description: Master 3-cushion billiards with precise ball control in immersive VR!

title: Door Runners
description: A 4-10 player online social deduction party game. Only one player knows the safe door, but that knowledge will not get them out early. Bluff and survive over live voice chat, round after round, until only two doors and two players remain.

title: Big City Adventure: London - Premium Edition
Rude Supermarket Simulator
description: Running the store is your job. Listening to the customers is your punishment. Rude Supermarket Simulator is a first-person supermarket management game for 1-4 players.

title: Furry Adventure!
description:
Furry Adventure is a relaxing puzzle game that invites you into a charming fantasy world filled with beautiful furry heroines, pleasant music, colorful illustrations, and Steam achievements.

Complete puzzles, unlock new images, and enjoy a calm atmosphere designed for players who love cute fantasy characters, simple gameplay, and beautiful visual rewards. The game is easy to understand, relaxing to play, and perfect for short casual sessions.

title: Dumb Ideas With Friends
description: Remember those super stupid ideas you used to have when you were a kid? Or maybe you still have them? Race shopping carts down a street, walk a plank high up between buildings, or try to trampoline over a house roof in your backyard! Call your friends...you got a really great dumb idea!

title: Bluebeard's Castle: Son of the Heartless
Cowgirl Maid Milk Cafe
description: Move to the city, start a small business, and build a new life—with your two cowgirl maids! Run your cafe, delve dungeons for resources, train new staff, milk your cowgirls... and more!

title: Bonfire Stories: Manifest Horror - Collector's Edition
Dark Succubus
description: Explore the labyrinth, collect crystal shards, uncover the truth and escape. The most important thing is: avoid the pursuit of the dark succubus and beware of this sweet temptation. (Female villain costume can be customized)

title: HardPunch: Sex Plague
description: A third-person action + visual novel hybrid, HardPunch: Sex Plague follows HardPunch through a collapsing world consumed by obsession, mutated desire, and the mysterious Alive-Bombs — physical manifestations of the cosmic entity known as Vaelis.

title: Sex Poker
description: Sex Poker brings the amazing world of high stakes poker to a whole new adult level. Allowing you to customize your own supermodel dealer and then take her to your personal high roller suite for adult fun.

title: DoHots
description: A game from the devs of AChat, which is a kind of stripped-down offline version, where is a large number of sex poses and the ability to try different clothes. More than 10 sexy virtual partners, more than 250 hot animations in more than 20 detailed sex positions and 3 lifelike rooms.

title: BDSM Sex: Futanari
description: An adult visual novel about a curious young woman whose fascination leads her into a deep exploration of submission and the intense pleasure only her Mistress can offer.

title: Sexophobia
description: A dating sim and card-based social strategy game where everyday life collides with the unknown. Build relationships, craft your deck, and uncover a hidden reality where every connection shapes your path—and your fate.

title: Chickens. Chickens? Chickens!
description:
Fight ridiculous chicken hordes in a fast, casual arena shooter. Move, dodge, shoot, survive waves, chase a better score, and try not to get buried in feathers.

Chickens. Chickens? Chickens! is a fast-paced arena survival shooter where the only thing standing between you and total poultry domination is a varied arsenal of weapons. Fight off relentless waves of angry chickens, build your score multiplier, unlock new weapons, and survive long enough to face the mighty Chicken King. Every run is quick to pick up, chaotic to master, and packed with absurd moments.
Designed around short, replayable sessions, the game rewards movement, positioning, and split-second decision-making. As the chicken horde grows larger and more aggressive, you'll need to adapt your strategy and avoid being overwhelmed. Whether you're chasing a new high score or just looking for ten minutes of over-the-top action, there's always time for one more run.
Behind the silliness is a polished solo-developed project built with a strong focus on responsive gameplay and satisfying combat.

title: Crown Of Blight
description: Crown of Blight is a dynamic top-down 3D metroidvania. As an elite Hunter of the Church, descend into cursed dungeons to find the source of the Blight. Annihilate hordes of enemies, unlock new paths, and uncover the grim truth hidden in the depths.

title: DinoBox
description: Drop dinosaurs,merge matching species, and evolve them into something bigger! DinoBox is a physics-based puzzle game where every 20 turns, a meteor strikes the box—destroying one dinosaur and potentially changing everything. Build bigger dinos, fill your encyclopedia, and see how far you can evolve!

title: Carnor City
description: Escape Carnor City by any means necessary. As a rogue MKUltra agent in a rustbelt dystopia, outsmart a brutal AI ecosystem where G-Men and local crooks clash in dynamic crossfire. Leverage darkness, trigger chaotic physics, then die, adapt, and rewrite your tactical approach in a true immersive sim.

title: Swarm Harvest
description:
Congratulations, you're hired!
Blast bugs, deploy defensive towers, and command a pack of powerful attack drones to carve through endless alien swarms. Evolve into an unstoppable bug-blasting machine with absurdly overpowered builds to generate massive profits and make the corporation proud.

title: Pinbomb
description: The Pinball Roguelike! Pinbomb traps you in a room with a pinball machine hungry for higher and higher scores. Buy new parts to upgrade it, build wild synergies to feed the machine, and send your score through the roof. Oh, and there's a bomb strapped to it, so score big or go boom!

title: If I Still Had Tomorrow
description: “If there is a tomorrow”is a puzzle-type Pixel game. until the old man's disappointment accumulates, and this kind of lonely and lonely state of mind slowly turns into an endless nightmare of cannibalism. Can you help the old man escape his nightmare and finally get to the bottom of the story?

title: Dysnomia Exburst
description: DYSNOMIA Exburst is a third-person shooter doujin game. Set in a futuristic setting, the player controls an android (known as an Armed Doll).

title: I Wanna Be the Hedgehog
description:
I Wanna Be The Hedgehog is a Sonic the Hedgehog (1991) ROM hack based on the series like I Wanna Be The Guy The Movie The Game, Cat Mario, Unfair Sonic, etc.
This ROM hack was previously released on SSRG and Sonic Retro for April Fools and has since gotten a few updates.

title: Steel Gullet
description: Build a massive factory aboard a moving ark. Melt, separate, and refine chaotic scrap using realistic thermodynamics. Process materials by mass instead of items, craft based on material properties, and optimize complex production lines in strictly limited space.

title: Mining Rail Adventure
description: Mining Rail Adventure is a tunnel and railway game that combines free cavern exploration with high-speed roller coaster elements. Players travel through branching tunnels, vast caverns, and hidden chambers deep within a mountain to search for radiant crystals. The gameplay focuses on a mix of exploration, searching for collectibles, and fast-paced rail navigation.

title: Bibi & Tina: Ready, Set, Ride!
description: A summer full of friendship, tournament excitement and horse-filled happiness: Ride with Bibi, Tina and Alex as they compete for the cup, stand together against unfair rivals – and dive into varied horse-riding adventures. Action-packed carriage races are among the special highlights.

title: Last Buzz
description: Last Buzz is a 2–6 player Humans vs. Flies multiplayer game. Steal food, crawl on ceilings, hide in stupid places, and rescue your friends as a fly—or grab the bug spray, lock down the house, and hunt the little bastards before they take over.

title: Unbaitable
description: After fishing becomes outlawed by the Fish Protection Bureau, a young fisher decides to continue the sport and illegally fish.

title: Cardsharp
description: Blackjack in a dark room. Solo or with friends. Win the hand and you get paid; lose it and the dealer takes a finger. Rob the other players, burn the card they were saving, push cursed items on them.

title: Project Seaborne
description: Project Seaborne is an open-world sailing game set across an entire world of open ocean and coastline. Players captain their own ships: they trade cargo between ports, design and refit vessels at the shipyard, and command a fleet of consorts. Naval combat is fought broadside to broadside against pirates, rival nations and crown warships. Wind, weather, storms and the day-night cycle shape every voyage, and captains must keep their crew fed, paid and loyal to stay at sea. Players can sail solo or join friends in online co-op.

title: Peer-2-Pizza
description: The future of pizza delivery is here: deliver pizza through the power of the internet today! And when delivering, time moves when you move. So jump, dash, and dive your way through a network of obstacles and challenges, reach the customer, and do one very important job: deliver the pizza.

title: Mayhem À La Carte
description: Cook, fight, and serve under pressure in this chaotic 4-player co-op first-person cooking shooter. Prepare delicious meals, defend your kitchen from relentless enemies, and keep the orders flowing before everything falls apart.

title: Hookeye
description: It's the end of the line. Resist the madness and use questionable bait to just keep fishing. Sacrifice everything for a bigger catch. It has to be worth it.

title: Dialshift
description: Dialshift is a single-player score-attack arcade game played on a circular dial. Players control a continuously moving cursor with two directional inputs and time hit attempts against targets while maintaining combos and Stability. Seven modes vary the rules with directional targets, forced reversals, sustained holds, and multi-hit targets. Each mode has its own scores, ranks, and leaderboard.

title: Demon Protocol
description: Lock On. Light Up. Lay Waste. Demon Protocol is a retro arcade space shooter with 25 waves of relentless enemies, 4 brutal bosses, and power-ups to keep you fighting. Choose your difficulty and see how far you can push before the demons win.

title: Misery Dungeon
description: A hand-drawn, story-driven tactical RPG in the spirit of Mystery Dungeon. Guide Kern, a runaway princess, and her loyal squire up a cursed mountain where every room can be reshaped, where knowledge is your greatest weapon, and where failure makes you stronger.

title: Cookiesaner
description: Vampire Survivors, but the survivor is a real apricot maltipoo. A Balkan bullet-heaven: Cookie auto-fires ćevapi, devours baklava and burek to chonk up through five belly stages, and hits STAGE 4: GOD MODE — a giant Cookie rolling through the horde. Sevdah soundtrack. One dog. The whole čaršija.

title: The Warfare
description: This is a classic tower defense game where players can experience the charm of tower defense. A wide variety of weapons and turrets. Players move the muzzle of the gun by sliding the screen to fire bullets and kill the invading enemies.

title: Arijigoku
description: A short, narrative-driven 2D pixel art adventure/horror game. Play as Erik, a man lost in grief, as you explore a secluded forest, solve puzzles, and uncover the truth. With multiple endings and deadly choices, curiosity can cost you — so save often.

title: Cypher Override
description: Cypher Override is a fast-paced, retro-inspired clicking game where precision and speed are everything. Step into the shoes of a digital intruder as you exploit vulnerabilities in a shifting mainframe grid — all while covering your tracks to stay one step ahead of detection.

title: Super Hashigo
description: The controls used during the game are a simple operation with only two keys: "Forward" and "Backward." However, it offers a highly challenging experience. Dodge various gimmicks and aim for the top of "Hashigo"!

title: Fatal Gaming
description: Drowning in debt and desperate for a way out, you're invited to a mysterious game show promising untold wealth. But behind the beautiful cover lies a cruel truth: the prize is real — and so is the price of failure.

title: Fickle Allies
description: Collect and deposit every crystal to escape in this first-person multiplayer thriller game. Form shifting alliances, steal from rivals, protect your haul, or eliminate threats as you explore a mansion, subway, and abandoned facility where trust never lasts.

title: Cajun Cop: The French Quarter Caper
Grandfather
description: Grandfather is a first-person psychological horror game set in a two-room apartment. One evening, the mother brings home the long-lost father. With his return, the house is filled with oppressive anxiety and fear.

title: Small Bird Forest
description: 3rd person bird flying game, time trial around checkpoints, gliding course, through trees and over terrain. Gather berries from trees and trains, run slalom course

title: Camelot II: The Holy Grail - Collector's Edition
Arcade Audience
description: The arcade is packed, and you're the reason! Hit the targets to the beat to impress the audience. Master the different timings and cues to achieve arcade perfection!

title: Noodle Jump
description: Jump, Noodle, Jump! Or else you will be eaten by the horrifying giants! Will there ever be an end to your torture or even a chance for payback? Jump higher than any Noodle before to meet your one and only God...

title: Mad Hatter's Wonderland: Stitch by Stitch - Collector's Edition
Detective Secrets Solitaire: The Greyhall Mystery
Helga the Viking Warrior 8: Valhalla's Last War
Rescue Team: Phantom Crisis - Collector's Edition
Dragon Tale 6: Veil of Time - Collector's Edition
Crown of the Empire: Temple of Resurrection - Collector's Edition
New Yankee: Jelly Chaos - Collector's Edition
Untergrund Raceways: Arena
description: Untergrund Raceways Arena (short: URA) is a kart arena fighter from Vantech Studios, developed in cooperation with the AAP. URA covers a scope that seems somewhat atypical for a first PC game.

title: Alchemy Odyssey 2: Tears of the Elements
City Mage 3: False Prophecy - Collector's Edition
This Is Not For You
description: After a ghost ship crashes into an isolated lighthouse, Ulysses’ memories come back to trap him in an endless, twisting maze full of riddles, blood, and magic. Draw your own map, and find a way to burn it all down.

title: Dragon Tale 5: The Queen's Destiny - Collector's Edition
Beeder's Big Adventure
description: Beeder's Big Adventure is a 3D Platformer inspired by Sonic Adventure and Sonic X-treme.

title: Becoming None
description: Becoming None is a philosophical JRPG about the loss of identity and homogenization. Experience a story told through collectable memories you can view at your own pace, alongside deep turn-based combat, customizable classes, and countless secrets.

title: Break The Night
description: Dreamy high-speed Hack 'N' Slash about magical girls stuck in a world of nightmares. Inspired by late 2000s aesthetics and combo-heavy action games.

title: Halley's Big Catch
description: A cartoon cat who loves to fish. Come home to Hidden Pond, fight real fish, and follow a trail of relics to waters around the world. New shores, new tackle, and a story that unfolds one cast at a time.

title: Verity JE
description:
This mod adds Verity, a yellow shaped ball made to assist you for the best, and for the worst.

Verity JE is an official adaptation of ThatMob's "Something" YouTube ARG video series for Minecraft Java Edition.

title: Avlo the Imp Wizard
description: Do the sickest tricks while reaching the finish line the fastest you can!

title: Riftshot
description: Riftshot is a 3D Platformer without the need for platforms. Utilize your trusty grappling hook to shoot through the air blisteringly fast!

title: Exitrance
description: Exitrance is a single-player psychological horror game set in a constantly shifting loop. Explore a confined environment where each cycle subtly changes, altering objects, sounds, and events. Observe your surroundings, and solve environmental puzzles to break the loop and escape.

title: Stella Supernova: The Astral Vale
description: Jump, dash, dodge, and battle numerous stellar bosses in a 2D action-platformer playable solo or with up to 8 players locally, featuring unlockable powers, upgrades, cinematic QTEs, and an emotional story.

title: Estium Online
description: An old-school MMORPG where progress is permanent. Train classless skills, craft your gear from raw materials, fight in point-and-click combat, and even run for mayor of a player-governed towns, all in the hunt for legendary treasures across a growing world.

title: Boy x Boy: Shiritsu Kouryou Gakuin Seishinryou
Spinny-Roly 64
description:
An old-school gem collection game about a roly-poly who likes to bounce around.

A game inspired by Super Kiwi 64 that is all about rolling and bouncing around in a cool little world.

Collect gems, bonk enemies, and jump around with a fun player controller!

title: "Did You Submit a Ticket?" Simulator
description: Welcome to your new job. HelpDesk OS is a corporate IT support simulator where you battle frustrated coworkers using logic, dialogue, and weaponized company policy. Drain their willpower, manage their rage, and survive your 9-to-5 shift without HR firing you. Have you tried turning it off and on?

title: MSO FreeCell Arena
description: Multiplayer FreeCell — same deal, every player, race to solve. Live leaderboards, daily challenges, head-to-head rivalries. Free to download and play, no ads. Free for everyone during beta; the competitive layer becomes an optional subscription later. One flat tier, no microtransactions.

title: Rotfang: The House
description: A short horror game where you play as the family dog. Everyone is gone from the house and the town. Set in a suburban house and small town, explore each room, complete tasks, and find the dark secrets hidden under the house.

title: Tavern Rivals
description: Tavern Rivals is a synergy-heavy PvP auto battler where every synergy has a body holding it up. No team health bar, on either side — so protect the minions your engine runs on, and go through the ones holding theirs together.

title: Super Gahaku
description:
Super Gahaku is a 3D drawing party game where players create sculptures directly in 3D space using simple 3D pieces.

Given a prompt, build your best—or worst—3D sculpture, then laugh together as everyone tries to guess what you were making. Drawing in 3D is harder than it looks, and the strange results are often the funniest part!

title: Resettle
description: Resettle is a deep incremental city builder where you develop settlements on islands. Strategically place buildings to maximize resource production, explore 10 different upgrade systems, and create a thriving island city.

title: Trenchblocks
description: Dig, build, and destroy in a cute yet violent voxel shooter! Battle in Capture the Flag where you construct forts, dig trenches, or tunnel under enemy bases with full voxel destruction.

title: Feed The Frog King: Incremental TD
description: A short incremental tower defense game with a massive skill tree! Recruit a team of cute and deadly animal friends, shop for powerful hats, construct buildings, assign workers, and unlock powerful upgrades to Feed The Frog King!

title: Drag'n Wash
description: Enjoy a narrative involving 3 male dragons. Wash them, chat with them, touch them, and more! A 3D dragon washing experience.

title: Christmas Stories: A Little Prince - Collector's Edition
Murmuring of Moth Mouth
description: An eleven-year-old video shows Yuna's car on the road today. Its instructions promise to get her to the interview that could change her life... A short psychological horror visual novel about desperation and dependence.

title: Mortality... Please
description: Penelope falls for someone with an impossible condition. Then an elderly former fiancée arrives with his letters. A short psychological horror visual novel about growing up and choosing what to do with an impossible situation.

title: Magic Shop Simulator
description:
Magic shop simulator: is a first-person, open-world sandbox simulation game where players manage and expand a magical store. The core gameplay revolves around foraging for ingredients, brewing potions, and selling goods to customers. Players can automate their shops daily operations by hiring workers to help handle foraging, brewing potions, and serving customers.

A central mechanic of the game is a risk- and-reward system involving four ward stones that protect the shop from monsters. Players must try to balance the cost between keeping the stones charged, allowing threats into the plaza, so they can gather the materials for their shop, and risking their shops risk reputation.

title: Maikuro: Ore ga Watashi de Boku ga Atashi de
description: The male protagonist, Kunieda Yuuma, lives a happy school life with his friends. One day, Yuuma says, "It would be fun if our bodies were suddenly swapped." Almost immediately, there is something wrong with their bodies.... Their bodies are actually swapped! Who did it? What will happen to their school life...?

title: Get Outta My Gut
description: A rogue-lite tower defense where you control the horde. Draft randomized bio-turret cards, reshape tissue into lethal killzones, and manually slice open pathogen sacs to unleash fluid swarms on your terms. Evolve across 10 organs, don't let the contagion reach the heart.

title: RV There Yet? St. Búttin Bay
description:
New map expansion for the game 'RV There Yet?'.

Once again our fellow vacation aficionados are on the lookout for a way home via Route 65, but this time they’re traveling from the wonderful beaches of St. Búttin Bay. So crack your fingers, clean out the sand between your cheeks and get ready to finish this EPIC TRILOGY with ONE LAST RIDE home!

title: Dwarf Core
description: Dwarf Core is an idle-management game about small colony of dwarves who love to mine. Send them to the mine to gather resources, gain experience, upgrade their stats and craft new pickaxes. Looking for more active gameplay than idle? Take control of one of the dwarves and help them mine!

title: Match: Isekai Journey
description: Welcome to Match: Isekai Journey—where your "magical destiny" is to align three identical icons before you run out of turns.

title: Raising a Happy NEET
description: A distant relative and NEET girl suddenly becomes your family. Together, you’ll begin a heartwarming and redemptive life together in this cohabitation sim.

title: Argonauts Agency: Patterns of Morpheus - Collector's Edition
Big City Adventure: Vancouver - Collector's Edition
Shipping
description: Shipping is a hectic co-op block pushing game where you fight against the clock to fill out rows of blocks to ship them around the world.

title: The Infectious Adventure
description: You have to save the world, by destroying cases, avoid infected cars...

title: Zero Contact
description:
Zero Contact is a horror first-person tower-defense shooter. The whole city has lost contact with the outside world, overrun by hostile alien monsters.
Armed with firearms and defensive setups, you must survive waves of alien creatures, gather data, discover the monsters’ weaknesses, and fight to reclaim the city.

title: That's My Village!
description: A roguelite village builder. Assign every job, keep morale from collapsing, and hold the line when fire, plague and monster waves arrive. Win or lose, your Legacy carries into the next run.

title: Genshin Impact: A Rekviem for the Underworld
description:
Version 7.1 of Genshin Impact. This update includes:
• New characters: Vesna and Vodyanitsa
• New main story quests: "White Night, Like a Dream Upon Waking" and "A Rekviem for the Underworld"
• New main event: Silverwing in Pursuit of the Moon
• 6th anniversary celebrations

title: Diablo V
description:
For three decades, Sanctuary has stood on the edge of oblivion, and we’ve managed to push the darkness back… until now. The next era of Diablo is now in development.

Revealed during the BlizzCon 2026 Opening Ceremony, Diablo V takes players into a Sanctuary that has fallen. The heroes are gone, and Diablo has won.

title: World of Warcraft: Forever
description: World of Warcraft: Forever is an invitation to take your first steps in a legendary world of untamed frontiers, warring factions, untold perils, and unseen mysteries. Experience an Azeroth that grows from the roots of WoW’s first age, continually evolving through regular content patches and updates that promise never-ending adventure.

title: City of Stories: The Hunter's Heart
Sonic and the Bayan Isles
description: A hand-drawn metroidvania passion project set in the mystical Bayan Isles, inspired by places and biomes in the Philippines. Explore the isles, discover new skills, defeat badniks, collect rings, and help tails find a chaos emerald to fix the tornado!

title: Banan Abanan
description: In Banan Abanan, you jump and slide around many little worlds, finding trinkets and helping out the many creatures you encounter!

title: Lightspeed Lina
description: A blazing-fast action-adventure 3D Platformer starring the speedy, sassy heroine; Lina! Help her fight, fly, and flaunt her way through loops, towns and bosses in search of new powers that will further her exploration of a series of vibrant, nonlinear islands to unlock secrets from beyond the stars.

title: Lost Crab​
description: Lost Crab is a Puzzle / Action hybrid. Imagine Pac-man combined with a Rubik's Cube.

title: Cubenen Gardens: Kingdom
description: Explore the Woodland District and help Ix search for his mysterious Tactician

title: Sonic SpeedStars
description: onic SpeedStars is a high-speed action platformer that uses character specific abilities to clear stages

title: Sonic into the Black Sea
description: This is a Sonic fangame made in Godot, with gameplay inspired by Dimps' Sonic Advance series and more heavily based on Sonic Advance 2. This project aims to expand on Sonic's core mechanics from those games and create levels that take full advantage of them in order to greatly challenge the player. The levels will present obstacles for players of all skill levels and heavily reward those who put in time to master Sonic's controls and the stage layouts. This is a fan game most players will find difficult, but will feel equally rewarded for the time put into it!​

title: Monochromatic Aberration
description:
A 3D speed based platformer with elements of collect-athon.

The goal is to reach the finish line as quickly as possible while collecting the lost souls within each level.

title: Benjy Adventure
description: Benjy adventure is a 2D platformer inspired by Mario, Donkey Kong Country and Sonic.

title: The Zium Railway
description:
In the Valley of the Underground Mountain.. In the picturesque land of Lyptch...

The Zium Railway is an open world gallery.

Experience a hand crafted open world, the open rails, a new collection of artists, a collaborative video game, and a new exhibition from The Zium Society.

Features works from Ada Null, Charlotte Madelon, Christopher Ferris, Farfama, Jacob Potterfield, John Flannelly & Virtual Neighbors, Julian Palacios, Michael Berto, Pippin Barr, and Zilasaule.

title: AuraTitan
description: AURATITAN is a Co-Op run-'n'-gun / movement platformer hybrid, starring the titular AuraTitans, Kita and Vana! Along the way, they'll be using the many mystical Auras of Shatterstar Island to save the world.

title: Sonic Clockwork
description: Sonic Clockwork is a Classic Sonic fangame that takes place after the good ending of Sonic CD.

title: Comet Cutter
description: Comet Cutter is a curtain fire shooting game where you play as one of three girls to knock down foes while you navigate through perilous terrain. The bullet patterns are a bit simple, but to get to the end, you will need to pull some dangerous maneuvers... so be careful and quick!

title: Amit the Paperman
description:
BE BOUNDLESS AND TEAR THROUGH ALL LIMITS!

Its a average day on the paper planet of Papercury until the president Porker P Prez decided that his planet needed less organic life and more machines! Its a bad situation for everyone especially a humble janitor called Amit! A ton of President Porker's men ransacked him! But he won't take this sitting down! Speed through environments, smash through foes, and use the power of the Pristine Pencils to transform into all shapes and sizes! Be bold and be boundless in AMIT THE PAPER MAN!

title: Connected Hearts: Hour of the Witch
American Gold Rush
description: Dahlonega, Georgia. 1829. You've got a shovel, a day's food, and a hole in the ground that gets richer the deeper you're willing to go. Every step and every swing costs energy and daylight, so the real game is deciding when to push one more swing of the axe, and when to climb out.

title: Mithril
description: Explore and mine in procedural caves. Master using struts to delve deeper and support the ceiling before it falls. Build automation chains to process ores. Then manipulate lava and trigger Dormancy to crystallise new ore where lava once flowed. Same world. New cave. New dangers. The world remembers.

title: Cawcaknight
description: In CAWCAKNIGHT, a 2D platformer focused on movement expression, you control a gallant knight chicken!

title: Cocosic: On Pirates' Trail
description: Cocosic and his brother Viki need to save their sister Aivochka, who has been kidnapped by the evil pirate king. On their journey, they will have to visit different worlds, as well as help restore them after the "Collapse" arranged by the villain on the way to his own world.

title: Donny Donut: Stardust
description: Welcome to the world of Donny Donut, a world full of colors and sweets! This time, Donny will travel through many planets and galaxies to save the whole universe from the evil Burger King!

title: Family Time
description: Build a family with thousands of wolf children with your own wolf partner!

title: Love, Peace, and Roseleaf
description: Momoba, a kindhearted girl, prays every day after her father falls ill. One day, the Spirit of Love and Peace appears, telling her that defeating the Yamichu with magic will cure him. Upon transforming, Momoba’s powers awaken—yet the evil Yamichu will not let a magical girl stand in their way…

title: Total Destruction 2Dee
description:
Take control of Dee the shape shifting gal and blast through several live tv shows before the show's over wrecking as much carnage as possible!

Get a combo, break boxes, get a high score and rush through an encore to get a high stage rank!

title: Ravage Fist
description: This is a 2D fighting game inspired by 90s anime, and vintage gaming. You can play as a shonen protagonist, a magical girl, a kaiju monster, or a juvenile delinquent. Choose any of these characters to accept Tereon's challenge, and save the earth from being gambled by the tyrant.

title: Dungeons & Dynasties
description:
A guild-management simulation where every league fixture is a procedurally generated dungeon and every
hero can die in it. You lead an adventuring guild through a six-tier pyramid of 72 rival houses: sign
delvers, train them, kit them, set the standing orders they will fight on, and send four of them into the
dark. You never click an attack. Heroes age, form friendships and grudges, are scarred by what they
survive, retire and die permanently, and the whole history of your guild is written back to you as prose
the simulation generated rather than an author wrote.

title: Adventure Trip: Amazing Wildlife - Collector's Edition
Cruel Collections: The Any Wish Hotel
Mole Escape
description: A little mole has had enough of living under the rule of the tyrannical Mole King. He wants only one thing — to escape the underground kingdom and finally be free.

title: Jarred Defense
description: A difficult maze-building tower defense about Yuki, a cat trapped in a teleporting jar. Protect it from robots and endure its unhelpful comments. Build your own paths, adapt as levels change, unlock powerful items, and uncover Yuki’s story. A love letter to Warcraft III custom maps.

title: Dark Are the Crypts: The Lost Idea

title: Podstakannik Rails
description:
Podstakannik Rails is a first-person social co-op game set aboard an overnight sleeper train. One to four players board the same car, take their berths, and spend the trip together. There are no quests, scores, or progression systems: the host sets the trip to 10, 15, or 20 minutes, the train pulls into the station when time runs out, and nothing carries over to the next trip.

Players talk over proximity voice chat, so voices are clear inside a compartment and fade down the corridor. Around the car, they can fill a glass of tea at the samovar and carry it in a metal glass holder called a podstakannik, tune the radio by hand through the static, make up a berth and lie down for a nap, and work the reading lamps, ceiling lights, and compartment doors. Non-player characters include the sleeping car attendant, a police officer, and passengers who tell stories to anyone who sits down to listen, while the countryside passes outside the window by day or by night.

Descend into a cave deeper than any man was ever meant to go. You are a Miner Knight, a miserable soul sent on a one way down quest into the absolute darkness to reach The Dreamer, the corpse of an ancient and forgotten god, laying at the very bottom of these caves.

Each level-up offers a choice of weapons and upgrades; pairs of weapons unlock synergies, and fully upgraded weapons can evolve into stronger forms.

A standard run lasts twenty minutes, after which the player can continue into an endless mode where enemies keep getting tougher. Every week brings a new mutator that changes the rules of each run, along with a weekly challenge and online leaderboards.

description:
Edicts of the Truthsinger: The Orb of Artemagus is a mystery game centering around a classic adventuring party that have returned from their latest quest only to discover the artifact they were sent to retrieve has vanished from their custody.

Six witnesses, six suspects, and thousands of discoverable lines of dialog. description: Collect, train, and battle Chibits in a fast-paced roguelike card game. Manage your creatures between runs, master tactical combat, and travel through a branching galaxy where every choice shapes your destiny.

description: Wager your soul against the Devil in an infernal 5-day tavern! Survive rigged wheels, folklore trivia, pachinko, arcade minigames, and a rhythm dance showdown. Can you bankrupt him?

description: Something in this abandoned boarding school refuses to rest. Use your flashlight to survive what lurks in its hallways and solve the puzzles that reveal its dark past. Will you find the truth, or will you be the one forgotten tonight?

description: Zenden is a relaxing garden-building game where you decorate a peaceful Zen garden and solve puzzles along the way. Place Trees, Rocks, Paths, and many more hand drawn pixel art items for a calming, meditative experience with instrumental music tracks.
