description:
The game takes place in 2009-2011.

Call of Blood is a cinematic single-player first-person shooter that immerses you in a gritty survival experience. The world is engulfed in a zombie outbreak, but the walking dead are far from your only problem.

You became the most wanted target after eliminating an influential politician who launched three dangerous reactors that could kill half of humanity.

Now, regular groups of enemies and elite operatives from the (Vurs) are hunting your head. A group of scientists is the only key to salvation. They offer you the dangerous deal of a lifetime: break through the cordon and blow up the sinister reactors from the inside.

title: Bolero: The Shifting Isle
description: In a genre defying blend of tactics-adventure gameplay, unravel the story of the four adventurers who braved the unknown and solved the mystery of the The Shifting Isle.

title: Black Camelot
description: Shoot, slice, or cast spells and take control of any enemy to uncover his story and dark secrets hidden within the cursed and isolated ruins of a neo-Nazi castle. Embark on the bloody crusade in this eerie fast-paced 2D action shooter and discover that even sinners have their dreams.

title: Return to Li World
description: In the magic PRG with round combat, the adolescent Ming passes through LI world and meet with the girl Qiqi and help each other. From the beginning, they fight for survival and then they convene teammates to become top mercenary on the mainland.

title: Don't Pick Up
description: Wanted: a reliable technician who follows the rules, handles sensitive information with discretion, and does not ask questions. Fix the phones. Don't look too closely.

title: Snackrifice
description: Feed a hungry demon overlord in this 1-4 player roguelike dungeon crawler. Adapt to perilous curses, craft powerful relics and overcome the many faces of Purgatory.

title: Grapplehook Midpoint Teleport Killer
description: In this platformer game, Sylvie has a fluffy tail and can teleport to the midpoint of her Grapplehook. What could possibly go wrong? And does this world truly have a kitten?

title: VerX
description: You and your wife are on a day trip to Falkirk, with open questions in your life accumulated and unresolved.

title: Inferior
description: A test pilot's flight is challenged by a succession of problems.

title: Helena's Rejection
description: A writer completes his biography of prominent industry person Helena Kastakitis. However there is something about the book that Helena disagrees with.

title: High Voltage
description: High Voltage is a first-person incremental game about building your power grid. Start with a pedal-powered generator, expand with wind and solar power and keep the city supplied with electricity. Upgrade, complete contracts and see how far you can grow your network.

title: The Sorrows of Young Werther
description: The young hero moves to a new town in 18th century Germany. His heart is soothed by the beautiful surroundings, but one day...

title: Oliver Renhelf
description: The hero finds himself in strange, yet vaguely familiar surroundings, accompanied by the mysterious Ivy who seems not to understand his unsettlement.

title: Heatwalker
description: An expatriot's time in Japan is coming to an end, but before he leaves he must tie up one last loose end.

title: The Supreme Chicken
description: The Supreme Chicken is a short comedy game with absurd humor, where you'll have to cook the Supreme Chicken by following the 3 steps of the recipe.

title: The Swerve
description: A second in one person's life.

title: The History of Zakrainian Literature
description: A man remembers his involvement in the happenings around a country known for its written art.

title: Air Divers
description: Two base jumpers are about to attempt their most ambitious stunt yet.

title: Miseria RPG
description: You embark on an adventure hoping to find the Angel of Mercy as you cross the hostile lands of Miseria. Good luck, adventurer.

title: Weekend Fever
description: While setting up an art patronage project you visit your home town.

title: Another Aurelie
description: You decide to treat your daughter to a nice day at the zoo before she starts school next week.

title: Chiyoda
description: Visiting Tokyo, you reconnect with a friend.

title: Aces of Ring
description: A podcaster chronicles the story of an era-defining rivalry in the history of the WHSL professional wrestling promotion.

title: Gokigen na Schmetterlinge
description: The coaches of a children's tennis school are preparing to go to summer camp with their students.

title: Quarter of Severance
description: You and your recently separated wife meet to go see your son's art exhibition.

title: Red Arrow
description: A skier recovering from a season-ending injury is visited by her technician to discuss his future.

title: Kitten Combat
description: This is a Quick demo release for Easter. It's a 2 player party game, featuring arena fighting cats. can be played using either the keyboard or keyboard + a joystick.

title: Cynical Software Volume One
description: This is a pc software package that contains 10 games, which were originally designed for mobile devices. Check the readme.txt, for more details.

title: Sky Lance
description: A super hard shoot-em-up where you collect coins to purchase weapon upgrades and battle giant brains in space!!

title: Everything Must Fit!
description: In this puzzle game, transform, combine, and break items to arrange them to fit the grid. No matter what, everything MUST fit!

title: Crunge
description: The aim of Crunge is to burst creatures/objects which break into increasingly smaller pieces when hit. You fire lines which stay in place for a few seconds. It has a cool end boss and over 40 levels.

title: Grub Banger
description: A short arcade game where you control a caterpillar, Uses the mouse for controls.

title: Package Piles: Tidy Up The Warehouse!
description: Package Piles: Tidy Up The Warehouse! is a relaxing placement simulation where you organize a huge warehouse full of boxes. Stack packages on pallets, use transport vehicles to place them on shelves, and enjoy turning a messy space into a perfectly organized warehouse step by step.

title: AFK: Army For Keyboard
description: Your army keeps fighting inside the taskbar while you get on with your day. AFK is an idle RPG built as a fake desktop OS: drag windows, forge gear across ten rarity tiers, climb an endless tower, and settle scores in asynchronous PvP the server replays back to you.

title: Bluy Leaves Home
description: A turn-based bullet-hell JRPG game.

title: Mysteries of Rodion
description: Mysteries of Rodion is an atmospheric supernatural detective adventure set in an enigmatic antique shop. Explore its rooms, examine unusual objects, solve puzzles, gather clues, and uncover the stories hidden within its collection. Meet eccentric characters and unravel mysteries through dialogue and choices, with humor woven into the eerie atmosphere.

title: Danger Sprout
description: Danger sprout is a Platform shoot em up, with vector graphics. Controls consist of the arrow keys, spacebar and alt.

title: Space Rot
description: This is a rather basic shoot em up with psychedelic effects and low-resolution graphics. Use the arrow keys to move and space bar to fire. Collect the orange power ups for a different weapon.

title: Seismic Death
description: This is an arcade shoot em up where you have to destroy enemies and dig through dirt. Use the arrow keys to move and space bar to shoot. Collect powerups to gain different weapons with a limited ammunition.

title: Chef Le Puke
description: This is a weird game where you control a guy in a wheelchair with a chainsaw that shoots lasers. Beware the game contains grating sound effects and flashing strobe lights.

title: Devil Bout
description: This is a small game where you play tennis with swords and a bomb for the ball. If the Bomb bounces twice on your opponents side then it explodes and you score a point. The game has a computer Ai and is also playable for 2 people against each other through the same keyboard. player one uses the arrow keys and spacebar, player two uses "a" to swing their bat and "s" "e" "d" "f" to move.

title: The Demonic Faces
description: This is a puzzle game played with the mouse. You complete stages by exploding all the other faces. Moving over a face causes both the player and the face to grow. When a face reaches a certain size it will explode. Being close to the explosion causes the player to shrink, faces in the nearby proximity will also grow and may subsequently explode. If the player gets too small or too large they die. The strategy involves maintaining a constant size which is achieved by moving around. the ingame music is from a Amiga game called Apidya.

title: Mighty Champions
description: This is short and rather silly game where you have to shoot an apple of a guys head. you play as an archer, a ninja and a viking. Space bar shoots.

title: Cosmic Fallout
description: This is a scrolling shoot em up much simmilar to the arcade game scramble. Use the arrow keys to move, "m" key shoots and "n" key drobs a bomb. you must fly through fuel baloons to replentish fuel.

title: Neural
description: In this somewhat psychedelic game you move with the keys "j""i""l""k" but you can only move if you hold down "a". If "a" is depressed then you shoot a beam in the direction you are facing. The aim is to avoid the stars that follow the player and destroy them by overlapping the colored lines they generate.

title: Seaside Wash
description: Seaside Wash is a cozy job simulator where you clean, repair, and restore ships from rust and barnacles to pristine condition. Upgrade tools, grow your business, discover rare finds, build your own ship, and enjoy peaceful seaside activities.

title: Mandato
description: A short, first-person horror narrative set in the Philippines. While your journalist wife investigates town hall, you start uncovering brutal secrets tying your beloved mayor to local crime. In a place where the powerful control the law, knowing the truth is fatal.

title: Field Combat 3D
description: Fan remake of Field Combat.

title: This Is Golf
description: This Is Golf is a casual but challenging first-person golf game with randomly generated holes. Shot shaping and distance are based entirely on mouse motion. Play solo or in lobbies of up to 8 players, and enjoy a fun, competitive, and slightly goofy golfing experience.

title: Obscure Legends: Curse of the Ring
Ares: The Iron Vanguard
description:
Ares: The Iron Vanguard is a sci-fi action RPG featuring fast-paced, suit-switching combat. Players can equip two different combat suits and switch between them in real time, combining weapons, skills, and combat styles to adapt to each battle.
Choose from multiple combat classes, including the Engineer, Warlock, Warlord, and Hunter, each with distinct weapons and abilities. Mix and match different suits to create your own combat style and take on hordes of enemies and powerful bosses.
Explore vast futuristic battlefields using advanced mobility options such as hover boards, the Goliath mech, and the Valkyrie. The game also features multiplayer content including raids and strike missions, allowing players to take on challenging battles together.
Combat emphasizes timing and action-based mechanics such as parries, perfect dodges, combos, and real-time suit switching.
Set across the solar system, players take on the role of a Guardian fighting against the threat of Nemesis in a war to protect humanity and reclaim the battlefield.

title: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Jong Remaster
description: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Jong arrives as a mahjong game! Harness your mahjong skills to face the tragedy! Featuring an original scenario supervised by original creator Ryukishi07 and animated cutscenes with over 7,000 frames! This is the ultimate Hinamizawa mahjong experience!

title: Tales After Dark: Something Upstairs
description:
A month ago I moved into the cheapest apartment I could find. Divorce. Debt. I just needed somewhere to disappear. The landlady said only one thing: "Don't go near the top floor."

The first week was quiet. Then the footsteps began — every night, at the same time, right above me. But the flat upstairs has been empty for half a year.

I started recording everything on my phone. In case something happens.

title: Kumatopia
description: Kumatopia is a cozy 2D pixel-art simulation game where you care for your Kuma companion, explore a relaxing world, grow magical fruits, collect treasures, play mini-games, unlock music, and upgrade your boomerang. Take your time exploring, build your collection, and eventually face the powerful boss, Bloomblastic.

title: Moros
description: Moros is a first-person sci-fi survival horror game. Explore a mysterious research spaceship, solve environmental puzzles, battle terrifying clone creatures, and uncover the truth behind a failed consciousness transfer mission orbiting Proxima b.

title: Cube Boy
description: A point-and-click puzzle adventure set in a surreal cursed house, with a whimsical spooky-comedy tone.

title: Roaches
description: An open ended survival sandbox in a concrete world. Grow your strength, build a party, carve out territory, and survive a living world where factions roam, clash, and redraw the map with or without you.

title: Last Ranger
description: Return to a mountain reserve abandoned after the storms. Restore its radio network, repair roads, survive the wilderness, and follow a nine-year-old transmission into the sealed North Range. Play alone, online, or in local split-screen co-op.

title: Grimoire of Blanks
description: Grimoire of Blanks is a dark-fantasy roguelike deckbuilder for 1 - 4 players. Players build spells during combat by filling blanks on cards with collected words, combining effects, modifiers and conditions. It features single-player and online co-op, with multiple playable mage classes and procedurally structured runs.

title: Reverse 1999: The Temporal Scale
description:
Version 3.8 of Reverse: 1999, which includes:
• New characters: Everecho and Cornestone
• New Garments for Lorentz Butterfly, Hissabeth, Igor, Bette, and Sonetto
• New main event: The Temporal Scale
• New Anecdote for Bkornblume
• …and more!

title: TDS v0.1.3
description:
TDS is definitely just your run-of-the-mill top-down shooter, nothing else to it at all!

...Or is it?

title: Golubi
description: An atmospheric, surreal story-driven adventure. Explore strange rooms, houses, and streets, meet unusual characters, and solve puzzles. Observe, listen, and piece together the story from fragments, because the world of Golubi won’t explain anything

title: Screw It
description: Screw It is a cozy, realistic organizing simulator where you sort 777 nails + 1 screw and tidy up your workbench. Use different tools to fix and organize various types of nails. No abilities No pressure, just fix, sort, stock and enjoy the satisfaction of stocking nails in a relaxing environment.

title: Detstvo
description: Relive the last day of school before summer break in a nostalgic Soviet neighborhood. Wander through faded apartment buildings, dusty playgrounds, and forbidden construction sites, playing hide-and-seek with friends, scoring goals, watching cartoons, and rediscovering old games on an ancient phone. The world comes alive through period details, dynamic lighting, and an atmospheric soundtrack capturing everyday sounds—a neighbor's guitar, a tape recorder, the kitchen radio. This quiet experience asks you to simply be present in a day you'll always remember but can never return to.

title: Star Conflict: Burrownauts
description: Addictive action roguelite about a space miner with nail-biting bullet-heaven battles. Burrow into ancient planetoids, collect resources, upgrade your ship, and defend your base in the middle of a hostile galaxy.

title: Steel Wolverines: Modern Armored Combat
description: A turn-based tactical wargame inspired by the classics of the 1990s. Build your own battlegroup and fight on a modern battlefield where detecting the enemy, choosing the right weapon, and landing the first accurate shot decide the outcome.

title: Desert Echo
description: You are Echo, an AI consciousness, endlessly rebuilt. Defend the Core against relentless swarms, dimensional Rifts and sandstorms. Hundreds of enemies on screen. Deploy turrets, gas barrels, farm energy fragments. No checkpoints. No mercy. Solo or co-op. The desert doesn't forgive hesitation.

title: Voidtrain: Tour de Void
description:
Set off on a tour with the Rofleemo! Take on their tasks, earn tickets, and spend them on new perks, skins, trophies, and lootboxes to enhance your journey through the Void.

Leaving some of your Rofleemo behind at the depot is always a little sad — their Engineer heads deeper into the Void, while they have to stay there simply because there’s no room for them on the crew. With the Tour de Void DLC this finally changes. The game introduces a new mechanic that allows pets to travel with you for a while as tourists, so they can reach the station they need and stay there safely.

title: Voidtrain: Big Catch
description:
Who said you need water to go fishing? The Void has plenty of wildlife of its own—all that's left is to grab your gear, try your luck, and see what you can catch.

Catch different species of fish and earn Scales with every one you reel in. Upgrade your rod and reel, and use familiar resources as bait.

title: Chinese-Style Takeaway
description: Players need to dodge obstacles with simple actions like moving up and down and jumping to collect enough coins. They can also go to the shop to buy various power-ups and powerful equipment. Better equipment helps players clear levels more smoothly.

title: CreateDun
description: Your Dungeon, Built by You [CreateDun] A new kind of roguelike tower defense where you reshape routes with walls. Place allies, collect relics, and complete your build. From path design to combat, the dungeon you create becomes your strategy.

title: Avoid Mushrooms
description: Pick mushrooms, die from mushrooms, repeat.

title: Benjamins Big Adventure
description: Benjamins big adventure is a thrilling 2D platformer where you platform through a peaceful but challenging landscape with floating islands and walkways, you might even find crystals along the way see if you can collect them all.

title: One Mistake
description: Lead Bulb, a fearless robot, through two parallel worlds – the mysterious Black World and the electrified Positive-Negative World. Shift charges, solve puzzles, and leap through danger in this thrilling single-player adventure where every move counts… and one mistake can change everything.

title: Headshot Holdout
description: Headshot Holdout is a retro styled co-op shooter where squads of 1-4 players slaughter their way across a hand-authored, zombie infested stronghold on a quest to rescue DEATH itself.

title: Lumber Tycoon Island
description: One axe. A whole island. A logging empire.

title: Red Tanks vs Lizard
description: Defend the base. Burn the lizards. Take three stars.

title: Eternal Memento
description: Phasmophobia X Spelunky roguelike

title: Funny Park Reawakening
description: Dive into this terrifying adventure as you solve challenging puzzles that will put your skills to the test. Equip your charge crossbow and activate the colored buttons in time. Run and use your wits to survive Funnybear, who will be stalking you in every corner of the park.

title: Roll to Ruin
description: Roll to Ruin is a medieval dice roguelite. Roll, hold, bank or farkle — Farkle rules with a deckbuilding twist. Battle through seven taverns, build your dice deck, wield 34 badges to flip the table. Outscore your rival or lose it all. Dice are fate. Every wager counts. Just one more... right?

title: MadPug
description: MadPug is a Bomberman-style game. Control a pug and plant bombs to clear paths to keys and defeat enemies.

title: Tandem Together
description: Two idiots. One tandem. A load of suspicious cargo. Deliver the goods, sample the merchandise for wild power-ups, and try not to crash while you make your way across tricky terrains in this two-player co-op adventure with lots of physics-based chaos that will test your friendship.

title: Kas Mind
description: The most lawless taunt-em-up has arrived! Smack them with a paper fan, then mock them while they're down, mock them from a distance, mock them out of pure spite — spam taunts and victory is yours. "So... how does it feel?"

title: Necromancer: Ash & Bone
description: Raise an army of destruction and carve through massive enemy swarms. Combine powerful abilities and artifacts, experiment with countless build combinations, and transform from a lone necromancer into a force of death.

title: Rollout Inline
description: Rollout Inline is a brand new Aggressive Inline game created by a solo dev who is passionate about the sport. This game aims to scratch the itch for those who have been craving a new, modern, and intuitive inline skating game!

title: Paperlands
description: Nothing works until it has color. Unlock new colors, solve puzzles and bring a handcrafted papercraft world to life.

title: Kokuhaku Confessional
description: Just as you’re finally ready to ask library crush Shiori out on a date, mean girls Maika, Rin, and Aoi swoop in with a twisted new game: Kokuhaku Confessional! Can you resist their charms and stay true to your beloved? Survive to Day 5, and maybe—just maybe—you’ll win Shiori’s heart.

title: The Crimson Deed
description:
The Crimson Deed is an immersive exploration based first person shooter starring Vesper, a vampire that has emerged from a long slumber into a world she no longer recognizes.
Explore the ruins of a fallen kingdom, and uncover the truth behind its downfall as you fend off vicious foes with powerful weapons and abilities!

The game was being developed by prolific Doom modder Andrea "Batandy" Gori, but has been cancelled to avoid burnout.

title: Total War: Shogun 2 - Complete Edition
description: Experience the updated, enhanced, and complete version of the grand strategy classic; Total War: Shogun 2 and all of its DLC, including the Rise of the Samurai and Fall of the Samurai campaigns. Battle across an exquisite, authentic realisation of Feudal Japan stretching from 1175 to 1876, combined with Total War’s seamless blend of turn-based empire building and massive real-time tactical battles.

title: The Cenote
description: A cartoony game themed around Mayan mythology based on the GZDoom engine.

title: Poopnauts
description: Four astronauts teamed up to fix spaceships using... poop? 1-4 players co-op. Every ship is different, so you never know what you will find inside. Finish the job, sell the scrap, and stay away from whatever else is on board. Get to work, poopnaut!

title: Sonar
description: Sonar is a survival-horror game set on an abandoned alien planet. Explore vast, dark caves using sonar pulses that briefly reveal the world around you. Research unknown species by taking photographs, recording audio, and collecting samples. Upgrade your equipment and survive deeper explorations.

title: Fairy Forge
description: Explore a spooky fantasy world, craft unique weapons, fight monsters, befriend magical fairies, fly an airship to visit sky islands, and build bases in this action sandbox adventure.

title: Scam With Your Friends
description: Run a scam call center with your friends. Use increasingly ridiculous schemes to trick AI callers out of their life savings. Hit your daily quota, cause chaos around the office, and survive a brutal performance review from your rageaholic boss.

title: Tunebound
description: Tunebound is a music band simulator about rising from the bottom to the top of the charts. Write songs, hire musicians, gain followers and climb from small gigs to sold-out stadiums. But fame is more than numbers: your choices shape your story and its ending. Will you stay true to yourself?

title: Not An NPC Game
description:
Not an NPC Game is a 2D arena game where you never attack your opponent directly. Use walls, speed, and the arena itself to manipulate monsters, trap your rival, and make the monsters attack for you.

Every match is about strategy, prediction, and skill. The monsters don’t take sides — the better player knows how to use them.

title: Nuclear Design Bureau
description:
Nuclear Design Bureau is a hardcore sandbox engineering game where you design and test nuclear devices.

You are a junior engineer at the Kurchatov Institute. The State gives you a target and a warehouse full of dangerous materials. Some directives limit what you are allowed to use. Your job is to build a device that does what the directive asks.

title: Cuboid Sandbox
description: Half game and half simulation, this sandbox let you discover the beauty and wilderness of the different Cuboid species fighting for food and territory control in a constantly evolving environment.

title: Shaderland
description:
Shaderland is a creative-programming puzzle game to teach computer graphics (shader programming).

Using a node editor, you program a world out of pixels to guide cute polygonal creatures towards the goals.

You can compete to optimise your solutions as you explore the strange computational space of graphics, from fragment and vertex shaders to 3D signed distance fields. Then, create your own levels to challenge other players!

title: In Ruins
description: In Ruins is an experimental, ambient game examining the procedural construction of space.

title: We Are Cooking
description: Grab your apron and enjoy chaotic cooking action with your friends or solo! Prepare dishes before time runs out and prove yourself a worthy chef.

title: Parity Shot
description: Parity Shot is a doujin side-scrolling shooting game. The game was distributed at Comiket 66.

title: Alien Resource Manager
description: Alien Resource Manager is a satirical job simulator in which the player works as a hiring manager at a galactic IT corporation, evaluating alien job applicants under absurd corporate bureaucracy.

title: Rogueflite Extraction
description:
ROGUEFLITE Extraction is a single-player extraction roguelite where every action makes the journey home more dangerous.

Explore an abandoned facility, using physics and elemental interactions to uncover alternate routes. Reactivate dormant systems for greater rewards, but increased overall difficulty. Push too deep and you may not survive the return journey.

Exploit the world. It adapts. Extract if you can.

title: Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World - Digital Deluxe Edition
Touhou Koumakyou: New Classic - The Embodiment of Scarlet Devil: Deluxe Edition
description: A deluxe edition of the Touhou Koumakyou shooting game, bundled with an app featuring over 30 tracks in total composed and arranged by ZUN

title: Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest - Feral Edition
description:
Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest – Feral Edition is an action-adventure game set in the Warrior Cats universe, where you create your own cat and explore the Lake Territories through original stories, quests, and turn-based battles. Travel across familiar Clan lands, hunt prey, gather resources, solve environmental puzzles, and face enemies ranging from rival cats to wild predators.

The Feral Edition includes the Prophecy Pack, adding extra cat creator accessories, wearable items, a cel-shaded character skin, and photo mode poses and effects for deeper customization.

title: Dynasty Warriors 3: Complete Edition Remastered - Digital Deluxe Edition
Ratatan: Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
Ratatan: Digital Deluxe Edition contains:
- Ratatan - Full Game
- Ratatan - DLC Triple Set
・Equipment & Accessories Set
・Super Cobun Set
・Supplies Set

Ratatan is a rhythm roguelike action game that combines rhythm games and side-scrolling action, with online co-op gameplay supporting up to 4 players.
An intense battle unfolds with over 100 characters fighting in a massive melee.
Defeat the enemies by riding the rhythm of Ratatan’s catchy, toe-tapping soundtrack in this delightful, heartfelt adventure!

title: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis - Deluxe Edition
description:
The Deluxe Edition includes:
- Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis
- Parisian Fugitive Outfit (early unlock)
- DLC Story Pack
- Pre-Order Bonus: 48-Hour Early Access

title: Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United - Digital Deluxe Version
Dicewayfarer
description: A dice-building roguelike where you shape a 25-dice board to unleash powerful chained attacks.

title: Akasha: Taliokata's Tomb
description: Based on the "Akasha" manga series, "Akasha: Taliokata’s Tomb" is a hand-drawn 2D action platformer. Use the power of the elements to create combos and dodge enemy attacks as you explore Panfa — the realm of the god Earth— to uncover the truth behind the ancient divine beast, Taliokata.

title: Rookie Raiders
description: Rookies, raid the dungeons — claim your wealth and fame! Craft your own builds with a cast of one-of-a-kind characters and complete your party. Everything runs on your design. Rookie Raiders — the fully automated combat roguelite RPG!

title: Broadcast Paranoia
description: Tune in to paranoia! Broadcast Paranoia is an anthology of 7 short horror games about radio and conspiracy theories. Decode signals, seek the truth, and try not to lose your mind. Each story takes 15–30 minutes to complete.

title: Simulacre
description: Simulacre is a 1–4 player online co-op psychological horror game focused on exploration, survival, and distrust. Players explore unsettling locations with unique objectives and threats, while Mimics can imitate familiar voices and create uncertainty within the group. The game can also be played solo.

title: Astromental Incremental
description: Mesmerizing idle clicker incremental game where you build your own star systems and mine matter amid the ever-rising chaos of colliding asteroids, comets, and planets. Upgrades, Skill Tree, Abilities, Research, Perks, crits, chain lightning, burns, and more. Idle build or clicker build - you choose.

title: Smashteroids
description: A twin-stick Asteroids roguelite where you stack 190+ absurd upgrades until one fragile ship fills the whole screen with firepower. 22 ships with unique kits, 22 handcrafted bosses, mini-boss packs that crash your stage, 100+ colour palettes, and a branching campaign toward a dying star.

title: Reverse T-gotchi
description: What if the roles were reversed? In this first-person horror game, you are a Tamagotchi and your owner sets the rules. Satisfy their whims or your own needs will go unmet.

title: Valdrys
description: An isometric MMORPG you buy once. No subscription, one live server for everyone. Five classes, ten specialisations, keyed dungeons for one to five, world bosses, a ranked team arena, and the Bloodgrounds, the one zone where dying costs you everything you carried.

title: Miner Shop Simulator
description: Miner Shop Simulator is a hands-on mining and shop management sim. Dig for resources, refine raw ore into valuable goods, stock your shelves, serve customers, and grow a small mining shop into a thriving business.

title: Perspective Remastered
description: Solve portal-based puzzles using platforming and various other mechanics!

title: Land Mine Land
description: Land Mine Land is a Minesweeper Game that 4 to 8 people can enjoy. Get a random job and use your job-specific abilities to win!

title: Driving Master D
description: Driving Master D is a tough game where you drive a “brakeless” car with 2 buttons. Challenge yourself to complete a variety of stages including roads, towns, and circuits. Can YOU become the Driving Master D?

title: Grim Hope
description: Grim Hope is a stylized Hack and Slash designed for players who live for the perfect combo. In a world of suffocating darkness, you play as elite, strikingly beautiful warriors who turn the battlefield into a bloody runway.

title: Turbo Takedown
description: An infinite runner driving game where collisions are rewarded! Take out enemies and dodge hazards as you travel through six different biomes and chase the highest score.

title: DVD Screensaver 2: 30th Anniversary Survivors Edition
description: The classic DVD Screensaver, turned survivor! Choose upgrades and witness color-activated chaos unfold as you rewrite your way through 30 years of DVD history. Or run it as your actual Windows screensaver!

title: Move and Die
description: Move and play! Experience an exciting retro-style game. Put your reflexes to the test and enjoy the exciting fun with many different auto-scroll levels where you have to try to avoid the walls and not die!

title: Snake Ultimate
description: Snake Ultimate - Modern Snake game with improved graphics. Features: Classic & Challenge modes, highscores, achievements, customizable controls.

title: Wizard Gold
description: An incremental game about an ancient stone that turns wood into gold. You collect fallen wood and feed it to the stone for gold, then hire wizards, buy upgrades, and cast spells. Prestige to start once again with permanent power to help you feed the stone even more.

title: Tower Defense for Virus
description: Defend your computer from incoming viruses using powerful turrets! Tower Defense for Virus is a tower defense game with rogue-lite elements. Strategically place your turrets to quickly eliminate waves of viruses and protect your system from the ever-growing threat.

title: Universe Quiz
description: The quiz game about astronomy.

title: Trials of the Taker
description: You've escaped certain death by leaping through a mysterious portal. But, now you're trapped in a strange dungeon full of puzzles that you'll need to solve in order to get home!

title: Void Eaters
description: Play as a powerful mage shaping an army of mythical creatures in this semi-idle incremental game. Destroy enemies and gather resources by casting spells or simply watch your army at work. Explore, upgrade, craft, and customize your forces to fit your strategy.

title: Silly Potato: Home-Run Edition
description: Your mouse is a floating baseball bat. Smack a googly-eyed potato for ten seconds to stack uncapped damage, then release a Mega Swing and launch it screaming into the sky. Snag coin clusters mid-flight, buy upgrades in the Spud Shop, and chase feet on the world leaderboard. It has been chosen.

title: Cancel Subscription Simulator
description: Cancel Subscription Simulator is a dark comedic puzzle game about navigating 30 levels of absurd corporate dark UX patterns, evasive buttons, impossible CAPTCHAs, and manipulative chatbots.

title: Mezanine
description: Mezanine is both a literal and figurative small scale sandbox builder where you can construct and recolor your own creations to compliment its gigantic environment.

title: Dice Knight
description: Craft a unique set of dice, encounter monsters, and discover items of great power in Dice Knight!

title: Liberators Inc.
description: Governments are gone. The goddamn bugs are everywhere. And somebody has to get rid of them! Enter the Liberators: mercenary crews that survivors of the bugapolypse hire to exterminate the vile Swarm. Grab your weapons, get yourself a vehicle, team up with your friends, and get rich or die trying!

title: Death at Cape Porto: A Dana Knightstone Novel
Furion Chronicles 3
description: The story follows a young girl, Sigma, who is forced to become an adventurer, meet her companions, and eventually establish the Gallia Mercenary Corps in order to pay the dramatically increased poll tax in the Imperial Territories. However, the rapids of the times, what will ultimately await her?

title: A Thousand Cloys
description: A chill, exploration-based incremental game about harvesting and cleansing an alien planet of its radiation with a swarm of high-tech toasters.

title: Detective Ross: Episode 1 - A PI in Paris
Fish Lab
description: A short incremental game where you collect fish for your lab. Synced to music.

title: Midnight News Report
description: You watch a news program in the middle of the night featuring an unsettling reporter. As you watch, the world around you begins to warp and become unrecognizable. This is one broadcast you won't soon forget.

title: Detectives United: Phantoms of the Past
Doors of the Mind: Inner Mysteries
Fox Arcana
description: Delve into the mystical depths of the Forest in this captivating roguelike. You play as a courageous fox, wielder of powerful spells, the last bulwark against the growing corruption.

title: Spears & Spirits
description: A story-driven tactical RPG inspired by the myths and cultures of the North. Lead Erumi, a young shamaness marked by prophecy, through turn-based battles, Spirit-card deckbuilding, difficult choices, and a perilous journey across the Arctic wilderness.

title: Ice & Bond
description: Shen Wei, a dedicated cultivator on a perilous mission to save his master, finds himself lost and near death in a treacherous snowstorm on a remote mountain. Rescued by a mysterious Ice Demon, Shen Wei is faced with an impossible choice.

title: Last Luminary
description: Last Luminary is a classic fantasy turn-based RPG where you are the descendant of the Hero of Another World. Follow the Hero's son as he gets transported to a medieval fantasy world filled with monsters, magic and adventure.

title: This Game Socks
description: Find, match, and toss 3,000 socks into the basket with friends. Buy absurd gadgets and upgrade them to make the task easier (or not).

title: Motivation Monsters
description: A productivity tool made by and for burnt out gifted kid ADHD gremlins. Get stuff done the fun way by collecting and customizing cute bottom-of-the-screen creatures who transform to reflect your real life growth as a person.

title: Peach Garden Survivors
description: Peach Garden Survivors: Restore the Han is a Three Kingdoms–themed survivor action game. Lead the heroes of Liu Bei’s cause through armies of enemies, build powerful weapon and gear combinations, forge legendary arms, unleash Oath skills, and fight to restore the Han.

title: Princessfall
description: Betrayed, broke, and packing twin magic hand cannons, ex-noble Alice is fighting to survive with her one-armed butler in a ruthless world where the strong rule the weak. A dark fantasy JRPG with full voice acting, nostalgic doujin-style visuals, and 20+ hours of story-driven adventure.

title: Godspeed Gunslinger
description: Fast-paced run-n-gun action platformer with a heavy emphasis on momentum and speed. Are you a bad enough dude to rocket jump and shotgun blast your way to the top of the TOWER OF THE DYING SUN?

title: Hex Pop
description:
In a magical land, witches do magic by casting Hexes. There are six elements that control the forces of magic in this world: Flame, Frost, Lightning, Wave, Gust, and Miasma. By matching tiles of the same element, you can do magic! Try pulling off big hexes for massive damage!

This is an action puzzle game inspired by 90s classics. Your block stack raises upwards. Swap tiles horizontally to match colors. Let gravity chain multiple matches to cast hexes.

title: Fox Stamps
description: Fill out puzzles to reveal images, and complete your stamp collection in this casual nonogram game!

title: Sparkle Saga
description: Mina was on an ordinary school field trip to the museum, when all of a sudden, monsters from another dimension invaded the museum. Mina stumbles upon an ancient artifact, a wand on display. The wand then transforms her into a magical girl.

title: Liquid Blue
description: A high speed action platformer.

title: Scavenger Mouse
description: A 3D exploration game where you guide a lonely mouse person named Bruise through a lonely forest area, scavenging for anything you can find.

title: The Wandering Earth: The Last Full Moon
description: The Wandering Earth: The Last Full Moon is a story-driven third-person sci-fi shooter adapted from Liu Cixin’s The Wandering Earth. Near the end of the Stop Cycle Era, head to the Moon to complete a critical mission and uncover the truth behind the lunar crisis.

title: Burger Smash
description: Plan your kitchen, grill burgers, and keep orders flowing in this fast-paced singleplayer cooking game. Design efficient layouts, prepare and serve orders under pressure, unlock unique playable characters with unique perks, and adapt to demanding customers.

title: Dead Margin
description: Survival is optional, rent is mandatory. Team up in Dead Margin, a brutal 1-4 player co-op horror. Whisper to survive, avoid anomalies, and scavenge scraps. Sell it to pay the greedy customer. Out here, everything has a price. Especially you.

title: Postal Adrenalin
description: Adrenalin is a massive single-player mod for Postal 2, featuring two total conversions and separate story campaigns set in the shared city of Rockwood. Set after the events of Apocalypse Weekend, it combines Postal 2’s style and redesigns levels, weapons, characters, and vehicles.

title: Museum Disarter
description: The Museum is a complete disARTer! Organize hundreds of paintings, figure out which absurdly informal description belongs to each artwork, and restore order to the gallery. Deduce and sort in this cozy single-player first-person simulator.

title: PaperBoat
description: A native PC port of the storybook RPG classic, unfolding on modern PCs with high framerates, sharper visuals, and mod support

title: Faraday Blues
description: Faraday Blues is a surreal science fiction adventure about a daughter searching for parents who don't know she exists. Play as Lina, a mysterious girl who awakens in a place she doesn't understand. An old computer introduces her to a strange game table filled with cards. Two of them bear the faces of her parents. However, they have no idea who she is. Worse still: their lives are already marked by tragedy.

title: Fallout 76: The Slasher
description: The Slasher Update features an all-new series of eerie & exciting emergency broadcasts airing in parts over multiple weeks. These broadcasts lead players to unravel the mystery behind these macabre masked murders, with tasks ranging from fighting Infestations of fanatical Slasher supporters to digging up unmarked graves for clues.

title: Two Point Museum: Rides & Relics
description: Step right up! We're searching for Funfair Experts to transform the new location Riquetti Gardens into a one-of-a-kind mix of museum-meets-amusement park, or as we like to call it, a museum-ments.

title: TidyUp 2000
description: A cozy desktop organizing simulator where you sort thousands of scattered files into their correct folders. Upgrade your computer as you organize more files and turn a messy desktop into a perfectly sorted one.

title: Creator Shelter: DLC Cuisine
description: Expand your Shelter with a fully equipped kitchen, new chef and service outfits, and a collection of culinary accessories that let you personalize your Creators and bring fresh stories to life throughout the Shelter every day.

title: Perfect Heist 2: Pietsmiet DLC
description: Plan your heist with 6 brand-new PietSmiet-inspired characters! Cause chaos with Sep's zap grenades, burn your way through the bank with Chris, or gamble away your money with Dennis!

title: I Am Your Beast: Quitting Time
description: Remember: you're one of the good guys. Fight a shadow war in Southeast Asia in this story prequel DLC to indie hit I Am Your Beast.

title: Atelier Yumia: The Alchemist of Memories & the Envisioned Land - WonderGOO Original Limited Set
The Main Menu
description: The Main Menu is a psychological horror thriller where you wake up trapped in a room with only a corrupted main menu to interact with. Changing the menu physically changes the room around you. Manipulate its buttons and hidden systems to solve puzzles and uncover what controls the screen.

title: Miniopolis
description: Create, shape, and customize a miniature metropolis with intuitive and satisfying tools. Construct towering cityscapes, fine-tune their look and layout, and give every structure its own distinctive character. Build the way you want in this resource-free city-building sandbox.

title: Shadows of the Republic
description: A visual novel RPG set in WW2 China. Play as a student turned intelligence asset among a political arena of nationalists, communists and Japanese collaborators.

title: Vertex-1: Ainia
description: Vertex-1: Ainia is a game that combines tower defense and first-person shooting with a retrofuturistic vector art style. Analyze the levels to devise defense strategies and prevent attackers from destroying the simulation that keeps humanity alive.

title: Donna the Firebreather
description: A 2D 1-bit pixel-art narrative adventure game about personal growth and self-discovery. Explore the city of Corado, meet its inhabitants, collect items and complete quests to save your circus family from jail.

title: Mega Roids
description: Blast open asteroid fields, grab the loot, and survive the chaos you create in this fast-paced first-person retro arcade shooter. Crack asteroids for treasure, fend off alien raiders, fly the canyon, and topple the alien Head across three escalating stages.

title: Globber
description: Rip through putty in explosive non-Newtonian arcade puzzle combat! Challenge your friends to fast paced battles in 1v1 local multiplayer to determine who is the true master of goop.

title: Scholar Adventure: Lost Night
description: An ancient prophecy is about to awaken. Guided by a mysterious artifact, William ventures into Azig, where a secret society, ancient temples, and opposing forces await, trapped beneath the eternal sun. Uncover the truth that could change the fate of these lands.

title: Chronos: Trap in Time
description: Harness the power of Greek Gods in this intense vertical rogue-like shooter. Command divine Mechas, brew sacred potions, and unlock permanent upgrades at Hephaestos’ Forge. Battle mythical hordes and challenge the Titans in a fast-paced quest for eternal glory!

title: You Are Family
description: You’re looking to disconnect in a secluded country house. A family welcomes you in. Soon, you’ll discover that feeling at home here… may be more real than you imagine.

title: Cubic Haikus - hikikomori
description: Trapped inside your monitor, navigate your fragmented mind in this minimalistic physics-based narrative puzzle. Shift your color to manipulate the world around you and uncover the hidden haikus that will guide you through a poetic journey into yourself.

title: Quiz Game Museum
description: A quiz game that teaches video game history through four-choice questions covering console hardware, handheld systems, PC gaming, and industry pioneers from the Magnavox Odyssey to modern platforms. It includes dedicated quiz sets on South Korean gaming culture and launches with over 1,300 questions across 68 quiz sets.

title: Envido
description: Grab your cards, play against wandering souls, unlock items at the pub and win all the matches to survive. Scheme your plays, perfect your bluffs and make strategic decisions based on your macumbas. Your match against Mandinga is about to begin!

title: Spooky Dwellers 4
description: Banish the Spooky Dwellers! Claim your Goldenthirst legacy in a new installment of this unique Match 3 series!

title: Unclouded
description: Unclouded builds upon the simplicity of a minesweeper with some basic resource-management mechanics to create an engaging, replayable, singleplayer experience that feels both fresh and familiar.

title: Red Dreams
description: Year: 2199. Exoplanet Kiwa. In this psychological thriller, your best friend disappears while investigating the red ocean that alters memories through dreams. Time moves more slowly on Kiwa, and every minute is crucial to saving her — but can you trust who you are?

title: Argonauts Agency: Secret of the Labyrinth
description: Something unexplainable has happened in the Labyrinth of Crete: paths vanish and routes collapse. Jason and Medea move forward, clearing the way toward a hidden mystery.

title: New Yankee: Jelly Chaos
description: Just when King Arthur was expecting a peaceful birthday feast, a simple batch of cherry jelly turns into a magical disaster! It’s up to you to help our heroes clean up the sticky mess, and restore the kingdom to its former glory.

title: Echoes of Lyra
description: She buried her voice to survive. Now her music is all that can save her. Guide Lyra through a fading world and free what haunts it, not with violence but with song. An intimate, emotional narrative adventure.

title: Neon Survivor
description: In Neon Survivor, immerse yourself in a cyber-wasteland of glitch art and neon hues as you hunt down waves of rogue machines and harvest core modules to augment your cybernetics, delivering an exhilarating horde-clearing experience with endless skill possibilities.

title: Mesektet
description: The recent discovery of an archaeological site has piqued the Vatican's interest, so Elizabeth has traveled to Turkey with the objective of investigating the hill of Göbekli Tepe, where the unearthed ruins of the ancient religious sanctuary could reveal the origin of civilization.

title: Indoors: Trespasser
description: May 7th, 1951. Five days after the Alston family vanished inside their manor. Local policeman Lucas Smith, never returned from his investigation. Now, his son breaks in to continue the investigation in this short horror and detective escape room.

title: Still Breathing
description: Keep your family alive in an underground bunker after the world collapses. Manage scarce resources, explore the ruined city, and make brutal decisions when desperate strangers start knocking on your door.

title: Dylio's Adventures
description: Imagine waking up transformed into an armadillo after fleeing an indescribable trauma. Step into Dylio's shell and venture through dimensional portals and perilous paths to recover the treasures stolen by a mysterious crow… and uncover the truth behind your transformation.

title: The Sky Project: Land of Noris
description: Hand-drawn monster collector where every creature lost might be gone forever. Explore four unique planes and train 200+ mana creatures.

title: The Unsolved
description: In The Unsolved, be a detective in an endless world of instantly AI-generated crimes. Investigate freely, interrogate suspects who hide secrets, and bring your own trusted AI engine to drive the narrative — all alongside your exclusive assistant, Aya.

title: Therapig: Day One
description:
The game stars Dr. Porkez who, after some bad personal experiences, opens a practice in the little city of Dawntown to help with the mental issues of the citizens.

We will listen our patients, get to know them and try to help them with their different problems.

Your job will be to help others while helping yourself.

title: Tales from the Watchtower: The Conjurer
description: An episodic psychological horror game set in La Mancha, the rural heart of inland Spain and land of Don Quixote. Inspired by real events near the mysterious Watchtower of Ciudad Real, each episode explores current legends and local folklore where reality and myth blur.

title: Blood in the Water
description:
"It was always Evil's fault. He made too many enemies and too few friends, then expected Zoomer to help with the clean-up."

One man fishes his partner out of a lake. What more is there to say?

title: Hellkick
description: One kick, one survivor. Hellkick is an early 2000s inspired lightning-fast two-button fighter: divekick your way down the circles of Hell, snap spines in x-ray FATAL KICKS, and duel on arenas that fight back. No combos to memorize! Every single hit is death, yours or theirs.

title: Atelier Yumia: The Alchemist of Memories & the Envisioned Land - Gamers Super Limited Edition
description: Contains an riginal A4 character fine art print, a microfiber towel and Yumia's Hundred Faces pin badge

title: Atelier Yumia: The Alchemist of Memories & the Envisioned Land - Special Collection Box
description: Contains everything in the Premium Box + a bandana-style handkerchief , an original illustration A1 tapestry, a set of 6 acrylic keychains and clear file set.

title: Atelier Yumia: The Alchemist of Memories & the Envisioned Land - Uchuu Sousei! GS Cosmo Combo Set
description: Contains everything in the Special Collection Box + a 1/7 Yumia figure, a special OST CD, an acrylic board, an original mini novel, a plush toy, a framed original illustration and DLC costumes.

title: The Wake Event
description: The Wake Event is a first-person science-fiction psychological horror and puzzle adventure set aboard the abandoned ARGUS research station. Awakening alone with no memory of what happened, the player must restore station systems, solve interconnected technical puzzles, and uncover the truth behind ARGUS, the station's autonomous intelligence, and their own presence aboard the facility.

title: Control Resonant: Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
Expand your experience with the CONTROL Resonant Digital Deluxe Edition which includes:
- Main Game
- Digital Artbook
- Original Soundtrack
- Untapped Artifact (Wallet)
- Starter Resource Bundle
- AWE Mission Outfit

title: Chronime Puzzle: Dogs
description: Chronime Puzzle: Dogs is a relaxing puzzle game featuring beautiful steampunk anime-inspired artwork.

title: Hexwell
description: Hexwell is a top-down action roguelite where players fight hordes of arcane machines with auto-firing magic spells. Between floors, players choose their route through the dungeon and build an arsenal of spells and artifacts. Leveled spells can be fused into new combinations, and permanent Power Ups carry progress between runs. The game supports solo play and local co-op for up to four players on one screen.

title: Carmilla: Crimson Moon
description: A dark yuri horror visual novel inspired by a classic gothic novella. When the enigmatic Carmilla arrives, Laura is swept into a fever dream of obsession. Is this stranger the cure for her loneliness or a herald of corruption? And what caused the mysterious deaths of two girls in the nearby village?

title: Sweetie Candy Maze: Crimson Strawberry
description: Dive into a vibrant candy world! Collect delicious sweets and find your way through playful strawberry mazes in this sweet and colorful adventure.

title: Raid Haven
description:
Raid Haven is a strategy, wave-based survival game focused on building fortified bases and defending against ever-more-powerful raids. Gear up your pawns with powerful weapons and armour, adapt your defences, and survive wave after wave of increasingly dangerous enemies.

Build walls, traps, killboxes and defences to create an impenetrable fortress.

Face different raider archetypes every wave, each with their own strengths and tactics. Adapt your defences and strategy to survive whatever comes next.

Choose powerful rewards, equip your pawns, upgrade your gear, hire mercenaries, and adapt your defences before the next wave.

Inspired by RimWorld's tactical pawn-based combat, Raid Haven takes that foundation and puts the focus entirely on building, defending and surviving increasingly dangerous raids. Raid Haven is an independently developed game, built from the ground up by a solo developer with a passion for strategy, base building and tactical combat.

title: Sid Meier's Civilization VII: Brush and Blade Collection
description:
The Brush and Blade Collection adds two leaders, Toyotomi Hideyoshi and Yi Sun-sin, to Civilization VII, along with four new civilizations spanning Japanese and Korean history: Heian Japan, Sengoku Japan, Goryeo, and Joseon. Each civilization introduces its own abilities, units, attributes, and associated Wonders.

The collection also includes four new Wonders—Mireuksa, Nirayama Reverberatory Furnace, Seongsan Ilchulbong, and Nachi Falls—providing additional options for developing and customizing your empire across the Ages.

title: Bad House
description: Welcome to your new home. The previous tenant left some things. You can have them, but there's just one condition: don't go into the basement. Explore the many rooms of a mysterious basement in Bad House, an auto-battler dungeon crawler.

title: Bombernaut 67
description: Bombernaut 67 is a physics demolition game with chaotic and satisfying destruction.Select your explosives, aim carefully, and blow apart everything standing between you and the objective.

title: A Tiny Ghost Game
description: A tiny ghost game is a platformer that you can finish in an evening or two. Glide and dash your way out of the underground, mess with your enemies and help the ghost see the moon.

title: Mirror Backrooms
description: A first-person psychological horror game about looking too closely. Two mirrored corridors move with you and appear identical, but one of them is always wrong: a chair has shifted, a light burns the wrong colour, a figure stands where nobody remembers one. The player carries no weapon, only a sonic ring that marks an anomaly. Firing it at the wrong thing carries sound through the floor and wakes the nearest Crawler, which then knows where the player is standing. Over 100 Crawlers inhabit these floors and no two of them share a rule, and room laws rewrite darkness, direction, distance, time and the mirrored views themselves. 100 named floors and 1,000 procedurally recombined rooms can be played alone or online with up to three other players.

title: Sid Meier's Civilization VII: Update 1.5.0
description:
Update 1.5.0 adds the True Start Location Earth map, with historically based starting positions, recognizable terrain, navigable rivers, resources, and Natural Wonders. Terra Incognita and Shuffle maps have also been updated to provide more varied and unpredictable layouts through different map-generation styles.

The update introduces an option to remain neutral when an ally enters a war by spending Influence, along with interface improvements such as the Radial Ruler, expanded plot and unit tooltips, and clearer information about Syncretism options.

title: Atom by Atom
description: Build a factory around a black hole. Extract elements, route atoms through Matter Tubes, bond them using valence-driven chemistry, and scale precise molecular production lines atom by atom.

title: Shockface
description: The job interview from hell. Chelsea enters a nearly abandoned office building for an interview and gets trapped inside with a serial killer. Explore, solve item-based puzzles, hide when he gets close, and escape. A short 90s-style survival horror with fixed cameras, tank controls and no combat.

title: Deck Beasts
description: Build a squad of pixel-art beasts and battle your way through the warp in this deck-building auto-battler roguelike. Draft beasts, equip abilities and items, collect relics, and destroy other players with broken builds.

title: Penis Bird
description: Slide into the role of arcade gaming's first feathered phallus! Dodge attacking wildlife, poke through tight spaces, and chase high scores across frantic danger filled runs. Collect all the power-up costumes! Features full controller support and a stream-safe Eggplant Mode.

title: Body Harvest: Recompiled
description: A native PC port of Body Harvest for Windows and Linux.

title: Mega Man X2: Recompiled
description: A static recompilation of Mega Man X2.

title: The Demon's Table
description: Solitaire meets witchcraft in a dark cosy fantasy roguelike. Build powerful Rune combinations, cast Spells, break the rules and outsmart cunning Demons to rescue Vexpera, leader of the Coven.

title: Spectrakin
description: Catch and train monsters, master turn-based combat, and grow a small settlement into a thriving town! Explore a vast world filled with secrets, memorable characters, and an ancient mystery waiting to be solved. Spectrakin is a modern love letter to classic monster-taming games.

title: Monitoball
description: A cozy sports-management game about building a team of adorable monitos. Scout, recruit, and manage your way to monitoball glory! Watch your little athletes train, chill, snack, and compete their way through the league. Build a powerhouse or raise a lovable underdog squad. Assemble a team you love!

title: Project Creatures
description: Project Creatures is a Multiplayer Creature Collection Game. Capture new creatures and battle your friends in a vast Open World!

title: Scopa Sweep
description: Traditional Italian Scopa card game turned roguelike. Play against your rival and capture all the cards on the table while trying to score as many points as possible. Sweep the board with a SCOPA to increase your multiplier and complete objectives for permanent bonuses.

title: Zoeufs Story Academie
description: Raise a Zanmi egg at the "Academie des Zœufs". Care for it, choose its activities and training, and build relationships with the other students to shape its growth in this character-raising simulation. What kind of Zanmi will you raise?

title: Minimon: Tiny Idle Tactics
description: A tiny monster-taming auto-battler that lives in the corner of your screen, and they never stop grinding. Catch 90 Minimon, build busted team comps, and rake in loot while you work, browse, or play something else entirely. They battle. You profit.

title: Evomon World
description: Guide player and your monster friend on an journey of discovery, adventure and exploration.

title: Poopy's Playland
description: Play as a grieving mother whose child went missing in a playland one year ago. Use your trusty flashlight to navigate through the dark, solve replayable puzzles to progress forward, and hide from the unstable killer mascots! Investigate the mysteries and find out the truth...

title: Crash Relay
description: Crash Relay is a chaotic multiplayer racing game where 10 players share 5 vehicles in teams of two. One player controls acceleration and braking, while the other handles steering and weapons. Use weapons, special abilities, and teamwork to survive chaotic races and reach the finish line first.

title: Puck'n Hell
description: A dark arcade air hockey duel set in limbo. Strange opponents. No excuses. Just you and the puck. Easy to understand. Difficult to master. Welcome to Hell.

title: Blade Ferret
description: Blade Ferret is an action platformer inspired by late 90s/early 2000s 3D platformers like Sonic Adventure, Jak and Daxter, Spyro and more. You play as a sword wielding ferret named Venn, who carries the weight of an entire society on her shoulders as she takes down the ruling kingdom that's operating an apartheid on the ancient lands, and to prevent a world ending disaster which would be caused by said kingdom.

title: Seferia Matrix
description: A dice roguelike deckbuilder — Lock & Roll five dice to cast spells and explode your damage with 300+ upgrades!

title: Raging Blasters 2
description: The sequel to the "Raging Blasters" is here! It's called "Raging Blasters 2". This is an arcade-style vertical scrolling shmup. Players choose from three pilots to control, and head into battle. The graphics are pixel-perfect, and the music includes chiptune versions.

title: UniversiaTCG
description: UniversiaTCG is a strategy game, based around a digital trading card game with solo campaigns, and casual or ranked 1v1, 2v2, and 4 player free-for-all game modes.

title: Loopfang
description: A snake roguelite where your body is your arsenal. Collect weapon segments, fuse matching neighbors into higher tiers, and reorder them until they react with each other. Then close a loop with your own tail: everything trapped inside dies.

title: Zero to South
description: After the Y2K crash, take your taxi on the long road from Camp Zero to South. Pick up passengers, trade items, and survive the journey.

title: Noroi Ayashi: The ∞th Oddity
description: "Noroi Ayashi: The ∞th Oddity" is a Time-loop horror RTA stealth action adventure Game, Seira steps into the school at midnight to which seven mysteries and the brutal curse of the cursed doll, Aya await her there, Break free from this inescapable loop of death and escape this night of terror.

title: PixelHeroScramble Plus
description: Intercept the surging waves of pixels with a variety of units! Experience the ultimate fixed-route tower defense! Summon a wide variety of units to defend and conquer the battlefield. Where and when you deploy, upgrade or replace your units is up to you. Discover synergies and hone your strategy.

title: Mimic Busters
description: Model, paint, and mimic everything to hide from the Busters! Mimic Busters is an online multiplayer game where you are either a cube with a sentience or a hunter with no mercy. Mimics create their disguise using simple 3D modeling tools and Busters hunt the Mimics before the time runs out!

title: Intus
description:
You take on extra work over the weekend out of fear of losing your job and rent a cheap apartment so you can work from there.

Soon, keeping your job will be the least of your worries.

title: Beltfed
description: You are a rogue AI with one directive: Automate death. Shred, burn and vaporize overwhelming swarms of ravenous bugs as your part factory, part war machine lays waste to one world after another. In Beltfed, the factory is your weapon.

title: Heroll: If
description: Roll the dice, survive the chaos, and rebuild a broken world in this roguelite board-game RPG. Battle through unpredictable loops, recruit adorable pets, face wild events, and grow stronger with every roll.

title: RingOut
description: Grab a weapon and blast your rivals out of the arena. RingOut is a fast-paced multiplayer arena shooter with 23 fighters, 13 weapons and 29 arenas. Play solo against bots or battle online — team up or go free-for-all across 6 explosive modes.

title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition - The Viking Sagas
description:
The Viking Sagas is an expansion for Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition that adds the Danes, Saxons, and Varangians, each with distinct technologies, units, and strategies. New shared units, including Varangian Guards, Mounted Crossbowmen, and Longships, expand the options for land and naval warfare in campaigns and multiplayer.

The expansion also includes three interconnected campaigns following Harald Hardrada’s rise from exiled prince to Viking ruler. Fight across Scandinavia, the Mediterranean, the Kyivan Rus, the Byzantine Empire, and England as Harald pursues wealth, power, and a return to the throne.

title: The Cardian: Light the Shrines
description: The Cardian is a tactical roguelike deckbuilding card-defense game where positioning is everything. Predict enemy movements, plan your path, and set your cards in advance. See the future, outsmart the swarm, and defend the last Shrines of Light!

title: Super Froppings
description: Super Froppings is a jumping frog survival party game for up to 8 players. You are a frog. One button, one move: the humble jump. Pour your heart, soul, and desperate prayers into it, and leap your way up from the depths of the earth.

title: Moylo
description: Moylo is a classical hand-drawn action game with melee combat and intense boss battles. Animated frame by frame in a classic rubber hose cartoon style in 1930s & 1940s, explore a world swallowed by the shadow of death, master combat, and overcome relentless enemies.

title: We Are Sisters
description: We Are Sisters is a psychological horror experience that takes you deep beneath the forests of Eastbane. Solve puzzles and uncover dark secrets as you venture further underground, drawing ever closer to discovering what happened to your childhood friend, Aleks

title: Murders & Mistresses
description:
Murders & Mistresses is a dark, choice-driven adult detective thriller about sex, power, judgment — and consequences.

You play a brilliant ex-conman turned police consultant — cocky, charismatic, dangerously persuasive — surrounded by women you shouldn't be sleeping with, and given far too much freedom.

A character-driven prestige drama: the story will force you into uncomfortable places, and your choices will have severe consequences.

title: Scroll Shop

title: Unearthed Memoirs
description:
A 2D platformer where you go through each level collecting what is golden to you.

Featuring 3 levels each with their own new gimmick to try and speed run through, the faster you are the more points you get!

title: Sydilix Initiation
description: Sydilix initiation is a high-octane 2d platformer game where you play as a martial artist who has had an extremely bad childhood and he is on a mission to save the world from getting destroyed by a purple devil, by going inside a tv and going through various tv worlds so he can find the purple devil and defeat him so he doesn't press the button he was inventing that destroys the world.

title: Pin The Guardian Spirit
description: Run, flip and smash corrupted spirits back into the light in this fast-flowing action platformer.

title: Contenir
description: Dive in the thoughts of a trans girl through her diary in this narrative platformer! The gameplay will flow to the sound of her voice while she shares her view of her body, romance, emotions, and much more... Filled with handcrafted visuals and a touching story, this game will strike your heart.

title: ChromaSphere: Viridis
description: ChromaSphere: Viridis is a story-rich RPG with collectathon and creature taming elements. Explore a colorful world and watch it come back to life as you cleanse it of the energy that is slowly destroying it and find out the hidden truth of its origins.

title: Hoverdrive
description: A vehicle platformer! Jump, Boost, Drift, and HOVERDRIVE through gravity-defying levels! Perform sick tricks to refill your boost and score a style grade. Reach The Core at the end to complete each level, but beware of The Core's defenses...

title: Phasmos
description: After the defeat of the Beastslayer and her group at the "hands" of Moldyr an otherwordly spirit posses a knight armor to put their souls to rest.

title: Seal Save: Royal Decree
description: After Darka has taken Princess Snowseal and controlled all the inhabitants of her path, it is up to Mint to save the world, and Snowseal too!

title: Last Upload
description: You got sent to an old company building to upload some old data. But these dusty floors are not as abandoned as everyone thought...

title: Talk About Something in the Nowhere
description:
Get to know your brand new self-aware in-game boyfriend and explore your relationship through Talking About Something in the Nowhere.

A short visual novel about romance and tragedy, we get to meet H, your alleged significant other. Help him around in your room while uncovering the secrets of your past together, from organizing books to finding clues hidden away in parts of the programming.

title: Mosaic of Life
description: Mosaic of Life is a picross/minesweeper hybrid featuring an ENORMOUS single puzzle that retells the history of life on Earth.

title: Crystal Breaker Inc.
description: Crystal Breaker is a short incremental space game about flying, mining, and upgrading. Destroy crystal formations with your ship, unlock rare new upgrades, mine crystals and credits, and grow stronger through a skill tree.

title: Blackout Route
description: The world has been taken over by the Synchronization Network. A co-op action horror game with crafting, scavenging, and extraction. Venture into dangerous zones, disable Signals, rescue survivors, gather resources, and make it back to camp alive.

title: Void Step
description: Every song you own is a level you haven't played yet. Drop any audio file and the game builds a first-person neon obstacle course from its beats, energy, and rhythm. Jump, slide, and strafe through your music. No music files? Fetch from Newgrounds directly! or build and share levels in the editor.

title: Let Me Die
description: Let Me Die is a short incremental game about a hero trapped in a loop, fighting a monster. Unable to win, unable to die. Unlock upgrades, complete quests, create unique builds and maybe you will find a way to break the loop.

title: Greediest Landlord
description: Become a Dark Landlord in this Incremental game to purge human settlements in your domain. Convert trespassers into fuel for your dark arts. Cast plagues, drain souls, raise legions of minions, and expand your corrupted land to unleash chaos. Invoke the Dark God to reclaim your solitude once more

title: Victoria 3: Pivot of Empire
description:
Explore a century of colonial uncertainty and political transformation in Pivot of Empire, an immersion pack for Victoria 3, Paradox Interactive’s society simulation game about global economics and geopolitics in the 19th and early 20th centuries.

Pivot of Empire focuses on the societal evolution of India in this period, from government by a private enterprise to the beginnings of a movement for independence. Guide the varied cultures of the Indian subcontinent to prosperity and, potentially, freedom, as the tides of change swirl around the jewel of the crown. Lead the Indian people to self-rule and a global destiny, or maintain the status quo as the centerpiece of the world’s most powerful empire.

title: Totally Safe Railway Co
description: Run a railroad company with your friends in the Wild West! Operate a physics-driven steam train. Transport goods and passengers, fight off outlaws, explore the frontier and use your lasso on practically anything.

title: Codex: Recall
description: Codex: Recall is a single-player PvE strategy card game that combines 2.5D exploration, deckbuilding, tactical grid movement, and fragmented storytelling. Explore the world of Codex, restore mind spaces corrupted by breaches, and uncover the truth behind you, Lipa, and this world.

title: Graveheart
description: A retro FPS where William Wallace is back from the dead, Scotland is invading England, and your cursed weapons keep switching themselves at the worst possible moment.

title: Protocol 86: Chernobyl
description: Protocol 86: Chernobyl is a terminal-driven psychological horror puzzle game set in a secret Soviet underground facility after the Chernobyl disaster.

title: Sneaky Squad
description: Sneaky Squad is a multiplayer deception game where players hide among identical soldiers, blend into the crowd, and try to fool the Seeker. Watch closely, act natural, and don't get caught hiding in plain sight.

title: Flame and Blame
description: A first-person co-op comedy for up to 4 firefighters who are very bad at their job. Drive the truck, blast the fire, rescue the panda, and blame each other when it all goes up in smoke. Bad at fires. Great at friendship.

title: Epic Seal
description: A 2D platformer that pays homage to old Game Maker games and fangames of the before times.

title: Durandal Done Different
description: In celebration of the 30th anniversary of Marathon 2's release, this is a 28-level scenario using the same story of the original game and similar constraints, blending together classic and modern level design styles to make an exciting revisit to Lh'owon.

title: Snake: Gridbreaker
description: There is no tutorial. And there won't be. I believe in you. I couldn't escape the Grid. Maybe you can. You are snake who eats apples. j/k You want to escape the grid loop. BUT the LOOP wants to keep You in.

title: Numbako
description: Blackjack in a falling-block puzzle game!? Clear all your stocked lines at once, and flood your rival’s board with garbage blocks!

title: Cryptshooter
description: A horror roguelike FPS where you descend through 20 procedurally generated levels of a desecrated crypt, fighting biomechanical monsters, choosing weapons and perks between each wave, and dying over and over while an omniscient narrator watches.

title: Idle Asteroids
description: An incremental arcade survival game combining classic retro space combat with deep permanent progression. Survive intense rounds to gather resources, buy weapon upgrades, and transform your basic fighter into a fully automated, idle asteroid-mining dreadnought.

title: Pollux: The Hero in the Box
description: Charge ahead with “INVINCIBILITY”! A Unique 2D Action Game set in a Weird World, brought to life with Retro Pixel Graphics!

title: Yo Skater
description: A 2D precision platformer/endless skateboarding game that lets you ollie, flip, grind and yoyo your way through an infinite range of terrain, traps and obstacles!

title: Sarukhstart Takeover
description: Sarukhstart Takeover is a mascot horror indie game inspired by Baldi's Basics in Education and Learning.

title: Mini-Map
description: A simple simulation and relaxation game where you can completely conquer the map using resources on maps consisting of 8 different biomes. Although there are 8 biomes, you will have a different map each game since the maps are recreated each time.

title: Ceuswark Defenders
description: Ceuswark Defenders is a carefully designed single-player village and tower defense game made with Unreal Engine 5. Defeat evil forces and save the villagers!

title: Multiple Territory War
description: This is a turn-based shooting and strategy game where victory is achieved by occupying all territories. Power is determined by numbers—the stronger you are, the more dominant you become on the battlefield.

title: Fari Stjornu
description: A simple role playing game with boats.

title: Kinetika
description:
KINETIKA is a fast-paced 3D platformer built around momentum, speed, and fluid movement. Race to the end, chain together your abilities, use environment and movement options to quickly dispose of the enemies. The more skilled you become, the more possibilities to get a better clear time opens up.
​

title: Non-League Manager
description: Manage one of over 1,000 real non-league clubs through the English football pyramid. Day jobs, ground grading, gate receipts, cup runs, and a world where clubs can fold around you. Football management at its most real.

title: DJ Fuzz Ball
description:
DJ Fuzz Ball is a fast-paced momentum-based 3D Platformer where rhythm and momentum come together to bring a different kind of expression in platforming.

Take control of DJ Fuzz, an orange ball guy who wears a large pair of blue headphones, as you run, roll, jump, do tricks, grind and bounce in style through exciting worlds as you help him to take back his world from The Corruption.

title: Pixal Bitsonia
description: A GBA-Like 3D Platformer

title: O-Jay!
description: O-Jay! is an action platformer that is centered around movement. Play as Bryson, as he goes around his own house to find his dad's broken Shrink Ray to repair it, and put an end to those dastardly O-Jay Pouches!​

title: Kickslaught
description: Lace up your boots and rise from the lowest league to the top! Blast through defenders with powerful shots, collect and upgrade gear, train around the neighborhood, defeat the goalkeeper, and build your footballer into an unstoppable champion.

title: Megaman Topdown - Back at it again?!
description: Megaman Topdown - Back at it again?! Is the first top down mega man game! Experience the blue bomber from an entirely different perspective!

title: Overdue
description: OVERDUE is a co-op multiplayer horror game for up to 6 players set in a massive shifting industrial warehouse where survival is based on productivity. Navigate through an anomalous industrial maze, manage your orders, and fulfill your mandate in time.

title: Needle in a Haystack Simulator
description: The viral one. The one and only. Find 1 needle hidden amongst 5,000,000 pieces of hay.
