title: Tidy Up the Town
description: What have you done to the market?! Practising your amateur sorcery in the town square might not have been the best idea… You should really tidy up the market stalls before everyone arrives for a hard day’s work!

title: No Truce With The Groceries
description: No Truce With The Groceries is a Disco-lite narrative point-and-click adventure set in the decaying hinterland of a declining America.

title: Drum Incremental
description: Drum Incremental is an incremental game built around real percussion rudiments. The player taps patterns on a practice pad using the left and right mouse buttons (with keyboard keys for flam and drag ornaments), earning Rhythm Points that unlock new rudiments and upgrades. The game features 40 rudiments from the PAS list across five progression phases, each gated by a boss exam judged by an on-screen teacher; a metronome with four speed tiers; a Study Companion that generates points passively, including while the game is closed; golden notes that fall during play; and a jam mode that recognizes the rudiments the player performs. The soundtrack is original and synchronized with the metronome tempo. Single-player, with full controller support and localization in ten languages. A free demo is planned for Steam Next Fest in October 2026, and the full game releases on Steam for Windows on November 2, 2026.

title: Too Many Clankers
description: Incremental tower defense game about one simple problem: too many clankers. Build an absurd amount of firepower and reduce the clankers to scrap.

title: Blendead
description: Find me. I'm right in front of you. A multiplayer blend-and-seek where you pose as an NPC in a crowd — one mistake and you're dead.

title: Siege of Akanor
description: Siege of Akanor is a third-person medieval tower defense game in which players prepare a castle's defenses, command troops, and fight directly on the battlefield. Between waves, players can deploy and upgrade defenses before joining the battle with melee and ranged weapons. The game features a single-player campaign, cooperative multiplayer, progression systems, multiple enemy types, siege weapons, and fantasy elements including dragons.

title: Petro Hunter
description: The Isle of Man TT reborn in the apocalypse. In this world, speed alone is not enough to survive. Become a Hunter, defeat the monstrous Petro, and use its blood as fuel to push beyond your limits!

title: Dashing Krew
description: After a tragic crash, dash across an unknown planet using your crew's wacky UFO abilities to find a way home.

title: Project Vanguard
description:
Project Vanguard is a fast neon bullet-hell roguelike built around endless waves, experimental ships, upgrade drafting, and boss survival.

Pick a chassis. Build your weapons. Break the screen. Survive the Void.

title: Ex-Master, Zombie
Neonsky
description: Take control of a fearless hero in a fast-paced 2D side-scrolling shooter with NES-inspired retro graphics! Fly through dangerous locations, battle epic bosses and hordes of enemies, and upgrade your arsenal of guns and rockets to survive intense action levels.

title: Hyper Sphere
description: Hyper Sphere is a high-octane roguelite bullet hell where you shoot, parry and dodge through waves of evil cubes. Combine a wide variety of wacky items to create broken builds, parry projectiles back at your enemies, and defeat the final boss.

title: Void Ward
description: A minimalist roguelite tower defense with neon aesthetics. Defend your planet against infinite waves of geometric enemies. Buy 70 upgrades, activate abilities, chain combos and grow stronger between runs with permanent upgrades. Every attempt makes you stronger.

title: Seconds Until You Die
description: Incremental survival game where you add seconds to your life by eating and drinking increasingly surreal foods, while trying to avoid getting burnt, crushed, dehydrated, distorted, destroyed, and many other things.

title: Die Diver
description: Here's an indie game idea... Build your Dice Pool and dive through the canopy of the 'Forest of the Dead' - the place where all who die will go.

title: Lunokhod
description: A simple retro sci-fi base builder with a socialist twist. Mine resources, build structures, prepare for crisis. Launch the Buran rocket, and usher in a new era of socialist production.

title: Vista Quest Pocket
description: The nearby island of Costa Vista has been taken over by the dark witch/sister of our favourite island hero! It's up to you to platform your way through 18 of the most wall-kicking-est levels to date to save the island.

title: Dread Line: Metro
description: A time sensitive horror collectathon where you avoid getting ripped to pieces by mutant monsters

title: Cryptwake
description: Cryptwake is a fast-paced first-person roguelike dungeon crawler. Fight through ever-changing floors, uncover strange secrets, wield powerful weapons, build devastating synergies, and survive the horrors that stalk the dungeon.

title: Anomaly Center
description: After a wave of layoffs following a murder at the mall, you step in as the night security guard. The job is simple: catch shoplifters and stop anomalies from reaching safe limits. Just remember - DAC has its eye on you.

title: Scratch It! Lucky Cards
description: Scratch tickets, uncover hidden rewards, and upgrade your abilities in this relaxing casual game. Discover unique themes, collect treasures, and build your luck one scratch at a time.

title: Trust the System
description: Trust the System is an intriguing incremental game where you mindlessly stamp papers to explore the System's restricted corridors. Upgrade your tools to better uncover what your job is really about...

title: Cursed Soulless Vagabonds
description: A dark fantasy rogue-incremental game. Steer your character through massive enemy hordes while your chosen build of floating swords fights for you autonomously.

title: Mandew vs the Upside Down Machine
description:
Mandew is back again for another adventure. The city of Salsa (homeland of one of Mandew's previous enemies) has been uprooted and it's up to Mandew to save the day.

Why does Mandew have to do it? Why not?

title: Burn Pixel Wood
description: Burn Pixel Wood is a retro-styled sidescroller game. The goal of the game is to burn all the wood in the towers with a flame thrower. The flame thrower uses unique physics where the gasoline flows through the flame which determines the power and reach of the flame. The player can turn the flame off to soak an area with gasoline and then set it all on fire. Orcs protect the towers and must be dealt with to move forward.

title: Blood Lily Cthulhu Mythos
description: A cultville horror dating sim. A girl from an occult club visits a remote village, where she encounters a local girl for whom she develops an indistinct attraction. But the giddiness cannot last long, as an ancient cult ritual threatens to draw them into its unspeakable abyss.

title: Peacemaker: The Die Is Cast
description: A dice-rolling puzzle RPG where you play the villain. You are the villainess, a reanimator who serves the Dark Lord. Roll your dice to perform checks such as Intelligence or Dexterity. Turn good people into zombie puppets and force them to slaughter their companions to make "peace" for you!

title: In These Hallowed Halls
description: In These Hallowed Halls is a first person, psychological horror puzzle game. Make your way through a decrepit, abandoned mental Institution as you solve puzzles and unravel the story behind what lurks in the darkest corners of the building.

title: Keeping You Close
description:
They were your closest friend.

They loved you, they really did.

They loved you to the point of hurting the people you cared about, to keep you for themselves.

So, you locked them in a rusted dog cage in your basement.

It was the only way.

title: Harvest Looper
description: Harvest plants, unlock upgrades, and expand your farming loop through skill trees, perks, and powerful harvesters. Collect fragments, complete Hidden Book sets, and optimize your incremental growth.

title: Trivasion
description: Survive against a swarm of geometric enemies and the bosses guarding your way forward in this fast, minimalist arcade survival game. Bounce, boost, and slide through the chaos, chain kills to build your multiplier, and chase the leaderboard. Simple to pick up, brutal to master.

title: Fill the Void
description: Start Small. Consume. Get huge. 'Fill The Void' is a physics-driven incremental 3D platforming collectathon where you play as a black hole.

title: Eden Camp
description: Arrive at Eden Camp as John, the newest counselor at a remote summer retreat. Three women welcome you warmly perhaps too warmly. As bonds deepen and nights grow darker, you'll learn that devotion has a price. Every choice matters. Not everyone makes it home.

title: Cat Music Chaos
description: Catch flow state on a 70 BPM timer. You don't need to read notes to play. You might learn by accident. Warning: prolonged exposure to classical music. Side effects include humming Ode to Joy at bus stops.

title: Chiasmus
description: Viktor finds himself in a mysterious apartment with no way out. He discovers an amazing ability to move between two parallel worlds. This discovery helps him piece together the scattered fragments of what is happening and find the key to solving the mystery.

title: Orbital Maintenance Technician
description: The stations in orbit need maintenance! A handful of specialized tools and zero gravity. Drift, dismantle, clean, restore. Just you, your tools, and a job well done. Suit up and get to work!

title: Olenveld
description: Olenveld is a DLC-sized new lands adventure mod for The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition. Journey to the forgotten island of Olenveld, a remote land north of Winterhold steeped in ancient history and haunted by the dead. Explore a vast new region, uncover a story-driven questline, battle powerful undead foes, make choices that shape the island's future, and reclaim its settlements through a unique island recapturing system.

title: Shelfbound
description: A storm has torn through, sending shelves and their contents flying across the room. In Shelfbound, it’s your job to clean up the mess, sort through scattered items, and put everything back where it belongs, one labeled shelf at a time.

title: Warframe: Iceblade of Narin
description: On the summit of a familiar peak on Earth—the place where you first learned to master your Void powers—a mysterious frozen monument has sprung up, sparking strange happenings aboard the Zariman and a new threat from the Man in the Wall.

title: Artificial Dawn
description: Defeat is not the end. After a game over, return to your base to strengthen with battle points and try again. Artificial Dawn is a shooting game designed to grow stronger the more you try, and anyone can clear it as long as they don't give up.

title: Hello Neighbor 2 Alpha 1
description: Alpha 1 of Hello Neighbor 2 is back! It is a Stealth Horror Game where you’re being stalked by a mysterious creature as you try to track down Mr. Peterson who has disappeared after the events of the first game. Play against an advanced, self-learning AI that adapts to your every move.

title: Cronus' Tomb: First Quest
description: Descend into Cronus' Tomb and revel in the spoils of being on the forefront of discovery. Explore a labyrinth of ancient chambers, fighting monsters from forgotten corners of Greek mythology, and maybe even uncover why no one has been there before.

title: Sneaky Fishy
description: Sneaky Fishy is a 2D puzzle platformer where the player is a fish with legs whose goal is to disable an oil rig that polluted its home.

title: Shibuya 88 StarBurner
description: Aliens are attacking Tokyo and kidnapping its citizens to transform them into mutants! Pilot the StarBurner to battle enemy waves, rescue helpless humans, and survive relentless alien attacks in this fast-paced arcade shooter.

title: Artesnaut
description: A hardcore medieval fantasy idle RPG, almost entirely in text. Build characters with races, jobs, and epithets. Over 1,000 items to loot. A story 93% of players rated "great." Combat and exploration are fully auto—just check your results. Now in Chapter 5, unfolding across five major updates.

title: The Horde of Gorak
description: Lead a growing orc horde in this pixel art incremental strategy game. Build your settlement, recruit powerful warriors, research new technologies, cast devastating spells, and destroy human castles to rescue your captured Warchief

title: Final Exit
description: Rescue your friend and escape the abandoned hospital alive. Navigate dark hallways, find hidden keys, and solve challenging puzzles to unlock doors and progress deeper into the facility.

title: Hot Land
description: Hot Land is a RPG that combines automoated production and tower defense.Freely build defense and production buildings within a limited map, develop their own industries.or contend with the major faction on the battlefield and make a fortune from the war.

title: Dark Shadows
description: Elena killed Jason to protect her friend but unleashed a terrifying curse. Now Dark Shadow is back for revenge. Survive, face your fears, and don’t scream—if you do, it all starts over!

title: Estellium Legends II
description: The gifted one must succeed no matter the cost. Survive against all threats, utilize a plethora of weapons and armor on over 100 characters in the Arena and fight your way to the end in this JRPG.

title: Bunny Bastion
description: A fast-paced roguelite defense game where you stop waves of enemies, choose powerful upgrades, and grow stronger in quick 10-minute runs.

title: The Dungeon Club
description: A fantasy card brawler where every accusation can spark a duel—and getting eliminated unlocks a second way to win. Return as a ghost, sabotage the living, and steal victory from the Underworld.

title: Warslave
description: An old-school sci-fi shooter in an exotic alien world. Compact, open world mini-Doom.

title: Mito's School in Basics
description: Just don't make any answers wrong, because Mito will find you after wrong answers with the Mathpad from notebooks

title: Stilltrace
description: Stilltrace is a bleak top-down survival horror about holding the last beacon in an infected sector. Scavenge for supplies, fortify your base, survive attacks, and decide whether to follow strange radio calls, tracks, and the stories left behind

title: Grim Siege
description: Grim Siege is a 1v1 dark-fantasy card duel. Raise your own tower or tear down your enemy's. Six classes and a deep status system turn every turn into a puzzle of combos and counterplay. Take on the AI or other players in quick matches and ranked battles.

title: Clone.Optimize.Sacrifice.
description: Build a city of science and magic, power up cloned heroes through automated dungeons, inherit their strength through cloning, and recycle the rest for science in this casual idle city-builder with deep RPG progression and competitive auto-battle leagues.

title: Trafficity
description: A city builder focused on traffic. Build out your city with gridless road tools. Fix traffic jams with roundabouts, fully-customizable traffic lights, or sprawling highway interchanges. Keep traffic flowing as you expand to a vast metropolis.

title: Tavern Farkle GB
description: Tavern Farkle GB is a push-your-luck dice game for the Game Boy. Roll six dice, bank your points or risk it all. Play a quick match against a random villager, or take on six opponents in a row, ending with Lucifer himself and his wild Devil's Die.

title: Bloom Control
description: Eradicate the Bloom in this high-energy active incremental. Hack into powerful security weaponry at infested target sites as the only AI fast enough to outpace the spread. Control and destroy the hostile growth before your transmission window closes.

title: Screenside Fisher
description: Sit back and relax with a desktop fishing game that stays in the corner of your screen. Catch fish, cook recipes, upgrade your gear, and complete your collection guide. Customize your character’s look and even design your very own custom fish to catch!

title: Stranded Rescue
description: Drive into the unknown, rescue the stranded, and outrun what's hunting you. Stranded Rescue is a roguelite horror driving game where you follow distress signals across a haunted desert, upgrade your car through strategic choices, and survive relentless monster chases.

title: Sword of the Demiurge
description: You have been bestowed the 'Sword of the Demiurge' and the authority to sever the bonds of soul and flesh. Make haste for your appointed time has arrived. Defeat your foes, collect their souls, and manifest your authority, until the myriads fall before you in a single moment.

title: Rescue Guardian Blaster
description: Rescue Guardian Blaster is a fast-paced, score-focused shoot 'em up! Destroy enemy ships by matching your ship's gun color to the enemy's to earn more points, all while tracking your score against the best players or your friends.

title: Sea of Stars: Sunset Edition
description:
The Sunset Edition will be the last content update for Sea of Stars. The main thing it brings to the game is a new cinematic intro, our highest budget one yet, which puts faces on heroes from the past known until now only by name. It tells the story of the tragedy they went through, and sets the stage for the adventure to come.

It's right at the start of the game, so even if you've already completed Sea of Stars, you can check it out simply by starting a new game!

title: Parasite Elevator
description: A space where parasites in human form lurk. You are trapped inside this bizarre and unsettling place. Count the number of parasites hidden throughout the corridor, then use the elevator to proceed to the correct floor. Choose the wrong floor, and the elevator will begin to consume you.

title: CatstaC
description: A puzzle game where the goal is to reunite two cats with symetric movement, in as few moves as possible, while you collect very green (and shiny) stars!

title: Island of Rebirth: NTR and Love
description: A mysterious island suddenly appears at sea. Rick, a protagonist suffering from amnesia, encounters two beautiful girls, Sienna and Mila. The three embark on a journey of exploration across the island.

title: World Orifice
description: World Orifice is a two-level PWAD for Doom II that was released in November 2017. It was designed by Benjogami and uses his own, unnamed music tracks. It consists of multiple, segmented layers full of a single type of monster for each. It contains exactly 20000 monsters. This slaughter map is included in two versions which have minor layout changes but notable differences in monster and equipment population.

title: Vibe Taxi
description: VibeTaxi is a top-down driving videogame heavily inspired by the saga Crazy Taxi. where you work as a taxi driver, with a slow car. The game's gimmick is music, once you pay attention to what the passenger has to say, you tune the right music on the radio and enter the Vibe Mode, where you drive faster and unlock drifting.

title: Mr Mageboy
description: A cozy incremental game about an aspiring mage trying to start a business selling resources. Upgrade your spells, explore biomes, and help your village!

title: Echoes in Darkness
description: Echoes in Darkness is a first-person psychological horror experience.

title: Bleach & Blood
description: Bleach & Blood is a retro slasher horror game about surviving the night shift at a small-town laundromat while a killer stalks the streets.

title: Onyx2d
description: A fast-paced, 2D Arena Shooter, based on the upcoming game 'Project Onyx'

title: Fat Chance
description: Escape the mansion before it claims you. A 1–5 player co-op horror.

title: Pale Incense
description: Pale Incense is a first-person gothic action-simulation where you run a perfume shop by day and hunt as a vampire by night. Harvest scents and human essence from your victims, evade hunters, and craft the healing incense that may save Johanna—the wife your failed transformation left dying.

title: Cakey & Tanaka: Candy Land Adventure
description: Protect the world’s sweetest cupcake! Cakey & Tanaka is a 3D roguelite shooter where you lead a fated duo. If either falls, it’s Game Over! Combine unique spells and unleash Rapid Fire to blast through candy monsters and survive the perils of CandyLand in this high-stakes, sweet adventure.

title: Bug Buster Bros.
description: Welcome to Exterminator Inc. The kitchen is infested, your shift just started, and the only thing between you and a paycheck is a swarm of cookieroaches. Click, crit, and crush your way through four nasty rooms in this cozy-chaotic survival clicker.

title: Chromatic Mage
description: Survive relentless waves of monsters in a dark fantasy action game. Choose your class, collect upgrade cards, unlock powerful weapons, dodge deadly boss attacks, and build your strength before the next threat takes over the arena.

title: Dyno Burst
description: Shoot, match, and burst colorful eggs in a dinosaur bubble puzzle.

title: Random Horse Derby
description: A minimalist and automatic horse racing game. Choose between 5 horses to get as many victories as possible in order to climb the world leaderboard.

title: For a Long Time, I Built Plans to Steal a Boy at Work and Didn't Dare to Do It, but I Happened to Get Him, so Now I Can Do All Sorts of Things with Him...
description: Watching my attractive colleague from work, I didn't even notice how I woke up at her house. Only the duct tape over my mouth and the heaviness in my legs bother me a little. I hope this is just a joke and she won't do A N Y T H I N G to me…

title: Path of the Idle Cultivator
description: An idle xianxia game about clawing your way from a nobody to a god. Sit, absorb Qi, break through realms, die - and come back stronger. Every death unlocks new paths, races, and systems. Defy the heavens one life at a time... then conquer galaxies, universes and... more?

title: ErfCity
description: Build a thriving city in this minimalist puzzle game by strategically placing buildings on a grid. Choose from random building options each round and optimize placement to maximize points based on proximity and synergies.

title: Quibi
description: Play a tragic story, overcome challenges and discover the story.

title: AI Games
description: Welcome to the inaugural AI Games, where you'll compete against the AI SUN. Come leave your scores and rank alongside players around the world, but your ultimate opponent is none other than yourself!

title: Puzzles: Monkey
description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

title: Puzzles: Water
description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

title: ROM Check Panic!
description:
ROM Check Panic! is a fan sequel/remake of Farbs’ 2008 fangame, ROM CHECK FAIL.
It now also serves as a fan sequel/successor to the NES Remix series, now with the added Remix Mode!

Go for a high score across 20 constantly changing levels. The goal is simple: defeat all the enemies… but who they are and how you fight them changes every few seconds.
Or test your speed in a set of curated challenges for you to get your best times.

title: Puzzles: Mountain
description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

title: Flutter Plane
description: Flutter Plane is a one-button pixel art arcade game. Tap to keep your little plane in the air, weave through trees and clouds to touch down on the landing pad. Each flight takes about 40 seconds, so there's always time for one more try. Finish the handcrafted levels, then take on Infinitely Random Levels with a new course every time across four difficulty settings.

title: Olympus 2249
description:
Olympus 2249 is a single-player, turn-based cRPG set in a post-nuclear dieselpunk America.

A journey through an atmospheric world packed with meaningful choices, branching dialogue, and brutal, bloody battles.

title: Exit_ComputerLab
description: Stuck in an infinite loop inside a computer lab. To escape, you need to find the necessary anomalies to break the loop, making it possible to get out of this place. Good luck ;)

title: Zombie Police: Midsummer Unhappy New Year
description: Ancient customs vs. Detective Zomby—what could possibly happen? Investigate a tragedy caught on a VTuber’s livestream in a village frozen in midsummer. Dive into minds, connect testimony in your Journal, and crack the case in this comedy-mystery adventure.

title: Tidy up the Backrooms
description: A store's items have gone missing in the Backrooms, and it's your job to bring it back. Explore the endless yellow halls using your tech and tools, restock the store and solve the mystery of what really happened to the store. Don't like scares? Turn the horror off and enjoy a cozy tidy!

title: Demidoff Corp
description: Demidoff Corp is an atmospheric 2D metroidvania based on Ural folk tales. Explore mystical lands, fight ancient creatures, unlock new abilities, and uncover Demidov’s secret to put an end to the evil that has awoken in the depths of the Ural mountains.

title: Antartida
description: No instructions, no manual, no help of any kind. Just you and a polar exploration vehicle. Are you capable of completing the mission, or will you be buried forever in Antarctica?

title: Sin and Serve
description: A dark comedy management sim set in Hell. The player works in Satan's kitchen, reading sinner case files, cooking a dish that matches the sinner's sin, and harvesting a body part as payment. Point and click, 2D, single player. A free demo is planned.

title: Holy Shroom!
description: Holy Shroom! is a photorealistic mushroom-foraging game for solo or co-op. Pick mushrooms by day and earn money to repair your van. At night, the forest fills with the most valuable mushrooms, but ghosts, monsters, and other strange residents wake up too. The bigger the reward, the greater the risk.

title: Mind the Clown: Reborn
description: A first-person survival horror game set in a cursed circus shaped by childhood memories. Move carefully and hide from the demonic clown stalking you. Explore dangerous attractions and burn circus posters to break the curse and save your life.

title: Beyond the Broken Veil
description: Beyond the Broken Veil is a heavily inspired RPG of the 90's. As a retired war veteran, uncover the mysteries that plague a war torn continent. Decide rather to embrace the darkness, or become the benevolent protector.

title: Stillwake
description: StillWake is an atmospheric first-person survival horror. Explore an abandoned psychiatric hospital, uncover its dark secrets, solve puzzles, and survive terrifying creatures. Stay quiet—your microphone picks up your voice, and enemies can hear you

title: Rense
description: A fast roguelite FPS. Make your build from level-up power choices and chest items, and fight through three maps of hostile drones. The longer a run goes, the stronger they get. Die, unlock more, come back stronger.

title: Elmer
description: Elmer is a metroidvania-style adventure game. AltroQuando is a place for those with a forgotten past, an illusionary present, and a future held only as a promise. Your presence here is the proof that you are seeking your own original sin, your own mask.

title: PlayIndex
description:
In PlayIndex, games are the stocks.

Every price is driven by one number: how many people are actually playing that game right now. Live Steam concurrent player counts are pulled every 10 minutes and turned into a market you can trade. No fictional companies, no invented charts: when a game blows up on a Friday night, you watch it happen on the tape.

Build a portfolio out of games you think are about to catch fire, and sell before the hype fades.

title: Foole's World
description: An absurd personality testing experience with a whole lot of questions for you.

title: Another Medium
description: Another Medium is a non-linear adventure featuring a mix of sci-fi, horror, drama, and thriller. Explore the world, make decisions, create your psychological profile, remain a puppet in the hands of outside forces, or break the control, even if the price turns out to be too high.

title: Skibidi Stones
description: A stone skipping rhythm game where you try to escape from an island.

title: Shattersight
description: Shattersight is a fast-paced online arcade FPS featuring sliding, dashing, double jumping, wall running, killstreaks, Team Deathmatch, and Capture the Flag.

title: Inky Fingers
description: An idle game about clicking a pen! Click for ink, unlock crazy new pens, buy powerful upgrades, and hire workers to automate production. Build your ultimate pen collection and grow your ink empire!

title: Legends of Hearts
description: Legends of Hearts (LOH) is a family-friendly 2.5D co-op platformer where two players explore vibrant levels, solve puzzles, and conquer challenges together. Play as Delmo and Dala to defeat the villain Sharshoor and share victories via digital gifts on social media.

title: Tiny Factory
description: Build a factory that refuses to stay solved. Orders arrive by themselves and keep growing, machines come from cards, and every run ends when your reputation runs out. How many orders can you deliver?

title: Abandoned Gameshop
description: Sort thousands of physical game cases scattered across the carpeted floors by Platform (Nindo 10, XCube, FunStation, PC) and Genre. Bring retro gaming nostalgia back to life!

title: Tidy or Treat
description: Halloween is coming and a restless spirit has emptied every shelf onto the floor. Sort out the pumpkin toys, learn tricks to work faster, and bring friends in to help.

title: Cozy Corner Cafe
description: Brew, upgrade, and relax! Build your dream coffee shop in Cozy Corner Cafe, a charming idle tycoon game. Automate prep stations, hire staff, handle in-store and online orders, and unlock upgrades through an extensive skill tree.

title: Game Breaker: Divine Error
description: A humorous, story-driven dark fantasy RPG where every character knows they're in a video game. You exploit glitches and cheats to rewrite the fate of a dying world and experience a deep narrative with a massive 119-track original soundtrack.

title: Alchemess: Tidy Up Your Potion Shop!
description: A cozy first-person sorting game. 2080 hand-named, physically reacting bottles scattered across the floor. A real mess. No, wait.. A real Alchemess! Join the mesmerizing flow of clicking each potion into its individual correct position. Tidy alone, or bring a friend. Or race one. Made with love.

title: Belief: A God's Burden
description: Belief: A God's Burden is an exploration and combat-focused top-down open-world RPG set up in a grim and dark city with procedurally generated dungeons underneath, where the player takes the role of a powerful demigod created from their believers' faith and wish for freedom.

title: Rip It! Card Collector
description: A single-player incremental game where you hunt down 1,809 collectible trading cards. Sell dupes and upgrade your retro-futuristic gear to pull more cards, quicker! Enjoy the satisfaction of ripping packs, filling your binder, and completing the ultimate card collection. It’s time to get cracking!

title: Fireworks Incremental
description: Bad Wizard covered the land with a Magical Dome and the only way to destroy it is with fireworks! Hire units, unlock buildings, buy upgrades, discover powerful synergies, turn a few tiny explosions into a ridiculous spectacle and ultimately defeat The Bad Wizard himself!

title: Freestyle Dunker
description: A real-time 3v3 street basketball game featuring online competitive matches, skill-based gameplay, player customization, and team-based street sports action.

title: Risen Blade
description: Smash the Dudes. Risen Blade is a fast-paced hack and slash roguelike where you chain brutal combos, carve through endless enemies, and forge powerful builds across unique classes.

title: Ars et Anima
description: A relaxing educational experience set in the Renaissance: face ancient Latin quizzes inside the convent of today's San Marco Museum in Florence. Test your knowledge and help Beato Angelico complete a precious painting commissioned by Cosimo de' Medici.

title: Animal Games
description: Animal Games is a fast-paced cartoon sports game where cute animal athletes compete across 10 unique maps, each with its own music, for nonstop fun and excitement!

title: Robo Rolo
description: Play as R0-L0 (a spherical robot from outer space) to roll, jump, and bounce through 6 colorful worlds to collect energy shards, so they can return home! Robo Rolo is a physics-based 3D collectathon platformer with fine-tuned, skill based movement that's fun to play, and even more fun to master.

title: Cursed House 8
description: Use your Match 3 skills to get rid of the demons!

title: Cursed House 6
description: Solve Match 3 Puzzles and free the town from the evil spirits!

title: Defy the Abyss
description: Survive relentless hordes in a dungeon deep within the Abyss. Swap between heroes, unleash powerful spells, and crush nightmares, demons, and immense horrors to grow stronger with every run, in this fast-paced horde survival.

title: Moon Pool
description: Ever wonder what it'd be like to go spelunking with a parachute? Ever wonder what it'd be like to be a Cow? Of course not, because why wonder when you can play this game!

title: Look / Don't
description: There are things you should look at. Things you should never look at. And things watching you. LOOK / DON'T is a first-person psychological horror exploration game about looking. Explore a changing house and bring back the requested items.

title: Astrosaurox
description: Astrosaurox is a tribute to the videogames of the late 70s and early 80s. Pilot an Astrosaurox tank and battle the space mafia. Depending on your age, either discover or relive the challenge, fun, and addictive nature of those classic games. Beat your highscore in solo or co-op mode.

title: Disciples of Canada
description: Play as Viviette, and her three lieutenants, and defeat the three rivalling criminal gangs in this cute RPG Maker game. Featuring a large cast of chibi girls in a unique Canadian city.

title: Spell Death
description:
An art deco-inspired roguelike deck-builder where the alphabet is the deck and the only power you have are the words you can spell.

Use stocks to add effects to your letters, spell words to awaken their power, discover enemies' true name to banish them and free the illiterate world from the demons that rule since humanity lost "the word".

title: Just Volleyball
description: just volleyball is an arcade-style action volleyball game that aims to bring a freeform, addicting, and simple volleyball experience to PC, with full online & offline play. with a cursor-based aiming system and fully manual movement, the game may seem simple to pick up, but has a steep and rewarding learning curve. (taken from Steam page)

title: Farm Harbeest
description: Farm Harbeest is a top-down farm shooter with light incremental progression. Become an armed bee, fight, harvest, gather resources, and upgrade as firepower, efficiency, and harvest range continue to escalate.

title: Sakurairo Prism: Beyond the Bloom
description: A coming-of-age romance visual novel set in a disbanded high school photography club. Three fully voiced heroines — a childhood friend, a playful junior, a mysterious senior. As love refracts like a prism, what will Hikaru's camera capture? A remake of Sakurairo Prism. "You can always start over."

title: Snowflakes in the Sun
description: Off-the-grid survivalist Dan and 2-inch-tall Holly have settled into their living arrangements together. But despite their close bond, they have some things they're still trying to figure out.

title: Hazmat Simulator
description: A chaotic cleaning simulator and exploration game. Explore strange and mysterious environments, clean up massive messes, uncover hidden objects, complete each level. You never know what you’ll find along the way—so keep your eyes open and hope for the best.

title: Cradle of Ash
description: Survival horror in a quarantined company town. You wake alone at the edge of Ashbrook, where the dead get back up from anything you do to them - unless what is left of them burns. Play solo or in co-op for up to four players.

title: Bones of the Error
description:
Nothing feels quite the same as it used to, yet it all still follows the same familiar beats. BB tags along with her sister ZZ to a convention far outside the strange town she's used to, but it seems that something follows her no matter where she goes in this changed world. Will she be able to ignore it, or will this feeling drag her six feet under?

10th game in the "of the error" cartoon horror series. Arrows or WASD to walk around, Enter to confirm.

Just kidding! Bones of the Error is a fake installment in the just-as-fake game series, Anthology of the Error. The game was made for SiIvagunner's April Fools' Day 2026 event and is meant to be a combination of Anthology of the Killer and the Undertale AU, Errortale

title: Beyond The Blight
description: A short first person, 2.5d incremental dungeon-crawler where you loot, upgrade, and grow stronger on the quest to find and defeat the source of the blight.

title: Welcome to Victorville
description: You wake in a strange facility alongside your work partner Victor Adams with no memory of how you arrived. Using arrow keys to navigate a branching narrative, you decide whether to trust Victor or forge your own escape. Your choices shape the story across multiple paths, revealing dark secrets and twisted turns. Hunt for every ending, though only one truly matters.

title: Dark Harvest
description: Dark Harvest is a retro-styled stalker horror inspired by Resident Evil and Signs. Your dog is trapped, and something is stalking you. Explore the manor, solve puzzles, and do everything in your power to survive.

title: Bush 1022
description: Fly bush planes on the moon of a gas giant. Do deliveries, challenges and explore an open world.

title: Stones Keeper: Director's Cut
description: Stones Keeper: Director's Cut reveals Stones Keeper in a new way: an updated campaign, a reworked story, new tactical mechanics, expanded character progression, and new equipment make every battle more compelling and the journey richer. Revamped animations, portraits, interface, world map, and flying fortress round out the game's distinctive world and tie its story to the sequel.

title: The Rounds of Six
description: A first-person psychological horror set in an oppressive clinic, centered on cyclical madness. As a doctor, perform daily rounds in Ward No. 6. Study your surroundings and stay attentive to break the loop.

title: SilentDarkness
description: A first-person liminal space escape game where exploration, observation, and trial and error are the keys to uncovering hidden rules. With no combat and no sudden jump scares, experience an oppressive atmosphere filled with mystery and fear of the unknown.

title: Drums Rock: Payday 2 - 'Death Wish'
description: Get the track 'Death Wish' from Payday 2! This track is part of the 'Payday Music Pack'. Music Downloads Not Rated by the ESRB Visit

title: Drums Rock: Payday 3 - 'No Rest for the Wicked'
description: Get the track 'No Rest for the Wicked' from Payday 3! This track is part of the 'Payday Music Pack'.

title: Drums Rock: Wind Rose - 'Drunken Dwarves'
description: Get the track 'Drunken Dwarves' from Wind Rose! This track is part of the 'Stage Dive Scene Pack'.

title: Drums Rock: Angus McSix - 'Laser-Shooting Dinosaur'
description: Get the track 'Laser-Shooting Dinosaur' from Angus McSix! This track is part of the 'Stage Dive Scene Pack'.

title: Kigurumi Hearts
description: Interrogate the suspect. Survive the shift. Interrogation survival horror about exploration of inability to become, and rotting with it.

title: Re:Store the Record Store
description: Re:Store the Record Store is a game about tidying up an indie record store after the owner had to run off to chase down his escaped monkey. Featuring over 1000 items to pick up, sort through and return back into the crates where they belong. Take your time to look through everything or speedrun it!

title: 8-Bit Selection: Arcade Replay
description:
This is a collection of 5 different 8-bit style arcade games.

• Guest Rush — You play as a hotel housekeeper, trying to clean rooms after customers as fast as possible.
• Mythos Dash — You play as the Hero of the Mythos, slaying deadly minotaurs and saving ladies.
• Cauldron Forager — You play as the Witch of the Forest, collecting ingredients for her potion cauldron and defending against the forest dwellers.
• Tube Repairs — You play as a plumber who goes around the tube maze and fixes potential leaks.
• Pumpkin Bloodshed — You play as the Slasher that has to defend against the army of evil pumpkins.

title: Magic Mess: Restore Order to the Wizard's Tower!
description: Magic Mess: Restore Order to the Wizard's Tower! is a cozy single-player organization simulator. Return 3,040 scattered items, including books, potions, scrolls, and crystals, to their proper places and restore order to the wizard's tower. Don't let your dragon waiting outside distract you.

title: Old Market Restored
description: Replace the misplaced products with your friends and step back into the Old Market universe and take control of the mess before the doors open.

title: NebulaSky Crossing
description: Nebula Sky Crossing is a game that blends 2D side-scrolling shooting—where you pilot a spaceship as a space trader—with station-based trading. Aim to conquer a galaxy filled with dangers such as pirates by mastering piloting skills and upgrades.

title: Neko Neko Shop
description: Neko Neko Shop is a cozy organizing game where you sort, stock, and display adorable neko collectibles in a wonderfully messy shop. Relax, tidy up, and turn the chaos into the cutest store around.

title: Lara Croft GO: The Cave of Fire
description: The Cave of Fire is the sixth area added to the puzzle game Lara Croft GO, released as a free update on November 26, 2015.

title: Cartas
description:
"A friend going to the city gives me the chance to write to you again. I don't know if you received my previous letters. Here I am, without being able to communicate with anyone in the world."

Images and stories from the journey of a man adrift. Cartas is based on a couple of letters that were written by inmigrants at the end of the 19th century in Argentina. It was first made in a few weeks for the Correspondence Jam: Make a game about, involving or using instant messages, email, letters, etc

title: Revenant Dawn
description: Survive a zombie outbreak as Eric, Sarah, and Kate. Explore the town and uncover the mysteries behind the incident - Fight or flee the monsters while managing your resources in a classic survival horror adventure.

title: Camp Paradise: Island Resort Tycoon
description: Transform a neglected island into the ultimate holiday escape in this cozy island resort tycoon. Clean, repair and build the island getaway of your dreams, then pack it with everything guests could want, from peaceful campsites to jet skis and ferris wheels. Your island. Their paradise.

title: Le Fishe
description: Le Fishe is a cozy fishing adventure where every cast of your line leads to something new. Catch a wide variety of fish, upgrade your fishing gear, and unlock new locations as you progress. Talk to an interesting cast of characters and try your best to catch the biggest fish of them all!

title: The Division 2: Echoes of Central Park
description: A narrative-driven DLC expansion where you explore a decayed Central Park and Upper West Side gripped by paranoia over a mysterious virus variant. Guided by a narrator recounting events as a flashback, you uncover what happened in the park while battling a new apex threat and familiar foes. You're joined by three companions with distinct fighting styles and backgrounds, each offering unique tactical support and reactions to situations. The endgame shifts you from hunted survivor to hunter, letting you dictate engagements and pursue enemies on your own terms, with your performance affecting future challenges and exclusive rewards. New skill variants and an exotic weapon round out the expansion.

title: Modularis
description: Modularis is a roguelike space shooter where you pilot prototype ships built to contain the chaos of space.

title: Safari-TV
description: Open a safari agency with friends and turn every trip into a vlog episode. Assemble a physics-driven safari truck, drive tourists across an open world, and choose peaceful tours or dangerous, high-paying routes. Smuggle contraband, film every disaster, and repair your safari truck.

title: Kuznetsk 1997: Detective Visual Novel
description: Immerse yourself in a gripping visual novel made in anime style, where dark secrets are hidden behind the usual everyday life.

title: Post Office: Tidy Up!
description: Post Office: Tidy Up! is a cozy sorting simulator where you shelve 3,360 parcels scattered across a postal depot by an earthquake. Read every label, find its courier, country and numbered slot, and restore order at your own pace.

title: Weiß Schwarz Online
description: Battle with cards from your favorite titles! Weiss Schwarz, the world's No. 1 card game by number of participating titles, is now a video game! With a full tutorial and online battles, players of all skill levels, from beginners to experts, can enjoy the game.

title: Wheel Estate
description: Become the wealthiest Business Hamster in the world! Expand your office space, build hamster wheels, hire hamster employee's and hamster managers! Provide water and decorations for your hard working Hamsters and reap the reward!

title: Bob-omb Blitz
description:
Bob-omb Blitz is a remake/reimagining of the minigame Bob-omb Squad from Super Mario 64 DS and New Super Mario Bros.

Bob-ombs are attacking Peach's flowers! The Toads are counting on you to hold them off as much as you can. Use the slingshot to attack the enemies and blast them out of the sky!

title: Diablo IV: Season of Hell's Legacy
description: Season of Hell’s Legacy is live in Diablo IV. Step into Waking Nightmares that bring some of the most infamous moments from Diablo’s past into the present. Guided by the lost soul of Deckard Cain, confront echoes of legendary foes, explore familiar locations reimagined in Diablo IV, and contain the fearsome powers of the Prime Evils.

title: Cursed Gas Station
description: At an isolated gas station in the 1990s, Cole takes a night-shift job that comes with a room to stay in. As you serve customers, unexplained events begin to unfold in this psychological horror game.

title: The Park Keeper
description: Manage a national park where something is clearly trying to get out. Screen visitors, cover up incidents, and keep everyone convinced that everything is under control.

title: Void Skirmisher
description: Void Skirmisher is an arcade co-op shooter for up to 8 players: jump the gate before the front line even exists, and face down hostile fleets as the first wave out where nobody's been before.

title: Evergrowing
description: Grow the tree you live on in this cozy incremental game. Play as a squirrel, tend its leaves and build along the branches. Travel by balloon to other trees or explore the roots below. Your tree keeps growing while you're away.

title: Neverscape
description: A hand-drawn, tactical RPG, with a deeply personal story set in a kingdom inspired by Serbian mythology.

title: Sort the Capybaras
description: Sort the Capybaras is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort over 4,800 unique capybara toys onto the correct shelves. Play with friends or go solo. Enjoy the satisfaction of using powerful skills turning a messy capybara store into a perfectly organized collection.

title: 9 Layers of Hell
description: Descend from the sanctuary of Florentia into the abyss. 9 Layers of Hell fuses the frantic combat of a horde survivor with the deep, randomized loot of a hardcore Action RPG. Choose a class, augment your skills, and forge god-tier gear to conquer the 9 Evils of the Underworld.

title: Packing Shift
description: Packing Shift is a cozy warehouse online co-op for 1-4 players. Sort the day's deliveries, fill the orders, box them up, and ship them out. Everything is physics-driven, so mind the shelves, mind the rockets, and try not to bury your coworkers under either.

title: Island Miner
description: Island Miner is a relaxing automation game set on beautiful, colorful islands. Mine, refine and combine resources within each island's footprint, connect islands and build advanced production chains at your own pace. No enemies, no timers, no pressure — just don't let pollution get out of control.

title: That's Exactly What a Wolf Would Say!
description: An online social deduction game for up to 10 players. Live the cottage dream by day and survive the werewolves by night! You hear howling outside, and the Witch isn't on the line... Coincidence? That's exactly what a wolf would say!

title: WanYaoChao
description: This is a multiplayer online role-playing battle game that combines exploration, strategy, and team collaboration with a visual perspective. Players must search for scattered seal stones throughout the map.

title: Fengshenyanyi SandBox
description: Command Nezha in epic five-way battles! A Fengshen Yanyi game blending city-building with massive real-time combat. Lead your army against 5 unique foes: the Shang Dynasty, Roman Legions, Sengoku Samurai, American Riflemen, and Imperial Japanese Forces.

title: Vladimir
description: A narrative game following an ordinary Russian citizen navigating wartime and political upheaval. Through sketches depicting "before and after" scenarios and real incidents, it examines personal choices and societal change rather than military statistics. Gameplay alternates between frenetic action and environmental storytelling that reflects the shifting world around the protagonist.

title: Built the End
description: Harvest resources, build and upgrade towers, and defend your base against escalating waves of robotic enemies in this resource management focused tower defense. Use an arsenal of unique towers and their upgrades against the multitudes of different robots.

title: Midnight Rogues
description: Midnight Rogues brings item placement and auto-battler combat to the roguelike deckbuilder formula. Choose one of three disgraced young superheroes, buy and rearrange items to build game-breaking combinations, and hunt down The City’s corrupted heroes.

title: Overdrive Breakout
description: Control a rusted mech in a fast-paced top-down survival action game. Enter unknown areas, dodge enemy swarms, choose random weapons, skill upgrades, and passive modules, defeat bosses, unlock maps, and break through on the edge of overload.

title: Spellarium 12
description: A new Spellarium episode with some improvements!

title: Skyfire Legends
description: Battle through 4 action-packed levels with the pilot of your choice. Face relentless waves of enemies as you fight your way to 4 powerful bosses. Compete against players worldwide — can you be the fastest to conquer the top of the scoreboard?

title: Sole Mates: Tidy Up the Shoe Store
description: Two thousand pairs of sneakers are scattered across the shop floor and every shelf is empty. Find each shoe's match, read its model and size, then put it where it belongs. Alone, or online with friends - 2 to 4 players. No timers, no score, no way to fail.

title: Bugs. Billions of Bugs.
description: An incremental swarm tower defense. Play solo or 2–4 player Steam co-op. Defend a doomed mining colony through a full campaign, infinite procedural maps and Workshop creations. Build towers. Call orbital strikes. Kill billions. The only good bug is a dead bug. Do your part!

title: Hostile Paths
description: A challenging top-down survival roguelike where scarcity is the real enemy. Manage limited resources and inventory space, explore unknown procedural routes, learn from every death, and decide which risks are worth taking.

title: Kick the Ball
description: Kick The Ball is a physics-based side-scrolling platformer where both you and the ball must reach the goal. Master precise movement, overcome challenging obstacles and beat your best times.

title: Questfarers of the Stone
description: A Dark fantasy themed 2D hand-drawn point and click adventure, following Kabe on a quest into a corrupted part of the Stone. Solve the puzzles of this world, or be lost in it.

title: Mortan
description:
You must venture through a series of combat challenges to prove you are worthy of facing what lies at the end. Fight enemies, find treasures, get upgrades and more.

Each run gives you different options for how to build your character, letting you try out different weapons, abilities, and upgrades.

title: Finding Hooman
description: Finding Hooman is an indie adventure game developed by a team of six university students as a project in 2022 and officially released in 2023.

title: Air Raid 1: ReOvercharge
description:
Join Jacob and his Watermelon Cannon on an adventure against robots to save his home and uncover the secrets of a mysterious energy called "Overcharge."

Play multi-round PvE battles, choosing your skills and upgrades that will progress through the story. Spend time with your allies in a visual novel format and strengthen your relationships to unlock PvE combat improvements.

title: Matchi Rider
description: In Matchi Rider, the grid isn't just a puzzle: it's an arena. Every row you slide lines up numbered tiles, and every match pushes your round score toward the target set by the enemy across from you. Reading the board several moves ahead, chaining combos and chains for bigger multipliers, and holding on until the end of the round: It's your FIGHT!

title: Honkai: Star Rail - Dance With the Beast Before Moonrise
description: Version 4.6 of Honkai: Star Rail, which includes: • New character: Pearl • New Trailblaze Mission: "Dance With the Beast Before Moonrise" • New events • ...and more!

title: Bikini Surfer Girl: Wild Wahine
description: A cool arcade surfing game with lots of options and loads of fun!

title: Rabbits Also Kill: Rezero
description: An action platformer roguelike where you use musical instruments to kill demons. Gain XP, build social links, upgrade your equipment, and become stronger to kill the Devil himself and put an end to the Cycle of Rebirth.

title: Can Your Otaku Cabinet Grow a Beautiful Girl?
description: Players will take on the role of a savior transported to a miniature world, rescuing flowers through battles and trials, protecting and caring for them, and embarking on a new harem life in a perilous fantasy world.

title: Mall Tidy Up Frenemies
description: Chaos in, order out. Sort a mall's worth of misplaced products back onto the shelves they belong on, using each item's packaging as the clue. Unlock perks, climb the standings against your friends, and restore the whole mall in online co-op for up to eight, AI players included.

title: Wrenny Lee: Witch-for-Hire!
description: A short visual novel comedy about Wrenny, a hard-working witch! The freelance life is anything but magical!

title: Dub Party
description: Dub Party is a party game where players replace every voice in a video with their own. Import a clip or pick a community scene, claim the roles, record each line, then watch the finished dub together. Play solo, pass one mic around the couch, or invite up to seven friends online.

title: Gamers Club Repeat
description: Uha was one of those who got hit by an asteroid incident and was hospitalized for years. And now when he wokes up there's an unfamiliar woman besides him sleeping right next to him!?

title: Nature Hike
description: A short and sweet fully voice-acted Visual Novel where you'll join Tendou, a recent friend and local tanuki hunk, on a hiking date... though, perhaps, just "friends" is not exactly what you'll end up being.

title: Thronefall: Craaghelm
description: Conquer the mountain in Craaghelm, the first expansion for Thronefall.

title: Crankles
description: 3rd person arcade platformer where you play as Crankles - a feline who despises everything and doesn't really care! Grab yarns, learns skills, defeat nasty dogs and uncover all the secrets! The fate of The Purring Island is in your paws!

title: A Game About Breaking Pots
description: A short, relaxing game about the joy of breaking pots with your sword. Explore a tranquil abandoned medieval castle, buy upgrades and smash every pot you can find.

title: Jono
description: Work together to complete one million levels, one player at a time. Continue where the previous left off. Chat with others while you wait for your turn. How long will it take?

title: My Adorable Ghost Story
description: A cowardly ghost needs your help to find peace. Complete his final wishes, get closer to him, and unravel the mystery of his death as you search for your own freedom in this short, story-driven adventure.

title: Orbital Hell
description: Orbital Hell is an arcade bullet hell shooter played from a first-person perspective inside a concave, spherical environment where the horizon curves upward. The player's rotary cannon fires automatically, requiring players to aim, manage secondary abilities, and navigate swarms of incoming enemies approaching from all directions. Core movement mechanics center on aerial traversal, allowing players to bounce directly off enemy units to reset double jumps, maintain airtime, charge defensive shields, and build scoring combos. Offensive and defensive tools include charged piercing shots, speed boosts, and an orbital shield that clears surrounding targets upon ground takeoff. The game features two primary modes: Normal Mode, focusing on surviving escalating enemy waves and bosses with time-slowing pickups, and Boss Rush, an endurance gauntlet of consecutive boss encounters with timed interludes.

title: Mess in the Toy Shop
description: Just the simple joy of putting toys back on the shelves. Dive into a relaxing gameplay experience where every toy has its place. Turn a messy toy shop into a perfectly organized store. Unlock new skills, improve your efficiency, and have fun.

title: Shelf Happens
description: You (alone or with friends) need to place scattered vinyl records on the right genre crates in a retro record store. Complete crates and earn XP to unlock abilities that improve your efficiency. Use your skills and strategies to sort hundreds of records by genre fast!

title: Lucid Cats
description: An online co-op horror extraction game. Fall asleep, loot a shared nightmare, and find the escape to keep your valuables.

title: Outwith
description: Outwith is a first-person, single-player open-world RPG set in a hand-crafted medieval fantasy world. Meet its inhabitants, face lurking dangers, uncover ancient secrets and shape a world that responds to your actions. Let your curiosity guide you as you wander this dark and mysterious land.

title: New Science
description: New Science is an open-ended card-combination discovery game in which players combine illustrated objects and ideas to create new discoveries. It uses cards to represent objects and uses AI to generate created images on demand.

title: Imagine We Were Human
description: A compilation of 12 small literary games about humans meeting and missing one another. Explore these experimental experiences that were made on a monthly basis over the course of a year.

title: Gangsta Bean 3: Night of the Rising Bread
description: Gangsta Bean, Krazy Karrot, T-Mato, and Brock Lee gang up to fight hordes of reanimated rotten food zombies in this retro arcade-style twin-stick beat 'em up sequel to the classic Flash games.

title: Hold On
description: Struggle. Fall. Triumph. Hold on. A small yet grand journey across life. Simple interactions connect seemingly unrelated moments, from the microscopic to the cosmic.

title: Backtrace: Mechanisms for Forgetting
description: Backtrace is a yuri mystery and puzzle game set inside a retro computer. Log on night after night to uncover a story of internet exploits and unexpected friendships with a crew of 80s hackers. Solve 2D grid-based puzzles to piece together the mystery.

title: Painwives
description: Painwives is an atmospheric walking simulator where you play a pregnant woman sent on a holy pilgrimage by a fertility cult that worships pain.

title: Velorys
description: Velorys is a character-driven fantasy RPG about two groups of childhood friends torn apart by war. Explore a Renaissance-inspired world from opposing perspectives, with tactical turn-based combat built around initiative, positioning and party synergy.

title: Dustpine District
description: Explore and restore a spooky forest town while collecting lost items along the way. Check off tasks, fill your home with treasures, meet your new neighbors and uncover Dustpine District's cosmic past!

title: Visceral
description: A turn-based horror roguelike where your flashlight is your best weapon. Awaken on a cursed farm, reveal the monsters hiding in the dark, and put them down with 51 weapons and 91 omens. Every run is randomly generated. Survive the night, or be torn apart trying.

title: Yakumo
description: A native port of Monster Hunter Portable 3rd HD Ver. made by static recompilation.

title: My Racing Car
description: Drag rusted wrecks from the scrapyard and rebuild them from scratch, one part at a time. A raw open-world driving life-sim — fix your car, fuel it, and hit the road. Race for cash, explore a living forest town, and survive the grind. Drive. Don't stop.

title: Towermouth
description:
Towermouth is a roguelite action game with automatic firing, played solo or by two players in local split-screen co-op. Each player controls a puppet climbing a living tower floor by floor; the tower watches the players, talks to them and remembers how the previous run ended.

Weapons fire on their own, so players move, jump and dash to position themselves while enemies swarm each floor. Clearing a floor opens its gate and offers a reward before the climb continues. Level-ups offer a choice of three cards that change the character's build, collecting five copies of one effect transforms it, and a Warden boss guards every fifth floor.

title: Oktoraid
description:
Oktoraid is a base-defence roguelite for one or two players with local split-screen co-op. The players control two operators, joined by a power cable, who defend a core against an invading machine army.

Each wave starts with a preparation phase in which the players build turrets, helper-bots and pallet walls before a siren starts the siege. During the siege the operators' weapons fire automatically alongside the turrets and bots, and the run ends if the core is destroyed. Staying close along the power cable raises both players' damage and lets the cable shock robots, while a market between waves offers items that can be rerolled or locked and weapons that can be upgraded and combined.

title: Foxtrot Creamery
description: Foxtrot Creamery is a 2D business and dating simulator where you own and operate your very own ice cream empire! Meet friendly faces, build a community, and take part in your own fantastic adventure. The central themes are love, community building, and life in the big city.

title: Paint Gang
description: Mix colors by eye, race across a giant canvas, and try not to step in the wet paint. Paint Gang is a chaotic online co-op game for 1–4 painters where every masterpiece becomes a team-made disaster.

title: Seed Shop: Tidy Up!
description: Restore a vintage seed shop by sorting thousands of scattered seed packets, bulbs, potted plants, and saplings. Read the labels, carry stacks, fill more than 300 plant slots, and unlock faster ways to bring order back one shelf at a time.

title: Hardware Store: Tidy Up
description: A cozy sorting simulator about calmly putting a chaotic hardware store back in order. Pick up tools, find their shelves, and enjoy the relaxing rhythm of organizing.

title: Sort The Toys
description: Sort The Toys is a relaxing organizing simulator where you place over 3,400 toys onto their designated shelves. Play at your own pace, unlock helpful skills, and enjoy the satisfying process of bringing complete order to a cluttered toy store.

title: VHS Nights: The Tidy Up Shift
description: It’s 1992 and the VHS store is counting on you! Sort 1,120 unique movies by genre and year with no title repeated twice. A true sorting game for movie lovers! Discover hilarious parody titles and blurbs, unlock abilities, and enjoy optional tape rewinding.

title: Heisen-Bro Hustler
description: You wake up in a gym bathroom stall with no memory. Suddenly you start receiving orders for gym supplements. It's time to start the hustle. This game will take you on a journey from potty jockey to the ultimate Heisen-Bro Hustler. A lighthearted tongue-in-cheek, self deprecating play on gym culture

title: Catetris
description: Catetris is a captivating puzzle game where players must place falling pieces of various shapes to fill horizontal lines on the board.

title: Goodnight, Sun
description: The sun is dying. One billion minds sleep below. You are HALCYON, the caretaker AI — dismantle a solar system, planet by planet, to build them an Ark. An incremental that ENDS: 4-6 hours, two endings, no infinite grind. Every world you consume stays gone. Even the Earth. Especially the Earth.

title: Dust & Diamonds
description: Humans are extinct, and Goblins proudly stand at the top of the food chain! Take over a mine, expand your surface base, and automate logistics. Manage workers, trade, avoid cave-ins and lava, and above all – try to endure your father's constant grumbling!

title: Astro Raiders
description: A retro-inspired arcade action game where you shoot, split, and dodge bouncing orbs across vibrant alien worlds. Grab power-ups, unlock characters, and climb the leaderboards as you battle through hundreds of increasingly challenging levels.

title: Debt of Life
description: You have money. You have a home. You have a family. And you're dying. You have very little time left. Make impossible choices and decide what you're willing to sacrifice for one more week of life.

title: Isekai: Waifu Overlord
description: Forget the daily grind - getting hit by a truck landed you right before the Goddess Divitai! Lead a village and assemble a squad of hot babes. Develop your settlement, go on dates, enjoy full voice acting, and unlock 18+ scenes. In this world, you make the rules!

title: Love Alt Delete
description: Date. Design. Destroy. A psychological chat simulator between you and two digital personalities who desperately want to be people. Type keywords to control them, uncover their secrets, and choose their fates.

title: Sayagatari: Promise of the Cursed Blade - First Press Limited Edition
description: Contains an acrylic charm, a mini shikishi, a votive picture, and a set of 3 amulets.

title: My Desktop Dwarf: Taskbar Forge
description: My Desktop Dwarf: Taskbar Forge is an idle crafting game in which Brokk, a pixel-art dwarf blacksmith, runs a small forge in a strip just above the Windows taskbar. Every key press or mouse click anywhere on the PC counts as one swing of his hammer, turning ore into ingots and ingots into finished items. His wife Brygida sells the pieces in the shop, and the gold pays for ore, new patterns and upgrades that unlock better metals, from copper up to mithril. Items come in 49 patterns and five rarities. Regular play needs no clicking, and the game counts inputs without recording what is typed. It runs offline.

title: Dumb Sherlock: The Hot Dogs of the Bakerville
description: Cracking cases isn’t elementary when you're Dumb Sherlock, the world’s dumbest detective and last living descendant of the brilliant original Sherlock. Inspect, interrogate, beat puzzles and minigames and solve a hilarious whodunit mystery in this charmingly handcrafted 2D point-and-click adventure!

title: Want a Bomb?
description: Blow up mountains with your friends in this chaotic online co-op game. Collect minerals, buy bigger explosives, build chains of explosions, and experiment with bomb-loaded drones, explosive baseballs, and a launcher that can send your friends flying.

title: Infinite Echoes Advance
description: A dungeon-crawling Final Fantasy fan game featuring a massive roster of characters from across the series.

title: Catjam
description:
Catjam is a 2D JRPG Adventure featuring: Cats, otherworldly creatures and vast magic worlds!
Venture through the lands of 'Mu' and fight against the darkness that has taken over this once peaceful realm.

title: Voltus' Neon Nightmare - Colossal Cure
description: After the previous events, you realized that this "mall" place was a trap to send you to another dimension, full of liminal and unknown places. Voltus is now controlled by the Core's energy, forced to keep you away from it.

title: No One Will Miss Me
description: An existential horror visual novel. Play as a voice inside a troubled mind. Identify her cognitive distortions, shift her perspective, and win the debate that decides whether she lives or dies.

title: Goblinfall: Defend Da Fort
description: Goblinfall: Defend Da Fort is a chaotic 1-4 player co-op defense game. Team up to protect the goblin fort from endless pig invasions! Manage ammo, extinguish fires, swap crystal upgrades, and survive the panic in a fantasy world!

title: Bannerlings
description: Build an unstoppable army in this strategy roguelite auto-battler. Fuse your Bannerlings, create powerful emblem synergies, and overcome unpredictable encounters on the road to the final boss.

title: Meme Classics 2
description:
Each question has four possible answers, one of which is correct. The answers are randomly shuffled each time, so you'll have to rely solely on your knowledge, not your keystroke memory.

Counters track your progress in real time. After each answer—correct or not—you immediately move on to the next question. At the end, you'll receive a personal title reflecting your level of meme knowledge: from beginner to meme guru.

title: Chomp Garden
description: A bite-sized puzzle adventure in a garden full of deceptively cute plants. Play as a tiny glowing lamp and shape them with your light to make your way deeper and find your pup.

title: Day 31
description: You were bitten hours ago. The clock in your blood is already running — and it isn't a virus. Fight through the waves of the dead, trade your nerve to a demon who was here before the city, and hold onto yourself for one more wave. Turn, and it's over.

title: Dungeon Crawl 94: What Was Taken
description:
Dungeon Crawl 94: What Was Taken is a grid-based dungeon-crawling RPG focused on exploration, turn-based combat, character progression, and procedurally generated environments. Players choose a class and develop attributes including Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence, Wisdom, Speed, Constitution, and Luck while discovering randomized equipment, spell books, cursed and legendary items, crafting supplies, merchants, animal companions, mimics, and bosses.

The game uses a 2D grid-based world with a perspective rendering system that allows outdoor environments to display a visible sky and horizon. The player's view can also be rotated through four orientations while exploring.

The story follows a traveler returning home who discovers his home in flames and his family missing, beginning a journey to discover what was taken and find them.

title: Eternal Refresh
description: This is the story of a middle school girl named Rosemary who takes care of this garden every day so that it remains fresh and vibrant.

title: Alone House
description:
Olivia, a 17-year-old girl, returns home on a rainy Friday evening. She expects to rest and have a normal dinner with her family, but the house is pitch black, deserted, and locked from the inside...

What happened to her family? Amidst the dead silence and misplaced belongings, Olivia begins to realize that she might not be alone in this house... and "someone" is watching her from the shadows.

title: Why Are My Prefects So Hot!!?
description: An RPG Maker game set in a high school rom-com world, designed to offer players a meaningful and memorable experience.

title: Her Heart, Anew
description: A turn-based RPG with romantic Otome elements set in the world of Vyen, Year 280 A.R. (Arcane Renaissance). A gentle healer named Myrrh flees a forced marriage and joins an expedition to the dangerous Lair of Ezul in search of the legendary Ruby Eye. Alongside a brave wolven gladiator, a sharp tongued elven warlock, and a mysterious vampiric swordsman, Myrrh must face monsters, ancient powers, and decide not only the fate of this expedition, but also the future of her own heart.

title: Long Live The Emperor
description: You'll time-travel to a turbulent ancient Chinese dynasty as a young monarch. Ascend the throne amidst chaos and navigate among powerful officials, noble clans, and common scholars. Each vermilion note harbors danger. Your choice will shape history: Create a prosperous era or be a fallen king.

title: Lily Adventuresses! Episode 4: The Ancienaut beneath the Mask
description: The fourth entry in an RPG anthology series featuring women loving women.

title: Ezalm: Magic's Memory
description: A narrative-driven action RPG where each spell you use will punish you, requiring you to be strategic in the combat styles you will build. Lost in the land of your ancestors, unravel the secrets of magic to return home and defend the people you swore to protect.

title: Shiki Tea House
description: Shiki Tea House is a single-player cozy life-sim game. Open a little cozy tea shop and take part in farming, running tea business, exploring the town and more.

title: Tiandao
description: Ready to rule the Three Realms? Tiandao blends Grand Strategy. As a powerless Celestial Emperor, will you rule in name or defy fate? Master court intrigue, find soulmates, and wield supreme authority to judge all life. Become the ultimate Heavenly Dao and master the fate of all!

title: Kuruki-chan the Cat
description: Kuruki-chan is a cute, bright, and heartwarming RPG adventure game that will surely heal your soul.

title: Puntar: The Somtum of Rememories
description: This is a cooking game where you play as a single father selling Som Tam (Thai papaya salad). Your child only drinks milk from demons. Earn money, upgrade your shop, and uncover strange dreams—fragmented memories of a childhood tragedy in this very place.

title: Cloudlapse!
description: Cloudlapse! is a pop-matching puzzle action roguelike that aims to bring the experience of classic Premium Casual Games into the modern era by blending old-school charm with modern game design.

title: Eldermyth
description: Defend a mythical land as ancient beasts in this high-score roguelike. Use powers, weather and land synergy to save villages and stop invaders from colonising the land.

title: Mythopolis
description: A fast-paced low-poly roguelike set in a 20th-century American town. Fight against mythological creatures from around the world, adapt your strategy each run, and survive the growing chaos.

title: BugPot
description: BugPot is a casual roguelike where every spin shapes the fight. Match weapons and charms, upgrade your weapons, build powerful combinations and adapt your strategy as you face a bizarre variety of bugs.

title: Spaceport Architect
description: Build, manage and expand a spaceport on a recently colonized planet. Import cargo to grow the colony population. Take care of the resulting passenger traffic to pay the bills. Bring your airport fantasy into space with this sci-fi business tycoon!

title: Still Sorting
description: A game about putting 4,344 volumes of manga back where they belong. They're heaped in front of the counter or packed away in boxes. Listen to the rain, take your time, and shelve them one at a time.

title: Vinyl Freak: Unsorted
description: Relax and tidy up 2,880 handcrafted vinyl records. Unpack the warehouse, clean up, and rearrange shelves & decor as you bring new life to a one of a kind record store. Unlock fun abilities and upgrade your skills with the help of your cat. Prepare for Vinyl Freak's grand opening!

title: Qtz
description: A rhythm game where you hit the notes as they reach the sweetspot

title: Kardiya: The Winds of Fate
description: Rogue-lite RPG Dicebuilding game. Roll the dice, choose your companions, organize your gear, explore all of Kardia, and die. Then try again! Try again and again. Experience a different story each time. Until you find The Winds of Fate.

title: Petal and Blade
description: Petal and Blade is a turn-based roguelike deckbuilder featuring four distinct playable characters. Build powerful decks, discover card synergies, adapt your strategy, and overcome challenging battles with each new run.

title: Leaf It Out
description: A cozy leaf and trash removal simulator. Clean up the streets, clear out the ponds, tidy up the place, and relax.

title: Seed to Leaf
description: Connect with Icardia - A world still glowing with hope long after the last light went out. Fight enemies while growing friendships, gather seeds to replant a devastated garden and uncover the mystery of a whole population slowly vanishing.

title: Potions Tidy
description: Clean up, organize your space in this cozy and relaxing game. Pick up potions and objetcs scattered across the floor and freely place them wherever you want across 300 different placement surfaces. With over 4,500 objects, no grid, and no time limits.

title: Relic Restorer
description: In this 2D puzzle game, you play as a cultural relic restorer tasked with mending broken cultural relics.

title: Magus Relics: The Majimono
description: Explore, find the light, unveil the truth. Dive into the secrets of Naivia's history, unearthing the voices once lost, facing the impossible contraptions of the Union, as the seemingly barren land reveals its gems through the use of a mysterious artefact of the past.

title: Shadowlight
description: A turn-based stealth roguelike with classic ASCII graphics where light and shadow decide who lives. Slip through procedurally generated dungeons as a thief who strikes from the dark for triple damage, dodges torch-carrying guards, and loots a manor heist — or dies in the light..

title: Papabile
description: Rome, 1492. The Holy Father is dead. The conclave has been convened. Can you seize the Throne of St. Peter for yourself?

title: The Clown's Forest: Shadows of Blood
description: Set during the events of The Clown's Forest 2: Waking Shadows, join Officer Dragon as he is kidnapped by Chester, and taken to a very familiar location. He isn't the only victim stuck in the forest though. Meet familiar, and unfamiliar faces as you fight to survive, or succumb to your death.

title: Glass Masquerade 4: Constellations - Tarots
description: "Tarots" puzzle set contains 8 new puzzles representing new constellation "Corvus"

title: Corrupted Veil
