description: Corrupted Veil is an old-school FPS that harks back to the classics, while bringing a modern approach to the genre. Trapped in the trenches, face waves of crazed soldiers and uncover dark experiments. Play solo or co-op, and use heavy weapons and mysterious machines to survive.

title: Pixel Planet Survivor
description: Stranded on an infected world, one survivor against a rising tide of alien bugs. A top-down survivors roguelite where every enemy is a single pixel and the whole swarm is on screen... a million of them. Build your loadout, hold the line, reach extraction.

title: Else If: ReCurse
description: Else If: ReCurse blends the finest aspects of grid-based strategy RPGs and turn-based JRPGs into one maddening package. Explore the post-apocalyptic digital hellscapes of Neo-Fantasia while engaging in intense and highly customizable strategic battles to determine the fate of the universe itself.

title: Nex Evo
description: Traverse a dying megacity infected by an alien parasite called the Pulse. Wall-run, grapple, and shift between human precision and monstrous power to survive. Master the vertical city or be consumed by it. The city is changing. So are you.

title: Deunocta
description: In a realm where witchcraft evolved along side technology, a lone marauder, Cassidy Chrome seeks vengeance against a tyrannical demi god who enslaves souls to conquer worlds and prolong his immortality. Cassidy, trained in the black arts fights against undead corrupted entities in a forsaken world.

title: Tkio
description: Pee, scratch, and stab your enemies in a real-time Chrono Trigger-style turn-based combat system where every character can join your party. In this story-rich JRPG, you'll play as Alice as she escapes her troubled past and builds an unlikely family of outcasts.

title: Shadow Princess
description: Shadow Princess is a bullet hell precision game where your goal is to reach the end of each stage and collect crowns.

title: Primitive Shades
description: Explore an abandoned school, solve puzzles, and survive the Shades: living creatures formed from primitive geometric shapes. What begins as a late night exploration becomes a desperate fight to uncover the truth and escape.

title: Calling in the Shadows
description: A multiplayer horror game. Work together to escape the island. Hunt by sound to murder your friends.

title: Dungeons of Ironshade
description: An old-school dungeon crawler inspired by classics like Eye of the Beholder and Dungeon Master.

title: Hearth & Shadow
description: Hearth & Shadow - is a card-based strategy game where you develop your settlement and defend it from monster invasions. Try different combinations, unlock new buildings and outposts, or upgrade them, and monitor your settlement's and defenses to defeat the monsters and save your human settlement!

title: Amnesia Bullet
description: An amnesiac girl fights “Bad Things” in a single-player third-person action shooter. Earn Crown Coins, raise stats, and reclaim lost memories. Clear the story to unlock the true-ending route and mini-games; reach the true ending for a survival endgame. Gyro aiming works with supported controllers.

title: Steel Shadows Arena
description: Steel shadows arena - Top down shooter tank arena game done in a 90s style. Fight AI tanks in 1v1s death match style arenas to unlock levels and Upgrade points.

title: Simian Shakespeare
description: One Bard. Infinite Monkeys. Hire apes to type at random until Shakespeare appears. Starting with a monkey pecking one character at a time, and scales all the way up to hundreds of monkeys hammering away and even a Monkey on your GPU typing millions of characters a second! Will they fill the book?

title: Chalk Paper Scissors
description: A visual novel/sidescroller about estranged childhood friends, Chalk, Paper, and Scissors. Explore each character's memories in different stylized worlds to find out exactly what happened to their shared childhood plushie, Stuffie all those years ago...

title: Silicon Sprint: Data Center Incremental
description: Sweep your cursor through swarms of data packets to turn them into cash, then pour it into racks, GPUs and drones. Keep it cool, keep it powered, and grow your company from one laptop into AGI. Get ready for a Silicon Sprint.

title: Overprint
description: Survive the night shift at a possessed print shop. You pick your tool, clock in at 10 PM, and mow down waves of printer's devils until the morning edition ships at 6 AM. You level up, evolve your arsenal, get PRINTED or get PULPED. A roguelike bullet heaven where ink runs. So should you.

title: Jelly Sprint
description: Guide a wobbly jelly runner across sky-high tracks, squeeze through gates, collect gems, and grow big enough to smash through the finish in a bright PC arcade runner.

title: Dreamer's Wake
description: A stylized third person collectathon set in collapsing dreamscapes. Play as a Haniwa, a Japanese clay figure, and explore surreal worlds to restore them from static.

title: Bet Shop Simulator
description: Run the neighborhood betting shop! Print bet slips, count out change and watch the match with your customers. A goal shakes the whole shop, a losing slip gets a TV smashed. Clean up, decorate, expand.

title: AFKTower
description: A pixel-art idle RPG docked to the edge of your screen. Your hero climbs a 10,000-floor tower while you work: 12-rarity loot, 4 classes, key-gated bosses, a deep forge and a Paragon Constellation. And it keeps earning while it's closed.

title: Barbe-Yeux
description: Barbe-Yeux is a single-player comedic narrative adventure set in a pirate world. Players follow a self-proclaimed legendary captain and his two companions on a treasure hunt, exploring islands, meeting eccentric characters and taking part in story-driven minigames. The game combines absurd humour, dialogue, exploration and party-based combat.

title: Kill All Clankers
description: Kill All Clankers is a fast paced 2D Platformer Rogue-lite with Bullet Heaven and Twin Stick Shooter mechanics. You play as agents of the Prohuman Revolutionary Movement. ​​​Your objective is to survive multiple levels for 30 minutes and free humanity from a tyrannical AI surveillance state.

title: The Residual
description: The Residual is a short, free atmospheric narrative platformer about loneliness, memory, love, and a collapsing world that may or may not be real.

title: Apocalypse Intern
description: Cancel the apocalypse before your first shift ends in this 20-minute workplace comedy about stamps, loopholes, and one terrible cup of coffee.

title: Graffiti Rush
description: Graffiti Rush is a chill, creative multiplayer game where you and your friends can paint the world your way—no pressure, no rules. Grab your spray cans and explore a vibrant open city filled with blank walls, hidden alleys, and rooftop spots waiting for your art.

title: Sinever: First Seal
description: Sinever: The First Seal is a 1-4 player co-op psychological horror game. Explore an isolated Victorian estate, operate paranormal equipment, manage your sanity, and uncover the truth behind its imprisoned entity before the house claims you too.

title: Mendicant Sea
description: Assume command of a five-floor containment facility. Manifest 200 strange PTF species, study their needs, direct staff, and build a live defense line for the moment containment fails—then field your subjects in 1v1 or 3v3 Containment Combat.

title: Ars Moriendi
description: Ars Moriendi is a muddy and tragic tactical RPG set in a war-torn Europe of the late 19th century, where you control the fate of a brother and sister on opposite sides. Raise powerful heroes into martyrs, unleash modern weaponry on a fully-destructible battlefield, seek glory in death.

title: Unglamorous
description: A punishing time-trial racer for dodgy cars and grassroot grit. Race real club-level motorsport disciplines against real or AI opponents on dynamic courses in cars not fit-for-purpose.

title: Sort of Magic
description: A cozy organizing game for 1–4 players in online co-op. You're a little magical cat who knocked over an entire magic school. Now put all 4,500 books, potions, and brooms back exactly where they belong. Learn sorting spells, split the rooms with friends, and restore the mess you made.

title: Neon One-Man Army
description: High-speed neon action! Swing with your grappling gun, blast rogue robots, and stay airborne. Shoot while flying, chain movement and combat, and feel the rush of unstoppable momentum. Choose powerful cards, unlock skill chests, and master your movement to become an unstoppable force.

title: Revolution: 25th Anniversary Collection
description: Celebrating 25 years of hits from UK game development studio Revolution Software, Revolution: The 25th Anniversary Collection contains a slew of Revolution titles as well as collectibles celebrating the team's work.

title: Vinyl Store: Tidy Up!
description: Vinyl Store: Tidy Up! is a cozy single-player simulation where you clean up a messy record store. Sort and place 4,281 vinyl records and CDs, find the best way to organize the store, and compete with other players for the fastest time.

title: Night Stocker
description: Immerse yourself in the neon nostalgia of the 90s! Nightstoker is a cozy organization game where you task yourself with bringing order to a chaotic video and music rental store. Sort through thousands of tapes and listen to retro hits. The pure joy of a perfectly organized shelf.

title: VHS Chaos
description: Thousands of VHS tapes are scattered across a chaotic 1980s video store. Pick them up, sort them onto the right shelves, unlock new abilities, and turn chaos into order. Play solo or with friends, restore the store, and uncover what happened here

title: I Can Smell You from Here
description:
You are an incel going on his first-ever date, with his first-ever match from a dating app.
What could possibly go wrong?

title: Potato.exe: A Game About Spinning a Wheel to Download Potatoes
description: A non-idle, wheel-spinning clicker. Spin the wheel to earn potatoes, you have a 20% chance. Collect potatoes, buy upgrades, increase your odds... Can you win ten times in a row? Pay attention to what's on screen: Hidden stories, extra upgrades, cats, and very sexy potatoes.

title: Super Robo Oh
description: SFC/SNES-style robots fighting game!

title: Petri Party
description: Petri Party is a frantic, physics-driven party platformer where disposable slimes battle it out across a playful laboratory micro-world. Grab a friend (or seventeen), pick your weapon, and dive into fast, high-skill rounds full of grappling, wall-walking and gloriously accidental victories.

title: Nightmare Neighborhood
description: Nightmare Neighborhood is a trick-or-treating roguelike visual novel where you must manage your resources, wear different costumes to double dip houses, all to collect as much candy as you can without getting eaten by the monsters who inhabit the Neighborhood.

title: Death Momotaro
description: This game is a horror-action-comedy based on the old Japanese story "Momotaro".

title: Backrooms Insane
description: Backrooms: Insane is a single-player psychological horror game with a found footage aesthetic. Explore disturbing levels, solve puzzles, find key items, and escape while timers, unpredictable events, and deadly entity hunts turn every objective into a fight for survival.

title: Backrooms Escape
description: Escape the endless Backrooms in a fast-paced endless runner. Keep moving as the path continuously changes, dodge deadly spikes, rolling saws, and other dangerous traps, and react quickly to survive. Run as far as you can, escape the dangers behind you, and challenge your best distance!

title: Vs. Tricky: Clowned Out
description: Tricky Mod is back and swinging hard!! Enjoy this visually recreated from the ground up take on Vs. Tricky. The mod includes full recreations of all 4 phases including some goodies for those who poke around the freeplay!

title: Where Did I Park?
description: You forgot where you parked. Unfortunately, there are 99,999 cars exactly like yours. Search the parking lot, rule out the wrong cars, collect valuables and slowly improve your chances of finding the right one.

title: Arcanefall: Darklands
description: Arcanefall: Darklands is a dark fantasy survivor-like game where you take on the role of a spellcaster fighting to survive endless waves of undead horrors in a cursed, crumbling world.

title: Mushroom Marketplace
description: Run a whimsical mushroom café by day and explore a quiet village by night in this cozy tea-brewing roguelike!

title: Dark Offering
description: Dark Offering is a linear, first-person RPG blended with tactical, card-based combat. Explore a handcrafted world that is filled with loot, puzzles and monstrous creatures.

title: shatAAAAp!
description: Exponentially bigger waves of cute animals require increasingly absurd means of destruction. Shoot, burn, electrocute, explode... and make sure no one ever helps you.

title: Legacy of the Ark: Beneath the Broken Sky
description: Awaken alone at the crash site of a fallen Ark and rebuild from a single handful of scrap. Gather, wake survivors, level them up, send expeditions, chart the deep, and stabilize a broken sky in this cozy, honest idle game. Play at your pace — online or off.

title: Puzzle Cottage
description: A cozy cottage of 16 hand-crafted logic puzzles, fresh every day — solved by pure deduction, never luck. Then pull up a second chair for six hot-seat games, or walk down to the shore and build a harbour town one floor at a time. Daily streaks, a world that grows as you play, 28 languages.

title: Amalgamated
description: A turn-based board game about manipulating a stock market, alone or against up to three others. Observe the trends, gamble, work the market in legal and less legal ways, and cross your fingers that the auditors don't catch you with your hands in the cookie jar.

title: One More Floor
description: One More Floor is a short incremental game. Ride an elevator into the mines, hit the targets to multiply your coins each floor, and cash out before you die. Unlock new mines, collect rare gems, and buy permanent prestige upgrades.

title: Roll for Order: Sort Every Set!
description: A cozy first-person sorting game set in a cluttered 1980s basement. Find thousands of scattered dice, identify their sets and return each one to the correct display. Play solo or in co-op, choose a fantasy class and unlock magical powers that make sorting easier.

title: Dust Rapture
description: Stranded on Route 66 after your truck is stripped for parts, explore the abandoned town of Iron Creek, survive its horrors, evade a murderous cult, and escape before it consumes everything.

title: Sort Labs
description: Sort Labs is a casual, first-person organization simulator with a laboratory experiment theme, daily puzzles and leaderboards, dynamic levels, and all the shape-sorting you could ask for.

title: A Sector Darkly
description: Experience an epic story in this open-world space exploration RPG. Stranded far from home in a region torn apart by war, you must scavenge, research, and craft what you need to survive as you chart a course through dangerous sectors, uncover rival alien agendas, and search for a way home.

title: Dark Bone Prison
description: This is a dungeon-based game full of oppressive atmosphere. You will delve into the maze filled with monsters, collect, combine and upgrade weapons, and fight for a glimmer of hope in the successive waves of attacks.

title: Roselle Hunt
description: Step into the shoes of a bounty hunter in a PvPvE backpack auto-battler. Combine and upgrade gear, obliterate your foes, and... Find Roselle.

title: Sukuji to Teikyou ni Kansuru Kousatsu
description: This work is structured around a full-length novel and consists of exploration of a 3D space, various materials such as images, audio, video, and documents, and questions that require careful consideration.

title: Exit Liquidity
description: You have a few dollars and a hunger for more. Navigate decades of economic booms, tech revolutions, and devastating crashes in this deep turn-based simulation. Will you build a legacy through meticulous analysis, or seize power through hostile takeovers and political shadow-play?

title: Demon Slayer Rome
description: A dark fantasy turn-based RPG. Battle demons and absorb their abilities, uncover secrets and progress in power, and save an Empire lost to sin as you go up against eight demon princes and the hordes of Hades! Demon Slayer Rome is turn-based Mega Man set in the time of the Roman Empire.

title: Night at the Fun Park
description: A horror game set in an abandoned amusement park. Players search for exit keys while avoiding a giant spider, using noise to distract it and freeing captured teammates from cocoons.

title: Deep in the Dark
description: Explore via the Deep in the Dark program and see all there is to see within the multiverse. As you complete research objectives your efforts will be rewarded with hats.

title: Synth Riders: Linkin Park - "One Step Closer"
description: Add Linkin Park - "One Step Closer" to your library!

title: Synth Riders: Linkin Park - "Castle of Glass"
description: Add Linkin Park - "CASTLE OF GLASS" to your library!

title: Synth Riders: Linkin Park - "The Emptiness Machine" (Radio Edit)
description: Add Linkin Park - "The Emptiness Machine" (Radio Edit) to your library!

title: Synth Riders: Linkin Park - "Faint"
description: Add Linkin Park - "Faint" to your library!

title: Synth Riders: Linkin Park - "Battle Symphony"
description: Add Linkin Park - "Battle Symphony" to your library!

title: Synth Riders: Linkin Park - "Breaking the Habit"
description: Add Linkin Park - "Breaking the Habit" to your library!

title: Potato Please
description: A first-person potato peeling game. You have a knife. You have a bucket. You have a mountain of potatoes. Peel them with real physics. Cut thin, waste nothing. Buy better tools. Finish the pile.

title: Motives: The Ultimate Problem
description: The top-ranked detectives and masterminds from six countries have been painstakingly assembled through extravagant detective competitions in order to form the Winner's Square: an elite team of detectives who will have what it takes to solve a world-threatening mystery. But the Winner's Square is not yet complete, as the latest detective competition has yet to conclude. Can the team pull together to solve the ultimate problem?

title: Roll Pick Go!
description: Build a team of pixel monsters in a free-to-play strategy auto battler. Buy, merge, and equip your squad, discover powerful combinations, and turn battles around with unique abilities and ultimates. Can your team reach 10 wins?

title: Daily Life with the Herb Girl
description: A slice-of-life visual novel steeped in Traditional Chinese Medicine. Befriend Linglan, a girl manifested from medicinal herbs, learn herbal properties, and guide her through the modern world. Features Live2D.

title: Sail: Evolved Tides
description: Sail: Evolved Tides is a 3D naval roguelike shooter. Set sail into uncharted waters and survive escalating sea battles as you sink enemy ships and defeat deep-sea bosses. Upgrade your warship and use Soul Essence dropped by bosses to unlock a permanent tech tree. Every voyage makes you stronger.

title: Unknown Passenger 47
description: 47 lives lost. 48 bodies recovered. Identify the victims of a fictional plane crash in this text-based deduction mystery. Cross-reference body records, passenger lists, medical reports, and personal effects to give every person back their name.

title: Rose of Dragontail
description: Kick tail with tail! Enjoy blazing-fast beat-em-up action as Rose, the scrappy fishing village girl turned half-dragon hero. Kick, slam, tail slap, tackle, pile drive, spit fire, and throw whatever and whoever you get your claws on to a groovy surf rock soundtrack.

title: Ghosts and Monsters
description: Survive waves of monsters in this pixel-art action roguelite. Collect organs, artifacts, and relics to build powerful synergies and uncover the mysteries of purgatory.

title: Mercenaries: Recompiled
description: Mercenaries: Recompiled is a recompilation project dedicated to preserving and modernizing Mercenaries: Playground of Destruction, the explosive open-world action game developed by Pandemic Studios.

title: Armorer: Tidy Up the Armory Before Dawn
description:
Armorer: Tidy Up the Armory Before Dawn is a first-person organizing game set in a two-story medieval armory with 50 rooms. Players collect scattered weapons and place them in their assigned racks and displays. Completing rooms awards skill points that unlock abilities to help locate and organize weapons.

The game supports single-player and online multiplayer for up to four players, with cooperative and competitive modes. There is no countdown to failure; dawn arrives when the final piece is in place.

title: Rock and Found
description: Your Grandma has willed you a collection of rocks deep in the woods, but when you arrive, you find that the rocks are strewn across the floor. Armed with your Grandma's journal, a determination to clean the collection, and the tools she left behind, you begin sorting through thousands of rocks.

title: Anomalous Research
description: Anomalous Research is a 2D sci-fi recourse management RPG set in a research base that has become an epicenter for anomalous activity. Where you preform daily tasks, write reports, and explore the base, and encounter strange creatures.

title: No Murders in Grimwick
description: Investigate a murder at Grimwick’s harvest festival in this hand-drawn point-and-click mystery. Question suspicious locals, collect clues, use items, and uncover the truth behind a town that insists there was no murder.

title: Deskrawl: Idle ARPG
description: Grind mobs, farm loot and capture enemies to serve you. Deskrawl is an epic idle ARPG that plays at the bottom of your desktop. Farm legendary items and build overpowered heroes while you work or chill.

title: Giantess Naval Defense
description: Giantess Naval Defense is a “Giant Girl vs. Kaiju Naval Artillery Defense Game” where you control Orca, the only giant beast humanity can rely on, and fight back against hordes of invading kaiju with devastating naval gunfire.

title: Break of Dawn
description:
Break of Dawn is a tower defense deckbuilder played on a hex grid. Players lead a cult holding a portal open against the New Dawn, an army that marches on it in waves. Every card in the deck places a building on the board.

Tower upgrades are paid for in enemies. Kills earn Souls, and wounded enemies dragged alive into a pit earn Sacrifices, which pay for higher ranks, so players have to decide when to stop shooting. From the fourth wave, players choose one of two roads between waves, and each road adds an enemy type to the army for the rest of the act. Two fully upgraded towers of the same kind can be fused into one crowned tower. A full run crosses ten acts and ends in a siege of the Keep. Up to three times a run, losing all ten lives grows the map behind the portal instead of ending the run.

title: Rage Mountain Rally
description: Rocket League and Happy Wheels had a baby, and someone gave it a mountain to climb! Drive, crash, bounce and rage your way to the summit while trying to keep your oversized balls under control.

title: Garbage Incident
description: A short psychological visual novel about a girl, a bag of garbage, and an ordinary evening that takes an unexpected turn

title: SMS 207
description: You’re heading home on a late-night Jeepney down Roxas Boulevard, passing passengers' bayad (payment) to the driver while keeping your head down. But as ominous text messages begin flooding your phone, a quiet commute quickly turns into a desperate negotiation. Someone knows where you are, someone knows what you owe and they’re guiding you toward a destination you never planned to visit.

title: Here Comes the Horde
description: Here Comes the Horde is an auto-battler incremental game where your loyal soldiers fight against hordes of undead enemies led by a formidable necromancer. Earn coins, improve your army, unlock new units, grow stronger, and fill the screen with your troops.

title: Pinecone Grove
description: Pinecone Grove is a cozy farming RPG game with a twist: Instead of optimizing for output & profit, you’ll focus on rebuilding your tree nursery and positively changing the world around you by bringing nature back to life. You'll also solve puzzles, meet quirky characters and experience nice stories!

title: Kill the Thing
description: Kill The Thing is a challenging roguelike turn-based tactical RPG. Keep the corruption under control while searching for its origin. Undertake missions across four distinct regions, targeting key resources, upgrading your base, and building your roster of heroes. For the final confrontation.

title: Chess Folk
description:
ChessFolk is a chess game featuring offline play against hundreds of fictional AI opponents with distinct profiles, playing styles and difficulty levels. Its opponent system combines Maia-2, Stockfish and custom behaviour rules.
Players can compete in Swiss, round-robin and knockout tournaments, track their in-game rating and match history, and practise through guided lessons, opening exploration and game analysis. The game offers 2D and 3D board views, animated battle-style captures, custom time controls, PGN import and export, and local two-player play on one device.

title: Crime Podcast: 1976
description: Thomas Hayes, a 63-year-old FBI special agent, returned home after his last day on the job before retiring. He needs to prepare the documents he keeps at home to turn them over to the FBI, but the evidence he chose to hide many years ago is coming to light again.

title: Money Burner
description: Slice banknotes, smash gold and torch piles of cash in this cartoon first-person incremental game. Earn rewards, upgrade your weapons and break into new rooms. Start with scissors and work your way up to a flamethrower and a massive laser cannon.

title: Grr Grr Gnomes
description: A co-op adventure about tiny gnomes on a very big ocean. Sail from island to island, scavenge for supplies, fight strange creatures, survive whatever goes horribly wrong, and keep your ship moving toward one goal, finding the way home...

title: Crime Podcast: Welcome to the Neighborhood
description: Jesse Turner, a 29-year-old employee of an insurance company, moves to a neighboring state after being assigned to a local branch. As he settles into his new place, he encounters unusual events that soon turn his life into a real nightmare.

title: Emberlost
description: The world went cold a long time ago. One ember remembers the light. A wordless, atmospheric journey through ten chapters - carry the last fire through fog, ruin and silence, and rekindle the Hearths of a world that forgot how to burn.

title: Only Farms
description: Hot days. Dirty secrets. Endless temptation. This summer is about to get hotter than you planned. Take on wild festival challenges, get dangerously close to tempting girls, uncover their hidden desires, and let every choice take you somewhere unexpected.

title: Dark Alley
description: A British detective has vanished in Kyoto. Step into Detective Bennett's shoes and uncover a mystery that reaches far beyond the Yakuza.

title: Cards after Midnight
description: A dark roguelike card adventure where a deadly curse controls the clock. Become a savage werewolf at midnight and a weapon-wielding survivor by day while escaping the villagers hunting you down.

title: King Assassination
description: A fast-paced multiplayer deception game where Guards protect the King and Assassins hunt their target. Work together, deceive your enemies, identify threats, and strike at the perfect moment to claim victory.

title: Spotsanity
description: Spotsanity is a 2D fast-paced, action-platformer about a hunter against a wide amount of adversaries.

title: Pla-toon 2
description: A chaotic, stylized, light-hearted, whimsical, cartoon party-style shooter.

title: Plunder Protocol
description: Plunder Protocol is a unique mix of RTS, MOBA, auto battler and tower defense turned base builder. Designed for players who love strategy but hate micromanagement. Build your base, recruit units, and outsmart opponents with strategy instead of fast clicks.

title: Plague Doctor vs. the Profane
description: Kill a boss. Become it. An isometric hack-and-slash where you carve through plague-born hordes with sweeping claws, a full-auto crossbow and lightning dashes, slip away as a plague rat and take the form of every boss you slay. Every power poisons you. Don't push too far.

title: Project: Taco
description: Your game when it comes to tacos. Play multiple minigames alone or with friends in local multiplayer mode. Catch tacos, set records, battle against each other, or head to the taco power plant and make sure the electricity is flowing. There's plenty to do.

title: Mobsteria: Rise
description: Start with empty pockets and a pickpocket's nerve. Build a criminal empire one racket at a time in this atmospheric pixel-art idle game. Train your skills, run your crew, manage the heat - and when the law closes in, burn it all down and rise again, stronger.

title: Pirates of Perfidy
description: With your hand of pirates, youll need to plan for victory, before theyre stolen, destroyed or crowded out by undesirable crew.

title: Project 117
description: A first-person survival horror game set in a sealed underground facility. Scavenge resources, avoid deadly machines, and uncover buried truths as you fight to escape.

title: Nohmen: Blood Rites
description: Return to your ancestral castle as Kento, a warrior bound by duty, and confront the force corrupting your clan. Battle possessed enemies in fast-paced combat focused on timing, dodges, and counters. Solve puzzles, explore cinematic spaces, and uncover the truth behind the curse threatening all.

title: Beerserker: The Stolen Brew
description: Beerserker is a modern fast-paced arcade game and comical twist. Blinded by the legendary dwarven ale’s taste, Ragna aims to retrieve this masterpiece from the grasp of the gods. Will you be able to make your way through a crowded dwarven brewery? Or end up crushed by their ranks?

title: Topidia: The Last Badge
description: Become the greatest explorer, find the last badges you are missing, and most importantly, be the first to discover Topidia!

title: Blutkapelle
description: Escape from a literal tourist trap in this fast-paced, gothic 2D platformer!

title: Vacuum Pilot 2
description: Vacuum Pilot 2 is a thrilling 2D speedrunning game thats entirely mouse-controlled. Challenge players worldwide for the fastest times, compare your records with friends, and study replays of the best runs to discover new strategies and perfect your skills.

title: Fuu3's Fuun Journey: Redux
description: Fuu3's Fuun Journey Redux is a ground up remake of past-SAGE attendant fuu3's fuun journey legacy edition, taking and expanding the ideas and concepts that made the original game work.

title: Touhou: GensoPanic
description: Fight as Sakuya against the fearsome hordes of yokai plaguing the land of Gensokyo; summon aid from the girls consumed by a mysterious black hole; and acquire items to boost your power—ranging from a cursed hat that enhances your attack to a small flower that continuously poisons your enemies—or, if you prefer, use defensive items to stave off imminent death; the choice is yours to make.

title: Noplace
description: Play as Termina, a young girl who washed up on a mysterious island, and her new friend, Autumn, as they journey through the island to find a way for Termina to get home.

title: Split FPV: Drone Racing
description: Split FPV is a detailed FPV drone control simulator with realistic flight physics and a drone customization system. Here you can learn to fly in a wide variety of flight modes and conditions. Explore the drone's design, experiment with the detailed customization system, and build your own drone.

title: Numiares: A Dark Tale
description: Step into a brutal, early-medieval nightmare. As a Holy Warrior and Shaman, you are the final arbiter between humanity and the ancient horrors of Central European & Nordic mythos. Negotiate treaties with supernatural gods or deliver a bloody verdict. In this brutal world, every choice leaves a scar.

title: Elven Rivers VII: The Crimson Tide
description: Harsh cold lands awaits! Fight, explore and befriend a young kind-hearted mermaid in most thrilling and perilous adventure of your life!

title: Call of Smoking Snakes
description: An intense multiplayer FPS set in World War II. Choose your side — Smoking Snakes or Black Eagles — pick your class, such as infantry, sniper, or bazooka, and fight across varied maps that demand strategy, smart positioning, and teamwork.

title: Chef Bacon
description: Casual restaurant management game in which a tiny piglet cook must feed a forest full of hungry creatures

title: War Asunder
description: A casual deck-building game based on the traditional card game War, but adds new, tactical features like elemental cards, special abilities, and unlockable upgrades.

title: Filo: Something Filamentous
description: Grab, pull, and draw out thin, filamentous structures. Feel each one bend, stretch, and sway, and discover how they react to where and how you pull. Lose yourself in a strange, quiet focus. Beyond the simple repetition, unexpected changes begin to unfold.

title: Cone Punk
description: Cone Punk is a challenging 2D platformer with 3D stop-motion characters, set in a whimsical post-apocalyptic world. Explore unique worlds, solve puzzles, and master precision platforming in this skill-based action-adventure game.

title: Blade Knight
description: Blade Knight is a first-person, dungeon crawler with a simple 2D art style, set in a colorful fantasy world. Attack and dodge your way through rooms of monsters and beasts using the weapons you find along the way. Combat is snappy and easy to learn, but becomes addicting when mastered.

title: Be the Block
description: Be the Block is a Sokoban-inspired 2D puzzle game where you dont just push the blocks, you ARE the blocks. Solve a collection of carefully hand-crafted puzzles that are by design simple yet challenging.

title: Wangzha: Dou Dizhu Roguelike
description: WANGZHA is a roguelike deckbuilder built on Dou Dizhu, the Chinese shedding game (think President or Big Two) where a 2 beats an Ace. Play straights, planes and bombs against landlords who keep raising the rent. Multipliers aren't drawn here, they're grown, one hand at a time.

title: Gnomes Garden: Mask of the Rat King
description: Help the Gnome Queen save the trolls and the Cheese Moon by fighting the Order of the Red Rose and the Rat King!

title: Lost Artifacts: The Ghost of Florence
description: Reveal the mystery of the Ghost of Florence, uncover the conspiracy, and save da Vinci’s inventions!

title: Ballseye
description: A Goofy 2D Nubby-like featuring Monsters, Shooting, Explosions. There are a total of 8 different areas and their contents are procedurally generated each time they are played. The game can be played Solo, but it also supports Multiplayer PVP, Co-op, Level building and sharing.

title: Boss Key
description: One-stop card game development toolbox: visual design, instant testing, AI assistance, and code extensionbuild your own trading card game solo.

title: Debauchery & Magic
description: In Haven, magic thrives and debauchery is strictly forbidden. Defy a ruthless new ruler as you and your friends quest, loot, party, and battle your way across the kingdom to bring freedom back to its people.

title: Folded Fables: Tidy Up The Dragon Hoard
description: Unwind in a relaxing first-person Tidy Up game where you'll sort and arrange 5,648 treasures in a papercraft world. Level up, unlock new skills, and tally every coin. Play solo or tidy up together with friends in online co-op.

title: Corpse Burger
description: Grind humans into tofu burgers, keep your customers hooked, and fight or avoid twisted mutants. Manage your secret meat supply, don't get caught, and deliver the most addictive meals in town.

title: Eternal Towers
description: Build, fight, and adapt as you make your way into the next level in this Roguelite Tower Defense with a splash of action combat and a dash of puzzle mechanics.

title: Over My Dead Booty!
description: You're pirates that died defending your treasure, but you're not going to let a little thing like death stop you from protecting your booty! Gather your crew, place towers, traps and fight beyond your last breath to stop these scallywags from taking your treasure!

title: Unharvest
description: Drain the life from everything around you in this reverse-farming incremental game. Infect all that grows and upgrade your plagues as the land slowly dies. How far can the decay reach?

title: Crack
description: Why is there a giant egg in this lab? Your job is simple: crack it open. Don't ask questions. Crack is a 1-4 player co-op incremental adventure about uncovering what's inside a mysterious giant egg.

title: Paleokin
description: Paleokin is a brutal prehistoric survival game set in an infinite procedural world. Fight mammoths and dinosaurs, build a settlement, farm the land, breed your own dinos, and stay alive. Alone or with friends.

title: Forest Fighters
description: We're proud to announce our first game, a fun and easy-to-learn but hard-to-master arcade puzzle battle. Build megablocks, trigger chains to send ghost blocks at your opponent. Counter incoming attacks with precise timing. 23 characters, each with a unique playstyle. No pay-to-win.

title: Imberite Idle
description: Open chests, collect rare structures, and optimize your build to maximize production in this steampunk idle incremental game.

title: Critical Ward
description: Treat patients, build massive combos, create absurd builds, deploy automated medical infrastructure, and survive the escalating arcade chaos before hospital saturation reaches 100%.

title: Silent Roots
description: Step into the shoes of a detective and investigate a chilling murder that leads to a centuries-old conspiracy. Solve intricate escape room puzzles, uncover hidden clues, and piece together the truth before history repeats itself.

title: Pull Me In
description: Pull Me In is a supernatural life simulation where you build a home, form relationships, pursue strange Purposes and survive a town plagued by ghosts, demons, possession and unexplained phenomena. Live an ordinary life in a place where nothing is ordinary.

title: Sky Paws Awakening
description: Swap between twin cadets Bonnie and Clyde in a handcrafted 16-bit action-adventure made with heart, inspired by retro classics. Master the Twin Tag System, battle monstrous hordes and begin their journey into legend.

title: Faraway Galaxy
description: Faraway Galaxy is a card-based roguelite about a battle-hardened space wolf in a bizarre galaxy, focused on short, intense tactical battles and meaningful decision-making. Fight alien pirates, collect artifacts, and uncover new encounters!

title: Nova Origin
description: Explore, scan, and conquer an unknown world. Deploy rovers, uncover hidden resources, and build a fully automated colony that must survive, adapt, and scale.

title: Nova Slash
description: Play as Veil, a hooded rebel infused with the cataclysmic energy of a collapsed artificial star. Tear through the corrupt mega-nation of Giaath in Nova Slash, an intense action platformer featuring roguelike progression and lethal melee combat.

title: Etherland Saga
description: Etherland Saga is a 2D action RPG with Metroidvania charm in a fantasy pixel art world. Switch between 3 unique heroes on the fly, upgrade their skills, unite divided clans, tame the power of crystals, and uncover the truth behind a cataclysm the world has spent two thousand years trying to forget.

title: Leaving Eden
description: Embark on an action-adventure RPG with pixel-inspired graphics. Play as The Banished Priest, who must explore a shadowy world filled with secrets and powerful enemies to rescue his daughter from eternal fear!

title: The Narrator
description: The developer calls this a point-and-click comedy exploration game. I call it letting strangers into my room to touch everything I own. Apparently you're supposed to explore, be curious and uncover secrets while I react to everything you do. Sounds wonderful. For you.

title: In Vino Veritas
description: Explore a desecrated cathedral to find your missing wife in this psychological horror adventure. Uncover the dark truth behind the Elohim, solve ancient puzzles, and survive a chilling journey where faith and reality collide. The Bible was mistranslated; the truth is much darker

title: Spooky Ride
description: Team up in 1–4 player co-op, hop on your bikes, and ride into a supernatural forest in search of bigfoot. Follow strange clues, survive ghostly encounters, solve co-op puzzles, and try to make it back before your crew becomes another forest legend.

title: Albor
description: Albor is a tactical roguelike dungeon crawler where every run demands a new party. Explore an ever-shifting tower and assemble the ultimate team by combining 8 distinct classes and 8 races, each with unique skills and stats

title: Ivory
description: Ivory is a story-rich, cold weather survival game with cosmic-horror elements. Enjoy the twists and turns of its gripping, dark narrative and rich lore as you explore two open-world locations dripping with psychological terror. Play as a man driven toward his grim fate by cowardice and greed.

title: Zombuffoonery
description: Survive in a bloody hell! Build fortifications, deploy turrets, and fend off waves of zombies. Upgrade with coins, use weapons from a pistol to an axe, and unlock 10 hardcore achievements.

title: Next of Kin: Epiphany
description: Become private detective Dennis Monroe, a relentless investigator driven to catch the infamous "Epiphany Killer," a shadowy figure who has haunted the city for over twenty years. Every clue draws you closer to the truth, but danger lurks behind every revelation.

title: Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer: Holiday Play Edition
description: Play the festive adventure plus King Moonracer’s Kingdom of Misfits in the Holiday Play Edition.

title: Thunder Hoop Collection
description: The adrenaline of 90s coin-ops is reborn! Thunder Hoop Collection unites the cult-classic 2D side-scrolling platformers in one definitive package, bringing the original 1992 masterpiece and its massive 1994 sequel, TH Strikes Back, straight to your screen.

title: Glow in the Shadows
description: This is a first-person exploration puzzle game set in a world of absolute darkness. Armed with a fluorescent spray gun, you must paint your own path and activate hidden mechanisms to progress. Each stroke of light reveals fragments of the forgotten world, guiding you through its mysteries.

title: Cat Meow-tilation
description: Become a U-O alien and gather as many cats as you can to save your home planet! A unique cat-capturing game themed around "Cats" × "Red Light, Green Light"!

title: Quest Dice
description: A book, a d20, a candle. Quest Dice is a solo pen-and-paper in three stories — write your own books and share them on the Workshop.

title: Camp Whittlewood
description: Camp Whittlewood is an old-school horror RPG. You've been dropped off for a weekend of outdoor fun, but soon find bullies are the least of your problems when a twisted campfire story begins to come true.

title: WhoIsHe
description: WhoIsHe is a narrative-driven point-and-click escape room. You play as a young man who was found 7 years after being kidnapped. Now, one year after his return, he wakes up locked in a police detective's office - covered in fresh blood and suffering from severe amnesia. As you solve logic puzzles and dig through old police files, you are forced to face one chilling question: Are you the real Henry Grudge, or a dangerous impostor who stole a missing child's identity?

title: Better Chaos
description: A massive supermarket, over 32,141 products scattered everywhere, and one mission: put it all back in order. Explore every aisle, find where each item belongs, and use powerful abilities to turn this total chaos into a perfectly organized store.

title: Welcome to the Syndicate
description: Rise to infamy through hits, heists, and upheaval as you build and manage your own mob of femme fatales in 1930s NYC. Will you be able to succeed against the odds and fight for those who cannot?

title: Society Chess 3D
description: Society Chess 3D is a multiplayer chess game for up to 32 players. Each player preselects their move, and the most popular move is the one played on their side. The key to victory is to convince your teammates using the chat function to secure the win. An offline mode is also available.

title: Never Enough Corn
description:
Never Enough Corn is an incremental farming game.
Harvest massive amounts of corn and try your luck at finding the 0.00001% rare corn.

title: Silk Collector: Tidy Up the Clothing Store!
description: Silk Collector is a cozy organizing simulator where you shelve 4,012 scattered clothes in a magical fashion house. Shelve the clothes to collect silk, then spend it on spells that speed up the sorting. Keep an eye out for the clothes that wander the store like ghosts.

title: Tilemancer
description:
Tilemancer is a strategy roguelite deckbuilder where every battle plays out like a tactical board puzzle.

Build two parts of your army: a deck of units that determines the soldiers available to you, and a deck of cards that supplements your units. Different unit types, terrain types and card effects interact through simple rules that can combine into increasingly complex situations.

title: Supercar Collection Together
description: Manage your own diecast store with friends! In this 1-4 player collection game, open surprise car packs, build your collection, race against customers, trade cards online, and grow your business together.

title: The Wrong Ones
description: The Wrong Ones is a dialogue-driven social deduction game where players must unmask Skinwalkers hiding in plain sight among innocent townspeople. Stripping away action and visual giveaways, the experience challenges players to rely entirely on logic, active observation, and critical reasoning to catch the monsters through what they say—and what they leave out.

title: Talon Towers
description: The mist parts and towering structures timidly pierce the gloom, ever yearning for the blinding sky. Traverse the remains of a scattered world with versatile and fluid parkour abilites and your trusty scout falcon.

title: Cellar Cleanup Simulator
description: Cellar Cleanup Simulator is a relaxing single-player simulation game where players organize hundreds of bottles in a mysterious cellar, place them on the correct shelves, and restore the collection to its former glory. Completing shelves grants Skill Points that can be used to unlock abilities, while a drunkenness system introduces a balance between increased power and reduced control. The game also features realistic physics based bottle handling, breakable bottles, scoring, and online leaderboards.

title: Football Academy Simulator
description: Football Academy Simulator is a single player sports and management simulation where players build and run their own football academy. Create personalized training programs, develop players across five core attributes, manage equipment and facilities, operate a sports store, and build a squad from the academy’s best talents to compete in the Fantasy League.

title: Allfather
description: A brutal, first-person roguelike with precise, stamina-driven combat. Play as a fallen shieldmaiden who rejects the judgement of the Valkyries. Proving to the gods she deserves their favour, she uses their blessings to crawl from the depths of Helheim to the halls of Valhalla.

title: Elf Shift
description: Only 4 real time days left until Christmas. Flawlessly pack 10,000 toys, unlock new products, and improve your skills to speed up the production line. Deliver the boxes on time, don't get too curious about the weird things happening around you, and most importantly... do not anger Santa.

title: Valenya Online
description: Old-school 2D MMORPG, played in French. Real-time combat, dungeons and raids of four to eight, six professions where crafting takes real time, an auction house in every village and trading companies run by guilds. Free, no daily limits, made by one person.

title: Messa Anomaly
description: Messa Anomaly is a first-person psychological horror game set in an endlessly shifting museum. Observe each corridor, spot unsettling changes, and choose the correct path. One mistake can send you deeper into a night shift that refuses to end.

title: ProtoStar
description: ProtoStar is a 2D platformer inspired by games like Celeste, Super Meat Boy, Sonic the Hedgehog, and NES classics such as Gimmick. It features a pixel art style reminiscent of PC games from the MS-DOS 90s era and music composed primarily in Famitracker chiptune music.

title: Don't Drop the Ball
description: Work together with your friends to keep a beach ball in the air. Punch the ball, pound the ground, or whack your buddies. Whatever you do, don't. drop. the. ball.

title: 101 Cats: Melbourne
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens in the hand-crafted Melbourne landscape. Earn lots of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

title: Cats and Hats
description: Cats and Hats is a cozy roguelike memory deckbuilder (tilebuilder?) where you flip tiles, build combos, and stack wacky hats on a variety of oddly compliant cats.

title: Delightful Adventure 2: Double Demise
description: This is a sequel to Delightful Adventure Enhanced! (you do not need to have played that to play this)

title: Storytime Cats: Meows and Mistletoes
description: Storytime Cats – Meows and Mistletoes invites you into a heartwarming Christmas adventure. Explore cozy, hand-drawn holiday scenes filled with festive cheer as you search for hidden cats tucked away in the magic of the season!

title: FotoMuseo 3D
description: A single-developer personal project. Discover all the hidden secrets in this little 3D Interactive Exploration Adventure. Your task is simple, cross the Earthgate Portal and visit a Photographic EXPO in the FotoMuseo. Collect clues and unlock new areas with your investigations.

title: Keypress Express
description: A cozy desktop train that runs on your keystrokes. The more you type, the farther your hand-drawn locomotive rolls along the bottom of your screen — sell the haul, buy bigger engines and longer trains, and grow a railroad empire while you work. Counts keystrokes only, never what you type.

title: Yapori Dimensões
description: Yapori Dimensions is a single-player action-adventure game set across multiple dimensions.

title: Scraplings
description: A 2D side-view recycling and automation game set above an infinite trash sea. Salvage waste left behind from the Lost Century, process it through advanced production lines, and grow your factory to keep it afloat in this harsh ecosystem while paying your rent on time.

title: Red Sauce: The Leftovers
description:
The tower has fallen, but its remains still stand

Red Sauce is a Fell!AU project that started back in 2021. You play as Ravio Lee, an angsty teenager that works for the now under new management Peppino's Pizza, is forced by his boss to go destroy the ruins of an old tower as they are ruining the already pretty bad view.

title: Sonic Collision
description: Sonic Collision is an evolution on the Sonic Adventure games built around a simple idea of the environment being a tool you use to explore and run throughout stages, almost like it's part of your moves.

title: Candy Clicker
description: Candy Clicker is a cozy candy clicker about big numbers and sweet meta progression: Steam inventory, crafting at the anvil, roulette, gifts, and leaderboards—all in one game you can enjoy for five minutes or a whole evening.

title: Knights vs Aliens
description: Command knights, aliens, and other historically dubious nations in a free real-time tower conquest game rebuilt from a 2009 iPad original. Grow armies, capture towers, and outmaneuver adaptive AI through 30 campaign levels.

title: Paper Baseball
description: Guess the secret number. Beat the AI. A classic Bulls & Cows deduction game with 3 or 4-digit modes, three difficulty levels, and a sharp AI opponent. Simple rules, deep strategy

title: Dozen Chess
description: Dozen Chess is a turn-based strategy roguelike that reinterprets the rules of chess into a modern tactical RPG. Players must utilize limited resources and action points to optimally deploy their pieces, combine unique skills, and overcome a trial consisting of 12 distinct stages.

title: Vexbound
description: Vexbound is a free tactical puzzle-battler RPG where one slide can chain into a storm. Line up troops, raise walls, summon elites and champions, and break the enemy hero across a story campaign, AI duels, private rooms, and ranked online PvP.

title: Ballshit 2D
description: Eggy, an otaku, wakes up one day to find himself transformed into a cute girl?! Ballshit 2D reimagines the original live-action story as a 2D visual novel. Follow Eggy through campus life, friendships, awkward romance, and absurd surprises, with new 2D art, CGs, and the original voice acting.

title: Torbjorn and the Birthday Cake Mishap
Journey TD
description:
Journey TD is a single-player tower defense game with roguelite progression and pixel art graphics. In each run, players draft towers from six elements – Fire, Ice, Storm, Darkness, Poison and the unlockable Astral element – and place them on procedurally generated maps, where the towers form the maze the enemies have to walk through. A builder character walks across the map and constructs every tower. Three identical towers can be merged into a higher rank, and power-up cards drafted during the run strengthen towers and elements. At fixed waves, a DPS arena tests the damage output of the current build.

The game offers three modes (150 waves, 300 waves and endless) and six difficulty levels. Between runs, progress carries over through builder equipment, skill trees, power runes, unlockable skins, achievements and a collection album of tower cards. Runs are ranked on Steam leaderboards. The game is available in English and German at the moment.

title: Goat Simulator 3: Ticket to Dizzyworld
description:
Welcome to Dizzyworld. An immersive goat-themed baa-musement park, letting you reach higher ups and downs than your mood swings.

Did you manage to save the Multiverse AND survive the apocalypse?
Take a well-deserved break and feel the g(oat)-force on the many thrilling rides the park has to offer, turn innocent visitors into baalloons, watch them puke, and trade Dizzy Tokens for sweet rewards.

title: Wild Draw
description: Play cards. Screw over your friends. Then shoot it out. WILD DRAW is a first-person party game for 3–6 players where every round starts at the saloon table and ends in chaos.

title: Honey or Else
description: Honey or Else is an incremental game about bees forced to make honey for their bear captors - while secretly plotting to free their Queen. Plant flowers, hire bees and upgrade the hive. Sweet, sticky, cute and quietly rebellious.

title: Teardown: Rally
description:
A brand-new game mode and we can't wait to get you behind the wheel! Compete in quick races, tournaments and cups with a fresh lineup of speedy Rally Cars and mighty Monster Trucks, each with its own distinct handling. Find your favourite, floor it and try to remember where the brakes are.

Picture 12 players drifting across Frozen Lake, launching off massive jumps in the Quarry and making a spectacular mess of the landing. That's the kind of racing we're here for.

And who says you have to stay in the car? Hop out, wreck your opponents' vehicles and help your team take the win. Overtaking is much easier when the other car isn't going anywhere.

title: Gnomesplosion!
description: Pachinko inspired puzzle game where you fend of invading fantasy creatures by launching your volunteer* constituents.

title: Castle Crew
description: In a vast magical castle, everything has ended up out of place! Sort books, scrolls, runes, and potions, find where each item belongs, and watch as room after room transforms from total chaos into a satisfyingly organized space - on your own or with friends.

title: Of Dice and Minions
description: Of Dice and Minions is a pixel-art dice-rolling auto-battler roguelite developed and published by Foorbytes. Each turn the player rolls five dice, holding and rerolling them in the style of Yahtzee. Every die represents a minion type, and the number rolled determines how many of that minion are summoned. The resulting poker hand grants a bonus, such as extra units, increased damage or health, or sending all five dice into battle, after which the army fights automatically. A run descends 100 floors across ten zones, with a boss every tenth floor whose own dice rolls summon reinforcements, and continues into an Endless mode after the final floor.

title: Solid Boat Adventure
description: Solid Boat Adventure is a co-op adventure game where you and your friends control an odd steamboat delivering curious cargo across treacherous waters.

title: A Corporate Machine
description: A cozy cleaning adventure where you control Sanitron TC-84, a secretly sentient robot vacuum cleaner, navigating the soul-crushing corridors of the giant conglomerate Omega Global. Can a janitorial bot defy its programming, outsmart the evil conglomerate and uncover the mystery of its own existence?

title: QuizLobby
description: Create your quiz lobby here and invite your friends. Choose a format, join using a code, and start playing together right away—featuring colors, country silhouettes, German license plates, and an "imposter" mode.

title: Paint the Moon
description: A relaxing game about painting the entire Moon

title: Acorn: Seed of Resistance
description: Exploration, party building, and against-all-odds heroism in 15-minute roguelike adventures. Shape your rodent companions into a formidable fighting force and unleash them in brutal auto battles to retake your woodland home.

title: Drill Bird: Cursed Mode
description: In Cursed Mode, a demon offers to make your child supremely powerful - but to do so you must be reincarnated into a brand new world filled with new puzzles, enemies and secrets. You’ll find the difficulty has been raised a notch, designed as a natural continuation of the base game.

title: Satisfactory: Core Values
description:
Core Values is the first paid DLC for Satisfactory and a major expansion.

Pioneers will reach into the crust of MASSAGE 2(A-B)b in a different setting with new resources, flora, fauna and more as you develop an underground factory network with new production lines and buildings, uncovering more about the world the deeper you go as you Construct, Automate, Explore & Exploit while continuing to uphold FICSIT's Core Values.

title: Goat Simulator 3: Digital Downgrade
description:
Digital Downgrade DLC brings more remastered goat content than you could ever want!

Remastered garbage:
- Play as Old school Pilgor
- Full Tank armour (MMO)
- Goat Zero skin (GoatZ)
- Space helmet & suit (Waste of Space)
- Masks of Don Pastrami, Valentino Salami, Dolph Spaghetti & Humphrey Ciabatta (Payday)
- Digital Soundtrack
- 3D Printing Files:
- Pilgor
- Tony Shark
- Goat Tower
- Trinket

title: Tiles & Vials
description: A strategic roguelike deckbuilder with tiles instead of cards. Fight enemies by collecting unique tiles and merging them to deal damage or defend yourself. Unleash devastating combos by combining powerful artifacts that radically change your run.

title: Dead by Daylight: Chorus of Sin
description: Step into the world of divine horror in Dead by Daylight's first community-created Chapter: Chorus of Sin. Play as The Judgment, a divine Killer sent to cleanse the world in flame, and Aurora Stardotter, a resolute Survivor leading her people out of the ashes.

title: Beyond the 10th
description: First-person anomaly horror game. Spot what's wrong, advance the levels, survive what's hunting your soul and go Beyond the 10th.

title: Cow
description: The steaks have never been higher! Cow is the one and only fast-paced game about a cow riding a skateboard in a volcano above a pool of lava 🤘. Hop on your deck and milk each level, or become a well-done dinner.

title: Ranger Commando
description: Nostalgic '80s-inspired isometric tactical shooter. Explore randomly generated missions, assassinate officers, free hostages, blow stuff up. No handholding, but easy to pick up!

title: Haley Is Not Alone
description: Haley Is Not Alone is a top down retro survival horror experience. Set right at the beginning of a new breed of apocalypse, you must obtain the keys to your survival. Discover chilling secrets, explore locations hidden from the world and defend yourself from a world gone mad.

title: The Royal Restoration Society
description: Tidy up a cozy castle, solo or with 3 other friends! Queen Zoe has called upon you to clean and redecorate her family home. Put everything in its rightful place, remove dirt and rubbish, and repair banners and rugs. Go at your own speed or try to beat your best time against your friends.

title: Reason & Rhyme
description: Birds of a feather solve puzzles together! An online co-op puzzle adventure for 2 friends (or soon-to-be-friends)

title: Shenaniguns
description: Get stupid & get stupid weapons. Kill your friends to WIN BIG!!!

title: Game Keeper: Somebody Messed Up My Shop!
description: Game Keeper: Somebody Messed Up My Shop! is a single-player organizing game set in a chaotic video game store. Sort 4,290 cases by genre and order, fill 96 racks, progress and unlock powerful abilities, and complete 650 parody-filled series - with questionable help from Jeff, the coolest cat ever.

title: Hino
description: Hino, a girl with a red ribbon, and the white Monimoni Skeleton journey through a world of darkness in this 2D dark fantasy game. Having lost her memory, Hino seeks a safe haven in a land overrun by monsters, uncovering the truth of the dark world as she travels.

title: Cicada Communication
description: A school life-focused RPG brought to you by MF Future. Setting out on his own, the protagonist begins his new dormitory life. Study hard, ace your tests, befriend your classmates, and deepen your relationship with others. Perhaps you may even find a special someone to spend the summer festival with.

title: Fallbearers
description: Fallbearers is a co-op dark-humor simulation where you and a colleague transport the deceased, grappling with volatile ragdoll physics, changing terrain, and pesky obstacles in the Victorian streets. Please ensure the client arrives in one piece (we certainly won't).

title: Mr. Chicken's Totally Ethical Farm
description:
Start with just a single chicken and work your way up to a profitable megafarm by using mechanics such as breeding and automation. Increase farm size and unlock and combine breeds to create the most profitable chicken line to have ever existed. Utilize your eggs in different ways by packaging them up or converting them into other means.
Place machines and feed/medicate your chickens to success, use different stations to maximize your profits and efficiency!

Chickens have varying stats such as Lay Speed, Hunger Rate, etc; breed different genetics to create the ultimate chicken. Make use of different consumables and genetics to maximize your efficiency and then set-up your logistics to synergize

title: The Graves Vigil
description: The Graves Vigil is an atmospheric psychological horror game with point-and-click elements. Alone in the Graves estate, you must survive until five in the morning: spot anomalies, guard your sanity, and keep the house from sinking into darkness.

title: Ability Roulette: Last Round Express
description: Ability Roulette is a turn-based strategy card game for one or two players set aboard the Last Round Express, a night train crossing a stylized late-1920s Britain. Players see the counts of live rounds and blanks in a shared revolver while the order remains hidden, use 15 combinable ability cards, and choose whether to aim at themselves or their opponent. It includes offline single-player play, private online matches with friends, public matchmaking, and cross-platform multiplayer.

title: Desktop Rave
description: Desktop Rave is an audio-reactive desktop companion and idle management game. Use your own music to drive the in-game economy and create your own unique club.

title: Frog is Crime
description: good criminal open world game of 2026. drive cars, commit crime, kill peoples and become crime king in world of humans as frog

title: Disney Dreamlight Valley: Season of Scares
description: The 25th free update for Disney Dreamlight Valley brings new content inspired by Tim Burton's The Nightmare Before Christmas - including Oogie Boogie as a new Villager. It also finished the Grand Exhibition questline, added Decoration Preset code sharing and started both the Haunting Elegance Star Path and the permanent Astronomer's Journey Star Path.

title: Huemon
description: Discover and collect Huemon, and lead your full team into tactical turn-based battles. Journey through a world powered by color, experiment with team compositions, positioning, and synergies to overcome every challenge.

title: Silent Noise: The Park Shift
description:
Silent Noise: Chapter 1 – The Park Shift is a first-person, story-driven psychological horror game. It combines cinematic storytelling, immersive atmosphere, and unique mechanics that challenge both mind and heart.
You play as David, an 18-year-old scarred by tragedy. At age five, his father died from chemical exposure at a factory, leaving David emotionally broken and unable to continue his education. His mother, weakened by grief and illness, depends entirely on him. To support her, David takes a job as a night security guard and caretaker in a park that was abandoned for years but has recently reopened.

title: Stockroom Syndrome
description: Build flatpack furniture and decorate showroom displays during the night shift in a giant Scandinavian furniture store, while demonic creatures hunt you through its ever-changing halls. HØLM. Build the room. Survive the store.

title: Crimson Frontier: Youth
description: This is a visual novel about the future, where every choice shapes the protagonist's character. Follow the path from youth to adulthood, play as a scoundrel or a champion of justice, fall in love, and create your own unique story.

title: Yolk & Yonder
description: Help the hen collect her chicks! Move blocks, press buttons, crawl through pipes, and avoid spikes. But remember: the more babies you rescue, the more massive the mother hen becomes, blocking the passages in the next stages.

title: Warden of the Sunken Keep
description: The sunken Aldermere Keep spews demonic miasma across the valley. Those who linger within it slowly lose their sanity and become monsters. Descend into the keep, find the source, and end the corruption in this retro fantasy turn-based roguelite.

title: Island Treasures
description: Island Treasures: 2D pixel action-adventure.Play as Jack. Slash or throw daggers.Collect gold & Golden Skulls.Find keys & chests for map fragments. Each world ends with escape: saws, monsters, gunboats, magma. Search hidden walls. Grab 1-ups. Score soars! Golden Skull whispers: treasure or death.

title: 101 Dogs Hidden in Orlando
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 dogs in Orlando in the hand-crafted landscape. Earn tons of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

title: Football Manager 27
description: Flow from the tactics board to the touchline in FM27, as foundations evolve to deliver greater control, smoother discovery and a richer footballing world to explore.

title: Ablation
description: A first person puzzle game where you carry one material at a time, and what you take from one surface, you can give to another.

title: Pixel Formation
description: 546 BC. Persia has taken Ionia. Cut off from his fleet, a Phocaean captain lands on the Ligurian coast with thirty oars and a crew that has to eat. Sail an unmapped sea, make camp, and hold the line in battles fought in real time or with autopause.

title: Wild West Simulator
description: Wild west simulator is a sandbox simulation game in the wild west hunt for pelts, dig for oil, manage the mine gather resources , and there is quests managing your colony entails a lot! you can also build your own settlement and develop your own colony.

title: A Game About Digging A Hole Together
description: A minimalist game about digging a hole at the beach, now with friends. Dig together, collect resources, sell them, upgrade your equipment and search for a promised treasure buried deep beneath the sand.

title: Asteroid Mine
description: Command your space mining ship, blast asteroids to gather valuable crystals, and upgrade your cargo and energy capacity to survive longer in the deep void.

title: Red Is Lava
description: In Red Is Lava, every jump counts! Control a color-shifting cube and paint the world as you leap through challenging levels. Touch the platform of the wrong color or the deadly red, and you die. Prepare for intense, precise action with no room for error! Can you survive?

title: IWA Fighting Adventure
description: A feature-packed autobattler where you build and develop your own settlement, gather resources, prepare for battle, and lead your forces on dangerous expeditions and auto-battles.

title: The Suitcase Agents
description: Free to play. A flashy, bizarre competitive TPS built around suitcases. Your suitcase is a shield that blocks bullets, a weapon to slam into enemies, a bomb to throw, and a ride to fly across the battlefield. Some agents' suitcases even spew fire and poison gas. Shoot. Defend. Throw. Fly.

title: Coffee In Space
description: Coffee In Space is a reskin of Freddy In Space from FNAF World, play as Coffee as he attempts to take the spotlight back from FNAF by infiltrating an upcoming FNAF spinoff!

title: Tidy Up the Flower Shop
description: The grand opening is tomorrow, and someone has helpfully unpacked the entire delivery onto the floor. Pick the flowers up an armful at a time, sort them by species into baskets, paint them in patterns, and have the place ready by morning. No timers, nobody watching. A cozy first-person tidy-up.

title: Hold My Wheel
description: HOLD MY WHEEL is a 5-player online co-op action-adventure set in a post-apocalyptic wasteland. You and your idiot twin brothers must visit grandma, living in a bus you can never leave thanks to the collars she put on you. Keep the bus running, fire junk from its roof-mounted Scrap Cannon, lift, flip and throw it with a magnetic gun, and build bridges from scrap. Go hungry too long and you start eyeing your teammates; get bitten or irradiated and you turn into a zombie. Death is not the end: keep playing as a ghost, zombie or floppy ragdoll until a Hell-Kitty restores your human form.

title: Category Connections
description: Category Connections is a chill puzzle game where you sort 3,000 things into 100 categories. No timers, no stress, just a big grid of things for you to organize. Perfect for a rainy afternoon.

title: Kyoufu Yawa: Dai-ni-ya
description: On a rainy night, three ghost stories are told in an old-fashioned café. As a writer for an occult magazine, you listen to three people recount their experiences. A psychological horror visual novel that slowly builds a sense of dread.

title: Iconology
description: Ten years ago, her parents were brutally murdered. Dive into suspects' minds using the Brain Wave Visualization Apparatus—the White Cube. Decode motives and trauma from beautifully twisted mental landscapes to expose them. Your choices warp fate in this art analysis detective thriller visual novel!

title: Experiment Anglerfish: White Hook River
description: Ice skate, ski and dig through the snow in the simulation created from your mind. Survive the darkness and cold within yourself. Collect postcards with personal stories to connect the dots. One of all the people you meet is the real you. Become human again, find yourself at White Hook River.

title: Path Defenders
description: A single-player MMORPG fused with tower defense. Recruit heroes, Build bizarre but devastating towers, and fight beside them in real-time 3D combat against waves of enemies.

title: Click Bait
description: Click Bait is a rhythm roguelite where the worst monsters of the internet finally face justice, requiring you to master the art of timing your clicks around a continuous spinning wheel to defeat these online threats.

title: Backrooms Adventure
description: You were walking home, and then the ground wasn't there. Now it's damp carpet, a hum that never stops, and yellow rooms that go on longer than any building could. Someone came through here before you. Follow what they left behind, solve the puzzle, and find a way out.

title: Backrooms Blocks
description: Mine the walls. Build a shelter. Keep the almond milk. Backrooms Blocks is a first-person voxel survival game filled with strange creatures, tiny clown familiars, dangerous lucky blocks, and doors into impossible places. You were only going to the grocery store.

title: Hasmoh
description: Explore terrifying Backrooms levels alone or with friends in this first-person horror experience. Complete objectives, avoid deadly entities, and search for a way out before the Backrooms consume you.

title: Backrooms Duck Edition
description: You’re a duck stuck in the Backrooms. Explore shifting hallways, find other lost ducks, and search for a way out. Quacking can help you find your flock, but be careful. Something else is out there, and it can hear you.

title: The Word
description: The Word is a Christian word game that recounts the life of Jesus through more than 600 cryptogram puzzles based on Gospel verses. Decode each passage using a revealed word as a clue, adjust the difficulty and play settings, and choose from several Bible translations. Solving puzzles also unlocks traditional artwork depicting moments from Jesus’s life.

title: Project Sakura
description: An unknown outbreak has erased people’s good emotions, turning them into hate-filled Kagebito who can still use their intelligence. Asumi, journeys through a world in chaos to save her friend Yuna.

title: Idle Sushi Bar Tycoon
description: Serve costumers fresh sushi and earn money to improve your restaurants.

title: Mineral Zone
description: Mine resources, automate production, and defend your base from escalating alien attacks. Expand your power grid, unlock new technology, and survive alone or with friends in online co-op.

title: Backrooms: Chase
description: This is a 1v5 fast-paced asymmetric competitive game with the theme of back room. It can play a human who accidentally falls into the back room, collect almond water, avoid monsters, repair generators to escape from the back room, and can also play a terrible monster to kill humans in the hierarchy.

title: United Online
description: United Online is a free-to-play 2D fantasy MMORPG where thousands of players share one persistent world. Choose your race and class, level up, master professions like fishing, mining and crafting, join a clan to conquer fortresses, and fight in duels, tournaments, Battle Rooms and Capture the Flag. Explore cities full of living NPCs with their own stories, take on quests and dungeon bosses, and play on PC, Mac, Linux, Android, iOS or straight from your browser.

title: Spell Code SlingerZ
description: Weave codes and sling spells as a punk Y2K Spell Code Synthesizer in this 2-4 player, couch/online, 2D party brawler. Annihilate the opposition, acquire powerful new Spellcodes, and beat them down again in a first-to-3-wins style tournament.

title: Roguerooms New Management
description: Roguerooms New Management is a BACKROOMS Roguelite game where you go in do jobs and eventually die but come back stronger. The game features Enemies Hazards Multiple backrooms levels and even a Skill Tree and Classes the player can choose.

title: Anomaly Archives
description: Trapped within shifting liminal spaces, you must rely on keen observation to survive. Inspect your surroundings, detect subtle anomalies, and make the right elevator decisions to break the loop and escape.

title: The Final Lane
description: Realistic bowling meets deckbuilding roguelike where the balls are the cards! Draft a synergistic deck of bowling balls, hone your skills, and battle the fellow damned as you climb through Hell for the ultimate prize: a shot at Satan and a chance at redemption.

title: Warframe: The Shadowgrapher
description: Update 42: The Shadowgrapher is a WARFRAME update released on March 25, 2026. This update adds the Follie warframe, a new game mode set in the destroyed Vesper Relay, Awakening quest remaster, new Adversary weapons, addition of Requiem Eterna relics, more items to purchase with Riven Slivers, additional Honorias, as well as more remastered Operator and Drifter faces.

title: Alone in the Backrooms
description: You were just trying to get home. Then you fell into the Backrooms. Explore what lies beyond reality, uncover its secrets, and find a way out.

title: Aberrant Domain: Fog City
description: A short survival-horror game. With only a compass and a fragmented map, scavenge, fight monsters and seek a way out of a fogbound city that should not exist.

title: That Corridor in the Backrooms
description: Descend into the Backrooms. Walk through an infinite yellow corridor. Inspect the doors and try to find a way out.

title: The Infinite Shift: Backrooms
description: The Infinite Shift is a psychological horror exploration game. As a pool cleaner caught in an unending shift, traverse eerie liminal spaces from submerged Poolrooms to Level 0. Solve environmental puzzles, evade lurking entities, and try to escape—before you drown in the depths of the Backrooms.

title: Backrooms: Forget Me Not
description: A co-op horror game set in the Backrooms. Explore shifting levels, complete objectives, and deal with whatever is waiting inside.

title: The Edge of the Backrooms
description: After discovering a strange anomaly on Jupiter's moon, Europa, you find yourself in the outer reaches of a dangerous, uncanny complex.

title: Palmoni
description: Shape the story with your choices in Palmoni! Explore the depths of the Earth and venture into forbidden spiritual realms. Face monstrous creatures, demons... and perhaps even angels. Will you keep your conscience pure, or will your will also be broken?

title: The Pale Sorcerer
description: The Pale Sorcerer is a fast-paced third-person action roguelike. Fight your way through floating island arenas using powerful spells, gather items to create your unique build, and conquer 3 final bosses!

title: Pawnie: Focus Pals
description: Pawnie: Focus Pals is a virtual pet desktop companion built around a mutual care bond that helps you stay productive.

title: Praise Be Evangeline
description:
