Praise Be Evangeline is a horror yandere visual novel, play as Saintess Evangeline and her ever-loving knight Therion to bring joy back to the realm, one smile at a time.

Once upon a time, in a kingdom weary of war and hunger, there was a little girl who dreamed of becoming a Saintess.

For a hundred years, the holy seat sat empty. Then, at last, the light chose her.

She walks among the suffering and lifts their grief away with her own two hands. Villages that once wept now greet her with smiles. Clerics bless her name in the halls, and even the far eastern provinces have heard of her miracles.

And, oh, of course. every Saintess needs a knight.

Someone who swears his whole life to her, which is rather more than the oath asks for. He guards her door through the night and counts her every breath, so that not a single one goes missing. Isn't that so very romantic?

Together they will travel the kingdom, soul by soul, until there is not a tear left to fall.

Surely that is the happiest ending of all!

title: Wizard Harder or Get Laid Off
description: An evil baron poisoned the king's mind in the kingdom you hail from, convincing him that enchanted objects in the hands of simple goblins meant he could reduce headcount - that means you. Explore this new town, complete quests, fight goblins, and increase your power to gain the favor of the king.

title: Keycap Keycap!
description: Enjoy the satisfying click of every keycap! Collect a variety of keycaps, upgrade your skills, and acquire powerful Relic Keycaps. Keycap Keycap! is a short and satisfying incremental ASMR game.

title: Warfare 1776
description: The Warfare series returns, now in 1776. Choose the Continental Army or the British Empire and fight a real-time tug-of-war across the American Revolution. Command infantry, cavalry, and cannon through line battles and a living campaign of fog, fatigue, and turning seasons.

title: Raw Egg Peeling
description: A relaxing game about peeling an egg.

title: Way of the Hunter 2: Lodge Decoration
LitGirls: Bookbound Dungeons
description: LitGirls: Bookbound Dungeons is a dungeon-crawler RPG where classic literature meets anime Girls! Assemble a party inspired by legendary characters such as Alice, Juliet, Dante, and Raven, then lead them into treacherous dungeons crawling with monsters, traps, treasure, and otherworldly horrors.

title: Battle Nap
description: Battle Nap is a procedural roguelite twin-stick shooter developed by 1050 Studio. A dad dozes off on a lake floatie and wakes up in a subconscious warzone. Armed with two swappable weapons and a choice of floatie-based dodge mechanics, he must fight his way through 4 dream worlds, full of bizarre creatures and bosses. The arsenal of 15 weapons, stackable perk system, procedurally generated levels, and both temporary and permanent upgrades make every run different, balancing moment-to-moment action chaos with meaningful progression.

title: The Emperor Penguin Incident
description: "All Antarctic researchers dead. Cause of death: Emperor Penguin attack?" Log into the isolated 'Amundsen-4' server. Extract and combine [keywords] from fragmented emails, chats, and logs to uncover the truth behind the bizarre disaster.

title: Parallel Park
description:
Parallel Park is an action game about time travel and parking cars. Each time you successfully park, time rewinds and another car is added to the map. Fill the map with cars as you cleverly dodge all your past selves and unravel a story about a future that's in danger of never happening.

Competitive multiplayer allows you to out-park your friends - adding more and more cars to the map as you go.

A built in level editor allows you to make custom levels too, and play the creations of others.

title: Motel 51: Papers, Keys & Aliens
description: Motel 51 is a story-driven desk and motel management game set beside Area 51. Players inspect IDs and alien transit permits, decide who receives a key, and match unusual guests to rooms. Between shifts, they review the ledger, repair damage and choose upgrades while trying to repay the motel’s bank debt.

title: Totally Normal Cat Shelter
description: In this cozy horror adventure you take over an old abandoned cat shelter. Take care of the cat's needs, discover their traits and find them fitting homes. Stick to this simple job, or start to snoop around the shelter and learn how to endorse a cat's unique traits to help you solve the riddles.

title: Fart Together
description: Fart Together is a physics-based parkour game where 1–4 players steer the same boat using fart power. Play alone or with friends and coordinate your direction, timing, and gas power to overcome challenging obstacle courses.

title: Swaggerfall
description: Swaggerfall is a first-person open world fantasy RPG that plays in the terminal. The graphics are ascii based and limited to what the command line offers. Playable with keyboard or gamepad.

title: Age of Harvest
description: Age of Harvest is a deep 2D simulation traditional roguelike. Explore a living world, manage your body and wounds, and survive an ever-changing world as you uncover its mysteries and bring about the true Age of Harvest.

title: The Boo Club
description: A 1–4 player co-op horror-comedy about amateur ghost hunters with terrible ideas. Complete rituals, unleash ridiculous gear, and mess with your friends. Gain superpowers, take flight, and fight Satan himself. Teamwork gets the job done. Taking all the glory is tempting.

title: DiscPods
description: Fly your DiscPod robot and compete by being the ultimate and only winner of the arena! PvP your way to the championship!

title: Toby's Carrot Patch
description: Toby the rabbit hops across your desktop, digging up carrots on top of your open windows. A cozy idle miner who keeps you company while you work — upgrade, collect, and dress him up at your own gentle pace. No combat, no pressure.

title: You Weren't Invited
description: Investigate a murder. Romance five women. But trust carefully: one of them is the killer.

title: Ornate Machina: The Thousand Trials
description: Ornate Machina: The Thousand Trials is a 2D puzzle game where you play as a stealthy infiltrator. Solve intricate mechanisms, test your logic, and navigate the secret trials of the Ministry of Mechanical Works to reach the final goal!

title: Dial Z to Zombie: Zombies Attack the Beach
description: Dial Z to Zombie is a retro-inspired old-school FPS where zombies have invaded the beach. Use ridiculous weapons, rescue survivors, discover secrets, and blast your way through a weird ’90s-inspired zombie apocalypse.

title: Lawnmower Game Horrorland
description: Lawnmower series are back. Collect skulls in different apocalyptic levels. Try to find all skulls under limited time and avoid zombies in this horror driving simulation

title: Smoke.exe
description: One cigarette is all the time you get to break in. Lay out nodes, wire them into an auto-hacking routine, then light it and let it run. A cyber-noir roguelite about how deep you can get before the smoke runs out.

title: Mortarot
description: Mortarot is a single-player push-your-luck card roguelike in which the player faces Death using her Tarot deck. Players reveal cards and decide whether to bank their gains or continue risking them while progressing through twelve circles. Major Arcana, amulets and relics change the rules of each run.

title: ChronoRewind: The Great Ritual
description: A strategic idle game where you, the Archmage-General, must channel mana into the Great Ritual, while fierce enemies assault the Kingdom. Will you balance defense, magical development, mage recruitment and ritual channeling well enough to save the Kingdom or will you lead it to its doom?

title: SnowFlow
description: Physics-based snowboarding with incremental progression where Flow is what you farm. Learn and collect tricks with a unique, accessible control system. Complete missions, upgrade your rider, and unlock terrain features, scenarios, and gear as you develop your own style.

title: Breaking Point: Operation Exodus
description: It’s an exciting first-person shooting game where you lead an elite squad against a devastating alien invasion. Defend iconic cities, infiltrate secret bases, and discover hidden secrets. With stunning graphics, fight for the survival of humanity.

title: Medieval War Simulator RTS
description: A dynamic RTS game where you command diverse units and build strategic bases to conquer enemies. Manage resources, engage in intense battles, and adapt to multiple game modes including endless zombie waves. Utilize fog of war, a mini-map,the swamp terrain to dominate the battlefield.

title: The Curse of Beatriz
description: Your parents are out celebrating their wedding anniversary. Alone at home, you decide to test the legend of Beatriz, a spirit that haunts those who summon her in front of the bathroom mirror. What seemed like just a joke soon turns into a terrifying nightmare.

title: 007 First Light: Extended Operations
description: Adds new activity “Valhalla Protocol,” new operation “Jungle Heist,” new weapons and outfits, New Game Plus, Photo Mode, and more

title: Go Dub Yourself!
description:
Go Dub Yourself! is an interactive party game where players re-voice video clips using on-screen timing markers. Players can play straight, go off-script, or improvise, with flexible scoring options including auto-scoring, player judging, and chat voting. Key features include an integrated voice changer with 18 choices, party tournaments, a dedicated Studio mode, dark mode, and Steam achievements.

Using the Clip Studio tool, users can import any video, set timing lines, assign characters, and convert clips into playable dubbing packs. Content can be exported locally or uploaded directly to the Steam Workshop. The game supports local co-op for up to 8 players on a single machine and online multiplayer for up to 12 players via simple room codes with built-in voice chat.

The game includes no pre-packaged copyrighted media; players are responsible for supplying their own video files and ensuring they have the rights to any content they import or share.

title: Muster
description: A roguelite autobattler where every dig shapes your next fight. Build, equip, and position a five-digger warband from eight roles, then watch your plan play out in automatic real-time hex battles. Read the buried grid to uncover recruits and loot—or wake a pocket of monsters.

title: Hephaestus Protocol
description: Hephaestus Protocol is a mythology centric Bullet Heaven Action Roguelike where players forge weapons mid-battle, and carve through endless waves of enemies, including mythical beasts, as well as the Gods themselves.

title: Bad Dogs
description: High-speed highway racing meets classic arcade madness. Drift through branching neon routes, survive dynamic roadblock mini-games, and compete across 5 endless arcade titles, weekly world events, and custom seeded runs. Will you ignite the revolution or sell out to the Syndicate?

title: Text Battle Royale
description: Step into the Ultimate Type and Death Fight! in Text Battle Royale, an online multiplayer game where you test your typing skills against players in a unique battle royale experience.

title: Blood & Canvas: Bareknuckle Boxing
description: Rise from illegal underground bouts to bareknuckle champion in a single-player boxing career where damage carries from fight to fight and can bring your career to an early end. Fight, upgrade your gym, climb the rankings, and see how far you can make it.

title: Zero Parades: Director's Cut
description: From the creators of Disco Elysium comes Zero Parades - the acclaimed espionage RPG, now expanded with the Director’s Cut. You're a brilliant but tormented operant on one final desperate assignment. Prove yourself on the world stage - or blow it all up again.

title: Reikoneo: Purge Protocol
description: Reikoneo: Purge Protocol is a third person shooter with light fighting game mechanics and a linear PS2 style campaign. Follow the story of Nyx, an android with the memories of a human. Shoot, punch, kick, disarm and stun your way through a cyberpunk anime city.

title: Plot Armor
description: Plot Armor is a turn-based RPG / visual novel combo in which your narrative choices in the latter affect your characters’ performance in the former. Characters who are involved in juicy storylines receive combat buffs to reduce their chances of dying, and characters who are neglected narratively are vulnerable to being killed off in battles.

title: Myrridon
description: The land of Myrridon awaits: a living, text-driven fantasy world inside a modern graphical client. Set out from castle Steepmarch into human-voiced quests, RNG dungeons, raids, and a sprawling Mastery Tree. Fully playable by screen reader. Read the world, type your intent, and go deeper.

title: Celestial Peak
description: Celestial Peak is a free-to-play anime-style action MMORPG set in a mythic Japan. Starting in Kazemura Village, players climb from cherry blossom fields through cedar forests, volcanic slopes and a sea of clouds toward the summit, where the seal binding Enma-Oni, the Lord of the Crimson Inferno, is breaking. Combat is real-time and skill-based, built around manual aiming, timed perfect parries, skill chaining and a Spirit Gauge that unleashes each class's ultimate skill. Players choose between three base weapons (katana, bow or staff) and branch into a tree of 93 classes across 100 levels. The game features 15 open regions, 7 dungeons with timed rankings, hourly open-world colossal bosses, parties of up to 5, guilds, a PvP arena, crafting, a player market, mounts and Kosei companion spirits.

title: The Bleakest Keep 2
description: The kingdom has been taken over by darkness once again. Hack your way through the keep, blast away your foes, or dropkick a vampire in this action-packed, dark fantasy roguelike. Edward and Juliet return in The Bleakest Keep 2!

title: Abyss: The Last Night of the Titania
description: You wake in Cabin 47, nine decks below the boat deck of a sinking liner. Abyss is a first-person horror escape game: every deck floods on its own clock and has its own monster, and the Captain follows you all the way up. Get caught and you start again from the bottom.

title: Tick & Tired
description: Tick & Tired is an incremental game about overcoming your to-do list. Complete short desktop tasks like sorting emails and organizing files, hire interns to automate the work and get massive combos at the end of the day to upgrade your workflow in a skill tree.

title: Beta Bar
description: Beta Bar sends you and your friends partying on 4 floors of bars and an active dance floor. Talk to the ladies to build your confidence and be ready to swing back when one of your friends throws a punch. If things get serious, grab a drink and make sure you're the last man standing.

title: Connected Hearts: Vanished Beauty - Collector's Edition
Please Be Funny
description: A kinetic visual novel about a clown named Clara who struggles with her emotions. Under 1000 words long.

title: Ghost Node
description: Play as a freelance hacker breaking into high-security facilities to steal corporate secrets in this stealth game. Use your drone to scout ahead, hack and rewire systems to slip past security, grab the data and get out unseen.

title: The Sundered Anvil
description: A party of greenhorn adventurers acquires a contract to retrieve an anvil stolen from a remote village, only to discover the job is more than they bargained for.

title: Possessed By Fate
description: After a ghost takes her apartment, a ghost hunter becomes the hunted—with her body the prize. This yuri visual novel is fully voiced and around 20k words long.

title: Ghost'Inn
description: GHOST'INN is a coop game up to 4 players , in which you go fishing for ghost in a charming breton style inn. Flush out spirit, capture them with your fishing rod and become rich !

title: Towers of Babble
description: Towers of Babble is a tower defense game where you play words to create towers with powerful synergies.

title: Florana Defense
description: Incremental Mazing Tower Defense game where you do not loose anything, just earn more and more gold to buy towers, mobs and upgrades to earn more gold.

title: Zaploopa 4040
description: Zaploopa is a post-apocalyptic dark humor competition game show. Set in 4040, in space. You are the contestants. An online 3D party game for up to 8 players: complete outrageous fill-in-the-blank sentences, vote for the funniest, sabotage your rivals with jokers. No place for snowflakes here.

title: Deal Flipper
description: Buy low, sell high. Master the art of the deal. Deal Flipper is a first-person flipping sim where you scour an online marketplace, haggle with sellers in real-time chat, and resell for profit. Every trader plays differently. Read them, outdeal them, and build your empire.

title: Urbanism
description: Explore abandoned environments, complete objectives, and survive an entity you cannot see with your own eyes. Your only advantage is a video camera that reveals what is hunting you.

title: Everybody Loves a Good Hole
description: Everybody Loves a Good Hole is a short, satisfying incremental about steering a black hole and swallowing everything in sight. Devour colorful cubes for XP and coins, grow bigger, and pour it all into a deep upgrade tree. Bigger cubes, wilder chaos, just one more run.

title: Overflow Protocol
description: A number-merging incremental game where you build a lab to push numbers higher and uncover the God Number. Generate and merge matching numbers, upgrade and automate your machines, and discover how far numbers can go.

title: StageStar
description: Create your dream artist, build a fanbase, release music, and shape your career in a world full of drama, competition, and surprises.

title: Level 9
description: You are trapped in a sterile and endless facility with no memory of what happened. Check your photo. Observe carefully. Follow the rules. Get out, and learn the truth.

title: Chess Army
description: Build your army, merge your units, and dominate the battlefield in a chess-inspired turn-based strategy game.

title: Where It Happened
description: You wake up to find yourself standing before an old house. The painful memories buried deep within your heart suddenly return. You don’t remember it well, but you used to live here. This is where it happened.

title: AeroBloom
description: AeroBloom is a single-player first-person action game set in a coastal city. Players throw bouncing discs to destroy the environment block by block, earn credits, buy upgrades, and unlock powers. The city includes parkour challenges, areas to explore, a tornado flight ability, and nighttime fireworks. Casino Brisa offers blackjack, roulette, and other minigames using currency earned in the game, with no real-money gambling.

title: Theoria: A God Simulator
description: A Godsimulator without limits. Throw buildings with your bare hand, burn nations down with meteors, or possess a peasant and walk through the war you started.

title: Spellchainer
description: Combine spells into a devastating chain and watch them wreak havoc on your foes. Unlock and upgrade spells, modify them with gemstones, and become unstoppable in this roguelike auto-battler with endless builds.

title: Empyrean League: Hex Tactics
description: Sports management meets tactical combat. Manage a roster of unique fighters, navigate player relationships, and deploy powerful tactical abilities in intense 5v5 battles. Rise through the leagues as you manage morale, fatigue, and transfers on your quest to conquer the Empyrean League

title: My Cat Scattered Games: Tidy Videogame Supermarket
description: My Cat Scattered Games is a cozy single-player organizing simulator. Put 5,798 games and consoles back on the shelves, restore your video game store, and free your mischievous cat from the claw machine!

title: All Rats on Deck
description: All Rats on Deck is an online co-op adventure game where you must navigate a paddle steam boat through dangerous waters. Forced to leave your home, you must work together to operate the boat, scour for resources, and overcome obstacles to reach the ocean.

title: That Which Remains
description: 1-4 player sci-fi ghost-hunting horror extraction sim with proximity voice chat. Travel across time to extract resources, identify and capture hostile entities as fuel for a supposed future utopia. Speak to entities using your voice, upgrade your prison, craft tools, and meet a rising daily quota.

title: The Wokest
description: You just want a job. Instead, you're trapped in an endless office. Solve puzzles, follow the rules, and reach the 10th floor. Don't anger the anomalies. If one snaps, run.

title: Cross Contamination
description: Cross Contamination is a fast-paced melee beat-em-up inspired by old school early playstation era classics, take control of the Half-Mutant Lucan Cross to clear the city of all of the disgusting mutants infecting it and attempt to find a cure!

title: Lan House Simulator
description: Lan House Simulator is a simulation game that attempts to recreate the chaos of Brazilian LAN houses in the 2000s. Here, you must manage your LAN center, organize tournaments, set up workstations, and deal with customers, featuring various management mechanics and mini-games that turn everything into total chaos.

title: Project Sun
description:
A 3D collect-a-thon where you play as Soliana, the new magical girl in the city. As a Magical Girl its your job to help the people around the city.
The city contains tons of collectables and plenty of enemies to clean up.

title: Sonic Nocturnal
description:
You're stuck in a world where the night never ends and a dangerous foe controls Eggman's robots and even Sonic's friends. Fight your way through enemies, protect the city, save your friends and bring back the light into the world.

This game is a turn based RPG that tells its story through visual novel style cutscenes.

title: 101 Dogs Hidden in Antalya
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 dogs in Antalya in the hand-crafted landscape. Earn tons of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

title: 101 Dogs Hidden in Thailand
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 dogs in Thailand in the hand-crafted landscape. Earn tons of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

title: Chair Chase
description: Chase the chair before someone steals your seat! Chair Chase is a chaotic 2-8 player online party game set in a big house full of living chairs that do not want to be sat on. They run, hide and parkour away from you, and they panic more the closer you get. Catch one, then win a quick balance fight while everyone else tries to knock you off. Grab jetpacks and glue guns between rounds to chase chairs and stop your friends. Seven rounds, most points wins. Play in private lobbies with friends or join public matches.

title: Sonic the Hedgehog RPG: The Fastest Thing Alive
description: The sixth episode in the Sonic the Hedgehog RPG series.

title: Game About Botting in an MMORPG
description: Idle Incremental MMORPG Simulator where you start grinding manually, then gradually unlock Bot Modules until the game plays itself. Setup combat behavior and farming routes to find the most optimal configuration.

title: To Raise a King
description: Rule a kingdom and prepare your heir in this fully voiced, free medieval strategy game. Choose one of six queen storylines and make decisions that lead to many different possible endings.

title: Cultist
description: Cultist is card game about begining of the religions and the way they grow, interact and even become immortal. Can you outgrow the world that contains yourself and become much bigger?

title: Amanda's Magic Book 16: The Dragon Chronicle
Dead Position
description:
Dead Position is a chess roguelike. Each round is a fresh game of chess against an engine on a 3D board: the player has ten moves and three take-backs to reach a score target, and every move scores chips × mult, from quiet moves through captures, checks, forks, pins, skewers and discovered attacks up to checkmate. Chaining tactics builds a streak that raises the mult of the next move.

Between rounds, players buy Gambits, passive cards that alter scoring and in some cases the rules of chess, along with study packs and card editions. The opponent, the Host, alters the board with Blaze and Frost events, and each ante ends with a boss lieutenant who imposes a special rule. A run consists of four antes of four rounds, and lost pieces stay lost unless bought back in the shop.

The game also includes free play against four engine levels, tutorial lessons and a Blitz mode played against the clock.

title: 101 Cats: Lisbon
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens in the hand-crafted Lisbon landscape. Earn lots of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

title: Midnight Flare
description: Midnight Flare is a multi episode point-and-click puzzle adventure. In this demo you explore a house in a town drowned in an eerie red glow, rummaging through objects, unlocking mechanisms, and dealing with strange characters. Can you solve the mystery of this strange house?

title: Mile Zero Anomaly
description: Car breakdown, deserted road, the dead of night. The only option is to follow the signs to the gas station. But on this last mile, not everything is as it seems.

title: C.R. League
description: Find your way through the weekly league!​ Climb to the top of the groups phase and dominate the elimination phase to win the grand prize! Explore the city, find the strongest Mutals, level up your ranger and show up for the official match in time!

title: BrokenLore: Miki-chan
description: A first-person psychological horror game set in a Japanese high school. Meet Miki-chan, your personal virtual assistant, and survive a nightmare where jealousy and obsession distort reality.

title: Break, Then Upgrade
description: A simple incremental game. Fire barrages at floating debris on the ocean floor, grab the loot, and upgrade!!!

title: Signal Veil
description: Aki Mizuno is a teenager who, after her mother’s disappearance, inherits a phone that vibrates and emits sounds in the presence of entities marked by deep emotional wounds, becoming her only guide within a haunted school, in a journey of classic survival horror rooted in psychological terror.

title: Riria
description:
A 3rd person action adventure blending parkour and combat!
Play as Riria, She's on a mission to uncover secrets of malicious organizations. Traverse the city skyline using Heat powers to defeat enemies in Her path!

title: Neverness to Everness: For Whom the Verses Mourn
description: Version 1.4 of Neverness to Everness, which includes: • New Characters: Blackbird and Akane Rin • New Main Story Chapter • New area: Pukaland • New events and game modes • ...and more!

title: Adrenaline Rush
description: Boost through STAGES and beat people's asses. Tension rises, but so does your Adrenaline.

title: Balls to the Walls
description: A short incremental physics game about upgrading and annihilating your balls. Equip chaotic special balls and buy physics-altering upgrades to break the simulation and get rich.

title: Godzilla vs. Sonic: First Encounter
description: Godzilla vs. Sonic: First Encounter is a 2D action game that takes place in Japan. Demolish everything in sight and fire off Heat Rays as Godzilla in miniature rage rooms. Reach breakneck speeds and use the environment to blast off as Sonic in sprawling obstacle courses. Make the creatures throw down in world-shattering combat against robots, monsters, entire landmasses, and especially each other

title: Warpspeeders
description: Warpspeeders is a 2D platformer where you run through small, enclosed stages and cover as much distance as possible! You control Sidus, an anthropomorphic star who leaves behind a trail everywhere he moves, and touching the trail will lose you a life! Go for a high distance or meet the distance requirements as quickly as possible!

title: Creepy Horrors: Blood Cult 2
description: Build a roster of Creepy Horrors in this spooky occult creature-collector RPG. Crawl through crypts collecting cursed curios and ingredients, combining them to summon adorable Horrors, wielding them in strategic 3v3 battles against rival sects. The Crypts are calling. Will you answer?

title: Oops, No Floor!
description: Bring your own floor in a chaotic co-op platformer for 1–4 players. Carry, throw and place floor panels, spring over gaps, dodge factory machinery and a claw-armed robot, and pull your friends out of trouble before the clock runs out.

title: Farhaven
description: Build a shared magical town with the people who matter most. A cozy co-op sandbox RPG for up to 16 players, where every crop planted, secret found, and friendship made benefits your whole group.

title: My Little Ranch
description: A cozy horse ranch that lives on your desktop while you work, or in full screen when you don't. Feed your horses, send them running together, race for coins, hire ranch hands and grow your ranch.

title: Astrophobia
description: A PSX-style cosmic horror game where a classified mission to study alien architecture on the Moon leads two astronauts into the ruins of an ancient civilization that predates humanity.

title: Water Drop Brick Breaker
description: A fresh take on the classic brick breaker! Control a water drop ball through 1000 levels of exciting challenges. Packed with power-ups, cool skins, and constellation-themed stages — every round brings something new. Free to play, easy to relax.

title: Block Wars: Falling Duel
description: A competitive falling-block puzzle game with online PvP, tactical line clearing, boosters, stone blocks, lightning symbols, and fast 1v1 matches.

title: Triogram
description:
Triogram is a cosy puzzle game where three flat Nonogram grids come together to reveal a 3D object. Use the number clues to work out its front, top and side silhouettes and watch the model take shape.

There are 480 puzzles across four worlds, arranged into 40 collections of 12. Start with small, straightforward objects and work your way towards intricate sculptures.

Three views, one object. Solve the front, top and side grids for each puzzle, meaning 1440 grids in total!

Watch it take shape. The 3D preview changes as you fill the grids.

title: RhyTime!
description: A Simple Rhythm Game.

title: Blade Man's Less Successful Business Ventures
description: A fast-paced action platformer with short- and long-ranged combat featuring a variety of movement and combat options fit for dealing with various complicated situations, such as all of a sudden getting attacked by your business partners!

title: Modice
description: Modice is a dice-building roguelike. Socket gems into five dice, combine sets, and turn high scores into steps. Choose where to land, build and upgrade along the board, and grow your combos to reach the finish before you run out of rolls.

title: ShadowComm. Associate Studio: Enterprise Edition
description: ShadowComm. Associate Studio: Enterprise Edition is the premier virtual loadout management and photography suite, built for the modern ultracorporate woman.

title: Psi Break
description: Uncover the dark truth of a ruined lunar colony in this isometric survival horror. As an amnesiac prisoner, wield devastating elemental powers to battle mutated horrors and solve puzzles. But beware: power comes at a cost. Manage your Sanity to survive, or let the madness consume you.

title: Conker's Bad Fur Day: Reloaded
description: Conker's Bad Fur Day: Reloaded statically recompiled with N64Recomp into a real Windows (and Linux) program, so it runs at full speed with modern graphics, widescreen, and proper mouse and controller support.

title: Aegis of Kings
description: Lead your kingdom to victory in this sandbox grand strategy RPG. Command heroes and monsters, capture castles, and customize your forces to your needs. Fight for the Aegis solo, join friends in co-op, or face rivals head-to-head.

title: Hot Wheels Infinite Rush: Vehicle Pass
description: Keep the race alive with the Hot Wheels Infinite Rush - Vehicle Pass and add 44 vehicles to your collection, including some fan-favorites from the Acceleracers and Highway 35!

title: Dorifto!
description: Push your car to the limit of grip and chase perfect lap times on winding back roads where drifting isn't just a technique, it's the only way to drive!

title: SMS Returns
description: The official remake of the 2012 viral hit Slenderman's Shadow is out! A faceless, slender man hunts you across your favourite maps. Survive with friends in multiplayer, immerse yourself in VR, and build your own terrifying maps with the in-game editor. He is ready. Are you?

title: Spaghetti Celesti
description: A falling block puzzle game, made in 7 days for Falling Block Jam 2026. Combine strands of pasta with garnishes before the hunger bar depletes for a high score.

title: 1Boss1Battle1Button
description: In this game you will find yourself enduring against 3 phases of a rhythmic bossfight, each set to a blood pumpin' beat. Your only means of defense is a single button. Holding it will allow you crouch and remain stationary, and letting go will give you a brief, nostalgic wind as you ascend.

title: Tide of the Depths
description: Build a team of mighty sea creatures in a lane-based tower defense where the battlefield reshapes your strategy. Harness environmental powers, trigger elemental chain reactions, and adapt your defenders to stop the corruption.

title: Embercast
description: Embercast is a wizard sport played in the air. Fly, boost and knock a glowing ember through the other team's hoop, 1v1 or 2v2, online with friends or against bots. Free on Windows and Mac.

title: Aurora Requiem: The Lullaby of Calvaris
description: Year 41 without the sun. Inside the skeleton of a colossal sea creature, the lighthouses burn memories for light. A late-90s-style JRPG with pre-rendered backdrops, three discs, time-gauge battles and a mechanic with a giant wrench who always keeps his word.

title: Depth Crushing
description: Dive into the crushing abyss of an alien world filled with horrifying mega-fauna, and harvest their organs to sell to interstellar corporations. Fabricate weapons, drugs, and machines to assist your descent in this subterranean souls-like rogue-like survival horror.

title: Dyrocraft
description: The first game in the Dyrocraft series.

title: Hiyoru
description: Hiyoru is a free-to-play dark fantasy digital card game inspired by Japanese folklore. In a world where the Sun no longer sets and the Night has been forgotten, players summon creatures from 14 dynasties, cast Techniques and Rituals and battle with 30-card decks. The game features a story campaign with 75 battles and two endings, matches against the computer at four difficulty levels, online duels, Draft, weekly tournaments, a ranked mode and puzzles. It can be played in the browser or through a launcher for Windows.

title: The Epic (Sort of Not Really) of Koneko: A Game Made in 4 Hours
description: The Epic (Sort of Not Really) of Koneko is a very short top-down adventure game made in 4 hours, following a little cat called Koneko as he tries to unlock a mysterious door at the back of his house.

title: Haikaburi to Bourei-tachi
description:
The boy who was supposed to be dead had mysteriously returned to life.
But as things stood, he’d vanish again in three days.
In the midst of a war-torn city, the main character—a commanding officer—throws everything he has into keeping the boy alive.
What he uncovers is the unsettling local legend of a witch.
This is a military-themed fantasy novel.

title: Stone Run
description:
The ultimate test of reflexes and nerves!
A giant, unstoppable rolling stone is breathing down your neck, and there’s only one golden rule to survive: never look back!
Dive headfirst into Stone Run, a fast-paced, hand-drawn retro arcade experience designed for non-stop adrenaline and pure fun. Outrun disaster, dodge unpredictable obstacles, and push your reaction speed to the absolute limit in a beautifully crafted world that feels like an interactive cartoon.

title: Dave the Diver: GGST
description:
Rhythm Game: The Disaster of Passion
Experience a special rhythm-game powered by the electrifying GGST track 'The Disaster of Passion'.

Feel the beat, hit the notes, and dive into the action with signature GGST flair.

Bancho Sushi: GGST Vibes All Night
Bancho Sushi welcomes cosplay customers inspired by iconic GGST fighters, bringing high-energy atmosphere to the night.

Enhance the restaurant’s vibe even further with the 'May Speaker', adding a stylish, rock-infused presence to your interior.

May’s Anchor: A Dolphin-Charged Strike
Equip the special weapon 'May’s Anchor' and unleash a powerful, dolphin-charged impact during your dives.

title: Last Haul
description: A mining roguelite where you fly a really small spaceship. Mining calls the enemies in. Haul the crystals home on a tractor beam and turn them into upgrades. Every zone ends on a boss, and if your ship is destroyed, the run is over.

title: Tidy Up the Halloween Shop
description: Something has made a spectacular mess of this cozy Halloween shop. Put pumpkins, potions and sweets back where they belong, uncover curious clues, and meet a mysterious new friend. A relaxing first-person tidy-up, with a little mischief.

title: Way Too Many Fish!
description: Way Too Many Fish! is a cozy sorting game aboard your own fishing boat. Haul the net, dump the catch on deck, and throw all 82 species of fish into the right crates.

title: Diorama Tactics
description: Diorama Tactics is a strategic roguelite auto-battler inspired by fantasy board games. Players build a team of unique units, place them on a grid-based battlefield, and watch them fight automatically. Each unit has different strengths, roles, and abilities, while positioning and team composition determine the outcome of battles. Players progress through increasingly difficult encounters, collect new units, and face different enemy factions and powerful bosses.

title: Depth Above
description: An atmospheric horror game inspired by classics from the 2000s. Playing as William in his constant search for Lynn, he ventures into all kinds of obscure places. With Lynn's last note as a guide, his goal remains, taking him through many places with creatures and environments shaped by corruption.

title: Promba
description:
Mr. Promba is a surveillance robot turned radio control experiment, and he needs your help to test the integrity of his radio functions in the treacherous test chamber!

Bounce off walls, swerve from hazards, and zoom to the PCB chips as you utilize your remote controls to communicate push and pull signals to keep Mr. Promba on track to success. How long can you and Mr. Promba last against the endless onslaught of red rockets?

title: The Gabrolin Crusade LSD
description: The Gabrolin Crusade LSD is a comedic JRPG where you and your friends go on a great adventure!

title: Penn Guiny's Lightmare
description:
Penn Guiny's Lightmare is a 3D collect-a-thon platformer with a horror twist!

Play as Penn Guiny, who has to collect stars while being chased down by the Sun!

title: Truth Universally Acknowledged: Nine Hearts
description: Truth Universally Acknowledged - Nine Hearts is a short college themed dating sim.

title: Truth Universally Acknowledged: Silver Heart
description: Truth Universally Acknowledged - Silver Heart is a CEO Romance dating sim with 3 routes. Every love interest is a CEO.

title: Five Hearts Under One Roof 2: Winter Trip DLC
description: After leaving the boarding house, relationships with familiar characters begin to move in new directions. From new episodes with Suzy, Gyu-ri, and Yu-jeong to unexpected moments where you become entangled once again with the original boarding house members. Experience the closer distance that unfolds during the winter trip and a special romance that changes depending on your choices.

title: Evenin' Shift
description: Comedy horror set in Somerset. You're on the night shift again. Look lively, you get all sorts turning up round these parts. Let the right ones in, send the wronguns on their way and try not to make any enemies— there are strange folk about.

title: Keep Farming Aura
description: Keep Farming Aura is an active 3D incremental game about turning attention into power. Perform stylish moves to farm Aura, attract a crowd, build your crew, and buy upgrades. Unlock permanent progression, customize your character, and face rivals in Aura battles. Optional Twitch integration brings viewers into the scene, with their names and chat messages appearing in-game.

title: Kingside Break
description: A chess game where you lead a customizable fantasy army through 1,500 levels of curated puzzles. Face checkpoint commanders in full matches, recruit new races, and customize your hero and army. Key chess concepts encountered are logged in a Sage Ledger for education and future reference.

title: Kawaii Push
description:
Kawaii Push is a casual and relaxing Sokoban-style game in which players must push boxes to the correct locations.
The protagonist is a red-haired girl who explores cute and colorful anime-style environments.
With moderately challenging puzzles, the game offers a fun and accessible experience for players of all ages.

title: Timefract
description: Move through time. Back and forward. Create clones across timelines and cooperate with yourself to solve impossible puzzles.

title: Find Shape
description: Find and click game. In top left cornet it is shown what you need to find. In center you have tiles where shape is hidden. Click it. If you find it, tiles change. Do it again. That is whole game loop.

title: Kachinka
description: Kachinka is a game of skill and chance. Based off the game of plinko, Kachinka brings you into a pixelated and relaxing world where gambling meets a healthy lifestyle near the fireplace. Destroy tiles, collect balls, buy customizations and upgrades and cash out!

title: Magic Fruit World
description: Magic Fruit World is an intense platforming adventure combining deep exploration and tactical combat. Master the power of Magic Fruits to face relentless enemies, uncover secrets in expansive worlds, and perfect your skills in levels built for high replayability.

title: Scary Cave
description: Scary Cave is a survival-horror game released by Alex After All Glazer Infinity. The game can be downloaded for free on Itch.io or Game Jolt.

title: Dead City: Red Protocol
description:
A once-thriving city has become a dangerous battlefield. Hostile forces control the streets, armed enemies patrol the urban districts, and every mission brings a new threat. When the red protocol is activated, there is only one objective: enter the city, complete your mission, and survive.

Dead City: Red Protocol is a third-person action shooter focused on urban combat, exploration, missions, vehicles, and intense encounters.

Explore a large city environment filled with streets, buildings, traffic, enemy-controlled areas, and hidden locations. Move through the city on foot or take control of different vehicles as you travel between objectives.

Engage enemies using a variety of weapons and combat tactics. Fight through dangerous streets, respond to hostile attacks, complete missions, and navigate an urban environment where danger can appear at any moment.

title: Mia's Journey
description:
An accident has transformed Mia into an adorable little cat, and now she must find a way to return to her human form. Guided by the enigmatic Cat God, Mia embarks on an enchanting journey filled with puzzles, souls, and discoveries!

In Mia's Journey, you will face 32 carefully crafted levels, where each challenge requires you to push souls across the environment and place each one on the purifying altars to progress. Sounds simple? Not quite! Every move can completely change the path, and if you're not careful, you may end up trapping a soul or blocking your own way.

As Mia moves forward, the challenges become increasingly creative, requiring observation, planning, and plenty of brainpower. Think before you act, find the perfect sequence of moves, and discover how to overcome each puzzle without leaving a single soul behind.

But the adventure doesn't take place only on the puzzle board. Between challenges, charming cutscenes reveal more about Mia's story and her relationship with the mysterious Cat God. Find out more and help Mia return to her human form.

With cozy visuals, Mia's Journey offers a comfortable adventure that is easy to learn, yet capable of challenging even the most dedicated puzzle fans.

title: Lanky Looters
description: Steal everything and run! "Lanky Looters" is a sneak-and-snatch game where you'll grow thick as Thieves. Swipe loot and escape before you're caught by pesky Officers. With quiet feet and sharp eyes, you might just survive as you steal your way through 4 varied maps...

title: The Sims 4: Mean Girls Capsule Kit
description: You’ll look like teen royalty with these styles from The Sims 4 Mean Girls Capsule Kit*. Mix and match Y2K styles, get out your Burn Book, and don’t forget that on Wednesdays we wear pink.

title: The Sims 4: Clueless Capsule Kit
description: Ensemble-y challenged? Ugh, as if! The Sims 4 Clueless Capsule Kit has fashion fit for the most popular Sims.

title: Sneak Cheese
description:
Get ready to think fast, plan carefully, and try not to become dinner in Sneak Cheese, a cozy and strategic puzzle game where a tiny mouse must push every piece of cheese into the burrows while trying to survive cats that are always ready to pounce!

Every move matters. Push the cheese through the environment, find the right path to the burrows, and turn every space on the board into part of your strategy. But don't think it will be that simple. With every valid move you make, the cats react too, and knowing exactly when they will move can mean the difference between a perfect escape and a disastrous capture!

You will encounter different types of cats, each with its own behavior. Some remain stationary but attack anything that appears directly in front of them. Others patrol the environment after every move you make, while the slower ones wait for the right moment to advance. Watch their routes, track their cycles, and plan every step before putting yourself in danger!

Across 30 handcrafted levels, divided into 3 different biomes, new challenges and increasingly clever combinations will put your reasoning to the test. You will need to figure out the right order for pushing the cheese, avoid getting trapped, predict the cats' movements, and make sure the little mouse stays alive until the final piece of cheese reaches its destination.

title: World of Mixed Martial Arts 6
description: World of Mixed Martial Arts 6 is the latest MMA release by developer Adam Ryland and makes a massive step forward in the series. In WMMA6, you run your own MMA organization in a lively, vivid, competitive game world that evolves over time. Play with companies, fighters, and teams from all around the globe. WMMA6 adds over 100 new features to the series. Deal with contracts, morale, promotional work, hype and more…this is the deepest MMA sim available.

title: Photoncytosis
description: Photoncytosis is an idle desktop life simulation in which a tiny organism feeds on the light of the screen and grows while the player works. Each cell stores energy, and absorbed colors influence the organism's development. Players can inspect cells under a microscope, research mutations, move creatures toward light, and confine them to an application window. Specialized cells support harvesting, perception, movement, energy storage, and repair. Organisms can split, regroup, and compete for resources in a changing desktop ecosystem.

title: Factorized
description: A 2D side-scroller about killing robots with janky guns as a morally questionable main character.

title: ProjectCane
description: ProjectCane is a playable PC port of the release of Sly Cooper and the Thievius Raccoonus.

title: Auris
description: Auris is a 2D Puzzle platformer where you play as a blind kid. Use echolocation to see objects, solve puzzles, fight enemies, and uncover hidden paths. Find your mother and help other trapped kids along your way out of the evil lab facility.

title: Unrivaled
description: Unrivaled is a single-player collectible card game set in Card City, where you're aiming to win tournaments and become the Unrivaled Champion. Along the way you battle 12 bosses and an evil team that's trying to scalp all the card packs in the city. Win battles, rip packs, and build decks from over 400 cards.

title: Monster Girls Survival & Craft 2040
description: 2040. You wake in a city half-swallowed by another world. Dig anywhere, build anything - a shack, a castle, a fortress. Capture the monster girls roaming the wastes and they fight, work and live beside you. Every seventh night a horde comes. Raise walls, set traps and survive until dawn.

title: Black Abyss Zero
description: Black Abyss Zero is an action roguelite game set in a ruined world where science fiction and magic coexist. Combine a variety of characters and artifacts, and overcome enemies that grow stronger as time passes.

title: Don't Stop Cutting The Trees!
description: Don’t Stop Cutting the Trees! is a colorful incremental game where you play as a determined lumberjack journeying through increasingly dangerous forest regions. Cutting down trees, collecting Wood, earning XP, unlocking skills, recruiting companions, and chopping down Boss Trees.

title: Asteris
description: Asteris is an action roguelite set in a dark fantasy world, playable solo or in online co-op with up to four players. Players choose one of four classes, combine skills into a new build each run, and retain equipment and upgrades between runs. Parties coordinate tank, damage, and healing roles while exploring stages and dungeons, fighting large bosses, and awakening new forms with divine power.

title: Whispers of Orange Island
description: A 2D top-down stealth puzzle story-rich game about helping wandering souls complete the things they couldn't finish in life.

title: Contract Terminated
description: Lead your band of mercenaries and figure out a way to survive on a hostile planet in this oldschool 1980s-style party-based RPG with pixel graphics. Features a mix of grid-based movement, turn-based tactical combat, and first-person dungeon crawling just like the classics.

title: Retro Cube Slider
description:
Dozens of engaging single-screen sliding puzzles! Retro goodness! Crazy contraptions to master!

Anyone can play Retro Cube Slider, just press the direction button and let the stylish neon cube slide away!

title: Runes Quest
description: Runes Quest is a sokoban-like puzzle game where you guide a knight through 30 levels across light and dark biomes on their journey home. Navigate rooms filled with interactive elements like buttons, grates, keys, runes, boxes, pits, and traps using logic and careful planning. Enjoy cute visuals and relaxing music as you solve increasingly complex spatial puzzles.

title: Wordless
description: Worldless is a stylised 2D platformer with a unique combat system and a mind-bending interpretative narrative. Players embark on a journey of self-growth and understanding, pushing the limits of their nature in a newly born and abstract universe.

title: House Zero
description: A social casino where the only thing at stake is bragging rights. Play 20+ games, from slots, Plinko and Crash to live poker and case battles with friends, using free play-money chips. Climb weekly leaderboards, finish quests and unlock cosmetics. No real-money gambling or payouts.

title: Give him a break!
description: Give him a break! is a physics comedy in which the player doesn't control the cat - they hold the laser pointer. The cat chases the dot through the house, and everything he lands on breaks and goes on the owner's receipt. Every ten breaks the player picks one of two power cards, such as antigravity or acid vomit, and between runs a yarn tree unlocks more powers and cat skins. The houses are generated, and the round ends when the owner comes home to the bill.

title: M!racle Home_Page
description: They were going to be social media millionaires! ...Five years later, they have only eighteen subscribers. Now Roo’s bedroom has been rebuilt, his friend is missing, and strangers laugh at everything he does! A choice-driven psychological horror visual novel about finally being watched.

title: Dressmaker Simulator
description:
Open the doors to a warm storybook atelier and turn every customer request into a finished garment. Accept a commission, choose the right material, sketch a design, arrange pattern pieces with the grain, cut the fabric, pin it to the mannequin, sew each seam, add decorations, and deliver your work.

Build a season from 12 garment projects, 16 fabrics, varied colors and patterns, and 10 client profiles with different tastes. Match fabrics and trims to each brief, balance cost against quality, earn money and reputation, keep favorite creations in the wardrobe, and care for Marmalade, the atelier cat.

Every production stage is designed for controller play, including precise pattern cutting. Keyboard and mouse are also supported. Versioned local autosave, Continue, pause, clear back actions, and a complete season flow make this a full cozy crafting game rather than a limited demo.

title: Cornelius Cat in: How the Cat Saved Christmas
Fit and Grow
description:
Get ready to get your hands dirty and let your creativity bloom in Fit and Grow, a relaxing puzzle game where every planted piece can completely transform the board!

Here, seeds and watering cans work together to create something bigger. Place the pieces carefully, make the plants grow, and watch as they expand into new spaces across the board. But be careful: the more your plants grow, the less space remains for your next moves. Planning the right moment to plant and water will be essential to finding the perfect solution!

Across 30 levels, divided into 3 different biomes, new board shapes and piece combinations will put your spatial reasoning to the test. Each stage brings a small challenge to solve, encouraging you to think several moves ahead and discover how the growth of a single plant can completely change your possibilities.

And there is no need to be afraid of making mistakes! With Undo, Hint, and Restart always available, you can experiment with different strategies, undo a move, or get a little help when the solution seems hidden among the leaves.

There are no timers, pressure, or rushing. Just you, your pieces, and a board waiting to bloom.

Observe the space, plan your moves, plant your seeds, position your watering cans, and discover the perfect combination to fill every corner.

Plant with strategy, water with intelligence, and make every level bloom!

title: Martial Art's History
description: Martial Art’s History: Early Republican China kung fu fighter inspired by classic kung fu films. Play varied warriors with unique authentic martial arts. Retro flat art depicts old dojos and arenas, with single-player story and local 2P duels & solid fluid melee combat.

title: RadiusBlood Crypta
description: Improve your sword skills for the time to come.

title: Outvote
description: Outvote is a free online party game about the people you play with. Every round asks one question – everyone answers yes or no in secret, then guesses how the room voted: estimate the share of yes votes, or call every single player's answer. The closer you get, the more points. Play with Steam friends or join in any web browser at outvote.de with a room code – crossplay between Steam and browser, up to 20 players. A streamer mode lets viewers play along from the browser and scores them separately, and community question packs or your own custom questions keep every round fresh.

title: Rooftops Jam
description:
Quake Rooftops map jam, ran from August 4th to September 15th.
The theme is "Rooftops", and mappers were free to interpret it however they wanted.

title: Feedstock
description: A four-player co-op horror game where you loot houses and feed everything to Tally, a creature that grows larger and angrier with each meal. As she swells, she becomes louder and harder to move, attracting hostile entities triggered by escalating noise. You must manage her size by forcing her to regurgitate items and extract her before the situation spirals out of control, coordinating through proximity voice chat.

title: Wroom Classic
description:
Wroom Classic is a 2D driving simulator; the game features a wide selection of pixelated cars that you need to earn by completing tasks.
• CAR DAMAGE: the game includes car damage: if you drive carelessly, you can break the car so badly that it won’t even move. In such a case, you’ll need to call a tow truck, but if the car is still moving, you can have it repaired for money (in development).
• BIG CITY: the game features a large city; the city isn’t just full of monotonous houses — many streets are different from one another, and exploring the city will be interesting (in development)
• CONTAINERS: in the game, you can buy containers, in which a car can be either more expensive or cheaper than the container’s price (in development)

title: Two-Fifteen
description: A first-person PSX horror game. Your baby is gone, and the things wearing your in-laws' faces are still in the house. Get the lights back on, hide when you hear footsteps on the stairs, and never trust a voice that sounds like someone you love.

title: The Phantom of the Opera
description:
When people start dying in the Palais Garnier opera house, up-and-coming soprano, Christine Daaé finds herself at the center of a dark obsession. Can Christine break free from the clutches of the Phantom of the Opera?

Or will she remain haunted by him forever?

title: Legacy Code
description: Legacy Code is a simulation game where you evolve as a mysterious lifeform called a Mechanimal and create a story that is uniquely yours. Fight other Mechanimals to gain EXP and collect parts. Combine the parts you gather, adjust your abilities, and evolve your form.

title: The Simpsons Game: Recompiled
description: A native PC port of The Simpsons Game (Xbox 360, 2007) for Linux, Steam Deck, and Windows.

title: Sunsoft is Back! Retro Game Selection 2
description: The "bad game" classic is back! Mysteries to unravel! The second installment in the “Retro Game Selection” series is here. Includes four classic titles ranging from major Sunsoft hits to hidden gems. New save and rewind features! Find rare never-before-seen game materials in Gallery Mode!

title: Intravenous 3: Borderline
description: Tense stealth action, tactical hardcore gunplay, and missions & story shaped by the way you play. Step into the shoes of Gideon, a feared mercenary with nothing left to lose, and carve a bloody path of revenge through deep systemic stealth and brutal tactical gunplay.

title: Mini Eulerian Graph
description: A relaxing one-stroke drawing game

title: Rocket League: Season 24
description:
Season 24 is the thirty-eighth competitive season in Rocket League and the twenty-fourth competitive season after the Free To Play update. It is themed around a specific concept and features the Dominus GT 76, Pareto 5S and Volkswagen Golf GTI Edition 50 Bodies in the Rocket Pass.

This season introduces the ability to directly invite a player from a match to initiate an Honor Duel, as well as the ability to trade-in Black Market items for new ones the player might not have.

title: Mystic Fog Maze
description: A casual puzzle game where the player navigates through endless mazes surrounded by a mysterious fog.

title: Groundwork Simulator
description: Dig, haul and wash for gold in an open-world heavy machinery simulator. Operate excavators, wheel loaders and bulldozers, reshape the terrain and build your washing setup. Work solo or team up in online co-op to turn untouched ground into a working site.

title: Blastlane Racers
description:
Blastlane Racers is a top-down arcade combat racing game inspired by classics of the genre.

Race across 24 hand-crafted tracks, use powerful weapons to take out your rivals, and upgrade your vehicles and equipment between races.

Choose from 10 unique vehicles and compete in championships, quick races, time trials, and challenges in the Blastlane Academy. Play solo or challenge your friends in local split-screen multiplayer for up to 4 players.

Fast racing, explosive combat, and plenty of chaos – cars and guns. What else do you need?

title: Pan-Dae-Mon-Ium
description: PAN-DAE-MON-IUM is a Mystery Dungeon inspired turn based RPG made with RPGMaker MV. Take control of sneering demons from the Ars Goetia as you traverse the Circles of Hell!

title: Ultrapolis
description: A cyberpunk city diorama with millions of possible buildings. No city management between you and pure layout and design.

title: Strange Days
description: The end of the world is near! After a mysterious package unleashes paranormal events in Triton Town, experience a chapter-based narrative through the eyes of multiple protagonists. Solve puzzles, explore detailed environments, and interview witnesses to uncover the truth before time runs out!

title: Dark Side Void
description: Dark Side Void is a 2D side-scrolling mecha action game set in space. Scarred by devastating interstellar wars, the Solar System is riddled with hidden dangers across its cosmic frontiers. Pilot your fully armed combat mech and embark on a cosmic journey packed with fierce mecha battles.

title: OpenTricky
description: SSX Tricky (Xbox, 2001), running natively on Windows.

title: BeaconBound
description:
BeaconBound is a momentum-based 3D adventure about a rolling ball trying to collect 15 glowing beacons in a living procedural world.

Every run creates a new world with different hills, lakes, weather, plants, creatures, and beacon positions. You must read the terrain on the fly, adapt your route, and decide when to risk a dash toward the light.

Your health slowly drains as you move, so standing still is not an option. Beacons restore a large amount of health and push you forward, while plants and neutral creatures scattered through the world can give you smaller chances to recover when a beacon is too dangerous to reach.
Every beacon brings you closer to victory — and raises the danger. As you collect beacons, you unlock new abilities: a directional pointer to find the next beacon, a speed boost for risky escapes, a protective shield, and stasis to freeze nearby enemies for a short time.

The guardians also grow more dangerous as you progress. They become more aggressive, start predicting your movement, and force you to choose your route carefully before committing to an attack or escape.

The world itself changes how you play. Lakes slow you down, grass pulls at your movement, slopes affect your momentum, and weather can reshape your plans: fog reduces visibility, rain weakens traction, wind pushes you off course, and night hides the terrain ahead.

Read the world fast, manage your health, keep your speed under control, and survive long enough to collect all 15 beacons.

title: Bootline: Desktop Simulator
description:
Start from a blinking cursor. Bootline hands you MorrowDesk, a small fictional personal computer, and a neighborhood of people who need things made on it. Draw a badge, save it as a picture, set it as your wallpaper, attach it to a mail, publish it on your home page. Everything you make stays on your machine, and the machine slowly becomes yours.

Everything in Bootline is fictional and local. No real drive, operating system, network or account is ever changed.

title: Tiny Brutalism
description: Tiny Brutalism is a relaxing diorama building game based on brutalist architecture. Create strange monuments, impossible structures, concrete towers, or just a really big wall. Then explore inside them in first person. There’s no goal and no right way to build. Make whatever you feel like making.

title: Rikogol
description:
Rikogol is a top-down 2D arcade soccer game driven by physics. Every player is a disc with just two actions, move and kick, and matches have no fouls or offside, so goals come down to positioning, passing and timing.

Matches range from one-on-one duels to full eleven-a-side games, with bots taking any empty spots. Each team can have a head coach who sets the formation and draws plays that only their own team can see. Two people can also play on one computer, either as teammates against bots or as rivals.

title: Crusader Kings III: By God Alone
Dying Land
description: Welcome to Dying Land. An equipment-driven loot-and-slash game blended with cozy life-sim activities like farming and fishing. Earn money, explore, and fight! Grow stronger with every cycle as you search for a way to change your fate.

title: The Adventures of Tango Rio
description:
A humoristic point-and-click adventure with hand-drawn 2D art, comedy, and investigation. As Tango Rio, explore a tropical archipelago, meet quirky characters, and gather clues by solving puzzles in the search for your mysteriously vanished father.

Tango Rio hasn’t seen his father in two years—not since he left with his uncle on “a journey that would change the world.” Or so he claimed. Then, silence.

The only clue: the name of a Polynesian archipelago... and the feeling that this time, the escape is different.

What awaits him? Tropical legends, strange rituals, time travel, dark prophecies, and a bunch of totally crazy characters.

title: The Other Side of the Wall
description:
This is the story of Julian Reed, a 13-year old boy attending Saint Maximus the Confessor Catholic School in the early 1980s. Saint Maximus is an all-boys boarding school that shares a wall with another institution for "troubled cases" called Cedar Tree House. Cedar Tree House is shrouded in mystery, as discussing it is frowned upon by the Benedictine monks who make up most of the teaching staff at Julian's school. There is no contact between the two institutions, at least not as far as the students are concerned.

It's late August, the semester has not even started, and only a few students and faculty members are present when Julian discovers a tiny hole in an isolated corner of the wall separating Saint Maximus from Cedar Tree House. The hole is just big enough for him to see a pair of blue eyes. They belong to a girl who soon becomes his closest confidante.

The opportunity to spend time with a girl, albeit separated by a wall, is a welcome distraction from Julian's routine, but it will not be the only one. One boring morning, during class, he notices that one of his classmates is missing from his usual desk. When Julian asks about him, he is shocked to discover that nobody acknowledges that the student ever existed.

The Other Side of the Wall is more than a whodunit game. It's a coming-of-age story of a boy who stumbles upon a mystery and finds himself in over his head. A story about friendship, curiosity, and the unsettling feeling that something is terribly wrong.

The Other Side of the Wall is a traditional 3rd person point & click adventure game. This is a game for people who enjoy being challenged with (mostly inventory based) puzzles and being rewarded for paying close attention to subtle clues.

title: Dude, Trust Me
description: Get hopelessly misunderstood by your two best friends. One of you goes blind, one goes deaf, one loses their voice, and no puzzle here can be solved by one person. Can the three of you work out how to understand each other?

title: Powder Park
description: Every other resort builder stops at the blueprint. Powder Park doesn't. Shape the mountain, design your runs, then drop in and ride them yourself in third person. A new experience from one of the original creators of Ski Resort Tycoon.

title: Dumpling Delight
description: Welcome to Dumpling Delight! Drop adorable dumplings, merge matching pairs, and watch them grow! Chase high scores, master satisfying physics, and enjoy a cozy, relaxing experience where every drop brings a little joy. How big can your dumplings get?

title: Empires of Black Powder
description: It's the Napoleonic era, and you must build the battlefield you fight on. Send Pioneers to gather supplies, expand the local town, and prepare your defenses. Command companies in formation, keep your veterans alive, and carry their experience and upgrades into the next battle.

title: Protocell
description: Mutation is evolution. A lab cell broke containment — pilot it through swarming arenas where every upgrade you take drags you closer to meltdown. Grow billions of one-of-a-kind protocells, hand any of them to a friend with a 16-character code, and dive into the Primordial Abyss.

title: Streak Of Power
description: Streak of Power is a turn-based strategy game featuring tactical duels. Aim your energy beam with precision, use gravity-affected satellites to change its direction, and take control of them. Outwit your opponent and destroy their base before they hit you.

title: Krappy Birds
description: A parody of Flappy birds intended to just have fun with the concept. The difference here is doing what birds do to car windows while dodging other birds, power lines and trying for the highest score. Have a laugh and have fun!

title: Omnivores Rule
description: Soar through an alien world as a flying android. Dominate the environment with thunderous shouts —or surrender to the strange rhythms of wildlife. This planet does not obey humans. And maybe, neither should you.

title: Caroline's Underworld
description: Navigate through a weird and whimsical underworld, meet curious creatures and undead spirits, and solve puzzles to uncover the way forward. Caroline's Underworld is a 2D puzzle RPG with digitally hand-drawn assets that explores loneliness, friendship, and discovering one's true self.

title: Mutagen
description: Explore a lush, interconnected alien ecosystem that reshapes itself each time you die. Absorb mutations from your fallen kin to reach new areas and adapt to your surroundings. Study the environment to find your own solutions, and unearth the planet's many secrets.

title: Keepshore: Hearth Seal
description: A ceremonial hearth at the heart of every town you build. Host a Hearth Festival and the fire roars three times as long. The town gathers there. Beauty first — duration only, never a standing production bonus.

title: Bread Makes the Heart Aflutter: The Baker's First Ball
description: With Autumn comes the annual Autumn Charity Ball, and after Damon learns that Emile's never been to one as a guest he takes it upon himself to invite him personally as his partner, helping him prepare for the night of song and dance.

title: Lights On My Screen
description: Lights On My Screen is a 2D adventure RPG set inside a video game. Help Kid navigate the colorful world, solve puzzles, talk to characters and fight (or don't fight) the enemies. And find the one who brought them to this world...

title: Keepshore
description: A calm 3D island town-builder spanning nine ages, from stone huts to electric streets. Raise workshops, wire production chains, work a living market, and grow a town that keeps producing while you're away. Settle a new island to advance the age — every shore you leave sends tribute home forever.

title: Cosmo Cat: A Cozy Desktop Idler
description: An emotional desktop idle game where you spend time with your own cat floating through space and record your day as constellations.

title: CodePhantom
description: "CodePhantom" is a 3D action game where you pilot the humanoid combat mech PHANTOM and take on a variety of missions. Experience the thrill of controlling a powerful mech with smooth, responsive gameplay. Enjoy intense, no-nonsense mech action designed for fans of authentic robotic combat.

title: Deleted Wiki: Clean Up the Lost Files
description: Deleted Wiki: Clean Up the Lost Files is a cozy incremental sorting game set inside a fictional 2007 fan wiki. As its new moderator, the player restores 10,324 deleted item entries by sorting them into categories, subfolders, and rows. Sorting earns points for userscripts that make the work easier, while restored pages and messages reveal the community's history.

title: Abyssal Moonlight: Chapter 1
description: No light. No names. Only numbers. In the lowest city of the deep, a boy raises forbidden jellyfish to buy his friend's dream — and every choice can end the story.

title: Helping Your Boyfriend
description: A cute-turned-creepy horror visual novel

title: Last Days of Tsufana
description:
The world descends into ruin. Its inhabitants have become monstrous abominations, with those fortunate enough to survive slowly succumbing to a mysterious dream. In the wake of the Goddess's departure, Tsufana encroaches upon the end of its days.

The player assumes the role of Falcon, one of two siblings whose lives were upended by the villainous machinations of Valdisna, a vile sorcerer who has ensnared the world of Tsufana in a wicked curse, causing the afflicted to become horrifying monsters. Vowing to put an end to Valdisna's schemes, Falcon and his sister set out into the collapsing world to end the sorcerer's reign of terror.

title: System Intruder
description: Dive into the atmospheric dread of classic 3D games. Unravel the dark secrets of the ASGARD-04 research complex in this gripping, narrative-driven retro-cyberpunk survival horror.

title: Attention, Dear Passengers
description:
Welcome aboard Flight ROSE-204. It should have been an ordinary flight. Then the cabin starts to break apart.

Attention, Dear Passengers is a single-player, physics-driven survival game where every round turns a routine flight into a fight to stay upright. Brace in your seat, move through a collapsing cabin, avoid dangerous debris, and keep going after the wreck hits the ground.

You are not alone. Six AI passengers react to the disaster around them: some seek safety, some panic, and some make a bad situation worse. Grab a passenger when the moment calls for it, pull them from danger, or fight to keep your own footing while the world shifts beneath you.

Each flight uses fresh random seeds for its disaster events. Lightning, ruptures, decompression, floods, fire, acid rain, aftershocks, and tornadoes can reshape the round and force a new survival plan.

title: Cargo Delivery Simulator
description: Cargo Delivery Simulator is a relaxed delivery game where you ride motorcycles through a 3D city, completing 10 timed routes with multiple stops while managing fuel and meeting deadlines. Earn credits from successful deliveries to unlock new bikes from a garage of 11 motorcycles, each with its own handling. Navigate using clear route guidance, monitor your fuel and time with a motorcycle-inspired interface, and enjoy a laid-back urban soundtrack as you progress through increasingly complex delivery assignments.

title: Perfectly Folded
description: Perfectly Folded is a cozy organizing game set in a clothing store turned upside down. Fold, hang and shelve every last shirt, hat and shoe, design your own fashion, and enjoy turning the mess into a perfectly folded store at your own pace.

title: VCR83
description:
VCR83 is a psychological horror game where you monitor security cameras and report strange anomalies.

Spot anomalies, survive your shift, and earn Tokens to unlock new levels and push deeper into the story. Reporting is simple: see something wrong, click it. Just make sure you're right.

Meet Pete, your small virtual assistant. At first, he's just there to help. As you progress, Pete reacts to the outcomes of your shifts, talks to you, answers your questions, sings, plays around with you, and becomes increasingly interested in what you're doing.

Maybe a little too interested.

title: Wolfsschanze: Operation Götterdämmerung
description: In this uncompromising first-person shooter, storm the Wolf’s Lair in 1944, the sealed-off power centre of the Nazi leadership. Fight your way through bunkers, defensive positions and Nazi troops using weapons, explosives and vehicles, and eliminate officers all the way up to Hitler himself.

title: Jo & Rubi: A Cozy Expedition
description: Join Jo and Rubi on a cozy archaeology expedition. Sort artefacts, clean up the garden, pull trash from the ocean, and explore a dig site. 19 relaxing mini-games across 3 chapters.

title: Naberon
description: Naberon is a real-time space 4X strategy game. The player explores a galaxy under fog of war, colonizes planets and manages their population, food, energy and taxes, researches technologies without a fixed tech tree, and designs ships and tanks from modules. Wars are fought on two levels: real-time fleet battles in space, and real-time ground battles after carriers land tanks on a planet's surface, where the terrain divides the planet into build zones. Random events such as pirate raids, refugees, distress calls and a market with timed deliveries shape each game. It can be played solo against AI empires, or online with other players, cooperatively or against each other.

title: GOAT: Gear Optimization Auto-Battle Tactics
description: An evil goat stole all your clothes. Win them back piece by piece, auto-battle goats, create powerful gear combos, and find absurd synergies in this dress-up roguelike auto-battler.

title: Leg It: Don't Stop
description: Leg It: Don't Stop is a fast-paced melee survival arena game in which the player fights continuous waves of enemies and elemental bosses. Across 32 arenas, players can choose from 35 character sets and mix and match arenas and characters, while pursuing higher scores, facing increasingly difficult bosses, and unlocking additional content.

title: Pop the Ghosts
description:
The ghosts have taken over the building. Do you have what it takes to drive them all out?

In Pop the Ghosts, you take on the role of a paranormal hunter armed with a special gun. Explore a haunted building, face different types of ghosts, and overcome challenges that become increasingly difficult.

Take on a campaign with 30 platform-style levels, run, jump, break boxes, and explore the environments to find your way to the enemies. Eliminate all the ghosts to advance, but stay alert: some enemies require more than one shot to defeat.

Find TVs to activate checkpoints and watch out for traps scattered throughout the environment, such as dangerous drops of acid falling from the ceiling. Take two hits and you will return to the beginning of the level or to the last checkpoint.

title: Will It Launch?
description: Will It Launch? is a co-op physics comedy with proximity voice chat. Players build improvised aircraft from household junk, using bolts, welds and straps, then fly cargo between islands. Aircraft handling depends on weight, wing area and engine placement. Crews share money and tools, and can repair, modify or sabotage each other's creations.

title: Trap Testers
description: Traps Testers is a co-op physics-based deathrun game where you're the one placing the traps! Compete against your friends to reach the finish line first, and try to kill them along the way.

title: Bubble Stomp
description:
