Get ready for an adventure packed with jumps, bubbles, and creativity in Bubble Stomp! Here, every obstacle is an opportunity to test your skills and discover new ways to move through stages filled with exciting platforming challenges.

Use temporary bubbles, Ground Pound, and cannons to reach impossible places, cross dangerous areas, and overcome increasingly challenging obstacles. Combine these mechanics in unexpected ways to create new paths, gain momentum, defeat enemies, and reach the final objective.

Across 30 levels, new enemies, hazards, and mechanics are gradually introduced, making every stage bring a new surprise. Breakable platforms, cannons, obstacles, enemies, and optional collectibles fill the environments with possibilities to explore.

Checkpoints help you continue your adventure without losing all your progress, while collectibles scattered throughout the levels encourage players who want to explore every corner and completely master the challenges.

Observe the environment, plan your next move, create a bubble, use Ground Pound, blast yourself from cannons, and discover how far your creativity can take you.

Jump, pop, smash, and master every level!

title: Air Race Assault
description: Air Race Assault is an arcade air racing game that blends high-speed flight with aerial combat. Pilot agile aircraft through obstacle-filled tracks featuring dangerous curves, alternate routes, and dynamic scenery while engaging opponents in mid-air dogfights. Use machine guns, missiles, and mines to attack rivals, while shields and repairs provide tactical defense. Manage boosters strategically, discover shortcuts, and outmaneuver competitors across three difficulty levels and multiple game modes—Championship, Arcade, and Time Trial. Local split-screen multiplayer lets you compete head-to-head on the same console, and progression unlocks new content and tracks as you climb the leaderboard.

title: Tank Mates
description: Tank Mates is a chaotic physics-based co-op platformer where one or two players share a single tank to tackle a brutal military obstacle course. Coordinate, survive deadly obstacles, and try not to destroy your friendship.

title: Timore Solum
description:
Short horror game about sadness

Stay. Cry.

title: Outbreak Z
description: A post-apocalyptic party-based auto battler RPG. Recruit three survivors with nothing in common, loot a dead city for their gear, level each one down their own tree, and send them into the horde. They fight every wave on their own. Whether they come home is on you.

title: No Brakes Club
description: A retro multiplayer platformer for up to 10 players per round. Sprint, sabotage, and backstab your way through quickfire minigames where every round takes seconds to learn and one mistake to lose.

title: Death Simulator
description: You are Death's newest employee, tasked with collecting souls across a supernatural world where the afterlife operates as a sprawling corporation. Armed with spectral chains and soul-hunting arrows, you must meet daily quotas while navigating dynamic combat encounters—from rooftop pursuits to hellish battlegrounds. Precision timing determines success as you hunt souls in first-person perspective, with every collection feeling immediate and consequential. Progress through Death's hierarchy, unlock new abilities, and advance your eternal career across photorealistic environments rendered in Unreal Engine 5, where otherworldly horror meets meticulous detail.

title: Home Reset: Organizing Simulator
description: Transform messy homes into cozy, beautifully organized spaces. Clean up, arrange every room, and place objects wherever you want—there are no wrong choices. Relax, get creative, and make every home feel just right.

title: Arctic Shop Simulator
description: Run a small shop at the edge of the Arctic wilderness. Ride your snowmobile into frozen regions, track and sedate wildlife, fish, survive brutal weather, and return home to sell your finds. Negotiate with customers, expand your shop, and build a thriving business in the far north.

title: The Lifeline
description: To escape this terrifying hospital, you must leave your fears behind. Can you do it? Explore, face zombies, use weapons, avoid traps, and react fast to survive.

title: Butts in Space: Porcelain Peril
description: Evil Butt has invaded the Porcelain Planet, central TP trading hub for the galaxy. Embark on a perilous journey as Butt Butt in an attempt to free the planet from Evil Butt's control in this fart filled platformer.

title: Double Skunk
description:
Double Skunk is a cribbage roguelite built on the real game played by the book. Between hands, players add powerups that change what the count pays and collect one-use pocket cards that bend the rules once, such as shoving the rival's peg back down the board or taking the crib whoever dealt. A short guided warm-up teaches cribbage to newcomers before the first match.

The campaign follows a traveling player up the Long Tally, a tournament tour of twenty-one named rivals running from a back-room parlor to a national championship, with house rules such as a chess clock and muggins at the higher tables. Outside the campaign, a weekly duplicate-cribbage challenge deals every player the same hands for a shared leaderboard, and players can face the AI at four difficulty levels or play one-on-one online.

title: Projet Brouillon
description: Experience an adventure where every discovery shapes your identity, as you journey along the boundary between reality and imagination in this 3D platformer.

title: Shadow Cat
description:
Darkness has swallowed the land. Only one unlikely hero is brave enough to fight back.
Shadow Cat is a focused 2D action-platformer that puts you in control of a fearless cat boy on a mission to save a world overrun by evil creatures. Run, jump, and dash through 25 handcrafted levels set across dark forests, abandoned factories, dangerous caves, and forgotten tunnels.
Straightforward controls make it easy to begin, but every new stage introduces more demanding platforming challenges. Time your jumps, dash across deadly gaps, avoid spikes and moving hazards, and launch fireballs to defeat the creatures standing in your way.
Explore each level to collect life points and replenish your fireball ammo. Activate checkpoints to protect your progress when danger strikes. Taking damage costs one life and returns you to the latest checkpoint—but lose every life, and the level must be faced again from the beginning.
The journey becomes more dangerous as new enemies, traps, and environmental threats test your timing, awareness, and resource management. Master your movement, use your fireballs wisely, and keep pushing forward until the final confrontation with a giant spider and its relentless minions.

title: The Fall of Zorata
description: Free Lovecraftian first-person puzzle game, 20~30 min linear story. Explore an underground palace, collect ritual items, and trigger a golden relic through chain puzzles—never touch it yourself. Includes 12 achievements, 3 save slots, 7 languages, and a full ending cinematic.

title: Grand Fantasy Empires
description: A grand strategy game with real time battles.

title: Y2K Coin Pusher
description: Enjoy this 2000's inspired coin pusher game with 13 unlockable levels, each corresponding to their own song and vibe, all in delicious PS2 inspired graphics.

title: Cosmic Warfront
description: Top-down space combat shooter. 6 chassis, 8 weapons, 3 enemy factions, 3 bosses. Craft your build, fight through 12 sectors, survive endless waves, and compete in daily challenges. Global leaderboards.

title: Signal Snow
description: Signal Snow is a paranoid Antarctic visual novel about a radio signal from beneath the ice, impossible memories, and a crew that may not survive its own fear. Decide who to trust, who to isolate, and whether to answer.

title: Soulstack
description: Idle card RPG on a table. Drag cards onto each other to do literally everything. 200+ weapon recipes (only ~40 are worth keeping), 140 pet evolutions, 12 prestige classes. Yet still feels like a Jira and Trello child.

title: Cursor Slayer
description: Your cursor is your weapon. Drag it across the battlefield to slash through waves of monsters, cast devastating spells, ascend and get stronger to face the Ultimate Boss.

title: Crazy Way
description: Crazy Way is an action-platformer inspired by games like Pizza Tower, Rayman, and the Sonic the Hedgehog series. You play as a tired office worker who, startled by the news on TV, falls down a manhole. Wandering through the sewers, you eventually emerge in another world—one where you'll have to fight for your life and interact with its unhinged inhabitants

title: The Reserve
description: Fast paced modern military FPS. Diverse game modes for fun PvP action or PvE game play with co-op mode with friends plowing through bots while hitting the mission objectives. Experience Rank up system along with daily challenges to expedite your ranking up progress. Can be played in FP or TP.

title: Kasperia Arena
description: Brace yourself and fight your way through intense battles, ruthless enemies, and ever-changing challenges. Win thrilling matches, gather resources, craft powerful gear, buy and equip the best weapons, and master your combat skills. All to prepare for the ultimate showdown against the final boss!

title: Slime Trader
description: Summon, place, and merge slimes to stop the larvae pouring from the pen. Collect 111 slimes across 12 grades from F to XXX, grow through runes and rebirths, trade eligible Steam Inventory items, and climb the stage leaderboard in this casual pixel-art horde defense game.

title: Foxy's Potion Shop
description: Join Foxy in its little cabin in the middle of the Magical Forest as the new potion crafter! All the inhabitants of the Forest are thrilled that you moved in to perform the art of brewing in a cauldron!

title: Keep Making Games
description: Tycoon for a one-person game studio, starting in 1976. Your only staff: a talking cassette, a bonsai and a chick with a megaphone. Unrealistic, I know. So is taking on the whole games industry alone for 50 years, and that's the plan. Build games from features, beat rivals to the shelves.

title: Cybernetic Strategy
description: Cybernetic Strategy is a flamboyant sci-fi auto-battler with an emphasis on being easier to play, powerful unit fantasies, and social competition!

title: The Empty Suitcase
description: A psychological horror game following a detective investigating the murder of Roland T. Owen in Room 1046. The investigation begins normally, but as strange events unfold, the case takes a disturbing turn.

title: Starstone
description: Starstone is a high-fantasy card game built for players who love deep strategy, dramatic combat, and stunning art. From summoning legendary creatures to mastering equipment synergies, every battle is a tactical where board control, timing, and style come together in a truly epic game experience.

title: Neo Sonic Fighting Heroes
description: In an effort to stay prepared for any future attacks from Eggman, Tails builds a simulation room which allows the user to generate any world they please, alongside a combatant which is indistinguishable from their real life counterpart. This room also allows for 2 people to enter at once, allowing for a more immersive sparring session. All your dream battles will happen here!

title: The Library Assistant
description: The Library Assistant is a cozy book-sorting game where you'll discover over 3,000 books across 600 unique book collections. Organize shelves, uncover charming literary treasures, and experience the satisfying feeling of bringing order to delightful physics-based chaos.

title: Tidy & Bright: Together at the Christmas Market
description: Cozy first-person co-op organizing and cleaning simulator! Sort gifts, sweets, decorations, toys and festive treats. Tidy up the Christmas market, earn points and restore order before the holiday crowds arrive!

title: Trash to Trees: Tidy Up the Forest!
description: A cozy first-person nature restoration game. Explore a polluted forest, collect litter, sort it at the recycling station, and watch the world come back to life, one piece of trash at a time. Solo or co-op for up to 4 players.

title: Pixel Chaos: Tidy Up the Museum
description: A cozy first-person organizing game set in a chaotic Victorian museum. Gather scattered colored cubes, carry them in stacks, and place them into matching slots to reveal pixel artworks and restore charming 3D voxel exhibits.

title: Scrolls of Alexandria: Tidy up the Lost Library
description: Cozy first-person organizing game. Sort 4,800 scrolls back onto the shelves of the Library of Alexandria, reading the colour of 21 real ancient alphabets. Every cat guards one and won't let go until you pet it! Eat a golden apple for optional magic, or take a quiet afternoon in the stacks :)

title: Poopy the Game
description: Poopy the Game is a fast-paced, physics-based platformer heavily inspired by the original Genesis Sonic the Hedgehog games with stupid, yet adorable characters. Poopy the Game sets itself apart from other high-speed platformers. With the completely physics-based grappling hook and the innovative enemy freeze/launch mechanic, you can launch yourself in any direction you want, in any location you want, as long as you have enough skill and speed.

title: Butt Ends Meet
description: A low-poly first-person cleanup game where you work for the mysterious Mr. N, cleaning up the city one cigarette butt at a time. Collect litter, earn money and upgrade your tools as you take on increasingly messy jobs.

title: Owlbound Tomes
description:
Get ready to enter a magical library where even the paths can disappear! In Owlbound Tomes, you follow a small owl librarian on a mission to recover runaway magical books, deliver them to the correct Book Return Tables, and finally reach her cozy perch.

But there is one important detail: the paths are not permanent. Some tiles collapse after one passage, others survive two, while special tiles can withstand up to three crossings. Every movement must be planned carefully, because a path used too early may simply disappear when you need it most.

Before starting, study the board, connect the paths, arrange the movable tiles, and think about the best order for collecting and returning each book. Once you press Play, there is no way to change the route. The owl will automatically follow the path you created, carrying multiple books and turning every crossing into a strategic decision.

Across 30 levels, divided into three magical biomes, the challenges become increasingly creative and require you to think not only about where to go, but also when to pass through each location. Can you make a round trip without destroying the path you need to return?

With a cozy atmosphere, charming visuals, and puzzles based on spatial planning, Owlbound Tomes delivers calm, clever, and deeply satisfying challenges. Observe, organize, calculate your passages, and create the perfect route for the little librarian.

Recover the books, preserve the paths, and find the perfect perch!

title: Bodybuilder Simulator Co-op
description: Bodybuilder Simulator Co-op is a deep open-world game set on an isolated Italian island where sport is the foundation of life. Train, manage your diet and develop your character while competing in various sports disciplines. Every decision impacts your body and your story.

title: Bodybuilder Simulator
description: Bodybuilder Simulator is a simulation game where you try to build muscle and earn money. You can train using various machines in the gym. Outside the gym, you can explore places like the market, hospital, and casino. You can also open and manage your own gym to multiply your earnings.

title: Panda: Shards of Aurora
description:
Panda: Shards of Aurora is a challenging platformer set in a frozen world trapped in an endless winter.

Take control of a young panda and embark on a journey across 30 handcrafted levels, guided by the mysterious Ancient Bear, an ancient guardian who will help you uncover the secrets of the frozen valley.

Navigate icy platforms, slippery surfaces, deadly spikes, fragile terrain, and dangerous environmental hazards as you search for the legendary Shards of Aurora.

But the frozen lands are not empty. Hostile penguins and aggressive seals stand in your way, testing your reflexes and precision as you progress through increasingly challenging stages.

Explore every corner of the frozen world, discover hidden gems, overcome challenging obstacles, and restore the Shards of Aurora to bring the light back to the valley.

title: Mise en War
description: A multiplayer cooking brawl for 2 to 8 players. Race to finish your recipe by chopping, frying, and baking while slapping rivals, stealing their prepared food, and deploying hilarious sabotage traps in a shared, chaotic kitchen arena!

title: Northfall
description: Northfall is a 3D survival horror game set in 1990s Pacific Northwest coastal forests where you scavenge for resources, expand your camp, and face mutated infected threats. You manage supplies carefully, explore dangerous foggy terrain, and must locate and destroy enemy nests with thermite to permanently secure areas. Your base serves as your only refuge—upgrade it to craft tools, heal wounds, and plan expeditions while staying vigilant against a world where mistakes are fatal.

title: Piecework: The Jigsaw Museum
description: Piecework: The Jigsaw Museum is a first-person jigsaw and tidying game set in a museum where thirty paintings have come apart. Find the pieces scattered around the building and put every painting back on the wall, at your own pace.

title: Cosmo Solitaire 4: Edge of the Galaxy
Kaerun
description: Uncover the buried history of Veyrland in a first-person exploration puzzle adventure. Survey ancient Stone Chambers, decipher runes, and follow the evidence from the Asterveen Field Institute into a landscape of forgotten secrets

title: Veillombre
description: Multiplayer pixel-art horror for 1-16 players. A manor drowned in darkness, a candle as your only ally, a monster on the prowl — and maybe traitors among you. Scavenge, barricade, hide, vote… and survive the night.

title: Rogue Elements
description: Rogue Elements is a tactical ASCII roguelike, where the environment is as lethal as the monsters lurking within it. Every step is a fair, but challenging tactical decision, as you will need to observe and learn enemy abilities and cloud patterns. Navigate a living dungeon where fire, ice, and poison and other elements continuously shape the dungeon around you.

title: The Citadel Must Hold
description: The Citadel Must Hold is a fantasy base-building survival RTS where players rebuild and defend a fortress-city, explore the surrounding map with a hero, discover Places of Power, and prepare for escalating Monster Tides. Each run is shaped by Founding Oaths, Rally Decrees, exploration rewards, research, and procedural maps.

title: The Voice Party
description: The Voice Party is a voice-mimic party game in which players listen to short sounds, record imitations through a microphone and compare scores. It includes solo practice, local pass-and-play for two to four players, private online rooms, a scene-dubbing mode and local custom audio packs.

title: More Slots More Money
description: A short incremental casino management game where you fill the floor with slot machines and table games, hire staff, expand to new rooms, and upgrade towards the ultimate automated casino.

title: Guilded Fools
description: Guilded Fools is a dark-comedy incremental game set inside a twisted stage play. Gather a cast of foolish heroes, customize their gear, channel eldritch powers and win over the crowd for a chance to escape.

title: Oortbound
description: A co-op space roguelite built on free-flight combat. Gun down raiders, grow a drone fleet and mine planets while the sun swells toward collapse, then dive in to face the boss or warp to a richer sector. One to four pilots, five classes, and every run ends past the event horizon, one way or another.

title: Never Happened
description: “If no one notices, it’s art history.” — Now you haul masterpieces. Rule one: never leave a scratch. But hands slip, and this company has a tradition: paint over it. Three minutes before the inspector arrives. No eyedropper — mix five pigments and match the color by eye. 100+ real masterpieces.

title: Tiny RTS
description: Tiny RTS is a 2D Pixel Real time Strategy game revolving around multiple factions that all have different Playstyles

title: Revenaevum
description: Revenaevum is a PSX-style gothic survival horror game set in a corrupted modern world. Explore oppressive environments, solve occult puzzles, evade twisted creatures, and use scarce weapons and deadly traps as Reven fights to uncover what remains of his humanity.

title: Elandrake
description: Elandrake is an incremental, twin-stick shooter game where you protect a cosmic entity as it emerges from another reality. Consume matter to gain abilities and use them to blast fleets back to where they came from!

title: IncrementalOS
description: An incremental love letter to the 90s desktop. Start with a blank desktop and one icon, unlock programs, systems and minigames, make more money, and build your way up to a system worth bragging about.

title: Abyssalis
description: Descend through the ocean layers, purify marine life, and survive the abyss in this bullet hell roguelite. Face deadly bosses, choose powerful upgrades, and uncover the origin of the curse. Can you save the ocean before becoming fish food?

title: Gigachomp
description: Feed your tiny creature until it gets HUGE! Blast through swarms of monsters to gather ingredients, and cook up mountains of food in this cozy incremental game. The bigger it gets, the stronger you become, helping you feed its growing appetite.

title: Stuck in a Broken Tutorial
description: You are Player, traversing the broken tutorials of disparate game worlds as you ponder your existence. Goofy, short, and fun.

title: Corel Wild Cards
description: CD-ROM set of 7 card games (Crazy Eights, Hearts, Fish, Old Maid, War, Twenty-One, Klondike) for Windows 3.1 and Macintosh. Intended for children, the games are played against talking cartoon animals.

title: Shole Soccer
description: Shole Soccer is a chaotic online soccer game where ball obeys physics - and your friends don't obey rules. Kick, stun or tackle your way to victory over your friends.

title: Potions Galore
description: Potions Galore is a cozy sorting game where you organize 2500+ potion bottles in their respective shelves. Read about every unique set in the Potion Encyclopedia, deduce the correct placement and tidy up the mess you made when your sorting ritual failed!

title: Your Way Out
description: Pushed into a manhole, you wake up in the sewers with nothing but a lighter. Scavenge the dark tunnels, sell your finds to Rattus the rat trader, upgrade your gear and find your way out before the flame dies.

title: Parcel Inspector Simulator
description: Parcel Inspector Simulator is a first-person inspection sim set on the night shift of a transit post office in 1962. Every parcel that crosses the desk is weighed, X-rayed, checked under a UV lamp, listened to with a probe and looked up in the terminal, then stamped: approve, return to sender, hold, dispose or confiscate. Regulations change from night to night, wages pay for desk upgrades and for a brother's sanatorium bills, and a 20-night story campaign with seven endings follows a favour that somebody upstairs keeps asking for. After the campaign the shifts go on as endless nights with special conditions.

title: Just Until Morning
description: Just Until Morning is a first-person horror game set during a single night shift at a 24-hour rural gas station. From 23:00 to 07:00 the player serves customers at the register, restocks shelves, takes out the trash, resets a faulty pump and watches four CCTV feeds that sometimes show people who are not there in person. There is no health bar: unanswered calls and ignored camera intrusions put the station's lamps out one by one, and a station left too dark ends the shift early. A full night takes about 80 minutes and can end in seven different ways.

title: 99 Fails Lite
description: 99 Fails Lite is a one-button precision platformer set in Zeebo's surreal nightmare. It features challenging jumps, multiplayer for up to four players, an endless mode, and music by David Wise.

title: Forgery: Before the Law (Study)
description: Push the box and go beyond the gate. A warehouse keeper-style 3D puzzle adventure inspired by Kafka's novels and myths. A short game exploring an absurd inner world across 6 stages.

title: Escape the Playground
description: One hears your voice. One only moves when you look away. One doesn't follow rules at all. The playground is open. Bring friends. 1-4 player co-op horror.

title: StarL 9 Ashes Of The Past
description: Enjoy a magical Match-3 journey through a mysterious island filled with secrets and adventure. Complete colorful levels, solve challenging puzzles, restore ancient magic, and uncover the truth behind an unforgettable legend.

title: Night of the Wolves
description: On Halloween night, José is attacked by a cursed beast, so his only hope lies with his girlfriend’s eccentric twin sister, who has at least read a book or two about werewolves.

title: ClearIt M4
description: Test your aim and puzzle-solving skills! Shoot colorful balls, match them by color, trigger chain reactions and overcome unique obstacles. Explore challenging levels, use powerful special elements and compete against the computer!

title: LSDos: Digital Simulation Simulator
description: LSDos is a weirdcore-inspired, open-world exploration game where you are trapped in a computer, searching for any way to escape. Complete tasks and do an abundance of things to acquire the tools and expertise needed to leave safely.

title: Spectral Map
description: Movement based texture adventure with RPG elements.

title: One More Candle
description: A cozy candle shop simulator where you take customer orders, melt and mix wax with colors and herbs, pour candles into unique molds, decorate each creation, and grow your little business one warm glow at a time.

title: Stick Life: The Daily Grind
description: Start in a tent with twenty-five dollars and a whole city to work out. Climb a career to the corner office, gamble, fight, date, adopt a stray, buy the mansion on the hill, and try not to miss rent. An isometric life sim where every day lasts 24 real minutes.

title: Cue-rious
description: That is a terrible pool cue. Let's use it. CUE-RIOUS is physics-based pool with cues you draw yourself. Try a crooked hook, a wonky fork, or your latest bad idea. Line up a shot and find out whether you've invented a trick shot or a complete disaster.

title: Stonefeather
description: Stonefeather is an atmospheric flying adventure where you fly as a stone-born bird across silent ruins. Ride updrafts, build momentum, and restore the vanished wind on a mystical journey.

title: Break the Piñatas
description: An incremental game where the goal is to smash 1,000 piñatas! Earn candy, buy upgrades, and unlock unique skills to become the strongest. So, are we stopping at the last piñata?

title: Where Are My Cats?
description: Explore different regions, find hidden cats, and unlock new areas! Discover all 100 cats across 5 main regions while enjoying a relaxing exploration experience with cozy sounds.

title: Axolotl Rangefighters
description: A fast-paced 2D local versus fighting game featuring characters from the Axolotl Rangefinders universe. Duel your friends, master unique character combos, and brawl across vibrant pixel art stages to claim victory in intense competitive matchups.

title: Glorgo's Microplastics Mine
description: Become an underpaid, overworked middle-manager for the callous mine boss Glorgo. Amass a hoard of wealth, navigate the vast eerie alien mines, and encounter voracious plastic beasts in a colorful, Y2K-themed dystopia filled with mayhem, microplastics, and monsters.

title: The Case of the Last Shawarma
description: The last shawarma in town is gone. The owner is destroyed. The police have "real crimes". You work for seeds, and you just took the case.

title: The Company
description: The Company wants you productive. The Company wants you calm. The Company wants you compliant.

title: Neon Hustle
description: A first-person management sim set in a living crime-noir town. Recruit workers, pitch clients on the street yourself, manage rising city heat, and keep the operation running before the night forces itself to end. Mature themes, no explicit content.

title: Beyond 90: A Footballer's Life
description: Live the life of a footballer, from your first contract at 16 to your final season up to 24 years later. A single career can last over 100 hours. Play every match in real time, earn your place, chase fame, money and love, and face the consequences that follow you beyond the 90 minutes.

title: Battlements
description: Pirate ships, fortresses, and cannons! Battlements is an arcade reimagining of the "Rampart" classic. Defend the peaceful nation of Marinia from the dreaded Crimson Waves Empire - build walls, set up cannons, bombard the enemy! Control the fight with upgrades and special cards!

title: Cube Sweeper: 3D Minesweeper
description: Classic Minesweeper, carved into three dimensions. Orbit each board and read the numbers around corners and down through tunnels. Every board is guaranteed solvable by logic alone, never a guess. Dig for hidden gems and climb from your first click to Expert.

title: Classic Blackjack
description: Play authentic 1, 6, or 8-deck blackjack with real casino rules, true 3:2 payouts, unbiased Fisher–Yates shuffles, and smooth chip animations. Learn fast, play endlessly, and chase perfect hands in a clean, focused table experience.

title: OurLife
description: OurLife is a text-forward life simulator game filled with immersive, choice-driven systems that impact more than just the character you're playing. Live any life, make any choice: OurLife.

title: LifeSimOS
description: A story-rich coming-of-age experience told through a 2004 desktop, where friendships, music, and late-night conversations shape who you become. Explore chats, drama, mini-games, and the early internet in a branching story about growing up, making mistakes, and finding your place.

title: Death and Burial of Poor Cock Robin
description: Visual novel adaptation of the original poem. Made for Nanoreno 2019.

title: Firechan Breaking and Entering
description: We have many VR games here, where you run through many different locations and beat up enemies, and destroying crates! By playing good you can maintain a flow state and consistent speed! Be sure to collect all the spray cans and the (useless) CD in every level! Beware though, as some of these can get tough!

title: Path to the End
description: Explore an imaginary world in ruins. Make friends, enemies, and rivals on a journey where every step brings you closer to a confrontation with destiny.

title: Sort My Pigs
description: Sort My Pigs is a 2D organizing simulator where you sort over 5,000 cute pigs into their correct pens. Pick a pig, find its pen, earn coins, and unlock upgrades as your farm grows. No timer, no pressure, just pure, cozy sorting bliss.

title: Harvest Hand
description: A cozy turn-based farming deckbuilder where cards serve as your farming tools. Plant and harvest crops, manage water and energy, adapt to changing weather and threats, and complete increasingly challenging contracts to earn coins and upgrade your deck. Balancing farm management with strategic card choices, the goal is to keep your farm thriving while building an increasingly powerful set of tools.

title: Scream Operator: Haunted House Manager
description: Run a haunted dark ride from the control booth in this spooky horror management sim. Load guests, trigger scares, route carts, and keep the power alive as the queue surges. Earn cash and prestige to rebuild the mansion, automate the ride, and survive every shift.

title: Buffer Phantom
description: A run-based action game of challenging encounters in a shooter's body.

title: Volleyball Mania
description: Volleyball Mania is a 3D beach and indoor volleyball game. Pass, set, spike, read the block, aim past the defender, and finish the rally. Take on the World Tour across three stadiums, or challenge a friend online.

title: Ace Marks the Spot
description: A relaxing card-based monster-hunting game that combines +1/-1 solitaire-style gameplay with crafting and exploration. Build card combos to defeat beasts, gather materials and doubloons, craft and upgrade more than 50 unique weapons, and travel across five islands as you take on increasingly powerful monsters. With a slow-burn progression system and no game-overs, the focus is on strategy, efficiency, and steadily growing your power.

title: ComicKingdom
description: Comic Kingdom is a text-based adventure game primarily featuring a black-and-white comic style. It tells the story of a group of young manga artists who are trapped in a suburban farm.

title: Impossible Machine
description: Impossible Machine is a 2.5D graphic adventure where you explore, talk, and build solutions while solving a mystery. No minigames, but plenty of terrible jokes. What could possibly go wrong?

title: Multiverse All Star Fighters!
description:
Multiverse All-Star Fighters is a 2D Crossover fighting fangame that brings all of your favorite characters from iconic worlds in a multiplayer throw-out fighting slam fest, what if sonic could fight spongebob, what if paper mario battles megaman x and
what if samurai jack challenges morrigan.

title: Routes and Forges
description: A resource manager/RTS set in a medieval world with a voxel-art (Minecraft-like) visual style. It allows players to build villages, establish logistics routes, and create production chains.

title: Gnomicide
description: 100,000 Gnomes have overrun the realm. It's time to clean up.

title: Daydream Cat: DreamSpirits Idle Adventure
description: Daydream Cat: DreamSpirits Idle Adventure is a desktop idle role-playing game. Players build a team, hatch and collect DreamSpirits, and progress through automated battles. The adventure runs alongside other desktop activities, allowing players to work, study, or watch videos while their team continues adventuring.

title: The Ramen Bar
description: Run a cozy ramen bar in a busy Japanese city. Prepare bowls, serve customers, and keep the place clean, all while expanding your menu every day. But when you're alone something doesn't feel quite right...

title: The Coast is Clear: Tidy up the Beach!
description: The Coast is Clear: Tidy up the Beach! is a first-person beach cleanup and restoration simulation. Collect and sort 7,621 items across the beach, ocean and pier, tidy clothing stores and surf rentals, put beach chairs and toys back in place, and restore the coral reef while helping turtles. Earn money to buy cleaning tools and skills, use an auto-sorter, and hire a dog to carry trash. Play alone or with friends in online, LAN and local split-screen co-op. Character customization unlocks as stores are sorted, and players can use water guns, throw coconuts and crabs, and play with a seagull gun.

title: Sorcerous 2: City of Cults
description: Kick down doors, hunt sinister cults, and face bloodthirsty gods in a dark diesel-punk metropolis. Lead a group of magic-school students into turn-based battles with carefully chosen spells, talismans, and occult weapons.

title: Conquisterra Roguelie
description: A 2D roguelike about escaping a dungeon nightmare, and choosing between a comforting lie or a painful truth.

title: Hitting Home's Carnival
description: This is no ordinary computer program. The Hitting Home "edu-tainment" program is an innovative, interactive, action-adventure education program set in a carnival environment.

title: Sort The Bunnies
description: A cozy organizing simulator for 1–4 players. Sort 500 bunny designs, fill colorful shelves, and turn a messy shop into a collection worth admiring. Unlock handy upgrades and make a little mischief along the way.

title: QuestAway
description: QuestAway is a free-to-play idle RPG that runs in a small window next to the Windows taskbar. The player builds a party of heroes that fights on its own while they do other things. Every so often they check in, equip the loot that dropped, spend skill points and send the party somewhere harder.

title: Crash Team Racing: Turbocharged
description: A PC port of Crash Team Racing, built on the community decompilation. It runs natively on Windows and Linux at up to 240 FPS, in widescreen, with a cleaned-up renderer. Or with the original PS1 look, if that’s what you prefer.

title: Hua Manlou
description: Infiltrate the enemy capital, using the entertainment venue "Hua Man Lou" as a cover, and secretly train six talented and beautiful women as spies to carry out reconnaissance and assassinations. Advance the plot through skill development, and unlock three endings through love, hate, and revenge.

title: Trenchworms
description: Trenchworms is a fast-paced 2D arena shooter featuring fully destructible terrain, 26 weapons and ninja-rope movement. It includes single-player, local multiplayer and online multiplayer, with PvP and PvE gameplay.

title: The Truth Written by the Stars
description: When you start the game, the narrator will instruct you to “close your eyes.” At that moment, whether you actually close them or keep them open will change the course of the story. Listen carefully to the voice as you proceed, and find your way to the truth.

title: Disco Ball Simulator 2000
description: You owe 1 million $ and all you have is a disco ball! A hectic but satisfying incremental swiping game about creating the perfect party night with light effects. Juggle cooldowns, upgrade equipment, earn $$$ and most importantly: Make numbers go up!

title: Leticulus
description: Beyond time. Beyond space. There lies the unknown. Build a ship unlike any other from over a billion combinations, battle dangerous enemies, uncover hidden secrets and push deeper toward the mysterious summit in this retro roguelite exploration shooter.

title: Tetric
description: Tetris-style puzzles meet horror and dark medieval fantasy in Tetric. Battle enemy blocks with magic, logic, and tactical cards. Buy, grade, and sell cards to fund your quest, unravel sinister mysteries, and help Don Femur save the kingdom of Calaberia.

title: I Am Plague
description: I Am Plague is a dark fantasy incremental roguelite in which players build a rat horde to climb an underground fortress. Combat is automatic, with outcomes determined by mutations, abilities, and their synergies. Players select mutations, visit shops, and choose branching routes through dungeon floors and text-based events. Flesh and skulls gathered during runs fund permanent upgrades and unlock new mutations at the Tree of Flesh and Tree of Bones. The full game is planned to include over 200 floors, more than 50 mutations across several rarity tiers, and increasingly dangerous enemies and bosses.

title: Wreck Below
description: Wreck Below is an underwater horror game where you dismantle wrecks and avoid the unseen threat of The Arbiter.

title: Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon: Breakpoint - Aurora Edition
Offside Deal: Football At Any Costs
description: The match is only half the job. Build a squad that fits the way you want to play, keep the dressing room together and make the right calls when matchday arrives. Egos, rivalries and loyalties can make or break your season.

title: Sinking
description: Sinking is a side-scrolling platformer developed in Adventure Game Studio, developed for the One Room One Week contest on the AGS forums in 2013.

title: Dungeonbound
description: Dungeonbound is a retro first-person auto-battler dungeon crawler. Send your Warrior, Mage or Rogue into monster-packed depths, watch battles play out turn by turn, and grow stronger every run. Death just sends you home with the loot. Merge gear, buy upgrades, descend again.

title: Deadful Leningrad: Developer Life Simulator
description: Deadful Leningrad: Developer Life Simulator is a dark comedy simulation and action-adventure game where you play as a game developer in the CIS region. The working week turns into pure chaos as everyday tasks conflict with unexpected challenges. Players must navigate a surreal environment, steal weapon models, search for a graphics card in garbage dumps, and vote in elections. The ultimate goal is to survive for at least a week without starving or losing limbs.

title: Fallen Sword II
description: Fallen Sword II is a turn-based fantasy adventure inspired by retro RPGs. Rise as Erildath's new Champion and journey through fantastical realms and perilous dungeons. Fight the darkness, break the cycle, and save the world.

title: On Your Own: Survival Inventory
description:
Rotate the grid and break groups of boxes to move your character, loot items and avoid enemies.
Explore places with different loot and levels.
Recycle items to get materials and craft new ones until you fix the radio and ask for help.

title: Curse of Cards
description: Battle through a shifting cosmic library in this roguelike card-crawler. Combine satisfying card strategy with first-person exploration. Unleash ancient creatures of British folklore, gather relics, collect powerful cards, and fight to shape your own story escaping the cursed library’s grasp.

title: Smokey Mike
description: In stand-up, talent isn't always enough. In this point and click adventure you have to improvise, survive and fail with style until you craft the five minutes that could change everything.

title: Death Insurance
description: You're a desk-jockey processing life-insurance claims. Collect and investigate 3D objects to piece together the cause of death. Case by case, the true nature of Bliss unfolds in this supernatural mystery.

title: Heldritch Rush
description: Heldritch Rush is a thrilling, Isometric Rail-shooter set in New Peak City. Play as Teddy MacAllister - an exterminator who is no stranger to the supernatural. Overrun with cosmic threats, battle your way through the city and put an end to the outbreak before the president pushes the big red button.

title: Summon Island: The Robot Pirate Invasion Was Today?!
description: This wizard vacation has quickly turned into an all out war! Summon powerful allies to protect yourself, and save the island from the robot pirate invasion!

title: Dragon's Jewels
description: Dragon's Jewels is a captivating 3D puzzle game! A mysterious and enigmatic island filled with captivating puzzles awaits you. Your task is to help the little dragon collect all the gems!

title: Cheese Stack
description: Cheese Stack is a cozy puzzle game where you need to arrange falling pieces of cheese into perfect rows. Simple rules, delicious graphics, upbeat music, and a highscore table you'll be tempted to beat. It's the perfect way to unwind for 5 minutes or get lost in the game for an hour.

title: The Lost Hunter
description: The Lost Hunter is a realistic hunting and survival simulation. Hunt in dynamic weather conditions, collect resources and upgrade your equipment. Your eagle will guide you on the trail. Dangers increase at night; are you ready to survive with your strategy and skills?

title: Tussle Works
description: Assemble a bench of scrap-built windup contraptions and battle the ghost teams of rival tinkerers. 210 hand-drawn machines, 7 game modes, a ranked ladder, and a collection to complete — a cozy 16-bit auto-battler where every pixel was placed by hand.

title: Vicious Cycle
description: Vicious Cycle is a first person Horror game where you venture into a dark forest by bike and on foot. Brave hazardous trails on your bike until the path is blocked. Then, explore abandoned sites on foot while solving puzzles and encountering supernatural creatures. Can you survive the cursed forest?

title: The Living Graveyard
description: Immerse yourself in the world of "The Living Graveyard" - a unique game in the style of Whac-A-Mole, where instead of moles you have to fight zombies rising from their graves!

title: The Messenger from Athens at Marathon
description: An adventure running game blending parkour and long-distance strategy. Manage stamina and willpower, control your pace, and avoid obstacles to complete the epic journey from Marathon to Athens. Every sprint and jump can change your fate.

title: A Matter of Murder: Second Stab
description: The game is afoot. Again. A Matter of Murder: Second Stab is a roguelite detective puzzler where every playthrough serves up a fresh murder, a new web of lies, and another chance to prove your little grey cells are sharper than the killers knife.

title: Fine Dying
description: A strange kitchen. Endless orders. Limited minutes. Serve, grow, survive. Bon Appétit!

title: Whistle Willie
description: A Steamboat Willie-inspired first-person, open-world horror game. Navigate a haunting world by boat, upgrade your vessel, and arm yourself to survive. Uncover the chilling secrets needed to free the inhabitants from Willies relentless attacks.

title: Super Terrestrial
description: A roguelite autoscroller, where you control a spaceship navigating procedurally generated levels. Use limited aerial jumps and hover abilities to dodge hazards, collect gems, and explore alternate biomes. Each run features upgrades, power-ups, dynamic enemies, and challenging bosses.

title: Promo Wrestling World
description: The most customizable wrestling management game is in your hands. Run or build your wrestling promotion. Sign talent, book matches and storylines, build stars, and watch rivals grow, wrestlers grow old, have kids, and their bloodline continue on.

title: Byrd Ronin
description: Byrd Ronin blends fast-paced 2D action with precise controls. As a Ronin bird, carve through chaos to reach the legendary cherry tree that holds your vow. Get stronger each run, unlock new items and skills, master combat flow, and survive - this is the Ronin path.

title: Plates of Peril
description: Plates of Peril is a chaotic cannibalistic restaurant-management game. Play solo or team up with up to 5 friends as you harvest limbs, prepare dishes, and screen guests for undercover cops to become the ultimate 5-star chef.

title: Forgotten Isle
description: Awaken upon a surreal fantasy isle far from time and explore its toxic shores for an audience with the Lord of Starlight. Brave the void of night in this first-person indie open world experience with retro 3D graphics.

title: Heroines' Chord
description: A classic JRPG dungeon crawler. You play as the heroines who defend the city against an alliance of sinister organizations and corporations. Having pooled their resources, these shadowy forces have established a new mercenary unit with a single purpose — to destroy you. They call it 'Counter Force.'

title: Shelved
description: Sort 1,560+ cursed VHS tapes across 20 genres as a tiny orc! Master magical powers, upgrade your gear, and outsmart a chaotic poltergeist who scatters your work. Features Hidden secrets, 26 achievements, and a Spooky-Free Peaceful Mode. The ultimate cozy horror organizer!

title: Capcom vs. Square: Parallel Destinies
description: A 1v1, 4-button fighter with a blend of the high points of "Vampire Savior", "MARVEL VS CAPCOM" and "CAPCOM VS SNK", it attempts to recreate the classic 90s CAPCOM vibe, and pits both universes in a battle for survival within the Void!

title: Loopers: Duel
description: LOOPERS: DUEL is a IKEMEN-based fighting game that seeks to convey traditional and untraditional ideas and features alongside original characters with unique movesets and appearances all while aiming for a certain level of balance which is considered unusual for IKEMEN fighters but still priotizing fun and hyper level combat.

title: Revolution Core
description: Revolution Core is a 2.5D fighting game inspired by older "airdasher" fighters. It aims to place player expression first and foremost. Wield the Assault Drive system to destroy your opponent in whatever way you see fit.

title: Ohayo Gianthook!: Monster Fishing Adventure
description: Ohayo Gianthook! is an epic fishing adventure where you hunt legendary monster fish in ancient seas. Upgrade your gear, dive into dangerous waters, and uncover the mysteries of the sunken realm known as the Deep World. Catch over 150 unique monster fish and become the ultimate king of the seas!

title: Hrspwr
description: Get a license, buy a beater, customize it, then fully send it! Meet local racers, develop your driving style, dominate the ranks. Grounded physics, unique boost mechanics, varied game modes, career progression, and online connectivity; HRSPWR is a fresh take on the best of arcade racers past.

title: Sugar Squad Rumble
description: Battle rival food factions in this hilarious tactical rogue-like RPG. Work your way through rounds of deliciously devious enemies to reach their final boss and fight your way to the top of the food chain! Do you have what it takes to be New York Citys greatest food mascots?

title: Love X Love
description: Play a gig-economy driver searching for love as the fate of the universe hangs in the balance. Drive the night. Tune your dreams. Chase love.

title: Forever Tunnel
description: Lead your squad through a destabilizing reality in this turn-based tactical roguelite. Defeat enemies. Contain corruption. Prevent collapse.

title: The Delivery Guy
description:
A short psx styled horror game by Unfall Games

You are a broke guy that would take any job to pay his cat's food (and rent).

One day you read about a pizza place that is searching their new delivery guy, the owner of the place has reported that he had to hire 3 delivery guys in the last month only, and that they have never returned. So you decide to send your rèsumé to that place without expecting anything, but during a boring evening...

The place is known for having some strange customers and workers, also, it's the only place in town that makes deliveries at night, but you decide to take the job, the pay seems good and you really need that.

You tell yourself that there is nothing to worry and that nothing will happen to you, but unfortunately... You couldn't have been more wrong...

title: Aphasia
description: Have you ever wondered what happens when we fall into a coma? Why do only some make it back? Aphasia is a first-person horror where you’re trapped inside your own mind, with no memory of who you are. As you explore your fractured memories, your sense of guilt won’t let you escape...

title: Tabletop Inc.
description: Start a tabletop game company in your bedroom workshop! Develop unique genres and themes, assemble the game boxes yourself, pay your bills, hire your friends, upgrade your workshop, and design even better games in this cozy management tycoon.

title: Gun Knife Bomb
description: Gun Knife Bomb is a deadly game of Rock, Paper, Scissors for 2-4 players. Use classified military technology to bluff, cheat, and betray your friends. Four feds enter, only one leaves.

title: Sundae Drive
description: Hit the road in your very own ice cream truck! Explore a cute neighborhood, park in the perfect spot, and serve adorable animal customers their dream sundaes. Scoop, drizzle, and top to perfection. Upgrade your cute truck, restock supplies, and create your own ice cream flavors!

title: Gloombo
description:
Gloombo is a cozy desktop companion game where a little floating island sits beside whatever the player is working on. Players choose crafting projects and start focus sessions while Gloombo works on her own tasks. Between sessions, they can decorate the island, grow a garden, fulfill orders from distant lands, trade with a traveling vendor, and care for a cat.

The island can be moved and resized on the desktop. Orders have no deadlines, and friendships and the bond with the cat do not fade while the player is away. Ambient sounds and music accompany focus sessions, and the game does not monitor the player’s work.

title: Partway
description: Sadie has borrowed the Necronomicon from the local library and has taken it down to the cemetery to commune with her sister, where she accidentally opens an interdimensional rift. Fight through enemies, meet lingering ghosts and find your missing gametoy in this action RPG.

title: Dead of Darkness 2
description: When Jun Takehara finds a wounded little girl in the Appalachians, her search for help leads her to the eerie town of Goldren Creek. What she uncovers in the town's depths will change her life forever. Experience intense, classic survival horror with a strong narrative and rich lore.

title: Alice in Pumpkinland
description: Alice In Pumpkinland is a third person over-the-shoulder-camera comedy horror game.

title: Bird Roll 64
description: This recovered copy of a lost 3D ball-rolling platformer from the 90s appears to have been created by eldritch forces from out of this world. Would you be able to find all its secrets and escape its surreal spaces?

title: Your Debt Is Paid
description: Delve deep into monster-filled dungeons to survive a cruel bargain for your life in this dark fantasy roguelike auto-battler. Wield powerful synergies and unique hero combinations to gather Blood from your enemies and satisfy the demands of your mysterious captor.

title: Paluah's Trench
description: An underwater narrative horror game where you must journey to the bottom of a deep-sea trench and uncover its mysteries.

title: Otherside Tapes: Favela
description: A first-person psychological horror game with a found-footage aesthetic. In search of the mysterious Street 7, an urban explorer finds himself trapped in a loop of distorted realities, rituals, and a supernatural presence that controls the Favela das Almas.

title: Dig to Escape
description: Dig to Escape is a co-op digging game where you search a mysterious island for buried objects. Turn your discoveries into scrap, upgrade your tools and uncover the missing boat motor parts you need to escape. Play alone or dig irresponsibly with your friends.

title: Hollow Ones
description: Hide away from the end of the world in Hollow Ones, a mid-apocalypse narrative horror game.

title: The Boba Teashop: Refill
description: The Boba Teashop - Refill is a first-person psychological horror game. Work at a new branch of Risa's boba shop as Maya, prepare drinks, serve customers, and survive increasingly disturbing shifts where routines slowly turn into a nightmare.

title: Dementium II
description: The DS horror sequel, reborn. William Redmoor wakes with fresh staples in his skull, inside an institution for the criminally insane, where the walls keep peeling back to expose something worse. Fight, solve, and survive your way out. The cult classic, remastered for PC.

title: Good Luck, Little Truck!
description: Good Luck, Little Truck! Is a genre-bending cozy navigation puzzler/narrative delivery sim. Set in a recovering post-collapse world where robots and humans coexist, help North Pacifica Island bounce back one delivery at a time!

title: P.T. for PC
description: A native PC port of P.T., the 2014 PS4 teaser by Kojima Productions.

title: Onward! Autobattles
description: Plan your line-up, set your formation and unleash devastating synergies to crush your enemies. Win battles to unlock more unique units and powerful artifacts in Onwards! Autobattles - a roguelike autobattler, where positioning is everything.

title: Lotwick Hill
description: Buy plots. Run shops. Outsmart your rivals. Lotwick Hill is a business tycoon set in a living town. Choose from 72 shop types, set prices and keep your shelves stocked. Customers have different budgets and tastes, and those tastes change as the years pass. Bid for plots when leases expire, react to your rivals, and zoom down to street level to watch customers queue outside your shops. Play single-player against AI, or compete online with up to four players and up to six competitors in total with AI.

title: De/Ascend
description: De/Ascend is a first-person survival horror game with FMV elements. Waking up in a locked-down underground facility with no memory of your past, you must ascend from its lowest depths and escape its horrors while pursued by a monstrous entity that always knows exactly where you are.

title: Huntsman: Protect & Serve
description: Huntsman: Protect & Serve is a DLC where you discover a hidden section of Atherton Labs teeming with ravenous creatures. Unlike the base game's evasion gameplay, you're armed and must stand your ground against multiple threats. Combat requires strategic ammunition management, careful reload timing, and awareness that gunshots attract more creatures. Puzzle-solving is essential to escape the facility's depths.

title: Night of the Idle Horde
description: Eat the world in this idle, incremental homage to B-movie horror classics. Start as a lowly Shambler and grow into a massive horde. Recruit evil little critters to automate brain collection and buy upgrades for your army. Unleash a mini apocalypse with Desktop Companion Mode.

title: Dark Pals: The 2nd Floor
description: The next chapter of the mascot horror game Dark Pals: The 1st Floor is set in the abandoned depths of UpWard. Armed with your Ink Blaster, you solve puzzles and navigate encounters with new creatures, including the Devourer, while uncovering the mystery of your connection to UpWard and the Dark Pals.

title: Blades & Trades
description: Forge your legacy as both merchant and hero. Explore Zoldar, battle monsters for rare materials, and craft epic gear. Team up with friends to build a thriving shop in the village markets or arm yourselves to conquer the dangerous depths of the wild.

title: Jubaku
description: A first-person psychological horror with branching choices and multiple endings. Investigate a haunted house, document paranormal events, uncover hidden recordings, and decide whether to confront or escape the horrors lurking within.

title: Dr. Mancell and Mr. Flame
description:
Short homage game to go with the song collaboration between Waterflame and Josh Mancell, composer of the original Crash Bandicoot! Just in time for the 30th anniversary (unintentionally)!

We always thought the boss fights of the original classic games like these were the most fun part but too short and unsatisfying. This scratches that itch and lets you duke it out in an unending 1v1 fashion with the boss continuously escalating in difficulty!

title: Scalpers' Spoils
description: A chaotic action and management sim about scalping limited releases: sprint to drops, snag online releases, haggle in your store, risk opening packs, grow your crew, and play solo or with up to 4 players.

title: Garden Hustle
description: Start your own gardening service in a charming neighborhood! Take on relaxing jobs like mowing lawns, planting flowers, blowing leaves, cleaning backyard pools, and more with bite-sized mini-games. Earn money to upgrade your tools, unlock plants, and decorate your own garden between jobs!

title: Largely Legal Monstrosity
description: Largely Legal Monstrosity is an incremental bullet heaven with optional auto-aim. Survive, consume, and GROW! Craft your build in a race to disrupt the market leader. Between rounds invest in infrastructure to power up and secure your place in the largest monster creation event in history!

title: Dracanea: The Ragtag Regalia
description: Dracanea: The Ragtag Regalia is a comedy adventure RPG featuring a washed-up hero who's turning 30, with talking dogs and hamburger monsters! Solve puzzles in the overworld to collect items, engage in turn-based battles with fighting-game button inputs, and even learn 150+ cooking recipes!

title: Over & Out!
description: Build a neighborhood fair (mela) in '90s South Asia during school break! Scavenge for parts, craft minigames, manage and grow your fair. Team up with friends, plan your day, outbuild your rival and see who can host the best fair before the break ends in this plucky tycoon adventure!

title: Bighorn Ramone
description: La final de 1986 que nunca terminó. Atrapado en un traje de mascota del que no puedes escapar. Anima al público y sobrevive a una noche de terror en la cancha mientras luchas por encontrar el camino de vuelta al presente.

title: The Final Cut of Lilith Cunningham
description: Regret has chased Lilith across the years but a chance to escape is within reach. Drawn in by a message from your estranged daughter, you must reshape reality with a mystical Film Reel to solve a mass vanishing. To erase your guilt, you'll decide what and who to leave on the cutting room floor.

title: Dustpocalypse
description: Play as a cute cat leading their trusty robo-vacuum into battle against endless waves of mutated dust monsters. Master working together with your robot friend, and experiment with different builds to finally achieve the perfect run. Will you be able to conquer the Dustpocalypse?

title: Rondo's Romp
description: Join Rondo, a cheerful Akita pup, as he explores 6 whimsical worlds, digging up coins, items, and throwable objects to solve puzzles, battle enemies, and uncover secrets... all with the charm and challenge of a classic 2D platformer!

title: Anna's Bakery Shop
description: Youre Anna, a young woman who ditches the boring city life to open a cozy bakery in a small town. Along with your animate mannequin friend Can Doe, you will embark on a delicious journey, decorate your beautiful shop and meet locals who are curious about the new bakery in their town.

title: King Out
description: King Out is a 1v1 online multiplayer Chess-Boxing game where players muster the strategy within chaos. Draft your pieces, navigate your moves in chess, then nominate your piece to become a fighter, and box on the board against your opponent. Capture or K.O. your opponents last King to win!

title: Countryball Football Online
description: Pick your country and step up to field! Control one player on your team or control all team and compete. Play 5v5 matches with your favorite countryball and show your football skills.

title: Trauma Playground
description: A nostalgic 2000s playground hides something dangerous. Investigate toys and rides, collect Joy, avoid Trauma, and uncover who is putting sharp objects inside them.

title: Cards of Calling
description: A roguelike deckbuilder where you command summoned creatures in battle. Build your deck, create powerful synergies, and fight alongside your pack in tactical turn-based combat.

title: Beellionaire Idle
description: In Bee-lionaire Idle, harvest your hives, process the honey, sell your produce and invest your profits in your farm. Unlock new equipment, speed up production and build a honey empire from a single hive.

title: A Shock of Dimension
description:
We've fallen into a parallel world after a failed experiment scattered crystals across the globe. Now we need to collect them before the villain, prevent a greater tragedy, and return home.

Join on this magical and colorful world wheres Lírio crosses valleys in search of the Crystals to prevent catastrophe and discover what caused its arrival., it will be a natural occurrence or a intentional cause?

Don't miss this Playstation 1-style journey, inspired by classics like NIGHTS Into Dreams, Ace Combat and SPYRO!

title: Banan's Peel Out
description:
Banan's Peel Out is a high-speed bike and gun game, combining elements of Excitebike with 2D shooters like Gradius.

Avoid bullets, shoot down enemies, and try to make some cool jumps on the way! It's all about the score after all.

title: Battle of the Strongest
description: One year after Dr. Willian Monark’s defeat and the disappearance of Line Gear, a new syndicate called Black Wilson takes over the Battle Knuckle tournament in order to face stronger fighters and take over the world.

title: Doctor Havoc
description: When Doctor Havoc finds himself on a mysterious archipelago in the middle of the ocean, it's up to You to help him Punch, Bash and Dive through perilous Fishy foes, and find a way off the island and back home!

title: Everyone Will Die
description: Everyone Will Die is a dark medieval survival city builder and tower defense strategy game set during the 1187 siege of Tyre. Players defend a besieged city with finite food, weapons, manpower and building materials: dismantling houses to reinforce the walls, issuing permanent Siege Council decrees that trade short-term relief for lasting consequences, recovering the wounded after each assault, and commanding troops directly in real-time battles. Expeditions beyond the walls allow raiding, scavenging and trading for supplies. Online co-op for up to four players defending the same town is planned for Early Access.

title: Dungeon Delights
description: Take the role of a night guard at Dungeon Delights, a new eating establishment in the city - and its main attraction is the use of demons and monsters working and performing. Magically bound, of course, they're not a threat to anyone! Well, that's what management claims, anyway. Once you sit down for work, your co-workers seem to be more interested in you than you'd want them to be...

title: CyberSprawl: Survivors
description: CyberSprawl: Survivors is a single-player cyberpunk bullet heaven with loot extraction. Players combine automatic weapons, upgrades, and evolutions to fight hordes and hunt for equipment. They can extract early to secure their haul or stay for greater rewards and risk losing it. Secured gear shapes later runs, while chapter progression unlocks operators, permanent upgrades, Doctrines, and relic hunts.

title: Heritage Flipper
description: Cozy house renovation simulator where you renovate historic old ruins into luxury estates. Clean, restore & decorate homes in American, French, English, Spanish, Dutch, Japanese, Chinese & more styles. Uncovering the secret history of each home

title: The Margot Collapse
description: Cultivate and study microbes in a satisfying chain-reaction incremental gameplay loop. Improve your research efficiency and watch your budget grow. Read your inbox carefully, because company memos, HR notices, and coworker messages don't always agree. Search your cubicle for clues about what Project M really is.

title: Bullistic
description: Bullistic is a chaotic multiplayer party game where you play as a bull, charging through crowded streets, smashing obstacles, attacking rival bulls, and fart-boosting your way to the final arena.

title: Demon General Kirsten
description: Kirsten is a soldier troubled by her current way of life. During her adventure, she'll encounter a wide variety of people, and those warm exchanges will shape her in one direction or another...

title: Drowse
description: DROWSE is a first-person psychological horror game set in the 1990s. A late-night favor brings you back to the office for a few photocopies. Explore, examine objects and solve puzzles as familiar places give way to memories you would rather leave behind.

title: House of Pips: a Domino Roguelike
description: A turn-based domino roguelike where you draft rule-bending perks, combine their effects, and shape your playstyle through a skill tree. Read the board, plan your placements, and adapt to each hand to outwit opponents in single-player or online multiplayer.

title: Save Amani
description: The city in the game has been destroyed beyond recognition by war; its former prosperity now lies in ruins. The rubble everywhere, the smoke filling the air, and the gloomy sky all convey the cruelty and ruthlessness of war, delivering an immersive experience to players.

title: Next Station is...
description:
Next Station is... is a first-person psychological horror and anomaly-detection game set aboard a subway train during its final service of the night.

As the train's driver, players must inspect each station for unusual occurrences before deciding whether to open the doors or bypass the platform. Using the driver's cabin window and CCTV cameras installed throughout the train, players must identify anomalies hidden among seemingly ordinary passengers and environments.

Each decision affects the journey. Opening the doors at an anomalous station may allow unwanted passengers or entities to board the train, carrying the consequences into subsequent stations. Players must make their decisions before the station timer expires, as failing to act causes the doors to open automatically.

Featuring PSX-inspired visuals, environmental observation, surveillance mechanics, and psychological horror elements, Next Station is... focuses on identifying subtle abnormalities while navigating an increasingly unsettling subway route.

title: The Lost Missions of Jax Corden: Episode 9 - In the Clutches of the Vorg
description: A retro-inspired sci-fi FPS adventure blending fast-paced combat, exploration, investigation and environmental storytelling. Fight through hostile worlds, uncover hidden clues, and survive a dangerous pulp-noir universe shaped by cartels, corruption and mystery.

title: Charnel
description: Diablo, but with guns. Descend into the crypts, where darkness reigns, the dead linger, and your light only reaches so far. In this real-time ASCII roguelike you'll uncover an arsenal of weapons, battle hordes of the damned, and navigate an ever-changing labyrinth, with one life to reach the bottom.

title: Werfast
description: A dark metroidvania where you pilot a powerful mech to explore a surreal underground world. Unlock new abilities, discover hidden areas, battle deadly enemies, uncover ancient secrets, and survive the horrors lurking below.

title: Unsound
description: Unsound is a first-person psychological horror game. Explore unsettling environments, solve puzzles, and uncover a dark mystery. Things are not always as they seem, and the deeper you go, the stranger things become. Pay attention to your surroundings and piece together the clues.

title: Laica
description: Live with Laica, a mysterious girl alone aboard a drifting space station, and explore the nightmare spreading beneath your quiet days together. A first-person sci-fi adventure that fuses survival horror with a slow-burn relationship. Is what waits ahead love, or despair?

title: Shiawase Kazoku-bu
description: Kazuki transferred to Amanogawa Gakuen in the middle of the school year. His childhood friend Honoha invited him to the unofficial ‘family club’ where the members pretend to be a family. In addition to the club leader Ougi and imouto-like kouhai Runa, they are soon joined by a robot Misora, the student council leader Mikage, his classmate Yuuki and energetic kouhai Suzu. For Kazuki, who had lost his family at a young age, he did not understand at first the meaning of family nor the purpose of the club, but he felt at ease with kind people at his side. Gradually after spending more and more time with them, they become precious to him, just like ‘family’.

title: Fool's Trigger
description:
Fool’s Trigger combines Russian roulette and card tactics in a deadly multiplayer game for up to six players.

Inspired by Buckshot Roulette, it puts a different spin on the formula: everyone acts simultaneously. Each player has cards, chips, and a revolver — the tools to outsmart opponents and knock them out of the game.

Bet on the outcome of other players’ shots, then spend your winnings on new cards and ammunition. Combine your actions, strike deals across the table, and betray your allies when the moment is right. With overlapping decisions and unexpected outcomes, every match can take a different turn.

Your goal is simple: be the last player at the table.

title: Dead of the Brain
description: Escape from the walking dead in this retro 90's pixel point-and-click adventure from Japan's PC-98 heyday, now playable on modern platforms!

title: Litmustest
description: Litmustest is a Horror Search Action game. Search every room, manage your inventory, solve puzzles and fight the dangers spawning from the depths of this facility. Fixed camera angles and Tank Controls. A limited inventory that forces real decisions about what you carry and what you leave behind.

title: Donauts
description: Donauts is a 3rd-person Roguelike Bullet-Heaven where Geometric heroes fight for survival on a shrinking donut planet. Fight thousands of foes to stop the Discontinuity from destroying topology itself!

title: Luvu: Your Desktop Pet
description: A cozy home-based desktop game where you organize, decorate, and interact with small living spaces alongside your companion. It watches you, reacts to you, and slowly grows attached to you. Quiet, playful, and alive in its own way. Your desktop stops feeling empty. It starts feeling shared.

title: Little Big Ghost Hunter
description: A wholesome horror game where you play as a kid hunting ghosts in the town park, using janky gadgets and a soul-snatching camera. One week until Midsummer. One week to capture them all.

title: Particle Storm
description: Particle Storm is challenging 2D run n gun blending bullet hell and shmup mechanics with striking pixel art, nonstop action, and an energetic soundtrack.

title: Just Open the Door
description: Just Open The Door is an incremental idle game where you open doors to earn money. Buy faster workers, unlock powerful upgrades and automate the entire process as endless doors keep spawning. Simple. Satisfying. Weirdly addictive.

title: Frog in the Pocket
description: Be the funkiest frog! Lay down real percussion grooves in this rhythm game that's all about staying in the pocket. Featuring an original jazz fusion soundtrack and levels designed by the musicians themselves, immerse yourself in a web of groove!

title: Bobarista: One Cup at a Time
description: A cozy narrative simulation game where you craft bubble tea, guide heartfelt conversations, and play character-driven mini-games.

title: Lemony Fresh
description: You are a tiny lemon who cleans filthy spaces. Explore and restore a home with a warm, beating heart.

title: Planet No More
description: An arcade-incremental game where you DESTROY planets! Build a fleet, upgrade weapons, max out your skill tree and destroy your target slowly. You'll advance deep into the galaxy, strategically shattering planets to their cores to unlock the next celestial.

title: Untarctica
description: Something is rotten at the South Pole. Blast through disfigured abominations using your gun's massive recoil in a fast-paced 1-bit bullet-hell platformer. Infiltrate the abandoned Tartarus station, dodge lethal crossfire, and uncover top-secret horrors hidden beneath the ice in Untarctica!

title: Wonder Air: Lunara's Adventure
description: Wonder Air: Lunaras Adventure is a fantasy flying action game where players can freely soar through a beautifully rendered 3D world.

title: Heretics Amulet
description: A dark, tarot-inspired roguelike card game. Draw cards and place them in a grid to get your total as low as possible. Earn souls and spend them on powerful items to improve your deck between rounds. Includes 8 rule-bending bosses and an endless freeplay mode.

title: Hive Havoc 3D
description: Secure the future of the hive in this silly third-person bee experience. Explore hostile locations like the desert, underground labs, and an asteroid. Invade hornet airspace or visit your isolationist juche ant neighbors to steal their nearby resources! This is what they don't want you to know.

title: Death Dealer
description: A multiplayer horror party game for up to 6 players where the losers of a card game are hunted by their friends.

title: Monster Cuisine
description: Best a beast and serve a feast in Monster Cuisine, an action-RPG where you're a tavern keeper hunting fabled creatures in a forbidden forest to cook mythical meals and grow your business. Craft unique weapons and armor sets to take on stronger monsters that are as delicious as they are dangerous.

title: Buru and the Old People
description: A narrative adventure where you take on the role of Buru, a retired thief who agrees to one last job... Chat with quirky locals, encounter D&D inspired mini-games, and try to uncover the truth before its too late in this short story about the connection between the characters and the land.

title: Pup & Mole: Gold Rush
description: Join Pup & Mole on a cozy mining adventure across 7 historical areas. Hop into your minecart, build rail tracks, and dig deeper for hidden artifacts. Upgrade your gear, unlock new tools, and complete your collection while earning money by selling gold and rare treasures.

title: Intercept Course
description: Intercept Course is a tactical space auto battler where you command a starship caught in a temporal rift while chasing a tech thief. Recruit a crew, survive with limited resources, and modify your starship to face rival factions stuck in their own conflicts across every corner of the multiverse.

title: Beetols They Do It
description: Meddle in the incey wincey romantic lives of beetles with old man faces in this absurd simulation game.

title: His Last Film
description: What happened during the filming? Stan doesn't remember. Explore the decaying depths of an abandoned subway station, piece together a fragmented reality, and discover the horrifying truth behind his last film. Some memories are better left unmade.

title: Nothing Lost
description: Nothing Lost is a generational action-roguelike where every death strengthens your next hero. Battle through ever-shifting dungeons, absorb the powers of your fallen heroes, and combine their abilities to conquer the Tower of Souls.

title: Date for Dead
description: A dark romantic comedy where every match brings you closer to love or something far more dangerous. Meet monsters, go on dates, and shape your relationships through meaningful choices. But behind every perfect date lies a secret: Youre not looking for love. Youre trying to bring love back.

title: Dronefall
description: Dronefall is a deck-building tower defense game where you defend humanity's last cities against relentless drone swarms.

title: Dead Awake
description: You fell asleep in class. You woke up in The Purgatory. Explore a nightmarish world between life and death, manage limited resources, and fight dreadful creatures in a desperate attempt to make it home safe.

title: Coldline: Disconnect
description: It's not who you are, it's what you do that matters! As an agent inside the enemy base, repair devices by solving puzzles! Plant your bug in the correct device! Listen on the radio at night and transmit critical intel. You are entirely alone in every decision, but your choices will affect everyone.

title: Jiaohun
description: Today is Dec 31, 1999. Happy New Year. And now, a message from Fairy Town's end...

title: Machinarium 2
description: Finally reunited and searching for a new home, Josef and Berta discover a hidden valley settled by two peculiar robot tribes slowly running short of power. The time has come for a sequel to Amanita Design's adventure classic.

title: Astral Ascent: Expedition 33 - For Those Who Come After
description: A free crossover update bringing Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 into Astral Ascent, featuring three new bosses, three themed rooms, and special summons based on Expedition members.
