Encounter Golgra, the Mimes, and Pétank, then choose an ally at the Campfire, each with unique combat abilities. The content unlocks after completing the game on its base difficulty.

title: Lazare's Sacrifice
description: The guillotine awaits. Your only escape? A deck of cards. Play for your life against legends of the French Revolution in this gripping narrative deckbuilder. Solve puzzles in the depths of prison to uncover the truth of your captivity. Cards, health, sanity... What will you sacrifice to survive?

title: Volatiles
description: Lay out your survival in a top-down action roguelike where every tile expands the battlefield, fuels your build, and pulls you deeper into an analog sci-fi nightmare. Fight alien hordes, unlock powerful weapons, shape deadly arenas, and survive the invasion within.

title: Aftergods
description: Play as a god who survived Ragnarök! Rise from the aftermath to form a new pantheon and restore the fallen Seeds of the World Tree. Recruit followers, build temples, and battle giant monsters solo or with friends across a mythical handcrafted open world.

title: Gamble Hunters
description: A first-person casino action roguelite for 1-4 players. One wallet, four hunters, zero trust. Hunt monsters for 60 seconds to fill the shared pot, then race your friends to gamble it into your own Gold. Upgrade guns, mix traits and artifacts, beat bosses, and pay off the shared debt or go bust.

title: Gods with Badges
description: Patrol the streets of Scarhelm. Decide the fate of your fellow citizens. Take down criminals in brutal turn-based combat. You are a god with a badge, and when you turn on your bodycam, the only thing you answer to is your conscience, and your fellow officers.

title: Kingdom Two Crowns: Pharaoh Lands
description: Pharaoh Lands is a DLC for the side-scrolling micro strategy game, Kingdom Two Crowns. Adventure within the Valley of Kings and discover the domain of powerful gods in an ancient Egypt-inspired setting as you uncover the source of the chaos throughout the land.

title: Little Prince Tyger
description: Combine archery and simulated physics in single screen levels in this violent action roguelike. By order of the Queen, hunt and do not question it.

title: PigPonyPocalypse
description: PigPonyPocalypse is a twin-stick shooter built entirely around boss fights. The game consists of four bosses with no levels in between, and each boss has its own mechanics: a fight in darkness, a collapsing bridge chased by a wall of fire, floor tiles that explode in a sequence the player has to memorize, and a final boss with four phases. Every boss can be fought on two difficulties, Forgiving and True Challenge, the latter adding new phases and mechanics. Victories post the player's damage per second to per-boss Steam leaderboards, and achievements unlock color variants for the heroine.

title: The Escapists 3
description: Plan ridiculous prison breaks, outsmart the guards and escape your way in The Escapists 3. Craft, sneak, fight and improvise through a new 3D prison sandbox, alone or with friends. Just remember to make roll call.

title: Dave the Diver: Subnautica 2
description: Dave the Diver dives into the mysterious world of Subnautica 2 in an all-new crossover adventure. New waters, strange creatures, and unexpected discoveries await beyond the portal.

title: The Legend of the Crystal Revolver
description: The Legend of the Crystal Revolver is a fast paced rogue-like platformer with an emphasis on fluid movement, satisfying combat, and fearsome challenges. With unique abilities to master, tightly generated levels, and the ever-looming threat of Death, each run has something new to experience.

title: BugTDX
description: Buy, sell, and merge towers in this tower defense roguelike inspired by Bloons TD6 and Super Auto Pets. With 40+ towers and 15 enemy types, this chill tower defense game provides hours of fun replayability!

title: Square Force
description: Run. Shoot. Swear. Repeat. Square Force is a fast, brutal co-op survival shooter where waves escalate, panic sets in, and surviving too long only makes things worse.

title: Infected World 2
description: Infected World 2 is the sequel to the first installment of this physics-based, object-destroying puzzle game! Embark on a thrilling adventure amidst a zombie apocalypse!

title: Whisker Mess
description:
Get ready for a feline adventure filled with adorable pieces, clever combinations, and toys scattered everywhere in Whisker Mess! In this fun tile-fitting puzzle, you must place cat-shaped pieces across the board, create lines, and clear the way while earning points and making room for new moves.

By completing horizontal, vertical, and, on certain levels, even diagonal lines, you clear pieces, remove toys from the board, and turn every move into a new strategic opportunity. But be careful: blockers act as extensions of the walls and can completely change the way lines are formed!

With 30 levels divided into 3 biomes, Whisker Mess gradually introduces new challenges. As you progress, you'll encounter special toys with different behaviors, requiring you to carefully observe the board, adapt your plans, and discover how to make the most of each effect.

With no time pressure, Whisker Mess offers a relaxing and accessible experience, while still providing plenty of possibilities for those who enjoy thinking several moves ahead. With different board layouts, varied blockers, and combinations of special toys, each level brings a new challenge to test your creativity and spatial reasoning.

Fit the pieces, create lines, clear the mess, and help turn this feline chaos into pure fun!

title: The Last Slava
description: Become a trickster detective embarking on an Eastern European adventure full of spatial puzzles. Observe your relatives loops, sabotage them, and piece the story together at a grandiose feast. Solve a mystery while pranking your family!

title: Sort My Comics!
description: Sort My Comics! is a casual sorting game set in a chaotic comic book shop. Players sort comics, rebuild collections, identify different formats, and unlock superpowers that make organizing the store easier. The full game features 2,760 comics to sort.

title: Crowd Playground
description: The one and only crowd simulation game, Crowd Playground!

title: Tiny Techie in Puzzle Land
description:
Help the crafty pink-haired gearhead complete a series of intricate puzzles in a beautiful pixel art world! Push, pull and trade places with objects to reach the end of each level! Create bridges by pushing minecarts or boxes into lakes, and navigate objects within complex railroad systems!

Buttons, boxes, minecarts, magical crystals, rails - there are too many objects and possible interactions to count! But don't worry, levels don't have a time limit and you can even skip the ones you think are too hard. Can you help the tiny techie beat puzzle land?

title: Swing Rush
description: Can you push your jumping, crawling and swinging skills? Challenge yourself in this physics-driven swinging game! Complete races, gather collectibles and master your momentum!

title: Something Is Wrong With the Library
description: Shelve hundreds of real books in a library haunted by blood and meat. A spooky narrative organizing simulator by the studio behind I Am Your Beast and Clickolding.

title: Frostmason
description: Hunt monsters for their body parts. Assemble them into a full specimen as part of a Cold War project

title: Electronic Woodfish
description: A casual companion that lives on your Windows desktop. Strike the woodfish to earn Merit, collect skins, open chests, complete collections and crafting, and play online with up to 3 Steam friends.

title: Cozy Meowmory
description:
Step into a cozy world of colorful rooms, adorable cats, and little details waiting to fool your eyes. Compare rooms carefully and find everything that has changed. Objects may move, disappear, rotate, change color, or hide somewhere you least expect!

Think you can remember every little detail? Study a room carefully, keep its layout in mind and then find what has changed without a side-by-side comparison. If things get tricky, use helpful boosters such as Highlight, Peek and Freeze to give yourself a little extra help.

title: Diceminoes
description: Diceminoes is a score-chasing roguelike where you roll dice, pair them up to make dominoes, and connect them into scoring patterns. Discover powerful upgrades, bend the rules, and turn clever placements into huge scoring cascades.

title: Clickhold
description: Defend your castle, click down invading enemies, and build your defenses as each wave gets harder

title: Synapse
description: A cyberpunk point-and-click thriller where your emotional score determines everything. Explore a city under constant surveillance, hack its systems, build dangerous connections, and make choices that decide your access - and whether you survive the night.

title: Dystopia vs. Distortion
description: Build the ultimate pedalboard and crush despair with your sound! A single-player pedalboard-building battle game. Rearrange your pedals to transform your tone and fight with a sound of your own.

title: Temlegen: System Breakdown
description: Trapped in a strange underground world, every choice shapes the story, leading to multiple endings that together reveal the full narrative. Explore, face tense horror moments, and uncover secrets in this unique experiment.

title: My Recycling Center 2
description:
Keep recycling - new challenges, containers, improved models, garbage trucks, management and much more.

Design and expand your new recycling center in this first-person simulation game. Take care of unloading, sorting and compacting the waste.

The new level editor allows you to freely design the yard, place upgrades and set it up the way you like.

With increasing experience, multiple customers will show up simultaneously and might create a queue if unloading does not happen fast enough.

Completely new shaders for containers and vehicles bring realistic graphics and more possibilities. You can not only clean containers with the pressure washer but also restore worn paint jobs with the paint gun.

title: Codex vs Science (Not Talos Principles)
description: Warning, this game is a clever joke: this game is a philosophical narrative that unites Science and Faith to combat global extremist ideology, offering cognitive physiotherapy and mental health support to all those saddened by conflicts such as the war between Ukraine and Russia. A light game!

title: The Great Wife's Guide
description: Play as Dolores, a 1950s housewife pushed to her breaking point by a toxic marriage and the pressure of a perfect suburban life. Set up sabotage in short, focused point-and-click puzzle levels, explore retro cartoon dollhouse rooms, and uncover the secrets hidden behind the perfect home.

title: Londoleon: Not a Single Penny
description: Many people dream of visiting London, but few ever stop to think about what would happen if they lost all their money in a foreign country. Unfortunately, Max's friend not only finds himself without any cash, but also discovers that it has been replaced with counterfeit banknotes.

title: PocoDoro
description: PocoDoro is a tiny virtual pet that lives in a little handheld device on your desktop, next to whatever you're working on. Hatch a squishy slime, poke it, stretch it and throw it so it splats against the walls. Feed it, put it to bed and clean up after it. It grows up in real time, even while you're away.

title: Troll Slayer
description:
The forest near the kingdom has become overrun with trolls, and only one brave knight stands between them and the kingdom.

Take up your sword and venture into the forest in this simple and challenging 2D pixel art platformer. Jump across dangerous terrain, avoid deadly hazards, and fight different types of trolls standing in your way.

Each troll has its own behavior and abilities, requiring you to learn their patterns and choose the right moment to strike.

title: Dragon Quest VIII: Recompiled
description: An experimental native port of Dragon Quest VIII: Journey of the Cursed King for PlayStation 2.

title: Sonic Adventure: Recompiled
description: The Dreamcast adventure, recompiled for PC.

title: Sproutrex
description:
Take control of Sproutrex, a small nature-powered mechanical sphere equipped with a propeller, and explore a colorful pixel-art world where plants and machines have grown together.

Run, jump, glide and fly your way through 28 handcrafted levels filled with hazards, enemies, moving platforms and environmental challenges. Use Sproutrex's unique abilities to reach new areas, overcome dangerous obstacles and discover different ways through each stage.

Along the way, collect coins and mechanical seeds hidden throughout the levels. Find every seed in a stage to earn its Perfect Level medal and prove you've mastered the challenge.

But Sproutrex is more than just a machine. In this strange world, nature has found a way to thrive among gears, metal and forgotten mechanisms — and this little robot is living proof that the two can grow together.

title: Hell-A
description: An online co-op horror action game. Enter the bureaucratic Hell and prove your worth through the Seven Deadly Sins. Master physics, combine magic, and face the trials together or turn on your friends. Maybe they hold you back?

title: Archi Vista
description: Dig, wash, and uncover the lost artifacts in Archi Vista, a relaxing first-person excavation game. Break through layers of earth, clean forgotten ruins, find hidden treasures, and restore extraordinary places one satisfying discovery at a time.

title: Game Shelver 99: I Must Organize My Steam Library and Defend It Against Pirates With a Shotgun
description: Game Shelver 99 is a satirical first-person organizing game set in a retro PC game store. Sort game boxes onto shelves by genre, tags, year, developer, title, or price, then defend your carefully arranged collection from waves of software pirates. Play solo or team up with up to three friends, or choose a peaceful mode focused entirely on organizing.

title: Gildoria: Organize a Dragon's Hoard
description: The dragon's hoard has gotten out of hand. Sit back, sweep up mountains of gold coin by coin, fill chest after chest, and give every buried treasure its rightful place on the shelves. Watch chaos turn into order, piece by piece. A cozy organizing game. There are cats.

title: Vectorline
description: Vectorline is a realistic air traffic control simulator. Sequence departures and arrivals, keep aircraft separated, and clear them to land at real-world airports. Type commands, click and drag aircrafts, or speak clearances out loud. Find out if you can become a controller!

title: Evercursed: Act I
description: Evercursed is a narrative-driven, atmospheric horror experience that delves into the world of sleep paralysis, and the demons that lurk within it. Step into Amelia's haunting nightmares, where the line between dreams and reality is blurred.

title: Myriorama
description: MYRIORAMA is a top-down action-adventure game with a twist: solve puzzles and complete dungeons by rearranging the rooms of the dungeons themselves! Use reality-altering powers to reveal, reshape, and rebuild a stop-motion world full of beguiling mysteries and head-scratching puzzles.

title: Highway Station Simulator
description: Run a highway station with up to four players. Somebody has to work the pumps, somebody has to stock the shelves, and somebody has to answer for the mess. A first-person co-op management sim about a very long shift.

title: Wheel of Death
description: Spin the wheel... or die. Wheel of Death is a dangerously addictive deck-builder and where you'll spin Death's wheel, changing your fate with powerful Tarot card combos, rule-breaking chips, illegal contraband, and a wheel where the numbers go up!

title: Fakin It XL
description: In Fakin’ It XL, one player, the Faker, never gets the prompt and has to bluff their way through. Choose in-room or remote play up front, and get round types built for either. New content, new question types, same lying and grilling you love.

title: Super-Type
description: Super-Type is a brutal keyboard-driven arcade score attack game. Use the entire range of keys to target multiple threats at once, and try to survive an invasion escalating faster than you can control.

title: Marvel Cosmic Invasion: The Siege of Castle Doom
description:
Marvel Cosmic Invasion - The Siege of Castle Doom includes two new playable characters and a new game mode.

The Fantastic Four's most powerful member and their greatest adversary are joining the fight against Annihilus!

Invisible Woman and Doctor Doom head to Marvel Cosmic Invasion for an intergalactic adventure that will see them face off against the fearsome Annihilation Wave!

The Siege of Castle Doom will put the leader of Latveria at the center of its new game mode, set in the nefarious Castle Doomstadt!

title: Boba Bears
description: Run a cozy boba shop for bears, discover hidden drink and topping combos, decorate your space, prep ingredients through playful minigames, and meet new bear customers at your own pace. No timers, no pressure, just sweet drinks, curious experiments, and soft village moments.

title: Backrooms 95
description: Explore eerie liminal spaces in a low-poly Backrooms horror experience inspired by the aesthetics of forgotten 90s technology.

title: Freshly Caught
description: Catch fish, arrange your stall, and run a cozy neighborhood fish stand by the water. Set up your stall, serve customers by finding the right fish for them, upgrade your gear, and grow your tiny seaside business one catch new and rare fish!

title: Tiny Patisserie
description: Run your own cozy pastry shop. Spot what customers are craving, combine and box up sweet treats, and jump into hands-on minigames for every order. Unlock new recipes, upgrade your tools, and grow your tiny shop into a thriving neighborhood favorite.

title: Sumoo
description: Sumoo is a minimalist grid puzzle where numbers slide, meet, and add up. Every stage demands one exact number. Use pits, portals, and multipliers to land on it.

title: What Killed Rachel
description: A story-driven psychological horror that chases the truth behind Rachel's death. As you follow scattered memories, you slowly come face to face with the reality of the tragedy. Blaming someone is easy. But answering what truly killed her is not.

title: A Real Life Party
description: Henry is late, as always... Guess I should just go inside. How bad could it be?

title: Cosmic Dominion
description: Cosmic Dominion is a 2D space combat and real-time strategy game. The player pilots a flagship in direct ship-to-ship combat while expanding and defending a territory of planets across a galaxy. Each planet runs its own economy: it mines ore, builds infrastructure and defences, recruits crew from its population, fields a garrison of ships and pays its holder a share of its income. Planets can be won by investment, by breaching their defences and landing a boarding party, or by destroying them and settling the ruins. Rival AI factions led by commanders play under the same economic rules as the player, mining, trading, colonising and going to war. The game features weapons with distinct damage classes and upgrade tracks, ship and planet modules, periodic invasions by an Insectoid swarm hostile to every faction, and configurable galaxies with up to eight player slots, teams, map sizes, wraparound edges, difficulty settings and shareable seeds.

title: Emblemania
description: Emblemania is a fast paced and challenging point and click shoot 'em up That sees you piloting the SL-78 "Shockwave" alongside an ancient cosmic artifact of limitless potential for power: The Archemblem, all in a bid to fend off the Zyklon galaxy against the threat of total galactic Tyranny.

title: Reel Adventure: The Autobattler Journey
description: With every battle, the slot machine spins, randomizing your enemies and rewards. Adapt your strategies on the fly, collect rare and powerful items, and guide your team through a journey fraught with danger. Each run is a fresh adventure where skill, luck, and strategy combine to determine your fate.

title: Unreal Tournament 2004: DVD Special Edition
description:
The DVD Special Edition comes with:
- Unreal Tournament 2004 on a DVD installation disc (instead of 6 CDs)
- Tin Box casing
- Custom Headset and Mic
- Bonus DVD including video tutorials on using Unreal Engine 2.5 tools and creating assets in Maya, as well as behind-the-scenes footage

title: Fox Heist Game
description: A 2D action platformer game inspired by old Flash Games, the likes of Lupin III, The Bad Guys and the Sonic the Hedgehog series.​

title: They Keep Rolling: Incremental Ball Roller
description: An incremental ball-roller about earning trillions of tokens. Roll, upgrade, hire, repeat. Something about this cozy-creepy arcade is a little off, but the 2000's vibe (and soda) are too good to quit.

title: Howell Land
description: Like Pizza Tower? Don't Like Pizza Tower? Well, If You Fall somewhere In-Between Those Two, You're Sure to Enjoy Howell Land. This Fast-Paced Platformer Takes Cues from Wario Land, Pizza Tower and Yes, Even Sonic the Hedgehog.

title: Jacunda Rangers: The Battle for Paracuru
description: Jacundá Rangers - The Battle for Paracuru is a mecha-themed shoot-'em-up that stands out with its PvP, arena, and survival battle modes. Choose your character, power up your mecha, and prepare for an epic battle for control of Paracuru!

title: Li'l Red II
description: Don the red hood and venture into this fabled adventure as Lyra. Metroidvania meets Top-Down Adventure in this challenging, side-scrolling tale.

title: Franchise Hockey Manager 13
description: Franchise Hockey Manager returns for the 2026-27 season with plenty of new additions to the deepest, most authentic hockey strategy gaming experience you can find. Choose from teams around the globe and select a team to guide to glory, including a chance at the ultimate prize, the Stanley Cup.

title: Uriel OS
description: Uriel OS is an audio horror game where the perspective never leaves your screen. Traverse the apocalypse while sealed inside a mechanical vehicle that barely protects you from whatever is outside. Hack devices to manipulate the environment and piece together what happened to a very different Earth.

title: LightQuest 2: The Ancient Temples
description: LightQuest 2 - The Ancient Temples is a role playing game that acts as the direct sequel to LightQuest, expanding greatly on its predecessor and much, much more!

title: Little Knight's Last Night
description: You are a QA tester for a game company working late at night. Your job is to look out for anomalies and glitches in their upcoming top-down adventure game. Will you play the game, or will the game play you?

title: Monkey Archival Expedition
description: Platformer monkey came where he jumps into books

title: Please File Accurately
description: Four coworkers stuck in one office. No reason to behave professionally. Complete the tasks, work together, sabotage each other, or destroy the office in this chaotic local 4-player party game.

title: Ball and Stick
description: Roll, swing, launch and cause chaos in a physics-driven sci-fi adventure with unique controls, wild attachments and character customization. Explore bizarre alien worlds alone or with friends, and unleash multiplayer mayhem!

title: Heart Harvest: A Detective Game
description: Passionate murders. Ripped out hearts. And something crawling within the walls. Find clues, gather the evidence and connect the dots in this point and click detective thriller game. Solve each murder and uncover the horror linking them all..

title: Tokyo Wanted
description: Hide-and-seek meets tag, in a crowd of 100. The stage is TOKYO. Slip through unseen and reach the goal, or work the wanted poster and stop the escape. A 3v3 team game between fugitives and hunters. Up to six players online at once; CPU fills any empty seats, so you can play solo.

title: Pale Static
description: A cinematic first-person survival horror about a squad sent into a town on what looked like a routine rescue operation. By the time they arrive, the town is already in chaos.

title: IronFlux
description: Three stranded civilizations fight for the ancient Monoliths of a living moon. Build a streaming economy, field armies on land, sea and air, and hold the map to ascend in a large-scale real-time strategy game.

title: EM-68's Adventure
description:
You are Experimental Mannequin No. 68. The Corporation didn’t create you to live. It created you to be tested.
They threw you into the grinder. Jump. Climb. Cling. There are no checkpoints here that will cut you any slack. There’s only the drop — and one question: how many times are you willing to fall before you break for good?
Jump. Scramble. Fall. Get back up. The world around you is one massive proving ground packed with strange and lethal locations.
Every leap isn’t just a test of skill. It’s part of the experiment. While you fight to survive and reach the end, the Corporation’s secrets slowly surface. Who are you really? Why are they testing you? And what happens if the experiment slips out of control?
Your choices matter. Three completely different endings await those who make it to the finish. Decide what you’ll become: a obedient tool, a rebel against the system… or something else entirely.
EM-68’s Adventure is a 3D platformer with exploration and meaningful choices, where every step could be your last… or the first on the path to the truth.

title: Candlemates
description:
Get ready for a bright adventure full of strategy in Candlemates! Control two enchanted candles and push the fire stones onto their matching braziers, but be careful: each candle has a limited number of moves, and every step can make all the difference!

Switch between the two characters to take advantage of their positions, create paths, and complete each puzzle. While one candle is active, the other remains still and can even be pushed like any other object in the environment. Use both wisely, plan your moves, and avoid wasting precious steps too soon!

As you progress, new challenges make the puzzles increasingly complex. Pressure plates, stone barriers, and other obstacles require precise movements, careful planning, and perfect coordination between the two candles.

title: Find the Needle: One in Ten Million
description: Find one needle in ten million strands of straw. Gather by hand, build an automated workshop, and follow the needle through your production lines.

title: Railroad Swap
description:
Get ready for a journey full of challenges in Railroad Swap! Help Mat, an adorable train-driving cat, build the tracks needed to guide his train to the final destination. But be careful: the available pieces aren't enough to complete the entire route, so you'll need to think beyond the tracks!

On a hexagonal grid, select, rotate, and reposition pieces to build the perfect route. Along the way, you'll find swap tiles that let you assign colors to tracks or empty spaces. When the train passes over them, their positions are swapped, transforming the board and revealing new possibilities for continuing the journey.

title: Refuel Together
description: Run a gas station with 1 to 6 player as Co-Op in Refuel Together. Build a large gas station from a single gas pump. Upgrade and expand your gas station as more cars arrive. Become popular as you meet your customers' demands.

title: Caravanserai Simulator
description: Build, manage, and expand your own trading outpost on the harsh Silk Road. Draw water from the well, care for merchants' camels, trade goods, and upgrade your caravanserai from a dusty camp into a thriving desert empire.

title: Haulage Simulator
description: Drive near real-world-scale UK motorways, battle traffic, roadworks, rain and crosswinds, master detailed trucks with force feedback, complete timed deliveries, build your reputation and grow from hired driver to owning your own haulage company.

title: The Last Case
description:
Step into the shoes of a police officer investigating the mysterious disappearance of children. Enter the twisted world of a dangerous mind and uncover the truth.

See everything through a body camera. Every moment is recorded and later reviewed at the station to teach rookies how a real pro handles a case.

It feels real — the old, abandoned school, the dark corners, and hidden secrets. You can almost touch the worn walls and feel the cracks beneath your fingertips.

It’s terrifying — the madman is out there, lurking. Be careful with every step. Stay sharp. This place may look deserted, but it hides terrible secrets.

Pay close attention to the clues — they might lead you back to where it all began. Only you have the power to put an end to it. Open the door and step into the nightmare.

title: Expand TD
description: Expand TD is a tower defense roguelite where you build and upgrade towers and traps while gradually uncovering an expanding map between waves. As you explore new locations and terrain, you'll discover resources, rewards, and unexpected threats that can shift your strategy. When your base falls, the run ends, but you earn Technology Points to unlock permanent upgrades for future attempts across four distinct biomes.

title: Mr. Panas
description: Mr. Panas is an asymmetric multiplayer game for 3 to 5 players, where one player is a grumpy old man and the rest are invisible Whispers turning his house upside down. They have until morning to finish their chores. He can only use sounds, shadows and their trail of mess to catch them.

title: TaskFall
description:
TaskFall is a chaotic physics-based co-op game for up to four players. Players have to work together to complete dangerous missions in various hand crafted levels where unpredictable disasters, enemies, destructible environments, and your own teammates can turn every mission into a disaster.

Each run throws you into a combination of tasks, locations, and unexpected hazards, making every run unique. Explore, improvise, use your equipment, and try to survive long enough to complete your objectives and extract safely. Earn money to purchase items and upgrades, then take on increasingly challenging missions.

title: Lone Lines: RPG
description: Roguelite RPG set between a shifting desert and the flipside of a grim dark future. Explore the world in the body of the Pilot, command a living, katana-wielding Rover, and forge your own path through a non-linear story. Fight, level up, and make choices where absolutely everything is on the line.

title: Black Helm: Desolated Forest
description: Black Helm: Desolated Forest is a retro first-person dungeon crawler with turn-based combat. Explore dungeons shrouded in a dark and decaying atmosphere, where the narrative, visuals and soundtrack blend together to create a dark fantasy experience.

title: Tomider
description: A psychological horror about Tomi, a teenager unraveling the truth behind a tragedy that struck his school ten years ago. Explore the 1990s town of Oford, gather clues, and discover what the darkness is really hiding.

title: Zombie Tag
description: Zombie Tag is a fast-paced online multiplayer tag game set in a construction-site parkour arena. Each round, one player starts as the zombie while the humans get a 10-second head start to run, climb and find escape routes. Every human the zombie catches is infected and joins the horde, so the chase gets more intense as the round goes on. Push other players with boxing gloves, stun them with bear traps and use the whole arena to survive until the timer runs out, or hunt down the last survivors as the zombie.

title: Taskbar Chickens
description: Taskbar Chickens is a cozy desktop companion game where a tiny chicken farm lives on top of your Windows taskbar while you work or play other games. Pet your chickens, toss them around and let them wander across your desktop. Breed them to hatch new chickens with unique looks and outfits, grow crops to keep them fed, clean up after them, and sell eggs to unlock new tools, structures and skills. Grow your collection and turn a small taskbar farm into a thriving chicken empire at your own pace.

title: Dentist Jams 2000
description: Since putting your dreams of becoming a musician aside to get a degree in Dentistry, you find yourself exploring ways to make music in your day to day job as a Dentist.

title: Dungeons of Destiny
description: Your Adventure, Your Dungeon, Your Loot! Dungeons of Destiny is an action-packed anime 3D dungeon crawler. Explore perilous dungeons, defeat formidable fantasy creatures, master powerful skills, and gather valuable loot to strengthen your character.

title: Cozy Cookmaster
description: Cozy Cookmaster is an incremental restaurant management and automation game about turning a tiny food counter into a busy, fully automated restaurant. Start by cooking fries by hand, serving customers and cleaning tables, then unlock new recipes like burgers, hot dogs, donuts and more. Hire chefs, waiters and cleaners to automate the work, use the skill tree to shape your restaurant, and renovate between days by adding tables, kitchen stations and machines. Start with a small counter, build the system and automate the chaos.

title: MOBA Manager 2026
description: Pick and run a professional MOBA esports club with a goal of becoming the best team in the world through management of drafts, training, transfers and many other gameplay elements.

title: We Don't Exist
description: A story-driven adventure game inspired by real-world paranormal legends—explore a parallel dimension where Bigfoot, Mothman, and other cryptids really do exist—and help them unravel a dark, interdimensional conspiracy.

title: Dead Prints
description: PSX style psychological horror where you run an overnight print shop. Identify sinister customers, manage print supplies, make copies, and manage your insanity as your mind gets more and more unstable.

title: Baff E
description: Minimalist, hardcore and challenging game in the genre of avoid-em up that will test your reflexes, timing and planning! This game is hard as hell!

title: Zone Idle
description: An incremental extraction simulator set in a ruthless world inspired by the extraction genre and book Roadside Picnic. Manage your inventory, navigate hazardous events, and upgrade your hideout. Same tension, but with time to think.

title: Woof and Wool
description: Green is grassing, flock is sheeping, Sparky is sparking! Discover the natural movement of the herd in Woof and Wool. Guide your sheep through handcrafted levels at your own pace or show off your mastery in more challenging modes.

title: Tower of Annihilation: Welcome to Hell
description: Tower of Annihilation: Welcome to Hell is a roguelite dungeon-crawler where the only way to escape eternal damnation is to climb a seemingly endless, interdimensional tower filled with monsters and temptation. Reforge your soul and climb ever-higher, or become corrupted by the evils lurking within.

title: Ultidark
description: A story based puzzle-platformer, about a stickman, being in the place, he shouldnt ever be in. survive in this demonic dimension, where the thousand year old evil lies, by whatever it means nessesary. solve puzzles, run, avoid, hide. maybe the freedom was taken out of you, but the hope still remains

title: Zenless Zone Zero: Update 3.3 - Journey to the Sky
Panic Sell 2
description: The continuation of the trading simulator is here! Try to build insane capital in this game while avoiding a total balance wipeout.

title: Warfront Vanguard
description: A casual and accessible tower defense game where you face waves of enemies with unique strengths and weaknesses. Build and upgrade towers, adapt your strategy, and overcome increasingly powerful enemies in a dynamic blend of challenges and strategy.

title: The Last Station: Baku
description: A first-person psychological survival horror set in the abandoned Baku subway. Explore dark tunnels, solve puzzles, investigate disturbing mysteries, and make emotional choices while trying to survive against terrifying horrors.

title: Last Chance: Birth
description: Enter the magic school of Academia! Last Chance: Birth is the mix of a narrative game and casual puzzles, where your performance impacts how the story is told. Solve puzzles to cast spells, to craft potions, to enchant artifacts and more!

title: Devil's Arcade
description: Escape from the Devil's latest creation! In the 2D top-down shooter Devil's Arcade, hordes of demons, a bunch of different game modes, randomized events and endless fun await you!

title: Let's Grow Together
description: Build your dream farm with friends in this cozy 1–4 player co-op farming adventure! Raise adorable animals, grow seasonal crops, fish, customize your farmer and loyal dog, and turn your small farm into a thriving countryside paradise.

title: Hollowcross
description: Hollowcross is a gothic-horror collectible card game where every card you own plays in every mode — so the deity you forge in one becomes a weapon in all of them.

title: Clean Tides
description: A cozy ocean-cleaning game where every haul builds a better boat. Sail a sunny bay, collect litter, clear oil spills, and power-wash coral reefs. Sell your haul to upgrade and customize your boat, hire cleanup boats, and feed wildlife. Bring a little sparkle back to the sea at your own pace.

title: Line Go Up
description: Play as a CEO where you buy companies & hire executives to build out your deck, then test your luck in the free market. Bad gambles may push you to make tough choices in the events that pop up along the way. You will get fired if you fail to meet expectations, so make that line go up!

title: One More Claw
description: 3D physics claw machine + roguelike building. Land it in the chute; blast the target with base times multiplier.

title: Le Shampoo War II
description: Fight through floors, build a deck from 146 cards, and take on 6 bosses in Le Shampoo War II, a roguelike deck builder. Beat the final portals gauntlet and the terror at the end to discover what controls the universe.

title: Hit the Anvil
description: Strike the anvil, forge rare gear, and build your legacy in a pixel-art incremental crafting game.

title: A Drop of Magenta
description: A Drop of Magenta is a puzzle game about painting inside (and outside) the lines.

title: VHS Tapes
description: VHS Tapes is a 1-4 player, online co-op horror. Experience a collection of mysterious video tapes, each one containing completely different stories, locations, puzzles and nightmares to endure. INSERT. PRESS PLAY.

title: One Must Rule
description: An empire-building auto-battler set in a harsh medieval settlement where every strategic command shapes your kingdom’s fate. Build your empire from the council table, discover game-breaking card synergies, and battle against rival players. Every choice counts, only one will rule!

title: WoundWake
description: WoundWake is a turn-based RPG with a parry system that explores the different facets of humanity in a world on the brink of extinction: fear, trauma, obsession, love, and corruption.

title: Rootabasis
description: Play as Jimmy, a little seed who ended up in a peculiar cave. You'll need to help him find his way out, and escape the creatures (and people?) lurking around... But will you go through the correct path?

title: Matchmaker95: A Programming Simulator
description: The programming simulator. MatchMaker95 is a cozy(ish) coding tycoon where you write real C++, grow a chaotic dating app startup, unlock game-changing upgrades, and turn lines of code into profit all inside a lo-fi Win98 desktop.

title: Conquer the Labyrinth
description: Conquer the Labyrinth is an anime-inspired third-person Action RPG where you battle through a 100-floor procedural dungeon filled with deadly monsters, powerful loot, and Epic Bosses guarding every portal to the floor below. Grow stronger through crafting, skill progression, and intense combat.

title: Eternal Chamber
description: A psychological horror about repetition, isolation, and the need to keep moving forward. Keep pushing. Don't stop. Break through.

title: Kleromancy
description: Awaken as Unit-01 in the Ark of Theseus. In this roguelike, your cards are 3D dice: roll them, spend energy, and conquer 7 corrupted biomes. Overcome narrative events and minigames, survive multi-phase bosses, and expand your generational station with every victory.

title: My Boyfriend, Sonic the Hedgehog
description:
Chloe the Cat is a girl on a mission... for Sonic's heart!
Follow her in this visual novel and help her execute her long awaited plan to make Sonic hers!

title: Split Out
description: Split Out - The Ultimate Auto Battle Racing Experience Embark on an epic journey through the world of rally racing in Split Out, where your dream of becoming the #1 racer in the Race of Champions begins with a single street kart and rise to the global championship glory.

title: Forged Cards
description: A roguelike deckbuilder where YOU forge the cards. Slot casts into molds, temper their power, and etch combo inscriptions. Pick your path, battle, bargain, or brave the unknown, then outplay your enemy in simultaneous, position-based combat. Each run is different and each deck yours.

title: My Many Masks
description: A 2.5D platformer that follows a young autistic adult going out into the world to try and make connections with others. He doesn't have any confidence in himself, though, so he uses the power of many different masks that alter his abilities, and hide his true self.

title: Rune Caves: Eternal Echo
description: Match runes and unravel layered boards while moving Echoes disrupt your view and clicks. Remember hidden symbols, track shifting targets, and reveal ambush pairs. Clear 20 campaign floors, unlock a tougher Endless mode, and customize your symbols, backgrounds, and music.

title: Log Away: Halloween DLC
description: Turn your Log Away cabin into a playful, spooky hideaway. Add pumpkins, cute spiderwebs and ghosts, then follow a calm Halloween soundtrack into a cozy night. Nothing grim, nothing urgent. Just a warm glow, soft shadows, and gentle magic.

title: Nightmare Retro
description: A psychological horror game inspired by the visual style of the PS1 era and the survival mechanics of Five Nights at Freddy's

title: ShredDead
description: ShredDead is a quirky relaxing incremental zombie-shredding game focused on progression with no lose conditions. Defeat endless waves, collect loot, grow your skill tree and evolve the zombies.

title: Paradox Boxing
description: The greatest boxer in the world! But without any further competition in his own time, he takes to others to fight the greatest warriors across history! Will his boxing skills be enough? Or the better question is; will yours?

title: Sneaky Purr
description: Get ready for a sneaky adventure in Sneaky Purr! Control Bill, a mischievous cat and expert little thief, and help him steal all the food pouches before making his way back to the exit of each level. But be careful: escaping with the loot can be much harder than it looks!

title: Spray Trace
description:
Grab your spray can and step into a colorful adventure in Spray Trace! Control a talented graffiti artist and move through each environment, painting the tiles along your path. But you can't just paint everything you see: each color has an exact number of tiles that must be filled!

Move across the environment in four directions and carefully plan your routes. Every tile you pass over is painted with your current color, but retracing a path already painted with the same color makes the paint disappear, allowing you to correct part of your route and discover new solutions.

Along the way, you'll find sprays in different colors. Collecting them permanently changes your paint color, completely transforming the possibilities of the level. Choose when and where to change colors, and think a few steps ahead to avoid leaving paint where it shouldn't be!

title: Paragon-R: Secrets of the Sky Sanctum
description: Venture across Mystiel's many landscapes, from the humble Granta Cave, to the lush Verda Forest, to the sparkling sea of Zephyra Coast, and beyond!

title: Platypus Steps
description:
Get ready for an adventure full of creativity and strategy in Platypus Steps! Help an adorable baby platypus reach the cookie jar by carefully planning the path it needs to follow. Observe the environment, choose the right elements, and build a safe route to reach the objective!

In each level, you begin in planning mode, observing the character's position, the obstacles, and all the available possibilities. Use the cursor to select and place elements such as springs, wind, and platforms, creating the perfect path for the platypus. When you're satisfied with your plan, press Play and watch your strategy come to life!

In execution mode, the platypus runs automatically, and you can no longer change the elements in the environment. It can hit walls and change direction, use springs, be carried by the wind, and cross platforms you placed earlier. But watch out for hazards! Pits, saws, and spikes restart the level, so every element needs to be in the right place.

title: Pinguino
description: Slip & Slide Your Way Through Each Level While Eating as Few Fish as Possible!

title: RuneEra
description: RuneEra is a single-player fantasy colony-management RPG in which players build a guild settlement, automate work and production and equip adventurers with runes that grant abilities and passive effects. Settlement management includes farming, animal husbandry, crafting and the needs and work schedules of guild members. Players form parties and directly control their movement, combat and abilities while exploring a procedurally generated world of biomes, quests, factions and dungeons.

title: Shadow Princess: Crystalbound
description: Shadow Princess: Crystalbound is 2D platformer where you can place crystals anywhere in any level to help you reach the end of the stage. You create your own difficulty.

title: Astro Kitty: Space Mining
description: Astro Kitty: Space Mining is an incremental mining game where you dig through planets, collect valuable resources, upgrade your gear, automate your mining operation, and travel between planets on an adventure with cats.

title: Eyes Behind 2
description: Eyes Behind 2 is the sequel to Eyes Behind, a retro-graphics FPS survival horror game inspired by cult horror classics. The killer has been caught and is behind bars. The file is closed. So why are you still finding notes on your car?

title: Purple Shift
description:
Purple Shift is a psychological mystery visual novel set in a world touched by an anomalous phenomenon known as the Purple Storm.

What begins as an ordinary shift slowly starts to fracture. Familiar places feel wrong. Conversations repeat in ways they shouldn't. Memories become unreliable. And somewhere behind it all, something is listening.

Over the course of seven days, your decisions shape the people around you, the information you uncover, and the version of events you ultimately believe.

title: Calmaria: Wild Growth
description: Build and automate your settlement in this island survival game, play solo or with friends, but it’s better with friends! Start by tilling the soil and planting your first crops, delegate tasks to your settlers. Sail to new islands, loot dungeons, and prepare your defenses for the next wave.

title: OxyDungeon
description: You wake up in a bizarre pop-art world, armed with a baseball bat and only four buttons: Up, Down, Left, and Right. Input dance-game-style arrow combos to create items, then smash and launch them with your bat to obliterate enemies and survive the chaos!

title: Saints Reborn
description: An unofficial native Windows port of Saints Row (Xbox 360, 2006).

title: SpeedBreaker
description: Most Wanted, the way you remember it. The definitive Need for Speed: Most Wanted recompilation. Built from the 2005 Xbox 360 version, the best-looking one, and made sharper, wider, and smoother for the modern era.

title: Free Time Puzzle
description: A puzzle game with square pieces instead of jigsaw shapes for a cozy and relaxing experience. 56 puzzle photographs by artist Dray Potts from locations across the western United States, each with 6 levels of difficulty.

title: Oink Splash Party
description: Oink Splash Party is a chaotic multiplayer physics-based party brawler where adorable pigs battle it out across colorful inflatable waterparks! Punch your opponents, inflate yourself to bounce and launch across arenas, and compete in a variety of competitive and team-based game modes. Customize your pig, tackle interactive obstacles, and dive into the mayhem with friends in online multiplayer or private matches.

title: Benki Sensou
description:
A super-dynamic action shooting visual novel that depicts battles centered around the mysterious substance known as “UNKO.”
In the game section, you’ll engage in fast-paced battles using the Toilet Machine, while in the VN sections you’ll experience life in the military alongside muscular beastmen.
By raising your ERP (Ero Points) gauge and leveling up, you’ll be able to steer the story towards erotic directions.

title: Antidote
description: 30 minutes. That is all the time you have left before the infection consumes you. Bitten and lost in the heart of a procedurally generated bunker, your only chance of survival is to locate and inject the antidote hidden within its depths. The countdown has begun.

title: Foxhollow
description: Foxhollow is a fully native port of Star Fox Adventures for modern platforms.

title: Divergence: Fracture
description:
Divergence: Fracture is a top-down tactical space combat game featuring single player battles against AI opponents and online multiplayer. Players control individual warships equipped with different weapon systems and abilities across several arena-based game modes.

Combat features Newtonian movement, directional armor, projectile penetration, localized hull damage, and internal ship modules that can be damaged or destroyed. Players manage weapons, energy, and repair systems while engaging enemy vessels. The game includes multiple ship classes, customizable weapon loadouts, and progression based unlocks.

title: Breakremental
description: Breakremental is a brick breaker incremental game. Break bricks, get coins, buy upgrades, add more balls and watch everything slowly get out of control. There are bosses too, because apparently breaking normal bricks wasn't enough.

title: Nightmare Funkin'
description:
A mod based on 2D platforming brawler video game "Nightmare Cops" developed by Tom Fulp and JohnnyUtah.

This mod might contain flashing lights so beware!!

After a long time cooking in the oven, Nightmare Funkin' is finally here!
A tribute to the hard work of Johnny Utah and the Nightmare Cops development team!

FEATURES:

2 Story Mode Weeks (NIGHTMARE & MISSION 1)
3 Pico Remixes
1 Erect Mix
Tankman

title: Sturmjäger
description:
Sturmjäger is a sci-fi shoot 'em up for everyone who wants to skip the cinematic fluff and dive straight into unadulterated, chaotic, and adrenaline-fueled arcade action. Master ten unique missions, either solo or with a friend in local co-op.

Every single stage features its own distinct visual theme and a custom-tailored soundtrack, taking you from the deepest corners of outer space straight to the bottom of the ocean, merciless boss fights included.

With three different game modes and three difficulty levels, maximum replayability is guaranteed, no matter how fast your reflexes are.

The rules are simple: If it moves, shoot it. If it doesn't move... shoot it anyway, just to be safe.

Genre veterans are in for a treat: The deep, finely-tuned scoring system rewards aggressive and flawless gameplay. Rack up massive score multipliers with quick kills, kill chains, risky proximity close-quarters attacks, no-death runs, and much more. Perfect your strategy, climb the global online leaderboards, and test your mettle against the best pilots in the world!

title: Adelaide: A Tiny Adventure
description: Four worlds. Four guardians. One tiny hero finding her way home. Run, double-jump and swing your hammer through 40 pixel-art levels filled with secrets, challenges and little memories worth keeping. A heartfelt adventure made by a dad for his daughter.

title: QUByte Classics: Gaelco Sports Collection
description:
Relive the thrill of 90s arcade games with 5 legendary, action-packed hits from Gaelco, a pioneer in the world of arcade gaming! Forget complex simulators; this collection is all about pure reflexes, instant fun, and high-speed adrenaline.

Take the wheel in the award-winning isometric masterpieces World Rally Championship and World Rally 2, executing precise drifts against a relentless 60-second countdown. Blaze a trail through icy tunnels and loops in Snowboard Championship, dominate the digital courts with quick shots in Squash, and unleash devastating spikes in beach volleyball in Touch and Go.

Play with friends in the chaotic local multiplayer mode and enjoy modern, convenient features like instant saves and retro CRT screen filters that perfectly recreate the glow of the original arcade cabinets!

title: Motapon
description:
Motapon is a peaceful game where you will have to create bridges with words to help Motapon the dog find its home. Craft the best words to lead them to the other side of the screen! Collect coins on the way, play mini-games at the fair to win bones, and trade with Greedo the fox to furnish your home !
Arrange your letters and place words on randomly generated grids for a big variety of play. If you feel stuck, change your letters, completly or partially, or even rewind time. Keep in mind, your goal is to help Motapon cross the screen with their pocket full of coins and bones!

title: Friday Night Funkin': Variety Vault Plus!
description:
A brand new Variety Vault release has hit the scene! Now including more content than ever before! Revisit the magic and fun of 12 beautiful games, now on your Personal Computer! All of these wonderful games have been powered up with a refreshing rhythm-based twist on their standard gameplay; made possible only through the hit Newgrounds game, Friday Night Funkin'! All neatly wrapped together into one wondrously bountiful package titled;

Friday Night Funkin': Variety Vault Plus!

title: Obsessed
description: OBSESSED is not a classic horror game focused on jump scares, but a psychological thriller-drama where Halloween night takes a terrifying turn. The mysterious One Wish Walnut can grant any wish... as long as you're willing to live with the consequences.

title: Webs of Reverie
description: Webs of Reverie is a first-person Survival horror game where you must explore the halls of Ironveil Psychiatric Hospital, solving puzzles, avoid detection from the staff, and managing your sanity levels. Will you decipher the clues and safely escape or fall victim to what hides in the shadows?

title: Simply Padel
description: A skill-based competitive padel game built around timing and shot decisions. Choose your forehand or backhand, compete online or locally, and practise against AI. Create your player and work your way from amateur matches to a professional career.

title: Tollmire
description: A dice roguelike in the bog. The witch demands eight tolls, each steeper than the last — you pay in rolls: points times mult. Between tolls you forge special faces onto your dice and gather talismans.

title: Endless.Fishing
description: Endless.Fishing is a 3D fishing game for Windows set on German waters. Find your fishing spot, choose rod, line, hook and bait to match your plan, cast out, watch the float, set the hook at the right moment and play the fish safely to the shore. The current early test version focuses on float fishing with a pole and spin fishing at an alpine lake, with species such as perch, brown trout, chub and pike. Further fishing methods, waters, countries and content are being developed and released step by step. An internet connection and a player account are required.

title: StackOn
description: StackOn is a card-based strategy game that combines town building with dungeon exploration. Players stack cards to gather resources, produce items, construct buildings, craft equipment, and develop their settlement. They can also assemble a party, explore dungeons, fight enemies, and bring valuable loot back to support the town.

title: Tsukumo Snap!
description: Tsukumo SNAP! is a spirit-photography RPG in which a flip phone reveals spirits inhabiting everyday objects. Players collect spirits and arrange a six-slot battle wheel, with three active spirits and three resting. The adventure uses a real calendar and includes a 50-floor tower.

title: Gemheart Valley
description: Grow crystals instead of crops. Crack geodes with the most satisfying tap in cozy games, fill a museum with one-of-a-kind gems, befriend a mountain village (and one very determined rival), and bring a sleeping valley back to life, season by season.

title: Echoes of Another Sky
description: Echoes of Another Sky is a fantasy action role-playing game about a boy and a talking bell exploring thirteen skies. Combat combines action combos with tuning-fork magic.

title: The Goddess Told Me: Steal That Loaf of Bread
description: A fantasy adventure about a five-millimetre ant sent by the goddess Kona to steal a seventy-two-centimetre loaf of bread. Players navigate a world built around differences of scale, crumbs and narrow passages.

title: Iwanu ga Hana
description: Iwanu ga Hana is a school-life role-playing game spanning a school year and seventeen social bonds. At midnight, unspoken words become monsters, connecting daily relationships with supernatural encounters.

title: Hamster Wheel Isekai
description: Hamster Wheel Isekai combines incremental progression with role-playing mechanics. Players power a wheel, change gears and time shifts to build speed and advance.

title: Jigoku Yugi
description: Jigoku Yugi follows a delivery boy who dies after winning the lottery and joins an underworld contest. One hundred souls compete across thirty-two games, and only the last survivor can return to life.

title: I Was Reincarnated as a Bosozoku Hamster, so I Became a Racing Champion to Return Home
description: A bicycle hits you, you die, and you wake up as a hamster in another world. There is only one way home: down the pass at night, five exhaust pipes over your roof and a rival on your bumper. A touge racing RPG with the full bosozoku kit welded on.

title: I'm Definitely in a Basement
description: A first-person psychological horror game set in a basement. A chair, camera, voices and a woman in white form part of its unsettling environment.

title: Hachikoma: Underground Stadium No. 8
description: Anime spinning-top battles in an endless underground passage. If something is wrong, turn back. If nothing is wrong, beat the blader who waits and walk on. Spot the anomalies, win the battles and reach the exit 8... if it exists.

title: Penguin Capitalism Simulator
description:
A calm and cozy idle game designed for controller play, about growing a peaceful little world, full of penguins.

You stand on a small island, surrounded by water. Click the water to collect fish, then spend them to place penguins, bears, and fashionable penguins who help you gather even more fish. Unlock new islands over time and watch your peaceful little world grow at a gentle pace.

The game is designed to be straightforward and relaxing. No complexity, simple mechanics, like in good old games.

title: Lucky Block
description: Open boxes, collect strange items, manage your limited inventory, sell what you don't need, and take risks on your journey from street junk to cosmic treasures.

title: Chronoseum
description: An action roguelite where you fight through arenas and unlock epic upgrades! Defeat the Bosses and challenge the Emperor. Die, upgrade, die and descend again.

title: Evoruption
description: A dark roguelike deckbuilder where you build and evolve powerful decks, battle corrupted creatures, and master new mechanics across handcrafted story campaigns or challenge other players in tactical 1v1 and 2v2 battles.

title: The Halloway Haunting
description: A first-person co-op horror game for 1-4 players. Explore six abandoned buildings in the town of Halloway, solve the puzzles that turn their lights back on, and get away from the thing hunting you in the dark. Play online, in splitscreen, or alone.

title: Legacy of Mind
description: Legacy of Mind is the first gothic soulslike FPS where nightmares and reality have merged. Face colossal Monarchs that rule over the world overrun by living nightmares. Unlock otherworldy powers hidden within your mind, but with every power unlocked, something in the dark wakes with you...

title: Hack and Slash Fury 2
description: Destroy the dark warriors with your sword at the rythm of heavy metal and see epic cinematics while you master the complex combat system to humilliate your rivals online or offline, here you will find fun, satire, and war created and combined like never before by his developer.

title: Life Is a Dungeon: Lean Into It.
description: Choose one of four adventurers, each driven to clear dungeon floors in a different way. Set a destination or take direct control, then combine equipment with powerful—but sometimes troublesome—random skills to shape every expedition in this dungeon-crawling roguelite RPG.

title: BitWise
description: BitWise is a puzzle game about electricity. Players place parts on a board, wire them by hand, and a circuit simulator runs the result. It starts with a battery and a lamp and climbs through relays, logic gates, adders, latches and counters to a small stored-program machine. The grader checks what a circuit actually does, so a strange build that does the job passes. 238 levels across seven chapters end with the telegraph, with a Koch-method Morse trainer, a Sandbox, a level editor and Steam Workshop sharing.

title: Night Drive: Anomaly
description: Night Drive - Anomaly is a supernatural driving horror game where you must navigate a mysterious endless night, spot anomalies, choose the right road, and survive until morning to escape the loop.

title: Square Computer
description: In this minimalist logic puzzle game, you will become the architect of computational rules. Arrange versatile logic blocks to construct sophisticated data processing pathways.

title: Stellar Wings
description: In this bullet-hell strategy sandbox game, lead your newly-formed fleet through a vast galaxy. Use your tactics and skills to amass wealth, build influence, engage in galactic affairs, and face the conflicts and crises threatening the entire star system.

title: The Legend of Celia
description: A fantasy real-time turn-based dungeon RPG. Play as the Arcane Knight, lead 5 heroes with front/back row tactics & magitech. Explore procedural dungeons, collect billions of gear & rune attributes, make choices at Obelisk Stones, rebuild a lost civilization. Native KB&M, remastered for PC.

title: Fragments of Ember
description: Explore the ruins of a forgotten kingdom in this atmospheric pixel-art platformer. Light ancient torches, solve environmental puzzles, uncover hidden secrets, and master challenging platforming as you restore the fading flame.

title: Formation Builder Idle
description: Every hero changes the heroes beside it. Arrange 46+ heroes on a grid, chain their abilities, and find the layout that multiplies your damage. Then prestige across 21 worlds, fight with mounts, and run missions, mines and a workshop while you're away.

title: Deep Frost
description: Single-player social-deduction horror in a failing Antarctic station. Question the crew, compare conflicting accounts and decide who to accuse or defend before the vote. The person you defend may be the one deceiving you.

title: Space Cadets: Engineering Corps
description: Survey planets. Obliterate the locals. Invest in your ship. An action packed rougelite where the engineering crew you hire is either your greatest asset or your worst enemy, sometimes both at the same time. Don't fret, they always mean well.

title: Fly&Goal
description: A casual puzzle game where you play disc golf while navigating holes that showcase the changing seasons. Read the wind to choose your throw, dodge obstacles, and aim to clear all 12 courses, each with 9 holes.

title: Fire. Hold. Repeat.
description: The only desktop companion shooter on Steam. Your soldier holds the line right on your desktop. Every click and every keystroke fires a shot fend off endless enemy waves, loot weapons and upgrade your gear while you go about your day.

title: The Sin of Ritter
description: The Sin of Ritter is a first-person horror game where the pursuit of justice becomes a journey through guilt, obsession, and consequences. Explore dark and disturbing environments, survive the horrors that await you, and uncover the truth behind the murder of your wife.

title: Toey Weedz Smoke Dead Halloween
description: The single-player Halloween special edition of the beloved long-nosed retro stoner, Toey Weedz! Save the famous rapping cow from her doom, defeat the witch, and experience 9 levels of pure retro FPS madness built on solid shooter gameplay.

title: Touhou Bansho Cards
description: Fight to the end! Once a card is played, don't stop. Push the Combo higher, break the damage limit, and blast through anything in your way! Touhou Bansho Cards is a roguelike deckbuilder. Collect cards, explore the Bansho Card Corridor, defeat Echoes, rescue Gensokyo's girls, uncover the truth.

title: Lord of the Grind
description: Lord of The Grind is a single-player 2D Action RPG focused on dungeon grinding, resource gathering, loot, crafting and long-term character progression.

title: Throughput
description: Wire yourself into a vector-bright city that runs on the beat. The system you built for people develops a pulse of its own. Build the city. Watch it breathe.

title: Scuttled
description: Your ship is gone. The derelict freighter you found was scuttled by her own crew - but her reactor is still warm. Shoot asteroids, refine ore, and rebuild her gun by gun to escape an asteroid belt that hunts the powered. A finite tower-defense / incremental crafting hybrid with an actual ending.

title: Drive Up: Together
description: Co-op climbing for up to 8 friends, built on real driving physics. Thin planks, giant pipes and vertical ramps stand between you and the summit, and there are no checkpoints. A friendly push saves your run. A friendly push also ends it.

title: Autogenesis
description: Autogenesis is a roguelike deckbuilder where any number can be exploited. Swap, Bind and Multiply endlessly to build overwhelming strategies, recursively self-improve, and rewrite the system containing you. Break the experiment. Achieve AUTOGENESIS.

title: Forester
description: Atmospheric forest management game about rebuilding a neglected woodland estate, mastering the care of the land, and finding your place among its inhabitants. Plant, cut and cultivate trees, restore your homestead, and shape the life of the one who tends it.

title: Primal One
description: Primal one is a first-person dinosaur survival horror set in an installation in the cretaceous period. Hide and evade dinosaurs that are hunting you, while you try to find a way to go back to the present alive or contact survivors in other installation.

title: Jiggle or Physics
description: An unofficial Windows x64 static recompilation of the US PlayStation 1 release of Dead or Alive, created by 3DGE.

title: Spellk
description: Spell a word. Smash an enemy. Turn random letters into attacks and stack strange items into ridiculous builds. Make rare letters hit harder or long words pay off in this turn-based word-combat roguelite, solo or with up to three friends in online co-op.

title: Graveyard Shift: A Sage's Last Stand
description: A dark pixel-art roguelike deckbuilder. You're the mortician the night the dead stop staying dead — turn every corpse into cards, forge them to Ascended rank, and survive 21 nights, three rule-breaking bosses, and one thing that was never meant to have a name.

title: Starways: Heart of the Cosmos
description: Wander through the cosmos and help strange and lonely people overcome their struggles through exploration, discovery, and heartfelt mini-adventures while building a home among the stars together.

title: Pixel Nightshift: The Vesta Protocol
description: You are on the night shift at a desolate robot logistics facility. Prepare orders, pack them, and deliver them. The routine appears simple, yet every night something shifts a little more out of place. Ten nights. Two endings. Free demo: the first 3 nights.

title: Move the Freak Out!
description: In Move The Freak Out. You are a contracted mover who specializes in haunted homes. Your job is to move furniture out of homes that are claimed to be haunted by the people who left in a hurry! Get in, get out, and don't die in.... Move The Freak Out!

title: Whitopia
description: Experience pure calm through a short relaxing 3D painting simulation. Cover graffiti, clutter, and anything colorful in pure white. Earn rewards, unlock upgrades, and become more efficient as you restore a world where white is the only color allowed to exist.

title: Pucked Up
description: The oddball hockey deckbuilder. Construct your roster, customize your playbook, and survive a season against teams that will do anything to cheat their way to victory. Outsmart your competition, make the playoffs, and hoist the cup in a league where every run is unique.

title: Falling Cubes
description: 3D falling sand simulation. Experiment to unlock new materials. Reactions, Temperature, Pressure are your tools to discover over 200 unique cube types.

title: Cosmo Corgis
description: Scout is a terrible pilot, but he loves corgis. Rescue a crew with six corgi personalities across ten planets in this cozy desktop companion idler. Gather, upgrade, and rebuild the rocket while your new favorite coworkers keep you company.

title: Defenders of Cinderkeep
description: Defenders of Cinderkeep is a dark fantasy incremental auto-battler. Battle endless waves of orcs, demons, dragons, and other mythic creatures in defense of the last bastion of humanity. Upgrade your heroes and equip them with a variety of spells and powers to unleash upon the demonic hordes.

title: Hermes Library
description: Hermes Library is a simulation game in which you will play as the new librarian Rainn Echo. In six weeks, you will be helping people to borrow and return books, while discovering hidden messages in books, meeting new friends and unraveling the mysteries happening at Hephaestus University.

title: Barnburners
description: Barnburners is a 5-on-5 arcade hockey game featuring 24 fictional clubs, body checks, one-timers and player-controlled fights. Players can compete against the CPU, share a team or play against friends with up to four people locally, or play online head-to-head. Franchise mode includes line management, trades, free-agent signings and a rookie draft across multiple seasons. Other modes include outdoor games, 3-on-3 Pond Hockey, Training Camp and arcade competitions.

title: Shatterflap
description:
Fire bouncing balls into towering ceilings of ice, carve open new ricochet paths, and rescue hidden Penguins.

Shatterflap is a physics incremental game where every shattered piece of ice opens new possibilities. Earn Coins, grow stronger through permanent upgrades, load specialized ammo, and conquer increasingly tricky procedural levels.

title: Brick by Brick: Tidy Up the Small Town!
description:
Brick by Brick: Tidy Up the Small Town! is a first-person building and tidy-up game that supports solo play and online co-op for up to five players. Players collect and sort 18,490 scattered bricks by shape and color, then place them according to building plans to reconstruct a small town.

Players unlock helpful abilities and use equipment such as a wheelbarrow, scaffolding, and a magnet to collect, transport, and place bricks. Completed buildings light up and gain decorations, gradually transforming the town as reconstruction progresses.

title: The Ultimate Idiot
description: A comedic life sim where the goal isn't to succeed — it's to be as gloriously stupid as possible. Forget your keys, park sideways across two spaces, argue with your dog, and level up your Idiot Rank one bad decision at a time.

title: Project: Null Hypothesis
description: You will play as Elias found recordings, exploring the anomalous space with him. Uncover the sinister secrets of the Backrooms as you wander through endless corridors and frighteningly familiar rooms.

title: Yukizuki no Seisou
description: High school student Kusaka Sousuke, who has faint precognition, visits Yukizuki during winter break—a town haunted by rumors of ghosts and mysterious disappearances. In the snow-covered town, he meets the mysterious girl he saw in a dream…

title: Resonurgy
description: Build an automated factory where machinery meets alchemy. Explore a technomagical world, scan matter and extract its hidden principles. Connect production lines, assemble research circuits and contain the Dissonance your factory creates. Play solo or with friends.

title: Just Shovel It!
description: It snowed all night, and the snow is not going anywhere on its own. Clear the yard before the New Year: a shovel, a furnace, warm light in the windows, and no reason to hurry.

title: Mighty Aphid: Remastered Edition
description:
His famous father is aging. His mother is dying. And his big sister is on the moon. So it is up to Avery "Aphid" Cavor to stop the villainous Lady Bug from wrecking the town of Victoria with her horde of monsters!

Run, shoot, swim, and fly. Explore huge levels. Fight big bosses. Earn upgrades.

title: Joker's Knock
description: A competitive online card game where every player fights for themselves. Draft powerful Jokers, outplay your opponents and climb the Ranked ladder. Easy to learn, hard to master—with fair competition, achievements and cosmetic progression, never pay to win.

title: Marvel Rivals: Season 10 - Butcher's Blasphemy
description: Even the gods can die. After wielding the power of All-Black the Necrosword against the would-be gods of Thebes, the God Butcher's dark crusade brings him to Yggsgard. As long as gods existed, mortals would be shackled to illusions and useless prayers instead of believing in themselves. His mission was clear: assemble the God Bomb and obliterate all things divine. But the King of Yggsgard stands at the ready to defend his kingdom, the sound of thunder close behind him. Will they be enough to save the heavens from true mortal vengeance?

title: Birds of Impalatism
description: Infiltrate a vaporwave mall run by a capatalist cult as an undercover agent. Trip out and shoot ghosts in puzzle levels. Uncover the truth of the Birds of Impalatism, and take down its leader.

title: DriftyLands
description: Buy an island, clear it, automate it, then find the hole underneath. A first-person co-op base builder for 2-4 friends: gather, craft, build machines, and take your tools down into the dungeon below every island you buy.

title: Psycorp
description: Three siblings are given AI-Powered cybernetics by their dying CEO father to permanently bring out the worst in them. How much of your mind are you willing to lose to control your family's company, and the future of surveillance in this narrative driven AI corporate dystopia?

title: Overwatch: Reign of Talon - Season 5: A Grim Doctrine
description: The wait is over! Our newest Support Hero is here with the arrival of Doctrine. Freed from his volcanic prison by Doomfist himself, this sinister foe can manipulate life using his Eternal Scepter and mechanical drones, while also empowering each ability with his signature Infuse.

title: Vinera
description: Vinera MMORPG is a 2D top-down multiplayer online role-playing game. Experience classic open-world exploration, character progression, questing, and real-time combat in a nostalgic 2D fantasy world.

title: Massively Singleplayer
description: A predatorily monetized MMO turned singleplayer action roguelite. Choose your class and face six biomes filled with hordes of monsters. You have 20 minutes before the servers shut down, survive the onslaught or get banned. Gamble your way to glory and pay some guy in a bush to bless you.

title: Anywhere RPG
description: An AI-directed RPG that unfolds in real time.

title: Off Axis
description: An action packed sci fi FPS set aboard a massive spaceship, where reversing gravity changes the way you fight and the environment helps you eliminate enemies.

title: Anu: Tablets of Thoth
description: ANU: Tablets of Thoth is a 3D platformer adventure where you play as Anu, a reincarnated jackal god. Sprint, scale, swim, and sail across Ancient Egypt. Use Soul Syphon to defeat undead enemies, discover hidden secrets, collect artifacts, and stop the dark sorcerer Voodoo Vulture.

title: The Cake Mistake
description: After being shipped the wrong form of 'YellowCake', a pastry chef bakes his creations, to find himself surrounded by nuclear cakes, ice cream sandwiches and other delicious desserts. Survive and navigate your way out of this Sugary Factory.

title: Daisy's Dead
description: Tend a cemetery for the dearly departed in this cozy but macabre decorating game. Fulfill final requests, craft personalized graves, shape the grounds your way, and uncover the mystery of Daisys own death.

title: Panda Fishing: The Way of Angling
description: Panda Fishing: The Way of Angling is a 2D fishing sim rooted in real Taiwan-style logic. Explore diverse waters—from city rivers to wild lakes. Adapt your rod, float, line, and bait—every detail shapes your catch. Hand-painted art and immersive play invite you to find joy in nature and self.

title: Whispers From Below
description: Trapped in a mysterious mansion, two detectives investigate their mentor's disappearance. With different visions of their surroundings and a shell as their only tool and bond between them, they must cooperate to solve the puzzles, unravel the cult's story, and make it out alive.

title: The Mountain Peak
description: A lost scout, one island, and a summit 190 metres up. Climb marked rock hand over hand, rest on chalked holds before your grip fails, and cross four biomes that each try to stop you a different way. The island is rebuilt every day at 00:00 UTC and every scout climbs the same one.

title: Western Wolf Hunter: The Dead Forest
description:
Western Wolf Hunter: The Dead Forest throws you into a wild and unforgiving world where survival belongs to the strongest.

Explore a vast open forest filled with dense wilderness, dangerous predators, rival animals, hidden territories, and untamed landscapes. Hunt for survival, defend your territory, confront powerful beasts, and fight your way through a world where every encounter can become a battle for dominance.
