Take control of powerful wild animals and experience intense animal combat, hunting, exploration, territory battles, and survival gameplay. Track prey through the wilderness, face rival predators, explore dangerous regions, and prove that you have what it takes to become the dominant beast.

title: Kizu Darake no Chou ga Tobu Toki
Eldertal
description:
Edertal is a 3D sandbox voxel RPG by RedKnack Interactive, featuring atmospheric and immersive mechanics, woven together with rich lore, extensive building capabilities, and an additional focus on custom-built, dedicated roleplaying experiences that enable players to host their own roleplaying servers.

The path is yours to forge, but heed this warning: the Eldritch keep a watchful eye upon thee.

title: I Just Wanted to Fish
description: A stranger, a fishing rod and an island full of closed paths. Fish, explore and help the townsfolk until every shore is yours to fish.

title: Warrior Is Just Going
description: There is no retreat. It is a game that tells the story of a mysterious journey of a warrior who only moves forward.

title: Video Store Chaos
description: Video Store Chaos is a single-player simulation. Pick up, sort and shelve over 2,500 movie, game and VHS cases to turn a messy video store into an organized collection. Unlock upgrades to carry more and work faster, find clues on the covers and explore the hidden basement.

title: Syncrafice
description: Are you the hunter, or the hunted? The answer is yes. Play as both Em and Vee in this short and mildly unsettling adventure, including a bit of action, several puzzles, and cool game feature! Oh, and while you are there might as well uncover the mysteries that lie below the surface.

title: Chiki Poki: Rush
description: The world's cutest extermination job. A fast, hands-on incremental shooter.Hunt down the Cheepy — cuddly critters that mimic anything — and gather 5 kinds of star candy to keep your ultimates chaining, endlessly.Grow stronger every run with what you collect. Until the Cheepy King falls!

title: Erewhon
description: Erewhon is a first person, turn-based, lovecraftian dungeon crawler with visual novel and soulslike elements. As the Wandering Psyche, explore the Weatherleigh Hotel and the diverse realities it connects through several investigations into the unthinkable. Death is not the end, but madness might be.

title: Hidden Cat Islands
description: Hidden Cat Islands is a relaxing 3D exploration game where you search for hidden cats across uniquely themed islands. Move your camera freely, use helpful hints, discover interactive objects, and find hidden photos along the way!

title: Ashen Swarm
description: Ashen Swarm is a single-player gothic arena roguelite in which abilities are based on the seven deadly sins. Players combine skills during each run and choose between keeping an Oath or gaining powers through Corruption. Decisions in recurring narrative events grant lasting artifacts. A gathering court culminates in a battle against the Collegium.

title: Gassed Up!
description: Gassed Up! is an online multiplayer party game about surviving the workday with a growing gas problem. Complete tasks, sabotage coworkers and use unique employee abilities to clock out first. Keep your gas meter under control, avoid getting caught farting and catch others in the act.

title: Inner Eko
description: A dreamlike first-person platformer about the thoughts you can't let go of. Explore a strange world, meet mysterious beings, and face yourself.

title: Famine
description: Play as the new candidate chosen to participate in a deadly game. If you succeed, humanity will survive a few more days. If you lose, you die.

title: Akgwi Slash
description: Endless hordes of ghosts swarming in. Become a Joseon exorcist, ride the 'Geogugoe,' and shout, 'Sleep the vengeful spirits. Slay the evil spirits!'

title: Mimic Party: Halloween
description: Listen, imitate, and laugh through every replay. Play solo, pass the mic with up to 6 local players, or join an online Halloween party.

title: ECC: Redline
description: ECC: Redline is a brand-new, self-developed extreme-sports tactical shooter from NetEase Games. It is faster, smoother, and more forgiving: every movement choice and every shot can turn the tide.

title: Laylines
description: Laylines is a sailing management game set in the world of the oldest trophy in sailing. The player runs a challenger syndicate competing against five rivals for the right to face the defender. Off the water, the game covers crew scouting and contracts, training, sailor careers and retirement, boat research and development with component reliability and sea trials, design philosophy and target wind, sponsors, TV rights, merchandising and headquarters upgrades. On the water, match race duels play out in real time, boat against boat, under real racing rules: right of way, penalties, laylines, wind zones and shifts. Each Cup is made up of round robin groups, a Semi-final, a Challenger Final and the Cup Final, followed by a new season with a rule change, in an open-ended campaign.

title: Haunted: Escape the Dollhouse
description: One player investigates a mysterious dollhouse while their friends are trapped inside it. A chaotic and highly replayable co-op paranormal investigation for 2–4 players. Share clues, solve occult puzzles, and try not to panic when your friends give terrible directions.

title: Lugano Bay Tycoon
description: Build and manage your lakeside business in Lugano Bay Tycoon. Rent out pedal boats and boats, serve customers, reinvest your profits, and expand your operation in a relaxing management game set on the shores of an Alpine lake.

title: Valehands
description: A cozy incremental management sim about guiding dwarven crews through their daily work and bringing their valley to life.

title: Iman
description: IMAN is an 8-bit Religious Horror Adventure inspired by "FAITH: The Unholy Trinity", putting you in the shoes of Rudi, a devout young man who must confront the possessed, the power of Dark Magic, and mystical beings.

title: Fish with Friends
description: A co-op fishing game for 1 to 4 players. Catch fish, sell your haul and buy better rods and bigger boats. Head further out for bigger catches, but keep an eye on the weight. Every fish goes in the boat, and too many will sink it.

title: Gee, Tea, Eh, Seven?
description: In a single night, your father's boba tea empire AND family were taken out by rivals. Take revenge as Seven, the tragic sole survivor. Brewing the best drinks and retake the town... or, you know, kneecap the competition through sabotage, subterfuge and violence.

title: Gravikitty
description:
Planet Aura is a colony of peaceful space cats. It is also directly in the path of an Evil Space Battleship. Gravikitty is the only one of them who can fly.

She's unarmed, so she improvises: a force-field swat that sends incoming fire straight back into the thing that fired it. The rest is paws and physics — thrust, drift, and swing around gravity wells while scooping up gold.

title: Feed My Hole!
description: Feed My Hole! is a first-person liminal horror game where every salted threshold costs a piece of you. Search impossible spaces for the objects demanded by the hole in the wall, before your crossings run out and the Caretaker comes to collect you.

title: Polda 5.5
description: Polda 5.5 is a comedic point-and-click adventure game featuring full Czech voice acting, stylized environments, and classic inventory-based puzzle solving. Players control three distinct characters across dozens of locations to uncover what happened during Pankrác's time as a pharaoh.

title: Lift
description: A 1-4 player co-op horror game: ride the elevator 99 floors down, grab valuables right under the monsters' noses and make it back to the doors — latecomers get left behind

title: Pixel Pawns: Chess Duels
description: Chess with pixel-art duels. Play on Windows PC and Xbox, solo or locally with a friend.

title: Final Selection
description: Fast-paced action adventure with brutal close combat. Lose limbs, learn the dungeon, and survive a seven-day trial beneath a ruined castle.

title: Idle Rocket Miner
description: Idle Rocket Miner is an idle game with a hands-on core. You pilot a rocket by hand, taking off from the Command Centre, landing at mines and hauling atoms home to sell, until the periodic table is complete. Every flight you make is recorded as a route, and autopilot then replays it while you’re away.

title: Chest Looter: Cardimonsta Collection
description: A chest-looting incremental game. Loot chests, collect unique cards, and gain endless upgrades. Unlock stronger packs, discover more powerful cards, and keep expanding your collection without end.

title: Silly Souls
description: Silly Souls is an online hide-and-seek party game for 2–8 players. Hide your soul, throw props, and taunt a friend playing the Grim Reaper to steal time—or grab the scythe and hunt your friends. Expect close calls, silly escapes, and proximity voice chat.

title: Sword Saint Soriel
description: Stranded in a distant land, her past and purpose lost to oblivion, what fate awaits Soriel as she struggles to reclaim her sainthood and find her way back to the Allmother?

title: Idle Hoops
description: An incremental idle basketball game. Shoot hoops, sign a roster that ends with an actual goat, and let your team keep scoring while you're away. Win championships, hang your retired jersey in the rafters, and work your way up from the driveway to a court in outer space.

title: Fold'Em
description: Join the table for a surreal high stakes poker card game experience. Discover creepy characters and survive each round with whatever you can. There is something sinister at play...

title: Warstead
description: Build your base, secure vital resources, and lead your troops into battle. Warstead combines base building with tactical real-time combat. Will you invest in your economy, strengthen your defenses—or launch an attack?

title: A Game About Picking Fruits
description: Picking apples, eating berries - remember those summer days? Maybe you did it as a summer job, or helped out in Grandpa's orchard. Now you can go back and relive those days. Pick dozens of different fruits, berries, and grapes, and pack them into boxes.

title: Silent Anomalies 2
description: A horror "spot the difference" game where you monitor security cameras, detect anomalies, and try to survive the night. Turn jumpscares off for a calm experience, or on for full horror tension.

title: Mario Prime
description: A unique Metroid-esque adventure with elements from Super Mario Bros 2, multi-phase boss fights and tons of secrets. An epic journey awaits!

title: Pages of Tomorrow
description:
Challenge fate in this psychological visual novel about a juvenile psych ward patient who discovers a book that can predict the future.

Take on the role of Alex, a teenager struggling with mental health, as she finds herself in the middle of a supernatural mystery. There are secrets to uncover in this ward, but putting the pieces together will not be easy. Forge your own destiny in this tale of recovery and finding happiness—is it true that fate cannot be changed?

title: No Sunrise
description: Survive the night in No Sunrise, a 2.5D zombie survival shooter for solo play and co-op with up to 8 players. Barricade windows, open new routes, upgrade your weapons and rescue your team as each wave turns up the pressure.

title: Re:Integral
description: Metal Gear Solid Re:Integral is a Windows x86 source port of the original PlayStation Metal Gear Solid Integral, built from FoxdieTeam's recovered C and the PsyZ platform library.

title: Watermellionaire
description: Watermellionaire is a dark battle royale fruit-matching game. Pitted against other employees, you compete to become the Most Valuable Packer (MVP) - those who fail are fired. Faced with nothing but a box, some fruit and a guard watching your every move, only one person can come out on top.

title: That Mountain Needs to Fall
description: An incremental game about dwarves and mining. Send your dwarves against the mountain, watch the ore fly and turn a single house into an army of different dwarves. Call the heroes of Ragnarok, conquer the mountain, unleash Ragnarok and start over stronger with Odin's blessings.

title: Mafia: Night Falls
description: A Mafia social deduction game for 8 to 16 players in a moonlit village. By day, accuse and vote at the plaza. By night, hidden roles kill, revive, jail, and investigate while a werewolf hunts and the Mafia plots. Everyone has a secret. Someone is always lying. Survive until dawn.

title: Hearty Haven: Amalgamated
description: Hearty Henrys back and he's stronger than ever along with his pals Moody Moo and Silly Sam! An upgraded magnet watch and so much more! Fight your way down to the depths of this facility while trying to keep your body in one piece

title: Urban Explorer: Baldwin
description: A violent storm forces an urban explorer to take refuge in the abandoned industrial district of Baldwin, Wisconsin. What looks like an unexpected jackpot quickly turns sinister. Notes hint at the truth the EPA was sent to cover up. Some places aren't abandoned by accident.

title: Dummy House
description: First-person psychological horror and survival. Use your camera and sound to identify and repel enemies that mimic humans in total darkness, uncover disturbing secrets, and face increasingly intense nights in an industrial complex with multiple endings and high replayability.

title: Nightshift; Nowhere
description: Welcome to Nowhere Medical! The pay is terrible, the night shift may be your last, and workplace safety has officially gone off the rails; grab whatever weapons you can find and get the hell out!

title: Iskra
description: You take on the role of Alice, who wanders through a dark forest in search of a way out. On her journey she meets many figures each one a reflection of her own personality, an echo of her fears, and a manifestation of her subconscious.

title: 20 Floors Down
description: Forced to descend a dark dungeon of endless horrors, you must get to the bottom to escape your torment. 20 Floors Down is a brutal top-down horror roguelite where you must manage items, manage upgrades, and survive relentless monsters in the dark. And remember... DO NOT let your light run out.

title: Birdworld
description: Do you like birds? How about worlds? Are you perhaps trying to bury a hatchet that keeps poking out from the dirt? Well have we got the game for you! Come on down to Birdworld, the eldritch role playing game about facing your dark past.

title: 4:12 AM
description: December 1999, the eve of Y2K. Twelve nights as the 911 operator of a dying Pennsylvania coal town. Speak with your own voice; a fully offline local AI plays every caller. Every night at 4:12 AM the phone rings: a girl missing for fifteen years. Who lives and who is lost depends on how you answer.

title: Spark of Tales
description: Ignite the spark of inspiration while writing tales in a cozy environment where readers become part of the creative process. Follow stories as they're being written, interact with other authors, shape worlds through your ideas, earn reputation, unlock unique abilities, and get rewarded for your aid.

title: Rules of the Inn
description: A Japanese horror-mystery. In an inn room at the edge of the afterlife, you follow a rule added nightly and judge what slips in; by morning, open the ledger for the truth. The rules never lie, but some nights something not in them arrives disguised as something that is. Obey, or doubt? Mouse only.

title: Last Inspection
description: Your new duty is to inspect properties before move-in. It does not matter what waits inside all responsibility will rest on your shoulders alone. Do the job well, and there is a good chance this inspection will not be your last...

title: Derail
description: Derail is a horror anomaly game where instead of spotting anomalies you have to cleanse them with you holy camera to escape the loop.

title: Cats Don't Carry Car Parts
description: A 14 player co-op horror game where a train crash strands you in a dark Soviet forest. With your friends, scavenge and carry parts to rebuild a dismantled truck, escape the Soviet Oblast of Novak, and survive cat-themed tests to convince IT you belong there.

title: MoonDoku: Sudoku Nights
description: MoonDoku: Sudoku Nights is a Sudoku game set in an observatory at night. Every day all players get the same Nightly puzzle, and each solve adds a star to the player's sky, where the stars gradually join into constellations. A cat sits on the observatory's window ledge and walks along the top of the board, reacting to mistakes and to streaks of correct answers; it can be petted and given one of eight coats. The game also includes 5,000 offline puzzles across four difficulties, ten switchable background worlds, an in-game lo-fi radio with optional ambient sounds, and an optional account for Nightly leaderboards.

title: Grab Your Deck
description: Build real skateboard tricks from cards: an Ollie paired with a Kickflip and two Shove-its fuse into a Tre Flip. Roll each trick into a manual or grind and land the line before bailing. Beat bosses that tape over your stickers to climb the ranks from AM to PRO. A press-your-luck skate deckbuilder.

title: Zone L.O.S.T.
description: Your body is your weakness. A four-player co-op horror game that puts you in the shoes of the chief scientists of a research facility. Your sole objective is to carry out the self-destruct plan and escape the facility.

title: Metro Anomaly
description: Watch the behavior of the office clerks closely and find the one who is merely pretending to be human. You have only one bullet to survive this cycle. Make a mistake, and the anomaly will attack you.

title: Not My Dad
description: Dad is acting strange, and maybe you're the only one who noticed. Meet Not My Dad, a first-person psychological horror game where evil may be lurking inside your own home.

title: Horror Game Creator
description: Horror Game Creator lets you build and explore your own liminal horror worlds. Design levels, customize enemies, lighting, and items, and create unique experiencesfrom quiet, eerie spaces to intense survival scenarios.

title: Dreadgence
description: A deterministic horror autobattler. Bind extinct monsters as Pacts, arm them with Rites and Relics, then deploy. Your units fight automatically with no mid-battle commands you win by building the right answer before combat begins. Conquer wounds, deepen your Pacts, and automate what you've mastered.

title: Feed the Vessel
description: A Short Active Incremental game where you grow clones in vats, feed them to the entity, butcher and burn them for meat, blood, and ichor, upgrade your ship's stations, push the engine into overdrive, and reach the other side.

title: KYC: K Stands for Killing
description: Suneil starts his new night job at a gas station on the outskirts of Highwayton, Colorado. The customers keep coming but few of them leave. Something in the dark keeps asking for them.

title: Please Confirm the Deceased
description: Psychological horror at a morgue's night intake desk. Bodies arrive with paperwork that has to match the body. Weigh it, measure it, take its temperature listen to its chest. Some still have a pulse. The rulebook gains a page every night, and some of what you sign in does not stay signed in.

title: The Previous Owner
description: Run a secondhand bookshop in London, 1994. Every book remembers who owned it before pressed flowers, letters, notes in the margins. Across books that should never have met, the same hand keeps writing. You inherited the rules with the shop: shelve carefully, and do not read the margins.

title: Noël Macabre
description: Noël macabre is a narrative-driven horror FPS that blends dark comedy with cosmic horror. Play as Georges, a police officer forced to return to work on Christmas Eve. Investigate a mysterious threat and save those who can still be saved. Will you see your duty through to the end?

title: Cult Crasher
description: Twenty years ago, Val Thorne's family was taken from her by a sinister cult. Now armed with nothing but her dad's old pistol and a fresh bottle of whiskey, she's vowed to get her revenge...

title: Pond Thing
description: PondThing is a micro-horror narrative puzzle game. It mainly tells the story of the narcissistic youth Shen Qingheng who, after being drawn into a sacrificial ritual, gradually becomes numb and collapses mentally, only to be ultimately saved by his familys love.

title: Down to Floor Zero
description: Down to Floor Zero is a survival horror experience set in an unreasonably large hotel. Your only means of transportation is an elevator that can solely go down. Each floor may host useful items and structures, as well as horrors beyond comprehension. Try to reach the ground floor intact.

title: Punch Clock Panic
description: This is a game where you help an executive named Ned navigate a minefield and arrive safely at his workplace.

title: Celestial Sentinel
description: This is Xhono overwatch space station. Enemy forces are attacking. All kinds of turrets, space station supports and plugins at your disposal. Please use your resources wisely, build your defense, face against all kinds of enemies, and explore the unknown secrets of Xhono.

title: Glow Arcade Racer
description: Classic top-down arcade racing, rebuilt with modern 3D visuals. Blast through 20 tracks packed with jumps, splits, teleports and weapons — solo or with up to 4 players — then build your own in the track editor. Simple, quick, retro fun in a neon-soaked modern package.

title: Wizards Never Lie
description:
Wizards Never Lie is a four-player online social deduction game set in a members-only club for wizards that stands in the space between worlds. Four players take seats at one table in first-person 3D, where nothing anyone claims can be verified — the round settles it a few seconds later, in front of everybody.

The house keeps four games: Revolvers, Hidden Figures, Cards and Poison. All four share one set of actions — Ask, Declare, Check — so the rules carry from one game to the next, and a single evening may only get through two of them. Any claim can be challenged with a Check at any moment, but each player holds only a few: catching a liar pays, and accusing an honest one costs.

Every claim a player makes goes on a public record, the Truth/Lie Trend. A long run of lies builds a streak and a readable pattern; a long run of honesty makes the first lie harder to see coming.

The table talks on three channels. Each player’s live webcam sits above their seat — optional, off until the player turns it on, and never scored; it changes what the table believes and nothing else. Voice chat is available and not required. A wand draws glowing glyphs in the air for accusations, warnings and jokes, so no shared language is needed at the table, and the game ships in 14 languages. Free Table mode removes scoring entirely, for players who want to sit, talk and take in the club.

title: Soma VR
description: A native VR mod by Bateau1 for SOMA, an award-winning video game created by Frictional Games, using its existing HPL3 engine. It has 6DoF motion controls, full finger-tracking (with compatible controllers), and hands which change dynamically with progress in the story.

title: The Only Eye: Arcane Legacy
description: The Only Eye is a 2D pixel-art action roguelite where every run reshapes your journey. Master unique classes, combine powerful relics, face relentless bosses, and push through a dark fantasy world with deep progression and a challenging endgame.

title: CrazyFood
description: Cook in the back of a food truck while a friend drifts through the city at full speed. Grill, chop, stack, and deliver on foot before your customers lose patience. Chaotic online co-op for 2–4 players, or team up for 4v4 Versus.

title: Dishonored VR Mod
description:
Dishonored VR puts the Steam version of Dishonored (2012) into a PC VR headset. Development of this mod was begun by GingasVR and continued by VR-Stereo-Hub. The game renders in real stereo with full head and position tracking, and you play it with tracked hands. You swing the sword by swinging the controller, aim Blink and the crossbow with your hand, crouch by crouching, and read your health and mana off your wrists.

It runs on Quest headsets through Virtual Desktop, on SteamVR headsets such as the Index and Vive, and on any headset whose runtime offers 32-bit OpenXR.

title: Cowpool
description:
If you could change one rule in pool, would it be:

1. Nothing

2. The table now contains grazing cattle?

Cowpool is a puzzle game hidden underneath a simple concept. The statespace of the board is tracked during gameplay - and its up to you to learn how to traverse it.

Or you can just sit back and knock some balls around, make up your own rules or play regular pool but with cows. Youre an infinite mind, you make each new day, theres nothing more I can say!

title: Against Heroes
description:
Against Heroes is a strategy auto-battler in which players take the role of a Demon Lord defending against invading heroes.

Players recruit and deploy troops, manage resources, and choose which heroes to eliminate. Heroes grow stronger over time, and the game ends in defeat if a hero reaches the maximum level.

Players can unlock upgrades, develop strategies, and face increasingly challenging heroes as they progress through the game.

title: Diona's Flower Shop
description:
Tomorrow is an especially important occasion, and you need to find the perfect bouquet of flowers. Unfortunately, you left work a bit too late at night, and now all the shops are closed.

Just when you're about to give up on the idea, you come across a flower shop that's still open... but it's a little odd?

title: Starlathe
description: Command your ship and fleet in a galaxy that truly lives: 150 sectors where six factions mine, haul, trade, build and wage war whether you're there or not. Trade it, rob it, defend it - or forge your own fleet and carve out your place in it. Play solo or in online co-op.

title: Road to Verdant
description: Immerse yourself in a massive magical world where you will start as a humble archer and grow to become a legend. An auto-runner with RPG elements where you can craft your equipment, upgrade your character, trade items, and complete quests... some of them very well hidden!

title: Super Astro Cat 2
description:
Super Astro Cat 2 is the direct sequel of Super Astro Cat 1. After exploring the universe for a suitable planet for the cats to live, now you have a new mission, protect and develop the bases from aliens attacking from everywhere! But don't worry, this time Agent C have a new arsenal of weapons to help this challenging mission.

Protect and develop your base against relentless waves of aliens. Choose the right weapon for the right moment and complete all the tasks to make the cats thrive in the space!

title: Spinful
description: A fantasy roguelite slot-builder. Upgrade, enhance and customize your slots into a powerful combat machine!

title: 26 Moves: The Queen's Plot
description: The year is 1907, set in a small, nearly abandoned town. Two murders within three days will shatter the peaceful life of recent years. A point-and-click adventure game where you play as both the killer and the detective, alternating each day, experiencing the story from both perspectives.

title: Deepstrata
description: Deepstrata is a single-player 2D mining adventure set on Luna, Mars, Io and Callisto. Players pilot a drill pod through destructible strata, haul ore to the surface and upgrade their rig while managing fuel, cargo weight and environmental hazards. The game includes story contracts, base building and guardians that can be fought or appeased with offerings.

title: Verdant Requiem
description: “SRPG in Search of Balance" On a continent where three nations’ ideals clash, what will you choose, and what will you protect? Verdant Requiem is a SRPG about a war for balance beyond good and evil, featuring detailed 2D maps, branching storylines, resource management, and elemental balance.

title: Impurity
description: Build and lead a settlement in a ruthless dark fantasy world. Command companions, explore shifting open world lands, and navigate rival settlements - trading, allying, or waging war. Walk the path of light or corruption as you endure relentless seasons and ancient horrors.

title: Unburied
description: The Unburied King's funeral marches home, waking every grave it crosses. Keep the vigil alone or with friends — hold until dawn, and the dead burn to ash. Free demo out now.

title: Muritura
description: A mouse wakes in a tiny community after a terrible storm brings more than just weather with it. Fight or flee monsters, mouse around puzzles, engage with locals, and uncover the source of the unnatural storm in this old-school, adventure game.

title: Ink and Lore
description: A 99-floor roguelike of cards that vanish the moment they're played. Lead two guardians of living stationery into a picture book someone stopped drawing. Your cards are finite—choosing when to spend them is life or death. And at the end of the world waits the one who—

title: Survivor's Notes
description:
Survivor's Notes is a zombie survival FMV. Players will take on the roles of both the male and female protagonists simultaneously, advancing different story branches through choices and various quick-time events during gameplay, and ultimately unlocking distinct endings based on their decisions.

This is not a story about "how the apocalypse destroys the world", but a tale of how humans choose to believe, take responsibility, and make sacrifices in the face of despair.

It does not depict how heroes conquer disasters, but how ordinary people, without divine intervention or retreat, shoulder the cost of saving the world with reason, courage, and sacrifice.

When the world is redeemed, the deeds of salvation are erased. What truly remains is only the possibility for the continuation of human civilization.

This is a work dedicated to "the survivors".

It is also a post-apocalyptic fable about memory, trust, and human dignity.

title: Compactor Baron
description: You're broke and the bills keep coming. Smash scrap into cubes, sell them, pay up. A short active incremental: aim, let the hammer swing, upgrade your tools, go bankrupt on purpose, and build a scrapyard that pays for itself.

title: Quiet Bloom
description: Quiet Bloom is a cozy idle game. Awaken the wind, dig wells, and call the rain to tend your land for you. Gather wood, stone, and water, raise wind vanes and solar panels, and watch a cracked desert slowly bloom into a luxuriant green oasis.

title: Night of Dread
description: Night of Dread is a retro-style survival horror inspired by 80s and 90s cult classics. Master modernized tank over-the-shoulder aiming and classic inventory management in a gritty world where early 3D aesthetics meet modern engine capabilities. Survive the nightmare.

title: Devouring City
description: Devouring City is a top-down management game about a living city that swallows giant minerals whole. Guide residents and organs as they digest matter, then turn visible resources into power, structures, inhabitants, and weapons. Balance expansion, production, and defense as your organism grows.

title: Slime Simulator
description: You need to obtain food to survive, and you can transform into the animals you hunt.

title: Every Man for Himself and God Against All or, for a shorter name: TimeLeft
description: A narrative blackjack survival game set on death row. Bet minutes of your remaining life, outplay the prison director, solve hidden puzzles, and survive as long as you can in a bleak pixel-art prison where every hand costs time.

title: Echo Sequence
description: An isometric, top-down roguelite shooter where your deaths are your squad. Die, and your last life fights on as an Echo, repeating every move and every shot. Die again and there are two. Plan across loops, split the work between your past selves, and clear each level together.

title: Oddments & Offerings
description: A first-person shopkeeper extraction game where you run a mysterious antique store by day and explore dangerous locations by night in search of rare and valuable oddities. Extract with you're loot, grow your shop and decide what is worth selling - and what is worth keeping.

title: Let Rat Be
description: Press countless keyboard keys simultaneously to help the little rat escape!

title: IncreTop
description: IncreTop is an incremental game about whipping spinning tops. You are trapped in a series of mysterious worlds filled with nothing but tops. Keep whipping tops, earning money, upgrading, unlock and buy powerful items. Destroy world after world in search of a way out.

title: Holdline: Last Gate
description: Holdline: Last Gate is a third-person tower-defense survival game. Harvest resources, craft and place towers, and hold the gate across a chain of diverse alien maps as the wave fights you on every front at once.

title: Roadside Mechanic Simulator
description: Save stranded drivers! Rescue clients with damaged cars across highways, forests and villages using your mobile diagnostic workshop. Upgrade tools and expand parts inventory over time become a mechanical master!

title: Doomsday Train
description: Doom falls and civilization collapses entirely. The roaming train becomes the last hope of mankind. You will take charge of the vehicle, manage and equip survivors, allocate food and daily tasks, collect resources to resist zombie swarms. The fate of everyone hinges on your decisions.

title: GigaStriker
description: GIGASTRIKER is a 3D football survivors-like where every goal sends enemies flying. Your striker kicks automatically as you dodge swarms, slide-tackle through crowds and stack upgrades into devastating builds. Recruit teammates, take down bosses and unlock new strikers for your next run.

title: The Evil Rise
description: A first-person survival horror game set in a house that should be empty. Ration scarce ammunition, unlock the house one organ at a time, and survive the thing that keeps the lamps lit. Your father still lives here.

title: The Cozy Funemployment
description: Take a well-deserved break before searching for your next job! Spend time doing all the things you've always wanted to: cook delicious meals, relax, collect cute figurines, chat with friends, and enjoy life at your own pace. Work can wait a little longer... you've earned this vacation.

title: Fork the Rich
description: Billionaires should not exist. It's time to Fork the Rich!

title: The Phone Game
description: The Phone Game is a chaotic physics game where you play an old phone, smash through playful levels, trigger chain reactions, use wild powerups, and launch revenge at Bobby who threw you away. Crazy combos, unlock APPs, collect cosmetics, and turn every world into a playground of chaotic destruction.

title: Chrome Circuit
description: A twin-stick roguelite in a 2086 cyber-dystopia. Chain kill-streaks for massive rewards, sign cursed loot contracts with brutal downsides, and stack upgrades into a new monster build every run.

title: Alchemy Duel
description: Alchemy Duel is a card game that combines elements of alchemy and roguelike gameplay. Alchemize monsters suited to the situation and unleash powerful combos by making use of synergies between your cards!

title: Settled At Sea
description: Settled At Sea is a first-person mystery set on a remote Scottish island. You are a lighthouse keeper grieving your wife's death-but the island doesn't feel as isolated as it should.

title: Keep Shearing
description: A cozy incremental game about shearing sheep, collecting wool, earning gold, and unlocking upgrades to grow your flock.

title: Defense Front
description: A new charm of traditional tower defense.Hordes of unknown aliens have descended upon Earth. On dynamic scene maps, you need cleverly build defense towers to construct their path of advance, combine with controllable targeting strategies, and stop the aliens' assault.

title: Anvilia
description: Run a medieval blacksmith shop in co-op. Gather resources, forge tools, stock your shelves, and grow a thriving business.

title: God of War III Remastered for PC
description: A native port of God of War III: Remastered (PlayStation 4) for Windows 10 and 11.

title: Space Manager
description: Take on realistic space missions, manage your economy, and explore the solar system. Build and expand your space center on Earth, accept contracts, and launch satellites into orbit. Research, adapt and collect valuable scientific data to commence your growing aerospace empire.

title: Light Work
description: In this first person experience, you are returning home after a long day of work. Turn off all of the lights on each floor of the office before you depart. Use the elevator to travel between floors, and be on the lookout for any unusual behavior from your coworkers.

title: Hasami: Moonlight Trim
description: Hasami is a tree pruning game where every cut cleaves through everything it crosses. Find the right angle, pull branches aside with ropes, nurture new growth, and clean endless procedural trees down to their blossom.

title: Sift
description: SIFT is a fast 2D action platformer about momentum. Fire your hook, push off thin air to dash and reset your jump, grab the key, hit the door then do it again, faster. 85 handcrafted levels. Race the clock, your friends, or everyone at once.

title: FlipBaka
description: Flip floor panels and launch enemies and friends off the island! Top-down arcade party action: explore and power up in Dungeon Mode, play 8 solo stages and a boss, co-op, or 8-player online PvP. Just one more round!

title: Another Tavern Simulator
description: Open your own tavern in a fantasy valley. Mix unusual cocktails, cook hearty meals, furnish the hall and hire a helping hand. Restore the old inn and rent out rooms to travelers. Get to know your neighbors and join their little adventures. Just remember who that drink was for.

title: Everburning Dark
description: Everburning Dark blends 2048-style roguelike merge combat, unlimited AI-driven storytelling, and companion AI bonding. Build with relics and skills, talk freely to reshape each run, and uncover the folk-horror truth of a dying dynasty.

title: Bombacon!
description: A blind pig, a mute pig, and a deaf pig. A bomb about to explode! Bombacon! is a chaotic 3-player co-op bomb defusal game that tests your friendships in the most absurd way. Grab your radios, set up your communication chain, and open the briefcase before time runs out. Or you're all bacon!

title: Rate & State
description: Rate & State is a macroeconomic simulator where you take control of a country’s economy. Manage inflation, set tax rates, invest, and overcome unexpected crises. Can you build an economic powerhouse and avoid debt? Your choices shape your future!

title: Arcade & Motel Simulator Together
description: Run a neon-lit roadside motel with an arcade next door. Haggle with guests, upgrade rooms, play eight fully playable arcade games, cook burgers for hungry players and manage it all from your retro tablet, solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players.

title: Moon Sweepers
description: Stop being lazy, youve got whole Moon to clean. Better get started.

title: Lost Vessel
description: Idle sci-fi RPG where combat actually matters. Crash-landed on an alien world, you rebuild through five skills, melee/ranged/void-magic combat, and a server-wide world boss. Progress keeps going while you're AFK. Solo, co-op, or faction raids. Free to play. No pay-to-win.

title: Jet Combat Simulator
description: Three brothers made the jet game they always wanted to play. Fly fast and low over an endless world you can blow apart. Mouse-aim flight with real aircraft numbers, 31 planes from the Me 262 to the B-52, low-pass streaks that score big, and a career that fills your hangar.

title: Slayer Mage: My First RPG
description: Inspired by classic 1980s and 90s JRPGs, this epic quest challenges you to save the world from a rising ancient darkness. Take control of Imi, a young elf mage, and recruit powerful allies across a world filled with wonder, danger, and a touch of 90s humor.

title: Wuthering Waves: Prism's Illusion, Heart's Illumination
Neo Light
description: Every room wants you dead in Neo Light. A brutal precision platformer where you master 9 short-burst powers while Glitch, your sarcastic assistant, guides, judges and mocks your failures in real time.

title: Ashbound: Endless Hunt
description: Ashbound: Endless Hunt is an active incremental action RPG where every click fuels the fight. Slay escalating waves and bosses, forge 100 weapon tiers, build a powerful party, complete relic sets, master combat upgrades, and prestige to return stronger and push deeper into the endless hunt.

title: Rax
description: Rax is a puzzle sandbox about light paths, logic, and modular construction. Place and rotate optical components to control the direction, color, and timing of light, activate targets, and package complex circuits into reusable blueprint chips.

title: Long Rest
description: Lead 4 auto-running heroes through dungeon runs, open chests, survive the curse, and spend your loot on permanent upgrades.

title: The Factory in the Shadows
description:
Some places are abandoned. Others are left behind for a reason.

The Factory in the Shadows is a psychological mystery horror experience that takes you into the remains of forgotten places, where traces of the past still linger and unanswered questions wait beneath the surface.

What happened here? Why was everything left behind? And what secrets were buried before the world moved on?

Explore, investigate, and uncover fragments of a story hidden across time. Every room, every recording, and every discovery brings you closer to the truth or just lies.

The deeper you look, the more you realize that the shadows are not empty.

They are hiding something.

title: Figure Me Out
description: A multiplayer FPS where you eliminate opponents by typing the numbers on their foreheads. Read theirs before they read yours, use tactical gadgets to disrupt the fight, and battle friends or strangers in matches with up to 20 players.

title: 100 Easy Maths
description: 100 Easy Maths is a minimalist math puzzle game designed to sharpen your mental agility. Solve 100 unique, fast-paced equations across 10 thematic rounds and unlock 100 Steam Achievements, one for every single correct answer!

title: Sloptoberfest
description: A chaotic festival tent simulator for up to 4 players. Run your own Oktoberfest beer tent, serve beer and food, expand your business, hire staff, brew your own beer, and sabotage the competition.

title: Universal Tidy Up
description: Explore different ways to "tidy up." A puzzle-focused first-person tidy-up game with 20+ stages to organize! Put scattered belongings on shelves, shelves inside bigger shelves, and delve into new spaces. Figure out the rules of each stage and keep tidying.

title: Coffee Craze
description: Serve coffees and small pastries to customers while slowly making the place your own by moving things around and changing decorations.

title: Color Capsules
description: Stack 'em, merge 'em, hit 'em, dodge 'em! Color Capsules is a versus physics puzzle game where your gachapon capsules go flying! With a frantic pace and over 100 cosmetics to unlock, you'll always have something new to mess with!

title: Echo Resonance
description: A classic science-fiction point-and-click adventure inspired by the genre’s greatest titles, where you’ll control two characters and solve ingenious puzzles using an innovative temporal superposition mechanic.

title: Balingo
description: Balingo is a bingo roguelike where every ball counts. Buy bingo cards, mark numbers, and combine tickets, stamps, markers, and marbles to create unique combos and reach ever-higher scores before you run out of balls.

title: Cozy Island Cleaner
description: Cozy Island Cleaner is a relaxing game where you clean up a trash-covered island with the help of the cat who lives there. Collect the trash on the beach, upgrade your gear, and restore the island to its former beauty step by step.

title: Squomb
description: Too close. Too late. You drop a bomb. Boom. You die. They die. Good. Respawn as your squomb and dive back in. 14 players. PvP or Co-op. Fast, explosive 1-bit madness inspired by Bomberman.

title: The King Got Too Much Gold
description: Your royal fountain spits out more gold than anyone could ever spend, and cleaning it up is somehow your job. Sweep coins, sell them, draft upgrades, hire goblins, trolls and a cat, unlock a big web of skills, then feed your whole fortune to the Glutton King. You can never lose. The gold never stops

title: Checkborne: A Chess Adventure
description: Challenge 20 chess masters from around the world to duels across the board. Defeat them one by one, prove your skills, and fight your way to the top to become the ultimate CHECKBORNE Champion.

title: Endless Battle: Idle & Build
description: Endless Battle：Idle & Build is an idle loot-farming game with 8 skills, 4 enhancements Tons of build effects, and unique support companions Defeat the enemies on every floor and keep climbing. Farm loot whilst the game runs in the background, until you reachthe Realm of the End!

title: Fishy Bar
description: Catch fish by day, run a shady lakeside bar by night. Hook 40+ species, cook them into questionable specials, keep the regulars fed and tipsy, dodge taxes and scammers, and upgrade your boat, your bar and your dog. First-person sim. Fresh fish, fishy business.

title: Roll of Chaos
description: Roll the dice and embrace the chaos in an epic roguelike where every decision could save you or destroy you... Combine abilities, create unique builds, and upgrade your character with every run while facing enemies with unique powers that change every battle!

title: Re:Draw
description: One day the Erasure happened. The world didn't die - it was simply erased. You're one of the few left holding a pencil. Restore the erased world from scratch: sketch, bring ecosystems to life, and watch as the settlers you drew build a civilization.

title: Sky Strike Overdrive
description: Fast-paced 2D retro synthwave arcade shooter inspired by 80s classics. Pilot an advanced starfighter, dodge endless enemy waves, upgrade your arsenal, and chase the ultimate high score in a neon-drenched sci-fi universe.

title: Facrobry
description: Facrobry is a strategy-simulator in which you will manage an automated robot production station. Research upgrades, assemble robots, and send them into battle!

title: Rustwater
description: Rustwater is a cozy post-opocalyptic cleanup simulator. Pilot your boat across a flooded world, using immersive cutting mechanics to dismantle structures and rotting ships to gather resources. Sail through isolated settlements, repair homes, and trade goods to help survivors rebuild their lives.

title: Virtumon
description: Adopt a mysterious virtual pet known as a Virtumon. Care for it, keep it alive, and guide it's evolution through countless possible forms. Train it for battle, send it on adventures, and uncover the secrets of the strange virtual world it calls home.

title: Tales of Symphonia: Definitive Edition
description: Tales of Symphonia: Definitive Edition is a large fan-made mod for the game's Steam version. The project aims to combine the best of the different versions released since the GameCube debut in 2003, restore features lost in later ports, and modernize aspects that have aged.

title: Splinter Cell: Double Agent - Recompiled
description: An unofficial native PC port of the original Xbox version of Splinter Cell: Double Agent via static recompilation.

title: The Scarlet Thread
description: The Scarlet Thread is a single-player point-and-click mystery set in a Victorian manor, presented in 1-bit ink-style visuals with touches of scarlet. The case unfolds through the accounts and journals of several narrators. Players inspect objects, compare clothing and ledgers, check tides and moon phases, and connect evidence on deduction boards. Re-enactments and a tabletop model allow them to test routes, lighting, and what a witness could have seen. Revisiting earlier records with new evidence reveals the limits of both unreliable and truthful accounts, while the evidence retained and choices made affect the ending.

title: Toiletocalypse
description:
This is not just a game about running to the toilet. Toiletocalypse is an absurd roguelike survival where you try to survive a work shift in someone else's apartment before your guts take you down. One shift can be calm. Another turns into chaos you can't control. Everything runs on RNG.

You're paid per job. Finish it, you get paid. Don't, you get nothing. Your guts came to work with you they're the main antagonist. Manage water, pressure, psyche and stamina while you build walls, mop floors, craft drinks and race to the toilet. Runs from 10 minutes to several hours. Early Access.

title: Red Rooster
description:
Red Rooster is an incendiary, physics-driven RPG combining the best of cerebral, worldbuilding-rich RPGs with the genetics of physics-driven immersive sims.

Play as Redrick Roost, a white-collar inmate thrust into the role of an arson investigator and partnered up with an opiate-dependent mathematician to investigate a mysterious string of arson that all seems to connect to his brother, the city’s fire–chief.

Explore the fractalized “border archipelago” of the tri-partite city of Arta-Tantor in a political alternate-history setting with a strong science fiction undercurrent.

title: Littlest Catalyst: Swarm Defense
description:
A small scale real-time strategy/base defense game with roguelite elements

Command a crew of tiny bots, build a modular space base, and repel relentless alien swarms. Build, upgrade, defend, and don't forget to pet the crew members.

title: Hood Warfare 2
description: Rival gangs fight for control of Chicago. Pick a side, customize your weapons, and fight other players across a variety of action-packed game modes. Spin the block and take over the streets in this chaotic multiplayer FPS.

title: Smiley Arena
description:
Smiley Arena is a single-player game that combines tower defense with
direct, action-based combat. The player controls a smiley character on the
battlefield, moving with WASD and aiming with the mouse, while placing and
upgrading turrets across five lanes to stop incoming waves of enemies.

Six classes are available, each with its own ability: Fire (burn damage),
Ice (slowing and freezing), Shadow (invisibility and critical hits), Medic
(regeneration and healing), Bomb (splash damage) and Speed (a high-speed
dash). Defeated enemies yield currency, which is spent on building turrets
and upgrading them through several tiers. Level-up choices are made while
the game continues to run, without pausing. Boss enemies appear at regular
intervals between the standard waves.

The full version features endless waves, all six classes, the complete
upgrade tree and an achievement system. A free browser-based demo covering
the first nine waves and the first boss encounter is also available. The
game supports English and German.

title: Elemental Lands
description: Build a base to support heroes in turn-based tactical card battles & defeat enemy breaches overwhelming your land! Your base-building strategy powers your spell deck, weakens foes & heals heroes. Position 3 heroes & use spell cards to seize enemy objectives for buffs. Cards are tactics, not damage.

title: The Great Release
description: Don’t get caught farting in the meeting! In this stealth-comedy game, you must strategically vent your mounting "pressure" by timing farts around office distractions.

title: Cat and Paste!
description: A chaotic copy-and-paste hide-and-seek with cats that can turn into anything. "Copy" a stage object to transform into it, then "Paste" decoys everywhere to hide in plain sight! A prop hunt party game for up to 16 players online!

title: Despiry
description: Despiry is a top-down sci-fi roguelite for 1 to 4 players with ARPG-style loot and run-based builds. Explore a hostile alien world, fight swarms, stack relics and passives, and bring back materials for permanent upgrades. There's no end to reach, only how far you go before enemies outgrow you.

title: Ninja Noboken Episode 2
description: A brutal 2.5D ninja action game built by a solo developer. Fast combat, precision platforming, and intense boss fights inspired by classic hardcore ninja games.

title: Phone Shop Simulator
description: Build and run your own phone shop! Stock phones and accessories, design your displays, set prices and serve customers. Manage your money and turn a small store into a thriving business in Phone Shop Simulator.

title: Refund This Game
description: Fling yourself up to the top in this “Getting Over It”-like 3D platformer! Stick your pole to walls, bend it and fling yourself with great speed! One mistake means falling all the way down. Can you reach the summit in under 2 hours and earn that refund?!

title: Krushpit
description: Krushpit is a Real-Time Indirect PvP roguelike survival set among brutal concrete blocks and rusty garages. Obliterate mutants, evolve skills, spin slots, and create OP builds! Survive the chaos or join the PvP ladder to crush everyone and dominate the leaderboard!

title: Prismania
description: Prismania is a surreal puzzle adventure game. After waking up in a strange triangle-shaped well full of strange mechanisms, you must solve prism puzzles to escape and figure out how you ended up there and what's going on.

title: Simmer Down
description: A cozy co-op cooking game for up to four. Chop, cook and plate real recipes, serve tables that eat together and furnish your own restaurant, then follow a family of caterers through forty years of other people's big days, always from the kitchen.

title: Graveyard Grift
description: Rob graves, stack coffins, and drive like hell in order to resurrect the love of your life. Graveyard Grift is a spooky driving heist game about things that refuse to stay buried.

title: Tom's Last Adventure
description: Jump, die, try again! Tom's Last Adventure is a brutal 2D precision platformer. Guide a celestial cat through unforgiving levels using unique star powers. Push your reflexes to the absolute limit to finally reach your new home.

title: Police Stories 2
description:
Police Stories 2 is a cooperative tactical top-down police shooter.

The sequel to the iconic Police Stories will feature new challenges, new mechanics, and a brand-new story. Take command of a rundown precinct in the most crime-ridden part of the city. With limited resources, dangerous choices, and enemies on every side, the line between justice and compromise starts to blur.
Serve the law. Protect the innocent. Survive the system.

title: No More Pain
description: No More Pain is a first-person psychological horror adventure game. Stepping into the shoes of different characters, you will examine personal belongings, gather photos, and inspect clues within mysterious environments to unravel the truth buried beneath past memories.

title: Alter-Egoism of Apocalypse
description: Infiltrate the Agent training program in Hinomoto to discover who murdered your mother and avenge her death!

title: AstraCube
description:
AstraCube is a voxel survival game where every planet is a cube. You crash on an alien world with a wrecked ship, a journal, and not much else. Mine and craft your way from bare hands to stone tools, metal, power and machines, then rebuild your ship and fly between the planets of your solar system, and beyond.

Every world is generated from its seed: its own ground, plants, weather, animals and ores. Walk over the edge of a cube and the ground becomes the wall. Live with the people of each world: villages of six different races who work, sleep, talk in their own alphabet (your suit translates) and trade from what they gather. Farm, hunt, build a sealed base, run power, and fly ships you built yourself. Play alone or co-op with friends, on your own dedicated server if you like.

title: Ampanic
description: AIM × Shop Management! Gather, process, craft, and serve customers — all with your aim. Let a customer escape and it's Game Over! Master flick & tracking aim and survive the chaos. 3 difficulty levels, from mouse beginners to seasoned veterans! Online co-op & competitive multiplayer!

title: OpenCMR2
description: OpenCMR2 is a work-in-progress native port of Colin McRae Rally 2.0 (PC, 2000) to modern platforms.

title: Misblood
description:
Misblood is an arcade-style top-down shooter built around short, brutal, replayable missions. The city has a list of 25 contracts with your name on it: drive to the address, kick the door, and fight room by room until nobody is left standing. You are always outnumbered, deaths come fast, and restarts come faster — every mission is a plan you rewrite on the fly.

Fight with whatever the job hands you: pistol, rifle, shotgun or bat, backed by grenades and a split-second dash.

An open pixel-art city to cruise between jobs, and a list that only ends one way.

title: Forgotten Towns
description: Build a flourishing settlement above a dangerous cave system. Explore unique biomes, manage happiness and grief, invite traders, defend against invasions, train soldiers, recruit heroes, defeat world bosses, and prepare to dig into the depths below.

title: SSX Reconstruction
description: This is a reconstruction of the PS2 game SSX in Rust and Bevy.

title: Arcanum Solitarius
description: Poker solitaire with an arcane twist. Each row and column of the 5x5 grid is a poker hand, scoring as it fills. Repeat a hand and it's worth half. Purify the cursed Arcana, corrupted tarot cards that penalize your play. Draft Jokers for unique powers and power up your deck and board for bonus chips.

title: Understander
description: Understander is a rhythm-infused 2D action-adventure. Master the "timing" to escape a mysterious laboratory alongside the protagonist, Meti!

title: Comet's wayfaring odyssey
description: Born from a graduating students' capstone project featured on the 2025 BAFTA Student Awards Longlist and the Unreal Engine Student Showcase 2025, discover an adorable and zany physics-based puzzle adventure following a dog training to become a stellar superstar.

title: Economy Bros
description: Build your dream city from scratch in this sandbox tycoon: start by working or gathering resources, trade businesses and real estate based on market demand, expand your land, and grow your empire—all while surviving and stacking up cold hard cash from your strategic moves.

title: Eternal Survivors
description: In this swashbuckling survivor-lite, face relentless hordes and ultimate bosses. Embark on a 3-act journey with 5 intrepid heroes. Harvest P.L.A.N.T power and shatter game designers’ dreams of balance with game-breaking builds.

title: Duoshift
description: Defend The Wall on a tactical 11x7 grid using your pair of battle vehicles. Outmaneuver waves of scavenged war machines, unleash game-breaking hacks and chain synergies. Draft, fight, and survive in this endlessly replayable tactical roguelite.

title: Catapult vs. Orcs
description: A dynamic incremental shooter in the style of dark fantasy. Destroy orcs with a catapult, open new portals, hire assistants, find artifacts. Constantly level up in a large skill tree.

title: Wizzy the Wood
description: Wizzy the Wood is a 3D adventure platformer where you play as a forest creature on a quest to reclaim the Stone of Eternity from an evil sorcerer and save your tribe.

title: Toziuha Night: Nosferatu's Curse
description:
A new adventure in the Toziuha Night series! With a classic 8-bit style and chiptune music, you’ll play through various semi-linear levels to face familiar enemies and new bosses! Whether you play alone or with a friend, the challenge will be waiting for you!

Eight years have passed since the battle against Dracula, the hero of Transylvania who succumbed to the power of darkness. However, peace is once again in danger. A pair of young alchemists will fight against the curse of the demon who goes by the name Nosferatu.

title: Grimhold
description: A dark fantasy roguelike tower defense. Hold the wall against endless legions across ten acts, command 23 unique heroes and forge runs that never repeat. Every wave you survive is a choice; every choice reshapes the siege. How long can Grimhold hold?

title: Vibe Together
description: Build songs you can see! Drop blocks on a grid, wire them together, and hear the vibe emerge. Jam with up to 8 friends, remix what the community makes, then play your own track as a game with a ton of Arcade Modes. A multiplayer music playground for everyone to enjoy!

title: High Typer
description: High Typer is an intense typing roguelike where every keystroke, word, and mistake feeds a physics-based scoring system. Build your run, improve your flow, and chase better results through sharper, faster typing.

title: Gallery Organizer
description: Tidy up the gallery, sort and hang all the paintings where they belong. Choose a gallery size. Enjoy the satisfaction of turning a messy gallery into a perfectly organized collection. 1,000 artworks by real artists.

title: Dig! Dig! Dig!
description: DIG Company hires you as a "Digger." Descend into abandoned mines to complete a mission - press the red button. Ride the elevator and DIG crystals to power it, choose characters with unique abilities, and escape terrifying monsters from the depths of the mines.

title: Warmace: Miniature Shop Simulator
description: Build the ultimate miniature hobby store! Order model kits, paint stunning miniatures, negotiate with collectors, and grow your business into every hobbyist's favorite shop.

title: Picatso
description: Play as Picatso, a calico cat painter searching for a creative spark. Navigate through underground ruins with his ability to paint the environment which allow him to advance in this platforming adventure!

title: Drain the Galaxy
description: Thousands of space dwarves vs. one planet. The planet loses. Land, strip it bare in short runs with pickaxes, lasers and missiles, haul the loot home and grow a huge upgrade tree. You can't lose. You can only get richer

title: Find Bunny: A Little Hidden Journey
description: Find Bunny is a cozy hidden-object game where you peel stickers to find and collect hidden pictures. Join Coco and Matcha on a journey to uncover the secret of the misbehaving crops. Cross the sea, ride the train, fill your album with stickers, and help new friends bring peace back to the farm!

title: Divided Empire: Sengoku
description: Lead your clan through Japan's turbulent Sengoku period. Craft wise strategies to expand your domain and use cunning tactics to defeat your enemies on the battlefield. Emerge victorious, restore order, and claim the title of Shogun!

title: All Eyes on Me
description: Everyone sees the same thing. Except you. Now every eye is on you. In this bullet heaven roguelite, their attention makes them deadlier and charges your strongest weapon. Find items, shape your build, beat challenges, play local co-op or online conquests.

title: Awaken, Empress of the Night
description: Take control of a dark cult and expand it through influence, schemes and war. Send your followers on Mandated Expeditions and manage their trust and love for you. Will you become known across the lands or remain a puppeteer in the shadows?

title: Missing Protocol
description: Follow Markus as he survives a dystopian tech program kept secret right under the public's nose. Missing Protocol is a retro-futuristic narrative driven survival horror experience that dives into the ulterior motives of those in power

title: Cascabel
description: Cascabel is an online western role-playing game set in a valley in the Brazilian countryside, played in the PC web browser with no download. Players arrive as travelers and choose their own path: learning trades, fishing, hunting, raising a ranch with crops and livestock, and riding between villages. Goods are sold and traded with other players in the village Market, and duels in the street only start when both players accept.

title: Virtua Fighter Recomp
description: Virtua Fighter Recomp is a fan-made project that rebuilds the 1993 arcade fighting game for native execution on modern hardware. It translates the arcade code into native code and recreates the surrounding Sega Model 1 board. No ROMs or game files are included.

title: Velmora Online
description: Velmora Online is a fantasy MMORPG built in Unity. Players explore an open world, complete quests from NPCs, craft equipment, and form parties and clans. It features open PvP with a criminal and citizen reputation system, loot chests, banking, and boat travel across the seas.

title: Watch Out: Shark!
description: Survive in the ocean by feeding on smaller fish, dodging predators, and facing various dangers in this relaxing, challenging, and super fun retro arcade game—all hand-drawn in pixel art style. Dive into this adventure solo or in multiplayer mode. But remember: watch out for the shark!

title: Junebug
description: Junebug is a cat companion and cozy building game. Create charming little spaces, make them your own, then experience what you’ve built through your cat. Explore, play, relax, and enjoy the little moments you create together.

title: Freeze Line
description: Freeze Line is a single-player 2D action-puzzle game built around freezing time and aiming precise dashes through hazardous rooms. Players pause the action, drag to set a direction, and release to move past traps and enemies. The journey begins in a clock tower, where an amnesiac character receives a pocket watch and a task to collect scattered fragments of time. New abilities introduce echoes, defensive shadows, frozen hazards, and rifts as the player explores hand-placed rooms across rainforest, ice, and desert environments. Choices made during the journey affect how the story ends.

title: Smash Their Heads
description: Smash mechanical heads in a twisted circus! A short active incremental game. Cash in poker chips, upgrade your launcher, and keep the crowd entertained before they get bored!

title: Dibaro: CryptoHunter Dice Battle Royal
description: Online battles for up to 6 players. Roll dice, command Fire, Water, Earth and Wind mana, and clash on a hex board where six factions fight at once. Affinity settles every attack, and reordering your mana is deckbuilding. Raise over 60 Hunters across Challenge, Survival and hidden-role Demon & Hero.

title: Calibration Sequence
description: Calibration Sequence is a bullet hell game where you play as a nanobot undergoing its factory calibration.

title: ArcaneBound
description: ArcaneBound is a pixel-art bullet heaven action RPG. Collect familiars, defeat hordes of monsters, gather rare cards, level up, and create increasingly devastating builds.

title: Wolf Plot
description: Wolf Plot is a tricky puzzle-platformer. Help your wolves catch the sheep in over 100 levels. Use a variety of tools to control your wolves: rockets, fans, bombs, bridges, and more.

title: 7Komada
description: A social deduction death game set in a backwater of alternate universe Europe. You and your class's graduation trip has been cut short by a novel 19-man kidnapping - and as you all wake up trapped in an abandoned mansion, you take it upon yourself to figure out what's going on before it's too late.

title: Now You're Cooking!
description: A roguelike deckbuilder about running your own restaurant. Cook delicious meals, build an extravagant menu, and keep your patrons happy. Did I mention that rent doubles every month?

title: Kristi Sky Islands
description: Kristi Sky Islands is a turn-based strategy game. Lead a group of heroes, face various foes, upgrade and equip your heroes, fuse your items to obtain higher-rarity items, and conquer bosses.

title: Crabrun
description: Face an unforgiving arcade ecosystem made up of simple rules and filled with subtle interactions. Learn to walk sideways, dash through danger, and combo your way to an absurdly high score. The gods of the sea reward persistence and style in CRABRUN.

title: No ESC
description: A first-person survival horror game where movement, combat, and all other actions are performed by typing. Explore a procedurally generated dungeon, evade or fight enemies, solve puzzles, and find what you need to escape. Featuring hand-painted watercolor artwork.

title: The Fight for Beardlandia
description: An auto-battler roguelike gacha. Recruit your party, min-max their builds, and stack class synergies, as you drag eight recruits deeper each run. Watch them fall, roll for powerful heroes, upgrade the skill tree, and march a stronger party into the fight for Beardlandia!

title: Bravest!2
description: The sequel to “Bravest!,” the classic front-view RPG that was a hit during the feature phone era!

title: Aegis Vanguard
description: Lead humanity's last hope, a squad of desperate heroes, through a grim, corrupted realm in this dark fantasy strategy roguelite. Master squad combos and grid inventory management tactics. Create builds & synergies to outsmart dangerous threats in a bleak world where our fate rests on your survival.

title: Expedition of the Guild
description: Lead your guild into epic raid battles! Recruit heroes from different classes, build your own team, and challenge powerful bosses with unique mechanics. Unlock talent trees, collect endgame gear, and grow from a small squad into the strongest guild. Relive the golden age of MMORPGs!

title: A Country Named Hunger
description: An AI-orchestrated zombie outbreak killed the world. Survive in what's left of it. Fight, build, barter in a world with no future.

title: Sanslo
description: A unique roguelite slot RPG inspired by Romance of the Three Kingdoms. Recruit legendary generals, build your army, unleash outrageous fantasy skills, and conquer the battlefield with strategy and luck in every spin.

title: Nightbrats
description: A 4-player co-op physics horror-comedy where clumsy characters fumble every dare, grab, and monster you drag to the van. You and three friends break into the one house nobody talks about, cameras rolling.

title: Alphadia F
description: Embark on an epic fantasy JRPG in Alphadia F, the remake of Alphadia IV. Explore Valhalard, uncover the mystery of six fallen crystals, and save four kingdoms in strategic turn-based battles. Master the energi system, character progression, cooking, and classic anime-style RPG adventure.

title: Elementys
description:
Elementys Online is a free-to-play 2D pixel-art MMORPG set in an open fantasy world.

Players can explore different regions, choose between four elements (Fire, Water, Earth and Wind), and develop their character through three classes: Warrior, Rogue and Mage.

The game features real-time combat, challenging bosses, dungeons, crafting professions, talent trees, equipment enchanting, guilds, flying mounts and ranked PvP arenas.

Players can team up to defeat powerful world bosses, collect rare equipment and explore a world filled with quests and secrets.

title: Chick'Hen Show
description: Chick’Hen Show is an adventure game for 2 to 4 players in which chickens compete against each other on a completely crazy TV show. Hosted by an eccentric presenter, players must cooperate to progress through the show while trying to become the grand prize winner!

title: Bubble[Hack]: Pinball Rivals
description: Make your way through different pinball tables in an adventure with Roguelite elements. Complete timed objectives, overcome challenges using Special Abilities, and plan strategies by using Mods. But remember, not everyone will play fair in this competition.

title: Slickwave
description: Slickwave is a dark-fantasy top-down action roguelite in which players shape a six-spell build while surviving 14 escalating waves inside the Moonlit Observatory. Spells branch at higher levels and can evolve when paired with the right relics, creating increasingly dense combinations against swarms, elite enemies, and bosses.

title: Bar Owner Simulator
description: Take over a small neighborhood bar and turn it into a thriving nightlife venue. Mix cocktails, serve customers, manage stock, add pool and karaoke, upgrade your bar, and handle the chaos of every busy night.

title: Italian Street Food Simulator
description: Run your own street food stand in a lively Italian coastal town. Prepare Italian street food, serve walk-up and seated customers, manage supplies and equipment and grow your business day by day in this first-person cooking simulator.

title: Camping Resort Simulator
description: Build and run your own campsite in this cozy management sim. Turn an empty stretch of coast into a camping resort with a character all its own: lay out paths, place pitches, glamping and bungalows, shape the landscape, and welcome guests who each live their own little holiday.

title: Spice Pound
description: Thud. Crack. Powder. Spice Pound is a cozy incremental game about the simple joy of grinding spices by hand. Season dish after dish, unlock rarer spices, upgrade your pestle and watch the Coins pile up. Play at your own pace, with no pressure and no timers.

title: Nightmare Hunter Galaxy
description: Hunt Nightmares, explore Vibrant Worlds, and save the Galaxy in this challenging and precise roguelike. Explore randomly generated levels, collect 25+ powerful items, and test your skills in fast-paced combat.

title: Tidy Tech
description: Tidy Tech is a relaxing first-person sorting game with over 14,000 items to put away. Fill shelves with PC parts, keyboards, consoles and more across seven rooms. Earn money, upgrade your tools and hire helper robots to make the cleanup even more satisfying.

title: The Wheelchair Man 2
description: Steal $5,000 from a new apartment complex full of shady business owners while avoiding their demented landlord - The Wheelchair Man.

title: Have a Good Night
description: Have a Good Night is a word adventure game where you guide Ye through her insomnia. Make choices to calm her restless thoughts and shape her path to peaceful sleep. Will tonight be the night she finally rests?

title: HandFoot
description: Inspired by 80s and 90s trash horror, HandFoot is a chaotic 3rd person action game where every gun is also a melee weapon. Shoot, smash, throw, climb, and sneak through gore-soaked battles with bullet-time, stealth gameplay, and puzzle-solving along the way.

title: Liminal Angel
description: Demons have possessed the wildlife, turning animals against humanity. As an angel in human form, you must prepare for a perilous journey. Meet the survivors without revealing your true identity, gather your gear, and evade demon-possessed beasts before dawn breaks.

title: Cluttermancer: Tidy Up the Nightmare Alley
description: A cozy first-person tidying sim set in a bustling alley: 5 magical shops and 6,666 items to sort. Every shop on this street is chaos, every shelf has a rule, and every misplaced wand is your problem now.

title: Desktop Drill
description: Every keypress fires up your drill! Desktop Drill turns your typing into a mining adventure that lives on your desktop. Blast through blocks, unearth rare resources, and unlock new drill parts as you dig deeper with every key you press.

title: Floppy Ear Chaos
description: Unleash pure chaos as a furious rabbit in this fast-paced comedic brawler with roguelike elements! Fight through waves of quirky enemies, unlock absurd upgrades, and experiment with wild abilities that change every run. Smash, spin, and explode your way through vibrant, comic-style arenas where every battle is unpredictable, over-the-top, and packed with humor.

title: UnDo
description: UnDo is a box-pushing puzzle game where you place boxes on target tiles using mechanics tied to Undo. To clear a stage, you must consider not only walls and boxes, but also the order of actions and how the mechanics interact.

title: Pitch & Power: Football Club Owner
description: Pitch & Power: Football Club Owner is a football club management simulation in which the player is the owner of a club rather than its coach. The player runs the club's money, squad, transfers and contracts, the stadium and facilities, and business ventures in the club's town, answers the press and manages supporter expectations. The club world is shown in 3D, with an office, dressing room, press room and stadium, and matches are presented as staged 3D broadcasts with highlights and replays. The game was released as an early beta for Windows on itch.io.

title: Achievement: Global Domination
description: Conquering the world has never been this addictive! Explore 100 countries, click and collect your achievements. Click one country or explore all, choose your strategy, and climb the leaderboard!

title: Devil Laugh
description: Devil Laugh - 2d platformer with puzzle elements. The player needs to move and jump on falling cubes to climb to inaccessible heights and enter the door to the next level.

title: Egg Reality
description: Egg Reality - A side-view game where the player or players control two eggs, jump on platforms, fly between ledges, switch buttons and solve logical problems, moving forward!

title: Take My Bomb
description: An online party game where up to 16 players shove a bubblegum bomb onto each other. It pops after 30 seconds, and takes anyone nearby with it. Only the one holding it can see the timer. As long as it's not you. Take My Bomb.

title: SnapCats
description: 100 cute and funny cat-scene stickers are waiting for you to find clues, sort the table, and snap them together. Snap, meow, and fill the whole table with cats.

title: Whispers Of The Lost Ticket
description: Whispers of the Lost Ticket is an exploration horror game centered around uncovering the events surrounding Guilded Hollow Carnival through story and event interactions while shadowy forces try to stop you. Uncover the secrets of those who came before you, as the carnival welcomes its final visitor.

title: What He Left
description: Every night at 3:03, someone knocks on your door. Through the peephole you see a hood, but no face. He wants to play a game: you step away, he changes one thing in your apartment, and you have to find what. Miss it, and something else comes through the door. He also asks you questions, and your answers come back later. A short first-person psychological horror game about spotting changes in your own apartment over seven nights, with a cat named Tisha and five endings.

title: Antes del Sur
description: Juego MMORPG ambientado 200 años antes del aclamado Tierras del Sur. Está desarrollado sobre la base del mítico Argentum Online. Actualmente disponible para la plataforma Windows.

title: How Empires Work
description: An incremental strategy game about history, expansion and development. Grow from humble beginnings to take your place on the world stage!

title: Tiny Fishing Club
description: A cozy desktop fishing companion you can leave beside your work. Fish solo or hang out online with friends, catch rare fish, customize your tiny angler, collect pets, and grow your little club.

title: Major Mutt
