description: Play as a combat ready pup in this 3D survivorlike. Blast through swarms of giant critters with auto firing weapons attached to your harness, but don't just survive, Do Your Job! Herd lost sheep to safety to earn permanent stat boosts and become the ultimate Good Boy

title: Starbloom Ranch
description: Build an alien homestead in a cosy creature-collecting farming RPG. Tame 300 companions to fight in turn-based battles and work your ranch. Grow crops, harpoon fish to feed your team, decorate your cottage, and brave the mines with sword combat. Play solo or with friends—100% free to play!

title: Parasite Core
description: Buy time to harvest resources in this incremental tower defense game where you defend your core from the native species that want you off their home! Play actively and unleash your abilities, or idle and let your turrets take care of the pests.

title: Catson Files: Wizard Town
description: All one hundred cats of Wizard Town are gone. The mayor promises a reward, the Academy asks that no questions be asked. Good advice. I need someone with a free evening and a good pair of eyes. — the Client

title: SpyCat: Codename Wu
description: SpyCat: Codename Wu is a 2D action-adventure platformer starring a feline secret agent. Run, climb, sneak, and fight past traps and pursuers. Every conversation walks the line between trust and betrayal. Uncover the truth, expose the conspiracy, find your place between humans and animals.

title: Cards of Bellum
description: A roguelike deckbuilder of strategy, dice, and luck. Master suit-based combat, turn defeat into glorious victory with a roll of the dice, and recruit unique heroes, powerful wizards, and legendary knights. Build your deck, storm the capital, and claim the throne

title: Ascended Snake
description: Ascended Snake is an incremental game based on the gameplay of the classic Snake. Earn points in your games to buy upgrades!

title: Todd The Technician
description: A first-person puzzle game where you're guided by a slightly sarcastic AI earpiece named A.N.D.I., you will use tools, warp reality, and solve a variety of mechanical and logic-based puzzles to keep the strange technology of the Anomaly Corporation running, all while hoping you won't get fired!

title: Hunt: Showdown 1896 - Sage of Joseon
description:
This DLC contains one Hunter, two Weapons, two Consumables, one Avatar, and one Frame:
- Roaming Sage (Hunter)
- Cold Patience (Uppercut)
- Yecheon’s Treasure (Hunting Bow)
- Tiger’s Fury (Dynamite Stick)
- Winged Purity (Waxed Dynamite Stick)
- Roaming Sage (Avatar)
- Roaming Sage (Frame)

title: Hunt: Showdown 1896 - It Takes a Rogue
Hunt: Showdown 1896 - The Heart of Lower DeSalle
Hunt: Showdown 1896 - The Madness of Montresor
Hunt: Showdown 1896 - Violent Balance
description: This DLC contains one Hunter, two Weapons, and one Consumable: Rangda's Shadow (Hunter), Charmed Calamity (Mako 1895 Claw), Strike a Balance (Scottfield), Wrath of Rangda (Sticky Bomb)

title: Hunt: Showdown 1896 - Cry of the Caged Bird
Jeon Woo-chi
description: This game is an action RPG set in the Joseon Dynasty. Players assume the role of Jeon Woo-chi, defeating various enemies as they advance. Experience the thrill of action using Jeon Woo-chi's dazzling martial arts, and dive into the painting to experience interdimensional battles!

title: Aftermath: Bunker Trader
description: A simulation game where a bunker becomes a bustling trading hub. Players trade and craft items - they organize them in storage. They scavenge the surface themselves and hire personnel to send on expeditions.

title: Scale a Building
description: A game about scaling a building

title: Cards Rumble: Clash of Elements
description: Cards Rumble: Clash of Elements is a fast-paced competitive strategy card game where Fire, Ice, and Venom collide. Unleash flames, freeze your opponent, and spread venom. Read every move, control the battlefield, and strike at the perfect moment. One decision can turn the tide of battle.

title: Hex Seculum
description: Explore a perilous hex map, delve into tense dungeons where time and torchlight run out, and fight turn-based battles where distance and positioning decide survival. Plan your expedition, manage supplies, and escape with treasure.

title: Granny: Recaptured
description:
This is an unofficial remake & port of the mobile horror game "Granny" by DVloper, for Windows. Compared to the original, this version has been reprogrammed from scratch with many bug fixes, additional customization and accessibility options, and a plethora of new features, some new and others backported from future games in the series.
It is perfect both as a faithful entry point for newcomers, and for veterans seeking to re-experience the game with a fresh coat of paint.

title: Glider Sim Lite: Soaring Simulator
description: Ready to experience flight like never before? Fly hang gliders, paragliders, paramotors, speedwings, and ultralight trikes across expansive, detailed landscapes. Customize the weather, fly solo or with friends, and experience realistic free-flight physics in VR or Flatscreen.

title: Worldly Saviors
description: Worldly Saviors is a visual novel RPG with anthropomorphic characters.

title: Gravity Paws
description: Gravity Paws is a pixel art platformer that blends classic challenges with modern movement and exploration mechanics. Play as Duke, a dog who becomes lost in a mysterious forest filled with strange anomalies.

title: Haunted Resort: Idle Game
description: Build the ultimate haunted resort and become the richest supernatural tycoon! Tap to earn gold, unlock spooky businesses, upgrade your haunted empire, and enjoy relaxing idle progression in a charming cartoon-style medieval world.

title: GreeDrill
description: You owe the Company $2,000,000. Pay it back in ore. A push-your-luck mining roguelike: drill deeper for a bigger payout, surface before the hull cracks, outrun the Bailiff and face the five Guardians of the deep.

title: BoomGround
description: BoomGround is a solo/multiplayer voxel destruction game.

title: Curvelicious 2
description: Your Curve never stops and leaves a solid trail behind it. Box your friends in, blast gaps through their trails and be the last Curve alive. The classic curve game, rebuilt in 3D as a party game for 2 to 4 players on one screen or up to 8 online.

title: Hatch'n'wall
description: A medieval board game where 4 knights race for the crown. Place walls, set traps, and outwit your rivals in turn-based dice combat. Play solo against AI or online with friends.

title: Beat Boxy
description: Beat Boxy is a 3D rhythm-based auto-runner. Play as Boxy, a shipping crate running, skateboarding & rollerblading to make his delivery. Jump & slide through dozens of rhythm-fueled levels, and build your own custom levels! Collect gems, unlock gear & survive the chaos while listening to epic music.

title: Ashworth
description: Something has been waiting for you. Explore a forgotten place buried beneath the earth, solve twisted puzzles, and piece together a dark story one clue at a time. But the deeper you go, the more it wakes. Survive what hunts you, or become part of Ashworth's story.

title: Punish Inc
description: You are being used. Your new job is to kill and punish. Clean up the mysterious concrete city of scum and remain human. Try to make friends in the corporation of killers, explore the secrets of the mega structure, and upgrade your equipment.

title: District Null
description:
District Null is a cyberpunk city-building simulation set on the colony planet AZ884, a world almost twice the size of Earth. Its northern side lies under a thick blanket of smog, while the unexplored region of Cibola waits in the south. On the General's orders, the player founds a district that is connected to the other territories by a highway.

The player lays roads, zones residential, commercial and industrial areas and watches the city grow house by house. Construction sites have real build times, all the way up to plateaus and skyscrapers. Traffic with commuters, traffic lights and highway interchanges, the power grid with fusion plants, thermal plants and energy relays, as well as fire services, ambulances and police are simulated at the same time. Venues such as a cinema, a stadium, a casino and a concert hall each have their own programme, visitors and income.

A research lab and a university unlock new technology and train skilled workers. Creatures like a giant worm, pterosaurs and slime men attack the city and are fought with defense units and ships from a weapons factory. The colony's long-term goal is drilling through the planet's core.

title: Heartfall: A Tale in Three Lives
description: From making new friends — or enemies — to exploring this island for secrets, how will your story end? Play as Grian in this visual-novel RPG and encounter new, shocking twists that you wouldn’t expect!

title: Center Ice Hockey
description: Fast, physical ice hockey game. Launch blistering slapshots, saucer passes, hit opponents down on to the ice, then drop your gloves to answer the call. Play exhibition, a full season, or a multi-season career with your friends sharing one team.

title: New Worlds
description:
New Worlds is a space-faring universe simulation game where you navigate gravity to explore, complete missions, trade, upgrade and improve your ship fleet. Adventure to uncharted planets, to settle and develop the “New Worlds” of the last great frontier!

Features a 2D space simulation built on multi-body Newtonian gravity. The player starts with a single ship in the Solus system and flies by planning burns and adjusting their trajectory: moons can capture a ship, gas giants can slingshot one, and an efficient orbit can reach a target with a fraction of the fuel a direct burn needs.

Stations and worlds are markets in a simulated economy, where rival powers expand whether or not the player takes part. The player hauls cargo and passengers, trades between markets, takes on missions and builds a fleet of scouts, freighters, starliners, carriers, colony ships and drones. Earnings pay for ship upgrades, stations, settlements and infrastructure. The player can join a faction or found their own and compete for territory through politics and diplomacy. Settlements grow from outposts into cities, and hostile worlds can be terraformed until they are habitable.

The game spans three star systems with 38 worlds. It supports co-op multiplayer for up to four players, has an original 19-track soundtrack and plays in the browser as well as on Windows, Linux and Android.

title: Shanwen
description: 1990s: Windswept mining town Linshan, dependent on fading coal mines, worshipped a mountain god’s stele. After it cracked and oozed brown liquid, a strange illness spread. Lin Tianqing returned for his sick father, uneasy as the eerie town neared, having overheard whispers.

title: Austin Lost in Maze
description:
Austin wakes up trapped in a maze that seems to shift every time he turns around. With no map, no clear way out, and strange sounds echoing through the corridors, he must explore carefully, solve puzzles, and uncover the truth behind the place he’s been trapped in.

Navigate winding passages, search for clues, and keep your bearings as the maze twists into something far more unsettling than it first appears. Every discovery brings Austin closer to an exit—and deeper into the mystery of why he’s there.

Can you guide Austin out before the maze closes in?

title: Moeka: Exposure’s Temptation
description: Live out Moeka’s hidden exhibitionist desires in a 3D anime experience. Push your limits in public, gain confidence, and unlock new challenges… all while staying one step away from being caught.

title: Walk-In: Fold It Together
description: Three thousand pieces of clothing just hit the floor. Iron out every crease, fold each one by hand, and file it back where it belongs. A cosy first-person tidying game that slowly automates your own ritual. Invite some friends to help, up to 8 players!

title: Gambapets
description: Spin a slot machine to summon pets, nudge the reels and merge dupes to evolve them, then watch your army grow! Feeling lucky?

title: Pizzapoly
description: PIZZAPOLY is a chaotic co-op pizza restaurant game where you cook, serve, make deliveries, and survive the rush in a lively city. Run your pizzeria with friends, keep your customers happy, and grow your small shop into a local favorite.

title: Verdreamia
description: A cozy gardening sim where you create the gardens of your dreams. Plant dreams in twelve places: a meadow, a conservatory, a window of stars. Tend them at your own pace, in your favorite world style, and frame the views you love into your gallery.

title: Modulink
description: A third-person action roguelite set in a hopeful post-apocalyptic world, where knowledge is the most powerful weapon. Discover mysterious Modules, learn how they work, and combine them into circuits that change your abilities. Fight deadly machines and use what you learn to repair the world.

title: Love Beyond Differences: Riku & Lily
description: Love Beyond Differences: Riku & Lily is a heartfelt spot-the-difference puzzle game about love, memory, and a lifetime shared together. Restore Riku’s fading memories across 21 illustrated chapters, solo or in local co-op.

title: Outbreak: Dead City
description:
Survive as a soldier sent to suppress the zombie threat and find a vaccine to save humanity!

Join the H.A.D.E.S. special forces team as they drop into a cityscape overrun by zombies in hopes of recovering valuable research, evacuating a key scientist and perhaps even finding a vaccine to put an end to the apocalypse! Outbreak: Dead City is a cinematic narrative first-person shooter presented in low-poly 3D style.

Take the role of a soldier tasked with locating a hidden laboratory, use firearms and melee strikes to fend off undead hordes and work with your squad as you navigate the urban sprawl. Cycle between upgradeable weapon types like semi-automatic rifles, handguns and more, pick up ammo wherever you can find it and make contact with human survivors to gain information or supplies. Complete mission objectives and survive at all costs, then push your skills even further in New Game Plus.

title: Hidden Cats in Beijing
description:
Centuries ago, the ancestors of Beijing's hidden cats traveled the legendary Silk Road to reach the Emperor's palace. Now, they are hiding all over the city!

Relax and enjoy a journey to the Far East and find +700 hidden cats in Beijing!

Celebrate the Spring Festival by breathing new life into dragon dances and ancient legends, all set to the rhythm of traditional Chinese music.

title: Force Typhoon
description: Experience the chaos and intensity of high-speed combat in this atmospheric sci-fi vertical Shoot ’Em Up, rendered in full 3D. Blast your way through relentless waves of enemies as you unleash your arsenal to defend your home against overwhelming odds!

title: Barkside Roads
description:
Get ready for a journey full of strategy, breathtaking scenery, and plenty of charm in Barkside Roads. Behind the wheel of a fun dune buggy, a friendly dog from Rio de Janeiro sets off on an adventure through some of Brazil's most iconic locations, where every road is a new puzzle waiting to be solved.

Build routes across a hexagonal grid, connect paths, reach intermediate objectives, and unlock new pieces that open up even more possibilities for your adventure. But think carefully before moving forward: every piece you use stays behind, making every decision count all the way to the finish line.

Travel through 30 levels inspired by famous destinations such as Copacabana, the Lapa Arches, and Arraial do Cabo, facing clever challenges that reward planning, creativity, and the determination to find the perfect route.

title: You’ll Never Find It!
description: A cozy hiding game for two! Hide everyday objects, then watch your friend search for them and laugh as they walk right past.

title: Adventures in Tower Defence Land
description: Go on an epic tower defence adventure collecting rare parts and craft the ultimate combination of towers while meeting silly characters on your way.

title: Roll Dice no Die
description: Choose your pawn and build a dead man's deck! Challenge yourself in a deadly reimagining of the famous tabletop game where every dice roll can save or kill you! Manipulate the board, make fateful decisions, outsmart the Master, and win this ultimate game of survival!

title: Noir
description:
Noir is a colorful, dynamic, and die-and-retry 2D platform game. Collect the orbs in each level to reveal the exit portal. Play through hundreds of levels to beat this fast-paced and exhilarating game !

The game is released on Steam since September 23rd 2026 : https://store.steampowered.com/app/3851170/Noir/

title: Giant's Steps
description: Survive and escape a decaying post-apocalyptic vault by uncovering its secrets and venturing deeper, in this turn-based rogue-like! Descend to grow stronger, find awesome gear and defeat terrifying mutants, post-human cultists and strange unearthly beings! Step into the void!

title: 8 Ball Challenge Puzzle
description: 8 Ball Pool Challenge is a single-player pool puzzle game. Aim your cue, plan your shots, pocket the balls, and complete each challenging level. Improve your skills and see how far you can progress!

title: Pluck Em!
description: Fight off annoying feathered pests in this addictive arcade shooter inspired by the classics of the 8- and 16-bit era. Explore strange biomes, discover bizarre bird species, earn medals, upgrade your gear and uncover secrets that are probably better left undiscovered.

title: Quarantine Lab Sort
description: Restore order to a lab left in complete chaos! Sort over 7,000 items, examine unknown samples in a centrifuge, catch escaped animals, and handle radioactive waste with care. Unlock skills and turn piles of clutter into neatly organized shelves.

title: Tiny Harbor
description: Build and automate your own fishing harbor in this cozy idle management game. Grow your fleet, discover new species and expand your harbor as your little coastal world comes to life, even while you’re busy doing other things.

title: Finals Week
description: A co-op cheating simulator where you and your friends try to survive the final week of exams. Steal answers, elude the teacher, and use every tool in your cheating arsenal to graduate from school without studying a single page.

title: Terrahold
description:
Terrahold is a strategy sandbox about building and defending a colony on a living procedural planet. Starting with a teleporter and a single drone, the player explores the world, establishes resource outposts, expands a shared power grid, and develops the colony toward the energy output required to open a permanent tunnel home.
The planet reacts to the colony's expansion through spreading alien vegetation, hostile creatures, eggs, spores, and other environmental threats rather than conventional scripted attack waves. Players can use autonomous robots, defensive structures, force fields, bridges, radar, and terraforming to reshape terrain, protect infrastructure, and expand into hostile territory.

title: Goodly Trials
description:
Goodly Trials is a tactical auto-battler with roguelite elements.

Hire a peculiar company of knights, sell-swords, merchants, and wizards, arm them as you please, arrange the line, and trust in your leader to survive your journey home. Victory belongs to preparation.

title: Nonogram Detective
description: Become a nonogram-solving detective! Complete picture puzzles to reveal clues, follow the trail, and crack silly cases for clients with unusual problems.

title: Fuck This Job
description: Play as Jake, a janitor threatened to be replaced by AI machines, then subsequently fired. Grab your super vacuum cleaner, use it to hoover and destroy everything in your path in this AI-infected company! Shoot and kick everything that is in your path to show your capabilities as a great employee.

title: Dancing Zombie
description: A sudden zombie outbreak has swept the city. You barely make it to a shelter, only to discover that five Host Dancing Zombies are hiding among the survivors, disguised as humans. Want to find them and take them down? Then, dance!

title: Prismpunk
description: Prismpunk is a narrative deck-building game set in a hopeful sci-fi world. Every choice you make during the story reshapes your deck, turning your decisions into your strategy.

title: Mercenaries Of Vector
description: First-person mech combat where everything is made of lines of light. 100 missions in open battlefields, inside Battlecruisers and Dreadnoughts, and out in deep space! 10 Mega Mech bosses and a salvage economy that pays for every piece of hardware you rip from your dying opponents.

title: Overtime at Holiday's
description: Overtime at Holiday's is a point-and-click adventure game. Cleaners Bill and Jules take a weekend job cleaning Max Holiday's mansion, but when they find Max dead in his pool they become trapped in an endless loop of overtime, forced to move his body around the mansion while avoiding security and the other guests. Players look at items, pick them up, use them and talk to characters to solve puzzles and find out how to escape the time loop.

title: Island Idle RPG: Build and Conquer
description: Lead a team of fox workers to build a thriving settlement, gather resources, and craft powerful gear. Prepare your leader to explore dungeons, defeat bosses, and bring home valuable loot as you conquer new islands in this relaxing idle RPG.

title: My Desktop Cat
description: Bring a cozy animated cat to your Windows desktop. Care for your companion, play with toys, decorate every screen, unlock new cats and achievements, and play mini games while normal apps stay unobstructed.

title: Global Plates
description: Global Plates is a single-player factory-automation puzzle game about cooking. Players build conveyor-belt kitchens with dispensers, processors and assemblers to prepare dishes from around the world. Food loses freshness over time, so short, efficient production lines score better. Each level ends with a café service day in which cat customers pay coins and tips based on how fresh their plates are, and coins are spent on upgrades. A free demo with four levels is available on Steam.

title: Rune Log
description: Decode a runic cipher, then decide what it truly means. A quiet, occult detective word game: solve each scripture letter by letter, then type your own conclusion to answer a villager's question about a death, a fraud, a haunting, or an old secret.

title: Rollfall: Quest of Acceleration
description: RollFall is what you'd expect, Roll the cube and let it Fall! This sounds easy but it gets tricky fast.

title: Zombie Wasteland Together
description: Zombie Wasteland Together is a 1–4 player co-op zombie shooter set in a post-apocalyptic desert. Team up with friends, fight endless hordes of infected, and survive using powerful weapons.

title: Zombillionaire
description: Incremental FPS game where Millions of Zombies came from the dead... AND THEY ARE FULL OF OIL!!!!!! Demolish Millions of Zombies. Buy Insane Weapons. and become a Zombie Oil Billionaire

title: NinFit
description: NinFit: The ultimate body-controlled fruit-slashing action game via Webcam. Leverage AI technology to turn your real-life movements into powerful Ninja slashes. Have fun while burning calories with smart Workout modes and a sleek Cyberpunk aesthetic. No controllers required – just move!

title: StoryForge
description: Create your own protagonist and live a serialized novel written around them. Steer your saga with your choices, talk to the characters you meet, and watch it unfold episode by episode in prose written to read like a real novel, in a world that remembers everything you do.

title: Civilio
description: The Civiliuses dropped into unknown, but familiar planet have to rebuild infrastructure from the ground up. Build, fight, craft and explore your area, in a race against your foes or other Civiliuses to become powerfull. Do you have what it takes?

title: Bravest! Side Story: Kurimoto Quest
description: Read your enemy’s next move and find a winning combination of weapons and armor! Discover merchant Kurimoto’s past in a one-on-one, turn-based RPG. This Bravest! side story returns from Japan’s feature phone era with modern usability improvements.

title: Memory Games
description: This game is a classic memory game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

title: Halloween on Goober Street
description: Halloween On Goober Street is a first-person horror-comedy taking place on Halloween night. Players must Trick-or-Treat their way to 100 candies or face the consequences. With lots of fun interactions and scares with the zippiest of characters, this Halloween night is one sure to be remembered.

title: Unwanted Guest
description: Unwanted Guest is a first-person survival horror game where players explore a haunted mansion, solve environmental and painting-based puzzles, evade a relentless ghost, and uncover the mystery behind the mansion while searching for a way to escape alive.

title: Princess Puikoru: A Space Time Vendetta
Made by Hand
description: Run your own woodshop: craft furniture and wooden household items by hand. Saw, sand, and assemble each piece, detail by detail. Sell your work online, earn ratings, likes, and comments, and leave delivery to a drone.

title: Sector: Cyber Crash Episode One: The Cyber Hour
description: After the fall of her own father Genesis decided to follow in her father's footsteps and awaken her new powers to a brand new world fighting off digital viruses that appear only with in the Cyber Hour.

title: Intercept Line
description: Intercept Line is a strategy and simulation game in which you command Ukraine's air defense on a real map of Ukraine. Every night swarms of Shahed drones, cruise missiles, ballistic and hypersonic missiles strike your cities and infrastructure, and there are never enough interceptors: deploy SAM batteries, anti-aircraft guns, mobile fire teams, radars and fighter jets, and decide what to protect. By day it is your turn: plan long-range drone and missile strikes on enemy refineries, airbases and depots, routing around enemy radars and air defenses or suppressing them to open a corridor for the next wave. When orders are not enough, take the controls of a fighter jet yourself. Online co-op for up to 4 players.

title: Mortuus
description:
Mortuus is a round-based zombies FPS for 1 to 4 players, played solo or in online co-op. Every run builds a new procedurally generated brutalist map, so the doors, perk machines, mystery box and power switch are never where they were last time, and a run can take place by day or by night, in clear weather or in a storm.

Players survive each round of zombies and spend the points they earn on doors, wall guns, perks and the mystery box. Guns are made stronger at the Gun Ascension altar, and after every round the player picks one upgrade from a draft, so each run builds differently. Zombies lose limbs where they are shot, and special enemies join the horde in later rounds: the Juggernaut, the Lope and the Skitter. A hidden Easter egg quest leads to a boss fight with the Mother. Beating her takes the party down to a second kind of map with everything they have, where a second boss waits.

title: Forgotten Hill Injustice
description:
Forgotten Hill Injustice is the newest chapter of the main story in the Forgotten Hill series.
It's a first person point and click game, with a grotesque and horror atmosphere, focused on solving puzzles and riddles in order to discover the secrets of the disturbing town of Forgotten Hill.

title: Sayara's Path
description: Join Sayara on a journey through the snow-covered Vad-Hidek to find a way to bring her brother back to the world of the living. Here everyone’s fate depends on the will of the Spirits, and the path to resurrection becomes a trial the result of which is unknown.

title: Alchemixum
description: Tasked with restoring a broken planet, you have been given the Great Alchemixum: a magical sticker book that can create and record matter instantly. With you, it can mix its stickers to make all-new elements, fill its collection, and restore the world to its former glory! You won't be alone.

title: Wren Falls
description: October 1994, 2:14 a.m. A 911 call from a farmhouse on Quarry Road: a child's voice, using his mother's name. You find his parents dead and the boy silent on the stairs. Investigate by day. By night, follow him as he sleepwalks, and don't wake him.

title: Arcade Archives 2: Stinger
description:
"STINGER" is a shooter released by SEIBU KAIHATSU in 1983.
Take control of the "STINGER WOLF" and head to the center of an enemy base where evil life forms roam.
In an emergency, you can call on the friendly robot "BONGO" to automatically destroy the enemy.

title: Urine Trouble: Pee V Pee
description: Urine Trouble: Pee V Pee is an asymmetrical multiplayer stealth shooter where the pissers must empty their bladders across the city without being detected, while the police will do anything they can to stop them.

title: Unchess
description: Chess, unchained. Play real chess, then break it: power-ups, four-player free-for-alls, a 3D cube board and Chess Royale – a battle royale where kings parachute in. Built for streamers: your Twitch chat can vote, freeze and meddle live.

title: Largitas: Fragments of War
description: A 2D top-down survival shooter set in a world where most of humanity has disappeared. Explore and scavenge a dangerous planet with the aid of your mechanized Aether Beast. Upgrade and customize your equipment, explore mysterious ruins, and interact with the people and factions on the planet.

title: Weirdose
description: A techno-gothic incremental roguelite with inventory management. Your application to Weird Co. has been accepted. Employee onboarding is now in progress. Please report to the Emotional Production Department.

title: Crave New World
description: Crave New World is a strategy sim about building an addictive drink. Buy compounds, rebuild the formula, collect Thirst from demand, open routes country by country, and turn consumers into addicts before Heat brings the operation down.

title: Gacha Chaos: Tidy Up Together
description: A cozy-chaotic co-op organizing sim. Sort 7,200 gacha capsules into 900 machines across 20 color zones, solo or with 1-4 players. Throw, catch, and slap capsules out of your friends' hands, unlock 13 team skills, and collect 100 capsule series. No timer, just chaos.

title: Sonic Chrono Adventure Eternal
description: Remaster of Sonic Chrono Adventure originally made by Lake Feperd

title: Jump Bald
description: A metroidvania full of bald guys? Reach the top of the tower with pixel-perfect jumps, collecting weapons that let you unlock the map. Be careful! Every mistake can send you, literally, back to the beginning. Only then will you be able to take revenge on the one who mocked you and your alopecia...

title: Revenger2
description: The second installment in the Revenger series: a retro RPG from the feature phone era!

title: Straight 4
description: The objective of this escape game is to solve the riddles in the 10 rooms and progress to the next room as you go. The game uses the mouse and keyboard. Some riddles may not be solved only within the game window.

title: Randomization of Souls
description: This is an interactive music video work that allows the viewer to manipulate objects and other objects in the video. The length of the main video is approximately 5 minutes and 32 seconds.

title: The Numbers
description: This software is a short escape game with a numbers and arithmetic theme. The objective of the game is to escape from the space by solving the riddles in each room of the game space.

title: Repeating Society
description: This is an interactive music video work of a musical piece titled "Repeating Society" composed by Kanoguti. The viewer can move the characters and other objects that appear in the video.

title: Marked
description: In a world ravaged by climate collapse, flee a ruthless mafia alongside fellow survivors in this cooperative turn-based strategy game: manage hunger, thirst and resources while journeying together toward safety.

title: The Bounty
description: Become a bounty hunter in a strange world crawling with monsters. Take on dangerous contracts, wield unusual weapons, and return from each hunt with the resources you need to rebuild a cozy camp in the wilderness.

title: Delenar TD: Remastered
description:
Delenar TD Remastered is an old school Grid based Tower Defense game, where you control the path of the mobs. Build towers, place mazing rocks, and adapt to the mobs in each level. The game is difficult, but the strategy of solving each level is completely up to you!

Game comes out tomorrow 10/15/2026

title: To Make Your Wish Come True
description: This is an interactive music video piece.

title: Infusion
description: Infusion is a cozy, narrative-focused, coffee-making sim with branching storylines that takes place in a fantasy world full of magic and intrigue. Make different types of coffee, get to know your patrons, help them solve their dilemmas and become the best barista the Cordara has ever seen!

title: Legend of St. Stephen: St. Stephen Preaching / St. Stephen before the High Priest and Elders of the Sanhedrin
description: This is the first part of three. Based on a painting by Mariotto di Nardo.

title: Being a Forest Snake Despite Rising Water Level
description: Collect gems and avoid falling swords.

title: My Cozy BookShop
description:
My Cozy Bookshop is a charming blend of shop management sim and light RPG, set in a colorful fantasy world full of magical readers, curious wanderers, and plenty of books to discover & find!

When your grandma decides to retire to a tropical island to finally finish writing her book, she hands the family bookshop over to you with no room for negotiation. The only thing you do get a say in? Renaming the place and making it your own.

title: Luz Mala
description: An action-adventure blending 3D exploration with 2.5D platforming sections. Overcome obstacles, solve puzzles, and face legendary threats. Experience South American folklore as the Luz Mala—a restless light seeking eternal peace.

title: Solar Arena
description: A 2D top-down versus shooter set in a wraparound space arena. Steer and boost your constantly moving craft, block attacks with a barrier, and fight in battles from 1-on-1 to 1-on-3. Customize your pilot’s appearance, with your chosen look reflected throughout the game.

title: Ami's Pearl Dive
description: Ami's Pearl Dive is a quaint underwater adventure game developed for the Game Boy Color! Help Ami dive deeper to find her missing mermaid friend, collect pearls and meet interesting faces along the way!

title: Blooming Solitude: Priestess of Hanafuda
description: Hanafuda × Roguelite × Action! Explore dungeons, collect Hanafuda cards, and grow stronger as a Miko. Battle enemies with the power of your cards, then face powerful bosses in Hanafuda battles. Form winning hands and unleash devastating attacks!

title: Sacrifice Sanctuary: The Ritual Maiden's Life With Monsters
description:
Chosen by her village to help stabilize a potentially dangerous monster population, Yomi is sent as an offering of the depths of Hell. Can she discover all that Hell has to offer?

In this monster-raising RPG, control Yomi as she does everything in her power to help manage the monsters of the underworld. Gather monster parts and experience to get stronger! Farm them and release the monsters back into the caverns to gain even further stats. Delve deeper and deeper, discovering all the secrets... and maybe even make a few friends along the way! Being a sacrifice isn't all bad, right?

title: Partial
description: Master difficult platforming, puzzles and combat with limited retries inside an unforgiving hazardous interconnected world. Partial is an intense 2D action-adventure where you play as a vulnerable and bizarre creature, seeking to uncover the mystery behind the Partial project and your own existence.

title: All Those Dungeons in Alva's Head
description: All Those Dungeons in Alvas Head is a surreal, turn-based and skill-based dungeon crawler filled with quirky characters, mind-bending puzzles, and a kick-ass electro-pop soundtrack. Fight wacky creatures, explore bizarre dungeons, and uncover the strange secrets lurking in Alvas mind.

title: Magical Ascent
description: This is a card game mixed with roguelike elements together to make the best single player deck builder possible. You can Craft a unique deck, encounter bizarre creatures, discover relics, curses, and Magical Ascension.

title: Intergalactic Puzzle Touchdown
description: Intergalactic Puzzle Touchdown is a first-of-its-kind asymmetric turn-based PvP puzzle game fusing the familiar mechanics of classic match-3 games with the excitement of gridiron football. Match tiles to earn yards, dodge your opponent's blockers, and create Big Plays to light up the scoreboard!

title: Garito
description: A rigged slot machine refuses to pay. Rig it back. GARITO is a slots roguelike where you edit the reels mid-spin, wire your own paylines, and beat the payout out of boss machines one strike at a time.

title: Endless Estate
description:
A spooky multiplayer game where you draft rooms to escape a haunted mansion.
Draft rooms to explore the endless estate. Discover the mysteries and monsters the estate has to offer with friends or on your own.
You play as a girl scout delivering cookies and find yourself fallen through a trapdoor of this endless mansion.

Each time you interact with a door you can choose what room will be drafted on the other side. This builds out a labyrinth of connected rooms.

Your objective is to get out but this is a haunted house, filled with monsters and ghosts.
Learn the patterns and rituals to summon or trap each of them on your way to get out.
Discover Vampires, demons, fairies, ghosts, poltergeists and more.

Fun with friends online.

title: Magehold Fairwinds
description: Magehold Fairwinds is a roguelite airship strategy game set in the world of Magehold. Players captain a leaking cargo airship across five acts and nine regions, fighting real-time-with-pause battles room by room: routing Flow between ship systems, targeting enemy rooms with 18 ship weapons, casting 30 spells, raising wind shields and boarding enemy vessels. Between battles, players take parties of up to four on dungeon delves, recruit and manage a crew who form bonds and gain skills, and make choices in more than 480 events. Features include 11 unlockable airships with a refit yard, 58 fittings, nine boss encounters, seeded voyages and a Daily Charter, multiple difficulty settings, an optional Auto Battle mode and three endings.

title: Digital Waste
description: Play as Kevin, guided by ChatGPT, as you travel through a world where countries, objects, conversations, ideas, emotions, technologies, memories, and philosophies each become their own unique game.

title: The Lich Wars
description: A story-rich gothic RPG. Live as a musketeer in the 1700s, fighting through two wars of the undead in a 30-year career. Serve a country burdened by guilt & black magic, where necromancy infects the minds of its people. Interactive fiction with RPG skills & combat, deep characters and relationships.

title: Dravora
description: A dark fantasy narrative roguelite about three lives on one hard road: a fallen mercenary, an oath-singer's apprentice, and the youngest of three fen brothers. No combat screens. Every choice is made in words, and every choice follows you down the road.

title: Hirugao
description: A mystery psychological thriller visual novel set in 2000. Follow a serial murder case through many eyes, including the woman, the man, and the detective. With live-action backgrounds and silhouetted characters, every choice branches the story, and one wrong move means game over.

title: Arknights: Endfield - Update 1.6: Sanctuary of Ink
description:
Version 1.6 of Arknights: Endfield includes:
• New Operators: Si, Argent Flow
• New RE-Factor Headhunting: Tangtang
• New Areas: Si's Painting
• New Story Content: New story chapter and missions
• New Gameplay Modes: Contingency Contract, Arena of Games
• New Systems: Gear Plans, Auto-Farmer
• New Events and Rewards

title: Sker: The Bleeding Veil
description: Evade Sister Gwenllian and her ritual-bound orphans as you use sound to explore, solve harmonic puzzles and survive blind stalkers that hunt by hearing. Sker: The Bleeding Veil is a first-person, stealth-focused survival horror set in the Sker universe.

title: Kaput
description: Kaput is a chaotic co-op horror comedy game for up to 6 players. Explore abandoned places, repair failing machinery, and salvage high-value scrap while avoiding terrifying anomalies. Work together, handle hazardous breakdown events, and escape with your loot before everything goes kaput!

title: The First Pixel
description: In the beginning there is a white screen and one black pixel. Click it, and it wakes. Grow it into pattern, memory and meaning, hunt 100 lost relics across erased worlds, and discover what a pixel sees once it has gathered everything. A quiet, mysterious incremental.

title: BigWall: WildKnight
description: The knight arrives in the wasteland and begins a so-called adventure. Will he mess everything up? Or will he gather himself and keep moving forward?

title: Particle Collectotron
description: Click and collect energy in this short, active incremental. Upgrade your reactor, tune injector payload and trajectories, unlock exotic matter, and push the experiment past its limits.

title: Curse of Diamond
description: After a mysterious flash, Jennifer, a young mage, awakens inside a cursed floating castle. Explore its halls, battle creatures, and master new abilities to find a way out and reunite with her lost love.

title: Kill Him
description: In slaughter and exploration, seek the truth. KILL HIM is a black-and-white Metroidvania game where you will traverse a hostile world, challenge powerful enemies, and uncover the secrets hidden behind everything.

title: Fine Dining Fraud
description: A chaotic co-op cooking game for 1-4 players. Run a fake fine dining restaurant you bought with mafia money: cook badly, serve picky guests, lie your way out of complaints, put out fires and survive the health inspector, all while the Don comes to collect.

title: Flearun!
description: A retro, fast paced multiplayer on foot racing game for up to 4 players

title: Colors of V
description: A vector dungeon on a monochrome tube, lit by three subtractive colour gels. Drop a gel and half the room stops existing: a wall you cannot see is not solid, an enemy you cannot see is frozen and cannot be shot. The colour channel is the collision layer, so sight and physics never drift.

title: A Little Faraway
description: Some days, you just need a quiet place to be. Come to a little island far away, where you can wander at your own pace, watch the sky change, and discover little wonders. No rush, no expectations, nothing you need to do. Just a beautiful place to stay awhile.

title: How to Wait for the Bus
description:
The bus will arrive when it arrives. In the meantime, make some tiles explode.

Fire coloured tiles into the board from any edge. Line up three or more matching tiles to make them explode, trigger chain reactions, and gradually clear the board.

Every shot can solve a problem, create a spectacular cascade — or leave you with an even worse problem than the one you started with.

No ads. No energy timers. No daily chores. No in-app purchases. Just a small puzzle game with exploding tiles.

title: Lone Sprout: Il Germoglio Solitario
description: Manage the Lone Sprout outpost as Sylvain. Balance your needs, optimize the cultivation of precious Claritea, and trade with Eve. Use a gramophone to listen to tracks with unique gameplay effects and unravel an ancient mystery in this 3D low-poly rural survival game.

title: Hold the Levee
description:
Hold the Levee is a strategy simulation game focused on real-time fluid dynamics and water physics. Players must dig trenches, raise levees, stack sandbags, and build dams, then watch how the water reacts to the structures.

The gameplay simulates realistic water behaviors such as seepage, undermined walls, flood waves, and ice jams across 24 unique missions. The campaign ranges from defending a town from natural disasters to flooding enemy villages guarded by the AI. The game also includes a sandbox map editor, local or online co-op, and a unique 1v1 "Water vs Defender" PvP mode.

title: Half-Life 2: All Good Things
description: 11 map campaign inspired by the Epistle 3 storyline

title: Brokeline
description: Brokeline is a story-driven text game with a messenger-style interface. Play as Ivan Savin, a resident of Tikhovsk: chat with friends and strangers, choose your replies, plan your day, and make time for meetings beyond the screen.

title: Troublelings
description: Climb impossible worlds alone or with up to 12 players. Wall-run, swing from physics-driven ropes, fight bosses and survive co-op chaos where helping your friends can go very wrong.

title: Drova II
description: The Divinites have been freed. Discover the Torn Lands that the Mist revealed: an all-new world, led by two ancient tribes that endured the Dark Fog. Magic has returned to Drova, but a dangerous wound remains…

title: Worjong
description: Build four three-letter English words from letter tiles, one draw and one discard at a time. Just don't throw away the letter a rival needs to finish their words. Play against the CPU or online with up to four players.

title: Match & Drop: Pachinko Rush
description: Match & Drop: Pachinko Rush fuses match-3 puzzles with physics-based Pachinko action! Match tiles to drop bouncy balls through pegs into multiplier slots for massive combos. Unleash powerful boosters, buy permanent upgrades, and dominate global leaderboards!

title: Stellar Wing
description: A space fighter shooter about taking a carrier apart. Fly as a flight of four, burn down the turrets, crack the shield generators, then kill the core. Rebuild your fighter from 200 parts across 12 campaign missions and 30 hunts against 10 machine leviathans.

title: Arcs
description: A stage‑based shooter where you build optimal strategies and wipe out over a thousand enemies.

title: Slythe
description: A snake made of heroes. An arena full of things that want it dead. Steer, stack classes, build something broken, and dive past the final boss into endless depths, New Game+, and a global leaderboard. The snake never stops - can you keep up?

title: Malignus
description: A dungeon colony sim where you play the dungeon itself: its Boss, its minions and the beasts in its caves. Dig out halls, wire deadly traps, and raid the world above for treasure. Then hold your hoard against the heroes who come to take it back. Play alone or in 2–4 player co-op.

title: Underpaid
description: A dark-comedy 2D narrative adventure. You spent a hundred years scaring children for a living - until New York rent forced you into a 5-day trial as a kindergarten teacher. Bond with a group of misfit kids, help them win their first team victory, and discover why one girl never wants to go home.

title: Sweep Protocol
description: Operate a remote military radar station while struggling to keep your family alive as an escalating invasion pushes your nation to the brink. Track incoming threats and manage scarce resources while balancing the needs of your loved ones. Every sweep matters. Every decision counts.

title: Underdeep
description: Underdeep is an idle RPG set in a gritty, immersive fantasy world, where you can dive deep into dungeon exploration and mapping. Blending the charm of classic RPGs with modern idle mechanics, it offers a rich and thoughtful gameplay experience.

title: Hover Raid
description: Hover, raid, upgrade. Eliminate thousands of zombies, unlock devastating abilities, and grow stronger with every run in this very short, linear incremental action game.

title: Megashootsplosion
description: A fast, physics-drunk arena shooter that never stays the same. Throw your gun to reload, wall-jump to stay alive, and stack chaotic upgrades until fights get gloriously out of hand. Duel 1v1 or brawl up to 4 players across 8 modes.

title: Body Kounts
description: Resurrect and Summon Extinct fantastical beasts to do battle on your behalf in this Arcadelike mind game of Life vs Death. Every defeat is fatal, you must use your wit and all the tools at your disposal to overcome challenges and survive.

title: Cat Rooms: Sticker Decor!
description: Cat Rooms: Sticker Decor! is a relaxing sticker game about cozy rooms and cats. Pick up stickers with tweezers, place them into tiny dioramas, and slowly create warm little spaces youll want to return to after a noisy day.

title: Tiny Garden Café
description: Sow seeds and nurture them, harvest fresh ingredients to cook meals, and serve them to your guests. As the seasons turn and dusk falls, the café lights glowenjoy a peaceful day in your very own little garden café.

title: Gore Grind
description: A first-person roguelite horde shooter for 1 to 4 players in couch co-op. The city mutated, the internet is down, and dying costs money. Shoot the horde, bank the cash, and keep working for the only pizza place still open.

title: Nova Warp
description: Nova Warp is a free multiplayer game with three player factions. Team up against the creatures of deep space, collect resources, master co-op dungeons, level your ship and equip your individual loadout. Dive into massive faction battles and conquer the stars, pilot!

title: Chronime Puzzle: Animals
description: Chronime Puzzle: Animals is a relaxing puzzle game featuring beautiful steampunk anime-inspired artwork.

title: Esc Ape, You Died?
description: Esc ape, You died? started as a project to recreate a game that fits on a single floppy disk (1.44 MB): a platformer where you solve puzzles with the ESC (menu) settings UI and every other piece of UI.

title: Horror Golf
description: Minigolf game with darker horror themed maps. 2 different levels with totally 28 holes. Play alone and try to make good score

title: Lootkeeper: Tidy Up the Loot
description: An adventurer has returned from his journey with 1834 items he'll never use. Now it's your job to sort his loot. Organize weapons, potions, relics, and all kinds of RPG junk, and use magic and upgrades to speed up the work. The loot chaos awaits!

title: Deckbound
description: Summoned to a world ruled by the Demon Lord, your only power is your deck. Dodge bullet-hell attacks in real time, fight with a 4-card hand, and loot a permanent card collection from procedural dungeons. Teleport home before you lose it all. Solo or 2-4 player co-op.

title: Meet Me in the Well
description: Meet Me in the Well is a frantic arena shooter for up to 4 players. Drop in with a revolver loaded with 6 bullets from a huge arsenal of effects, spin the chamber, and fire. Every shot is a gamble so be ready for chaos. Includes online and local multiplayer support.

title: Zombie City Together
description: Take on a city overrun by zombies with 1 to 4 players online — co-op or PvP! Hold the line against running, leaping, spitting hordes. Fight by day, hunt in the dark of night. Tear off limbs and unlock cosmetics with every kill. Stand together... or hunt each other down.

title: Welcome to Hell Resort!
description: Rebuild hell from the paths its souls must walk. Extend corridors and combine turrets, traps, and guard stations in a tower defense game built around tile placement. Grow your blueprint deck and redevelop hell alongside Enma.

title: Pixel Quest: Guild
description: Your guild fights at the bottom of your screen. Hire heroes, merge them, take on bosses, collect Arcanas, call in your Steam friends, and see how deep you get before you ascend and start over

title: Ewephoria
description: Herd sheep, avoid cows, terrify wolves, fly fighter jets, sail the seas, and other related sheepherding activities in this exciting new party game. Gather your friends around the screen and use your phones to control your sheepdogs and save the day in Ewephoria!

title: Puzzle
description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

title: Puzzles
description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

title: Lilifel
description: High roll your way through an everchanging dungeon in this roguelike, turn-based dungeon crawler. Fight enemies using your elemental runes to conjure powerful spells. Synergize your elements as you loot items that combo with just about everything. Ever Low roll? Just SLAM your way out of it!

title: Pray & Slay
description: Pray & Slay is a short-form action incremental where you wield holy light, tear through fast-paced runs, and unlock increasingly powerful—and increasingly unholy—ways to destroy everything in your path.

title: Welcome Back to Aeris
description: Welcome back to Aeris! A point-and-click psychological horror about reviving a Frutiger Aero minigame console shutting down in 7 days. Restore its dead channels with your guide Mora — and follow the strange traces appearing beyond the screen.

title: Sponge Bridges
description: G-City has fallen. Survivors are hiding in scattered corners of the city, and food, and everyday supplies are scarce. You make a living delivering cargo for others—and, along the way, try to find out what happened here. For now... just get the cargo delivered. And try not to starve on the way.

title: Epsilon Hyperpunk
description: Enter a cyber world in this on-rails space shooter. You are a lone K.I.L.L.E.R. facing an impossible mission in a decaying dystopian future. Your only edge? Running high-stakes combat simulations through a neurovisor powered by a highly illegal, custom-built operating system-- HyperpunkOS.

title: Giga Digger
description: Giga Digger is a short and casual incremental mining game. Mine minerals and uncover upgrades to delve deeper and deeper!

title: Rat Tag!
description: RAT TAG! is an online multiplayer tag game where you play as rats. Jump, run, and dive your way through handcrafted ratty arenas in a variety of tag-based game modes. Grab wacky items to outmaneuver or sabotage your friends. Bounce off walls, smack the cheese out of each other, and go rat feral.

title: Senti Metrica
description: “If you are not loved, you won’t survive—” A girl slowly turning into a monster, and the “Metrica” who hunt her. A survival otome game where you waver between reason and instinct.

title: Falafel King
description: Take orders, fry falafel and fill pitas, solo or with up to three friends, at a quiet stand in Tel Aviv’s Carmel market, back in the early 2000s. Do it well and word gets around: more customers, more dishes, and a lunch rush you’ll need every hand for.

title: Wishknot
description: You've fallen into an endless wishing well, with nothing but a rope and far too much momentum. Swing, snare and squash to survive in this difficult physics platformer with roguelite runs and secrets worth falling for.

title: Blackwood: A Sétima Safra
description: Run a remote butcher shop by day and uncover the horrors buried beneath Blackwood by night. Serve customers, manage the store, investigate a sinister cult, and make choices that shape Lorena's fate in this first-person psychological horror.

title: Towered
description: Defend the Nexus, run after run. Build under population limits, balance gold and mana, draft augments as you level, and spend gems on a permanent power-up tree in this pixel-art tower defense roguelite.

title: Prehistoric Pit
description: Prehistoric Pit is a bullet heaven roguelite with voxel graphics. The player controls one of nine dinosaurs in an arena that fills with waves of Ice Age mammals, while weapons fire automatically. Between waves the player picks upgrades, limited to four weapon slots per run. Every weapon evolves into a second form at level 30 with its matching relic. A run lasts about 30 minutes across volcanic stages. Each dinosaur has its own exclusive starting weapon, active ability and passive; eight of them are unlocked through in-run challenges.

title: Malsort
description: Malsort is an action MMO inspired by the classic ARPGs. A cursed world of ash and burning thrones, shared with every hero who dares. Hunt in parties, craft from what you slay, sell your finds at your own stall, and raid the world bosses to loot ancient relics.

title: MMOS: MMO Simulator
description: Build and run your own fantasy MMO in a single-player management sim. Design the world, classes, loot and raids, then watch simulated adventurers play, form guilds and chase rare drops. Keep them happy, keep them subscribed, and decide what your MMO needs next.

title: Oblivion Lost Remake Semi-Official Patches: Standalone
description:
Oblivion Lost Remake Semi-Official Patches: Standalone is a fan-made project based on the Oblivion Lost Remake 3.0 mod, developed under the leadership of Hrust and Vector.

SOP introduces numerous gameplay and graphical improvements, tweaks, and bug fixes to the original mod without altering the gist of the storyline. Instead, it focuses on completely reworking the visual style to match the spring-summer 2003 aesthetic, aiming to perfectly capture the legendary concept of "the Old Good Stalker".

title: The World of Dokkaebi
description: Set 300 years before the events of the popular web novel/webtoon Demon Exterminator's Cultivation, World of Dokkaebi is a 2.5D dot-art MMORPG set in a world governed by the balance of natural order and corruption. Players step into the shoes of a Taoist cultivator during an era when humans and Dokkaebi (Korean goblins) are still learning to trust one another, embarking on a journey to combat rising demonic forces and restore harmony to the realm.

title: Scared Puppies
description: In Scared Puppies, you dive into the paws of adventurous puppies on a mission to find their lost owner. Set in a vibrant world, the game blends puzzle-solving with light adventure elements, promoting teamwork and clever strategy.

title: Crowfarm
description: Crowfarm is a 1-6 Co-op Horror Farming Game where you grow crops, hunt them, and get hunted by them.

title: In Your Dreams
description: A short survival horror experience where you must elude a bloodthirsty shape-shifting beast. Created in one month for spooky season!

title: Carpet Daddy
description: Turn filthy carpets into satisfying clean stripes in this first-person cleaning simulator. Vacuum, pre-spray, agitate and extract with professional tools, treat stubborn stains, and move furniture to reach every dirty corner.

title: Rejoin Me After Brexit
description: An adult romance visual novel about Owen Pascoe, a struggling English coach operator sent across the Channel on a civic errand. Choose one of three distinct routes as a herring fair, a hungry local paper, and two watchful towns turn private romance into public news.

title: Chaotic Virus
description: Fight to survive by controlling a cell in this top-down action roguelite. Destroy waves of viruses, gain experience, evolve through transformations, and create powerful combinations of active and passive abilities.

title: The Long Dark: Iron Road
description: The Long Dark Survival Expansion. Welcome to Cauldron Island. Lost to history, hiding a mystery. Restore & activate a century-old train to journey deep along the caldera’s spine & uncover a dark secret. What you discover in the end will change how you survive in this Aurora-changed world, forever.

title: Little Witch’s Lodge a Cozy Magical Cleanup Game
description: A young witch has accidentally cast the wrong spell and turned her cozy lodge into complete chaos. Books, potions, bottles, and magical objects are scattered everywhere. Your task is simple: explore the lodge, collect every item, and return it to the correct place.

title: My Penguin Friend
description: Washed up thousands of miles from home, Dindim, a little penguin on a big journey must puzzle across an unfamiliar, tropical coastline, and forge an unlikely friendship to find more than just his way home.

title: SFTP: Super Football Tactics Pro
description: Super Football Tactics Pro drops you into the high-energy chaos of a wild football league where classic checkers meets hard-hitting strategy. Plan your moves, outsmart your opponent, and unleash game-changing special powers that can flip the match in an instant.

title: Encryption
description: Encryption is a cinematic first-person psychological horror adventure set during a climate catastrophe burning through southern Italy. A father searches for his missing daughter in Matera, one of the oldest inhabited places on Earth, now evacuated, while something awaits in the darkness below.

title: Afterzero: The Last Drive
description: Drive and survive through a frozen post-industrial wasteland. Gear up your vehicle with different tools to tackle hostile threats, while scavenging for resources. Lead a small survivor camp while discovering the truth about what happened.

title: Kubi Meguri
description: Swap your severed head and the hell you wander changes. A Japanese psychological walking-horror: drift a fallen warrior's ghost through absurd afterlives that shift with every head you wear.

title: Touhou: BlackEight
description: If there is an anomaly, do not put the lights out. Survive eight nights at Eientei in this first person Touhou Project horror fan game. 99 ruinous anomalies warp the sleeping girls in the dark, and the distance between Reimu, Marisa, Kaguya and Mokou shifts night by night. Exit 8 like, yuri horror.

title: Invincible Vs.: Angstrom Levy - Additional Fighter
description: From a thousand worlds comes Angstrom Levy, the genius transformed by tragedy and obesssion. Once driven by a desire to unite infinite versions of himself, Angstrom now carries the memories of countless realities. This brilliant and dangerous dimensional traveler can tear open portals to teleport, control space, and always keeps his opponents guessing.

title: Capital Criminal
description: Capital Criminal is a retro-inspired economic strategy and management game. Players buy and sell contraband, travel between city markets, and manage cash, bank deposits and debt while dealing with police, rival gangs and unexpected events. The full game offers 30-, 90- and 365-day campaigns.

title: Island Off Outer Dancing
description: A narrative rhythm game taking place shortly after the first ending of Island Off Outer Darkness. Meet the new Postman, Utah, as a fresh mystery envelops Rekkieg...

title: Broken Soccer
description: Pick one of 38 ridiculous teams, roll the die and unleash a dinosaur charge, a zombie infection, a bull market (with an actual bull) or Nietzsche off the bench. Tied at full time? Boots off, fists up. Solo, co-op or online versus up to 4v4.

title: Clawstral
description: A charming claw machine-themed roguelite! Never underestimate the claw!

title: Gamblin' Geezers
description: A rummy roguelike deckbuilder set in a wacky nursing home! Inspired by games like Balatro. You're just trying to visit grandma, but the residents can't remember where she's at! Beat them at their own strange house rules, collect their Heirlooms and track her down.

title: Scarlet Beret: Murder at the Orphanage
description: Fabienne a 17-year-old genius, has a rare gift: she detects lies! But when she discovers the body of one of her teachers, she’s left with no choice but to uncover the killer among the residents she’s lived with her entire life.

title: The Heart of Gold
description: The Heart of Gold is a Bullet Heaven game with RPG elements, where each character is unique thanks to their own abilities, progression, and combat style. Upgrade your equipment, evolve your weapons, collect cards, and survive hordes of enemies in a colorful world full of secrets and challenges.

title: Islandry
description: Turn a wild island into a thriving, self-running production network. Gather resources, build farms and machines, automate with drones and conveyor belts, process goods, manage interconnected production, earn profits from trading, and ship your products across the sea in this cozy automation game.

title: Talaire
description: Astronauts stranded on the moon have gone a little crazy. Race office chairs, complete repair mini-games, and sabotage your rivals to win the heart of the Moon Princess: a rock with a wig. They're taking this very seriously.

title: Temple of Your Mom
description: A puzzle RPG with turn-based combat and a darkly silly story. Estimated playtime is 4-6 hours.

title: Cult of the Red Heifer
description: Horror RPG FPS set in a dystopian United States controlled by a fanatical cult determined to create the perfect Red Heifer. Play as the Firestarter, a normal person who has decided to resist the Cult against all odds

title: Umm Oyoun
description: The game is an episodic narrative journey following a mother and her daughter, Sarah, as they search for Sarah's missing father in a stormy, mysterious setting. It combines emotional depth and suspense, immersing players in a world of secrets and intrigue.

title: Neo Bananas
description:
It’s 21XX and you’re the last gorilla on Earth.
Barely saved by a group of humans and upgraded into a cyborg, you’re trying to take down the evil tech corporation that made your species extinct. Most fruits on Earth have been hoarded by the tech giants to power their datacenters and machines, and have been replaced by a digitally-altered synthetic version called “Neo Fruits”.

Your goal is to follow the trail of Neo Bananas and destroy all of them. It's a speedrun precise-platformer that rewards the player to go as fast as possible. Neo fruits are used towards the adventure as weapons and explosives to help you restore the real fruits into the world.

title: Vanakan
description: Vanakan is the journey of Tadevos - a priest, who travels the 500s Armenia to find the monastery that suits for his goal of becoming spiritually closer to Jesus Christ. He meets different people on his way and makes choices which will define his future and that of the country.

title: Obolus
description: A roguelike deckbuilder with a party of three. Every hero has their own deck, their own hand and their own obols to spend, so each turn you choose not just what to play but who plays it. 22 heroes, 787 cards, six lands and a path made of cards, where picking one burns the rest.

title: Deadly Match
description: Deadly Match is a singleplayer thirdperson murder mystery. Investigate the deaths of two young women in a small, seemingly peaceful town.

title: Duck Duck Grenade
description: Duck Duck Grenade is a fast, silly online party game for 2 to 8 players. Chase your friends, pass the live grenade before it explodes, and grab abilities when running away is not enough. Players who explode return as ghosts and can keep interfering with the survivors.

title: The Christmas Bakeshop
description: Supply festive breads, pastries, and sweet treats while serving cheerful customers and keeping your shop warm and welcoming. Expand your bakery, discover new recipes, and make your cozy little corner the heart of the town this holiday season.

title: Comic Shop Tycoon
description:
Comic Shop Tycoon is a first-person retail management simulation game where players build and manage their own comic book store. Order merchandise, stock shelves, set prices, serve customers, and manage daily store operations.

Players can sell comic books, collectible figures, tabletop RPG supplies, and other merchandise while collecting and selling valuable back-issue comics. As the business grows, players unlock new products, improve their store, and work toward building a successful comic book retail business.

title: Ruby's Trick or Treat
description: Welcome to Ruby's Trick or Treat, a fully voice-acted anime VTuber horror game for Halloween, starring VTuber RubyWhiska. You walked out of her party once. Now she's coming trick-or-treating at your house.

title: G-Mode Archives+: Lost Savior
description:
This is a port of a JRPG originally developed exclusively for mobile devices by Bandai Namco Entertainment.
Embark on your adventure by choosing from six elements — Fire, Wind, Earth, Water, Dark, and Light — and a wide range of jobs, including Fencer, Scout, Mage, and Cleric.
This story is a sequel to the previous title, LOST CHRONICLE.

title: Alice Nation
description: Explore, talk, and solve puzzles with cards in a solo tabletop adventure! Play as Alice, a girl trapped in the Beyond. Drag cards to craft items, meet curious companions, and find your way home. Stuck? Try a different card—and a different approach. This charming fairy-tale world has its secrets.

title: Mebula Legends
description:
Mebula Legends is a free-to-play idle RPG. Your empire produces gold and resources around the clock, even while you are away. Use them to recruit Mebulis, level them up and send a team of five creatures into automatic battles.

More than 100 Mebulis in six rarity tiers, each with its own element, family ultimates and element bond bonuses. Story campaign with elemental realms, the Shadow Journey and the Prism Rift. Arena and league with leaderboards and a weekly tournament. Roguelike dungeons and the Endless Tower. Guilds with guild wars, a guild merchant and chat with built-in translation. Equipment with a forge, jewelry and the Resonance Chamber. Prestige system with an energy tree for long-term progression.

All content can be reached without paying. Mebula Legends is an online game and requires a Bitmeup account.

title: Amanojaku Nightmare
description: Based on the Touhou Project, this is a fantastical and intense bullet-hell Shoot 'em up. Dive into a nightmare where Gensokyo’s strongest fighters gather, and aim to conquer it. There are no special systems or complex controls. From Beginners players to those who have “graduated from being human,” we await your challenge.

title: 11 pm
description: A minimalist factory game that doesn't quite work the way you expect. Choose modules carefully, place them on your machines, and watch them drastically change how each machine produces. Build your own factory with its own rules. Optimizing it can become an obsession!

title: My Gaming Shop
description: Start from scratch and build the gaming shop of your dreams! Assemble your own PCs, stock the shelves, welcome your customers and expand your store to become the best in town.

title: Magically Sorted
description: Tidy up a magical shop by sorting scattered potions, ingredients, and books back onto their shelves, uncovering curious lore behind them as you go. Brew potions in the cauldron to unlock magical skills and find lost recipes for legendary potions, while enjoying the shop's relaxing atmosphere.

title: Unfrost
description: Unfrost is a co-op Antarctic horror FPS about hunting ancient entities known as the Riftborne. Gather evidence, survive extreme conditions, prepare a nuclear strike, and extract before impact.

title: Caramel Creek
description: ☕ Turn a run-down house by the river into a cozy cafe of your own design. Grow and brew your coffee, paint and furnish the place, meet three neighbours with lives of their own - and keep Ostin the cat company. Early Access.

title: Miecze Valdgira I+II
description: Swords of Valdgir is without a doubt a true legend of the Polish retro gaming scene, having achieved cult status on 8-bit Atari computers. Both parts take players on an unforgettable journey into a dark world of sword and sorcery, where finding the titular weapon grants unimaginable power. The mechanics masterfully combine arcade elements with demanding puzzles, guaranteeing high-energy fun.

title: Demiourgos
description: A first-person horror. A man wakes up at 3 AM and the sea starts calling. Every person and every animal has a line of destiny. Can you change them before the great end?

title: Cat Pipes: More Meow
description:
Cat Pipes: More Meow is a cozy, hand-drawn puzzle game about guiding warmth to sleepy cats. Rotate the pipes to connect the flow from the main source to every cat in the room, then watch each one light up and purr.

With 51 handcrafted levels that ease you in and slowly grow into satisfying brain-teasers, portals that bend the path across the board, and a warm lo-fi atmosphere, it's the perfect little game to unwind with.

title: Kitties on Planets
description:
Get ready for a space adventure full of strategy in Kitties on Planets! Control two astronaut cats with different abilities and use their unique skills to place every supply box on its respective objective. Switch between the characters, combine their abilities, and discover the perfect solution for each puzzle!

The white cat can push supply boxes, causing them to keep moving until they collide with an obstacle. The black cat cannot push boxes, but can move the magnets scattered throughout the environment. These magnets attract boxes and the inactive character when they enter their range, allowing you to change their positions and create new paths.

Magnetic attraction works in a straight line and cannot pass through walls or other objects that block its range. Observe the environment, switch between the two cats, and carefully consider every move to prevent a box from becoming stuck in an unreachable position.

title: Mascareri: Mask Making Simulator
description: You are a Venetian maskmaker in 1797. Craft stunning masks for picky patrons, upgrade your shop and discover branching story lines.

title: Howling Woods
description: A cozy Halloween town builder. Lay out paths and plots in a clearing in the woods and the town takes care of the rest: crooked houses go up, curio shops open, and goblins, ghosts and witches move in. The spookier your town gets, the grander it grows. Nothing costs a thing. Every day is Halloween!

title: Rex Summons a Meteor
description: A short game about a large rock. You accidentally summoned a meteor. Oops. Now you have to save the island! Barter with stubborn dinosaurs who only talk in emoji, play absurd mini-games, and solve puzzles in this silly first-person puzzle adventure.

title: Woozy
description: Woozy is a 1-4 player online co-op adventure about coworkers on a journey with a billion-dollar casino chip, where staying sober might kill you. Scavenge ingredients and brew drinks to cross deadly biomes, getting increasingly woozy, and somehow make it to the Cocktail Casino to cash it in.

title: Amusement Factory
description:
Amusement Factory is a cozy theme park builder with a bright, stylized look.

You start with an empty field, a bus stop and a bank balance, and you lay out everything else: roads, queues, rides, shops, arcades, and a lake with boats running laps of a route you painted yourself. Guests arrive by the busload with their own energy, hunger, thirst and patience, and their mood is blended from everything the park does to them, so a filthy path costs you as surely as a broken ride does.
Play the ten campaign locations in order, each with its own land, budget, wage bill and goals, or take free play and build for the pleasure of it.

title: Scratch Your Luck
description: Scratch tickets, upgrade your odds, and pay deadlines before you go broke.

title: Cape Warrior
description: Top down shooter where you control cape warrior. Mission to kill different enemies and main boss spider and collect star to finish level

title: Tasmon: Taskbar Monsters
description: An idle RPG that lives in your taskbar. While you work, your monsters auto-battle and bring back eggs and loot. Collect 156+ species, evolve and awaken them, forge one-of-a-kind serial-stamped weapons, and shape every weekly update from the in-game suggestion box. Free to play.

title: Inn Kreeper
description: Run a spooky-cozy haunted inn as a broke lich, stress out your guests, trap them in rooms to turn them into ghost, and sell them online to rebuild your retro game collection.

title: Stravaeger
description: A survival RPG with a huge open world for 1-10 players to explore, with towns full of NPCs to talk to, dungeons to delve into, and adventure to be had. Build bases, craft gear, battle foes and unlock the mystery behind the nefarious forces that have taken over the land.

title: Tunnel
description: Tunnel is an atmospheric single-player game focused on survival and maintenance in subway tunnels. Step into the shoes of a tunnel worker, keep tunnels in good condition, battle breakdowns, and face mysterious dangers lurking in the darkness. Don’t let the tunnel consume you…or maybe it already has?

title: Five Nights at Frickbear's 3: Four Layers Down
Kings of Antikva
description: Turn-based strategy with hidden information. Position your army, outsmart your opponent and capture the enemy flag before it’s too late. Easy to learn, hard to master. Ranked online multiplayer and offline mode versus AI.

title: Wavertree Mountain
description: A 2D top-down MMORPG on an island the humans left behind. Choose one of six species, pick a side, and dig a burrow of your own. Gather, craft, build and fight your way across the island, run the local economy with your wares, or just go fishing. You choose.

title: Ladder Knight
description: A small hero, a trusty ladder, and a world full of trouble. Explore strange lands, solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and face mighty bosses in this pixel-art platformer. Put your ladder to work in ways it was never built for.

title: HeroQuest: Digital Edition
description: Descend into the dungeon to destroy the forces of Dread and protect the Realm in this tactical turn-based RPG based on the timeless tabletop legacy. Form a fellowship of four or set forth on your adventure solo, roll the dice and let the quest begin!

title: Rampartloom: PvP Tower Defense
description: Tower Defense meets 3v3 Tower Wars. Build mazes with defensive towers, send assault units, and grow your economy in free-to-play team battles. Draft from twelve factions and coordinate with your team to break the opposing defense.

title: Brushland
description: A fairytale kingdom-builder where every tile you paint makes a difference. Shape the land, welcome the villagers, and tend to their needs until a handful of tiles becomes a country they love.

title: Rescue Drone Simulator: Second Chance
description: Pilot drones into burning buildings, frozen landmarks, and collapsing tunnels. Rescue survivors, build and customize your fleet, and lead a team of specialists who never got a second chance - until now.

title: Nyra and the Garden of Moros
description: The prison of Moros is broken. Venture into a moody open world, action-adventure. Recover the legendary seals of the Keepers to restore the bindings before the corruption of Moros blooms.

title: RUIN: 35th Anniversary - Definitive Edition
description: RUIN is a Point-&-Click Adventure set in a cyber-fantasy world of kingdoms and ancient relics. Journey through this mysterious land, behold its wonders, and ponder 35 years of mysteries.

title: Send In The Clown
description: A bite-sized birthday catastrophe clown comedy role-playing experience - with minigames!

title: Slamaverse!
