description: Welcome to the SLAMAVERSE!, a world where everything is wrestling and wrestling is everything! Choose your wrestler, build a deck, and battle against friends and foes in this hard-hitting, tactical deckbuilder. Do you have what it takes to become the champ?

title: Grazed: Incremental Arcade
description: Grazed is an incremental arcade game where every kill means getting within range of death. Push your kill combo high enough to ignite absurd powers and chase the highest score. Every run earns upgrades, so you always come back deadlier.

title: Flame Hunter: Zhong Kui
description: Hunt down and shapeshift into your enemies in this genre-bending ARPG. Carve a path to the Underworld as the legendary demon hunter Zhong Kui!

title: Odd Shop
description: Manage a haunted pawn shop in this cozy horror game. Cursed items are your most popular wares, but keeping them all under one roof can have deadly consequences. Upgrade and maintain the shop to build a retail reputation that cannot be denied...or make your money and get out before it’s too late.

title: Nether Abyss
description: Scale the doomed Nether Abyss to leap into the Well of Reincarnation. In this dark Chinese Action-Roguelite with Extraction mechanics, rise as a nameless undead from the blood pools. Scavenge the fallen, endure cycles of rebirth, slay ancient demons, and draw your blade against heaven as you climb.

title: Aeterna: Curse of The First King
description: An isometric soulslike action RPG set in the final years of the Roman Republic. As one of the Custodes Umbrae, a secret order sworn to protect Rome from threats beyond mortal comprehension, you must face ancient horrors as the Republic descends into chaos.

title: Gumbo
description: Mysterious signals and curiosity... One step into a rabbit hole, one giant leap into destiny... Crash landed in an uncharted galaxy, you discovered the Gumbo: cute alien blobs held captive by dark forces. Explore and befriend these voxel creatures to defy darkness in this sci-fi adventure.

title: Strato Alto
description:
Strato Alto is a 3D aerial combat action rogue-like game.

Features two game modes, Classic and Journey.

Classic is an arcadey timed round survival mode. Down enemies, choose upgrades, and gain currency to unlock new planes and equipment for future rounds.

Journey mode is a rogue-lite campaign. Outfit and upgrade your aircraft as you journey across three world maps in pursuit of the legendary Red Baron to prove your own mastery of the stratosphere!

title: Neighborhood Watchers
description: Neighborhood Watchers is a spooky-cozy cooperative game for one to four players. Players fish, farm, shop, and decorate homes in an abandoned suburb, then explore procedurally generated haunted houses to recover memories and rescue lost spirit children. Restoring the neighborhood alternates with stealth, combat, and guiding spirits to safety through dangerous streets.

title: Backrooms Anomaly: Pools
description: Backrooms Anomaly: Pools is a first-person anomaly-spotting horror game set in a looping complex of liminal poolrooms. Players study tiled corridors, pools and flooded chambers, turning back when something has changed and continuing when everything looks normal. In the Survival Stage, players photograph multiple anomalies before time runs out.

title: Chimpy Protects
description: At night you feel something ominous, you must be courageous and brave to find Chimpy. Something is watching and spirits are haunting you but Chimpy will protect, the soothing light will guide you and he will finally help you sleep.

title: The Debtician
description: Buy items to gain debt in this level-based Credit Card deckbuilder game!

title: House Music Incremental
description: A music based incremental in which progress in the game through buying instruments also changes and progresses the music.

title: FurHouse
description: In this Big Brother-inspired furry visual novel, your vote determined who stayed, who went, and who won. 12 young adults entered the FurHouse with the hopes of winning the 100,000 dollar grand prize. With no access to their phones or the outside world, they braved social challenges, constant camera surveillance, and each other in order to make it through. Every two weeks, from March 15 to July 18, an episode of FurHouse was released. Contestants were put up for elimination and the collective vote of all of the readers determined who went home.

title: Tiny Havoc
description: Smash crates as Tin, a tiny salvage robot with a hammer, and free the memories locked inside ten vaults. A handful of crates grows into total havoc of lightning, saw blades and drones in this 5–7 hour incremental game with a real ending.

title: RyGT
description: Gran Turismo Sport running as a native Windows program.

title: Severed Chains
description: Severed Chains is an unofficial port of Legend of Dragoon for PC and Steam Deck, created by Monoxide.

title: Who's Cheating?
description: Everyone is gambling. One player is cheating. In this social deduction game for 3 to 8 players, the Cheater uses glasses that reveal the next winning bet while the Security Guard studies the tables, reads the bets and decides who gets the shotgun. Lie, steal and larp over proximity chat.

title: Village of the Mirror
description: A first-person psychological horror set in a forgotten village where Japanese and Anatolian folklore collide. Explore abandoned places, solve puzzles, uncover the past, and cross Torii gates into the afterlife to uncover the truth.

title: Deus Ex + Deus Ex: Invisible War
Samopal Protocol
description: A story-driven retro FPS. Fight through industrial zones, the districts of a dead city, and experimental areas to recover your memories and uncover the bloody truth of Samopal Protocol.

title: Link Loop
description: Link Loop is a physics-based 2D puzzle platformer built around portals, momentum, and objects. Use your portals to move objects, lasers and fluids. Levels have multiple solutions, and creativity is key.

title: Coup de Grass
description: Coup de Grass is an incremental management game about turning a small grass field into a sprawling automated operation.

title: Prigod Idle
description: An incremental auto-battler with hundreds of hours of content. Craft different builds to take on 100 stages with different enemies, while resources are farmed passively. If you can't defeat a boss, change your build and try something new! 38 heroes, 99 relics, 22 minigames and 4 tech trees.

title: Defend Wallace
description: A silly 1-4 player horde defense game where you protect your completely oblivious best friend Wallace from an entire army of monsters. Pick your hero, annihilate enemies, and unlock/upgrade new skills to grow as strong as you need to be to KEEP WALLACE SAFE! He's useless but you still love him.

title: Kirr
description: Cooperative horror where surviving isn't enough: you must locate and destroy the thinking brains behind a collective hive mind before it finishes calculating your end. Stay alert, trust no one — not even the voices in the dark. Coordinate, move fast: hesitation is what it's counting on.

title: Revenge of Doctor Breen
description: Doctor Breen is back to once again subject the people of earth to his rule. It's up to Gordon to thwart his plans and save the day.

title: Fieldmade
description: Everything in this world is something you drew. Sketch a hoe and till the soil with it. Sketch an axe, a watering can, a fishing rod... and they become real, working tools with real stats. You can draw literally anything you want.

title: Keyboard Chaos
description: 2,692 keycaps. 32 keyboards. One messy desk. Find the right keycaps, match them to their positions, and complete every keyboard, square or round. Search, organize, and enjoy the satisfying process of turning chaos into perfectly assembled keyboards.

title: Ultracapitalism
description:
Ultracapitalism is a company-building roguelike autobattler where corporate greed is weaponized into deterministic combat.

Pick a founder, survive fiscal years of questionable business decisions, and assemble a 10-slot Board of Assets — unpaid interns, offshore tax havens, union busters, automated server racks, AI agents, and more. Then sit back and watch your corporate engine auto-battle rival corporations to the death.

title: The Wizard's Assistants
description:
The Wizard’s Assistants is a single-player exploration adventure where you traverse a chaotic collapsing tower, help the assistants stranded within it, and gather quarks to gain magical augments as you search for a way upward to the moon.

Something has gone awry in the Wizard’s tower. As one of the assistants, explore a strange and increasingly chaotic world of magical experiments, scattered clues, and fellow assistants in need of help. Follow your curiosity, collect quarks, and earn new magical augments as you unravel what happened and find out how to escape.

The Wizard's experiments have left the tower in a state of magical disarray. Assistants are scattered throughout, continuously performing the last task they were assigned. You play an assistant whose eyes are on the moon and making your way through it all: lending a hand where you can, examining the Wizard's questionable notes, unraveling your past, and following a trail of quarks that charge Nexus points along the way. Above it all is the moon.

Explore places within the tower ranging from the tower’s pipes to the Wizard's workshop, reaching as high up as the rafters. Run, climb, jump, and glide, all at your own pace. Talk with the assistants you encounter, and investigate the oddities the Wizard has left behind. Collect quarks to charge Nexus points to unlock magical augments that you can use to bounce, traverse ledges, teleport, ride beams of light, and puzzle your way through the tower, revealing paths that were previously out of reach. Along the way, examine notes, scrolls, and glyphs that gradually unveil the workings of the Wizard and the assistants who need your help to escape along with you.

Every place you visit invites another question, every assistant has another situation to resolve, and every augment leads to new experiments. Keep exploring, keep helping, and keep following the quarks upward to find out for yourself if the moon really is made of cheese.

title: Maldhalla
description: Just one more minute. Then another. Outlast endless hordes and a new boss every three minutes in this survival roguelite with 21 characters, 32 weapons, and relics triggered by weapon combos.

title: Money Makes Money: Historical Market Simulator
description: Travel through 2010–2025 and trade historical stocks and cryptocurrencies with the benefit of hindsight. Build a fortune, survive unexpected costs, and uncover the story behind it all.

title: Don Bradman Cricket Jr
description:
Out of the highly successful Don Bradman simulation series comes Don Bradman Cricket JR, the hard-hitting arcade cricket game. Step onto the pitch and feel the thrill of every shot, smash boundaries, outplay opponents and make every run count.

Complete the Bradman Challenge Round and you'll unlock Sir Donald Bradman himself as the captain of the Australian side, along with the Bradman vs Water Tank Mini Game. Easy to pick up…impossible to put down.

title: Mojo Is Loved
description: Mojo invites his ex and an old friend to hear his new EP. Their kindness is real... until the room starts rewriting every sign of rejection. A short psychological horror visual novel about love, reassurance, and the cost of demanding certainty.

title: Infinite Gambit
description: Infinite Gambit is a chess roguelike with automatic battles and powerful upgrade combinations. Position your pieces, play gambits, and build a royal court that turns your army into a force of destruction. Find the combination that will crush bosses and lead you to victory.

title: Herd Dispatch
description:
Get ready for a cozy and adorable adventure in Herd Dispatch, a charming puzzle game where every little sheep is counting on you to find its way home. Watch carefully, think quickly, and switch the paths at just the right moment to guide each sheep safely to the pen that matches its color.

Explore 30 carefully handcrafted levels across 3 delightful rural biomes, where every new stage puts your logic, planning, and attention to the test. As the challenges grow, you'll need to anticipate each sheep's movement and create the perfect connections before they wander down the wrong path.

With charming pixel art, a warm atmosphere, and mechanics that are easy to learn yet surprisingly clever, Herd Dispatch delivers a relaxing and rewarding experience for anyone who loves creative puzzles and casual challenges.

title: Prismhold
description: A card-driven tower defense: draft towers from your deck every wave, merge three copies to evolve them without limit and mix 14 elements to survive endless waves, crowned bosses and flyers. Play solo, co-op on one map, or side by side with up to 4 players.

title: Pokémon GS Vitro
description:
Experience Johto like never before in Pokémon GS Vitro, a remake of Pokémon Crystal—now with an open world!
A game for all fans of the second generation, featuring an expanded Pokédex, new Mega Evolutions, and modernized mechanics for the best experience these games have to offer.

title: Catch the Octopus
description: Catch the Octopus is an online multiplayer hide-and-seek game for 2 to 24 players. Transform into objects as an Octopus to fool the Seeker and escape, or become the Seeker and hunt down hidden Octopuses. Use unique abilities to stun, chase, and escape in unpredictable rounds with your friends!

title: Hehehe Game
description:
Hehehe game is...

- 10 unique levels: sell crates just for the sake of crates, and then participate in cart-racing (and all of this in a single level).
- Two narrators: who will constantly mock you (no hard feelings).
- Total absurdity: inspired by The Stanley Parable and all kinds of memes.
- Perfect for streaming: tons of unexpected twists (WW cargo bringers).

This is the second installment of the game. The first part was released only on itch io and was not registered on IGDB

title: Fate/Empire of Dirt: Stella Splendens
description:
The second and last append for Fate/Empire of Dirt, taking places after Made in Heaven and adding new routes for Morgan and Musashi.
Anastasia, Murasaki Shikibu and Consort Yu are also upgrated from sub-heroines to heroines roles.

title: Winter Wraith
description:
You are tasked with investigating a mysterious disease in the south west. Armies are moving rapidly in the trench. You don't have much time before more important matters call to your attention. Solve your first task and get back to the Harmonium for the next.

You will play as one of the great heroes of the continent, leading and managing your own minor faction: Ankh among others at the great Fortress of Harmonium.

The game includes everything a classic infinity engine RPG usually does, you will solve quests and gain experience, many times by fighting. It also includes huge field battles (on table top), faction management, romance and friendships, crafting and alchemy, resource harvesting, as well as many many others.

title: Hubble Bubble
description: Co-op hookah shop sim for 1 to 4 friends. Run Ghalyan's Hookah Lounge on a space station: pack the bowl, light the coals, serve the aliens and act normal. Nothing on this station is normal.

title: Mind Gazing
description: Mind Gazing is a lateral thinking puzzle game where players solve mysterious scenarios by asking yes-or-no questions. Play solo or with friends, uncover hidden clues, and use creative thinking to solve intriguing mysteries. Create your own scenarios, explore a variety of puzzles, and challenge your reasoning skills.

title: NAND²
description: Build a computer from a single NAND gate: wire relays into logic, memory and a 16-bit CPU with a pipeline, branch prediction and a cache, then program it. Robots in mazes, Nim, even a shooter on your own CPU. A long campaign through the eras of computing, plus a level editor and Steam Workshop.

title: The Citadel Project
description: The Citadel Project is a first-person stealth game with lite survival-horror elements, inspired by the Thief series and set in a dark fantasy world. Use your tools and surroundings wisely, stay hidden in the shadows, and uncover the dark secrets behind the Citadel's downfall.

title: Project RE: Visited - Resident Evil 3
description: A native PC port & clean-room static recompilation of Resident Evil 3: Nemesis (1999, PlayStation 1) for Windows.

title: Her Revenge
description: You are stuck inside a sealed apartment, and have to uncover a massive misunderstanding. Discover what happened to Grandma, and be completely silent. It's not your apartment. You are STUCK

title: Shores of the Fallen
description: Shores of the Fallen is a first-person, open-world zombie survival game set on a storm-battered island. Zombies track the player by sight and sound, making stealth a core part of play, and night fog brings larger hordes. The surrounding water is patrolled by sharks. Players scavenge buildings and wrecks for supplies, hunt wildlife, fish, craft tools and weapons, and build a base piece by piece. A drivable truck and boat are used to cross the island, and a day/night cycle and storms shape each run. The game is in Early Access and is developed by a single developer.

title: Terminidle
description: Terminidle is an incremental hacking game about mining data from a bare terminal. Grow botnets, run hack contracts, and upgrade your rig until it boots a whole desktop OS and maybe more! Then wipe it all for permanent power and climb back faster!

title: Letrazo
description:
Letrazo is a TV game show style quiz in which two teams, Blue and Orange, compete for every letter of the alphabet. Each match moves through several rounds, One of Four, The Clue, Crosswords and Where Are They?, before the final letter wheel, where every answer has to start with or contain the given letter. Players answer by typing or by voice, and the team with the most correct answers takes the jackpot.

Matches can be played online from 1 vs 1 up to 4 vs 4, with bots filling any empty seats, or in private rooms with friends using a code. A single-player story mode pits the player against eight increasingly difficult rivals in 1 vs 1 duels, ending with a trophy.

title: Hiru: Mansa Assegai
description: A Maasai prince’s quest for vengeance. HIRU is a 3D African action-adventure game based on the Maasai (African Vikings) where you avenge your clan and rescue your kidnapped sister from poachers across Savannas, Forests and Deserts!

title: SubDuctis
description: Traverse a puzzling metallic landscape by folding away space itself. Bypass obstacles, form conductive paths, and discover new areas by folding, unfolding, and folding again

title: The Arcane Open
description: Golf, but every swing is a card. Build a deck of enchanted shots, bend the odds to find the fairway, and play your way through a fantasy golf tournament where anything can happen.

title: Shrek 2 Remastered
description: DreamWorks Shrek 2 Remastered: The cult-classic, button-mashing co-op adventure is back with all your favorite characters and improved graphics.

title: Survive & Craft
description: You survive in a terrible plane crash and now you are out of civilization. Around the endless ocean, exhausting sun and hungry sharks. There is only one thing left for you - to survive at any cost.

title: Greed for Glory
description: In this chaotic board game, take on the roles of creatures straight out of fables. Use your wits and think carefully about every move to become the richest among your friends and claim the throne. Then, watch your plans unfold before your eyes, because in a fable, nothing ever goes quite as planned.

title: ReStreet
description: ReStreet is a Windows PC version of FIFA Street (2012) made by recompiling the Xbox 360 game.

title: Birthday
description: A little present in the forest! A short puzzle game that can be cleared in 10-20 minutes.

title: Rainfusor
description: Each element combination creates its own playstyle. Reclaim the lost parts of yourself in rooms in a side-scroller physics rogue-arcade without any boring stat boosts or platforming. Rip apart segmented bugs, uncover new runes and synergies and find crazy emergent mechanics.

title: Keep Skeleton Alive!
description: Vampires, necromancer, skeleton and even a time traveler. This visual novel has it all. But most important question is, can you actually keep skeleton alive? I guess we will find out.

title: Quatiica Motorsports
description: An anti-gravity racing game set in 2096. Gear up and take flight across multiple race types: soar over mountain ranges on fore thrusters, rush through narrow canyons in an endurance prototype, or dive underwater in a pulse sprinter. We are racing in the new 90s!

title: Strategic Tactics
description: Strategic Tactics is a Real-Time territorial Strategy game, where you control individual units that represent brigades or whatever your mind can think of when looking at abstract shapes! You build economy, manage the front, make offensives, defend, encircle and peform diplomacy in tense 45 minute matches, with built-in map editor and replays.

title: Room Movers
description: Room Movers is a cozy two-player online co-op game about unboxing and arranging tiny diorama workplaces such as a café, a flower shop and a dentist's office. Small boxes can be opened alone, while big boxes and heavy furniture need both players to grab an end and pull together. There is no grid and nothing snaps into place: every item is moved by hand with physics. There is no score, no timer and no fail state. When both players press Done, the camera circles the finished room and hands them a polaroid that is added to an album on the menu wall and can be saved to the desktop.

title: Granny 2 Enhanced
description: An improved version of the original granny chapter two game, designed for replayability, fairness and polished gameplay that lacks the bugs from the original game.

title: On the Way Home: Strange Incidents
description: A novel adventure where two high school girls encounter the supernatural on their pixelated way home.

title: Granny 3 Evolved
description: An improved version of the original granny 3 game, designed for replayability, fairness and polished gameplay that lacks the bugs from the original game.

title: Narnok: Help! I Was Reincarnated as a Brain in a Jar and Need to Plug in My Power Cables
description: im a brain in a jar now and I got these cables that gotta be plugged in but there are many dangerous things in the way, so its always a puzzle to solve haha

title: Narnok: Feed Grommy Candy
description: A push-your-luck roguelike sackbuilder where you feed candy to a worm called Grommy. Draw candies from your sack, chain their effects, and feed Gromintler but not too sweet!

title: Narnok: Little Bean Glandoid
description: Dig deep, collect buried treasures, return to the surface, trade with charming friends, unlock upgrades, and keep going deeper as you search for a way home in this cozy digging adventure as Little Bean Glandoid!

title: The Enthralling Realms 7: Curse of the Wildwood
Lumenfall
description: The world sank into the Gloom. One island still holds a light. Build a cozy factory high above a sea of clouds, push back the darkness, then take the helm of your own skyship and sail through the mountain passes to new islands — alone or with up to three friends.

title: 101 Cats in Athens
description: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens  in the hand-crafted Athens landscape.  Earn lots of achievements. How many  can you find?  Be quick! ⏱️

title: Ace Attorney: Memories and Turnabout
description: Ace Attorney: Memories and Turnabout is an unofficial Ace Attorney fangame featuring an original story told across five interconnected cases.

title: Bippo Bot
description: A 2D platformer featuring 30 handcrafted levels where you'll collect hidden Energy Fragments, overcome dangerous obstacles, and unlock the path through three distinct futuristic city districts.

title: Shards of Mistfrost
description:
The giants of Calamity appeared together with winter crystals. Their goal is to make the entire world ruled by snow and ice, with the winter crystals generating an eternal and neverending cold weather. But before they can execute their plan, our hero Hrok Thorgril sets on a journey with his trusty axe, hoping to destroy every winter crystal and defeat every giant before it's too late.

Shards of Mistfrost is a 2d action adventure platformer with a norse mythology aesthetic and retro gameplay. The game's main mechanic is the weapon, an axe that must be thrown to destroy obstacles, winter crystals and enemies, but the player must wait the axe return to their hands. Positioning, quick reflexes and good map awareness are key points to conquer all levels.

title: Fading Clouds
description:
Embark on a peaceful journey through the skies in Fading Clouds, a charming puzzle adventure where every step transforms the path ahead. Carefully plan your moves, cross clouds that vanish beneath your feet, and discover the perfect route to reach the star waiting at the end of every challenge.

Explore 30 carefully crafted levels where new cloud types and clever mechanics make every puzzle feel fresh and rewarding. Restore clouds at the right moment, adapt your strategy, and discover creative solutions as the difficulty gently grows with each stage.

With beautiful pixel art, a relaxing atmosphere, and thoughtful puzzles that encourage careful planning without pressure, Fading Clouds is perfect for players who love to think, experiment, and celebrate every clever solution.

title: Under Review
description: Under Review is an anomaly-hunt horror game. Inspect uncanny hotel rooms, document discrepancies and survive the strict, unforgiving bureaucracy of the Manager.

title: One Million Coins
description: A short, focused first-person incremental mining game. Dig through a vault of one million coins, bank your haul, buy better tools, and build an ever-faster gold-collecting operation.

title: Bloom & Dine
description: Bloom & Dine is a cozy chaos cooking game on a match-3 board. Match ingredients to fire up the stoves, fit each dish onto the board and serve it before your guest's patience runs out. Work your way through a few kitchens over 99 in-game days, from a tiny pizzeria to a grill terrace by the sea, with bonus puzzle days and hidden object levels along the way.

title: Almost Home
description: A 1-4 player co-op survival adventure about making it home together. Explore unique biomes, uncover their secrets, adapt to their rules, and survive the unexpected challenges along the way.

title: Recharged
description: A native PC port built from the source code of Mario Strikers Charged for Windows, Linux, macOS, and Steam Deck.

title: Hamventure
description:
Hamventure is a platformer featuring creative puzzles and engaging challenges. Guide a small pig through 40 levels, overcoming traps such as spikes, saws, and arrows that react to your movements.
Each level introduces new situations that will make you think before taking your first jump.

title: The Edutainment Vortex Diner
description: It's time to make learning fun, with sandwiches and smalltalk at the Edutainment Vortex Diner, in retro PC game style! Take classes from ageless and immortal teachers. Get good grades or embrace your inner bratty problem child! Unpack the mystery of this cosmic eatery and perhaps you'll inherit their burdens.

title: Tanuki Tag
description: This ain't your grandma's hide-and-seek! Stretch, squash, and shape yourself into ridiculous disguises. Go tiny, go huge, blend into your surroundings, and cause absolute chaos with your friends!

title: Skewer'd
description: Skewer'd is the best multi-player physics based javelin sports combat game ever made. Disclaimer: Statement based on zero research

title: Crown of Time
description: Rebuild a forgotten kingdom in this dark-fantasy idle RPG. Gather and craft by hand, command Echoes to work while you’re away, and explore Past, Present, and Future. Fight the guardians by hand, gather the crown’s three fragments, and reach the one place that stands outside time.

title: Below the Ashes
description: Forty years after the sky caught fire, your group goes underground to survive. Lead a crew, dig into a world of cave-ins, floods and darkness, and face what is climbing up from the deep. Alone or in online co-op with up to 8 players.

title: Trash Island
description: Set off on a 1-4 player co-op adventure on an island buried in trash! Collect garbage, grind it into useful materials, build your shelter, and clean up the island. Craft your own boat from scrap, head out to sea, and hunt for valuable debris drifting across the ocean.

title: Shared Custody
description: Youre demons with temporary legal guardianship of Sprog, the heir to the infernal throne. Team up in co-op to escort him through hazardous worlds to the Unholy Gates. Keep him happy, keep him alive, and appease his demands.

title: What Do You Meme? The Video Game
description: The smash-hit card game has gone digital! What Do You Meme? The Video Game brings internet humor to the living room. Use your phone as a controller to battle your friends and build hilarious memes!

title: Station 12
description: Station 12 is a chaotic sci-fi horror party game for 4–6 players. Team up to escape a doomed space station while one of your friends hunts you as the monster. Scream over proximity chat, rescue your crew, and turn a desperate escape into a hilarious disaster.

title: Just One More Coin
description: Just One More Coin is a relaxing game about digging through a massive gold hoard of a sleeping dragon. Earn money, upgrade your equipment, and dig through trillions of coins in search of a single golden key.

title: Just One More Season
description: A roguelike esports management sim: take charge of a team and climb from Iron league to Diamond. Recruit and train players, manage finances and fans across seasons that play out differently every run. Lost the final? Just one more season.

title: Just One More Fly
description: Hunt pesky flies in this first-person swatting game. Clear rooms, earn upgrades, and tackle bigger infestations with swatters, electric rackets, a hand vacuum, and a flamethrower. Place traps, beat your best time, and catch that one last fly.

title: Standard Procedures
description: A casual team vs. team FPS about gunfights and negotiation. Your character is completely physically simulated and can interact with the world and be injured dynamically.

title: CourseCraze
description: Hover at high speed through loops, halfpipes and wall rides. Chase gold medals, hunt your own ghost, build tracks, share them on the Workshop.

title: Drone Arena
description: A survivors-like arena roguelite. Pilot a drone, stack weapons and upgrades into absurd builds, and hold out against waves of mechas until the timer runs out. Every run ends. Every run teaches.

title: Slavlands: Tribes at War
description: Raise a Slavic gord, feed your people and lead your warband across a great map of the early medieval Slavic lands. A 90s-style real-time strategy with a deep simulation, where wars are won with granaries, supply trains, weather and faith long before the first blow.

title: Blockflow
description: Blockflow is a roguelike puzzle game where strategic grid placement meets satisfying combo mechanics. Clear lines, manage your shape pool to hit score milestones, and draft powerful upgrades. Earn Blockcoins to unlock new shapes and permanent buffs in this highly addictive meta-progression puzzler!

title: Kachow Kart Racing
description:
Kachow Kart Racing is an arcade kart racing game featuring drift-based boosts, chaotic races, and power-ups. Players can customize their karts, race against AI opponents, challenge friends in local split-screen, or compete in online multiplayer with ranked competition and leaderboards.

Use rockets, smoke bombs, shields, and oil to disrupt rivals and take the lead. Join or create a clan, grow your team, and compete together.

title: Fiak
description: Four nights of survival in a realistic, immersive horror experience. Alone in your house, you face a malicious entity determined to get inside. This is not a walking simulator: every decision affects your survival. One mistake is fatal.

title: Birdy's Island
description: The future is in ruins. Travel back in time as Birdy, a small bird with a big mission: fly, swim and dive across an open world, regrow forests, clean up polluted seas, and drive off the polluters with a well-aimed arsenal of poop.

title: As Long as She Forgot
description: A first-person psychological horror game. Play as Marlene, an 86-year-old woman preparing for her family's visit. They're coming. They always do.

title: It Happened at Night: A New Nightmare
description: While working at a remote site deep in the woods, Chloe becomes entangled in a disturbing mystery that leads her into something far more terrifying than she could have imagined.

title: Cubic Earth
description:
In Cubic Earth's Early Access release, you can fly, walk and hang glide around a 1:1 scale voxel recreation of the planet we all call home! You can go anywhere you'd like: your hometown, old workplace, New York City, Mount Everest, or somewhere you've never even heard of.

Across the entire planet, there are millions of locations to discover and (re) experience. Pick a random place and see where you end up, look for somewhere specific, or wander until you find something interesting. Either way, you're sure to come across something worth discovering!

Additionally, the game includes a freecam Photo Mode, enabling you to take epic screenshots of your surroundings and share them with your friends! Reminisce on an old memory, plan a trip, or create content with ease.

Cubic Earth makes use of voxel technology to ensure a street level which remains coherent across the planet. Roads, trails, forests and more remain legible and navigable, unlike many planet-scale games. From places as iconic as Times Square to your local neighborhood, street level is accessible!

Familiar places can bring back memories you've long since forgotten, and new places can make for an amazing adventure. One of the most fun parts about Cubic Earth is not knowing what you'll find around the corner!

title: Hero Chains of Destiny
description:
Hero Chains of Destiny is a fantasy dungeon-crawling, deck-building RPG developed by TavernCatGames. Players build and manage their own guild, collect cards, assemble a party of three characters, and venture into dangerous dungeons filled with monsters, treasure, and encounters.

Combat combines turn-based strategy with collectible cards, character abilities, equipment, summoned monsters, and a shared Power Stone resource system. Players can expand their collections through dungeon expeditions and card packs, experiment with different party and deck combinations, and challenge increasingly difficult enemies.

The game also features arena battles, multiplayer activities, card collection management, and optional town activities such as fishing and the Wheel of Fate.

title: Cozy Shores
description: You find yourself stranded on an abandoned island with your beloved cat. Clean the island, recycle all the trash, build a bond with your pet and create a cozy paradise.

title: Just One Bite
description: A 1~4 player co-op horror game. Your mission is to gather as much food as possible for the humans. But not all food is normal. Can you complete this mission to the very end?

title: Bigger Bang
description: 3 a.m. The neighbor is thudding again, so you pick up a hammer. Every run deals new relics that change how your hammer hits: echoes, chains, fire. The holes stay between runs. Break through, and the noise comes from farther away: apartment, city, mountain, planet, spacetime.

title: Knight's Party
description: Knight's Party is a bunch of lethal tournament party games where everyone wants to become a knight yet nobody absolutely knows what they're doing. Take your friends, fire cannons, pour glasses, pursue crowns, and disintegrate to limb by limb. Here, survival is quite challenging.

title: Shore
description: Stuck in the middle of the ocean, survive together on a fragile physics-based raft. Fight storms, tsunamis, sharks, and starvation as you find your way back home in SHORE, a 1-4-player co-op survival adventure.

title: Drop Dead Party
description: Drop Dead Party is a chaotic 2-4 players PvP arena of a bomb tag. Pass the ticking bomb before you explode, drop dirty power-ups on your friends, and survive fast-paced chaotic circus rounds. Invite your Steam squad and ruin your group chat!

title: Gimbap Heaven
description: Run a Korean snack bar with your own crew! Hire staff, hand out kitchen tasks, plan the menu and juggle wages, stress and bills in this card-based restaurant management sim. Jump in to cook and serve by hand when it gets busy, and stay afloat for 15 days.

title: Total Backfire
description: A co-op third-person action roguelite where every run drops you into a different action movie. Build powerful loadouts, battle aliens, zombies, and colossal bosses, and fight through cinematic biomes inspired by iconic '90s action blockbusters.

title: Rapid Miner
description: Rapid Miner is a desktop idler: a tiny pixel mine floats in the corner of your screen in Pocket Mode, and your typing and clicks keep the miner swinging while you work. Open the full game to explore caves, beat bosses, grow a village and Rebirth.

title: Saju Friend
description: A small pixel luck cat lives in the corner of your screen. Click to crack a fortune cookie, toss coins, roll dice, check name compatibility or shake an omikuji box for a fortune slip, and collect keepsakes and outfits. For entertainment only.

title: Leather Atelier
description: Cut, hand-stitch, dye and stamp wallets and bags from a single hide in a cozy leather-crafting sim. Design your own patterns, then photograph, sell or repair every piece.

title: Hospital Hustle
description: A chaotic co-op hospital comedy for 1-4 players. Run an overwhelmed hospital with your friends, diagnose ridiculous patients, juggle emergencies, and keep the whole place from falling apart. Between shifts, upgrade your hospital, unlock new rooms and equipment, and prepare for even bigger chaos.

title: Don't Get Six
description: Play a deadly dice game where anomalies reveal what's inside the cup. Reveal the die or shake again, but whatever you do... Don't Get Six.

title: Hotel Manager Simulator
description: Build and run your own hotel from the ground up. Manage guests, design rooms, hire staff and upgrade floors. Set competitive prices for rooms and turn the tiny 1-floor building into a thriving 100-story luxury hotel.

title: Rerouted
description: Stranded deep in the North, you have just one goal: make it home alive. Solo or with friends, fight the cold, hunt for food, set up camps, watch out for wildlife, and... try not to lose anyone along the way.

title: Mayday Vacay
description: A physics-based co-op adventure where a relaxing boat trip turns into total chaos. Work together to sail, improvise… and keep your boat afloat.

title: Cave Expedition
description: The Ultimate Caving Simulator, solo or in co-op with up to 4 players. Experience dry and wet caving as you descend into tight squeezes, massive chambers, and uncharted depths. The deeper you go, the more upgrades & equipment you need ... and every decision matters!

title: Mall Corp
description: John is an ordinary security guard at a shopping mall who has been working there for 40 years. It was supposed to be just another routine shift. But this night hits different.

title: Alruna: No Man's Land
description: Give Alruna a gun! A compact, high-density Metroidvania, more non-linear than ever. Create your own path with mutually exclusive upgrades. Living men have no place in this war to end all wars. It is a no man's land.

title: The Eggsortist
description: A chicken possessed by the Devil has laid 4,266 colored eggs in a barn, but 666 of them are demonic eggs in disguise! Sort the eggs, find the evil impostors, and burn them before they hatch and doom the world.

title: Mafia Deal
description: Mafia Deal is an online auction game for 3–6 players. Gather your crew of mobsters and bid on collectibles with hidden twists. Hype up your wares, place secret bids, and outsmart your friends to make a fortune. Bid the same amount? Draw your guns and let your aim settle the deal!

title: Mono Chameleon
description: Mono Chameleon is an online hide-and-seek game for 2 to 10 players, drawn in four dithered shades of olive and cream. Hiders sample colors from walls and floors with an eyedropper and paint their own bodies with brushes, down to the thin mortar lines between bricks, to blend into the scenery. Seekers search in first person with no radar, relying on their eyes, a five-shot catch-gun and a whistle that sounds late in each round. The game has five modes (Normal, Infection, Double, Tag and Prop Hunt), and bots fill empty slots.

title: Skoot: Keyboard Brawl
description: Press any key on your keyboard to drive Skoot toward that key’s position in the arena. Dodge, ram, and outmaneuver opponents in fast-paced vehicular brawls built around your entire keyboard. Take on boss fights, Endless Mode, and online PvP as you brawl throughout Skoot’s strange futuristic worlds.

title: Wayward Cosmos
description: Explore a seed-driven galaxy where every ship, planet, and dungeon is generated at runtime. Dogfight pirate wings, land on 20 kinds of worlds, raid surface sites on foot, and build a fleet from salvaged hulls, solo or in Steam co-op. The same seed rebuilds the same galaxy, every time.

title: Strikem
description: Fast, physics-driven 2D platform shooter built for chaos. Battle across Team Deathmatch, CTF, Free-For-All, King of the Hill & Coin Confirmed, survive co-op Zombie waves and the Iron Directive campaign, then grind 108 ranks of loot. Squad up with friends or drop in solo vs AI.

title: Grim Guild
description: A management game about sending other people into danger. Run the adventurers' guild your grandfather left you: write each contract (the pay, how plainly the danger is written, whether they may turn back), never see the fight, read the report, and count who comes back at the door. Monsters, grief, trust and ale. A year ends at the old quarry and is bound into a book. Optional asynchronous shared towns of up to 100 halls over Steam.

title: Island Sort
description: Pirates trashed the island! Grab thousands of scattered goods and sort them into the right crates and shelves, solo or in 3-player co-op. Unlock portal doors, uncover secrets and race a friend in 1v1 sorting duels.

title: White Christmas
description: White Christmas is a cozy multiplayer winter playground set in a snowy village. Build snowmen, trade gifts, rent skates, throw snowballs, and warm up at the Christmas market. Host a village with friends and turn a school-free snow day into shared holiday chaos.

title: Magic Isle Simulator
description: Magic Isle Simulator is a first-person magic shop management and crafting game set in a secret town where only wizards live. Players inherit a magic shop from their grandfather and run it alone or in online co-op for up to four players. They grow magical herbs, brew potions in a cauldron mini-game, craft wands in a line-tracing mini-game, and sell goods such as flying wands, spellbooks, broomsticks and prophecy orbs. Earnings and higher-level licences expand the shop, while thieves and cursed items add risk. Seasons and festivals change customer demand, and players choose between two secret societies, the Round Table, which keeps magic hidden and offers rent discounts, and the Watchers, which share magic openly and offer rare rewards; angering the wrong side can bring raids or taxes.

title: Arbiter's Circus
description: Pluto Circus has recently become a hot topic in Las Vegas. Beyond its bizarre shows, there's also news of the sheriff's son going missing. You secretly became the lucky audience and will be featured in a global live broadcast, spending a marvelous day until the final show begins...

title: Aurum: City of Chains
description: A grim dark narrative-driven RPG where your choices shape your future. Build wealth, influence and reputation in a city that never stops moving.

title: Clickomorph
description: Hover over enemies to kill them... Until you choose an ability! Each new ability offers a new playstyle! Build a small auto clicker army, shoot your enemies as an archer, summon a Soul Reaper to assist you or even play a mini rhythm game! And more!

title: Barely Afloat
description: Only one of you gets the wheel. The rest get a hammer, a bucket and a harpoon. Barely Afloat is a first-person co-op trip for 1 to 4 players in one small, leaky motorboat, from a mountain pond all the way to the sea. Somebody always ends up in the river.

title: The Fame Game II: L.A. Heartbreaker
description: Shot across Los Angeles by a team with Hollywood experience, this live-action interactive drama stars Zhong Chenyao as Ayaka, with a cast shaped by 200,000+ votes. As a cash-strapped student posing as a wealthy heir, navigate five dangerous relationships—and risk losing yourself behind the mask.

title: The Arcane Archive
description: Step into the mystical halls of The Arcane Archive! In this cozy and atmospheric 3D puzzle game, your task is to sort and organize over 100 glowing magical potions on ancient shelves. Bring order to the chaos and unwind in the ultimate relaxing wizard's library.

title: Typing...
description: TYPING... is a cozy skill-based typing game where your keyboard is your controller. Take on writing jobs, type faster and more accurately, earn money, and build your career from tiny posts to prestigious writing books.

title: Drift Riot
description: Drift Riot is an arcade racer where style is speed. Chain drifts, jumps and near misses into huge scores, outrun the Patrols in Heat Run, conquer 150 career courses, race leaderboard ghosts, and build tracks to share.

title: Nightcup
description: Pull up a chair: in Nightcup everything is played at one table. Four classics on the shelf, plus various modes and house rules you can switch on. Fill the empty seats with bots or invite your Steam friends straight into your lobby. No long loading screens in between.

title: So You Think You Can Talk?
description: An online word party game for 2-8 players. Take intense turns describing as many words as you can whilst your friends race to guess them.

title: OCDust: One Room. Every Last Speck. One Way Out.
description: You woke up in a room full of dust. The only way out is to clean it all. All one million specks.

title: Fairy Keykeepers: Tidy Up Together
description: Fly through a huge workshop as a tiny fairy and sort 3,200 keys by colour, head and shape. Play solo or in a group of up to 4, learn useful magic, restore the workshop, collect picture pieces and spoil the resident cat.

title: MXGP 26: The Official Game - Scrubdesignz Liveries
description: This DLC gives you access to 6 SCRUB Designz liveries for your bike.

title: Chamber: Atom Breaker Inc
description: A reactor made of breakable pixels. Stir the atoms with your hand, fuse them up the ladder, and chew through the chamber wall layer by layer until the fuel runs out. The playing field is what you spend.

title: Boulito
description: Boulito is a top-down arena survival action game. Players control Boulito, a small repair robot, and fight off waves of enemies in a closed arena using six upgradeable weapons. The game features 20 handcrafted waves with boss fights, an endless mode, an in-game shop between waves, and online leaderboards. Developed by the independent French studio PixelRed Studio with the Godot engine, it is available on PC (Windows) and Android.

title: BrouHaHa
description: Hear a word. Type it in 12 seconds. Get it wrong and you fall down a 12-player leaderboard until you're the one eliminated. Buy coupons between words to distort your rivals' audio, scramble their typing, and steal their dollars.

title: HoneyMoon to Hell
description: Follow the adventure of Mr Honey and Miss Moon as they enjoy the trip and strengthen their bond. On their journey, they will go through different romantic places, solving puzzles and facing unique challenges. Cooperation is key when facing the adversities of this twisted and romantic journey...

title: Retro Empire
description:
Retro Empire is a first-person simulation game about running a second-hand video game store. Most stock comes from local sellers found through an in-game classifieds app, where the player haggles over the price before meeting them in person. Much of what comes in is dirty or broken, so consoles go to a workbench to be cleaned, taken apart, repaired with replacement parts, and tested before they are priced and put on the shelves.

Customers arrive with their own budgets, compare prices, sell their old games to the store, and bring in faulty consoles for repair jobs. Arcade cabinets can be repaired and fitted with swappable game boards that are fully playable. Each day the store is open earns experience, and new levels unlock furniture, decorations, game and console rentals, wholesale orders, staff who help run the business, and a second venue that can be turned into an arcade hall.

title: Spectral Divide
description: Enter haunted locations alone or with friends, gather evidence, and identify the entity before it hunts you. Uncover memory fragments to piece together its past, discover its motive, and choose how to resolve the haunting.

title: I Missed the Apocalypse
description: Humanity has fallen under alien control. Every mind but yours is under their influence. Alone and immune, you must gather resources, build robots, and fortify your base against ever-larger nighttime assaults. Grow strong enough to strike back at the purple fortress looming over Neo Roma.

title: Pawn Shift
description: You're working the night shift at a pawn shop on an isolated road. Haggle with every customer who walks in, inspect what they bring you, and decide what goes on your shelf. Some of it should not be here. Nothing is supernatural, and that is the scariest part. A PSX-style horror shift.

title: Parawyrm
description: Parawyrm is a unique horror experience like no other where enemies and hazards will challenge your very senses. Explore a seamless world with collectables to find and secrets to uncover...

title: Desperate Kart
description: Desperate Kart is a free-to-play racing game and a spinoff of the YouTube series Danganronpa: Desperate Heart.

title: Outono Adventures
description: A simple 3D platform game where a court jester gets trapped inside a game and must save her best friend within a digital world. but to achieve that, she'll have to go through many adventures that go far beyond just jumping on enemies' heads.

title: The Wrong Way
description: The Wrong Way is a psychological horror experience about a camping trip that takes a dark turn when one friend drives home alone and ends up on a road he was never supposed to be on. Sometimes the most dangerous places are the ones you stumble into by accident.

title: Necro Echo
description: A 3D shooting puzzle adventure set in a zombie apocalypse: Reconnect the shattered circuits of memory, fight through the subconscious battlefield, and uncover the tragic truth.

title: Don't Go Duck
description: Don't Go Duck is a physics platformer where you roll an arrow-marked die inside a cylinder. The arrow on the top face sets the duck’s direction. Time each roll and jump carefully to guide the duck up the cloud platforms without falling.

title: Breadwalk
description: There is war going on. But you need to buy bread.

title: Shadows of the Dungeon
description: A first-person dark fantasy dungeon crawler powered by 5.5e SRD tabletop rules in real-time. Switch seamlessly between classic grid and free 3D movement, build your party, roll d20s, disarm deadly traps, and manage your campfire roster to survive Torment Keep.

title: Dead Station Together
description: A deadly outbreak has consumed a remote space station. Team up with friends, recover DNA samples, rescue the crew, and survive against the infected in this 1–4 player co-op survival horror experience.

title: Waifu Curator
description: Restore a chaotic waifu museum by finding, sorting, and displaying collectible scale figures. Collect, organize, and build the perfect exhibition!

title: No Body No Problem!
description: One of you is the cop. The rest are panicked suspects. Hide the body, clean up the evidence, don’t rat each other out, and get rid of everything before your cop friend knocks on the door. There is only one rule: if the body is found, you’re all done for.

title: Blood Covenant
description: Blood Covenant is a 1-4 player online co-op survival horror job-sim. Players are a hazmat cleaning crew taking night jobs at farmhouses, barns in the woods and an abandoned psychiatric hospital. Each shift they scrub blood, bag remains, seal breaches and repair fences, then return to the van before the entity that has moved in comes for them. Players spot anomalies, read messages written on the walls under UV light, and must identify the entity before lighting the ritual altar; naming the wrong one turns it against the crew. Can be played solo or with up to three friends.

title: Talk Of The Tavern
description: A co-op autobattler roguelike where rival guilds journey toward the King’s castle, stopping at taverns to outbid each other for mercenaries and shape their builds with powerful scrolls. Survive the road and conquer the King’s Tournament.

title: Mindscape
description: A unique blend of incremental progression and tower defense, set to the rhythm of the breath. Protect the Breath Center from Thoughts by releasing them through Awareness into Clarity.

title: Happy Propaganda
description: Approve or censor live chat in Happy Propaganda. Balance viewer anger and the host's well-being, choose broadcast topics, and talk off-air. Five days of choices lead to multiple endings.

title: Disk-Y
description: Show Yuu—a transfer student struggling with psychological issues—around the school and become a source of emotional support for her. This is a minimalist retro visual novel featuring elements of psychological horror.

title: Seabun
description: Seabun is an incremental 2D survivor-like with creature collection elements, where you play a scientist bunny diving deeper and deeper to find the source of the sea's corruption. Haul your loot home between dives, grow your lab, and raise the fish you rescue into rideable mounts.

title: 1 Day
description: “I wish the balance of our friendship was always in balance.” The game included a variety of classic 2D playing technics such as shooting, jumping, tank war, puzzle solving, etc. With delicate drawings, let's reminisce our childhood playmates now.

title: Flora's World
description: Help Flora save Flower Land! Jump, smash enemies with your hammer, and explore gardens filled with giant flowers, secrets, and challenges in a classic 2D platformer.

title: Kur: Endless Descent
description:
KUR is a free to play idle dungeon crawler set in the underworld of Mesopotamian myth. It runs in a small window you can resize, switch to a minimal view or shrink to a tiny progress tracker in the corner of your screen while you work or play something else.

Your party of three heroes explores and fights on its own. You decide who descends, what they carry, how they grow and how deep to push. Choose from eight classes, each with a male and a female version, and combine skills, a passive tree for every class and party synergies to face what lies below.

Descend through seven Domains, each with its own monsters and a guardian waiting at its Gate. Break the last Gate and the descent begins again under the Mark, deeper and harder, with no bottom. Fight more than 80 creatures drawn from Mesopotamian sources, loot hundreds of named items across nine rarities, forge and fuse gear at camp and grow a Seal that never resets.

Monsters drop Ash, which can become Artifacts, numbered, limited and never sold. Player trading through the Steam Inventory is coming soon. Free to play, and you never pay to win.

title: Buggos: Death Squad
description: Buggos: Death Squad is a first-person co-op wave defense shooter for 1 to 4 players. The squad drops onto a planet overrun by the Buggos, an alien insect swarm, builds a base of turrets, walls, generators and shields, and holds out against waves of hundreds of Buggos until it has gathered enough research to escape. Players can also assault Buggo nests and fortifications to reduce wave pressure. The swarm evolves as the run goes on, adding new species, upgrades and boss Buggos that counter the players' defenses. Weapons, armor and buildings all have module sockets that add effects such as split shots, chain hits and explosions on kill. Before each drop, players choose a loadout on their ship and unlock new weapons, armor and modules through meta progression. In Versus mode, one player commands the swarm against 1 to 3 human players.

title: Dwarven Shift 98
description:
Dwarven Shift 98 is an incremental mining game played in short timed shifts. A dwarf strikes a rock wall that breaks layer by layer, each layer richer in ore and gems than the last. The player collects the pieces before they fade and picks one of three cards at each level-up.

Between shifts, ore buys upgrades on a skill tree. Relics found at the end of each mine grant bonuses, open new mines and let the player ascend.

title: Space Is Crazy
description: Pilot your ship through chaotic battles, destroy enemies, and strengthen your ship with random upgrades. Unlock new pilots and ships to create unique combinations and face increasingly greater challenges.

title: A Game About Needle in a Haystack
description: A first-person game about finding a needle in a giant haystack. Dig through the hay by hand, sell it at the cow, buy tools and upgrades in the workshop, and search the pile until you find the needle.

title: Island Architect
description: Sculpt seaside towns nestled between cliffs in Island Architect, a relaxing free-form builder. Shape winding streets, carve tunnels, and craft cozy harbors inspired by coastal Europe. Build with flowing, organic forms—no stress, just create.

title: Foodgitives
description: Foodgitives is a physics-based action arcade game where players control runaway food escaping deadly, hazard-filled kitchens. Tilt cutting boards, pans, and trays to help your foodgitives dodge flying utensils, environmental hazards, and rhythm-synced enemies. Play singleplayer or in chaotic 1–4 player local co-op. Featuring fast die-and-retry gameplay, expressive 1930s rubber-hose cartoon aesthetic, and a big band jazz soundtrack, Foodgitives blends precision, comedy, and cooperation into a frantic arcade experience built for mastery and replayability.

title: Milo's Escape
description:
Jump, push, and escape the ruins!
Solve crate puzzles and survive dangerous traps in Milo's Escape — a charming 2D pixel art platformer where your mission is to outsmart the ancient ruins and find your way out.

title: Zombie Crawlers
description: Crawl through a haunted mansion and gun down the undead with a deck of cards! Zombie Crawlers a 3D first-person roguelite deckbuilder where your deck is your boomstick. Explore the mansion, uncover its secrets, and face the neverending horrors behind each door.

title: Sivers
description: Sivers is an RPG-roguelike with a unique style, where waves of enemies test your strategy. Use spells and build defenses, develop your hero, and fight bosses and varied foes. Victory on the first try is unlikely — every attempt brings you closer to success!

title: Goddle
description: A word race where your whole chat plays against you from their phones. No download, no account, just the room code.

title: 7 Millimeters
description: Start your journey as a carpenter in a new neighborhood. Take measurements, install furniture and fulfill customer orders. But success attracts trouble; a local gang demands a fee. Refuse, turn your shop into a fortress, and arm yourself to defend your life. will you pay or resist?

title: Heavy in the Hand
description: Cock the hammer, pull the trigger, count to six. Release the cylinder, eject the shells, count to six again. You hold death in your hand, and death is heavy. Descend to the abyss, shoot the horrors you can comprehend, and survive the horrors you cannot.

title: Our Church and Halloween RPG
description: A Christian-themed, story driven, black and white pixel art, Japanese styled RPG video game in the Our Church and Halloween franchise by Breakthrough Gaming!

title: Tie Down
description: Tie Down is a first-person, open-world multiplayer driving game. Take on procedurally generated, physics-based deliveries, buy, customize and sell vehicles, earn Greystone’s trust to unlock bigger contracts, build your business, make your fortune, and drive hard.

title: Skullf!
description: You are Skullf! Disembodied skull of terror & mini-golf action! After another hilarious night terrorizing locals it's time to return to your grave. Dodge traps, spelunk tombs and even go head to head with friends (Friends not included). Never before have you had so much fun a graveyard! (Probably)

title: Alleymental
description: Alleymental is a Metroidvania set in a modern India woven with myth. Master elemental weapons and switch between them mid-combo without breaking your flow. Explore a living Astrapunk India you perma-change as you cross it, uncover hidden fusions, and discover what your parents built and died for.

title: Giraffe Champion 3: Halloween Party & the Ghost Guitar
description: Play rock and metal songs and compete against zombies, witches, ghosts in the guitar battle to get all your guitars back. You are going to perform at a Halloween party but zombies have stolen all your guitars. Collect all the guitars before the Halloween party starts!

title: 3 Switch Problem
description: A casual, 3D, observation and puzzle game. Flip switches and observe results to answer which switch is controlling an apparatus as you work your way through the nine challenges of the 3-Switch Problem Puzzle Park. Talk to other kids and play outdoor activities along the way.

title: Mahjong Rush
description: Mahjong Rush is a relaxing ink-wash roguelike. Score by matching mahjong tiles into combos — no mahjong experience needed, an interactive tutorial teaches you from scratch. Collect Flowers, Fu cards, and Relics to grow small scores into huge ones. Every run is randomized. This round — clean house.

title: Five-Star Courier and the Fog That Reeks of Death
description: Experience the work of a courier in a city of living rumors and legends. Pay off your debt by carrying out strange requests from mystical customers. Uncover the reason behind the appearance of a mysterious fog that smells of decay.

title: OmniMart Tycoon
description: Design and manage the ultimate retail empire in OmniMart Tycoon! Build complex store layouts, optimize daily supply chains, and set prices. Hire staff and watch hundreds of simulated shoppers navigate your aisles as you balance profits with ultimate customer satisfaction.

title: Dome: Become Thyself
description: Dome: Become Thyself is a simulation roguelite where the players can learn the language of emotions, explore the infinite procedurally generated world, speak to other versions of yourself, and uncover what lies beneath the surface.

title: Survival.io
description: A 2D multiplayer survival strategy game built with modern web technologies where players survive, gather resources, and compete in real-time

title: Tombone: Legend of the Cave Babes
description: Tombone is a fast paced action-adventure game set in a fantastic prehistoric world. Jump, climb, and slide through vast levels full of collectibles, bash loads of enemies, and go toe to toe in huge boss fights as you save the world and the cave babes.

title: Nascor Descent
description: Nascor Descent is a first-person dark fantasy dungeon crawler with a grim atmosphere, fast-paced combat, and meaningful choices that will affect both the story and your gameplay.

title: False Testimony
description:
False Testimony is a story driven fantasy detective game focused on interrogation, logic, and deduction.
I am a detective. My job is to deal with situations that are convenient to blame on coincidence. Where there is no obvious crime, no confession, and no single place where "everything happened".

I visit different locations, talk to people, study the environment, and collect clues. Every conversation gives new information, every place adds details that need to be connected. No one lies outright, but everyone speaks from their own perspective, and I have to separate facts from interpretations.

There are no loud revelations or dramatic scenes in this work. The truth emerges gradually - from access, timing, sequences of actions, and small inconsistencies. To reach the right conclusion, I need to understand the full picture: who did it, how it was done, and what the motive was.

title: The Spectacular Evermore
description: Learn each room of the theatre, spot anomalies, and photograph them to restore the room. Keep your eyes open for anything unusual, from living statues to possessed paintings.

title: Room Zero
description: A first-person psychological mystery set in a liminal space that should not exist.

title: Hoofprints
description: A fairytale-like atmospheric game about a little foal lost in a dark forest. Find food, hide from the night, meet strange creatures, and slowly grow up - leaving hoofprints along your journey.

title: Checkmate: The Red General’s Last Move
description: Checkmate is a turn-based Xiangqi roguelite where a lone red general carries a cannon into a 9×10 battlefield. Move to reload, fire risky snap shots, aim for precision, and use enemy pieces as firing screens. Each upgrade also strengthens the opposing army.

title: Gorgeous Baby Bella
description: While her husband is away, Liora is forced to spend her days alone. But solitude is not as quiet as she thinks.

title: Shin'ai Rewritten
description: Run off to the Japanese countryside to connect with your Grandfather. Breathe new life into your grandmother's garden, and get to know the locals of a rural Japanese town in this cozy life sim rpg.

title: TCG Card Collection: Tidy Up
description: Organize and restore a special collection of 3,200 TCG cards. Clean each card and reveal their true glory. Match and sort them to sixteen themed sets. Turn a room full of chaos back to a collector's gallery.

title: Neon Breaker: Endless Arcade
description: Blast your way onto the leaderboards in a twin-stick arcade shooter built around rapid destruction, evasion, kill combos and overwhelming firepower. Fight escalating fleets, merge power-ups and face 20+ unique bosses solo or in co-op. Play roguelike Anomaly runs that stack risk-reward mutations.

title: Towertower
description: Stack. Mislead. Wipe them out. A punishing tower defense about building a fortress out of stacked blocks. Every tower is a weapon, a wall, and a piece of terrain that leads enemies astray. Let 50 through and it is over.

title: Deliwhere?
description: Run a chaotic air cargo business across floating islands in 1-4 player co-op or solo! Pick from 4 unique roles, board your flying platform, dodge incoming rockets and aerial mines, upgrade your hangar, and deliver packages to pay off your massive bank loan!

title: Hidden Raccoons in Winter
description: Hidden Raccoons in Winter is a cozy pixel art hidden object game! Search for adorable raccoons hidden across handcrafted winter landscapes. Relax, take your time, and find them all!

title: TV Station Tycoon
description: Build and manage your own TV station. License shows, create schedules, attract viewers, sell advertising, grow your audience, and compete for the top spot in the ratings in this broadcasting management tycoon.

title: Your Friends vs. Hidebehind
description: A co-op survival horror game for 1-6 players. Record your real scream and it plays back when it takes you. Explore a procedurally generated forest, deny it by facing the terror, and escape before the forest decides you're staying.

title: Wild Heroes: Fight Together
description: Team up with up to 3 friends in an online co-op action roguelite. Carve a path into the living Wild, battle monster packs in bramble arenas, topple three colossal bosses and come back stronger after every expedition.

title: Spook & Sell
description: Stage the haunt. Sell the house. You’re the world’s most desperate real-estate agents — hide the ghosts, mop the ectoplasm, and keep buyers calm in this chaotic 1–4 player co-op physics party game before the haunting meter tips over.

title: Rocket Factory
description: Roctket Factory is an incremental game with factory building elements. Players will build machines, manage workers, build assembly lines, and expand their factories in the game until they build rockets and move towards the next destination.

title: Hot Mic
description: A party game played with your voice, for 2 to 8 friends online. Give a museum bust a voice or do your best cockerel, then vote for a favourite before you find out who made it. Free to play. If anyone at the table has VIP, everyone gets the full game, your own pictures included.

title: Leverage Real Estate Simulator
description: Leverage Real Estate Simulator is an incremental clicker game. Play as an ambitious, ruthless property developer and expand your capital empire through a cycle of borrowing money, buying land, constructing and selling properties—all while stacking every form of leverage you can find.

title: Dumpster Diving Simulator
description: Dig through dumpsters, uncover hidden treasures and flip junk for profit on an open island. Sell scrap, win storage auctions, run a flea market stall, trade used cars, go live to your fans and rise from broke newcomer to Çamlıada's scavenging legend.

title: Special Case
description: You won't win a war as a one man army, But because you keep fighting you are still alive_Mohamed Mostafa Battle the Occupation with unique super powers! Destroy helicopters, drones, and armored vehicles. Explore "The Strip," protect its people, and rebuild a war-torn world. Welcome to Special Case

title: Potion Pantry
description: Restore a mysterious magical pantry through handcrafted logic puzzles. Follow the previous Keeper's notes, uncover what happened to them, and decide what it means when the pantry welcomes you home.

title: Potion Pantry: Sort the Apothecary
description: A cozy first-person sorting game set in a candlelit apothecary. Thousands of potions in every shape and color are scattered across the workshop you just inherited. Inspect bottles up close, climb ladders, and fill every shelf at your own pace.

title: Trash Party
description: Trash Party is an online co-op party game for up to four players. You and your friends are the garbage collectors of a colorful cartoon city: one player drives the truck while the others grab bags, throw them in and hang off the back to catch a ride. Sort trash into recycling, organic and glass compartments to earn points and extra time, run bulky items like sofas and fridges through the compactor, and clean the whole city to earn stars that unlock new levels on a world map hub. It can also be played solo.

title: Junkyard Astronauts
description: Scavenge a junkyard at night, weld the scrap into a rocket and press the big red button. Highest flight wins the shift. The Moon is 384,400 km up, and your fuel tank used to be a water heater. Online co-op for 14 robots, Mac and PC together.

title: Ladykiller in a Bind: Ladykiller Unleashed
description: The original lesbian ladykiller is back after ten years! Return as the Beast for a full run's worth of new Ladykiller in a Bind content, featuring new romances with brand new characters, threesomes with old love interests, and of course, the return of the IGF award-winning experimental choice system that you told all your friends was the real reason why you played the original game. Spread across 78 000 words, 14 new scenes, and six new sex scenes, Ladykiller Unleashed threatens a whole lot of new sexy trouble for the Beast to handle with her characteristic wink and smug grin.

title: Last Man Running
description: Last Man Running is a physics-based parkour party game in which players race across procedurally assembled rooftops while escaping a zombie horde. Players can tackle, grab and throw rivals in free-for-all or team elimination matches, cooperate to survive, or chase high scores solo. It supports local and online multiplayer, including mixed couch and remote players.

title: Memories of Magic
description:
Memories of Magic, formerly known as EvilQuest, is a browser-based MMORPG set in a dark fantasy world, built around old-school combat, skilling, quests, and character progression. With a retro online RPG feel, Memories of Magic invites players to create an adventurer, explore the world directly from the browser, and build their account through classic MMO activities. The game leans into familiar scapelike systems such as skill training, monster hunting, rankings, and persistent progression while wrapping it in a darker, more ominous fantasy atmosphere.

In Memories of Magic, players can train skills, fight enemies, complete quests, compare progress through hiscores, and explore a growing online world alongside other adventurers. For players who enjoy browser MMOs focused on gradual progression, skilling, combat, and community-driven discovery, Memories of Magic offers a fresh dark-fantasy take on the classic scapelike formula.

title: Bit-Broken Identity
description: Bit-Broken Identity is a psychological horror visual novel about escaping reality. A tempting part-time job. Just submit a form. What could go wrong?

title: Parrygon
description: Deflect energy orbs, land a perfect parry, and survive as the arena collapses around you. Take on 36 campaign missions, chase Steam high scores in endless Arcade, or challenge friends in local Versus for 2–4 players.

title: Nick vs. the Brick of Ick from space
description: Build an outrageous deck of alien cards and deploy them onto the battle field. Unleash game-breaking combos in this tactical roguelite deckbuilder.

title: Tainted Tide
description: The world is drowning, and the Tainted are evolving. Scavenge, upgrade your raft, and survive each passing day in this roguelite survival RPG. Master match-3 combat, dodge deadly attacks, craft powerful abilities, and fight to finish a mission humanity cannot afford to lose.

title: Undermoon
description: UnderMoon is a dark fantasy turn-based tactical roguelike RPG. Step through portals, plan your moves on a square grid, choose a race, and combine weapons and skills. Use fire, ice and lightning to shape battles, explore themed areas, face bosses and find a way out of this moonlit world.

title: Dribble Basket
description: Bounce your way to the basket in this physics-based basketball challenge. Master your dribble, overcome obstacles, and guide the ball to victory with nothing but timing and control.

title: Arctic Roll
description: Embark on a relaxing turn-based tactical roguelite adventure. Lead your team of explorers, face dangerous encounters, uncover mysterious artifacts, and unravel the secret behind a strange signal.

title: Inearth
description: A tactical turn-based roguelite with environmental interactions, spellcrafting, and deckbuilding. Descend into the Hollow Earth. As above, so below.

title: Cyberlife
description: CYBERLIFE is an online hacking game played through a terminal, in one world shared by every player. Break into companies, bring your loot back to your localhost, and take the crossroads every other operator has to go through.

title: Cloud JourneyVR
description: Discover the world through a magical travel book. YunYou uses Gaussian Splatting to bring real landscapes into immersive VR. Flip pages to explore stunning scenery, walk freely, and listen to cultural stories. Peaceful, beautiful, and deeply engaging.

title: Alembix TCG
description: Brew the periodic table into a card game. A free-to-play alchemical TCG where every creature is an element and every fusion is a real reaction.

title: One More Flight
description: One More Flight is a psychological horror game with dark humor, set on a plane trapped in a time loop. Die, learn, and find a way to break the loop.

title: Nutshot Simulator
description: Throw things at people. Aim low. Nutshot Simulator is a physics comedy set in Kumquat Cove, a perfectly ordinary town with a doctor's office, a church, a frat house and a moon base. Every hit gets a slow-motion replay, the town has a life of its own, and if you can see them, you can hit them.

title: Ambitious Mission After Episode 2
description: The hit visual novel "AMBITIOUS MISSION" is back! By popular demand, Lotte finally gets her very own love story! Now you can enjoy the romance with Lotte that the main game didn't have room for!

title: Drawmi: Terraform Sim
description: An alien planet terraforming sim where you can draw all of the plants, animals, and bugs that you use to make a thriving ecosystem.

title: Speed Card Eatery
description: Hurry!Hurry!I'm going to become a legendary card-stall master—right this second!

title: Legends of the Pitch
description: Football meets roguelike deckbuilding. Choose your nation, build your team, and combine cards in tactical battles. Upgrade your deck, explore branching paths, and defeat legendary bosses across five regions on your journey to football glory.

title: Escape The Zoo
description: You came to escape the zoo. Somehow, you're stealing a drink first. Escape The Zoo is an adventure for 1–4 players: climb out of the monkey enclosure, run from tigers and take a break for poop-ball games. Play solo or online with your crew.

title: Where Is My Sword
description: A mismatched duo—a wicked demon god and a kind-hearted fox girl—is gathering followers!? Travel across many lands and survive hectic yet strategic real-time battles by rummaging through your bag for just the right item! Fight your foes or turn them into followers... What awaits at journey's end?

title: Buitopia DVD
description: A short interactive DVD game. Today is Jess's Birthday! Can you find her a suitable gift? Just don't get distracted and forget about Jess. DVDs can't be cursed... right? Yeah it's fine.

title: Too Slow Again
description: Too Slow Again is a first-person shooter in which every level is a race against the clock. On each track the player has to eliminate every target, complete its objectives and reach the finish line as fast as possible: every hit taken adds two seconds, dying ends the run and restarts are instant, with nothing left to chance. Over 100 tracks are split into weapon circuits for the assault rifle, pistol, shotgun and sniper rifle, set in a bright, flooded white city where glass, screens, steam pipes and gas cans break and explode. Movement includes sprinting, sliding, vaulting, climbing, leaning, ziplines and rappelling.
