Bronze, silver and gold medals and a leaderboard on every track measure each run, weapons level up from 1 to 50 to unlock attachments, and the Duo and Squad circuits are built for online co-op with two and four players.

title: Click & Loot
description: Click & Loot is a short autobattle incremental clicker about looting dungeons. Level up, upgrade your gear and delve into the dungeons to pay off your ever increasing debt. And don't forget to renew your dungeon license!

title: Address The Mess
description: Address The Mess is a single-player narrative sim. Clean up the scattered post, use magic, solve puzzles, find props and assemble furniture. Unlock & use magic spells and be unstoppable, or relax and enjoy the narrative sim at your own pace, with a spirit doggo, cat and your friendly mail pigeon.

title: WhiskersOS: Click and Survive
description: Your family computer has been infected! In this survivor-like roguelite, battle through hordes of viruses using your desktop applications as weapons. Recover corrupted data to level up, then upgrade your apps and drivers to purge the infection for good.

title: Badass Brad
description: They killed your wife. They killed your dog. Now it's your turn to kill them in this fast paced roguelike!

title: Neofold: The Feast
description: Become the greatest cook by feeding your creatures customizable meals, and earn coins for satisfying their cravings. Discover thousands of recipes using ingredients spread across the world. Add a little Stardust to meals to finally be able to breed pets.

title: Last Core
description: Androids branched from the same AI fight to become the one true complete entity in this TPS battle royale. Defeat alone is not enough—extract exposed cores, learn, and awaken. Form temporary links, betray when the time comes, and survive the battlefield where only one core can remain.

title: Path//Hack
description: Step into the shoes of a Y2K network hacker in this deckbuilding roguelike. Evade the watchful eye of the network's security or get booted. Find your flow as you blind security nodes with cascading combos and turn the network's security defenses against itself.

title: Critters vs. Predators
description: The food chain is fighting back. Collect a squad of tiny garden critters, gear them up and send them against the foxes, snakes, hawks and cats that hunt them. A cozy, chaotic auto-battler RPG: fight on auto or call every move. No pay-to-win.

title: Aptacris: Dipolos Anomalia
description:
Anomalia is a puzzle adventure game set in a solarpunk dystopian world where memories become puzzle worlds

Switch between two perception states to reveal hidden paths, overcome shifting obstacles, and solve puzzles within fractured memories.

Play as Ai'Lynn, a scientist capable of entering and manipulating memories, as she searches for a mysterious fragment hidden deep within her own mind.

title: Pixel Solo Ops
description: Pixel Solo Ops is a retro-inspired 2D action-platformer. After a covert mission goes wrong, your closest comrade is captured by a ruthless military faction. Fight through enemy troops, infiltrate fortified bases, and survive intense pixel-art firefights to rescue him. With tight gunplay, fast-paced challenges, and nostalgic visuals, you’re the last hope. One soldier. One mission. No backup.

title: Please, Tell Me Why?
description: You live alone. Or so you think. Stream live. Explore your apartment. Talk to your viewers. Everything seems normal… until the little details stop making sense. A first-person psychological horror film about identity, isolation, and the terrifying price of facing the truth.

title: Manus Sors
description: A puzzle and mystical horror game in which Grandma's cozy house hides dark family secrets. Explore every room, solve the puzzles, and stay alert: every detail counts here!

title: Silver Service
description: Silver Service is a cozy tidying game where you put 11,132 portions back where they belong aboard a cruise liner, solo or with up to 3 friends. Fill your tray, find the right display, unlock upgrades, and to unwind, grab your fishing rod and see what’s hiding under the water.

title: Escape: The Cabin
description: Trapped, alone, and hunted by a captor who knows your past. Solve twisted puzzles, uncover the truth, and escape before the cabin breaks you. With 70+ randomised puzzles and solutions, every nightmare changes as you fight to get back to your family.

title: Eldwyn's Dungeon Academy
description: Eldwyn's Dungeon Academy is a human made top-down action-adventure game where you explore magical dungeons, fight monsters, overcome traps, solve puzzles, and find hidden treasures. What grade will you get?

title: Golden Trivia Show
description: Golden Trivia Show is a quiz game presented as a TV show that can be played solo or cooperatively with friends online (up to 4 players). You start with a pile of gold bars and need to avoid losing them. Each question has 4 possible answers, and you can choose to divide your gold bars among them. Only the gold bars placed on the correct answer will remain with you; the rest will fall into a pool filled with piranhas. If you manage to make it to the end and win some gold, you can spend it on cosmetics.

title: Labyrinth of Doom
description: A dark fantasy multiplayer dungeon crawler with real-time combat fully playable solo against challenging AI bots. Fight, scavenge, and outwit rivals in procedurally generated labyrinths Battle Royale or Co-op, up to 10 players, with legendary artifacts drawn from world mythology.

title: Feet in Food
description: What could possibly be better than food? That's right! Feet in food! LOTS OF FEET! Create food arrangements around the girls, then wash their feet clean of all the food and sauces afterward. You wouldn't want them to stay dirty, would you?

title: Make the World Great Again
description: Infiltrate a private island where the elite meet, and every room, every piece of paper and every locked cabin hides something or someone they paid a great deal to bury. Uncover every secret and escape before they catch you.

title: Sack Investigation
description: Sack Investigation an online multiplayer co-op casual puzzle platforming game. Join with up to 7 of your friends to explore and investigate the innerworkings of a magical and whimsical wizard tower. Find and destroy the cursed objects to progress and upgrade your Sack.

title: Demon Rising
description: Rule as the Demon Lord in a dark fantasy roguelike auto-battler. Recruit AI-driven demons who talk back, build deadly class synergies, equip relics, and survive brutal heroes, bosses, and events.

title: Beatrice
description: You are sent to inspect an old abandoned estate before its demolition. Locals refuse to speak about the place, only whispering of a doll named Beatrice left behind. Uncover the horrible events that took place chapter by chapter, solve the mysteries, and find a way to escape. Are you brave enough?

title: Stellacore Defense
description: A 2D pixel art tower defense game with unparalleled strategic depth. Deploy modules to redirect enemies, use tactical chips to command the battlefield, and upgrade towers with multi-branch modifications to protect humanity's vital Stellacore energy.

title: Black Market Space Station Shop Simulator
description: Newly released from prison, you've been sent to a distant space station to manage a general store. This is your last chance at redemption and the authorities are watching. Can you keep your nose clean and still earn a profit in this trading simulator?

title: Flipocalypse
description: One button flips the world upside down. Race, dodge and outlast up to 8 players across seven party modes in a neon city that never stops trying to kill you. Run the walls. Sprint the ceiling. Last one standing wins.

title: Unedited Footage: The Abandoned Factory
description: YouTuber Junho enters an abandoned factory at night to film his next video. The footage from that night is never uploaded. Explore the dark, three-story factory, complete the shoot, and uncover its secrets in this first-person psychological horror game.

title: The Hollow Road: Echoes of Dresden
description: A first-person psychological horror game about a dark secret, a hidden past, and a reality falling apart. Uncover Clara’s story, face the influence of the demon, and shift between disturbing dimensions.

title: Beat Ten
description: Rhythm action sandbox that lets you use your local audio files or streaming apps to fuel the Beat!

title: Desktop Monkey
description: A challenging game where you fight for the best places on Steam Leaderboards. A funny little Monkey living on your screen will prepare you for everything.

title: La Gran Aventura de David Santiso
description: Point-and-click adventure in the classic Sierra/LucasArts style, packed with Spanish humor and satire of the paranormal subculture. Verbal duels against believers, two full arcade minigames hidden inside. Spanish audio and text only.

title: Chief? About That File...
description: Step into an atmospheric 1990s police archive. Inspect, classify, and organize 3,360 unique criminal dossiers, crack safes, and uncover crime syndicates in this immersive first-person archival detective simulator.

title: All haul the king
description: A co-op game where you and your friends embark on an epic journey to drag the goblin king’s dead body across the kingdom to resurrect him. Use brains, brawn and crazy goblin magic to navigate the tricky terrain and puzzles that lie in your path.

title: Outclassed
description: Outclassed is an arcade dungeon crawler roguelite where you combine unique class abilities to clear an expansive dungeon. Level up, collect items, and create powerful synergies to become truly outclassed!

title: Folding Dungeon
description: Folding Dungeon is a grid-based puzzle game where you fold and connect space to carve out a path. Reshape the map's structure yourself to avoid monsters and descend to the bottom of the dungeon.

title: StarCalibur
description: A brutal interstellar war is raging. Humanity has been forced to abandon much of the explored galaxy to a mysterious alien race. The aliens continue to hold the initiative on the front lines, while their motives and ultimate goals remain unknown.

title: Rent Due
description: Every door in this town owes you money. Buy homes, furnish them, screen tenants face to face, and knock on doors when the rent comes due. Answer the phone, evict with grounds, and outrun the bank's weekly cut, all in first person. The rent is due. Go get it.

title: Drazy and the Puppets JB
description: Work the night shift at a cursed party center where every task builds tension. Survive murderous puppets, mysterious entities, and a calm but relentless nightmare as you uncover a story hidden beneath forgotten secrets.

title: Last Lawn Standing
description: Shape enemy paths with towers and barricades, then fight alongside your defenses as a garden gnome armed with auto-firing weapons and powerful potions. Protect bonus-granting shrines, upgrade without limits, unlock permanent rewards, and survive solo or in 4-player local co-op.

title: Element Idle
description: Click the atom, earn particles, evolve through all 118 elements of the periodic table. A free idle/clicker game with a deep skill tree, prestige system, and Steam achievements.

title: Typing with Ghostie
description: A cute little Ghostie game that helps you type!

title: Patients
description: Psychological horror with a retro atmosphere,solo or co-op experience for 2 or more players,Inventory and, resource management, interactive and explorable environment, unpredictable events

title: Chrono Cards
description: Chrono Cards is a digital PVP card game that puts you in the role of a time traveler, summoning cards from across history and manipulating time itself to triumph over your opponent. The game is built around its unique Timeline mechanic which splits the board into Past, Present, and Future regions that move on every turn, forcing players to carefully plan ahead and adapt to a constantly evolving board state.

title: Hardcore Yet Laid-Back Hero Battle: Kamuikko-tan Passionate Edition!?
description: Kamuikko-tan is stranded on a mysterious island and dragged into another absurd hero battle—only to discover that the enemy leader looks exactly like the man she once killed. Has the dead man returned, or is something far more sinister hiding behind his identity?

title: Legends Of Glory
description: Legends of Glory – The Gladiator Action Game! Fight against computer opponents or real players in the arena, destroy crates, and collect silver or gold to upgrade your equipment. Level up your hero and reach the top league!

title: Next time... I'll work from home
description: Eric Stokes, a 27-year-old office clerk, finally found a new job after a long unemployment. As a new father, he eagerly starts his new job, but quickly finds that something about this office is off.

title: Magenta Down
description: You and your crew have crashed and are now scattered across the surface of a harsh, remote exoplanet. With limited supplies and surrounded by hostile terrain, can you find your crew and escape?

title: Love is a Roguelite
description: A turn-based tactical deck-building roguelite where heartbreak makes you stronger. Craft absurd card synergies, outsmart procedural dungeons, and romance your partner across a fracturing timeloop to restore their lost memories—one run at a time.

title: Waveling Island
description: Waveling Island is a Creature-Collecting Sim that takes place on a beautiful, hand-drawn pixelart island full of mysterious creatures called Wavelings. Catch, train and battle these creatures in order to complete quests, gather materials, and make a stake in this new tropical home of yours.

title: Dirtborn: Colony Rising
description: Ants are fascinating insects, and they have taught mankind what the power of teamwork can accomplish. Develop your own colony of ants, dig every tunnel, and protect your queen from the numerous enemies you'll encounter! No two games will ever be the same and online PvP ensures fun to the thorax!

title: Rustown
description: Five years after the idiot virus pandemic, a letter arrives from the father you thought was dead. Rustown is a story-driven stealth adventure about finding him in a slum where the infected live. Evade watchful eyes, follow clues, and discover the stories of those caught up in the city's troubles.

title: 23 Days
description: Trapped within an ancient darkness, Alex faces an unknown force that knows him better than he knows himself. 23 Days is a first-person psychological atmospheric adventure about survival, choice, and the price of escape. Each day here is a step toward freedom… or a step into the void.

title: 72 Seconds
description: 72 Seconds is a fast-paced isometric action RTS where tactical squad micro meets ARPG progression. Command specialized units, build defenses, upgrade skill trees, and battle hostile alien threats. Adapt to randomized enemy affixes and survive high-stakes campaign permadeath.

title: Idle Legions
description: Your legion fights on its own, even with the game closed. Five heroes, five acts and bosses with their own mechanics. Forge your gear, raise pets, test your build against other players, and go down into the Abyss for what drops nowhere else.

title: Moving Oasis
description: Moving Oasis is a single-player, top-down game about restoring a world overrun by living black goo. Players drive a water tank, wash away the goo, restore vegetation, rescue animals, and awaken fungal cities connected by mycelium. The game features a story campaign and an Endless mode.

title: Sawad
description:
In Sawad, you and your friends are content creators desperate for FAME and subscribers.

Break into haunted locations, eliminate whatever is there.

Hidden CCTVs record it all. Make the clips go viral and get filthy rich!

The only catch? You must survive long enough to hit upload.

title: Drainbound
description: You are Drainbound, it is your time. A roguelike adventure where you must fight, suffer and sever to discover your true destination.

title: Chodd
description: The council of gods has no ruler, and you intend to keep it that way. A difficult coop roguelike: march your warp core across a hostile world, command your goons in real time, and play scheming gods against each other so none grow strong enough to stop you.

title: Idle Slots: Casino HQ
description: Ever wanted to build a casino empire without the risk of actual luck? Start with a single Penny Slot and click your way to a multi-trillion-dollar galactic syndicate! Automate your floor, exploit corporate synergies, and sell the whole lot for a profit in this dangerously addictive idle clicker.

title: Cat Eats Sushi
description: Place sushi to guide a sushi-loving cat in this unique puzzle game.

title: Scrappers Paradise
description: A physics based incremental game about scrapping junk to collect scrap and components. Build machines and buy powerful upgrades to become more efficient.

title: Picofender
description: Picofender is an incremental defense action game where you guide a hero with your cursor and defend a village with automated allies. Defeat monsters, earn gold, upgrade skills, gear, and active abilities, then push through escalating waves toward the Demon Lord.

title: Romul
description: Romul is a co-op looting horror game. Together with a voice-controlled robot with early-stage AI, explore abandoned space stations with unstable gravity and use it to your advantage. Survive among monsters and extract valuable cargo.

title: Lanelord
description: You ever wanted to feel how a road feels? Now you can! Either team up with a car or try to shake it of. Solo and Multiplayer fun guaranteed!

title: Fantasy Idle RPG
description: From the solo developer of Idle Trillionaire, set in a world of knights, dragons, dungeons, and magic. Purchase cards to earn gold and experience, unlock new quests, and watch your character grow. Every card is hand written with a touch of the developers signature humor.

title: Dive Log: A Focus Voyage
description: Dive Log is an idle treasure-hunting game driven by a pomodoro timer: every stretch of focus becomes a deep-sea voyage. Collect treasures, upgrade your submarine and hunt the relic hidden in each sea. Play your own music and ambience, and design the sea's treasures to share with other captains.

title: Lintbreakers: Night Shift
description: Survive a haunted laundromat in a top-down bullet-heaven roguelite. Move, dodge, collect lint sparks, build automatic cleaning tools, evolve weapons, defeat machine bosses, and spend quarters to make every night shift last longer.

title: Skysunder
description: An auto-battler fought on floating isles. Draft from 64 units across 8 races, kit them with over 60 relics, item upgrades, and unique unit modifiers called imprints! Strategize by giving every squadron its orders, and casting spells in real-time to change the battle!

title: Animal Mystery: 100 Hidden Cats
description: Animal Mystery: 100 Hidden Cats is a hidden object game where you race against time to find 100 cats hidden across the world's most iconic locations. Spot the cats, click carefully, use hints wisely, and climb to the top of the global leaderboard.

title: Tax Empire
description: Build your own Tax Empire! Collect taxes, expand your city, hire tax officers, control traffic, enact new policies and squeeze out as much revenue as you can on your road to riches.

title: You Must Sleep: Ravenous Nightmares
description: You must sleep is a First-Person Single-Player Survival Horror game in which you play as John, a man tormented by entities that appear whenever he tries to sleep. Manage your personal needs, stay alert for monsters, and hide when necessary to make it through the night.

title: Idle Necronomics
description: Incremental Idle Souls Gambling Investing Clicker. You are the Necromancer. Reap the living, turn their Souls into supernatural capital, and build an undead operation that keeps the harvest going around the clock.

title: Kritsana
description: A Thai anomaly-spotting horror game. In 1997, a man swore something was in his house. His psychiatrist said no. Now the case is yours. Go through his old CCTV tapes, report every anomaly, and figure out why this case never made sense.

title: Medieval Bust
description: Assemble a party of powerful heroes, create devastating synergies, and battle through relentless hordes in this fast-paced auto-battler roguelite.

title: Halloween Pumpkin Simulator
description: Become a pumpkin on Halloween night! Absolute zen, midnight melancholy, and zero fuss. The perfect evening plan!

title: Rogue Links
description: Drive the ball. Fight your way to it. Rogue Links is a top-down action roguelite where every shot is a tradeoff: longer drives save strokes but unleash more monsters. Play the Campaign, Onslaught, the Endless Gauntlet, Daily runs and Head-to-Head, or build and share your own courses.

title: Paladin HC
description: Command a 3D Paladin self-propelled howitzer in scenarios based on real military operations. Calculate firing range, adjust your tactical position, manage resources, and support your allies.

title: My Little Empire: Cyber Lounge
description: Build your own computer club from an empty lot: rows of gaming PCs, console and VR corners, a bar and a kitchen. Hire staff, keep gamers happy, deal with 21 city factions — and don't forget to pet Luna, the club cat.

title: Trash to Cash
description: Trash to Cash a satisfying, surprising incremental trash-diving game. Rummage for treasure, and maybe you'll become the next Trash King!

title: Monmusu Rush
description: A roguelite deck-building auto battler where you gather Monmusu and fight. Place your team and battles play out automatically, and allies left off the field charge in with a Rush! Also includes Auto Battle Rush, an asynchronous PvP mode against other players' teams. One run takes 1560 minutes.

title: Scentkeeper: Tidy Up the Perfume Archive!
description: Scentkeeper: Tidy Up the Perfume Archive! is a first-person organizing game set in a two-floor perfume archive containing 3,240 bottles. Players inspect bottle labels, locate the correct shelves using an archive map, and complete collections that illuminate cabinets and fragrance-family signs. The game supports solo play and two-player online co-op. Its four modes are Cozy, Speedrun, Duo, and Hardcore. Cozy mode includes unlockable carrying, movement, and search skills, while Hardcore adds breakable bottles and time penalties.

title: Tropic Industry
description: Build your tropical industry. Grow, process, and export resources — from simple plantations to complex production chains. Optimize logistics, increase efficiency, and grow your business into a global export network.

title: Cluemates
description: A co-op puzzle game where you and your friends explore maps, search for clues, and try to crack a hidden color sequence. Half the clues are fake. All of your friends will be wrong. Good luck.

title: Under Investigation
description:
Investigate strange phenomena, use your camera to determine whether they are real anomalies or unstable phenomena, and keep the station from falling into darkness. Every use of your camera drains its energy faster, bringing you closer to danger.

Can you identify every anomaly before it's too late?

Under Investigation is a first-person horror game about investigating strange phenomena and identifying anomalies.

title: Historiker
description: You have inherited a train station from a family that never mentioned it. Walk its platforms into Berlin, Paris, New York and Hong Kong across the last century, and learn how a single clue found in one decade rewrites the meaning of another.

title: Better World
description: Seven evenings in one house. A tired father, five kids, a wife who counts his pills. Take one every evening and everything is lovely — until the walls start writing back. A short PS1-style psychological horror story. Two endings. What did you do, Arthur?

title: Pit Purge
description: An online co-op horror game for up to 4 players. In the pit, the creatures are the loot. Hunt them or capture them alive, then send them up to get paid.

title: Bathroom Please!
description: You really, really need the toilet, and you only have so many steps to get there. A comedy puzzle adventure where every step counts, every accident is your fault, and every level hides absurd endings.

title: Pickie Grappy
description: A satisfying claw-machine arcade sim where every click counts. Time your grabs, chase rare prizes, and get rich by catching every satisfying item.

title: Cutset
description: Cut pipes and close valves until no route from source to sink survives. 80 industrial puzzles, each with one unique, provably optimal shutoff and exactly enough torch fuel to match it. No partial credit. One-time purchase. No in-app purchases, no ads, no internet required.

title: Tidy Arcana
description: Tidy Arcana is a cozy first person organizing game about restoring a magical library. Return 1,312 numbered books and 248 potions to their matching shelves, working at your own pace with help from a customizable wizard cat.

title: Idle Demon Lord II
description: Idle Demon Lord II combines idle progression with dark fantasy loot hunting. Fight automatically and earn rewards offline. Choose from five classes, each with unique skills and mechanics. Hunt six tiers of gear, customize affixes, gems, runes, and Legendary Powers, and build your endgame character.

title: The Attending
description:
The Attending is a medical management sim about running one night shift in an emergency department. You manage the board, assign patients to doctors, review cases, and sign the decisions that send people home or upstairs.

Built around diagnosis, trust, and quick judgment, the game puts you in charge of a shifting stream of patients and dilemmas, with each procedurally generated shift playing out as a tense race to keep the department moving.

title: Dungeon Cleared!
description: Pick four heroes and enter the dungeon. Hopefully four come back. The rules are simple. The dungeon maybe not. Position your party, manage spells, avoid traps and survive ten procedural levels of old-school turn-based tactics—one short adventure and one questionable decision at a time.

title: Hospital Rhapsody
description: Build your hospital and form special bonds. From daily management to private moments, discover their stories amid the bustle of work. As trust and affection grow, uncover another side beneath the white coat…

title: Field Surgeon
description: Scrub in as the field surgeon of a city at war. Draw arrows from bone, close sabre cuts, cut soldiers out of their armour and saw off what cannot be saved, on humans, dwarves, elves, orcs, hornfolk and giants. Then face eight plagues a heretic choir has sung into your patients.

title: Woks & Works
description: Build and automate your restaurant empire. Manage chefs, customers, supplies, and production chains in a living food economy.

title: Cure The Dead
description: Run a pharmacy for the infected. Stock medical supplies, diagnose zombie customers and craft cures to sell or trade. Hire customers with useful skills, assign them roles, unlock new resources and upgrade your pharmacy through a growing skill tree.

title: Bastion Rivals
description: Bastion Rivals is a fantasy strategy game in which players control a builder, develop an economy and construct buildings that produce troops automatically. Armies move and fight across two lanes toward the opposing stronghold. Four factions provide different units, structures and counters, with spells, items and upgrades supporting army composition. The game includes solo battles against AI; ranked and unranked online modes are planned for launch.

title: Brain Bomb
description: Concepts are bombs. Association is death. An cult-like anti-utopian psychological horror puzzle game. The subject has a concept bomb implanted in brain. If a subject thinks of the [Fuse Word], their head detonates. You, as the "cognitive bomb defuser", dismantling the deadly "brain bomb".

title: My Lovely Nurse
description: Spend ten nights in the hospital with the mysterious nurse Lilith. Make choices, complete sensual mini-games, unlock explicit artwork, and watch professional distance turn into mutual desire. Adults only.

title: A Healer's Almanac
description: A cozy pixel-art life sim inspired by traditional Chinese medicine. Grow medicinal herbs, examine symptoms, read the pulse, diagnose patterns, craft remedies, and care for a village through four seasons and the twenty-four solar terms.

title: Applied Shamanism
description: A cozy 3D game about a rookie rabbit shaman. Diagnose quirky illnesses with X-ray spirit vision, gather and grow elemental ingredients, and brew always-useful potions. Each patient is a bite-size mystery of folk ailments and guardian spirits, with no combat, damage, or timers.

title: Menthal
description: Menthal is a first-person horror game where you are the test subject. Take experimental medicine, endure the side effects, and try to survive what happens next.

title: Glob & the Missing Globbies
description: Glob & the Missing Globbies is a handcrafted 2D platformer. Glob has lost the Globbies, and to get them back Glob must jump, bounce and squash through multiple worlds: stomp bugs, dodge birds and fight big bosses, while tracking down extra hidden Globbies, treasure crystals and secret spots in every level. Play solo or in local co-op for up to four players (team up, share hearts and revive your partner), or go head to head in local versus mode. Supports keyboard and gamepad with fully remappable controls.

title: Pokémon World Frontier
description: A Pokémon Fangame where you revive the Battle Frontier challenge. Battle in quick matches in an island full of different challenges and aim to be a Pokémon Master!

title: Eventlocation Simulator
description:
Build your own club. Run the night. Deal with the chaos.
Turn an empty venue into a thriving nightlife destination. Design your interiors, install lighting and sound systems, hire staff, stock the bar, serve drinks, and organize everything from club nights and concerts to poker tournaments, bot fights, and boxing events.
Outside your doors, explore a strange city filled with eccentric characters, side jobs, minigames, and secrets. Earn money, make questionable decisions, and try to keep your business—and yourself—in one piece.

title: Manual Teller Machine
description: In this office simulator, you play as an employee hiding behind an ATM, taking care of all the tasks assigned by your manager. Complete quests to unlock rewards and even get a raise! Manage your daily diet, maintain your body shape, and treat yourself with your paycheck.

title: A Noble Steed
description: A Noble Steed is an old-school style "horse game" RPG set in a post-apocalyptic medieval world. It features horse breeding, zombies, freely building your farm, a village full of shops to upgrade over time, and is powered by a random encounter system so every playthrough is different.

title: Kill or Be Killed
description: Kill or Be Killed is a fast-paced action combat game where deadly combos and quick thinking decide who survives. Outsmart your opponents, punish their mistakes, and master your next move in multiplayer PvP or sharpen your skills solo against bots.

title: Age Breaker
description: Mine gold, train an army and evolve your fortress from bone clubs to plasma blades in this one-lane strategy game. Lead four peoples and eight Leaders through a 36-battle campaign with boss fights, or set up your own skirmish on six maps.

title: Who Heckled?
description: Heckle, hide & hope you don't get caught. Who Heckled? is a 2-8 player online social deduction party game set in a comedy club. Sit among the crowd, heckle whoever's performing on stage with iconic memes, then blend back in. Get spotted and you're out. Grab your friends and figure out Who Heckled?

title: Alderun
description:
Alderun is a free-to-play fantasy strategy RPG that blends real-time strategy with MOBA-style hero combat. Players choose a hero, such as a holy knight, a dark summoner, or a marksman with a wolf companion, then level up, learn skills, and buy gear from merchants while leading an army across a variety of battlegrounds.

Solo modes include defending a fortress against waves of enemies and bosses, building towers to stop an enemy advance, and one-on-one duels in the Arena. In 5v5 matches, teams push three lanes toward the enemy citadel, farm creep camps, and contest a pit boss and runes. Large-scale 10v10 and 20-player battles take place in a frozen valley, where teams capture graveyards and bunkers to push their front line forward.

Matches can be played against AI or real players, with cross-platform multiplayer across PC, mobile, and browser. Players can host public or private games, join friends by code, or use quick match. A map editor is also included.

title: Abdication
description: Fight through this corrupted monarchy in order to take the king's power and the crown, and destroy it to free the kingdom, all with a yoyo. It's too powerful to let anyone else wield it, so protect it at all costs!

title: Cinderwake
description: Cinderwake is a dark action RPG with click-to-move combat, deep loot and five classes with their own skill trees: the Arcanist, Ravager, Huntress, Gravecaller and Oathsworn. Players fight through acts of randomly generated maps alone or in online co-op with up to 8 players. Items have random affixes, sockets, runes and sets. Every hero has a pet fox that picks up loot and sells the junk in town. After the story come harder world levels and an endless endgame dungeon.

title: Abyss Forge
description: Abyss Forge is a sci-fi match-and-merge roguelike set in deep space. Move tiles, create matches, merge modules, gather fuel, efficiency, research, and other resources, then shape your build through random upgrades as you push your ship deeper into unknown sectors.

title: Minimal AI Build Shop 24-26
description: Run a tiny build-to-order shop, read the emails, and put together just the right machine. A cozy, lightweight pixel-art shop sim.

title: Nexus: Eternal Ruin
description: Chosen by the gods, fight to save the universe in this survivor-like bullet heaven. Complete objectives, slay endless hordes, collect their souls and unlock new abilities on your way to each world's final boss. Play solo or with up to three friends in online co-op.

title: Gobble Inn
description: Gobble Inn is a soothing, relaxing roguelike with no fail states. Use powerful tools to dig deep for delicious, rare foodstuffs. Eat dishes to power up. Experiment with builds that help you explore the Chasm. Fill your pack with food and cursèd trinkets, and keep the inn supplied with ingredients!

title: Whiskers of Yesterday
description: You're a cat, and the whole house is yours. Bring up to 7 friends: knock plates off the table, play cat football in the garden, swim in the pool, or curl up together in a sunbeam. No timers, no fail states. Just a warm place to be.

title: Smawverse
description: Smawverse is a dark fantasy bullet-heaven roguelite. The player controls Smaw, a stray cat reforged in iron, fighting through escalating hordes of undead in a fallen kingdom whose streets are laid out differently on every run. Weapons attack automatically while the player moves, and blessings from nine elemental prophets are chosen on level-up and stacked into builds. Between runs, progress is spent in a hideout on a prophet skill tree, weapon mastery, gear and capes. Built in Unreal Engine 5.

title: Anubis: Wrath of the Underworld
description: Action-RPG Top-down view of Anubis in the Egyptian afterlife: fast melee combat, dashes, relics, and battles with hordes of the dead and ancient gods.

title: Reunion Fate
description: Reunion Fate is a psychological horror game where terror lurks in the places you think are safe. Use the flame to guide you through the darkness. Explore familiar and unfamiliar places. Hide from them. No one will tell you what you want to hear.

title: Capsule Arcade
description: A cozy first-person tidying game in a neon capsule-toy arcade. Crack open capsules, sort 216 cute figures into their display cases and bring six dark floors of Hoshizora Capsule Hall back to life, one glowing machine at a time.

title: Puzzle Arrows: The Original
description:
One click. One direction. The right order

Arrow Puzzle is a calm single-player puzzle game about clearing crowded boards one arrow at a time. Click any part of an arrow to launch it toward its head. If the route is clear, it leaves the board. If another arrow blocks the way, you lose a life, and it returns. To solve each level, study which arrows block one another, choose the right sequence, and think several moves ahead.

title: Loop Dungeon: Incremental
description: A short incremental dungeon RPG with a finite campaign. Unlock heroes, gather resources, upgrade your party, and reset progress for prestige rewards. Heroes fight automatically, but skills and upgrades need your input—not a fully hands-off idle game.

title: Block Battlefield
description: Block Battlefield is a light Roguelike game that combines real-time falling blocks with auto-battler combat. By clearing blocks, you can deploy soldiers, choose random upgrades, and break through enemy fortresses. Build your block army and push your limits on an ever-changing battlefield!

title: Cursed Castle
description: This is a psychological horror game steeped in oppressive atmosphere. Players must control Daniel as he races against time to protect his companions, gather clues and items, while evading Victor's relentless pursuit and the curse of the colossal face-shaped boulder.

title: GemCremental
description: Craft a variety of gems and become the greatest witch! It's a cozy incremental crafting game.

title: Dice Sort Together: Arcane Hall
description: A cozy first-person tidy up and organizing simulator where you sort 4,400+ fantasy dice and tabletop pieces. Solo or online co-op with up to 4 players, restore the Arcane Hall's 9 departments through relaxing, satisfying ASMR dice sounds and magic skills - no time limit.

title: Dying Patience
description: For years, you cared for your mother until her illness began to destroy your life. Her weak voice, her exhausted appearance, her fading consciousness... Are you willing to keep enduring this?

title: Paint the World
description: A casual, first-person painting simulator with multiplayer, timelapse, and unlockable colors, tools and worlds!

title: Habitat: The Endless Terrarium
description: Build living habitats on a clay tabletop world. Draft animals, shape the land they need, and watch your terrarium fill with life through the turning seasons. A strategy game without stress — deep enough to master, calm enough to unwind with. Alone or with up to 4 friends.

title: VPet Sort Together: Cozy Tidy Up
description: A cozy organizing sim for 14 players: sort 9,600+ virtual pet toys egg keychains, boxed pets, watches, rings and more onto the shelves of a pastel VPet shop. Toss, stack and tidy up the chaos together, unlock skills and perks, no timer.

title: Frog Garden
description: Grow a garden with friends or strangers. Plant flowers, decorate your patch, collect hats, and occasionally swallow or cast spells on your gardening partners.

title: Jumppass
description: Jump down, collect bananas, and survive as long as possible in this fast-paced 2D casual game.

title: Cloud Patrol
description: Fly across floating islands, hold off swarming drones, and face down three colossal bosses. Earn coins, unlock stronger firepower, and climb the endless Ascension ladder. This sky is yours to guard. Dive into a fast, exhilarating wave-based first-person aerial shooter.

title: Draft Day Sports: Pro Football 2025
description: Draft Day Sports: Pro Football 2025 puts you in the role of general manager of your favorite football team. Every decision can be made by you from drafting, trading, signing free agents right down to creating and calling your own plays to lead your team to championship glory and becoming a dynasty.

title: Death City
description: Death City is the story of Loy, a protagonist trying to overcome his fate as he repeatedly faces death amidst a world in the grip of a zombie apocalypse. Solve various puzzles, defeat enemies with firearms, and experience multiple endings based on your choices.

title: Know Your Ánima
description: A cozy farming sim with a mystical, introspective soul. Tend your inner garden over a 12-day cycle, make choices and bond with the spirit animals who visit you. Everything you do, and everything you don't, reveals your personality through your dominant Ánimas. Do you dare to know yourself?

title: Dark Rally
description: Face extreme terrains and unpredictable challenges in the ultimate off-road experience. Ride bikes, quads, cars, SxS, and trucks across intense rally stages where skill, courage, and precision define the true champion.

title: Zombie Cropse
description: Zombie Cropse is a cozy gothic idle management game where you plant zombie seeds to grow zombies, automate your graveyard, and raid the living. Build your horde, conquer a branching campaign, and ascend to begin again with permanent power.

title: Dugout Dice
description: Step up to the plate in Dugout Dice, where classic dice combos meet roguelike baseball strategy! Roll Full Houses and Four-of-a-Kinds to drive in runs, conquer innings, and build unstoppable synergy with fan boosts and careful strategy on your journey to beat the odds and win the World Series.

title: Emojis vs. Zombies
description: Emojis vs Zombies is an Idle Desktop Companion Zombie Defense Game! Open packs, Collect Emoji Defenders, Upgrade your squad or base and survive endless waves even while you're AFK or working!

title: Director, Please Give More Guidance
description: "Director, Please Give More Guidance" is the world's first director simulator on Steam. You will become a director, going through a series of processes from casting to exploring the inner world of actors, exerting every effort to create a perfect work. Six women with different personalities will bring changes to your movie career. Director, please give more guidance.

title: Pointless Climb
description: Escape an impossible abyss as Ilia Movahed in a brutal, parkour climber. Execute precision vaults, wall climbs, and high stakes jumps to reach the summit. There are no checkpoints. one simple mistake will send you tumbling back to the start.

title: Night Concierge
description: Night Concierge is a short first-person horror game with a retro PSX look, set in a Soviet-style apartment block in November 2003. The player works the night shift as a concierge: residents come home one by one, and the task is to let them in while keeping out the "others" — impostors who only pretend to be residents. To decide, the player uses lobby security cameras (including a mirror that does not always show what it should), a video intercom for questioning visitors, a resident logbook with photos and apartment numbers, and a phone for calling apartments to check who is already home. The campaign spans five nights and an epilogue with several endings. An optional streamer mode connects to Twitch chat, letting viewers vote on whether to open the door and trigger events during the shift.

title: CyberBot: Zero
description:
Jump, hack, and escape the facility!
Solve system puzzles and survive dangerous laser traps in CyberBot — a charming 2D pixel art platformer where your mission is to override the security networks and find your way out.

title: Westward Dash
description: Relive the childhood board game of Journey to the West. An ink-wash race for 1-8 players. Roll your dice to avoid peril on every space! One staff to sweep demons aside, one dash die to turn the race on its head. Solo or with friends: nothing is settled until the very last space!

title: Timberworks
description: Timberworks is an incremental factory automation and management game. Start with a small sawmill, automate production, expand your railway network, and build a vast industrial empire.

title: Good President Simulator
description: A satirical political simulation played from a first-person desk. The player runs for office and signs laws by hand, while fifteen factions react to every decision and the next day's newspaper reports on what was signed. Visitors bring favours, gifts and offers, and each law pleases some factions and angers others.

title: Can 'Em All
description: A juicy first-person incremental game about turning cute creatures into cans. Kill them, collect their bodies, can them, and sell them. Make money, upgrade your weapons and machines, and produce more and more.

title: Formula Z: Controlled Dose
description:
Formula Z: Controlled Dose is a first-person open-world pharmacy simulation game where you start as a pharmacist, manage your own pharmacy, serve customers, and grow your pharmaceutical business.

Expand into factories, manufacture medications, purchase properties, and explore a large open world filled with activities, vehicles, and business opportunities.

Travel between four different eras: the modern world, medieval 1419, post-apocalyptic 2049, and futuristic 2079. Each era features unique environments, pharmacies, factories, medications, and opportunities.

title: Street Value
description: You owe the Shark, and you have thirty days. Deal across seven gritty New York neighborhoods with one deck: Hustle cards bend the market; Street cards shake the cops. Take turf from rival crews, survive Collection Day, then risk it all for one more week!

title: Aesthoria: Beyond the Realm
description: A monster-collector tactical JRPG inspired from Digimon World 2, where you summon, train, evolve, and command mysterious Aesther through grid-based battles and dangerous expeditions into the shifting realm of Vanadis.

title: Dark Pixel
description: A stylized retro inspired platformer. Fight for creativity against an A.I. threatening your beloved art application. Use a unique collection of art tool inspired power-ups to restore colour to your worlds. A.I. is destroying art! It's time to stomp it out!

title: Afterwork Apocalypse
description: A horde-survival roguelite in a cursed office tower. Weaponise the stapler, the hot coffee and the all-hands microphone, keep your panicking colleagues from quitting mid-fight, and ride the elevator up floor by floor. Overtime is not optional.

title: Third Bloc
description:
Third Bloc is a text-based political strategy game set during the Cold War. The player founds a small, fictional republic in 1945 and steers it through 45 years of superpower pressure, six months at a time, until 1990. The state is run from a single operations terminal: every order is a numbered line, typed or clicked, and every consequence arrives in print, from parliament votes and bank offers to letters at the State Telegraph Office.

Caught between Washington and Moscow, the player can stay a client state, switch patrons, or call a congress and found a third bloc of their own, while climbing the nuclear and space ladders from the first rocket to a crewed landing on Mars. The whole game, including its animated films, is drawn in ASCII characters.

title: A Game About Everbranching
description: A Game About Everbranching is a minimalist incremental game where your cosmic structure continuously grows and branches. Expand your constellation, unlock upgrades, collect Cosmic Dust and Dark Matter, and watch your creation evolve into an ever-growing cosmic network.

title: A Game About Farting
description: A Game About Farting is a game about farting. Take on Master Beast's $1M challenge to evacuate the park. Upgrade your stomach, intestines... avoid getting caught, and try not to poop your pants.

title: Serious Sam: The Third Encounter
description: Serious Sam: The Third Encounter picks up exactly where 'The Second Encounter' left off, bringing classic run-and-gun mayhem to bold new worlds. Bigger hordes. Bigger guns. One last score to settle with Mental.

title: AShrimpFriedThisRice?
description: Cooking game in which you play as Shrimp chased by ruthless Octopus mafia while providing the best & most distinguished dishes in the whole ocean!

title: Tirade
description: An idle clicker about playing on 16 chessboards at once. Do you know how to play chess? You won't need it here.

title: Winky!: Find the Golden Ticket
description: 1 Billion chocolate bars! One golden ticket is hidden in a mountain of Winky chocolate bars. Open them, rewrap the chocolate as your own knock-off brand, Wonko!, and sell it. Hire staff, build production lines and grow a factory big enough to find the ticket, alone or with up to three friends.

title: Console Repair Simulator
description: Inherit your uncle's dusty console shop on a Tokyo back street. Sell new hardware, haggle for used consoles, then open them up on the repair mat: unscrew every screw, find the fault, swap the part, power on. Restore, grade, resell, and turn the top floor into a 90s Game Saloon.

title: Count on Chaos
description: Your computer is infected. Help Buddy, a tiny calculator, fight through the Wallpaper Kingdom. Give a plain answer to strike and brace, or build an equivalent equation to hit harder while viruses throw pop-ups, steal keys and play dirty.

title: A Game About Shooting Targets
description: Complete challenging missions across diverse shooting ranges, build your custom arsenal with unique weapons and attachments and defeat all blacklist members in order to take your place in the most prestigious squad of the army in this Game About Shooting Targets!

title: Kickoff
description: A kid from the outskirts wants to go pro. When his mother falls ill, the dream becomes a bill: $50,000 in treatment, rent that climbs on its own, and a clock that never stops. Work, train, take penalties — and choose where to be on the day it all lands at once.

title: Marble Co.
description: Build your own marble factory, experiment with different machines, and turn simple marbles into increasingly valuable materials. Unlock new technologies, automate production, and keep expanding your factory as you progress.

title: Kingdom.py
description: A town builder you play in real Python. Write the scripts your heroes run: build, farm, collect taxes, fight off bandits, trade with six islands. Then script the townsfolk too, down to personalities their children inherit.

title: Merdan: Night Protocol
description: Work the night shift in a city where emergency calls and official records do not always agree. Question callers, connect evidence, challenge MERDAN's recommendations and decide where limited help goes. The consequences follow you into later shifts.

title: Paperworks: Paper Shredder Inc.
description: Shred paper, scan books, and burn humanity's knowledge for cash in this first-person incremental game. Upgrade your machines, automate the paperwork, and uncover the dark secrets behind an AI-driven future.

title: Grim & Bear It
description: A dark comedy bureaucracy game where you're the Grim Reaper's overworked intern. Read each soul's case file, check the day's ever-changing rulebook, and stamp them to one of six afterlife destinations before the timer runs out. Eternal judgment, run like a soul-crushing office.

title: Turtles Go Fast
description: In Turtles Go Fast, you must make your way to the other side traversing various biomes to reunite with your family; with the help of upgrades and other useful utilities, or by spicing things up with challenges.

title: It's a Flop
description: Fish Flopping physics meet party-game chaos! Flop out-of-water across many zany game modes. Customize your aquatic fighter, team up with up to 8 friends locally or online, and flop your way to victory.

title: Dungeon Prisoner Simulator
description: Thrown into a dungeon after delivering your king's ultimatum, you have one goal: survive 72 real gameplay hours until his army arrives. Drink, sleep, keep the rats away, and wait...

title: Below Lethe
description: The River Lethe holds memories of the dead. Use its memories to uncover what happened and prove a soul's guilt in the Underworld. His guilt seemed clear—until truth shook the verdict. Knowing all the truth, can you still call him guilty? A story-driven psychological horror about memory and judgment.

title: Focus Grove: Magical Evening DLC
description: Turn your grove into a magical evening retreat! Enjoy cozy Evening Mode, new glowing objects, customizable colorful lights, a dreamy night sky, and peaceful new ambience. Perfect for night owls and relaxing evenings with your Woodlings!

title: Monster Breeder Battler
description: Monster Breeder Battler is a factory-building and tower defense hybrid. Players build a production line on their ranch, using spawn pens, conveyor belts, berry feeders, Element Baths, trainers and groupers to breed and buff monsters, which then march up into a lane to defend the ranch wall against shadow waves emerging from a rift. The game features 65 breedable species across ten tiers, grown from four starters through a 61-recipe breeding tree, and four elements: Ember, Frost, Terra and Volt. Monster deaths are permanent. Between rounds, players see a preview of the next wave and can rebuild against it, draft perks, unlock nodes in a four-branch research tree, and spend boss drops in the Forge. The campaign consists of three fifteen-round hunts, each ending in a fight against a warlord.

title: Cozy Airways
description: Cozy Airways is a relaxed airline management simulation. Starting with a single plane and one city, players open routes across a stylized world map, set fares, and grow a small carrier into a global airline, tuning comfort and advertising along the way. Passengers are individually named, and flights include light minigames such as sorting baggage, serving meals and drinks, checking boarding passes, keeping the plane level through turbulence, and running in-flight trivia, all of which feed into a star rating. Players also furnish and expand an airport lounge with facilities that raise passenger happiness, and hire named cabin crew. Time advances only when the player chooses.

title: The Rug Racket
description: The Rug Racket is a first-person restoration and shop-management simulation with a dark-comedy crime story. The player inherits a failing rug-cleaning business along with a debt owed to a mob family. Each rug goes through five stages: dusting, colorfast testing, washing, rinsing, and extraction and drying. Fiber, dye and heat rules mean the wrong tool or too much heat can cause permanent damage. Alongside the cleaning, players serve customers with differing demands, manage a three-axis reputation, choose between four upgrade branches and cover rising overhead, while paying a weekly tribute across a three-act crime arc that includes police heat and enforcer visits. Special jobs, such as flood-damaged rugs and mob work, change the rules. The goal is to buy the shop out from under the family.

title: Space Planet Explorer
description: Space Planet Explorer is an exploration game in which the player operates a survey satellite in low Earth orbit, above a model of Earth built from NASA, ESA and USGS data with real terrain, city lights and a day/night cycle. The satellite's sonar returns only a distance, so players narrow down and identify 35 real-world points of interest, such as Mount Everest, the Mariana Trench and Angkor Wat, each with information on its geology, fauna and flora. Identifications earn research data that is spent at the International Space Station on upgrades, including a wider sonar, faster analysis, infrared for the night side of the planet and a polar orbit. Some sites can only be detected with upgraded instruments.

title: I Know Kung Fu
description: I Know Kung Fu is a side-scrolling pixel-art beat 'em up modeled on arcade classics. After a crime syndicate seizes the Devil's Temple, players fight their way up its five themed floors (a stone gate, a wooden dojo, a jade hall, a fire pit and a black-marble sanctum), each ending in a boss fight. Combat includes high and low strikes, jump kicks, grabs and grab-breaks, parries, dodges and cancels, along with pickup weapons such as knives, spears and staffs, and a Ki-Burst meter that fills by chaining hits. The game has two playable heroes, seven enemy types and five bosses, and supports local two-player co-op on a shared screen.

title: Divine Ascendancy
description: Divine Ascendancy is a god game and civilization builder. Playing as one of five gods of Olympus, the player guides a mortal settlement through the Neolithic, Chalcolithic, Bronze and Early Iron ages. Peasants are converted into followers and assigned to six work roles, and the settlement grows through 21 building types that change appearance as faith deepens, with roads forming along the paths villagers actually walk. Faith powers 34 miracles across creation, protection and destruction, and a perk and research tree lets players specialize their god. The settlement must defend itself against escalating enemies on the Road of Doubt and survive calamities such as plague, wildfire and earthquake. The campaign culminates in a fight with the dragon Heresiarch and an Ascension Ritual.

title: Null Keeper
description: Null Keeper is a sci-fi lair-building and management game in the tradition of dungeon-management games, set inside an asteroid in deep space. Players designate tunnels to be dug, claim the floor space and build rooms such as vaults, habitats, BioSynth labs and combat simulators, and summon creatures through Warp Rifts. Increasingly well-equipped Vanguard raids target the base's Void Core, and losing it ends the run, so players lay out defenses and choke points to protect it. A fully voiced, sarcastic AI named MALACHAR narrates and comments on the player's decisions.

title: Battleboard
description: Battleboard is a turn-based hex wargame with card-driven army building. Instead of recruiting from a menu, players construct buildings that produce unit cards, then deploy those cards onto a hex map within a point budget, using terrain across six biomes, with combat resolved by dice. The game features four asymmetric factions (Iron Pact, Verdant Choir, Ashen Legion and Sunforged), each with its own units and a 48-node research tree, an eight-resource economy in which construction competes with research, tactics and spell cards such as Fireball and Shield Wall, and an Army Builder for assembling forces against a point tracker.

title: Holofleet
description: Holofleet is a roguelike deckbuilder based on the rules of Battleship. Players place a fleet drawn from nine ship classes on a grid and spend a limited energy budget each turn on multi-cell attack cards, such as Orbital Strike, Spread Salvo and Torpedo Volley, or on scouting cards like Survey Ping and Recon Drone, to locate and sink a hidden enemy fleet. Asteroid fields block lines of fire on some battlefields. Modes include a ten-mission campaign against named commanders, endless Survival waves and a branching roguelike Expedition, all playable offline against three AI difficulty tiers or in local hotseat multiplayer. Commanders level up persistently between runs.

title: Dot Colony
description: Dot Colony is a 2D colony simulation in which players raise a swarm of dots in a cross-section nest built room by room, including food storage, a hatchery, a nursery and barracks. A Queen lays eggs while a Breeding dial sets the balance between Workers, Pushers and Nurses, and colony behavior can be tuned between nesting, foraging and pushing. The central objective is a tug-of-war against the Wall, a giant rolling log, which Pushers splat against to shove it back toward a rival colony. Food funds a research tree of new rooms and abilities, splats are spent on permanent upgrades, and a campaign called the Dot Trail spans several biomes.

title: Agency
description: Play as π (Pi) in a weird game that makes you figure out the rules of eight very distinct challenges. Discover the meaning of the game and email us your thoughts on it.

title: Stonk: Timing the Market
description: Go from being a struggling day trader to running the city. Build out your office and find employees around town to increase your profits. Some of them may have special abilities to manipulate the markets in your favor.

title: Sketch Kingdom
description: A short, incremental game with notebook aesthetic. Draw your own creatures, gather resources and accumulate gold to unlock upgrades. Complete missions to progress through a skill tree that expands everything you can do. Simple, charming and surprisingly addictive. Can you complete the notebook?

title: The Flesh Beneath
description: A dark-fantasy card-roguelike about giving the cathedral below what it asks for one piece of yourself at a time. Sever your own flesh for power. Press blood-stones into your cards. Permadeath. Every name is remembered.

title: Twilight Tides: Mirage Journey
description: At this encounter, journey's begun. Tarot. Two worlds: apocalypse & WWII Nanyang. Love, loss, stolen fate. Choice forges destiny.

title: Qwak Reborn
description: Cute looks. Brutal gameplay. Qwak Reborn is a frantic arcade platformer packed with action, power-ups, secrets, puzzles and traps. Simple to learn. Impossible to put down. Even better with a friend!

title: Metal Quadriga
description: Take control of the high-speed humanoid mech QUADRIGA and complete a variety of intense missions in METAL QUADRIGA. Master unique weapon systems and unleash devastating airstrikesdominate the battlefield with your machine.

title: BudMageddon
description: Aliens demanded 3 billion KGs of buds or they vaporize The Earth! Humanity's last hope is You & weed. a cozy, pixel-art idle/incremental grower.

title: NeoRunners
description: NeoRunners is a playable cyberpunk comic and roguelite deckbuilder. Combine Burn, Volt, and Flow into explosive reactions, then build relationships that unlock new cards, modifications, services, and story paths.

title: Chako
description: Survive enemy swarms in this isometric Action-Roguelite blending bullet-heaven combat with tabletop RPG mechanics. Auto-attack through procedural dungeons, roll d20s in event nodes, and gather loot to upgrade your spells and gear at the base. Dominate the leaderboards!

title: Nonogram Art
description: Classic & variant nonogram puzzles with a collectible twist: solve number puzzles, piece fragments together, and light up themed albums.

title: Tea Party for 4
description: Horror Cozy Anomaly Game

title: 1453: Fall of Constantinople
description: Venice, 1500. Anna Notaras takes down four testimonies of the fall of Constantinople: a janissary, a baker's daughter, an engineer and a noble, each living the same 53 days of the siege. What one witness does changes what the others can do. An illustrated, choice-driven historical novel.

title: Draftfall
description: Jake died saving a stranger and woke up in a war. Draft from 90 cards across nine affinities, pick your weapon, and build a hero who fights on his own in this story-driven fantasy auto-battler.

title: The Doi
description: A hilarious 18 player co-op puzzle platformer for friends, families, and chaos. Play online or locally with split-screen multiplayer.

title: DaDee
description: DaiDee 大弟 turns Hong Kong Big Two into a solo run for survival. Split 13 cards into unbeatable combos, chain plays to stoke the Flow, and unleash bombs that seize the table. Between rounds, stack Style cards that rewrite the rules. Miss the target and the run is over. Play it smart, play it loud.

title: Pixel Coloring World
description: Relax and complete 12 different themed pixel art images! Color 6 pictures at 50×50, 3 at 100×100, 2 at 150×150, and one large 200×200 artwork. Fill in a total of 130,000 pixels and reveal every hidden picture.

title: Beam Inc.
description: A short active incremental where you neutralize unknown specimens in a sterile research facility.

title: Widget Idle
description: Your desktop is its controller. Every click, keypress, and mouse movement helps it grow. Widget Idle lives quietly in the corner of your desktop while you get on with the more important things in life. Now with a little extra happiness.

title: Prideblood: Born of Claws
description: Real-world horse racing, swapped for monster battles in a fantasy world. Raise them, fight them, reach the top of 2,000 rivals. Calendar, classes and five-generation pedigrees stay as in racing, so little to learn. 576 battles a year, up to eight at once, all automatic. Upload one to the Workshop.

title: Brush Rush
description: Paint your own parkour path to escape in this new "Brush Rush" multiplayer, casual, tag game! Runners try to escape by painting 3D paths around a parkour map to hide from the chasers who get super human movement, a paint shotgun, and a pair of boxing gloves. Public matches and streaming is welcome!

title: Lanternfall
description: Defend a handcrafted gothic Halloween world across fifteen haunted realms. Build and upgrade distinctive towers, counter armour and immunities, link aura towers to empower their neighbours, and carry your hard-won arsenal from one nightmarish battlefield to the next.

title: Zombie Mystery: 100 Hidden Cats
description: Zombie Mystery: 100 Hidden Cats challenges you to rescue 100 cats that survived the zombie outbreak and are hiding in abandoned streets! Find them, click carefully, use clues wisely, race against time, and climb to the top of the global leaderboard!

title: Vibe Train
description: A cozy train-themed idle game. Build your own train at the bottom of your screen, trade goods, carry passengers, and grow crops as you enjoy a relaxing journey through a beautiful pixel-art world.

title: Bouncy Ball Battle
description: Bouncy Ball Battle is a chaotic, turn-based online multiplayer game where physics meets strategy. Break through blocks to open up lines of attack, line up your shots, and bounce off walls to knock out your opponents and be the last ball standing!

title: Type the World
description: Learn to type on a keyboard with all ten fingers by typing the world map. Learn geography. Thats it, thats the game. For kids and grownups.

title: MMA Tactics
description: A tactical turn-based MMA simulation with (optional auto-battle) and perma-death. From your backyard to a world title. Recruit Fighters, Assign Perks, Train Stats, Build Synergies, Manage Injuries, Unlock strategies, Upgrade your Gym, Bribe the Commission and create a roster of MMA Champions.

title: A Place for Every Potion
description: A cozy potion-sorting puzzle game. Pour scrambled liquids until every bottle runs pure, then shelve each one where it belongs. Fill 4,160 potions across 52 shelves. No timers, no fail state, no rush.

title: Synapse Grid
description: A neon light-cycle combat racer where the wall you leave behind becomes the arena. Green trail is rideable terrain; amber kills. 90-mission campaign, 24 player split-screen, online beta (unproven). Free demo out now (beta). Next Fest 1926 Oct. Release 28 Oct 2026.

title: A Waddle Quest
description: A cozy but chaotic adventure in a world where magic shouldn’t exist. Play as a very determined waddler (not necessarily qualified, but definitely available) sent to figure it out, explore strange lands, fight magical creatures, collect gear, and bring a friend in local co-op for extra chaos and fun.

title: Sortalis
description: A rogue-like deck-builder built on the classic dice game of Farkle. Build absurd combos and push your luck! Over 250 cards with unique effects that power up your rolls. Play solo runs or play multiplayer draft with friends in a round-robin draft tournament!

title: Twin Drive
description: Twin Drive is an online co-op racing game built around one gimmick: a single car split in half. One player drives the front, the other drives the rear. Stay in sync to steer straight, or fight each other into a screeching donut. Climb a giant stunt tower and race up to 4 cars to the finish.

title: Coins Must Be Made
description: Crush goblins with a magical stamp to mint coins, pay the king's tax, and invest your earnings in upgrades in this active incremental roguelite.

title: Zombie Tide Arena
description: Welcome to the Zombie Tide Arena. Draw all kinds of weapons and upgrades, keep strengthening your arsenal and your character, and survive the onslaught in the arena.

title: Stick a Fork
description: Just hover. Stuck forks leap up and stab back into giant fruit, and every landing pays out gold. Buy more forks, make jam, Ascend and Transcend, and watch the table get wilder every run. An active incremental game played with your cursor.

title: Retro Chaos: Together Tidy Up
description: A chaotic co-op organizing sim in a retro electronics store. Team up with up to 3 friends to sort thousands of CRTs, consoles and gadgets throw, catch, stack and stock your way from total mess to the perfect shelf.

title: EpicSelectly
description: EpicSelectly is a bullet hell shooter where you choose between the dense Red World and the fast Blue World. Repeated choices raise each world's rank and intensify its patterns. Dodge aimed and random bullets, customize Extra Mode's difficulty, and compete on Steam leaderboards.

title: Ship Busters
description: Sink ships the hard way, one plank at a time. Arc your shot, tear the sails, set the deck alight, then charge every gun on the flank and fire them as one. Free to play.

title: Forgery
description: Forgery is a dark medieval roguelike about counterfeiting the King’s coins. Meet each buyer’s target with a handful of punches, then arrange stamp dies that trigger and repeat one another. One good strike can be worth a king’s ransom.

title: O2gether
description: O2GETHER is a co-op survival game with one shared oxygen tank. Untether from it to scout, grab loot, or save a friend, but your air is on a countdown. Drift back in time, or black out. Haul the tank through wreckage, dodge the chaos, and reach the space station before air runs out.

title: Space Travelers
description: Mine asteroids, trade minerals and chart an endless, procedurally generated galaxy in a relaxed 2D space sim. Then pin it to your desktop as a live wallpaper: your ship keeps flying, mining and discovering while you work

title: Azure Striker Gunvolt Trilogy Enhanced: Additional Mode - Azure Striker Gunvolt GX
description:
"Azure Striker Gunvolt GX" adds a new mode featuring Copen, protagonist of the spin-off Luminous Avenger iX 2, fighting alongside Gunvolt.

①Complete new story with full voice acting! Experience an all-new, exclusive story in the Gunvolt timeline starting from the mystery of Xiao Wu, Gunvolt's old friend and comrade. Featuring full English and Japanese voice acting!

②Copen and GV work together with the "Inspiration" system! Gunvolt GX features a tag-team of Copen and GV as playable characters, leaving you to choose how to tackle mission with the two. While one is fighting, the other on standby will gain "Inspiration". Tag between them while Inspiration is full and you'll gain a temporary boost, making the powerful fighters even stronger. Swapping out with high Inspiration will also fill your "GX Skill" gauge, allowing you to unleash a devastating tag attack when full.

③Defeat bosses to gain new EX Weapons and Skills! As Copen and GV team up to defeat the bosses, they'll also share the rewards. Copen gets a new EX Weapon for each boss you defeat, and GV will awaken a new Skill. Copen's EX Weapons are all-new for Gunvolt GX, opening up new strategies as you take on its challenges.

④Two Muses heat up battle with a duet! Clear 1000 Kudos and GV's "Muse" Lumen, or Copen's "Muse of Hope" Lola will amp up the battle with song. But when the muses sing together, their song will transform. Keep earning Kudos and their song will further change!

⑤Earn rewards for leveling up, plus more replayability! Gain EXP and raise the heroes' level to earn more health and new ability slots. Buy new abilities with credits and equip them to further power up. After finishing the main story, you'll unlock challenging special missions to take on with your full power Copen and GV!

title: Cataclyzm
description: A 2D arcade shoot 'em up forged in the age of fire, feedback and METAL! Battle corrupted amps, demonic guitars and epic metalheads as you chug beer in a hellish concert of bullets and riffs. Crank it up to eleven and enter the moshpit!

title: Silly Typing Game
description: A typing action roguelike of arcade survival, shifting systems, bosses, and viruses—and a short philosophical story about an AI that wants you optimized. Type well enough, and the terminal starts looking back.

title: Before All Saints Day
description: One night. One secret. One very curious ghost. Step into a 1020 minute atmospheric Halloween tale where a human girl hides among ghosts at their yearly festival and tries to slip away before a mischievous boy exposes what she really is.

title: Blight Brigade
description: A co-op extraction horror where your crew of plague doctors are sent back through time to investigate a blight that has consumed the future. Collect evidence of the blight and avoid the horrors that blight has created.

title: Feeding Gooble
description: A roguelike deckbuilder about feeding the hungriest little guy. Push buttons, combine foods, and press your luck to keep him sated... or else.

title: Joust Champions
description: Joust Champions is a pixel-art jousting game with a life simulation between tournaments. Each pass down the lists lasts eight hoofbeats: the player spurs the horse on the first three, chooses where to aim, re-aims once after the rival shifts his guard, braces against the incoming lance and strikes on the eighth beat, with timing judged in milliseconds. Twelve named rivals each follow a rule that changes the pass. Between tourneys the player lives out the week in town, training, working shifts, visiting the tavern and chapel, buying horses, armor and lances, and hiring a posse. A seven-chapter career climbs across five venues from a village green to the King's tourney, alongside Daily Tourney and Gauntlet modes.

title: Tidy Farm
description: Tidy Farm is a cozy organizing simulator where you transform a chaotic farm into your dream homestead. Pick everything up, figure out where it belongs and sort 4,544 Items.

title: Mowed Down
description: Mowed Down is a multiplayer prop hunt in which the hunters drive ride-on lawnmowers and everyone else disguises themselves as props, from hay bales and wheelie bins to a piano or a giant toilet. Hiders score points only while a mower can see them, and caught players come back as a mower or a ghost. Lobbies hold up to 40 players across nine arenas, with a walk-around garden lobby, solo play against AI hiders, and a Map Maker with Steam Workshop sharing. A free demo with the Backyard arena and online lobbies of up to 6 releases on 29 October 2026.

title: Desk Rumble
description: Desk Rumble is a cute and casual desktop adventure. Play as a pencil case and round up your runaway stationery friends in short, lively rounds. Upgrade skills, evolve stationery, unlock skins, and complete your collection. Easy to pick up, hard to put down — just one more round!

title: The Hundredth Floor: Extraction
description: A 3D dungeon crawler ARPG blending looter-slasher & extraction mechanics. Delve into a 100-floor abyss where you must choose: play it safe or risk it all! Craft unique builds with massive talent trees & 1,000+ affixes. Defeat bosses and extract with epic loot, or lose everything to greed!

title: Outliers: Incrementum
description: An incremental ARPG about rising from a nobody to the most powerful assassin alive. Slash through waves of monsters, collect loot and upgrade your abilities. Get stronger with every run until even bosses become easy targets.

title: Keyboard Warriors
description: Keyboard Warriors is a bullet-heaven roguelite typing game, customise your mech and weapon loadout and type out the story of the world to cut down huge hordes of enemies and bosses, powering up with each victory and unlocking new upgrades with every run.

title: Cheeseonomics Deluxe
description:
In Cheeseonomics Deluxe, you need to build wacky cheese-making contraptions to make juuust the right amount of profit to win! You'll need to run the numbers on the output of your Rube-Goldberg Fromageries to make sure that you're hitting that sweet spot in the middle, the space between the minimum allowed profit and the maximum allowed profit! (as ordained by the federal government of the United Plates of Gouda-merica)

Often, you'll have to nudge your design with memos! These consumable directives allow you to change the way the game works to make a factory that would normally fail, win! Cheating has never been this fun!

title: Tiny Knight and the Corrupted Crystal
description:
Tiny Knight and the Corrupted Crystal is a single-player action roguelite built around an incremental power curve. The knight's corrupted sword drains his own health for as long as he stays in a level, so the health bar doubles as the level timer and there is no separate countdown; upgrading maximum health buys survivability and time in the same purchase.

Attacks fire automatically as a 360-degree pulse, leaving positioning as the only moment-to-moment decision, and every kill shortens the player's ability cooldowns. Death is the progression system rather than the fail state: banked gold and the permanent skill tree both survive it, so each run funds the next. Five biomes end in boss fights, and an elemental infusion system lets the player commit to fire, frost or lightning — or to the corruption itself, which is stronger and changes the ending.

title: Revenant of Tsushima
description:
Revenant of Tsushima is a first-person Japanese folklore horror adventure game developed by Aurora Studio, an independent game studio based in Hong Kong.

Set in a supernatural interpretation of Edo-period Japan, the game follows Tsushima Mewa on a mysterious journey through historical villages, mountain paths, shrines, and haunted landscapes inspired by the Tokaido route.

Players explore atmospheric environments, investigate supernatural incidents, interact with characters, collect spiritual clues, and encounter mysterious entities inspired by traditional Japanese folklore.

The experience combines environmental exploration, narrative-driven investigation, supernatural encounters, and elements of Japanese religious and cultural traditions.

title: OMSI 2: Project Numazu
description:
OMSI 2: Project Numazu is a downloadable content expansion for the bus simulation game OMSI 2. Set in Numazu, a coastal city in Shizuoka Prefecture, Japan, the add-on recreates Japanese urban roads, residential neighborhoods, industrial areas, and landmarks surrounding Numazu Station and Numazu Port.

The expansion features four playable bus routes (N12, N13, N41, and N45), Japanese left-hand traffic, regional road signage, detailed bus interiors, interactive fare collection systems, and AI traffic.

title: The Ostrakon
description: Become the ruler of human space. Design, build, and command hundreds of thousands of ships and break the invading Hollow wherever they stand. Unite the rival human powers or take them by force. In the end every star in the galaxy answers to humanity. And humanity answers to you.
