title: Warmachine: Rogue-Scout
description: Warmachine: Rogue-Scout is a sci-fi tactical strategy game where you build a squad of machines, upgrade your loadout, and fight through dangerous missions using cards, factions, and powerful combat abilities.

title: Jarkeeper
description: A cozy first-person sorting game in a spooky old mansion on a stormy night. You sleepwalked out the front door, and all 3,120 specimen jars hit the floor. Carry armfuls, learn odd little spells from the bimbous and put every jar back on its shelf.

title: Flopball
description: Flopball is a physics-based football party game for up to 6 players online. Players compete in team-based matches, combining passing and shooting with slide tackles, punches and ragdoll collisions. Power-ups and arena-specific hazards can change the course of a match. The game features extensive character customisation, adjustable match settings, a shared locker-room lobby and offline play against bots.

title: Cyndy
description: Cyndy is an adult adventure game set in the porn industry. With mainstream studios in decline and internet porn on the rise, the player sets out to make a name for themselves in the business. The game contains explicit sexual content.

title: Brothel Master
description: Brothel Master is an adult management and tycoon game. The player takes over a fallen brothel in a city full of clients, then hires, trains and customizes workers, upgrades rooms and maximizes profits. The game contains explicit sexual content.

title: Tap 4 Sex 2
description: Tap 4 Sex 2 is an adult clicker game and the sequel to Tap 4 Sex, with new gameplay, new girls and more animations. The game contains explicit sexual content.

title: The Guestbook of the Otherworld
description: Run an inn in the Otherworld, where forgotten things become tsukumogami. By day, tend to guests burdened by Kegare. By night, survive the horrors born from the impurity left behind. Your choices shape the guests’ healing and the inn’s fate.

title: Perfect Date HD
description: Perfect Date HD is a remake of the 2022 adult dating simulator Perfect Date. The player gets the chance to prove they can seduce some of the best-looking girls they have ever met. The game contains explicit sexual content.

title: Futa: Beer & Sex
description: Futa: Beer & Sex is a fast adult arcade game. The player catches beer to unlock three futa bartenders and an uncensored animated sex gallery. The game contains explicit sexual content.

title: Vikings: Sex and Blood - Chapter 2
description: Vikings: Sex and Blood - Chapter 2 is a standalone adult RPG and the second chapter of Vikings: Sex and Blood. The player is now Jarl of Krokr, leads turn-based raids with a warband, grows Renown, holds a feast in the Longhouse and wins over the fully voiced women of Krokr. The game contains explicit sexual content.

title: Hatsune Miku Connecting Puzzle Tamagotori: Deluxe
description: Hatsune Miku Connecting Puzzle Tamagotori arrives in a Deluxe Edition with two previously released Premium DLC packs included!

title: Ordinary Oddness
description: Ordinary Oddness is a Nothing-Stays-Oddinary Open-World RPG. Since the Albinox Judgment, humans and Mythoids have lived side by side in Elysian Skies, a city suspended above a sea of clouds, sharing the same streets and the same everyday rules.

title: Ourself
description: Ourself is an online co-op physics platformer for exactly two players who share a single ragdoll body. Each player controls one half of the body: one arm, one leg and their own camera. Walking, jumping, climbing ropes and monkey bars, and carrying a crate all require both players to act together; a jump only works if both press within 0.2 seconds. Players climb 400 m through The Sky Kingdom across 36 checkpoints, from a meadow to the Ruined Keep, past pistons, swinging hammers, cannons and fans, and use a fishing rod as a grappling hook. A fall of 1.5 m or more knocks the character out. The game has a Campaign mode with checkpoints, a Time Trial mode without checkpoints, four secret trials and built-in voice chat. Each player needs their own copy; there is no single-player or split-screen mode.

title: Lucky Castaway
description: In this roguelike deckbuilder you are stranded with a slot machine! Gather resources, craft items and create game-breaking synergies to survive against all odds!

title: Cyber Breaker ’95
description: Relive classic brick-breaking arcade action in a neon 16-bit world. Control your paddle, keep the ball in play, and smash through colorful brick formations as you chase a high score. Collect power-ups to widen your paddle, fire lasers, split the ball, unleash a fireball, or activate an energy shield. Each stage features new brick patterns, retro-inspired visuals, and synthesized arcade sounds. Play with a keyboard or mouse.

title: Minesleeper
description: You wake up in a distant part of the universe 25.000 years after being deployed on an urgent mission to save humanity from extinction. A minesweeper gets a dangerous makeover in this hexagonal roguelite. Outsmart devious puzzles, bend the odds, and turn failures into triumph.

title: ExoFlora: First Seeds
description: A cozy sci-fi farming sim. Run a greenhouse on an alien world: grow strange plants, discover reactions between neighbors (fire, frost, crystal and light), breed and name your own hybrids, survive seasons and pest swarms, and restore a dying valley through a campaign. Includes a Relaxed mode where plants never die.

title: Tower! Simulator 3: RCTP Airport
description: Take control of Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport (RCTP), the major international gateway serving Taipei and northern Taiwan. Manage arriving and departing aircraft, coordinate ground movements, and keep traffic flowing at this important East Asian aviation hub in Tower! Simulator 3.

title: Motion Sensing Car
description: This is a motion-sensing racing game. It can recognize your hand gestures through a computer camera. There is no need for a mouse, keyboard,or any wearable devices. Simply wave your palm in the air to control the race car and enjoy the cool driving fun.

title: Last Landlord
description: Last landlord a roguelike deckbuilder using poker rules,beat all skill enemy,gain relic and consumables,upgrade your poker hand type,add stats to your champion,receive enhanced poker card,encouter all random event and becoming ultimate poker champion.

title: Dino Goodbye
description: An absurd comedy visual novel about a scientist dinosaur trying to stop a meteor while politicians, media stars, and rich lizards compete to be catastrophically stupid.

title: Pindemonium
description: A roguelike pinball deckbuilder. Beat each stage's target score before you run out of balls. Between stages, buy passives and upgrades in the shop to build your deck. Choose from 10 flippers, clear 12 stages, then see how far your build can go in Endless Mode.

title: Anomaly Jobs: Death Row
description: Same Path again and again. Everything looks familiar, until it does not. Some Anomalies hide in plain sight. Some are hard to spot. Find them, then take the correct exit. Every wrong choice lets the night draw closer.

title: Throne Digger
description: Dig out a buried castle room by room in this turn-based pixel art roguelite. Every action costs energy: when it runs out you're back at camp, but everything you dug stays dug. Upgrade your tools, unearth monsters and beat bosses that each play by their own rules.

title: Eliminate Fear
description: A first person shooter game where you can fight monsters, buy guns, buy props, explore, and play cards (not yet finished)

title: Dreamy Sakura's Graduation Ceremony
description: A graduation that breaks, again and again. It should have been an ordinary day where all you had to do was choose which friend to talk to first. The order changes the conversations, and each loop warps the scene. Your friends' smiles fade. A visual novel about friendship. Broken, with care.

title: Tiny Glass Tank: Dwarf Shrimp and Friends
description: A cozy pixel-art aquarium game about collecting tiny critters, caring for them, trading extras, and decorating living glass tanks. Raise hearts, keep water steady, and use View Mode to safely watch your tanks while critters and decorations keep gently moving. *Not an idle coin game.

title: All About Luck
description: All About Luck is a roguelike auto battler where luck is everything. Build your formation by gacha and test your fortune. No P2W, no grinding — just pulls, rolls, and fate. Crush the boss with god-tier pulls, then ask your friends: Still not cleared it?

title: Dungeon Munchies 2
description: Who in their right mind would even WANT to eat cosmic monsters? Find out in this side-scrollin', action-fightin', level-grindin', treasure-lootin', dungeon-munchin' grubapalooza!

title: Monster Prom 5: Monster Retreat
description: Get ready for the ultimate winter war in this hilarious narrative adventure with dashes of strategy and romance! Visit snowy locations, recruit from a pool of over 80 wacky characters onto your team, and destroy your opponents in a fierce snowball fight to the death. Oh, and date hot monsters too

title: Iron & Oil
description: A WW2 real-time strategy game inspired by the RTS classics of the '90s, on maps of every size. Run supply lines of metal and fuel, build an army, a navy and an air force, and fight on land and at sea as one of six nations, each with its own special weapons. Cut the enemy's oil, and his army stops.

title: For Honor: The Nightstalker
description: Satiate your thirst for blood by incarnating the cursed Lord Dragomir the Nightstalker, and use his monstrous features.

title: For Honor: Liana the Pale
description: Join the cursed Dragomir family and become Liana the Pale to inspire bloodcurdling nightmares on the battlefield.

title: Halloween: Tidy Up
description: One witch's manor desperately in need of a little tidying up. Welcome to an old Victorian manor filled with magic, mysteries, and an unbelievable amount of clutter! Your task is simple: find a place for every item and turn this charming chaos into a perfectly organized collection.

title: Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves - Classic Mai Shiranui
description: Unlocks the "Classic Mai Shiranui" alternate costume for Mai Shiranui.

title: The Lighthouse Restaurant
description: The Lighthouse Restaurant is a first-person psychological horror game set in a unique dining spot. Listen to your guests' stories, decide what they eat, shape their fates, and unearth the truth behind your own story.

title: It Wants You To Stay
description: The lights are on. Everyone is gone. Descend through eleven shifting liminal worlds in this first-person psychological horror game. Photograph the impossible, follow a missing woman's VHS recordings, and save your light for what follows you. When the lights fail, stand still.

title: Dino Crisis: Modern Edition
description: A fan mod of Dino Crisis (PS1): the game is rebuilt from your own disc into a native Windows program, made to look and play like the Resident Evil remakes.

title: Rally Point
description: A strategy roguelite set in a galaxy that fights back. Draft 90+ heroes, mechs, and support cards. Campaign solo or co-op — between your missions, enemy factions reinforce, counterattack, and contest your ground. In solo, pause to replan.

title: Dress Your Meat
description: Dress Your Meat is a cooking horror game where you work at a dumpling restaurant. Take orders, prepare dishes, and do your best to keep your chef happy. Sounds simple enough, until things in the kitchen start getting seriously disturbing.

title: Spellstrider
description: A tactical deckbuilder where every card moves the battle. Stride across the grid, strike from behind, shove foes into pits, and outwit enemies that react to each card you play. Choose your hero, conquer 3 acts, and fight solo or in 2-player online co-op.

title: ClawGnomes
description: Every grab is real claw physics, with no rigged drops. After closing, the arcade belongs to its night-shift gnomes: restock 16 claw machines, tune their grip and price, fix what breaks, then play them yourself. Collect 400+ prizes. Solo, or online co-op for up to 4.

title: Lumbric
description: Hatch from a cocoon under someone's garden and grow up as a real earthworm. Burrow through crackling ASMR soil, feed the roots of the flowers above, meet the worms next door, and fill a journal of true worm facts. No timers, no game over. Or just let it crawl on your second screen.

title: Danelaw
description: Northumbria, 875. Land with a Danish war-band and carve out a saga of your own: fight in the shield wall, raid and ride, feud with named war-leaders who remember you, and rise from a hired spear to king in the north. Alone, or with up to three friends in online co-op.

title: Grit and Valor - 1949: Resistance Edition
description:
Looking to get a little more out of the Grit & Valor - 1949 dieselpunk experience? Support our mechs with the Resistance Edition including:

Grit and Valor - 1949 (Base game)
14 track OST
98 page digital artbook
8 unique skins for your all-important Command Vehicle

title: Sanarara R
description: Sanarara R is a multi-ending visual novel about a young man approached by a mysterious girl who claims she can grant any wish. Explore seven heroine routes, each with its own story and ending, through fully voiced Japanese dialogue, except for the protagonist. This version adds stories for Higuchi, Kanae, and Hikaru, extra scenarios from the fan discs, widescreen graphics, and a gallery mode.

title: Kiwi Boing
description: Triple-jump, air dash, plant your beak on walls, leap off and more in this 3D collectathon platformer about a flightless bird that gets everywhere anyway. You crashed on tiny open-world islands, and you have places to be. Find secrets, Meet the locals, fix your plane and F off home (F is for Fly).

title: Virtue: Prologue
description: Virtue: Prologue is an experimental visual novella and companion piece to the violent catharsis of Virtue and a Sledgehammer. Navigate the complex feelings of your first love: a hot, rich boy from Barcelona. Sneak into the graveyard at night with your sister, or climb a tree for high-stakes conversations. Created by Juno Menager in collaboration with Deconstructeam and Selkie Harbour, Virtue: Prologue introduces you to the characters and relationships at the heart of Virtue and a Sledgehammer.

title: The Sixth Sin
description: The Sixth Sin is a first-person psychological survival horror game. In 1996, thirty-two children died in one night at St. Adela's Orphanage on Blackmoor Hill. Thirty years later, the player returns to the orphanage carrying a box left by the only adult who survived that night. The game features a grid-based inventory where items have shapes and can be rotated, an ultraviolet flashlight mode as the only means of harming certain spirits, puzzles solved in the environment without a pause menu, hand-drawn ritual sequences, mirrors that act as passages, and a radio voice whose guidance the player chooses whether to trust. Developed by HAPPYTECH, a one-person studio in Türkiye, in Unity.

title: WildBonds
description: Play as a little fox and help the forest animals find what they've lost! Each request hides three items in random spots, and a mischievous fox may run off with one. Dash through the woods, beat your best time, and climb the global leaderboard in this charming 3D exploration time-attack game.

title: Overspray
description: OVERSPRAY is a tactical 4v4 first-person paintball shooter. Short rounds, precise aim and one flag in the middle of the map: hold E for 6 seconds to raise it, or soak the whole enemy team. Nobody dies - everybody gets soaked. Paint builds up on the body until 100 and knocks you out until the next round; fresh paint glows for 30 seconds and then dries, leaving a trail. Buy markers, vests, masks and paint, smoke and flash grenades every round. Modes include Casual, Competitive, Deathmatch, Marker Race and Training, on dedicated servers. Developed by Fazay Games in Brazil.

title: Ambrosius
description: Ambrosius is a fantasy dungeon crawler where every monster, room and item is an original hand-painted artwork — not a filter, not AI. Fight through ever-shifting labyrinths, let Corruption steer your fate down one of three story paths, and end every battle in a cinematic kill-cam.

title: Saving Songburg
description: Saving Songburg is a 3D third-person action-adventure platformer, set in a whimsical Steampunk world. Help the robot Automavoz save the town of Songburg from the interdimensional gang of art thieves known as the Dream Stealers!

title: The Abjuration Stand
description:
Fast 2D tower defense and survival game. You play a small wizard who holds the line while green slimes and other monsters flood the path.

You fight on the field and build at the same time. Place attacking orbs, swords and staffs. Spend crystals on new defenses. Between waves choose upgrades that stay for the rest of the run.

title: Tidyspell
description: Tidyspell is a cozy first person magic tidying game. Lift and place every object with your wand, catch invisible thieving spirits, fly on your broom, brew potions and step through doors into rooms that are bigger on the inside.

title: My Snake Likes Apples
description: A short, minimalist incremental game about raising a foolish snake and helping it go the distance. The snake moves on its own to reach apples. Players collect apple seeds to upgrade its speed, bite strength, and intelligence, helping it progress through harsher places.

title: Tidy Town
description: Tidy Town is a third-person cleaning game where you combine everyday objects to tidy up messes and transform spaces. Help Percy lend a paw one room at a time as he saves a friend’s cafe, rebuilds a city park, refreshes an artist’s studio, and tidies his way across town and into his community's heart.

title: Aiming Fighter
description: Aiming Fighter is a space-themed shooter that puts you right in the cockpit. Alone against endless enemies, your only lifeline is your lock-on system. Survival depends on your strategy: choose the right targets to lock-on, build up combos to unleash skills to stay alive!

title: Brofish
description: Brofish is an autobattler roguelite with Tower Defense elements. Catch and upgrade bizarre fish, combine items, effects, and hold back waves of undead to save the village from the Sea King!

title: Food Delivery Simulator 2027
description: Take orders on your phone, pick up meals from restaurants serving world cuisines and deliver them across a living city on foot, by bike, scooter or car. Grow from your first delivery to your own delivery business!

title: Omni Growth
description:
Humans invaded a massive galactic ship and nearly wiped out an ancient arachnid species. But one hatchling survived... Now you are the last hope of your kind.

Explore the abandoned sections of the colossal spacecraft, hunt space insects and invaders, consume your prey, and evolve from a helpless creature into a deadly predator.

Each level takes you to a new part of the ship, featuring unique environments, biomes, traps, and enemies. Use your surroundings to survive, grow stronger, and unlock new abilities.

title: Pripyat: Exclusion Zone
description: A short, 16-bit survival action game set in the abandoned ruins of Pripyat. Search for classified documents, manage radiation and scarce supplies, and fend off mutated creatures as you make your way toward extraction near Reactor No. 4.

title: Spin Tactics
description: Spin Tactics is a roguelike engine-builder set inside a slot machine. Each spin fills the board with coloured symbols, and connecting three or more of the same colour makes a combo. Gems change a symbol's colour, timing or effect for the rest of the run. Over 100 Companions can be equipped in eight slots, and their order matters, since some boost or copy the Companion next to them. Unwanted Companions, symbols and Gems can be sold in the Black Hole for gold. Each encounter has a score goal and a limited number of Actions, and bosses work against the player. Between runs, credits unlock Chips and Portals that change the starting hero. Runs take 30 to 60 minutes and end on an online leaderboard. There is no real-money gambling and no microtransactions.

title: Kitchen Tidy
description: Kitchen Tidy is a cozy organizing simulation game focused on sorting and arranging kitchen items. Players collect misplaced objects and put them in their proper places across cabinets, drawers, shelves, and storage spaces. Featuring over 2,000 kitchen items, the game centers on item placement, spatial organization, and transforming a messy kitchen into a tidy, organized space at a relaxed pace.

title: Dream Voyage
description: An Indie Story rich Walking simulator focused on the hudless exploration of introspective surreal levels in the dream world of a 10 years old blind child who's looking for the memories of their late mother.

title: Hollowstride
description:
Hollowstride is an open-world voxel sandbox survival game developed by VixVoid. Set in a procedurally generated world featuring mountains, valleys, and extensive cave systems, players can explore, gather resources, build structures, and shape their surroundings.

The game supports both single-player and multiplayer, allowing players to explore independently, host their own worlds, or join shared servers. Hollowstride also features modding support, enabling customization of blocks, items, textures, loot, and world generation.

The game is designed around exploration, building, survival, and player-driven experiences in an expandable sandbox environment.

title: Tsukimi Planet: Classic Remaster
description: A mysterious girl named Tsukimi appears beside a terminally ill young man, claiming to be an alien from the Moon. She offers to grant his final wish. His answer is simple: “I want to talk with you again tomorrow.” A short visual novel reborn as a Classic Remaster.

title: Call Me, Liar
description: Call Me, Liar is a social deduction party game show for 4 to 8 friends, played online with voice chat. Everyone plays from their own room, makes deals and tells lies over private phone calls, and then watches the truth come out on live TV. Ten games, eight in every show, and only one winner.

title: Hollow Flesh
description: A first-person psychological horror set in a decaying 1950s psychiatric hospital. You came for your daughter. The building came for you. Explore its wards, solve its locks, relive the past it won't let you forget. Run and hide when it remembers too much.

title: Shardwatch Dominion
description:
Shardwatch Dominion is a classic top-down tower defense game set in circular arenas. You protect a central fortress and its glowing crystals from waves of enemies that attack from every direction.
Every decision matters: where you build, what you spend crystals on, and which upgrades you take between waves. Placement and resource management decide whether the fortress holds.

title: Pawn Shop Days
description: Run a pawnshop: inspect goods, haggle with unusual visitors, repair your finds and sell them on. Spot fakes, decide whose story to trust and invest your profits in the shop. Between questionable deals, take a moment to pet the kitten.

title: Shoot & jump
description: Every shot moves you. Each bullet's recoil knocks you back across a tiny chessboard surrounded by conveyor belts. Dodge, ram and chain shots with two guns, survive 5–10 boss waves, and build your run from 398 cards across 20 archetypes.

title: Mega Tag Panic
description: Tag — but IT keeps GROWING. The giant tagger can't fit through narrow doors, and that's your way out. Charge your slap, release it in the RED, send a friend flying. 2-10 players, 12 maps, 6 modes, 10 characters with 10 special powers. Nobody online? The bots don't go easy on you.

title: Tomorrow Never Comes
description: Tomorrow Never Comes is a choice-driven first-person narrative thriller. Trapped in a time loop, Noah must relive the same day, manage his injuries, use items, unlock new paths, and discover multiple endings in his attempt to finally reach tomorrow.

title: Return to Planet Zoveka
description: A physics-driven 2D incremental space-mining sim. Help a family herd cosmic dust, automate production, unlock research, and turn a single inherited station into a vast operation. Enjoy a relaxing, colourful journey to heal Zoveka.

title: Plunder Bay
description: An online pirate board game for 2–6 players. Sail scattered islands, blast rivals with cannons and rockets, and STEAL their treasure when you sink them. Spin the helm, claim islands, and win wild minigames — first to 4 treasures wins. Grab your crew and plunder the bay!

title: Winnie-the-Pooh Redux: Halloween Survivors
description: Heal instead of harm in this wholesome Halloween bullet heaven! Play as 9 magical versions of Pooh, recruit a Ghost Army, collect Candy Corn, upgrade abilities, and restore peace to the Hundred Acre Wood. Based on the public-domain works of A. A. Milne and E. H. Shepard. Not affiliated with Disney.

title: Echo Stalker
description: In this game, players explore a randomly generated map using a Lidar scanner to reveal their surroundings. As they scan for paths and hidden dangers, a relentless enemy chases them. Players must use the scanner to find escape routes and avoid being caught, creating a tense and fast-paced experience.

title: Grombo Card Shop Tycoon
description: Manage your own card shop, open packs, and collect absurd Grombos. Restock products, set prices, and design your store. Unlock upgrades, automate tasks, and grow your business while hunting for that one card you still need.

title: Cobot-Man Adventure
description: Cobot-Man Adventure is an action shooter game against evil robots. It offers a fun and entertaining experience. Discover the excitement and amusement it provides with its action-adventure gameplay. Cobot-Man will face bosses of different kind during the adventure.

title: No Death No Life
description: An existential horror visual novel where you explore how immortality affects your relationships through a variety of dialogue options and paths.

title: What the Buck?!
description: What the Buck?! is an incremental game about destroying money. Swipe a credit card through an ATM, bills land on a table, and the breaker shreds them for money. Electric bills arc to the bills next to them, explosive bills blow up the stack around them, and burning bills set their neighbours on fire. Over 240 upgrades are spread across upgrade panels, a skill tree and a prestige tree. Ending a shift turns the money destroyed into Prestige Points for permanent upgrades, so the next shift starts stronger. Mr. Buck, the player's boss, calls in with instructions and opinions.

title: Aniimo: Season 1 - Departure with the Wind: Part 2
description: Aniimo’s Season 1: Departure with the Wind Part 2 has arrived, introducing 32 new species and 51 new Aniimo, fresh storylines, and the Whisperwake Isles region, featuring Crescent Bay, Rosy Mirelands, Wildwater Gorge, and Cloudreach Falls. Players can discover new Prismana forms for Whirlbite, Gachapus, Jabster, and Sugartini, alongside seasonal additions such as Prismana Hypnyto, Prismana Ekrim, Hoptail, and the player-designed Jaguaraun. The update also adds permanent real-time 1v1 duels and a new fair-play PvP mode for Operation: Egg Heist, while limited-time activities include Aniimo Dash racing and new Dark, Earth, and Lightning stages in Holo-Battle Sim. Seasonal events include Night Parade, featuring decorating and fragrance-mixing activities; Magical Night, introducing special crops for your Home; and additional login, exploration, and photography events. Vein Abundance features weekly Prismana rotations, culminating in a Prismana Carnival.

title: Ayako's Endeavors
description: A combat-free, casual exploration RPG. Play as a single mother exploring a town, talking to NPCs, and solving their troubles to gather "Faith" and save your comatose son. Enjoy over 190 story events, diverse outfit CGs, and a unique "Inner Thoughts" system to hear inner thoughts and get hints.

title: Willy and Charlie: Solitaire
description: In *Willy and Charlie: Solitaire*, players journey through evolving challenges, building powerful decks and using strategy with a touch of luck to defeat opponents. Each match is unique—narrow wins or perfect chains can swing outcomes dramatically.

title: Battle Investment Master
description: Two teams sent their own warriors to fight each other. The winner is the one who kills all the warriors of the other team. The Jockey Club provides betting on the team you support. Use your shrewd vision to earn more money!

title: Escape From Prompt: Rogue Ai
description: To optimize your "happiness," an AI assistant named Opti has taken over your PC. Your only ally is an obsolete assistant everyone abandoned twenty years ago. Take your permissions back, one at a time — armed with his gloriously terrible code.

title: Collapsle
description: Collapsle is a fast-paced match-three score attack roguelite set in the Gold Rush West. Create powerful synergies and score big, with tons of items, characters, customization options, and challenges to discover!

title: Easy
description: Easy- 2D dynamic platformer, made in the style of minimalism and has a creative approach to level design, each level becomes a real challenge and gives a lot of emotions. Discover new tactics and approaches to completing the game. Be smart and enter the top players of the game "Easy"!

title: Excisa
description: Sit down at a séance table in an abandoned house. Choose a tarot card. Roll the dice. Risk everything to summon the Angel who never lies. Every reach across the table might bring you closer to the truth—or seat something else opposite you. Five chairs. The dead have heard you, too.

title: Soul Finders
description: Soul Finders is a third-person survival shooter. Blast through waves of bugs, collect souls, upgrade your character, and face the Queen while storms turn the battlefield against you.

title: Mortality
description: This game takes place against a pure white background, with black columns positioned at the top and bottom, creating a simple yet challenging environment.

title: Eris One Stand
description: Join the Pook Star Legion in this shoot em up roguelike and battle through waves of enemies. Dodge incoming fire and choose your upgrades to transform your ship throughout each run as you fight to reclaim the Kryos Crystals stolen from the Pooks.

title: SwapHeads!
description: A failed experiment has caused your heads to get swapped!? Control your buddys body from your own point of view in this unique 3D platform action game for two players,. Your bond with your buddy will be put to the ultimate test!?

title: Worldkampf '72
description: Worldkampf is a 4X real-time grand strategy game set in a fractured 1970s interstellar empire. As an upstart noble following the Kaiser's assassination, develop tile-based economies, command battle walkers and combined-arms armies, and conquer a handcrafted universe to claim the throne.

title: Differentiate
description: This game immerses players in the vast expanse of a blue sky and sea, taking on the role of a courageous pilot.

title: Timber & Fortune
description: Build a woodworking business from a humble camp. Gather timber, craft furniture, fulfill timed contracts, research new techniques, expand your workshop, trade goods, and protect your reputation as you grow from beginner to master carpenter.

title: Sacred Land
description: Sacred Land is a fast-paced action roguelite where you play as an ancient nature spirit defending your island against invading settlers.

title: Reoguna
description: Organize fragmented files and aim to clear the level in as few moves as possible. "REOGUNA" is a minimalist optimization puzzle game inspired by the classic disk defragmentation process.

title: Shot Up: Turtle Gun Jump
description: Jump endlessly upward and master your gun's recoil to soar even higher! Combine powerful augmentations to craft unique builds, and survive relentless hazards and monsters for as long as you can. An action platformer where no two runs are ever the same.

title: Tessela
description: Relax and organize the chaos in Tessela, a 2D pixel art puzzle game designed to play without pressure or clocks. Overcome 99 handcrafted levels featuring colored blocks, different shapes, and challenges meant to clear your mind.

title: Rookie Rook
description: Broke, principled, and full of terrible ideas. Build sentences from word blocks and watch them come to life. No strength needed here, no sword, no good intentions: just look closely, move the one piece that matters, and watch everything else fall apart.

title: GloveUp!
description: GloveUp! is a singleplayer anime-themed female boxing game featuring realistic and physics-driven animations. Create and customize a roster of fighters, shape unique fighting styles through abilities, unlock outfits, level up and take on tougher opponents and challenges.

title: Everest: Survival Simulator
description: Survive a full expedition on a 1:1 satellite-mapped Mount Everest. Acclimatize, manage oxygen, cold, fatigue and supplies, pitch your tent at each camp, cross crevasses in the Khumbu Icefall and push for the 8,848 m summit — then make it back down alive.

title: Music Maniaz
description: Play the drums in a rhythm game anyone can pick up, packed with lo-fi. (Over 20 lo-fi songs alone!) 50+ original tracks across all kinds of genres! Besides drums, play Melody and All Mix at three difficulties! Add your own favorite songs, auto-generate the chart, and play as much as you want!

title: Mogumogu! Poop Battle
description: Control a , gather , and feed them to with your teammate! Eaten turn into and get SHOOT at the enemy! 2v2 online battle for up to 4 players. Play solo or with friends!

title: Halloween Poppp
description: Halloween Poppp is an easy, Halloween-themed connect-and-match puzzle. Space keeps shrinking — plan each move and pick the best option under pressure. Master 10 tools, chain combos for multiplied scores, and earn richer gems. Level up, then prove yourself on the Steam leaderboard!

title: Soul Tides
description: Command dark armies in this tug-of-war auto-battler. Build your base, summon units, customize abilities, and push the battlefield toward your enemy’s stronghold. Adapt your strategy each match and dominate in PvP, co-op, or Trials mode.

title: Back Together
description: Back Together is a chaotic co-op platformer where four players work together to overcome difficult stages. Pull each other together with ropes, merge into one, and overcome massive obstacles to test true friendship (and rage)!

title: Barn Rush
description: Barn Rush is a top-down time-attack collectathon roguelite set on a pixel-art farm. Gather food in 15-second rounds, haul it back to the barn, and bank it before the buzzer. Rounds come in sets of five, each with a Harvest Goal, and every fifth round is a 45-second Gauntlet with a game-changing challenge. Pick upgrades between rounds and build a different run every time.

title: Blowhole
description: You're a dolphin. Your job: make everything sparkle by spitting high-pressure water. 1–6 players, seagulls with a grudge, crazy modifiers and absolutely zero professionalism.

title: Kuroshio: Neon Blood
description: Tokyo, at night, in the rain. Twelve years after vanishing, Kyōsuke Narumi returns to Shinbashi and walks straight into a war between yakuza families. An open-world crime saga: brawls, katana and gunfights, police chases, mountain-pass races and a shinkansen to the old capital.

title: BetDog Cards
description: A Texas Hold'em hand-builder meets tactical card battling. Luck makes you smile, decisions make you win — burst enemies with overflow damage, or duel AI, friends, and players worldwide!

title: Goons!
description: Goons! is a roguelike auto-battler where you travel through space, building an army of silly little aliens! Discover powerful, game-breaking synergies to take down your foes!

title: Coin Shower
description: Coin Shower is a short, cozy incremental casino arcade game. Every machine pays out in a burst of coins that pile up on the floor. Scoop them up, spend them on upgrades, unlock new machines, and chase the $1,000,000 moon shot.

title: Family Manners
description: Light caresses every corner of the home, and the clock marks the first heartbeats of the morning. It's just another typical day in the wonderful life of the Evans family… right?

title: BallHole
description: BallHole is somewhere between a physics toy and a meditation tool. Frantically smash the button to drop balls and try to hit score boosting combos! Or turn on "auto drop" mode and relax to the gentle sounds of balls bouncing while numbers go brrrrrrrrr.

title: Pick a Part
description: Clean dirty items and sell them to the locals, in the post-post-apocalyptic world of Pick a Part! Join Sprout, the newcomer of a small island, where she has to manage her store and gain the trust of the town.

title: Halls of Torment: The Lost Archives
description:
The Lost Archives adds a haunted library stage to a dark fantasy action roguelike, where animated books and other enemies guard forbidden knowledge. Explore the Archives as two new heroes: a hammer-wielding Inquisitor who marks foes for execution, or a Blood Apostle who spends her life force to power her attacks.

New combat mechanics center on judgment, retaliation, and sacrifice, alongside quests, abilities, artifacts, and equipment to unlock.

title: Making Room?
description: An unpaid-rent argument leads Var to a house book that changes her housemates whenever they cross the kitchen threshold. A short psychological horror visual novel about living together, resentment, and making other people easier to bear.

title: Dreadmiles
description: Combine weapon modules, destroy obstacles and spread fire in this claymation rogue-lite horde survivor. Choose your route, take on missions and giant bosses, and head back to your truck before the Seep closes in.

title: The King Must Grow
description:
A physics-based active incremental about a not entirely humble jester with one very important job: Feed cute, entirely innocent slimes to the ever-hungry Slime King.
Throw them by hand, then see if you can build systems that do it for you.
Just never, ever question the King.

title: Blotch
description: Paint yourself to match the scenery and sneak past guards. Explore an island of magical paintings, help its residents save their homes, or bring friends for online hide-and-seek and Prop Hunt. Create your own maps and share them on Steam Workshop.

title: Love is Undead
description: In this adventure game, play as a scientist immune to a deadly virus. Scavenge for resources, develop a vaccine, and test it on Amber, a recently infected girl. Manage supplies, explore dangerous areas, and build a bond that could save humanity. Enjoy post-apocalyptic life with a zombie girl!

title: Click Flip
description:
Click Flip is a short incremental game about flipping tiles and setting off ridiculous chain reactions.

Flip tiles to earn points, spend them on an upgrade grid, and build toward the moment one click lights up the whole board. Every tile from 1 to 10 has its own ability, enemy tiles fight back, and the jackpot system rewards you for pushing your luck.

title: Zarlor: Le Sanctuaire des Veilleurs
description:
Zarlor: Le Sanctuaire des Veilleurs is a single-player roguelite deckbuilder inspired by the wildlife and landscapes of Réunion Island. Players choose a pair of Wardens, prepare a compact deck and follow branching expeditions through four regions. In Sanctuary mode, card-based encounters focus on observing animals, building Understanding and managing Distance and Vigilance rather than lethal combat.

Between expeditions, players develop a visible refuge and regional habitats, record wildlife observations and expand a persistent card collection. Animal companions and regional knowledge provide bonuses for later outings. A separate Legacy mode is included in the same game.

title: Nyantum Jump
description: Walk, jump, and fall on a grid! Nyantum Jump brings Sokoban and puzzle platforming together. Your cat waits for your next move—even in midair! Push boxes into stepping stones, discover new abilities and hidden tricks, and explore places you couldn't reach before.

title: Wiltcards
description: Wiltcards is a standard turn based trading card game. Place cards on the board, give them equipment and use actions card in order to attack your opponent. In the match itself, you might use your turn's gold to buy a card from the mutual shop instead.

title: Snow Worries!
description: Santa crashed his sleigh into your garden and Christmas is buried under the snow. Call up to three friends and dig it all out: sell the snow, upgrade from bare cookie hands to absurd machines, and bury each other along the way. Cozy, chaotic co-op with proximity voice chat.

title: Beast Hunt
description: Hunt the Beast through deadly caves in this first-person survival horror game. Read the clues, map your route, and manage light, air, and sanity. Scavenge strange powers, evade giant spiders, and trust your deductions when it's time to take the shot.

title: Brainrotting
description: Brainrotting is a "scroller" desktop simulator about doomscrolling or solving minigames, getting upgrades and eventually automating your dopamine generation.

title: King Dies Rich
description: Defend your throne against undead hordes in a pixel-art siege roguelite. Aim your attacks without leaving your seat, hunt legendary gear, and combine seven schools of power. Turn your spoils into permanent kingdom upgrades. The king will not survive the siege. His gold will.

title: The Last Brazilian
description: Dark fantasy, folklore and Brazilian satire collide in precision combat. Turn the Journey Cube, choose one of five fighters and cross three acts of shifting routes through a fantastical Brazil. Face regional stages, short challenges, events, bosses and Colossi in a 2D action-platformer driven by precision, risk and style.

title: Beloved, Below
description: A story of unconditional love and sacrifice told in between puzzles and combat, where each player navigates either the spirit world or the physical world as you escape through elemental realms.

title: Only Booze: Liquor Store Simulator
description: Only Booze: Liquor Store Simulator is a first-person store management simulator about an alcoholic who opens a liquor store. Players stock shelves, manage supply, set prices, hire staff and expand the store in a dynamic market where prices change daily and trends shift overnight. Holidays, festivals, inspections and market rumors change demand, and the store's reputation on social media affects customer traffic, premium buyers, events and police inspections. Players can run a legal business or break rules such as skipping ID checks for bigger profits at the risk of an inspection, and can drink their own stock, which affects their judgment, reputation and performance.

title: Sad Virus Tokyo
description: Player controls sad Virus character in this 3rd person walking simulation and platformer game. Sad virus is now at Tokyo named city where Sad virus mission is to find 9 beer bottles hidden in different places. Avoid traps like moving spikes and balls. Use checkpoint system and jumping platforms to find all beer bottles in this 3rd person walking adventure game

title: Crumple Toss
description:
A very difficult game of precise throws, dozens of misses, and world records.
The goal is simple: land the shot in the bin. But every level will make you miss again and again.
The timer is already running. Beat the level faster than anyone else and set a world record.
Build your own level, beat it twice, and challenge everyone else.

title: Terra Machina
description: Dig to build your factory. Build your factory to dig even more. TerraMachina is a 2D mining and factory sandbox where every new discovery fuels bigger machines, stronger equipment, and your next expedition.

title: Masterpiece Malpractice
description: Ruin art. Precisely. Inflate, twist and smudge famous paintings to match their distorted doubles. A playful visual puzzle with 70 art challenges, 13 distortion tools and three stars to chase on every canvas.

title: BetWin
description: This is a local two-player split-screen fighting game. The background of the game is set in a floating villa. The two protagonists need to fight against each other to win the final victory.

title: Rubber Duck Frontier
description: Rubber Duck Frontier is a creature-collecting adventure set on the Pearlwater Isles. Players catch wild rubber ducks by drawing a bubble ring at the right moment, build a team and fight turn-based battles, including stadium team battles and a boss raid. Players can record their own voice for each duck they own. The game includes minigames such as voice-controlled parkour, duck bowling and a duck pond, and supports hosting or joining other players over a local network or the internet. A stream mode lets TikTok LIVE and Twitch viewers trigger in-game events through local webhook URLs compatible with tools such as TikFinity.

title: Dog Licking Simulator
description: "Dog Licking Simulator" is a relaxing and casual love-making game. Players need to interact with their goddess in the game, and often give the goddess various cosmetics, luxury goods, takeaways, milk tea etc. to increase their feelings with the goddess.

title: Arcade Warlord
description: A business strategy game set in the 80s arcade boom, where your company exists on the map. Develop hit games, deploy specialist Agents, move cabinets and cash across the city, and compete for strategic locations while managing the logistics of expansion.

title: 007: From Russia with Love - XBE Recomp
description: An unofficial native PC port of the original Xbox version of 007: From Russia with Love, with extended graphics options, keyboard and mouse support, and other enhancements.

title: Recycle Rivals
description: A multiplayer junkyard game for 1 to 4 players, as a team or as rivals. Smash junk with a sledgehammer, sort it, bale it and sell it in town. Invent machines and vehicles, build a line that runs itself, and turn a pile of scrap into a machine empire

title: My Owner's Graveyard
description:
Follow a young vampire named Olleander Van Nosferacula IV, as they revisit their family graveyard and the final resting place of all the pets they have outlived.

Guided by their new familiar, Bela, Ollie is tasked to restore and clean the gravestones and reminisce on the memories their owners had left behind.

Only once the graves have been cleaned can the spirits truly rest--better get to work!

title: Psychoscope
description: Psychoscope is a short horror game (play time only a few minutes) about using an experimental device that lets you see the last moments of someone before they died.

title: Carry On Together
description: Carry On Together is a physics-based online co-op moving game for up to 4 players. Run a tiny delivery company with your friends: lift heavy furniture together, drive the truck across town and deliver everything in one piece… or don’t. Can you keep the company alive?

title: Hockey Legacy Manager 27
description: A full hockey season simulated in under a minute. Draft, trade, scout and build a dynasty across decades, from junior and college hockey to the professionals, starting anywhere from 1917 to the present day. Manage your own hockey team in a general manager simulation available on PC and mobile.

title: Alignment: An Engineering Odyssey
description: Route a road through real mountain terrain, build it with curves, earthworks, bridges and tunnels, then drive it to test the design.

title: Punch Through
description: Punch your way through prison walls in a satisfying first-person incremental destruction game! Smash concrete, collect resources, earn money, and upgrade your strength, tools, and abilities. Break tougher walls, unlock powerful upgrades, and fight your way toward freedom!

title: Gemloop
description: GemLoop is a Match-3 incremental game featuring continuous progression through earning money and unlocking skills in an extensive skill tree.

title: Television Dynasty Manager
description: Take over your own station at the dawn of television and turn it into America’s greatest TV dynasty. Produce your own series, shows and films, secure the best programs, build studios, expand your broadcast area and plan the perfect schedule. But the competition never sleeps.

title: Crash of the Titans: Definitive Edition
description: A native Windows port of Crash of the Titans (Xbox 360), made by statically recompiling the game's PowerPC code to x86-64 with XenonRecomp.

title: The Trivia Show
description: Chaotic multiplayer for up to 8 friends, trapped in a TV show. Think fast, dodge traps and turn the tables. A question hits the screen, the clock runs, and every wrong answer sets off the room: exploding platforms, ankle bombs, axe-wielding gnomes, revolvers on the table and much more.

title: Sonic Like-A-Wind
description: After receiving a calling of help , Sonic and his friends takes a journey to the Silverwind Island to investigate who asked for help and what is causing the problem

title: Sputnitsa Dress Up 2
description: Create a Sputnitsa with a fresh look to your liking!

title: A Northern Evil: Tape One
description: A short atmospheric horror experience set in the remote north of Sweden. Explore an abandoned village where something is deeply wrong, uncover strange clues, and face a lurking evil hidden beneath the quiet surface.

title: SCP: Project Pneuma
description: A first-person psychological horror game set in the ruins of SCP Foundation Site-63. Sneak past anomalies you cannot fight, scavenge scarce supplies, and piece together what Project Echelon released - because whatever is hunting you knows exactly where you're going.

title: Network Engineer
description: Build a server empire from a rural farm. Place buildings and generators, rack routers and servers, cable real networks, power everything correctly, then sign clients and keep them online as you grow from a shed into a serious hosting business.

title: Courage and Faith: Into the Dark Woods
description: A dark, atmospheric party-based RPG where you form an expedition, make difficult choices, manage tension, and fight tactical turn-based battles. AI-generated narration reacts to your decisions, making each journey into the forest feel distinct.

title: What the Cluck
description: Fire eggs. Eggs explode. You go up. That's the whole plan. A Foddian precision platformer about a hen and their stolen golden egg.

title: Anomaly Core: Hospital
description: You are a patient. You should avoid treatment at the old hospital. The crazy doctor's strange methods raise doubts. The treatment may not go as you imagine.

title: The Galactic Pac-Man Brothers
description:
Johnny and Louie return to fight a new evil...

Serving as a sequel to the Pac-Man Brothers, The Galactic Pac-Man Brothers is a hybrid between Pac-Man and Galaga. Collect dots and avoid ghosts on the ground, and then take to the skies and shoot down all bugs in sight!

title: Angelfall
description: Face the endless armies of Light and become the nightmare they fear! Angelfall is a roguelike reverse-horror game, in which you play as powerful Archdemon, slaughter hordes of humans, harvest their souls, and discover devastating synergies. Grow stronger, unlock new powers, and conquer the Light.

title: Apiary in Flow
description: Apiary in Flow is an incremental game with automation elements where you place bees inside a hive to build efficient honey-gathering chains. Unlock new bee types and spend your harvest on permanent skill tree upgrades!

title: Medieval Shepherd
description: Experience life as a medieval shepherd. Herd your flock with loyal dogs, protect them from wolves, and expand your farm. Master survival through crafting, develop your economy, and upgrade your homestead in this immersive pastoral simulation.

title: The Last Guardian
description: In a strange and mystical land, a young boy discovers a mysterious creature with which he forms a deep, unbreakable bond. The unlikely pair must rely on each other to journey through towering, treacherous ruins filled with unknown dangers. Experience the journey of a lifetime in this touching, emotional story of friendship and trust.

title: Dark Cloud
description: One of the PS2's first RPGs, Dark Cloud is a title that challenges players to not only strategise, battle and solve puzzles, but also to create geographical landscapes using the new Georama system. Gamers assume the role of a young boy named Toran on an unforgettable journey of rebirth, revival and hope. Unfortunately an evil demon spirit has been released and has left destruction in its wake and Toran must harness the spirit of those destroyed to rebuild the lands in time for an epic confrontation. True to life graphics should mesmerise gamers as they create villages complete with houses, hills, churches, volcanoes, and streams; they'll even be able to control the weather!

title: Dark Cloud 2
description:
BUILD your world. INVENT your weapons. CREATE your adventure.

Discover a secret binding the past, present and future. A secret where an innocent inventor, a temporal warrior and an ageless evil hold the key.

Experience an epic action/RPG adventure that relies on your innovation as much as exploration and fighting reflexes.

title: Tekken X Street Fighter
description:
A crossover game that is planned to have Street Fighter characters in the 3D fighting style of a normal Tekken game.
The reverse of Street Fighter x Tekken which put Tekken characters into the 2D fighting style of a Street Fighter game in 2012.

The game has been stuck in development since its 2010 announcement and the game was put on hold officially in 2016, though early character models and some gameplay systems were said to be finished at the time.

title: Kengo 2: Sword of the Samurai
description:
The second game in the Kengo series was released for the PlayStation 2 in Japan on June 27, 2002. It was released in Europe on February 14, 2003 under the title Sword of the Samurai. It features a character creation feature and over 100 detailed swords to choose from. Published by Ubisoft.

Ubisoft announced a US release to be called Kengo: Legacy of the Blade at one point but the deal ended up falling through, thus it was never released.

title: Jak and Daxter: The Precursor Legacy
description: A port of Jak and Daxter: The Precursor Legacy, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

title: Jak II
description: Jak II is an open-world platform, third-person shooter, and an action-adventure video game. It is the second game of the Jak and Daxter series and a sequel to Jak and Daxter: The Precursor Legacy.

title: Jak 3
description: Jak 3 is a platform game developed by Naughty Dog for Sony's PlayStation 2 console. The game is the sequel to Jak II, and third in the series. The game features new weapons and devices, new playable areas, and a storyline that picks up after the events of the previous games. As in the other games in the series, the player takes on the dual role of recurring protagonists Jak and Daxter.

title: Jak X: Combat Racing
description:
After saving Haven City once again, Jak and Daxter find themselves poisoned forced into competition on the international car-racing circuit by the execution of Krew's will.

Featuring over a dozen customizable vehicles designed with unique handling characteristics, players will race their whip through 20 tracks in eight different terrain arenas. With an assortment of power-ups available, including projectile weapons, mines, ranged weapons, turbo boosts, shields, and smart bombs, players should have the means necessary to ensure they're the first to cross the finish line.

The game supports both offline and online multiplayer. Offline multiplayer is the typical two-player split-screen multiplayer. Online multiplayer is playable with up to five other players. Both modes feature the same game types, which are the same as the single player except that human players are replacing the AI.

title: Wipeout 2048
description: The single player campaign progresses through the first three years of the A.G.R.C. (Anti-Gravity Racing Championships): 2048, 2049, and 2050. All events have pass and elite pass targets. Unless the elite pass criteria is met unknowingly, it will only be displayed after a player passes an event. If the player fails to complete an event multiple times in a row, the event can be skipped. Skipping an event will allow the player to move on to the next available event; a player can return to a skipped event at any time in order to try it again.

title: Wild Arms 3
description: Wild Arms 3 (titled Wild Arms Advanced 3rd in Japan) boasts major technological improvements and a number of new gameplay elements. Featuring "stroke-shaded" animation-style graphics, a "Wild West" setting, and a completely 3D game engine (not just for battles, as in the previous games).

title: Dragon Quest II: Luminaries of the Legendary Line
description: This game allows the player to control more than one character, and it is the first one in the Dragon Quest series to do so. The player controls his or her characters as they move in the game world. They can search treasure chests, talk and trade with villagers, equip weapons and armor, and cast spells.

title: Dragon Quest III: The Seeds of Salvation
description:
Dragon Quest III is noted for greatly expanding upon the original Dragon Warrior and Dragon Warrior II. The game uses basic console role-playing game conventions, such as leveling up by gaining experience points and equipping items. Battle is turn-based like the other games in the series.
Dragon Warrior III features a class system, in which each character has a certain class. While the Hero always keeps the Hero class, the other characters can choose among the following: Soldier (Warrior in the GBC version), Fighter, Pilgrim (Cleric), Wizard (Mage), Merchant (Dealer), Goof-Off (Jester), Sage, and Thief which was available only in the later versions. The choice of class greatly affects the character's stats and spells he or she can learn. Furthermore, upon reaching experience Level 20, a character has the option of changing classes at the temple of Dhama, found halfway through the game. The game starts with just the Hero in the party, who then is able to recruit a party of three at the local tavern. Unlike most Dragon Quest parties, aside from the Hero, the party is not made up of characters involved in the story. Although only four characters can be in the party at a time, extra members of the party can be kept at the tavern, allowing room for new recruits. Another innovation is an arena where the player can place bets on the outcome of monster battles.
The remakes incorporated some interface changes from later games in the series, such as simplified door opening; the bag, which replaced bank item storage; the item sorting "Tidy Item" and "Tidy Bag" commands; and the "Full HP" command, which can be used outside of combat to automate the process of casting healing and status restoring spells.
While the earlier Dragon Quest games were also non-linear, Dragon Quest III was the most substantial example of open-world gameplay among the early Dragon Quest games. It also allowed the player to swap characters in and out of the party at will, and another "major innovation was the introduction of day/night cycles; certain items, characters, and quests are only accessible at certain times of day."

title: Killzone: Shadow Fall
description: Killzone Shadow Fall is the sixth game of the Killzone series. Gameplay in Shadow Fall is fairly similar to previous installments, though now with more improvements. The game is much more open-ended allowing for multiple ways to reach your target and complete objectives. The player is accompanied by a companion drone called the OWL which can help you in many different ways including deploying a zip-line or stunning the enemy. Using futuristic weapons and gear allows for new stealth gameplay. The online multiplayer mode allows for up to 24-players to battle at once on any of the games default 10 maps. The level system is now challenge-based where completing any of the games many challenges will upgrade your rank. Warzone returns as an online game mode along with Team Deathmatch and Beacon Retrieval (Capture the Flag). A new feature allows for the user to create Warzones with their own specific rules and share them with the community to download and play.

title: Driveclub
description: DRIVECLUB brings to life the heart and soul of car culture. An incredible, authentic and immersive PS4 driving experience, DRIVECLUB makes you feel the exhilaration of driving the most powerful and beautifully designed cars in the world; all rendered in staggering detail, inside and out as you race them in richly detailed real-world locations alongside your Club.

title: Infamous: Second Son
description: Infamous: Second Son, a PlayStation 4 exclusive , brings you an action adventure game where surrounded by a society that fears them, superhumans are ruthlessly hunted down and caged by the Department of Unified Protection. Step into a locked-down Seattle as Delsin Rowe, who has recently discovered his superhuman power and is now capable of fighting back against the oppressive DUP. Enjoy your power as you choose how you will push your awesome abilities to the limit and witness the consequences of your actions as they affect the city and people around you.

title: Red Dead Revolver
description:
Red Dead Revolver is a 2004 action-adventure game developed by Rockstar San Diego and published by Rockstar Games. It is the first entry in the Red Dead series and was released for the PlayStation 2 and Xbox in May 2004.

Set in the 1880s, during the American frontier, the single-player story follows bounty hunter Red Harlow's quest for revenge after the murder of his parents.

A local multiplayer mode allows up to four players to face off against each other or AI-controlled bots in free-for-all battles.

title: MLB The Show 16
description: Baseball games don't get much better than this. MLB The Show 16 continues Sony's acclaimed slugger series in triumphant fashion, where every strikeout feels like a monumental feat, and a grand slam is just as glorious as in the real world. It's all about the details here: your pitcher's fatigue is tracked and actually factors into their throws, your team's morale will affect your performance during a season, and scouting new players is an impressively multifaceted process (while still being accessible).

title: Destroy All Humans! 2
description:
Assume the role of the human-hating alien Crypto once again, in the sci-fi action-adventure spoof, bound to enslave mankind.

Take revenge on humanity for destroying your mothership. “Make War, not Love” and take on new enemies such as secret agents, giant creatures, Soviet Forces and even ninja warriors in an expanded open-world.

title: The Order: 1886
description: The Order: 1886 introduces players to a unique vision of Victorian-Era London where Man uses advanced technology to battle a powerful and ancient foe. As a member of an elite order of knights, join a centuries-old war that will determine the course of history forever.

title: War of the Monsters
description:
Experience War of the Monsters originally released on the PlayStation2 console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

Stare in disbelief! Scream in Horror! Run for your life!

100-foot tall monsters have stormed the world, causing panic and despair! Engage in a savage battle, these behemoths won’t let anything stand in their way. Which one will win this War of the Monsters?

title: Just Dance 2014
description:
Just Dance 2014 is a dance rhythm game that has you match the choreography of an on-screen dancer to earn points for accuracy, using your motion controller for real-time movement tracking. Beyond single-player routines, it expands the experience with online multiplayer via World Dance Floor, where you compete simultaneously with others, plus Wii U and Xbox-style second-screen support that helps you manage routines, playlists, and performance from a companion device.
The update also adds spotlight-friendly On Stage modes, letting one player lead with others as backup dancers, along with AutoDance to record and share your gameplay and Karaoke for singing along to on-screen lyrics. For variety and fitness, it supports customized workout playlists, calorie tracking across modes, and more dances per track through alternate choreographies in categories like Just Sweat, Extreme, Battle, and Mash-Up.

title: Harvest Moon: Save the Homeland
description: The first Harvest Moon game for the PS2 takes a little deviance from all the other games in the series. The goal this time around is to save your town from being turned into a resort next year. The game focuses more on relationships than making money - which is the goal in all other Harvest Moon games to date. You still are running a farm and must succeed in the life of a farmer, but the actual gameplay rewards those who interact with the townspeople over those who just work the fields.

title: Peggle 2
description: Peggle 2 is a puzzle video game where you shoot balls at orange and blue pegs in order to finish the level. You have to hit all the orange pegs in order to complete the level, and you can shoot the blue pegs to get more points. You can hit green pegs which give you a special ability which will help you clear more pegs faster and easier. There a multiple different funny characters you can play as, and each character has a special unique ability.

title: Brunswick Pro Bowling
description: Work your way from an amateur to a true professional Brunswick Pro Champion. Featuring real-time changing lane conditions for the player to master during the course of a match, authentic Brunswick bowling products to improve your character's performance, and ten different environments to choose from.

title: EA Sports UFC
description: Electronic Arts teams with Ultimate Fighting Championship to bring the ferocity of mixed-martial arts to players everywhere. Developed by the team behind the critically-acclaimed Fight Night franchise, and powered by EA Sports Ignite technology, EA Sports UFC brings the action, emotion and intensity inside the Octagon to life in ways that were never before possible. The next-generation of True Player Motion not only showcases the diverse, powerful and fluid of attacks of elite mixed martial artists through Precision Movement, Dynamic Striking and Strategic Submission Battles, but also brings the combatants to life with a Full Body Deformer and Real-Time Exertion. The simulation of Human Intelligence takes leaps forward with the strategic and adaptive MMAi system and is expressed through the most realistic characters ever created in a sports game.

title: Metal Slug Anthology
description: A compilation of the successful side-scrolling arcade games as a result of the series 10th anniversary. A upgraded PS4 version with trophy support and 1080p visuals was launched July 5th 2016 as part of the PS2-PS4 program.

title: Rainbow Moon
description:
Embark on an epic adventure that leads you through a beautiful, isometric, open world with detailed high-definition visuals. Rainbow Moon is a strategy RPG with a strong emphasis on exploration, character development and turn-based battles. Six playable main characters with upgradeable weapons, armor and accessories; about 100 special skills and more than 20 challenging dungeons are awaiting you in a fascinating story that lasts over 40 hours.

Rainbow Moon is a game by gamers, dedicated to gamers.

title: Sengoku Basara 2
description: A new PlayStation 3 and PlayStation 4 entry into the longrunning Sengoku Basara series which follows the life of Sanada Yukimura

title: Skylanders: Swap Force
description:
Skylanders: Swap Force is a platformer video game developed by Vicarious Visions and published by Activision. It is the third main game in the Skylanders video game and toy franchise, following 2012's Skylanders: Giants, which was a direct sequel to 2011's Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure (the spin-off of The Legend of Spyro series). It is the game before Skylanders: Trap Team and features the voices of John DiMaggio, Jess Harnell, Audrey Wasilewski, Richard Tatum, David Sobolov, Josh Keaton, Keythe Farley, Dave Wittenberg, Joey Camen, Gregg Berger, Troy Baker and Robin Atkin Downes.

It is the first Skylanders game to be released in North America before other regions, unlike the previous two games where Australia got the installments first. It is also the first Skylanders game not to be owned by Vivendi.

title: We Sing
description: The karaoke franchise comes to PS4 and Xbox One.

title: We Sing Pop!
description:
We Sing Pop! a brand new addition to the We Sing range of games for Wii it will feature 40 of the greatest pop tracks around.

We Sing Pop! will be available in Europe and the US on Wii and will feature some of the most well-known pop hits covering four poptastic decades. The look and feel of the game will also replicate a real 'pop' vibe.

title: NBA Live 14
description: Powered by EA SPORTS IGNITE, NBA LIVE 14 delivers the ultimate on court control combining the art of basketball with the science of next generation technology. bounceTek, fueled by next-gen visual fidelity and up to 8x the processing power, unlocks a revolutionary new, physics-based dribbling system. Players perform more like their real-life counterparts than ever before, informed by 70+ stats and tendencies, updated not monthly, weekly or daily, but within 1-hr of every NBA game. With fresh content and challenges on a daily basis, NBA LIVE 14 delivers the pulse of the NBA...24/7/365.

title: Twisted Metal: Black
description: Twisted Metal: Black is a vehicle combat video game developed by Incognito Entertainment (formerly Incog Inc.) and published by Sony Computer Entertainment America for the PlayStation 2 video game console. It is the fifth installment to the Twisted Metal series and was released June 18, 2001. An online enabled multiplayer-only variant, Twisted Metal: Black Online, was released later as a free update.

title: Awesomenauts Assemble!
description:
Awesomenauts Assemble! is a conversion of the PC 2D multiplayer online battle arena game Awesomenauts for the PS4/Xbox One.

Awesomenauts is a MOBA fitted into the form of an accessible 3-on-3 action platformer. Head out to the online battlefields together with your friends as an online party or in local split screen, and never worry about having to wait for an online match because of drop-in matchmaking!

Devise strategies as you upgrade and customize each character's skills to suit your playing style.

title: Resogun
description:
Resogun is a shoot 'em up game. Unleash an explosive array of devastating weapons to obliterate hordes of ruthless enemies while making sure you rescue the last survivors and keep your multiplier going!
Push yourself to the limits trying to climb the global leaderboards for each game mode and difficulty setting. Join forces with your friends online and show off your skills in action packed co-op multiplayer.

title: Zen Pinball 2
description:
Zen Pinball 2 launched on PlayStation 4 as a free platform download with a total of 20 tables available as paid DLC. Users can purchase tables inside the Zen Pinball 2 platform, including the following tables and packs at launch:

• Star Wars Pinball
• Star Wars Pinball: Balance of the Force
• Marvel Pinball
• Marvel Pinball:Avengers Chronicles
• Plants vs. Zombies Pinball
• Epic Quest
• Paranormal
• Earth Defense

Zen Studios has HUGE plans for pinball in 2014, including more Star Wars Pinball and
Marvel Pinball tables, as well as tables based on more iconic and exciting brands.

title: The Warriors
description: Based on the 1979 movie of the same name. A battle on the New York streets. The armies of the night number 60,000 strong, and tonight they're all after The Warriors - a street gang wrongly accused of killing a rival gang leader.

title: The Last of Us Remastered
description: The Last of Us Remastered is an updated release of the PS3 game The Last of Us. It is identical to the PS3 version but runs at a 1080p resolution and incorporates character models with a higher resolution. There are also improved shadows and lighting, upgraded textures, 60 frames per second and other types of improvements. In addition to the base game, two map packs and the expansion The Last of Us: Left Behind are included.

title: Ape Escape 2
description:
Ape Escape 2 is the sequel to Ape Escape. In this platform game it's your goal to catch all the apes jumping, walking and flying around the diverse levels the game has to offer.

A large arsenal of gadgets can be used to make it all a little easier, with the catching net being the most important weapons of them all. Other gadgets include a RC Car, to drive over monkey's and collect objects, an Ape Radar, to detect the nearest monkey, a baseball bat, to hit monkeys unconscious, and a magnet, to move certain objects in the maps.

Your quest is to catch all monkeys in the levels and to stop the evil Specter from taking over the world. All monkeys in the levels are somewhat unique with their own character abilities and their unique name. Some monkeys just sit on their place, while others attack you with projectiles or run away quickly.

title: PaRappa the Rapper 2
description:
THE ORIGINAL RAP STAR'S BACK IN THE HOUSE!

See if you have enough rhythm to keep the beat with everyone's favorite rappin' puppy. Parappa the Rapper returns with all new levels and songs to keep your head bobbin' & PlayStation 2 bumpin'.

title: Star Wars: Jedi Starfighter
description:
The game features two immediately playable craft: Nym's starfighter, "The Havoc", which features heavy armament as a bomber, and Adi's fighter, which features force powers such as lightning and force shield.

There are also nine unlockable craft which can be played on any mission: the X-wing, Tie fighter, Reti's advanced Zoomer, Adi's advanced Jedi starfighter, Saboath fighter, Jenkin's advanced Freefall, Nym's advanced Havoc, a Republic gunship, and Jango Fett's Slave I. In addition, with the code "headhunt," the Z-95 headhunter can be unlocked.

title: Gem Smashers
description:
Gem Smashers is a puzzle game with eight worlds and over 100 levels.

Help the three heroic creatures who escaped capture during the invasion of the Earth to rescue their friends. Travel the world springing, spinning, and smashing the crystal cells where their friends are imprisoned. Save the Earth from the evil IMBU and put your skills to the test with Gem Smashers.

title: Art of Balance
description:
Grab your controller and build a balanced stack in this physics-based puzzler!

The goal sounds simple at first: Build a balanced stack from all given shapes, but there are plenty of challenges. Some shapes break under load, while others can even reverse gravity and literally turn the stack upside down. With practice, some experimentation and a little bit of luck however you'll quickly master even the most difficult challenges.

Packed with 5 unique game modes, online play and local split-screen, Art of Balance is the ultimate test for aspiring puzzle masters. On supported platforms, three additional players can join in at any time and help you solve the puzzles.

With a relaxing lounge soundtrack and 8 beautiful environments, Art of Balance is the ideal fit for casual gaming sessions alone or with friends.

title: Rygar
description: An evil being known as Ligar is about to conquer the land of Argool. Such is his power that no living creature dares to cross paths with him. But the legendary warrior Rygar rises from his grave to restore peace and justice. Armed with his famed weapon Diskarmor, Rygar begins to traverse the vast lands that lead to the lair of the demon, as his minions are trying in vain to stop him...

title: Cyber Troopers Virtual-On Force
description:
Cyber Troopers Virtual-On Force is a 3D mecha fighting game developed by Sega AM3 (formerly Hitmaker) and published by Sega. It was released in Japanese arcades only on the Sega Hikaru arcade system board in 2001. Following its initial release, there was initially no home console port of the game due to the Hikaru's superior graphical capabilities.

A region free home port of the game was released for Xbox 360 on December 22, 2010. The Xbox 360 version retains the same gameplay as the original series, only with a few inclusions: 2 on 2 Leader Battles, co-op boss fight mode, a Mission mode and Xbox Live support for online play. Battles have local 2 player splitscreen or up to 4 player over System Link. The game also has a special Collector's edition which includes a booklet called Virtual On Chronicle 15, that looks back at 15 years of Virtual-On, and a six disc soundtrack called Virtual On Official Sound Data. All of the items come packaged in a box with artwork from Hajime Katoki. Jaguarandi is now available as a hidden character, along with Apharmd the Hatter based on Apharmd J. However, Ajim, which was a playable character in Oratorio Tangram, is not playable in this Force version. The split-screen gameplay, which was absent from Xbox Live Arcade version of Oratorio Tangram, makes a return in this version. Preordering of the games allows access and download a special "Thorax" item that adjusts the bust sizes of both female Virtualoids: Fei-Yen and Angelan.

title: Samurai Warriors 4
description: Samurai Warriors 4 is a hack and slash game, and sequel to Samurai Warriors 3. The game was made to celebrate the tenth anniversary of the series. The game features a character-switching feature, similar to the spin-off, Samurai Warriors: Chronicles, with which players can take two characters into battles simultaneously, and freely switch between the two. Two new moves, "Hyper Attacks" and "Rage Mode" are featured in this game: Hyper Attacks is a secondary moveset available to all characters that allows the player to sweep through and clear out crowd of enemies with a dashing animation, although it is useless against enemy officers, as they will either deflect it or are otherwise immune against it. Rage Mode renders the player invincible for a period of time, and also enhances the player's attacks as well as empowering their Musou attack by using the Spirit Gauge.

title: NHL 15
description:
12 PLAYER NHL COLLISION PHYSICS
For the first time in any sports game, real-world physics affects every player through every on-ice collision with the new 12 Player NHL Collision Physics. Utilizing the power of the next generation consoles, and building off the critically-acclaimed NHL Collision Physics system, every player on the ice is governed by physics at all times. Feel the hard-hitting chaos of NHL hockey through true-to-life secondary collisions, net scrambles and player pileups, capturing the desperation of every shift.

REAL PUCK PHYSICS
The puck is one of the most complex items in the game to authentically replicate and it finally gets its due in NHL 15. Completely rebuilt puck physics result in a more realistic feel to every puck interaction.
